# File Summary

## Purpose
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A header with the file path (## File: path/to/file)
  b. The full contents of the file in a code block

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

## Notes
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: vendor/**, node_modules/**, public/**, storage/**, bootstrap/cache/**, database/migrations/**, database/factories/**, tests/**, .git/**, *.lock, package-lock.json, composer.lock, repomix*.xml
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

```javascript
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';

export function useDynamicFooterHeight(targetRef, options = {}) {
    const {
        cssVarName = '--app-footer-height',
        fallbackHeight = 96,
        extraOffset = 16,
        includeBottomMargin = true
    } = options;

    const footerHeight = ref(fallbackHeight);
    let observer = null;
    let currentObservedEl = null;

    const resolveElement = (target) => {
        if (!target) return null;
        const el = target.$el !== undefined ? target.$el : target;

        // 🛡️ Blindagem estrita: só aceita Elementos HTML reais (nodeType 1)
        // Ignora comentários DOM (<!---->), fragmentos ou nós de texto
        if (el && el.nodeType === 1 && typeof el.getBoundingClientRect === 'function') {
            return el;
        }
        return null;
    };

    const updateHeight = (el) => {
        if (!el || el.nodeType !== 1 || typeof el.getBoundingClientRect !== 'function' || !el.isConnected) return;

        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        let totalSpan = rect.height;

        if (includeBottomMargin) {
            const distanceFromBottom = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - rect.bottom);
            totalSpan += distanceFromBottom;
        }

        const calculatedHeight = Math.ceil(totalSpan) + extraOffset;

        if (calculatedHeight > 0 && calculatedHeight !== footerHeight.value) {
            footerHeight.value = calculatedHeight;
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty(cssVarName, `${calculatedHeight}px`);
        }
    };

    const handleResize = () => {
        if (currentObservedEl) {
            updateHeight(currentObservedEl);
        }
    };

    const setupObserver = (newEl) => {
        if (observer) {
            observer.disconnect();
            observer = null;
        }
        currentObservedEl = null;

        const el = resolveElement(newEl);
        if (!el) {
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty(cssVarName, '0px');
            footerHeight.value = 0;
            return;
        }

        currentObservedEl = el;
        updateHeight(el);

        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            observer = new ResizeObserver(() => updateHeight(el));
            observer.observe(el);
        }
    };

    watch(
        () => resolveElement(targetRef?.value),
        (newEl) => {
            setupObserver(newEl);
        },
        { immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
    );

    onMounted(() => {
        window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize, { passive: true });
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        if (observer) {
            observer.disconnect();
            observer = null;
        }
        window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(cssVarName);
    });

    return {
        footerHeight
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';

export function usePosIdleTimer({ timeout = 60000, onIdle, isEnabled = () => true }) {
    let timer = null;
    let lastActivity = Date.now();

    const resetTimer = () => {
        // Throttling: ignora chamadas repetidas em menos de 1 segundo
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastActivity < 1000) return;
        lastActivity = now;

        if (timer) {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = null;
        }

        if (isEnabled()) {
            timer = setTimeout(() => {
                if (isEnabled()) {
                    onIdle();
                }
            }, timeout);
        }
    };

    const stopTimer = () => {
        if (timer) {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = null;
        }
    };

    const handleUserActivity = () => {
        resetTimer();
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        const events = ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll'];
        events.forEach(evt => window.addEventListener(evt, handleUserActivity, { passive: true }));
        resetTimer();
    });

    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        stopTimer();
        const events = ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll'];
        events.forEach(evt => window.removeEventListener(evt, handleUserActivity));
    });

    return {
        resetTimer,
        stopTimer
    };
}
```

```vue
const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    order: { type: Object, default: () => null }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'payment-success']);

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (v) => emit('update:visible', v)
});

const isLoading = ref(false);
const isPaidSuccess = ref(false);
const qrCodeString = ref('');
const pixAmount = ref(0);
const errorMessage = ref('');
const copied = ref(false);
const timeLeft = ref(600);
let timer = null;

const formattedTime = computed(() => {
    const m = Math.floor(timeLeft.value / 60);
    const s = timeLeft.value % 60;
    return `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
});

const startCountdown = () => {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timeLeft.value = 600;
    timer = setInterval(() => {
        if (timeLeft.value > 0) timeLeft.value--;
        else clearInterval(timer);
    }, 1000);
};

const generatePix = async () => {
    if (!props.order?.id) return;
    isLoading.value = true;
    errorMessage.value = '';
    qrCodeString.value = '';
    isPaidSuccess.value = false;

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('operations.orders.generate-pix', props.order.id));
        if (response.data.success) {
            qrCodeString.value = response.data.qr_code;
            pixAmount.value = response.data.amount;
            startCountdown();
        } else {
            errorMessage.value = response.data.message || 'Erro ao gerar PIX.';
        }
    } catch (e) {
        errorMessage.value = e.response?.data?.message || 'Falha ao comunicar com o servidor.';
    } finally {
        isLoading.value = false;
    }
};

const copyCode = async () => {
    if (!qrCodeString.value) return;
    try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(qrCodeString.value);
        copied.value = true;
        setTimeout(() => { copied.value = false; }, 3000);
    } catch (e) {}
};

// 📡 Reconhecimento em Tempo Real via Reverb
const handleOrderUpdated = (incoming) => {
    const o = incoming.order || incoming;
    if (Number(o.id) === Number(props.order?.id) && o.payment_status === 'paid') {
        isPaidSuccess.value = true;
        clearInterval(timer);
        if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([100, 50, 100]);
        emit('payment-success', o);
        setTimeout(() => {
            isVisible.value = false;
        }, 2200);
    }
};

watch(isVisible, (val) => {
    if (val && props.order) {
        generatePix();
        const echo = useTenantEcho();
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.order.updated', handleOrderUpdated);
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.OrderUpdated', handleOrderUpdated);
    } else {
        clearInterval(timer);
        qrCodeString.value = '';
        isPaidSuccess.value = false;
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    clearInterval(timer);
});

const formatCurrency = (v) => Number(v || 0).toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { abbreviateName } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    order: {
        type: Object,
        required: true
    }
});

defineEmits(['charge-pix']);

const page = usePage();
const isExpanded = ref(false);

const customerName = computed(() => {
    return props.order.customer_name || props.order.customer?.name || 'Cliente';
});

// 4) Bairro
const neighborhood = computed(() => {
    return props.order.neighborhood ||
        props.order.address?.neighborhood ||
        props.order.address_snapshot?.neighborhood ||
        '';
});

// 6) Verificação se o item pertence à cozinha do tipo 'bar'
const isItemFromBar = (item) => {
    const kitchenType = item.kitchen?.type ||
        item.kitchen_type ||
        item.product?.kitchen?.type;

    return String(kitchenType || '').toLowerCase() === 'bar';
};

const hasDrink = computed(() => {
    const items = props.order.items;
    if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) return false;
    return items.some(item => isItemFromBar(item));
});

// 3) Endereço Completo: Rua + Número + Complemento + Referência
const formattedAddress = computed(() => {
    const addr = props.order.address_snapshot || props.order.address;

    if (typeof addr === 'object' && addr !== null) {
        const street = addr.street || addr.street_name || '';
        const number = addr.number || 'S/N';
        const complement = addr.complement ? `, ${addr.complement}` : '';
        const reference = addr.reference ? ` (Ref: ${addr.reference})` : '';

        const main = `${street}, ${number}${complement}`.trim();
        const extra = reference.trim();

        return {
            main: main || 'Endereço cadastrado',
            extra: extra
        };
    }

    if (typeof props.order.address === 'string' && props.order.address.trim()) {
        return {
            main: props.order.address,
            extra: ''
        };
    }

    return {
        main: 'Endereço não informado',
        extra: ''
    };
});

// 5) Valor total devedor real gravado na tabela
const totalAmount = computed(() => {
    const o = props.order;
    if (!o) return 0;

    const alreadyPaid = Array.isArray(o.payments)
        ? o.payments.reduce((acc, p) => acc + Number(p.amount || 0), 0)
        : 0;

    const grandTotal = Number(o.total ?? o.balance_due ?? o.grand_total ?? o.total_amount ?? 0);
    return Math.max(0, grandTotal - alreadyPaid);
});

// 5) Nome da forma de pagamento e valor do troco
const paymentMethodDescription = computed(() => {
    const o = props.order;
    if (!o) return 'Dinheiro';

    const methods = o.payment_intent_methods;
    let label = '';

    if (Array.isArray(methods) && methods.length > 0) {
        label = methods
            .map(m => m.method_name || m.name || (typeof m === 'string' ? m : ''))
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join(', ');
    } else if (typeof methods === 'string') {
        label = methods;
    } else if (o.payment_method_name) {
        label = o.payment_method_name;
    }

    if (!label) {
        label = 'Dinheiro';
    }

    // Leitura do troco
    const rawTroco = o.change_target ?? (Array.isArray(methods) ? methods[0]?.change_target : null);
    const troco = Number(rawTroco || 0);

    if (troco > 0) {
        label += ` (Troco p/ R$ ${troco.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')})`;
    }

    return label;
});

// ⚡ Regra de Negócio: Libera cobrança PIX pelo Motoboy
const canChargePix = computed(() => {
    const settings = page.props.companySettings || {};
    return (
        Boolean(settings.sicredi_is_active) &&
        settings.sicredi_enable_driver_pix !== false &&
        props.order.payment_status !== 'paid' &&
        totalAmount.value > 0.01
    );
});

const formatCurrency = (val) => {
    return Number(val || 0).toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
};
</script>
```

```
 DownArrow ...................... ESC-j ... Retrieve next command line.
 TAB ...................................... Complete filename & cycle.
 SHIFT-TAB ...................... ESC-TAB   Complete filename & reverse cycle.
 ctrl-L ................................... Complete filename, list all.
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Models\Tenant;

class AuditModifiers extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'catalog:audit-modifiers {--tenant=}';
    protected $description = 'Auditoria investigativa de modificadores no banco de dados.';

    public function handle()
    {
        $tenantId = $this->option('tenant');
        if (!$tenantId) {
            $this->error('Por favor, informe o tenant. Ex: --tenant=nativa');
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $tenant = Tenant::find($tenantId);
        if (!$tenant) {
            $this->error('Tenant não encontrado.');
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
        $this->info("🕵️ Iniciando auditoria no tenant: {$tenantId}...");

        // 1. Amostra bruta de modificadores vendidos recentemente
        $this->warn("\n1. Últimos 5 order_item_modifiers vendidos (Dados puros):");
        dump(DB::table('order_item_modifiers')->orderByDesc('id')->limit(5)->get()->toArray());

        // 2. Tipos de grupos existentes no banco
        $this->warn("\n2. Tipos de modifier_groups existentes no cardápio:");
        dump(DB::table('modifier_groups')
            ->select('type', DB::raw('count(*) as total'))
            ->groupBy('type')
            ->get()
            ->toArray()
        );

        // 3. Teste do JOIN que fizemos (onde a informação evaporou)
        $this->warn("\n3. Cruzamento entre o item vendido e o grupo:");
        dump(
            DB::table('order_item_modifiers')
                ->leftJoin('modifier_groups', 'order_item_modifiers.modifier_group_id', '=', 'modifier_groups.id')
                ->select(
                    'order_item_modifiers.name',
                    'order_item_modifiers.modifier_option_id',
                    'order_item_modifiers.modifier_group_id',
                    'modifier_groups.type as group_type'
                )
                ->orderByDesc('order_item_modifiers.id')
                ->limit(5)
                ->get()
                ->toArray()
        );

        tenancy()->end();
        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Console/Commands/CacheTopCombinations.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use App\Models\Tenant;

class CacheTopCombinations extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'catalog:cache-top-combinations {--tenant=}';
    protected $description = 'Top 10: Ranking geral de produtos expandido nas top 3 variações de ingredientes.';

    public function handle()
    {
        $cutoffDate = Carbon::now()->subDays(30);
        $tenantId = $this->option('tenant');
        $tenants = $tenantId ? Tenant::where('id', $tenantId)->get() : Tenant::all();

        if ($tenants->isEmpty()) {
            $this->error("Nenhum tenant encontrado.");
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        foreach ($tenants as $tenant) {
            $this->info("\n==================================================");
            $this->info("🚀 PROCESSANDO RANKING INTELIGENTE: {$tenant->id}");
            $this->info("==================================================");

            tenancy()->initialize($tenant);

            try {
                // =========================================================================
                // 0. DICIONÁRIO DE OPÇÕES E GRUPOS DO TIPO 'INGREDIENT'
                // =========================================================================
                $v3Options = DB::table('modifier_options')
                    ->join('modifier_groups', 'modifier_options.modifier_group_id', '=', 'modifier_groups.id')
                    ->whereNull('modifier_options.deleted_at')
                    ->whereNull('modifier_groups.deleted_at')
                    ->select(
                        'modifier_options.id',
                        'modifier_options.name',
                        'modifier_groups.type as group_type'
                    )
                    ->get();

                $v3OptionsById = [];
                $v3OptionsByName = [];
                foreach ($v3Options as $opt) {
                    $v3OptionsById[$opt->id] = $opt;
                    $cleanName = mb_strtolower(trim($opt->name));
                    if (!isset($v3OptionsByName[$cleanName])) {
                        $v3OptionsByName[$cleanName] = $opt;
                    }
                }

                $productsWithIngredients = DB::table('modifier_group_product')
                    ->join('modifier_groups', 'modifier_group_product.modifier_group_id', '=', 'modifier_groups.id')
                    ->whereNull('modifier_groups.deleted_at')
                    ->where('modifier_groups.type', 'ingredient')
                    ->pluck('modifier_group_product.product_id')
                    ->unique()
                    ->toArray();

                // =========================================================================
                // 1. CARGA ATUAL (SISTEMA V3) - Sem descartar os itens ainda!
                // =========================================================================
                $currentItems = DB::table('order_items')
                    ->join('orders', 'order_items.order_id', '=', 'orders.id')
                    ->join('products', 'order_items.product_id', '=', 'products.id')
                    ->leftJoin('categories', 'products.category_id', '=', 'categories.id')
                    ->whereNull('products.deleted_at')
                    ->whereIn('orders.status', ['completed', 'closed', 'delivered', 'paid', 'finished'])
                    ->where('orders.created_at', '>=', $cutoffDate)
                    ->select(
                        'order_items.id',
                        'products.id as product_id',
                        'products.name',
                        'categories.name as category_name',
                        'products.status',
                        'products.track_inventory',
                        'products.current_stock',
                        'order_items.unit_price'
                    )
                    ->get()
                    ->map(fn($i) => (array) $i);

                $currentIds = $currentItems->pluck('id')->filter()->toArray();

                // Dicionário Estrito: Só aceita modificadores oficiais do tipo 'ingredient'
                $currentModifiers = empty($currentIds) ? collect() : DB::table('order_item_modifiers')
                    ->whereIn('order_item_id', $currentIds)
                    ->get()
                    ->map(function ($m) use ($v3OptionsById, $v3OptionsByName) {
                        $name = trim($m->name ?? '');
                        if (str_starts_with($name, '[') || empty($name)) return null;

                        $opt = null;
                        if (!empty($m->modifier_option_id) && isset($v3OptionsById[$m->modifier_option_id])) {
                            $opt = $v3OptionsById[$m->modifier_option_id];
                        } else {
                            $cleanKey = mb_strtolower($name);
                            $opt = $v3OptionsByName[$cleanKey] ?? null;
                        }

                        // Se não for um ingrediente oficial mapeado, descarta (limpa lixo do V3)
                        if (!$opt || $opt->group_type !== 'ingredient') return null;

                        return [
                            'order_item_id' => $m->order_item_id,
                            'id' => $opt->id,
                            'name' => $opt->name,
                            'quantity' => (float) ($m->quantity ?? 1),
                            'price' => (float) ($m->price ?? 0),
                        ];
                    })
                    ->filter()
                    ->groupBy('order_item_id');

                $currentMapped = $currentItems->map(function ($item) use ($currentModifiers) {
                    $item['modifiers'] = $currentModifiers->get($item['id'], collect())->toArray();
                    return $item;
                });

                // =========================================================================
                // 2. CARGA LEGADA - Sem descartar os itens ainda!
                // =========================================================================
                $legacyMapped = collect();
                $schema = DB::getSchemaBuilder();

                if ($schema->hasTable('legacy_orders') && $schema->hasTable('legacy_order_items')) {
                    $legacyItems = DB::table('legacy_order_items')
                        ->join('legacy_orders', 'legacy_order_items.legacy_order_id', '=', 'legacy_orders.id')
                        ->join('legacy_products', 'legacy_order_items.legacy_product_id', '=', 'legacy_products.id')
                        ->join('products', 'legacy_products.current_product_id', '=', 'products.id')
                        ->leftJoin('categories', 'products.category_id', '=', 'categories.id')
                        ->whereNull('products.deleted_at')
                        ->where('legacy_products.is_ignored', 0)
                        ->whereIn('legacy_orders.status', ['completed', 'closed', 'delivered', 'paid', 'finished', 'authorized', 'processed'])
                        ->where('legacy_orders.issue_date', '>=', $cutoffDate)
                        ->whereNotNull('legacy_products.current_product_id')
                        ->select(
                            'legacy_order_items.id',
                            'products.id as product_id',
                            'products.name',
                            'categories.name as category_name',
                            'products.status',
                            'products.track_inventory',
                            'products.current_stock',
                            'legacy_order_items.unit_price'
                        )
                        ->get()
                        ->map(fn($i) => (array) $i);

                    $legacyIds = $legacyItems->pluck('id')->filter()->toArray();

                    $legacyModifiers = empty($legacyIds) ? collect() : DB::table('legacy_order_item_modifiers')
                        ->join('legacy_modifiers', 'legacy_order_item_modifiers.legacy_modifier_id', '=', 'legacy_modifiers.id')
                        ->join('modifier_options', 'legacy_modifiers.modifier_option_id', '=', 'modifier_options.id')
                        ->join('modifier_groups', 'modifier_options.modifier_group_id', '=', 'modifier_groups.id')
                        ->whereIn('legacy_order_item_modifiers.legacy_order_item_id', $legacyIds)
                        ->where('legacy_modifiers.is_ignored', 0)
                        ->whereNotNull('legacy_modifiers.modifier_option_id')
                        ->select(
                            'legacy_order_item_modifiers.legacy_order_item_id as order_item_id',
                            'modifier_options.id as option_id',
                            'modifier_options.name as option_name',
                            'legacy_order_item_modifiers.quantity',
                            'legacy_order_item_modifiers.price',
                            'modifier_groups.type as group_type'
                        )
                        ->get()
                        ->map(function ($m) {
                            if ($m->group_type !== 'ingredient') return null;
                            return [
                                'order_item_id' => $m->order_item_id,
                                'id' => $m->option_id,
                                'name' => $m->option_name,
                                'quantity' => (float) ($m->quantity ?? 1),
                                'price' => (float) ($m->price ?? 0),
                            ];
                        })
                        ->filter()
                        ->groupBy('order_item_id');

                    $legacyMapped = $legacyItems->map(function ($item) use ($legacyModifiers) {
                        $item['modifiers'] = $legacyModifiers->get($item['id'], collect())->toArray();
                        return $item;
                    });
                }

                // =========================================================================
                // 3. O RANKING INTELIGENTE
                // =========================================================================
                $allItems = $currentMapped->merge($legacyMapped);

                if ($allItems->isEmpty()) {
                    $this->warn("⚠️ Nenhum item válido encontrado para o tenant {$tenant->id}.");
                    tenancy()->end();
                    continue;
                }

                // A "Lista Geral": Agrupa 100% dos itens (incluindo os vazios) e rankeia
                $groupedByProduct = $allItems->groupBy('product_id');
                $sortedProducts = $groupedByProduct->sortByDesc(fn($items) => $items->count());

                $finalData = [];

                foreach ($sortedProducts as $productId => $productItems) {
                    if (count($finalData) >= 10) break;

                    $requiresIngredients = in_array($productId, $productsWithIngredients);

                    // Validação: Só extrai ocorrências que sejam válidas para virarem variações
                    $validItems = $productItems->filter(function($item) use ($requiresIngredients) {
                        if ($requiresIngredients && empty($item['modifiers'])) {
                            return false; // É um campeão de vendas, mas essa ocorrência específica tá vazia
                        }
                        return true;
                    });

                    // Se for um Pastel campeão mas TODAS as suas vendas estiverem vazias, nós pulamos
                    if ($validItems->isEmpty()) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    // Agrupa os itens válidos nas suas assinaturas
                    $combinations = $validItems->groupBy(function ($item) {
                        if (empty($item['modifiers'])) {
                            return $item['product_id'] . '_no_mods';
                        }
                        $modSignature = collect($item['modifiers'])
                            ->map(fn($m) => $m['id'] . 'x' . ($m['quantity'] ?? 1))
                            ->sort()
                            ->implode('-');

                        return $item['product_id'] . '_mods_' . $modSignature;
                    });

                    // Extrai as 3 melhores variações desse produto campeão
                    $topCombinations = $combinations->sortByDesc(fn($comb) => $comb->count())->take(3);

                    foreach ($topCombinations as $signature => $items) {
                        if (count($finalData) >= 10) break;

                        $sampleItem = $items->first();

                        $finalData[] = [
                            'id' => $sampleItem['product_id'],
                            'variant_signature' => $signature,
                            'name' => $sampleItem['name'],
                            'category_name' => $sampleItem['category_name'] ?? 'Mais Pedidos',
                            'unit_price' => (float) $sampleItem['unit_price'],
                            'status' => $sampleItem['status'] ?? 'active',
                            'track_inventory' => (bool) ($sampleItem['track_inventory'] ?? false),
                            'current_stock' => (float) ($sampleItem['current_stock'] ?? 99),
                            'modifiers' => collect($sampleItem['modifiers'] ?? [])->map(fn($mod) => [
                                'id' => $mod['id'],
                                'name' => $mod['name'],
                                'quantity' => (float) ($mod['quantity'] ?? 1),
                                'price' => (float) ($mod['price'] ?? 0),
                            ])->toArray(),
                            'sales_count' => $items->count(), // Volume da Variação
                            'base_product_sales' => $productItems->count(), // Volume Global para o Terminal
                        ];
                    }
                }

                // SALVA NO CACHE
                Cache::store('file')->put('tenant_top_combinations', $finalData, now()->addHours(25));

                // 🚀 AVISA O FRONTEND QUE O CARDÁPIO/RANKING MUDOU!
                broadcast(new \App\Events\CatalogUpdated());

                // EXIBIÇÃO CLARA E DETALHADA NO TERMINAL
                if (empty($finalData)) {
                    $this->warn("Nenhuma combinação formada.");
                } else {
                    $tableRows = [];
                    foreach ($finalData as $index => $item) {
                        $modsSummary = collect($item['modifiers'])->map(function ($m) {
                            return (int)$m['quantity'] . 'x ' . $m['name'];
                        })->implode(', ');

                        $tableRows[] = [
                            $index + 1,
                            $item['name'],
                            $modsSummary ?: 'Sem modificadores',
                            $item['sales_count'] . 'x',
                            $item['base_product_sales'] . 'x'
                        ];
                    }

                    $this->table(
                        ['#', 'Produto Base', 'Variação Extraída', 'Vendas da Variação', 'Volume Global do Produto'],
                        $tableRows
                    );

                    $this->info("✅ Cache atualizado e Aplicativos notificados: Produtos rankeados pelo volume global e expandidos!");
                }

            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                $this->error("Erro no processamento: " . $e->getMessage());
            }

            tenancy()->end();
        }

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Console/Commands/DebugCost.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class DebugCost extends Command
{
    // 🚀 Definimos que o comando recebe o ID do produto e o nome do tenant
    protected $signature = 'debug:cost {product_id} {--tenant= : O ID do tenant (ex: nativa)}';

    protected $description = 'Realiza um raio-X do custo de um produto em cascata';

    public function handle()
    {
        // 1. INICIALIZAMOS O TENANT (A sua sacada de mestre!)
        if ($this->option('tenant')) {
            tenancy()->initialize($this->option('tenant'));
            $this->info("✅ Tenant inicializado: " . $this->option('tenant'));
        }

        $productId = $this->argument('product_id');
        $product = Product::find($productId);

        if (!$product) {
            $this->error("❌ Produto {$productId} não encontrado neste tenant.");
            return;
        }

        $this->warn("\n=== INICIANDO RAIO-X DO PRODUTO {$product->id} ===");
        $this->calc($product, 0);
        $this->warn("==================================================\n");
    }

    private function calc($prod, $lvl = 0)
    {
        $sheets = DB::table('technical_sheets')->where('parent_product_id', $prod->id)->get();

        if($sheets->isEmpty()) {
            $this->line(str_repeat("  ", $lvl) . "-> [ID:{$prod->id}] {$prod->name} (Cru) | base_cost: R$ " . ($prod->base_cost ?? 0));
            return (float)($prod->base_cost ?? 0);
        }

        $total = 0;
        $this->info(str_repeat("  ", $lvl) . "-> [ID:{$prod->id}] {$prod->name} (Composto) | rendimento: " . ($prod->recipe_yield ?? 1));

        foreach($sheets as $s) {
            $c = Product::find($s->ingredient_product_id);
            if($c) {
                $this->line(str_repeat("  ", $lvl+1) . "- Usa {$s->quantity} de [ID:{$c->id}] {$c->name}");
                $cost = $this->calc($c, $lvl + 2);
                $total += $cost * $s->quantity;
            } else {
                $this->error(str_repeat("  ", $lvl+1) . "- [⚠️ ERRO] Insumo ID {$s->ingredient_product_id} não encontrado no banco!");
            }
        }

        $y = (float)($prod->recipe_yield ?? 1);
        $y = $y > 0 ? $y : 1;
        $f = $total / $y;

        $this->question(str_repeat("  ", $lvl) . "=> Custo Final [ID:{$prod->id}]: R$ {$f}");
        return $f;
    }
}


// USAR ASSIM NO TERMINAL: php artisan debug:cost XXXX --tenant=nativa [sendo XXXX o ID do produto]
```

## File: app/Console/Commands/DebugPixFlow.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Services\Financial\PaymentGatewayManager;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class DebugPixFlow extends Command
{
    // O comando aceita o nome do tenant como argumento. O padrão será "nativa"
    protected $signature = 'debug:pix {tenant=nativa}';
    protected $description = 'Simula a geração de PIX Sicredi e valida se o payload EMV sofreu truncamento no banco de dados.';

    public function handle(PaymentGatewayManager $gatewayManager)
    {
        $tenantId = $this->argument('tenant');

        try {
            // Inicializa o Tenant
            tenancy()->initialize($tenantId);
            $this->info("🔍 Iniciando diagnóstico de PIX no tenant: {$tenantId}");
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->error("❌ Falha ao inicializar o tenant '{$tenantId}'. Verifique se o nome está correto.");
            return;
        }

        // 1. Buscar um método de pagamento PIX ativo
        $method = PaymentMethod::where('engine_type', 'bank_api')
            ->orWhere('name', 'like', '%PIX%')
            ->first();

        if (!$method) {
            $this->error("❌ Nenhum método de pagamento PIX/Bank API encontrado neste tenant.");
            return;
        }

        // 2. Criar um Pedido Fake de Balcão
        $order = Order::create([
            'type'           => 'counter',
            'source'         => 'pos_app',
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'payment_status' => 'pending',
            'subtotal'       => 1.00,
            'total'          => 1.00,
            'customer_name'  => 'Teste PIX Debug Automatizado'
        ]);

        $this->info("✅ Pedido de Teste #{$order->id} criado com sucesso.");

        try {
            // 3. Chamar o Gateway do Sicredi
            $this->info("⏳ Conectando à API do Sicredi...");
            $gateway = $gatewayManager->resolveGateway($method->gateway_driver ?? 'sicredi');

            // Simula um pagamento de R$ 1,00
            $pixData = $gateway->generatePayment($order, 1.00);
            $this->info("✅ Retorno da API recebido com sucesso!");

            // 4. Salvar no Banco (Com inteligência para detectar se você já migrou para 'payments')
            $targetTable = Schema::hasColumn('payments', 'pix_payload') ? 'payments' : 'orders';
            $recordId = null;

            if ($targetTable === 'payments') {
                $payment = $order->payments()->create([
                    'payment_method_id' => $method->id,
                    'amount'            => 1.00,
                    'status'            => 'pending',
                    'txid'              => $pixData['txid'],
                    'pix_payload'       => $pixData['qr_code']
                ]);
                $recordId = $payment->id;
            } else {
                $order->update([
                    'txid'        => $pixData['txid'],
                    'pix_payload' => $pixData['qr_code']
                ]);
                $recordId = $order->id;
            }

            // 5. Ler o dado crú diretamente do banco
            $this->info("⏳ Lendo dados salvos na tabela '{$targetTable}'...");
            $savedPayload = DB::table($targetTable)->where('id', $recordId)->value('pix_payload');
            $payloadLength = strlen($savedPayload);
            $originalLength = strlen($pixData['qr_code']);

            // ==========================================
            // 📊 IMPRESSÃO DO RELATÓRIO DE AUDITORIA
            // ==========================================
            $this->newLine();
            $this->warn("==================================================");
            $this->warn("               RELATÓRIO DO PIX                   ");
            $this->warn("==================================================");
            $this->line("📍 Tabela Destino : " . $targetTable);
            $this->line("📍 TXID Sicredi   : " . $pixData['txid']);
            $this->line("📍 Tamanho Gateway: " . $originalLength . " caracteres");
            $this->line("📍 Tamanho Banco  : " . $payloadLength . " caracteres");
            $this->newLine();

            // Validação de Truncamento
            if ($payloadLength === $originalLength) {
                $this->info("🎯 SUCESSO: O payload (Copia e Cola) foi salvo integralmente sem sofrer cortes!");
            } elseif ($payloadLength === 255) {
                $this->error("🚨 TRUNCAMENTO DETECTADO!");
                $this->error("A coluna 'pix_payload' na tabela '{$targetTable}' foi criada como VARCHAR(255).");
                $this->line("Acesse o MySQL e rode: ALTER TABLE {$targetTable} MODIFY pix_payload TEXT;");
            } else {
                $this->error("⚠️ ALERTA: O tamanho do banco difere do original de forma desconhecida.");
            }

            // Validação da Assinatura Criptográfica (CRC16)
            // O padrão do BACEN dita que o Copia e Cola sempre termina com '6304' seguido de 4 caracteres alfanuméricos.
            if (preg_match('/6304[A-F0-9]{4}$/i', $savedPayload)) {
                $this->info("🔒 ASSINATURA CRC16 INTACTA: O código passará na validação do app do banco do cliente.");
            } else {
                $this->error("💔 ASSINATURA CRC16 PERDIDA: O final do código PIX foi cortado ou corrompido.");
            }
            $this->warn("==================================================");

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->error("❌ Falha na simulação: " . $e->getMessage());
        } finally {
            // Limpeza: Apagar o pedido de teste do banco para não sujar o sistema
            if ($order) {
                $order->forceDelete();
                // Se criou pagamento atrelado, exclui também
                DB::table('payments')->where('order_id', $order->id)->delete();
                $this->comment("🧹 Limpeza concluída: Pedido de teste excluído do banco.");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use App\Models\Customer;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ExpireLoyaltyPoints extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'loyalty:expire';
    protected $description = 'Zera os pontos de fidelidade que ultrapassaram a data limite de expiração.';

    public function handle(): int
    {
        $now = Carbon::now();

        // 🚀 Atualização atômica direta no banco do tenant ativo
        $affected = Customer::whereNotNull('loyalty_points_expires_at')
            ->where('loyalty_points_expires_at', '<', $now)
            ->where('loyalty_points', '>', 0)
            ->update([
                'loyalty_points' => 0,
                'loyalty_points_expires_at' => null,
            ]);

        if ($affected > 0) {
            $msg = "Expiração de Fidelidade: {$affected} cliente(s) tiveram o saldo zerado.";
            Log::info($msg);
            $this->info($msg);
        }

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Console/Commands/GenerateReportsFromXmlFolder.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

class GenerateReportsFromXmlFolder extends Command
{
    // Exemplo de uso: php artisan fiscal:xml-reports xml_setembro 2026-09-01 2026-09-30
    protected $signature = 'fiscal:xml-reports {folder} {start_date} {end_date}';
    protected $description = 'Gera relatórios PDF a partir de uma pasta com arquivos XML brutos (Transição de Sistema)';

    public function handle()
    {
        $folder = $this->argument('folder');
        $startDate = $this->argument('start_date');
        $endDate = $this->argument('end_date');

        // Força a busca na pasta global (ignorando o isolamento do tenant)
        $absolutePath = base_path("storage/app/{$folder}");

        if (!is_dir($absolutePath)) {
            $this->error("A pasta {$absolutePath} não existe.");
            return;
        }

        $files = glob($absolutePath . '/*.xml');
        $this->info("Encontrados " . count($files) . " arquivos na pasta.");

        $documents = [];
        $monophasicItems = collect();

        $this->output->progressStart(count($files));

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            // Lê o conteúdo usando a função nativa do PHP
            $content = file_get_contents($file);

            // Hack para remover namespaces e facilitar o SimpleXML
            $content = preg_replace('/xmlns="[^"]+"/', '', $content);
            $xml = @simplexml_load_string($content);

            if (!$xml) {
                $this->output->progressAdvance();
                continue;
            }

            // Localiza o nó principal da nota (depende se tem a tag envolvente <nfeProc> ou não)
            $infNFe = $xml->NFe->infNFe ?? $xml->infNFe ?? null;
            if (!$infNFe) {
                $this->output->progressAdvance();
                continue;
            }

            $ide = $infNFe->ide;
            $dest = $infNFe->dest ?? null;
            $total = (float) ($infNFe->total->ICMSTot->vNF ?? 0);
            $prot = $xml->protNFe->infProt ?? null;
            $status = $prot ? 'authorized' : 'canceled'; // Assumimos autorizada se tiver protocolo

            if ($status === 'authorized') {
                $documents[] = (object) [
                    'issue_date' => (string) $ide->dhEmi,
                    'model' => (string) $ide->mod,
                    'series' => (string) $ide->serie,
                    'number' => (string) $ide->nNF,
                    'status' => $status,
                    'access_key' => str_replace('NFe', '', (string) $infNFe['Id']),
                    'protocol' => $prot ? (string) $prot->nProt : 'S/N',
                    'total_value' => $total,
                    'order' => (object) [
                        'customer' => (object) [
                            'cpf' => $dest ? ((string) ($dest->CPF ?? $dest->CNPJ ?? '')) : null,
                        ],
                        'customer_name' => $dest ? (string) ($dest->xNome ?? 'Consumidor Final') : 'Consumidor Final',
                    ]
                ];

                foreach ($infNFe->det as $det) {
                    $ncm = (string) $det->prod->NCM;

                    if (str_starts_with($ncm, '2201') || str_starts_with($ncm, '2202') || str_starts_with($ncm, '2203')) {
                        $monophasicItems->push([
                            'name' => (string) $det->prod->xProd,
                            'qty' => (float) $det->prod->qCom,
                            'value' => (float) $det->prod->vProd,
                        ]);
                    }
                }
            }

            $this->output->progressAdvance();
        }

        $this->output->progressFinish();

        $documentsCollection = collect($documents)->sortBy('issue_date');

        $monophasicGrouped = $monophasicItems->groupBy('name')->map(function ($items, $name) {
            return [
                'name' => $name,
                'total_qty' => $items->sum('qty'),
                'total_value' => $items->sum('value'),
            ];
        });

        $settings = CompanySetting::first() ?? new CompanySetting();
        $logoBase64 = $this->getLogoBase64($settings->logo_path);

        $this->info("Gerando PDF Geral...");
        $pdfGeneral = Pdf::loadView('reports.fiscal_general', [
            'settings' => $settings,
            'documents' => $documentsCollection,
            'startDate' => Carbon::parse($startDate)->format('d/m/Y'),
            'endDate' => Carbon::parse($endDate)->format('d/m/Y'),
            'totalFaturado' => $documentsCollection->sum('total_value'),
            'logoBase64' => $logoBase64,
        ])->setPaper('a4', 'landscape');

        // Salva diretamente na raiz de onde o script foi chamado
        $generalPath = base_path("Relatorio_Geral_XML_{$startDate}_a_{$endDate}.pdf");
        $pdfGeneral->save($generalPath);

        $this->info("Gerando PDF Monofásico...");
        $pdfMonophasic = Pdf::loadView('reports.fiscal_monophasic', [
            'settings' => $settings,
            'items' => $monophasicGrouped,
            'startDate' => Carbon::parse($startDate)->format('d/m/Y'),
            'endDate' => Carbon::parse($endDate)->format('d/m/Y'),
            'totalFaturado' => $monophasicGrouped->sum('total_value'),
            'logoBase64' => $logoBase64,
        ]);

        $monoPath = base_path("Relatorio_Monofasicos_XML_{$startDate}_a_{$endDate}.pdf");
        $pdfMonophasic->save($monoPath);

        $this->info("✅ Relatórios gerados com sucesso!");
        $this->line("Geral: " . $generalPath);
        $this->line("Monofásico: " . $monoPath);
    }

    private function getLogoBase64(?string $logoPath): ?string
    {
        if ($logoPath && Storage::disk('public')->exists($logoPath)) {
            $logoContent = Storage::disk('public')->get($logoPath);
            $logoMime = Storage::disk('public')->mimeType($logoPath);
            return 'data:' . $logoMime . ';base64,' . base64_encode($logoContent);
        }
        return null;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Console/Commands/ImportProductsCsv.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Tenant;

class ImportProductsCsv extends Command
{
    // O comando que vamos digitar no terminal:
    protected $signature = 'import:products {tenant} {file}';
    protected $description = 'Importa produtos de um CSV para um Tenant específico';

    public function handle()
    {
        $tenantId = $this->argument('tenant');
        $filePath = base_path($this->argument('file'));

        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            $this->error("Arquivo não encontrado: {$filePath}");
            return;
        }

        // Inicializa a conexão com o banco de dados da lanchonete (nativa)
        $tenant = Tenant::find($tenantId);
        if (!$tenant) {
            $this->error("Tenant {$tenantId} não encontrado!");
            return;
        }
        tenancy()->initialize($tenant);

        $this->info("Importando produtos para o tenant: {$tenantId}...");

        $file = fopen($filePath, 'r');
        $header = fgetcsv($file, 1000, ',');

        $count = 0;
        while (($row = fgetcsv($file, 1000, ',')) !== false) {
            $data = array_combine($header, $row);

            // Traduz o status do português pro nosso padrão gringo
            $statusMap = [
                'disponivel' => 'available',
                'indisponivel' => 'unavailable',
                'oculto' => 'hidden'
            ];

            // Função para limpar vírgulas de preços ("10,5" -> 10.5)
            $formatDecimal = fn($val) => (float) str_replace(',', '.', $val);

            Product::create([
                // Como o CSV não tem Categoria, deixamos null por enquanto
                'name' => $data['Nome'],
                'base_cost' => $formatDecimal($data['Custo Base']),
                'dine_in_price' => $formatDecimal($data['Preco Base']),
                'delivery_price' => $formatDecimal($data['Preco Base']), // Repetindo para o delivery
                'promo_price' => $formatDecimal($data['Preco Promocional']) > 0 ? $formatDecimal($data['Preco Promocional']) : null,
                
                'track_inventory' => (bool) $data['Controlar Estoque (1/0)'],
                'current_stock' => $formatDecimal($data['Qtd Estoque']),
                'min_stock' => $formatDecimal($data['Estoque Minimo']),
                'status' => $statusMap[strtolower($data['Status (disponivel/indisponivel/oculto)'])] ?? 'available',
                
                'requires_preparation' => (bool) $data['Exige Preparo (1/0)'],
                'print_station_id' => $data['ID Estacao de Impressao'] ?: null,
                
                'show_on_delivery' => (bool) $data['Exibir no Delivery (1/0)'],
                'show_on_menu' => (bool) $data['Exibir na Mesa (1/0)'],
                'is_age_restricted' => (bool) $data['Apenas Maiores de 18 (1/0)'],
                'loyalty_reward' => (bool) $data['Recompensa Fidelidade (1/0)'],
                
                // Fiscal
                'fiscal_ncm' => $data['Fiscal NCM'] ?: null,
                'fiscal_cest' => $data['Fiscal CEST'] ?: null,
                'fiscal_cfop' => $data['Fiscal CFOP'] ?: null,
                'fiscal_origin' => $data['Fiscal Origem'] ?: null,
                'fiscal_csosn' => $data['Fiscal CSOSN'] ?: null,
                
                'type' => $data['Tipo de Item'] ?: 'resale',
                'unit_of_measure' => $data['Unidade de Medida'] ?: 'un',
                'conversion_factor' => $formatDecimal($data['Fator Conversao']) ?: 1,

                // Salva os legados como JSON para processarmos depois
                'legacy_modifier_groups' => json_encode(explode(',', $data['IDs Grupos Adicionais (separados por virgula)'])),
                'legacy_recipe' => json_encode($data['Ficha Tecnica (ID:Qtd|ID:Qtd)']),
            ]);

            $count++;
        }

        fclose($file);
        $this->info("Sucesso! {$count} produtos importados.");
    }
}
```

## File: app/Console/Commands/ImportWpCatalog.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ImportWpCatalog extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'tenant:import-wp-catalog
                            {--tenant=nativa : Identificador do Tenant destino}
                            {--dry-run : Simula a importação sem persistir alterações}
                            {--rollback : Restaura o catálogo para o estado anterior ao último import}';

    protected $description = 'Importa catálogo do MVP WordPress com suporte a snapshot e rollback automático.';

    public function handle()
    {
        $tenantId = $this->option('tenant');
        $isDryRun = $this->option('dry-run');
        $isRollback = $this->option('rollback');

        if (!tenancy()->initialized) {
            tenancy()->initialize($tenantId);
        }

        $backupDir = storage_path("app/catalog_backups/{$tenantId}");

        // =========================================================================
        // MODO ROLLBACK: RESTAURA O ÚLTIMO SNAPSHOT
        // =========================================================================
        if ($isRollback) {
            return $this->executeRollback($backupDir);
        }

        if ($isDryRun) {
            $this->warn("⚠️  MODO DRY-RUN: Nenhuma alteração será feita no banco.");
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // SNAPSHOT DE SEGURANÇA (Antes de tocar no banco)
        // =========================================================================
        if (!$isDryRun) {
            $this->createSnapshot($backupDir, $tenantId);
        }

        try {
            DB::connection('wordpress')->getPdo();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->error("Erro ao conectar no banco legado 'wordpress': " . $e->getMessage());
            return 1;
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // 1. IMPORTAÇÃO DE CATEGORIAS
        // =========================================================================
        $this->info("1. Sincronizando Categorias...");

        $wpCategories = DB::connection('wordpress')->table('terms')
            ->join('term_taxonomy', 'terms.term_id', '=', 'term_taxonomy.term_id')
            ->whereIn('term_taxonomy.taxonomy', ['category', 'product_cat'])
            ->whereNotIn('terms.slug', ['sem-categoria', 'uncategorized'])
            ->select('terms.term_id', 'terms.name', 'terms.slug', 'term_taxonomy.description', 'term_taxonomy.parent')
            ->get();

        $categoryMap = [];
        $createdCats = 0;
        $updatedCats = 0;

        foreach ($wpCategories as $wpCat) {
            $name = html_entity_decode(trim($wpCat->name), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $slug = Str::slug($wpCat->slug ?: $name);

            if (!$isDryRun) {
                $category = Category::updateOrCreate(
                    ['slug' => $slug],
                    [
                        'name'        => $name,
                        'description' => $wpCat->description ?: null,
                        'is_active'   => true,
                        'status'      => 'active',
                        'visibility'  => 'both',
                        'type'        => 'food',
                    ]
                );
                $categoryMap[$wpCat->term_id] = $category->id;
                $category->wasRecentlyCreated ? $createdCats++ : $updatedCats++;
            } else {
                $categoryMap[$wpCat->term_id] = 1;
                $createdCats++;
            }
        }

        if (!$isDryRun) {
            foreach ($wpCategories as $wpCat) {
                if (!empty($wpCat->parent) && isset($categoryMap[$wpCat->parent], $categoryMap[$wpCat->term_id])) {
                    Category::where('id', $categoryMap[$wpCat->term_id])->update([
                        'parent_id' => $categoryMap[$wpCat->parent]
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }

        $this->line("Categorias: <comment>{$createdCats} criadas</comment>, <comment>{$updatedCats} atualizadas</comment>.");

        // =========================================================================
        // 2. IMPORTAÇÃO DE PRODUTOS
        // =========================================================================
        $this->info("2. Carregando Produtos Legados...");

        $wpPosts = DB::connection('wordpress')->table('posts')
            ->whereIn('post_type', ['nativa_produto', 'product'])
            ->whereIn('post_status', ['publish', 'draft', 'pending', 'private'])
            ->select('ID', 'post_title', 'post_content', 'post_excerpt', 'post_status')
            ->get();

        if ($wpPosts->isEmpty()) {
            $this->warn("Nenhum produto encontrado.");
            return 0;
        }

        $postIds = $wpPosts->pluck('ID')->toArray();

        $metaCollection = DB::connection('wordpress')->table('postmeta')
            ->whereIn('post_id', $postIds)
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('post_id');

        $catRelationships = DB::connection('wordpress')->table('term_relationships')
            ->join('term_taxonomy', 'term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id', '=', 'term_taxonomy.term_taxonomy_id')
            ->whereIn('term_taxonomy.taxonomy', ['category', 'product_cat'])
            ->whereIn('term_relationships.object_id', $postIds)
            ->select('term_relationships.object_id', 'term_taxonomy.term_id')
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('object_id');

        $unitRelationships = DB::connection('wordpress')->table('term_relationships')
            ->join('term_taxonomy', 'term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id', '=', 'term_taxonomy.term_taxonomy_id')
            ->join('terms', 'term_taxonomy.term_id', '=', 'terms.term_id')
            ->where('term_taxonomy.taxonomy', 'nativa_unidade_medida')
            ->whereIn('term_relationships.object_id', $postIds)
            ->select('term_relationships.object_id', 'terms.name')
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('object_id');

        $thumbIds = [];
        foreach ($metaCollection as $metas) {
            $tId = $metas->firstWhere('meta_key', '_thumbnail_id')?->meta_value;
            if ($tId) $thumbIds[] = (int) $tId;
        }

        $imagesMap = [];
        if (!empty($thumbIds)) {
            $imagesMap = DB::connection('wordpress')->table('posts')
                ->whereIn('ID', array_unique($thumbIds))
                ->pluck('guid', 'ID')
                ->toArray();
        }

        $bar = $this->output->createProgressBar($wpPosts->count());
        $bar->start();

        $created = 0;
        $updated = 0;

        foreach ($wpPosts as $wpPost) {
            $metas = $metaCollection->get($wpPost->ID, collect());

            $getMeta = fn($key, $default = null) => $metas->firstWhere('meta_key', $key)?->meta_value ?? $default;

            $price = (float) ($getMeta('produto_preco') ?: $getMeta('_regular_price') ?: 0);
            $promoPrice = (float) ($getMeta('produto_preco_promocional') ?: $getMeta('_sale_price') ?: 0);

            $isControlled = ($getMeta('nativa_stock_controlled') == '1' || $getMeta('nativa_estoque_ativo') == '1');
            $currentStock = (float) ($getMeta('nativa_estoque_qtd') ?: 0);
            $minStock = (float) ($getMeta('nativa_stock_min') ?: 0);

            $requiresPrep = ($getMeta('nativa_requires_preparation') !== '0');
            $stationId = is_numeric($getMeta('nativa_estacao_impressao')) ? (int) $getMeta('nativa_estacao_impressao') : null;
            $showDelivery = ($getMeta('nativa_exibir_delivery') !== '0');
            $showTable = ($getMeta('nativa_exibir_mesa') !== '0');
            $is18Plus = ($getMeta('nativa_apenas_maiores') == '1');
            $isLoyalty = ($getMeta('nativa_is_loyalty_reward') == '1');

            $baseCost = (float) ($getMeta('nativa_base_cost') ?: 0);
            $conversion = (float) ($getMeta('nativa_purchase_conversion') ?: 1);

            $unitTerm = $unitRelationships->get($wpPost->ID)?->first();
            $unit = $unitTerm ? $unitTerm->name : 'un';

            $fichaCount = (int) $getMeta('nativa_ficha_tecnica', 0);
            $ficha = [];
            for ($i = 0; $i < $fichaCount; $i++) {
                $itemId = (int) $getMeta("nativa_ficha_tecnica_{$i}_item_id");
                $quantity = (float) $getMeta("nativa_ficha_tecnica_{$i}_quantity");
                if ($itemId > 0) {
                    $ficha[] = ['item_id' => $itemId, 'quantity' => $quantity];
                }
            }

            $rawGroups = $getMeta('produto_grupos_adicionais');
            $groups = [];
            if ($rawGroups) {
                if (is_string($rawGroups) && str_starts_with($rawGroups, 'a:')) {
                    $unserialized = @unserialize($rawGroups);
                    $groups = is_array($unserialized) ? array_values($unserialized) : [];
                } elseif (is_string($rawGroups)) {
                    $groups = array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $rawGroups)));
                }
            }

            $catRel = $catRelationships->get($wpPost->ID)?->first();
            $localCategoryId = $catRel ? ($categoryMap[$catRel->term_id] ?? null) : null;

            $thumbId = $getMeta('_thumbnail_id');
            $imagePath = $thumbId && isset($imagesMap[$thumbId]) ? $imagesMap[$thumbId] : null;

            $availability = $getMeta('produto_disponibilidade', 'disponivel');
            $isActive = ($wpPost->post_status === 'publish' && $availability === 'disponivel');

            $name = html_entity_decode(trim($wpPost->post_title), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $rawDesc = !empty($wpPost->post_excerpt) ? $wpPost->post_excerpt : $wpPost->post_content;
            $cleanDesc = trim(strip_tags(html_entity_decode($rawDesc, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8')));

            $sku = str_pad($wpPost->ID, 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);

            $productData = [
                'category_id'             => $localCategoryId,
                'name'                    => $name,
                'description'             => $cleanDesc ?: null,
                'type'                    => 'simple',
                'unit_measure'            => $unit,
                'unit_of_measure'         => $unit,
                'sku'                     => $sku,
                'base_cost'               => $baseCost,
                'dine_in_price'           => $price,
                'delivery_price'          => $price,
                'promo_price'             => ($promoPrice > 0 && $promoPrice < $price) ? $promoPrice : null,
                'conversion_factor'       => $conversion,
                'track_inventory'         => $isControlled,
                'current_stock'           => $currentStock,
                'min_stock'               => $minStock,
                'status'                  => $isActive ? 'active' : 'inactive',
                'show_on_menu'            => $showTable,
                'show_on_delivery'        => $showDelivery,
                'is_age_restricted'       => $is18Plus,
                'requires_preparation'    => $requiresPrep,
                'print_station_id'        => $stationId,
                'loyalty_reward'          => $isLoyalty,
                'fiscal_ncm'              => $getMeta('nativa_prod_ncm'),
                'fiscal_cest'             => $getMeta('nativa_prod_cest'),
                'fiscal_cfop'             => $getMeta('nativa_prod_cfop'),
                'fiscal_origin'           => $getMeta('nativa_prod_origem'),
                'fiscal_csosn'            => $getMeta('nativa_prod_csosn'),
                'legacy_modifier_groups'  => !empty($groups) ? json_encode($groups) : null,
                'legacy_recipe'           => !empty($ficha) ? json_encode($ficha) : null,
            ];

            if ($imagePath) {
                $productData['image_path'] = $imagePath;
            }

            if (!$isDryRun) {
                $existing = Product::where('sku', $sku)->orWhere('name', $name)->first();

                if ($existing) {
                    $existing->update($productData);
                    $updated++;
                } else {
                    Product::create($productData);
                    $created++;
                }
            } else {
                $created++;
            }

            $bar->advance();
        }

        $bar->finish();
        $this->newLine(2);

        $this->info("✅ Catálogo sincronizado com sucesso!");
        $this->line("Produtos Criados: <comment>{$created}</comment>");
        $this->line("Produtos Atualizados: <comment>{$updated}</comment>");
        $this->line("Dica: Em caso de inconsistência, reverta executando: <comment>php artisan tenant:import-wp-catalog --tenant={$tenantId} --rollback</comment>");

        return 0;
    }

    protected function createSnapshot(string $backupDir, string $tenantId): void
    {
        if (!File::exists($backupDir)) {
            File::makeDirectory($backupDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $snapshotData = [
            'created_at' => now()->toDateTimeString(),
            'tenant_id'  => $tenantId,
            'categories' => Category::all()->toArray(),
            'products'   => Product::all()->toArray(),
        ];

        $filename = "snapshot_" . date('Y_m_d_His') . ".json";
        $filepath = "{$backupDir}/{$filename}";

        File::put($filepath, json_encode($snapshotData, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
        $this->info("📸 Snapshot do catálogo salvo em: {$filepath}");
    }

    protected function executeRollback(string $backupDir): int
    {
        if (!File::exists($backupDir)) {
            $this->error("Nenhum diretório de backup encontrado em: {$backupDir}");
            return 1;
        }

        $files = collect(File::files($backupDir))
            ->filter(fn($f) => str_starts_with($f->getFilename(), 'snapshot_') && $f->getExtension() === 'json')
            ->sortByDesc(fn($f) => $f->getMTime());

        if ($files->isEmpty()) {
            $this->error("Nenhum snapshot de backup disponível para rollback.");
            return 1;
        }

        $latestBackup = $files->first();
        $this->warn("Carregando snapshot: {$latestBackup->getFilename()}");

        $data = json_decode(File::get($latestBackup->getRealPath()), true);

        if (!$data || !isset($data['categories'], $data['products'])) {
            $this->error("Arquivo de snapshot corrompido ou inválido.");
            return 1;
        }

        if (!$this->confirm("Deseja realmente restaurar o catálogo gravado em [{$data['created_at']}]? O estado atual será substituído.", true)) {
            $this->line("Rollback cancelado pelo usuário.");
            return 0;
        }

        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;');

        // Restaura Categorias
        Category::truncate();
        foreach ($data['categories'] as $cat) {
            Category::create($cat);
        }

        // Restaura Produtos
        Product::truncate();
        foreach ($data['products'] as $prod) {
            Product::create($prod);
        }

        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;');

        $this->info("✅ Rollback concluído com sucesso!");
        $this->line("Categorias restauradas: " . count($data['categories']));
        $this->line("Produtos restaurados: " . count($data['products']));

        return 0;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Console/Commands/ImportWpCustomers.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use App\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\LegacyCustomer;
use App\Models\LegacyImportLog;
use App\Models\Street;
use App\Models\Neighborhood;
use App\Models\StreetSegment;
use App\Models\Address;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class ImportWpCustomers extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'import:wp-customers {tenant=nativa}';
    protected $description = 'Suga os clientes da V1 (WP), decodifica endereços e vincula estritamente ao mapa existente.';

    public function handle()
    {
        $tenantId = $this->argument('tenant');
        $tenant = Tenant::find($tenantId);

        if (!$tenant) {
            $this->error("❌ Lanchonete '{$tenantId}' não encontrada!");
            return;
        }

        tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
        $this->info("🔌 Conectando ao Banco V1 (WordPress) e achatando wp_users / wp_usermeta...");

        $wp = DB::connection('wordpress');
        $tag = 'WP_CUST_' . now()->format('Ymd_His');

        $query = "
            SELECT
                u.ID as wp_user_id,
                u.display_name as name,
                u.user_email as email,
                MAX(CASE WHEN m.meta_key IN ('nativa_user_phone', 'billing_phone') THEN m.meta_value END) as phone,
                MAX(CASE WHEN m.meta_key IN ('nativa_user_cpf', 'billing_cpf') THEN m.meta_value END) as cpf,
                MAX(CASE WHEN m.meta_key = 'nativa_user_dob' THEN m.meta_value END) as birth_date,
                MAX(CASE WHEN m.meta_key = 'nativa_user_points' THEN m.meta_value END) as loyalty_points,
                MAX(CASE WHEN m.meta_key IN ('nativa_saved_addresses', 'nativa_user_addresses') THEN m.meta_value END) as raw_addresses
            FROM wp_users u
            LEFT JOIN wp_usermeta m ON u.ID = m.user_id
            GROUP BY u.ID, u.display_name, u.user_email
        ";

        try {
            $wpCustomers = $wp->select($query);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->error("❌ Erro ao ler tabelas do WordPress: " . $e->getMessage());
            return;
        }

        $totalCustomers = count($wpCustomers);
        $this->info("👥 {$totalCustomers} clientes encontrados na V1.");

        $importedCount = 0;
        $addressesCount = 0;
        $skippedAddresses = 0;
        $autoMatchedCount = 0;
        $pointsRecovered = 0;
        $usersCreated = 0;

        $bar = $this->output->createProgressBar($totalCustomers);
        $validNicknames = ['Casa', 'Trabalho', 'Amor', 'Pai/Mãe', 'Outro'];

        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            foreach ($wpCustomers as $c) {
                $name = trim($c->name ?? '');

                if (empty($name)) {
                    $bar->advance();
                    continue;
                }

                $email = trim($c->email ?? '');
                $phone = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($c->phone ?? ''));
                $cpf = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($c->cpf ?? ''));
                $loyaltyPoints = (int) ($c->loyalty_points ?? 0);

                $birthDate = null;
                if (!empty($c->birth_date)) {
                    try {
                        $birthDate = Carbon::parse($c->birth_date)->format('Y-m-d');
                    } catch (\Exception $e) {
                        $birthDate = null;
                    }
                }

                // CRIAÇÃO / VÍNCULO DO USUÁRIO DE APP
                $user = null;
                if (!empty($email)) {
                    $user = User::where('email', $email)->first();
                    if (!$user) {
                        $user = User::create([
                            'name' => $name,
                            'email' => $email,
                            'password' => Hash::make(Str::random(24)),
                            'is_active' => true,
                        ]);
                        $usersCreated++;
                    }
                }

                // CRIAÇÃO / ATUALIZAÇÃO DO CLIENTE
                $customer = null;

                if (!empty($cpf)) {
                    $customer = Customer::withTrashed()->where('cpf', $cpf)->first();
                }

                if (!$customer) {
                    $customer = Customer::withTrashed()->where('name', $name)->first();
                }

                if ($customer) {
                    if ($customer->trashed()) $customer->restore();

                    $updateData = [];
                    if (empty($customer->email) && !empty($email)) $updateData['email'] = $email;
                    if (empty($customer->phone) && !empty($phone)) $updateData['phone'] = $phone;
                    if (empty($customer->birth_date) && !empty($birthDate)) $updateData['birth_date'] = $birthDate;
                    if (empty($customer->user_id) && $user) $updateData['user_id'] = $user->id;

                    if ($loyaltyPoints > 0) {
                        $updateData['loyalty_points'] = DB::raw("loyalty_points + {$loyaltyPoints}");
                        $pointsRecovered += $loyaltyPoints;
                    }

                    if (empty($customer->cpf) && !empty($cpf)) {
                        $cpfInUse = Customer::withTrashed()->where('cpf', $cpf)->where('id', '!=', $customer->id)->exists();
                        if (!$cpfInUse) $updateData['cpf'] = $cpf;
                    }

                    if (!empty($updateData)) {
                        $customer->update($updateData);
                    }

                } else {
                    $customer = Customer::create([
                        'name' => $name,
                        'email' => $email ?: null,
                        'phone' => $phone ?: null,
                        'cpf' => $cpf ?: null,
                        'birth_date' => $birthDate,
                        'loyalty_points' => $loyaltyPoints,
                        'user_id' => $user?->id,
                    ]);

                    $pointsRecovered += $loyaltyPoints;
                }

                $importedCount++;

                // ==========================================
                // 🚀 DECODIFICAÇÃO E MAPEAMENTO ESTRITO
                // ==========================================
                if (!empty($c->raw_addresses)) {
                    $addressArray = @unserialize($c->raw_addresses);

                    if (is_array($addressArray)) {
                        foreach ($addressArray as $addr) {
                            // Decodifica a URL (ex: Am%C3%A2ndio -> Amândio)
                            $streetName = trim(urldecode($addr['street'] ?? ''));
                            if (empty($streetName)) continue;

                            // Tenta encontrar a rua exata na base de dados (Sem Create!)
                            $street = Street::where('name', 'LIKE', $streetName)->first();
                            if (!$street) {
                                $skippedAddresses++;
                                continue;
                            }

                            $districtName = trim(urldecode($addr['district'] ?? $addr['bairro'] ?? ''));
                            $neighborhood = null;

                            if (!empty($districtName)) {
                                $neighborhood = Neighborhood::where('name', 'LIKE', $districtName)->first();
                            }

                            // Se não achou pelo nome, tenta deduzir pela tabela street_segments
                            if (!$neighborhood) {
                                $segment = StreetSegment::where('street_id', $street->id)->first();
                                if ($segment) {
                                    $neighborhood = Neighborhood::find($segment->neighborhood_id);
                                }
                            }

                            // Se definitivamente não achou o bairro no mapa atual, pula o endereço
                            if (!$neighborhood) {
                                $skippedAddresses++;
                                continue;
                            }

                            $number = trim(urldecode($addr['number'] ?? 'S/N'));
                            if (empty($number)) $number = 'S/N';

                            $nickname = trim(urldecode($addr['nickname'] ?? $addr['apelido'] ?? 'Casa'));
                            if (!in_array($nickname, $validNicknames)) {
                                $nickname = 'Outro';
                            }

                            $customer->addresses()->updateOrCreate(
                                [
                                    'street_id' => $street->id,
                                    'number' => $number,
                                ],
                                [
                                    'neighborhood_id' => $neighborhood->id,
                                    'nickname' => $nickname,
                                    'complement' => urldecode($addr['complement'] ?? null),
                                    'reference' => urldecode($addr['reference'] ?? null),
                                    'is_active' => true,
                                ]
                            );

                            $addressesCount++;
                        }
                    }
                }

                $updated = LegacyCustomer::whereRaw('LOWER(legacy_name) = ?', [strtolower($name)])
                    ->whereNull('customer_id')
                    ->update(['customer_id' => $customer->id]);

                $autoMatchedCount += $updated;

                $bar->advance();
            }

            LegacyImportLog::create([
                "import_tag" => $tag,
                "type" => "v1_customers_db",
                "items_count" => $importedCount,
            ]);

            DB::commit();

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            $this->error("\n❌ Erro durante a importação: " . $e->getMessage());
            return;
        }

        $bar->finish();

        $this->info("\n\n🎉 Importação de Clientes concluída: {$tag}");
        $this->info("=================================================");
        $this->info("Clientes na V3 (Novos/Atualizados): {$importedCount}");
        $this->info("Contas de App Criadas (Users):      {$usersCreated}");
        $this->info("E-mails e Pontos transferidos:      " . number_format($pointsRecovered, 0, ',', '.') . " pontos!");
        $this->info("Endereços 100% compátiveis:         {$addressesCount}");
        $this->info("Endereços ignorados (Fora do mapa): {$skippedAddresses}");
        $this->info("Órfãos (Legacy) Auto-Vinculados:    {$autoMatchedCount}");
        $this->info("=================================================\n");

        tenancy()->end();
    }
}
```
