## File: app/Filament/Central/Widgets/SystemStatusWidget.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Central\Widgets;

use Filament\Widgets\StatsOverviewWidget as BaseWidget;
use Filament\Widgets\StatsOverviewWidget\Stat;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class SystemStatusWidget extends BaseWidget
{
    // Força o widget a ficar no topo do Dashboard
    protected static ?int $sort = -10;

    // Atualiza os dados a cada 10 segundos automaticamente na tela!
    protected ?string $pollingInterval = '10s';

    protected function getStats(): array
    {
        return [
            $this->getWorkerStatus(),
            $this->getReverbStatus(),
        ];
    }

    private function getWorkerStatus(): Stat
    {
        $lastHeartbeat = Cache::store('file')->get('system_worker_heartbeat', 0);

        // Se o último batimento foi há menos de 120 segundos (2 minutos), está vivo.
        $isOnline = (time() - $lastHeartbeat) <= 120;

        return Stat::make('Filas & Workers (Supervisor)', $isOnline ? 'Online' : 'Offline / Falha')
            ->description($isOnline ? 'Tarefas processadas em tempo real.' : 'As filas estão travadas! Reinicie o Supervisor.')
            ->descriptionIcon($isOnline ? 'heroicon-m-check-circle' : 'heroicon-m-exclamation-triangle')
            ->color($isOnline ? 'success' : 'danger')
            ->chart($isOnline ? [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 4, 3, 4, 5] : [1, 0, 0, 0, 0]) // Um gráfico visual bonitinho
            ->extraAttributes([
                'class' => $isOnline ? '' : 'animate-pulse ring-2 ring-danger-500',
            ]);
    }

    private function getReverbStatus(): Stat
    {
        // Lê as configurações de host/porta originais do Reverb (.env)
        $host = config('reverb.servers.reverb.host', '127.0.0.1');
        $port = config('reverb.servers.reverb.port', 8080);

        // PING RÁPIDO: Tenta abrir a porta do WebSockets localmente com 1 segundo de Timeout
        $isOnline = false;
        try {
            $fp = @fsockopen($host, $port, $errno, $errstr, 1);
            if ($fp) {
                $isOnline = true;
                fclose($fp);
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $isOnline = false;
        }

        return Stat::make('Reverb (WebSockets)', $isOnline ? 'Online' : 'Offline / Falha')
            ->description($isOnline ? 'Conexões bidirecionais ativas.' : 'Servidor WebSockets caiu! Reinicie o Reverb.')
            ->descriptionIcon($isOnline ? 'heroicon-m-bolt' : 'heroicon-m-x-circle')
            ->color($isOnline ? 'success' : 'danger')
            ->chart($isOnline ? [5, 4, 5, 4, 5, 4, 5, 4] : [1, 0, 0, 0, 0])
            ->extraAttributes([
                'class' => $isOnline ? '' : 'animate-pulse ring-2 ring-danger-500',
            ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/Actions/ImportV0ConsolidatedAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Repeater;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Wizard\Step;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use App\Models\LegacyDailyRevenue;
use App\Models\LegacyImportLog;

class ImportV0ConsolidatedAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return "importConsolidated";
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->modalHeading("Faturamento Consolidado Diário")
            ->modalWidth("4xl")
            ->steps([
                Step::make("1. Estrutura")
                    ->schema([
                        Toggle::make("has_payments")
                            ->label("Tem colunas de Pagamento?")
                            ->live(),
                        Toggle::make("has_order_count")
                            ->label("Tem coluna de Qtd Pedidos?")
                            ->live(),
                        Toggle::make("has_expenses")
                            ->label("Tem coluna de Despesas?")
                            ->live(),
                    ])
                    ->columns(2),

                Step::make("2. Upload")->schema([
                    TextInput::make("import_tag")
                        ->label("Tag Única do Lote")
                        ->required()
                        ->default("Consolidado_" . now()->format("Ymd_His")),
                    FileUpload::make("csv_file")
                        ->label("Arquivo CSV")
                        ->disk("local")
                        ->directory("csv_v0_imports")
                        ->required()
                        ->live()
                        ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set) {
                            $headers = [];
                            if ($state) {
                                $file = is_array($state)
                                    ? array_values($state)[0]
                                    : $state;
                                if (
                                    $file instanceof
                                    \Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile
                                ) {
                                    $handle = fopen($file->getRealPath(), "r");
                                    if ($handle) {
                                        $firstLine = fgets($handle);
                                        if ($firstLine) {
                                            $delimiter =
                                                strpos($firstLine, ";") !==
                                                false
                                                    ? ";"
                                                    : ",";
                                            rewind($handle);
                                            $rawHeaders = fgetcsv(
                                                $handle,
                                                0,
                                                $delimiter,
                                            );
                                            if ($rawHeaders) {
                                                foreach (
                                                    $rawHeaders
                                                    as $idx => $col
                                                ) {
                                                    $headers[
                                                        (string) $idx
                                                    ] = trim($col);
                                                };
                                            }
                                        }
                                        fclose($handle);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            $set("csv_headers", json_encode($headers));
                        }),
                    Hidden::make("csv_headers"),
                ]),

                Step::make("3. Mapeamento")
                    ->schema(function (Get $get) {
                        $headers = json_decode($get("csv_headers"), true) ?? [];
                        if (empty($headers)) {
                            return [
                                Placeholder::make("w")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->content(
                                        "⚠️ Faça o upload do arquivo no Passo 2.",
                                    ),
                            ];
                        }

                        $schema = [
                            Select::make("col_date")
                                ->label("Coluna de Data")
                                ->options($headers)
                                ->required(),
                            Select::make("col_total")
                                ->label("Coluna de Total Faturado")
                                ->options($headers)
                                ->required(),
                        ];

                        if ($get("has_order_count")) {
                            $schema[] = Select::make("col_order_count")
                                ->label("Coluna de Qtd Pedidos")
                                ->options($headers)
                                ->required();
                        }
                        if ($get("has_expenses")) {
                            $schema[] = Select::make("col_expenses")
                                ->label("Coluna de Despesas")
                                ->options($headers)
                                ->required();
                        }

                        if ($get("has_payments")) {
                            $v3Payments = \App\Models\PaymentMethod::pluck(
                                "name",
                                "id",
                            )->toArray();
                            $schema[] = Repeater::make("payment_mappings")
                                ->label("Mapeamento de Formas de Pagamento")
                                ->addActionLabel(
                                    "Adicionar Coluna de Pagamento",
                                )
                                ->columnSpanFull()
                                ->schema([
                                    Select::make("csv_column")
                                        ->label("Coluna no CSV")
                                        ->options($headers)
                                        ->required(),
                                    Select::make("v3_payment_id")
                                        ->label("Forma no ERP (V3)")
                                        ->options($v3Payments)
                                        ->searchable()
                                        ->required(),
                                ])
                                ->columns(2);
                        }
                        return $schema;
                    })
                    ->columns(2),
            ])
            ->action(function (array $data) {
                $fileState = $data["csv_file"];
                $file = is_array($fileState)
                    ? array_values($fileState)[0]
                    : $fileState;
                $disk = Storage::disk("local");

                if (!$disk->exists($file)) {
                    return;
                }
                $handle = $disk->readStream($file);
                $firstLine = fgets($handle);
                $delimiter = strpos($firstLine, ";") !== false ? ";" : ",";
                rewind($handle);
                $headers = [];
                foreach (fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter) as $idx => $col) {
                    $headers[(string) $idx] = trim($col);
                }

                $parseMoney = fn($v) => (float) str_replace(
                    ",",
                    ".",
                    preg_replace("/[^0-9,-]/", "", $v),
                );
                $count = 0;

                while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
                    $rawDate = trim($row[$data["col_date"]] ?? "");
                    if (empty($rawDate)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    try {
                        $date = Carbon::parse(
                            str_replace("/", "-", $rawDate),
                        )->format("Y-m-d");
                    } catch (\Exception $e) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    $payments = [];
                    if (
                        !empty($data["has_payments"]) &&
                        !empty($data["payment_mappings"])
                    ) {
                        foreach ($data["payment_mappings"] as $mapping) {
                            $val = $parseMoney(
                                $row[$mapping["csv_column"]] ?? 0,
                            );
                            if ($val > 0) {
                                $payments[$mapping["v3_payment_id"]] =
                                    ($payments[$mapping["v3_payment_id"]] ??
                                        0) +
                                    $val;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    LegacyDailyRevenue::updateOrCreate(
                        ["date" => $date],
                        [
                            "total_revenue" => $parseMoney(
                                $row[$data["col_total"]] ?? 0,
                            ),
                            "order_count" => isset($data["col_order_count"])
                                ? (int) $row[$data["col_order_count"]]
                                : null,
                            "expenses" => isset($data["col_expenses"])
                                ? $parseMoney($row[$data["col_expenses"]])
                                : null,
                            "payments_breakdown" => empty($payments)
                                ? null
                                : $payments,
                            "import_tag" => trim($data["import_tag"]),
                        ],
                    );
                    $count++;
                }
                fclose($handle);
                $disk->delete($file);

                LegacyImportLog::create([
                    "import_tag" => trim($data["import_tag"]),
                    "type" => "v0_consolidated",
                    "items_count" => $count,
                ]);
                Notification::make()
                    ->title("Importação V0 concluída: {$count} dias salvos!")
                    ->success()
                    ->send();
            });
    }
}
```

```php
                    }
                }

                return [
                    Grid::make(6)->schema([

                        Group::make([

                                        .smart-match-list > div { width: 100% !important; display: block !important; }
                                        .smart-match-list label.fi-checkbox-list-option { width: 100% !important; display: flex !important; max-width: none !important; }

                                        <div style='flex: 5;'>Produto na Nota (XML)</div>
                                        <div style='flex: 4;'>Insumo Vinculado</div>
                                        <div style='flex: 2;'>Qtd. na Nota</div>

                                ->default(array_keys($options))

                                ->columns(1)
                                ->extraAttributes([
                                    'class' => 'smart-match-list max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto pr-2',
                                ]),
                        ])->columnSpan(5),

                        // 🚀 COLUNA 6: O PAINEL DE AUTOMAÇÃO
                        Group::make([
                            Placeholder::make('auto_approve_header')
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->content(new HtmlString("
                                    <div class='flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center'>
                                        <div class='w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center mb-3'>
                                            <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' fill='none' viewBox='0 0 24 24' stroke-width='2' stroke='currentColor' class='w-6 h-6 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'>
                                                <path stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' d='m3.75 13.5 10.5-11.25L12 10.5h8.25L9.75 21.75 12 13.5H3.75Z' />
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                        <h3 class='font-medium text-[13px]'>Auto Aprovar</h3>
                                    </div>

                            Toggle::make('auto_approve_future')
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                 ->extraFieldWrapperAttributes(['class' => 'h-full flex flex-col items-center'])
                                ->default(false),

                            Placeholder::make('auto_approve_helper')
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->content(new HtmlString("
                                    <div class='text-[11px] text-center'>

                                    ->color('primary')
                                    ->link()

                                    ->url(fn() => \App\Filament\Pages\ManageAutomations::getUrl(), shouldOpenInNewTab: true)
                            ])
                            ->alignCenter()
                            ->extraAttributes(['class' => 'mt-2 opacity-70 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity']),
                        ])
                        ->columnSpan(1)
                        ->extraAttributes([
                            'class' => 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full',
                            'style' => 'border: none; min-height: 100%;'
                        ]),

                    ]),
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (array $data, $livewire) {
                $approvedIndexes = $data['approved_indexes'] ?? [];

                // 🚀 A VACINA APLICADA NO MODAL: Lemos direto da variável pública do Livewire
                $items = $livewire->data['xml_items'] ?? [];

                $invoiceKey = $livewire->data['invoice_key'] ?? '';
                $supplierId = $livewire->data['supplier_id'] ?? null;

                $autoApprove = $data['auto_approve_future'] ?? false;
                $processor = app(InvoiceItemProcessor::class);

                $processedCount = 0;

                // Aqui $uuid é exatamente o índice que vem da CheckboxList
                foreach ($approvedIndexes as $uuid) {
                    if (isset($items[$uuid])) {
                        // Processa o item e salva no banco
                        $processor->processDirectItem($items[$uuid], $invoiceKey, $supplierId, $autoApprove);

                        // Remove o item preservando o UUID e sem usar array_values
                        unset($items[$uuid]);
                        $processedCount++;
                    }
                }

                if ($processedCount > 0) {
                    // 🚀 Devolvemos a array para o componente sem usar o form->fill()
                    $livewire->data['xml_items'] = $items;

                    \Filament\Notifications\Notification::make()
                        ->title($processedCount . ' itens processados com sucesso!')
                        ->success()
                        ->send();

                    $livewire->dispatch('items-processed');
                }
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/ImportInvoice/Schemas/ItemRowSchema.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\ImportInvoice\Schemas;

use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Actions;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Filament\Actions\Action;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\GoodsReceiptItem;
use App\Services\Purchases\InvoiceItemProcessor;
use App\Support\ProductFormatter;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Number;
use Throwable;

class ItemRowSchema
{
    public static function schema(): array
    {
        return [
            self::getXmlNameField(),
            self::getXmlQtyField(),
            self::getConversionFactorField(),
            self::getIsPersonalField(),
            self::getProductSelectField(),
            self::getGoodsReceiptMatchField(),
            self::getRealEntryField(),
            self::getConfirmItemAction(),

            // Controles Ocultos
            Hidden::make("xml_cost"),
            Hidden::make("xml_uom"),
            Hidden::make("available_qty"),
            Hidden::make("is_matched"),
            Hidden::make("item_uuid"),
            Hidden::make("confirmation_step")->default(0),
        ];
    }

    private static function getXmlNameField(): TextInput
    {
        return TextInput::make("xml_name")
            ->label("Item da Nota")
            ->readOnly()
            ->hint(function (Get $get) {
                $cost = (float) $get("xml_cost");
                $formattedCost = rtrim(rtrim(number_format($cost, 5, ",", "."), "0"), ",");
                $cleanUom = strtoupper(preg_replace("/[^A-Z]/", "", (string) ($get("xml_uom") ?? "")));
                return "Original: R$ {$formattedCost} /{$cleanUom}";
            })
            ->columnSpan(3);
    }

    private static function getXmlQtyField(): TextInput
    {
        return TextInput::make("xml_qty")
            ->label("Qtd.")
            ->numeric()
            ->required()
            ->live(debounce: 500)
            ->hint(fn(Get $get) => "Max: " . $get("available_qty"))
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getConversionFactorField(): TextInput
    {
        return TextInput::make("conversion_factor")
            ->label(function (Get $get) {
                $xmlUom = strtoupper(preg_replace("/[^A-Z]/", "", (string) ($get("xml_uom") ?? "")));
                return match ($xmlUom) {
                    "CX", "CX1" => "Qtd. na caixa",
                    "FD", "FDO" => "Qtd. no fardo",
                    "PC" => "Qtd. na peça",
                    "PCT" => "Qtd. no pacote",
                    "SC" => "Qtd. no saco",
                    default => "Fator de Conversão",
                };
            })
            ->numeric()
            ->default(1)
            ->required()
            ->live(debounce: 500)
            ->extraInputAttributes(fn(Get $get) => match ($get("factor_source")) {
                "history", "auto" => ["style" => "background-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15) !important;"],
                "identical" => ["style" => "background-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15) !important;"],
                "auto_math" => ["style" => "background-color: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.15) !important;"],
                "assistant_used" => ["style" => "background-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15) !important;"],
                default => [],
            })
            ->suffixAction(self::getAssistantAction())
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getIsPersonalField(): Toggle
    {
        return Toggle::make("is_personal")
            ->label("Uso Pessoal?")
            ->live()
            ->inline(false)
            ->columnSpan(1)
            ->afterStateUpdated(function (Set $set) {
                $set("product_id", null);
                $set("goods_receipt_item_id", null);
                $set("confirmation_step", 0);
            });
    }

    private static function getProductSelectField(): Select
    {
        return Select::make("product_id")
            ->label("Produto / Insumo / Suprimento")
            ->searchable()
            ->allowHtml()
            ->getSearchResultsUsing(function (string $search): array {
                $products = Product::with('category')
                    ->whereIn('type', ['ingredient', 'resale', 'packaging', 'consumable'])
                    ->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->whereIn('status', ['available', 'out_of_stock', 'active'])
                    ->limit(50)
                    ->get();

                return $products->mapWithKeys(function ($product) {
                    return [$product->id => ProductFormatter::getHtmlLabel($product)];
                })->toArray();
            })
            ->getOptionLabelUsing(function ($value): ?string {
                $product = Product::with('category')->find($value);
                return $product ? ProductFormatter::getCleanLabel($product) : null;
            })
            ->live()
            ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set, Get $get, $livewire) {
                if (!$state) return;

                $invoice = method_exists($livewire, 'getInvoiceRecord') ? $livewire->getInvoiceRecord() : null;
                $supplierId = $invoice?->supplier_id ?? ($livewire->data['supplier_id'] ?? null);

                $processor = app(InvoiceItemProcessor::class);
                $conversion = $processor->calculateSmartConversion(
                    productId: (int) $state,
                    supplierId: $supplierId ? (int) $supplierId : null,
                    currentXmlName: (string) $get('xml_name'),
                    xmlUomRaw: (string) $get('xml_uom')
                );

                $set('conversion_factor', $conversion['factor']);
                $set('factor_source', $conversion['source']);
            })
            ->hint(fn(Get $get) => $get("product_id") ? "U.M Interna: " . Product::where("id", $get("product_id"))->value("unit_of_measure") : null)
            ->hidden(fn(Get $get) => $get("is_personal"))
            ->required(fn(Get $get) => !$get("is_personal"))
            ->columnSpan(3);
    }

    private static function getGoodsReceiptMatchField(): Select
    {
        return Select::make('goods_receipt_item_id')
            ->label('Conciliar Romaneio / Canhoto')
            ->placeholder('Nenhum (Entrada Nova no Estoque)')
            ->options(function (Get $get, $livewire) {
                $productId = $get('product_id');
                if (!$productId) return [];

                $supplierId = $livewire->data['supplier_id'] ?? null;

                $query = GoodsReceiptItem::with('goodsReceipt')
                    ->where('product_id', $productId)
                    ->where('status', 'pending');

                if ($supplierId) {
                    $query->whereHas('goodsReceipt', fn ($q) => $q->where('supplier_id', $supplierId));
                }

                return $query->get()->mapWithKeys(function ($item) {
                    $receiptNum = $item->goodsReceipt?->receipt_number ?: "ID #{$item->goods_receipt_id}";
                    $date = $item->goodsReceipt?->received_at ? $item->goodsReceipt->received_at->format('d/m') : '';
                    $uom = $item->product?->unit_of_measure ?: 'UN';
                    return [$item->id => "Canhoto {$receiptNum} ({$date}) - Qtd: {$item->quantity} {$uom}"];
                })->toArray();
            })
            ->helperText('Selecione caso este item já tenha sido entregue fisicamente para não duplicar o estoque.')
            ->hidden(fn(Get $get) => $get("is_personal") || empty($get("product_id")))
            ->columnSpan(2);
    }

    private static function getRealEntryField(): Placeholder
    {
        return Placeholder::make("total_entrada")
            ->label("Entrada Real")
            ->content(function (Get $get) {
                if (!$get("product_id")) {
                    return new HtmlString('<span class="text-gray-400">-</span>');
                }
                $total = ((float) ($get("xml_qty") ?: 0)) * ((float) ($get("conversion_factor") ?: 1));
                $uom = Product::find($get("product_id"))?->unit_of_measure ?? "UN";
                $formattedTotal = Number::format($total, maxPrecision: 4);

                $receiptId = $get('goods_receipt_item_id');
                $badge = $receiptId ? "<span class='text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-amber-500 bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded'>Conciliação</span>" : "";

                return new HtmlString("<div class='flex flex-col gap-0.5 mt-1'><div class='flex items-baseline gap-1'><span class='text-base font-black text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-400'>{$formattedTotal}</span><span class='text-xs font-medium text-gray-500'>{$uom}</span></div>{$badge}</div>");
            })
            ->hidden(fn(Get $get) => $get("is_personal"))
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getConfirmItemAction(): Actions
    {
        return Actions::make([
            Action::make("confirmItem")
                ->label(fn(Get $get) => $get("is_personal") ? "Gerar Despesa" : "Associar")
                ->icon(fn(Get $get) => $get("is_personal") ? "heroicon-m-banknotes" : "heroicon-m-link")
                ->color(fn(Get $get) => $get("is_personal") ? "warning" : "primary")
                ->size('sm')
                ->extraAttributes(['class' => 'whitespace-nowrap'])
                ->disabled(fn(Get $get) => !$get("is_personal") && empty($get("product_id")))
                ->action(function (Get $get, $livewire) {
                    $processQty = (float) ($get('xml_qty') ?? 0);
                    $availableQty = (float) ($get('available_qty') ?? 0);

                    if ($processQty <= 0 || $processQty > $availableQty) {
                        Notification::make()
                            ->title('Quantidade Inválida')
                            ->body("A quantidade deve ser maior que zero e menor ou igual a {$availableQty}.")
                            ->danger()
                            ->send();
                        return;
                    }

                    $invoice = method_exists($livewire, 'getInvoiceRecord') ? $livewire->getInvoiceRecord() : null;
                    $supplierId = $invoice?->supplier_id ?? ($livewire->data['supplier_id'] ?? null);

                    if (!$supplierId) {
                        Notification::make()
                            ->title('Fornecedor Obrigatório')
                            ->body('Não foi possível identificar o fornecedor vinculado à nota.')
                            ->danger()
                            ->send();
                        return;
                    }

                    $isPersonal = (bool) $get('is_personal');
                    $productId = $get('product_id') ? (int) $get('product_id') : null;

                    $payload = [
                        'item_uuid'             => (string) ($get('item_uuid') ?? ''),
                        'xml_name'              => (string) ($get('xml_name') ?? ''),
                        'xml_qty'               => $processQty,
                        'available_qty'         => $availableQty,
                        'xml_cost'              => (float) ($get('xml_cost') ?? 0),
                        'xml_uom'               => (string) ($get('xml_uom') ?? ''),
                        'conversion_factor'     => (float) ($get('conversion_factor') ?? 1),
                        'is_personal'           => $isPersonal,
                        'product_id'            => $productId,
                        'goods_receipt_item_id' => $get('goods_receipt_item_id') ? (int) $get('goods_receipt_item_id') : null,
                        'supplier_id'           => (int) $supplierId,
                        'invoice_key'           => $invoice?->nfe_key ?? $invoice?->access_key ?? ($livewire->data['invoice_key'] ?? null),
                    ];

                    try {
                        $result = $livewire->confirmItem($payload);
                        $autoCount = $result['auto_processed_count'] ?? 0;

                        $targetXmlName = $payload['xml_name'] ?: 'Item';
                        $body = $isPersonal
                            ? "Despesa gerada para '{$targetXmlName}'."
                            : "Item '{$targetXmlName}' integrado com sucesso!";

                        if ($payload['goods_receipt_item_id']) {
                            $body .= " (Estoque conciliado com o romaneio anterior sem duplicação).";
                        }

                        if ($autoCount > 0) {
                            $body .= " Efeito dominó: +{$autoCount} item(ns) idêntico(s) associado(s) automaticamente.";
                        }

                        Notification::make()
                            ->title($isPersonal ? 'Despesa Registrada' : 'Estoque Conciliado')
                            ->body($body)
                            ->success()
                            ->send();

                    } catch (Throwable $e) {
                        Notification::make()
                            ->title('Erro ao Processar Item')
                            ->body($e->getMessage())
                            ->danger()
                            ->send();
                    }
                }),
        ])
        ->alignEnd()
        ->columnSpan(fn(Get $get) => $get("is_personal") ? 6 : 1)
        ->extraAttributes(fn(Get $get) => $get("is_personal") ? [] : ["style" => "margin-top: 32px"]);
    }

    private static function getAssistantAction(): Action
    {
        return Action::make("assistente")
            ->icon("heroicon-m-sparkles")
            ->tooltip("Assistente de Conversão")
            ->color("primary")
            ->visible(fn(Get $get) => filled($get("product_id")))
            ->modalHeading("Assistente de Conversão")
            ->form(function (Get $get) {
                $xmlUom = strtoupper(preg_replace("/[^A-Z]/", "", (string) ($get("xml_uom") ?? "")));
                $internalUom = Product::find($get("product_id"))->unit_of_measure ?? "UN";
                $isPackage = in_array($xmlUom, ["CX", "FD", "FDO", "PC", "PCT", "SC"]);

                $fields = [Placeholder::make("info")->hiddenLabel()->content(new HtmlString("Nota: <strong>{$xmlUom}</strong> | Estoque: <strong>{$internalUom}</strong>"))];
                if ($isPackage) {
                    $fields[] = TextInput::make("qtd_pacote")->label("Itens por pacote/caixa")->numeric()->required();
                }
                if (in_array($xmlUom, ["KG", "KIL", "L", "LT", "LIT"]) && $internalUom === "UN") {
                    $fields[] = TextInput::make("peso_in")->label("Peso/Volume de 1 {$internalUom} (em {$xmlUom})")->numeric()->required();
                }
                if (($xmlUom === "UN" || $isPackage) && in_array($internalUom, ["KG", "G", "L", "ML"])) {
                    $fields[] = TextInput::make("peso_out")->label("Peso/Volume de 1 UN (em {$internalUom})")->numeric()->required();
                }

                return $fields;
            })
            ->action(function (array $data, Set $set, Get $get) {
                $xmlUom = strtoupper(preg_replace("/[^A-Z]/", "", (string) ($get("xml_uom") ?? "")));
                $internalUom = Product::find($get("product_id"))->unit_of_measure ?? "UN";
                $isPackage = in_array($xmlUom, ["CX", "FD", "FDO", "PC", "PCT", "SC"]);

                $qtd = (float) ($data["qtd_pacote"] ?? 1);
                $pesoIn = (float) ($data["peso_in"] ?? 0);
                $pesoOut = (float) ($data["peso_out"] ?? 0);

                $factor = 1.0;
                if ($xmlUom === $internalUom || (in_array($xmlUom, ["KG", "KIL"]) && $internalUom === "KG") || (in_array($xmlUom, ["L", "LT", "LIT"]) && $internalUom === "LT")) {
                    $factor = 1.0;
                } elseif (in_array($xmlUom, ["KG", "KIL"]) && $internalUom === "G") {
                    $factor = 1000.0;
                } elseif ($xmlUom === "G" && in_array($internalUom, ["KG", "KIL"])) {
                    $factor = 0.001;
                } elseif (in_array($xmlUom, ["L", "LT", "LIT"]) && $internalUom === "ML") {
                    $factor = 1000.0;
                } elseif ($xmlUom === "ML" && in_array($internalUom, ["L", "LT", "LIT"])) {
                    $factor = 0.001;
                } elseif ($isPackage && $internalUom === "UN") {
                    $factor = $qtd;
                } elseif (in_array($xmlUom, ["KG", "KIL", "L", "LT", "LIT"]) && $internalUom === "UN" && $pesoIn > 0) {
                    $factor = 1 / $pesoIn;
                } elseif ($isPackage && in_array($internalUom, ["KG", "G", "L", "ML"]) && $pesoOut > 0) {
                    $factor = $qtd * $pesoOut;
                } elseif ($xmlUom === "UN" && in_array($internalUom, ["KG", "G", "L", "ML"]) && $pesoOut > 0) {
                    $factor = $pesoOut;
                }

                $set("conversion_factor", round($factor, 4));
                $set("factor_source", "assistant_used");

                Notification::make()
                    ->title("Fator de Conversão Aplicado!")
                    ->success()
                    ->send();
            });
    }
}
```

```php
class ItemsSection

    public static function make(): Section
    {
        return Section::make('Itens da Nota')
            ->description('Associe os produtos do XML aos seus insumos e valide as conversões.')
            ->icon('heroicon-m-clipboard-document-list')
            ->headerActions([self::getMarkAllPersonalAction()])
            ->schema([
                self::getSuccessPlaceholder(),

                Repeater::make("xml_items")
                    ->hiddenLabel()
                    ->addable(false)
                    ->deletable(false)
                    ->reorderable(false)
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => !empty($get("xml_items")))

        return Placeholder::make('all_processed_success')

            ->visible(fn (Get $get) => empty($get('xml_items')))
            ->content(new HtmlString('
                <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 text-center rounded-2xl bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-500/10 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-500/20">
                    <div class="w-16 h-16 bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-500/20 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 shadow-sm">
                        <svg class="w-8 h-8" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M10.125 2.25h-4.5c-.621 0-1.125.504-1.125 1.125v17.25c0 .621.504 1.125 1.125 1.125h12.75c.621 0 1.125-.504 1.125-1.125v-9M10.125 2.25h.375a9 9 0 0 1 9 9v.375M10.125 2.25A3.375 3.375 0 0 1 13.5 5.625v1.5c0 .621.504 1.125 1.125 1.125h1.5a3.375 3.375 0 0 1 3.375 3.375M9 15l2.25 2.25L15 12" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-medium text-green-800 dark:text-green-400">Tudo Pronto!</h3>
                    <p class="text-sm text-green-700 dark:text-green-300 mt-2 max-w-lg">
                        Todos os itens desta nota foram processados e direcionados com sucesso.
                        Agora basta clicar no botão azul <strong>"Finalizar Importação"</strong> logo abaixo para concluir o processo e voltar à tela inicial.
                    </p>
                </div>
            '));
    }

    private static function getMarkAllPersonalAction(): Action
    {
        return Action::make("marcar_todos_pessoal")
            ->label("Marcar Tudo como Despesa Pessoal")
            ->icon("heroicon-m-banknotes")
            ->color("warning")
            ->visible(fn(Get $get) => !empty($get("xml_items")))
            ->requiresConfirmation()
            ->modalHeading("Ação em Lote")
            ->modalDescription('Isto irá marcar TODOS os itens pendentes como "Uso Pessoal", limpando qualquer produto associado. Deseja continuar?')
            ->action(function (Get $get, Set $set) {
                $items = $get("xml_items") ?? [];
                if (empty($items)) return;
                foreach ($items as $key => $item) {
                    $items[$key]["is_personal"] = true;
                    $items[$key]["product_id"] = null;
                    $items[$key]["confirmation_step"] = 0;
                }
                $set("xml_items", $items);
                Notification::make()->title("Todos os itens marcados como Pessoal!")->success()->send();
            });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\ImportInvoice\Schemas;

use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

class SummarySection
{
    public static function make(): Section
    {
        return Section::make('Resumo da Compra')
            ->description('Confirme o fornecedor vinculado a esta nota.')
            ->icon('heroicon-m-building-storefront')
            ->columns(['md' => 3])
            ->headerActions([self::getDanfeAction()])
            ->schema([
                Placeholder::make('xml_info')
                    ->label('Dados no XML')
                    ->content(fn (Get $get) => new HtmlString('<span class="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">' . $get('xml_supplier_name') . '</span><br><span class="text-sm text-gray-500">CNPJ: ' . $get('xml_supplier_cnpj') . '</span>'))
                    ->columnSpan(1),

                Placeholder::make('xml_total')
                    ->label('Valor Total da Nota')
                    ->content(fn (Get $get) => new HtmlString('<span class="font-black text-lg text-primary-600">R$ ' . number_format((float) $get('xml_total_amount'), 2, ',', '.') . '</span>'))
                    ->columnSpan(1),

                self::getSupplierSelectField(),
            ]);
    }

    private static function getSupplierSelectField(): Select
    {
        return Select::make("supplier_id")
            ->label("Fornecedor no Sistema")
            ->hint("Vínculo Interno")
            ->searchable()
            ->getSearchResultsUsing(fn (string $search): array => Supplier::where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")->orWhere('document', 'like', "%{$search}%")->limit(50)->where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id')->toArray())
            ->getOptionLabelUsing(fn ($value): ?string => Supplier::find($value)?->name)
            // 🚀 AQUI: Substitui o formulário cheio de Tabs pelo modelo direto
            ->createOptionForm(\App\Filament\Resources\Suppliers\Schemas\SupplierForm::getQuickCreateSchema())
            ->createOptionAction(function ($action) {
                return $action
                    ->modalHeading('Cadastro Rápido de Fornecedor')
                    ->modalWidth('md')
                    ->mountUsing(function ($form, $livewire) {
                        $form->fill([
                            "document" => $livewire->data["xml_supplier_cnpj"] ?? null,
                            "document_name" => $livewire->data["xml_supplier_name"] ?? null,
                            // Extraímos o nome fantasia caso a nota traga a SEFAZ suja
                            "name" => $livewire->data["xml_supplier_trade_name"] ?? $livewire->data["xml_supplier_name"] ?? null,
                        ]);
                    });
            })
            ->createOptionUsing(function (array $data, $livewire) {
                return Supplier::create([
                    // Pega estritamente o que foi digitado no modal, recaindo no XML caso o usuário deixe o campo nome em branco (incomum pois é required)
                    "name" => $data["name"] ?? $livewire->data["xml_supplier_trade_name"] ?? $livewire->data["xml_supplier_name"] ?? "S/ Fornecedor",
                    "document_name" => $data["document_name"] ?? $livewire->data["xml_supplier_name"] ?? null,
                    "document" => $data["document"] ?? $livewire->data["xml_supplier_cnpj"] ?? null,
                    "type" => $data["type"] ?? "physical",
                    "is_personal" => $data["is_personal"] ?? false,
                ])->id;
            })
            ->required()
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getDanfeAction(): Action
    {
        return Action::make('view_danfe')
            ->label('Visualizar DANFE')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-document-text')
            ->color('gray')
            ->modalHeading('Documento Auxiliar da Nota Fiscal (DANFE)')
            ->modalWidth('7xl')
            ->modalSubmitAction(false)
            ->modalCancelActionLabel('Fechar')
            ->modalContent(function (Get $get) {
                $invoice = \App\Models\ReceivedInvoice::find($get('received_invoice_id'));
                if (!$invoice || empty($invoice->xml_content) || str_contains($invoice->xml_content, 'resNFe')) {
                    return new HtmlString('<div class="p-4 text-center text-gray-500">O XML completo ainda não está disponível para esta nota.</div>');
                }
                try {
                    $danfe = new \NFePHP\DA\NFe\Danfe($invoice->xml_content);
                    $pdf = $danfe->render();
                    $base64 = base64_encode($pdf);
                    return new HtmlString("<iframe src='data:application/pdf;base64,{$base64}#toolbar=0' width='100%' height='700px' style='border: none; border-radius: 8px;'></iframe>");
                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                    return new HtmlString("<div class='p-4 text-red-500'>Erro ao gerar PDF: {$e->getMessage()}</div>");
                }
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/Schemas/BillingFiltersSchema.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Schemas;

use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Forms\Components\ToggleButtons;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use App\Services\Analytics\LegacyDataCapabilityService;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class BillingFiltersSchema
{
    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {
        $capabilities = LegacyDataCapabilityService::analyze();
        $initialMinDate = $capabilities['absolute_min_date'] ?? '2020-01-01';
        $initialMaxDate = $capabilities['absolute_max_date'] ?? now()->toDateString();

        // 🚀 O MOTOR DE AGRUPAMENTO AUTOMÁTICO
        $autoGroup = function ($start, $end, Set $set) {
            if (!$start || !$end) return;

            $days = Carbon::parse($start)->diffInDays(Carbon::parse($end));

            if ($days <= 60) {
                $set('time_grouping', 'day');
            } elseif ($days <= 700) {
                $set('time_grouping', 'month');
            } else {
                $set('time_grouping', 'year');
            }
        };

        return [
            Section::make('Recorte Temporal')
                ->description('Selecione um período rápido ou escolha as datas manualmente.')
                ->icon('heroicon-o-calendar-days')
                ->schema([
                    ToggleButtons::make('quick_range')
                        ->hiddenLabel()
                        ->options([
                            'today' => 'Hoje',
                            'yesterday' => 'Ontem',
                            'this_week' => 'Esta Semana',
                            'last_week' => 'Sem. Passada',
                            'this_month' => 'Este Mês',
                            'last_month' => 'Mês Passado',
                            'this_year' => 'Este Ano',
                            'last_year' => 'Ano Passado',
                            'custom' => 'Personalizado',
                        ])
                        ->default('this_month')
                        ->inline()
                        ->live()
                        ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set) use ($autoGroup) {
                            if ($state === 'custom') return;

                            $cap = LegacyDataCapabilityService::analyze();
                            $minDate = $cap['absolute_min_date'] ?? '2020-01-01';
                            $maxDate = $cap['absolute_max_date'] ?? now()->toDateString();

                            $now = Carbon::now();
                            $start = $now->toDateString();
                            $end = $now->toDateString();

                            match ($state) {
                                'today' => [$start = $now->toDateString(), $end = $now->toDateString()],
                                'yesterday' => [$start = $now->copy()->subDay()->toDateString(), $end = $now->copy()->subDay()->toDateString()],
                                'this_week' => [$start = $now->startOfWeek()->toDateString(), $end = $now->endOfWeek()->toDateString()],
                                'last_week' => [$start = $now->copy()->subWeek()->startOfWeek()->toDateString(), $end = $now->copy()->subWeek()->endOfWeek()->toDateString()],
                                'this_month' => [$start = $now->startOfMonth()->toDateString(), $end = $now->endOfMonth()->toDateString()],
                                'last_month' => [$start = $now->copy()->subMonth()->startOfMonth()->toDateString(), $end = $now->copy()->subMonth()->endOfMonth()->toDateString()],
                                'this_year' => [$start = $now->startOfYear()->toDateString(), $end = $now->endOfYear()->toDateString()],
                                'last_year' => [$start = $now->copy()->subYear()->startOfYear()->toDateString(), $end = $now->copy()->subYear()->endOfYear()->toDateString()],
                            };

                            $adjusted = false;
                            $message = "";

                            if ($end > $maxDate) {
                                $end = $maxDate;
                                $adjusted = true;
                                $message = "Os dados mais recentes vão até " . Carbon::parse($maxDate)->format('d/m/Y') . ".";
                            }

                            if ($start < $minDate) {
                                $start = $minDate;
                                $adjusted = true;
                                $message = "O histórico mais antigo começa em " . Carbon::parse($minDate)->format('d/m/Y') . ".";
                            }

                            if ($start > $end) {
                                $start = $end;
                            }

                            $set('startDate', $start);
                            $set('endDate', $end);

                            // Dispara a reatividade do agrupamento
                            $autoGroup($start, $end, $set);

                            if ($adjusted) {
                                Notification::make()
                                    ->title('Período Ajustado Automaticamente')
                                    ->body($message)
                                    ->warning()
                                    ->send();
                            }
                        })
                        ->columnSpanFull(),

                    Grid::make(2)
                        ->schema([
                            DatePicker::make('startDate')
                                ->label('Data Inicial')
                                ->minDate($initialMinDate)
                                ->maxDate($initialMaxDate)
                                ->live()
                                ->afterStateUpdated(function (Set $set, Get $get, $state) use ($autoGroup) {
                                    $set('quick_range', 'custom');

                                    $cap = LegacyDataCapabilityService::analyze();
                                    $minDate = $cap['absolute_min_date'] ?? '2020-01-01';

                                    if ($state < $minDate) {
                                        $set('startDate', $minDate);
                                        $state = $minDate;
                                        Notification::make()->title('Ajustado')->body('A data inicial foi limitada ao primeiro registro disponível.')->warning()->send();
                                    }

                                    // Dispara a reatividade
                                    $autoGroup($state, $get('endDate'), $set);
                                })
                                ->required(),

                            DatePicker::make('endDate')
                                ->label('Data Final')
                                ->minDate(fn (Get $get) => $get('startDate') ?? $initialMinDate)
                                ->maxDate($initialMaxDate)
                                ->live()
                                ->afterStateUpdated(function (Set $set, Get $get, $state) use ($autoGroup) {
                                    $set('quick_range', 'custom');

                                    $cap = LegacyDataCapabilityService::analyze();
                                    $maxDate = $cap['absolute_max_date'] ?? now()->toDateString();

                                    if ($state > $maxDate) {
                                        $set('endDate', $maxDate);
                                        $state = $maxDate;
                                        Notification::make()->title('Ajustado')->body('A data final foi limitada ao último registro disponível.')->warning()->send();
                                    }

                                    // Dispara a reatividade
                                    $autoGroup($get('startDate'), $state, $set);
                                })
                                ->required(),
                        ]),
                ]),

            Section::make('Estratificações Avançadas')
                ->description('Ao usar estes filtros, a época da "caderneta" (V0) será ocultada dos cálculos.')
                ->icon('heroicon-o-funnel')
                ->schema([
                    ToggleButtons::make('time_grouping')
                        ->label('Agrupar Gráficos Por')
                        ->options([
                            'day' => 'Dia',
                            'week' => 'Semana',
                            'month' => 'Mês',
                            'year' => 'Ano', // 🚀 NOVA OPÇÃO
                        ])
                        ->default('day')
                        ->grouped()
                        ->colors([
                            'day' => 'primary',
                            'week' => 'info',
                            'month' => 'success',
                            'year' => 'warning',
                        ])
                        ->columnSpanFull(),

                    ToggleButtons::make('order_types')
                        ->label('Canais de Atendimento')
                        ->multiple()
                        ->inline()
                        ->options([
                            'delivery' => 'Delivery',
                            'counter' => 'Balcão / Retirada',
                            'table' => 'Consumo Local (Mesas)',
                        ])
                        ->columnSpanFull(),

                    ToggleButtons::make('payment_methods')
                        ->label('Formas de Pagamento')
                        ->multiple()
                        ->inline()
                        ->options(fn () => \App\Models\PaymentMethod::pluck('name', 'id')->toArray())
                        ->columnSpanFull(),
                ]),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Settings\Schemas\Partials;

use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;

use Filament\Schemas\Components\Actions;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

class FinancialSchema
{
    public static function make(): array
    {
        return [
            Section::make("Integração Sicredi (PIX)")
                ->description("Configuração para geração de PIX Dinâmico com baixa automática via Webhook.")
                ->icon('heroicon-o-banknotes')
                ->schema([
                    Toggle::make("sicredi_is_active")
                        ->label("Ativar Integração Sicredi")
                        ->live()
                        ->default(false)
                        ->columnSpanFull(),

                    // 🚀 VISIBILITY DIRETO NO GRID GARANTE REATIVIDADE PERFEITA!
                    Grid::make(2)
                        ->visible(fn(Get $get) => (bool) $get("sicredi_is_active"))
                        ->schema([
                            TextInput::make("sicredi_chave_pix")
                                ->label("Chave PIX")
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            TextInput::make("sicredi_client_id")
                                ->label("Client ID")
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            TextInput::make("sicredi_client_secret")
                                ->label("Client Secret")
                                ->password()
                                ->revealable()
                                ->columnSpan(2),

                            FileUpload::make("sicredi_cert_path")
                                ->label("Certificado (.pem / .crt)")
                                ->disk('local')
                                ->directory("certificates/sicredi")
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            FileUpload::make("sicredi_key_path")
                                ->label("Chave Privada (.key)")
                                ->disk('local')
                                ->directory("certificates/sicredi")
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            // 🚀 REGRAS DE NEGÓCIO DA OPERAÇÃO
                            Section::make("Canais de Cobrança PIX Dinâmico")
                                ->description("Defina em quais telas a equipe poderá gerar QR Codes do Sicredi diretamente para os clientes.")
                                ->schema([
                                    Toggle::make("sicredi_enable_driver_pix")
                                        ->label("Motoboy (Entregas)")
                                        ->helperText("Exibe o botão 'Receber com PIX' no painel do entregador para pedidos com saldo a cobrar.")
                                        ->default(true),

                                    Toggle::make("sicredi_enable_pos_pix")
                                        ->label("Caixa (PDV / Balcão)")
                                        ->helperText("Abre o modal de QR Code dinâmico quando a forma PIX Sicredi for selecionada no caixa.")
                                        ->default(true),

                                    Toggle::make("sicredi_enable_waiter_pix")
                                        ->label("Atendente (Mesas / Salão)")
                                        ->helperText("Exibe a ação 'Cobrar com PIX' no menu rápido de comandas e mesas.")
                                        ->default(true),
                                ])
                                ->columns(3)
                                ->columnSpanFull(),

                            Placeholder::make('dica_teste')
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->content(new HtmlString('<div class="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-warning-50 text-warning-700 dark:bg-warning-900/30 dark:text-warning-400 rounded-xl border border-warning-200 dark:border-warning-800 text-sm"><i class="heroicon-m-exclamation-triangle w-5 h-5"></i><span><b>Atenção:</b> Salve as configurações antes de realizar os testes.</span></div>'))
                                ->columnSpanFull(),

                            Actions::make([
                                Action::make('testar_handshake')
                                    ->label('Testar Conexão')
                                    ->icon('heroicon-m-signal')
                                    ->color('success')
                                    ->action(function () {
                                        try {
                                            $gateway = new \App\Services\Financial\Gateways\SicrediPixGateway();
                                            $result = $gateway->testHandshake();
                                            if ($result['success']) Notification::make()->title('Conexão Estabelecida!')->body(new HtmlString("{$result['message']}<br><b>Token:</b> {$result['token_preview']}"))->success()->send();
                                            else Notification::make()->title('Falha')->body($result['message'])->danger()->send();
                                        } catch (\Exception $e) { Notification::make()->title('Erro')->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send(); }
                                    }),

                                Action::make('testar_pix')
                                    ->label('Gerar PIX Teste')
                                    ->icon('heroicon-m-qr-code')
                                    ->color('info')
                                    ->action(function () {
                                        try {
                                            $gateway = new \App\Services\Financial\Gateways\SicrediPixGateway();
                                            $result = $gateway->generateTestPix();
                                            if ($result['success']) Notification::make()->title('PIX Gerado!')->body(new HtmlString("<b>TXID:</b> {$result['txid']}<br><span class='text-xs font-mono'>{$result['copia_e_cola']}</span>"))->success()->duration(20000)->send();
                                            else Notification::make()->title('Falha')->body($result['message'])->danger()->send();
                                        } catch (\Exception $e) { Notification::make()->title('Erro')->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send(); }
                                    }),
                            ])
                            ->columnSpanFull()
                            ->extraAttributes(['class' => 'mt-2 flex gap-3']),
                        ]),
                ]),
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/Settings/Schemas/Partials/IdentificationSchema.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Settings\Schemas\Partials;

use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Actions;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;

class IdentificationSchema
{
    public static function make(): array
    {
        return [
            Section::make("Instruções e Boas Práticas")
                ->icon("heroicon-o-information-circle")
                ->schema([
                    Placeholder::make('instrucoes')
                        ->hiddenLabel()
                        ->content(new HtmlString('
                            <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 bg-info-50 text-info-700 dark:bg-info-900/30 dark:text-info-400 rounded-xl border border-info-200 dark:border-info-800 text-sm">
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold mb-1">
                                    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                                    </svg>
                                    Antes de alterar os dados, preste atenção:
                                </div>
                                <ul class="list-disc list-inside space-y-1.5 ml-1">
                                    <li><b>Certificado Digital:</b> Envie apenas arquivos <code>.pfx</code>. Informe a senha <b>antes</b> ou <b>durante</b> o envio do arquivo.</li>
                                    <li><b>Travamento Fiscal:</b> Se o certificado for validado, o <b>CNPJ e Razão Social serão bloqueados</b>. Para corrigi-los, remova o certificado primeiro.</li>
                                    <li><b>Autopreenchimento de Endereço:</b> Digite o CEP e aguarde 1 segundo. O sistema preencherá a Rua, Bairro e os <b>códigos do IBGE</b> obrigatórios para a Sefaz.</li>
                                </ul>
                            </div>
                        ')),
                ]),

            Section::make("Identidade e Certificado")
                ->schema([
                    Grid::make(6)->schema([
                        TextInput::make("trade_name")->label("Nome Fantasia")->required()->columnSpan(2),
                        TextInput::make("app_name")->label("Nome do App")->helperText("Pode ser diferente do Fantasia")->required()->columnSpan(2),
                        TextInput::make("support_whatsapp")->label("WhatsApp de Suporte")->helperText("Apenas números com DDD")->mask("(99) 99999-9999")->stripCharacters(['(', ')', '-', ' '])->columnSpan(1),
                        TextInput::make("whatsapp_handle")->label("Usuário do WhatsApp (@)")->placeholder("Ex: pastelarianativa")->helperText("Se preenchido, os botões usarão este @ em vez do número.")->prefix('@')->columnSpan(1),
                        Hidden::make("certificate_path"),

                        Grid::make(2)->schema([
                            FileUpload::make("new_certificate")
                                ->label("Atualizar Certificado (.pfx)")
                                ->storeFiles(false)
                                ->acceptedFileTypes(['application/x-pkcs12', 'application/octet-stream'])
                                ->helperText('Ao salvar, os dados serão extraídos automaticamente.')
                                ->required(fn (Get $get) => $get('is_fiscal_emitter') && blank($get('certificate_expiration')))
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            TextInput::make("certificate_password")
                                ->label("Senha do Certificado")
                                ->password()
                                ->revealable()
                                ->dehydrated(fn($state) => filled($state))
                                ->helperText('Obrigatório ao enviar um novo arquivo.')
                                ->required(fn (Get $get) => filled($get('new_certificate')) || ($get('is_fiscal_emitter') && blank($get('certificate_expiration'))))
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            TextInput::make("certificate_expiration")
                                ->label("Certificado Válido Até")
                                ->readOnly()
                                ->dehydrated(false)
                                ->formatStateUsing(function ($state) {
                                    if (empty($state) || $state === 'Não identificado') return null;
                                    try { return \Carbon\Carbon::parse($state)->format('d/m/Y'); } catch (\Exception $e) { return null; }
                                })
                                ->visible(fn(Get $get) => filled($get("certificate_expiration")))
                                ->helperText(function (?CompanySetting $record, Get $get) {
                                    $expState = $get("certificate_expiration");
                                    if (empty($expState) || $expState === 'Não identificado') return null;
                                    try {
                                        $expiryDate = str_contains($expState, '/') ? \Carbon\Carbon::createFromFormat('d/m/Y', $expState)->startOfDay() : \Carbon\Carbon::parse($expState)->startOfDay();
                                        $today = now()->startOfDay();
                                        if ($today->greaterThan($expiryDate)) return new HtmlString('<span class="text-red-500 font-medium">⚠️ Certificado expirado!</span>');
                                        $days = (int) $today->diffInDays($expiryDate);
                                        if ($days <= 60) return new HtmlString('<span class="text-red-500 font-medium">⚠️ Atenção: Faltam apenas ' . $days . ' dias para expirar!</span>');
                                        return new HtmlString('<span class="text-success-600 font-medium">Faltam ' . $days . ' dias para expirar.</span>');
                                    } catch (\Exception $e) { return null; }
                                })
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            Actions::make([
                                Action::make("download_certificate")
                                    ->label("Baixar Cópia")
                                    ->icon("heroicon-o-arrow-down-tray")
                                    ->color("success")
                                    ->action(function () {
                                        $setting = CompanySetting::getCached();
                                        if ($setting && $setting->certificate_path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($setting->certificate_path)) {
                                            return Storage::disk('local')->download($setting->certificate_path, "certificado_atual.pfx");
                                        }
                                    }),

                                Action::make("clear_certificate")
                                    ->label("Remover do Cofre")
                                    ->icon("heroicon-o-trash")
                                    ->color("danger")
                                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                                    ->action(function (Set $set) {
                                        $setting = CompanySetting::first();
                                        if ($setting) {
                                            if ($setting->certificate_path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($setting->certificate_path)) Storage::disk('local')->delete($setting->certificate_path);
                                            $setting->update(['certificate_path' => null, 'certificate_expiration' => null, 'certificate_password' => null]);
                                        }
                                        $set("new_certificate", null); $set("certificate_path", null); $set("certificate_expiration", null); $set("certificate_password", null);
                                        Notification::make()->title("Certificado Removido")->success()->send();
                                    }),
                            ])->visible(fn(Get $get) => filled($get("certificate_expiration")))->columnSpan(1),
                        ])->columnSpanFull(),
                    ]),
                ]),

            Section::make("Identificação Fiscal e Endereço")
                ->description("Se houver um Certificado Digital ativo, Razão Social e CNPJ serão bloqueados para evitar rejeição da Sefaz. O endereço utiliza a base oficial do IBGE.")
                ->schema([
                    Grid::make(4)->schema([
                        TextInput::make("company_name")->label("Razão Social")->readOnly(fn(Get $get) => filled($get('certificate_expiration')))->columnSpan(2),
                        TextInput::make("cnpj")->label("CNPJ")->mask("99.999.999/9999-99")->readOnly(fn(Get $get) => filled($get('certificate_expiration')))->columnSpan(1),
                        TextInput::make("ie")->label("Inscrição Estadual (IE)")->numeric()->required(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_fiscal_emitter'))->helperText("Obrigatório para emissão de notas.")->columnSpan(1),
                        TextInput::make("zip_code")
                            ->label("CEP")
                            ->columnSpan(1)
                            ->mask("99999-999")
                            ->live(debounce: 500)
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function (?string $state, Set $set) {
                                if (!$state) return;
                                $cleanCep = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $state);
                                if (strlen($cleanCep) === 8) {
                                    $response = Http::get("https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cep/v2/{$cleanCep}");
                                    if ($response->successful()) {
                                        $data = $response->json();
                                        if (!empty($data['street'])) $set('street', $data['street']);
                                        if (!empty($data['neighborhood'])) $set('neighborhood', $data['neighborhood']);
                                        $set('state', $data['state'] ?? null);
                                        $set('ibge_code', $data['ibge'] ?? null);
                                        $set('city', $data['city'] ?? null);
                                    }
                                }
                            }),
                        TextInput::make("street")->label("Rua / Logradouro")->columnSpan(2),
                        TextInput::make("number")->label("Número")->columnSpan(1),
                        TextInput::make("neighborhood")->label("Bairro")->columnSpan(2),
                        Select::make("state")
                            ->label("Estado (UF)")
                            ->columnSpan(1)
                            ->searchable()
                            ->options(function () {
                                return Cache::remember('ufs_brasilapi', 86400, function () {
                                    $response = Http::get('https://brasilapi.com.br/api/ibge/uf/v1');
                                    return $response->successful() ? collect($response->json())->pluck('nome', 'sigla')->toArray() : [];
                                });
                            })
                            ->live()
                            ->afterStateUpdated(fn(Set $set) => $set('ibge_code', null)),
                        Select::make("ibge_code")
                            ->label("Cidade")
                            ->columnSpan(1)
                            ->searchable()
                            ->required(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_fiscal_emitter'))
                            ->options(function (Get $get) {
                                $uf = $get('state');
                                if (!$uf) return [];
                                return Cache::remember("ibge_cities_v2_{$uf}", 86400, function () use ($uf) {
                                    $response = Http::get("https://brasilapi.com.br/api/ibge/municipios/v1/{$uf}");
                                    return $response->successful() ? collect($response->json())->pluck('nome', 'codigo_ibge')->toArray() : [];
                                });
                            })
                            ->live()
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set, Get $get) {
                                if ($state) {
                                    $uf = $get('state');
                                    $cidades = Cache::get("ibge_cities_v2_{$uf}", []);
                                    if (isset($cidades[$state])) $set('city', $cidades[$state]);
                                }
                            }),
                        Hidden::make("city"),
                    ])
                ]),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Settings\Schemas\Partials;

use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Radio;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

class MarketingSchema
{
    public static function make(): array
    {
        return [
            Section::make("Programa de Fidelidade")
                ->description("Incentive a recompra recompensando os seus clientes mais fiéis.")
                ->schema([
                    Toggle::make('loyalty_is_active')
                        ->label('Ativar Programa de Fidelidade')
                        ->default(false)
                        ->live(),

                    Grid::make(3)
                        ->visible(fn(Get $get) => (bool) $get('loyalty_is_active'))
                        ->schema([
                            Radio::make('loyalty_reward_type')
                                ->label('Tipo de Recompensa')
                                ->options([
                                    'cashback' => 'Cashback (Saldo em R$ para a próxima compra)',
                                    'product'  => 'Cortesia (Trocar pontos por produtos específicos)',
                                ])
                                ->default('cashback')
                                ->live(),

                            Select::make('loyalty_accumulation_rule')
                                ->label('Regra de Acúmulo de Pontos')
                                ->options([
                                    'cart_value'                => 'Por Valor do Pedido (Ex: R$ 1 = 1 Ponto)',

                                ->default('manual')
                                ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('print_loyalty_flyer'))
                                ->columnSpanFull(),
```
