```php
                    // Aviso caso a fidelidade esteja desligada
                    Placeholder::make('loyalty_flyer_warning')
                        ->hiddenLabel()
                        ->content(new HtmlString('<div class="p-3 bg-warning-50 text-warning-700 rounded-xl text-sm"><i class="pi pi-exclamation-triangle mr-2"></i> O Flyer de Fidelidade/Cashback está oculto porque o Programa de Fidelidade está desativado.</div>'))
                        ->visible(fn(Get $get) => !(bool) $get('loyalty_is_active'))
                        ->columnSpanFull(),

                        Placeholder::make('divider')
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->content(new HtmlString('<hr class="my-2 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700" />'))
                            ->columnSpanFull(),

                    // 2. FLYER DE GROWTH (PRESENTE / INDICAÇÃO)
                    Grid::make(2)->schema([
                        Toggle::make('print_growth_flyer')
                            ->label('Imprimir Flyer de Presente (Growth)')
                            ->helperText('Gera um cupom descartável para o cliente presentear um amigo na primeira compra.')
                            ->live()
                            ->columnSpanFull(),

                        Radio::make('growth_flyer_mode')
                            ->label('Modo de Impressão')
                            ->options([
                                'auto' => 'Automático (Sempre imprime)',
                                'manual' => 'Manual (Perguntar antes)',
                            ])
                            ->inline()
                            ->default('manual')
                            ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('print_growth_flyer'))
                            ->columnSpanFull(),

                        TextInput::make('growth_flyer_value')
                            ->label('Valor do Cupom de Presente')
                            ->helperText('Quantos reais de desconto o amigo vai ganhar?')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->prefix('R$')
                            ->default(10.00)
                            ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('print_growth_flyer'))
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ]),
                ]),

        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/Settings/Schemas/Partials/SecuritySchema.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Settings\Schemas\Partials;

use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Forms\Components\ToggleButtons;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\CheckboxList;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Radio;
use Filament\Forms\Components\ViewField;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;

class SecuritySchema
{
    public static function make(): array
    {
        return [
            // ==========================================
            // 🛑 CONTROLE DE PERDAS OPERACIONAIS
            // ==========================================
            Section::make("Segurança e Controle de Perdas")
                ->description("Defina como o PDV deve lidar com ações críticas (estornos, cancelamentos, descontos). Ações liberadas com senha de gestor ficam gravadas no relatório de Auditoria.")
                ->schema([
                    ToggleButtons::make('pos_security_mode')
                        ->label('Nível de Segurança Operacional')
                        ->options([
                            'free' => new HtmlString('
                                <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center py-3 w-full">
                                    ' . Blade::render('<x-heroicon-o-lock-open class="w-8 h-8 mb-2"/>') . '
                                    <span class="font-black text-sm">Modo Livre</span>
                                    <span class="text-[11px] font-medium mt-1 leading-snug">Nenhuma ação exige senha.<br>Ideal para donos operando.</span>
                                </div>
                            '),
                            'standard' => new HtmlString('
                                <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center py-3 w-full">
                                    ' . Blade::render('<x-heroicon-o-shield-check class="w-8 h-8 mb-2"/>') . '
                                    <span class="font-black text-sm">Modo Padrão</span>
                                    <span class="text-[11px] font-medium mt-1 leading-snug">Senha apenas para perdas<br>(Estornos, Sangria).</span>
                                </div>
                            '),
                            'strict' => new HtmlString('
                                <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center py-3 w-full">
                                    ' . Blade::render('<x-heroicon-o-shield-exclamation class="w-8 h-8 mb-2"/>') . '
                                    <span class="font-black text-sm">Modo Estrito</span>
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Pages\Settings\Schemas\Partials;

use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;

class SupplyChainSchema

    {
        return [
            Section::make('Cadeia de Suprimentos & Produção (MRP)')
                ->description('Configure a inteligência de reposição e produção automática.')
                ->icon('heroicon-o-truck')
                ->schema([
                    Grid::make(2)->schema([
                        Select::make('demand_forecast_mode')
                            ->label('Estratégia de Reposição de Estoque')
                            ->options([
                                'manual_par'   => 'Estoque de Segurança Fixo (Par Level)',
                                'auto_history' => 'Inteligência de Histórico de Vendas',
                            ])
                            ->default('manual_par')
                            ->required(),

                        TextInput::make('production_buffer_days')
                            ->label('Margem de Segurança (Dias)')
                            ->helperText('Quantos dias de "gordura" a produção deve garantir.')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->default(1)
                            ->required(),

                        // 🚀 NOVO CAMPO: Modo de Reposição WMS
                        Select::make('wms_restock_mode')
                            ->label('Modo de Reposição WMS (Prateleiras & Salão)')
                            ->options([
                                'free'         => 'Modo Livre (Anotação / Bloco de Notas Local)',
                                'sales_driven' => 'Modo Puxado (Guiado por Vendas do Turno)',
                            ])
                            ->helperText('No Modo Livre, o atendente anota livremente o que falta trazer (salvo localmente). No Modo Puxado, o sistema exige a reposição exata dos itens vendidos no turno.')
                            ->default('free')
                            ->required()
                            ->columnSpanFull(),
                    ])
                ]),
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/ImportFiscalHistory.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use Filament\Pages\Page;
use Filament\Tables\Contracts\HasTable;
use Filament\Tables\Concerns\InteractsWithTable;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Actions\Action as PageAction;

// Page Actions (Cabeçalho)
use App\Filament\Pages\Actions\ImportV0ConsolidatedAction;
use App\Filament\Pages\Actions\ImportV1OrdersAction;
use App\Filament\Pages\Actions\ImportV2XmlAction;

// Table Actions (Linhas)
use App\Filament\Pages\Actions\MapFiscalDocumentsAction;
use App\Filament\Pages\Actions\UndoImportAction;

// Models
use App\Models\LegacyImportLog;

class ImportFiscalHistory extends Page implements HasTable
{
    use InteractsWithTable;

    protected static string|\BackedEnum|null $navigationIcon = "heroicon-o-archive-box-arrow-down";
    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = "Legado Fiscal";
    protected static ?string $navigationLabel = "Central de Importações";
    protected static ?int $navigationSort = 10;
    protected static ?string $title = "Importação de Dados Históricos";

    protected string $view = "filament.pages.import-fiscal-history";

    public function importConsolidatedAction(): PageAction
    {
        return ImportV0ConsolidatedAction::make();
    }

    public function importV1OrdersAction(): PageAction
    {
        return ImportV1OrdersAction::make();
    }

    public function importV2XmlAction(): PageAction
    {
        return ImportV2XmlAction::make();
    }

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->query(LegacyImportLog::query())
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make("created_at")
                    ->label("Data da Importação")
                    ->dateTime("d/m/Y H:i")
                    ->sortable(),
                TextColumn::make("import_tag")
                    ->label("Tag / Lote")
                    ->badge()
                    ->color("gray")
                    ->searchable(),
                TextColumn::make("type")
                    ->label("Conteúdo")
                    ->badge()
                    ->color("primary")
                    ->formatStateUsing(
                        fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                            "v0_consolidated" => "Faturamento Consolidado Diário",
                            "v1_detailed" => "Histórico de Pedidos (CSV)",
                            "v2_fiscal" => "Documentos Fiscais (XML)",
                            default => $state,
                        },
                    ),
                TextColumn::make("items_count")
                    ->label("Registros Extraídos")
                    ->numeric()
                    ->alignEnd(),
            ])
            ->defaultSort("created_at", "desc")
            ->actions([
                MapFiscalDocumentsAction::make(),
                UndoImportAction::make(),
            ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/LocalIntegration.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use Filament\Pages\Page;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\Printer;
use App\Models\PrintJob;
use App\Events\PrintJobCreated;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class LocalIntegration extends Page
{
    protected static string|\BackedEnum|null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-cpu-chip';
    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = 'Configurações';
    protected static ?string $title = 'Integração Local (Impressoras)';
    protected static ?string $navigationLabel = 'Integração Local';
    protected static ?int $navigationSort = 100;

    protected string $view = 'filament.pages.local-integration';

    public $bridgeToken;
    public $bridgeVersion;
    public $lastConnection;
    public $deepLink;

    public $windowsDownloadUrl;
    public $macDownloadUrl;

    public function mount()
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::first();

        if (empty($settings->print_bridge_token)) {
            $settings->update(['print_bridge_token' => Str::random(32)]);
            $settings->refresh();
        }

        $this->bridgeToken = $settings->print_bridge_token;
        $this->bridgeVersion = $settings->print_bridge_version ?? 'Nunca conectada';
        $this->lastConnection = $settings->print_bridge_connected_at
            ? $settings->print_bridge_connected_at->diffForHumans()
            : 'N/A';

        $domain = request()->getHost();
        $this->deepLink = "brasumeprint://setup?domain={$domain}&token={$this->bridgeToken}";

        $this->windowsDownloadUrl = asset('downloads/BrasumePrint-Setup.exe');
        $this->macDownloadUrl = asset('downloads/BrasumePrint-Mac.zip');
    }

    // 🚀 NOVO TESTE DE IMPRESSÃO INTELIGENTE
    public function testPrint(\App\Services\Terminals\OrderPrintService $printService)
    {
        try {
            $printService->dispatchTestPrint();
            Notification::make()->title('Comando enviado para a impressora do Caixa!')->success()->send();
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Notification::make()->title('Atenção!')->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send();
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use Filament\Pages\Page;
use Filament\Tables\Contracts\HasTable;
use Filament\Tables\Concerns\InteractsWithTable;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use App\Models\ProductCostHistory;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class ManageAutomations extends Page implements HasTable
{
    use InteractsWithTable;

    protected static string | \BackedEnum | null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-bolt';
    protected static string | \UnitEnum | null $navigationGroup = 'Estoque & Compras';
    protected static ?string $title = 'Regras de Automação';
    protected static ?int $navigationSort = 5;

    // Aponta para a view que criaremos no Passo 2
    protected string $view = 'filament.pages.manage-automations';

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->query(
                ProductCostHistory::query()
                    ->whereIn('id', function ($query) {
                        // 🚀 O SEGREDO: Subquery para driblar o strict_mode do MySQL e trazer 1 regra única por Produto+Fornecedor
                        $query->selectRaw('MAX(id)')
                            ->from('product_cost_histories')
                            ->where('auto_approve', true)
                            ->groupBy('supplier_id', 'xml_name');
                    })
                    ->latest('id')
            )
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('supplier.name')
                    ->label('Fornecedor')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->default('Desconhecido')
                    ->description(fn($record) => 'CNPJ: ' . ($record->supplier->document ?? 'N/A')),

                TextColumn::make('xml_name')
                    ->label('Produto na Nota (XML)')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->weight('bold')
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('product.name')
                    ->label('Insumo Vinculado')
                    ->color('primary')
                    ->weight('bold')
                    ->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Regra criada em')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),
            ])
            ->actions([
                Action::make('revogar')
                    ->label('Revogar Automação')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-trash')
                    ->color('danger')
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->modalHeading('Revogar Automação')
                    ->modalDescription('O robô deixará de dar entrada neste item automaticamente nas próximas notas. Esta ação não apaga o histórico de custos passado, apenas remove a permissão futura.')
                    ->modalSubmitActionLabel('Sim, Revogar')
                    ->action(function (ProductCostHistory $record) {

                        // 🚀 A MÁGICA DA REVOGAÇÃO: Limpa a flag de auto-aprovação de TODO o histórico desse item com esse fornecedor
                        ProductCostHistory::where('supplier_id', $record->supplier_id)
                            ->where('xml_name', $record->xml_name)
                            ->update(['auto_approve' => false]);

                        Notification::make()
                            ->title('Automação revogada com sucesso!')
                            ->success()
                            ->send();
                    })
            ])
            ->emptyStateHeading('Nenhuma regra de automação ativa')
            ->emptyStateDescription('Quando você marcar a opção "Aprovar automaticamente no futuro" na importação de notas, os robôs assumirão o controle e as regras aparecerão aqui.')
            ->emptyStateIcon('heroicon-o-bolt-slash');
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/AccountPayables/Actions/ReverseConciliationAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\Actions;

use Filament\Forms\Components\Radio;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use App\Models\BankStatement;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Services\Accounting\BankMatchScoringService; // 🚀 Import do Cérebro!
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;

class ReverseConciliationAction
{
    public static function configure($action)
    {
        return $action
            ->label('Buscar no Extrato')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-sparkles')
            ->color('warning')
            ->visible(fn (?AccountPayable $record) => $record && $record->status === 'pending')
            ->modalHeading('Conciliar com Transação Bancária')
            ->modalDescription('O sistema encontrou estas transações órfãs no banco com valores parecidos. Qual delas pagou esta conta?')
            ->modalWidth('5xl')
            ->extraModalWindowAttributes(["class" => "ux-conciliation-modal"])
            ->form(function (?AccountPayable $record) {
                if (!$record) return [];

                // 1. Busca todos os extratos num raio de 60 dias (para garantir que apanha atrasos longos)
                $statements = BankStatement::where('status', 'pending')
                    ->where('amount', '<', 0)
                    ->whereBetween('bank_date', [
                        $record->due_date->copy()->subDays(15),
                        $record->due_date->copy()->addDays(45)
                    ])
                    ->get();

                // 2. Chama o Cérebro de Conciliação!
                $service = new BankMatchScoringService();
                $scoredQueue = [];

                foreach ($statements as $stmt) {
                    $score = $service->calculateScore($stmt, $record);

                    // Se a pontuação for boa OU o valor bater perfeitamente ao cêntimo (como salvaguarda)
                    if ($score >= 30 || abs(abs($stmt->amount) - abs($record->amount)) < 0.05) {
                        $scoredQueue[] = [
                            'stmt' => $stmt,
                            'score' => $score
                        ];
                    }
                }

                // 3. Ordena os melhores e limita ao TOP 3 para não estourar o modal!
                usort($scoredQueue, function ($a, $b) use ($record) {
                    if ($a['score'] !== $b['score']) return $b['score'] <=> $a['score'];
                    return abs($a['stmt']->bank_date->diffInDays($record->due_date)) <=> abs($b['stmt']->bank_date->diffInDays($record->due_date));
                });

                $topMatches = array_slice($scoredQueue, 0, 3); // 🚀 LIMITADO A 3!

                $options = [];
                $descriptions = [];

                foreach ($topMatches as $match) {
                    $options[$match['stmt']->id] = " ";
                    $descriptions[$match['stmt']->id] = new HtmlString(
                        view('components.bank-statement-row', [
                            'statement' => $match['stmt'],
                            'score' => $match['score']
                        ])->render()
                    );
                }

                return [
                    Grid::make(12)->schema([
                        Placeholder::make('payable_info')
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->columnSpan(4)
                            ->content(fn() => new HtmlString(
                                view('components.account-payable-card', ['payable' => $record])->render()
                            )),

                        Grid::make(1)
                            ->columnSpan(8)
                            ->schema([
                                Radio::make('bank_statement_id')
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->options($options)
                                    ->descriptions($descriptions)
                                    ->visible(count($options) > 0)
                                    ->live()
                                    // Se selecionar uma sugestão, limpa o select manual
                                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn($state, Set $set) => filled($state) ? $set("manual_bank_statement_id", null) : null),

                                Placeholder::make("no_matches")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->visible(count($options) === 0)
                                    ->content(function () {
                                        $searchIcon = Blade::render('<x-heroicon-m-magnifying-glass class="w-12 h-12 mb-2 opacity-20"/>');
                                        return new HtmlString("<div class=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-xl text-gray-400 text-sm italic text-center\">{$searchIcon}A IA não encontrou sugestões com alta probabilidade.</div>");
                                    }),

                                // 🚀 O DIVISOR
                                Placeholder::make("divider")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->content(new HtmlString('<div class="relative flex items-center py-2"><div class="grow border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"></div><span class="shrink-0 mx-4 text-[10px] font-medium text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-center">Ou busque manualmente</span><div class="grow border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"></div></div>')),

                                // 🚀 O SELECT PARA A BUSCA MANUAL (NOVO!)
                                Select::make('manual_bank_statement_id')
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->placeholder("🔍 Pesquisar qualquer transação no extrato...")
                                    ->searchable()
                                    ->preload()
                                    ->live()
                                    // Se selecionar algo manual, limpa os botões de rádio
                                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn($state, Set $set) => filled($state) ? $set("bank_statement_id", null) : null)
                                    ->options(function () {
                                        return BankStatement::where('status', 'pending')
                                            ->where('amount', '<', 0)
                                            ->orderBy('bank_date', 'desc')
                                            ->limit(100) // Traz as 100 últimas para o dropdown ser rápido
                                            ->get()
                                            ->mapWithKeys(function ($s) {
                                                $date = $s->bank_date->format('d/m/Y');
                                                $val = number_format(abs($s->amount), 2, ',', '.');
                                                $desc = $s->counterparty_name ?: $s->description;
                                                return [$s->id => "{$date} | R$ {$val} | {$desc}"];
                                            });
                                    })
                            ]),
                    ])
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (AccountPayable $record, array $data, $livewire) {
                // 🚀 Pega o ID selecionado (seja da sugestão ou do manual)
                $selectedId = $data['manual_bank_statement_id'] ?? ($data['bank_statement_id'] ?? null);

                if (!$selectedId) {
                    Notification::make()->title('Selecione uma transação!')->warning()->send();
                    return;
                }

                $stmt = BankStatement::find($selectedId);
                if (!$stmt) return;

                $record->update([
                    'status' => 'paid',
                    'payment_date' => $stmt->bank_date,
                ]);

                $transaction = Transaction::create([
                    "type" => $stmt->type,
                    "amount" => abs((float) $stmt->amount),
                    "description" => $record->description,
                    "transaction_date" => clone $stmt->bank_date,
                    "supplier_id" => $record->supplier_id,
                ]);

                $stmt->update([
                    'status' => 'reconciled',
                    'conciliable_id' => $record->id,
                    'conciliable_type' => AccountPayable::class,
                    'transaction_id' => $transaction->id,
                ]);

                Notification::make()->title('Sincronizado com o Banco!')->success()->send();

                if ($livewire instanceof \Filament\Resources\Pages\EditRecord) {
                    $livewire->redirect(
                        \App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\AccountPayableResource::getUrl('edit', ['record' => $record])
                    );
                }
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/AccountPayables/Widgets/AccountPayablesCalendarWidget.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\Widgets;

use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use Saade\FilamentFullCalendar\Widgets\FullCalendarWidget;
use App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\AccountPayableResource;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Filament\Actions\Action; // <-- NOVA IMPORTAÇÃO AQUI!

class AccountPayablesCalendarWidget extends FullCalendarWidget
{
    protected function headerActions(): array
    {
        return [];
    }

    public function config(): array
    {
        return [
            "eventOrder" => "sortOrder",
        ];
    }

    // 1. ENSINAMOS O CALENDÁRIO A LER O NOSSO ID CUSTOMIZADO COM A ASSINATURA EXATA
    public function resolveRecord(
        string|int $key,
    ): \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model {
        if (is_string($key) && str_starts_with($key, "payable-")) {
            // Usa o findOrFail para garantir que devolve o Modelo (se não achar, dá erro 404 seguro)
            return AccountPayable::findOrFail(
                str_replace("payable-", "", $key),
            );
        }

        // Se por algum acaso bizarro tentar resolver outra coisa, interrompe de forma segura
        abort(404);
    }

    // 2. SUBSTITUÍMOS O MODAL POR UM REDIRECIONAMENTO DIRETO
    protected function viewAction(): Action
    {
        return Action::make("view")->url(
            fn($record) => $record
                ? AccountPayableResource::getUrl("edit", ["record" => $record])
                : null,
        );
    }

    public function fetchEvents(array $fetchInfo): array
    {
        $payables = AccountPayable::query()
            ->where("due_date", ">=", $fetchInfo["start"])
            ->where("due_date", "<=", $fetchInfo["end"])
            ->get();

        $supplierIds = $payables->pluck("supplier_id")->filter()->unique();
        $suppliers = Supplier::whereIn("id", $supplierIds)->get()->keyBy("id");

        $individualAccounts = $payables->map(function (
            AccountPayable $payable,
        ) use ($suppliers) {
            $supplier = $suppliers->get($payable->supplier_id);
            $rawSupplierName = $supplier->name ?? "S/ Fornec.";
            $supplierName = Str::limit($rawSupplierName, 12, "...");

            $value = number_format((float) $payable->amount, 2, ",", ".");

            $className = "event-warning";
            if ($payable->status === "paid") {
                $className = "event-success";
            } elseif (
                $payable->status === "pending" &&
                $payable->due_date < now()->startOfDay()
            ) {
                $className = "event-danger";
            }

            return [
                "id" => "payable-" . $payable->id,
                "title" => "{$supplierName} | R$ {$value}",
                "start" => $payable->due_date,
                // Mantemos a URL aqui por segurança, mas o viewAction acima é quem vai mandar no clique agora
                "url" => AccountPayableResource::getUrl("edit", [
                    "record" => $payable->id,
                ]),
                "className" => $className,
                "allDay" => true,
                "sortOrder" => 1,
            ];
        });

        $dailySummaries = AccountPayable::query()
            ->where("due_date", ">=", $fetchInfo["start"])
            ->where("due_date", "<=", $fetchInfo["end"])
            ->select("due_date", DB::raw("SUM(amount) as total_amount"))
            ->groupBy("due_date")
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($summary) {
                $total = number_format(
                    (float) $summary->total_amount,
                    2,
                    ",",
                    ".",
                );

                return [
                    "id" => "summary-" . $summary->due_date,
                    "title" => "R$ {$total}",
                    "start" => $summary->due_date,
                    "className" => "event-daily-summary",
                    "allDay" => true,
                    "sortOrder" => 99,
                ];
            });

        return $individualAccounts->concat($dailySummaries)->toArray();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\AccountReceivables\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Grouping\Group;
use Filament\Actions\Action;

class AccountReceivablesTable 
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table 
    {
        return $table
            ->defaultGroup('due_date')
            ->groups([
                Group::make('due_date')->label('Data de Previsão')->date(),
                Group::make('bankAccount.name')->label('Conta Bancária'),
                Group::make('status')->label('Status'),
            ])
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('due_date')->label('Previsão')->date('d/m/Y')->sortable(),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('description')->label('Descrição')->searchable(),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('payment_method')
                    ->label('Método')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color('primary')
                    ->searchable(),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('bankAccount.name')->label('Destino')->badge()->color('info')->searchable(),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('gross_amount')->label('Venda')->money('BRL')->color('gray'),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('net_amount')->label('Líquido')->money('BRL')->weight('bold')->sortable(),
                
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('status')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'pending' => 'A Receber',
                        'paid' => 'Caiu na Conta',
                        'anticipated' => 'Antecipado',
                        'cancelled' => 'Cancelado',
                        default => $state,
                    })
                    ->colors([
                        'warning' => 'pending',
                        'success' => fn ($state) => in_array($state, ['paid', 'anticipated']),
                        'danger' => 'cancelled',
                    ]),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('due_date', 'asc')
            ->filters([
                Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make('status')->options([
                    'pending' => 'A Receber',
                    'paid' => 'Caiu na Conta',
                    'anticipated' => 'Antecipado',
                ]),
            ])
            ->actions([
                // O Botão Mágico para dar baixa rápida do que pingou na conta!
                \Filament\Actions\Action::make('receber')
                    ->label('Dar Baixa')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-check-circle')
                    ->color('success')
                    ->visible(fn ($record) => $record->status === 'pending')
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->form([
                        \Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker::make('payment_date')
                            ->label('Data do Crédito no Banco')
                            ->default(now())
                            ->required(),
                    ])
                    ->action(function ($record, array $data) {
                        $record->update([
                            'status' => 'paid',
                            'payment_date' => $data['payment_date'],
                        ]);
                    }),
                    
                \Filament\Actions\EditAction::make()->iconButton(),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                \Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup::make([
                    \Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankAccounts\RelationManagers;

use Filament\Forms;
use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Resources\RelationManagers\RelationManager;

use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\Summarizers\Summarizer;
use Filament\Tables\Grouping\Group;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Filter;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class AccountReceivablesRelationManager extends RelationManager
{
    protected static string $relationship = 'accountReceivables';
    protected static ?string $title = 'Recebimentos (Fluxo de Caixa)';
    protected static string | \BackedEnum | null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-arrow-trending-up';

    public function table(Table $table): Table
        {
            return $table
                // 🚀 A MÁGICA 3.0: Derived Tables (Subconsultas)
                // Embrulhamos a tabela numa subconsulta pura. O MySQL agora reconhecerá os aliases no WHERE!
                ->modifyQueryUsing(function (Builder $query) {
                    $subquery = DB::table('account_receivables')
                        ->select('account_receivables.*')
                        ->selectRaw('DATE_FORMAT(due_date, "%Y-%m") as due_month')
                        ->selectRaw('DATE_FORMAT(due_date, "%x-W%v") as due_week');

                    return $query->fromSub($subquery, 'account_receivables');
                })

                ->recordTitleAttribute('description')
                ->defaultGroup('due_date')
                ->groupsOnly()

                // 🚀 OS TRÊS NÍVEIS DE AGRUPAMENTO (BI)
                ->groups([
                    Group::make('due_date')
                        ->label('Por Dia')
                        ->date('d/m/Y')
                        ->collapsible(),

                    Group::make('due_week')
                        ->label('Por Semana')
                        ->orderQueryUsing(fn (Builder $query, string $direction) => $query->orderBy('due_date', $direction))
                        ->getTitleFromRecordUsing(fn ($record) => $record->due_date ? 'Semana ' . Carbon::parse($record->due_date)->format('W / Y') : 'Sem data')
                        ->collapsible(),

                    Group::make('due_month')
                        ->label('Por Mês')
                        ->orderQueryUsing(fn (Builder $query, string $direction) => $query->orderBy('due_date', $direction))
                        ->getTitleFromRecordUsing(fn ($record) => $record->due_date ? Carbon::parse($record->due_date)->format('m / Y') : 'Sem data')
                        ->collapsible(),
                ])
                ->columns([

                    // ==========================================
                    // COLUNAS DE TEXTO COM ÂNCORAS INVISÍVEIS (ALINHAMENTO)
                    // ==========================================
                    Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('due_date')
                        ->label('Previsão')
                        ->date('d/m/Y')
                        ->sortable()
                        ->summarize(
                            Summarizer::make()
                                ->label('Totais do Grupo')
                                ->using(fn () => new HtmlString('&nbsp;'))
                        ),

                    Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('description')
                        ->label('Origem / Venda')
                        ->searchable()
                        ->summarize(
                            Summarizer::make()
                                ->label('')
                                ->using(fn () => new HtmlString('&nbsp;'))
                        ),

                    Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('payment_method')
                        ->label('Forma Pgto.')
                        ->badge()
                        ->color('gray')
                        ->summarize(
                            Summarizer::make()
                                ->label('')
                                ->using(fn () => new HtmlString('&nbsp;'))
                        ),

                    // ==========================================
                    // COLUNAS FINANCEIRAS COM SOMA SILENCIOSA
                    // ==========================================
                    Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('gross_amount')
                        ->label('Valor Bruto')
                        ->money('BRL')
                        ->color('gray')
                        ->size('sm')
                        ->summarize(
                            Summarizer::make()
                                ->using(fn ($query) => $query->sum('gross_amount'))
                                ->money('BRL')
                        ),

                    Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('fee_amount')
                        ->label('Taxa (-)')
                        ->money('BRL')
                        ->color('danger')
                        ->size('sm')
                        ->summarize(
                            Summarizer::make()
                                ->using(fn ($query) => $query->sum('fee_amount'))
                                ->money('BRL')
                        ),

                    Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('net_amount')
                        ->label('Líquido Esperado')
                        ->money('BRL')
                        ->weight('bold')
                        ->color('success')
                        ->summarize(
                            Summarizer::make()
                                ->using(fn ($query) => $query->sum('net_amount'))
                                ->money('BRL')
                        ),

                    // ==========================================
                    // STATUS E O TERMÔMETRO DE SAÚDE (BI)
                    // ==========================================
                    Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('status')
                        ->label('Status')
                        ->badge()
                        ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                            'pending' => 'A Receber',
                            'paid' => 'Realizado',
                            'anticipated' => 'Antecipado',
                            'cancelled' => 'Cancelado',
                            default => $state,
                        })
                        ->colors([
                            'warning' => 'pending',
                            'success' => 'paid',
                            'info' => 'anticipated',
                            'danger' => 'cancelled',
                        ])
                        ->summarize(
                            Summarizer::make()
                                ->using(function ($query) {
                                    // 1. O total que deveria cair na conta neste período
                                    $totalAmount = (clone $query)->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')->sum('net_amount');

                                    // 2. O total que já caiu na conta
                                    $paidAmount = (clone $query)->whereIn('status', ['paid', 'anticipated'])->sum('net_amount');

                                    // Se não houver valor, mantemos a âncora vazia para não quebrar o layout
                                    if ($totalAmount <= 0) return new HtmlString('&nbsp;');

                                    // 3. Calcula a percentagem
                                    $percent = round(($paidAmount / $totalAmount) * 100);

                                    // 4. Retorna a Badge Sintética baseada na saúde
                                    if ($percent == 100) {
                                        return new HtmlString('<span class="text-success-600 font-medium uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider">100% Recebido</span>');
                                    } elseif ($percent == 0) {
                                        return new HtmlString('<span class="text-danger-600 font-medium uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider">0% Recebido</span>');
                                    } else {
                                        return new HtmlString("<span class='text-warning-600 font-medium uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider'>{$percent}% Recebido</span>");
                                    }
                                })
                        ),
                ])
                ->filters([
                    Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make('status')
                        ->label('Situação')
                        ->options([
                            'pending' => 'A Receber (Esperado)',
                            'paid' => 'Realizado (Caiu na Conta)',
                        ]),

                    Filter::make('due_date_filter')
                        ->label('Filtrar Período')
                        ->form([
                            Grid::make(2)->schema([
                                DatePicker::make('created_from')->label('De (Previsão)'),
                                DatePicker::make('created_until')->label('Até (Previsão)'),
                            ])
                        ])
                        ->query(function (Builder $query, array $data): Builder {
                            return $query
                                ->when(
                                    $data['created_from'],
                                    fn (Builder $query, $date): Builder => $query->whereDate('due_date', '>=', $date),
                                )
                                ->when(
                                    $data['created_until'],
                                    fn (Builder $query, $date): Builder => $query->whereDate('due_date', '<=', $date),
                                );
                        }),
                ])
                ->defaultSort('due_date', 'asc');
        }
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\CheckboxList;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Group;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Number;
use App\Models\BankStatement;
use App\Services\Accounting\BankReconciliationService;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Schemas\ConciliationTabsSchema;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;

class AutoConciliateBatchAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'auto_conciliate_batch';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('Automação')
            ->color('warning')
            ->icon('heroicon-m-bolt')
            ->button()
            // Só aparece se houver pendências (evita processamento desnecessário)
            ->visible(fn () => BankStatement::where('status', 'pending')->where('amount', '<', 0)->exists())
            ->modalHeading('Conciliação Rápida em Lote')
            ->modalDescription('A nossa inteligência varreu as suas pendências e encontrou estes vínculos prováveis. Desmarque os que não fizerem sentido, ou aprove todos de uma só vez.')
            ->modalSubmitActionLabel('Aprovar e Conciliar')
            ->modalWidth('6xl')
            ->schema(function () {
                $options = [];
                $service = new BankMatchScoringService();

                // Busca todas as saídas pendentes
                $pendingStatements = BankStatement::where('status', 'pending')
                    ->where('amount', '<', 0)
                    ->get();

                foreach ($pendingStatements as $stmt) {
                    $matches = $service->findMatchesFor($stmt);

                    if ($matches->isNotEmpty()) {
                        $bestMatch = $matches->first();

                        // Só mostra sugestões com uma confiança decente (>= 50%)
                        if ($bestMatch['score'] >= 50) {
                            $payable = $bestMatch['candidate'];
                            $score = $bestMatch['score'];

                            // 1. Dados do Extrato (Banco)
                            $stmtDate = $stmt->bank_date->format('d/m/Y');
                            $stmtName = $stmt->counterparty_name ?? $stmt->description;
                            $stmtAmt = Number::format(abs((float)$stmt->amount), maxPrecision: 2, locale: 'pt_BR');

                            // 2. Dados do Sistema (AccountPayable)
                            $payableDate = \Carbon\Carbon::parse($payable->due_date)->format('d/m/Y');
                            $payableName = $payable->supplier->name ?? ($payable->employee->name ?? 'Fornecedor S/N');
                            $payableAmt = Number::format(abs((float)$payable->amount), maxPrecision: 2, locale: 'pt_BR');

                            $badgeColor = $score >= 80 ? 'text-success-700 bg-success-100' : 'text-warning-700 bg-warning-100';

                            // 🚀 O SEU LAYOUT DE FLEXBOX APLICADO AQUI!
                            $label = "
                                <div style='display: flex; width: 100%; gap: 1rem; align-items: center;' class='text-sm py-1.5 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 border-dashed'>
                                    <div style='flex: 2; min-width: 0;' class='text-gray-500 font-medium'>
                                        {$stmtDate}
                                    </div>
                                    <div style='flex: 4; min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;' class='font-semibold' title='{$stmtName}'>
                                        {$stmtName}
                                    </div>
                                    <div style='flex: 2; min-width: 0;' class='text-danger-600 font-medium'>
                                        R$ {$stmtAmt}
                                    </div>
                                    <div style='flex: 4; min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;' class='font-medium' title='{$payableName}'>
                                        {$payableName} <span class='ml-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-medium {$badgeColor}'>{$score}% Match</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div style='flex: 2; min-width: 0;' class='text-gray-500 font-medium'>
                                        {$payableDate}
                                    </div>
                                    <div style='flex: 2; text-align: right; min-width: 0;' class='font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100'>
                                        R$ {$payableAmt}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            ";

                            $options[$stmt->id . '::' . $payable->id] = new HtmlString($label);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Se a IA não achar absolutamente nada:
                if (empty($options)) {
                    $sadIcon = Blade::render('<x-heroicon-o-face-frown class="w-12 h-12 mb-2 opacity-30"/>');
                    return [
                        Placeholder::make('no_matches')
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->content(new HtmlString("
                                <div class='flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-xl text-gray-400 text-sm italic text-center'>
                                    {$sadIcon}
                                    A nossa inteligência não encontrou correspondências seguras para as pendências atuais.<br>Tente conciliar manualmente usando as outras opções.
                                </div>
                            "))
                    ];
                }

                return [
                    Grid::make(1)->schema([
                        Group::make([
                            Placeholder::make('table_header')
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->content(new HtmlString("
                                    <style>
                                        .smart-match-list { width: 100% !important; }
                                        .smart-match-list > div { width: 100% !important; display: block !important; }
                                        .smart-match-list label.fi-checkbox-list-option { width: 100% !important; display: flex !important; max-width: none !important; align-items: center; }
                                        .smart-match-list .fi-checkbox-list-option-label { width: 100% !important; flex: 1 1 auto !important; max-width: none !important; }
                                        .fi-fo-checkbox-list .fi-fo-checkbox-list-option .fi-fo-checkbox-list-option-text { width: 100%;}
                                    </style>

                                    <div style='display: flex; width: 100%; gap: 1rem; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; padding-left: 2.25rem;' class='text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 border-b border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700'>
                                        <div style='flex: 2;'>Data (Banco)</div>
                                        <div style='flex: 4;'>Contraparte</div>
                                        <div style='flex: 2;'>Valor (Banco)</div>
                                        <div style='flex: 4;'>Fornecedor (Sistema)</div>
                                        <div style='flex: 2;'>Vencimento</div>
                                        <div style='flex: 2; text-align: right;'>Valor (Sistema)</div>
                                    </div>
                                ")),

                            CheckboxList::make('approved_matches')
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->options($options)
                                ->default(array_keys($options)) // Deixa todas marcadas por padrão!
                                ->bulkToggleable()
                                ->columns(1)
                                ->extraAttributes([
                                    'class' => 'smart-match-list max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto pr-2',
                                ]),
                        ])->columnSpanFull()
                    ])
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (array $data) {
                $approvedMatches = $data['approved_matches'] ?? [];

                if (empty($approvedMatches)) {
                    Notification::make()->title('Nenhuma ação realizada.')->warning()->send();
                    return;
                }

                $count = 0;

                foreach ($approvedMatches as $matchKey) {
                    [$stmtId, $payableId] = explode('::', $matchKey);

                    $statement = BankStatement::find($stmtId);
                    if (!$statement) continue;

                    // O motor perfeito que criámos anteriormente
                    ConciliationTabsSchema::processConciliation(
                        ['existing_payable_id' => 'payable_' . $payableId],
                        $statement
                    );

                    $count++;
                }

                Notification::make()
                    ->title("{$count} transações auto-conciliadas com sucesso!")
                    ->success()
                    ->send();
            });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\BulkAction;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use App\Services\Accounting\BankReconciliationService;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Services\Accounting\AccountingService;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class BulkEmployeeAction extends BulkAction
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'bulk_employee';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('Lançar Colaborador em Lote')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-users')
            ->color('info')
            ->form([
                Select::make('employee_id')
                    ->label('Colaborador')
                    ->options(\App\Models\Employee::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                    ->searchable()
                    ->required(),

                TextInput::make('description')
                    ->label('Descrição Padrão')
                    ->placeholder('Ex: Adiantamento Quinzenal, Salário')
                    ->helperText('Se deixar em branco, usaremos a descrição do extrato.'),

                Select::make("accounting_category")
                    ->label("Categoria DRE")
                    ->options(AccountingService::getCategories())
                    ->live()
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn(Set $set) => $set("accounting_subcategory", null))
                    ->required(),

                Select::make("accounting_subcategory")
                    ->label("Subcategoria")
                    ->options(fn(Get $get) => AccountingService::getSubcategories($get("accounting_category")))
                    ->required()
                    ->disabled(fn(Get $get) => !$get("accounting_category")),
            ])
            ->action(function (Collection $records, array $data) {
                            $employee = \App\Models\Employee::find($data['employee_id']);
                            $count = 0;

                            foreach ($records as $stmt) {
                                if ($stmt->status !== 'pending' || $stmt->amount >= 0) continue;

                                $desc = !empty($data['description'])
                                    ? $data['description'] . " - " . ($stmt->counterparty_name ?: '')
                                    : $stmt->description;

                                $payable = AccountPayable::create([
                                    "description" => $desc,
                                    "employee_id" => $employee->id,
                                    "amount" => abs((float) $stmt->amount),
                                    "due_date" => $stmt->bank_date,
                                    "accounting_category" => $data['accounting_category'],
                                    "accounting_subcategory" => $data['accounting_subcategory'],
                                ]);

                                // 🚀 O MOTOR FAZ A MÁGICA (Passamos null no Supplier)
                                BankReconciliationService::finalize($stmt, $payable, null, $desc);
                                $count++;
                            }

                            Notification::make()->title("{$count} pagamentos a colaboradores conciliados!")->success()->send();
                        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\BulkAction;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use App\Services\Accounting\BankReconciliationService;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Services\Accounting\AccountingService;
use App\Filament\Resources\Suppliers\Schemas\SupplierForm; // 🚀 IMPORT DO SEU FORMULÁRIO OFICIAL
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class BulkExpenseAction extends BulkAction
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'bulk_expense';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('Lançar Despesas em Lote')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-document-duplicate')
            ->color('primary')
            // 🚀 1. Transformamos num Closure para ler os extratos selecionados
            ->form(function (Collection $records) {

                // 🚀 2. A MÁGICA: Extrai os dados do banco
                $stmt = $records->first();
                $defaultDoc = $stmt ? preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $stmt->document) : null;
                $defaultName = $stmt ? ($stmt->counterparty_name ?: $stmt->description) : null;

                return [
                    Select::make('supplier_id')
                        ->label('Fornecedor')
                        ->options(Supplier::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                        ->searchable()
                        ->required()
                        // 🚀 3. O SEU FORMULÁRIO OFICIAL COMPLETO
                        ->createOptionForm(SupplierForm::getFormSchema())
                        ->createOptionUsing(
                            fn(array $data) => Supplier::create($data)->id
                        )
                        // 🚀 4. A INJEÇÃO DE DADOS (Preenche o modal antes de abrir)
                        ->createOptionAction(
                            fn (Action $action) => $action->mountUsing(function (Schema $form) use ($defaultDoc, $defaultName) {
                                $form->fill([
                                    'document' => $defaultDoc,
                                    'name' => $defaultName,
                                    'document_name' => $defaultName,
                                    'type' => 'physical',
                                    'is_active' => true,
                                    'is_formal' => true,
                                ]);
                            })
                        )
                        ->live()
                        ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set) {
                            if ($state && ($sup = Supplier::find($state))) {
                                $set("accounting_category", $sup->accounting_category);
                                $set("accounting_subcategory", $sup->accounting_subcategory);
                            }
                        }),

                    TextInput::make('description')
                        ->label('Descrição Padrão')
                        ->placeholder('Deixe em branco para usar o nome do extrato'),

                    Select::make("accounting_category")
                        ->label("Categoria DRE")
                        ->options(AccountingService::getCategories())
                        ->live()
                        ->afterStateUpdated(fn($set) => $set("accounting_subcategory", null))
                        ->required(),

                    Select::make("accounting_subcategory")
                        ->label("Subcategoria")
                        ->options(fn($get) => AccountingService::getSubcategories($get("accounting_category")))
                        ->required()
                        ->disabled(fn($get) => !$get("accounting_category")),
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (Collection $records, array $data) {
                            $supplier = Supplier::find($data['supplier_id']);
                            $count = 0;

                            foreach ($records as $stmt) {
                                if ($stmt->status !== 'pending' || $stmt->amount >= 0) continue;

                                $desc = !empty($data['description']) ? $data['description'] . " - " . $stmt->counterparty_name : $stmt->description;

                                $payable = AccountPayable::create([
                                    "description" => $desc,
                                    "supplier_id" => $supplier->id,
                                    "amount" => abs((float) $stmt->amount),
                                    "due_date" => $stmt->bank_date,
                                    "accounting_category" => $data['accounting_category'],
                                    "accounting_subcategory" => $data['accounting_subcategory'],
                                ]);

                                // 🚀 O MOTOR FAZ A MÁGICA
                                BankReconciliationService::finalize($stmt, $payable, $supplier->id);

                                if (!empty($stmt->counterparty_name)) {
                                    $supplier->update(['document_name' => $stmt->counterparty_name]);
                                }
                                $count++;
                            }

                            Notification::make()->title("{$count} despesas conciliadas em lote!")->success()->send();
                        });
    }
}
```

```php
class BulkPersonalAction extends BulkAction

    {

            ->modalHeading('Lançar Despesas Pessoais em Lote')

                    ->default(false),

                Select::make('supplier_id')
                    ->label('Favorecido / Sócio')
                    ->options(Supplier::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                    ->searchable()
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('identify_supplier'))
                    ->required(fn(Get $get) => $get('identify_supplier'))
                    ->createOptionForm([
                        Section::make("Novo Favorecido")
                            ->schema(\App\Filament\Resources\Suppliers\Schemas\SupplierForm::getFormSchema())
                    ])
                    ->createOptionUsing(
                        fn(array $data) => \App\Models\Supplier::create($data)->id
                    ),

                TextInput::make('description')
                    ->label('Descrição')
                    ->placeholder('Ex: PIX Avó, Lanche')
                    ->helperText('Se deixar em branco, manteremos o nome que veio do banco.'),
            ])
            ->action(function (Collection $records, array $data) {
                            if (!empty($data['identify_supplier']) && !empty($data['supplier_id'])) {
                                $supplierId = $data['supplier_id'];
                            } else {
                                $genericSupplier = Supplier::firstOrCreate(
                                    ['name' => 'Uso Pessoal / Sócios'],
                                    ['type' => 'physical', 'is_personal' => true, 'accounting_category' => 'socios', 'accounting_subcategory' => 'pessoal', 'is_active' => true]
                                );
                                $supplierId = $genericSupplier->id;
                            }

                            $count = 0;

                            foreach ($records as $stmt) {
                                if ($stmt->status !== 'pending' || $stmt->amount >= 0) continue;

                                $finalDescription = !empty($data['description'])
                                    ? $data['description'] . " - " . $stmt->counterparty_name
                                    : "Uso Pessoal: " . ($stmt->counterparty_name ?? $stmt->description);

                                $payable = AccountPayable::create([
                                    "description" => $finalDescription,
                                    "supplier_id" => $supplierId,
                                    "amount" => abs((float) $stmt->amount),
                                    "due_date" => $stmt->bank_date,
                                    "is_personal" => true,
                                    "accounting_category" => "socios",
                                    "accounting_subcategory" => "pessoal",
                                ]);

                                // 🚀 O MOTOR FAZ A MÁGICA
                                BankReconciliationService::finalize($stmt, $payable, $supplierId, $finalDescription);
                                $count++;
                            }

                            Notification::make()->title("{$count} transações marcadas como Uso Pessoal!")->success()->send();
                        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions;


use App\Enums\RecurringExpenseValueType;use Filament\Actions\BulkAction;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use App\Models\RecurringExpense;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Services\Accounting\AccountingService;
use App\Filament\Resources\Suppliers\Schemas\SupplierForm; // 🚀 IMPORT DO SEU FORMULÁRIO OFICIAL
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use App\Services\Accounting\BankReconciliationService;

class BulkRecurringAction extends BulkAction
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'bulk_recurring';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('Vincular a Conta Recorrente')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-arrow-path-rounded-square')
            ->color('warning')
            ->modalHeading('Vincular a Conta Fixa em Lote')
            ->modalDescription('Selecione o contrato. O sistema gerará as contas a pagar para as transações selecionadas puxando a DRE correta automaticamente.')
            ->form(function (Collection $records) {

                // 🚀 A MÁGICA DE LEITURA DO OFX: Pega o primeiro extrato selecionado
                $stmt = $records->first();
                $defaultDoc = $stmt ? preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $stmt->document) : null;
                $defaultName = $stmt ? ($stmt->counterparty_name ?: $stmt->description) : null;

                return [
                    Select::make('recurring_expense_id')
                        ->label('Contrato / Conta Fixa')
                        ->options(fn() => RecurringExpense::where('is_active', true)->get()->mapWithKeys(fn($f) => [$f->id => ($f->supplier->name ?? "S/F") . " - " . $f->name]))
                        ->searchable()
                        ->required()
                        // 🚀 1ª CAMADA: Criar o Contrato/Conta Recorrente na hora
                        ->createOptionForm([
                            TextInput::make('name')
                                ->label('Nome do Contrato / Conta')
                                ->placeholder('Ex: Internet Fibra Vivo')
                                ->default($defaultName) // Já sugere o nome do banco como nome do contrato
                                ->required(),

                            Select::make('supplier_id')
                                ->label('Fornecedor Vinculado')
                                ->options(fn() => Supplier::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                                ->searchable()
                                ->required()
                                // 🚀 2ª CAMADA: RESTAURAMOS O SEU QUICK CREATE OFICIAL AQUI!
                                ->createOptionForm(SupplierForm::getFormSchema())
                                ->createOptionUsing(fn (array $data) => Supplier::create($data)->id)
                                // 🚀 A MÁGICA DA INJEÇÃO: Preenchemos o modal do fornecedor antes de ele abrir
                                ->createOptionAction(
                                    fn (Action $action) => $action->mountUsing(function (Schema $form) use ($defaultDoc, $defaultName) {
                                        $form->fill([
                                            'document' => $defaultDoc,
                                            'name' => $defaultName,
                                            'document_name' => $defaultName,
                                            'type' => 'physical',
                                            'is_active' => true,
                                            'is_formal' => true,
                                        ]);
                                    })
                                ),

                            Grid::make(2)->schema([
                                Select::make('accounting_category')
                                    ->label('Categoria DRE')
                                    ->options(AccountingService::getCategories())
                                    ->live()
                                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn($set) => $set('accounting_subcategory', null))
                                    ->required(),

                                Select::make('accounting_subcategory')
                                    ->label('Subcategoria')
                                    ->options(fn($get) => AccountingService::getSubcategories($get('accounting_category')))
                                    ->required()
                                    ->disabled(fn($get) => !$get('accounting_category')),
                            ]),

                            Grid::make(2)->schema([
                                TextInput::make('due_day')
                                    ->label('Dia de Vencimento')
                                    ->numeric()
                                    ->minValue(1)
                                    ->maxValue(31)
                                    ->required(),

                                Select::make('value_type')
                                    ->label('Tipo de Valor')
                                    ->options(RecurringExpenseValueType::class)
                                    ->default('variable')
                                    ->required(),
                            ]),
                        ])
                        ->createOptionUsing(function (array $data) {
                            $data['is_auto_debit'] = false;
                            $data['account_holder'] = 'company';
                            $data['paid_by'] = 'company';
                            $data['is_personal'] = false;
                            $data['is_active'] = true;
                            return RecurringExpense::create($data)->id;
                        }),
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (Collection $records, array $data) {
                            $fixed = RecurringExpense::find($data['recurring_expense_id']);
                            $count = 0;

                            foreach ($records as $stmt) {
                                if ($stmt->status !== 'pending' || $stmt->amount >= 0) continue;

                                $desc = $fixed->name . " (" . $stmt->bank_date->format("M/Y") . ")";

                                $payable = AccountPayable::create([
                                    "description" => $desc,
                                    "amount" => abs((float) $stmt->amount),
                                    "supplier_id" => $fixed->supplier_id,
                                    "recurring_expense_id" => $fixed->id,
                                    "accounting_category" => $fixed->accounting_category,
                                    "accounting_subcategory" => $fixed->accounting_subcategory,
                                    "due_date" => $stmt->bank_date,
                                ]);

                                // 🚀 O MOTOR FAZ A MÁGICA
                                BankReconciliationService::finalize($stmt, $payable, $fixed->supplier_id);
                                $count++;
                            }

                            Notification::make()->title("{$count} transações vinculadas à conta fixa!")->success()->send();
                        });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/BankStatements/Actions/BulkTransferAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\BulkAction;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use App\Models\BankAccount;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use App\Services\Accounting\BankReconciliationService;

class BulkTransferAction extends BulkAction
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'bulk_transfer';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('Transferência em Lote (Cartões/Contas)')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-arrows-right-left')
            ->color('success')
            ->modalHeading('Transferência entre Contas / Pagamento de Fatura')
            ->modalDescription('As transações selecionadas serão liquidadas como transferências (sem impacto na DRE) e o saldo será movido para a conta de destino.')
            ->form([
                Select::make('target_account_id')
                    ->label('Conta de Destino / Origem')
                    ->helperText('Selecione o Cartão de Crédito ou a Conta Bancária que recebeu/enviou estes valores.')
                    ->options(BankAccount::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                    ->searchable()
                    ->required(),

                TextInput::make('description')
                    ->label('Descrição Padrão')
                    ->placeholder('Ex: Pagamento Fatura Nubank')
                    ->helperText('Se deixar em branco, manteremos a descrição original de cada extrato.'),
            ])
            ->action(function (Collection $records, array $data) {
                            $targetAccount = \App\Models\BankAccount::find($data['target_account_id']);
                            $count = 0;

                            foreach ($records as $stmt) {
                                if ($stmt->status !== 'pending' || $stmt->bank_account_id == $targetAccount->id) continue;

                                $desc = !empty($data['description'])
                                    ? $data['description'] . " - " . ($stmt->counterparty_name ?: $stmt->description)
                                    : "Transferência: " . ($stmt->counterparty_name ?: $stmt->description);

                                // 🚀 O MOTOR FAZ A MÁGICA DIRETAMENTE NA CONTA BANCÁRIA!
                                BankReconciliationService::finalize($stmt, $targetAccount, null, $desc);
                                $count++;
                            }

                            if ($count > 0) {
                                Notification::make()->title("{$count} transferências realizadas com sucesso!")->success()->send();
                            } else {
                                Notification::make()->title("Nenhuma ação realizada.")->warning()->send();
                            }
                        });
    }
}
```
