```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\CashShifts\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\CashShifts\CashShiftResource;
use App\Models\BankAccount;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\ManageRecords;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class ManageCashShifts extends ManageRecords
{
    protected static string $resource = CashShiftResource::class;

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            Action::make('abrir_caixa')
                ->label('Abrir Novo Turno')
                ->icon('heroicon-o-play')
                ->color('success')
                ->form([
                    Select::make('bank_account_id')
                        ->label('Selecione a Gaveta / Cofre')
                        ->options(BankAccount::where('type', 'vault')->pluck('name', 'id'))
                        ->required()
                        ->searchable()
                        ->preload(),
                        
                    TextInput::make('opening_balance')
                        ->label('Fundo de Troco Inicial')
                        ->numeric()
                        ->prefix('R$')
                        ->default(0)
                        ->required(),
                ])
                ->action(function (array $data): void {
                    // Impede de abrir se a gaveta já estiver aberta
                    $hasOpenShift = CashShift::where('bank_account_id', $data['bank_account_id'])
                        ->where('status', 'open')
                        ->exists();
                        
                    if ($hasOpenShift) {
                        Notification::make()
                            ->title('Atenção!')
                            ->body('Esta gaveta já possui um turno aberto. Feche-o primeiro.')
                            ->warning()
                            ->send();
                        return;
                    }

                    CashShift::create([
                        'bank_account_id' => $data['bank_account_id'],
                        'opened_by' => auth()->id(),
                        'opened_at' => now(),
                        'opening_balance' => $data['opening_balance'],
                        'status' => 'open',
                    ]);

                    Notification::make()
                        ->title('Turno Aberto!')
                        ->body('O caixa está pronto para operar.')
                        ->success()
                        ->send();
                }),
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Categories/Pages/TreeCategory.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Categories\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\Categories\CategoryResource;
use App\Models\Category;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\Page;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class TreeCategory extends Page
{
    protected static string $resource = CategoryResource::class;

    protected string $view = 'filament.resources.categories.pages.tree-category';

    protected static ?string $title = 'Organização do Cardápio';

    public function getCategories()
    {
        return Category::whereNull('parent_id')
            ->with('children')
            ->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc')
            ->get();
    }

    // 🚀 MÉTODO QUE SALVA O DRAG AND DROP
    public function updateCategoryOrder(array $treeData, ?int $parentId = null): void
    {
        foreach ($treeData as $index => $node) {
            Category::where('id', $node['id'])->update([
                'sort_order' => $index,
                'parent_id'  => $parentId,
            ]);

            // Se o nó arrastado tem subcategorias dentro dele, atualiza os filhos recursivamente
            if (! empty($node['children'])) {
                $this->updateCategoryOrder($node['children'], $node['id']);
            }
        }

        Notification::make()
            ->title('Cardápio reordenado com sucesso!')
            ->success()
            ->send();
    }
}
```

```php
                                    ->columnSpan(8),
                            ]),

                        // Bloco: QUEM FAZ
                        Grid::make(12)
                            ->schema([
                                Select::make('assignment_type')
                                    ->label('Quem deve fazer?')
                                    ->options([
                                        'all' => 'Todos',
                                        'roles' => 'Cargos Específicos',
                                        'users' => 'Pessoas Específicas',
                                    ])
                                    ->default('all')
                                    ->live()
                                    ->required()
                                    ->columnSpan(4),

                                Select::make('target_roles')
                                    ->label('Quais Cargos?')
                                    ->multiple()
                                    ->options([
                                        'kitchen' => 'Cozinha (KDS)',
                                        'waiter' => 'Garçons / Salão',
                                        'cashier' => 'Caixa / Atendimento',
                                        'driver' => 'Entregadores',
                                        'admin' => 'Gestão',
                                    ])
                                    ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('assignment_type') === 'roles')
                                    ->required(fn (Get $get) => $get('assignment_type') === 'roles')
                                    ->columnSpan(4),

                                Select::make('target_users')
                                    ->label('Quais Pessoas?')
                                    ->multiple()
                                    ->options(fn () => User::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                                    ->searchable()
                                    ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('assignment_type') === 'users')
                                    ->required(fn (Get $get) => $get('assignment_type') === 'users')
                                    ->columnSpan(4),

                                Select::make('completion_type')
                                    ->label('Dinâmica de Conclusão')
                                    ->options([
                                        'shared' => 'Compartilhada (Um faz por todos da equipe)',
                                        'individual' => 'Individual (Cada pessoa selecionada precisa fazer a sua)',
                                    ])
                                    ->default('shared')
                                    ->visible(fn (Get $get) => in_array($get('assignment_type'), ['all', 'roles', 'users']))
                                    ->columnSpan(4),
                            ]),

                        // Bloco: QUANDO FAZ E DEADLINES
                        Grid::make(12)
                            ->schema([
                                Select::make('trigger_type')
                                    ->label('Momento do Disparo')
                                    ->options([
                                        'manual' => 'Livre (Fica disponível o dia todo)',
                                        'shift_start' => 'Vinculado à Abertura do Turno',
                                        'shift_end' => 'Vinculado ao Fechamento do Turno',
                                        'scheduled' => 'Agendado (Horário Fixo)',
                                    ])
                                    ->default('manual')
                                    ->live()
                                    ->required()
                                    ->columnSpan(4),

                                TimePicker::make('trigger_time')
                                    ->label('Horário Exato')
                                    ->required(fn (Get $get) => $get('trigger_type') === 'scheduled')
                                    ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('trigger_type') === 'scheduled')
                                    ->seconds(false)
                                    ->columnSpan(4),

                                TextInput::make('deadline_minutes')
                                    ->label('Tolerância (Minutos)')
                                    ->numeric()
                                    ->default(60)
                                    ->helperText(fn (Get $get) =>
                                        $get('trigger_type') === 'shift_start'
                                            ? 'Tempo limite após a Abertura do Turno (baseado nos horários da loja).'
                                            : 'Tempo limite após o Fechamento do Turno (baseado nos horários da loja).'
                                    )
                                    ->visible(fn (Get $get) => in_array($get('trigger_type'), ['shift_start', 'shift_end']))
                                    ->required(fn (Get $get) => in_array($get('trigger_type'), ['shift_start', 'shift_end']))
                                    ->columnSpan(4),

                                Select::make('recurrence_type')
                                    ->label('Recorrência')
                                    ->options([
                                        'daily' => 'Diária (Todos os dias)',
                                        'weekly' => 'Semanal (Dias específicos)',
                                        'monthly' => 'Mensal (Dias específicos)',
                                        'once' => 'Pontual (Uma única vez)',
                                    ])
                                    ->default('daily')
                                    ->live()
                                    ->required()
                                    ->columnSpan(4),

                                Select::make('recurrence_days')
                                    ->label('Dias da semana')
                                    ->multiple()
                                    ->options([
                                        0 => 'Domingo', 1 => 'Segunda-feira', 2 => 'Terça-feira',
                                        3 => 'Quarta-feira', 4 => 'Quinta-feira', 5 => 'Sexta-feira', 6 => 'Sábado',
                                    ])
                                    ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('recurrence_type') === 'weekly')
                                    ->required(fn (Get $get) => $get('recurrence_type') === 'weekly')
                                    ->columnSpan(8),

                                Select::make('recurrence_days')
                                    ->label('Dias do mês')
                                    ->multiple()
                                    ->options(array_combine(range(1, 31), range(1, 31)))
                                    ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('recurrence_type') === 'monthly')
                                    ->required(fn (Get $get) => $get('recurrence_type') === 'monthly')
                                    ->columnSpan(8),

                                DateTimePicker::make('deadline_date')
                                    ->label('Data e Hora Limite (Deadline)')
                                    ->helperText('Prazo final irrevogável para a conclusão desta tarefa pontual.')
                                    ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('recurrence_type') === 'once')
                                    ->required(fn (Get $get) => $get('recurrence_type') === 'once')
                                    ->seconds(false)
                                    ->columnSpan(4),
                            ]),
                        ]),
                ]),
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Checklists/Tables/ChecklistsTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Checklists\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\ToggleColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\TernaryFilter;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use Filament\Actions\ViewAction;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;

class ChecklistsTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('title')
                    ->label('Nome do Grupo (Rotina)')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('bold'),

                // 🚀 Conta magicamente quantas tarefas (checklist_tasks) estão atreladas a este grupo
                TextColumn::make('tasks_count')
                    ->counts('tasks')
                    ->label('Qtd. de Tarefas')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color('info')
                    ->sortable(),

                // Permite ligar/desligar a rotina inteira direto da tabela, sem precisar abrir para editar!
                ToggleColumn::make('is_active')
                    ->label('Rotina Ativa')
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Criado em')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(isToggledHiddenByDefault: true),

                TextColumn::make('updated_at')
                    ->label('Última Atualização')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(isToggledHiddenByDefault: true),
            ])
            ->filters([
                TernaryFilter::make('is_active')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->placeholder('Todos os Grupos')
                    ->trueLabel('Apenas Ativos')
                    ->falseLabel('Apenas Inativos'),
            ])
            ->actions([
                ViewAction::make(),
                EditAction::make(),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Checklists;

use App\Models\Checklist;
use BackedEnum;
use Filament\Resources\ResourceConfiguration;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Resources\Resource;
use App\Filament\Resources\Checklists\Pages;
use App\Filament\Resources\Checklists\Schemas\ChecklistForm;
use App\Filament\Resources\Checklists\Tables\ChecklistsTable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use UnitEnum;
/**
 * @extends Resource<Model,ResourceConfiguration>
 */
class ChecklistResource extends Resource
{
    protected static ?string $model = Checklist::class;
    protected static string|\BackedEnum|null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-clipboard-document-check';
    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = 'Gestão & RH';
    protected static ?string $modelLabel = 'Tarefa';
    protected static ?string $pluralModelLabel = 'Tarefas';

    public static function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return ChecklistForm::configure($schema);
    }

    public static function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return ChecklistsTable::configure($table);
    }

    public static function getPages(): array
    {
        return [
            'index' => Pages\ListChecklists::route('/'),
            'create' => Pages\CreateChecklist::route('/create'),
            'edit' => Pages\EditChecklist::route('/{record}/edit'),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Coupons\RelationManagers;

use Filament\Forms;
use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Resources\RelationManagers\RelationManager;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\Summarizers\Summarizer;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

class OrdersRelationManager extends RelationManager
{
    protected static string $relationship = 'orders';
    protected static ?string $title = 'Histórico de Utilização (Métricas)';
    protected static string | \BackedEnum | null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-shopping-bag';

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->recordTitleAttribute('id')
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('id')
                    ->label('Pedido #')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('bold'),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Data de Uso')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('customer.name')
                    ->label('Cliente')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->placeholder('Visitante / Não Identificado'),

                // Métrica 1: O custo da campanha
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('discount')
                    ->label('Desconto Concedido (Custo)')
                    ->money('BRL')
                    ->color('danger')
                    ->summarize(
                        Summarizer::make()
                            ->label('Custo Total')
                            ->money('BRL')
                    ),

                // Métrica 2: A receita gerada
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('total')
                    ->label('Valor Pago (Receita)')
                    ->money('BRL')
                    ->color('success')
                    ->weight('bold')
                    ->summarize(
                        Summarizer::make()
                            ->label('Receita Total')
                            ->money('BRL')
                    ),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('status')
                    ->label('Status do Pedido')
                    ->badge()
                    ->colors([
                        'success' => 'closed',
                        'warning' => 'pending',
                        'danger' => 'cancelled',
                    ]),
            ])
            ->filters([
                Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make('status')
                    ->label('Status do Pedido')
                    ->options([
                        'closed' => 'Finalizados',
                        'cancelled' => 'Cancelados',
                    ]),
            ])
            ->headerActions([])
            ->actions([
                Action::make('view_order')
                    ->label('Ver Pedido')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-eye')
                    ->url(fn ($record): string => \App\Filament\Resources\Orders\OrderResource::getUrl('view', ['record' => $record]))
            ])
            ->bulkActions([])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc');
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Customers/RelationManagers/OrdersRelationManager.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Customers\RelationManagers;

use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Resources\RelationManagers\RelationManager;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Actions; // <-- A MÁGICA ESTÁ AQUI: Importamos a pasta correta de Ações
use App\Filament\Resources\Orders\OrderResource;

class OrdersRelationManager extends RelationManager
{
    protected static string $relationship = 'orders';
    protected static ?string $title = 'Histórico de Pedidos';
    protected static string | \BackedEnum | null $icon = 'heroicon-o-shopping-bag';

    public function form(Schema $schema): Schema 
    {
        return $schema->schema([]);
    }

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->recordTitleAttribute('id')
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('id')->label('Pedido #')->sortable()->searchable(),
                
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('type')->label('Modalidade')->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) { 
                        'delivery' => 'Delivery', 'counter' => 'Balcão', 'pickup' => 'Retirada', 'table' => 'Mesa', default => $state 
                    })
                    ->colors(['info' => 'delivery', 'warning' => 'counter', 'success' => 'pickup', 'gray' => 'table']),
                    
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('total')->label('Total')->money('BRL')->sortable(),
                
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('status')->label('Status')->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'pending' => 'Pendente', 'preparing' => 'Preparando', 'ready' => 'Pronto', 'out_for_delivery' => 'Em Entrega', 'closed' => 'Concluído', 'cancelled' => 'Cancelado', default => $state
                    })
                    ->colors(['warning' => 'pending', 'info' => 'preparing', 'success' => fn ($state) => in_array($state, ['ready', 'closed']), 'danger' => 'cancelled', 'primary' => 'out_for_delivery']),
                    
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('payment_status')->label('Pagamento')->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) { 
                        'paid' => 'Pago', 'partial' => 'Parcial', 'pending' => 'Pendente', 'cancelled' => 'Cancelado', default => $state 
                    })
                    ->colors(['success' => 'paid', 'warning' => fn ($state) => in_array($state, ['pending', 'partial']), 'danger' => 'cancelled']),
                    
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('created_at')->label('Data')->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')->sortable(),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc')
            // <-- USAMOS A ESTRUTURA CORRETA DO SEU SISTEMA (recordActions e toolbarActions)
            ->recordActions([
                Actions\Action::make('Ver Pedido Completo')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-eye')
                    ->url(fn ($record): string => OrderResource::getUrl('edit', ['record' => $record]))
            ])
            ->toolbarActions([]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Devices/Schemas/DeviceForm.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Devices\Schemas;


use App\Enums\DeviceType;use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class DeviceForm
{
    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {
        return [
                Section::make('Identificação do Terminal')
                    ->description('Cadastre a máquina para gerar a chave de emparelhamento.')
                    ->columns(2)
                    ->schema([
                        TextInput::make('name')
                            ->label('Nome do Dispositivo')
                            ->placeholder('Ex: Caixa Principal, Tablet Cozinha 1')
                            ->required()
                            ->maxLength(255)
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        Select::make('type')
                            ->label('Função da Máquina')
                            ->options(DeviceType::class)
                            ->required()
                            ->native(false)
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ]),

                Section::make('Segurança e Status')
                    ->columns(2)
                    ->schema([
                        // 🚀 O UUID é gerado automaticamente e não pode ser editado!
                        TextInput::make('device_uuid')
                            ->label('Chave de Emparelhamento (UUID)')
                            ->default(fn () => (string) Str::uuid())
                            ->disabled()
                            ->dehydrated() // Garante que, mesmo desabilitado, vai para o banco ao criar
                            ->unique(ignoreRecord: true)
                            ->helperText('Use este código para autorizar a máquina na tela de Gateway.')
                            ->columnSpan(2),

                        Toggle::make('is_active')
                            ->label('Dispositivo Ativo')
                            ->default(true)
                            ->helperText('Desative para bloquear imediatamente o acesso desta máquina.')
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        Placeholder::make('last_active_at')
                            ->label('Última Sincronização')
                            ->content(fn ($record) => $record?->last_active_at ? $record->last_active_at->diffForHumans() : 'Nunca acessado')
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ]),
            ];
    }
    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->schema(self::getFormSchema());
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Employees\RelationManagers;

use Filament\Forms;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema; // 🚀 Importação v4
use Filament\Resources\RelationManagers\RelationManager;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Actions\Action;

class LedgersRelationManager extends RelationManager
{
    // O nome da relação no Model Employee
    protected static string $relationship = "ledgers";

    protected static ?string $title = "Conta Corrente (Extrato)";

    // 🚀 Assinatura 100% atualizada para o Filament v4
    public function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->components([]);
    }

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->recordTitleAttribute("description")
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("created_at")
                    ->label("Data")
                    ->dateTime("d/m/Y H:i")
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("type")
                    ->label("Tipo")
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(
                        fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                            "credit" => "Serviço Prestado (+)",
                            "debit" => "Pagamento/Vale (-)",
                        },
                    )
                    ->color(
                        fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                            "credit" => "success",
                            "debit" => "danger",
                        },
                    ),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("description")
                    ->label("Descrição")
                    ->searchable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("amount")
                    ->label("Valor")
                    ->money("BRL")
                    ->color(
                        fn($record) => $record->type === "credit"
                            ? "success"
                            : "danger",
                    )
                    ->weight("bold"),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("balance")
                    ->label("Saldo Atualizado")
                    ->money("BRL")
                    ->weight("bold")
                    ->color(fn($state) => $state < 0 ? "danger" : "primary"),
            ])
            ->defaultSort("created_at", "desc")
            ->filters([
                //
            ])
            ->headerActions([
                // ==========================================
                // BOTÃO 1: LANÇAR SERVIÇO (CRÉDITO)
                // ==========================================
                Action::make("add_credit")
                    ->label("Lançar Serviço")
                    ->icon("heroicon-m-plus-circle")
                    ->color("success")
                    ->form([
                        Forms\Components\Select::make("service_type")
                            ->label("Tipo de Serviço")
                            ->options([
                                "diaria" => "Diária Padrão",
                                "outro" => "Outro Serviço / Avulso",
                            ])
                            ->live()
                            ->default("diaria")
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function (
                                $get,
                                $set,
                                $livewire,
                            ) {
                                if ($get("service_type") === "diaria") {
                                    $employee = $livewire->getOwnerRecord();
                                    $set(
                                        "amount",
                                        $employee->base_remuneration ?? 0,
                                    );
                                    $set("description", "Diária de Trabalho");
                                } else {
                                    $set("amount", null);
                                    $set("description", null);
                                }
                            }),

                        Forms\Components\TextInput::make("description")
                            ->label("Descrição")
                            ->required(),

                        Forms\Components\TextInput::make("amount")
                            ->label('Valor a Pagar (R$)')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->required()
                            ->prefix('R$'),
                    ])
                    ->action(function (array $data, $livewire) {
                        $employee = $livewire->getOwnerRecord();

                        // Descobre o saldo atual da última movimentação
                        $latestLedger = $employee
                            ->ledgers()
                            ->latest("id")
                            ->first();
                        $currentBalance = $latestLedger
                            ? (float) $latestLedger->balance
                            : 0;

                        // Cria o crédito e atualiza o saldo (Soma)
                        $employee->ledgers()->create([
                            "type" => "credit",
                            "description" => $data["description"],
                            "amount" => $data["amount"],
                            "balance" =>
                                $currentBalance + (float) $data["amount"],
                        ]);
                    }),

                // ==========================================
                // BOTÃO 2: LANÇAR VALE/PAGAMENTO (DÉBITO)
                // ==========================================
                Action::make("add_debit")
                    ->label("Lançar Adiantamento / Vale")
                    ->icon("heroicon-m-minus-circle")
                    ->color("danger")
                    ->form([
                        Forms\Components\TextInput::make("description")
                            ->label("Descrição")
                            ->default("Vale / Adiantamento Manual")
                            ->required(),

                        Forms\Components\TextInput::make("amount")
                            ->label('Valor (R$)')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->required()
                            ->prefix('R$'),
                    ])
                    ->action(function (array $data, $livewire) {
                        $employee = $livewire->getOwnerRecord();

                        // Descobre o saldo atual da última movimentação
                        $latestLedger = $employee
                            ->ledgers()
                            ->latest("id")
                            ->first();
                        $currentBalance = $latestLedger
                            ? (float) $latestLedger->balance
                            : 0;

                        // Cria o débito e atualiza o saldo (Subtrai)
                        $employee->ledgers()->create([
                            "type" => "debit",
                            "description" => $data["description"],
                            "amount" => $data["amount"],
                            "balance" =>
                                $currentBalance - (float) $data["amount"],
                        ]);
                    }),
            ])
            ->actions([
                // Protegido contra edições manuais para garantir a integridade
            ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/FiscalDocuments/Actions/ExportFiscalDataAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\FiscalDocuments\Actions;

use App\Services\Fiscal\FiscalExportService;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use ZipArchive;

class ExportFiscalDataAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'export_fiscal_data';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('Exportar Relatórios')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-arrow-down-tray')
            ->color('primary')
            ->form([
                // Linha 1: Filtros de Data (Grid de 3)
                Grid::make(3)->schema([
                    Select::make('quick_period')
                        ->label('Período')
                        ->options([
                            'this_month' => 'Este Mês',
                            'last_month' => 'Mês Passado',
                            'custom'     => 'Personalizado',
                        ])
                        ->default('this_month')
                        ->live()
                        ->afterStateUpdated(function (string $state, Set $set) {
                            if ($state === 'this_month') {
                                $set('start_date', now()->startOfMonth()->format('Y-m-d'));
                                $set('end_date', now()->endOfMonth()->format('Y-m-d'));
                            } elseif ($state === 'last_month') {
                                $set('start_date', now()->subMonth()->startOfMonth()->format('Y-m-d'));
                                $set('end_date', now()->subMonth()->endOfMonth()->format('Y-m-d'));
                            }
                        }),

                    DatePicker::make('start_date')
                        ->label('Data Inicial')
                        ->required()
                        ->default(now()->startOfMonth()),

                    DatePicker::make('end_date')
                        ->label('Data Final')
                        ->required()
                        ->default(now()->endOfMonth()),
                ])->extraAttributes(['class' => 'mb-4']),

                // Linha 2: Toggles de Exportação (Grid de 3)
                Grid::make(3)->schema([
                    Toggle::make('export_xml')
                        ->label('XMLs (ZIP)')
                        ->default(true),

                    Toggle::make('export_general')
                        ->label('Relatório Sintético')
                        ->default(true),

                    Toggle::make('export_monophasic')
                        ->label('Monofásicos (PDF)')
                        ->default(false),
                ]),
            ])
            ->action(function (array $data, FiscalExportService $exportService) {
                try {
                    $filesToDownload = [];

                    if ($data['export_xml']) {
                        $filesToDownload[] = $exportService->generateXmlZip($data['start_date'], $data['end_date']);
                    }
                    if ($data['export_general']) {
                        $filesToDownload[] = $exportService->generateGeneralReportPdf($data['start_date'], $data['end_date']);
                    }
                    if ($data['export_monophasic']) {
                        $filesToDownload[] = $exportService->generateMonophasicReportPdf($data['start_date'], $data['end_date']);
                    }

                    if (empty($filesToDownload)) {
                        throw new \Exception("Selecione pelo menos um tipo de relatório para exportar.");
                    }

                    if (count($filesToDownload) === 1) {
                        return response()->download($filesToDownload[0])->deleteFileAfterSend(true);
                    }

                    $tempDir = storage_path('app/temp_fiscal_exports');
                    if (!file_exists($tempDir)) {
                        mkdir($tempDir, 0755, true);
                    }

                    $masterZipName = "Fechamento_Fiscal_{$data['start_date']}_a_{$data['end_date']}.zip";
                    $masterZipPath = $tempDir . '/' . $masterZipName;

                    $zip = new ZipArchive();
                    if ($zip->open($masterZipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) === TRUE) {
                        foreach ($filesToDownload as $filePath) {
                            $zip->addFile($filePath, basename($filePath));
                        }
                        $zip->close();
                    } else {
                        throw new \Exception("Falha ao criar o arquivo ZIP com os relatórios agrupados.");
                    }

                    foreach ($filesToDownload as $filePath) {
                        @unlink($filePath);
                    }

                    return response()->download($masterZipPath)->deleteFileAfterSend(true);

                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                    Notification::make()
                        ->title('Erro na Exportação')
                        ->body($e->getMessage())
                        ->danger()
                        ->send();
                }
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/FiscalDocuments/Tables/FiscalDocumentsTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\FiscalDocuments\Tables;

use App\Models\FiscalDocument;
use App\Services\Fiscal\SpedDocumentService;
use App\Filament\Resources\FiscalDocuments\FiscalDocumentResource;
use App\Filament\Resources\Orders\OrderResource; // <-- Importação do Resource de Pedidos
use Filament\Forms;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Filter;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\BulkAction;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class FiscalDocumentsTable
{
    public static function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->defaultSort('issue_date', 'desc')
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('number')
                    ->label('Número')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('bold'),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('series')
                    ->label('Série')
                    ->toggleable(isToggledHiddenByDefault: true),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('order.id')
                    ->label('Pedido')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    // 🚀 Forma correta e dinâmica para Tenants: pedir a URL direto para o Resource alvo
                    ->url(fn (FiscalDocument $record): string => OrderResource::getUrl('edit', ['record' => $record->order_id]))
                    ->color('primary'),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('issue_date')
                    ->label('Emissão')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i:s')
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('total_value')
                    ->label('Valor Total')
                    ->money('BRL')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('bold'),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('status')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'authorized' => 'success',
                        'canceled', 'canceled_by_substitution' => 'danger',
                        'rejected' => 'warning',
                        default => 'secondary',
                    })
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'authorized' => 'Autorizada',
                        'canceled' => 'Cancelada',
                        'rejected' => 'Rejeitada',
                        default => ucfirst($state),
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('access_key')
                    ->label('Chave de Acesso')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->toggleable(isToggledHiddenByDefault: true)
                    ->copyable()
                    ->tooltip('Clique para copiar'),
            ])
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make('status')
                    ->options([
                        'authorized' => 'Autorizada',
                        'canceled' => 'Cancelada',
                    ]),
                Filter::make('issue_date')
                    ->form([
                        Forms\Components\DatePicker::make('emitted_from')->label('Emitido a partir de'),
                        Forms\Components\DatePicker::make('emitted_until')->label('Emitido até'),
                    ])
                    ->query(function (Builder $query, array $data): Builder {
                        return $query
                            ->when(
                                $data['emitted_from'],
                                fn (Builder $query, $date): Builder => $query->whereDate('issue_date', '>=', $date),
                            )
                            ->when(
                                $data['emitted_until'],
                                fn (Builder $query, $date): Builder => $query->whereDate('issue_date', '<=', $date),
                            );
                    })
            ])
            ->actions([
                Action::make('view')
                    ->label('Visualizar')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-eye')
                    ->color('gray')
                    ->url(fn (FiscalDocument $record): string => FiscalDocumentResource::getUrl('view', ['record' => $record])),

                Action::make('download_xml')
                    ->label('XML')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-code-bracket')
                    ->color('info')
                    ->action(function (FiscalDocument $record) {
                        $filename = "{$record->access_key}-nfce.xml";
                        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($record) {
                            echo $record->xml_content;
                        }, $filename, ['Content-Type' => 'application/xml']);
                    }),

                Action::make('download_pdf')
                    ->label('PDF')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-document-arrow-down')
                    ->color('success')
                    ->action(function (FiscalDocument $record, SpedDocumentService $spedService) {
                        try {
                            $pdfContent = $spedService->renderDanfePdf($record->xml_content);
                            $filename = "{$record->access_key}-danfe.pdf";
                            return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($pdfContent) {
                                echo $pdfContent;
                            }, $filename, ['Content-Type' => 'application/pdf']);
                        } catch (\Exception $e) {
                            \Filament\Notifications\Notification::make()->title('Erro')->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send();
                        }
                    }),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                BulkAction::make('export_selected_xmls')
                    ->label('Baixar XMLs (ZIP)')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-archive-box-arrow-down')
                    ->action(function (\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection $records) {
                        $zip = new \ZipArchive();
                        $zipFileName = 'NFCe_Selecionadas_' . now()->format('YmdHis') . '.zip';
                        $zipFilePath = storage_path('app/temp/' . $zipFileName);

                        if (!file_exists(storage_path('app/temp'))) {
                            mkdir(storage_path('app/temp'), 0755, true);
                        }

                        if ($zip->open($zipFilePath, \ZipArchive::CREATE | \ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) === TRUE) {
                            foreach ($records as $record) {
                                if ($record->xml_content) {
                                    $zip->addFromString("{$record->access_key}-nfce.xml", $record->xml_content);
                                }
                            }
                            $zip->close();
                        }

                        return response()->download($zipFilePath)->deleteFileAfterSend(true);
                    })
                    ->deselectRecordsAfterCompletion(),
            ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/GoodsReceipts/Pages/CreateGoodsReceipt.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\GoodsReceiptResource;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\CreateRecord;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class CreateGoodsReceipt extends CreateRecord
{
    protected static string $resource = GoodsReceiptResource::class;

    protected function afterCreate(): void
    {
        $record = $this->getRecord();

        // 🚀 Forçamos o recarregamento profundo de todos os itens e do produto recém-criado pelo Quick Create
        $record->load(['items.product', 'supplier']);

        $inventoryService = app(InventoryService::class);
        $totalAmount = 0.0;

        $supplierName = $record->supplier?->trade_name ?: ($record->supplier?->name ?? 'Fornecedor Avulso');
        $dateStr = Carbon::parse($record->received_at ?? now())->format("Ymd");
        $timeStr = now()->format("His");

        // Geramos uma chave de NF-e falsa para linkar o romaneio ao histórico
        $fakeNfeKey = "ROMANEIO-{$record->id}-{$dateStr}-{$timeStr}";

        // Gravamos uma invoice avulsa (espelho) para não quebrar a tela de histórico
        ReceivedInvoice::create([
            "nfe_key"      => $fakeNfeKey,
            "emitter_name" => $supplierName,
            "emitter_cnpj" => $record->supplier?->document ?? "00000000000000",
            "total_value"  => 0, // Atualizaremos no final do loop
            "issue_date"   => Carbon::parse($record->received_at ?? now()),
            "status"       => "processed",
        ]);

        foreach ($record->items as $item) {
            // Pegamos o produto atualizado direto da relação carregada
            $product = $item->product;

            if (! $product) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($product->track_inventory) {
                $inventoryService->addStock($product, (float) $item->quantity, 'goods_receipt');
            }

            $cost = (float) ($item->unit_cost_estimated ?? $product->base_cost ?? 0);
            $totalAmount += round($cost * (float) $item->quantity, 2);

            // 🚀 1. ATUALIZA O CUSTO BASE DO INSUMO COM O NOVO VALOR PAGO
            if ($cost > 0 && $cost != $product->base_cost) {
                $product->update(['base_cost' => $cost]);
            }

            // 🚀 2. REGISTRA O HISTÓRICO DE COMPRA
            $product->costHistories()->create([
                "supplier_id"              => $record->supplier_id,
                "nfe_key"                  => $fakeNfeKey,
                "xml_name"                 => $product->name . " (Canhoto #{$record->receipt_number})",
                "quantity"                 => $item->quantity,
                "conversion_factor"        => $item->conversion_factor ?? 1,
                "unit_cost"                => $cost,
                "original_quantity"        => $item->raw_quantity ?? $item->quantity,
                "original_unit_of_measure" => $item->purchase_uom ?? $product->unit_of_measure,
                "original_unit_cost"       => $cost,
            ]);
        }

        $record->update(['total_amount' => $totalAmount]);
        ReceivedInvoice::where('nfe_key', $fakeNfeKey)->update(['total_value' => $totalAmount]);

        // 🚀 Fechamento Financeiro de acordo com a origem selecionada
        $origin = $record->payment_origin ?? 'payable';

        if ($origin === 'cash_drawer' && $totalAmount > 0) {
            $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();
            if ($shift) {
                Transaction::create([
                    'cash_shift_id'   => $shift->id,
                    'bank_account_id' => $shift->bank_account_id,
                    'type'            => 'out',
                    'category'        => 'cash_out',
                    'amount'          => $totalAmount,
                    'description'     => "Sangria: Compra de Insumos - Canhoto #{$record->receipt_number} ({$supplierName})",
                    'operator_name'   => auth()->user()?->name ?? 'Sistema',
                    'transaction_date'=> now(),
                ]);
            }
        }
        // 🚀 PAGAMENTO VIA BANCO (PIX, Cartão, Transferência)
        elseif ($origin === 'bank_account' && $totalAmount > 0 && $record->bank_account_id) {
            Transaction::create([
                'bank_account_id' => $record->bank_account_id,
                'type'            => 'out',
                'category'        => 'supplier_payment',
                'amount'          => $totalAmount,
                'description'     => "Pagamento de Compras (Canhoto #{$record->receipt_number}) - {$supplierName}",
                'operator_name'   => auth()->user()?->name ?? 'Sistema',
                'transaction_date'=> now(),
            ]);
        }
        elseif ($origin === 'partner' && $totalAmount > 0) {
            AccountPayable::create([
                'supplier_id'   => $record->supplier_id,
                'supplier_name' => "Reembolso Sócio - {$supplierName}",
                'description'   => "Compra Avulsa Canhoto #{$record->receipt_number}",
                'amount'        => $totalAmount,
                'installment'   => '1/1',
                'due_date'      => $record->due_date ?: now()->addDays(7)->toDateString(),
                'status'        => 'pending',
            ]);
        }
        elseif ($origin === 'payable' && $totalAmount > 0) {
            AccountPayable::create([
                'supplier_id'   => $record->supplier_id,
                'supplier_name' => $supplierName,
                'description'   => "Compra a Prazo Direto (Canhoto #{$record->receipt_number})",
                'amount'        => $totalAmount,
                'installment'   => '1/1',
                'due_date'      => $record->due_date ?: now()->toDateString(),
                'status'        => 'pending',
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/GoodsReceipts/Pages/EditGoodsReceipt.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\GoodsReceiptResource;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Filament\Actions;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\EditRecord;

class EditGoodsReceipt extends EditRecord
{
    protected static string $resource = GoodsReceiptResource::class;

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            Actions\DeleteAction::make()
                ->before(function ($record, Actions\DeleteAction $action) {
                    $hasReconciled = $record->items()->where('status', 'reconciled')->exists();
                    if ($hasReconciled) {
                        Notification::make()
                            ->title('Ação Bloqueada')
                            ->body('Este romaneio já possui itens conciliados com uma Nota Fiscal. Não é possível excluí-lo.')
                            ->danger()
                            ->send();
                        $action->cancel();
                        return;
                    }

                    // Estorna o estoque adicionado fisicamente
                    $inventoryService = app(InventoryService::class);
                    foreach ($record->items as $item) {
                        $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
                        if ($product && $product->track_inventory) {
                            $inventoryService->deductStock($product, (float) $item->quantity);
                        }
                    }
                }),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\Schemas;

use App\Models\Product;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Repeater;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Textarea;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;

class GoodsReceiptForm
{
    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema
            ->components([
                // 🚀 Único Grid de 3 colunas para o topo inteiro, forçando ocupar 100% da largura
                Grid::make(3)
                    ->schema([
                        // --- LINHA 1 ---
                        Select::make('supplier_id')
                            ->label('Fornecedor')
                            ->relationship('supplier', 'name')
                            ->searchable()
                            ->preload()
                            ->required()
                            // 🚀 QUICK CREATE: Fornecedor
                            ->createOptionForm(\App\Filament\Resources\Suppliers\Schemas\SupplierForm::getQuickCreateSchema())
                            ->createOptionAction(function ($action) {
                                return $action
                                    ->modalHeading('Cadastro Rápido de Fornecedor')
                                    ->modalWidth('md');
                            })
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        TextInput::make('receipt_number')
                            ->label('Nº do Canhoto / Cupom')
                            ->placeholder('Ex: CANHOTO-1049')
                            ->maxLength(50)
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        DatePicker::make('received_at')
                            ->label('Data de Entrada')
                            ->default(now())
                            ->required()
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        // --- LINHA 2 ---
                        // DIMENSÃO FISCAL
                        \Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle::make('requires_nfe')
                            ->label('Aguardando NF-e Posterior?')
                            ->helperText('Deixe ativo se o fornecedor emitirá uma Nota Fiscal.')
                            ->default(true)
                            ->inline(false)
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        // DIMENSÃO FINANCEIRA
                        Select::make('payment_origin')
                            ->label('Forma / Origem do Pagamento')
                            ->options([
                                'cash_drawer'     => 'Pago no Caixa (Sangria)',
                                'bank_account'    => 'Pago via Banco (PIX / Cartão)',
                                'partner'         => 'Pago pelo Sócio (Reembolso)',
                                'payable'         => 'A Prazo / Boleto Direto',
                            ])
                            ->default('payable')
                            ->required()
                            ->live()
                            ->helperText(fn (Get $get) => match ($get('payment_origin')) {
                                'cash_drawer'     => 'Gera sangria imediata no caixa físico.',
                                'bank_account'    => 'Debita diretamente da conta para conciliação.',
                                'partner'         => 'Gera Contas a Pagar em favor do sócio.',
                                'payable'         => 'Gera duplicata direto para o fornecedor.',
                                default           => '',
                            })
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        // COMPLEMENTOS (Ocupam a 3ª coluna da Linha 2 dinamicamente)
                        Select::make('bank_account_id')
                            ->label('Conta Bancária Origem')
                            ->options(fn () => \App\Models\BankAccount::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                            ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('payment_origin') === 'bank_account')
                            ->required(fn (Get $get) => $get('payment_origin') === 'bank_account')
                            ->searchable()
                            ->preload()
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        DatePicker::make('due_date')
                            ->label('Data de Vencimento')
                            ->visible(fn (Get $get) => in_array($get('payment_origin'), ['partner', 'payable']))
                            ->required(fn (Get $get) => in_array($get('payment_origin'), ['partner', 'payable']))
                            ->default(now()->addDays(7))
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ])
                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                FileUpload::make('document_path')
                    ->label('Foto do Canhoto / Cupom / Recibo Físico')
                    ->image()
                    ->directory('goods-receipts')
                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                Repeater::make('items')
                    ->relationship('items')
                    ->label('Insumos Recebidos')
                    ->schema([
                        Select::make('product_id')
                            ->label('Insumo / Produto')
                            // 🚀 Mudamos de options() para relationship() para habilitar a criação nativa do Filament
                            ->relationship('product', 'name', fn ($query) => $query->where('track_inventory', true))
                            ->searchable()
                            ->preload()
                            ->required()
                            ->live()
                            // 🚀 QUICK CREATE: Produto/Insumo
                            ->createOptionForm(\App\Filament\Resources\Products\Schemas\ProductForm::getQuickCreateSchema())
                            ->createOptionAction(function ($action) {
                                return $action
                                    ->modalHeading('Cadastro Rápido de Insumo')
                                    ->modalWidth('md');
                            })
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set) {
                                if ($state) {
                                    $prod = Product::find($state);
                                    if ($prod) {
                                        $set('unit_cost_estimated', $prod->base_cost ?: 0);
                                        if (method_exists($prod, 'resolvePurchasePackaging')) {
                                            $pkg = $prod->resolvePurchasePackaging();
                                            $set('conversion_factor', $pkg['factor'] ?: 1);
                                            $set('purchase_uom', $pkg['purchase_uom'] ?: $prod->unit_of_measure);
                                        } else {
                                            $set('conversion_factor', 1);
                                            $set('purchase_uom', $prod->unit_of_measure);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            })
                            ->columnSpan(3),

                        TextInput::make('raw_quantity')
                            ->label('Qtd. Comprada')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->default(1)
                            ->required()
                            ->live(debounce: 400)
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function (Get $get, Set $set) {
                                $raw = (float) ($get('raw_quantity') ?: 1);
                                $factor = (float) ($get('conversion_factor') ?: 1);
                                $set('quantity', round($raw * $factor, 4));
                            })
                            ->suffix(fn (Get $get) => $get('purchase_uom') ?: 'UN')
                            ->columnSpan(2),

                        TextInput::make('conversion_factor')
                            ->label('Fator (Unid./Fardo)')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->default(1)
                            ->required()
                            ->live(debounce: 400)
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function (Get $get, Set $set) {
                                $raw = (float) ($get('raw_quantity') ?: 1);
                                $factor = (float) ($get('conversion_factor') ?: 1);
                                $set('quantity', round($raw * $factor, 4));
                            })
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        TextInput::make('quantity')
                            ->label('Entrada Real')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->readOnly()
                            ->suffix(function (Get $get) {
                                $prodId = $get('product_id');
                                return $prodId ? Product::find($prodId)?->unit_of_measure : 'UN';
                            })
                            ->columnSpan(2),

                        TextInput::make('unit_cost_estimated')
                            ->label('Custo Unit. Real')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->prefix('R$')
                            ->required()
                            ->columnSpan(2),
                    ])
                    ->columns(10)
                    ->defaultItems(1)
                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                Textarea::make('notes')
                    ->label('Observações do Recebimento')
                    ->placeholder('Ex: Mercadoria recebida no turno da tarde. Aguardando nota fiscal no fim do mês.')
                    ->columnSpanFull(),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;

class GoodsReceiptsTable
{

    {

            ->columns([

                    ->label('#')
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('supplier.name')
                    ->label('Fornecedor')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('bold'),

                    ->searchable()
                    ->placeholder('S/N'),

                TextColumn::make('received_at')
                    ->label('Data de Chegada')
                    ->date('d/m/Y')
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('items_count')
                    ->counts('items')
                    ->label('Itens')
                    ->badge(),

                TextColumn::make('status')
                    ->label('Status Fiscal')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'pending_invoice' => 'Aguardando NF-e',
                        'reconciled' => 'Conciliado (Com NF-e)',
                        'cancelled' => 'Cancelado',
                        default => $state,
                    })
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'pending_invoice' => 'warning',
                        'reconciled' => 'success',
                        'cancelled' => 'danger',
                        default => 'gray',
                    }),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('received_at', 'desc')
            ->actions([
                EditAction::make(),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts;

use App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\Pages;
use App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\Schemas\GoodsReceiptForm;
use App\Filament\Resources\GoodsReceipts\Tables\GoodsReceiptsTable;
use App\Filament\Traits\HasGlobalSearch;
use App\Models\GoodsReceipt;
use Filament\Resources\Resource;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class GoodsReceiptResource extends Resource
{
    use HasGlobalSearch;

    protected static ?string $model = GoodsReceipt::class;

    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = 'Estoque & Compras';

    // 🚀 Atributo título principal do registro
    protected static ?string $recordTitleAttribute = 'receipt_number';

    public static function getNavigationIcon(): string | \BackedEnum | null
    {
        return 'heroicon-o-truck';
    }

    public static function getNavigationGroup(): ?string
    {
        return 'Financeiro';
    }

    public static function getNavigationSort(): ?int
    {
        return 5;
    }

    public static function getModelLabel(): string
    {
        return 'Romaneio / Canhoto';
    }

    public static function getPluralModelLabel(): string
    {
        return 'Romaneios / Canhotos';
    }

    // 🚀 Define as colunas reais para o Global Search (evita buscar 'name' inexistente)
    public static function getGloballySearchableAttributes(): array
    {
        return [
            'receipt_number',
            'supplier.name',
            'items.product.name',
        ];
    }

    // 🚀 Título exibido no resultado da busca global
    public static function getGlobalSearchResultTitle(Model $record): string
    {
        $num = $record->receipt_number ?: "ID #{$record->id}";
        $supplier = $record->supplier?->name ? " ({$record->supplier->name})" : '';
        return "Romaneio: {$num}{$supplier}";
    }

    // 🚀 Detalhes contextuais no card de resultado
    public static function getGlobalSearchResultDetails(Model $record): array
    {
        return [
            'Fornecedor' => $record->supplier?->name ?? 'Não informado',
            'Data'       => $record->received_at ? $record->received_at->format('d/m/Y') : 'N/D',
            'Status'     => match ($record->status) {
                'pending', 'pending_invoice' => 'Aguardando NF-e',
                'reconciled'                 => 'Conciliado',
                default                      => $record->status,
            },
        ];
    }

    public static function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return GoodsReceiptForm::configure($schema);
    }

    public static function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return GoodsReceiptsTable::configure($table);
    }

    public static function getPages(): array
    {
        return [
            'index'  => Pages\ListGoodsReceipts::route('/'),
            'create' => Pages\CreateGoodsReceipt::route('/create'),
            'edit'   => Pages\EditGoodsReceipt::route('/{record}/edit'),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\IngredientResource;
use Filament\Actions;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\ViewRecord;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class ViewIngredient extends ViewRecord
{
    protected static string $resource = IngredientResource::class;

    public function getTitle(): string|\Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Htmlable
    {
        return $this->record->name;
    }

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            // Botão padrão para ir para a tela de edição
            Actions\EditAction::make(),

            // Ação personalizada para Duplicar o Insumo
            // Útil para quando você tem insumos muito parecidos (ex: marcas diferentes do mesmo produto)
            Actions\Action::make("duplicate")
                ->label("Duplicar Insumo")
                ->color("gray")
                ->icon("heroicon-o-document-duplicate")
                ->requiresConfirmation()
                ->modalHeading("Duplicar este insumo?")
                ->modalDescription(
                    "Uma cópia exata deste insumo será criada. Você poderá editar o nome e os detalhes em seguida.",
                )
                ->action(function () {
                    // Replica o registro atual do banco de dados
                    $newIngredient = $this->record->replicate();

                    // Adiciona um sufixo para diferenciar da original
                    $newIngredient->name = $newIngredient->name . " (Cópia)";

                    // Salva o novo registro
                    $newIngredient->save();

                    Notification::make()
                        ->title("Insumo Duplicado com Sucesso!")
                        ->success()
                        ->send();

                    // Redireciona o usuário para a visualização do novo registro criado
                    return redirect(
                        IngredientResource::getUrl("view", [
                            "record" => $newIngredient->id,
                        ]),
                    );
                }),
        ];
    }
    protected function getHeaderWidgets(): array
    {
        return [
            \App\Filament\Resources\Products\Widgets\ProductMarginWidget::class,
        ];
    }

    public function hasCombinedRelationManagerTabsWithContent(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function getContentTabLabel(): ?string
    {
        return "Cadastro do Insumo";
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\Tables;

use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\IngredientResource;
use Filament\Actions;

class IngredientTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            // Redireciona o clique da linha para a tela de Visualização (View)
            ->recordUrl(
                fn(Product $record): string => IngredientResource::getUrl(
                    "view",
                    ["record" => $record],
                ),
            )
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("name")
                    ->label("Insumo")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight("bold"),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("category.name")
                    ->label("Categoria")
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("current_stock")
                    ->label("Stock Atual")
                    ->numeric(3)
                    ->color(fn($state) => $state <= 0 ? "danger" : "primary")
                    ->weight("bold"),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("unit_of_measure")->label(
                    "U.M.",
                ),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("base_cost")
                    ->label("Custo Médio")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $latestHistory = \App\Models\ProductCostHistory::where(
                            "product_id",
                            $record->id,
                        )
                            ->latest("id")
                            ->first();
                        $cost = $latestHistory
                            ? $latestHistory->unit_cost
                            : $record->base_cost;
                        return 'R$ ' .
                            number_format((float) $cost, 5, ",", ".");
                    })
                    ->color("success"),
            ])
            ->filters([
                Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make("category_id")
                    ->label("Filtrar Categoria")
                    ->options(
                        fn() => Category::where("type", "internal")->pluck(
                            "name",
                            "id",
                        ),
                    ),
            ])
            ->actions([
                Actions\ViewAction::make()->iconButton(),
                Actions\EditAction::make()->iconButton(),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                Actions\BulkActionGroup::make([
                    Actions\DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\InventoryLosses\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\InventoryLosses\InventoryLossResource;
```

```php
use Filament\Resources\Pages\ListRecords;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Tabs\Tab;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class ListInventoryLosses extends ListRecords
{
    protected static string $resource = InventoryLossResource::class;

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            Actions\Action::make('auditBalance')
                ->label('Balanço Rápido (Modo Inventário)')
                ->icon('heroicon-o-clipboard-document-check')
                ->color('warning')
                ->modalHeading('Conferência de Inventário por Local')
                ->modalDescription('Selecione o local de armazenamento para comparar as quantidades contadas com o saldo do sistema. As divergências negativas serão lançadas como perdas de inventário.')
                ->form([
                    Components\Select::make('storage_location_id')
                        ->label('Local a Conferir')
                        ->options(fn () => StorageLocation::pluck('name', 'id'))
                        ->required()
                        ->searchable()
                        ->live(),

                    Components\Placeholder::make('info')
                        ->content('Após selecionar o local, insira os itens e o saldo contado para atualizar a casa e gerar o relatório de auditoria.'),
                ])
                ->action(function (array $data) {
                    Notification::make()
                        ->info()
                        ->title('Local Selecionado')
                        ->body('Utilize o painel operacional para contagem detalhada com scanner ou biometria.')
                        ->send();
                }),

            Actions\CreateAction::make()
                ->label('Lançar Descarte Manual'),
        ];
    }

    public function getTabs(): array
    {
        return [
            'todos' => Tab::make('Todas as Perdas')
                ->badge(fn () => InventoryLoss::count()),

            'operacional' => Tab::make('Erros Operacionais')
                ->badge(fn () => InventoryLoss::where('loss_type', InventoryLoss::TYPE_OPERATIONAL)->count())
                ->badgeColor('warning')
                ->modifyQueryUsing(fn (Builder $q) => $q->where('loss_type', InventoryLoss::TYPE_OPERATIONAL)),

            'balanco' => Tab::make('Furos de Inventário')
                ->badge(fn () => InventoryLoss::where('loss_type', InventoryLoss::TYPE_INVENTORY_AUDIT)->count())
                ->badgeColor('danger')
                ->modifyQueryUsing(fn (Builder $q) => $q->where('loss_type', InventoryLoss::TYPE_INVENTORY_AUDIT)),

            'vencidos' => Tab::make('Vencidos & Deteriorados')
                ->badge(fn () => InventoryLoss::whereIn('loss_type', [InventoryLoss::TYPE_EXPIRED, InventoryLoss::TYPE_SPOILAGE])->count())
                ->badgeColor('gray')
                ->modifyQueryUsing(fn (Builder $q) => $q->whereIn('loss_type', [InventoryLoss::TYPE_EXPIRED, InventoryLoss::TYPE_SPOILAGE])),
        ];
    }
}
```
