```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\InventoryLosses\Schemas;

use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Forms\Components;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\InventoryLoss;

class InventoryLossForm
{
    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            Section::make('Registro de Perda / Descarte')
                ->description('Informe o produto, o tipo de ocorrência e a quantidade perdida.')
                ->schema([
                    Grid::make(3)->schema([
                        Components\Select::make('product_id')
                            ->label('Produto / Insumo')
                            ->relationship('product', 'name')
                            ->searchable()
                            ->preload()
                            ->required()
                            ->live()
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set) {
                                if ($state) {
                                    $p = Product::find($state);
                                    if ($p) {
                                        $cost = (float) ($p->base_cost ?? 0);
                                        $set('unit_cost', $cost);
                                    }
                                }
                            })
                            ->columnSpan(2),

                        Components\Select::make('loss_type')
                            ->label('Origem / Classificação da Perda')
                            ->options(InventoryLoss::TYPES)
                            ->default(InventoryLoss::TYPE_OPERATIONAL)
                            ->required()
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ]),

                    Grid::make(3)->schema([
                        Components\TextInput::make('quantity')
                            ->label('Quantidade Perdida')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->step('0.0001')
                            ->required()
                            ->live()
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function (Get $get, Set $set) {
                                $qty = (float) $get('quantity');
                                $unitCost = (float) $get('unit_cost');
                                $set('total_cost', round($qty * $unitCost, 2));
                            })
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        Components\TextInput::make('unit_cost')
                            ->label('Custo Unitário')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->prefix('R$')
                            ->required()
                            ->live()
                            ->afterStateUpdated(function (Get $get, Set $set) {
                                $qty = (float) $get('quantity');
                                $unitCost = (float) $get('unit_cost');
                                $set('total_cost', round($qty * $unitCost, 2));
                            })
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        Components\TextInput::make('total_cost')
                            ->label('Prejuízo Total')
                            ->numeric()
                            ->prefix('R$')
                            ->readOnly()
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ]),

                    Grid::make(2)->schema([
                        Components\Select::make('storage_location_id')
                            ->label('Local Físico (Onde ocorreu / Armário)')
                            ->relationship('storageLocation', 'name')
                            ->searchable()
                            ->preload()
                            ->placeholder('Não especificado')
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        Components\TextInput::make('reason')
                            ->label('Motivo / Resumo')
                            ->placeholder('Ex: Carne queimada, quebra de garrafa, erro de garçom')
                            ->required()
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ]),

                    Components\Textarea::make('notes')
                        ->label('Observações Adicionais')
                        ->rows(3)
                        ->columnSpanFull(),
                ])
                ->columnSpanFull(),
        ];
    }

    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->schema(self::getFormSchema());
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\InventoryLosses\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns;
use Filament\Tables\Filters;
use Filament\Actions;
use App\Models\InventoryLoss;

class InventoryLossesTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                Columns\TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Data / Hora')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),

                Columns\TextColumn::make('product.name')
                    ->label('Item Perdido')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('bold')
                    ->description(fn (InventoryLoss $record) => $record->storageLocation ? "Local: {$record->storageLocation->name}" : null),

                Columns\BadgeColumn::make('loss_type')
                    ->label('Classificação')
                    ->colors([
                        'warning' => InventoryLoss::TYPE_OPERATIONAL,
                        'danger'  => [InventoryLoss::TYPE_INVENTORY_AUDIT, InventoryLoss::TYPE_SPOILAGE],
                        'gray'    => InventoryLoss::TYPE_EXPIRED,
                        'info'    => InventoryLoss::TYPE_DAMAGED,
                    ])
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn ($state) => InventoryLoss::TYPES[$state] ?? ucfirst($state)),

                Columns\TextColumn::make('quantity')
                    ->label('Qtd.')
                    ->numeric(3)
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn ($state, $record) => number_format((float)$state, 2, ',', '.') . ' ' . strtoupper($record->product?->unit_of_measure ?? 'UN')),

                Columns\TextColumn::make('total_cost')
                    ->label('Prejuízo Total')
                    ->money('BRL')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->color('danger')
                    ->weight('black'),

                Columns\TextColumn::make('reason')
                    ->label('Motivo')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->limit(35)
                    ->tooltip(fn ($record) => $record->notes),

                Columns\TextColumn::make('user.name')
                    ->label('Responsável')
                    ->placeholder('Sistema'),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc')
            ->filters([
                Filters\SelectFilter::make('loss_type')
                    ->label('Tipo de Perda')
                    ->options(InventoryLoss::TYPES),

                Filters\SelectFilter::make('storage_location_id')
                    ->label('Local de Armazenamento')
                    ->relationship('storageLocation', 'name'),
            ])
            ->actions([
                Actions\ViewAction::make(),
            ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyCustomers/Pages/ManageLegacyCustomers.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyCustomers\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\LegacyCustomers\LegacyCustomerResource;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\LegacyCustomer;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\CreateAction;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Components\ToggleButtons;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\ManageRecords;

class ManageLegacyCustomers extends ManageRecords
{
    protected static string $resource = LegacyCustomerResource::class;

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            // 🚀 1. MATCH EXATO (Mantido)
            Action::make("auto_match")
                ->label("Match Automático")
                ->icon("heroicon-o-bolt")
                ->color("success")
                ->requiresConfirmation()
                ->modalHeading("Vincular Clientes Automaticamente")
                ->modalDescription(
                    "O sistema procurará clientes na V3 com o nome exato da V1. Se encontrar apenas 1 cliente correspondente, fará o vínculo automático.",
                )
                ->modalSubmitActionLabel("Iniciar Match")
                ->action(function () {
                    $unmappedCustomers = LegacyCustomer::whereNull(
                        "customer_id",
                    )
                        ->where("is_ignored", false)
                        ->get();
                    $matchCount = 0;

                    foreach ($unmappedCustomers as $legacy) {
                        $cleanName = trim($legacy->legacy_name);
                        $v3Matches = Customer::where("name", $cleanName)->get();

                        if ($v3Matches->count() === 1) {
                            $legacy->update([
                                "customer_id" => $v3Matches->first()->id,
                            ]);
                            $matchCount++;
                        }
                    }

                    if ($matchCount > 0) {
                        Notification::make()
                            ->title("Match Concluído!")
                            ->body(
                                "🎉 <b>{$matchCount} clientes</b> foram vinculados automaticamente.",
                            )
                            ->success()
                            ->send();
                    } else {
                        Notification::make()
                            ->title("Nenhum match exato encontrado.")
                            ->info()
                            ->send();
                    }
                }),

            // 🚀 2. MATCH INTELIGENTE (COM EFEITO ESTEIRA E PHPACTOR FELIZ)
            Action::make("smart_match")
                ->label("Match Inteligente (Checklist)")
                ->icon("heroicon-o-clipboard-document-check")
                ->color("warning")
                ->modalHeading("Sugestões de Mapeamento (Lote de 10 registros)")
                ->modalDescription(
                    'Avalie as sugestões de nomes semelhantes abaixo. Se marcar "Pular", o cliente não aparecerá mais nesta lista.',
                )
                ->modalSubmitActionLabel("Confirmar Lote e Avançar")
                ->modalWidth("5xl")
                ->form(function () {
                    // 🚀 Adicionado o query() para o PHPactor não reclamar
                    $unmappedLegacy = LegacyCustomer::query()
                        ->whereNull("customer_id")
                        ->where("is_ignored", false)
                        ->get();

                    if ($unmappedLegacy->isEmpty()) {
                        return [
                            Placeholder::make("empty")
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->content(
                                    "Não há clientes pendentes para mapear.",
                                ),
                        ];
                    }

                    $allV3Customers = Customer::all(["id", "name"]);
                    $suggestions = [];
                    $limitCounter = 0;

                    foreach ($unmappedLegacy as $legacy) {
                        if ($limitCounter >= 10) {
                            break;
                        }

                        $legacyName = trim($legacy->legacy_name);
                        $legacyParts = array_values(
                            array_filter(explode(" ", $legacyName)),
                        );

                        if (count($legacyParts) < 2) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        $legacyFirst = mb_strtolower($legacyParts[0]);
                        $legacyLast = mb_strtolower(end($legacyParts));

                        $matches = [];
                        foreach ($allV3Customers as $v3) {
                            $v3Name = trim($v3->name);
                            $v3Parts = array_values(
                                array_filter(explode(" ", $v3Name)),
                            );

                            if (count($v3Parts) < 2) {
                                continue;
                            }

                            $v3First = mb_strtolower($v3Parts[0]);
                            $v3Last = mb_strtolower(end($v3Parts));

                            if (
                                $legacyFirst === $v3First &&
                                $legacyLast === $v3Last
                            ) {
                                $matches[$v3->id] = "🤝 " . $v3Name;
                            }
                        }

                        if (!empty($matches)) {
                            $suggestions[$legacy->id] = [
                                "legacy_name" => $legacyName,
                                "matches" => $matches,
                            ];
                            $limitCounter++;
                        }
                    }

                    if (empty($suggestions)) {
                        return [
                            Placeholder::make("empty")
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->content(
                                    "Nenhuma sugestão inteligente pendente com esta regra.",
                                ),
                        ];
                    }

                    $schema = [];
                    foreach ($suggestions as $legacyId => $data) {
                        $options = $data["matches"];
                        $options["skip"] = "Pular";

                        $schema[] = Grid::make(12)
                            ->extraAttributes([
                                "class" =>
                                    "items-center py-2 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 gap-4",
                            ])
                            ->schema([
                                Placeholder::make("label_{$legacyId}")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->content($data["legacy_name"])
                                    ->extraAttributes([
                                        "class" =>
                                            "text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 uppercase truncate pt-1",
                                    ])
                                    ->columnSpan(4),

                                ToggleButtons::make("match_{$legacyId}")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->options($options)
                                    ->default("skip")
                                    ->inline()
                                    ->icons([
                                        "skip" => "heroicon-m-x-mark",
                                    ])
                                    ->extraAttributes([
                                        "class" =>
                                            "ms-auto flex justify-end max-w-max",
                                    ])
                                    ->columnSpan(8),
                            ]);
                    }

                    return [
                        Section::make("Painel de Mapeamento Rápido")
                            ->description(
                                "Os nomes à esquerda são da V1, os botões à direita são as opções da V3.",
                            )
                            ->schema([Grid::make(1)->schema($schema)->gap(0)]),
                    ];
                })
                ->action(function (array $data) {
                    $countMatched = 0;
                    $countIgnored = 0;

                    foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
                        if (str_starts_with($key, "match_")) {
                            $legacyId = str_replace("match_", "", $key);

                            if ($value === "skip") {
                                // 🚀 query() adicionado
                                LegacyCustomer::query()
                                    ->where("id", $legacyId)
                                    ->update(["is_ignored" => true]);
                                $countIgnored++;
                            } else {
                                // 🚀 query() adicionado
                                LegacyCustomer::query()
                                    ->where("id", $legacyId)
                                    ->update(["customer_id" => $value]);
                                $countMatched++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Notification::make()
                        ->title("Lote Processado")
                        ->body(
                            "<b>{$countMatched}</b> vinculados e <b>{$countIgnored}</b> ignorados.",
                        )
                        ->success()
                        ->send();
                })
                // 🚀 O SEGREDO ESTÁ AQUI: O HOOK "AFTER" (Roda depois que o modal principal fecha)
                ->after(function (\Livewire\Component $livewire) {
                    $hasMore = false;
                    $unmappedLegacy = LegacyCustomer::query()
                        ->whereNull("customer_id")
                        ->where("is_ignored", false)
                        ->get();
                    $allV3Customers = Customer::all(["id", "name"]);

                    foreach ($unmappedLegacy as $legacy) {
                        $legacyParts = array_values(
                            array_filter(
                                explode(" ", trim($legacy->legacy_name)),
                            ),
                        );
                        if (count($legacyParts) < 2) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        $legacyFirst = mb_strtolower($legacyParts[0]);
                        $legacyLast = mb_strtolower(end($legacyParts));

                        foreach ($allV3Customers as $v3) {
                            $v3Parts = array_values(
                                array_filter(explode(" ", trim($v3->name))),
                            );
                            if (count($v3Parts) < 2) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            if (
                                $legacyFirst === mb_strtolower($v3Parts[0]) &&
                                $legacyLast === mb_strtolower(end($v3Parts))
                            ) {
                                $hasMore = true;
                                break 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if ($hasMore) {
                        // 🚀 Reabre a ação, criando o "Efeito Esteira" perfeito e dinâmico!
                        $livewire->mountAction("smart_match");
                    }
                }),

            CreateAction::make()->modalWidth("md"),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;

class LegacyCustomerForm

    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {

                ->schema([

                        ->preload()
                        ->helperText(
                            "Selecione o cliente real do sistema atual para vincular o histórico.",
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyModifiers/Actions/BatchResolveModifiersAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyModifiers\Actions;

use App\Models\LegacyModifier;
use App\Models\ModifierOption;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\CheckboxList;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

class BatchResolveModifiersAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return "batch_resolve_modifiers";
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label("Mapeamento Inteligente")
            ->icon("heroicon-o-sparkles")
            ->color("primary")
            ->modalHeading("Mapeamento em Lote (Sabores e Adicionais)")
            ->modalDescription("Verifique os cruzamentos abaixo. Se o sabor bater com o grupo correto, mantenha marcado!")
            ->modalSubmitActionLabel("Vincular Selecionados")
            ->modalWidth("3xl") // 🚀 Um pouco mais largo para caber o nome do grupo confortavelmente
            ->form(fn() => $this->getBatchForm())
            ->action(fn(array $data) => $this->performBatchAction($data));
    }

    protected function getBatchForm(): array
    {
        $matches = $this->getNextBatchMatches();

        if (empty($matches["items"])) {
            return [
                Placeholder::make("empty")
                    ->hiddenLabel()
                    ->content(new HtmlString('<div class="text-center text-gray-500 py-4">Nenhuma sugestão óbvia encontrada.<br>Os itens restantes precisam ser mapeados manualmente na tabela.</div>')),
            ];
        }

        $allOfferedKeys = collect($matches["items"])
            ->map(fn($m) => $m["legacy_id"] . "|" . $m["option_id"])
            ->toArray();

        return [
            Placeholder::make("confidence_badge")
                ->hiddenLabel()
                ->content(new HtmlString("<div class='text-lg font-medium text-primary-600 mb-2'>🔥 Lote de Confiança Atual: ~{$matches["confidence"]}%</div>")),

            CheckboxList::make("approved_matches")
                ->hiddenLabel()
                ->options(collect($matches["items"])->mapWithKeys(function ($match) {
                    // 🚀 Agora a exibição inclui o grupo da Opção! (Ex: Carne ➔ Carne (Sabores de Pastel))
                    return [$match["legacy_id"] . "|" . $match["option_id"] => "{$match["legacy_name"]} ➔ {$match["option_name"]}"];
                }))
                ->default($allOfferedKeys)
                ->bulkToggleable()
                ->columns(1)
                ->extraAttributes([
                    // 🚀 ROLAGEM INTERNA: A lista agora rola por dentro, preservando o modal!
                    'class' => 'max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 shadow-inner'
                ]),

            Hidden::make("all_suggested_pairs")->default(json_encode($allOfferedKeys)),
        ];
    }

    protected function performBatchAction(array $data): void
    {
        $approved = $data["approved_matches"] ?? [];
        $allSuggested = json_decode($data["all_suggested_pairs"] ?? '[]', true);

        $rejected = array_diff($allSuggested, $approved);

        if (!empty($rejected)) {
            $cachedRejects = session()->get('rejected_legacy_mod_matches', []);
            $mergedRejects = array_unique(array_merge($cachedRejects, array_values($rejected)));
            session()->put('rejected_legacy_mod_matches', $mergedRejects);
        }

        $count = 0;
        foreach ($approved as $combined) {
            [$legacyId, $optionId] = explode("|", $combined);
            LegacyModifier::where("id", $legacyId)->update([
                "modifier_option_id" => $optionId,
                "is_ignored" => false,
            ]);
            $count++;
        }

        Notification::make()
            ->title("{$count} opções vinculadas com sucesso!")
            ->success()
            ->send();
    }

    private function getNextBatchMatches(): array
    {
        $pendingLegacy = LegacyModifier::whereNull("modifier_option_id")
            ->where("is_ignored", false)
            ->get();

        if ($pendingLegacy->isEmpty()) return ["confidence" => 0, "items" => []];

        // 🚀 O JOIN MÁGICO: Traz o nome da opção e o nome do grupo ("modifier_groups") ao qual ela pertence
        $options = ModifierOption::join('modifier_groups', 'modifier_groups.id', '=', 'modifier_options.modifier_group_id')
            ->select('modifier_options.id', 'modifier_options.name as option_name', 'modifier_groups.name as group_name')
            ->get();

        if ($options->isEmpty()) return ["confidence" => 0, "items" => []];

        $rejectedPairs = session()->get('rejected_legacy_mod_matches', []);
        $allBestMatches = [];

        foreach ($pendingLegacy as $legacy) {
            $bestMatch = null;
            $highestSim = 0;
            $legacyName = strtoupper(trim($legacy->name));

            foreach ($options as $opt) {
                $pairKey = $legacy->id . "|" . $opt->id;
                if (in_array($pairKey, $rejectedPairs)) continue;

                $optName = strtoupper(trim($opt->option_name));
                similar_text($legacyName, $optName, $percent);

                if (str_contains($optName, $legacyName) || str_contains($legacyName, $optName)) {
                    $percent += 20;
                }

                if ($percent > $highestSim) {
                    $highestSim = $percent;
                    $bestMatch = $opt;
                }
                if ($highestSim >= 100) break;
            }

            if ($bestMatch && $highestSim >= 50) {
                $groupSim = floor($highestSim);
                if ($groupSim % 2 !== 0) $groupSim--;

                $allBestMatches[$groupSim][] = [
                    "legacy_id" => $legacy->id,
                    "legacy_name" => $legacy->name,
                    "option_id" => $bestMatch->id,
                    // 🚀 Montando o nome visual com o grupo!
                    "option_name" => $bestMatch->option_name . " (" . $bestMatch->group_name . ")",
                ];
            }
        }

        if (empty($allBestMatches)) return ["confidence" => 0, "items" => []];

        krsort($allBestMatches);
        $highestConfidence = array_key_first($allBestMatches);

        return [
            "confidence" => $highestConfidence > 100 ? 100 : $highestConfidence,
            "items" => $allBestMatches[$highestConfidence],
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyModifiers/LegacyModifierResource.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyModifiers;

use App\Models\LegacyModifier;
use Filament\Resources\Resource;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\TernaryFilter;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction; // 🚀 Corrigido para Tables\Actions
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Radio;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use App\Filament\Resources\LegacyModifiers\Pages;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class LegacyModifierResource extends Resource
{
    protected static ?string $model = LegacyModifier::class;
    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = 'Sistema Legado';
    protected static ?string $navigationLabel = "Modificadores Antigos";
    protected static ?string $modelLabel = "Modificador Legado";

    public static function getNavigationBadge(): ?string
    {
        // Conta pendentes que não têm nem opção nem produto mapeado
        $count = static::getModel()::whereNull("modifier_option_id")
            ->whereNull("current_product_id")
            ->where("is_ignored", false)
            ->count();

        return $count > 0 ? (string) $count : null;
    }

    public static function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->components([
            TextInput::make('name')->label('Nome Original')->disabled(),

            // 🚀 A DUPLA POSSIBILIDADE!
            Radio::make('mapping_type')
                ->label('O que este item era na verdade?')
                ->options([
                    'option' => 'Era um Modificador/Sabor',
                    'product' => 'Era um Produto / Combo Disfarçado',
                ])
                ->default('option')
                ->live()
                ->afterStateHydrated(function ($component, $state, $record) {
                    // Puxa o status correto ao abrir o modal de edição
                    if ($record?->current_product_id) {
                        $component->state('product');
                    } else {
                        $component->state('option');
                    }
                })
                ->dehydrated(false), // Não salva este campo "virtual" no banco

            Select::make('modifier_option_id')
                ->label('Opção Mapeada (Cardápio V3)')
                ->relationship('currentOption', 'name')
                ->searchable()
                ->preload()
                ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('mapping_type') === 'option'),

                Select::make('current_product_id')
                                ->label('Produto Mapeado (Cardápio V3)')
                                ->relationship(
                                    name: 'currentProduct',
                                    titleAttribute: 'name',
                                    // 🚀 O FILTRO ESTRITO NAS CATEGORIAS: Verifica a relação 'category' do Produto
                                    modifyQueryUsing: fn (Builder $query) => $query->whereHas('category', fn (Builder $q) => $q->where('type', 'external'))
                                )
                                ->searchable()
                                ->preload()
                                ->visible(fn (Get $get) => $get('mapping_type') === 'product'),

            Toggle::make('is_ignored')->label('Ignorar no BI')->inline(false),
        ]);
    }

    public static function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Sabor / Adicional (Legado)')
                    ->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make('order_item_modifiers_count')
                    ->counts('orderItemModifiers')
                    ->label('Ocorrências')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color('info')
                    ->sortable(),

                // 🚀 Exibe de forma inteligente para onde ele foi mapeado!
                TextColumn::make('mapped_to')
                    ->label('Mapeado Para')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn ($record) => ($record->modifier_option_id || $record->current_product_id) ? 'gray' : ($record->is_ignored ? 'gray' : 'danger'))
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        if ($record->is_ignored) return 'Ignorado';
                        if ($record->modifier_option_id) return 'Opção: ' . ($record->currentOption->name ?? '');
                        if ($record->current_product_id) return 'Produto: ' . ($record->currentProduct->name ?? '');
                        return 'Pendente';
                    }),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('modifier_option_id', 'asc')
            ->filters([
                TernaryFilter::make('is_mapped')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->queries(
                        true: fn ($query) => $query->whereNotNull('modifier_option_id')->orWhereNotNull('current_product_id'),
                        false: fn ($query) => $query->whereNull('modifier_option_id')->whereNull('current_product_id')->where('is_ignored', false),
                    )
            ])
            ->actions([
                            EditAction::make()
                                ->modalWidth('md')
                                ->mutateFormDataUsing(function (array $data): array {
                                    // 🚀 SEGURANÇA (MÉTODO CORRETO PARA TABLE ACTIONS):
                                    // Garante que um item não seja Produto E Opção ao mesmo tempo
                                    if (!isset($data['mapping_type'])) return $data;

                                    if ($data['mapping_type'] === 'option') {
                                        $data['current_product_id'] = null;
                                    } else {
                                        $data['modifier_option_id'] = null;
                                    }

                                    return $data;
                                }),
                        ]);
    }

    public static function getPages(): array
    {
        return [
            'index' => Pages\ManageLegacyModifiers::route('/'),
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyOrders/Actions/ScanV1CsvAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyOrders\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use App\Models\LegacyCustomer;
use App\Models\LegacyNeighborhood;
use App\Models\LegacyProduct;
use App\Models\LegacyPaymentMethod;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Support\Enums\Alignment;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ScanV1CsvAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'scan_v1_csv';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('1. Varrer CSV V1 (Mapeamento)')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-magnifying-glass-circle')
            ->color('info')
            ->modalHeading('Scanner Preparatório (Fase 1)')
            ->modalDescription('Faça o upload do CSV da V1. O sistema irá varrer todas as linhas para descobrir Clientes, Bairros, Produtos e Formas de Pagamento únicos.')
            ->modalSubmitActionLabel('Iniciar Varredura')
            ->modalFooterActionsAlignment(Alignment::End)
            ->form([
                FileUpload::make('csv_file')
                    ->label('Ficheiro CSV (V1)')
                    ->acceptedFileTypes(['text/csv', 'text/plain', 'application/csv'])
                    ->disk('local')
                    ->directory('csv_imports')
                    ->required(),
            ])
            ->action(function (array $data) {
                // Previne problemas com quebras de linha do Mac/Windows antigo
                ini_set('auto_detect_line_endings', true);

                $filePath = Storage::disk('local')->path($data['csv_file']);

                $handle = fopen($filePath, 'r');
                if (!$handle) {
                    Notification::make()->title('Erro ao abrir o ficheiro.')->danger()->send();
                    return;
                }

                // Deteta automaticamente se o separador é vírgula ou ponto-e-vírgula
                $firstLine = fgets($handle);
                $delimiter = strpos($firstLine, ';') !== false ? ';' : ',';
                rewind($handle); // Volta ao início do ficheiro

                // Lê o cabeçalho
                $header = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);

                $uniqueCustomers = [];
                $uniqueNeighborhoods = [];
                $uniqueProducts = [];
                $uniquePayments = [];

                // As formas de pagamento começam no índice 14 ("CC SIC")
                $paymentStartIndex = 14;
                for ($i = $paymentStartIndex; $i < count($header); $i++) {
                    $paymentName = trim($header[$i]);
                    if (!empty($paymentName)) {
                        $uniquePayments[$paymentName] = true;
                    }
                }

                // Varrer as Linhas
                $lineNumber = 1;
                while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
                    $lineNumber++;

                    // Se a linha não tem colunas suficientes para chegar ao Item (índice 7), ignora
                    if (count($row) < 8) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    // Usa exatamente os índices que você definiu no seu mapa:
                    $customer = trim($row[1] ?? ''); // Coluna 2
                    $neighborhood = trim($row[2] ?? ''); // Coluna 3
                    $product = trim($row[7] ?? ''); // Coluna 8

                    if (!empty($customer)) {
                        $uniqueCustomers[$customer] = true;
                    }
                    if (!empty($neighborhood)) {
                        $uniqueNeighborhoods[$neighborhood] = true;
                    }
                    if (!empty($product)) {
                        $uniqueProducts[$product] = true;
                    }
                }

                fclose($handle);

                // ==========================================
                // SALVAR NA BASE DE DADOS E CONTAR
                // ==========================================
                $counters = [
                    'customers_new' => 0, 'customers_total' => count($uniqueCustomers),
                    'neighborhoods_new' => 0, 'neighborhoods_total' => count($uniqueNeighborhoods),
                    'products_new' => 0, 'products_total' => count($uniqueProducts),
                    'payments_new' => 0, 'payments_total' => count($uniquePayments),
                ];

                foreach (array_keys($uniqueCustomers) as $c) {
                    if (LegacyCustomer::firstOrCreate(['legacy_name' => $c])->wasRecentlyCreated) $counters['customers_new']++;
                }

                foreach (array_keys($uniqueNeighborhoods) as $n) {
                    if (LegacyNeighborhood::firstOrCreate(['legacy_name' => $n])->wasRecentlyCreated) $counters['neighborhoods_new']++;
                }

                foreach (array_keys($uniqueProducts) as $p) {
                    if (LegacyProduct::firstOrCreate(['legacy_code' => $p], ['name' => $p])->wasRecentlyCreated) $counters['products_new']++;
                }

                foreach (array_keys($uniquePayments) as $pay) {
                    if (LegacyPaymentMethod::firstOrCreate(['name' => $pay])->wasRecentlyCreated) $counters['payments_new']++;
                }

                Storage::disk('local')->delete($data['csv_file']);

                // Relatório Rico
                Notification::make()
                    ->title('Varredura Concluída!')
                    ->body(
                        "Foram lidas <b>" . ($lineNumber - 1) . " linhas de dados</b>.<br><br>" .
                        "<b>Clientes:</b> {$counters['customers_new']} novos (Lidos: {$counters['customers_total']})<br>" .
                        "<b>Bairros:</b> {$counters['neighborhoods_new']} novos (Lidos: {$counters['neighborhoods_total']})<br>" .
                        "<b>Produtos:</b> {$counters['products_new']} novos (Lidos: {$counters['products_total']})<br>" .
                        "<b>Pagamentos:</b> {$counters['payments_new']} novos (Lidos: {$counters['payments_total']})"
                    )
                    ->success()
                    ->duration(15000)
                    ->send();
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyOrders/Infolists/LegacyOrderInfolist.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyOrders\Infolists;

use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\TextEntry;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\RepeatableEntry;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Actions;
use Filament\Actions\Action;

class LegacyOrderInfolist
{
    public static function build(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->components([
            Section::make("Resumo da Nota")
                ->compact()
                ->columns(4)
                ->columnSpanFull()
                ->schema([
                    // Esconde a chave da NFe se estiver vazia (típico da V1)
                    TextEntry::make("nfe_key")
                        ->label("Chave de Acesso")
                        ->columns(2)
                        ->copyable()
                        ->visible(fn($record) => filled($record->nfe_key)),

                    TextEntry::make("issue_date")
                        ->label("Data do Pedido")
                        ->dateTime("d/m/Y H:i"),

                    TextEntry::make("series")->label("Série")->default("N/A"),

                    TextEntry::make("number")->label("Número do Pedido/Nota"),

                    // 🚀 OS NOSSOS BOTÕES FISCAIS
                    Actions::make([
                        // Botão 1: Download Nativo do XML
                        Action::make('download_xml')
                            ->label('Baixar XML')
                            ->icon('heroicon-o-code-bracket')
                            // Só aparece se tiver chave E conteúdo XML salvo no banco
                            ->visible(fn($record) => filled($record->nfe_key) && filled($record->xml_content))
                            ->action(function ($record) {
                                return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($record) {
                                    echo $record->xml_content;
                                }, "{$record->nfe_key}.xml");
                            }),

                        // Botão 2: Imprimir DANFE
                        Action::make('print_danfe')
                            ->label('Imprimir Cupom (DANFE)')
                            ->icon('heroicon-o-printer')
                            // Só aparece se tiver chave
                            ->visible(fn($record) => filled($record->nfe_key))
                            ->url(fn ($record) => "/admin/legacy-orders/{$record->id}/print")
                            ->openUrlInNewTab(),
                    ])->columnSpanFull(),
                ]),

            Section::make("Dados do Pedido & Cliente")
                ->compact()
                ->columns(5)
                ->columnSpanFull()
                ->schema([
                    TextEntry::make("import_tag")->label("Tag Lote")->badge(),

                    TextEntry::make("order_type")
                        ->label("Tipo")
                        ->badge()
                        ->state(function ($record) {
                            if ($record->order_type) {
                                return match ($record->order_type) {
                                    "delivery" => "Delivery",
                                    "counter" => "Balcão",
                                    "table" => "Mesa",
                                    default => $record->order_type,
                                };
                            }
                            return "-";
                        }),

                    // 🚀 VACINA 1: Nullsafe no Cliente
                    TextEntry::make("customer_name_display")
                        ->label("Nome do Cliente")
                        ->state(function ($record) {
                            if ($record->customer_id) {
                                return $record->customer?->name ??
                                    "Consumidor Final";
                            }
                            if ($record->legacy_customer_id) {
                                return $record->legacyCustomer?->legacy_name ??
                                    "Consumidor Final";
                            }
                            return "Consumidor Final";
                        }),

                    TextEntry::make("customer.cpf")
                        ->label("CPF/CNPJ")
                        ->default("Não informado"),

                    // 🚀 VACINA 2: Nullsafe Duplo no Bairro e Taxa
                    TextEntry::make("neighborhood_display")
                        ->label("Bairro de Entrega")
                        ->state(function ($record) {
                            if ($record->legacy_neighborhood_id) {
                                // Tenta o mapeado da V3, senão cai pro legado
                                $mapped =
                                    $record->legacyNeighborhood?->neighborhood;
                                return $mapped?->name ??
                                    ($record->legacyNeighborhood
                                        ?->legacy_name ??
                                        "Bairro Desconhecido");
                            }
                            return "-";
                        })
                        ->visible(
                            fn($record) => $record->order_type === "delivery",
                        ),
                ]),

            Section::make("Itens do Pedido")
                ->compact()
                ->columnSpanFull()
                ->schema([
                    RepeatableEntry::make("items")
                        ->hiddenLabel() // Oculta o título padrão "Items" do relacionamento
                        ->columns(4) // Distribui os campos em 4 colunas horizontais
                        ->contained(false)
                        ->schema([
                            TextEntry::make("legacyProduct.name")
                                ->hiddenlabel()
                                ->weight("bold")
                                ->default("Produto Desconhecido"), // 🚀 Previne erro se o produto foi apagado

                            TextEntry::make("quantity")
                                ->hiddenlabel()
                                ->numeric(decimalPlaces: 3), // Removido o sufixo "un"

                            TextEntry::make("unit_price")
                                ->hiddenlabel()
                                ->money("BRL")
                                ->alignEnd(),

                            TextEntry::make("total_price")
                                ->hiddenlabel()
                                ->money("BRL")
                                ->alignEnd(),
                        ]),
                ]),

            Section::make("Financeiro & Pagamentos")
                ->compact()
                ->columns(2)
                ->columnSpanFull()
                ->schema([
                    // Lado Esquerdo: Resumo dos Valores
                    Section::make()
                        ->columnSpan(1)
                        ->schema([
                            // Calcula e mostra a taxa de entrega a partir do bairro mapeado
                            TextEntry::make("delivery_fee")
                                ->label("Taxa de Entrega")
                                ->money("BRL")
                                ->visible(fn($record) => $record->order_type === "delivery"),

                            TextEntry::make("discount")
                                ->label("Desconto")
                                ->money("BRL")
                                ->visible(fn($record) => $record->discount > 0),

                            // O Total Final já deve vir calculado da nossa importação, mas podemos recalcular visualmente por garantia
                            TextEntry::make("total_value")
                                ->label("Valor Total do Pedido")
                                ->weight("bold")
                                ->size("lg")
                                ->money("BRL"),
                        ]),

                    // Lado Direito: Métodos de Pagamento Utilizados
                    Section::make("Pagamentos Registados")
                        ->columnSpan(1)
                        ->schema([
                            RepeatableEntry::make("payments") // Precisa garantir que no Model a relação se chama 'payments'
                                ->label("")
                                ->columns(2)
                                ->contained(false)
                                ->schema([
                                    TextEntry::make("legacyPaymentMethod.name")
                                        ->hiddenLabel()
                                        ->default("Pgt. Desconhecido"), // 🚀 Previne erro

                                    TextEntry::make("amount")
                                        ->hiddenLabel()
                                        ->money("BRL")
                                        ->alignEnd(),
                                ]),
                        ]),
                ]),
        ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyProducts/Tables/LegacyProductsTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyProducts\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\ActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\BulkAction;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

// Models
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\LegacyProduct;

// Actions & Schemas
use App\Filament\Resources\LegacyProducts\Actions\BatchResolveProductsAction;
use App\Filament\Resources\LegacyProducts\Schemas\LegacyProductForm;

class LegacyProductsTable
{
    public static function build(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make("legacy_code")->label("Código")->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make("name")
                    ->label("Nome Legado")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->limit(30),

                TextColumn::make("mapped_status")
                    ->label("Status de Mapeamento")
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(
                        fn($record) => match (true) {
                            $record->is_ignored => "danger",
                            $record->current_product_id !== null => "success",
                            default => "warning",
                        },
                    )
                    ->state(
                        fn($record) => match (true) {
                            $record->is_ignored => "Ignorado",
                            $record->current_product_id !== null => $record->currentProduct?->name,
                            default => "Pendente",
                        },
                    ),
            ])
            // 🚀 ORDENAÇÃO DEFAULT: Joga os itens pendentes para o topo!
            ->defaultSort('current_product_id', 'asc')
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make("status")
                    ->label("Situação")
                    ->options([
                        "pending" => "Pendentes",
                        "mapped" => "Mapeados",
                        "ignored" => "Ignorados",
                    ])
                    ->query(
                        fn($query, array $data) => match ($data["value"]) {
                            "pending" => $query->whereNull("current_product_id")->where("is_ignored", false),
                            "mapped" => $query->whereNotNull("current_product_id"),
                            "ignored" => $query->where("is_ignored", true),
                            default => $query,
                        },
                    ),
            ])
            ->headerActions([
                BatchResolveProductsAction::make(),
            ])
            ->actions([
                ActionGroup::make([

                    // 1. Associar Produto
                    EditAction::make()
                        ->label('Associar Produto (V3)')
                        ->icon('heroicon-o-link')
                        ->color('primary')
                        ->after(
                            fn($record) => LegacyProductForm::goToNextRecord($record),
                        ),

                    // 2. Migrar como Descontinuado
                    Action::make('migrate_individual_discontinued')
                        ->label('Migrar como Descontinuado (BI)')
                        ->icon('heroicon-o-archive-box-arrow-down')
                        ->color('warning')
                        ->form([
                            Select::make('category_id')
                                ->label('Categoria de Agrupamento')
                                ->options(Category::where('type', 'external')->pluck('name', 'id'))
                                ->searchable()
                                ->required(),
                        ])
                        ->action(function (LegacyProduct $record, array $data) {
                            $ghostProduct = Product::create([
                                'name' => $record->name . ' (Descontinuado)',
                                'category_id' => $data['category_id'],
                                'status' => 'archived',
                                'show_on_menu' => false,
                                'show_on_delivery' => false,
                                'type' => 'resale',
                                'unit_measure' => 'un',
                            ]);

                            $record->update([
                                'current_product_id' => $ghostProduct->id,
                                'is_ignored' => false,
                            ]);

                            Notification::make()
                                ->title("Item descontinuado criado e vinculado!")
                                ->success()
                                ->send();
                        }),

                    // 3. Ignorar
                    Action::make('ignore_individual')
                        ->label('Ignorar (Excluir do BI)')
                        ->icon('heroicon-o-trash')
                        ->color('danger')
                        ->requiresConfirmation()
                        ->modalHeading('Ignorar Produto Legado')
                        ->modalDescription('Tem certeza que deseja ignorar este item? Ele não fará parte do faturamento histórico.')
                        ->action(function (LegacyProduct $record) {
                            $record->update([
                                'is_ignored' => true,
                                'current_product_id' => null,
                            ]);

                            Notification::make()
                                ->title("Item ignorado com sucesso!")
                                ->success()
                                ->send();
                        }),

                ])
                ->icon('heroicon-m-ellipsis-vertical')
                ->tooltip('Ações disponíveis')
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([

                    // 1. Vincular Múltiplos
                    BulkAction::make('map_to_single_product')
                        ->label('Vincular ao mesmo Produto (V3)')
                        ->icon('heroicon-o-link')
                        ->color('primary')
                        ->modalHeading('Vincular Vários Itens')
                        ->modalDescription('Escolha o produto do ERP atual (V3) que será associado a todos os registos legados selecionados.')
                        ->form([
                            Select::make('current_product_id')
                                ->label('Produto Final (V3)')
                                ->options(Product::pluck('name', 'id'))
                                ->searchable()
                                ->required(),
                        ])
                        ->action(function (Collection $records, array $data) {
                            $productId = $data['current_product_id'];
                            $count = 0;

                            foreach ($records as $record) {
                                $record->update([
                                    'current_product_id' => $productId,
                                    'is_ignored' => false,
                                ]);
                                $count++;
                            }

                            Notification::make()
                                ->title("{$count} itens vinculados com sucesso!")
                                ->success()
                                ->send();
                        })
                        ->deselectRecordsAfterCompletion(),

                    // 2. Migrar Múltiplos como Descontinuado
                    BulkAction::make('migrate_as_discontinued')
                        ->label('Migrar como Descontinuado (BI)')
                        ->icon('heroicon-o-archive-box-arrow-down')
                        ->color('warning')
                        ->requiresConfirmation()
                        ->modalHeading('Migrar para o Histórico de Faturação')
                        ->modalDescription('Estes itens serão criados no sistema atual como produtos "Fantasmas" para o BI. Indique a qual categoria este faturamento deve ser somado.')
                        ->form([
                            Select::make('category_id')
                                ->label('Categoria de Agrupamento')
                                ->options(Category::where('type', 'external')->pluck('name', 'id'))
                                ->searchable()
                                ->required(),
                        ])
                        ->action(function (Collection $records, array $data) {
                            $categoryId = $data['category_id'];
                            $count = 0;

                            foreach ($records as $record) {
                                $ghostProduct = Product::create([
                                    'name' => $record->name . ' (Descontinuado)',
                                    'category_id' => $categoryId,
                                    'status' => 'archived',
                                    'show_on_menu' => false,
                                    'show_on_delivery' => false,
                                    'type' => 'resale',
                                    'unit_measure' => 'un',
                                ]);

                                $record->update([
                                    'current_product_id' => $ghostProduct->id,
                                    'is_ignored' => false,
                                ]);

                                $count++;
                            }

                            Notification::make()
                                ->title("{$count} itens descontinuados migrados para a V3!")
                                ->success()
                                ->send();
                        })
                        ->deselectRecordsAfterCompletion(),

                    // 3. Ignorar Múltiplos
                    BulkAction::make('ignore_selected')
                        ->label('Ignorar (Excluir do BI)')
                        ->icon('heroicon-o-trash')
                        ->color('danger')
                        ->requiresConfirmation()
                        ->modalHeading('Ignorar Produtos Legados')
                        ->modalDescription('Atenção: Ao ignorar estes itens, as vendas associadas a eles NÃO farão parte do faturamento histórico.')
                        ->action(function (Collection $records) {
                            $count = 0;
                            foreach ($records as $record) {
                                $record->update([
                                    'is_ignored' => true,
                                    'current_product_id' => null,
                                ]);
                                $count++;
                            }
                            Notification::make()
                                ->title("{$count} itens ignorados!")
                                ->success()
                                ->send();
                        })
                        ->deselectRecordsAfterCompletion(),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\Neighborhoods\Schemas;

use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Schemas\Components as SchemaComponents;
use Filament\Forms\Components as FormComponents;

class NeighborhoodForm
{
    /**
     * @return array<int,SchemaComponents\Section>
     */
    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            SchemaComponents\Section::make("Dados do Bairro")
                ->schema([
                    FormComponents\TextInput::make("name")
                        ->label("Nome do Bairro")
                        ->required()
                        ->maxLength(255)
                        ->columnSpan(1),
                    FormComponents\TextInput::make("delivery_fee")
                        ->label('Taxa de Entrega (R$)')
                        ->required()
                        ->numeric()
                        ->default(0.0)
                        ->prefix('R$')
                        ->columnSpan(1),
                    FormComponents\TextInput::make("free_shipping_over")
                        ->label('Frete Grátis Acima De (R$)')
                        ->numeric()
                        ->prefix('R$')
                        ->helperText("Deixe em branco se não houver")
                        ->columnSpan(1),
                ])
                ->columns(3),
        ];
    }
    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->schema(self::getFormSchema());
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/PersonalPurchases/Tables/PersonalPurchasesTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\PersonalPurchases\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;

// 🚀 IMPORTAÇÕES PARA OS FILTROS
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Filter;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Indicator;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class PersonalPurchasesTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make("nfe_key")
                    ->label("Data")
                    ->formatStateUsing(function (string $state) {
                        $invoice = ReceivedInvoice::where(
                            "nfe_key",
                            $state,
                        )->first();
                        $dataCompra = $invoice ? $invoice->issue_date : null;

                        return $dataCompra
                            ? Carbon::parse($dataCompra)->format("d/m/Y")
                            : "Desconhecida";
                    })
                    ->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make("supplier.name")
                    ->label("Fornecedor")
                    ->formatStateUsing(function (string $state, $record) {
                        return $record->supplier
                            ? $record->supplier->name
                            : "Desconhecido";
                    })
                    ->searchable(["name", "document_name"]), // 🚀 Atualizado!

                TextColumn::make("xml_name")->label("Item (XML)")->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make("quantity")->label("Qtd")->numeric(),

                TextColumn::make("unit_cost")
                    ->label("Custo Unit.")
                    ->money("BRL"),

                TextColumn::make("total_cost")
                    ->label("Total do Item")
                    ->money("BRL")
                    ->sortable(),
            ])
            ->defaultSort("created_at", "desc")

            // 🚀 OS NOSSOS NOVOS FILTROS
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make("supplier_id")
                    ->label("Fornecedor")
                    ->relationship("supplier", "name")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload(),

                Filter::make("data_compra")
                    ->form([
                        DatePicker::make("created_from")->label("A partir de"),
                        DatePicker::make("created_until")->label("Até"),
                    ])
                    // Motor inteligente que filtra pela data da Nota Fiscal original
                    ->query(function (Builder $query, array $data): Builder {
                        return $query
                            ->when(
                                $data["created_from"],
                                fn(
                                    Builder $query,
                                    $date,
                                ): Builder => $query->whereIn(
                                    "nfe_key",
                                    ReceivedInvoice::whereDate(
                                        "issue_date",
                                        ">=",
                                        $date,
                                    )->pluck("nfe_key"),
                                ),
                            )
                            ->when(
                                $data["created_until"],
                                fn(
                                    Builder $query,
                                    $date,
                                ): Builder => $query->whereIn(
                                    "nfe_key",
                                    ReceivedInvoice::whereDate(
                                        "issue_date",
                                        "<=",
                                        $date,
                                    )->pluck("nfe_key"),
                                ),
                            );
                    })
                    // Mostra as tags bonitas de filtro ativo em cima da tabela
                    ->indicateUsing(function (array $data): array {
                        $indicators = [];
                        if ($data["created_from"] ?? null) {
                            $indicators[] = Indicator::make(
                                "A partir de " .
                                    Carbon::parse(
                                        $data["created_from"],
                                    )->format("d/m/Y"),
                            )->removeField("created_from");
                        }
                        if ($data["created_until"] ?? null) {
                            $indicators[] = Indicator::make(
                                "Até " .
                                    Carbon::parse(
                                        $data["created_until"],
                                    )->format("d/m/Y"),
                            )->removeField("created_until");
                        }
                        return $indicators;
                    }),
            ])

            ->actions([
                Action::make("desvincular")
                    ->label("Desfazer")
                    ->icon("heroicon-o-arrow-uturn-left")
                    ->color("danger")
                    ->tooltip("Desfazer marcação de uso pessoal")
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->modalHeading("Desfazer uso pessoal?")
                    ->modalDescription(
                        "Esta ação devolverá o item para a tela de importação da Nota Fiscal. (Nota: Nenhum estoque será alterado, pois o item não havia entrado no estoque).",
                    )
                    ->action(function ($record) {
                        // 1. Mudar status da NFe para 'ready' (A nota volta a ficar pendente de finalização)
                        $invoice = ReceivedInvoice::where(
                            "nfe_key",
                            $record->nfe_key,
                        )->first();
                        if ($invoice && $invoice->status === "processed") {
                            $invoice->update(["status" => "ready"]);
                        }

                        // 2. Deletar o registro de uso pessoal
                        $record->delete();

                        Notification::make()
                            ->title("Ação desfeita com sucesso!")
                            ->body(
                                "O item voltou para a Nota Fiscal original para ser reprocessado.",
                            )
                            ->success()
                            ->send();
                    }),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([BulkActionGroup::make([DeleteBulkAction::make()])]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/PosAudits/Tables/PosAuditTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\PosAudits\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Filter;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Filament\Actions\ViewAction;

class PosAuditTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Data e Hora')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i:s')
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('action')
                    ->label('Operação')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'cancel_item' => 'Estorno de Item',
                        'edit_item' => 'Edição de Item',
                        'cancel_order' => 'Cancelamento de Pedido',
                        'cash_out' => 'Sangria de Caixa',
                        'apply_discount' => 'Desconto Manual',
                        default => $state,
                    })
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'cancel_item', 'cancel_order' => 'danger',
                        'edit_item', 'apply_discount' => 'warning',
                        default => 'primary',
                    }),

                TextColumn::make('reason')
                    ->label('Motivo / Justificativa')
                    ->limit(40)
                    ->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make('operator.name')
                    ->label('Operador')
                    ->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make('authorizer.name')
                    ->label('Autorizado por')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn ($record) => $record->operator_id === $record->authorizer_id ? 'gray' : 'success')
                    ->searchable(),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc')
            ->filters([
                Filter::make('created_at')
                    ->form([
                        DatePicker::make('created_from')->label('A partir de'),
                        DatePicker::make('created_until')->label('Até'),
                    ])
                    ->query(function (Builder $query, array $data): Builder {
                        return $query
                            ->when($data['created_from'], fn(Builder $query, $date): Builder => $query->whereDate('created_at', '>=', $date))
                            ->when($data['created_until'], fn(Builder $query, $date): Builder => $query->whereDate('created_at', '<=', $date));
                    }),
                SelectFilter::make('authorizer_id')
                    ->label('Autorizador')
                    ->relationship('authorizer', 'name'),
            ])
            ->actions([
                ViewAction::make()->label('Detalhes')->iconButton(),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\PosAudits;

use App\Filament\Resources\PosAudits\Schemas\PosAuditInfolist;

class PosAuditResource extends Resource
{
    protected static ?string $model = PosAudit::class;
    protected static string|\BackedEnum|null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-eye';
    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = 'PDV & Infraestrutura';
    protected static ?string $modelLabel = 'Auditoria do PDV';
    protected static ?string $pluralModelLabel = 'Auditoria do PDV';

    public static function canCreate(): bool { return false; }
    public static function canEdit(\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $record): bool { return false; }

    {

        return PosAuditInfolist::configure($schema);

    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\PrintJobs\Schemas;

use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\TextEntry;

class PrintJobInfolist
{
    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema
            ->components([
                Section::make('Detalhes do Trabalho')
                    ->columnSpanFull() // 🚀 FORÇA A SEÇÃO A OCUPAR A LINHA INTEIRA
                    ->columns(3)
                    ->schema([
                        // 🚀 MOSTRA O NOME NO SO (COM O APELIDO ENTRE PARÊNTESES)
                        TextEntry::make('printer.os_name')
                            ->label('Impressora')
                            ->formatStateUsing(fn ($record) => $record->printer ? "{$record->printer->os_name} ({$record->printer->name})" : 'Impressora Removida'),

                        TextEntry::make('job_type')
                            ->label('Tipo')
                            ->formatStateUsing(fn ($state) => match ($state) {
                                'kitchen_ticket' => 'Comanda Cozinha',
                                'customer_receipt' => 'Recibo Cliente',
                                'conference_bill' => 'Conferência Mesa',
                                'delivery_dispatch' => 'Via Motoboy',
                                'freelancer_receipt' => 'Vale Freelancer',
                                'test_page' => 'Página de Teste', // 🚀 TRADUÇÃO ADICIONADA AQUI!
                                default => $state,
                            }),

                        TextEntry::make('status')
                            ->badge()
                            ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                                'success' => 'success',
                                'failed' => 'danger',
                                'pending' => 'warning',
                                default => 'gray',
                            }),

                        TextEntry::make('order_id')
                            ->label('Pedido Associado')
                            ->formatStateUsing(fn ($state) => $state ? "#{$state}" : '-'),

                        TextEntry::make('attempts')
                            ->label('Tentativas de Envio'),

                        TextEntry::make('created_at')
                            ->label('Data do Disparo')
                            ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i:s'),
                    ]),

                Section::make('Mensagem de Erro (Retorno da Bridge)')
                    ->columnSpanFull() // 🚀 FORÇA A FICAR NA LINHA DE BAIXO
                    ->schema([
                        TextEntry::make('error_message')
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->color('danger'),
                    ])
                    ->visible(fn ($record) => !empty($record->error_message)), // Só aparece se houver erro!

                Section::make('Carga de Dados (Blueprint do Recibo)')
                    ->columnSpanFull() // 🚀 FORÇA A FICAR NA LINHA DE BAIXO
                    ->schema([
                        TextEntry::make('payload')
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->formatStateUsing(fn ($state) => '<pre style="font-size:12px; overflow-x:auto; background:#f4f4f5; padding:10px; border-radius:8px;">' . json_encode($state, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . '</pre>')
                            ->html(),
                    ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```
