```php
            'items.*.comboItems.*.name' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.price' => ['nullable', 'numeric'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.qty' => ['nullable', 'numeric'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.group_id' => ['nullable', 'integer'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.notes' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.structuredModifiers' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.structuredModifiers.*.id' => ['nullable'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.structuredModifiers.*.name' => ['required', 'string'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.structuredModifiers.*.price' => ['required', 'numeric'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.structuredModifiers.*.qty' => ['required', 'numeric'],
            'items.*.comboItems.*.structuredModifiers.*.group_id' => ['nullable', 'integer'],

            // 2. ROTEAMENTO E LOGÍSTICA
            'routing' => ['required', 'array'],
            'routing.type' => ['required', 'string', 'in:delivery,counter,table'],
            'routing.identifier' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'routing.notes' => ['nullable', 'string'],

            // 🚀 MESA (Normalizada estritamente com base no Model DiningTable)
            'routing.table' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'routing.table.id' => ['required_if:routing.type,table', 'nullable', 'integer', 'exists:dining_tables,id'],
            'routing.table.name' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'routing.dining_table_id' => ['required_if:routing.type,table', 'nullable', 'integer', 'exists:dining_tables,id'],
            'routing.table_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'exists:dining_tables,id'],
            'routing.table_number' => ['nullable', 'string'],

            'routing.customer' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'routing.customer.id' => ['nullable'],
            'routing.customer.name' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'routing.customer.phone' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'routing.customer.cpf' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'routing.customer.email' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'routing.customer.birth_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'routing.customer.loyalty_points' => ['nullable', 'numeric'],
            'routing.customer.addresses' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'routing.customer_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'routing.customer_phone' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:20'],

            'routing.address' => ['required_if:routing.type,delivery', 'nullable', 'array'],
            'routing.address.id' => ['nullable'],
            'routing.address_id' => ['nullable'],
            'routing.address.street' => [
                Rule::requiredIf($isDelivery && !$hasAddressId),
                'nullable',
                'string',
                'max:255'
            ],
            'routing.address.street_id' => ['nullable', 'integer'],
            'routing.address.number' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
            'routing.address.neighborhood' => [
                Rule::requiredIf($isDelivery && !$hasAddressId),
                'nullable',
                'string',
                'max:255'
            ],
            'routing.address.neighborhood_id' => ['nullable', 'integer'],
            'routing.address.complement' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'routing.address.reference' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'routing.address.is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            'routing.address.nickname' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'routing.address.full_address' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
            'routing.address.delivery_fee' => ['nullable', 'numeric'],

            'routing.payment_method_id' => [
                Rule::requiredIf($requiresPayment),
                'nullable',
                'integer',
                'exists:payment_methods,id'
            ],
            'routing.payment_method_name' => [
                Rule::requiredIf($requiresPayment),
                'nullable',
                'string'
            ],
            'routing.payment_engine' => [
                Rule::requiredIf($requiresPayment),
                'nullable',
                'string'
            ],
            'routing.change_target' => ['nullable', 'numeric'],
            'routing.cash_change_target' => ['nullable', 'numeric'],

            'routing.payment_intent_status' => [
                Rule::requiredIf($requiresPayment),
                'string',
                Rule::notIn(['pending_choice', 'not_applicable', 'pending'])
            ],
            'routing.payment_intent_methods' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'routing.payment_intent_methods.*.method_id' => ['required_with:routing.payment_intent_methods', 'integer'],
            'routing.payment_intent_methods.*.method_name' => ['required_with:routing.payment_intent_methods', 'string'],
            'routing.payment_intent_methods.*.amount' => ['required_with:routing.payment_intent_methods', 'numeric'],
            'routing.payment_intent_methods.*.change_target' => ['nullable', 'numeric'],

            // 3. FINANCEIRO E TOTAIS
            'financials' => ['required', 'array'],
            'financials.subtotal' => ['required', 'numeric'],
            'financials.deliveryFee' => ['required', 'numeric'],
            'financials.serviceFee' => ['required', 'numeric'],
            'financials.discount' => ['required', 'numeric'],
            'financials.finalTotal' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
            'financials.coupon_code' => ['nullable', 'string', 'prohibits:routing.cashback_discount'],
            'routing.cashback_discount' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'prohibits:financials.coupon_code'],
            'items.*.is_reward' => ['nullable', 'boolean', 'prohibited_if:financials.coupon_code,!=,null'],
        ];
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $routing = $this->input('routing', []);
        $financials = $this->input('financials', []);
        $items = $this->input('items', []);

        if (is_array($items)) {
            foreach ($items as &$item) {
                if (!empty($item['structuredModifiers']) && is_array($item['structuredModifiers'])) {
                    foreach ($item['structuredModifiers'] as &$mod) {
                        if (!isset($mod['qty']) && isset($mod['quantity'])) {
                            $mod['qty'] = $mod['quantity'];
                        }
                        if (!isset($mod['qty']) || $mod['qty'] === '') {
                            $mod['qty'] = 1;
                        }
                        if (!isset($mod['price']) || $mod['price'] === '') {
                            $mod['price'] = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!empty($item['comboItems']) && is_array($item['comboItems'])) {
                    foreach ($item['comboItems'] as &$sub) {
                        if (isset($sub['id']) && is_string($sub['id']) && preg_match('/_prod_(\d+)/', $sub['id'], $matches)) {
                            $sub['product_id'] = (int) $matches[1];
                        } elseif (!empty($sub['product_id'])) {
                            $sub['product_id'] = (int) $sub['product_id'];
                        } elseif (!empty($sub['id']) && is_numeric($sub['id'])) {
                            $sub['product_id'] = (int) $sub['id'];
                        }

                        if (!empty($sub['structuredModifiers']) && is_array($sub['structuredModifiers'])) {
                            foreach ($sub['structuredModifiers'] as &$subMod) {
                                if (!isset($subMod['qty']) && isset($subMod['quantity'])) {
                                    $subMod['qty'] = $subMod['quantity'];
                                }
                                if (!isset($subMod['qty']) || $subMod['qty'] === '') {
                                    $subMod['qty'] = 1;
                                }
                                if (!isset($subMod['price']) || $subMod['price'] === '') {
                                    $subMod['price'] = 0;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            $this->merge(['items' => $items]);
        }

        // 🚀 Resolução de Mesa estritamente por ID via Model DiningTable
        if (isset($routing['type']) && $routing['type'] === 'table') {
            $tableId = $routing['dining_table_id']
                ?? $routing['table_id']
                ?? $routing['table']['id']
                ?? null;

            if ($tableId) {
                $table = DiningTable::find((int) $tableId);
                $tableIdInt = (int) $tableId;
                $tableName = $table?->name ?? ($routing['table_number'] ?? $routing['table']['name'] ?? '');

                $routing['dining_table_id'] = $tableIdInt;
                $routing['table_id'] = $tableIdInt;
                $routing['table_number'] = $tableName;
                $routing['table'] = [
                    'id'   => $tableIdInt,
                    'name' => $tableName,
                ];
            }
        }

        // 🚀 Normalização e desaninhamento de objetos de Rua e Bairro
        if (isset($routing['address']) && is_array($routing['address'])) {
            if (isset($routing['address']['street']) && is_array($routing['address']['street'])) {
                $routing['address']['street_id'] = $routing['address']['street']['id'] ?? ($routing['address']['street_id'] ?? null);
                $routing['address']['street'] = $routing['address']['street']['name'] ?? '';
            }
            if (isset($routing['address']['neighborhood']) && is_array($routing['address']['neighborhood'])) {
                $routing['address']['neighborhood_id'] = $routing['address']['neighborhood']['id'] ?? ($routing['address']['neighborhood_id'] ?? null);
                $routing['address']['neighborhood'] = $routing['address']['neighborhood']['name'] ?? '';
            }
            if (empty($routing['address_id']) && !empty($routing['address']['id'])) {
                $routing['address_id'] = $routing['address']['id'];
            }
        }

        if (!empty($routing['address_id']) && empty($routing['address']['id'])) {
            $routing['address']['id'] = $routing['address_id'];
        }

        // 🚀 Sincronização e Auto-Hidratação de Endereço Existente do Banco
        $addressId = $routing['address_id'] ?? ($routing['address']['id'] ?? null);
        if (!empty($addressId) && is_numeric($addressId)) {
            $routing['address_id'] = (int) $addressId;
            if (!isset($routing['address']) || !is_array($routing['address'])) {
                $routing['address'] = [];
            }
            $routing['address']['id'] = (int) $addressId;

            if (empty($routing['address']['street']) || empty($routing['address']['neighborhood'])) {
                $existingAddress = Address::with(['street', 'neighborhood'])->find((int) $addressId);
                if ($existingAddress) {
                    $routing['address']['street'] = $existingAddress->street?->name ?? ($existingAddress->street_name ?? 'Logradouro');
                    $routing['address']['street_id'] = $existingAddress->street_id;
                    $routing['address']['neighborhood'] = $existingAddress->neighborhood?->name ?? ($existingAddress->neighborhood_name ?? 'Bairro');
                    $routing['address']['neighborhood_id'] = $existingAddress->neighborhood_id;
                    $routing['address']['number'] = $existingAddress->number ?? ($routing['address']['number'] ?? 'S/N');
                    $routing['address']['full_address'] = $existingAddress->full_address ?? ($routing['address']['full_address'] ?? null);
                    if (!isset($routing['address']['delivery_fee'])) {
                        $routing['address']['delivery_fee'] = $existingAddress->delivery_fee;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (isset($routing['cash_change_target']) && !isset($routing['change_target'])) {
            $routing['change_target'] = $routing['cash_change_target'];
        } elseif (isset($routing['change_target']) && !isset($routing['cash_change_target'])) {
            $routing['cash_change_target'] = $routing['change_target'];
        }

        if (empty($financials['coupon_code'])) {
            unset($financials['coupon_code']);
        }
        if (empty($routing['cashback_discount']) || (float) $routing['cashback_discount'] <= 0) {
            unset($routing['cashback_discount']);
        }

        if (isset($financials['delivery_fee'])) {
            $financials['deliveryFee'] = $financials['delivery_fee'];
            unset($financials['delivery_fee']);
        }
        if (isset($financials['final_total'])) {
            $financials['finalTotal'] = $financials['final_total'];
            unset($financials['final_total']);
        }
        if (!isset($financials['serviceFee'])) {
            $financials['serviceFee'] = 0;
        }

        // 🚀 Resolução de Forma de Pagamento baseada no Model PaymentMethod
        if (!empty($routing['payment_method_id'])) {
            $paymentMethod = PaymentMethod::find((int) $routing['payment_method_id']);
            if ($paymentMethod) {
                $routing['payment_engine'] = $paymentMethod->engine_type;
                $routing['payment_method_name'] = $paymentMethod->name;
            }
        }

        $finalTotal = (float) ($financials['finalTotal'] ?? 0);
        $engine = $routing['payment_engine'] ?? null;
        if ($finalTotal > 0 && empty($routing['payment_intent_status'])) {
            if ($engine === 'bank_api') {
                $routing['payment_intent_status'] = 'paid';
            } elseif (!empty($routing['payment_method_id'])) {
                $routing['payment_intent_status'] = 'pay_on_delivery';
            }
        } elseif ($finalTotal <= 0) {
            $routing['payment_intent_status'] = 'free_order';
        }

        $this->merge([
            'routing'    => $routing,
            'financials' => $financials
        ]);
    }

    public function attributes(): array
    {
        return [
            'financials.deliveryFee'         => 'Taxa de Entrega',
            'financials.serviceFee'          => 'Taxa de Serviço',
            'financials.subtotal'            => 'Subtotal',
            'financials.finalTotal'          => 'Total Final',
            'routing.payment_method_id'      => 'Forma de Pagamento',
            'routing.address.street'         => 'Rua/Logradouro',
            'routing.address.number'         => 'Número',
            'routing.address.neighborhood'   => 'Bairro',
            'routing.payment_intent_status'  => 'Status da Intenção de Pagamento',
            'routing.payment_intent_methods' => 'Formas de Pagamento na Entrega',
            'routing.dining_table_id'        => 'Mesa',
            'routing.table.id'               => 'Mesa',
        ];
    }

    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'items.required'                     => 'O seu carrinho está vazio. Adicione itens antes de finalizar.',
            'routing.type.required'              => 'O formato do pedido (Delivery, Balcão ou Mesa) é obrigatório.',
            'routing.table.id.required_if'       => 'Por favor, informe a mesa para atendimento.',
            'routing.dining_table_id.required_if'=> 'Por favor, informe a mesa para atendimento.',
            'routing.address.street.required'    => 'Para delivery, selecione ou informe o logradouro de entrega.',
            'routing.address.neighborhood.required' => 'Para delivery, selecione ou informe o bairro de entrega.',
            'routing.payment_method_id.required' => 'Por favor, selecione uma forma de pagamento para concluir o pedido.',
            'routing.payment_method_id.exists'   => 'A forma de pagamento selecionada não está mais disponível.',
            'routing.payment_intent_status.required' => 'A forma de pagamento é obrigatória.',
            'routing.payment_intent_status.not_in'   => 'Não é permitido finalizar pedidos com pagamento pendente no cardápio online.',
            'financials.coupon_code.prohibits'   => 'Não é possível utilizar um Cupom de Desconto junto com saldo de Cashback.',
            'routing.cashback_discount.prohibits'=> 'Não é possível utilizar saldo de Cashback junto com um Cupom de Desconto.',
            'items.*.is_reward.prohibited_if'    => 'Remova os itens de cortesia (Fidelidade) para poder utilizar um Cupom de Desconto.',
        ];
    }

    public function withValidator($validator): void
    {
        $validator->after(function ($validator) {
            $setting = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
            $finalTotal = (float) $this->input('financials.finalTotal', 0);

            if ($finalTotal > 0) {
                $hasMethod = !empty($this->input('routing.payment_method_id'));
                $hasMultiMethods = !empty($this->input('routing.payment_intent_methods'));
                if (!$hasMethod && !$hasMultiMethods) {
                    $validator->errors()->add(
                        'routing.payment_method_id',
                        'Por favor, selecione a forma de pagamento (PIX, Cartão ou Dinheiro) antes de enviar o pedido.'
                    );
                }
            }

            $isGuest = !auth()->check();
            if ($isGuest) {
                $restricted = $setting->guest_restricted_payments ?? true;
                $engine = $this->input('routing.payment_engine');
                if ($restricted && $engine !== 'bank_api') {
                    $validator->errors()->add('routing.payment_method_id', 'Por medida de segurança, visitantes só podem pagar online (PIX). Faça login para liberar outras formas de pagamento.');
                }
            }

            $isDelivery = $this->input('routing.type') === 'delivery';
            $isCash = ($this->input('routing.payment_engine') === 'money');
            $changeTarget = (float) ($this->input('routing.change_target') ?? $this->input('routing.cash_change_target', 0));

            if ($isDelivery && $isCash && $changeTarget > $finalTotal) {
                $hasLimit = (bool) ($setting->has_max_change_limit ?? false);
                $maxChange = (float) ($setting->max_change_amount ?? 0);
                if ($hasLimit && $maxChange > 0) {
                    $calculatedChange = $changeTarget - $finalTotal;
                    if ($calculatedChange > $maxChange) {
                        $maxFormatted = number_format($maxChange, 2, ',', '.');
                        $validator->errors()->add(
                            'routing.change_target',
                            "O troco solicitado ultrapassa o limite máximo de R$ {$maxFormatted} permitido para entregas."
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator)
    {
        Log::error('🚨 [SONDA CHECKOUT] Falha de validação no pedido:', [
            'erros'            => $validator->errors()->toArray(),
            'payload_recebido' => $this->all()
        ]);
        parent::failedValidation($validator);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Customer;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class RegisterCustomerRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function rules(): array
    {
        $setting = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
        $mode = $setting?->customer_registration_mode ?? 'basic';
        $isCpfRequired = in_array($mode, ['cpf_required', 'customer_only', 'serpro_magic']);
        $requireBirth = (bool) ($setting?->require_birth_date ?? false);

        return [
            'name'       => ['required', 'string', 'min:3', 'max:255'],
            'email'      => ['nullable', 'string', 'email', 'max:255', Rule::unique('customers', 'email')],
            'password'   => ['required', 'string', 'min:6'],
            'phone'      => ['required', 'string', 'min:10'],
            'cpf'        => [
                $isCpfRequired ? 'required' : 'nullable',
                'string',
                Rule::unique('customers', 'cpf'),
            ],
            'birth_date' => [
                $requireBirth ? 'required' : 'nullable',
                'date',
            ],
        ];
    }

    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'name.required'       => 'O nome completo é obrigatório.',
            'name.min'            => 'O nome deve ter no mínimo 3 caracteres.',
            'email.unique'        => 'Este e-mail já está em uso por outro cliente.',
            'password.required'   => 'Crie uma senha de acesso.',
            'password.min'        => 'A senha deve ter no mínimo 6 caracteres.',
            'phone.required'      => 'O WhatsApp/Telefone é obrigatório.',
            'phone.min'           => 'Forneça um número de telefone válido com DDD.',
            'cpf.required'        => 'O CPF é obrigatório para cadastro no aplicativo.',
            'cpf.unique'          => 'Este CPF já está cadastrado em outra conta.',
            'birth_date.required' => 'A data de nascimento é obrigatória.',
        ];
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        if ($this->has('phone')) {
            $this->merge([
                'phone' => preg_replace('/\D/', '', (string) $this->input('phone')),
            ]);
        }

        if ($this->has('cpf')) {
            $cleanCpf = preg_replace('/\D/', '', (string) $this->input('cpf'));
            $this->merge([
                'cpf' => !empty($cleanCpf) ? $cleanCpf : null,
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Pos;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class CloseShiftRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return auth()->check();
    }

    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'amount'          => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
            'retained_amount' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
            'observation'     => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
            'pin'             => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'details'         => ['nullable'],
            'attendees'       => ['nullable', 'array'],
        ];
    }

    public function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $attendees = $this->input('attendees');

        if (is_string($attendees)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($attendees, true);
            if (json_last_error() === JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
                $this->merge(['attendees' => $decoded]);
            } else {
                $this->merge(['attendees' => []]);
            }
        } elseif (!is_array($attendees)) {
            $this->merge(['attendees' => []]);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Pos;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class OpenShiftRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return auth()->check();
    }

    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'amount'      => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
            'observation' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
            'details'     => ['nullable'],
            'attendees'   => ['nullable', 'array'],
        ];
    }

    public function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $attendees = $this->input('attendees');

        if (is_string($attendees)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($attendees, true);
            if (json_last_error() === JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
                $this->merge(['attendees' => $decoded]);
            } else {
                $this->merge(['attendees' => []]);
            }
        } elseif (!is_array($attendees)) {
            $this->merge(['attendees' => []]);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
    protected function prepareForValidation(): void

        $rootOrderId = $this->input('order_id');
        if (empty($rootOrderId)) {
            $rootOrderId = $routing['order_id'] ?? $routing['existing_order_id'] ?? $routing['id'] ?? null;
            if ($rootOrderId) {
                $this->merge(['order_id' => (int) $rootOrderId]);
            }
        }

        if (is_array($items)) {
            foreach ($items as &$item) {
                if (!empty($item['comboItems']) && is_array($item['comboItems'])) {
                    foreach ($item['comboItems'] as &$sub) {
                        if (isset($sub['id']) && is_string($sub['id']) && preg_match('/_prod_(\d+)/', $sub['id'], $matches)) {
                            $sub['product_id'] = (int) $matches[1];
                        } elseif (!empty($sub['product_id'])) {
                            $sub['product_id'] = (int) $sub['product_id'];
                        } elseif (!empty($sub['id']) && is_numeric($sub['id'])) {
                            $sub['product_id'] = (int) $sub['id'];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            $this->merge(['items' => $items]);
        }

        if (isset($routing['type']) && $routing['type'] === 'table') {
            $tableId = $routing['dining_table_id']
                ?? $routing['table_id']
                ?? $routing['table']['id']
                ?? null;

            if ($tableId) {
                $table = DiningTable::find((int) $tableId);
                $tableIdInt = (int) $tableId;
                $tableName = $table?->name ?? ($routing['table_number'] ?? $routing['table']['name'] ?? '');

                $routing['dining_table_id'] = $tableIdInt;
                $routing['table_id'] = $tableIdInt;
                $routing['table_number'] = $tableName;
                $routing['table'] = [
                    'id'   => $tableIdInt,
                    'name' => $tableName,
                ];
            }
        }

        if (isset($routing['type']) && $routing['type'] !== 'delivery') {
            $routing['address'] = null;
            $routing['address_id'] = null;
            if (is_array($financials)) {
                $financials['deliveryFee'] = 0.00;
            }
        }

        // 🚀 SALVAGUARDA DELIVERY: Se mandou address_id mas esqueceu o address.id, clona para passar na validação estrita
        if (isset($routing['type']) && $routing['type'] === 'delivery') {
            if (!empty($routing['address_id']) && empty($routing['address']['id'])) {
                if (!isset($routing['address']) || !is_array($routing['address'])) {
                    $routing['address'] = [];
                }
                $routing['address']['id'] = $routing['address_id'];
            }
        }

        if (isset($routing['type']) && $routing['type'] === 'counter') {
            if (empty($routing['customer']['id']) && empty($routing['identifier'])) {
                $routing['identifier'] = null;
            }
        }

        if (isset($routing['cash_change_target']) && !isset($routing['change_target'])) {
            $routing['change_target'] = $routing['cash_change_target'];
        } elseif (isset($routing['change_target']) && !isset($routing['cash_change_target'])) {
            $routing['cash_change_target'] = $routing['change_target'];
        }

        if (!empty($routing['payment_method_id'])) {
            $paymentMethod = PaymentMethod::find((int) $routing['payment_method_id']);
            if ($paymentMethod) {
                $routing['payment_engine'] = $paymentMethod->engine_type;
                $routing['payment_method_name'] = $paymentMethod->name;
            }
        }

        $this->merge([
            'routing'    => $routing,
            'financials' => $financials,
            'source'     => $this->input('source') ?: 'pos_app',
        ]);
    }
```

## File: app/Jobs/DispatchScheduledTasksJob.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Jobs;

use App\Models\ChecklistTask;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Events\ChecklistsUpdated;
use App\Notifications\NewTasksNotification;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

class DispatchScheduledTasksJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public function handle(): void
    {
        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO 2: Garante o relógio correto do Brasil independentemente do servidor Cloud
        $now = now()->setTimezone('America/Sao_Paulo');
        $currentTime = $now->format('H:i') . ':00';
        $dayOfWeek = $now->dayOfWeek;
        $dayOfMonth = $now->day;

        $tasks = ChecklistTask::where('trigger_type', 'scheduled')
            ->whereTime('trigger_time', $currentTime)
            ->where(function ($query) use ($dayOfWeek, $dayOfMonth) {
                $query->where('recurrence_type', 'daily')
                    ->orWhere(function ($qWeekly) use ($dayOfWeek) {
                        $qWeekly->where('recurrence_type', 'weekly')
                            ->where(function ($jsonQ) use ($dayOfWeek) {
                                $jsonQ->whereJsonContains('recurrence_days', $dayOfWeek)
                                    ->orWhereJsonContains('recurrence_days', (string)$dayOfWeek);
                            });
                    })
                    ->orWhere(function ($qMonthly) use ($dayOfMonth) {
                        $qMonthly->where('recurrence_type', 'monthly')
                            ->where(function ($jsonQ) use ($dayOfMonth) {
                                $jsonQ->whereJsonContains('recurrence_days', $dayOfMonth)
                                    ->orWhereJsonContains('recurrence_days', (string)$dayOfMonth);
                            });
                    })
                    ->orWhere('recurrence_type', 'once');
            })
            ->get();

        if ($tasks->isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        event(new ChecklistsUpdated());

        $usersToNotify = collect();

        foreach ($tasks as $task) {
            if ($task->assignment_type === 'all') {
                $usersToNotify = $usersToNotify->merge(User::where('is_active', true)->get());
            }
            elseif ($task->assignment_type === 'roles' && !empty($task->target_roles)) {
                $users = User::where('is_active', true)
                    ->whereHas('roles', function ($q) use ($task) {
                        $q->whereIn('name', $task->target_roles);
                    })->get();
                $usersToNotify = $usersToNotify->merge($users);
            }
            elseif ($task->assignment_type === 'users' && !empty($task->target_users)) {
                $users = User::where('is_active', true)
                    ->whereIn('id', $task->target_users)
                    ->get();
                $usersToNotify = $usersToNotify->merge($users);
            }
        }

        $usersToNotify = $usersToNotify->unique('id');

        if ($usersToNotify->isNotEmpty()) {
            Notification::send(
                $usersToNotify,
                new NewTasksNotification('Novas tarefas agendadas acabaram de ser liberadas para você!')
            );
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Jobs;

use App\Models\ChecklistTask;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Events\ChecklistsUpdated;
use App\Notifications\NewTasksNotification;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

class DispatchShiftTasksJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    protected string $triggerType;

    /**
     * Recebe 'shift_start' (abertura) ou 'shift_end' (fechamento)
     */
    public function __construct(string $triggerType)
    {
        $this->triggerType = $triggerType;
    }

    public function handle(): void
    {
        $dayOfWeek = now()->dayOfWeek;
        $dayOfMonth = now()->day;

        // 1. Busca as tarefas vinculadas a este momento do turno e que devem rodar hoje
        $tasks = ChecklistTask::where('trigger_type', $this->triggerType)
            ->where(function ($query) use ($dayOfWeek, $dayOfMonth) {
                $query->where('recurrence_type', 'daily')
                    ->orWhere(function ($qWeekly) use ($dayOfWeek) {
                        $qWeekly->where('recurrence_type', 'weekly')
                            ->where(function ($jsonQ) use ($dayOfWeek) {
                                $jsonQ->whereJsonContains('recurrence_days', $dayOfWeek)
                                    ->orWhereJsonContains('recurrence_days', (string)$dayOfWeek);
                            });
                    })
                    ->orWhere(function ($qMonthly) use ($dayOfMonth) {
                        $qMonthly->where('recurrence_type', 'monthly')
                            ->where(function ($jsonQ) use ($dayOfMonth) {
                                $jsonQ->whereJsonContains('recurrence_days', $dayOfMonth)
                                    ->orWhereJsonContains('recurrence_days', (string)$dayOfMonth);
                            });
                    })
                    ->orWhere('recurrence_type', 'once');
            })
            ->get();

        if ($tasks->isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Dispara a atualização em tempo real para os PDVs abertos
        event(new ChecklistsUpdated());

        // 3. Monta a lista de usuários que precisam ser notificados via Push
        $usersToNotify = collect();

        foreach ($tasks as $task) {
            if ($task->assignment_type === 'all') {
                $usersToNotify = $usersToNotify->merge(User::where('is_active', true)->get());
            }
            elseif ($task->assignment_type === 'roles' && !empty($task->target_roles)) {
                $users = User::where('is_active', true)
                    ->whereHas('roles', function ($q) use ($task) {
                        $q->whereIn('name', $task->target_roles);
                    })->get();
                $usersToNotify = $usersToNotify->merge($users);
            }
            elseif ($task->assignment_type === 'users' && !empty($task->target_users)) {
                $users = User::where('is_active', true)
                    ->whereIn('id', $task->target_users)
                    ->get();
                $usersToNotify = $usersToNotify->merge($users);
            }
        }

        $usersToNotify = $usersToNotify->unique('id');

        // 4. Envia o alerta Push
        if ($usersToNotify->isNotEmpty()) {
            $msg = $this->triggerType === 'shift_start'
                ? 'O turno foi aberto! Verifique as suas tarefas iniciais.'
                : 'O turno está a fechar! Conclua as rotinas de fechamento.';

            Notification::send($usersToNotify, new NewTasksNotification($msg));
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Jobs/SyncTenantSefazJob.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Jobs;

use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use App\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use NFePHP\NFe\Tools;
use NFePHP\Common\Certificate;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class SyncTenantSefazJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public $tenantId;
    public $force;
    public $tries = 3;
    public $timeout = 300;

    public function __construct($tenantId, $force = false)
    {
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->force = $force;
    }

    public function handle()
    {
        Log::info("==========================================");
        Log::info("👻 [Job Sefaz] Fila acordou! Tenant ID: " . $this->tenantId);

        $tenant = Tenant::find($this->tenantId);
        if (!$tenant) return;

        tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
        $setting = CompanySetting::first();

        if ($setting && $setting->cnpj && $setting->certificate_path && $setting->certificate_password) {
            $this->syncForCompany($setting);
        } else {
            Log::warning("⚠️ [Job Sefaz] Credenciais incompletas.");
        }

        tenancy()->end();
        Log::info("==========================================");
    }

    private function syncForCompany(CompanySetting $setting)
    {
        try {
            $config = json_encode([
                "atualizacao" => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                "tpAmb"       => 1,
                "razaosocial" => $setting->company_name,
                "cnpj"        => preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $setting->cnpj),
                "siglaUF"     => $setting->state,
                "schemes"     => "PL_009_V4",
                "versao"      => '4.00',
            ]);

            $pfxContent = Storage::get($setting->certificate_path);
            $certificate = Certificate::readPfx($pfxContent, $setting->certificate_password);
            $tools = new Tools($config, $certificate);
            $std = new \NFePHP\NFe\Common\Standardize();

            $isOnCooldown = false;

            if (!$this->force && $setting->sefaz_last_sync_at) {
                $liberaEm = Carbon::parse($setting->sefaz_last_sync_at)->addMinutes(60);
                if (now()->lessThan($liberaEm)) {
                    $isOnCooldown = true;
                    Log::warning("⏳ [Sefaz] BLOQUEIO ATIVO até {$liberaEm->format('H:i')}.");
                }
            }

            if (!$isOnCooldown) {
                $continuarBuscando = true;
                $currentNsu = (int) ($setting->last_nsu ?? 0);

                while ($continuarBuscando) {
                    Log::info("🛸 [Sefaz] Consultando distDFeInt a partir do NSU: {$currentNsu}");
                    $response = $tools->sefazDistDFe($currentNsu);
                    $arr = $std->toArray($response);

                    $cStat   = (int) ($arr['cStat'] ?? 0);
                    $xMotivo = $arr['xMotivo'] ?? 'N/A';
                    $ultNSU  = (int) ($arr['ultNSU'] ?? 0);
                    $maxNSU  = (int) ($arr['maxNSU'] ?? 0);

                    Log::info("🛸 [Sefaz] Retorno: cStat={$cStat} ({$xMotivo}) | ultNSU={$ultNSU} | maxNSU={$maxNSU}");

                    if ($cStat == 656) {
                        Log::warning("⚠️ [Sefaz] Consumo Indevido (656). Abortando loop.");
                        break;
                    }

                    // 137: Nenhum documento novo localizado
                    if ($cStat == 137) {
                        if ($ultNSU > $currentNsu) {
                            $setting->last_nsu = $ultNSU;
                            $setting->saveQuietly();
                            $this->clearSettingsCache();
                        }
                        $continuarBuscando = false;
                        break;
                    }

                    // 138: Documentos localizados
                    if ($cStat == 138 && isset($arr['loteDistDFeInt']['docZip'])) {
                        $docs = $arr['loteDistDFeInt']['docZip'];

                        if (!is_array($docs) || (isset($docs['_value']) || isset($docs['@value']))) {
                            $docs = [$docs];
                        }

                        $salvasHoje = 0;

                        foreach ($docs as $doc) {
                            $base64Data = '';
                            if (is_string($doc)) {
                                $base64Data = $doc;
                            } elseif (is_array($doc)) {
                                $base64Data = $doc['_value'] ?? $doc['@value'] ?? '';
                            }

                            if (empty($base64Data)) continue;

                            $xmlContent = gzdecode(base64_decode($base64Data));
                            if (!$xmlContent) continue;

                            $xml = @simplexml_load_string($xmlContent);
                            if (!$xml) continue;

                            $rootName = $xml->getName();

                            if ($rootName === 'resNFe') {
                                $chave = (string) $xml->chNFe;
                                ReceivedInvoice::firstOrCreate(
                                    ['nfe_key' => $chave],
                                    [
                                        'emitter_cnpj' => (string) $xml->CNPJ,
                                        'emitter_name' => (string) $xml->xNome,
                                        'issue_date'   => Carbon::parse((string) $xml->dhEmi)->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                                        'total_value'  => (float) $xml->vNF,
                                        'status'       => 'pending',
                                        'has_full_xml' => false,
                                        'xml_content'  => $xmlContent
                                    ]
                                );
                                $salvasHoje++;
                            } elseif ($rootName === 'nfeProc') {
                                $chave = str_replace('NFe', '', (string) $xml->NFe->infNFe['Id']);

                                $finNFe = (int) $xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->finNFe;
                                $natOp = strtoupper((string) $xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->natOp);
                                $isDevolucao = ($finNFe === 4) || str_contains($natOp, 'DEVOLUCAO') || str_contains($natOp, 'RETORNO');

                                $targetStatus = 'ready';

                                if ($isDevolucao) {
                                    $targetStatus = 'return_receipt';
                                    if (isset($xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->NFref->refNFe)) {
                                        $chaveOriginal = (string) $xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->NFref->refNFe;
                                        if (substr($chaveOriginal, 20, 2) === '65') {
                                            $targetStatus = 'processed';
                                        } else {
                                            ReceivedInvoice::where('nfe_key', $chaveOriginal)->update(['status' => 'return_pending']);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                $invoice = ReceivedInvoice::firstOrNew(['nfe_key' => $chave]);
                                $invoice->emitter_cnpj = (string) $xml->NFe->infNFe->emit->CNPJ;
                                $invoice->emitter_name = (string) $xml->NFe->infNFe->emit->xNome;
                                $invoice->issue_date   = Carbon::parse((string) $xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->dhEmi)->format('Y-m-d H:i:s');
                                $invoice->total_value  = (float) $xml->NFe->infNFe->total->ICMSTot->vNF;
                                $invoice->xml_content  = $xmlContent;
                                $invoice->has_full_xml = true;

                                if (!in_array($invoice->status, ['processed', 'rejected', 'canceled_by_supplier', 'returned'])) {
                                    $invoice->status = $targetStatus;
                                }
                                $invoice->save();
                                $salvasHoje++;

                                if ($targetStatus === 'ready') {
                                    app(\App\Services\Purchases\InvoiceImportService::class)->attemptAutoApproval($invoice);
                                }
                            } elseif ($rootName === 'resEvento' || $rootName === 'procEventoNFe') {
                                $tpEvento = $rootName === 'resEvento' ? (string) $xml->tpEvento : (string) $xml->evento->infEvento->tpEvento;
                                $chave = $rootName === 'resEvento' ? (string) $xml->chNFe : (string) $xml->evento->infEvento->chNFe;
                                if ($tpEvento == '110111') {
                                    ReceivedInvoice::where('nfe_key', $chave)->update(['status' => 'canceled_by_supplier']);
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Log::info("✅ Salvas ou atualizadas {$salvasHoje} notas na base de dados neste lote.");
                    }

                    // Avança o ponteiro de leitura local e persiste
                    if ($ultNSU > $currentNsu) {
                        $currentNsu = $ultNSU;
                        $setting->last_nsu = $ultNSU;
                        $setting->saveQuietly();
                        $this->clearSettingsCache();
                    }

                    // Se a SEFAZ indicou que ainda há mais documentos à frente no lote
                    if ($ultNSU > 0 && $ultNSU < $maxNSU && $cStat == 138) {
                        sleep(2);
                    } else {
                        $continuarBuscando = false;
                    }
                }

                $setting->sefaz_last_sync_at = now();
                $setting->saveQuietly();
                $this->clearSettingsCache();
            }

            // =======================================================
            // PARTE 2: DOWNLOAD ESPECÍFICO DE XMLS MANIFESTADOS
            // =======================================================
            $notasPendentes = ReceivedInvoice::where('status', 'manifested')
                ->where('has_full_xml', false)
                ->get();

            foreach ($notasPendentes as $nota) {
                try {
                    $respEspecifica = $tools->sefazDistDFe(0, 0, $nota->nfe_key);
                    $arrEspec = $std->toArray($respEspecifica);
                    $cStatEsp = (int) ($arrEspec['cStat'] ?? 0);

                    if ($cStatEsp == 138 && isset($arrEspec['loteDistDFeInt']['docZip'])) {
                        $docs = $arrEspec['loteDistDFeInt']['docZip'];
                        if (!is_array($docs) || (isset($docs['_value']) || isset($docs['@value']))) { $docs = [$docs]; }

                        foreach ($docs as $doc) {
                            $base64Data = is_string($doc) ? $doc : ($doc['_value'] ?? $doc['@value'] ?? '');
                            if (empty($base64Data)) continue;

                            $xmlContent = gzdecode(base64_decode($base64Data));
                            if (!$xmlContent) continue;

                            $xml = @simplexml_load_string($xmlContent);
                            if (!$xml || $xml->getName() !== 'nfeProc') continue;

                            $finNFe = (int) $xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->finNFe;
                            $natOp = strtoupper((string) $xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->natOp);
                            $isDevolucao = ($finNFe === 4) || str_contains($natOp, 'DEVOLUCAO') || str_contains($natOp, 'RETORNO');
                            $targetStatus = 'ready';

                            if ($isDevolucao) {
                                $targetStatus = 'return_receipt';
                                if (isset($xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->NFref->refNFe)) {
                                    $chaveOriginal = (string) $xml->NFe->infNFe->ide->NFref->refNFe;
                                    if (substr($chaveOriginal, 20, 2) === '65') {
                                        $targetStatus = 'processed';
                                    } else {
                                        ReceivedInvoice::where('nfe_key', $chaveOriginal)->update(['status' => 'return_pending']);
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            $nota->update([
                                'xml_content'  => $xmlContent,
                                'status'       => $targetStatus,
                                'has_full_xml' => true,
                            ]);

                            Log::info("✅ Download de XML pendente feito: {$nota->nfe_key}");

                            if ($targetStatus === 'ready') {
                                app(\App\Services\Purchases\InvoiceImportService::class)->attemptAutoApproval($nota);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                    Log::error("❌ Erro no XML da NF {$nota->nfe_key}: " . $e->getMessage());
                }
                sleep(2);
            }

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error("❌ ERRO CRÍTICO NA COMUNICAÇÃO SEFAZ: " . $e->getMessage());
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    private function clearSettingsCache(): void
    {
        Cache::forget('company_settings');
        Cache::forget('tenant_company_settings');
    }
}
```

## File: app/Listeners/AddLowStockToShoppingList.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Listeners;

use App\Events\StockLowDetected;
use App\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\ShoppingListItem;
use App\Models\ProductCostHistory;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;

class AddLowStockToShoppingList implements ShouldQueue
{
    use InteractsWithQueue;

    public function handle(StockLowDetected $event): void
    {
        if ($event->tenantId !== 'central') {
            $tenant = Tenant::find($event->tenantId);
            if ($tenant) tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
        }

        $product = $event->product;

        // 1. Calcula a meta de reposição (Prioridade: max_stock -> par_level -> min_stock * 2 -> 1)
        $targetStock = (float) ($product->max_stock ?? ($product->par_level ?? (($product->min_stock ?? 0) * 2)));
        $currentStock = (float) ($product->current_stock ?? 0);
        $deficit = max(1.0, round($targetStock - $currentStock, 3));

        // 2. Busca registro pendente existente ou instancia novo
        $item = ShoppingListItem::firstOrNew([
            'product_id' => $product->id,
            'status'     => 'pending'
        ]);

        // 3. Atualiza com o déficit necessário (sem inflação por vendas repetidas)
        $item->suggested_qty = $item->exists ? max((float) $item->suggested_qty, $deficit) : $deficit;

        // Se o evento for crítico (ruptura/zerado), eleva a urgência
        if ($event->urgency === 'critical' || $currentStock <= 0) {
            $item->urgency_level = 'critical';
        } elseif (!$item->exists) {
            $item->urgency_level = $event->urgency ?? 'normal';
        }

        // 4. Resolve fornecedor preferencial se ainda não estiver preenchido
        if (!$item->supplier_id) {
            $item->supplier_id = $product->supplier_id
                ?? ProductCostHistory::where('product_id', $product->id)->latest('id')->value('supplier_id');
        }

        // 5. Custo unitário de referência
        $unitCost = (float) ($product->base_cost ?? 0);
        if ($unitCost > 0) {
            $item->estimated_cost = round($item->suggested_qty * $unitCost, 2);
        }

        $item->save();

        if ($event->tenantId !== 'central') tenancy()->end();
    }
}
```

## File: app/Listeners/ProcessGatewayRefund.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Listeners;

use App\Events\OrderCancelled;
use App\Models\Tenant;
use App\Services\Financial\PaymentGatewayManager;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ProcessGatewayRefund implements ShouldQueue
{
    use InteractsWithQueue;

    public function __construct(protected PaymentGatewayManager $gatewayManager) {}

    public function handle(OrderCancelled $event): void
    {
        try {
            if ($event->tenantId !== 'central') {
                $tenant = Tenant::find($event->tenantId);
                if ($tenant) tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
            }

            $order = $event->order;

            // Só processa se o pedido realmente tiver um TXID (foi gerado PIX Dinâmico)
            // e se tiver pagamentos registrados com sucesso
            $totalPaid = $order->payments()->sum('amount');

            if ($order->txid && $totalPaid > 0) {
                // Recupera a integração ativa. No futuro, isso pode vir de uma configuração do banco.
                $gateway = $this->gatewayManager->resolveGateway('sicredi_pix');

                Log::info("🔄 [ProcessGatewayRefund] Iniciando estorno automático de R$ {$totalPaid} para o Pedido #{$order->id}...");

                $gateway->refundPayment($order, $totalPaid);

                Log::info("✅ [ProcessGatewayRefund] Estorno concluído com sucesso para o Pedido #{$order->id}.");
            }

            if ($event->tenantId !== 'central') tenancy()->end();

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error("❌ [ProcessGatewayRefund] Falha ao processar estorno do Pedido #{$event->order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Listeners/SendToKitchenPrinters.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Listeners;

use App\Events\OrderItemsSentToKitchen;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\Kitchen;
use App\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Printing\PrintDispatcher;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\KitchenTicket;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class SendToKitchenPrinters implements ShouldQueue
{
    use InteractsWithQueue;

    public $afterCommit = true;

    public function __construct(private PrintDispatcher $printDispatcher) {}

    public function handle(OrderItemsSentToKitchen $event): void
    {
        try {
            $itemsData = $event->items;
            if (empty($itemsData)) return;

            $tenantId = $itemsData[0]['tenant_id'] ?? null;
            if ($tenantId && $tenantId !== 'central') {
                $tenant = Tenant::find($tenantId);
                if ($tenant) tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
            }

            $orderId = $itemsData[0]['order']['id'] ?? $itemsData[0]['order_id'];
            $order = Order::find($orderId);
            if (!$order) return;

            $itemIds = array_column($itemsData, 'id');
            $orderItems = OrderItem::with(['modifiers', 'subItems.modifiers', 'product.category'])
                ->whereIn('id', $itemIds)
                ->get();

            if ($orderItems->isEmpty()) {
                if ($tenantId && $tenantId !== 'central') tenancy()->end();
                return;
            }

            $settings = CompanySetting::first();

            $printMode = $settings->kitchen_print_mode ?? 'station';
            $separateMultiples = $settings->kitchen_separate_multiples ?? false;
            $cashierPrinter = \App\Models\Printer::where('is_cashier', true)->where('is_active', true)->first();

            // 🚀 Identifica se há itens pai de combo presentes no lote
            $parentIds = $orderItems->pluck('parent_item_id')->filter()->unique()->toArray();

            $groupedByPrinter = [];

            foreach ($orderItems as $item) {
                // Se o item é apenas o cabeçalho do combo e os filhos estão no pedido, não despacha o pai para produção
                if (in_array($item->id, $parentIds)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $targetPrinter = null;

                if ($printMode !== 'order' && $item->kitchen_id) {
                    $kit = Kitchen::with('printer')->find($item->kitchen_id);
                    if ($kit && $kit->printer && $kit->printer->is_active) {
                        $targetPrinter = $kit->printer;
                    }
                }

                $targetPrinter = $targetPrinter ?? $cashierPrinter;

                if ($targetPrinter && $targetPrinter->is_active) {
                    $printerId = $targetPrinter->id;
                    if (!isset($groupedByPrinter[$printerId])) {
                        $groupedByPrinter[$printerId] = [
                            'printer' => $targetPrinter,
                            'items' => collect()
                        ];
                    }
                    $groupedByPrinter[$printerId]['items']->push($item);
                }
            }

            foreach ($groupedByPrinter as $group) {
                $doc = new KitchenTicket($order, $group['items'], $printMode, $separateMultiples);
                $this->printDispatcher->dispatch($group['printer'], $doc);
            }

            if ($tenantId && $tenantId !== 'central') tenancy()->end();

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error("ERRO FATAL NA FILA DE COZINHA (Listener): " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Models/FailedJob.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use App\Models\Tenant;

class FailedJob extends Model
{
    protected $connection = 'mysql';
    protected $table = 'failed_jobs';
    public $timestamps = false;

    protected $casts = [
        'failed_at' => 'datetime',
        'payload' => 'array',
    ];

    /**
     * Tenta identificar o nome/ID do Tenant dentro do payload do Job.
     */
    public function getTenantIdentifierAttribute(): string
    {
        $payload = $this->payload;

        if (is_array($payload)) {
            // Tenta localizar o tenant_id no payload serializado
            if (isset($payload['tenant_id'])) {
                return $payload['tenant_id'];
            }

            // Se for um Job do Stancl Tenancy, o tenant_id costuma estar no comando serializado
            if (isset($payload['data']['command'])) {
                if (preg_match('/"tenant_id";s:\d+:"([^"]+)"/', $payload['data']['command'], $matches)) {
                    return $matches[1];
                }
            }
        }

        return 'Sistema / Central';
    }

    /**
     * Extrai o nome legível da classe do Job (ex: ProcessOrderPrintJob)
     */
    public function getJobNameAttribute(): string
    {
        $payload = $this->payload;

        if (is_array($payload)) {
            if (isset($payload['displayName'])) {
                return class_basename($payload['displayName']);
            }
        }

        return 'Job Desconhecido';
    }
}
```

```php
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

#[ObservedBy([InventoryLossObserver::class])]
class InventoryLoss extends Model
{
    // Constantes de retrocompatibilidade com o enum InventoryLossType
    public const TYPE_OPERATIONAL      = 'operational';
    public const TYPE_INVENTORY_AUDIT  = 'inventory_audit';
    public const TYPE_EXPIRED          = 'expired';
    public const TYPE_SPOILAGE         = 'spoilage';
    public const TYPE_DAMAGED          = 'damaged';

    protected $guarded = [];

    // 🚀 Flag em memória: impede dedução dupla quando o balanço/ajuste já deduziu o saldo
    public bool $skipInventoryDeduction = false;

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'quantity'   => 'decimal:4',
            'unit_cost'  => 'decimal:5',
            'total_cost' => 'decimal:5',
            'loss_type'  => InventoryLossType::class,
        ];
    }

    public function product(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Product::class);
    }

    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    public function orderItem(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(OrderItem::class);
    }

    public function storageLocation(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(StorageLocation::class);
    }

    /**
     * Mantido por retrocompatibilidade caso alguma view antiga ainda acesse $loss->formatted_type
     */
    public function getFormattedTypeAttribute(): string
    {
        return $this->loss_type?->getLabel() ?? 'Desconhecido';
    }
}
```

## File: app/Models/ProductStorageLocation.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

class ProductStorageLocation extends Model
{
    // 🚀 Nome real da tabela no banco
    protected $table = 'product_storage_location';

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        'max_capacity' => 'integer',
        'restock_threshold' => 'integer',
        'current_stock' => 'decimal:3',
    ];

    public function product(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Product::class);
    }

    public function location(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(StorageLocation::class, 'storage_location_id');
    }

    public function sourceLocation(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(StorageLocation::class, 'source_location_id');
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        $syncTotalStock = function ($storageRule) {
            $product = $storageRule->product;

            if ($product && $product->track_inventory) {
                $totalStock = $product->storageRules()->sum('current_stock');
                $product->current_stock = $totalStock;
                $product->save();
            }
        };

        static::saved($syncTotalStock);
        static::deleted($syncTotalStock);
    }
}
```

```php
/**
 * @property-read \App\Models\Supplier|null $supplier
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|RecurringExpense newModelQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|RecurringExpense newQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|RecurringExpense onlyTrashed()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|RecurringExpense query()

 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|RecurringExpense withoutTrashed()
 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder
 */
class RecurringExpense extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    // 🚀 O Laravel é inteligente: como a classe se chama RecurringExpense,

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        "is_auto_debit" => "boolean",

        "default_amount" => "decimal:2",

     */
    public function supplier(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Supplier::class);
    }
    public function accountPayables(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(AccountPayable::class);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue; // 🚀 OBRIGATÓRIO PARA A FILA
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushMessage;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushChannel;

class DeviceWaitingNotification extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public string $deviceName;
    public string $deviceType;

    public function __construct(string $deviceName, string $deviceType)
    {
        $this->deviceName = $deviceName;
        $this->deviceType = $deviceType;
    }

    public function via($notifiable): array
    {
        // 🚀 Define os canais (Database para o sininho no painel, WebPush para o telemóvel)
        return ['database', WebPushChannel::class];
    }

    public function toWebPush($notifiable, $notification)
    {
        $tipo = $this->deviceType === 'kds' ? 'Cozinha (KDS)' : 'Caixa / POS';

        return (new WebPushMessage)
            ->title('Acesso Solicitado')
            ->icon('/icon-192x192.png')
            ->body("O terminal {$this->deviceName} ({$tipo}) está a pedir liberação de acesso.")
            ->action('Autorizar Agora', '/team/mobile/menu');
    }

    public function toArray($notifiable): array
    {
        return [
            'title' => 'Acesso Solicitado',
            'message' => "O terminal {$this->deviceName} requer a sua autorização.",
            'device' => $this->deviceName
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushMessage;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushChannel;
use App\Models\Order;

class NewB2COrderNotification extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public function __construct(
        public Order $order,
        public string $customMessage = '' // 🚀 Adicionamos o recebedor da mensagem customizada
    ) {}

    public function via($notifiable): array
    {
        return [WebPushChannel::class];
    }

    public function toWebPush($notifiable, $notification)
    {
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::info("📍 [SONDA PUSH BACK] Construindo payload WebPush para o usuário ID: {$notifiable->id}");

        $typeText = $this->order->type === 'delivery' ? 'entrega' : 'retirada';
        $customerName = $this->order->customer_name ?? 'Cliente';

        $body = $this->customMessage ?: "{$customerName} fez um pedido de {$typeText}.";

        return (new WebPushMessage)
            ->title('🛒 Novo Pedido On-line!')
            ->icon('/icon-192x192.png')
            ->body($body)
            ->data(['action_url' => "/team/mobile/operations"])
            ->action('Ver Pedido', "/team/mobile/operations")
            ->options(['TTL' => 3600]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Notifications/OrderReadyForDeliveryNotification.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use App\Models\Order;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushChannel;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushMessage;

class OrderReadyForDeliveryNotification extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public function __construct(public Order $order) {}

    public function via(object $notifiable): array
    {
        return [WebPushChannel::class];
    }

    public function toWebPush(object $notifiable, object $notification): WebPushMessage
    {
        $orderId = $this->order->id;
        $neighborhood = $this->order->neighborhood
            ?? $this->order->address_snapshot['neighborhood']
            ?? $this->order->address?->neighborhood
            ?? 'Delivery';

        $totalFormatted = number_format((float) ($this->order->total ?? $this->order->balance_due ?? 0), 2, ',', '.');
        $isPaid = $this->order->payment_status === 'paid';
        $paymentText = $isPaid ? 'Já Pago' : "Cobrar R$ {$totalFormatted}";

        return (new WebPushMessage)
            ->title("🛵 Pedido #{$orderId} Pronto para Entrega!")
            ->icon('/icons/icon-192x192.png')
            ->badge('/icons/icon-192x192.png')
            ->body("Bairro {$neighborhood} • {$paymentText}. Já embalado no balcão.")
            ->tag("order-ready-{$orderId}")
            ->data([
                'url' => url('/team/driver'),
                'order_id' => $orderId
            ])
            ->action('Abrir Pedido', 'open_order');
    }
}
```

## File: app/Notifications/OrderStatusUpdated.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushMessage;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushChannel;
use App\Models\Order;

class OrderStatusUpdated extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public $order;
    public $message;

    public function __construct(Order $order, string $message)
    {
        $this->order = $order;
        $this->message = $message;
    }

    public function via($notifiable)
    {
        return [WebPushChannel::class];
    }

    public function toWebPush($notifiable, $notification)
    {
        $statusMap = [
            'preparing' => '👨‍🍳 Na Cozinha',
            'ready' => '✅ Pronto!',
            'out_for_delivery' => '🛵 A Caminho',
            'dispatched' => '🛵 A Caminho',
            'closed' => '✨ Concluído'
        ];

        $title = $statusMap[$this->order->status] ?? 'Atualização do Pedido';

        $settings = \App\Models\CompanySetting::getCached();
        $badgeUrl = $settings && $settings->push_badge_path
            ? '/media/file?path=' . $settings->push_badge_path
            : '/icon-192x192.png';

        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO 3: Define um Topic (Vibration/Collapse ID).
        // Se o Firebase tiver 3 notificações pendentes para esse Pedido (Ex: Saiu, Chegou, Concluiu),
        // ele vai descartar as antigas e exibir apenas a última, preservando a bateria do cliente!
        return (new \NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushMessage)
            ->title($title)
            ->icon('/icon-192x192.png')
            ->badge($badgeUrl)
            ->body($this->message)
            ->data(['action_url' => '/customer/orders'])
            ->action('Acompanhar Pedido', '/customer/orders')
            ->options([
                'TTL' => 3600,
                'topic' => 'pedido_' . $this->order->id // 👈 A regra de Ouro!
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushMessage;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\WebPushChannel;

class SystemPushNotification extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public string $title;
    public string $message;
    public string $actionUrl;

    public function __construct(string $title, string $message, string $actionUrl = '/')
    {
        $this->title = $title;
        $this->message = $message;
        $this->actionUrl = $actionUrl;
    }

    public function via($notifiable): array
    {
        return [WebPushChannel::class];
    }

    public function toWebPush($notifiable, $notification): WebPushMessage
    {
        // Resgata o ícone da empresa no cache
        $settings = \App\Models\CompanySetting::getCached();
        $badgeUrl = $settings && $settings->push_badge_path
            ? '/media/file?path=' . $settings->push_badge_path
            : '/icon-192x192.png';

        return (new WebPushMessage)
            ->title($this->title)
            ->icon('/icon-192x192.png')
            ->badge($badgeUrl)
            ->body($this->message)
            ->data(['action_url' => $this->actionUrl])
            ->action('Abrir Sistema', $this->actionUrl)
            ->options(['TTL' => 3600]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\Transaction;

class AccountPayableObserver
{
    public function created(AccountPayable $payable): void
    {
        // 1. Lógica do Colaborador (Migrada do Model)
        if ($payable->employee_id) {
            $desc = strtolower($payable->description);
            $isVale = str_contains($desc, "vale") || str_contains($desc, "adiantamento");

            if (!$isVale) {
                $payable->launchLedger("credit", "Provisão de Serviço: " . $payable->description);
            }

            if ($payable->status === "paid") {
                $payable->launchLedger("debit", "Pagamento: " . $payable->description);
            }
        }

        // 2. Lógica Bancária: Se já nasceu PAGO, gera transação de saída
        if ($payable->status === 'paid' && $payable->bank_account_id) {
            $this->createBankTransaction($payable);
        }
    }

    public function updated(AccountPayable $payable): void
    {
        if ($payable->isDirty('status')) {
            
            // 1. Lógica do Colaborador
            if ($payable->employee_id) {
                if ($payable->status === "paid") {
                    $payable->launchLedger("debit", "Pagamento: " . $payable->description);
                }
                if ($payable->status === "pending" && $payable->getOriginal("status") === "paid") {
                    $payable->launchLedger("credit", "Estorno de Pagamento: " . $payable->description);
                }
            }

            // 2. Lógica Bancária: Efetuou pagamento
            if ($payable->status === 'paid' && $payable->bank_account_id) {
                $this->createBankTransaction($payable);
            }
            
            // 3. Lógica Bancária: Estornou (voltou pra pendente ou cancelado)
            if (in_array($payable->status, ['pending', 'cancelled']) && $payable->getOriginal('status') === 'paid') {
                Transaction::where('description', 'LIKE', "Baixa de Conta a Pagar #{$payable->id}%")->delete();
            }
        }
    }

    public function deleting(AccountPayable $payable): void
    {
        // 1. Lógica do Colaborador
        if ($payable->employee_id && $payable->status === 'pending') {
            $payable->launchLedger("debit", "Cancelamento Administrativo de Serviço: " . $payable->description);
        }

        // 2. Remove as saídas financeiras atreladas
        Transaction::where('description', 'LIKE', "Baixa de Conta a Pagar #{$payable->id}%")->delete();
    }

    /**
     * Auxiliar para criar a transação bancária
     */
    private function createBankTransaction(AccountPayable $payable): void
    {
        $beneficiary = $payable->employee_id 
            ? ($payable->employee?->name ?? 'Colaborador') 
            : ($payable->supplier?->trade_name ?? $payable->supplier?->name ?? 'Fornecedor');

        Transaction::create([
            'bank_account_id'  => $payable->bank_account_id,
            'type'             => 'out',
            'category'         => 'payable_settlement', // Ou 'supplier_payment' se preferir
            'amount'           => $payable->amount,
            'description'      => "Baixa de Conta a Pagar #{$payable->id} - {$beneficiary} ({$payable->description})",
            'operator_name'    => auth()->user()?->name ?? 'Sistema',
            'transaction_date' => $payable->payment_date ?? now(),
        ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class CustomerObserver
{
    /**
     * Disparado quando um novo cliente é salvo no banco pela primeira vez.
     */
    public function created(Customer $customer): void
    {
        $this->generateWelcomeCoupon($customer);
    }

    /**
     * Gera um cupom de Primeira Compra se as configurações da empresa permitirem.
     */
    private function generateWelcomeCoupon(Customer $customer): void
    {
        try {
            // (Opcional) Podemos checar uma flag no CompanySettings se o dono da loja quer dar esse benefício
            // $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
            // if (!$settings->enable_welcome_coupons) return;

            $firstName = explode(' ', trim($customer->name))[0] ?? 'CLIENTE';
            $firstName = strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z]/', '', Str::ascii($firstName)));
            $uniqueHash = substr(uniqid(), -4);
            
            $code = "BEMVINDO-{$firstName}-{$uniqueHash}";

            $customer->coupons()->create([
                'code'            => $code,
                'description'     => 'Presente de Boas-Vindas (1ª Compra)',
                'type'            => 'percentage', 
                'value'           => 10.00, // 10% Off
                'usage_limit'     => 1, 
                'is_active'       => true,
                'expires_at'      => now()->addDays(30),
            ]);
            
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            // Se o model Coupon não tiver as colunas exatas que passei acima, 
            // a falha será silenciosa e não impedirá o cadastro do cliente.
            Log::error("CRM: Erro ao gerar cupom de boas-vindas para o Cliente ID {$customer->id} - " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\GoodsReceipt;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use App\Models\ProductCostHistory;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class GoodsReceiptObserver
{
    public function deleting(GoodsReceipt $goodsReceipt): void
    {
        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Tudo numa única transação
        DB::transaction(function () use ($goodsReceipt) {
            $inventoryService = app(InventoryService::class);
            $goodsReceipt->load('items.product');

            // 1. REVERTER O ESTOQUE NO KARDEX
            foreach ($goodsReceipt->items as $item) {
                $product = $item->product;

                if ($product && $product->track_inventory) {
                    $inventoryService->deductStock(
                        product: $product,
                        qtySold: (float) $item->quantity,
                        originModel: $goodsReceipt,
                        description: "Estorno de Entrada: Romaneio #{$goodsReceipt->receipt_number} excluído"
                    );
                }
            }

            // 2. REVERTER O FINANCEIRO
            if ($goodsReceipt->receipt_number) {
                Transaction::where('description', 'LIKE', "%Canhoto #{$goodsReceipt->receipt_number}%")
                    ->where('amount', $goodsReceipt->total_amount)
                    ->delete();

                AccountPayable::where('description', 'LIKE', "%Canhoto #{$goodsReceipt->receipt_number}%")
                    ->where('amount', $goodsReceipt->total_amount)
                    ->delete();
            }

            // 3. REVERTER HISTÓRICO DE CUSTOS E NF-E FANTASMA
            ProductCostHistory::where(function ($query) use ($goodsReceipt) {
                $query->where('origin_type', GoodsReceipt::class)
                      ->where('origin_id', $goodsReceipt->id);
            })->orWhere('nfe_key', 'LIKE', "ROMANEIO-{$goodsReceipt->id}-%")->delete();

            $fakeNfeKeyPrefix = "ROMANEIO-{$goodsReceipt->id}-";
            ReceivedInvoice::where('nfe_key', 'LIKE', "{$fakeNfeKeyPrefix}%")->delete();
        });
    }
}
```

```php
    {
        if ($loss->skipInventoryDeduction || (float) $loss->quantity <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        app(InventoryService::class)->deductLoss($loss);
    }

    public function deleted(InventoryLoss $loss): void
    {
        if ($loss->skipInventoryDeduction || (float) $loss->quantity <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        app(InventoryService::class)->restoreLoss($loss);
    }
```
