```php
<?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Services\Marketing\LoyaltyService;

class OrderObserver
{
    /**
     * Disparado sempre que um Pedido sofre um UPDATE no banco.
     */
    public function updated(Order $order): void
    {
        // 🚀 CENÁRIO 1: O pedido foi FINALIZADO (cobre balcão, mesa e entregas)
        if ($order->wasChanged('status') && in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'completed', 'delivered', 'finished'])) {
            if ($order->customer_id && (int) ($order->loyalty_points_earned ?? 0) === 0) {
                $customer = $order->customer ?: Customer::find($order->customer_id);
                if ($customer) {
                    app(LoyaltyService::class)->earnPoints($order, $customer);
                }
            }
        }

        // 🚀 CENÁRIO 2: O pedido foi CANCELADO
        if ($order->wasChanged('status') && $order->status === 'cancelled') {
            if ($order->customer_id) {
                app(LoyaltyService::class)->refundOrderCashback($order);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Events\CatalogUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ProductObserver
{
    public function saving(Product $product): void
    {
        // 1. Geração de Slug
        if (empty($product->slug) || $product->isDirty('name') || $product->isDirty('slug')) {
            $source = (!empty($product->slug) && $product->isDirty('slug')) ? $product->slug : $product->name;
            $product->slug = Str::slug($source ?? '');
        }

        // 🛡️ 2. BLINDAGEM DE IDENTIDADE: Insumos e Materiais Operacionais
        $operationalTypes = ['ingredient', 'supply', 'consumable', 'packaging', 'service', 'manufactured', 'internal'];

        if (in_array($product->type, $operationalTypes, true)) {
            // Insumos NUNCA aparecem em cardápios e não possuem preço ao consumidor
            $product->show_on_menu = false;
            $product->show_on_delivery = false;
            $product->dine_in_price = null;
            $product->delivery_price = null;
            $product->promo_price = null;
            $product->requires_preparation = false;
        }

        // 🛡️ 3. BLINDAGEM DE PRODUTOS DE VENDA (resale, dish, combo)
        if (in_array($product->type, ['resale', 'dish', 'combo'], true)) {
            // Se for cadastrado como prato ou combo, obrigatoriamente requer preparo
            if (in_array($product->type, ['dish', 'combo'], true)) {
                $product->requires_preparation = true;
            }
        }

        // 4. Gestão de status baseada no estoque físico
        if ($product->track_inventory) {
            if ($product->current_stock <= 0) {
                if (in_array($product->status, ['available', 'active'], true)) {
                    $product->status = 'out_of_stock';
                }
            } elseif ($product->current_stock > 0 && $product->status === 'out_of_stock') {
                $product->status = 'available';
            }
        }
    }

    public function saved(Product $product): void
    {
        $this->flushCacheAndBroadcast($product);
    }

    public function deleted(Product $product): void
    {
        $this->flushCacheAndBroadcast($product);
    }

    public function forceDeleted(Product $product): void
    {
        try {
            if ($product->image_path && Storage::disk('public')->exists($product->image_path)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($product->image_path);
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error("Erro ao apagar imagem física do Produto: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    private function flushCacheAndBroadcast(Product $product): void
    {
        $tenantId = $product->tenant_id ?? tenant('id') ?? 'central';

        try {
            if (method_exists(Cache::getStore(), 'tags')) {
                Cache::tags(['catalog'])->flush();
            }
            Cache::forget('customer_catalog_data');
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::warning("Falha ao limpar cache do catálogo: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        if (class_exists(CatalogUpdated::class)) {
            broadcast(new CatalogUpdated((string) $tenantId));
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Observers/TransactionObserver.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Transaction;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TransactionObserver
{
    public function created(Transaction $transaction): void
    {
        $this->applyBalance($transaction, 1);
    }

    public function updated(Transaction $transaction): void
    {
        // Se mudou o valor, o tipo ou a conta de destino, revertemos o estado original e aplicamos o novo
        if ($transaction->isDirty(['amount', 'type', 'bank_account_id', 'cash_shift_id'])) {
            
            DB::transaction(function () use ($transaction) {
                // 1. Estorna o valor antigo das contas originais
                $this->updateTarget(
                    $transaction->getOriginal('bank_account_id'),
                    $transaction->getOriginal('cash_shift_id'),
                    $transaction->getOriginal('type'),
                    (float) $transaction->getOriginal('amount'),
                    -1 // Reverte
                );
                
                // 2. Aplica o valor novo nas contas atuais
                $this->applyBalance($transaction, 1);
            });
        }
    }

    public function deleted(Transaction $transaction): void
    {
        $this->applyBalance($transaction, -1);
    }

    public function restored(Transaction $transaction): void
    {
        $this->applyBalance($transaction, 1);
    }

    private function applyBalance(Transaction $transaction, int $multiplier): void
    {
        $this->updateTarget(
            $transaction->bank_account_id,
            $transaction->cash_shift_id,
            $transaction->type,
            (float) $transaction->amount,
            $multiplier
        );
    }

    private function updateTarget(?int $bankId, ?int $shiftId, string $type, float $amount, int $multiplier): void
    {
        if ($amount == 0) return;

        // Se for saída ('out'), o valor fica negativo. Se for entrada, fica positivo.
        $realValue = ($type === 'out' ? -$amount : $amount) * $multiplier;

        if ($bankId) {
            // O increment nativo do Laravel já lida perfeitamente com valores negativos (virando decrement)
            DB::table('bank_accounts')->where('id', $bankId)->increment('current_balance', $realValue);
        }

        if ($shiftId) {
            DB::table('cash_shifts')->where('id', $shiftId)->increment('closing_balance_expected', $realValue);
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Accounting/BankMatchScoringService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Accounting;

use App\Models\BankStatement;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\Supplier;

class BankMatchScoringService
{
    private array $familyDocsCache = [];

    public function findMatchesFor(BankStatement $statement)
    {
        $candidates = AccountPayable::with(["supplier", "employee"])
            ->where("status", "pending")
            ->whereBetween("due_date", [
                $statement->bank_date->copy()->subDays(45),
                $statement->bank_date->copy()->addDays(15),
            ])
            ->get();

        $matches = collect();

        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
            $score = $this->calculateScore($statement, $candidate);

            if ($score >= 30) {
                $matches->push([
                    "candidate" => $candidate,
                    "score" => $score,
                    "type" => "Contas a Pagar",
                ]);
            }
        }

        return $matches->sortByDesc("score")->values();
    }

    public function calculateScore(BankStatement $statement, AccountPayable $candidate): int
    {
        $amountData = $this->calculateAmountScore($statement, $candidate);

        if ($amountData['score'] === 0) return 0;

        $identityScore = $this->calculateIdentityScore($statement, $candidate);

        if ($amountData['is_late_match'] && $identityScore === 0) return 0;

        $dateScore = $this->calculateDateScore($statement, $candidate, $amountData['is_late_match']);

        return min($amountData['score'] + $identityScore + $dateScore, 100);
    }

    private function calculateAmountScore(BankStatement $statement, AccountPayable $candidate): array
    {
        $statementAmount = abs((float) ($statement->amount ?? 0));
        $candidateAmount = abs((float) ($candidate->amount ?? 0));
        $diff = abs($statementAmount - $candidateAmount);

        $isLate = $statement->bank_date && $candidate->due_date && $statement->bank_date->greaterThan($candidate->due_date);
        $daysLate = $isLate ? $candidate->due_date->diffInDays($statement->bank_date) : 0;

        $lateMatch = false;
        $expectedLateValue = $candidateAmount;

        if ($daysLate > 0) {
            $multa = $candidateAmount * 0.02;
            $juros = $candidateAmount * (0.01 / 30) * $daysLate;
            $expectedLateValue = $candidateAmount + $multa + $juros;
        }

        $score = 0;

        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO DA ORDEM LÓGICA
        // 1. O Match Perfeito com Multa: Adivinha o Juros com precisão?
        if ($daysLate > 0 && abs($statementAmount - $expectedLateValue) <= 2.0) {
            $score = 35;
            $lateMatch = true;
        }
        // 2. O Match Perfeito Seco (Pago em dia na vírgula)
        elseif ($diff < 0.01) {
            $score = 40;
        }
        // 3. Arredondamentos e Descontos pequenos
        elseif ($diff <= 1.0) {
            $score = 35;
        }
        // 4. Aceita diferença de 2% (Ex: Desconto por antecipação)
        elseif ($statementAmount >= $candidateAmount * 0.98 && $statementAmount <= $candidateAmount * 1.02) {
            $score = 20;
        }

        return ['score' => $score, 'is_late_match' => $lateMatch];
    }

    private function calculateIdentityScore(BankStatement $statement, AccountPayable $candidate): int
    {
        $bankDoc = preg_replace("/[^0-9]/", "", (string) ($statement->document ?? ""));
        $stmtDesc = (string) ($statement->description ?? "");
        $stmtCounter = (string) ($statement->counterparty_name ?? "");

        $cleanStr = fn($s) => preg_replace("/[^a-z0-9]/", "", strtolower(trim($s)));
        $bankText = $cleanStr($stmtDesc . " " . $stmtCounter);

        if ($candidate->supplier) {
            return $this->scoreSupplierIdentity($candidate->supplier, $bankDoc, $bankText);
        } elseif ($candidate->employee) {
            return $this->scoreEmployeeIdentity($candidate->employee, $bankDoc, $bankText);
        }

        $candDesc = $cleanStr($candidate->description ?? "");
        if (!empty($candDesc) && str_contains($bankText, $candDesc)) return 20;

        return 0;
    }

    private function scoreSupplierIdentity(Supplier $supplier, string $bankDoc, string $bankText): int
    {
        $supDoc = preg_replace("/[^0-9]/", "", (string) ($supplier->document ?? ""));
        $bankDocLen = strlen($bankDoc);
        $supDocLen = strlen($supDoc);

        if (in_array($bankDocLen, [11, 14]) && in_array($supDocLen, [11, 14])) {
            if ($bankDoc === $supDoc) return 40;
            if ($bankDocLen === 14 && $supDocLen === 14 && substr($bankDoc, 0, 8) === substr($supDoc, 0, 8)) return 40;

            $familyDocs = $this->getFamilyDocs($supplier);
            if (in_array($bankDoc, $familyDocs)) return 40;

            return 0;
        }

        $cleanStr = fn($s) => preg_replace("/[^a-z0-9]/", "", strtolower(trim($s)));
        $supName = $cleanStr($supplier->name ?? "");
        $supTrade = $cleanStr($supplier->trade_name ?? "");

        if (!empty($supName) && str_contains($bankText, $supName)) return 40;
        if (!empty($supTrade) && str_contains($bankText, $supTrade)) return 40;

        return 0;
    }

    private function scoreEmployeeIdentity($employee, string $bankDoc, string $bankText): int
    {
        $empDoc = preg_replace("/[^0-9]/", "", (string) ($employee->cpf ?? ""));
        $bankDocLen = strlen($bankDoc);
        $empDocLen = strlen($empDoc);

        if (in_array($bankDocLen, [11, 14]) && in_array($empDocLen, [11, 14])) {
            if ($bankDoc !== $empDoc) return 0;
            return 40;
        }

        $cleanStr = fn($s) => preg_replace("/[^a-z0-9]/", "", strtolower(trim($s)));
        $empName = $cleanStr($employee->name ?? "");

        if (!empty($empName) && str_contains($bankText, $empName)) return 40;

        return 0;
    }

    private function calculateDateScore(BankStatement $statement, AccountPayable $candidate, bool $lateMatch): int
    {
        if (!$statement->bank_date || !$candidate->due_date) return 0;

        $absDaysDiff = (int) $statement->bank_date->diffInDays($candidate->due_date);

        if ($lateMatch) return 20;
        if ($absDaysDiff === 0) return 20;
        if ($absDaysDiff === 1) return 15;
        if ($absDaysDiff === 2) return 10;
        if ($absDaysDiff <= 5) return 5;

        return 0;
    }

    private function getFamilyDocs(Supplier $supplier): array
    {
        $supplierId = $supplier->id;

        if (isset($this->familyDocsCache[$supplierId])) {
            return $this->familyDocsCache[$supplierId];
        }

        $familyIds = $supplier->family_ids;

        $familyDocs = Supplier::whereIn('id', $familyIds)
            ->pluck('document')
            ->map(fn($d) => preg_replace("/[^0-9]/", "", (string) $d))
            ->filter()
            ->toArray();

        foreach ($familyIds as $famId) {
            $this->familyDocsCache[$famId] = $familyDocs;
        }

        return $familyDocs;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Accounting;

use App\Models\BankStatement;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\PaymentBatch;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Exception;

class BankReconciliationService
{
    public static function finalize(
        BankStatement $statement,
        Model $conciliable,
        ?int $supplierId = null,
        ?string $description = null
    ): Transaction {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($statement, $conciliable, $supplierId, $description) {

            // 🚀 TRAVA PESSIMISTA: Bloqueia a linha do extrato para edição simultânea
            $lockedStatement = BankStatement::where('id', $statement->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();

            // 🚀 PROTEÇÃO DE CONCORRÊNCIA: Se já foi conciliado por outro request no milissegundo anterior, aborta!
            if ($lockedStatement->status === 'reconciled') {
                throw new Exception('Operação abortada: Este extrato bancário já foi conciliado.');
            }

            // 1. Cria a Transação Real amarrada ao Banco
            $transaction = Transaction::create([
                "bank_account_id" => $lockedStatement->bank_account_id,
                "type" => $lockedStatement->type,
                "amount" => abs((float) $lockedStatement->amount),
                "description" => $description ?? $lockedStatement->description,
                "transaction_date" => clone $lockedStatement->bank_date,
                "supplier_id" => $supplierId,
            ]);

            // 2. Amarra o Extrato à Entidade
            $lockedStatement->update([
                "status" => "reconciled",
                "conciliable_id" => $conciliable->id,
                "conciliable_type" => get_class($conciliable),
                "transaction_id" => $transaction->id,
            ]);

            // 3. Atualiza Conta a Pagar
            if ($conciliable instanceof AccountPayable) {
                $conciliable->update([
                    "status" => "paid",
                    "payment_date" => $lockedStatement->bank_date
                ]);
            }
            // 4. Atualiza Lote e Contas Filhas
            elseif ($conciliable instanceof PaymentBatch) {
                $conciliable->update([
                    "status" => "paid",
                    "payment_date" => $lockedStatement->bank_date
                ]);
                AccountPayable::where("payment_batch_id", $conciliable->id)->update([
                    "status" => "paid",
                    "payment_date" => $lockedStatement->bank_date
                ]);
            }

            return $transaction;
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Accounting;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Carbon\CarbonPeriod;

class BillingConsolidator
{
    public static function getDashboardData(
        string $startDate, string $endDate, string $compareWith,
        string $groupBy, string $stratifyBy,
        array|string|null $filterType = null,
        array|string|null $filterPayment = null
    ): array {
        $start = Carbon::parse($startDate)->startOfDay();
        $end = Carbon::parse($endDate)->endOfDay();

        // 1. DADOS DO PERÍODO ATUAL
        $currentRaw = self::fetchData($start, $end, $filterType, $filterPayment);
        $currentRaw = self::applyStratification($currentRaw, $stratifyBy);

        $currentTotals = [
            'revenue' => $currentRaw->sum('revenue'),
            'orders' => $currentRaw->sum('order_count'),
        ];
        $currentTotals['avg_ticket'] = $currentTotals['orders'] > 0 ? ($currentTotals['revenue'] / $currentTotals['orders']) : 0;

        // 2. DADOS DO PERÍODO ANTERIOR
        $previousTotals = ['revenue' => 0, 'orders' => 0, 'avg_ticket' => 0];
        $deltas = ['revenue' => 0, 'orders' => 0, 'avg_ticket' => 0];
        $previousGrouped = [];

        $isComparing = ($compareWith !== 'none' && $stratifyBy === 'none');

        if ($isComparing) {
            $prevStart = $start->copy();
            $prevEnd = $end->copy();

            if ($compareWith === 'previous_period') {
                $diffInDays = $start->diffInDays($end) + 1;
                $prevStart->subDays($diffInDays);
                $prevEnd->subDays($diffInDays);
            } elseif ($compareWith === 'previous_year') {
                $prevStart->subYear();
                $prevEnd->subYear();
            }

            $previousRaw = self::fetchData($prevStart, $prevEnd, $filterType, $filterPayment);
            $previousRaw = self::applyStratification($previousRaw, 'none');
            $previousGrouped = self::groupData($previousRaw, $groupBy, $prevStart, $prevEnd);

            $previousTotals['revenue'] = $previousRaw->sum('revenue');
            $previousTotals['orders'] = $previousRaw->sum('order_count');
            $previousTotals['avg_ticket'] = $previousTotals['orders'] > 0 ? ($previousTotals['revenue'] / $previousTotals['orders']) : 0;

            $deltas['revenue'] = self::calculateDelta($currentTotals['revenue'], $previousTotals['revenue']);
            $deltas['orders'] = self::calculateDelta($currentTotals['orders'], $previousTotals['orders']);
            $deltas['avg_ticket'] = self::calculateDelta($currentTotals['avg_ticket'], $previousTotals['avg_ticket']);
        }

        // 3. ESTRUTURAÇÃO PARA O GRÁFICO
        $currentSeries = [];
        $stratifiedSeries = [];

        if ($stratifyBy === 'none') {
            $currentSeries = self::groupData($currentRaw, $groupBy, $start, $end);
        } else {
            $stratifiedSeries = self::groupStratifiedData($currentRaw, $groupBy, $start, $end);
        }

        return [
            'current_totals' => $currentTotals,
            'previous_totals' => $previousTotals,
            'deltas' => $deltas,
            'current_series' => $currentSeries,
            'previous_series' => $previousGrouped,
            'stratified_series' => $stratifiedSeries,
            'is_comparing' => $isComparing,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Motor de Extração: Simples, Limpo e Seguro
     */
    private static function fetchData(Carbon $start, Carbon $end, array|string|null $filterType, array|string|null $filterPayment = null): \Illuminate\Support\Collection
    {
        $startStr = $start->toDateString();
        $endStr = $end->toDateString();
        $data = collect();

        // Normalização dos Arrays
        $typeArray = !empty($filterType) ? (is_array($filterType) ? $filterType : [$filterType]) : [];
        $paymentArray = !empty($filterPayment) ? (is_array($filterPayment) ? $filterPayment : [$filterPayment]) : [];

        // ==========================================
        // 🚀 O TRADUTOR DE PAGAMENTOS
        // ==========================================
        $hasNullPayment = in_array('null_payment', $paymentArray);
        $cleanPaymentIds = array_filter(array_diff($paymentArray, ['null_payment']));

        $v3PaymentNames = [];
        $legacyPaymentIds = [];

        if (!empty($cleanPaymentIds)) {
            // Pega o nome real do pagamento para procurar nas colunas varchar da V3
            $v3PaymentNames = DB::table('payment_methods')
                ->whereIn('id', $cleanPaymentIds)
                ->pluck('name')
                ->toArray();

            // Pega o ID antigo mapeado para filtrar no histórico V1/V2
            $legacyPaymentIds = DB::table('legacy_payment_methods')
                ->whereIn('current_payment_method_id', $cleanPaymentIds)
                ->pluck('id')
                ->toArray();
        }

        // Array híbrido para a V3 (Busca pelo ID em string ou pelo Nome real)
        $v3SearchTerms = array_merge($cleanPaymentIds, $v3PaymentNames);


        // ==========================================
        // DADOS V3
        // ==========================================
        $v3 = DB::table('orders')
            ->where(function($query) {
                $query->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'canceled', 'rejected', 'pending'])
                      ->orWhereNull('status');
            })
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$start, $end]);

        // Filtro de Tipo V3
        if (!empty($typeArray)) {
            $v3->where(function($query) use ($typeArray) {
                if (in_array('null_type', $typeArray)) {
                    $cleanTypes = array_diff($typeArray, ['null_type']);
                    $query->whereNull('type');
                    if (!empty($cleanTypes)) $query->orWhereIn('type', $cleanTypes);
                } else {
                    $query->whereIn('type', $typeArray);
                }
            });
        }

        // Filtro de Pagamento V3
        if (!empty($paymentArray)) {
            $v3->where(function($query) use ($hasNullPayment, $v3SearchTerms) {
                if ($hasNullPayment) {
                    $query->whereNotExists(function ($q) {
                        $q->select(DB::raw(1))->from('order_payments')->whereRaw('order_payments.order_id = orders.id');
                    })->whereNotExists(function ($q) {
                        $q->select(DB::raw(1))->from('payments')->whereRaw('payments.order_id = orders.id');
                    });
                }

                if (!empty($v3SearchTerms)) {
                    // Cobre as duas tabelas de pagamento possíveis na V3
                    $query->orWhereExists(function ($q) use ($v3SearchTerms) {
                        $q->select(DB::raw(1))
                          ->from('order_payments')
                          ->whereRaw('order_payments.order_id = orders.id')
                          ->whereIn('order_payments.payment_method', $v3SearchTerms);
                    })->orWhereExists(function ($q) use ($v3SearchTerms) {
                        $q->select(DB::raw(1))
                          ->from('payments')
                          ->whereRaw('payments.order_id = orders.id')
                          ->whereIn('payments.method', $v3SearchTerms);
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        $v3Data = $v3->selectRaw("DATE(created_at) as raw_date, type as order_type, SUM(total) as revenue, COUNT(id) as order_count")
                     ->groupBy('raw_date', 'order_type')->get();
        $data = $data->merge($v3Data);


        // ==========================================
        // DADOS V1 e V2 (Histórico)
        // ==========================================
        $v1 = DB::table('legacy_orders')
            ->where(function($query) {
                $query->whereNotIn('status', ['canceled', 'cancelled', 'rejected'])
                      ->orWhereNull('status');
            })
            ->whereBetween('issue_date', [$start, $end]);

        // Filtro de Tipo Legado
        if (!empty($typeArray)) {
            $v1->where(function($query) use ($typeArray) {
                if (in_array('null_type', $typeArray)) {
                    $cleanTypes = array_diff($typeArray, ['null_type']);
                    $query->whereNull('order_type');
                    if (!empty($cleanTypes)) $query->orWhereIn('order_type', $cleanTypes);
                } else {
                    $query->whereIn('order_type', $typeArray);
                }
            });
        }

        // Filtro de Pagamento Legado
        if (!empty($paymentArray)) {
            $v1->where(function($query) use ($hasNullPayment, $legacyPaymentIds) {
                if ($hasNullPayment) {
                    $query->whereNotExists(function ($q) {
                        $q->select(DB::raw(1))
                          ->from('legacy_order_payments')
                          ->whereRaw('legacy_order_payments.legacy_order_id = legacy_orders.id');
                    });
                }

                if (!empty($legacyPaymentIds)) {
                    $query->orWhereExists(function ($q) use ($legacyPaymentIds) {
                        $q->select(DB::raw(1))
                          ->from('legacy_order_payments')
                          ->whereRaw('legacy_order_payments.legacy_order_id = legacy_orders.id')
                          ->whereIn('legacy_order_payments.legacy_payment_method_id', $legacyPaymentIds);
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        $v1Data = $v1->selectRaw("DATE(issue_date) as raw_date, order_type, SUM(total_value) as revenue, COUNT(id) as order_count")
                     ->groupBy('raw_date', 'order_type')->get();
        $data = $data->merge($v1Data);


        // ==========================================
        // DADOS V0 (Legado Consolidado Diário)
        // ==========================================
        if ((empty($typeArray) || in_array('null_type', $typeArray)) && (empty($paymentArray) || in_array('null_payment', $paymentArray))) {
            $v0 = DB::table('legacy_daily_revenues')
                ->whereBetween('date', [$startStr, $endStr])
                ->selectRaw("date as raw_date, 'Consolidado' as order_type, total_revenue as revenue, IFNULL(order_count, 0) as order_count")
                ->get();
            $data = $data->merge($v0);
        }

        return $data;
    }

    /**
     * Limpa as Datas e Classifica os Tipos de Venda
     */
    private static function applyStratification(\Illuminate\Support\Collection $data, string $stratifyBy): \Illuminate\Support\Collection
    {
        return $data->map(function ($item) use ($stratifyBy) {
            $item->raw_date = Carbon::parse($item->raw_date)->format('Y-m-d');

            if ($stratifyBy === 'type') {
                $t = strtolower($item->order_type ?? '');

                $item->strat_key = match (true) {
                    $t === '' || $t === 'null' => 'Sem Tipo Mapeado 🪹',
                    str_contains($t, 'delivery') => 'Delivery',
                    str_contains($t, 'table') || str_contains($t, 'mesa') => 'Mesa',
                    str_contains($t, 'counter') || str_contains($t, 'balcao') || str_contains($t, 'balcão') => 'Balcão',
                    $t === 'consolidado' => 'Legado S/ Tipo',
                    default => 'Outros',
                };
            } else {
                $item->strat_key = 'Geral';
            }
            return $item;
        });
    }

    /**
         * Agrupamento para Série Simples
         */
        private static function groupData(\Illuminate\Support\Collection $rawData, string $groupBy, Carbon $start, Carbon $end): array
        {
            // 🚀 O 'o-W' é o padrão ISO perfeito para não bugar a virada de ano em Semanas!
            $format = match ($groupBy) {
                'year' => 'Y',
                'month' => 'Y-m',
                'week' => 'o-W',
                default => 'Y-m-d',
            };

            $grouped = $rawData->groupBy(function ($item) use ($format) {
                return Carbon::parse($item->raw_date)->format($format);
            })->map(function ($group) {
                return [
                    'revenue' => $group->sum('revenue'),
                    'order_count' => $group->sum('order_count')
                ];
            })->toArray();

            $series = [];

            // 🚀 PREENCHEDOR DE BURACOS (Gaps): Garante que a linha do tempo seja contínua
            $period = match ($groupBy) {
                'year' => CarbonPeriod::create($start->copy()->startOfYear(), '1 year', $end->copy()->startOfYear()),
                'month' => CarbonPeriod::create($start->copy()->startOfMonth(), '1 month', $end->copy()->startOfMonth()),
                'week' => CarbonPeriod::create($start->copy()->startOfWeek(), '1 week', $end->copy()->startOfWeek()),
                default => CarbonPeriod::create($start, '1 day', $end),
            };

            foreach ($period as $date) {
                $key = $date->format($format);
                $series[$key] = $grouped[$key] ?? ['revenue' => 0, 'order_count' => 0];
            }

            return $series;
        }

        /**
         * Agrupamento para Série Estratificada (Barras Empilhadas)
         */
        private static function groupStratifiedData(\Illuminate\Support\Collection $rawData, string $groupBy, Carbon $start, Carbon $end): array
        {
            $format = match ($groupBy) {
                'year' => 'Y',
                'month' => 'Y-m',
                'week' => 'o-W',
                default => 'Y-m-d',
            };

            $periodKeys = [];
            $period = match ($groupBy) {
                'year' => CarbonPeriod::create($start->copy()->startOfYear(), '1 year', $end->copy()->startOfYear()),
                'month' => CarbonPeriod::create($start->copy()->startOfMonth(), '1 month', $end->copy()->startOfMonth()),
                'week' => CarbonPeriod::create($start->copy()->startOfWeek(), '1 week', $end->copy()->startOfWeek()),
                default => CarbonPeriod::create($start, '1 day', $end),
            };

            foreach ($period as $date) {
                $periodKeys[$date->format($format)] = 0;
            }

            $series = [];
            $groupedByKey = $rawData->groupBy('strat_key');

            foreach ($groupedByKey as $stratKey => $items) {
                $timeValues = $periodKeys; // Começa com todas as datas preenchidas com 0
                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $k = Carbon::parse($item->raw_date)->format($format);
                    if (isset($timeValues[$k])) {
                        $timeValues[$k] += $item->revenue;
                    }
                }
                $series[$stratKey] = array_values($timeValues); // Chart.js exige array puro
            }

            return $series;
        }

    private static function calculateDelta($current, $previous): float
    {
        if ($previous == 0) return $current > 0 ? 100 : 0;
        return (($current - $previous) / $previous) * 100;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Analytics;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class BillingService
{
    /**
     * Retorna o faturamento diário reagindo aos filtros avançados.
     */
    public static function getConsolidatedDailyRevenue(array $filters = [])
    {
        $startDate = $filters['startDate'] ?? Carbon::now()->subDays(30)->toDateString();
        $endDate = $filters['endDate'] ?? Carbon::now()->toDateString();

        $orderTypes = $filters['order_types'] ?? [];
        $paymentMethods = $filters['payment_methods'] ?? [];

        // Se houver filtros avançados, a V0 (consolidação pura) não consegue responder
        $hasAdvancedFilters = !empty($orderTypes) || !empty($paymentMethods);

        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. BASE V3 (A atual e mais rica)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        $queryV3 = DB::table('orders as v3')
            ->selectRaw("DATE(v3.created_at) as report_date, SUM(v3.total) as total_revenue, COUNT(v3.id) as total_orders, 'v3' as source")
            ->whereIn('v3.status', ['closed', 'paid', 'completed'])
            ->whereBetween('v3.created_at', [$startDate . ' 00:00:00', $endDate . ' 23:59:59']);

        if (!empty($orderTypes)) {
            $queryV3->whereIn('v3.type', $orderTypes); // Assumindo 'type' ou 'order_type' na sua base
        }

        if (!empty($paymentMethods)) {
            $queryV3->whereExists(function ($q) use ($paymentMethods) {
                $q->select(DB::raw(1))
                  ->from('payments') // Tabela de pagamentos da V3
                  ->whereColumn('payments.order_id', 'v3.id')
                  ->whereIn('payments.payment_method_id', $paymentMethods);
            });
        }
        $queryV3->groupByRaw("DATE(v3.created_at)");

        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. BASE V1 (O Legado Rico - Esmagada pela V3 em caso de conflito)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        $queryV1 = DB::table('legacy_orders as v1')
            ->selectRaw("DATE(v1.issue_date) as report_date, SUM(v1.total_value) as total_revenue, COUNT(v1.id) as total_orders, 'v1' as source")
            ->whereIn('v1.status', ['processed', 'completed', 'authorized'])
            ->whereBetween('v1.issue_date', [$startDate . ' 00:00:00', $endDate . ' 23:59:59'])
            ->whereNotExists(function ($query) {
                $query->select(DB::raw(1))
                    ->from('orders as v3')
                    ->whereRaw("DATE(v3.created_at) = DATE(v1.issue_date)");
            });

        if (!empty($orderTypes)) {
            $queryV1->whereIn('v1.order_type', $orderTypes);
        }

        if (!empty($paymentMethods)) {
            $queryV1->whereExists(function ($q) use ($paymentMethods) {
                $q->select(DB::raw(1))
                  ->from('legacy_order_payments as lop')
                  ->join('legacy_payment_methods as lpm', 'lop.legacy_payment_method_id', '=', 'lpm.id')
                  ->whereColumn('lop.legacy_order_id', 'v1.id')
                  ->whereIn('lpm.current_payment_method_id', $paymentMethods);
            });
        }
        $queryV1->groupByRaw("DATE(v1.issue_date)");

        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        // 3. BASE V0 (A Caderneta - Excluída se houver filtro avançado)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        $queryV0 = DB::table('legacy_daily_revenues as v0')
            ->selectRaw("DATE(v0.date) as report_date, SUM(v0.total_revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(v0.order_count) as total_orders, 'v0' as source")
            ->whereBetween('v0.date', [$startDate, $endDate])
            ->whereNotExists(function ($query) {
                $query->select(DB::raw(1))
                    ->from('orders as v3')
                    ->whereRaw("DATE(v3.created_at) = DATE(v0.date)");
            })
            ->whereNotExists(function ($query) {
                $query->select(DB::raw(1))
                    ->from('legacy_orders as v1')
                    ->whereRaw("DATE(v1.issue_date) = DATE(v0.date)");
            });

        // 🚀 A REGRA DE OURO DO BI:
        if ($hasAdvancedFilters) {
            $queryV0->whereRaw('1 = 0'); // Força a exclusão total da V0 na query
        }

        $queryV0->groupByRaw("DATE(v0.date)");

        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        // CONSOLIDAÇÃO FINAL
        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        return DB::query()
            ->fromSub($queryV3->unionAll($queryV1)->unionAll($queryV0), 'consolidated')
            ->orderBy('report_date', 'asc')
            ->get();
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Analytics/LegacyDataCapabilityService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Analytics;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use App\Models\LegacyDailyRevenue;
use App\Models\LegacyOrder;
use App\Models\Order;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class LegacyDataCapabilityService
{
    public static function analyze(): array
    {
        $tenantId = tenant('id') ?? 'global';

        // O cache garante que essa varredura profunda não pese a cada clique do usuário
        return Cache::remember("tenant_{$tenantId}_data_capabilities", 300, function () {

            $v0Min = LegacyDailyRevenue::min('date');
            $v0Max = LegacyDailyRevenue::max('date');

            $v1Min = LegacyOrder::min('issue_date');
            $v1Max = LegacyOrder::max('issue_date');

            $v3Min = Order::min('created_at');
            $v3Max = Order::max('created_at');

            // Fronteira do BI de Alta Fidelidade (Heatmap, etc)
            $detailedMinDates = array_filter([$v1Min, $v3Min]);
            $detailedStartDate = empty($detailedMinDates) ? null : min($detailedMinDates);

            // 🚀 Fronteiras Absolutas da Empresa (A primeira e a última venda de sempre)
            $allMinDates = array_filter([$v0Min, $v1Min, $v3Min]);
            $absoluteMinDate = empty($allMinDates) ? now()->toDateString() : Carbon::parse(min($allMinDates))->toDateString();

            $allMaxDates = array_filter([$v0Max, $v1Max, $v3Max]);
            $absoluteMaxDate = empty($allMaxDates) ? now()->toDateString() : Carbon::parse(max($allMaxDates))->toDateString();

            return [
                'has_v0' => !is_null($v0Min),
                'v0_start' => $v0Min ? Carbon::parse($v0Min) : null,
                'v0_end' => $v0Max ? Carbon::parse($v0Max) : null,

                'has_v1' => !is_null($v1Min),
                'v1_start' => $v1Min ? Carbon::parse($v1Min) : null,
                'v1_end' => $v1Max ? Carbon::parse($v1Max) : null,

                'has_detailed_data' => !is_null($detailedStartDate),
                'detailed_start_date' => $detailedStartDate ? Carbon::parse($detailedStartDate) : null,

                // Injetamos as fronteiras reais aqui!
                'absolute_min_date' => $absoluteMinDate,
                'absolute_max_date' => $absoluteMaxDate,
            ];
        });
    }

    public static function getDetailedCutoffMessage($filterStartDate): ?string
    {
        $capabilities = self::analyze();

        if (!$capabilities['has_detailed_data']) {
            return "O seu histórico atual contém apenas totais diários consolidados. Dados detalhados estarão disponíveis conforme você processa novos pedidos no sistema.";
        }

        $cutoffDate = $capabilities['detailed_start_date'];
        $filterDate = Carbon::parse($filterStartDate);

        if ($filterDate->lessThan($cutoffDate)) {
            return "Há dados detalhados para este gráfico somente a partir de " . $cutoffDate->format('d/m/Y') . ".";
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```php
use Exception;

class AuthService
{
    /**
     * Autentica no terminal via PIN comparando a hash Bcrypt dos operadores ativos
     */
    public function loginWithPin(string $pin): void
    {
        $activeStaff = User::where('is_active', true)
            ->whereNotNull('pin')
            ->whereHas('roles', function ($q) {
                $q->whereIn('name', ['admin', 'gerente', 'manager', 'caixa', 'garcom', 'pos', 'waiter', 'kitchen']);
            })
            ->get();

        $matchedUser = null;

        foreach ($activeStaff as $user) {
            $isHash = str_starts_with($user->pin, '$2y$') || str_starts_with($user->pin, '$2a$');

            if ($isHash ? Hash::check($pin, $user->pin) : ($user->pin === $pin)) {
                $matchedUser = $user;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!$matchedUser) {
            throw new Exception('PIN incorreto ou operador não autorizado para operar terminais.');
        }

        Auth::guard('team')->login($matchedUser, true);
        Auth::guard('web')->login($matchedUser, true);
    }

    public function loginWithEmail(string $email, string $password): void
    {
        $user = User::where('email', $email)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->whereNotNull('employee_id')
            ->first();

        if ($user && Hash::check($password, $user->password)) {
            Auth::guard('team')->login($user, true);
            Auth::guard('web')->login($user, true);
            return;
        }

        throw new Exception('Credenciais inválidas ou acesso não autorizado para a operação.');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Auth;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Crypt;
use App\Services\Customers\CustomerRegistrationService;
use Exception;

class GoogleAuthService
{
    /**
     * 🚀 Recebe o Token do Google, decodifica e delega a identidade para o Motor Universal de Clientes
     */
    public function processCustomerLogin(string $encryptedToken, ?int $guestId, CustomerRegistrationService $registrationService): array
    {
        $payload = $this->decodeAndValidateToken($encryptedToken);

        // Avalia o login sem persistência prematura
        $result = $registrationService->evaluateSocialLogin($payload, $guestId);

        // Só efetua login se o usuário já possuir cadastro completo com CPF
        if ($result['status'] === 'authenticated') {
            Auth::login($result['user'], true);
        }

        return [
            'status'    => $result['status'],
            'message'   => $result['message'],
            'return_to' => $payload['return_to'] ?? '/',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * 👔 Processa o login da equipe (B2B) validando os cargos
     */
    public function processTeamLogin(string $encryptedToken): array
    {
        $payload = $this->decodeAndValidateToken($encryptedToken);
        $user = User::where('email', $payload['email'])->first();

        if (!$user) {
            throw new Exception('Acesso negado. Usuário não registrado na equipe.');
        }

        if (!$user->is_active) {
            throw new Exception('Acesso negado. Colaborador inativo.');
        }

        $intent = $payload['intent'] ?? 'team';

        if ($intent === 'admin') {
            Auth::guard('web')->login($user, true);
            return ['guard' => 'web', 'redirect' => '/admin'];
        }

        if (!$user->hasAnyRole(['admin', 'gerente', 'manager', 'caixa', 'garcom', 'pos', 'waiter', 'motoboy', 'driver', 'kitchen'])) {
            throw new Exception('Acesso negado. Perfil de colaborador incorreto.');
        }

        // 🚀 Autentica tanto no guard padrão (web) quanto no team com lembrete ativo, espelhando o PinAuthController
        Auth::guard('web')->login($user, true);
        Auth::guard('team')->login($user, true);

        return ['guard' => 'web', 'redirect' => '/team'];
    }

    /**
     * 🔒 Decodifica a string gerada no Callback central e verifica validade
     */
    private function decodeAndValidateToken(string $encryptedToken): array
    {
        try {
            $payload = json_decode(Crypt::decryptString($encryptedToken), true);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            throw new Exception('Link de login inválido ou corrompido.');
        }

        if (now()->timestamp > $payload['expires_at']) {
            throw new Exception('O link de login expirou. Tente novamente.');
        }

        return $payload;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Auth;

use App\Models\Device;
use App\Events\DeviceQrAuthorized;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Exception;

class QrAuthService
{
    /**
     * Armazena a autorização e dispara o WebSocket para a máquina
     */
    public function authorizeTerminal(string $token, int $userId): void
    {
        Cache::put('qr_auth_' . $token, $userId, 120);
        event(new DeviceQrAuthorized($token, $userId));
        Log::info("✅ SUCESSO! Evento WebSocket disparado para a chave qr-auth.{$token}");
    }

    /**
     * Valida o dispositivo e consome o token do cache
     */
    public function exchangeToken(string $deviceUuid, string $token): ?int
    {
        $device = Device::where('device_uuid', $deviceUuid)->where('is_active', true)->first();

        if (!$device) {
            Log::warning("⚠️ Polling QR: Dispositivo {$deviceUuid} não homologado.");
            throw new Exception('Dispositivo não autorizado.', 403);
        }

        return Cache::pull('qr_auth_' . $token);
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se a máquina é confiável
     */
    public function validateAndTouchDevice(string $deviceUuid): Device
    {
        $device = Device::where('device_uuid', $deviceUuid)->where('is_active', true)->first();

        if (!$device) {
            throw new Exception('Máquina não autorizada.', 404);
        }

        $device->update(['last_active_at' => now()]);

        return $device;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Auth;

use App\Models\Device;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Events\DeviceRemoteUnlocked;
use App\Events\DeviceRemoteLocked;
use App\Notifications\DeviceWaitingNotification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Exception;

class RemoteUnlockService
{
    /**
     * Retorna a "Frota" de hardware do restaurante e verifica quem está pedindo acesso.
     */
    public function getDeviceFleet()
    {
        $devices = Device::where('is_active', true)->get();

        return $devices->map(function ($device) {
            $isWaiting = Cache::has("device_waiting_{$device->device_uuid}");
            $operator = Cache::get("device_operator_{$device->device_uuid}");

            $status = 'locked';
            if ($operator && !$isWaiting) {
                $status = 'operating';
            }

            return [
                'id'         => $device->id,
                'uuid'       => $device->device_uuid,
                'name'       => $device->name,
                'type'       => $device->type,
                'is_waiting' => $isWaiting,
                'status'     => $status,
                'operator'   => $operator, // Retorna ['name' => 'Kauê', 'role' => 'Gerente'] ou null
            ];
        });
    }

    /**
     * O Terminal avisa que foi ligado e está aguardando liberação.
     */
    public function setDeviceWaiting(string $deviceUuid): void
    {
        $device = Device::where('device_uuid', $deviceUuid)->first();

        if ($device) {
            Cache::put("device_waiting_{$deviceUuid}", true, now()->addMinutes(10));

            $managers = User::whereHas('roles', function ($q) {
                $q->whereIn('name', ['admin', 'gerente', 'manager']);
            })->get();

            if ($managers->isNotEmpty()) {
                Notification::send(
                    $managers,
                    new DeviceWaitingNotification($device->name, $device->type)
                );
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * O Usuário (Gestor ou Operador) aciona a autorização remota.
     */
    public function approveUnlock(User $authorizer, string $deviceUuid): void
    {
        $device = Device::where('device_uuid', $deviceUuid)->firstOrFail();

        $token = Str::random(40);

        Cache::put("device_unlock_{$token}", $authorizer->id, now()->addMinutes(1));
        Cache::forget("device_waiting_{$deviceUuid}");

        $roleName = 'Operador';
        if (method_exists($authorizer, 'roles') && $authorizer->roles->isNotEmpty()) {
            $roleName = ucfirst($authorizer->roles->first()->name);
        } elseif (isset($authorizer->role)) {
            $roleName = ucfirst($authorizer->role);
        }

        Cache::put("device_operator_{$deviceUuid}", [
            'name' => $authorizer->name,
            'role' => $roleName,
        ], now()->addHours(12));

        // Roteamento pós-login respeitando o hardware físico (KDS ou PDV Caixa)
        $redirectUrl = $device->type === 'kds'
            ? route('kds.index')
            : route('pos.index', ['tab' => 'pos']);

        broadcast(new DeviceRemoteUnlocked($deviceUuid, $token, $redirectUrl));
    }

    /**
     * Interrompe ativamente a sessão do terminal e fecha a tela via WebSocket.
     */
    public function lockDevice(string $deviceUuid): void
    {
        Cache::forget("device_operator_{$deviceUuid}");

        broadcast(new DeviceRemoteLocked($deviceUuid));
    }

    /**
     * O Terminal recebe o token temporário via WebSocket e troca pelo ID do usuário.
     */
    public function exchangeToken(string $token): int
    {
        $userId = Cache::pull("device_unlock_{$token}");

        if (!$userId) {
            throw new Exception('Token inválido ou expirado. Peça ao gestor para autorizar novamente.');
        }

        return (int) $userId;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Auth;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use PragmaRX\Google2FA\Google2FA;

class TwoFactorService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected Google2FA $google2fa
    ) {}

    /**
     * Gera os dados necessários para o primeiro acesso (QR Code e Segredo).
     */
    public function getSetupData(User $user): array
    {
        // Gera um segredo único e guarda temporariamente na sessão
        $secret = $this->google2fa->generateSecretKey();
        session(['temp_2fa_secret' => $secret]);

        $companyName = CompanySetting::getCached()?->totp_issuer_name ?? 'Brasume ERP';

        // Retorna a URL no formato "otpauth://totp/..."
        $qrCodeUrl = $this->google2fa->getQRCodeUrl($companyName, $user->email, $secret);

        return [
            'secret' => $secret,
            'qrCodeUrl' => $qrCodeUrl
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Valida o código numérico e, se for a primeira vez, salva o segredo no utilizador.
     */
    public function verifyAndSave(User $user, string $code): bool
    {
        // Recupera o segredo definitivo da base de dados ou o temporário do setup
        $secret = $user->two_factor_secret ?? session('temp_2fa_secret');

        if (!$secret) {
            return false;
        }

        // Valida o código informado contra o relógio do servidor
        $isValid = $this->google2fa->verifyKey($secret, $code);

        if ($isValid) {
            // Se passou na validação e era a primeira vez, oficializa o segredo
            if (empty($user->two_factor_secret)) {
                $user->update([
                    'two_factor_secret' => $secret,
                    'two_factor_confirmed_at' => now()
                ]);
                session()->forget('temp_2fa_secret');
            }

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Auth;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Customer;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Exception;

class WhatsAppAuthService
{
    /**
     * Gera o OTP e simula o envio via WhatsApp (Cache)
     */
    public function sendOtp(string $phone): void
    {
        $cleanPhone = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $phone);
        $code = (string) rand(100000, 999999);

        Cache::put("whatsapp_otp_{$cleanPhone}", $code, now()->addMinutes(5));

        // Aqui entra a sua API do WhatsApp (Z-API, Evolution, etc.)
        Log::info("🔑 TOKEN OTP GERADO PARA {$cleanPhone}: {$code}");
    }

    /**
     * Valida o OTP, cria/atualiza o cliente e retorna a instância de User
     */
    public function verifyOtpAndAuthenticate(string $phone, string $code, ?array $socialData = null): User
    {
        $cleanPhone = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $phone);
        $cachedCode = Cache::get("whatsapp_otp_{$cleanPhone}");

        if (!$cachedCode || $cachedCode !== $code) {
            throw new Exception('Código de verificação inválido ou expirado.');
        }

        Cache::forget("whatsapp_otp_{$cleanPhone}");

        $customer = Customer::where('phone', $cleanPhone)->first();

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($customer, $cleanPhone, $socialData) {
            if ($customer && $customer->user_id) {
                return $customer->user;
            }

            $email = $socialData['email'] ?? "{$cleanPhone}@pastelarianativa.com.br";
            $name = $socialData['name'] ?? ($customer->name ?? 'Cliente Nativa');

            $user = User::create([
                'name' => $name,
                'email' => $email,
                'password' => bcrypt(Str::random(16)),
                'is_active' => true
            ]);

            if ($customer) {
                $customer->update(['user_id' => $user->id, 'email' => $email]);
            } else {
                Customer::create([
                    'user_id' => $user->id,
                    'name' => $name,
                    'phone' => $cleanPhone,
                    'email' => $email,
                    'is_active' => true
                ]);
            }

            return $user;
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\BankDictionaries;

class SicrediDictionary implements BankDictionaryInterface
{
    public function parseMemo(string $memo): array
    {
        $result = [
            "document" => null,
            "name" => null,
            "clean_description" => trim($memo),
            "movement_type" => "other", // 🚀 NOVA PROPRIEDADE PADRÃO
        ];

        $upperMemo = strtoupper($memo);

        // 1. Pix, Boletos, TEDs, Transferências
        if (
            preg_match(
                "/(?:PAGAMENTO PIX.*?|RECEBIMENTO PIX.*?|DEVOLUCAO PIX|LIQUIDACAO BOLETO.*?|DEBITO TED\/IB|TED|TRANSF ENTRE CONTAS|DEP DINHEIRO ATM).*?\s+([0-9]{11,14}|\*\*\*[0-9]{6}\*\*)\s+(.+)/i",
                $memo,
                $matches,
            )
        ) {
            $doc = trim($matches[1]);
            $result["document"] = str_contains($doc, "*") ? null : $doc;
            $result["name"] = trim($matches[2]);

            if (str_contains($upperMemo, "RECEBIMENTO PIX")) {
                $prefix = "Pix Recebido";
                $result["movement_type"] = "pix_in";
            } elseif (str_contains($upperMemo, "DEVOLUCAO PIX")) {
                $prefix = "Estorno de Pix";
                $result["movement_type"] = "pix_out";
            } elseif (str_contains($upperMemo, "LIQUIDACAO BOLETO")) {
                $prefix = "Boleto Pago";
                $result["movement_type"] = "boleto_out";
            } elseif (
                str_contains($upperMemo, "TED") ||
                str_contains($upperMemo, "TRANSF")
            ) {
                $prefix = "Transferência";
                $result["movement_type"] = "transfer";
            } elseif (str_contains($upperMemo, "DEP DINHEIRO")) {
                $prefix = "Depósito ATM";
                $result["movement_type"] = "atm_in";
            } else {
                $prefix = "Pix Pago";
                $result["movement_type"] = "pix_out";
            }
            $result["clean_description"] = $result["name"]; // 🚀 Limpamos o prefixo do nome para a tabela ficar bonita!
        }
        // 2. Maquininha de Cartão
        elseif (
            preg_match(
                "/SICREDI (DEBITO|CREDITO|ANTECIPACAO|ANTEC) (VISA|MASTER|ELO|AMEX)/i",
                $memo,
                $matches,
            )
        ) {
            $result["name"] =
                "Repasse " .
                ucfirst(strtolower($matches[1])) .
                " " .
                $matches[2];
            $result["clean_description"] = $result["name"];
            $result["movement_type"] = "card_in";
        }
        // 3. Maquininha Física
        elseif (str_starts_with($upperMemo, "REEMBOLSO POS SICREDI")) {
            $result["name"] = "Banco Sicredi";
            $result["clean_description"] = "Reembolso Maquininha POS";
            $result["movement_type"] = "card_in";
        }
        // 4. Contas Fixas
        elseif (
            preg_match(
                "/DEBITO CONVENIOS-(.*?)\s+(?:ID.*?)?(?:([0-9]{11,14}))/i",
                $memo,
                $matches,
            )
        ) {
            $result["name"] = trim($matches[1]);
            $result["document"] = isset($matches[2]) ? $matches[2] : null;
            $result["clean_description"] =
                "Convênio / Fatura - " . $result["name"];
            $result["movement_type"] = "fixed_bill";
        }
        // 5. Arrecadação de Impostos
        elseif (str_starts_with($upperMemo, "DEBITO ARRECADACAO")) {
            if (preg_match("/([0-9]{14})/", $memo, $matches)) {
                $result["document"] = $matches[1];
            }
            $result["name"] = "Receita Federal / Impostos";
            $result["clean_description"] = "Imposto (DARF/DAS/GPS)";
            $result["movement_type"] = "tax_bill";
        }
        // 6. Saque Físico
        elseif (str_starts_with($upperMemo, "SAQUE DINHEIRO ATM")) {
            $result["clean_description"] = "Saque em Dinheiro (ATM)";
            $result["movement_type"] = "atm_out";
        }
        // 7. Folha de Pagamento em Lote
        elseif (str_starts_with($upperMemo, "DEB. FOLHA PAGTO")) {
            $result["clean_description"] = "Folha de Pagamento (Lote)";
            $result["movement_type"] = "payroll";
        }
        // 8. Taxas e Juros do Banco
        elseif (
            str_starts_with($upperMemo, "CESTA DE RELACIONAMENTO") ||
            str_starts_with($upperMemo, "PLANO INT CAPITAL") ||
            str_starts_with($upperMemo, "IOF") ||
            str_starts_with($upperMemo, "JUROS UTILIZ")
        ) {
            $result["name"] = "Banco Sicredi";
            $result["clean_description"] = str_contains($upperMemo, "CESTA")
                ? "Tarifa Bancária (Cesta)"
                : "Juros e Encargos";
            $result["movement_type"] = "bank_fee";
        }

        $result["clean_description"] = preg_replace(
            "/\s+/",
            " ",
            $result["clean_description"],
        );
        return $result;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Catalog/AvailabilityService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Catalog;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\TechnicalSheet;
use App\Models\ModifierOption;
use App\Models\ShoppingListItem;
use App\Events\CatalogUpdated;
use App\Events\StockLowDetected;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class AvailabilityService
{
    public function __construct(protected InventoryService $inventoryService) {}

    public function updateAvailability(int $productId, string $action, ?float $newStock = null): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($productId, $action, $newStock) {
            $product = Product::findOrFail($productId);
            $visitedIds = [];

            if ($action === 'out_of_stock') {
                $product->update(['status' => 'out_of_stock']);

                if ($product->track_inventory) {
                    $product->update(['current_stock' => 0]);
                    event(new StockLowDetected($product, 'critical'));
                }

                // Desativa adicionais vinculados a este insumo
                ModifierOption::where('linked_product_id', $product->id)->update(['is_active' => false]);

                // Cascateia indisponibilidade para pratos que usam este insumo
                $this->cascadeDisable($product->id, $visitedIds);

            } elseif ($action === 'paused') {
                $product->update(['status' => 'paused']);

                // Pausa gerencial também desativa modificadores e pratos dependentes
                ModifierOption::where('linked_product_id', $product->id)->update(['is_active' => false]);
                $this->cascadeDisable($product->id, $visitedIds);

            } elseif ($action === 'archived') {
                $product->update(['status' => 'archived']);

                ModifierOption::where('linked_product_id', $product->id)->update(['is_active' => false]);
                $this->cascadeDisable($product->id, $visitedIds);

            } elseif ($action === 'available') {
                $updates = ['status' => 'available'];

                if ($product->track_inventory && !is_null($newStock)) {
                    $updates['current_stock'] = $newStock;

                    ShoppingListItem::where('product_id', $product->id)
                        ->whereIn('status', ['pending', 'ordered'])
                        ->update(['status' => 'received']);
                }

                $product->update($updates);

                // Reativa modificadores vinculados
                ModifierOption::where('linked_product_id', $product->id)->update(['is_active' => true]);

                // Reavalia pratos dependentes na ficha técnica
                $this->cascadeEnable($product->id, $visitedIds);
            }
        });

        Cache::tags(['catalog'])->flush();

        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') && tenant('id') ? tenant('id') : 'central';
        broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenant));
    }

    public function toggleProductStatus(int $productId, string $newStatus): void
    {
        $action = match ($newStatus) {
            'out_of_stock', 'unavailable' => 'out_of_stock',
            'paused'                      => 'paused',
            'archived'                    => 'archived',
            default                       => 'available'
        };

        $this->updateAvailability($productId, $action);
    }

    private function cascadeDisable(int $ingredientId, array &$visitedIds): void
    {
        if (in_array($ingredientId, $visitedIds)) return;
        $visitedIds[] = $ingredientId;

        $parentIds = TechnicalSheet::where('ingredient_product_id', $ingredientId)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->pluck('parent_product_id')
            ->unique();

        if ($parentIds->isNotEmpty()) {
            Product::whereIn('id', $parentIds)
                ->where('status', '!=', 'paused')
                ->where('status', '!=', 'archived')
                ->update(['status' => 'out_of_stock']);

            foreach ($parentIds as $parentId) {
                $this->cascadeDisable($parentId, $visitedIds);
            }
        }
    }

    private function cascadeEnable(int $ingredientId, array &$visitedIds): void
    {
        if (in_array($ingredientId, $visitedIds)) return;
        $visitedIds[] = $ingredientId;

        $parentIds = TechnicalSheet::where('ingredient_product_id', $ingredientId)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->pluck('parent_product_id')
            ->unique();

        foreach ($parentIds as $parentId) {
            $parentProduct = Product::find($parentId);
            if (!$parentProduct) continue;

            $hasMissingIngredients = TechnicalSheet::where('parent_product_id', $parentId)->where('is_active', true)
                ->whereHas('ingredient', function ($query) {
                    $query->whereIn('status', ['out_of_stock', 'unavailable', 'paused', 'archived']);
                })
                ->exists();

            $isPhysicallyBlocked = $parentProduct->track_inventory && (float) $parentProduct->current_stock <= 0;
            $isManuallyBlocked = in_array($parentProduct->status, ['paused', 'archived'], true);

            if (!$hasMissingIngredients && !$isPhysicallyBlocked && !$isManuallyBlocked) {
                $parentProduct->update(['status' => 'available']);
                $this->cascadeEnable($parentId, $visitedIds);
            }
        }
    }

    public function registerLoss(array $data, int $userId): void
    {
        $product = Product::findOrFail($data['target_id']);

        $this->inventoryService->registerLoss(
            $product,
            (float) $data['quantity'],
            'Salão/Bar: ' . ($data['reason'] ?? 'Desperdício informado'),
            'Registrado via Módulo Operacional.',
            $userId
        );
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Catalog;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Category;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class CustomerCatalogService
{
    public function getCatalog(): array
    {
        return Cache::tags(['catalog'])->remember('customer_catalog_data', 86400, function () {

            $categories = Category::where("type", "external")
                ->where("is_active", 1)
                ->orderBy("sort_order")
                // 🚀 slug adicionado ao select das categorias
                ->select("id", "name", "slug", "image_path", "parent_id", "sort_order")
                ->get()
                ->map(function ($category) {
                    $category->image_url = $category->image_path ? url("/media/file?path=" . $category->image_path) : null;
                    return $category;
                });

            $validCategoryIds = $categories->pluck("id")->toArray();

            // OTIMIZAÇÃO: Cache de produtos para evitar N+1
            $categoryProductsCache = Product::whereNotNull('category_id')
                ->whereIn("type", ["dish", "resale", "manufactured"])
                ->whereIn("status", ["available", "out_of_stock", "paused", "active"])
                ->where("show_on_delivery", true)
                ->get()
                ->groupBy('category_id');

            $products = Product::with(["modifiers.options", "comboGroups.items.product"])
                ->whereIn("category_id", $validCategoryIds)
                ->whereIn("type", ["dish", "resale", "combo", "manufactured"])
                ->whereIn("status", ["available", "out_of_stock", "paused", "active"])
                ->where("show_on_delivery", true)
                ->get()
                ->map(function ($product) use ($categoryProductsCache) {
                    return $this->formatProductForCustomer($product, $categoryProductsCache);
                })->values();

            return [
                "categories" => $categories,
                "products" => $products,
            ];
        });
    }

    private function formatProductForCustomer(Product $product, $categoryProductsCache): array
    {
        $basePrice = $product->delivery_price > 0 ? $product->delivery_price : $product->dine_in_price;
        $finalPrice = $product->promo_price > 0 ? $product->promo_price : $basePrice;

        return [
            "id" => $product->id,
            "category_id" => $product->category_id,
            "name" => $product->name,
            // 🚀 slug adicionado ao payload do produto
            "slug" => $product->slug,
            "description" => $product->description,
            "type" => $product->type,
            "status" => $product->status,
            "price" => (float) $finalPrice,
            "image" => $product->image_path ? url("/media/file?path=" . $product->image_path) : null,

            "modifiers" => $product->modifiers->map(function ($group) use ($product, $finalPrice) {
                $excluded = json_decode($group->pivot->excluded_options ?? '[]', true) ?? [];

                return [
                    "id" => $group->id,
                    "name" => $group->display_name ?? $group->name,
                    "type" => $group->type,
                    "status" => $group->status,
                    "loyalty_reward" => (bool) $product->loyalty_reward,
                    "loyalty_points_cost" => (int) $product->loyalty_points_cost,
                    "price" => (float) $finalPrice,
                    "pricing_strategy" => $group->pricing_strategy,
                    "display_order_strategy" => $group->display_order_strategy,
                    "min_selections" => $group->min_selections,
                    "max_selections" => $group->max_selections,
                    "max_free" => $group->max_free,
                    "increment" => $group->increment,
                    "allow_quantity" => $group->allow_quantity,
                    "options" => $group->options
                        ->filter(fn($opt) => !in_array($opt->id, $excluded))
                        ->map(fn($opt) => [
                            "id" => $opt->id,
                            "name" => $opt->name,
                            "price" => (float) $opt->price,
                            "sort_order" => $opt->sort_order ?? 0,
                                            "is_active" => (bool) ($opt->is_active ?? true),
                                            "is_active" => (bool) ($opt->is_active ?? true),
                                            "is_active" => (bool) ($opt->is_active ?? true),
                        ])->values(),
                ];
            }),
            "combo_groups" => $product->comboGroups->map(function ($group) use ($categoryProductsCache) {
                return [
                    "id" => $group->id,
                    "name" => $group->name,
                    "min_choices" => $group->min_choices,
                    "max_choices" => $group->max_choices,
                    "items" => $group->items->flatMap(function ($item) use ($categoryProductsCache) {
                        if ($item->category_id) {
                            $categoryProducts = $categoryProductsCache->get($item->category_id, collect());

                            return $categoryProducts->map(fn($catProduct) => [
                                "id" => "cat_" . $item->id . "_prod_" . $catProduct->id,
                                "product_id" => $catProduct->id,
                                "category_id" => $item->category_id,
                                "product_name" => $catProduct->name,
                                "additional_price" => (float) $item->additional_price,
                            ]);
                        }
                        return [[
                            "id" => (string) $item->id,
                            "product_id" => $item->product_id,
                            "category_id" => null,
                            "product_name" => $item->product->name ?? "Item Desconhecido",
                            "additional_price" => (float) $item->additional_price,
                        ]];
                    })->values(),
                ];
            }),
        ];
    }
}
```
