## File: app/Services/Catalog/InventoryService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Catalog;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\TechnicalSheet;
use App\Models\InventoryLoss;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\ModifierOption;
use App\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Events\StockLowDetected;
use App\Events\CatalogUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class InventoryService
{
    private function deductFromStorageLocations(Product $product, float $qty): void
    {
        // Contorna a ausência da função FIELD() no SQLite verificando o driver
        $isSqlite = DB::connection()->getDriverName() === 'sqlite';

        $locations = $product->storageLocations()
            ->when(!$isSqlite, function ($query) {
                // Ordenação original no MySQL
                return $query->orderByRaw("FIELD(type, 'display', 'intermediate', 'storage')");
            })
            ->when($isSqlite, function ($query) {
                // Ordenação simplificada para SQLite (baseada no sort_order, por exemplo)
                return $query->orderBy('sort_order');
            })
            ->get();

        foreach ($locations as $location) {
            if ($qty <= 0) break;

            $stock = (float) $location->pivot->current_stock;
            if ($stock > 0) {
                $take = min($stock, $qty);
                $product->storageLocations()->updateExistingPivot($location->id, [
                    'current_stock' => $stock - $take
                ]);
                $qty -= $take;
            }
        }
    }

    private function addToStorageLocations(Product $product, float $qtyToAdd): void
    {
        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Evita a query de verificação caso não tenha localizações
        if (!$product->relationLoaded('storageLocations') && DB::table('product_storage_location')->where('product_id', $product->id)->count() === 0) {
            return;
        }

        $locations = $product->storageLocations()
            ->orderByRaw("FIELD(type, 'storage', 'intermediate', 'display')")
            ->get();

        if ($locations->isEmpty()) return;

        $targetLoc = $locations->first();
        $currentLocal = (float) $targetLoc->pivot->current_stock;
        $product->storageLocations()->updateExistingPivot($targetLoc->id, [
            'current_stock' => $currentLocal + $qtyToAdd
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Registra o movimento imutável no Livro-Razão Kardex
     */
    public function logMovement(
        Product $product,
        string $type,
        float $quantity,
        float $newBalance,
        string $description,
        $originModel = null,
        ?int $locationId = null
    ): void {
        DB::table('inventory_movements')->insert([
            'product_id'          => $product->id,
            'storage_location_id' => $locationId,
            'type'                => $type,
            'quantity'            => $quantity,
            'balance_after'       => $newBalance,
            'unit_cost'           => (float) ($product->base_cost ?? 0),
            'origin_type'         => $originModel ? get_class($originModel) : null,
            'origin_id'           => $originModel ? $originModel->id : null,
            'description'         => $description,
            'user_id'             => auth()->id(),
            'created_at'          => now(),
            'updated_at'          => now(),
        ]);
    }

    public function addStock(Product $product, float $quantity, string $origin = 'compra', $originModel = null): void
    {
        if ($quantity <= 0) return;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $quantity, $origin, $originModel) {
            $wasOutOfStock = $product->status === 'out_of_stock' || (float) $product->current_stock <= 0;
            $newStock = (float) $product->current_stock + $quantity;

            $this->logMovement($product, 'in', $quantity, $newStock, "Entrada via {$origin}", $originModel);

            $product->update(['current_stock' => $newStock]);
            $this->addToStorageLocations($product, $quantity);

            if ($wasOutOfStock && $newStock > 0 && $product->status !== 'paused' && $product->status !== 'archived') {
                $this->triggerStockRestored($product);
            } else {
                $tenantId = tenant('id') ?? 'central';
                broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenantId));
            }
        });
    }

    public function deductStock(Product $product, float $qtySold, $originModel = null, ?string $description = null): void
    {
        if ($product->track_inventory) {
            $newStock = (float) $product->current_stock - $qtySold;
            $movementDesc = $description ?? "Saída operacional";

            $this->logMovement($product, 'out', -$qtySold, $newStock, $movementDesc, $originModel);

            // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Atualização em massa em vez de requerer transações extras
            $product->updateQuietly(['current_stock' => $newStock]);
            $this->deductFromStorageLocations($product, $qtySold);

            if ($qtySold > 0) {
                // Removemos o fresh() que gerava mais uma query N+1; passamos os novos dados pelo objecto
                $product->current_stock = $newStock;
                $this->checkThresholds($product);
            }

            if ($newStock <= 0 && $product->status === 'available') {
                $this->triggerStockRupture($product);
            }
        }

        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Eager loading de 'ingredient' evita dezenas de queries find() na tabela de produtos
        $sheets = TechnicalSheet::with('ingredient')
            ->where('parent_product_id', $product->id)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->get();

        if ($sheets->isEmpty()) return;

        foreach ($sheets as $sheet) {
            $ingredient = $sheet->ingredient;
            if ($ingredient && $ingredient->track_inventory) {

                $ingQty = (float) $sheet->quantity * $qtySold;
                $newIngStock = (float) $ingredient->current_stock - $ingQty;

                $this->logMovement($ingredient, 'out', -$ingQty, $newIngStock, "Saída via Ficha Técnica", $originModel);

                $ingredient->updateQuietly(['current_stock' => $newIngStock]);
                $this->deductFromStorageLocations($ingredient, $ingQty);

                if ($qtySold > 0) {
                    $ingredient->current_stock = $newIngStock;
                    $this->checkThresholds($ingredient);
                }

                if ($newIngStock <= 0 && $ingredient->status === 'available') {
                    $this->triggerStockRupture($ingredient);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function deductLoss(InventoryLoss $loss): void
    {
        $loss->loadMissing('product');
        $product = $loss->product;

        if (!$product || !$product->track_inventory || (float) $loss->quantity <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $loss) {
            $qty = (float) $loss->quantity;
            $newStock = (float) $product->current_stock - $qty;

            $this->logMovement(
                product: $product,
                type: 'loss',
                quantity: -$qty,
                newBalance: $newStock,
                description: "Perda: {$loss->reason} ({$loss->formatted_type})",
                originModel: $loss,
                locationId: $loss->storage_location_id
            );

            $product->update(['current_stock' => $newStock]);

            if ($loss->storage_location_id) {
                $pivot = DB::table('product_storage_location')
                    ->where('product_id', $product->id)
                    ->where('storage_location_id', $loss->storage_location_id)
                    ->first();
                if ($pivot) {
                    $currentLoc = (float) $pivot->current_stock;
                    $product->storageLocations()->updateExistingPivot($loss->storage_location_id, [
                        'current_stock' => $currentLoc - $qty
                    ]);
                }
            } else {
                $this->deductFromStorageLocations($product, $qty);
            }

            if ($qty > 0) {
                $product->current_stock = $newStock;
                $this->checkThresholds($product);
            }

            if ($newStock <= 0 && $product->status === 'available') {
                $this->triggerStockRupture($product);
            }
        });
    }

    public function restoreLoss(InventoryLoss $loss): void
    {
        $loss->loadMissing('product');
        $product = $loss->product;

        if (!$product || !$product->track_inventory || (float) $loss->quantity <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $loss) {
            $qty = (float) $loss->quantity;
            $newStock = (float) $product->current_stock + $qty;

            $this->logMovement(
                product: $product,
                type: 'adjustment',
                quantity: $qty,
                newBalance: $newStock,
                description: "Estorno de Perda #{$loss->id}: {$loss->reason}",
                originModel: $loss,
                locationId: $loss->storage_location_id
            );

            $product->update(['current_stock' => $newStock]);

            if ($loss->storage_location_id) {
                $pivot = DB::table('product_storage_location')
                    ->where('product_id', $product->id)
                    ->where('storage_location_id', $loss->storage_location_id)
                    ->first();
                if ($pivot) {
                    $currentLoc = (float) $pivot->current_stock;
                    $product->storageLocations()->updateExistingPivot($loss->storage_location_id, [
                        'current_stock' => $currentLoc + $qty
                    ]);
                }
            } else {
                $this->addToStorageLocations($product, $qty);
            }

            if ($newStock > 0 && $product->status === 'out_of_stock') {
                $product->current_stock = $newStock;
                $this->triggerStockRestored($product);
            }
        });
    }

    public function restoreStock(Product $product, float $qtyReturned, $originModel = null): void
    {
        if ($product->track_inventory) {
            $newStock = (float) $product->current_stock + $qtyReturned;

            $this->logMovement($product, 'in', $qtyReturned, $newStock, "Estorno/Devolução", $originModel);

            $product->updateQuietly(['current_stock' => $newStock]);
            $this->addToStorageLocations($product, $qtyReturned);

            if ($newStock > 0 && $product->status === 'out_of_stock') {
                $product->current_stock = $newStock;
                $this->triggerStockRestored($product);
            }
        }

        $sheets = TechnicalSheet::with('ingredient')
            ->where('parent_product_id', $product->id)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->get();

        if ($sheets->isEmpty()) return;

        foreach ($sheets as $sheet) {
            $ingredient = $sheet->ingredient;
            if ($ingredient && $ingredient->track_inventory) {
                $ingQty = (float) $sheet->quantity * $qtyReturned;
                $newIngStock = (float) $ingredient->current_stock + $ingQty;

                $this->logMovement($ingredient, 'in', $ingQty, $newIngStock, "Estorno via Ficha Técnica", $originModel);

                $ingredient->updateQuietly(['current_stock' => $newIngStock]);
                $this->addToStorageLocations($ingredient, $ingQty);

                if ($newIngStock > 0 && $ingredient->status === 'out_of_stock') {
                    $ingredient->current_stock = $newIngStock;
                    $this->triggerStockRestored($ingredient);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // [Os métodos adjustStock, processOrderItemStock, auditStorageLocation, triggerStockRupture e triggerStockRestored mantêm-se iguais e otimizados]

    public function processOrderItemStock(OrderItem $item, string $action = 'deduct'): void
    {
        $multiplier = $action === 'restore' ? -1 : 1;

        if ($item->product_id) {
            $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
            if ($product) {
                if ($multiplier === 1) {
                    $this->deductStock($product, $item->quantity, $item);
                } else {
                    $this->restoreStock($product, $item->quantity, $item);
                }
            }
        }

        foreach ($item->modifiers as $mod) {
            if ($mod->modifier_option_id) {
                $opt = ModifierOption::find($mod->modifier_option_id);
                if ($opt && $opt->linked_product_id) {
                    $linked = Product::find($opt->linked_product_id);
                    $qtyToProcess = $opt->linked_qty * $mod->quantity;
                    if ($linked) {
                        if ($multiplier === 1) $this->deductStock($linked, $qtyToProcess, $item);
                        else $this->restoreStock($linked, $qtyToProcess, $item);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        foreach ($item->subItems as $sub) {
            if ($sub->product_id) {
                $subProd = Product::find($sub->product_id);
                if ($subProd) {
                    if ($multiplier === 1) $this->deductStock($subProd, $sub->quantity, $item);
                    else $this->restoreStock($subProd, $sub->quantity, $item);
                }
            }
            foreach ($sub->modifiers as $mod) {
                if ($mod->modifier_option_id) {
                    $opt = ModifierOption::find($mod->modifier_option_id);
                    if ($opt && $opt->linked_product_id) {
                        $linked = Product::find($opt->linked_product_id);
                        $qtyToProcess = $opt->linked_qty * $mod->quantity;
                        if ($linked) {
                            if ($multiplier === 1) $this->deductStock($linked, $qtyToProcess, $item);
                            else $this->restoreStock($linked, $qtyToProcess, $item);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function adjustStock(Product $product, float $newStock, string $reason, ?int $userId = null): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $newStock, $reason, $userId) {
            $oldStock = (float) $product->current_stock;
            $diff = $newStock - $oldStock;

            $this->logMovement($product, 'adjustment', $diff, $newStock, "Ajuste: {$reason}");

            $product->update(['current_stock' => $newStock]);

            if ($diff < 0) {
                $this->deductFromStorageLocations($product, abs($diff));
                $this->registerLoss(
                    product: $product,
                    qty: abs($diff),
                    reason: 'Ajuste Manual: ' . $reason,
                    notes: "Estoque alterado de {$oldStock} para {$newStock}",
                    userId: $userId,
                    orderItemId: null,
                    lossType: InventoryLoss::TYPE_INVENTORY_AUDIT,
                    storageLocationId: null,
                    skipDeduction: true
                );
            } elseif ($diff > 0) {
                $this->addToStorageLocations($product, $diff);
            }

            if ($newStock <= 0) {
                if ($product->status === 'available') {
                    $this->triggerStockRupture($product);
                }
            } else {
                if ($product->status === 'out_of_stock') {
                    $this->triggerStockRestored($product);
                } else {
                    $this->checkThresholds($product);
                    broadcast(new CatalogUpdated(tenant('id') ?? 'central'));
                }
            }
        });
    }

    public function registerLoss(
        Product $product,
        float $qty,
        string $reason,
        string $notes,
        ?int $userId = null,
        ?int $orderItemId = null,
        string $lossType = InventoryLoss::TYPE_OPERATIONAL,
        ?int $storageLocationId = null,
        bool $skipDeduction = false
    ): InventoryLoss {
        $unitCost = class_exists(ProductCostingService::class)
            ? ProductCostingService::calculateBaseCost($product)
            : (float) ($product->base_cost ?? 0);

        $loss = new InventoryLoss([
            'product_id'          => $product->id,
            'order_item_id'       => $orderItemId,
            'user_id'             => $userId,
            'storage_location_id' => $storageLocationId,
            'loss_type'           => $lossType,
            'quantity'            => $qty,
            'unit_cost'           => $unitCost,
            'total_cost'          => round($unitCost * $qty, 5),
            'reason'              => $reason,
            'notes'               => $notes,
        ]);

        $loss->skipInventoryDeduction = $skipDeduction;
        $loss->save();

        return $loss;
    }

    public function auditStorageLocation(int $locationId, array $countedItems, int $userId): array
    {
        $location = StorageLocation::findOrFail($locationId);
        $divergences = [];
        $totalLossBrl = 0.0;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($location, $countedItems, $userId, &$divergences, &$totalLossBrl) {
            foreach ($countedItems as $entry) {
                $productId = (int) $entry['product_id'];
                $countedQty = (float) $entry['counted_stock'];

                $product = Product::find($productId);
                if (!$product || !$product->track_inventory) continue;

                $pivotData = DB::table('product_storage_location')
                    ->where('product_id', $productId)
                    ->where('storage_location_id', $location->id)
                    ->first();

                $localSystemQty = $pivotData ? (float) $pivotData->current_stock : 0;
                $delta = round($countedQty - $localSystemQty, 4);

                if ($delta === 0.0) continue;

                if ($pivotData) {
                    $product->storageLocations()->updateExistingPivot($location->id, ['current_stock' => $countedQty]);
                } else {
                    $product->storageLocations()->attach($location->id, ['current_stock' => $countedQty]);
                }

                $newGlobalStock = (float) DB::table('product_storage_location')
                    ->where('product_id', $productId)
                    ->sum('current_stock');

                $this->logMovement($product, 'adjustment', $delta, $newGlobalStock, "Balanço Local: {$location->name}", null, $location->id);

                $product->update(['current_stock' => $newGlobalStock]);

                if ($delta < 0) {
                    $lossQty = abs($delta);
                    $lossRecord = $this->registerLoss(
                        product: $product,
                        qty: $lossQty,
                        reason: "Furo de Balanço: {$location->name}",
                        notes: "Contagem física: {$countedQty}. Sistema esperava: {$localSystemQty}.",
                        userId: $userId,
                        orderItemId: null,
                        lossType: InventoryLoss::TYPE_INVENTORY_AUDIT,
                        storageLocationId: $location->id,
                        skipDeduction: true
                    );

                    if ($newGlobalStock <= 0) {
                        $this->triggerStockRupture($product);
                    }

                    $totalLossBrl += (float) $lossRecord->total_cost;
                    $divergences[] = [
                        'product' => $product->name,
                        'type'    => 'loss',
                        'delta'   => $delta,
                        'uom'     => $product->unit_of_measure,
                        'cost'    => (float) $lossRecord->total_cost
                    ];
                } elseif ($delta > 0) {
                    if ($product->status === 'out_of_stock' && $newGlobalStock > 0) {
                        $this->triggerStockRestored($product);
                    }
                    $divergences[] = [
                        'product' => $product->name,
                        'type'    => 'surplus',
                        'delta'   => $delta,
                        'uom'     => $product->unit_of_measure,
                        'cost'    => 0
                    ];
                }
            }
        });

        broadcast(new CatalogUpdated(tenant('id') ?? 'central'));

        return [
            'location'       => $location->name,
            'divergences'    => $divergences,
            'total_loss_brl' => round($totalLossBrl, 2),
        ];
    }

    public function triggerStockRupture(Product $product): void
    {
        $product->updateQuietly(['status' => 'out_of_stock']);

        ModifierOption::where('linked_product_id', $product->id)->update(['is_active' => false]);

        $parentIds = TechnicalSheet::where('ingredient_product_id', $product->id)->where('is_active', true)->pluck('parent_product_id')->unique();
        if ($parentIds->isNotEmpty()) {
            Product::whereIn('id', $parentIds)->whereNotIn('status', ['paused', 'archived'])->update(['status' => 'out_of_stock']);
        }

        event(new StockLowDetected($product, 'critical'));
        broadcast(new CatalogUpdated(tenant('id') ?? 'central'));

        Log::warning("🚨 [Estoque Ruptura] '{$product->name}' esgotou. Adicionais e pratos bloqueados.");
    }

    public function triggerStockRestored(Product $product): void
    {
        if (in_array($product->status, ['paused', 'archived'], true)) {
            return;
        }

        $hasMissingIngredients = TechnicalSheet::where('parent_product_id', $product->id)->where('is_active', true)
            ->whereHas('ingredient', function ($query) {
                $query->whereIn('status', ['out_of_stock', 'unavailable', 'paused', 'archived']);
            })
            ->exists();

        if (!$hasMissingIngredients) {
            $product->updateQuietly(['status' => 'available']);
        }

        ModifierOption::where('linked_product_id', $product->id)->update(['is_active' => true]);

        $parentIds = TechnicalSheet::where('ingredient_product_id', $product->id)->where('is_active', true)->pluck('parent_product_id')->unique();
        foreach ($parentIds as $parentId) {
            $parent = Product::find($parentId);
            if (!$parent || in_array($parent->status, ['paused', 'archived'], true)) continue;

            $parentMissing = TechnicalSheet::where('parent_product_id', $parentId)->where('is_active', true)
                ->whereHas('ingredient', fn($q) => $q->whereIn('status', ['out_of_stock', 'unavailable', 'paused', 'archived']))
                ->exists();

            $parentPhysical = $parent->track_inventory && (float) $parent->current_stock <= 0;

            if (!$parentMissing && !$parentPhysical) {
                $parent->updateQuietly(['status' => 'available']);
            }
        }

        broadcast(new CatalogUpdated(tenant('id') ?? 'central'));
    }

    private function checkThresholds(Product $product): void
    {
        if ($product->min_stock !== null && $product->current_stock <= $product->min_stock) {
            Log::info("⚠️ [Estoque Baixo] Produto {$product->name} atingiu o limite mínimo.");
            event(new StockLowDetected($product, $product->current_stock <= 0 ? 'critical' : 'normal'));
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Catalog/ProductCostingService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Catalog;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ProductCostingService
{
    // 🚀 CACHE EM MEMÓRIA: Evita consultas recursivas pesadas
    private static array $costCache = [];

    /**
     * Limpa o cache estático em memória (essencial para testes e workers).
     */
    public static function clearCache(): void
    {
        self::$costCache = [];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string,mixed>
     */
    public static function getMarginData(Product $product): array
    {
        $sellPrice = (float) ($product->dine_in_price ?? ($product->delivery_price ?? 0));

        // 1. Custos de Insumos (CMV)
        $costTable = self::calculateBaseCost($product, "table");
        $costCounter = self::calculateBaseCost($product, "counter");
        $costDelivery = self::calculateBaseCost($product, "delivery");

        // 2. Média Ponderada
        $activeChannels = 0;
        $sumCost = 0;
        if ($product->show_on_menu) {
            $sumCost += $costTable + $costCounter;
            $activeChannels += 2;
        }
        if ($product->show_on_delivery) {
            $sumCost += $costDelivery;
            $activeChannels += 1;
        }
        if ($activeChannels === 0) {
            $sumCost = $costTable + $costCounter + $costDelivery;
            $activeChannels = 3;
        }

        $baseCost = $sumCost / $activeChannels;

        // INJEÇÃO DO CUSTO PREDITIVO (BI)
        $predictiveModifiersCost = self::getPredictiveModifiersCost($product);
        $baseCost += $predictiveModifiersCost;

        // 3. Impostos Individuais com Proteção Null-Safe
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $simplesRate = (float) ($settings?->simples_rate ?? 0);

        $icmsRate = 0;
        $icmsAmount = 0;

        $effectiveSimplesRate = $simplesRate;
        if ($product->is_monofasico) {
            $effectiveSimplesRate = $simplesRate * (1 - 0.34);
        }

        $simplesAmount = $sellPrice * ($effectiveSimplesRate / 100);

        // 4. Taxas de Cartão
        $avgFeeResult = DB::table("bank_accounts")
            ->where("is_active", true)
            ->selectRaw("AVG((credit_fee + debit_fee) / 2) as avg_fee")
            ->first();

        $cardFeePercentage = (float) ($avgFeeResult->avg_fee ?? 0);
        $cardFeeAmount = $sellPrice * ($cardFeePercentage / 100);

        // A SOMA REAL DOS VARIÁVEIS
        $totalVariables = $simplesAmount + $icmsAmount + $cardFeeAmount;

        // 5. Margem de Contribuição
        $contributionMargin = $sellPrice - $baseCost - $totalVariables;
        $marginPercentage = $sellPrice > 0 ? ($contributionMargin / $sellPrice) * 100 : 0;

        $fmt = fn($val) => 'R$ ' . number_format($val, 2, ",", ".");

        return [
            "sell_price" => $sellPrice,
            "base_cost" => $baseCost,
            "cost_table" => $costTable,
            "cost_counter" => $costCounter,
            "cost_delivery" => $costDelivery,
            "total_variables" => $totalVariables,
            "simples_amount" => $simplesAmount,
            "icms_amount" => $icmsAmount,
            "simples_display" => ($settings?->tax_regime === "mei") ? "ISENTO" : $fmt($simplesAmount),
            "icms_display" => $product->is_monofasico ? "ISENTO" : $fmt($icmsAmount),
            "card_fee_amount" => $cardFeeAmount,
            "contribution_margin" => $contributionMargin,
            "marginPercentage" => $marginPercentage,
            "margin_percentage" => $marginPercentage,
            "simples_rate" => $simplesRate,
            "icms_rate" => $icmsRate,
            "card_fee_percentage" => $cardFeePercentage,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Calcula o custo de forma recursiva, filtrando pelo tipo de pedido ($orderType)
     * e considerando APENAS insumos com is_active = true.
     */
    public static function calculateBaseCost(Product $product, string $orderType = "all"): float
    {
        $cacheKey = $product->id . '_' . $orderType;

        if (isset(self::$costCache[$cacheKey])) {
            return self::$costCache[$cacheKey];
        }

        // 🛡️ Filtra somente insumos ativos na Ficha Técnica
        $sheetItems = \App\Models\TechnicalSheet::where("parent_product_id", $product->id)
            ->where("is_active", true)
            ->get();

        if ($sheetItems->isEmpty()) {
            $latestHistory = \App\Models\ProductCostHistory::where("product_id", $product->id)
                ->latest("id")
                ->first();

            if ($latestHistory) {
                $cost = (float) $latestHistory->unit_cost;
                self::$costCache[$cacheKey] = $cost;
                return $cost;
            }

            $cost = (float) ($product->base_cost ?? 0);
            self::$costCache[$cacheKey] = $cost;
            return $cost;
        }

        $cost = 0;

        foreach ($sheetItems as $item) {
            $channelsArray = is_array($item->order_type) ? $item->order_type : ["table", "counter", "delivery"];

            if ($orderType === "all" || in_array($orderType, $channelsArray)) {
                $child = Product::find($item->ingredient_product_id);
                if ($child) {
                    $childCost = self::calculateBaseCost($child, $orderType);
                    $cost += $childCost * (float) $item->quantity;
                }
            }
        }

        $yield = max((float) ($product->recipe_yield ?? 1), 1);
        $finalCost = $cost / $yield;

        self::$costCache[$cacheKey] = $finalCost;

        return $finalCost;
    }

    public static function getPredictiveModifiersCost(Product $product): float
    {
        $totalPredictiveCost = 0;
        $modifierGroups = $product->modifiers()->where("type", "ingredient")->get();

        foreach ($modifierGroups as $group) {
            $options = $group->options()->whereNotNull("linked_product_id")->get();
            if ($options->isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            $groupExpectedCost = 0;
            $totalWeight = 0;

            foreach ($options as $option) {
                $linkedInsumo = Product::find($option->linked_product_id);
                if (!$linkedInsumo) {
                    continue;
                }

                $actualCost = self::calculateBaseCost($linkedInsumo);
                $optionCost = $actualCost * ($option->linked_qty ?? 0);
                $weight = $option->historical_weight ?? 1;

                $groupExpectedCost += $optionCost * $weight;
                $totalWeight += $weight;
            }

            if ($totalWeight > 0) {
                $averageOptionCost = $groupExpectedCost / $totalWeight;
                $includedQty = $group->max_free > 0 ? $group->max_free : 1;
                $totalPredictiveCost += $averageOptionCost * $includedQty;
            }
        }

        return $totalPredictiveCost;
    }

    public static function simulatePricing(Product $product, array $selectedAddons, ?string $activeMode, ?float $customValue): array
    {
        $marginData = self::getMarginData($product);
        $modifierGroups = $product->modifiers()->whereIn('type', ['add_on', 'ingredient'])->with('options')->get();

        $predictiveCostTotal = self::getPredictiveModifiersCost($product);
        $simulatedCost = $marginData['base_cost'] - $predictiveCostTotal;
        $addonSellPriceTotal = 0;

        foreach ($modifierGroups as $group) {
            $groupIsSimulated = false;
            $groupSimulatedCost = 0;

            foreach ($group->options as $option) {
                if (in_array($option->id, $selectedAddons)) {
                    $groupIsSimulated = true;
                    $addonSellPriceTotal += $option->price;

                    if ($option->linked_product_id) {
                        $linkedInsumo = \App\Models\Product::find($option->linked_product_id);
                        if ($linkedInsumo) {
                            $actualCost = self::calculateBaseCost($linkedInsumo);
                            $groupSimulatedCost += $actualCost * ($option->linked_qty ?? 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if ($groupIsSimulated) {
                $simulatedCost += $groupSimulatedCost;
            } else {
                if ($group->type === 'ingredient') {
                    $groupExpectedCost = 0;
                    $totalWeight = 0;
                    foreach ($group->options as $opt) {
                        if (!$opt->linked_product_id) continue;
                        $linked = \App\Models\Product::find($opt->linked_product_id);
                        if (!$linked) continue;

                        $optCost = self::calculateBaseCost($linked) * ($opt->linked_qty ?? 0);
                        $weight = $opt->historical_weight ?? 1;

                        $groupExpectedCost += ($optCost * $weight);
                        $totalWeight += $weight;
                    }
                    if ($totalWeight > 0) {
                        $simulatedCost += ($groupExpectedCost / $totalWeight) * ($group->max_free > 0 ? $group->max_free : 1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $simplesRate = $marginData['simples_rate'] ?? 0;
        $icmsRate = ($product->is_monofasico ?? false) ? 0 : ($marginData['icms_rate'] ?? 0);
        $cardFeePercentage = $marginData['card_fee_percentage'] ?? 0;
        $totalTaxRate = $simplesRate + $icmsRate + $cardFeePercentage;

        $simulatedSellPrice = $marginData['sell_price'];

        if ($activeMode === null) {
            $simulatedSellPrice += $addonSellPriceTotal;
        } elseif ($activeMode === 'margin' && $customValue !== null) {
            $divisor = 1 - (($totalTaxRate + $customValue) / 100);
            $simulatedSellPrice = $divisor > 0 ? ($simulatedCost / $divisor) : 0;
        } elseif ($activeMode === 'price' && $customValue !== null) {
            $simulatedSellPrice = $customValue;
        }

        $simplesAmount = $simulatedSellPrice * ($simplesRate / 100);
        $icmsAmount = $simulatedSellPrice * ($icmsRate / 100);
        $cardFeeAmount = $simulatedSellPrice * ($cardFeePercentage / 100);
        $totalVariableCosts = $simplesAmount + $icmsAmount + $cardFeeAmount;

        $netProfit = $simulatedSellPrice - $simulatedCost - $totalVariableCosts;
        $marginPercentage = $simulatedSellPrice > 0 ? ($netProfit / $simulatedSellPrice) * 100 : 0;

        return [
            'sell_price' => $simulatedSellPrice,
            'cost' => $simulatedCost,
            'net_profit' => $netProfit,
            'contribution_margin' => $netProfit,
            'margin_percentage' => $marginPercentage,
            'simples_amount' => $simplesAmount,
            'icms_amount' => $icmsAmount,
            'card_fee_amount' => $cardFeeAmount,
            'total_variable_costs' => $totalVariableCosts,
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Catalog;

use App\Models\OrderItem;

class TopSellingCombinationsService
{
    public function getTopCombinations(int $limit = 10): array
    {
        $items = OrderItem::with(['modifiers', 'product.category'])
            ->whereHas('order', function ($query) {
                $query->whereIn('orders.status', ['completed', 'closed', 'delivered']);
            })
            ->orderBy('id', 'desc')
            ->limit(500)
            ->get();

        $grouped = $items->groupBy(function ($item) {
            $modIds = $item->modifiers->map(function($m) {
                return $m->modifier_option_id ?? $m->id;
            })->sort()->implode('-');

            return $item->product_id . '_mods_' . $modIds;
        });

        $ranked = $grouped->sortByDesc(fn($group) => $group->count())->take($limit);

        return $ranked->map(function ($group, $signature) {
            $baseItem = $group->first();

            return [
                'id' => $baseItem->product_id,
                'variant_signature' => $signature,
                'name' => $baseItem->product_name ?? $baseItem->name ?? $baseItem->product?->name ?? 'Destaque',
                'category_name' => $baseItem->product?->category?->name ?? 'Mais Pedidos',
                'unit_price' => (float) $baseItem->unit_price,
                'status' => $baseItem->product?->status ?? 'active',
                'track_inventory' => (bool) ($baseItem->product?->track_inventory ?? false),
                'current_stock' => $baseItem->product?->current_stock ?? 99,
                'modifiers' => collect($baseItem->modifiers)->map(fn($mod) => [
                    'id' => $mod->modifier_option_id ?? $mod->id,
                    'name' => $mod->name ?? '',
                    'quantity' => (float) ($mod->quantity ?? 1),
                    'price' => (float) ($mod->price ?? 0),
                ])->toArray(),
                'sales_count' => $group->count(),
            ];
        })->values()->toArray();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Communications;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Exception;

class WhatsAppService
{
    public function sendOtp(string $phone, string $code): bool
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        // Pega as configurações ou usa variáveis de ambiente como fallback
        $token = $settings?->wa_provider_token ?? env('WHATSAPP_TOKEN');
        $endpoint = $settings?->wa_provider_url ?? env('WHATSAPP_ENDPOINT', 'https://graph.facebook.com/v17.0/YOUR_PHONE_ID/messages');

        if (!$token || !$endpoint) {
            Log::warning("WhatsApp API não configurada. OTP gerado: {$code} para {$phone}");
            return false; // Retorne true em ambiente de desenvolvimento se quiser testar sem enviar
        }

        // Limpa o número (apenas dígitos) e adiciona DDI se faltar
        $cleanPhone = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $phone);
        if (strlen($cleanPhone) <= 11) {
            $cleanPhone = '55' . $cleanPhone;
        }

        try {
            $response = Http::withToken($token)->post($endpoint, [
                'messaging_product' => 'whatsapp',
                'to' => $cleanPhone,
                'type' => 'template',
                'template' => [
                    'name' => 'auth_otp_code', // Nome do template aprovado na Meta
                    'language' => ['code' => 'pt_BR'],
                    'components' => [
                        [
                            'type' => 'body',
                            'parameters' => [
                                ['type' => 'text', 'text' => $code]
                            ]
                        ],
                        [
                            'type' => 'button',
                            'sub_type' => 'url',
                            'index' => '0',
                            'parameters' => [
                                ['type' => 'text', 'text' => $code] // Preenche a variável do botão de copiar código
                            ]
                        ]
                    ]
                ]
            ]);

            return $response->successful();
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            Log::error("Erro ao enviar OTP WA: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Customers;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\LegacyOrder;
use App\Models\LegacyOrderItem;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class CustomerDashboardService
{
    public function getDashboardPayload(?User $user, ?int $guestId, array $allowedGuestAddresses = []): array
    {
        $targetCustomer = null;
        $isGuest = false;

        if ($user && $user->customer) {
            $targetCustomer = $user->customer;
        } elseif ($guestId) {
            $targetCustomer = Customer::find($guestId);
            if ($targetCustomer) {
                $isGuest = true;
            }
        }

        $customerPayload = null;
        $myActiveOrders = [];
        $myHistory = [];

        if ($targetCustomer) {
            if (!$isGuest) {
                $targetCustomer->load(['addresses' => function($q) {
                    $q->where('is_active', true)->with(['street', 'neighborhood']);
                }]);
            } else {
                $targetCustomer->load(['addresses' => function($q) use ($allowedGuestAddresses) {
                    $q->where('is_active', true)
                      ->whereIn('id', $allowedGuestAddresses)
                      ->with(['street', 'neighborhood']);
                }]);
            }

            $customerPayload = [
                'id'             => $targetCustomer->id,
                'name'           => $targetCustomer->name,
                'phone'          => $targetCustomer->phone,
                'cpf'            => $targetCustomer->cpf,
                'email'          => $targetCustomer->email,
                'birth_date'     => $targetCustomer->birth_date,
                'loyalty_points' => $targetCustomer->loyalty_points,
                'addresses'      => $targetCustomer->addresses->map(fn($a) => [
                    'id'              => $a->id,
                    'is_active'       => (bool) $a->is_active,
                    'nickname'        => $a->nickname,
                    'street'          => $a->street?->name ?? '',
                    'street_id'       => $a->street_id,
                    'neighborhood'    => $a->neighborhood?->name ?? '',
                    'neighborhood_id' => $a->neighborhood_id,
                    'number'          => $a->number ?? 'S/N',
                    'no_number'       => (bool) $a->no_number,
                    'complement'      => $a->complement,
                    'reference'       => $a->reference,
                    'full_address'    => trim(($a->street?->name ?? 'Rua') . ", " . ($a->number ?? 'S/N') . " - " . ($a->neighborhood?->name ?? 'Bairro')),
                    'delivery_fee'    => (float) ($a->delivery_fee ?? $a->neighborhood?->delivery_fee ?? 0)
                ])
            ];

            // 🚀 Busca configurações de Marketing para gerar a métrica virtual de Cashback
            $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
            $isCashbackMode = ($settings->loyalty_reward_type ?? '') === 'cashback';
            $conversionRate = (float) ($settings->loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate ?? 5);

            // 🎯 LISTA BRANCA DO POS: apenas pedidos nestes status permanecem como ativos
            $posActiveStatuses = ['pending', 'confirmed', 'preparing', 'ready', 'dispatched', 'pending_payment'];
            $tableMode = session('table_mode');

            if ($tableMode) {
                // 🚀 "Todos veem tudo": Busca os pedidos ativos DESTA MESA, não importa o cliente
                $myActiveOrders = Order::with([
                        'items.modifiers', 'items.subItems.modifiers', 'coupon:id,code,type,value',
                        'payments', 'payments.paymentMethod', 'customer:id,name'
                    ])
                    ->where('dining_table_id', $tableMode['id'])
                    ->whereIn('status', $posActiveStatuses)
                    ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get()
                    ->map(function ($order) use ($isCashbackMode, $conversionRate) {
                        $order->cashback_earned = ($isCashbackMode && $order->loyalty_points_earned > 0)
                            ? round(($order->loyalty_points_earned / 100) * $conversionRate, 2)
                            : null;
                        return $order;
                    });
            } else {
                // 🚀 Fluxo normal (Delivery/Balcão/Pre-order)
                $myActiveOrders = Order::with(['items.modifiers', 'items.subItems.modifiers', 'coupon:id,code,type,value', 'payments', 'payments.paymentMethod'])
                    ->where('customer_id', $targetCustomer->id)
                    ->whereIn('status', $posActiveStatuses)
                    ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get()
                    ->map(function ($order) use ($isCashbackMode, $conversionRate) {
                        $order->cashback_earned = ($isCashbackMode && $order->loyalty_points_earned > 0)
                            ? round(($order->loyalty_points_earned / 100) * $conversionRate, 2)
                            : null;
                        return $order;
                    });
            }

            // 🚀 Histórico V3 (cobre cancelamentos em ambas as grafias)
            $historyStatuses = ['closed', 'completed', 'delivered', 'finished', 'canceled', 'cancelled'];

            $myHistoryNew = Order::with(['items.modifiers', 'items.subItems.modifiers', 'coupon:id,code,type,value', 'payments', 'rating'])
                ->where('customer_id', $targetCustomer->id)
                ->whereIn('status', $historyStatuses)
                ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
                ->limit(15)->get()
                ->map(function ($order) use ($isCashbackMode, $conversionRate) {
                    $order->cashback_earned = ($isCashbackMode && $order->loyalty_points_earned > 0)
                        ? round(($order->loyalty_points_earned / 100) * $conversionRate, 2)
                        : null;
                    return $order;
                });

            // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Busca prévia dos IDs legados sem OR EXISTS correlacionado
            $legacyCustomerIds = DB::table('legacy_customers')
                ->where('customer_id', $targetCustomer->id)
                ->pluck('id')
                ->all();

            $directOrderQuery = DB::table('legacy_orders')
                ->where('customer_id', $targetCustomer->id)
                ->select('id', 'issue_date');

            if (!empty($legacyCustomerIds)) {
                $viaLegacyCustomerQuery = DB::table('legacy_orders')
                    ->whereIn('legacy_customer_id', $legacyCustomerIds)
                    ->select('id', 'issue_date');

                $recentLegacyIds = $directOrderQuery->union($viaLegacyCustomerQuery)
                    ->orderBy('issue_date', 'desc')
                    ->limit(15)
                    ->pluck('id')
                    ->all();
            } else {
                $recentLegacyIds = $directOrderQuery
                    ->orderBy('issue_date', 'desc')
                    ->limit(15)
                    ->pluck('id')
                    ->all();
            }

            $myHistoryLegacy = empty($recentLegacyIds)
                ? collect()
                : LegacyOrder::with(['items.legacyProduct', 'items.modifiers', 'payments.legacyPaymentMethod'])
                    ->whereIn('id', $recentLegacyIds)
                    ->orderBy('issue_date', 'desc')
                    ->get()
                    ->map(function ($oldOrder) {
                        return [
                            'id' => 'LEG-' . $oldOrder->id,
                            'status' => 'closed',
                            'created_at' => $oldOrder->issue_date,
                            'total' => (float) $oldOrder->total_value,
                            'subtotal' => (float) ($oldOrder->total_value + $oldOrder->discount),
                            'delivery_fee' => 0,
                            'discount' => (float) $oldOrder->discount,
                            'coupon' => null,
                            'loyalty_points_earned' => 0,
                            'cashback_earned' => null,
                            'rating' => null,
                            'payments' => $oldOrder->payments->map(function($p) {
                                return ['method_name' => $p->legacyPaymentMethod?->name ?? 'Dinheiro'];
                            })->toArray(),
                            'items' => $oldOrder->items->map(function ($oldItem) {
                                return [
                                    'id' => 'leg-item-' . $oldItem->id,
                                    'product_id' => $oldItem->legacy_product_id,
                                    'product_name' => $oldItem->legacyProduct?->name ?? 'Item Antigo',
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Customers;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\LegacyOrderItem;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class CustomerFavoritesService
{
    public function getFavorites(Customer $customer): array
    {
        // 1. Busca agregada (Agrupa e Conta primeiro - NOVOS)
        $newAggregates = OrderItem::whereHas('order', function ($q) use ($customer) {
                $q->where('customer_id', $customer->id)->where('status', 'closed');
            })
            ->whereNull('parent_item_id')
            ->select('product_id', DB::raw('MAX(id) as latest_id'), DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total_orders'))
            ->groupBy('product_id')
            ->get()
            ->keyBy('latest_id');

        $newItems = [];
        if ($newAggregates->isNotEmpty()) {
            $newItems = OrderItem::with(['product.category', 'modifiers.modifierOption'])
                ->whereIn('id', $newAggregates->keys())
                ->get()
                ->mapWithKeys(function($item) use ($newAggregates) {
                    $productId = $item->product_id;
                    return [$productId => [
                        'id' => $productId,
                        'name' => $item->product_name ?: ($item->product?->name ?? 'Item'),
                        'category_name' => $item->product?->category?->name ?? 'Favoritos',
                        'unit_price' => (float) $item->unit_price,
                        'status' => $item->product?->status ?? 'available',
                        'track_inventory' => (bool) ($item->product?->track_inventory ?? false),
                        'current_stock' => (float) ($item->product?->current_stock ?? 0),
                        'notes' => $item->notes,
                        'modifiers' => $item->modifiers->map(fn($m) => [
                            'id' => $m->modifier_option_id,
                            'name' => $m->name,
                            'price' => (float) $m->price,
                            'quantity' => (int) $m->quantity
                        ])->toArray(),
                        'total_orders' => $newAggregates[$item->id]->total_orders
                    ]];
                })->toArray();
        }

        // 2. Busca agregada (LEGADOS - OTIMIZADO)
        $legacyCustomerIds = DB::table('legacy_customers')
            ->where('customer_id', $customer->id)
            ->pluck('id')
            ->all();

        $legacyOrderIdsQuery = DB::table('legacy_orders')
            ->where('customer_id', $customer->id);

        if (!empty($legacyCustomerIds)) {
            $legacyOrderIdsQuery->orWhereIn('legacy_customer_id', $legacyCustomerIds);
        }

        $legacyOrderIds = $legacyOrderIdsQuery->pluck('id')->all();

        $legacyAggregates = collect();
        if (!empty($legacyOrderIds)) {
            $foreignKey = method_exists(LegacyOrderItem::class, 'order')
                ? (new LegacyOrderItem)->order()->getForeignKeyName()
                : 'legacy_order_id';

            $legacyAggregates = LegacyOrderItem::whereIn($foreignKey, $legacyOrderIds)
                ->select('legacy_product_id', DB::raw('MAX(id) as latest_id'), DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total_orders'))
                ->groupBy('legacy_product_id')
                ->get()
                ->keyBy('latest_id');
        }

        $legacyItems = [];
        if ($legacyAggregates->isNotEmpty()) {
            $legacyRawItems = LegacyOrderItem::with([
                'legacyProduct.currentProduct.category',
                'modifiers'
            ])
            ->whereIn('id', $legacyAggregates->keys())
            ->get();

            foreach ($legacyRawItems as $item) {
                $legacyProd = $item->legacyProduct;
                $currentProd = $legacyProd ? $legacyProd->currentProduct : null;
                $totalOrders = $legacyAggregates[$item->id]->total_orders;

                if ($currentProd) {
                    $resolvedId = $currentProd->id;

                    if (isset($newItems[$resolvedId])) {
                        $newItems[$resolvedId]['total_orders'] += $totalOrders;
                        continue;
                    }

                    $basePrice = $currentProd->delivery_price > 0 ? $currentProd->delivery_price : $currentProd->dine_in_price;
                    $finalPrice = $currentProd->promo_price > 0 ? $currentProd->promo_price : $basePrice;

                    $legacyItems[$resolvedId] = [
                        'id' => $resolvedId,
                        'name' => $currentProd->name,
                        'category_name' => $currentProd->category?->name ?? 'Favoritos',
                        'unit_price' => (float) $finalPrice,
                        'status' => $currentProd->status,
                        'track_inventory' => (bool) $currentProd->track_inventory,
                        'current_stock' => (float) $currentProd->current_stock,
                        'notes' => '',
                        'modifiers' => $item->modifiers->map(function($m) {
                             $optionId = null;
                             if ($m->legacyModifier && $m->legacyModifier->modifier_option_id) {
                                 $optionId = $m->legacyModifier->modifier_option_id;
                             }
                             return [
                                'id' => $optionId,
                                'name' => $m->legacyModifier ? ($m->legacyModifier->currentOption->name ?? $m->name) : $m->name,
                                'price' => (float) ($m->price ?? 0),
                                'quantity' => (int) ($m->quantity ?? 1)
                            ];
                        })->toArray(),
                        'total_orders' => $totalOrders,
                    ];
                } else {
                    $legacyItems['legacy_' . $item->legacy_product_id] = [
                        'id' => $item->legacy_product_id,
                        'name' => $legacyProd?->name ?? 'Item Antigo',
                        'category_name' => 'Descontinuado',
                        'unit_price' => (float) $item->unit_price,
                        'status' => 'out_of_stock',
                        'track_inventory' => false,
                        'current_stock' => 0,
                        'notes' => '',
                        'modifiers' => [],
                        'total_orders' => $totalOrders,
                    ];
                }
            }
        }

        return collect($newItems)->concat(collect($legacyItems))
            ->sortByDesc('total_orders')
            ->take(12)
            ->values()
            ->toArray();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Customers;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Models\Customer;

class CustomerMappingService
{
    /**
     * Retorna todos os clientes e endereços ativos de forma otimizada (Query Builder).
     * Usado no carregamento inicial da Tela de Vendas (PDV).
     */
    public function getAllForPos()
    {
        $customers = DB::table("customers")
            ->select("id", "name", "phone", "cpf")
            ->whereNull("deleted_at")
            ->get();

        if ($customers->isEmpty()) {
            return collect();
        }

        // 🚀 Busca todos os endereços de uma só vez (1 query em vez de N queries)
        $addressesGrouped = DB::table("addresses")
            ->whereIn("customer_id", $customers->pluck("id"))
            ->leftJoin("streets", "addresses.street_id", "=", "streets.id")
            ->leftJoin("neighborhoods", "addresses.neighborhood_id", "=", "neighborhoods.id")
            ->select(
                "addresses.id",
                "addresses.customer_id",
                "addresses.number",
                "addresses.complement",
                "addresses.is_active",
                "addresses.nickname",
                "streets.name as street_name",
                "neighborhoods.name as neighborhood_name",
                "neighborhoods.delivery_fee"
            )
            ->get()
            ->groupBy("customer_id");

        return $customers->map(function ($c) use ($addressesGrouped) {
            $customerAddresses = $addressesGrouped->get($c->id, collect())->map(function ($addr) {
                return [
                    "id"           => $addr->id,
                    "is_active"    => (bool) $addr->is_active,
                    "nickname"     => $addr->nickname,
                    "full_address" => trim("{$addr->street_name}, {$addr->number} - {$addr->neighborhood_name} " . ($addr->complement ? "({$addr->complement})" : "")),
                    "neighborhood" => $addr->neighborhood_name,
                    "delivery_fee" => (float) $addr->delivery_fee,
                ];
            });

            return [
                "id"        => $c->id,
                "name"      => $c->name,
                "phone"     => $c->phone,
                "cpf"       => $c->cpf,
                "addresses" => $customerAddresses,
            ];
        });
    }

    /**
     * Mapeia um único cliente (Model Eloquent) para a estrutura exigida pelo Vue.
     * Usado no carregamento do Kanban de Operações.
     */
    public function mapOrderCustomer(?Customer $customer): ?array
    {
        if (!$customer) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            "id" => $customer->id,
            "name" => $customer->name,
            "phone" => $customer->phone,
            "cpf" => $customer->cpf,
            "addresses" => $customer->addresses->map(function ($addr) {
                $sName = $addr->street->name ?? '';
                $nName = $addr->neighborhood->name ?? '';
                $fAddress = trim("{$sName}, {$addr->number} - {$nName} " . ($addr->complement ? "({$addr->complement})" : ""));

                $deliveryFee = $addr->delivery_fee ?? $addr->neighborhood->delivery_fee ?? 0;

                return [
                    "id" => $addr->id,
                    "is_active" => (bool) $addr->is_active, // 🚀 Injetado aqui também!
                    "nickname" => $addr->nickname,          // 🚀 Injetado aqui também!
                    "full_address" => $fAddress,
                    "delivery_fee" => (float) $deliveryFee,
                ];
            })->values()->toArray()
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Customers;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Address;
use App\Models\Street;
use App\Models\Neighborhood;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Exception;

class CustomerProfileService
{
    public function searchCustomers(string $search)
    {
        $onlyNumbers = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $search);
        $query = Customer::query()->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%");

        if (!empty($onlyNumbers)) {
            $query->orWhere('phone', 'like', "%{$onlyNumbers}%")
                  ->orWhere('cpf', 'like', "%{$onlyNumbers}%");
        }

        return $query->take(10)->get(['id', 'name', 'phone', 'cpf']);
    }

    public function addAddress(Customer|int $customerOrId, array $data): Address
        {
            $customerId = $customerOrId instanceof Customer ? $customerOrId->id : $customerOrId;

            // 🚀 1. TRATAMENTO DO BAIRRO (Prioriza o ID para não perder a taxa de entrega!)
            if (!empty($data['neighborhood_id'])) {
                $neighborhood = Neighborhood::findOrFail($data['neighborhood_id']);
            } else {
                $neighborhood = Neighborhood::firstOrCreate(
                    ['name' => trim($data['neighborhood'])],
                    ['delivery_fee' => 0.00]
                );
            }

            // 🚀 2. TRATAMENTO DA RUA (Prioriza o ID)
            if (!empty($data['street_id'])) {
                $street = Street::findOrFail($data['street_id']);
            } else {
                $street = Street::firstOrCreate(
                    ['name' => trim($data['street'])],
                    ['zip_code' => $data['zipcode'] ?? null]
                );
            }

            $number = isset($data['noNumber']) && $data['noNumber'] ? 'S/N' : ($data['number'] ?? 'S/N');

            return Address::create([
                'customer_id' => $customerId,
                'nickname' => $data['nickname'] ?? 'Casa',
                'street_id' => $street->id,
                'neighborhood_id' => $neighborhood->id,
                'number' => $number,
                'no_number' => $data['noNumber'] ?? false,
                'complement' => $data['complement'] ?? null,
                'is_active' => true,
            ]);
        }

    public function updateAddress(Customer $customer, int $addressId, array $data): void
    {
        $address = $customer->addresses()->findOrFail($addressId);
        $address->update($data);
    }

    public function deactivateAddress(Customer $customer, Address $address): void
    {
        if ($address->customer_id !== $customer->id) {
            throw new Exception('Operação não autorizada.');
        }

        $address->update(['is_active' => false]);
    }

    public function updateCustomerProfile(array $data, ?User $user, ?int $guestId): void
    {
        $customer = null;
        if ($user && $user->customer) {
            $customer = $user->customer;
        } elseif ($guestId) {
            $customer = Customer::find($guestId);
        }

        if (!$customer) {
            throw new Exception('Sessão inválida.');
        }

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $isSerproActive = $settings && $settings->customer_registration_mode === 'serpro_magic';
        $canEditProfile = $settings ? $settings->customer_can_edit_profile : true;

        $isLocked = $isSerproActive || !$canEditProfile;

        if (!$isLocked) {
            if (isset($data['name'])) $customer->name = $data['name'];
            if (isset($data['birth_date'])) $customer->birth_date = $data['birth_date'];
        }

        if (isset($data['phone'])) $customer->phone = $data['phone'];

        $customer->save();

        if ($user && !$isLocked && isset($data['name'])) {
            $user->update(['name' => $data['name']]);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Customers;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Address;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Marketing\LoyaltyService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Exception;

class CustomerRegistrationService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected LoyaltyService $loyaltyService
    ) {}

    public function createCustomer(array $data): Customer
    {
        return Customer::create($data);
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 RESTAURADO: Cria ou recupera o perfil de um visitante (Customer anônimo)
     */
    public function registerGuestCustomer(array $data): int
{
    // 1. Higieniza o telefone (apenas números)
    $cleanPhone = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $data['phone']);
    $rawPhone = $data['phone'];

    // 2. Busca se o cliente já existe por qualquer variação do telefone
    $existing = Customer::where('phone', $cleanPhone)
        ->orWhere('phone', $rawPhone)
        ->first();

    if ($existing) {
        // 🚀 SE JÁ EXISTE: Não trava! Apenas atualiza o nome (se não tiver) e reaproveita o ID
        if (empty($existing->name) && !empty($data['name'])) {
            $existing->update(['name' => $data['name']]);
        }

        return (int) $existing->id;
    }

    // 3. SE NÃO EXISTE: Cria um novo registro como guest/visitante
    $customer = Customer::create([
        'name'         => $data['name'],
        'phone'        => $cleanPhone,
        'user_id'      => null, // Sem vínculo com conta oficial ainda
    ]);

    return (int) $customer->id;
}

    public function registerOfficialCustomer(array $data): User
    {
        $cleanPhone = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $data['phone']);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $cleanPhone) {
            $user = User::create([
                'name'      => $data['name'],
                'email'     => $data['email'],
                'password'  => Hash::make($data['password']),
                'is_active' => true,
            ]);

            Customer::create([
                'name'       => $data['name'],
                'phone'      => $cleanPhone,
                'cpf'        => !empty($data['cpf']) ? preg_replace('/\D/', '', $data['cpf']) : null,
                'birth_date' => $data['birth_date'] ?? null,
                'email'      => $data['email'],
                'user_id'    => $user->id,
                'is_active'  => true,
            ]);

            return $user;
        });
    }

    public function upgradeGuestAccount(int $guestId, array $data, SerproService $serproService): User
    {
        $customer = Customer::findOrFail($guestId);
        $cleanCpf = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $data['cpf']);

        $existingUser = User::whereHas('customer', fn($q) => $q->where('cpf', $cleanCpf))->first();
        if ($existingUser) {
            throw new Exception('Este CPF já possui cadastro. Por favor, faça Login na tela inicial.', 409);
        }

        $nameToSave = $data['name'] ?? ($data['fallback_name'] ?? $customer->name);
        $birthDateToSave = $data['birth_date'] ?? ($data['fallback_birth_date'] ?? null);

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $isSerproActive = $settings
            && $settings->customer_registration_mode === 'serpro_magic'
            && !empty($settings->serpro_client_id);

        // Apenas consulta o Serpro se estiver ativado e o nome não foi enviado
        if ($isSerproActive && empty($data['name']) && empty($data['fallback_name']) && !empty($birthDateToSave)) {
            try {
                $serproData = $serproService->consultCpf($cleanCpf, $birthDateToSave);
                $nameToSave = $serproData['nome'];
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                // Fallback gracioso: mantém o nome informado pelo cliente
            }
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($customer, $cleanCpf, $nameToSave, $birthDateToSave) {
            $customer->update([
                'cpf'        => $cleanCpf,
                'name'       => $nameToSave,
                'birth_date' => $birthDateToSave
            ]);

            $safeEmail = "cliente_" . strtolower(Str::random(6)) . "@brasume.com";

            $user = User::create([
                'name'      => $nameToSave,
                'email'     => $safeEmail,
                'password'  => Hash::make($cleanCpf),
                'is_active' => true,
            ]);

            $customer->update(['user_id' => $user->id]);

            $pastOrders = Order::where('customer_id', $customer->id)
                ->whereIn('status', ['closed', 'completed'])
                ->where('loyalty_points_earned', 0)
                ->get();

            foreach ($pastOrders as $pastOrder) {
                $this->loyaltyService->earnPoints($pastOrder, $customer);
            }

            return $user;
        });
    }

    public function completeSocialRegistration(array $data, ?int $guestId, SerproService $serproService): User
    {
        $pending = session('pending_social_auth');
        if (!$pending) {
            throw new Exception('Sessão de cadastro expirada. Faça login novamente.', 419);
        }

        $cleanCpf = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $data['cpf']);

        $nameToSave = $data['name'] ?? ($data['fallback_name'] ?? $pending['name']);
        $birthDateToSave = $data['birth_date'] ?? ($data['fallback_birth_date'] ?? null);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($pending, $cleanCpf, $nameToSave, $birthDateToSave, $guestId) {
            $user = User::firstOrCreate(
                ['email' => $pending['email']],
                [
                    'name'      => $nameToSave,
                    'password'  => bcrypt(Str::random(24)),
                    'is_active' => true
                ]
            );

            $targetCustomer = $guestId ? Customer::find($guestId) : null;

            if ($targetCustomer && is_null($targetCustomer->user_id)) {
                $targetCustomer->update([
                    'user_id'    => $user->id,
                    'cpf'        => $cleanCpf,
                    'name'       => $nameToSave,
                    'birth_date' => $birthDateToSave,
                    'email'      => $pending['email']
                ]);
            } else {
                $targetCustomer = Customer::firstOrCreate(
                    ['email' => $pending['email']],
                    [
                        'user_id'    => $user->id,
                        'cpf'        => $cleanCpf,
                        'name'       => $nameToSave,
                        'birth_date' => $birthDateToSave,
                        'is_active'  => true
                    ]
                );
            }

            session()->forget(['pending_social_auth', 'guest_customer_id']);
            return $user;
        });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 🌐 ENGINE DE LOGIN SOCIAL E TRANSAÇÃO ATÔMICA ANTI-ZUMBI (RESTAURADOS)
    // =========================================================================

    public function evaluateSocialLogin(array $payload, ?int $guestId): array
    {
        Log::info("🛸 [ANTI-ZUMBI] Avaliando acesso social para: {$payload['email']}");
        $email = strtolower(trim($payload['email']));
        $user = User::where('email', $email)->first();

        // 1. Cliente já existente no banco com cadastro completo (Com CPF)
        if ($user && $user->customer && !empty($user->customer->cpf)) {
            Log::info("🛸 [ANTI-ZUMBI] Cliente com CPF validado. Autenticando imediatamente.");

            $this->mergeGuestDataToOfficialCustomer($guestId, $user->customer);

            return [
                'status' => 'authenticated',
                'user'   => $user,
                'message' => 'Login realizado com sucesso!'
            ];
        }

        // 2. Se a conta não existe, não tem CPF, ou não tem Perfil de Customer, entra em espera segura!
        Log::info("🛸 [ANTI-ZUMBI] Cliente sem CPF ou Inédito. Guardando dados na Sessão para transação futura.");
        session(['pending_social_auth' => [
            'name'      => $payload['name'],
            'email'     => $email,
            'provider'  => 'google',
            'return_to' => $payload['return_to'] ?? '/'
        ]]);

        return [
            'status'             => 'requires_cpf',
            'user'               => null,
            'pending_customer'   => [
                'name'  => $payload['name'],
                'email' => $email
            ],
            'message' => 'Por favor, informe seu CPF para concluir o acesso.'
        ];
    }

    private function mergeGuestDataToOfficialCustomer(?int $guestId, ?Customer $targetCustomer): void
    {
        if (!$guestId || !$targetCustomer) {
            return;
        }

        if ($guestId !== $targetCustomer->id) {
            Order::where('customer_id', $guestId)->update(['customer_id' => $targetCustomer->id]);
            Address::where('customer_id', $guestId)->update(['customer_id' => $targetCustomer->id]);

            $guest = Customer::find($guestId);
            if ($guest && is_null($guest->user_id)) {
                $guest->delete();
            }
        }

        session()->forget('guest_customer_id');
    }

    public function deleteCustomerAccount(?User $user, ?int $guestId): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($user, $guestId) {
            $customerToTrash = null;

            if ($user && $user->customer) {
                $customerToTrash = $user->customer;
                $user->delete();
            } elseif ($guestId) {
                $customerToTrash = Customer::find($guestId);
            }

            if ($customerToTrash) {
                $customerToTrash->update(['is_active' => false]);
                $customerToTrash->delete();
            }
        });
    }

    public function ensureUserHasCustomerProfile(User $user): void
    {
        if (!$user->customer) {
            Customer::create([
                'user_id' => $user->id,
                'name' => $user->name,
                'email' => $user->email,
                'phone' => '00000000000',
                'is_active' => true,
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function generateUniqueGhostEmail(): string
    {
        do {
            $code = strtolower(Str::random(5));
            $email = "cliente_{$code}@brasume.com";
        } while (User::where('email', $email)->exists());

        return $email;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Customers;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;

class CustomerValidationService
{
    public function checkCpfAvailability(string $rawCpf, SerproService $serpro, ?string $birthDate = null): array
    {
        $cpf = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $rawCpf);

        // 1. Validação Algorítmica Local do CPF (Módulo 11)
        if (!$this->isValidCpf($cpf)) {
            return [
                'available' => false,
                'invalid_cpf' => true,
                'message' => 'O número de CPF informado contém erros de digitação.'
            ];
        }

        // 2. Verifica duplicidade na base de clientes da empresa
        $customer = Customer::where('cpf', $cpf)->first();

        if ($customer) {
            $nameParts = explode(' ', $customer->name);
            $maskedName = $nameParts[0];
            if (count($nameParts) > 1) {
                $maskedName .= ' ' . mb_substr(end($nameParts), 0, 1) . '***';
            }

            return [
                'available'    => false,
                'cpf_exists'   => true,
                'masked_name'  => $maskedName,
                'masked_phone' => $customer->phone ? '(**) *****-' . mb_substr($customer->phone, -4) : null,
            ];
        }

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $isSerproActive = $settings
            && $settings->customer_registration_mode === 'serpro_magic'
            && !empty($settings->serpro_client_id)
            && !empty($settings->serpro_client_secret);

        // 3. Se Serpro estiver ligado E a data de nascimento for fornecida (Regra Serpro v3)
        if ($isSerproActive && !empty($birthDate)) {
            try {
                $data = $serpro->consultCpf($cpf, $birthDate);
                return [
                    'available'  => true,
                    'used_api'   => true,
                    'name'       => $data['nome'] ?? '',
                    'birth_date' => $data['nascimento'] ?? null,
                ];
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                return ['available' => true, 'used_api' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
            }
        }

        // 4. Modo Ágil / Serpro Desligado
        return ['available' => true, 'used_api' => false];
    }

    public function isValidCpf(string $cpf): bool
    {
        if (strlen($cpf) !== 11 || preg_match("/^{$cpf[0]}{11}$/", $cpf)) {
            return false;
        }

        for ($t = 9; $t < 11; $t++) {
            $d = 0;
            for ($c = 0; $c < $t; $c++) {
                $d += $cpf[$c] * (($t + 1) - $c);
            }
            $d = ((10 * $d) % 11) % 10;
            if ($cpf[$c] != $d) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Customers;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Exception;

class SerproService
{
    private $baseUrl = 'https://gateway.apiserpro.serpro.gov.br';

    public function consultCpf(string $cpf): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        if (empty($settings->serpro_client_id) || empty($settings->serpro_client_secret)) {
            Log::error("🛸 [SERPRO] Falha: Credenciais ausentes no banco de dados.");
            throw new Exception("As credenciais da Serpro não estão configuradas no painel Administrativo.", 500);
        }

        $cleanCpf = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $cpf);
        Log::info("🛸 [SERPRO] Iniciando consulta (v2) para o CPF: {$cleanCpf}");

        // 🚀 Bypass de testes ajustado para o formato com barras
        if ($cleanCpf === '00000000000') {
            return [
                'nome' => 'Usuário Teste Nativa',
                'nascimento' => '01/01/2000',
            ];
        }

        $token = $this->getAccessToken($settings->serpro_client_id, $settings->serpro_client_secret);

        $response = Http::withToken($token)
            ->withHeaders(['Accept' => 'application/json'])
            ->get("{$this->baseUrl}/consulta-cpf-df/v2/cpf/{$cleanCpf}");

        $status = $response->status();

        if ($status !== 200 && $status !== 206) {
            Log::error("🛸 [SERPRO] Falha na consulta do CPF. Status HTTP: {$status} | Corpo: {$response->body()}");
            throw new Exception("CPF protegido por LGPD ou dados não encontrados.", 403);
        }

        $data = $response->json();
        Log::info("🛸 [SERPRO] Consulta (v2) do CPF realizada com sucesso.");

        // 🚀 O SEGREDO: A v2 retorna DDMMYYYY contínuo (Ex: 15051990).
        // Vamos formatar para DD/MM/YYYY para agradar a sua API Controller.
        $dob = $data['nascimento'] ?? '';
        $dobFmt = $dob;

        if (strlen($dob) === 8 && is_numeric($dob)) {
            $dobFmt = substr($dob, 0, 2) . '/' . substr($dob, 2, 2) . '/' . substr($dob, 4, 4);
        }

        $name = !empty($data['nomeSocial']) ? $data['nomeSocial'] : ($data['nome'] ?? '');

        return [
            'nome' => ucwords(strtolower($name)),
            'nascimento' => $dobFmt
        ];
    }

    private function getAccessToken($clientId, $clientSecret): string
    {
        Log::info("🛸 [SERPRO] Solicitando novo token de acesso...");

        $response = Http::withBasicAuth($clientId, $clientSecret)
            ->asForm()
            ->post("{$this->baseUrl}/token", [
                'grant_type' => 'client_credentials',
            ]);

        if ($response->failed()) {
            Log::error("🛸 [SERPRO] Falha na geração do token. Status HTTP: {$response->status()} | Corpo: {$response->body()}");
            throw new Exception("Falha ao autenticar na Serpro. Verifique as chaves.");
        }

        Log::info("🛸 [SERPRO] Token gerado com sucesso.");
        return $response->json('access_token');
    }
}
```
