```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Financial\Gateways;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Exception;

class SicrediPixGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private $settings;
    private $baseUrl;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $this->baseUrl = 'https://api-pix.sicredi.com.br';
    }

    private function getHttpOptions(): array
    {
        $certRelativePath = $this->settings->sicredi_cert_path;
        $keyRelativePath  = $this->settings->sicredi_key_path;

        if (empty($certRelativePath) || empty($keyRelativePath)) {
            throw new Exception("Caminhos vazios! Por favor, anexe os certificados no painel antes de testar.");
        }

        $certPath = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage::disk('local')->path($certRelativePath);
        $keyPath  = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage::disk('local')->path($keyRelativePath);

        if (!file_exists($certPath)) {
            throw new Exception("Certificado mTLS não encontrado no cofre privado: {$certPath}");
        }

        if (!file_exists($keyPath)) {
            throw new Exception("Chave privada mTLS não encontrada no cofre privado: {$keyPath}");
        }

        return [
            'cert'    => $certPath,
            'ssl_key' => $keyPath,
        ];
    }

    public function obterTokenOauth(): string
    {
        $response = Http::withOptions($this->getHttpOptions())
            ->withBasicAuth($this->settings->sicredi_client_id, $this->settings->sicredi_client_secret)
            ->asForm()
            ->post("{$this->baseUrl}/oauth/token", [
                'grant_type' => 'client_credentials',
                'scope'      => 'cob.write cob.read webhook.read webhook.write'
            ]);

        if ($response->successful()) {
            return $response->json('access_token');
        }

        Log::error('Erro Sicredi OAuth', ['response' => $response->body()]);
        throw new Exception("Falha no Handshake mTLS com Sicredi: " . $response->json('detail', $response->body()));
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 Higienização blindada da Chave PIX segundo regras do BACEN.
     * Evita que o app do cliente retorne "PIX Inválido".
     */
    private function sanitizePixKey(string $key): string
    {
        $key = trim($key);

        // Se for E-mail, retorna limpo
        if (filter_var($key, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            return $key;
        }

        // Se for Chave Aleatória (EVP/UUID), retorna em minúsculas
        if (preg_match('/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i', $key)) {
            return strtolower($key);
        }

        // Remove tudo que não for número (para limpar máscaras de CPF, CNPJ e Celular)
        $digits = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $key);

        // Se o usuário digitou o telefone já com o +55
        if (str_starts_with($key, '+55') && (strlen($digits) === 12 || strlen($digits) === 13)) {
            return '+' . $digits;
        }

        // Se for telefone com DDD (10 ou 11 dígitos), injeta o +55 obrigatório do BACEN
        if (strlen($digits) === 10 || strlen($digits) === 11) {
            return '+55' . $digits;
        }

        // Retorna apenas números para CPF (11) ou CNPJ (14)
        return $digits;
    }

    public function generatePayment($order, $amount): array
    {
        $token = $this->obterTokenOauth();
        $txid = $this->generateTxid();

        $chaveLimpa = $this->sanitizePixKey($this->settings->sicredi_chave_pix);

        $payload = [
            "calendario" => ["expiracao" => 600],
            "valor" => [
                "original" => number_format($amount, 2, '.', ''),
                "modalidadeAlteracao" => 0
            ],
            "chave" => $chaveLimpa,
            "solicitacaoPagador" => "Pedido #" . $order->id,
        ];

        $response = Http::withOptions($this->getHttpOptions())
            ->withToken($token)
            ->put("{$this->baseUrl}/api/v3/cob/{$txid}", $payload);

        if ($response->successful()) {
            $data = $response->json();
            return [
                'qr_code' => $data['pixCopiaECola'],
                'txid'    => $data['txid'],
                'status'  => 'pending'
            ];
        }

        Log::error('Erro Sicredi Gerar COB', ['payload' => $payload, 'response' => $response->body()]);
        throw new Exception("Erro ao gerar PIX Sicredi: " . $response->json('detail', $response->body()));
    }

    private function generateTxid(): string
    {
        return substr(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/', '', (string) Str::uuid() . Str::random(10)), 0, 30);
    }

    public function testHandshake(): array
    {
        try {
            $token = $this->obterTokenOauth();
            return [
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Handshake mTLS estabelecido com sucesso!',
                'token_preview' => substr($token, 0, 15) . '...'
            ];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }

    public function generateTestPix(): array
    {
        try {
            $token = $this->obterTokenOauth();
            $txid = $this->generateTxid();

            $chaveLimpa = $this->sanitizePixKey($this->settings->sicredi_chave_pix);

            $payload = [
                "calendario" => ["expiracao" => 300],
                "valor" => ["original" => "0.01", "modalidadeAlteracao" => 0],
                "chave" => $chaveLimpa,
                "solicitacaoPagador" => "PIX TESTE DE CONECTIVIDADE",
            ];

            $response = Http::withOptions($this->getHttpOptions())
                ->withToken($token)
                ->put("{$this->baseUrl}/api/v3/cob/{$txid}", $payload);

            if ($response->successful()) {
                return [
                    'success' => true,
                    'message' => 'PIX de teste gerado!',
                    'txid' => $txid,
                    'copia_e_cola' => $response->json('pixCopiaECola')
                ];
            }

            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $response->json('detail', $response->body())];

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }

    public function validateWebhookToken(string $tokenReceived): bool
    {
        if (!empty($this->settings->sicredi_webhook_token)) {
            return hash_equals($this->settings->sicredi_webhook_token, $tokenReceived);
        }

        $expectedToken = md5(($this->settings->sicredi_client_id ?? '') . ($this->settings->sicredi_client_secret ?? ''));
        return hash_equals($expectedToken, $tokenReceived);
    }

    public function testConnection(): bool
    {
        try {
            $this->obterTokenOauth();
            return true;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 Alterado para buscar o TXID de forma inteligente (suporta Model Order ou Payment)
     */
    public function refundPayment($model, $amount): array
    {
        $token = $this->obterTokenOauth();

        // Extrai o txid do modelo enviado (seja ele Order ou Payment), ou busca do relacionamento se aplicável
        $txid = $model->txid ?? (method_exists($model, 'payments') ? $model->payments()->whereNotNull('txid')->latest('id')->value('txid') : null);

        if (!$txid) {
            throw new Exception("Não foi possível localizar o TXID do pagamento para realizar o estorno.");
        }

        $responseCob = Http::withOptions($this->getHttpOptions())
            ->withToken($token)
            ->get("{$this->baseUrl}/api/v3/cob/{$txid}");

        if (!$responseCob->successful() || empty($responseCob->json('pix'))) {
            throw new Exception("Não foi possível localizar o pagamento original na API do Sicredi para realizar o estorno.");
        }

        $e2eid = $responseCob->json('pix')[0]['endToEndId'];
        $idControleDevolucao = str_replace('-', '', (string) Str::uuid());

        $payload = [
            "valor" => number_format($amount, 2, '.', '')
        ];

        $responseDevolucao = Http::withOptions($this->getHttpOptions())
            ->withToken($token)
            ->put("{$this->baseUrl}/api/v2/pix/{$e2eid}/devolucao/{$idControleDevolucao}", $payload);

        if ($responseDevolucao->successful()) {
            return [
                'success' => true,
                'devolucao_id' => $idControleDevolucao,
                'status' => $responseDevolucao->json('status')
            ];
        }

        Log::error('Erro Sicredi Estorno', ['payload' => $payload, 'response' => $responseDevolucao->body()]);
        throw new Exception("Erro ao estornar PIX Sicredi: " . $responseDevolucao->json('detail', $responseDevolucao->body()));
    }

    public function registerWebhook(string $webhookUrl): array
    {
        $token = $this->obterTokenOauth();
        $chavePix = $this->sanitizePixKey($this->settings->sicredi_chave_pix);

        $response = Http::withOptions($this->getHttpOptions())
            ->withToken($token)
            ->put("{$this->baseUrl}/api/v2/webhook/{$chavePix}", [
                'webhookUrl' => $webhookUrl
            ]);

        if ($response->successful()) {
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Webhook registrado com sucesso!'];
        }

        Log::error('Erro Sicredi Webhook', ['response' => $response->body()]);
        throw new Exception("Erro ao registrar Webhook: " . $response->json('detail', $response->body()));
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Financial/PaymentGatewayManager.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Financial;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Exception;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use App\Services\Financial\Gateways\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use App\Services\Financial\Gateways\SicrediPixGateway;

class PaymentGatewayManager
{
    /**
     * Retorna a lista de integrações para o Filament
     */
    public static function getAvailableGateways(): array
    {
        return [
            'sicredi_pix' => 'Sicredi: PIX Dinâmico',
            'mercado_pago_pix' => 'Mercado Pago: PIX (Em Breve)',
        ];
    }

    public function resolveGateway(string $gatewayDriver): PaymentGatewayInterface
    {
        return match ($gatewayDriver) {
            'sicredi_pix' => new SicrediPixGateway(),
            default => throw new Exception("Gateway não suportado para o driver: {$gatewayDriver}"),
        };
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 LÓGICA DE UX EXTRAÍDA: Analisa e devolve o HTML do Status para o Form!
     */
    public static function getCredentialStatusHtml(?string $driver): HtmlString
    {
        if (!$driver) return new HtmlString('-');

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        // REGRAS DO SICREDI
        if ($driver === 'sicredi_pix') {
            if (!$settings->sicredi_is_active) {
                return new HtmlString('<span class="text-danger-600 font-medium">❌ Integração Desativada:</span> O Sicredi está desligado nas Configurações.');
            }
            if (empty($settings->sicredi_client_id) || empty($settings->sicredi_cert_path) || empty($settings->sicredi_key_path)) {
                return new HtmlString('<span class="text-warning-600 font-medium">⚠️ Faltam Credenciais:</span> Preencha o Client ID, Secret e os Certificados nas Configurações.');
            }

            try {
                // Tenta o Handshake!
                $gateway = new SicrediPixGateway();
                if ($gateway->testConnection()) {
                    return new HtmlString('<span class="text-success-600 font-medium">Online:</span> Comunicação mTLS com o Sicredi estabelecida com sucesso!');
                }
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                return new HtmlString('<span class="text-danger-600 font-medium">❌ Erro de Conexão:</span> ' . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        // REGRAS DO MERCADO PAGO (Exemplo Futuro)
        if (str_starts_with($driver, 'mercado_pago')) {
            if (!$settings->mp_is_active) {
                return new HtmlString('<span class="text-danger-600 font-medium">❌ Integração Desativada:</span> O Mercado Pago está desligado nas Configurações.');
            }
            return new HtmlString('<span class="text-warning-600 font-medium">⏳ Em Desenvolvimento:</span> Disponível em breve.');
        }

        return new HtmlString('-');
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Fiscal/FiscalExportService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Fiscal;

use App\Models\FiscalDocument;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf;
use ZipArchive;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Exception;

class FiscalExportService
{
    public function generateXmlZip(string $startDate, string $endDate): string
    {
        $documents = FiscalDocument::whereBetween('issue_date', [$startDate, $endDate])
            ->where('status', 'authorized')
            ->whereNotNull('xml_content')
            ->get();

        if ($documents->isEmpty()) {
            throw new Exception("Nenhum documento fiscal autorizado encontrado no período especificado.");
        }

        $tempDir = storage_path('app/temp_fiscal_exports');
        if (!file_exists($tempDir)) {
            mkdir($tempDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $zipFileName = "XMLs_NFCe_{$startDate}_a_{$endDate}.zip";
        $zipFilePath = $tempDir . '/' . $zipFileName;

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($zipFilePath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) === TRUE) {
            foreach ($documents as $doc) {
                $filename = "{$doc->access_key}-nfce.xml";
                $zip->addFromString($filename, $doc->xml_content);
            }
            $zip->close();
        } else {
            throw new Exception("Falha ao criar o arquivo ZIP.");
        }

        return $zipFilePath;
    }

    private function getLogoBase64(?string $logoPath): ?string
    {
        if ($logoPath && Storage::disk('public')->exists($logoPath)) {
            $logoContent = Storage::disk('public')->get($logoPath);
            $logoMime = Storage::disk('public')->mimeType($logoPath);
            return 'data:' . $logoMime . ';base64,' . base64_encode($logoContent);
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function generateGeneralReportPdf(string $startDate, string $endDate): string
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::first();

        // FILTRO: Apenas autorizadas
        $documents = FiscalDocument::with(['order.payments.paymentMethod'])
            ->whereBetween('issue_date', [$startDate, $endDate])
            ->where('status', 'authorized')
            ->orderBy('issue_date')
            ->get();

        $totalFaturado = $documents->sum('total_value');
        $logoBase64 = $this->getLogoBase64($settings->logo_path);

        $pdf = Pdf::loadView('reports.fiscal_general', [
            'settings' => $settings,
            'documents' => $documents,
            'startDate' => Carbon::parse($startDate)->format('d/m/Y'),
            'endDate' => Carbon::parse($endDate)->format('d/m/Y'),
            'totalFaturado' => $totalFaturado,
            'logoBase64' => $logoBase64,
        ])->setPaper('a4', 'landscape');

        $tempDir = storage_path('app/temp_fiscal_exports');
        if (!file_exists($tempDir)) {
            mkdir($tempDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $filePath = $tempDir . "/Relatorio_Fiscal_Geral_{$startDate}_a_{$endDate}.pdf";
        $pdf->save($filePath);

        return $filePath;
    }

    public function generateMonophasicReportPdf(string $startDate, string $endDate): string
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::first();

        $monophasicItems = \App\Models\OrderItem::whereHas('order.fiscalDocument', function ($q) use ($startDate, $endDate) {
                $q->whereBetween('issue_date', [$startDate, $endDate])
                  ->where('status', 'authorized');
            })
            ->whereHas('product', function ($q) {
                $q->where('fiscal_ncm', 'like', '2201%')
                  ->orWhere('fiscal_ncm', 'like', '2202%')
                  ->orWhere('fiscal_ncm', 'like', '2203%');
            })
            ->with(['product', 'order.fiscalDocument'])
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('product.name')
            ->map(function ($items, $productName) {
                return [
                    'name' => $productName,
                    'total_qty' => $items->sum('quantity'),
                    'total_value' => $items->sum('total_price'),
                ];
            });

        $totalFaturado = $monophasicItems->sum('total_value');
        $logoBase64 = $this->getLogoBase64($settings->logo_path);

        $pdf = Pdf::loadView('reports.fiscal_monophasic', [
            'settings' => $settings,
            'items' => $monophasicItems,
            'startDate' => Carbon::parse($startDate)->format('d/m/Y'),
            'endDate' => Carbon::parse($endDate)->format('d/m/Y'),
            'totalFaturado' => $totalFaturado,
            'logoBase64' => $logoBase64,
        ]);

        $tempDir = storage_path('app/temp_fiscal_exports');
        if (!file_exists($tempDir)) {
            mkdir($tempDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $filePath = $tempDir . "/Relatorio_Monofasicos_{$startDate}_a_{$endDate}.pdf";
        $pdf->save($filePath);

        return $filePath;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Fiscal;

use App\Models\LegacyPaymentMethod;
use App\Models\LegacyCustomer;
use App\Models\LegacyOrder;
use App\Models\LegacyOrderItem;
use App\Models\LegacyOrderPayment;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class LegacyFiscalImportService
{
    public function processV2XmlContent(string $xmlContent, string $tag): string
    {
        // 1. Remove os Null Bytes (\x00) e o BOM (Byte Order Mark) que corrompem o parser
        $xmlContent = str_replace("\x00", "", $xmlContent);
        $xmlContent = preg_replace('/^[\xef\xbb\xbf]+/', '', $xmlContent);

        // 🚀 2. A BUSCA CIRÚRGICA (Sem estourar a memória do PHP)
        // Usa o PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE apenas para encontrar a POSIÇÃO exata onde o XML real começa.
        if (preg_match('/(<\?xml|<nfeProc|<NFe)/i', $xmlContent, $matches, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE)) {
            // Corta o arquivo a partir dessa posição até ao fim (ignora 100% do lixo binário anterior)
            $xmlContent = substr($xmlContent, $matches[0][1]);
        } else {
            throw new \Exception("Nenhuma estrutura XML válida encontrada no arquivo.");
        }

        // 3. Remove os namespaces e prefixos que atrapalham o SimpleXML do PHP
        $cleanXml = preg_replace('/xmlns[^=]*="[^"]*"/i', '', $xmlContent);
        $cleanXml = preg_replace('/<[a-zA-Z0-9]+:([a-zA-Z0-9]+)/i', '<$1', $cleanXml);
        $cleanXml = preg_replace('/<\/[a-zA-Z0-9]+:([a-zA-Z0-9]+)>/i', '</$1>', $cleanXml);

        libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $xml = @simplexml_load_string($cleanXml);

        if (!$xml) {
            $errors = libxml_get_errors();
            libxml_clear_errors();
            $firstError = $errors[0]->message ?? 'Erro de formatação estrutural';
            throw new \Exception("XML Malformado ({$firstError})");
        }

        $rootName = $xml->getName();

        // 🚀 DIAGNÓSTICO: Identificar Eventos (Cancelamentos, Cartas de Correção)
        if (in_array($rootName, ['procEventoNFe', 'evento'])) {
            $desc = $xml->evento->infEvento->detEvento->descEvento ?? 'Evento Fiscal Indefinido';
            throw new \Exception("Ignorado: XML de {$desc}");
        }

        // 🚀 DIAGNÓSTICO: Identificar Inutilização
        if (in_array($rootName, ['procInutNFe', 'inutNFe'])) {
            throw new \Exception("Ignorado: XML de Inutilização de Numeração");
        }

        // 🚀 DIAGNÓSTICO: Identificar SAT (Caso usem CFe em SP/CE)
        if ($rootName === 'CFe') {
            throw new \Exception("Ignorado: Cupom SAT (CFe) não suportado neste parser");
        }

        $infNFe = $xml->NFe->infNFe ?? $xml->infNFe ?? null;
        if (!$infNFe) {
            throw new \Exception("Tag <infNFe> ausente. Raiz encontrada: <{$rootName}>");
        }

        $fullKey = (string) $infNFe->attributes()->Id;
        $accessKey = preg_replace("/[^0-9]/", "", $fullKey);

        if (strlen($accessKey) !== 44) throw new \Exception("Chave de acesso inválida ({$accessKey})");
        if (FiscalDocument::where("access_key", $accessKey)->exists()) return "duplicate";

        $model = (string) $infNFe->ide->mod;
        $series = (string) $infNFe->ide->serie;
        $number = (string) $infNFe->ide->nNF;
        $issueDate = (string) $infNFe->ide->dhEmi;
        $totalValue = (float) $infNFe->total->ICMSTot->vNF;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($infNFe, $accessKey, $model, $series, $number, $issueDate, $totalValue, $xmlContent, $tag) {
            // 1. Clientes
            if (isset($infNFe->dest)) {
                $nome = (string) ($infNFe->dest->xNome ?? "");
                if (!empty($nome) && !str_contains(strtoupper($nome), "CONSUMIDOR")) {
                    LegacyCustomer::firstOrCreate(["legacy_name" => trim($nome)]);
                }
            }

            // 2. Pagamentos
            if (isset($infNFe->pag->detPag)) {
                $paymentNames = ["01" => "Dinheiro", "02" => "Cheque", "03" => "Cartão de Crédito", "04" => "Cartão de Débito", "05" => "Crédito Loja", "15" => "Boleto", "17" => "PIX", "90" => "Sem Pagamento", "99" => "Outros"];
                foreach ($infNFe->pag->detPag as $detPag) {
                    $tPag = (string) $detPag->tPag;
                    if (!empty($tPag)) {
                        LegacyPaymentMethod::firstOrCreate(
                            ["sefaz_code" => $tPag],
                            ["name" => $paymentNames[$tPag] ?? "Sefaz Código $tPag"]
                        );
                    }
                }
            }

            // 3. Produtos
            if (isset($infNFe->det)) {
                foreach ($infNFe->det as $det) {
                    $prod = $det->prod;
                    $cEAN = (string) $prod->cEAN;
                    LegacyProduct::firstOrCreate(
                        ["name" => trim((string) $prod->xProd)],
                        ["legacy_code" => (string) $prod->cProd, "ean" => $cEAN === "SEM GTIN" || empty($cEAN) ? null : $cEAN]
                    );
                }
            }

            // 4. Staging
            FiscalDocument::create([
                "import_tag" => $tag, "model" => $model ?: '65', "series" => $series,
                "number" => $number, "access_key" => $accessKey, "issue_date" => Carbon::parse($issueDate),
                "total_value" => $totalValue, "status" => "processing", "xml_content" => $xmlContent
            ]);
        });

        return "imported";
    }

    public function mapFiscalDocuments(string $tag): array
    {
        $docs = FiscalDocument::where('import_tag', $tag)->where('status', 'processing')->get();
        if ($docs->isEmpty()) return ['matched' => 0, 'created' => 0];

        $matchedCount = 0; $createdCount = 0;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($docs, &$matchedCount, &$createdCount) {
            foreach ($docs as $doc) {
                $match = LegacyOrder::whereDate('issue_date', $doc->issue_date->toDateString())
                    ->where('total_value', $doc->total_value)->whereNull('nfe_key')->first();

                if ($match) {
                    $match->update(['nfe_key' => $doc->access_key, 'series' => $doc->series, 'number' => $doc->number, 'xml_content' => $doc->xml_content]);
                    $doc->update(['status' => 'authorized']);
                    $matchedCount++;
                } else {
                    $xml = @simplexml_load_string(str_replace("xmlns=", "ns=", $doc->xml_content));
                    if (!$xml) continue;

                    $infNFe = $xml->NFe->infNFe ?? $xml->infNFe;
                    $newOrder = LegacyOrder::create([
                        'import_tag' => $doc->import_tag, 'nfe_key' => $doc->access_key, 'series' => $doc->series,
                        'number' => $doc->number, 'issue_date' => $doc->issue_date, 'total_value' => $doc->total_value,
                        'discount' => (float) ($infNFe->total->ICMSTot->vDesc ?? 0), 'status' => 'completed', 'xml_content' => $doc->xml_content,
                    ]);

                    if (isset($infNFe->pag->detPag)) {
                        foreach ($infNFe->pag->detPag as $detPag) {
                            $legacyPayment = LegacyPaymentMethod::where('sefaz_code', (string) $detPag->tPag)->first();
                            if ($legacyPayment) {
                                LegacyOrderPayment::create(['legacy_order_id' => $newOrder->id, 'legacy_payment_method_id' => $legacyPayment->id, 'amount' => (float) $detPag->vPag]);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (isset($infNFe->det)) {
                        foreach ($infNFe->det as $det) {
                            $legacyProd = LegacyProduct::where('name', trim((string) $det->prod->xProd))->first();
                            if ($legacyProd && !$legacyProd->is_ignored) {
                                LegacyOrderItem::create(['legacy_order_id' => $newOrder->id, 'legacy_product_id' => $legacyProd->id, 'quantity' => (float) $det->prod->qCom, 'unit_price' => (float) $det->prod->vUnCom, 'total_price' => (float) $det->prod->vProd]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    $doc->update(['status' => 'authorized']);
                    $createdCount++;
                }
            }
        });

        return ['matched' => $matchedCount, 'created' => $createdCount];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Marketing;

use App\Models\Coupon;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\Customer;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class CouponService
{
    public function applyCoupon(string $code, float $cartSubtotal, ?int $customerId = null, bool $isPos = false): array
    {
        $coupon = Coupon::where('code', strtoupper(trim($code)))->first();

        if (!$coupon) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Cupom inválido ou não encontrado.'];
        }

        $validation = $this->validateRules($coupon, $cartSubtotal, $customerId, $isPos);

        if (!$validation['success']) {
            return $validation;
        }

        return [
            'success'   => true,
            'message'   => 'Cupom aplicado com sucesso!',
            'coupon_id' => $coupon->id,
            'code'      => $coupon->code,
            'type'      => $coupon->type,
            'value'     => (float) $coupon->value,
            'is_pos_only' => (bool) $coupon->is_pos_only,
        ];
    }

    private function validateRules(Coupon $coupon, float $cartSubtotal, ?int $customerId = null, bool $isPos = false): array
    {
        if (!$coupon->is_active) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Este cupom está desativado.'];
        }

        // 🚀 BLINDAGEM DE CANAL: Clientes no CustomerApp não podem usar cupons de caixa
        if ($coupon->is_pos_only && !$isPos) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Este cupom é de uso exclusivo no caixa do estabelecimento.'];
        }

        if ($coupon->starts_at && now()->lessThan($coupon->starts_at)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Este cupom ainda não é válido.'];
        }

        if ($coupon->expires_at && now()->greaterThan($coupon->expires_at)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Este cupom já expirou.'];
        }

        if ($coupon->global_usage_limit > 0 && $coupon->usage_count >= $coupon->global_usage_limit) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Este cupom esgotou.'];
        }

        if ($coupon->min_subtotal > 0 && $cartSubtotal < (float) $coupon->min_subtotal) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Valor mínimo para este cupom é R$ ' . number_format($coupon->min_subtotal, 2, ',', '.')];
        }

        if ($coupon->customer_id && $coupon->customer_id !== $customerId) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Este cupom é exclusivo para outro cliente.'];
        }

        if ($customerId) {
            if ($coupon->user_usage_limit > 0) {
                $userUsages = $coupon->orders()
                    ->where('customer_id', $customerId)
                    ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'voided', 'failed', 'refunded', 'pending_payment'])
                    ->count();

                if ($userUsages >= $coupon->user_usage_limit) {
                    return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Limite de uso atingido para este cliente.'];
                }
            }

            if ($coupon->first_order_only) {
                $hasValidOrders = Order::where('customer_id', $customerId)
                    ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'voided', 'failed', 'refunded', 'pending_payment'])
                    ->exists();

                if ($hasValidOrders) {
                    return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Cupom exclusivo para primeira compra.'];
                }
            }
        } elseif (!$isPos && ($coupon->first_order_only || $coupon->user_usage_limit > 0)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Faça login para usar este cupom.'];
        }

        return ['success' => true];
    }

    /**
     * Lista todos os cupons disponíveis para o operador de PDV escolher
     */
    public function getAvailableCouponsForPos(float $cartSubtotal = 0, ?int $customerId = null): array
    {
        $coupons = Coupon::query()
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->where(function ($q) {
                $q->whereNull('starts_at')->orWhere('starts_at', '<=', now());
            })
            ->where(function ($q) {
                $q->whereNull('expires_at')->orWhere('expires_at', '>=', now());
            })
            ->where(function ($q) use ($customerId) {
                $q->whereNull('customer_id');
                if ($customerId) {
                    $q->orWhere('customer_id', $customerId);
                }
            })
            ->orderBy('is_pos_only', 'desc')
            ->orderBy('value', 'desc')
            ->get();

        $result = [];

        foreach ($coupons as $coupon) {
            // Checa limite global
            if ($coupon->global_usage_limit > 0 && $coupon->usage_count >= $coupon->global_usage_limit) {
                continue;
            }

            $meetsMinSubtotal = ($coupon->min_subtotal <= 0 || $cartSubtotal >= (float) $coupon->min_subtotal);

            $result[] = [
                'id'                 => $coupon->id,
                'code'               => $coupon->code,
                'name'               => $coupon->name ?: $coupon->code,
                'label'              => $this->getCouponDiscountLabel($coupon),
                'type'               => $coupon->type,
                'value'              => (float) $coupon->value,
                'min_subtotal'       => (float) $coupon->min_subtotal,
                'meets_subtotal'     => $meetsMinSubtotal,
                'is_pos_only'        => (bool) $coupon->is_pos_only,
                'first_order_only'   => (bool) $coupon->first_order_only,
                'is_customer_bound'  => !is_null($coupon->customer_id),
                'description'        => $coupon->description ?: ($coupon->min_subtotal > 0
                    ? 'Mínimo: R$ ' . number_format($coupon->min_subtotal, 2, ',', '.')
                    : 'Sem valor mínimo'),
            ];
        }

        return $result;
    }

    public function calculateDiscountValue(Coupon $coupon, float $cartSubtotal, float $deliveryFee = 0, float $serviceFee = 0): float
    {
        if ($coupon->type === 'free_delivery') return $deliveryFee;
        if ($coupon->type === 'fixed') return min((float) $coupon->value, $cartSubtotal);
        if ($coupon->type === 'percent') return round($cartSubtotal * ($coupon->value / 100), 2);

        if ($coupon->type === 'fixed_total') {
            $totalBruto = $cartSubtotal + $deliveryFee + $serviceFee;
            $descontoNecessario = $totalBruto - (float) $coupon->value;

            return $descontoNecessario > 0 ? $descontoNecessario : 0.00;
        }

        return 0.00;
    }

    public function getWalletForCustomer(?int $customerId): array
    {
        $wallet = [];

        // 🚀 Oculta cupons de PDV da carteira do cliente final
        $publicCoupons = Coupon::whereNull('customer_id')
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->where('is_pos_only', false)
            ->where(function ($q) {
                $q->whereNull('starts_at')->orWhere('starts_at', '<=', now());
            })
            ->where(function ($q) {
                $q->whereNull('expires_at')->orWhere('expires_at', '>=', now());
            })
            ->get();

        foreach ($publicCoupons as $coupon) {
            if ($this->isCouponAvailableFor($coupon, $customerId)) {
                $wallet[] = $this->formatCouponForFrontend($coupon);
            }
        }

        if (!$customerId) {
            return $wallet;
        }

        $this->generateAutomatedCouponsIfNeeded($customerId);

        $exclusiveCoupons = Coupon::where('customer_id', $customerId)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->where('is_pos_only', false)
            ->where(function ($q) {
                $q->whereNull('expires_at')->orWhere('expires_at', '>=', now());
            })
            ->get();

        foreach ($exclusiveCoupons as $coupon) {
            if ($this->isCouponAvailableFor($coupon, $customerId)) {
                $wallet[] = $this->formatCouponForFrontend($coupon, true);
            }
        }

        return $wallet;
    }

    private function generateAutomatedCouponsIfNeeded(int $customerId): void
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $customer = Customer::find($customerId);

        if (!$customer || !$settings) return;

        if ($settings->auto_birthday_coupon && $customer->birth_date) {
            $isBirthday = Carbon::parse($customer->birth_date)->isBirthday();

            if ($isBirthday) {
                $receivedRecently = Coupon::where('customer_id', $customerId)
                    ->where('code', 'LIKE', 'NIVER%')
                    ->where('created_at', '>=', now()->subMonths(11))
                    ->exists();

                if (!$receivedRecently) {
                    Coupon::create([
                        'code'             => 'NIVER' . strtoupper(Str::random(4)),
                        'type'             => 'percent',
                        'value'            => 20,
                        'customer_id'      => $customerId,
                        'is_active'        => true,
                        'is_pos_only'      => false,
                        'expires_at'       => now()->endOfDay(),
                        'user_usage_limit' => 1,
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }

        if ($settings->auto_churn_coupon) {
            $lastOrder = Order::where('customer_id', $customerId)->latest('created_at')->first();

            if ($lastOrder && $lastOrder->created_at->diffInDays(now()) >= $settings->churn_days_threshold) {
                $alreadyHasChurnCoupon = Coupon::where('customer_id', $customerId)
                    ->where('code', 'LIKE', 'VOLTA%')
                    ->where('is_active', true)
                    ->where('expires_at', '>', now())
                    ->exists();

                if (!$alreadyHasChurnCoupon) {
                    Coupon::create([
                        'code'             => 'VOLTA' . strtoupper(Str::random(4)),
                        'type'             => 'percent',
                        'value'            => 15,
                        'customer_id'      => $customerId,
                        'is_active'        => true,
                        'is_pos_only'      => false,
                        'expires_at'       => now()->addDays(7),
                        'user_usage_limit' => 1,
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function isCouponAvailableFor(Coupon $coupon, ?int $customerId): bool
    {
        if ($coupon->global_usage_limit > 0 && $coupon->usage_count >= $coupon->global_usage_limit) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($customerId && $coupon->user_usage_limit > 0) {
            $userUsages = $coupon->orders()
                ->where('customer_id', $customerId)
                ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'voided', 'failed', 'refunded'])
                ->count();

            if ($userUsages >= $coupon->user_usage_limit) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function getCouponDiscountLabel(Coupon $coupon): string
    {
        if ($coupon->type === 'free_delivery') return 'Entrega Grátis';
        if ($coupon->type === 'fixed') return 'R$ ' . number_format($coupon->value, 2, ',', '.') . ' OFF';
        if ($coupon->type === 'percent') return round($coupon->value, 0) . '% OFF';
        if ($coupon->type === 'fixed_total') return 'Total Fixo R$ ' . number_format($coupon->value, 2, ',', '.');

        return 'Desconto';
    }

    private function formatCouponForFrontend(Coupon $coupon, bool $isExclusive = false): array
    {
        $purpose = 'general';
        if (str_starts_with($coupon->code, 'NIVER')) $purpose = 'birthday';
        if (str_starts_with($coupon->code, 'VOLTA')) $purpose = 'churn';

        return [
            'id'           => $coupon->id,
            'code'         => $coupon->code,
            'label'        => $this->getCouponDiscountLabel($coupon),
            'description'  => $coupon->min_subtotal > 0 ? "Em pedidos acima de R$ " . number_format($coupon->min_subtotal, 2, ',', '.') : 'Sem valor mínimo',
            'is_exclusive' => $isExclusive,
            'purpose'      => $purpose,
            'expires_at'   => $coupon->expires_at ? $coupon->expires_at->toIso8601String() : null,
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Marketing;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\Coupon;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\OrderRating;

class CrmService
{
    public function getDashboardData(): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $startOfMonth = now()->startOfMonth();

        // 1. Métricas Gerais
        $totalDiscount = Order::where('created_at', '>=', $startOfMonth)->sum('discount');
        $salesFromCoupons = Order::whereNotNull('coupon_id')->where('created_at', '>=', $startOfMonth)->sum('total');

        // 2. Garimpo de Oportunidades (Aniversários e Churn)
        $opportunities = collect();

        $birthdays = Customer::whereNotNull('birth_date')
            ->whereMonth('birth_date', now()->month)
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($c) {
                return [
                    'id' => $c->id, 'name' => $c->name, 'phone' => $c->phone, 'reason' => 'birthday',
                    'last_order_days' => $c->orders()->latest('created_at')->first()?->created_at->diffInDays(now()) ?? 'Muitos'
                ];
            });
        $opportunities = $opportunities->merge($birthdays);

        $churnThreshold = $settings->churn_days_threshold ?? 30;
        $inactiveCustomers = Customer::whereHas('orders', function ($q) use ($churnThreshold) {
                $q->where('created_at', '<', now()->subDays($churnThreshold));
            })
            ->whereDoesntHave('orders', function ($q) use ($churnThreshold) {
                $q->where('created_at', '>=', now()->subDays($churnThreshold));
            })
            ->whereNotNull('phone')
            ->take(15)
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($c) use ($churnThreshold) {
                return [
                    'id' => $c->id, 'name' => $c->name, 'phone' => $c->phone, 'reason' => 'churn',
                    'last_order_days' => $c->orders()->latest('created_at')->first()?->created_at->diffInDays(now()) ?? $churnThreshold
                ];
            });
        $opportunities = $opportunities->merge($inactiveCustomers);

        // 3. Avaliações (Order Ratings)
        $ratings = OrderRating::with('customer:id,name,phone')
            ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->take(50)->get()
            ->map(function ($r) {
                return [
                    'id' => $r->id, 'order_id' => $r->order_id, 'customer_name' => $r->customer->name ?? 'Visitante',
                    'customer_phone' => $r->customer->phone ?? null, 'rating' => $r->rating,
                    'tags' => $r->tags ?? [], 'comment' => $r->comment, 'created_at' => $r->created_at->toIso8601String(),
                ];
            });

        // 4. Lista de Cupons de Marketing Direto (Ignoramos os VEM de growth aqui)
        $coupons = Coupon::where('code', 'not like', 'VEM%')
            ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($c) {
                return [
                    'id' => $c->id, 'code' => $c->code, 'type' => $c->type, 'value' => (float) $c->value,
                    'is_active' => (bool) $c->is_active, 'expires_at' => $c->expires_at ? $c->expires_at->format('Y-m-d') : null,
                    'usage_count' => Order::where('coupon_id', $c->id)->count(),
                ];
            });

        // 🚀 5. MÓDULO DE GROWTH O2O (Onde a Mágica Financeira Acontece)

        // 5.1 Fidelidade e Cashback
        // Calcula a moeda virtual: Pontos ganhos vs Valor Real de conversão
        $conversionRate = $settings->loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate ?? 5;

        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Puxa o saldo exato que os clientes têm na carteira HOJE
        $totalPointsOutstanding = Customer::sum('loyalty_points') ?? 0;
        $cashbackLiability = ($totalPointsOutstanding / 100) * $conversionRate; // Passivo financeiro em aberto

        // O que já foi utilizado historicamente
        $cashbackUsed = Order::sum('cashback_used') ?? 0;

        // O Total distribuído é a soma do que já usaram com o que ainda guardam!
        $cashbackGiven = $cashbackLiability + $cashbackUsed;

        // 5.2 Rastreio de Conversão de Flyers (Indicação)
        $growthCoupons = Coupon::where('code', 'like', 'VEM%')->get();
        $flyersPrinted = $growthCoupons->count(); // 1 Cupom "VEM" = 1 Flyer impresso e grampeado na sacola

        $growthCouponIds = $growthCoupons->pluck('id');
        $flyersConverted = Order::whereIn('coupon_id', $growthCouponIds)->count();
        $flyerDiscountsGiven = Order::whereIn('coupon_id', $growthCouponIds)->sum('discount');

        return [
            'metrics' => [
                'totalDiscount' => (float) $totalDiscount,
                'salesFromCoupons' => (float) $salesFromCoupons,
            ],
            'opportunities' => $opportunities->values(),
            'settings' => [
                'auto_birthday_coupon' => (bool) ($settings->auto_birthday_coupon ?? false),
                'auto_churn_coupon' => (bool) ($settings->auto_churn_coupon ?? false),
            ],
            'ratings' => $ratings,
            'coupons' => $coupons,

            // 🚀 Injetando os dados crus para a CrmGrowthTab processar
            'growth' => [
                'cashback_given' => (float) $cashbackGiven,
                'cashback_used' => (float) $cashbackUsed,
                'cashback_liability' => (float) $cashbackLiability, // 🚀 O Front vai ler isso direto!
                'flyers_printed' => $flyersPrinted,
                'flyers_converted' => $flyersConverted,
                'flyer_discounts_given' => (float) $flyerDiscountsGiven,
            ]
        ];
    }

    public function toggleAutomation(string $key, bool $value): void
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        if ($settings) {
            $settings->update([$key => $value]);
        }
    }

    public function createCoupon(array $data): Coupon
    {
        $data['code'] = strtoupper($data['code']);
        $data['is_active'] = true;

        if (empty($data['value'])) {
            $data['value'] = 0;
        }

        return Coupon::create($data);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Marketing;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Exception;

class LoyaltyService
{
    public function validateCashback(Customer $customer, float $orderSubtotal, float $requestedCashback): float
    {
        if ($requestedCashback <= 0) return 0.0;

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        if (!$settings || !$settings->loyalty_is_active || $settings->loyalty_reward_type !== 'cashback') {
            throw new Exception("O programa de cashback não está ativo no momento.");
        }

        if ($customer->loyalty_points_expires_at && Carbon::parse($customer->loyalty_points_expires_at)->isPast()) {
            $customer->update([
                'loyalty_points' => 0,
                'loyalty_points_expires_at' => null,
            ]);
            throw new Exception("Seu saldo de cashback expirou e não está mais disponível.");
        }

        $minRedeem = (float) ($settings->loyalty_min_redeem_value ?? 0);
        if ($orderSubtotal < $minRedeem) {
            throw new Exception("O subtotal do pedido não atingiu o mínimo de R$ " . number_format($minRedeem, 2, ',', '.') . " para resgate.");
        }

        $maxRedeemVal = (float) ($settings->loyalty_max_redeem_value ?? 0);
        $maxRedeemType = $settings->loyalty_max_redeem_type ?? 'fixed';
        $maxCapLimit = $orderSubtotal;

        if ($maxRedeemVal > 0) {
            $maxCapLimit = ($maxRedeemType === 'percentage')
                ? round($orderSubtotal * ($maxRedeemVal / 100), 2)
                : $maxRedeemVal;
        }

        $conversionRate = max(0.01, (float) ($settings->loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate ?? 5));
        $maxAvailableInReais = ($customer->loyalty_points / 100) * $conversionRate;

        return min($requestedCashback, $maxAvailableInReais, $orderSubtotal, $maxCapLimit);
    }

    public function consumeCashback(Order $order, Customer $customer, float $cashbackUsed): void
    {
        if ($cashbackUsed <= 0) return;

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $conversionRate = max(0.01, (float) ($settings->loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate ?? 5));

        $pointsToDeduct = (int) ceil(($cashbackUsed / $conversionRate) * 100);
        $customer->loyalty_points = max(0, $customer->loyalty_points - $pointsToDeduct);

        if ($customer->loyalty_points === 0) {
            $customer->loyalty_points_expires_at = null;
        }

        $customer->save();

        $hasCashbackPayment = $order->payments()->where('method', 'like', '%Cashback%')->exists();

        if (!$hasCashbackPayment) {
            $paymentMethod = PaymentMethod::where('engine_type', 'internal_loyalty')->first();

            $order->payments()->create([
                'payment_method_id' => $paymentMethod?->id,
                'amount'            => $cashbackUsed,
                'method'            => 'Cashback',
            ]);
        }
    }

    public function earnPoints(Order $order, Customer $customer): void
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        if (!$settings || !$settings->loyalty_is_active) return;

        $cashbackUsed = (float) (
            $order->cashback_used > 0
                ? $order->cashback_used
                : $order->payments()->where('method', 'like', '%Cashback%')->sum('amount')
        );
        $couponDiscount = (float) ($order->discount ?? 0);

        // Pontua estritamente sobre dinheiro real gasto (sem cobrir cupom nem cashback já utilizado)
        $netMoneyPaid = max(0, (float) $order->subtotal - $couponDiscount - $cashbackUsed);

        if ($netMoneyPaid <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        $pointsEarned = 0;

        if ($settings->loyalty_accumulation_rule === 'cart_value') {
            $multiplier = (float) ($settings->loyalty_points_multiplier ?? 1);
            $pointsEarned = (int) floor($netMoneyPaid * $multiplier);
        } elseif ($settings->loyalty_accumulation_rule === 'product_qty_all') {
            $multiplier = (float) ($settings->loyalty_points_multiplier ?? 1);
            $totalQty = (int) $order->items()->sum('quantity');
            $pointsEarned = (int) floor($totalQty * $multiplier);
        }

        if ($pointsEarned > 0) {
            $customer->loyalty_points += $pointsEarned;

            $expiryDays = (int) ($settings->loyalty_points_expiry_days ?? 0);
            $customer->loyalty_points_expires_at = $expiryDays > 0
                ? Carbon::now()->addDays($expiryDays)
                : null;

            $customer->save();

            $cashbackEarned = null;
            if ($settings->loyalty_reward_type === 'cashback') {
                $conversionRate = max(0.01, (float) ($settings->loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate ?? 5));
                $calculatedValue = round(($pointsEarned / 100) * $conversionRate, 2);
                if ($calculatedValue > 0) {
                    $cashbackEarned = $calculatedValue;
                }
            }

            $order->update([
                'loyalty_points_earned' => $pointsEarned,
            ]);

            $order->cashback_earned = $cashbackEarned;
        }
    }

    public function refundOrderCashback(Order $order): void
    {
        if (!$order->customer) return;

        // 🚀 1. Revoga os pontos ganhos neste pedido cancelado
        if ((int) ($order->loyalty_points_earned ?? 0) > 0) {
            $pointsToRevoke = (int) $order->loyalty_points_earned;
            $order->customer->loyalty_points = max(0, (int) $order->customer->loyalty_points - $pointsToRevoke);
            $order->customer->save();
            $order->update(['loyalty_points_earned' => 0]);
        }

        // 🚀 2. Restaura os pontos gastos via Cashback como forma de pagamento
        $loyaltyPayment = $order->payments()
            ->where(function ($query) {
                $query->whereHas('paymentMethod', function ($q) {
                    $q->where('engine_type', 'internal_loyalty');
                })->orWhere('method', 'like', '%Cashback%');
            })->first();

        if (!$loyaltyPayment || $loyaltyPayment->amount <= 0) return;

        $amountRefunded = (float) $loyaltyPayment->amount;
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $conversionRate = max(0.01, (float) ($settings->loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate ?? 5));

        $pointsToRefund = (int) ceil(($amountRefunded / $conversionRate) * 100);
        $order->customer->increment('loyalty_points', $pointsToRefund);

        $expiryDays = (int) ($settings->loyalty_points_expiry_days ?? 0);
        if ($expiryDays > 0 && (!$order->customer->loyalty_points_expires_at || Carbon::parse($order->customer->loyalty_points_expires_at)->isPast())) {
            $order->customer->update([
                'loyalty_points_expires_at' => Carbon::now()->addDays($expiryDays)
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Marketing/OrderClaimService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Marketing;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Exception;

class OrderClaimService
{
    /**
     * Gera ou recupera um claim_hash único para pedidos não identificados.
     */
    public function generateClaimHashForOrder(Order $order): string
    {
        if ($order->claim_hash && $order->claim_expires_at && now()->lessThan($order->claim_expires_at)) {
            return $order->claim_hash;
        }

        $hash = 'MESA-' . strtoupper(Str::random(6));

        $order->updateQuietly([
            'claim_hash'       => $hash,
            'claim_expires_at' => now()->addHours(48), // Janela de 48h
        ]);

        return $hash;
    }

    /**
     * Calcula quanto o pedido renderá de pontos/cashback para o cliente.
     */
    public function calculateEstimatedRewards(Order $order, ?CompanySetting $settings = null): array
    {
        $settings = $settings ?? CompanySetting::getCached();
        if (!$settings || !$settings->loyalty_is_active) {
            return ['points' => 0, 'cashback_value' => 0.00];
        }

        $subtotal = (float) $order->subtotal;
        $multiplier = (float) ($settings->loyalty_points_multiplier ?? 1);
        $points = (int) round($subtotal * $multiplier);

        $conversionRate = (float) ($settings->loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate ?? 5.00);
        $cashbackValue = round(($points / 100) * $conversionRate, 2);

        return [
            'points'         => $points,
            'cashback_value' => $cashbackValue,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Processa a reivindicação do pedido de forma atômica.
     */
    public function claimOrder(string $hash, Customer $customer): Order
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($hash, $customer) {
            /** @var Order $order */
            $order = Order::where('claim_hash', strtoupper(trim($hash)))
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            if (!$order) {
                throw new Exception('Comprovante de resgate inválido ou não encontrado.');
            }

            if ($order->claimed_at) {
                throw new Exception('Este comprovante já foi resgatado anteriormente.');
            }

            if ($order->claim_expires_at && now()->greaterThan($order->claim_expires_at)) {
                throw new Exception('O prazo de 48 horas para resgatar este pedido expirou.');
            }

            if (!in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'completed', 'delivered']) && $order->payment_status !== 'paid') {
                throw new Exception('O pedido ainda não foi finalizado pelo estabelecimento.');
            }

            if ($order->customer_id && $order->customer_id !== $customer->id) {
                throw new Exception('Este pedido já possui outro cliente vinculado.');
            }

            // 1. Calcula os pontos devidos
            $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
            $rewards = $this->calculateEstimatedRewards($order, $settings);

            // 2. Atualiza a comanda
            $order->update([
                'customer_id'           => $customer->id,
                'customer_name'         => $customer->name,
                'customer_phone'        => $customer->phone,
                'loyalty_points_earned' => $rewards['points'],
                'cashback_earned'       => $rewards['cashback_value'],
                'claimed_at'            => now(),
            ]);

            // 3. Credita no saldo do cliente
            if ($rewards['points'] > 0) {
                $customer->increment('loyalty_points', $rewards['points']);
            }

            return $order;
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Marketing;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ServerSideTrackingService
{
    public function trackPurchase(Order $order): void
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
        if (!$settings) return;

        // 1. DISPARO GOOGLE ANALYTICS 4 (MEASUREMENT PROTOCOL)
        if (!empty($settings->google_pixel_id) && !empty($settings->google_api_secret)) {
            $this->dispatchGooglePurchase($order, $settings);
        }

        // 2. DISPARO META (CONVERSIONS API / CAPI)
        if (!empty($settings->meta_pixel_id) && !empty($settings->meta_capi_token)) {
            $this->dispatchMetaPurchase($order, $settings);
        }
    }

    protected function dispatchGooglePurchase(Order $order, CompanySetting $settings): void
    {
        try {
            $order->loadMissing('items.product');

            $items = $order->items->map(function ($item) {
                return [
                    'item_id'   => (string) ($item->product_id ?? $item->id),
                    'item_name' => $item->product_name ?? 'Produto',
                    'price'     => (float) $item->unit_price,
                    'quantity'  => (int) $item->quantity,
                ];
            })->values()->all();

            // Client ID de fallback se o cookie _ga não foi lido a tempo
            $clientId = $order->ga_client_id ?: sprintf('%08x.%010d', crc32($order->ip_address ?? '127.0.0.1'), time());

            $payload = [
                'client_id' => $clientId,
                'events'    => [
                    [
                        'name'   => 'purchase',
                        'params' => [
                            'transaction_id' => (string) $order->id,
                            'value'          => (float) $order->total,
                            'currency'       => 'BRL',
                            'items'          => $items,
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ];

            $url = 'https://www.google-analytics.com/mp/collect?' . http_build_query([
                'measurement_id' => trim($settings->google_pixel_id),
                'api_secret'     => trim($settings->google_api_secret),
            ]);

            // Disparo assíncrono/rápido para não onerar o checkout
            Http::timeout(3)->post($url, $payload);
            Log::info("🎯 [Marketing Server-Side] Evento Purchase GA4 enviado para o Pedido #{$order->id}");

        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::warning("⚠️ [Marketing Server-Side] Falha ao enviar Purchase GA4: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    protected function dispatchMetaPurchase(Order $order, CompanySetting $settings): void
    {
        try {
            $url = "https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/{$settings->meta_pixel_id}/events";

            $payload = [
                'data' => [
                    [
                        'event_name'       => 'Purchase',
                        'event_time'       => time(),
                        'event_id'         => "order_{$order->id}",
                        'action_source'    => 'website',
                        'user_data'        => [
                            'client_ip_address' => $order->ip_address,
                            'client_user_agent' => $order->user_agent,
                            'fbp'               => $order->fbp,
                            'fbc'               => $order->fbclid ? "fb.1." . time() . ".{$order->fbclid}" : null,
                            'ph'                => $order->customer_phone ? hash('sha256', preg_replace('/\D/', '', $order->customer_phone)) : null,
                        ],
                        'custom_data'      => [
                            'currency' => 'BRL',
                            'value'    => (float) $order->total,
                            'order_id' => (string) $order->id,
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
                'access_token' => $settings->meta_capi_token,
            ];

            Http::timeout(3)->post($url, $payload);
            Log::info("🎯 [Marketing Server-Side] Evento Purchase Meta CAPI enviado para o Pedido #{$order->id}");

        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::warning("⚠️ [Marketing Server-Side] Falha ao enviar Purchase Meta CAPI: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders\Handlers;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Exception;

class CounterOrderHandler
{
    public function resolveCustomer(array &$routing): array
    {
        $customerId = $routing["customer"]["id"] ?? ($routing["customer_id"] ?? null);
        $customerName = null;

        if (!empty($customerId) && str_starts_with((string) $customerId, 'temp_')) {
            $tempName = $routing["customer"]["name"] ?? ($routing["customer_name"] ?? 'Cliente Balcão');
            $tempPhone = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $routing["customer"]["phone"] ?? ($routing["customer_phone"] ?? ''));

            $customer = Customer::create([
                'name'  => $tempName,
                'phone' => !empty($tempPhone) ? $tempPhone : null,
                'cpf'   => !empty($routing["customer"]["cpf"]) ? preg_replace('/\D/', '', $routing["customer"]["cpf"]) : null,
            ]);

            $customerId = $customer->id;
            $customerName = $customer->name;
        } else {
            $candidate = $routing["customer"]["name"] ?? ($routing["identifier"] ?? ($routing["customer_name"] ?? null));
            $customerName = !empty($candidate) ? trim($candidate) : null;
        }

        if (empty($customerName) && empty($customerId)) {
            throw new Exception("Para pedidos de Balcão, é obrigatório identificar o cliente (Nome ou Cadastro).");
        }

        return [
            'id'   => is_numeric($customerId) ? (int) $customerId : null,
            'name' => $customerName
        ];
    }

    public function buildOrderData(array $payload, int $operatorId, string $source): array
    {
        $routing = $payload['routing'] ?? [];
        $financials = $payload['financials'] ?? [];
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();

        $customerData = $this->resolveCustomer($routing);

        $subtotal = (float) ($financials["subtotal"] ?? 0);
        $serviceFee = $settings ? $settings->calculateServiceFee($subtotal, 'counter') : 0.00;
        $discount = (float) ($financials["discount"] ?? 0);
        $finalTotal = round($subtotal + $serviceFee - $discount, 2);

        $changeTarget = $routing["change_target"] ?? ($routing["delivery_change_target"] ?? ($routing["cash_change_target"] ?? null));

        return [
            "customer_id"            => $customerData['id'],
            "customer_name"          => $customerData['name'],
            "customer_phone"         => $routing["customer_phone"] ?? ($routing["customer"]["phone"] ?? null),
            "coupon_id"              => $financials["coupon_id"] ?? null,
            "type"                   => "counter",
            "source"                 => $source,
            "status"                 => "pending",
            "payment_status"         => "pending",
            "subtotal"               => $subtotal,
            "discount"               => $discount,
            "delivery_fee"           => 0.00,
            "service_fee"            => $serviceFee,
            "total"                  => $finalTotal,
            "employee_id"            => $operatorId,
            "cashier_id"             => in_array($source, [Order::SOURCE_POS_APP, Order::SOURCE_CASHIER], true) ? $operatorId : null,
            "payment_intent_status"  => $routing["payment_intent_status"] ?? 'pending',
            "payment_intent_methods" => $routing["payment_intent_methods"] ?? null,
            "change_target"          => $changeTarget,
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders\Handlers;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Orders\OrderAddressResolver;

class DeliveryOrderHandler
{
    public function __construct(protected OrderAddressResolver $addressResolver) {}

    public function resolveCourier(): ?int
    {
        $activeCouriers = User::whereHas('roles', function($q) {
            $q->whereIn('name', ['driver', 'motoboy', 'entregador']);
        })
        ->whereHas('attendedShifts', function($q) {
            $q->where('cash_shifts.status', 'open');
        })
        ->where('is_active', true)
        ->get();

        return $activeCouriers->count() === 1 ? $activeCouriers->first()->id : null;
    }

    public function buildOrderData(array $payload, int $operatorId, string $source): array
    {
        $routing = $payload['routing'] ?? [];
        $financials = $payload['financials'] ?? [];
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();

        $customerId = $routing["customer"]["id"] ?? ($routing["customer_id"] ?? null);
        $customerName = $routing["customer"]["name"] ?? ($routing["customer_name"] ?? 'Cliente Delivery');

        if (!empty($customerId) && str_starts_with((string) $customerId, 'temp_')) {
            $tempPhone = preg_replace('/\D/', '', $routing["customer"]["phone"] ?? ($routing["customer_phone"] ?? ''));
            $created = Customer::create([
                'name'  => $customerName,
                'phone' => !empty($tempPhone) ? $tempPhone : null,
                'cpf'   => !empty($routing["customer"]["cpf"]) ? preg_replace('/\D/', '', $routing["customer"]["cpf"]) : null,
            ]);
            $customerId = $created->id;
        }

        $deliveryFee = (float) ($financials["deliveryFee"] ?? 0);
        $resolvedAddress = $this->addressResolver->resolve(
            $routing,
            is_numeric($customerId) ? (int) $customerId : null,
            $deliveryFee
        );

        $subtotal = (float) ($financials["subtotal"] ?? 0);
        $serviceFee = $settings ? $settings->calculateServiceFee($subtotal, 'delivery') : 0.00;
        $discount = (float) ($financials["discount"] ?? 0);
        $finalTotal = round($subtotal + $deliveryFee + $serviceFee - $discount, 2);

        $changeTarget = $routing["change_target"] ?? ($routing["delivery_change_target"] ?? ($routing["cash_change_target"] ?? null));

        return [
            "customer_id"            => is_numeric($customerId) ? (int) $customerId : null,
            "address_id"             => $resolvedAddress['address_id'],
            "address_snapshot"       => $resolvedAddress['snapshot'],
            "address"                => $resolvedAddress['snapshot'],
            "customer_name"          => $customerName,
            "customer_phone"         => $routing["customer_phone"] ?? ($routing["customer"]["phone"] ?? null),
            "coupon_id"              => $financials["coupon_id"] ?? null,
            "type"                   => "delivery",
            "source"                 => $source,
            "status"                 => "pending",
            "payment_status"         => "pending",
            "subtotal"               => $subtotal,
            "discount"               => $discount,
            "delivery_fee"           => $deliveryFee,
            "service_fee"            => $serviceFee,
            "total"                  => $finalTotal,
            "employee_id"            => $operatorId,
            "cashier_id"             => in_array($source, [Order::SOURCE_POS_APP, Order::SOURCE_CASHIER], true) ? $operatorId : null,
            "driver_id"              => $this->resolveCourier(),
            "payment_intent_status"  => $routing["payment_intent_status"] ?? 'pending_choice',
            "payment_intent_methods" => $routing["payment_intent_methods"] ?? null,
            "change_target"          => $changeTarget,
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders\Handlers;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Orders\OrderItemProcessor;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\KitchenDispatchService;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class OrderAppendHandler
{
    public function __construct(
        protected OrderItemProcessor $itemProcessor,
        protected KitchenDispatchService $kitchenDispatchService
    ) {}

    public function canAppend(?int $orderId): bool
    {
        if (empty($orderId)) return false;

        $order = Order::find($orderId);
        if (!$order) return false;

        if ($order->type === 'table' && $order->payment_status === 'paid') {
            return false;
        }

        return !in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'merged'], true);
    }

    public function handle(int $orderId, array $payload): Order
    {
        $order = DB::transaction(function () use ($orderId, $payload) {
            $order = Order::lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($orderId);

            if (in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'merged'], true)) {
                throw new \Exception("Ação recusada: O Pedido #{$order->id} já se encontra encerrado ou cancelado.");
            }

            if ($order->type === 'table' && $order->payment_status === 'paid') {
                throw new \Exception("Ação recusada: A comanda da Mesa #{$order->table_number} já foi quitada. Abra uma nova conta.");
            }

            $financials = $payload['financials'] ?? [];
            $routing    = $payload['routing'] ?? [];

            $addedSubtotal = (float) ($financials['subtotal'] ?? 0);
            $addedDiscount = (float) ($financials['discount'] ?? 0);

            $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
            $addedServiceFee = $settings ? $settings->calculateServiceFee($addedSubtotal, $order->type) : 0.00;

            foreach ($payload['items'] as $item) {
                $this->itemProcessor->process($order, $item);
            }

            $order->subtotal += $addedSubtotal;
            $order->discount += $addedDiscount;
            $order->service_fee += $addedServiceFee;
            $order->total += round($addedSubtotal + $addedServiceFee - $addedDiscount, 2);

            if (method_exists($order, 'recalculatePaymentStatus')) {
                $order->recalculatePaymentStatus();
            } else {
                $totalPaid = (float) $order->payments()->sum('amount');
                if ($totalPaid <= 0) {
                    $order->payment_status = 'pending';
                } elseif ($totalPaid < ((float) $order->total - 0.01)) {
                    $order->payment_status = 'partial';
                } else {
                    $order->payment_status = 'paid';
                }
            }

            // 🚀 Chama o Recalculo com as regras refinadas
            $this->recalculatePaymentIntents($order, $routing);
            $order->save();

            return $order;
        });

        $isBankApiPending = ($payload['routing']['payment_engine'] ?? null) === 'bank_api'
            || ($order->payment_intent_status === 'pix_waiting');

        if (!$isBankApiPending) {
            $this->kitchenDispatchService->dispatchNewItems(
                $order,
                $payload['routing']['kitchen_print_mode'] ?? 'station',
                (bool) ($payload['routing']['kitchen_separate_multiples'] ?? false)
            );
        }

        try {
            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [WebSockets] Falha ao transmitir broadcast do pedido append #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return $order;
    }

    protected function recalculatePaymentIntents(Order $order, array $routing): void
    {
        // 1. Atualiza Status
        if (isset($routing['payment_intent_status'])) {
            $order->payment_intent_status = $routing['payment_intent_status'];
        }

        // 2. 🚀 RESPEITO ABSOLUTO AO FRONTEND!
        // Se o frontend (Modal) mandou os métodos recalculados, nós aceitamos eles cegamente
        if (!empty($routing['payment_intent_methods'])) {
            $order->payment_intent_methods = is_array($routing['payment_intent_methods'])
                ? $routing['payment_intent_methods']
                : json_decode($routing['payment_intent_methods'], true);
        }
        // 3. Fallback Seguro: Se o modal não abriu ou mandou vazio, tenta esticar a última regra guardada na comanda
        elseif (!empty($order->payment_intent_methods) && is_array($order->payment_intent_methods) && in_array($order->type, ['delivery', 'counter'])) {
            $methods = $order->payment_intent_methods;
            if (count($methods) > 0) {
                // Modifica apenas a última forma registrada para cobrir o buraco de saldo
                $lastIndex = count($methods) - 1;
                $methods[$lastIndex]['amount'] = round((float) $methods[$lastIndex]['amount'] + (float) $order->balance_due, 2);

                // Limpa o target do troco para segurança se ele não abrange mais
                if (isset($methods[$lastIndex]['change_target']) && (float) $methods[$lastIndex]['change_target'] < $methods[$lastIndex]['amount']) {
                    $methods[$lastIndex]['change_target'] = null;
                }

                $order->payment_intent_methods = $methods;
            }
        }

        // 4. Analisa a sobra de troco declarada
        $changeTarget = $routing['cash_change_target']
            ?? ($routing['change_target']
            ?? ($routing['delivery_change_target']
            ?? $order->change_target));

        if (!empty($changeTarget)) {
            $targetFloat = (float) $changeTarget;
            $order->change_target = $targetFloat;

            if ($targetFloat < (float) $order->total) {
                Log::warning("⚠️ [OrderAppend] Pedido #{$order->id}: Novo total (R$ {$order->total}) excede o valor para troco informado (R$ {$targetFloat}).");
                $order->change_target = null;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders\Handlers;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\DiningTable;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Exception;

class TableOrderHandler
{
    public function resolveTableId(array $routing): int
    {
        $tableId = $routing["table"]["id"] ?? ($routing["dining_table_id"] ?? ($routing["table_id"] ?? null));
        $tableName = $routing["table"]["name"] ?? ($routing["table_number"] ?? null);

        if (empty($tableId) && !empty($tableName)) {
            $tableId = DiningTable::where('name', $tableName)->value('id');
        }

        if (empty($tableId)) {
            throw new Exception("A mesa (ID) é obrigatória para pedidos de salão. Nenhuma mesa foi identificada.");
        }

        return (int) $tableId;
    }

    public function findActiveTableOrder(int $tableId, bool $isSubaccount = false): ?Order
    {
        if ($isSubaccount) return null;

        return Order::where('dining_table_id', $tableId)
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'delivered'])
            ->where('payment_status', '!=', 'paid')
            ->latest('id')
            ->first();
    }

    public function buildOrderData(array $payload, int $tableId, int $operatorId, string $source): array
    {
        $routing = $payload['routing'] ?? [];
        $financials = $payload['financials'] ?? [];
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();

        $subtotal = (float) ($financials["subtotal"] ?? 0);
        $serviceFee = $settings ? $settings->calculateServiceFee($subtotal, 'table') : 0.00;
        $discount = (float) ($financials["discount"] ?? 0);
        $finalTotal = round($subtotal + $serviceFee - $discount, 2);

        $customerName = !empty($routing["identifier"])
            ? $routing["identifier"]
            : "Mesa " . ($routing["table"]["name"] ?? ($routing["table_number"] ?? (string) $tableId));

        return [
            "customer_id"            => $routing["customer"]["id"] ?? ($routing["customer_id"] ?? null),
            "dining_table_id"        => $tableId,
            "table_number"           => $routing["table"]["name"] ?? ($routing["table_number"] ?? (string) $tableId),
            "customer_name"          => $customerName,
            "customer_phone"         => $routing["customer_phone"] ?? ($routing["customer"]["phone"] ?? null),
            "coupon_id"              => $financials["coupon_id"] ?? null,
            "type"                   => "table",
            "source"                 => $source,
            "status"                 => "pending",
            "payment_status"         => "pending",
            "subtotal"               => $subtotal,
            "discount"               => $discount,
            "delivery_fee"           => 0.00,
            "service_fee"            => $serviceFee,
            "total"                  => $finalTotal,
            "employee_id"            => $operatorId,
            "cashier_id"             => in_array($source, [Order::SOURCE_POS_APP, Order::SOURCE_CASHIER], true) ? $operatorId : null,
            "payment_intent_status"  => $routing["payment_intent_status"] ?? 'pending',
            "payment_intent_methods" => $routing["payment_intent_methods"] ?? null,
        ];
    }
}
```
