## File: app/Services/Orders/ComboItemProcessor.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ComboGroup;
use App\Models\ComboItem;
use App\Models\ModifierOption;
use App\Models\PosAudit;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ComboItemProcessor
{
    private static array $productCache = [];
    private static array $modifierOptionCache = [];

    public function __construct(protected InventoryService $inventoryService) {}

    protected function getProduct(int $id): ?Product
    {
        if (!isset(self::$productCache[$id])) {
            self::$productCache[$id] = Product::find($id);
        }
        return self::$productCache[$id];
    }

    protected function getModifierOption(int $id): ?ModifierOption
    {
        if (!isset(self::$modifierOptionCache[$id])) {
            self::$modifierOptionCache[$id] = ModifierOption::find($id);
        }
        return self::$modifierOptionCache[$id];
    }

    /**
     * Instancia e vincula todos os subitens de um combo novo.
     */
    public function processChildren(Order $order, OrderItem $parentItem, array $comboItems, float $parentQty): Collection
    {
        $createdChildren = collect();

        foreach ($comboItems as $cItem) {
            $childProductId = $cItem["product_id"] ?? $cItem["id"] ?? null;
            if (is_string($childProductId) && preg_match('/_prod_(\d+)/', $childProductId, $matches)) {
                $childProductId = (int) $matches[1];
            }

            $childProductModel = $childProductId ? $this->getProduct((int)$childProductId) : null;

            $subQty = (float) ($cItem["qty"] ?? 1);
            $subPrice = (float) ($cItem["price"] ?? 0);
            $subNotes = !empty($cItem["notes"]) ? trim((string) $cItem["notes"]) : null;

            $subOrderItem = $order->items()->create([
                "parent_item_id"    => $parentItem->id,
                "is_combo_item"     => true,
                "product_id"        => $childProductId,
                "product_name"      => $cItem["name"] ?? 'Item de Combo',
                "quantity"          => $subQty * $parentQty,
                "unit_price"        => $subPrice,
                "total_price"       => $subPrice * ($subQty * $parentQty),
                "kitchen_id"        => $childProductModel?->kitchen_id,
                "prep_time_minutes" => $childProductModel?->prep_time_minutes,
                "notes"             => $subNotes,
                "user_name"         => auth()->user()?->name ?? 'Sistema',
                "status"            => 'active',
                "production_status" => 'pending',
            ]);

            if ($childProductModel) {
                $this->inventoryService->deductStock($childProductModel, $subQty * $parentQty);
            }

            if (!empty($cItem["structuredModifiers"]) && is_array($cItem["structuredModifiers"])) {
                $this->attachModifiers($subOrderItem, $cItem["structuredModifiers"], $subQty * $parentQty);
            }

            $createdChildren->push($subOrderItem);
        }

        return $createdChildren;
    }

    /**
     * Processa a substituição/edição de um único subitem dentro de um combo existente.
     */
    public function processChildReplacement(Order $order, array $itemData, OrderItem $oldChild): OrderItem
    {
        $parentCombo = OrderItem::find($oldChild->parent_item_id);
        $oldChildPrice = (float) $oldChild->total_price;

        // 1. Estorna estoque e modificadores do subitem antigo
        $oldProduct = $this->getProduct($oldChild->product_id);
        if ($oldProduct) {
            $this->inventoryService->deductStock($oldProduct, -$oldChild->quantity);
        }

        foreach ($oldChild->modifiers as $mod) {
            if (!empty($mod->modifier_option_id)) {
                $modifierOption = $this->getModifierOption($mod->modifier_option_id);
                if ($modifierOption && $modifierOption->linked_product_id) {
                    $linkedProduct = $this->getProduct($modifierOption->linked_product_id);
                    if ($linkedProduct) {
                        $deduction = ((float) ($modifierOption->linked_qty ?? 1)) * ((float) ($mod->quantity ?? 1));
                        $this->inventoryService->deductStock($linkedProduct, -$deduction);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!empty($itemData['is_loss']) && $oldProduct) {
            $this->inventoryService->registerLoss(
                $oldProduct,
                $oldChild->quantity,
                'Modificação de Combo: ' . ($itemData["auth_reason"] ?? 'Alteração de ingredientes'),
                'Lançamento gerado na substituição de subitem de combo.',
                auth()->id(),
                $oldChild->id
            );
        }

        $oldChild->update([
            'status'            => 'cancelled',
            'production_status' => 'cancelled',
            'cancel_reason'     => 'Substituído por alteração de ingredientes'
        ]);

        // 2. Calcula novo valor: base de subitem é 0, cobrando apenas modificadores adicionais
        $productId = $itemData["id"] ?? $oldChild->product_id;
        $productModel = $productId ? $this->getProduct((int)$productId) : null;
        $productName = $itemData["name"] ?? $oldChild->product_name;

        $newExtraPrice = (float) ($itemData["extra_price"] ?? $itemData["extraPrice"] ?? 0);
        $qty = (float) ($itemData["qty"] ?? $oldChild->quantity);
        $newTotalPrice = round($newExtraPrice * $qty, 2);

        $notes = !empty($itemData["notes"]) ? trim((string) $itemData["notes"]) : null;
        $notes = trim(($notes ? $notes . " " : "") . "*** MODIFICAÇÃO DE ITEM DO COMBO ***");

        // 3. Cria o novo subitem com parent_item_id preservado
        $newChild = $order->items()->create([
            "parent_item_id"    => $oldChild->parent_item_id,
            "is_combo_item"     => true,
            "product_id"        => $productId,
            "product_name"      => $productName,
            "quantity"          => $qty,
            "unit_price"        => $newExtraPrice,
            "total_price"       => $newTotalPrice,
            "kitchen_id"        => $productModel?->kitchen_id ?? $oldChild->kitchen_id,
            "prep_time_minutes" => $productModel?->prep_time_minutes ?? $oldChild->prep_time_minutes,
            "notes"             => $notes,
            "user_name"         => auth()->user()?->name ?? 'Sistema',
            "status"            => 'active',
            "production_status" => 'pending',
        ]);

        if ($productModel) {
            $this->inventoryService->deductStock($productModel, $qty);
        }

        if (!empty($itemData["structuredModifiers"]) && is_array($itemData["structuredModifiers"])) {
            $this->attachModifiers($newChild, $itemData["structuredModifiers"], $qty);
        }

        // 4. Ajuste atômico da diferença de preço na conta e no combo pai
        $priceDelta = round($newTotalPrice - $oldChildPrice, 2);

        if ($priceDelta != 0) {
            if ($parentCombo) {
                $parentCombo->increment('total_price', $priceDelta);
            }
            $order->increment('subtotal', $priceDelta);
            $order->increment('total', $priceDelta);
        }

        PosAudit::create([
            'action'        => 'edit_combo_child',
            'operator_id'   => auth()->id(),
            'authorizer_id' => auth()->id(),
            'reason'        => $itemData["auth_reason"] ?? 'Edição de item de combo',
            'context'       => [
                'parent_combo_id' => $oldChild->parent_item_id,
                'old_item_id'     => $oldChild->id,
                'new_item_id'     => $newChild->id,
                'price_delta'     => $priceDelta,
            ]
        ]);

        Log::info("🍔 [ComboItemProcessor] Subitem #{$oldChild->id} substituído por #{$newChild->id} no Combo #{$oldChild->parent_item_id} (Delta: R$ {$priceDelta}).");

        return $newChild;
    }

    public function attachModifiers(OrderItem $orderItem, array $structuredModifiers, float $qtyMultiplier): void
    {
        foreach ($structuredModifiers as $mod) {
            if (empty($mod["name"])) continue;

            $modQty = (float) ($mod["qty"] ?? $mod["quantity"] ?? 1);
            $optionId = !empty($mod["id"]) ? (int) $mod["id"] : null;
            $groupId = !empty($mod["group_id"]) ? (int) $mod["group_id"] : null;

            $orderItem->modifiers()->create([
                "modifier_option_id" => $optionId,
                "modifier_group_id"  => $groupId,
                "name"               => trim((string) $mod["name"]),
                "quantity"           => $modQty * $qtyMultiplier,
                "price"              => (float) ($mod["price"] ?? 0),
            ]);

            if ($optionId) {
                $modifierOption = $this->getModifierOption($optionId);
                if ($modifierOption && $modifierOption->linked_product_id) {
                    $linkedProduct = $this->getProduct($modifierOption->linked_product_id);
                    if ($linkedProduct) {
                        $deduction = ((float) ($modifierOption->linked_qty ?? 1)) * ($modQty * $qtyMultiplier);
                        $this->inventoryService->deductStock($linkedProduct, $deduction);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/ComboProrationHelper.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\OrderItem;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

class ComboProrationHelper
{
    /**
     * Obtém o preço de venda avulso do produto fora do combo,
     * acrescido de eventuais modificadores/adicionais pagos.
     */
    public static function getStandalonePrice(OrderItem $item, string $orderType = 'table'): float
    {
        $product = $item->product;
        $basePrice = 0.0;

        if ($product) {
            if ($orderType === 'delivery' && (float) ($product->delivery_price ?? 0) > 0) {
                $basePrice = (float) $product->delivery_price;
            } elseif (isset($product->dine_in_price) && (float) $product->dine_in_price > 0) {
                $basePrice = (float) $product->dine_in_price;
            } elseif (isset($product->price) && (float) $product->price > 0) {
                $basePrice = (float) $product->price;
            }
        }

        if ($basePrice <= 0 && (float) $item->unit_price > 0) {
            $basePrice = (float) $item->unit_price;
        }

        // Soma eventuais adicionais pagos de modificadores
        $modsExtra = 0.0;
        if ($item->relationLoaded('modifiers') && $item->modifiers->isNotEmpty()) {
            $itemQty = max(1, (float) $item->quantity);
            $totalModsCost = $item->modifiers->sum(fn($m) => ((float) $m->price) * ((float) ($m->quantity ?: 1)));
            $modsExtra = $totalModsCost / $itemQty;
        }

        return round($basePrice + $modsExtra, 2);
    }

    /**
     * Calcula o rateio proporcional do valor do combo pai entre todos os subitens.
     */
    public static function calculateProration(OrderItem $parent, ?Collection $children = null, string $orderType = 'table'): array
    {
        if ($children === null) {
            $children = $parent->relationLoaded('subItems') && $parent->subItems->isNotEmpty()
                ? $parent->subItems
                : OrderItem::with(['product', 'modifiers'])->where('parent_item_id', $parent->id)->get();
        }

        if ($children->isEmpty()) {
            return [];
        }

        $parentTotalPrice = (float) ($parent->total_price ?: ((float) $parent->unit_price * (float) $parent->quantity));

        // 1. Calcula o total de catálogo de todos os filhos somados
        $catalogValues = [];
        $totalCatalogSum = 0.0;

        foreach ($children as $child) {
            $qty = max(1, (float) $child->quantity);
            $standaloneUnit = self::getStandalonePrice($child, $orderType);
            $childCatalogTotal = $qty * ($standaloneUnit > 0 ? $standaloneUnit : 10.0);

            $catalogValues[$child->id] = [
                'qty'   => $qty,
                'unit'  => $standaloneUnit,
                'total' => $childCatalogTotal,
            ];
            $totalCatalogSum += $childCatalogTotal;
        }

        $proration = [];

        // 2. Rateio ponderado baseado no valor de mercado de cada item
        if ($totalCatalogSum > 0.001) {
            $factor = $parentTotalPrice / $totalCatalogSum;

            foreach ($children as $child) {
                $cData = $catalogValues[$child->id];
                $proratedUnit = round($cData['unit'] * $factor, 2);
                $proratedTotal = round($cData['total'] * $factor, 2);
                $weight = $cData['total'] / $totalCatalogSum;

                $proration[$child->id] = [
                    'catalog_unit_price'  => $cData['unit'],
                    'catalog_total'       => $cData['total'],
                    'weight'              => $weight,
                    'prorated_unit_price' => $proratedUnit,
                    'prorated_total'      => $proratedTotal,
                ];
            }
        } else {
            // Fallback: divisão por cotas simples caso nenhum item tenha preço de catálogo
            $totalQty = $children->sum(fn($c) => max(1, (float) $c->quantity));
            $unitShare = $totalQty > 0 ? round($parentTotalPrice / $totalQty, 2) : 0;

            foreach ($children as $child) {
                $qty = max(1, (float) $child->quantity);
                $proration[$child->id] = [
                    'catalog_unit_price'  => 0.0,
                    'catalog_total'       => 0.0,
                    'weight'              => $totalQty > 0 ? ($qty / $totalQty) : 0,
                    'prorated_unit_price' => $unitShare,
                    'prorated_total'      => round($unitShare * $qty, 2),
                ];
            }
        }

        return $proration;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/CustomerCheckoutService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Financial\PaymentGatewayManager;
use App\Services\Marketing\LoyaltyService;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\StoreAvailabilityService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Exception;

class CustomerCheckoutService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected PaymentGatewayManager $gatewayManager,
        protected LoyaltyService $loyaltyService,
        protected OrderItemProcessor $itemProcessor,
        protected InventoryService $inventoryService,
        protected OrderCancellationService $cancellationService,
        protected OrderAddressResolver $addressResolver,
        protected StoreAvailabilityService $availabilityService,
        protected CustomerOrderSideEffects $sideEffects
    ) {}

    public function processB2CCheckout(array $payload, $customer, bool $isGuest): array
    {
        // 🚀 SONDA 1: Verifica o que o front enviou de verdade
        Log::info('📍 [SONDA CHECKOUT B2C - 1] Recebendo payload:', [
            'customer_id' => $customer->id ?? 'guest',
            'type' => $payload['routing']['type'] ?? 'null',
            'payment_method_id' => $payload['routing']['payment_method_id'] ?? 'NULO',
            'final_total' => $payload['financials']['finalTotal'] ?? 0
        ]);

        // 🛡️ 1. BARREIRA DE HORÁRIO E TURNO DE CAIXA
        $storeStatus = $this->availabilityService->getStoreStatus();
        $canOrder = $storeStatus['is_open'] || $storeStatus['is_pre_order'];

        if (!$canOrder) {
            $reasonMsg = match ($storeStatus['reason']) {
                'closed_indefinitely'    => 'O restaurante está fechado temporariamente.',
                'manual_override_closed' => 'O expediente de hoje já foi encerrado pelo operador.',
                'cashier_closed'         => 'Estamos preparando o sistema. O caixa abrirá em instantes!',
                default                  => 'O restaurante está fechado no momento para novos pedidos.'
            };
            throw new Exception($reasonMsg);
        }

        $isAppend = !empty($payload['append_to_order']);
        $order = null;
        $remainingBalance = 0.00;
        $needsPixPayment = false;
        $paymentMethod = null;

        // =========================================================================
        // 🚀 FASE 1: TRANSAÇÃO DE BANCO
        // =========================================================================
        DB::transaction(function () use (
            $payload, $customer, $isGuest, $isAppend,
            &$order, &$remainingBalance, &$needsPixPayment, &$paymentMethod
        ) {
            $routing    = $payload['routing'];
            $financials = $payload['financials'];
            $items      = $payload['items'];

            $targetCustomerId = $customer->id ?? null;
            $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
            $orderType = $routing['type'] ?? 'delivery';

            if ($orderType === 'table' && !$isAppend && empty($settings?->allow_table_self_service)) {
                throw new Exception("Acesso Negado: O cardápio digital está configurado apenas para consulta nesta mesa.");
            }

            $serviceFee = $settings ? $settings->calculateServiceFee((float) $financials['subtotal'], $orderType) : 0.00;

            $couponCode   = $financials['coupon_code'] ?? null;
            $couponId     = $financials['coupon_id'] ?? null;
            $discount     = (float) ($financials['discount'] ?? 0);
            $cashbackUsed = (float) ($routing['cashback_discount'] ?? 0);

            if ($cashbackUsed > 0) {
                if ($isGuest || !$customer) {
                    $cashbackUsed = 0;
                } else {
                    try {
                        $cashbackUsed = $this->loyaltyService->validateCashback($customer, (float) $financials['subtotal'], $cashbackUsed);
                    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                        $cashbackUsed = 0;
                        Log::warning("Cashback invalidado: " . $e->getMessage());
                    }
                }
            }

            $paymentMethodId = $routing['payment_method_id'] ?? null;
            $paymentMethod = $paymentMethodId ? PaymentMethod::find($paymentMethodId) : null;
            $isBankApi = $paymentMethod && $paymentMethod->engine_type === 'bank_api';

            // 🚀 SONDA 2 E TRAVA DE SEGURANÇA B2C
            $previewTotal = round((float)$financials['subtotal'] + (float)($financials['deliveryFee'] ?? 0) + $serviceFee - $discount - $cashbackUsed, 2);

            Log::info('📍 [SONDA CHECKOUT B2C - 2] Validação de Pagamento:', [
                'previewTotal' => $previewTotal,
                'metodo_encontrado' => $paymentMethod ? $paymentMethod->name : 'NENHUM',
                'isBankApi' => $isBankApi
            ]);

            if ($previewTotal > 0 && !$paymentMethod && !$isAppend && $orderType !== 'table') {
                Log::error('🚨 [SONDA CHECKOUT B2C - ERRO CRÍTICO] O Front-End tentou enviar um pedido pago sem selecionar a forma de pagamento!');
                throw new Exception("É obrigatório selecionar uma forma de pagamento válida para concluir este pedido online.");
            }

            // A. APPEND TO ORDER
            if ($isAppend) {
                if ($cashbackUsed > 0) throw new Exception("Não é possível utilizar Cashback ao adicionar itens.");
                if (!$settings || empty($settings->customer_can_append_orders)) throw new Exception("O restaurante não permite adicionar itens.");

                $order = Order::lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($payload['append_to_order']);

                if (in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'delivered', 'merged'], true)) {
                    throw new Exception("O pedido já saiu para entrega ou foi finalizado.");
                }

                $addedSubtotal = (float) $financials['subtotal'];
                $addedTotal    = round($addedSubtotal + $serviceFee - $discount, 2);

                $order->subtotal += $addedSubtotal;
                $order->discount += $discount;
                $order->service_fee += $serviceFee;
                $order->total += $addedTotal;
                $order->recalculatePaymentStatus();
                $order->save();

                $remainingBalance = $addedTotal;
            }
            // B. NOVO PEDIDO
            else {
                $realOrderTotal   = round((float)$financials['subtotal'] + (float)$financials['deliveryFee'] + $serviceFee - $discount, 2);
                $remainingBalance = round($realOrderTotal - $cashbackUsed, 2);

                $changeTarget = $routing['cash_change_target'] ?? ($routing['change_target'] ?? null);
                $finalNotes   = $routing['notes'] ?? null;

                $resolvedAddress = $this->addressResolver->resolve($routing, $targetCustomerId, (float) ($financials['deliveryFee'] ?? 0));

                $customerPhone = $routing['customer_phone'] ?? ($routing['customer']['phone'] ?? null) ?? ($customer->phone ?? null);

                $deliveryPaymentMethods = $routing['payment_intent_methods'] ?? null;

                if (empty($deliveryPaymentMethods) && !empty($paymentMethodId)) {
                    $deliveryPaymentMethods = [
                        [
                            'method_id'     => (int) $paymentMethodId,
                            'method_name'   => $routing['payment_method_name'] ?? ($paymentMethod->name ?? 'Não identificado'),
                            'amount'        => (float) $remainingBalance,
                            'change_target' => !empty($changeTarget) ? (float) $changeTarget : null,
                        ]
                    ];
                }

                $isFullyCoveredByCashback = ($remainingBalance <= 0);
                $needsPixPayment = $isBankApi && !$isFullyCoveredByCashback;

                $deliveryPaymentStatus = $needsPixPayment
                    ? 'pix_waiting'
                    : ($isFullyCoveredByCashback
                        ? 'paid'
                        : ($routing['payment_intent_status'] ?? ($orderType === 'delivery' ? 'pay_on_delivery' : 'pay_on_pickup')));

                $marketing = session('marketing_traffic', []);

                $order = Order::create([
                    'customer_id'            => $targetCustomerId,
                    'coupon_id'              => $couponId,
                    'type'                   => $orderType,
                    'source'                 => Order::SOURCE_CUSTOMER_APP,
                    'address_id'             => $resolvedAddress['address_id'],
                    'address_snapshot'       => $resolvedAddress['snapshot'],
                    'address'                => $resolvedAddress['snapshot'],
                    'customer_name'          => $routing['identifier'] ?? ($customer->name ?? ($routing['customer']['name'] ?? 'App')),
                    'customer_phone'         => $customerPhone,
                    'ip_address'             => request()->ip(),
                    'user_agent'             => request()->userAgent(),
                    'payment_intent_methods' => $deliveryPaymentMethods,
                    'payment_intent_status'  => $deliveryPaymentStatus,
                    'delivery_change_target' => $changeTarget,
                    'change_target'          => $changeTarget,
                    'status'                 => $needsPixPayment ? 'pending_payment' : 'pending',
                    'payment_status'         => 'pending',
                    'subtotal'               => $financials['subtotal'],
                    'delivery_fee'           => $financials['deliveryFee'],
                    'service_fee'            => $serviceFee,
                    'discount'               => $discount,
                    'cashback_used'          => $cashbackUsed > 0 ? $cashbackUsed : 0,
                    'total'                  => $realOrderTotal,
                    'notes'                  => $finalNotes,
                ]);
            }

            foreach ($items as $item) {
                $this->itemProcessor->process($order, $item);
            }

            if ($cashbackUsed > 0 && !$isGuest && $customer) {
                $this->loyaltyService->consumeCashback($order, $customer, $cashbackUsed);
            }

            $isFullyCoveredByCashback = ($remainingBalance <= 0);
            $needsPixPayment = $isBankApi && !$isFullyCoveredByCashback;

            if ($isFullyCoveredByCashback) {
                $order->update(['payment_status' => 'paid', 'payment_intent_status' => 'paid', 'status' => 'pending']);
            }

            Log::info('📍 [SONDA CHECKOUT B2C - 3] Transação de banco concluída.', ['needsPix' => $needsPixPayment]);
        });

        // =========================================================================
        // 🚀 FASE 2: GERAÇÃO DE PIX FORA DA TRANSAÇÃO
        // =========================================================================
        $pixData = null;

        if ($needsPixPayment && $paymentMethod) {
            try {
                Log::info('📍 [SONDA CHECKOUT B2C - 4] Solicitando PIX ao Banco...');
                $gateway = $this->gatewayManager->resolveGateway($paymentMethod->gateway_driver);
                $pixData = $gateway->generatePayment($order, $remainingBalance);

                // 🔥 CRIAR O REGISTO DO PAGAMENTO AQUI:
                $order->payments()->create([
                    'payment_method_id' => $paymentMethod->id,
                    'amount' => $remainingBalance,
                    'status' => 'pending',
                    'txid' => $pixData['txid'],
                    'pix_payload' => $pixData['qr_code']
                ]);

                Log::info('📍 [SONDA CHECKOUT B2C - 5] PIX Gerado com Sucesso!', ['txid' => $pixData['txid']]);
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                Log::error("❌ [PixGateway] Falha ao gerar cobrança Pix: " . $e->getMessage());
                if (!$isAppend) {
                    $order->update(['status' => 'cancelled', 'cancel_reason' => 'Falha bancária: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
                }
                throw new Exception("Falha de comunicação com o Banco: " . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        $this->sideEffects->handle($order, $isAppend, $needsPixPayment);

        return [
            'isBankApi' => $needsPixPayment,
            'order'     => $order,
            'pixData'   => $pixData
        ];
    }

    public function cancelOrderByCustomer(Order $order, ?int $activeCustomerId): void
    {
        $this->cancellationService->cancelByCustomer($order, $activeCustomerId);
    }

    public function systemCancelOrder(Order $order, string $reason = 'Cancelado pelo sistema'): void
    {
        $this->cancellationService->cancelBySystem($order, $reason);
    }

    public function rateOrder(Order $order, array $data, ?int $customerId): void
    {
        if ($order->customer_id && $order->customer_id !== $customerId) {
            throw new Exception('Você não tem permissão para avaliar este pedido.', 403);
        }

        $order->rating()->updateOrCreate(
            ['order_id' => $order->id],
            [
                'customer_id' => $customerId,
                'rating'      => $data['rating'],
                'tags'        => $data['tags'] ?? [],
                'comment'     => $data['comment'] ?? null,
            ]
        );
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Events\OrderCreated;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\KitchenDispatchService;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftAttendanceService;
use App\Services\Marketing\ServerSideTrackingService;
use App\Notifications\NewB2COrderNotification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class CustomerOrderSideEffects
{
    public function __construct(
        protected KitchenDispatchService $kitchenDispatchService,
        protected ShiftAttendanceService $attendanceService,
        protected ServerSideTrackingService $trackingService
    ) {}

    /**
     * Orquestra todos os efeitos colaterais de uma encomenda de cliente.
     */
    public function handle(Order $order, bool $isAppend, bool $needsPixPayment): void
    {
        // 🍳 1. KDS & Produção física (somente se NÃO estiver retido aguardando Pix)
        if (!$needsPixPayment) {
            try {
                $this->kitchenDispatchService->dispatchNewItems($order);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                Log::error("❌ [KDS/Print] Falha no despacho para produção do pedido #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        // 📡 2. WebSockets em tempo real (atualiza POS, KDS e Kanban)
        try {
            if ($isAppend) {
                broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
            } else {
                broadcast(new OrderCreated($order));
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [WebSockets] Falha ao transmitir broadcast do pedido B2C #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        // 🔔 3. Notificações da Equipe em Turno (Caixa, Bar, Cozinha)
        $this->notifyTeam($order, $needsPixPayment);

        // 📊 4. Marketing & Conversões (Server-Side Tracking)
        if (!$isAppend) {
            try {
                $this->trackingService->trackPurchase($order);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                Log::warning("⚠️ [Tracking] Falha ao registrar tracking da compra #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Notifica os operadores em turno conforme a praça e o status do pagamento.
     */
    protected function notifyTeam(Order $order, bool $isPixWaiting): void
    {
        $order->loadMissing('items.product');

        // Notifica o Caixa / Frente de loja
        $cashierStaff = $this->attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['caixa', 'pos', 'manager', 'admin', 'gerente']);
        if ($cashierStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
            $msgCaixa = $isPixWaiting
                ? "🔔 Novo Pedido #{$order->id} recebido (Aguardando Pix)! (Tipo: {$order->type})"
                : "🔔 Novo Pedido #{$order->id} na fila! (Tipo: {$order->type})";
            Notification::send($cashierStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, $msgCaixa));
        }

        // Se estiver aguardando Pix, a cozinha e o bar não devem ser acionados ainda!
        if ($isPixWaiting) {
            return;
        }

        $activeStations = $order->items->pluck('product.production_station')->filter()->unique();

        foreach ($activeStations as $station) {
            $stationLower = mb_strtolower($station);

            if (str_contains($stationLower, 'bar') || $stationLower === 'bebidas') {
                $barStaff = $this->attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['bar', 'bartender', 'copa']);
                if ($barStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
                    Notification::send($barStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, "🍹 Novos itens de Bar solicitados no Pedido #{$order->id}!"));
                }
            }

            if (str_contains($stationLower, 'cozinha') || $stationLower === 'quente') {
                $kitchenStaff = $this->attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['cozinha', 'cook', 'chef', 'kds']);
                if ($kitchenStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
                    Notification::send($kitchenStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, "🍳 Novos pratos para preparo - Pedido #{$order->id}!"));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Services\Financial\PaymentGatewayManager;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Exception;

class CustomerReorderService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected PaymentGatewayManager $paymentGateway,
        protected InventoryService $inventoryService
    ) {}

    public function processReorder(Order $oldOrder, string $newPaymentAction): array
    {
        // 🚀 BLINDAGEM: Só cancela se o pedido for um rascunho/PIX pendente que expirou.
        // Pedidos já concluídos (delivered/completed) JAMAIS devem ser cancelados retroativamente!
        if ($oldOrder->status === 'pending_payment') {
            $oldOrder->update([
                'status' => 'cancelled',
                'cancel_reason' => 'PIX Expirado / Refeito pelo cliente'
            ]);
        }

        $unavailableItems = $this->checkAvailability($oldOrder);
        if (count($unavailableItems) > 0) {
            $nomes = implode(', ', $unavailableItems);
            throw new Exception("Os seguintes itens não estão mais disponíveis: {$nomes}.", 422);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($oldOrder, $newPaymentAction) {
            $newOrder = $oldOrder->replicate();
            $newOrder->status = 'pending_payment';
            $newOrder->payment_status = 'pending';
            $newOrder->created_at = now();
            $newOrder->updated_at = now();

            $meta = $newOrder->meta ?? [];
            unset($meta['pix_qr_code'], $meta['pix_copia_e_cola'], $meta['transaction_id']);
            $newOrder->meta = $meta;

            $newOrder->save();

            $oldOrder->load('items.modifiers', 'items.subItems.modifiers');

            foreach ($oldOrder->items as $item) {
                if ($item->parent_item_id) continue;

                $newItem = $item->replicate();
                $newItem->order_id = $newOrder->id;
                $newItem->save();

                foreach ($item->modifiers as $mod) {
                    $newMod = $mod->replicate();
                    $newMod->order_item_id = $newItem->id;
                    $newMod->save();
                }

                foreach ($item->subItems as $subItem) {
                    $newSubItem = $subItem->replicate();
                    $newSubItem->order_id = $newOrder->id;
                    $newSubItem->parent_item_id = $newItem->id;
                    $newSubItem->save();

                    foreach ($subItem->modifiers as $subMod) {
                        $newSubMod = $subMod->replicate();
                        $newSubMod->order_item_id = $newSubItem->id;
                        $newSubMod->save();
                    }
                }

                $newItem->load(['modifiers', 'subItems.modifiers']);
                $this->inventoryService->processOrderItemStock($newItem, 'deduct');
            }

            $pixData = null;
            if ($newPaymentAction === 'same' && str_contains(strtolower($oldOrder->payment_method_name), 'pix')) {
                $gatewayResponse = $this->paymentGateway->processPayment($newOrder);

                if (!$gatewayResponse['success']) {
                    throw new Exception("Falha ao comunicar com o banco para gerar o novo PIX.");
                }

                $pixData = $gatewayResponse['pix_data'] ?? null;
            }

            return [
                'new_order' => $newOrder,
                'pix_data'  => $pixData
            ];
        });
    }

    private function checkAvailability(Order $order): array
    {
        $unavailable = [];
        foreach ($order->items as $item) {
            $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
            if (!$product || !$product->is_active) {
                $unavailable[] = $item->product_name;
            } elseif ($product->track_inventory && $product->current_stock < $item->quantity) {
                $unavailable[] = $item->product_name . ' (Estoque insuficiente)';
            }
        }
        return array_unique($unavailable);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/OrderCancellationService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Coupon;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\FiscalDocument;
use App\Models\DiningTable;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\PosSecurityService;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\TablesService;
use App\Services\Fiscal\SpedDocumentService;
use App\Services\Marketing\LoyaltyService;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use App\Events\OrderCancelled;
use App\Notifications\OrderStatusUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Exception;

class OrderCancellationService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected PosSecurityService $securityService,
        protected InventoryService $inventoryService,
        protected OrderNotificationDispatcher $notificationDispatcher
    ) {}

    public function cancelByCustomer(Order $order, ?int $activeCustomerId): void
    {
        if ($order->customer_id && (int) $order->customer_id !== (int) $activeCustomerId) {
            throw new Exception("Operação não autorizada. Este pedido não pertence à sua conta.", 403);
        }

        if (!in_array($order->status, ['pending', 'pending_payment'])) {
            throw new Exception("Este pedido já entrou em preparação e não pode mais ser cancelado.");
        }

        $this->executeB2CCancellation($order, 'Cancelado pelo cliente via App');

        $this->notificationDispatcher->notifyTeamOfCancellation(
            $order,
            "ALERTA: O cliente cancelou o pedido #{$order->id} pelo App!"
        );
    }

    public function cancelBySystem(Order $order, string $reason = 'Cancelado pelo sistema'): void
    {
        if (!in_array($order->status, ['pending', 'pending_payment'])) {
            return;
        }

        $this->executeB2CCancellation($order, $reason);

        $this->notificationDispatcher->notifyTeamOfCancellation(
            $order,
            "Sistema: Pedido #{$order->id} cancelado ({$reason})."
        );
    }

    protected function executeB2CCancellation(Order $order, string $reason): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $reason) {
            $order->update([
                'status'         => 'cancelled',
                'payment_status' => 'cancelled',
                'notes'          => trim(($order->notes ? $order->notes . ' | ' : '') . $reason)
            ]);

            // Carrega os itens e subitens com Eager Loading
            $order->load(['items.modifiers', 'items.subItems.modifiers']);

            foreach ($order->items as $item) {
                if ($item->status === 'cancelled') continue;

                // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Estorna apenas se for item principal (parent_item_id = null)
                // O método processOrderItemStock JÁ lida com os subitens recursivamente!
                if ($item->parent_item_id === null) {
                    $this->inventoryService->processOrderItemStock($item, 'restore');
                }
            }

            // Atualiza o status em massa (uma query para todos os itens do pedido)
            $order->items()->update([
                'status'            => 'cancelled',
                'production_status' => 'cancelled',
                'cancel_reason'     => $reason,
            ]);

            if ($order->coupon_id) {
                $coupon = Coupon::find($order->coupon_id);
                if ($coupon && $coupon->usage_count > 0) {
                    $coupon->decrement('usage_count');
                }
            }
        });

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
        event(new OrderCancelled($order));
    }

    public function cancelItem(Order $order, array $data): void
    {
        $orderWasCancelled = false;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $data, &$orderWasCancelled) {
            $item = OrderItem::with(['modifiers', 'subItems.modifiers'])
                ->where('order_id', $order->id)
                ->findOrFail($data['item_id']);

            $authorizer = $this->securityService->validateAndLog(
                'cancel_item',
                $data['pin'] ?? null,
                $data['reason'] ?? 'Sem motivo informado',
                ['item_name' => $item->product_name, 'price' => $item->total_price, 'order_id' => $order->id]
            );

            // Se for perda operacional, lança o registro
            if (!empty($data['is_loss'])) {
                $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
                if ($product) {
                    $this->inventoryService->registerLoss(
                        $product,
                        $item->quantity,
                        'Salão: ' . ($data['reason'] ?? 'Não especificado'),
                        'Estornado diretamente na comanda.',
                        $authorizer->id,
                        $item->id
                    );
                }
            } else {
                // Estorna tudo do item pai E DOS SUBITENS usando o método centralizado
                $this->inventoryService->processOrderItemStock($item, 'restore');
            }

            // 1. Cancela o item solicitado
            $item->update([
                'status'            => 'cancelled',
                'production_status' => 'cancelled',
                'cancel_reason'     => 'Salão: ' . ($data['reason'] ?? null)
            ]);

            // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Apenas altera o status no BD dos subitens, sem restaurar estoque de novo (evitando Kardex N+1 duplicado)
            if ($item->subItems()->exists()) {
                $item->subItems()->update([
                    'status'            => 'cancelled',
                    'production_status' => 'cancelled',
                    'cancel_reason'     => 'Salão: Combo cancelado (' . ($data['reason'] ?? 'Cancelamento') . ')'
                ]);
            }

            // 2. Recalcula o subtotal e total com base nos itens ativos não-filhos
            $remainingSubtotal = $order->items()
                ->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')
                ->whereNull('parent_item_id')
                ->sum(DB::raw('quantity * unit_price'));

            $order->subtotal = max(0, (float) $remainingSubtotal);
            $order->total = max(0, (float) $order->subtotal + (float) $order->delivery_fee + (float) $order->service_fee - (float) $order->discount);
            $order->save();

            // 3. AUTO-CANCELAMENTO: Verifica se restou algum item ativo na comanda
            $hasActiveItems = $order->items()
                ->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')
                ->exists();

            $totalPaid = (float) $order->payments()->sum('amount');

            // Se não restou item ativo e não há saldo pago, cancela a comanda e libera a mesa
            if (!$hasActiveItems && $totalPaid <= 0.01) {
                $order->update([
                    'status'         => 'cancelled',
                    'payment_status' => 'cancelled',
                    'total'          => 0,
                    'subtotal'       => 0,
                    'notes'          => trim(($order->notes ? $order->notes . ' | ' : '') . 'Cancelado automaticamente: todos os itens foram estornados.')
                ]);

                if (true) {
                    $order->update(['closed_at' => now()]);
                }

                // 4. Liberação da mesa física
                $tableId = $order->dining_table_id;
                if ($tableId) {
                    $hasOtherActive = Order::where('dining_table_id', $tableId)
                        ->where('id', '!=', $order->id)
                        ->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'cancelled'])
                        ->exists();

                    if (!$hasOtherActive) {
                        $table = DiningTable::find($tableId);
                        if ($table) {
                            $table->update(['status' => 'free']);
                            if (class_exists(TablesService::class)) {
                                app(TablesService::class)->split($table);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                $orderWasCancelled = true;
            }
        });

        $freshOrder = $order->fresh(['items', 'payments', 'diningTable']);
        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($freshOrder));

        if ($orderWasCancelled) {
            event(new OrderCancelled($freshOrder));
        }
    }

    public function cancelOrder(Order $order, array $data): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $data) {
            $authorizer = $this->securityService->validateAndLog(
                'cancel_order',
                $data['pin'] ?? null,
                $data['reason'] ?? 'Cancelamento de Pedido',
                ['order_id' => $order->id, 'total' => $order->total]
            );

            $reasonText = $data['reason'] ?? 'Cancelado pela loja';
            $operatorId = $authorizer?->id ?? auth()->id();

            $order->load(['items.modifiers', 'items.subItems.modifiers']);

            foreach ($order->items as $item) {
                if ($item->status === 'cancelled') continue;

                // Apenas processa se for o PAI (o processOrderItemStock vai varrer os filhos)
                if ($item->parent_item_id === null) {
                    if (!empty($data['is_loss']) && !empty($data['lost_items']) && in_array($item->id, $data['lost_items'])) {
                        if ($item->product_id) {
                            $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
                            if ($product) {
                                $this->inventoryService->registerLoss(
                                    $product,
                                    $item->quantity,
                                    'Cancelamento do Pedido #' . $order->id . ': ' . $reasonText,
                                    'Cancelamento total via POS.',
                                    $operatorId,
                                    $item->id
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        $this->inventoryService->processOrderItemStock($item, 'restore');
                    }
                }
            }

            $order->update([
                'status'         => 'cancelled',
                'payment_status' => 'cancelled',
                'notes'          => trim(($order->notes ? $order->notes . ' | ' : '') . 'Cancelado: ' . $reasonText),
            ]);

            $order->items()->update([
                'status'            => 'cancelled',
                'production_status' => 'cancelled',
                'cancel_reason'     => $reasonText,
            ]);

            if ($order->coupon_id) {
                $coupon = Coupon::find($order->coupon_id);
                if ($coupon && $coupon->usage_count > 0) {
                    $coupon->decrement('usage_count');
                }
            }

            // Libera a mesa física se for pedido de mesa
            $tableId = $order->dining_table_id;
            if ($tableId) {
                $hasOtherActive = Order::where('dining_table_id', $tableId)
                    ->where('id', '!=', $order->id)
                    ->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'cancelled'])
                    ->exists();

                if (!$hasOtherActive) {
                    $table = DiningTable::find($tableId);
                    if ($table) {
                        $table->update(['status' => 'free']);
                        if (class_exists(TablesService::class)) {
                            app(TablesService::class)->split($table);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
        event(new OrderCancelled($order));

        if ($order->customer && $order->customer->user_id) {
            $pushMessage = "O pedido #{$order->id} foi cancelado pela loja.";
            $order->customer->user->notify(new OrderStatusUpdated($order, $pushMessage));
        }
    }

    public function refundAndClone(Order $order, array $data): void
    {
        $justification = $data['reason'] ?? 'Correcao de lancamento';
        if (strlen($justification) < 15) {
            $justification .= ' - Solicitado Reabertura';
        }

        $fiscalDoc = FiscalDocument::where('order_id', $order->id)
            ->where('status', 'authorized')
            ->first();

        if ($fiscalDoc) {
            $spedService = app(SpedDocumentService::class);
            $spedService->cancelNfce($fiscalDoc, $justification);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $data) {
            $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();

            if (!$shift && $order->payments()->count() > 0) {
                throw new Exception("Não é possível realizar o estorno financeiro com o caixa fechado. Abra o turno primeiro para poder devolver o dinheiro do pedido #{$order->id}.");
            }

            $totalChangeReturned = (float) ($order->change_returned ?? 0);

            foreach ($order->payments as $payment) {
                $pm = $payment->payment_method_id ? PaymentMethod::find($payment->payment_method_id) : null;

                if ($pm && $pm->engine_type === 'internal_loyalty') {
                    app(LoyaltyService::class)->refundOrderCashback($order);
                    continue;
                }

                if ($pm && $pm->engine_type === 'internal') {
                    if ($order->customer) {
                        $employee = Employee::where('cpf', preg_replace('/\D/', '', $order->customer->cpf ?? ''))
                            ->orWhere('email', $order->customer->email)
                            ->first();

                        if ($employee) {
                            $latestLedger = $employee->ledgers()->latest('id')->first();
                            $currentBalance = $latestLedger ? (float) $latestLedger->balance : 0;

                            $employee->ledgers()->create([
                                'type'        => 'credit',
                                'description' => "Estorno de Consumo Interno - Pedido #{$order->id}",
                                'amount'      => $payment->amount,
                                'balance'     => $currentBalance + (float) $payment->amount
                            ]);
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                $isCash = ($pm && in_array($pm->engine_type, ['money', 'cash']))
                    || str_contains(mb_strtolower($payment->method ?? ''), 'dinheiro');

                $amountToRefund = (float) $payment->amount;

                if ($isCash && $totalChangeReturned > 0) {
                    $deduction = min($amountToRefund, $totalChangeReturned);
                    $amountToRefund -= $deduction;
                    $totalChangeReturned -= $deduction;
                }

                if ($amountToRefund > 0 && $shift) {
                    Transaction::create([
                        'bank_account_id'  => $shift->bank_account_id,
                        'cash_shift_id'    => $shift->id,
                        'type'             => 'out',
                        'category'         => 'refund',
                        'amount'           => $amountToRefund,
                        'description'      => 'Estorno Pedido #' . $order->id . ' (' . $payment->method . ')',
                        'operator_name'    => auth()->user()->name ?? 'Sistema',
                        'transaction_date' => now(),
                        'order_id'         => $order->id
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $order->change_returned = 0;
            $order->payments()->delete();
            $order->items()->update(['paid_qty' => 0]);

            $order->update([
                'status'                => 'pending',
                'payment_status'        => 'pending',
                'payment_intent_status' => 'pending_choice',
                'txid'                  => null,
                'notes'                 => ltrim($order->notes . "\nReativado. Motivo: " . ($data['reason'] ?? 'Correção de Lançamentos.'))
            ]);
        });

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/OrderCreationService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use Exception;
use App\Services\Orders\Handlers\OrderAppendHandler;
use App\Services\Orders\Handlers\TableOrderHandler;
use App\Services\Orders\Handlers\CounterOrderHandler;
use App\Services\Orders\Handlers\DeliveryOrderHandler;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\KitchenDispatchService;
use App\Notifications\OrderStatusUpdated;
use App\Events\OrderCreated;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Detection\MobileDetect;

class OrderCreationService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected OrderAppendHandler $appendHandler,
        protected TableOrderHandler $tableHandler,
        protected CounterOrderHandler $counterHandler,
        protected DeliveryOrderHandler $deliveryHandler,
        protected OrderItemProcessor $itemProcessor,
        protected KitchenDispatchService $kitchenDispatchService
    ) {}

    public function processCheckout(array $payload): Order
    {
        $routing = $payload["routing"] ?? [];
        $targetOrderId = $payload["order_id"] ?? ($routing["id"] ?? ($routing["order_id"] ?? null));

        // 🚀 1. FLUXO DE ADIÇÃO (APPEND TO EXISTING ORDER)
        if ($this->appendHandler->canAppend($targetOrderId)) {
            return $this->appendHandler->handle((int) $targetOrderId, $payload);
        }

        // 🚀 2. FLUXO DE CRIAÇÃO DE NOVO PEDIDO
        $order = DB::transaction(function () use ($payload, $routing) {
            // Regra de Ouro: Pedidos via PDV/Garçom exigem turno aberto
            $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();
            if (!$shift) {
                throw new Exception("Nenhum turno de caixa aberto. Abra o caixa antes de registrar pedidos no PDV.");
            }
            $orderType = $routing["type"] ?? "table";
            $source    = $this->resolveSource($payload);
            $operatorId = auth('team')->id() ?? auth('web')->id() ?? auth()->id() ?? 1;

            // Se for mesa sem ID explícito, verifica se a mesa já possui comanda em aberto
            if ($orderType === 'table') {
                $tableId = $this->tableHandler->resolveTableId($routing);
                $isSubaccount = !empty($routing['is_subaccount']) || !empty($routing['new_subaccount']);

                $existingOrder = $this->tableHandler->findActiveTableOrder($tableId, $isSubaccount);
                if ($existingOrder && $this->appendHandler->canAppend($existingOrder->id)) {
                    return $this->appendHandler->handle($existingOrder->id, $payload);
                }

                $orderData = $this->tableHandler->buildOrderData($payload, $tableId, $operatorId, $source);
            } elseif ($orderType === 'counter') {
                $orderData = $this->counterHandler->buildOrderData($payload, $operatorId, $source);
            } else {
                $orderData = $this->deliveryHandler->buildOrderData($payload, $operatorId, $source);
            }

            $orderData['cash_shift_id'] = $shift->id;
            $order = Order::create($orderData);

            foreach ($payload["items"] as $item) {
                $this->itemProcessor->process($order, $item);
            }

            return $order;
        });

        // 🚀 3. EFEITOS COLATERAIS (KDS, Impressão e WebSockets)
        $isBankApiPending = ($routing['payment_engine'] ?? null) === 'bank_api'
            || ($routing['payment_intent_status'] ?? null) === 'pix_waiting';

        if (!$isBankApiPending) {
            $this->kitchenDispatchService->dispatchNewItems(
                $order,
                $routing['kitchen_print_mode'] ?? 'station',
                (bool) ($routing['kitchen_separate_multiples'] ?? false)
            );

            $this->notifyProductionTeam($order);
        // 🚀 Notificação WebPush para o Cliente no balcão/telefone
        if ($order->customer) {
            try {
                if ($order->customer->user) {
                    $order->customer->user->notify(new OrderStatusUpdated($order, "Seu pedido #{$order->id} foi lançado e já está confirmado!"));
                } else {
                    $order->customer->notify(new OrderStatusUpdated($order, "Seu pedido #{$order->id} foi lançado e já está confirmado!"));
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                Log::error("Falha ao notificar cliente via push no pedido #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        }

        try {
            broadcast(new OrderCreated($order));
            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [WebSockets] Falha ao transmitir evento do pedido #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return $order;
    }

    protected function resolveSource(array $payload): string
    {
        $rawSource = $payload["source"] ?? ($payload["routing"]["source"] ?? null);

        if (in_array($rawSource, Order::VALID_SOURCES, true)) {
            return $rawSource;
        }
        if (request()->is('team*') || request()->routeIs('team.*')) {
            return Order::SOURCE_TEAM_APP;
        }
        if (request()->is('pos*') || request()->routeIs('pos.*')) {
            return Order::SOURCE_POS_APP;
        }

        $detect = new MobileDetect();
        return ($detect->isMobile() || $detect->isTablet())
            ? Order::SOURCE_TEAM_APP
            : Order::SOURCE_POS_APP;
    }

    private function notifyProductionTeam(Order $order): void
    {
        $attendanceService = app(\App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftAttendanceService::class);
        $order->loadMissing('items.product');

        $activeStations = $order->items->pluck('product.production_station')->filter()->unique();

        foreach ($activeStations as $station) {
            $stationLower = strtolower($station);
            if (str_contains($stationLower, 'bar') || $stationLower === 'bebidas') {
                $barStaff = $attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['bar', 'bartender', 'copa']);
                if ($barStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
                    \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::send($barStaff, new \App\Notifications\OrderStatusUpdated($order, "🍹 Preparo de Bar solicitado para o Pedido #{$order->id}!"));
                }
            }

            if (str_contains($stationLower, 'cozinha') || $stationLower === 'quente') {
                $kitchenStaff = $attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['cozinha', 'cook', 'chef', 'kds']);
                if ($kitchenStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
                    \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::send($kitchenStaff, new \App\Notifications\OrderStatusUpdated($order, "🍳 Novos pratos na tela do KDS - Pedido #{$order->id}!"));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/OrderItemProcessor.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\PosAudit;
use App\Models\ModifierOption;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;

class OrderItemProcessor
{
    private static array $productCache = [];
    private static array $modifierOptionCache = [];

    public function __construct(
        protected InventoryService $inventoryService,
        protected ComboItemProcessor $comboProcessor
    ) {}

    protected function getProduct(int $id): ?Product
    {
        if (!isset(self::$productCache[$id])) {
            self::$productCache[$id] = Product::find($id);
        }
        return self::$productCache[$id];
    }

    protected function getModifierOption(int $id): ?ModifierOption
    {
        if (!isset(self::$modifierOptionCache[$id])) {
            self::$modifierOptionCache[$id] = ModifierOption::find($id);
        }
        return self::$modifierOptionCache[$id];
    }

    public function process(Order $order, array $itemData): OrderItem
    {
        $isReplacement = !empty($itemData["replaces_item_id"]);

        // 🛡️ ENCAMINHAMENTO CIRÚRGICO: Se estiver substituindo um subitem de combo
        if ($isReplacement) {
            $oldItem = OrderItem::with(['modifiers', 'subItems.modifiers'])->find($itemData["replaces_item_id"]);
            if ($oldItem && !empty($oldItem->parent_item_id)) {
                return $this->comboProcessor->processChildReplacement($order, $itemData, $oldItem);
            }

            if ($oldItem) {
                $this->handleRootReplacement($order, $itemData, $oldItem);
            }
        }

        $productId = $itemData["id"] ?? null;
        $productModel = $productId ? $this->getProduct((int)$productId) : null;
        $productName = $itemData["name"] ?? 'Produto';
        if (!empty($itemData["isTakeaway"])) {
            $productName .= " (Viagem)";
        }

        $notes = !empty($itemData["notes"]) ? trim((string) $itemData["notes"]) : null;
        if ($isReplacement) {
            $notes = trim(($notes ? $notes . " " : "") . "*** ATENÇÃO: ITEM MODIFICADO NO SISTEMA ***");
        }

        $hasComboItems = !empty($itemData["comboItems"]) && is_array($itemData["comboItems"]);
        $qty = (float) ($itemData["qty"] ?? 1);
        $unitPrice = (float) ($itemData["price"] ?? 0);

        $mainOrderItem = $order->items()->create([
            "parent_item_id"    => null,
            "product_id"        => $productId,
            "product_name"      => $productName,
            "quantity"          => $qty,
            "unit_price"        => $unitPrice,
            "total_price"       => round($unitPrice * $qty, 2),
            "kitchen_id"        => $productModel?->kitchen_id,
            "prep_time_minutes" => $productModel?->prep_time_minutes,
            "notes"             => $notes,
            "user_name"         => auth()->user()?->name ?? 'Sistema',
            "is_combo_item"     => $hasComboItems,
            "status"            => 'active',
            "production_status" => 'pending',
        ]);

        if ($productModel) {
            $this->inventoryService->deductStock($productModel, $qty);
        }

        // 🚀 Delega com segurança ao ComboItemProcessor nativo
        if (!empty($itemData["structuredModifiers"]) && is_array($itemData["structuredModifiers"])) {
            $this->comboProcessor->attachModifiers($mainOrderItem, $itemData["structuredModifiers"], $qty);
        }

        if ($hasComboItems) {
            $this->comboProcessor->processChildren($order, $mainOrderItem, $itemData["comboItems"], $qty);
        }

        return $mainOrderItem;
    }

    private function handleRootReplacement(Order $order, array $itemData, OrderItem $oldItem): void
    {
        if ($oldItem->status === 'cancelled') return;

        if ((float) $oldItem->total_price > 0) {
            $order->decrement('subtotal', $oldItem->total_price);
            $order->decrement('total', $oldItem->total_price);
        }

        $oldProduct = $this->getProduct($oldItem->product_id);
        if ($oldProduct) {
            $this->inventoryService->deductStock($oldProduct, -$oldItem->quantity);
        }

        foreach ($oldItem->modifiers as $mod) {
            if (!empty($mod->modifier_option_id)) {
                $modifierOption = $this->getModifierOption($mod->modifier_option_id);
                if ($modifierOption && $modifierOption->linked_product_id) {
                    $linkedProduct = $this->getProduct($modifierOption->linked_product_id);
                    if ($linkedProduct) {
                        $deduction = ((float) ($modifierOption->linked_qty ?? 1)) * ((float) ($mod->quantity ?? 1));
                        $this->inventoryService->deductStock($linkedProduct, -$deduction);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!empty($itemData['is_loss']) && $oldProduct) {
            $this->inventoryService->registerLoss(
                $oldProduct,
                $oldItem->quantity,
                'Substituição de Pedido: ' . ($itemData["auth_reason"] ?? 'Não especificado'),
                'Lançamento automático de cancelamento de item pai.',
                auth()->id(),
                $oldItem->id
            );
        }

        $oldItem->update(['status' => 'cancelled', 'production_status' => 'cancelled']);

        OrderItem::where('parent_item_id', $oldItem->id)->update([
            'status'            => 'cancelled',
            'production_status' => 'cancelled'
        ]);

        PosAudit::create([
            'action'        => 'edit_item',
            'operator_id'   => auth()->id(),
            'authorizer_id' => auth()->id(),
            'reason'        => $itemData["auth_reason"] ?? 'Edição de Item',
            'context'       => ['old_item_id' => $oldItem->id, 'new_product' => $itemData["name"], 'is_loss' => $itemData["is_loss"] ?? false]
        ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/OrderLogisticsService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Address;
use App\Models\DiningTable;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Notifications\OrderReadyForDeliveryNotification;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Exception;

class OrderLogisticsService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected OrderAddressResolver $addressResolver
    ) {}

    public function transformOrder(Order $order, array $data): Order
    {
        $newType = $data['new_type'] ?? $data['newType'] ?? $data['type'] ?? null;

        if (!$newType || !in_array($newType, ['table', 'counter', 'delivery'], true)) {
            throw new Exception("Tipo de pedido inválido ou não informado.");
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $newType, $data) {
            $order->type = $newType;

            if ($newType === 'table') {
                $tableId = $data['dining_table_id'] ?? $data['table_id'] ?? null;
                $tableName = $data['table_number'] ?? $data['identifier'] ?? null;

                if (!$tableId && $tableName) {
                    $table = DiningTable::where('name', $tableName)
                        ->orWhere('number', $tableName)
                        ->first();
                    $tableId = $table?->id;
                    $tableName = $table?->name ?? $tableName;
                } elseif ($tableId && empty($tableName)) {
                    $tableName = DiningTable::find($tableId)?->name;
                }

                $order->dining_table_id = $tableId;
                $order->table_number = $tableName;

                if (!empty($data['customer_name'])) {
                    $order->customer_name = $data['customer_name'];
                }

                $order->delivery_fee = 0;
                $order->driver_id = null;
                $order->address_id = null;
                $order->address_snapshot = null;
                $order->address = null;
                $order->payment_intent_status = null;
                $order->payment_intent_methods = null;

            } elseif ($newType === 'counter') {
                $order->dining_table_id = null;
                $order->table_number = null;
                $order->delivery_fee = 0;
                $order->driver_id = null;
                $order->address_id = null;
                $order->address_snapshot = null;
                $order->address = null;
                $order->payment_intent_status = null;
                $order->payment_intent_methods = null;

                $identifier = $data['identifier'] ?? $data['customer_name'] ?? null;
                if (!empty($identifier)) {
                    $order->customer_name = $identifier;
                }

            } elseif ($newType === 'delivery') {
                $order->dining_table_id = null;
                $order->table_number = null;

                if (empty($order->payment_intent_status) || $order->payment_intent_status === 'none') {
                    $order->payment_intent_status = 'pending_choice';
                }
            }

            $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
            $serviceFee = $settings ? $settings->calculateServiceFee((float) $order->subtotal, $newType) : 0.00;
            $order->service_fee = $serviceFee;

            $deliveryFee = (float) ($order->delivery_fee ?? 0);
            $subtotal = (float) ($order->subtotal ?? 0);
            $discount = (float) ($order->discount ?? 0);

            $order->total = max(0, round(($subtotal + $serviceFee + $deliveryFee) - $discount, 2));
            $order->save();

            try {
                broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                Log::error("🚨 [WebSockets] Falha ao transmitir conversão do pedido #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
            }

            return $order;
        });
    }

    public function changeAddress(Order $order, int|string|null $addressId, ?float $deliveryFee = null, ?array $rawAddress = null): void
    {
        if ($order->type !== 'delivery') {
            $order->type = 'delivery';
        }

        $routingPayload = [
            'type'        => 'delivery',
            'address_id'  => $addressId,
            'address'     => $rawAddress,
        ];

        $resolved = $this->addressResolver->resolve(
            $routingPayload,
            $order->customer_id,
            (float) ($deliveryFee ?? $order->delivery_fee ?? 0)
        );

        $resolvedAddressId = $resolved['address_id'];
        $resolvedSnapshot = $resolved['snapshot'];

        if ($deliveryFee === null && $resolvedSnapshot) {
            $deliveryFee = (float) ($resolvedSnapshot['delivery_fee'] ?? 0);
        }

        $deliveryFee = (float) ($deliveryFee ?? $order->delivery_fee ?? 0);
        $newTotal = max(0, round(($order->subtotal + $order->service_fee + $deliveryFee) - $order->discount, 2));

        $order->update([
            'type'             => 'delivery',
            'address_id'       => $resolvedAddressId,
            'address_snapshot' => $resolvedSnapshot ?? $order->address_snapshot,
            'address'          => $resolvedSnapshot ?? $order->address,
            'delivery_fee'     => $deliveryFee,
            'total'            => $newTotal
        ]);

        try {
            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [WebSockets] Falha ao transmitir endereço do pedido #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function assignCourier(Order $order, int $driverId): void
    {
        if ($order->type !== 'delivery') {
            throw new Exception('Apenas pedidos de delivery podem receber entregadores.');
        }

        $order->update(['driver_id' => $driverId]);

        $driver = User::find($driverId);
        if ($driver) {
            // 🚀 Envia o Web Push dedicado ao motoboy com link direto para /team/driver
            try {
                $driver->notify(new OrderReadyForDeliveryNotification($order));
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                Log::warning("⚠️ [WebPush] Falha ao notificar motorista #{$driverId}: " . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        try {
            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [WebSockets] Falha ao transmitir entregador do pedido #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function updateDeliveryPayment(Order $order, array $data): void
    {
        $order->update([
            'payment_intent_status'  => $data['payment_intent_status'],
            'payment_intent_methods' => $data['payment_intent_methods'] ?? null,
        ]);

        try {
            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [WebSockets] Falha ao transmitir status de pagamento do pedido #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function getAvailableCouriers(): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        $couriersQuery = User::with('employee:id,phone')
            ->whereHas('roles', function ($q) {
                $q->whereIn('name', ['driver', 'motoboy', 'entregador']);
            })
            ->where('is_active', true);

        if ($settings && $settings->require_shift_attendance) {
            $couriersQuery->whereHas('attendedShifts', function ($q) {
                $q->where('cash_shifts.status', 'open')
                  ->where('shift_attendance.status', 'active')
                  ->where('shift_attendance.attendance_status', 'present');
            });
        }

        return $couriersQuery->get(['id', 'name', 'employee_id'])
            ->map(fn ($user) => [
                'id'          => $user->id,
                'name'        => $user->name,
                'phone'       => $user->employee ? $user->employee->phone : null,
                'employee_id' => $user->employee_id ?? $user->id,
            ])->toArray();
    }

    public function bulkCompleteDispatched(): array
    {
        $orders = Order::with('payments')->where('status', 'dispatched')->get();

        $processed = 0;
        $skipped = 0;

        foreach ($orders as $order) {
            if ($order->payment_status === 'paid' || $order->payment_intent_status === 'paid') {
                $order->update(['status' => 'closed']);
                try {
                    broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
                $processed++;
                continue;
            }

            $promises = $order->payment_intent_methods;
            if (is_string($promises)) {
                $promises = json_decode($promises, true);
            }

            if (empty($promises) || !is_array($promises)) {
                $skipped++;
                continue;
            }

            $orderTotal = (float) $order->total;
            $alreadyPaid = (float) $order->payments->sum('amount');
            $remaining = round($orderTotal - $alreadyPaid, 2);

            if ($remaining <= 0) {
                $order->update([
                    'payment_status'        => 'paid',
                    'payment_intent_status' => 'paid',
                    'status'                => 'closed'
                ]);
                try {
                    broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
                $processed++;
                continue;
            }

            $promisedTotal = collect($promises)->sum(fn ($p) => (float) ($p['amount'] ?? 0));

            if (round($promisedTotal, 2) >= $remaining) {
                DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $promises) {
                    foreach ($promises as $promise) {
                        $amount = (float) ($promise['amount'] ?? 0);
                        if ($amount <= 0) continue;

                        $order->payments()->create([
                            'payment_method_id' => !empty($promise['method_id']) ? (int) $promise['method_id'] : null,
                            'method'            => $promise['method_name'] ?? 'Dinheiro',
                            'amount'            => $amount,
                        ]);
                    }

                    $order->update([
                        'payment_status'        => 'paid',
                        'payment_intent_status' => 'paid',
                        'status'                => 'closed'
                    ]);
                });

                try {
                    broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
                $processed++;
            } else {
                $skipped++;
            }
        }

        return [
            'processed' => $processed,
            'skipped'   => $skipped
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Notifications\NewB2COrderNotification;
use App\Notifications\OrderStatusUpdated;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftAttendanceService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class OrderNotificationDispatcher
{
    public function __construct(
        protected ShiftAttendanceService $attendanceService
    ) {}

    /**
     * Notifica a equipe de atendimento e produção sobre um novo pedido B2C.
     */
    public function notifyTeamOfNewOrder(Order $order): void
    {
        $order->loadMissing('items.product');

        $cashierStaff = $this->attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['caixa', 'pos', 'manager', 'admin', 'gerente']);

        if ($cashierStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
            $msgCaixa = "🔔 Novo Pedido #{$order->id} na fila! (Tipo: {$order->type})";
            Notification::send($cashierStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, $msgCaixa));
        }

        $activeStations = $order->items->pluck('product.production_station')->filter()->unique();

        foreach ($activeStations as $station) {
            $stationLower = strtolower($station);

            if (str_contains($stationLower, 'bar') || $stationLower === 'bebidas') {
                $barStaff = $this->attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['bar', 'bartender', 'copa']);
                if ($barStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $msgBar = "🍹 Novos itens de Bar solicitados no Pedido #{$order->id}!";
                    Notification::send($barStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, $msgBar));
                }
            }

            if (str_contains($stationLower, 'cozinha') || $stationLower === 'quente') {
                $kitchenStaff = $this->attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['cozinha', 'cook', 'chef', 'kds']);
                if ($kitchenStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $msgCozinha = "🍳 Novos pratos para preparo - Pedido #{$order->id}!";
                    Notification::send($kitchenStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, $msgCozinha));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Notifica a equipe operacional sobre o cancelamento de um pedido.
     */
    public function notifyTeamOfCancellation(Order $order, string $message): void
    {
        $posStaff = $this->attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['pos', 'manager', 'admin', 'caixa']);

        if ($posStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
            Notification::send($posStaff, new OrderStatusUpdated($order, $message));
        }
    }
}
```
