## File: app/Services/Orders/OrderPaymentService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use App\Events\OrderCreated;
use App\Services\Marketing\LoyaltyService;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\KitchenDispatchService;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftAttendanceService;
use App\Notifications\NewB2COrderNotification;
use App\Notifications\OrderStatusUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Exception;

class OrderPaymentService
{
    public function __construct(protected LoyaltyService $loyaltyService) {}

    public function processPayment(Order $order, array $data): void
    {
        $cashbackUsed = (float) ($data['cashback_used'] ?? 0);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $data, $cashbackUsed) {
            $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();

            if (!$shift) {
                throw new Exception('Operação negada: Nenhum turno de caixa aberto. Por favor, abra o caixa antes de receber pagamentos.');
            }

            if ($cashbackUsed > 0 && $order->customer) {
                $this->loyaltyService->consumeCashback($order, $order->customer, $cashbackUsed);
            }

            $baseSubAndDelivery = (float) $order->subtotal + (float) $order->delivery_fee;
            $appliedDiscount = min((float) $order->discount, $baseSubAndDelivery);

            $baseTotal = $baseSubAndDelivery - $appliedDiscount;
            $requestedServiceFee = isset($data['service_fee']) ? (float) $data['service_fee'] : (float) $order->service_fee;

            $expectedTotal = max(0, round($baseTotal + $requestedServiceFee, 2));

            $cashPaidThisRun = 0;
            $createdPayments = [];

            foreach ($data['payments'] as $payment) {
                $methodId = $payment['method_id'] ?? null;
                $paymentMethod = PaymentMethod::find($methodId);
                $methodName = $paymentMethod->name ?? 'Outros';

                if ($paymentMethod && $paymentMethod->engine_type === 'internal_loyalty') {
                    $alreadyRegistered = $order->payments()->where('payment_method_id', $methodId)->exists();
                    if ($alreadyRegistered) {
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                $isInternalAllowance = $paymentMethod && $paymentMethod->engine_type === 'internal';

                if ($isInternalAllowance) {
                    if (!$order->customer) {
                        throw new Exception("Para usar o Consumo Interno, é obrigatório identificar o colaborador no pedido.");
                    }

                    $employee = Employee::where('cpf', preg_replace('/\D/', '', $order->customer->cpf ?? ''))
                        ->orWhere('email', $order->customer->email)
                        ->first();

                    if (!$employee && auth()->user() && auth()->user()->employee_id) {
                        $employee = Employee::find(auth()->user()->employee_id);
                    }

                    if (!$employee) {
                        throw new Exception("O cliente não possui um cadastro de Colaborador válido para usar o Vale-Alimentação.");
                    }

                    $latestLedger = $employee->ledgers()->latest('id')->first();
                    $currentBalance = $latestLedger ? (float) $latestLedger->balance : 0;

                    if ($currentBalance < (float) $payment['amount'] - 0.01) {
                        throw new Exception("Saldo de vale-alimentação insuficiente. Saldo atual: R$ " . number_format($currentBalance, 2, ',', '.'));
                    }

                    $employee->ledgers()->create([
                        'type'        => 'debit',
                        'description' => "Consumo Interno - Pedido #{$order->id}",
                        'amount'      => $payment['amount'],
                        'balance'     => $currentBalance - (float) $payment['amount']
                    ]);
                }

                $orderPayment = $order->payments()->create([
                    'payment_method_id' => $methodId,
                    'cash_shift_id'     => $shift->id,
                    'cashier_id'        => auth()->id(),
                    'amount'            => $payment['amount'],
                    'method'            => $methodName
                ]);

                $createdPayments[] = $orderPayment;

                $isCash = ($paymentMethod && $paymentMethod->engine_type !== 'loss' && in_array($paymentMethod->engine_type, ['money', 'cash']))
                    || str_contains(mb_strtolower($methodName), 'dinheiro');

                if ($isCash) {
                    $cashPaidThisRun += (float) $payment['amount'];
                }

                if ($paymentMethod && !in_array($paymentMethod->engine_type, ['internal_loyalty', 'internal', 'loss'])) {
                    Transaction::create([
                        'bank_account_id'  => $shift->bank_account_id,
                        'cash_shift_id'    => $shift->id,
                        'order_id'         => $order->id,
                        'payment_id'       => $orderPayment->id,
                        'payment_method_id'=> $methodId,
                        'type'             => 'in',
                        'category'         => 'order_sale',
                        'amount'           => $payment['amount'],
                        'description'      => "Pedido #{$order->id} ({$methodName})",
                        'operator_name'    => auth()->user()->name ?? 'Sistema',
                        'transaction_date' => now(),
                    ]);
                }
            }

            // Baixa de itens
            if (!empty($data['items'])) {
                foreach ($data['items'] as $pItem) {
                    if (!isset($pItem['id']) || !isset($pItem['pay_qty'])) continue;

                    $payQty = (float) $pItem['pay_qty'];
                    if ($payQty <= 0) continue;

                    $item = OrderItem::where('order_id', $order->id)->find($pItem['id']);
                    if (!$item) continue;

                    $available = max(0, (float) $item->quantity - (float) $item->paid_qty);
                    $toAdd = min($payQty, $available);

                    if ($toAdd > 0) {
                        $item->paid_qty = round((float) $item->paid_qty + $toAdd, 4);
                        $item->save();

                        $itemCoveredAmount = isset($pItem['amount']) && (float) $pItem['amount'] > 0
                            ? (float) $pItem['amount']
                            : round($toAdd * (float) $item->unit_price, 2);

                        if ($itemCoveredAmount <= 0 && count($data['items']) === 1 && !empty($data['payments'])) {
                            $itemCoveredAmount = (float) $data['payments'][0]['amount'];
                        }

                        if (!empty($createdPayments)) {
                            $targetPayment = $createdPayments[0];
                            $targetPayment->items()->attach($item->id, [
                                'quantity' => $toAdd,
                                'amount'   => $itemCoveredAmount
                            ]);
                        }

                        if ($item->parent_item_id) {
                            $parent = OrderItem::find($item->parent_item_id);
                            if ($parent && (float) $parent->total_price > 0) {
                                $proportionalAdvance = ($itemCoveredAmount / (float) $parent->total_price) * (float) $parent->quantity;
                                $parent->paid_qty = min((float) $parent->quantity, round((float) $parent->paid_qty + $proportionalAdvance, 4));
                                $parent->save();
                            }
                        }

                        $subItems = OrderItem::where('parent_item_id', $item->id)->get();
                        if ($subItems->isNotEmpty() && (float) $item->quantity > 0) {
                            $ratio = $toAdd / (float) $item->quantity;
                            foreach ($subItems as $sub) {
                                $subToAdd = (float) $sub->quantity * $ratio;
                                $sub->paid_qty = min((float) $sub->quantity, round((float) $sub->paid_qty + $subToAdd, 4));
                                $sub->save();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            $totalPaid = (float) $order->payments()->sum('amount');
            $excess = round($totalPaid - $expectedTotal, 2);

            $unpaidItemsCount = $order->items()
                ->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')
                ->where(function ($q) {
                    $q->whereNull('paid_qty')
                      ->orWhereRaw('paid_qty < quantity - 0.001');
                })
                ->count();

            $areAllItemsPaid = ($unpaidItemsCount === 0);

            // Troco Real: Saída da gaveta se pago em espécie
            if ($excess > 0.02 && $cashPaidThisRun > 0) {
                $cashChange = min($cashPaidThisRun, $excess);
                $order->change_returned = round(($order->change_returned ?? 0) + $cashChange, 2);

                Transaction::create([
                    'bank_account_id'  => $shift->bank_account_id,
                    'cash_shift_id'    => $shift->id,
                    'order_id'         => $order->id,
                    'type'             => 'out',
                    'category'         => 'change',
                    'amount'           => $cashChange,
                    'description'      => "Troco - Pedido #{$order->id}",
                    'operator_name'    => auth()->user()->name ?? 'Sistema',
                    'transaction_date' => now(),
                ]);
            }

            // Liquidação da conta
            if ($totalPaid >= ($expectedTotal - 0.05) || $areAllItemsPaid || $excess > 0.02) {
                $order->service_fee = $requestedServiceFee;
                $order->total = $expectedTotal;
                $order->payment_status = 'paid';

                OrderItem::where('order_id', $order->id)
                    ->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')
                    ->update(['paid_qty' => DB::raw('quantity')]);

                if ($order->type === 'table') {
                    $order->status = 'closed';
                    $order->closed_at = now();
                } elseif (in_array($order->status, ['pending', 'pending_payment'])) {
                    $order->status = 'preparing';
                }
            } else {
                $order->service_fee = $requestedServiceFee;
                $order->total = $expectedTotal;
                $order->payment_status = 'partial';
            }

            $order->save();
        });

        try {
            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error('🚨 [WebSockets] Falha ao transmitir OrderUpdated #'.$order->id.': '.$e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function processWebhookPayment(string $txid, float $amount, ?string $endToEndId = null): void
    {
        Log::info("OrderPaymentService acionado para o TXID: {$txid}");

        $order = DB::transaction(function () use ($txid, $amount, $endToEndId) {
            $order = Order::with(['customer.user', 'items'])->where('txid', $txid)->first();

            if (!$order) {
                throw new Exception("Pedido com TXID {$txid} não foi encontrado no banco de dados.");
            }

            if ($order->payment_status === 'paid' || $order->status === 'preparing') {
                return $order;
            }

            $paymentMethod = PaymentMethod::where('engine_type', 'bank_api')->first();
            $methodId = $paymentMethod ? $paymentMethod->id : null;
            $methodName = $paymentMethod ? $paymentMethod->name : 'Pix Sicredi';

            $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();

            if (!$shift) {
                throw new Exception('Operação negada: Nenhum turno de caixa aberto. Por favor, abra o caixa antes de receber pagamentos.');
            }

            $orderPayment = $order->payments()->create([
                'payment_method_id' => $methodId,
                'cash_shift_id'     => $shift->id,
                'amount'            => $amount,
                'method'            => $methodName
            ]);

            Transaction::create([
                'bank_account_id'  => $shift->bank_account_id,
                'cash_shift_id'    => $shift->id,
                'order_id'         => $order->id,
                'payment_id'       => $orderPayment->id,
                'payment_method_id'=> $methodId,
                'type'             => 'in',
                'category'         => 'order_sale',
                'amount'           => $amount,
                'description'      => "Pix Confirmado Webhook - Pedido #{$order->id}",
                'operator_name'    => 'Sistema (Sicredi API)',
                'transaction_date' => now(),
            ]);

            foreach ($order->items as $item) {
                if ($item->status === 'cancelled') continue;
                $item->update(['paid_qty' => $item->quantity]);

                $orderPayment->items()->attach($item->id, [
                    'quantity' => $item->quantity,
                    'amount'   => (float) $item->total_price
                ]);
            }

            $order->payment_status = 'paid';

            if ($order->type === 'table') {
                $order->status = 'closed';
                $order->closed_at = now();
            } elseif (in_array($order->status, ['pending', 'pending_payment'])) {
                $order->status = 'preparing';
            }

            $order->save();

            return $order;
        });

        try {
            if ($order) {
                broadcast(new OrderCreated($order));
                broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order));

                app(KitchenDispatchService::class)->dispatchNewItems($order);
                $this->notifyTeamOfPaidPixOrder($order);

                if ($order->customer && $order->customer->user) {
                    $pushMessage = "Seu pagamento de R$ " . number_format($amount, 2, ',', '.') . " foi confirmado! Seu pedido já está em preparação.";
                    $order->customer->user->notify(new OrderStatusUpdated($order, $pushMessage));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            Log::error("Falha ao notificar pedido pago via Webhook ({$txid}): " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    private function notifyTeamOfPaidPixOrder(Order $order): void
    {
        $attendanceService = app(ShiftAttendanceService::class);
        $order->loadMissing('items.product');

        $cashierStaff = $attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['caixa', 'pos', 'manager', 'admin', 'gerente']);

        if ($cashierStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
            $msgCaixa = "PIX Recebido! Pedido #{$order->id} pago e na fila! (Tipo: {$order->type})";
            Notification::send($cashierStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, $msgCaixa));
        }

        $activeStations = $order->items->pluck('product.production_station')->filter()->unique();

        foreach ($activeStations as $station) {
            $stationLower = mb_strtolower($station);

            if (str_contains($stationLower, 'bar') || $stationLower === 'bebidas') {
                $barStaff = $attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['bar', 'bartender', 'copa']);
                if ($barStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $msgBar = "PIX Pago: Novos itens de Bar liberados no Pedido #{$order->id}!";
                    Notification::send($barStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, $msgBar));
                }
            }

            if (str_contains($stationLower, 'cozinha') || $stationLower === 'quente') {
                $kitchenStaff = $attendanceService->getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['cozinha', 'cook', 'chef', 'kds']);
                if ($kitchenStaff->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $msgCozinha = "PIX Pago: Novos pratos liberados para preparo - Pedido #{$order->id}!";
                    Notification::send($kitchenStaff, new NewB2COrderNotification($order, $msgCozinha));
                }
            }
        }
    }
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/OrderStatusService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\OrderStatusUpdated;
use App\Notifications\OrderDispatchedNotification;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftAttendanceService;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

class OrderStatusService
{
    public function updateStatus(Order $order, string $newStatus): void
    {
        $order->update(["status" => $newStatus]);

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh()));

        if ($newStatus === 'dispatched' || $newStatus === 'out_for_delivery') {
            if ($order->driver_id) {
                $driver = User::find($order->driver_id);
                if ($driver) {
                    $driver->notify(new OrderDispatchedNotification($order));
                }
            } else {
                $activeDrivers = ShiftAttendanceService::getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(['driver']);
                if ($activeDrivers->isNotEmpty()) {
                    Notification::send($activeDrivers, new OrderDispatchedNotification($order));
                }
            }
        }

        if ($order->customer_id) {
            $customer = Customer::with('user')->find($order->customer_id);

            if ($customer && $customer->user) {
                $pushMessage = $this->resolvePushMessage($order, $newStatus);
                if ($pushMessage) {
                    $customer->user->notify(new OrderStatusUpdated($order, $pushMessage));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Alterna a inibição preventiva de avaliação pelo caixa.
     */
    public function toggleRatingSuppression(Order $order, bool $skipRating): void
    {
        if ($skipRating) {
            $order->rating()->updateOrCreate(
                ['order_id' => $order->id],
                [
                    'customer_id' => $order->customer_id,
                    'rating'      => 0,
                    'comment'     => '[Sistema] Ocultado preventivamente pelo operador.',
                ]
            );
        } else {
            $order->rating()->where('rating', 0)->delete();
        }

        $order->touch();

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['rating', 'items', 'payments'])));
    }

    private function resolvePushMessage(Order $order, string $newStatus): ?string
    {
        if ($newStatus === 'preparing') return "👨‍🍳 O seu pedido #{$order->id} começou a ser preparado!";
        if ($newStatus === 'dispatched' && $order->type === 'delivery') return "🛵 O entregador está a caminho. Fique de olho!";
        if ($newStatus === 'closed') return "✨ Pedido concluído. Muito obrigado pela preferência!";

        if ($newStatus === 'ready') {
            if ($order->type === 'counter') {
                return "✅ Tudo pronto! Já pode vir retirar o seu pedido no balcão.";
            } elseif ($order->type === 'delivery' && $order->driver_id) {
                $driver = User::find($order->driver_id);
                if ($driver) {
                    $driver->notify(new OrderStatusUpdated($order, "🛵 O pedido de {$order->customer_name} está pronto no balcão para entregar!"));
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/OrderTransferService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\DiningTable;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use App\Events\DiningTableUpdated;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\TablesService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class OrderTransferService
{
    public function execute(array $data): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($data) {
            $sourceOrder = Order::findOrFail($data['source_order_id']);
            $itemIds = $data['item_ids'];

            $mainItems = OrderItem::where('order_id', $sourceOrder->id)
                ->whereIn('id', $itemIds)
                ->get();

            if ($mainItems->isEmpty()) {
                throw new \Exception("Nenhum item válido encontrado para transferência.");
            }

            foreach ($mainItems as $item) {
                if ($item->paid_qty > 0) {
                    throw new \Exception("Não é possível transferir '{$item->product_name}' pois o item já possui pagamentos vinculados.");
                }
            }

            $childItems = OrderItem::where('order_id', $sourceOrder->id)
                ->whereIn('parent_item_id', $mainItems->pluck('id'))
                ->get();

            $transferValue = (float) $mainItems->sum('total_price');

            // 1. Resolve ou localiza a comanda de destino
            $destOrder = $this->resolveDestinationOrder($data);

            // 2. Transfere fisicamente os itens para o pedido de destino
            $allItemsToTransfer = $mainItems->pluck('id')->merge($childItems->pluck('id'));
            OrderItem::whereIn('id', $allItemsToTransfer)->update(['order_id' => $destOrder->id]);

            // 3. Recalcula a comanda de origem
            $this->recalculateOrderTotals($sourceOrder);

            // Verifica se ainda restam itens ativos na comanda de origem
            $remainingActiveItems = $sourceOrder->items()
                ->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')
                ->count();

            if ($remainingActiveItems === 0) {
                // 🚀 Em vez de 'cancelled', marcamos como 'merged' (transferido), registrando histórico
                $sourceOrder->update([
                    'status' => 'merged',
                    'notes'  => trim(($sourceOrder->notes ? $sourceOrder->notes . ' | ' : '') . "Itens transferidos para {$destOrder->customer_name} (#{$destOrder->id})"),
                ]);

                // Se a mesa de origem não tiver mais nenhum pedido ativo, libera a mesa física
                $this->freeTableIfEmpty($sourceOrder);
            }

            // 4. Recalcula a comanda de destino
            $this->recalculateOrderTotals($destOrder);

            // Garante que a mesa de destino fique marcada como ocupada
            $this->occupyDestinationTable($destOrder);

            // 5. Transmissão em tempo real para os terminais
            try {
                broadcast(new OrderUpdated($sourceOrder->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));
                broadcast(new OrderUpdated($destOrder->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        });
    }

    private function recalculateOrderTotals(Order $order): void
    {
        $subtotal = (float) $order->items()
            ->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')
            ->sum('total_price');

        $deliveryFee = (float) ($order->delivery_fee ?? 0);
        $discount    = (float) ($order->discount ?? 0);

        // Mantém a taxa de serviço proporcional se houver
        $serviceFee = 0.00;
        if ((float) $order->service_fee > 0 && $subtotal > 0) {
            $oldSubtotal = (float) $order->subtotal > 0 ? (float) $order->subtotal : $subtotal;
            $rate = (float) $order->service_fee / $oldSubtotal;
            $serviceFee = round($subtotal * $rate, 2);
        }

        $total = max(0, round($subtotal + $deliveryFee + $serviceFee - $discount, 2));

        $order->update([
            'subtotal'    => $subtotal,
            'service_fee' => $serviceFee,
            'total'       => $total,
        ]);

        if (method_exists($order, 'recalculatePaymentStatus')) {
            $order->recalculatePaymentStatus();
        }
    }

    private function resolveDestinationOrder(array $data): Order
    {
        if ($data['destination_type'] === 'table') {
            $intent = $data['destination_order_intent'] ?? null;

            // Se o usuário selecionou uma comanda específica existente
            if (is_numeric($intent)) {
                $destOrder = Order::findOrFail((int) $intent);

                if (in_array($destOrder->status, ['closed', 'cancelled', 'merged'])) {
                    throw new \Exception("A comanda de destino (#{$destOrder->id}) já está finalizada. Selecione outra comanda ou abra uma nova.");
                }

                return $destOrder;
            }

            // Resolução da mesa de destino por ID ou Nome
            $tableId = $data['destination_dining_table_id'] ?? ($data['destination_table_id'] ?? null);
            $tableName = $data['destination_table_name'] ?? null;

            $table = null;
            if ($tableId) {
                $table = DiningTable::find($tableId);
            } elseif ($tableName) {
                $table = DiningTable::where('name', $tableName)->first();
            }

            if (!$table) {
                throw new \Exception("Mesa de destino não localizada para concluir a transferência.");
            }

            $tableId = $table->id;
            $tableName = $table->name;

            // 🚀 Se a intenção NÃO for criar uma subconta isolada, reaproveita a comanda ativa da mesa
            if ($intent !== 'new_subaccount') {
                $existingActiveOrder = Order::where(function ($q) use ($table) {
                        $q->where('dining_table_id', $table->id)
                          ->orWhere('table_number', $table->name);
                    })
                    ->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'cancelled', 'merged', 'completed'])
                    ->latest('id')
                    ->first();

                if ($existingActiveOrder) {
                    return $existingActiveOrder;
                }
            }

            // Caso a mesa esteja livre ou tenha sido solicitado subconta, cria a comanda de destino
            $customerName = ($intent === 'new_subaccount' && !empty($data['new_subaccount_name']))
                ? trim($data['new_subaccount_name'])
                : "Mesa " . $tableName;

            return Order::create([
                "dining_table_id" => (int) $tableId,
                "table_number"    => $tableName,
                "customer_name"   => $customerName,
                "type"            => "table",
                "status"          => "pending",
                "payment_status"  => "pending",
                "subtotal"        => 0,
                "discount"        => 0,
                "delivery_fee"    => 0,
                "service_fee"     => 0,
                "total"           => 0,
                "employee_id"     => auth()->id(),
            ]);
        }

        $type = ($data['destination_order_intent'] ?? '') === 'new_delivery' ? 'delivery' : 'counter';

        return Order::create([
            "customer_name"  => "Novo " . ucfirst($type),
            "type"           => $type,
            "status"         => "pending",
            "payment_status" => "pending",
            "subtotal"       => 0,
            "discount"       => 0,
            "delivery_fee"   => 0,
            "service_fee"    => 0,
            "total"          => 0,
            "employee_id"    => auth()->id(),
        ]);
    }

    private function freeTableIfEmpty(Order $sourceOrder): void
    {
        $table = $sourceOrder->diningTable
            ?? ($sourceOrder->dining_table_id ? DiningTable::find($sourceOrder->dining_table_id) : null)
            ?? (!empty($sourceOrder->table_number) ? DiningTable::where('name', $sourceOrder->table_number)->first() : null);

        if (!$table) return;

        $hasOtherActive = Order::where(function ($q) use ($table) {
                $q->where('dining_table_id', $table->id)
                  ->orWhere('table_number', $table->name);
            })
            ->where('id', '!=', $sourceOrder->id)
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'cancelled', 'merged', 'completed'])
            ->exists();

        if (!$hasOtherActive) {
            $table->update(['status' => 'available']);
            app(TablesService::class)->split($table);

            try {
                broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($table->fresh()));
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }
    }

    private function occupyDestinationTable(Order $destOrder): void
    {
        if ($destOrder->type !== 'table') return;

        $table = $destOrder->diningTable
            ?? ($destOrder->dining_table_id ? DiningTable::find($destOrder->dining_table_id) : null)
            ?? (!empty($destOrder->table_number) ? DiningTable::where('name', $destOrder->table_number)->first() : null);

        if ($table && $table->status !== 'occupied') {
            $table->update(['status' => 'occupied']);

            try {
                broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($table->fresh()));
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Orders/PosCheckoutService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Orders;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\KitchenDispatchService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class PosCheckoutService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected InventoryService $inventoryService,
        protected KitchenDispatchService $kitchenDispatchService
    ) {}

    /**
     * Trava atômica que impede mutação financeira em pedidos já liquidados.
     */
    protected function assertOrderCanBeMutated(Order $order, bool $allowIfPaid = false): void
    {
        $isClosed = in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'delivered', 'merged'], true);
        if ($isClosed) {
            throw new \Exception("Ação Recusada: O Pedido #{$order->id} já se encontra finalizado ou cancelado.");
        }

        if (!$allowIfPaid && $order->payment_status === 'paid') {
            throw new \Exception("Ação Recusada: O Pedido #{$order->id} já se encontra quitado.");
        }
    }

    public function getCheckoutData(Order $order): array
    {
        $relations = ['items.modifiers', 'items.subItems.modifiers'];
        if (method_exists($order, 'customer')) $relations[] = 'customer';
        if (method_exists($order, 'address')) $relations[] = 'address';
        if (method_exists($order, 'payments')) $relations[] = 'payments.items';
        if (method_exists($order, 'diningTable')) $relations[] = 'diningTable';

        $order->loadMissing($relations);

        $paymentMethods = PaymentMethod::where('is_active', true)
            ->where('show_on_pos', true)
            ->where('engine_type', '!=', 'internal_loyalty')
            ->orderBy('id', 'asc')
            ->get();

        $companySettings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? Setting::first();

        if (!$companySettings) {
            $companySettings = (object) [
                'has_service_tax'     => true,
                'is_fiscal_emitter'   => false,
                'checkout_print_mode' => 'ask',
            ];
        }

        $hasFiscalDocument = \App\Models\FiscalDocument::where('order_id', $order->id)
            ->where('status', 'authorized')
            ->exists();

        return [
            'order'             => $order,
            'paymentMethods'    => $paymentMethods,
            'companySettings'   => $companySettings,
            'hasFiscalDocument' => $hasFiscalDocument,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Duplica um item ou combo completo.
     * Subitens de combo são compulsoriamente convertidos em itens soltos ao preço de catálogo.
     */
    public function quickAdd(Order $order, int $itemId, bool $shouldPrint = false): OrderItem
    {
        $this->assertOrderCanBeMutated($order, true);

        $newItem = DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $itemId, $shouldPrint) {
            $originalItem = OrderItem::with(['modifiers', 'subItems.modifiers'])
                ->where('order_id', $order->id)
                ->findOrFail($itemId);

            $isSubItem = !empty($originalItem->parent_item_id);

            // =========================================================================
            // CENÁRIO A: É UM SUBITEM DE COMBO -> EMANCIPAÇÃO COMO ITEM SOLTO
            // =========================================================================
            if ($isSubItem) {
                $product = $originalItem->product_id ? Product::find($originalItem->product_id) : null;

                // 1. Resolução do preço real do produto fora do combo
                $isDelivery = in_array($order->type, ['delivery', 'takeaway', 'pickup'], true);
                $catalogPrice = 0.00;
                if ($product) {
                    $catalogPrice = ($isDelivery && ($product->delivery_price > 0))
                        ? (float) $product->delivery_price
                        : (float) ($product->dine_in_price ?? $product->price ?? 0);
                }

                // 2. Soma o valor dos adicionais/modificadores
                $origItemQty = max(1, (float) $originalItem->quantity);
                $modifiersExtra = 0.00;
                foreach ($originalItem->modifiers as $mod) {
                    $modQty = max(1, (int) round(($mod->quantity ?: 1) / $origItemQty));
                    $modifiersExtra += ((float) ($mod->price ?? 0)) * $modQty;
                }

                $finalUnitPrice = round($catalogPrice + $modifiersExtra, 2);

                // 3. Clona o item como SOLTO (parent_item_id = null)
                $clone = $originalItem->replicate([
                    'id',
                    'created_at',
                    'updated_at',
                    'fired_at',
                    'printed_at',
                    'paid_qty',
                ]);

                $clone->order_id          = $order->id;
                $clone->parent_item_id    = null; // 🛡️ Sem combo pai
                $clone->quantity          = 1;
                $clone->paid_qty          = 0.00;
                $clone->unit_price        = $finalUnitPrice;
                $clone->total_price       = $finalUnitPrice;
                $clone->status            = 'active';
                $clone->production_status = $shouldPrint ? 'pending' : 'ready';
                $clone->fired_at          = $shouldPrint ? null : now();
                $clone->save();

                // 4. Clona os modificadores para a nova linha independente
                foreach ($originalItem->modifiers as $modifier) {
                    $newMod = $modifier->replicate(['id', 'order_item_id', 'created_at', 'updated_at']);
                    $newMod->order_item_id = $clone->id;
                    $newMod->quantity      = max(1, (int) round(($modifier->quantity ?: 1) / $origItemQty));
                    $newMod->save();
                }

                if ($product) {
                    $this->inventoryService->deductStock($product, 1);
                }

                $this->syncOrderTotals($order);

                if ($shouldPrint) {
                    $this->kitchenDispatchService->dispatchNewItems($order);
                }

                return $clone;
            }

            // =========================================================================
            // CENÁRIO B: PRODUTO AVULSO OU COMBO PAI COMPLETO
            // =========================================================================
            $clone = $originalItem->replicate([
                'id',
                'created_at',
                'updated_at',
                'fired_at',
                'printed_at',
                'paid_qty',
            ]);

            $clone->order_id          = $order->id;
            $clone->parent_item_id    = null;
            $clone->quantity          = 1;
            $clone->paid_qty          = 0.00;
            $clone->unit_price        = (float) $originalItem->unit_price;
            $clone->total_price       = round(1 * (float) $originalItem->unit_price, 2);
            $clone->status            = 'active';
            $clone->production_status = $shouldPrint ? 'pending' : 'ready';
            $clone->fired_at          = $shouldPrint ? null : now();
            $clone->save();

            $origItemQty = max(1, (float) $originalItem->quantity);

            // Modificadores do item principal
            foreach ($originalItem->modifiers as $modifier) {
                $newMod = $modifier->replicate(['id', 'order_item_id', 'created_at', 'updated_at']);
                $newMod->order_item_id = $clone->id;
                $newMod->quantity      = max(1, (int) round(($modifier->quantity ?: 1) / $origItemQty));
                $newMod->save();
            }

            // 🚀 Clona todos os subitens se for um combo inteiro
            foreach ($originalItem->subItems as $subItem) {
                $newSub = $subItem->replicate([
                    'id',
                    'parent_item_id',
                    'created_at',
                    'updated_at',
                    'fired_at',
                    'printed_at',
                    'paid_qty'
                ]);

                $subItemOrigQty = max(1, (float) $subItem->quantity);
                $newSubQty = max(1, (int) round($subItemOrigQty / $origItemQty));

                $newSub->parent_item_id    = $clone->id; // Vinculado ao novo combo pai
                $newSub->order_id          = $order->id;
                $newSub->quantity          = $newSubQty;
                $newSub->unit_price        = (float) $subItem->unit_price;
                $newSub->total_price       = round($newSubQty * (float) $subItem->unit_price, 2);
                $newSub->status            = 'active';
                $newSub->production_status = $shouldPrint ? 'pending' : 'ready';
                $newSub->fired_at          = $shouldPrint ? null : now();
                $newSub->paid_qty          = 0.00;
                $newSub->save();

                foreach ($subItem->modifiers as $subMod) {
                    $newSubMod = $subMod->replicate(['id', 'order_item_id', 'created_at', 'updated_at']);
                    $newSubMod->order_item_id = $newSub->id;
                    $newSubMod->quantity      = max(1, (int) round(($subMod->quantity ?: 1) / $subItemOrigQty));
                    $newSubMod->save();
                }

                if ($newSub->product_id) {
                    $subProduct = Product::find($newSub->product_id);
                    if ($subProduct) {
                        $this->inventoryService->deductStock($subProduct, (float) $newSub->quantity);
                    }
                }
            }

            if ($clone->product_id) {
                $product = Product::find($clone->product_id);
                if ($product) {
                    $this->inventoryService->deductStock($product, (float) $clone->quantity);
                }
            }

            $this->syncOrderTotals($order);

            if ($shouldPrint) {
                $this->kitchenDispatchService->dispatchNewItems($order);
            }

            return $clone;
        });

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));

        return $newItem;
    }

    public function addItem(Order $order, array $data): OrderItem
    {
        $this->assertOrderCanBeMutated($order, true);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $data) {
            $product = Product::findOrFail($data['product_id']);
            $qty = (float) ($data['quantity'] ?? 1);
            $unitPrice = isset($data['unit_price'])
                ? (float) $data['unit_price']
                : (float) ($product->dine_in_price ?? $product->price ?? 0);

            $item = $order->items()->create([
                'product_id'  => $product->id,
                'name'        => $product->name,
                'quantity'    => $qty,
                'unit_price'  => $unitPrice,
                'total_price' => round($qty * $unitPrice, 2),
                'status'      => 'pending',
                'notes'       => $data['notes'] ?? null,
            ]);

            $this->syncOrderTotals($order);

            $this->inventoryService->processOrderItemStock($item, 'deduct');

            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));

            return $item;
        });
    }

    public function cancelItem(Order $order, int $itemId, string|float $qtyParam = 'all', ?string $reason = null): array
    {
        $this->assertOrderCanBeMutated($order);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $itemId, $qtyParam, $reason) {
            $targetItem = OrderItem::where('order_id', $order->id)->findOrFail($itemId);

            $qtyToCancel = (float) $targetItem->quantity;
            $isPartial = false;

            if ($qtyParam !== 'all' && (float) $qtyParam < (float) $targetItem->quantity) {
                $qtyToCancel = (float) $qtyParam;
                $isPartial = true;
            }

            if ($isPartial) {
                $targetItem->quantity -= $qtyToCancel;
                $targetItem->total_price = round($targetItem->quantity * $targetItem->unit_price, 2);
                $targetItem->save();

                $clone = $targetItem->replicate();
                $clone->quantity = $qtyToCancel;
                $clone->total_price = round($qtyToCancel * $clone->unit_price, 2);
                $clone->status = 'cancelled';
                $clone->cancel_reason = $reason ?? 'Cancelado no checkout (Parcial)';
                $clone->save();

                $this->inventoryService->processOrderItemStock($clone, 'restore');
            } else {
                $targetItem->update([
                    'status'        => 'cancelled',
                    'cancel_reason' => $reason ?? 'Cancelado no checkout',
                ]);

                $this->inventoryService->processOrderItemStock($targetItem, 'restore');
            }

            $this->syncOrderTotals($order);

            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));

            return [
                'is_partial'    => $isPartial,
                'cancelled_qty' => $qtyToCancel,
            ];
        });
    }

    public function applyDiscount(Order $order, float $discount): void
    {
        $this->assertOrderCanBeMutated($order);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $discount) {
            $order->update(['discount' => $discount]);
            $this->syncOrderTotals($order);
        });

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));
    }

    public function removeDiscount(Order $order): void
    {
        $this->assertOrderCanBeMutated($order);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order) {
            $order->update(['discount' => 0]);
            $this->syncOrderTotals($order);
        });

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));
    }

    public function toggleServiceFee(Order $order, bool $enabled, float $rate = 0.10): void
    {
        $this->assertOrderCanBeMutated($order);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $enabled, $rate) {
            $subtotal = (float) $order->items()
                ->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')
                ->sum('total_price');

            $serviceFee = $enabled ? round($subtotal * $rate, 2) : 0;

            $order->update(['service_fee' => $serviceFee]);
            $this->syncOrderTotals($order);
        });

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));
    }

    public function linkCustomer(Order $order, ?int $customerId, ?string $customerName): void
    {
        $this->assertOrderCanBeMutated($order);

        $order->update([
            'customer_id'   => $customerId,
            'customer_name' => $customerName,
        ]);

        broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh(['items', 'payments'])));
    }

    public function syncOrderTotals(Order $order): void
    {
        if (method_exists($order, 'recalculateTotals')) {
            $order->recalculateTotals();
            return;
        }

        $subtotal = (float) $order->items()
            ->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled')
            ->sum('total_price');

        $deliveryFee = (float) ($order->delivery_fee ?? 0);
        $serviceFee  = (float) ($order->service_fee ?? 0);
        $discount    = (float) ($order->discount ?? 0);

        $total = max(0, round($subtotal + $deliveryFee + $serviceFee - $discount, 2));

        $order->update([
            'subtotal' => $subtotal,
            'total'    => $total,
        ]);

        if (method_exists($order, 'recalculatePaymentStatus')) {
            $order->recalculatePaymentStatus();
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Printing\BlueprintBuilder;
use App\Services\Printing\ReceiptFormatter;
use App\Services\Printing\OrderTableBuilder;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ConferenceBill
{
    protected Order $order;
    protected array $settings;

    public function __construct(Order $order, array $settings)
    {
        $this->order = $order;
        $this->settings = $settings;
    }

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'conference_bill';
    }

    private function cleanText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        $text = str_replace(['[VIAGEM]', '(VIAGEM)'], '', $text);
        return trim(Str::ascii(mb_strtoupper($text)));
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $order = $this->order;
        $settings = $this->settings;
        $b = new BlueprintBuilder();

        // 🎯 1. LOGOTIPO DINÂMICO DO TENANT (OU NOME FANTASIA)
        $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];

        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;
        $domain = $tenant?->domains?->first()?->domain
            ?? ($tenant ? $tenant->id . '.brasume.com.br' : request()->getHost());

        $logoUrl = !empty($settings['receipt_logo_url'])
            ? $settings['receipt_logo_url']
            : (!empty($settings['logo_path']) ? "https://{$domain}/media/file?path=" . $settings['logo_path'] : null);

        if ($logoUrl) {
            $b->image($logoUrl);
        } else {
            $b->text($this->cleanText($settings['trade_name'] ?? $settings['company_name'] ?? 'SISTEMA ERP'), true, '2x');
        }

        $b->text(' ', false, '1x');

        $typeTitle = 'BALCAO';
        if ($order->type === 'delivery') $typeTitle = 'ENTREGA';
        if ($order->type === 'pickup' || $order->type === 'takeaway') $typeTitle = 'RETIRADA';
        if ($order->type === 'table') $typeTitle = 'MESA ' . ($order->table_number ?: '?');

        $b->text("*** {$typeTitle} ***", true, '2x')
          ->text(' ', false, '1x');

        $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
        $b->text('PEDIDO: #' . $order->id, true, '1x');

        $clientName = $order->customer_name ?: 'CONSUMIDOR FINAL';
        $b->text($this->cleanText('CLIENTE: ' . $clientName));

        if ($order->customer && $order->customer->phone) {
            $b->text('TEL: ' . $order->customer->phone);
        }

        $b->text('DATA: ' . now()->format('d/m/Y H:i'));

        if ($order->type === 'delivery' && $order->address) {
            $b->divider()->text('ENDERECO DE ENTREGA:', true);
            $addr = $order->address;
            $streetLine = "{$addr['street']}, {$addr['number']}";
            if (!empty($addr['neighborhood'])) $streetLine .= " - {$addr['neighborhood']}";
            $b->text($this->cleanText($streetLine));

            if (!empty($addr['complement'])) $b->text($this->cleanText('COMP: ' . $addr['complement']));
            if (!empty($addr['reference'])) $b->text($this->cleanText('REF: ' . $addr['reference']));
        }

        $b->divider()->text('CONFERENCIA DE ITENS:', true);

        $activeItems = $order->items ? $order->items->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled') : collect();
        OrderTableBuilder::buildConference($b, $activeItems);

        if ($order->notes) {
            $b->divider()->text('OBSERVACOES:', true)->text($this->cleanText($order->notes));
        }

        $b->divider();
        $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'rt'];

        if ($order->subtotal > 0) $b->text('PRODUTOS R$: ' . $this->money($order->subtotal));
        if ($order->delivery_fee > 0) $b->text('TAXA ENTREGA R$: ' . $this->money($order->delivery_fee));
        if ($order->service_fee > 0) $b->text('TAXA SERVICO R$: ' . $this->money($order->service_fee));
        if ($order->discount > 0) $b->text('DESCONTO R$: -' . $this->money($order->discount));

        $b->text('TOTAL R$: ' . $this->money($order->total), true, '2x')->space();

        $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];

        $isPaidStatus = in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'completed']) || $order->payment_status === 'paid';
        $paidAmount = $order->payments->sum('amount');
        $toCollect = max(0, (float)$order->total - (float)$paidAmount);

        if ($isPaidStatus || $toCollect <= 0.02) {
            $b->text('PAGO', true, '2x')->text('NAO COBRAR DO CLIENTE.');
        } else {
            $b->text('*** A COBRAR R$: ' . $this->money($toCollect) . ' ***', true, '2x')->space();

            $methods = $order->payment_intent_methods ?? [];
            $hasPendingIntents = (!empty($methods) && is_array($methods))
                || in_array($order->payment_intent_status, ['pay_on_delivery', 'pay_on_pickup', 'pending_choice']);

            $hasPayments = $order->payments->count() > 0 || $hasPendingIntents;

            if ($hasPayments) {
                $b->text('FORMA DE PAGTO', true);
                $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];

                if (!empty($methods) && is_array($methods)) {
                    $orderChangeTarget = (float) ($order->change_target ?? $order->delivery_change_target ?? 0);

                    foreach ($methods as $method) {
                        $methodName = $this->cleanText($method['method_name'] ?? 'DINHEIRO');
                        $amount = (float) ($method['amount'] ?? $toCollect);
                        $changeFor = (float) ($method['change_target'] ?? $orderChangeTarget);
                        $troco = max(0, $changeFor - $amount);

                        if (str_contains($methodName, 'DINHEIRO')) {
                            if ($changeFor > 0 && $troco > 0) {
                                $methodName = 'DINHEIRO (LEVAR TROCO)';
                            } else {
                                $methodName = 'DINHEIRO - SEM TROCO';
                            }
                        }

                        $b->text($methodName, true, '2x');

                        if (count($methods) > 1) {
                            $b->text('VALOR R$: ' . $this->money($amount));
                        }
                        if ($changeFor > 0 && $troco > 0) {
                            $b->text('PAGAMENTO EM: R$ ' . $this->money($changeFor))
                              ->text('TROCO R$: ' . $this->money($troco), true);
                        }
                        $b->space();
                    }
                }

                foreach ($order->payments as $pay) {
                    $b->text($this->cleanText($pay->method) . ' (JA PAGO)', true)
                      ->text('VALOR R$: ' . $this->money($pay->amount))
                      ->space();
                }
            } else {
                $b->text('(!) FORMA NAO INFORMADA', true)->text('RECEBER NO FECHAMENTO.');
                $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
            }
        }

        $b->space();
        $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];
        $b->divider();

        $dbSettings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        if ($dbSettings && !empty($dbSettings->receipt_footer_text)) {
            $b->text($this->cleanText($dbSettings->receipt_footer_text));
        }

        if (!empty($settings['receipt_promo_qrcode'])) {
            $b->qrCode($settings['receipt_promo_qrcode'], 6);
        }

        return $b->cut()->get();
    }

    private function money($value): string
    {
        return number_format((float) $value, 2, ',', '.');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Services\Printing\BlueprintBuilder;
use App\Services\Printing\ReceiptFormatter;
use App\Services\Printing\OrderTableBuilder;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class CustomerReceipt
{
    public function __construct(
        public Order $order,
        public array $settings,
        public ?string $cpf = null
    ) {}

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'customer_receipt';
    }

    public function getOrderId(): ?int
    {
        return $this->order?->id;
    }

    private function cleanText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        $text = str_replace(['[VIAGEM]', '(VIAGEM)'], '', $text);
        return trim(Str::ascii(mb_strtoupper($text)));
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $order = $this->order;
        $settings = $this->settings;
        $b = new BlueprintBuilder();

        $cols = !empty($settings['printer_columns']) ? (int) $settings['printer_columns'] : 48;

        // 🎯 1. LOGOTIPO DINÂMICO DO TENANT (OU NOME FANTASIA)
        $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];

        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;
        $domain = $tenant?->domains?->first()?->domain
            ?? ($tenant ? $tenant->id . '.brasume.com.br' : request()->getHost());

        $logoUrl = !empty($settings['receipt_logo_url'])
            ? $settings['receipt_logo_url']
            : (!empty($settings['logo_path']) ? "https://{$domain}/media/file?path=" . $settings['logo_path'] : null);

        if ($logoUrl) {
            $b->image($logoUrl);
        } else {
            $companyName = $this->cleanText($settings['trade_name'] ?? $settings['company_name'] ?? 'SISTEMA ERP');
            $b->text($companyName, true, '2x');
        }

        $b->text('RECIBO DE PAGAMENTO', true, '1x')
          ->text('PEDIDO: #' . $order->id);

        if ($this->cpf) {
            $b->text('CPF/CNPJ: ' . $this->cpf);
        }

        $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
        $b->divider();

        // 🎯 2. TABELA DE ITENS (JUSTIFICADA COM RECEIPTFORMATTER)
        $activeItems = $order->items ? $order->items->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled') : collect();
        $hasDecimal = OrderTableBuilder::hasDecimalQuantity($activeItems, fn($item) => (float) $item->quantity);

        $qtySize = $hasDecimal ? 6 : 4;
        $priceSize = 10;
        $fixedTotal = $qtySize + 1 + 1 + $priceSize;
        $descSize = max(15, $cols - $fixedTotal);

        $headers = ['QTD', ' ', 'DESCRICAO', ' ', 'VALOR R$'];
        $sizes   = [$qtySize, 1, 0, 1, $priceSize];
        $aligns  = ['L', 'L', 'L', 'L', 'R'];

        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns($headers, $sizes, $aligns, $cols), true);
        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider($cols));

        $parents = $activeItems->filter(fn($item) => empty($item->parent_item_id));
        $children = $activeItems->filter(fn($item) => !empty($item->parent_item_id));

        foreach ($parents as $parent) {
            $qty = (float) $parent->quantity;
            $qtyStr = substr(OrderTableBuilder::formatQty($qty, $hasDecimal) . 'x', 0, $qtySize);

            $rawName = $this->cleanText($parent->product_name);
            if (!empty($parent->is_reward)) {
                $rawName .= ' [CORTESIA]';
            }
            $pName = substr($rawName, 0, $descSize);
            $totalItem = substr(number_format((float) $parent->total_price, 2, ',', '.'), 0, $priceSize);

            $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
                [$qtyStr, ' ', $pName, ' ', $totalItem],
                $sizes,
                $aligns,
                $cols
            ), true);

            if (!empty($parent->notes)) {
                $cleanNotes = substr($this->cleanText($parent->notes), 0, max(5, $descSize - 7));
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['', '  (OBS: ' . $cleanNotes . ')'], [$qtySize + 1, 0], ['L', 'L'], $cols), false);
            }

            $rawMods = $parent->modifiers ?? $parent->structured_modifiers ?? $parent->structuredModifiers ?? [];
            if (!empty($rawMods)) {
                foreach ($rawMods as $mod) {
                    $modObj = is_array($mod) ? (object) $mod : $mod;
                    $cleanMod = substr($this->cleanText($modObj->name ?? ''), 0, $descSize);
                    $modQty = (float)($modObj->quantity ?? $modObj->qty ?? 1);
                    $prefix = ($modQty > 1) ? ((int)$modQty . 'X ') : '';
                    $sign = (str_starts_with($cleanMod, 'SEM ') || str_starts_with($cleanMod, 'NAO ')) ? '- ' : '+ ';
                    $modPrice = (float)($modObj->price ?? 0) > 0 ? number_format((float)$modObj->price, 2, ',', '.') : '';

                    $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
                        ['', ' ', '  ' . $sign . $prefix . $cleanMod, ' ', $modPrice],
                        [$qtySize, 1, 0, 1, $priceSize],
                        ['L', 'L', 'L', 'L', 'R'],
                        $cols
                    ), false);
                }
            }

            $itemChildren = $children->filter(fn($c) => (int)$c->parent_item_id === (int)$parent->id);
            if ($itemChildren->isEmpty() && method_exists($parent, 'relationLoaded') && $parent->relationLoaded('subItems')) {
                $itemChildren = $parent->subItems->filter(fn($c) => ($c->status ?? null) !== 'cancelled');
            }

            foreach ($itemChildren as $child) {
                $cQty = (float) $child->quantity;
                $cQtyStr = substr(OrderTableBuilder::formatQty($cQty, $hasDecimal) . 'x ', 0, $qtySize);
                $cName = '   > ' . $cQtyStr . $this->cleanText($child->product_name);
                $cDesc = substr($cName, 0, $descSize);
                $cTotal = ((float)$child->total_price > 0) ? substr(number_format((float)$child->total_price, 2, ',', '.'), 0, $priceSize) : '';

                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
                    ['', ' ', $cDesc, ' ', $cTotal],
                    $sizes,
                    $aligns,
                    $cols
                ), false);

                if (!empty($child->notes)) {
                    $cNotes = substr($this->cleanText($child->notes), 0, max(5, $descSize - 9));
                    $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['', '    (OBS: ' . $cNotes . ')'], [$qtySize + 1, 0], ['L', 'L'], $cols), false);
                }
            }
        }

        $b->divider();

        // 🎯 3. FECHAMENTO FINANCEIRO JUSTIFICADO
        $hasFeesOrDiscount = (float) $order->delivery_fee > 0
            || (float) $order->service_fee > 0
            || (float) $order->discount > 0;

        if ($hasFeesOrDiscount) {
            if ((float) $order->subtotal > 0) {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['SUBTOTAL:', 'R$ ' . number_format((float) $order->subtotal, 2, ',', '.')], [24, 0], ['L', 'R'], $cols));
            }
            if ((float) $order->delivery_fee > 0) {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['TAXA DE ENTREGA:', 'R$ ' . number_format((float) $order->delivery_fee, 2, ',', '.')], [24, 0], ['L', 'R'], $cols));
            }
            if ((float) $order->service_fee > 0) {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['TAXA DE SERVICO:', 'R$ ' . number_format((float) $order->service_fee, 2, ',', '.')], [24, 0], ['L', 'R'], $cols));
            }
            if ((float) $order->discount > 0) {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['DESCONTO:', '-R$ ' . number_format((float) $order->discount, 2, ',', '.')], [24, 0], ['L', 'R'], $cols));
            }
            $b->divider();
        }

        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
            ['TOTAL PAGO:', 'R$ ' . number_format((float) $order->total, 2, ',', '.')],
            [20, 0],
            ['L', 'R'],
            $cols
        ), true);

        // 🎯 4. FORMAS DE PAGAMENTO
        if ($order->relationLoaded('payments') && $order->payments->isNotEmpty()) {
            $b->space()->text('FORMA DE PAGAMENTO:', true);
            foreach ($order->payments as $p) {
                $methodName = $this->cleanText($p->paymentMethod?->name ?? $p->method ?? 'PAGAMENTO');
                $amount = 'R$ ' . number_format((float) $p->amount, 2, ',', '.');
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns([' - ' . $methodName, $amount], [24, 0], ['L', 'R'], $cols));
            }
        }

        // 🎯 5. RODAPÉ
        $b->space();
        $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];
        $b->divider();

        if (!empty($settings['receipt_footer_text'])) {
            $b->text($this->cleanText($settings['receipt_footer_text']));
        } else {
            $b->text('OBRIGADO PELA PREFERENCIA!');
        }

        if (!empty($settings['receipt_promo_qrcode'])) {
            $b->space()
              ->text('AVALIE OU GANHE DESCONTOS:')
              ->qrCode($settings['receipt_promo_qrcode'], 6);
        }

        return $b->cut()->get();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Printing\BlueprintBuilder;
use App\Services\Printing\OrderTableBuilder;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class DeliveryDispatch
{
    protected Order $order;

    public function __construct(Order $order)
    {
        $this->order = $order;
    }

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'delivery_dispatch';
    }

    private function cleanText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        return trim(Str::ascii(mb_strtoupper($text)));
    }

    private function abbreviateName(?string $name): string
    {
        if (!$name) return '';
        $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($name));

        if (count($parts) === 1) return mb_strtoupper($parts[0]);

        $firstName = array_shift($parts);
        $lastNameInitial = mb_strtoupper(mb_substr(array_pop($parts), 0, 1));

        return mb_strtoupper("{$firstName} {$lastNameInitial}.");
    }

    private function formatPhone(?string $phone): string
    {
        if (!$phone) return '';
        $p = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $phone);
        if (strlen($p) === 11) return preg_replace('/(\d{2})(\d{5})(\d{4})/', '($1) $2-$3', $p);
        if (strlen($p) === 10) return preg_replace('/(\d{2})(\d{4})(\d{4})/', '($1) $2-$3', $p);
        return $phone;
    }

    private function justifyRow(string $left, string $right, int $cols = 48): string
    {
        $left = $this->cleanText($left);
        $right = $this->cleanText($right);
        $spaces = max(1, $cols - strlen($left) - strlen($right));
        return $left . str_repeat(' ', $spaces) . $right;
    }

    private function removeViagemTag(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        $cleaned = preg_replace('/\s*\(\s*VIAGEM\s*\)\s*/i', ' ', $text);
        return trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $cleaned));
    }

    private function cleanModifiersViagem(array $modifiers): array
    {
        array_walk_recursive($modifiers, function (&$value) {
            if (is_string($value)) {
                $value = $this->removeViagemTag($value);
            }
        });
        return $modifiers;
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached()?->toArray() ?? [];
        $order = $this->order;
        $b = new BlueprintBuilder();

        $cols = !empty($settings['printer_columns']) ? (int) $settings['printer_columns'] : 48;

        $s3 = chr(29) . chr(33) . chr(34); // 3x3
        $sW = chr(29) . chr(33) . chr(16); // Dupla largura
        $s0 = chr(29) . chr(33) . chr(0);  // Reset

        // 🎯 1. Logotipo (Centralizado)
        $b->alignCenter();
        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;
        $domain = $tenant?->domains?->first()?->domain
            ?? ($tenant ? $tenant->id . '.brasume.com.br' : request()->getHost());

        $logoUrl = !empty($settings['receipt_logo_url'])
            ? $settings['receipt_logo_url']
            : (!empty($settings['logo_path']) ? "https://{$domain}/media/file?path=" . $settings['logo_path'] : null);

        if ($logoUrl) {
            $b->image($logoUrl);
        } else {
            $b->text($this->cleanText($settings['trade_name'] ?? 'SISTEMA ERP'), true, '2x');
        }

        $typeTitle = 'ENTREGA';
        if (in_array($order->type, ['pickup', 'takeaway'])) $typeTitle = 'RETIRADA';
        if ($order->type === 'counter') $typeTitle = 'BALCAO';
        if ($order->type === 'table') $typeTitle = 'MESA ' . $order->table_number;

        // 🎯 2. Tipo do Pedido (Centralizado)
        $b->alignCenter()
          ->space()
          ->text($s3 . $typeTitle . $s0, true)
          ->divider();

        // 🎯 3. Linha do Pedido e Telefone em tamanho normal (1x)
        $time = $order->created_at ? $order->created_at->format('H:i') : now()->format('H:i');
        $formattedOrderId = number_format($order->id, 0, '', '.');
        $phone = $order->customer && $order->customer->phone ? $this->formatPhone($order->customer->phone) : '';

        $topLine = "#{$formattedOrderId} - {$time}";
        if ($phone) $topLine .= "   {$phone}";

        $b->alignCenter()
          ->text($topLine, true, '1x');

        // 🎯 4. Nome do Cliente (Abreviado LGPD e 3x)
        $clientName = $order->customer_name ?: 'CONSUMIDOR FINAL';
        $b->text($s3 . $this->cleanText($this->abbreviateName($clientName)) . $s0, true);

        // 🎯 5. Endereço de Entrega (Sem cabeçalho, direto na rota)
        $addr = $order->address;

        if ($order->type === 'delivery' && !empty($addr)) {
            $b->divider()
              ->alignCenter();

            $streetLine = '';
            $complement = '';
            $reference = '';

            if ($addr instanceof \App\Models\Address) {
                $streetLine = $addr->full_address
                    ?: (($addr->street?->name ?? 'Rua') . ', ' . $addr->number . ($addr->neighborhood ? ' - ' . $addr->neighborhood->name : ''));
                $complement = $addr->complement ?? '';
                $reference = $addr->reference ?? '';
            } elseif (is_array($addr)) {
                if (!empty($addr['full_address'])) {
                    $streetLine = $addr['full_address'];
                } else {
                    $street = is_array($addr['street'] ?? null) ? ($addr['street']['name'] ?? '') : ($addr['street'] ?? '');
                    $number = $addr['number'] ?? 'S/N';
                    $neighborhood = is_array($addr['neighborhood'] ?? null) ? ($addr['neighborhood']['name'] ?? '') : ($addr['neighborhood'] ?? '');

                    $streetLine = "{$street}, {$number}";
                    if (!empty($neighborhood)) {
                        $streetLine .= " - {$neighborhood}";
                    }
                }

                $complement = $addr['complement'] ?? '';
                $reference = $addr['reference'] ?? '';
            } else {
                $streetLine = (string) $addr;
            }

            // Quebra preservando palavras inteiras no modo dupla largura (máx 22 colunas)
            $wrappedStreetLines = explode("\n", wordwrap($this->cleanText($streetLine), 22, "\n", false));
            foreach ($wrappedStreetLines as $line) {
                $line = trim($line);
                if (!empty($line)) {
                    $b->text($sW . $line . $s0, true);
                }
            }

            if (!empty($complement)) {
                $wrappedCompLines = explode("\n", wordwrap('COMP: ' . $this->cleanText($complement), 44, "\n", false));
                foreach ($wrappedCompLines as $cline) {
                    $b->text(trim($cline), true, '1x');
                }
            }
            if (!empty($reference)) {
                $wrappedRefLines = explode("\n", wordwrap('REF: ' . $this->cleanText($reference), 44, "\n", false));
                foreach ($wrappedRefLines as $rline) {
                    $b->text(trim($rline), true, '1x');
                }
            }
        }

        // 🎯 6. Lista de Itens (Sem cabeçalho, direto na tabela)
        $b->divider()
          ->alignLeft();

        $cleanItems = $order->items ? $order->items->map(function ($item) {
            $clone = clone $item;

            foreach (['name', 'product_name', 'notes', 'observations', 'observation'] as $field) {
                if (!empty($clone->{$field})) {
                    $clone->{$field} = $this->removeViagemTag($clone->{$field});
                }
            }

            if ($clone->relationLoaded('product') && $clone->product) {
                $clone->product = clone $clone->product;
                if (!empty($clone->product->name)) {
                    $clone->product->name = $this->removeViagemTag($clone->product->name);
                }
            }

            if (!empty($clone->modifiers) && is_array($clone->modifiers)) {
                $clone->modifiers = $this->cleanModifiersViagem($clone->modifiers);
            }

            return $clone;
        }) : collect();

        OrderTableBuilder::buildDispatch($b, $cleanItems, 'A', true);

        // 🎯 7. Observações do Pedido
        if (!empty($order->notes)) {
            $b->divider()
              ->alignCenter()
              ->text('OBSERVACOES DO PEDIDO:', true)
              ->text($this->cleanText($order->notes), true, '1x');
        }

        // 🎯 8. Resumo Financeiro (Justificado)
        $b->divider()->alignLeft();

        if ($order->subtotal > 0) {
            $b->text($this->justifyRow('PRODUTOS:', 'R$ ' . $this->money($order->subtotal), $cols), true, '1x');
        }
        if ($order->delivery_fee > 0) {
            $b->text($this->justifyRow('TAXA ENTREGA:', 'R$ ' . $this->money($order->delivery_fee), $cols), true, '1x');
        }
        if ($order->service_fee > 0) {
            $b->text($this->justifyRow('TAXA SERVICO:', 'R$ ' . $this->money($order->service_fee), $cols), true, '1x');
        }
        if ($order->discount > 0) {
            $b->text($this->justifyRow('DESCONTO:', '-R$ ' . $this->money($order->discount), $cols), true, '1x');
        }

        $b->text($this->justifyRow('TOTAL DO PEDIDO:', 'R$ ' . $this->money($order->total), $cols), true, '1x')
          ->space();

        // 🎯 9. Apuração Financeira e Banners de Cobrança
        $validPayments = $order->payments
            ? $order->payments->filter(fn($p) => !in_array($p->status ?? 'paid', ['cancelled', 'failed', 'refunded']))
            : collect();

        $paidAmount = $validPayments->sum('amount');
        $toCollect = max(0, (float)$order->total - (float)$paidAmount);
        $isPaidStatus = in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'completed']) || $order->payment_status === 'paid';

        $b->alignCenter();

        if ($isPaidStatus || $toCollect <= 0.02) {
            $b->blueprint[] = [
                'cmd'    => 'text',
                'val'    => $s3 . '   JA PAGO   ' . $s0,
                'bold'   => true,
                'invert' => true
            ];
            $b->space()
              ->text('NAO COBRAR DO CLIENTE', true);
        } else {
            $b->blueprint[] = [
                'cmd'    => 'text',
                'val'    => $s3 . ' A COBRAR ' . $s0,
                'bold'   => true,
                'invert' => true
            ];

            $b->text(' ', false, '1x');
            $b->text('VALOR R$: ' . $this->money($toCollect), true, '2x')
              ->space();

            $methods = $order->payment_intent_methods
                ?? $order->payment_intent_methods
                ?? [];

            $hasPromises = (!empty($methods) && is_array($methods))
                || in_array($order->payment_intent_status, ['pay_on_delivery', 'pay_on_pickup', 'pending_choice']);

            if ($hasPromises && !empty($methods)) {
                $b->text('FORMA DE PAGAMENTO:', true);

                $orderChangeTarget = (float) ($order->change_target ?? $order->delivery_change_target ?? 0);

                foreach ($methods as $method) {
                    $methodName = $this->cleanText($method['method_name'] ?? 'DINHEIRO');
                    $amount = (float) ($method['amount'] ?? $toCollect);
                    $changeFor = (float) ($method['change_target'] ?? $orderChangeTarget);
                    $troco = max(0, $changeFor - $amount);

                    if (str_contains($methodName, 'DINHEIRO')) {
                        if ($changeFor > 0 && $troco > 0) {
                            $methodName = 'DINHEIRO (LEVAR TROCO)';
                        } else {
                            $methodName = 'DINHEIRO - SEM TROCO';
                        }
                    }

                    $b->text($sW . $methodName . $s0, true);

                    if (count($methods) > 1) {
                        $b->text('VALOR: R$ ' . $this->money($amount));
                    }

                    if ($changeFor > 0 && $troco > 0) {
                        $b->text('PAGAMENTO EM: R$ ' . $this->money($changeFor))
                          ->text($sW . 'LEVAR TROCO: R$ ' . $this->money($troco) . $s0, true);
                    }
                    $b->space();
                }
            } else {
                $b->text('(!) FORMA NAO INFORMADA', true)
                  ->text('PERGUNTAR AO CLIENTE NA ENTREGA.');
            }
        }

        // 🎯 10. Rodapé
        $b->space()
          ->divider()
          ->alignCenter()
          ->text($this->cleanText($settings['receipt_footer_text'] ?? 'OBRIGADO PELA PREFERENCIA!'));

        return $b->cut()->get();
    }

    private function money($value): string
    {
        return number_format((float) $value, 2, ',', '.');
    }
}
```
