```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Printing\BlueprintBuilder;
use App\Services\Printing\ReceiptFormatter;
use App\Services\Printing\OrderTableBuilder;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Exception;

class FiscalReceipt
{
    public Order $order;
    public string $xmlContent;

    public function __construct(Order $order, string $xmlContent)
    {
        $this->order = $order;
        $this->xmlContent = $xmlContent;
    }

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'fiscal_receipt';
    }

    public function getOrderId(): ?int
    {
        return $this->order?->id;
    }

    private function cleanText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        return trim(Str::ascii(mb_strtoupper($text)));
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $b = new BlueprintBuilder();

        try {
            $cleanXml = preg_replace('/xmlns[^=]*="[^"]*"/i', '', $this->xmlContent);
            $xml = simplexml_load_string($cleanXml);

            if (!$xml) throw new Exception("XML INVALIDO PARA IMPRESSAO.");

            $nfeNode = $xml->getName() === 'nfeProc' ? $xml->NFe : $xml;
            $infNFe = $nfeNode->infNFe;
            $protNFe = $xml->getName() === 'nfeProc' ? $xml->protNFe : null;

            if (!$infNFe) throw new Exception("TAG <INFNFE> NAO ENCONTRADA NO XML.");

            $emit = $infNFe->emit;
            $dest = $infNFe->dest ?? null;
            $ide = $infNFe->ide;
            $total = $infNFe->total->ICMSTot;
            $pag = $infNFe->pag;

            $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
            $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;
            $domain = $tenant?->domains?->first()?->domain
                ?? ($tenant ? $tenant->id . '.brasume.com.br' : request()->getHost());

            $logoUrl = !empty($settings?->receipt_logo_url)
                ? $settings->receipt_logo_url
                : (!empty($settings?->logo_path) ? "https://{$domain}/media/file?path=" . $settings->logo_path : null);

            $b->alignCenter();
            if ($logoUrl) {
                $b->image($logoUrl)->space();
            }

            $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'font', 'val' => 'B'];

            $b->alignCenter()
              ->text($this->cleanText((string) $emit->xNome), true)
              ->text($this->cleanText("CNPJ: " . $this->formatCnpjCpf((string) $emit->CNPJ) . "  IE: " . (string) $emit->IE))
              ->text($this->cleanText((string) $emit->enderEmit->xLgr . ", " . (string) $emit->enderEmit->nro . " - " . (string) $emit->enderEmit->xBairro))
              ->text($this->cleanText((string) $emit->enderEmit->xMun . " - " . (string) $emit->enderEmit->UF))
              ->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider('B'));

            $b->text("DOCUMENTO AUXILIAR DA NOTA FISCAL", true)
              ->text("DE CONSUMIDOR ELETRONICA", true)
              ->text("NAO PERMITE APROVEITAMENTO DE CREDITO DE ICMS")
              ->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider('B'));

            $b->alignLeft();
            OrderTableBuilder::buildFiscal($b, $infNFe->det, 'B');

            $qtdItens = (string) count($infNFe->det);
            $valTotal = number_format((float) $total->vNF, 2, ',', '.');

            $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['QTD. TOTAL DE ITENS:', $qtdItens], [40, 0], ['L', 'R'], 'B'))
              ->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['VALOR TOTAL R$:', $valTotal], [40, 0], ['L', 'R'], 'B'), true)
              ->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider('B'))
              ->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['FORMA DE PAGAMENTO', 'VALOR PAGO R$'], [40, 0], ['L', 'R'], 'B'), true);

            foreach ($pag->detPag as $detPag) {
                $tPagMap = [
                    '01' => 'DINHEIRO',
                    '03' => 'CARTAO CREDITO',
                    '04' => 'CARTAO DEBITO',
                    '17' => 'PIX',
                    '99' => 'OUTROS'
                ];
                $tPag = (string) $detPag->tPag;
                $forma = $tPagMap[$tPag] ?? 'OUTROS';
                $vPag = number_format((float) $detPag->vPag, 2, ',', '.');
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns([$forma, $vPag], [40, 0], ['L', 'R'], 'B'));
            }

            if (isset($pag->vTroco) && (float) $pag->vTroco > 0) {
                $vTroco = number_format((float) $pag->vTroco, 2, ',', '.');
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['TROCO R$:', $vTroco], [40, 0], ['L', 'R'], 'B'));
            }

            $urlChave = isset($nfeNode->infNFeSupl->urlChave)
                ? (string) $nfeNode->infNFeSupl->urlChave
                : "CONSULTE NO SITE DA SEFAZ";

            $b->alignCenter()
              ->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider('B'))
              ->text("CONSULTE PELA CHAVE DE ACESSO EM:", true)
              ->text($this->cleanText($urlChave))
              ->space()
              ->text("CHAVE DE ACESSO:", true)
              ->text($this->formatChave((string) $infNFe->attributes()->Id), true)
              ->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider('B'));

            $hasCpfCnpj = false;
            if ($dest) {
                if (isset($dest->CPF) || isset($dest->CNPJ)) $hasCpfCnpj = true;
            }

            if ($hasCpfCnpj) {
                $doc = isset($dest->CPF) ? $this->formatCnpjCpf((string) $dest->CPF) : $this->formatCnpjCpf((string) $dest->CNPJ);
                $nome = isset($dest->xNome) ? (string) $dest->xNome : 'CONSUMIDOR';
                $b->text($this->cleanText("CONSUMIDOR: {$doc} - {$nome}"));
            } else {
                $b->text("CONSUMIDOR NAO IDENTIFICADO");
            }

            if (isset($nfeNode->infNFeSupl->qrCode)) {
                $b->space()->qrCode((string) $nfeNode->infNFeSupl->qrCode, 4)->space();
            }

            $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider('B'))
              ->text($this->cleanText("NFC-E N: " . (string) $ide->nNF . "  SERIE: " . (string) $ide->serie . "  EMISSAO: " . date('d/m/Y H:i:s', strtotime((string) $ide->dhEmi))));

            if ($protNFe) {
                $b->text($this->cleanText("PROTOCOLO DE AUTORIZACAO: " . (string) ($protNFe->infProt->nProt ?? '')))
                  ->text($this->cleanText("AUTORIZACAO: " . date('d/m/Y H:i:s', strtotime((string) ($protNFe->infProt->dhRecbto ?? '')))));
            }

            if (isset($total->vTotTrib) && (float) $total->vTotTrib > 0) {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider('B'))
                  ->text("Tributos Totais Incidentes (Lei 12.741/2012): R$ " . number_format((float) $total->vTotTrib, 2, ',', '.'));
            }

            if ($settings && !empty($settings->receipt_footer_text)) {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider('B'))
                  ->text($this->cleanText($settings->receipt_footer_text));
            }

            $b->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'font', 'val' => 'A'];

        } catch (\Throwable $t) {
            $b->text("ERRO AO LER O XML DA NFC-E", true)->text($this->cleanText($t->getMessage()));
        }

        return $b->cut()->get();
    }

    private function formatCnpjCpf(string $doc): string
    {
        $doc = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $doc);
        if (strlen($doc) === 11) return preg_replace('/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{2})/', '$1.$2.$3-$4', $doc);
        if (strlen($doc) === 14) return preg_replace('/(\d{2})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{4})(\d{2})/', '$1.$2.$3/$4-$5', $doc);
        return $doc;
    }

    private function formatChave(string $chave): string
    {
        $chave = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $chave);
        return trim(chunk_split($chave, 4, ' '));
    }
}
```

```php
            ->text('Operador: ' . $this->operatorName)
            ->divider()
            ->alignLeft()
            ->text('Colaborador: ' . $this->freelancerName);

        if ($this->pixKey && str_contains(strtolower($this->paymentMethod), 'pix')) {

        }

        $b->divider()
            ->alignLeft()

            ->space()

            ->space()
            ->space()
            ->alignCenter()
            ->text('____________________________________')
            ->text($this->freelancerName)
            ->cut();

        return $b->get();
    }
```

```php
namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

class GrowthFlyer

    protected string $appUrl;

    public function __construct(Coupon $coupon, ?string $appUrl = null)
    {
        $this->coupon = $coupon;
        $this->appUrl = $appUrl ?: route('customer.app', [
            'tab'   => 'menu',
            'cupom' => $coupon->code,
        ]);
    }

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'growth_flyer';
    }

    private function cleanText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        return trim(Str::ascii(mb_strtoupper($text)));
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached()?->toArray() ?? [];
        $b = new BlueprintBuilder();

        // 🎯 Força alinhamento centralizado para todo o documento
        $b->alignCenter();

        // 1. Logotipo do Tenant (com fallback para Nome Fantasia)
        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;
        $domain = $tenant?->domains?->first()?->domain
            ?? ($tenant ? $tenant->id . '.brasume.com.br' : request()->getHost());

        $logoUrl = !empty($settings['receipt_logo_url'])
            ? $settings['receipt_logo_url']

        if ($logoUrl) {
            $b->image($logoUrl);
        } else {
            $b->text($this->cleanText($settings['trade_name'] ?? 'PRESENTE ESPECIAL'), true, '2x');

          ->text("R$ {$valueStr} OFF", true, '2x')
          ->text("no 1º pedido feito no nosso App!", true)
          ->divider()
          ->text("CUPOM EXCLUSIVO:", true)
          ->text($this->coupon->code, true, '2x')
          ->space()
          ->text("Aponte a camera para ativar direto:", true)
          ->qrCode($this->appUrl, 5)
          ->space()
          ->text("Valido por 30 dias. Limite: 1 uso.", true)
          ->divider();

        return $b->cut()->get();
    }
```

## File: app/Services/Printing/Documents/KitchenTicket.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\ProductModifier;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class KitchenTicket
{
    protected array $blueprint = [];
    protected Order $order;
    protected Collection $items;
    protected string $printMode;
    protected bool $separateMultiples;
    protected bool $isReprint;

    public function __construct(Order $order, Collection $items, string $printMode = 'station', bool $separateMultiples = false, bool $isReprint = false)
    {
        $this->order = $order;
        $this->items = $items;
        $this->printMode = $printMode;
        $this->separateMultiples = $separateMultiples;
        $this->isReprint = $isReprint;
    }

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'kitchen_ticket';
    }

    public function getOrderId(): ?int
    {
        return $this->order->id ?? null;
    }

    private function cleanText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        $text = Str::ascii($text);
        $text = mb_strtoupper($text);
        $text = str_replace(['[VIAGEM]', '(VIAGEM)'], '', $text);
        return trim($text);
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $itemsToProcess = $this->resolvePrintableItems();

        $groupIds = $itemsToProcess
            ->flatMap(function ($item) {
                $rawMods = $item->modifiers ?? $item->structured_modifiers ?? $item->structuredModifiers ?? [];
                return collect($rawMods)
                    ->map(fn($m) => is_array($m) ? (object)$m : $m)
                    ->pluck('modifier_group_id');
            })
            ->filter()
            ->unique()
            ->values();

        $modifierGroups = !empty($groupIds)
            ? ProductModifier::whereIn('id', $groupIds)->get()->keyBy('id')
            : collect();

        if ($this->printMode === 'item') {
            foreach ($itemsToProcess as $item) {
                $iterations = $this->separateMultiples ? (int)$item->quantity : 1;
                $qtyToPrint = $this->separateMultiples ? 1 : (float)$item->quantity;
                $showQty = !($qtyToPrint == 1);

                for ($i = 0; $i < $iterations; $i++) {
                    $this->buildHeader();
                    $this->buildItemBody($item, $qtyToPrint, $showQty, $modifierGroups);
                    $this->buildFooter();

                    $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'beep'];
                    $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'cut'];
                }
            }
        } else {
            $this->buildHeader();
            $lastIndex = count($itemsToProcess) - 1;

            foreach ($itemsToProcess as $index => $item) {
                $this->buildItemBody($item, (float)$item->quantity, true, $modifierGroups);
                if ($index !== $lastIndex) {
                    $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
                }
            }
            $this->buildFooter();

            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'beep'];
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'cut'];
        }

        return $this->blueprint;
    }

    private function resolvePrintableItems(): Collection
    {
        $allItems = $this->order->relationLoaded('items')
            ? $this->order->items
            : $this->items;

        $parentIds = $allItems->pluck('parent_item_id')->filter()->unique()->toArray();
        $existingItemIds = $this->items->pluck('id')->filter()->toArray();
        $printable = collect();

        foreach ($this->items as $item) {
            $isComboParent = in_array($item->id, $parentIds)
                || ($item->relationLoaded('subItems') && $item->subItems->isNotEmpty())
                || (!empty($item->id) && $item->subItems()->exists());

            if ($isComboParent) {
                $subItems = $item->relationLoaded('subItems')
                    ? $item->subItems
                    : $item->subItems()->with('modifiers')->get();

                if ($subItems instanceof Collection && $subItems->isNotEmpty()) {
                    foreach ($subItems as $subItem) {
                        if (!in_array($subItem->id, $existingItemIds)) {
                            $subItem->_combo_name = $item->product_name;
                            $printable->push($subItem);
                        }
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }

            if (!empty($item->parent_item_id) && empty($item->_combo_name)) {
                $parent = $allItems->firstWhere('id', $item->parent_item_id)
                    ?? (method_exists($item, 'parentItem') ? $item->parentItem : null)
                    ?? OrderItem::find($item->parent_item_id);

                if ($parent) {
                    $item->_combo_name = $parent->product_name;
                }
            }

            $printable->push($item);
        }

        return $printable->unique('id')->values();
    }

    private function buildHeader(): void
    {
        $s3 = chr(29) . chr(33) . chr(34);
        $s0 = chr(29) . chr(33) . chr(0);

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];

        $headerText = 'CLIENTE';
        if ($this->order->type === 'table') {
            $headerText = 'MESA ' . ($this->order->table_number ?: '?');
        } elseif ($this->order->customer_id && $this->order->customer) {
            $headerText = $this->abbreviateName($this->order->customer->name);
        } elseif ($this->order->customer_name) {
            $headerText = $this->order->customer_name;
        } else {
            $headerText = $this->order->type === 'delivery' ? 'DELIVERY' : 'BALCAO';
        }

        if ($this->isReprint) {
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '*** REIMPRESSAO ***', 'bold' => true, 'size' => '1x'];
        }

        $this->blueprint[] = [
            'cmd'  => 'text',
            'val'  => $s3 . $this->cleanText($headerText) . $s0,
            'bold' => true
        ];

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false, 'size' => '1x'];

        $time = $this->order->created_at ? $this->order->created_at->format('H:i') : now()->format('H:i');
        $orderIdFmt = number_format($this->order->id, 0, '', '.');
        $operator = $this->order->employee ? $this->abbreviateName($this->order->employee->name) : 'APP';
        $infoLine = "{$time} - #{$orderIdFmt} - {$operator}";

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->cleanText($infoLine), 'bold' => false, 'size' => '1x'];

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false, 'size' => '1x'];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
    }

    private function buildItemBody($item, float $qty, bool $showQty, Collection $modifierGroups): void
    {
        $prefix = '';
        if ($showQty) {
            $qtyStr = $qty == floor($qty) ? (string)floor($qty) : number_format($qty, 1, ',', '');
            $prefix = $qtyStr . 'X ';
        }

        $productName = $item->product_name;
        if (isset($item->is_reward) && $item->is_reward) {
            $productName .= ' [CORTESIA]';
        }

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->cleanText($prefix . $productName), 'bold' => true, 'size' => '2x'];

        $sW = chr(29) . chr(33) . chr(16);
        $s0 = chr(29) . chr(33) . chr(0);

        $rawMods = $item->modifiers ?? $item->structured_modifiers ?? $item->structuredModifiers ?? [];
        $validModifiers = collect($rawMods)->map(function ($mod) {
            return is_array($mod) ? (object) $mod : $mod;
        })->filter(function ($mod) {
            return !str_contains(mb_strtoupper($mod->name ?? ''), 'VIAGEM');
        });

        if ($validModifiers->isNotEmpty()) {
            $itemQty = max(1, (float)($item->quantity ?: 1));

            $rankedModifiers = $validModifiers->map(function ($mod) use ($modifierGroups, $itemQty) {
                $groupId = $mod->modifier_group_id ?? $mod->group_id ?? null;
                $group = $groupId ? $modifierGroups->get($groupId) : null;
                $type = strtolower((string)($group?->type ?? $mod->type ?? $mod->group_type ?? ''));

                if (in_array($type, ['ingredient', 'ingrediente', 'flavor', 'sabor', 'option', 'opcao'])) {
                    $rank = 1;
                    $normalizedType = 'ingredient';
                } elseif (in_array($type, ['add_on', 'adicional', 'extra'])) {
                    $rank = 2;
                    $normalizedType = 'add_on';
                } elseif (in_array($type, ['observation', 'observacao', 'removal', 'remocao'])) {
                    $rank = 3;
                    $normalizedType = 'observation';
                } else {
                    $rank = ((float)($mod->price ?? 0) > 0) ? 2 : 1;
                    $normalizedType = ($rank === 2) ? 'add_on' : 'ingredient';
                }

                // 🚀 Cálculo da proporção de quantidade por unidade do item
                $modQty = (float)($mod->quantity ?? $mod->qty ?? 1);
                $unitQty = $itemQty > 0 ? ($modQty / $itemQty) : $modQty;

                // Ingredientes NUNCA recebem multiplicador numérico.
                // Adicionais só mostram o prefixo se a porção por unidade for maior que 1.
                $qtyPrefix = '';
                if ($normalizedType === 'add_on' && $unitQty > 1 && $modQty > $itemQty) {
                    $displayQty = (floor($unitQty) == $unitQty) ? (int)$unitQty : (int)$modQty;
                    $qtyPrefix = $displayQty . 'X ';
                }

                $mod->_hierarchy_rank = $rank;
                $mod->_normalized_type = $normalizedType;
                $mod->_qty_prefix = $qtyPrefix;
                return $mod;
            });

            $groupedByHierarchy = $rankedModifiers
                ->sortBy('_hierarchy_rank')
                ->groupBy('_hierarchy_rank');

            $firstGroup = true;
            foreach ($groupedByHierarchy as $rank => $mods) {
                if (!$firstGroup) {
                    $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' ', 'size' => '1x'];
                }
                $firstGroup = false;

                foreach ($mods as $mod) {
                    $cleanName = trim(preg_replace('/^[\s•+\-]+/i', '', $mod->name ?? ''));
                    $cleanName = $this->cleanText($cleanName);

                    if (empty($cleanName)) continue;

                    $prefixMod = match ($mod->_normalized_type) {
                        'ingredient', 'observation' => '- ',
                        'add_on' => empty($mod->_qty_prefix) ? '+ ' : '  ' . $mod->_qty_prefix,
                    };

                    $this->blueprint[] = [
                        'cmd'  => 'text',
                        'val'  => $sW . $prefixMod . $cleanName . $s0,
                        'bold' => true
                    ];
                }
            }
        }

        $notesToPrint = [];
        if (!empty($item->_combo_name)) {
            $notesToPrint[] = $this->cleanText($item->_combo_name);
        }
        if (!empty($item->notes)) {
            $notesToPrint[] = $this->cleanText($item->notes);
        }

        if (!empty($notesToPrint)) {
            if ($validModifiers->isNotEmpty()) {
                $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' ', 'size' => '1x'];
            }

            foreach ($notesToPrint as $note) {
                $this->blueprint[] = [
                    'cmd'  => 'text',
                    'val'  => $sW . 'Obs.: ' . $note . $s0,
                    'bold' => true
                ];
            }
        }

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' ', 'size' => '1x'];

        $isTakeout = in_array($this->order->type, ['delivery', 'pickup', 'takeaway', 'counter']);
        if (!$isTakeout && isset($item->is_takeaway) && $item->is_takeaway) {
            $isTakeout = true;
        }

        if ($isTakeout) {
            $s3 = chr(29) . chr(33) . chr(34);

            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];
            $this->blueprint[] = [
                'cmd'  => 'text',
                'val'  => $s3 . '   VIAGEM   ' . $s0,
                'bold' => true,
                'invert' => true
            ];
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
        }

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false, 'size' => '1x'];
    }

    private function buildFooter(): void
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        if ($settings && !empty($settings->receipt_footer_text)) {
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->cleanText($settings->receipt_footer_text), 'bold' => false, 'size' => '1x'];
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
        }
    }

    private function abbreviateName($name): string
    {
        if (!$name) return "";
        $cleanName = trim($name);
        if (is_numeric($cleanName)) return $cleanName;

        $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', $cleanName);
        if (count($parts) === 1) return strtoupper($parts[0]);

        return strtoupper($parts[0] . ' ' . substr(end($parts), 0, 1) . '.');
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Printing/Documents/LoyaltyFlyer.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Printing\BlueprintBuilder;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class LoyaltyFlyer
{
    protected string $customerName;
    protected int $pointsEarned;
    protected string $appUrl;

    public function __construct(string $customerName, int $pointsEarned, string $appUrl)
    {
        $this->customerName = $customerName;
        $this->pointsEarned = $pointsEarned;
        $this->appUrl = $appUrl;
    }

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'loyalty_flyer';
    }

    private function cleanText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        return trim(Str::ascii(mb_strtoupper($text)));
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached()?->toArray() ?? [];
        $b = new BlueprintBuilder();

        // 🎯 Força alinhamento centralizado para todo o documento
        $b->alignCenter();

        // 1. Logotipo do Tenant (com fallback para Nome Fantasia)
        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;
        $domain = $tenant?->domains?->first()?->domain
            ?? ($tenant ? $tenant->id . '.brasume.com.br' : request()->getHost());

        $logoUrl = !empty($settings['receipt_logo_url'])
            ? $settings['receipt_logo_url']
            : (!empty($settings['logo_path']) ? "https://{$domain}/media/file?path=" . $settings['logo_path'] : null);

        if ($logoUrl) {
            $b->image($logoUrl);
        } else {
            $b->text($this->cleanText($settings['trade_name'] ?? 'PROGRAMA DE FIDELIDADE'), true, '2x');
        }

        // 2. Primeiro Nome do Cliente
        $firstName = Str::upper(explode(' ', trim($this->customerName))[0] ?? 'CLIENTE');

        // 3. Mensagem Centralizada de Cashback
        $b->alignCenter()
          ->divider()
          ->text('*** DINHEIRO DE VOLTA ***', true)
          ->space()
          ->text("PARABENS, {$firstName}!", true)
          ->text("VOCE GANHOU", true)
          ->text("+{$this->pointsEarned} PONTOS", true, '2x')
          ->text("de Cashback para a proxima compra!", true)
          ->divider()
          ->text("Aponte a camera para resgatar no App:", true)
          ->qrCode($this->appUrl, 5)
          ->space()
          ->text("Ou acesse:", true)
          ->text(str_replace(['https://', 'http://'], '', $this->appUrl), true)
          ->divider();

        return $b->cut()->get();
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Printing/Documents/ShiftClosureReport.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ShiftClosureReport
{
    protected array $blueprint = [];
    protected CashShift $shift;

    public function __construct(CashShift $shift)
    {
        $this->shift = $shift->fresh();
    }

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'shift_closure_report';
    }

    public function getOrderId(): ?int
    {
        return null;
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $this->buildHeader();
        $this->buildLifecycleSection();
        $this->buildDrawerSection();
        $this->buildPaymentsSection();
        $this->buildLossSection();
        $this->buildChannelBreakdownSection();
        $this->buildGrandTotalSection();
        $this->buildFooter();

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'beep'];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'cut'];

        return $this->blueprint;
    }

    private function buildHeader(): void
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $settingsArray = $settings?->toArray() ?? [];
        $companyName = $settings->trade_name ?? $settings->company_name ?? $settings->name ?? 'RESTAURANTE';

        // 🎯 LOGOTIPO DINÂMICO DO TENANT (OU NOME FANTASIA)
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];

        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;
        $domain = $tenant?->domains?->first()?->domain
            ?? ($tenant ? $tenant->id . '.brasume.com.br' : request()->getHost());

        $logoUrl = !empty($settingsArray['receipt_logo_url'])
            ? $settingsArray['receipt_logo_url']
            : (!empty($settingsArray['logo_path']) ? "https://{$domain}/media/file?path=" . $settingsArray['logo_path'] : null);

        if ($logoUrl) {
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'image', 'val' => $logoUrl];
        } else {
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => Str::ascii(mb_strtoupper($companyName)), 'bold' => true, 'size' => '2x'];
        }

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => "FECHAMENTO DE TURNO #{$this->shift->id}", 'bold' => true, 'size' => '1x'];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
    }

    private function buildLifecycleSection(): void
    {
        $openedAt = $this->shift->opened_at ? Carbon::parse($this->shift->opened_at)->format('d/m/Y H:i') : '--';
        $closedAt = $this->shift->closed_at ? Carbon::parse($this->shift->closed_at)->format('d/m/Y H:i') : now()->format('d/m/Y H:i');

        $openedBy = null;
        if ($this->shift->opened_by) {
            $openedBy = User::find($this->shift->opened_by)?->name;
        }

        $closedBy = null;
        if ($this->shift->closed_by) {
            $closedBy = User::find($this->shift->closed_by)?->name;
        }

        $openedBy = $openedBy ?: 'Sistema';
        $closedBy = $closedBy ?: (auth()->user()->name ?? 'Sistema');

        $duration = '--';
        if ($this->shift->opened_at) {
            $start = Carbon::parse($this->shift->opened_at);
            $end = $this->shift->closed_at ? Carbon::parse($this->shift->closed_at) : now();
            $duration = $start->diff($end)->format('%Hh %Im');
        }

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->row('Abertura:', "{$openedAt} ({$openedBy})"), 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->row('Fechamento:', "{$closedAt} ({$closedBy})"), 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->row('Duracao:', $duration), 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
    }

    private function buildDrawerSection(): void
    {
        $openedAt = $this->shift->opened_at;
        $closedAt = $this->shift->closed_at ?? now();

        $moneyMethodIds = PaymentMethod::where('engine_type', 'money')->pluck('id')->all();

        $cashSales = (float) Payment::where('is_paid', true)
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$openedAt, $closedAt])
            ->whereHas('order', fn($q) => $q->whereIn('status', ['closed', 'completed', 'dispatched', 'preparing']))
            ->where(function ($q) use ($moneyMethodIds) {
                if (!empty($moneyMethodIds)) {
                    $q->whereIn('payment_method_id', $moneyMethodIds);
                }
                $q->orWhere('method', 'LIKE', '%Dinheiro%');
            })
            ->sum('amount');

        $shiftTransactions = Transaction::where('cash_shift_id', $this->shift->id)
            ->whereNull('order_id')
            ->get();

        if ($shiftTransactions->isEmpty()) {
            $shiftTransactions = Transaction::whereBetween('transaction_date', [$openedAt, $closedAt])
                ->where('bank_account_id', $this->shift->bank_account_id)
                ->whereNull('order_id')
                ->get();
        }

        $supplies = (float) $shiftTransactions->filter(function ($t) {
            return $t->category === 'supply'
                || ($t->type === 'in' && !str_contains(mb_strtolower($t->description), 'abertura'));
        })->sum('amount');

        $sangrias = (float) $shiftTransactions->filter(function ($t) {
            return $t->category === 'bleed'
                || ($t->type === 'out' && !str_contains(mb_strtolower($t->description), 'retirada de fechamento'));
        })->sum('amount');

        $opening = (float) $this->shift->opening_balance;
        $expected = (float) ($this->shift->closing_balance_expected ?? ($opening + $cashSales + $supplies - $sangrias));
        $actual = (float) ($this->shift->closing_balance_actual ?? $expected);
        $diff = round($actual - $expected, 2);

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => 'CONCILIACAO DA GAVETA (DINHEIRO)', 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->moneyRow('Fundo de Abertura:', $opening), 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->moneyRow('(+) Vendas em Dinheiro:', $cashSales), 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->moneyRow('(+) Suprimentos (Reforco):', $supplies), 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->moneyRow('(-) Sangrias (Retiradas):', $sangrias), 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .', 'bold' => false];

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->moneyRow('(=) Saldo Esperado:', $expected), 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->moneyRow('(=) Saldo Informado (Contado):', $actual), 'bold' => true];

        $diffTag = ($diff == 0) ? 'EXATO' : (($diff > 0) ? 'SOBRA' : 'FALTA');
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->diffRow('Diferenca de Caixa:', $diffTag, $diff), 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
    }

    private function buildPaymentsSection(): void
    {
        $openedAt = $this->shift->opened_at;
        $closedAt = $this->shift->closed_at ?? now();

        $payments = Payment::where('is_paid', true)
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$openedAt, $closedAt])
            ->whereHas('order', fn($q) => $q->whereIn('status', ['closed', 'completed', 'dispatched', 'preparing']))
            ->get();

        $revenuePayments = $payments->reject(fn($p) => $p->paymentMethod?->engine_type === 'loss');
        $grouped = $revenuePayments->groupBy(fn($p) => $p->method ?: 'Outros');

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => 'FATURAMENTO POR FORMA DE PAGAMENTO', 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->headerRow3('FORMA', 'QTD', 'TOTAL'), 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .', 'bold' => false];

        foreach ($grouped as $methodName => $methodPayments) {
            $sum = (float) $methodPayments->sum('amount');
            $count = $methodPayments->count() . 'x';
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->moneyRow3($methodName, $count, $sum), 'bold' => false];
        }

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
    }

    private function buildChannelBreakdownSection(): void
    {
        $openedAt = $this->shift->opened_at;
        $closedAt = $this->shift->closed_at ?? now();

        $orders = Order::where(function ($q) use ($openedAt, $closedAt) {
            $q->whereBetween('created_at', [$openedAt, $closedAt])
              ->orWhereBetween('updated_at', [$openedAt, $closedAt]);
        })->get();

        $tableOrders = $orders->where('type', 'table')->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled');
        $counterOrders = $orders->where('type', 'counter')->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled');
        $deliveryOrders = $orders->where('type', 'delivery')->where('status', '!=', 'cancelled');
        $cancelledOrders = $orders->where('status', 'cancelled');

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => 'RESUMO OPERACIONAL POR CANAL', 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->headerRow3('CANAL', 'PEDIDOS', 'TOTAL'), 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .', 'bold' => false];

        $this->blueprint[] = [
            'cmd' => 'text',
            'val' => $this->moneyRow3('Mesa', $tableOrders->count() . ' ped', (float) $tableOrders->sum('total')),
            'bold' => false
        ];
        $this->blueprint[] = [
            'cmd' => 'text',
            'val' => $this->moneyRow3('Balcao', $counterOrders->count() . ' ped', (float) $counterOrders->sum('total')),
            'bold' => false
        ];
        $this->blueprint[] = [
            'cmd' => 'text',
            'val' => $this->moneyRow3('Delivery', $deliveryOrders->count() . ' ped', (float) $deliveryOrders->sum('total')),
            'bold' => false
        ];

        if ($cancelledOrders->isNotEmpty()) {
            $this->blueprint[] = [
                'cmd' => 'text',
                'val' => $this->moneyRow3('Cancelados', $cancelledOrders->count() . ' ped', (float) $cancelledOrders->sum('total')),
                'bold' => false
            ];
        }

        $totalOrdersCount = $tableOrders->count() + $counterOrders->count() + $deliveryOrders->count();
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .', 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = [
            'cmd' => 'text',
            'val' => $this->row('TOTAL DE PEDIDOS ATENDIDOS:', "{$totalOrdersCount} ped"),
            'bold' => true
        ];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
    }

    
    private function buildLossSection(): void
    {
        $openedAt = $this->shift->opened_at;
        $closedAt = $this->shift->closed_at ?? now();

        $lossPayments = Payment::with('paymentMethod')
            ->where('is_paid', true)
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$openedAt, $closedAt])
            ->whereHas('order', fn($q) => $q->whereIn('status', ['closed', 'completed', 'dispatched', 'preparing']))
            ->whereHas('paymentMethod', fn($q) => $q->where('engine_type', 'loss'))
            ->get();

        if ($lossPayments->isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        $grouped = $lossPayments->groupBy(fn($p) => $p->method ?: 'Perda / Cortesia');

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => 'BAIXAS OPERACIONAIS / PERDAS (NAO FATURADO)', 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->headerRow3('MOTIVO / FORMA', 'QTD', 'TOTAL'), 'bold' => true];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .', 'bold' => false];

        foreach ($grouped as $methodName => $methodPayments) {
            $sum = (float) $methodPayments->sum('amount');
            $count = $methodPayments->count() . 'x';
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $this->moneyRow3($methodName, $count, $sum), 'bold' => false];
        }

        $totalLoss = (float) $lossPayments->sum('amount');
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .', 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = [
            'cmd' => 'text',
            'val' => $this->moneyRow('TOTAL PERDAS / CORTESIAS:', $totalLoss),
            'bold' => true
        ];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
    }

    private function buildGrandTotalSection(): void
    {
        $openedAt = $this->shift->opened_at;
        $closedAt = $this->shift->closed_at ?? now();

        $totalSales = Payment::where('is_paid', true)
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$openedAt, $closedAt])
            ->whereHas('order', fn($q) => $q->whereIn('status', ['closed', 'completed', 'dispatched', 'preparing']))
            ->whereDoesntHave('paymentMethod', fn($q) => $q->where('engine_type', 'loss'))
            ->sum('amount');

        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => 'TOTAL FATURADO NO TURNO', 'bold' => true, 'size' => '1x'];
        $this->blueprint[] = [
            'cmd'  => 'text',
            'val'  => 'R$ ' . number_format($totalSales, 2, ',', '.'),
            'bold' => true,
            'size' => '2x'
        ];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
    }

    private function buildFooter(): void
    {
        if (!empty($this->shift->notes)) {
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => 'OBSERVACOES:', 'bold' => true];
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => Str::ascii($this->shift->notes), 'bold' => false];
            $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------', 'bold' => false];
        }

        $now = now()->format('d/m/Y H:i:s');
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'ct'];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => "EMISSAO: {$now}", 'bold' => false, 'size' => '1x'];
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'lt'];
    }

    private function row(string $left, string $right, int $width = 48): string
    {
        $left = Str::ascii($left);
        $right = Str::ascii($right);

        $spaces = max(1, $width - mb_strlen($left) - mb_strlen($right));
        return $left . str_repeat(' ', $spaces) . $right;
    }

    private function moneyRow(string $label, float $amount, int $width = 48): string
    {
        $label = Str::ascii($label);
        $val = number_format($amount, 2, ',', '.');
        $labelCol = Str::padRight(mb_substr($label, 0, 35), 35);
        return $labelCol . 'R$ ' . Str::padLeft($val, 10);
    }

    private function diffRow(string $label, string $tag, float $diff, int $width = 48): string
    {
        $label = Str::ascii($label);
        $val = number_format(abs($diff), 2, ',', '.');
        $sign = ($diff > 0) ? '+ ' : (($diff < 0) ? '- ' : '');
        $colVal = $sign . $val;

        $col1 = Str::padRight(mb_substr($label, 0, 25), 25);
        $col2 = Str::padBoth(mb_substr("({$tag})", 0, 10), 10);
        return $col1 . $col2 . 'R$ ' . Str::padLeft($colVal, 10);
    }

    private function moneyRow3(string $left, string $mid, float $amount, int $width = 48): string
    {
        $left = Str::ascii($left);
        $mid = Str::ascii($mid);
        $val = number_format($amount, 2, ',', '.');

        $col1 = Str::padRight(mb_substr($left, 0, 25), 25);
        $col2 = Str::padBoth(mb_substr($mid, 0, 10), 10);
        return $col1 . $col2 . 'R$ ' . Str::padLeft($val, 10);
    }

    private function headerRow3(string $left, string $mid, string $right, int $width = 48): string
    {
        $left = Str::ascii($left);
        $mid = Str::ascii($mid);
        $right = Str::ascii($right);

        $col1 = Str::padRight(mb_substr($left, 0, 25), 25);
        $col2 = Str::padBoth(mb_substr($mid, 0, 10), 10);
        $col3 = Str::padLeft(mb_substr($right, 0, 13), 13);
        return $col1 . $col2 . $col3;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing\Documents;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Printing\BlueprintBuilder;
use App\Services\Marketing\OrderClaimService;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class TableClaimFlyer
{
    protected Order $order;
    protected string $claimUrl;
    protected array $rewards;

    public function __construct(Order $order, string $claimUrl)
    {
        $this->order = $order;
        $this->claimUrl = $claimUrl;

        $claimService = app(OrderClaimService::class);
        $this->rewards = $claimService->calculateEstimatedRewards($order);
    }

    public function getJobType(): string
    {
        return 'table_claim_flyer';
    }

    private function cleanText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        return trim(Str::ascii(mb_strtoupper($text)));
    }

    public function build(): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached()?->toArray() ?? [];
        $b = new BlueprintBuilder();

        $b->alignCenter();

        // 🎯 1. Logotipo do Tenant
        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;
        $domain = $tenant?->domains?->first()?->domain
            ?? ($tenant ? $tenant->id . '.brasume.com.br' : request()->getHost());

        $logoUrl = !empty($settings['receipt_logo_url'])
            ? $settings['receipt_logo_url']
            : (!empty($settings['logo_path']) ? "https://{$domain}/media/file?path=" . $settings['logo_path'] : null);

        if ($logoUrl) {
            $b->image($logoUrl);
        } else {
            $b->text($this->cleanText($settings['trade_name'] ?? 'SEU CASHBACK'), true, '2x');
        }

        $cashbackFormatted = number_format($this->rewards['cashback_value'], 2, ',', '.');
        $points = $this->rewards['points'];
        $tableName = $this->order->table_number ? "MESA {$this->order->table_number}" : 'SUA CONTA';

        // 🎯 2. Gancho Psicológico de Posse
        $b->alignCenter()
          ->divider()
          ->text('*** DINHEIRO DE VOLTA ***', true)
          ->space()
          ->text("CONSUMO NA {$tableName}", true)
          ->text("VOCE TEM", false)
          ->text("R$ {$cashbackFormatted} DE SALDO", true, '2x')
          ->text("esperando por voce no nosso App!", true)
          ->space()
          ->text("({$points} pontos de Cashback acumulados)")
          ->divider()
          ->text("Aponte a camera do celular", true)
          ->text("para resgatar o seu saldo agora:", true)
          ->space()
          ->qrCode($this->claimUrl, 5)
          ->space()
          ->text("CODIGO DO COMPROVANTE:", true)
          ->text($this->order->claim_hash, true, '2x')
          ->space()
          ->text("Valido por 48 horas. Uso unico.")
          ->divider();

        return $b->cut()->get();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing;

class BlueprintBuilder
{
    // 🚀 Público para permitir manipulação direta em documentos complexos como FiscalReceipt
    public array $blueprint = [];

    public function alignCenter(): self
    {
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'center'];
        return $this;
    }

    public function alignLeft(): self
    {
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'left'];
        return $this;
    }

    public function alignRight(): self
    {
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'align', 'val' => 'right'];
        return $this;
    }

    public function text(string $text, bool $bold = false, string $size = '1x', bool $invert = false): self
    {
        $command = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => $text];
        if ($bold) $command['bold'] = true;
        if ($size !== 'normal' && $size !== '1x') $command['size'] = $size;
        if ($invert) $command['invert'] = true;

        $this->blueprint[] = $command;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * 🎯 Atalho de alta visibilidade: texto em negativo (fundo preto com letra branca).
     * Aplica padding lateral automático para preenchimento térmico consistente.
     */
    public function inverted(string $text, bool $bold = true, string $size = '2x'): self
    {
        $padded = ' ' . trim($text) . ' ';
        return $this->text($padded, $bold, $size, true);
    }

    public function divider(): self
    {
        // 48 caracteres preenchem perfeitamente a bobina de 80mm
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => '------------------------------------------------'];
        return $this;
    }

    public function space(): self
    {
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'text', 'val' => ' '];
        return $this;
    }

    public function image(string $url): self
    {
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'image', 'url' => $url];
        return $this;
    }

    public function qrCode(string $data, int $size = 6): self
    {
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'qrcode', 'data' => $data, 'size' => $size];
        return $this;
    }

    public function cut(): self
    {
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'cut'];
        return $this;
    }

    public function beep(): self
    {
        $this->blueprint[] = ['cmd' => 'beep'];
        return $this;
    }

    public function get(): array
    {
        return $this->blueprint;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\Printer;
use App\Models\Kitchen;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\FiscalDocument;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\ConferenceBill;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\CustomerReceipt;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\DeliveryDispatch;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\FiscalReceipt;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\KitchenTicket;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\GrowthFlyer;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\LoyaltyFlyer;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\TableClaimFlyer;
use App\Services\Marketing\CouponService;
use App\Services\Marketing\OrderClaimService;
use Exception;

class OrderPrintService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected PrintDispatcher $dispatcher,
        protected CouponService $couponService,
        protected OrderClaimService $claimService
    ) {}

    protected function resolveCashierPrinter(): Printer
    {
        $printer = Printer::where('is_cashier', true)->where('is_active', true)->first()
            ?? Printer::where('is_active', true)->first();

        if (!$printer) {
            throw new Exception('Nenhuma impressora ativa configurada para o caixa/balcão.');
        }

        return $printer;
    }

    public function isEligibleChannel(Order $order): bool
    {
        return in_array($order->type, ['delivery', 'counter', 'takeaway', 'pickup']);
    }

    public function isClaimFlyerEligible(Order $order): bool
    {
        return empty($order->customer_id)
            && in_array($order->type, ['table', 'counter', 'takeaway', 'pickup', 'delivery']);
    }

    public function isFromCustomerApp(Order $order): bool
    {
        return $order->source === 'customer_app'
            || (empty($order->employee_id) && !in_array($order->source, ['pos_app', 'team_app', 'pos', 'team']));
    }

    public function isFromOperatorApp(Order $order): bool
    {
        return in_array($order->source, ['pos_app', 'team_app', 'pos', 'team'])
            || !empty($order->employee_id);
    }

    public function printConferenceBill(Order $order): void
    {
        $printer = $this->resolveCashierPrinter();

        $order->refresh()->loadMissing([
            'items.modifiers',
            'items.subItems.modifiers',
            'customer',
            'payments.paymentMethod'
        ]);

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached()?->toArray() ?? [];
        $document = new ConferenceBill($order, $settings);

        $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
    }

    public function dispatchCheckoutReceipts(Order $order, string $printAction): void
    {
        $printer = $this->resolveCashierPrinter();

        $order->refresh()->loadMissing([
            'items.modifiers',
            'items.subItems.modifiers',
            'customer',
            'payments.paymentMethod',
            'fiscalDocument'
        ]);

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $settingsArray = $settings?->toArray() ?? [];

        // 1. Recibo Não-Fiscal / Interno (cobre 'non_fiscal', 'receipt', 'customer_receipt', 'both', 'all')
        if (in_array($printAction, ['non_fiscal', 'receipt', 'customer_receipt', 'both', 'all'], true)) {
            $document = new CustomerReceipt($order, $settingsArray, $order->customer?->cpf);
            $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
        }

        // 2. Cupom Fiscal NFC-e (cobre 'fiscal', 'nfce', 'fiscal_receipt', 'both', 'all')
        if (in_array($printAction, ['fiscal', 'nfce', 'fiscal_receipt', 'both', 'all'], true)) {
            $this->printFiscalReceipt($order, $printer);
        }

        $isEligibleChannel = $this->isEligibleChannel($order);
        $isLoyaltyEnabled = (bool) ($settings?->loyalty_is_active && $settings?->print_loyalty_flyer);

        // 3. Flyer de Fidelidade / Cashback
        $shouldPrintLoyalty = $isLoyaltyEnabled
            && $isEligibleChannel
            && !empty($order->customer_id)
            && $this->isFromOperatorApp($order)
            && (($settings?->loyalty_flyer_mode === 'auto') || in_array($printAction, ['loyalty', 'all'], true));

        $hasEarnedRewards = (int) ($order->loyalty_points_earned ?? 0) > 0 || (float) ($order->cashback_earned ?? 0) > 0;

        if ($shouldPrintLoyalty && $order->customer && $hasEarnedRewards) {
            $appUrl = route('customer.app', ['tab' => 'wallet']);
            $points = (int) ($order->loyalty_points_earned ?: ($order->cashback_earned * 20));
            $document = new LoyaltyFlyer($order->customer->name, $points, $appUrl);
            $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
        }

        // 4. Flyer de Growth (Indicação de Amigo)
        $isGrowthEnabled = (bool) ($settings?->print_growth_flyer);
        $shouldPrintGrowth = $isGrowthEnabled
            && $isEligibleChannel
            && $this->isFromCustomerApp($order)
            && (($settings?->growth_flyer_mode === 'auto') || in_array($printAction, ['growth', 'all'], true));

        if ($shouldPrintGrowth) {
            $couponValue = (float) ($settings?->growth_flyer_value ?? 10.00);
            $coupon = $this->couponService->generateGrowthCoupon($couponValue);

            $appUrl = route('customer.app', [
                'tab'   => 'menu',
                'cupom' => $coupon->code,
            ]);

            $document = new GrowthFlyer($coupon, $appUrl);
            $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
        }

        // 5. Flyer de Resgate O2O (Mesa sem Cliente Identificado)
        $shouldPrintClaim = (bool) ($settings?->loyalty_is_active)
            && $this->isClaimFlyerEligible($order)
            && (float) $order->total > 0
            && (($settings?->loyalty_flyer_mode === 'auto') || in_array($printAction, ['table_claim', 'all'], true));

        if ($shouldPrintClaim) {
            $this->printTableClaimFlyer($order);
        }
    }

    public function printFiscalReceipt(Order $order, ?Printer $printer = null): void
    {
        $printer = $printer ?? $this->resolveCashierPrinter();

        $fiscalDoc = ($order->relationLoaded('fiscalDocument') && $order->fiscalDocument)
            ? $order->fiscalDocument
            : (FiscalDocument::where('order_id', $order->id)
                ->whereIn('status', ['authorized', 'emitted'])
                ->latest('id')
                ->first()
                ?? FiscalDocument::where('order_id', $order->id)->latest('id')->first());

        $xmlContent = $fiscalDoc?->xml_content
            ?? $fiscalDoc?->xml
            ?? $fiscalDoc?->xml_authorized
            ?? $order->fiscal_xml
            ?? null;

        if (empty($xmlContent)) {
            throw new Exception("NFC-e autorizada não foi encontrada para o pedido #{$order->id}. Emita a nota antes de imprimir.");
        }

        $document = new FiscalReceipt($order, $xmlContent);
        $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
    }

    public function printTableClaimFlyer(Order $order): void
    {
        $printer = $this->resolveCashierPrinter();

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        if (!$settings || !$settings->loyalty_is_active) {
            return;
        }

        $claimHash = $this->claimService->generateClaimHashForOrder($order);
        $claimUrl = route('customer.order.claim', ['hash' => $claimHash]);
        $document = new TableClaimFlyer($order, $claimUrl);

        $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
    }

    public function printDeliveryDispatch(Order $order, bool $includeLoyalty = false, bool $includeGrowth = false): void
    {
        $printer = $this->resolveCashierPrinter();

        $document = new DeliveryDispatch($order);
        $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $isEligibleChannel = $this->isEligibleChannel($order);

        $hasEarned = (int) ($order->loyalty_points_earned ?? 0) > 0 || (float) ($order->cashback_earned ?? 0) > 0;
        if ($includeLoyalty && $isEligibleChannel && $this->isFromOperatorApp($order) && $settings?->loyalty_is_active && $settings?->print_loyalty_flyer && $order->customer && $hasEarned) {
            $appUrl = route('customer.app', ['tab' => 'wallet']);
            $points = (int) ($order->loyalty_points_earned ?: 0);
            $document = new LoyaltyFlyer($order->customer->name, $points, $appUrl);
            $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
        }

        if ($includeGrowth && $isEligibleChannel && $this->isFromCustomerApp($order) && $settings?->print_growth_flyer) {
            $couponValue = (float) ($settings?->growth_flyer_value ?? 10.00);
            $coupon = $this->couponService->generateGrowthCoupon($couponValue);

            $appUrl = route('customer.app', [
                'tab'   => 'menu',
                'cupom' => $coupon->code,
            ]);

            $document = new GrowthFlyer($coupon, $appUrl);
            $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
        }
    }

    protected function resolvePrinterForItem(OrderItem $item, ?OrderItem $parentItem = null): ?Printer
    {
        $printer = $item->product?->kitchen?->printer;

        if (!$printer && $item->kitchen_id) {
            $printer = Kitchen::find($item->kitchen_id)?->printer;
        }

        if (!$printer && $parentItem) {
            $printer = $parentItem->product?->kitchen?->printer;
            if (!$printer && $parentItem->kitchen_id) {
                $printer = Kitchen::find($parentItem->kitchen_id)?->printer;
            }
        }

        return ($printer && $printer->is_active) ? $printer : null;
    }

    public function reprintKdsItem(OrderItem $item, string|float|int $qty = 'all'): void
    {
        $item->loadMissing([
            'order.items.modifiers',
            'product.kitchen.printer',
            'modifiers',
            'subItems.modifiers',
            'subItems.product.kitchen.printer',
            'parentItem.product.kitchen.printer'
        ]);

        $originalQty = (float) ($item->quantity ?: 1);
        $targetQty = $originalQty;

        if ($qty === 'single') {
            $targetQty = 1.0;
        } elseif (is_numeric($qty) && (float) $qty > 0 && (float) $qty < $originalQty) {
            $targetQty = (float) $qty;
        }

        $isScaled = $targetQty < $originalQty;
        $ratio = $isScaled ? ($targetQty / $originalQty) : 1.0;

        $printableItem = clone $item;
        $printableItem->setRelations($item->getRelations());
        $printableItem->quantity = $targetQty;

        if ($isScaled && $item->relationLoaded('modifiers')) {
            $scaledModifiers = $item->modifiers->map(function ($mod) use ($ratio) {
                $clonedMod = clone $mod;
                $clonedMod->quantity = max(1, (int) round(($clonedMod->quantity ?: 1) * $ratio));
                return $clonedMod;
            });
            $printableItem->setRelation('modifiers', $scaledModifiers);
        }

        $subItems = $printableItem->subItems;
        if (($subItems === null || $subItems->isEmpty()) && $printableItem->order && $printableItem->order->relationLoaded('items')) {
            $subItems = $printableItem->order->items->where('parent_item_id', $printableItem->id);
        }

        if ($subItems && $subItems->isNotEmpty()) {
            if ($isScaled) {
                $subItems = $subItems->map(function ($sub) use ($ratio) {
                    $clonedSub = clone $sub;
                    $clonedSub->setRelations($sub->getRelations());
                    $clonedSub->quantity = max(1, (int) round(($clonedSub->quantity ?: 1) * $ratio));

                    if ($sub->relationLoaded('modifiers')) {
                        $scaledSubMods = $sub->modifiers->map(function ($m) use ($ratio) {
                            $clonedM = clone $m;
                            $clonedM->quantity = max(1, (int) round(($clonedM->quantity ?: 1) * $ratio));
                            return $clonedM;
                        });
                        $clonedSub->setRelation('modifiers', $scaledSubMods);
                    }

                    return $clonedSub;
                });
            }

            $groupedByPrinter = $subItems->groupBy(function ($sub) use ($printableItem) {
                $p = $this->resolvePrinterForItem($sub, $printableItem);
                return $p ? $p->id : 'none';
            });

            $dispatched = 0;

            foreach ($groupedByPrinter as $printerId => $printerSubItems) {
                if ($printerId === 'none') continue;

                $firstSub = $printerSubItems->first();
                $printer = $this->resolvePrinterForItem($firstSub, $printableItem);

                if (!$printer) continue;

                foreach ($printerSubItems as $subItem) {
                    $subItem->_combo_name = $printableItem->product_name;
                }

                $document = new KitchenTicket(
                    $printableItem->order,
                    $printerSubItems,
                    'item',
                    false,
                    true
                );

                $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
                $dispatched++;
            }

            if ($dispatched === 0) {
                throw new Exception('Nenhuma impressora ativa configurada para as praças deste combo.');
            }

            return;
        }

        $parent = $printableItem->parentItem
            ?? ($printableItem->parent_item_id ? OrderItem::find($printableItem->parent_item_id) : null);

        $printer = $this->resolvePrinterForItem($printableItem, $parent);

        if (!$printer) {
            throw new Exception('Nenhuma impressora configurada para esta praça de produção.');
        }

        if ($parent && empty($printableItem->_combo_name)) {
            $printableItem->_combo_name = $parent->product_name;
        }

        $document = new KitchenTicket(
            $printableItem->order,
            collect([$printableItem]),
            'item',
            false,
            true
        );

        $this->dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Printing/OrderTableBuilder.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing;

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class OrderTableBuilder
{
    public static function hasDecimalQuantity(iterable $items, callable $getQty): bool
    {
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $qty = (float) $getQty($item);
            if (floor($qty) != $qty) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static function formatQty(float $qty, bool $hasDecimal): string
    {
        if ($hasDecimal) {
            return number_format($qty, 1, ',', '');
        }
        return (string) round($qty);
    }

    /**
     * 1. CONSTRUTOR DA TABELA FISCAL (NFC-e)
     */
    public static function buildFiscal(
        BlueprintBuilder $b,
        $detList,
        int|string $columnsOrFont = 'A',
        int $paperWidth = 80
    ): void {
        $cols = ReceiptFormatter::resolveColumns($columnsOrFont, $paperWidth);
        $isFontB = ($cols >= 60);

        $hasDecimal = self::hasDecimalQuantity($detList, fn($det) => (float) $det->prod->qCom);

        $codSize  = $isFontB ? 4 : 3;
        $qtySize  = $hasDecimal ? 4 : ($isFontB ? 3 : 2);
        $unSize   = 2;
        $vUnSize  = $isFontB ? 8 : 7;
        $vTotSize = $isFontB ? 9 : 8;

        $headers = ['COD', ' ', 'DESCRICAO', ' ', 'QTD', ' ', 'UN', ' ', 'VL UN', ' ', 'VL TOT'];
        $sizes   = [$codSize, 1, 0, 1, $qtySize, 1, $unSize, 1, $vUnSize, 1, $vTotSize];
        $aligns  = ['L', 'L', 'L', 'L', 'R', 'L', 'L', 'L', 'R', 'L', 'R'];

        $fixedTotal = $codSize + 1 + 1 + $qtySize + 1 + $unSize + 1 + $vUnSize + 1 + $vTotSize;
        $descSize   = max(10, $cols - $fixedTotal);

        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns($headers, $sizes, $aligns, $cols), true);
        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider($cols));

        foreach ($detList as $det) {
            $prod = $det->prod;

            $cProd = substr(trim((string) $prod->cProd), 0, $codSize);
            $xProd = substr(trim(strtoupper(Str::ascii((string) $prod->xProd))), 0, $descSize);

            $qty = (float) $prod->qCom;
            $qCom = substr(self::formatQty($qty, $hasDecimal), 0, $qtySize);

            $un = substr(trim(strtoupper((string) $prod->uCom)), 0, $unSize);
            $vUnCom = substr(number_format((float) $prod->vUnCom, 2, ',', ''), 0, $vUnSize);
            $vProd = substr(number_format((float) $prod->vProd, 2, ',', ''), 0, $vTotSize);

            $row = [$cProd, ' ', $xProd, ' ', $qCom, ' ', $un, ' ', $vUnCom, ' ', $vProd];

            $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns($row, $sizes, $aligns, $cols));
        }
    }

    /**
     * 2. CONSTRUTOR DA TABELA DE CONFERÊNCIA (Recibo de Salão / Balcão)
     */
    public static function buildConference(
        BlueprintBuilder $b,
        $items,
        int|string $columnsOrFont = 'A',
        int $paperWidth = 80
    ): void {
        $activeItems = collect($items)->filter(function ($item) {
            return ($item->status ?? null) !== 'cancelled';
        });

        $cols = ReceiptFormatter::resolveColumns($columnsOrFont, $paperWidth);
        $hasDecimal = self::hasDecimalQuantity($activeItems, fn($item) => (float) $item->quantity);

        $qtySize = $hasDecimal ? 6 : 4;
        $priceSize = 10;
        $fixedTotal = $qtySize + 1 + 1 + $priceSize;
        $descSize = max(15, $cols - $fixedTotal);

        $headers = ['QTD', ' ', 'DESCRICAO', ' ', 'VALOR R$'];
        $sizes   = [$qtySize, 1, 0, 1, $priceSize];
        $aligns  = ['L', 'L', 'L', 'L', 'R'];

        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns($headers, $sizes, $aligns, $cols), true);
        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider($cols));

        $parents = $activeItems->filter(fn($item) => empty($item->parent_item_id));
        $children = $activeItems->filter(fn($item) => !empty($item->parent_item_id));

        foreach ($parents as $parent) {
            $qty = (float) $parent->quantity;
            $qtyStr = substr(self::formatQty($qty, $hasDecimal) . 'x', 0, $qtySize);

            $rawName = trim(strtoupper(Str::ascii($parent->product_name)));
            if (!empty($parent->is_reward)) {
                $rawName .= ' [CORTESIA]';
            }
            $pName = substr($rawName, 0, $descSize);
            $totalItem = substr(number_format((float) $parent->total_price, 2, ',', '.'), 0, $priceSize);

            $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
                [$qtyStr, ' ', $pName, ' ', $totalItem],
                $sizes,
                $aligns,
                $cols
            ), true);

            self::buildModifiersAndNotes($b, $parent, $qtySize + 1, $descSize, $priceSize, 'R', $cols);

            $itemChildren = $children->filter(fn($c) => (int)$c->parent_item_id === (int)$parent->id);
            if ($itemChildren->isEmpty() && method_exists($parent, 'relationLoaded') && $parent->relationLoaded('subItems')) {
                $itemChildren = $parent->subItems->filter(fn($c) => ($c->status ?? null) !== 'cancelled');
            }

            foreach ($itemChildren as $child) {
                $childName = '    ' . trim(strtoupper(Str::ascii($child->product_name)));
                $cDesc = substr($childName, 0, $descSize);

                $cTotal = ((float)$child->total_price > 0)
                    ? substr(number_format((float)$child->total_price, 2, ',', '.'), 0, $priceSize)
                    : '';

                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
                    ['', ' ', $cDesc, ' ', $cTotal],
                    $sizes,
                    $aligns,
                    $cols
                ), false);

                self::buildModifiersAndNotes($b, $child, $qtySize + 1 + 4, $descSize - 4, $priceSize, 'R', $cols);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * 3. CONSTRUTOR DO CHECKLIST DO MOTOBOY (Delivery)
     */
    public static function buildDispatch(
        BlueprintBuilder $b,
        $items,
        int|string $columnsOrFont = 'A',
        int $paperWidth = 80
    ): void {
        $activeItems = collect($items)->filter(function ($item) {
            return ($item->status ?? null) !== 'cancelled';
        });

        $cols = ReceiptFormatter::resolveColumns($columnsOrFont, $paperWidth);
        $hasDecimal = self::hasDecimalQuantity($activeItems, fn($item) => (float) $item->quantity);

        $chkSize = 3;
        $qtySize = $hasDecimal ? 6 : 4;
        $fixedTotal = $chkSize + 1 + $qtySize + 1;
        $descSize = max(15, $cols - $fixedTotal);

        $headers = ['CHK', ' ', 'QTD', ' ', 'DESCRICAO'];
        $sizes   = [$chkSize, 1, $qtySize, 1, 0];
        $aligns  = ['L', 'L', 'L', 'L', 'L'];

        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns($headers, $sizes, $aligns, $cols), true);
        $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::divider($cols));

        $parents = $activeItems->filter(fn($item) => empty($item->parent_item_id));
        $children = $activeItems->filter(fn($item) => !empty($item->parent_item_id));

        foreach ($parents as $parent) {
            $qty = (float) $parent->quantity;
            $qtyStr = substr(self::formatQty($qty, $hasDecimal) . 'x', 0, $qtySize);

            $rawName = trim(strtoupper(Str::ascii($parent->product_name)));
            if (!empty($parent->is_reward)) {
                $rawName .= ' [CORTESIA]';
            }
            $pName = substr($rawName, 0, $descSize);

            $itemChildren = $children->filter(fn($c) => (int)$c->parent_item_id === (int)$parent->id);
            if ($itemChildren->isEmpty() && method_exists($parent, 'relationLoaded') && $parent->relationLoaded('subItems')) {
                $itemChildren = $parent->subItems->filter(fn($c) => ($c->status ?? null) !== 'cancelled');
            }
            $isComboParent = $itemChildren->isNotEmpty();

            if ($isComboParent) {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
                    ['   ', ' ', $qtyStr, ' ', $pName],
                    $sizes,
                    $aligns,
                    $cols
                ), true);
            } else {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
                    ['[ ]', ' ', $qtyStr, ' ', $pName],
                    $sizes,
                    $aligns,
                    $cols
                ), true);
            }

            self::buildModifiersAndNotes($b, $parent, $chkSize + 1 + $qtySize + 1, $descSize, 0, 'L', $cols);

            if ($isComboParent) {
                foreach ($itemChildren as $child) {
                    $cQty = (float) $child->quantity;
                    $cQtyStr = substr(self::formatQty($cQty, $hasDecimal) . 'x', 0, $qtySize);
                    $cName = '   └ ' . trim(strtoupper(Str::ascii($child->product_name)));
                    $cDesc = substr($cName, 0, $descSize);

                    $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(
                        ['[ ]', ' ', $cQtyStr, ' ', $cDesc],
                        $sizes,
                        $aligns,
                        $cols
                    ), false);

                    self::buildModifiersAndNotes($b, $child, $chkSize + 1 + $qtySize + 1 + 5, $descSize - 5, 0, 'L', $cols);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static function buildModifiersAndNotes(
        BlueprintBuilder $b,
        $item,
        int $leftOffset,
        int $descSize,
        int $rightOffset,
        string $rightAlign,
        int $cols = 48
    ): void {
        $rawMods = $item->modifiers ?? $item->structured_modifiers ?? $item->structuredModifiers ?? [];

        if (!empty($rawMods)) {
            $itemQty = max(1, (float)($item->quantity ?? 1));

            foreach ($rawMods as $mod) {
                $modObj = is_array($mod) ? (object) $mod : $mod;
                $cleanName = substr(trim(preg_replace('/^[\s•+\-]+/', '', strtoupper(Str::ascii($modObj->name ?? '')))), 0, $descSize);
                if (str_contains($cleanName, '[VIAGEM]')) continue;

                $modQty = (float)($modObj->quantity ?? $modObj->qty ?? 1);

                // 🚀 DETECÇÃO INTELIGENTE DE INGREDIENTE / OPÇÃO
                $type = strtolower((string)($modObj->type ?? $modObj->modifier_type ?? $modObj->group_type ?? ''));
                $isIngredient = in_array($type, ['ingredient', 'ingrediente', 'option', 'opcao', 'flavor', 'sabor']);

                // Quantidade do modificador por unidade do produto pai
                $unitQty = $itemQty > 0 ? ($modQty / $itemQty) : $modQty;

                // Ingredientes NUNCA exibem multiplicador. Adicionais só exibem se forem > 1 por unidade.
                if ($isIngredient || $unitQty <= 1 || $modQty == $itemQty) {
                    $prefix = '';
                } else {
                    $displayQty = (floor($unitQty) == $unitQty) ? (int)$unitQty : (int)$modQty;
                    $prefix = ($displayQty > 1) ? ($displayQty . 'X ') : '';
                }

                $sign = (str_starts_with($cleanName, 'SEM ') || str_starts_with($cleanName, 'NAO ') || str_starts_with($cleanName, 'SEM_')) ? '- ' : '+ ';

                if ($rightOffset > 0) {
                    $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['', ' ', '  ' . $sign . $prefix . $cleanName, ' ', ''], [$leftOffset - 1, 1, 0, 1, $rightOffset], ['L', 'L', 'L', 'L', $rightAlign], $cols), false);
                } else {
                    $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['', '  ' . $sign . $prefix . $cleanName], [$leftOffset, 0], ['L', 'L'], $cols), false);
                }
            }
        }

        if (!empty($item->notes)) {
            $cleanNotes = substr(strtoupper(Str::ascii($item->notes)), 0, max(5, $descSize - 7));
            if ($rightOffset > 0) {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['', ' ', '  (OBS: ' . $cleanNotes . ')', ' ', ''], [$leftOffset - 1, 1, 0, 1, $rightOffset], ['L', 'L', 'L', 'L', $rightAlign], $cols), false);
            } else {
                $b->text(ReceiptFormatter::columns(['', '  (OBS: ' . $cleanNotes . ')'], [$leftOffset, 0], ['L', 'L'], $cols), false);
            }
        }
    }
}
```
