## File: app/Services/Printing/PrintDispatcher.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing;

use App\Models\Printer;
use App\Models\PrintJob;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Events\PrintJobCreated;
use App\Events\PrintAlertTriggered;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class PrintDispatcher
{
    public function dispatch(Printer $printer, $document): void
    {
        Log::info("🚀 [PrintDispatcher] Iniciando formatação do documento para a impressora: {$printer->name}");

        if ($printer->fallback_printer_id) {
            $printer = Printer::find($printer->fallback_printer_id) ?? $printer;
            Log::info("🔄 [PrintDispatcher] Rota de Contingência ativada! Destino final: {$printer->name}");
        }

        $orderId = null;
        if (method_exists($document, 'getOrderId')) {
            $orderId = $document->getOrderId();
        } elseif (property_exists($document, 'order') && isset($document->order->id)) {
            $orderId = $document->order->id;
        }

        $order = $orderId ? Order::find($orderId) : null;

        if (!$printer->is_active) {
            Log::warning("🛑 [PrintDispatcher] A impressora de destino está inativa. Disparo cancelado.");
            $this->firePrintAlert($printer, $order, 'Impressora de destino está desativada.');
            return;
        }

        $blueprint = $document->build();

        // 1. Grava no Banco de Dados o "Log" SEMPRE como pending, confiando que a Bridge puxará o evento
        try {
            $job = PrintJob::create([
                'printer_id'    => $printer->id,
                'order_id'      => $orderId,
                'job_type'      => $document->getJobType(),
                'payload'       => $blueprint,
                'status'        => 'pending',
                'error_message' => null,
                'attempts'      => 0
            ]);
            Log::info("💾 [PrintDispatcher] PrintJob #{$job->id} salvo com sucesso!");
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error("❌ [PrintDispatcher] Erro ao salvar na tabela 'print_jobs': " . $e->getMessage());
            $this->firePrintAlert($printer, $order, 'Erro interno ao salvar ordem de impressão.');
            return;
        }

        // 2. Prepara o Pacote para a Bridge Node.js
        $payload = [
            'print_job_id' => $job->id,
            'printer_type' => $printer->connection_type,
            'os_name'      => $printer->os_name,
            'paper_width'  => $printer->paper_width,
            'job_type'     => $document->getJobType(),
            'blueprint'    => $blueprint
        ];

        // 3. Dispara para o Reverb (WebSocket) IMEDIATAMENTE
        try {
            $tenantId = tenant('id') ?? 'central';
            broadcast(new PrintJobCreated($tenantId, $payload));
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $job->update(['status' => 'failed', 'error_message' => 'Falha no WebSocket: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
            Log::error("❌ [PrintDispatcher] Erro ao tentar disparar o WebSocket: " . $e->getMessage());
            $this->firePrintAlert($printer, $order, 'Falha ao transmitir ordem para a fila.');
        }
    }

    public function retryJobs(array $jobIds): int
    {
        $jobs = PrintJob::whereIn('id', $jobIds)->get();
        $count = 0;

        foreach ($jobs as $job) {
            $job->update(['status' => 'pending', 'attempts' => $job->attempts + 1]);

            $printer = Printer::find($job->printer_id);
            if ($printer && $printer->fallback_printer_id) {
                $printer = Printer::find($printer->fallback_printer_id) ?? $printer;
            }

            if (!$printer || !$printer->is_active) continue;

            $payload = [
                'print_job_id' => $job->id,
                'printer_type' => $printer->connection_type,
                'os_name'      => $printer->os_name,
                'paper_width'  => $printer->paper_width,
                'job_type'     => $job->job_type,
                'blueprint'    => $job->payload,
            ];

            try {
                $tenantId = tenant('id') ?? 'central';
                broadcast(new PrintJobCreated($tenantId, $payload));
                $count++;
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                Log::error("Falha ao disparar Retry Print Job: " . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        return $count;
    }

    public function notifyPrintFailure(Printer $printer, ?Order $order, string $reason, string $status = 'failed'): void
    {
        $this->firePrintAlert($printer, $order, $reason, $status);
    }

    protected function firePrintAlert(Printer $printer, ?Order $order, string $reason, string $status = 'failed'): void
    {
        if (!$order) return;

        $tableName = $order->table_number
            ?? $order->table?->name
            ?? $order->table?->number
            ?? null;

        $orderTitle = $order->type === 'table'
            ? ($tableName ? "Mesa {$tableName}" : "Mesa (Pedido #{$order->id})")
            : ($order->customer_name ?? "Pedido #{$order->id}");

        $source = $order->source ?? ($order->type === 'delivery' ? 'customer_app' : 'team_app');

        event(new PrintAlertTriggered([
            'id'           => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'order_id'     => $order->id,
            'order_title'  => trim($orderTitle),
            'source'       => $source,
            'printer_name' => $printer->name ?? 'Impressora',
            'status'       => $status,
            'reason'       => $reason,
            'created_at'   => now()->toIso8601String(),
        ]));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing;

use App\Models\Printer;
use App\Models\PrintJob;

class PrintQueueService
{
    public function getQueueDashboardData(): array
    {
        $printers = Printer::where('is_active', true)->get()->map(function ($printer) {
            $lastJob = PrintJob::where('printer_id', $printer->id)->latest()->first();

            return [
                'id' => $printer->id,
                'name' => $printer->name,
                'type' => $printer->type,
                'is_cashier' => $printer->is_cashier,
                'connection_type' => $printer->connection_type,
                'fallback_printer_id' => $printer->fallback_printer_id,
                'last_status' => $lastJob ? $lastJob->status : 'success',
                'last_error' => $lastJob && $lastJob->status === 'failed' ? $lastJob->error_message : null,
            ];
        });

        $jobs = PrintJob::with(['printer:id,name', 'order:id,customer_name'])
            ->latest('id')
            ->limit(100)
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($job) {
                return [
                    'id' => $job->id,
                    'printer_name' => $job->printer->name ?? 'Desconhecida',
                    'order_id' => $job->order_id,
                    'customer_name' => $job->order->customer_name ?? '-',
                    'job_type' => $job->job_type,
                    'status' => $job->status,
                    'error_message' => $job->error_message,
                    'created_at' => $job->created_at->format('H:i:s'),
                ];
            });

        return ['printers' => $printers, 'printJobs' => $jobs];
    }

    public function retryAllFailed(PrintDispatcher $dispatcher): int
    {
        $failedJobs = PrintJob::where('status', 'failed')
            ->where('created_at', '>=', now()->subHours(12))
            ->pluck('id')
            ->toArray();

        if (empty($failedJobs)) return 0;

        return $dispatcher->retryJobs($failedJobs);
    }

    // 🚀 MÉTODOS ADICIONADOS AQUI
    public function updateFallback(Printer $printer, ?int $fallbackPrinterId): void
    {
        $printer->update(['fallback_printer_id' => $fallbackPrinterId]);
    }

    public function dismissJobs(array $jobIds): int
    {
        return PrintJob::whereIn('id', $jobIds)->delete();
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Printing/ReceiptFormatter.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Printing;

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ReceiptFormatter
{
    public const COLS_80MM_A = 48;
    public const COLS_80MM_B = 64;
    public const COLS_58MM_A = 32;
    public const COLS_58MM_B = 42;

    /**
     * Resolve o número de colunas por largura de papel e tipo de fonte
     */
    public static function resolveColumns(int|string $columnsOrFont = 48, int $paperWidth = 80): int
    {
        if (is_string($columnsOrFont)) {
            $font = strtoupper(trim($columnsOrFont));
            if ($paperWidth === 58) {
                return $font === 'B' ? self::COLS_58MM_B : self::COLS_58MM_A;
            }
            return $font === 'B' ? self::COLS_80MM_B : self::COLS_80MM_A;
        }

        return $columnsOrFont;
    }

    /**
     * Gera divisor de linha ocupando 100% da largura útil
     */
    public static function divider(int|string $columnsOrFont = 48, string $char = '-', int $paperWidth = 80): string
    {
        return str_repeat($char, self::resolveColumns($columnsOrFont, $paperWidth));
    }

    /**
     * Alinha colunas monospace (tamanho 0 = preenchimento automático do restante da linha)
     */
    public static function columns(
        array $texts,
        array $sizes,
        array $aligns = [],
        int|string $columnsOrFont = 48,
        int $paperWidth = 80
    ): string {
        $paperColumns = self::resolveColumns($columnsOrFont, $paperWidth);
        $result = '';

        // Calcula a coluna expansível (tamanho 0)
        $expandIndex = array_search(0, $sizes, true);
        if ($expandIndex !== false) {
            $fixedTotal = array_sum($sizes);
            $sizes[$expandIndex] = max(0, $paperColumns - $fixedTotal);
        }

        foreach ($texts as $index => $text) {
            $size = $sizes[$index] ?? 0;
            $align = $aligns[$index] ?? 'L';

            $cleanText = Str::ascii((string) $text);
            $textStr = substr($cleanText, 0, $size);

            if ($align === 'R') {
                $result .= str_pad($textStr, $size, ' ', STR_PAD_LEFT);
            } elseif ($align === 'C') {
                $result .= str_pad($textStr, $size, ' ', STR_PAD_BOTH);
            } else {
                $result .= str_pad($textStr, $size, ' ', STR_PAD_RIGHT);
            }
        }

        return $result;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Purchases;

use App\Models\ProductCostHistory;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use App\Models\PersonalPurchase;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class InvoiceImportService
{
    /**
     * Tenta encontrar o ID do Fornecedor pelo CNPJ do XML
     */
    public function findSupplierIdByCnpj(string $cnpj): ?int
    {
        $cleanCnpj = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $cnpj);
        return Supplier::where('document', $cleanCnpj)->value('id');
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 SMART MATCH (Busca em Cascata):
     * Retorna um array com o 'product_id' e o 'conversion_factor'.
     */
    public function findInternalMatch(?int $supplierId, string $xmlName): ?array
    {
        // 1. Tenta a Correspondência Exata (Mesmo fornecedor + Mesmo Nome XML)
        if ($supplierId) {
            $exactMatch = ProductCostHistory::where('supplier_id', $supplierId)
                ->where('xml_name', $xmlName)
                ->latest('id')
                ->first();

            if ($exactMatch) {
                return [
                    'product_id' => $exactMatch->product_id,
                    'conversion_factor' => $exactMatch->conversion_factor
                ];
            }
        }

        // 2. Tenta a Correspondência Ampla (Qualquer fornecedor + Mesmo Nome XML)
        $broadMatch = ProductCostHistory::where('xml_name', $xmlName)
            ->latest('id')
            ->first();

        if ($broadMatch) {
            return [
                'product_id' => $broadMatch->product_id,
                'conversion_factor' => $broadMatch->conversion_factor
            ];
        }

        // Se não achou em lugar nenhum, retorna null
        return null;
    }

    public function extractDataFromXml(string $xmlContent, int|string|null $receivedInvoiceId = null): array
    {
        try {
            if (str_contains($xmlContent, 'base64,')) {
                $xmlContent = base64_decode(explode('base64,', $xmlContent)[1]);
            }

            $xmlContent = preg_replace('/xmlns[^=]*="[^"]*"/i', '', $xmlContent);
            $xml = @simplexml_load_string($xmlContent, 'SimpleXMLElement', LIBXML_NOCDATA);

            $nfeNode = isset($xml->NFe) ? $xml->NFe : ($xml->getName() === 'NFe' ? $xml : null);
            $inf = $nfeNode->infNFe;

            $state = [
                'received_invoice_id' => $receivedInvoiceId,
                'invoice_key' => str_replace('NFe', '', (string) $inf->attributes()->Id),
                'xml_total_amount' => (float) $inf->total->ICMSTot->vNF,
                'xml_supplier_cnpj' => (string) $inf->emit->CNPJ,
                'xml_supplier_name' => (string) $inf->emit->xNome,
            ];

            $state['financial_already_launched'] = AccountPayable::where('nfe_key', $state['invoice_key'])->exists();
            $state['supplier_id'] = $this->findSupplierIdByCnpj($state['xml_supplier_cnpj']);

            $installments = [];
            if (isset($inf->cobr->dup)) {
                foreach ($inf->cobr->dup as $dup) {
                    $installments[] = [
                        'number' => (string) $dup->nDup,
                        'due_date' => (string) $dup->dVenc,
                        'amount' => (float) $dup->vDup
                    ];
                }
            }
            $state['xml_installments'] = $installments;

            $groupedItems = [];
            if (isset($inf->det)) {
                foreach ($inf->det as $det) {
                    $xmlName = (string) $det->prod->xProd;
                    $xmlQty = (float) $det->prod->qCom;
                    $xmlCost = (float) $det->prod->vUnCom;
                    $xmlTotal = (float) $det->prod->vProd;
                    // Remove qualquer coisa que não seja letra e joga para maiúsculo (ex: "un1" vira "UN")
                    $xmlUom = strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z]/', '', (string) $det->prod->uCom));
                    $xmlCode = (string) $det->prod->cProd;

                    if ($xmlCost <= 0.001 && $xmlQty > 0) {
                        $xmlCost = $xmlTotal / $xmlQty;
                    }

                    $groupKey = md5($xmlName . '_' . $xmlCost . '_' . $xmlUom);

                    if (!isset($groupedItems[$groupKey])) {
                        $groupedItems[$groupKey] = [
                            'name' => $xmlName,
                            'code' => $xmlCode,
                            'cost' => $xmlCost,
                            'uom'  => $xmlUom,
                            'qty'  => 0
                        ];
                    }
                    $groupedItems[$groupKey]['qty'] += $xmlQty;
                }
            }

            $items = [];
            foreach ($groupedItems as $group) {
                $xmlName = $group['name'];
                $xmlCost = $group['cost'];
                $xmlQty = $group['qty'];
                $xmlUom = $group['uom'];
                $xmlCode = $group['code'];

                $processed = ProductCostHistory::where('nfe_key', $state['invoice_key'])->where('xml_name', $xmlName)->exists()
                    || PersonalPurchase::where('nfe_key', $state['invoice_key'])->where('xml_name', $xmlName)->exists();

                if (!$processed) {
                    // 🚀 Aplicamos o Smart Match!
                    $matchData = $this->findInternalMatch($state['supplier_id'], $xmlName);

                    $matchProductId = $matchData['product_id'] ?? null;
                    $matchFactor = $matchData['conversion_factor'] ?? 1;

                    $items[] = [
                        'xml_name' => $xmlName,
                        'supplier_product_code' => $xmlCode,
                        'xml_qty'  => $xmlQty,
                        'available_qty' => $xmlQty,
                        'xml_cost' => $xmlCost,
                        'xml_uom'  => $xmlUom,
                        'conversion_factor' => $matchFactor,
                        'product_id' => $matchProductId,
                        'is_matched' => $matchProductId ? 1 : 0,
                        'item_uuid'  => (string) Str::uuid(),
                        'confirmation_step' => 0,
                        'factor_source' => 'auto',
                    ];
                }
            }

            $state['xml_items'] = collect($items)->sortByDesc('is_matched')->values()->toArray();
            return $state;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::error("Erro no XML Import: " . $e->getMessage());
            return [];
        }
    }

    public function finalizeInvoice(array $formData): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($formData) {
            if (!empty($formData['supplier_id'])) {
                $supplier = Supplier::find($formData['supplier_id']);
                if ($supplier) {
                    $needsSave = false;
                    if (empty($supplier->document) && !empty($formData['xml_supplier_cnpj'])) {
                        $supplier->document = $formData['xml_supplier_cnpj'];
                        $needsSave = true;
                    }
                    if (empty($supplier->name) && !empty($formData['xml_supplier_name'])) {
                        $supplier->name = $formData['xml_supplier_name'];
                        $needsSave = true;
                    }
                    if ($needsSave) $supplier->save();
                }
            }

            if (!$formData['financial_already_launched']) {
                $this->generateFinancial($formData);
            }

            if (!empty($formData['received_invoice_id'])) {
                ReceivedInvoice::where('id', $formData['received_invoice_id'])->update(['status' => 'processed']);
            }
        });
    }

    protected function generateFinancial(array $data): void
    {
        $supplier = Supplier::find($data['supplier_id']);
        $supplierName = $supplier ? ($supplier->trade_name ?: $supplier->name) : 'Fornecedor';
        $installments = $data['xml_installments'] ?? [];

        if (count($installments) > 0) {
            foreach ($installments as $dup) {
                AccountPayable::create([
                    'nfe_key' => $data['invoice_key'],
                    'supplier_id' => $data['supplier_id'],
                    'supplier_name' => $supplierName,
                    'description' => "Invoice #{$data['invoice_key']} - Parc {$dup['number']}",
                    'amount' => $dup['amount'],
                    'installment' => $dup['number'],
                    'due_date' => $dup['due_date'],
                    'status' => 'pending',
                ]);
            }
        } else {
            AccountPayable::create([
                'nfe_key' => $data['invoice_key'],
                'supplier_id' => $data['supplier_id'],
                'supplier_name' => $supplierName,
                'description' => "Pagamento Único - Nota #{$data['invoice_key']}",
                'amount' => $data['xml_total_amount'],
                'installment' => '1/1',
                'due_date' => now()->toDateString(),
                'status' => 'pending',
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
         * 🚀 O ROBÔ: Tenta aprovar automaticamente uma nota inteira logo após o download.
         */
        public function attemptAutoApproval(ReceivedInvoice $invoice): void
        {
            // 1. Finge que a nota foi aberta na tela e extrai os dados
            $data = $this->extractDataFromXml($invoice->xml_content, $invoice->id);

            if (empty($data['xml_items']) || empty($data['supplier_id'])) {
                return;
            }

            $processor = app(InvoiceItemProcessor::class);
            $allProcessed = true;

            foreach ($data['xml_items'] as $index => $item) {
                // 2. Procura se existe uma regra de auto-aprovação para este item exato
                $rule = ProductCostHistory::where('supplier_id', $data['supplier_id'])
                    ->where('xml_name', $item['xml_name'])
                    ->where('auto_approve', true)
                    ->latest('id')
                    ->first();

                if ($rule) {
                    // 3. TRAVA DE SEGURANÇA: A unidade de medida mudou? (Ex: Era UN e agora é FD?)
                    $xmlUom = strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z]/', '', $item['xml_uom']));
                    $ruleUom = strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z]/', '', $rule->original_unit_of_measure ?? ''));

                    if ($xmlUom === $ruleUom) {
                        // 4. Injeta os dados históricos no item e processa direto!
                        $item['product_id'] = $rule->product_id;
                        $item['conversion_factor'] = $rule->conversion_factor;
                        $item['is_personal'] = false;

                        // O último 'true' mantém a flag acesa para compras futuras
                        $processor->processDirectItem($item, $data['invoice_key'], $data['supplier_id'], true);
                        continue; // Item processado com sucesso! Vai para o próximo.
                    }
                }

                // Se o item não tem regra ou a segurança falhou, a nota não pode ser fechada 100%
                $allProcessed = false;
            }

            // 5. Se o robô conseguiu processar TODOS os itens sozinho, ele gera as contas a pagar e finaliza a nota!
            if ($allProcessed) {
                // Removemos os xml_items do payload para evitar retrabalho, pois já foram processados linha a linha
                unset($data['xml_items']);
                $this->finalizeInvoice($data);
            }
        }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Purchases/InvoiceItemProcessor.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Purchases;

use App\Models\GoodsReceiptItem;
use App\Models\GoodsReceipt;
use App\Models\PersonalPurchase;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ProductCostHistory;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use InvalidArgumentException;

class InvoiceItemProcessor
{
    public function calculateSmartConversion(?int $productId, ?int $supplierId, ?string $currentXmlName, ?string $xmlUomRaw): array
    {
        $result = [
            'factor' => 1.0,
            'source' => 'manual',
            'notification' => null,
        ];

        if (!$productId || !$currentXmlName) {
            return $result;
        }

        if ($supplierId) {
            $lastPurchase = ProductCostHistory::where('supplier_id', $supplierId)
                ->where('product_id', $productId)
                ->where('xml_name', $currentXmlName)
                ->latest('id')
                ->first();

            if ($lastPurchase && $lastPurchase->conversion_factor) {
                $factor = (float) $lastPurchase->conversion_factor;
                $result['factor'] = $factor;
                $result['source'] = 'history';
                return $result;
            }
        }

        $product = Product::find($productId);
        $internalUom = strtoupper((string) ($product?->unit_of_measure ?? ''));
        $xmlUom = strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Z]/', '', (string) ($xmlUomRaw ?? '')));

        $isIdentical = ($xmlUom === $internalUom)
            || (in_array($xmlUom, ['KG', 'KIL']) && $internalUom === 'KG')
            || (in_array($xmlUom, ['L', 'LT', 'LIT']) && $internalUom === 'LT')
            || (in_array($xmlUom, ['UN', 'UND']) && $internalUom === 'UN');

        if ($isIdentical) {
            $result['factor'] = 1.0;
            $result['source'] = 'identical';
            return $result;
        }

        $factor = 1.0;
        $autoMath = false;

        if (in_array($xmlUom, ['KG', 'KIL']) && $internalUom === 'G') {
            $factor = 1000.0;
            $autoMath = true;
        } elseif ($xmlUom === 'G' && in_array($internalUom, ['KG', 'KIL'])) {
            $factor = 0.001;
            $autoMath = true;
        } elseif (in_array($xmlUom, ['L', 'LT', 'LIT']) && $internalUom === 'ML') {
            $factor = 1000.0;
            $autoMath = true;
        } elseif ($xmlUom === 'ML' && in_array($internalUom, ['L', 'LT', 'LIT'])) {
            $factor = 0.001;
            $autoMath = true;
        }

        if ($autoMath) {
            $result['factor'] = $factor;
            $result['source'] = 'auto_math';
        }

        return $result;
    }

    public function processDirectItem(array $item, ?string $invoiceKey, ?int $supplierId, bool $autoApprove = false): void
    {
        $processQty = (float) ($item['xml_qty'] ?? 0);
        $invoiceCost = (float) ($item['xml_cost'] ?? 0);
        $invoiceUom = (string) ($item['xml_uom'] ?? '');
        $isPersonal = !empty($item['is_personal']);
        $receiptItemId = $item['goods_receipt_item_id'] ?? null;

        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Transação individual removida! Assumimos que o chamador (processConfirmedItems) já abriu a transação.
        if ($isPersonal) {
            PersonalPurchase::create([
                'nfe_key'    => $invoiceKey,
                'supplier_id'=> $supplierId,
                'xml_name'   => $item['xml_name'],
                'quantity'   => $processQty,
                'unit_cost'  => $invoiceCost,
                'total_cost' => round($processQty * $invoiceCost, 4),
            ]);
            return;
        }

        $productId = $item['product_id'];
        $conversionFactor = (float) ($item['conversion_factor'] ?? 1.0);
        if ($conversionFactor <= 0) $conversionFactor = 1.0;

        $actualQty = round($processQty * $conversionFactor, 4);
        $actualUnitCost = round($invoiceCost / $conversionFactor, 5);

        $product = Product::find($productId);
        $inventoryService = app(InventoryService::class);

        if ($product) {
            // Usa updateQuietly para não disparar observers desnecessários
            $product->updateQuietly(['base_cost' => $actualUnitCost]);

            if ($receiptItemId) {
                $receiptItem = GoodsReceiptItem::find($receiptItemId);
                if ($receiptItem) {
                    $receiptQty = (float) $receiptItem->quantity;
                    $delta = round($actualQty - $receiptQty, 4);

                    if ($delta > 0) {
                        $inventoryService->addStock($product->fresh(), $delta, 'nfe_reconcile_surplus');
                    } elseif ($delta < 0) {
                        $inventoryService->deductStock($product->fresh(), abs($delta));
                    }

                    $receiptItem->update([
                        'status'         => 'reconciled',
                        'reconciled_qty' => $actualQty,
                        'nfe_key'        => $invoiceKey,
                    ]);

                    $receipt = $receiptItem->goodsReceipt;
                    if ($receipt) {
                        $hasPending = $receipt->items()->where('status', '!=', 'reconciled')->exists();
                        if (!$hasPending) {
                            $receipt->update([
                                'status'  => 'reconciled',
                                'nfe_key' => $invoiceKey,
                            ]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $inventoryService->addStock($product->fresh(), $actualQty, 'nfe_import');
            }
        }

        ProductCostHistory::create([
            'product_id'               => $productId,
            'supplier_id'              => $supplierId,
            'nfe_key'                  => $invoiceKey,
            'xml_name'                 => $item['xml_name'],
            'quantity'                 => $actualQty,
            'unit_cost'                => $actualUnitCost,
            'conversion_factor'        => $conversionFactor,
            'original_quantity'        => $processQty,
            'original_unit_cost'       => $invoiceCost,
            'original_unit_of_measure' => $invoiceUom,
            'auto_approve'             => $autoApprove,
        ]);
    }

    public function processConfirmedItems(array $payload, array $currentItems): array
    {
        $processQty = (float) ($payload['xml_qty'] ?? 0);
        $availableQty = (float) ($payload['available_qty'] ?? 0);

        if ($processQty <= 0 || $processQty > $availableQty) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("A quantidade informada ({$processQty}) deve ser maior que zero e menor ou igual a {$availableQty}.");
        }

        $supplierId = isset($payload['supplier_id']) && !empty($payload['supplier_id'])
            ? (int) $payload['supplier_id']
            : null;

        if (!$supplierId) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O fornecedor é obrigatório para processar itens da nota.');
        }

        $isPersonal = !empty($payload['is_personal']);
        $productId = isset($payload['product_id']) && !empty($payload['product_id'])
            ? (int) $payload['product_id']
            : null;

        if (!$isPersonal && !$productId) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Selecione um produto cadastrado ou marque a compra como Uso Pessoal.');
        }

        $invoiceKey = $payload['invoice_key'] ?? null;
        $targetXmlName = (string) ($payload['xml_name'] ?? '');
        $conversionFactor = (float) ($payload['conversion_factor'] ?? 1.0);
        $uuidToFind = (string) ($payload['item_uuid'] ?? '');
        $receiptItemId = $payload['goods_receipt_item_id'] ?? null;

        $itemData = [
            'xml_qty'               => $processQty,
            'xml_cost'              => (float) ($payload['xml_cost'] ?? 0),
            'xml_uom'               => (string) ($payload['xml_uom'] ?? ''),
            'is_personal'           => $isPersonal,
            'xml_name'              => $targetXmlName,
            'product_id'            => $productId,
            'goods_receipt_item_id' => $receiptItemId,
            'conversion_factor'     => $conversionFactor,
        ];

        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Uma única transação para englobar a inserção manual e as duplicadas (efeito dominó)
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($itemData, $invoiceKey, $supplierId, $currentItems, $uuidToFind, $processQty, $availableQty, $targetXmlName, $isPersonal, $productId, $conversionFactor, $receiptItemId) {

            $this->processDirectItem($itemData, $invoiceKey, $supplierId, false);

            $autoProcessedCount = 0;
            $items = $currentItems;

            foreach ($items as $key => $item) {
                if ((isset($item['item_uuid']) && (string)$item['item_uuid'] === $uuidToFind) || (string)$key === $uuidToFind) {
                    if ($processQty < $availableQty) {
                        $newAvailable = round($availableQty - $processQty, 4);
                        $items[$key]['available_qty'] = $newAvailable;
                        $items[$key]['xml_qty'] = $newAvailable;
                        $items[$key]['is_personal'] = false;
                        $items[$key]['factor_source'] = 'manual';
                    } else {
                        unset($items[$key]);
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                // Efeito dominó para itens idênticos pendentes
                if (!$receiptItemId && isset($item['xml_name']) && (string)$item['xml_name'] === $targetXmlName) {
                    $duplicateItemData = [
                        'xml_qty'           => (float) ($item['available_qty'] ?? $item['xml_qty'] ?? 0),
                        'xml_cost'          => (float) ($item['xml_cost'] ?? 0),
                        'xml_uom'           => (string) ($item['xml_uom'] ?? ''),
                        'is_personal'       => $isPersonal,
                        'xml_name'          => $targetXmlName,
                        'product_id'        => $productId,
                        'conversion_factor' => $conversionFactor,
                    ];

                    $this->processDirectItem($duplicateItemData, $invoiceKey, $supplierId, false);
                    unset($items[$key]);
                    $autoProcessedCount++;
                }
            }

            return [
                'updated_items'        => $items,
                'auto_processed_count' => $autoProcessedCount,
            ];
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\PrintJob;
use App\Models\Printer;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Events\BridgeStatusUpdated;
use App\Events\PrintAlertTriggered;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Exception;

class BridgeService
{
    const REQUIRED_VERSION = '1.0.0';

    /**
     * Avalia se a bridge física local está ativa e comunicando.
     */
    public function isOnline(): bool
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
        if (!$settings || empty($settings->print_bridge_connected_at)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Considera online se comunicou nos últimos 180 segundos (3 minutos)
        return Carbon::parse($settings->print_bridge_connected_at)->diffInSeconds(now()) <= 180;
    }

    public function processHandshake(string $providedToken, string $bridgeVersion, string $tenantId): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        if (empty($settings->print_bridge_token)) {
            $settings->update(['print_bridge_token' => Str::random(32)]);
        }

        if ($providedToken !== $settings->print_bridge_token) {
            throw new Exception('Acesso Negado. Token da Bridge inválido.', 403);
        }

        $status = version_compare($bridgeVersion, self::REQUIRED_VERSION, '>=') ? 'online' : 'outdated';

        $settings->update([
            'print_bridge_version' => $bridgeVersion,
            'print_bridge_connected_at' => now(),
        ]);

        broadcast(new BridgeStatusUpdated($tenantId, $status, $bridgeVersion));

        return [
            'status' => $status,
            'tenant_id' => $tenantId,
            'required_version' => self::REQUIRED_VERSION,
            'message' => $status === 'outdated' ? 'Versão obsoleta. Atualização necessária.' : 'Conectado!',
        ];
    }

    public function updateJob(string $providedToken, $jobId, string $status, ?string $errorMessage): void
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        if ($providedToken !== $settings->print_bridge_token) {
            throw new Exception('Acesso Negado.', 403);
        }

        // ⏱️ Atualiza a presença da Bridge
        $settings->update(['print_bridge_connected_at' => now()]);

        $job = PrintJob::find($jobId);
        if ($job) {
            $job->update([
                'status' => $status,
                'error_message' => $errorMessage,
            ]);

            // 🚀 SE A BRIDGE REPORTAR ERRO / FALHA FÍSICA NO SPOOLER OU IMPRESSORA:
            if ($status === 'failed') {
                $order = $job->order_id ? Order::find($job->order_id) : null;
                $printer = $job->printer_id ? Printer::find($job->printer_id) : null;

                if ($order && $printer) {
                    $tableName = $order->table_number
                        ?? $order->table?->name
                        ?? $order->table?->number
                        ?? null;

                    $orderTitle = $order->type === 'table'
                        ? ($tableName ? "Mesa {$tableName}" : "Mesa (Pedido #{$order->id})")
                        : ($order->customer_name ?? "Pedido #{$order->id}");

                    $rawSource = strtolower((string) ($order->source ?? ''));
                    if (in_array($rawSource, ['customer_app', 'customer', 'b2c', 'online', 'web', 'cardapio'], true)) {
                        $source = 'customer_app';
                    } elseif (in_array($rawSource, ['team_app', 'team', 'waiter', 'garcom', 'pos'], true)) {
                        $source = 'team_app';
                    } else {
                        $source = in_array($order->type, ['delivery'], true) ? 'customer_app' : 'team_app';
                    }

                    event(new PrintAlertTriggered([
                        'id'           => (string) Str::uuid(),
                        'order_id'     => $order->id,
                        'order_title'  => trim($orderTitle),
                        'source'       => $source,
                        'printer_name' => $printer->name ?? 'Impressora',
                        'status'       => 'failed',
                        'reason'       => $errorMessage ?? 'Falha na impressora física (sem papel ou desconectada).',
                        'created_at'   => now()->toIso8601String(),
                    ]));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function getActivePrinters()
    {
        return Printer::where('is_active', true)
            ->select('id', 'name', 'type', 'is_cashier', 'paper_width')
            ->get();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\Checklist;
use App\Models\ChecklistLog;
use App\Models\ChecklistTask;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\User;
use Exception;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ChecklistService
{
    private function getTodayRecurrenceFilter(): \Closure
    {
        $dayOfWeek = now()->dayOfWeek;
        $dayOfMonth = now()->day;

        return function ($query) use ($dayOfWeek, $dayOfMonth) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($dayOfWeek, $dayOfMonth) {
                $q->where('recurrence_type', 'daily')
                  ->orWhere(function ($qWeekly) use ($dayOfWeek) {
                      $qWeekly->where('recurrence_type', 'weekly')
                              ->where(function($jsonQ) use ($dayOfWeek) {
                                  $jsonQ->whereJsonContains('recurrence_days', $dayOfWeek)
                                        ->orWhereJsonContains('recurrence_days', (string)$dayOfWeek);
                              });
                  })
                  ->orWhere(function ($qMonthly) use ($dayOfMonth) {
                      $qMonthly->where('recurrence_type', 'monthly')
                               ->where(function($jsonQ) use ($dayOfMonth) {
                                  $jsonQ->whereJsonContains('recurrence_days', $dayOfMonth)
                                        ->orWhereJsonContains('recurrence_days', (string)$dayOfMonth);
                               });
                  })
                  ->orWhere('recurrence_type', 'once');
            });
        };
    }

    public function getChecklistsForUser(User $user): array
    {
        $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();
        if (!$shift) {
            return [];
        }

        $roles = $user->roles->pluck('name')->toArray();
        if (empty($roles)) {
            $roles = ['waiter'];
        }
        $userId = $user->id;

        $todayFilter = $this->getTodayRecurrenceFilter();

        $taskFilter = function ($query) use ($roles, $userId, $todayFilter, $shift) {
            $query->with('inventoryItem');

            $query->where(function ($q) use ($roles, $userId) {
                $q->where('assignment_type', 'all')
                  ->orWhere(function ($qRoles) use ($roles) {
                      $qRoles->where('assignment_type', 'roles');
                      $qRoles->where(function ($qInJson) use ($roles) {
                          foreach ($roles as $r) {
                              $qInJson->orWhereJsonContains('target_roles', $r)
                                      ->orWhereJsonContains('target_roles', (string)$r);
                          }
                      });
                  })
                  ->orWhere(function ($qUsers) use ($userId) {
                      $qUsers->where('assignment_type', 'users')
                              ->where(function($qInJson) use ($userId) {
                                  $qInJson->whereJsonContains('target_users', $userId)
                                          ->orWhereJsonContains('target_users', (string)$userId);
                              });
                  });
            });

            $todayFilter($query);

            $query->whereNotExists(function ($qDone) use ($shift) {
                $qDone->select(DB::raw(1))
                        ->from('checklist_logs')
                        ->whereColumn('checklist_logs.checklist_task_id', 'checklist_tasks.id')
                        ->where('checklist_tasks.recurrence_type', 'once')
                        ->where('checklist_logs.status', 'done')
                        ->where('checklist_logs.cash_shift_id', '!=', $shift->id);
            });

            $query->orderBy('sort_order');
        };

        return Checklist::with(['tasks' => $taskFilter])
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->whereHas('tasks', $taskFilter)
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($checklist) use ($shift) {
                $tasks = $checklist->tasks->map(function ($task) use ($shift) {
                    $log = ChecklistLog::where('checklist_task_id', $task->id)
                        ->where('cash_shift_id', $shift->id)
                        ->first();

                    return [
                        'id'                => $task->id,
                        'description'       => $task->description,
                        'instructions'      => $task->instructions,
                        'status'            => $log ? $log->status : 'pending',
                        'notes'             => $log ? $log->notes : null,
                        'trigger_type'      => $task->trigger_type,
                        'trigger_time'      => $task->trigger_time,
                        'recurrence_type'   => $task->recurrence_type,
                        'deadline_minutes'  => $task->deadline_minutes,
                        'deadline_date'     => $task->deadline_date,
                        'is_inventory_task' => (bool) $task->is_inventory_task,
                        'inventory_item'    => $task->is_inventory_task ? $task->inventoryItem : null,
                    ];
                });

                return [
                    'id'          => $checklist->id,
                    'title'       => $checklist->title,
                    'progress'    => $tasks->where('status', '!=', 'pending')->count(),
                    'total_tasks' => $tasks->count(),
                    'tasks'       => $tasks->values(),
                ];
            })->toArray();
    }

    public function syncTask(int $userId, array $data): void
    {
        $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();
        if (!$shift) {
            throw new Exception('Não existe nenhum turno aberto para registrar esta tarefa.');
        }

        ChecklistLog::updateOrCreate(
            [
                'checklist_task_id' => $data['task_id'],
                'cash_shift_id'     => $shift->id,
            ],
            [
                'user_id' => $userId,
                'status'  => $data['status'],
                'notes'   => $data['notes'] ?? null,
            ]
        );
    }

    public function getShiftOverview(): array
    {
        $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();
        if (!$shift) {
            return [
                'has_open_shift'        => false,
                'total_tasks'           => 0,
                'completed_tasks'       => 0,
                'issues_count'          => 0,
                'completion_percentage' => 0,
                'issues'                => [],
            ];
        }

        $todayFilter = $this->getTodayRecurrenceFilter();

        $activeChecklists = Checklist::with(['tasks' => $todayFilter])
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->whereHas('tasks', $todayFilter)
            ->get();

        $allTasks = $activeChecklists->pluck('tasks')->flatten();
        $totalTasksCount = $allTasks->count();

        if ($totalTasksCount === 0) {
            return [
                'has_open_shift'        => true,
                'total_tasks'           => 0,
                'completed_tasks'       => 0,
                'issues_count'          => 0,
                'completion_percentage' => 100,
                'issues'                => [],
            ];
        }

        $logs = ChecklistLog::with(['task.checklist', 'user'])
            ->where('cash_shift_id', $shift->id)
            ->get();

        $completedCount = $logs->where('status', 'done')->count();
        $issues = $logs->where('status', 'issue');

        $completionPercentage = round((($completedCount + $issues->count()) / $totalTasksCount) * 100);

        return [
            'has_open_shift'        => true,
            'total_tasks'           => $totalTasksCount,
            'completed_tasks'       => $completedCount,
            'issues_count'          => $issues->count(),
            'completion_percentage' => min(100, $completionPercentage),
            'issues'                => $issues->map(function ($log) {
                return [
                    'id'              => $log->id,
                    'task_name'       => $log->task->description ?? 'Tarefa',
                    'checklist_title' => $log->task->checklist->title ?? 'Rotina',
                    'reported_by'     => $log->user->name ?? 'Colaborador',
                    'notes'           => $log->notes,
                    'time'            => $log->updated_at ? $log->updated_at->format('H:i') : '--:--',
                ];
            })->values()->toArray(),
        ];
    }

    public function getManagementData(): array
    {
        $checklists = Checklist::with(['tasks' => function ($q) {
            $q->with('inventoryItem')->orderBy('sort_order')->orderBy('id');
        }])->orderBy('title')->get();

        $users = User::where('is_active', true)->select('id', 'name')->get();

        $roles = [
            ['value' => 'kitchen', 'label' => 'Cozinha (KDS)'],
            ['value' => 'waiter',  'label' => 'Garçons / Salão'],
            ['value' => 'cashier', 'label' => 'Caixa / Atendimento'],
            ['value' => 'driver',  'label' => 'Entregadores'],
            ['value' => 'admin',   'label' => 'Gestão'],
        ];

        return [
            'checklists' => $checklists,
            'users'      => $users,
            'roles'      => $roles,
            'overview'   => $this->getShiftOverview(),
        ];
    }

    public function createChecklist(array $data): Checklist
    {
        return Checklist::create([
            'title'     => $data['title'],
            'is_active' => $data['is_active'] ?? true,
        ]);
    }

    public function updateChecklist(Checklist $checklist, array $data): Checklist
    {
        $checklist->update([
            'title'     => $data['title'] ?? $checklist->title,
            'is_active' => $data['is_active'] ?? $checklist->is_active,
        ]);
        return $checklist;
    }

    public function deleteChecklist(Checklist $checklist): void
    {
        $checklist->tasks()->delete();
        $checklist->delete();
    }

    public function createTask(Checklist $checklist, array $data): ChecklistTask
    {
        return $checklist->tasks()->create([
            'description'         => $data['description'],
            'instructions'        => $data['instructions'] ?? null,
            'assignment_type'     => $data['assignment_type'] ?? 'all',
            'target_roles'        => $data['target_roles'] ?? null,
            'target_users'        => $data['target_users'] ?? null,
            'completion_type'     => $data['completion_type'] ?? 'shared',
            'trigger_type'        => $data['trigger_type'] ?? 'manual',
            'trigger_time'        => $data['trigger_time'] ?? null,
            'deadline_minutes'    => $data['deadline_minutes'] ?? 60,
            'recurrence_type'     => $data['recurrence_type'] ?? 'daily',
            'recurrence_days'     => $data['recurrence_days'] ?? null,
            'deadline_date'       => $data['deadline_date'] ?? null,
            'sort_order'          => $checklist->tasks()->max('sort_order') + 1,
            'is_inventory_task'   => (bool) ($data['is_inventory_task'] ?? false),
            'inventory_item_type' => $data['inventory_item_type'] ?? null,
            'inventory_item_id'   => $data['inventory_item_id'] ?? null,
        ]);
    }

    public function updateTask(ChecklistTask $task, array $data): ChecklistTask
    {
        $task->update([
            'description'         => $data['description'] ?? $task->description,
            'instructions'        => $data['instructions'] ?? $task->instructions,
            'assignment_type'     => $data['assignment_type'] ?? $task->assignment_type,
            'target_roles'        => $data['target_roles'] ?? $task->target_roles,
            'target_users'        => $data['target_users'] ?? $task->target_users,
            'completion_type'     => $data['completion_type'] ?? $task->completion_type,
            'trigger_type'        => $data['trigger_type'] ?? $task->trigger_type,
            'trigger_time'        => $data['trigger_time'] ?? $task->trigger_time,
            'deadline_minutes'    => $data['deadline_minutes'] ?? $task->deadline_minutes,
            'recurrence_type'     => $data['recurrence_type'] ?? $task->recurrence_type,
            'recurrence_days'     => $data['recurrence_days'] ?? $task->recurrence_days,
            'deadline_date'       => $data['deadline_date'] ?? $task->deadline_date,
            'is_inventory_task'   => (bool) ($data['is_inventory_task'] ?? false),
            'inventory_item_type' => $data['inventory_item_type'] ?? null,
            'inventory_item_id'   => $data['inventory_item_id'] ?? null,
        ]);
        return $task;
    }

    public function deleteTask(ChecklistTask $task): void
    {
        $task->delete();
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Exception;

class EmployeeWalletService
{
    public function getWalletDashboardData(int $employeeId): array
    {
        // Traz o funcionário e os últimos 50 movimentos da conta corrente
        $employee = Employee::with(['ledgers' => function($q) {
            $q->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->limit(50);
        }])->findOrFail($employeeId);

        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        // O saldo atual é sempre o 'balance' do último registro inserido
        $latestLedger = $employee->ledgers->first();
        $currentBalance = $latestLedger ? (float) $latestLedger->balance : 0.00;

        return [
            'employee' => [
                'id' => $employee->id,
                'name' => $employee->name,
                'food_allowance_amount' => $employee->food_allowance_amount,
            ],
            'currentBalance' => $currentBalance,
            'ledgers' => $employee->ledgers,
            'settings' => [
                'has_food_allowance' => $settings->has_food_allowance ?? false,
                'self_service_enabled' => $settings->self_service_enabled ?? false,
                'allowance_frequency' => $settings->allowance_frequency ?? 'monthly',
                'allowance_scope' => $settings->allowance_scope ?? 'global',
            ]
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/RestaurantOps/KdsService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\Kitchen;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ModifierOption;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class KdsService
{
    public function __construct(protected InventoryService $inventoryService) {}

    public function getBoardData(string|int $activeKitchenId): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $user = auth()->user();
        $employee = $user?->employee;

        $kitchensQuery = Kitchen::where('is_active', true);

        if ($settings && $settings->kds_access_mode === 'individual' && $employee) {
            $allowedIds = $employee->kitchens()->pluck('kitchens.id')->toArray();
            $kitchensQuery->whereIn('id', $allowedIds);
        }

        $kitchens = $kitchensQuery->get();
        $allowedKitchenIds = $kitchens->pluck('id')->toArray();

        if ($activeKitchenId !== 'all' && !in_array((int)$activeKitchenId, $allowedKitchenIds)) {
            $activeKitchenId = 'all';
        }

        $currentShift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest('opened_at')->first();

        if (!$currentShift || $kitchens->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'kitchens' => $kitchens,
                'activeKitchenId' => $activeKitchenId === 'all' ? 'all' : (int) $activeKitchenId,
                'initialItems' => [],
                'shiftActive' => $currentShift ? true : false
            ];
        }

        $query = OrderItem::with(['order:id,customer_name,type,table_number', 'modifiers'])
            ->where('status', 'active')
            ->whereNotIn('production_status', ['delivered', 'cancelled'])
            ->where('created_at', '>=', $currentShift->opened_at);

        if ($activeKitchenId !== 'all') {
            $query->where('kitchen_id', $activeKitchenId);
        } else {
            if ($settings && $settings->kds_access_mode === 'individual') {
                $query->whereIn('kitchen_id', $allowedKitchenIds);
            }
        }

        return [
            'kitchens' => $kitchens,
            'activeKitchenId' => $activeKitchenId === 'all' ? 'all' : (int) $activeKitchenId,
            'initialItems' => $query->orderBy('created_at', 'asc')->get(),
            'shiftActive' => true
        ];
    }

    public function getItems(string|int $activeKitchenId)
    {
        $boardData = $this->getBoardData($activeKitchenId);
        return $boardData['initialItems'] ?? [];
    }

    public function updateItemStatus(OrderItem $item, string $status): void
    {
        $updateData = ['production_status' => $status];

        if ($status === 'preparing') {
            $updateData['prepared_by_id'] = auth()->id();
        }

        $item->update($updateData);

        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Garante a passagem do Model Order completo
        $order = $item->order ?? \App\Models\Order::find($item->order_id);
        if ($order) {
            event(new \App\Events\OrderUpdated($order));
        }
    }

    public function cancelItemAndRefund(OrderItem $item, array $data): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($item, $data) {
            $order = $item->order;
            $itemTotal = $item->total_price;

            $order->subtotal -= $itemTotal;

            $serviceFeePercentage = $order->subtotal > 0 ? ($order->service_fee / ($order->subtotal + $itemTotal)) : 0;
            $order->service_fee = round($order->subtotal * $serviceFeePercentage, 2);

            $order->total = $order->subtotal + $order->delivery_fee + $order->service_fee - $order->discount;
            $order->save();

            $totalPaid = $order->payments()->sum('amount');
            if ($totalPaid > $order->total) {
                AccountPayable::create([
                    'supplier_name' => $order->customer_name ?? 'Cliente Avulso (Ped #' . $order->id . ')',
                    'description' => "Crédito de Cancelamento - Pedido #{$order->id} ({$item->product_name})",
                    'amount' => $itemTotal,
                    'due_date' => now()->toDateString(),
                    'status' => 'pending',
                    'accounting_category' => 'adm',
                    'observations' => 'Gerado automaticamente por um cancelamento na Cozinha (KDS) de um pedido já pago.',
                ]);
            }

            $item->update([
                'status' => 'cancelled',
                'production_status' => 'cancelled',
                'cancel_reason' => 'Cozinha: ' . $data['reason'],
            ]);

            if (!empty($data['block_sales']) && !empty($data['block_id'])) {
                if ($data['block_type'] === 'main') {
                    $product = Product::find($data['block_id']);
                    if ($product) {
                        $product->update(['status' => 'out_of_stock']);

                        if ($product->track_inventory) {
                            event(new \App\Events\StockLowDetected($product, 'critical'));
                        }
                    }
                } elseif ($data['block_type'] === 'modifier') {
                    $modifierOption = ModifierOption::find($data['block_id']);
                    if ($modifierOption) {
                        if ($modifierOption->linked_product_id) {
                            $product = Product::find($modifierOption->linked_product_id);
                            if ($product) {
                                $product->update(['status' => 'out_of_stock']);

                                if ($product->track_inventory) {
                                    event(new \App\Events\StockLowDetected($product, 'critical'));
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            $modifierOption->update(['is_active' => false]);
                            $tenant = tenant('id') ?? 'central';
                            broadcast(new \App\Events\CatalogUpdated($tenant));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Passando o Model Order em vez da string $tenant
            event(new \App\Events\OrderUpdated($order));
        });
    }

    public function registerLoss(OrderItem $item, array $data, int $userId): void
    {
        $product = null;

        if ($data['type'] === 'main') {
            $product = Product::find($data['target_id']);
        } else {
            $modifierOption = ModifierOption::find($data['target_id']);
            if ($modifierOption && $modifierOption->linked_product_id) {
                $product = Product::find($modifierOption->linked_product_id);
            }
        }

        if (!$product && $data['type'] === 'main') {
            $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
        }

        if ($product) {
            $this->inventoryService->registerLoss(
                $product,
                $data['quantity'],
                'Cozinha: ' . $data['reason'],
                $data['notes'] ?? null,
                $userId,
                $item->id
            );
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/RestaurantOps/KitchenDispatchService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\Kitchen;
use App\Models\Printer;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Services\Printing\PrintDispatcher;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\KitchenTicket;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class KitchenDispatchService
{
    /**
     * Despacha novos itens para produção (KDS e Impressoras Físicas).
     */
    public function dispatchNewItems(Order $order, string $printMode = 'station', bool $separateMultiples = false): void
    {
        // Busca apenas os itens "reais" (filhos do combo ou itens soltos), descartando os cabeçalhos pais
        $parentIds = OrderItem::where('order_id', $order->id)
            ->whereNotNull('parent_item_id')
            ->pluck('parent_item_id')
            ->unique()
            ->toArray();

        $newItems = OrderItem::with(['modifiers', 'product.category', 'kitchen.printer', 'product.kitchen'])
            ->where('order_id', $order->id)
            ->where('status', 'active')
            ->where('production_status', 'pending')
            ->whereNull('fired_at')
            ->whereNotIn('id', $parentIds)
            ->get();

        if ($newItems->isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        $now = now();
        $itemIds = $newItems->pluck('id')->all();

        OrderItem::whereIn('id', $itemIds)->update([
            'fired_at' => $now,
        ]);

        // Disparo único de impressão física (síncrono e confiável)
        try {
            $this->printPhysicalTickets($order, $newItems, $printMode, $separateMultiples);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error("❌ Erro ao disparar impressão de cozinha: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    protected function printPhysicalTickets(Order $order, Collection $items, string $printMode, bool $separateMultiples): void
    {
        $dispatcher = app(PrintDispatcher::class);
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

        // 🍸 REGRA DE NEGÓCIO: Suprime impressão de itens de bar/copa quando o pedido for de mesa
        if ($order->type === 'table' && (bool) ($settings?->suppress_bar_print_tables)) {
            $items = $items->reject(function ($item) {
                $kitchen = $item->kitchen ?? $item->product?->kitchen;

                if (!$kitchen && $item->kitchen_id) {
                    $kitchen = Kitchen::find($item->kitchen_id);
                }

                if ($kitchen) {
                    $type = strtolower((string) ($kitchen->type ?? ''));
                    $name = strtolower((string) ($kitchen->name ?? ''));

                    if ($type === 'bar' || str_contains($name, 'bar') || str_contains($name, 'copa')) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }

                if ($item->product?->production_station) {
                    $station = strtolower($item->product->production_station);
                    if (str_contains($station, 'bar') || str_contains($station, 'copa') || $station === 'bebidas') {
                        return true;
                    }
                }

                return false;
            });
        }

        if ($items->isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        // 📋 ORDENAÇÃO INTELIGENTE DE PRODUÇÃO
        // Agrupa por Categoria -> Nome do Produto -> ID do Item
        $items = $this->sortItemsForKitchenProduction($items);

        $actualPrintMode = $settings?->kitchen_print_mode ?? $printMode;
        $actualSeparateMultiples = (bool) ($settings?->kitchen_separate_multiples ?? $separateMultiples);

        $cashierPrinter = Printer::where('is_cashier', true)->where('is_active', true)->first()
            ?? Printer::where('is_active', true)->first();

        // 🚀 MODO UNIFICADO
        if ($actualPrintMode === 'unified') {
            $printer = Printer::where('is_active', true)->where('is_cashier', false)->first()
                    ?? $cashierPrinter;

            if ($printer) {
                $document = new KitchenTicket($order, $items, $actualPrintMode, $actualSeparateMultiples, false);
                $dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
            }
            return;
        }

        // 🚀 AGRUPAMENTO POR IMPRESSORA DE DESTINO
        $groupedByPrinter = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $targetPrinter = null;

            if ($item->kitchen?->printer && $item->kitchen->printer->is_active) {
                $targetPrinter = $item->kitchen->printer;
            } elseif ($item->kitchen_id) {
                $kitchen = Kitchen::with('printer')->find($item->kitchen_id);
                if ($kitchen?->printer && $kitchen->printer->is_active) {
                    $targetPrinter = $kitchen->printer;
                }
            }

            $targetPrinter = $targetPrinter ?? $cashierPrinter;

            if ($targetPrinter && $targetPrinter->is_active) {
                $printerId = $targetPrinter->id;
                if (!isset($groupedByPrinter[$printerId])) {
                    $groupedByPrinter[$printerId] = [
                        'printer' => $targetPrinter,
                        'items'   => collect(),
                    ];
                }
                $groupedByPrinter[$printerId]['items']->push($item);
            }
        }

        foreach ($groupedByPrinter as $group) {
            $printer = $group['printer'];
            $printerItems = $group['items'];

            if ($actualPrintMode === 'item') {
                foreach ($printerItems as $item) {
                    $copies = $actualSeparateMultiples ? (int) $item->quantity : 1;
                    $printItem = clone $item;

                    if ($actualSeparateMultiples) {
                        $printItem->quantity = 1;
                    }

                    for ($i = 0; $i < $copies; $i++) {
                        $document = new KitchenTicket($order, collect([$printItem]), 'item', $actualSeparateMultiples, false);
                        $dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $document = new KitchenTicket($order, $printerItems, $actualPrintMode, $actualSeparateMultiples, false);
                $dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Ordena itens por categoria e produto para facilitar a esteira de produção.
     */
    protected function sortItemsForKitchenProduction(Collection $items): Collection
    {
        return $items->sort(function ($a, $b) {
            $catA = $a->product?->category;
            $catB = $b->product?->category;

            // 1. Ordem numérica da categoria (se configurada)
            $orderA = $catA?->order ?? $catA?->sort_order ?? 999;
            $orderB = $catB?->order ?? $catB?->sort_order ?? 999;
            if ($orderA !== $orderB) {
                return $orderA <=> $orderB;
            }

            // 2. Nome da categoria alfabético
            $catNameA = $catA?->name ?? 'Geral';
            $catNameB = $catB?->name ?? 'Geral';
            $cmpCat = strcasecmp($catNameA, $catNameB);
            if ($cmpCat !== 0) {
                return $cmpCat;
            }

            // 3. Nome do produto alfabético (agrupa itens idênticos)
            $prodNameA = $a->product_name ?? $a->product?->name ?? '';
            $prodNameB = $b->product_name ?? $b->product?->name ?? '';
            $cmpProd = strcasecmp($prodNameA, $prodNameB);
            if ($cmpProd !== 0) {
                return $cmpProd;
            }

            // 4. Critério de desempate estável
            return $a->id <=> $b->id;
        })->values();
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/RestaurantOps/OperationalShiftClosureService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\PrintJob;
use App\Events\ShiftClosed;
use App\Events\StoreStatusUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class OperationalShiftClosureService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected WmsRestockService $wmsService
    ) {}

    public function closeShift(?int $shiftId = null, bool $closeStore = true): array
    {
        Log::info("🛑 [OperationalShiftClosure] Iniciando encerramento operacional do turno #" . ($shiftId ?? 'ativo') . "...");

        $results = [
            'store_closed'      => false,
            'wms_rules_synced'  => 0,
            'print_jobs_purged' => 0,
        ];

        $shift = $shiftId
            ? CashShift::find($shiftId)
            : CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest('opened_at')->first();

        // 🚀 ACÚMULO DE DÍVIDAS: Lança diárias não pagas no extrato (Ledger) dos colaboradores
        if ($shift) {
            try {
                $attendanceService = app(\App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftAttendanceService::class);
                
                $unpaidAttendees = $shift->attendees()
                    ->wherePivot('status', 'active')
                    ->wherePivot('attendance_status', 'present')
                    ->wherePivotNull('account_payable_id')
                    ->wherePivot('daily_rate', '>', 0)
                    ->get();

                foreach ($unpaidAttendees as $user) {
                    if (!$user->employee) continue;

                    // Evita duplicidade caso o turno seja reaberto e fechado novamente
                    $alreadyProcessed = $user->employee->ledgers()
                        ->where('description', 'like', "%Turno #{$shift->id}%")
                        ->where('type', 'credit')
                        ->exists();

                    if ($alreadyProcessed) continue;

                    $grossRate = (float) $user->pivot->daily_rate;
                    $latestLedger = $user->employee->ledgers()->latest('id')->first();
                    $balance = $latestLedger ? (float) $latestLedger->balance : 0.00;

                    // 1. Crédito da Diária (Acumulada)
                    $user->employee->ledgers()->create([
                        'type'        => 'credit',
                        'description' => "Diária de Trabalho (Turno #{$shift->id}) - Acumulada",
                        'amount'      => $grossRate,
                        'balance'     => $balance + $grossRate,
                    ]);
                    $balance += $grossRate;

                    // 2. Abatimento de Consumo Interno do Turno
                    $consumptionData = $attendanceService->getFreelancerShiftConsumption($user, $shift);
                    $consumptionAmount = (float) $consumptionData['total'];

                    if ($consumptionAmount > 0) {
                        $user->employee->ledgers()->create([
                            'type'        => 'debit',
                            'description' => "Abatimento de Consumo Interno (Turno #{$shift->id})",
                            'amount'      => $consumptionAmount,
                            'balance'     => $balance - $consumptionAmount,
                        ]);
                    }
                    
                    \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::info("💰 Diária do garçom {$user->name} (R$ {$grossRate}) acumulada no extrato.");
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::error("Erro ao acumular dívidas no fechamento do turno: " . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        // 1. GESTÃO DO STATUS DA LOJA NO APP DO CLIENTE
        if ($closeStore && $shift) {
            $shift->update([
                'accepting_orders' => false,
            ]);

            Cache::forget('store_availability_status');
            Cache::forget('customer_catalog_data');

            if (method_exists(CompanySetting::class, 'purgeCache')) {
                CompanySetting::purgeCache();
            }

            $tenantId = function_exists('tenant') && tenant() ? tenant('id') : 'central';
            if (class_exists(StoreStatusUpdated::class)) {
                broadcast(new StoreStatusUpdated($tenantId));
            }

            $results['store_closed'] = true;
            Log::info("🚪 [OperationalShiftClosure] Loja fechada no app do cliente.");
        }

        // 2. CONSOLIDAÇÃO DO WMS (Baixa de Prateleira por Consumo)
        try {
            $affected = $this->wmsService->syncPendingConsumptionToShelf($shift?->id);
            $results['wms_rules_synced'] = $affected;
            Log::info("📦 [OperationalShiftClosure] Consumo de prateleira consolidado ({$affected} regras).");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [OperationalShiftClosure] Falha ao sincronizar WMS: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        // 🚀 3. EXPURGO DO SPOOLER DE IMPRESSÃO (Remove impressões antigas do turno que fechou)
        try {
            $purged = PrintJob::where('created_at', '<=', now())->delete();
            $results['print_jobs_purged'] = $purged;
            Log::info("🖨️ [OperationalShiftClosure] Spooler limpo ({$purged} trabalhos de impressão removidos).");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [OperationalShiftClosure] Falha ao limpar spooler de impressão: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        // 🚀 4. AVISO EM TEMPO REAL PARA LIMPEZA DE RASCUNHOS NOS APPS
        if ($shift) {
            $tenantId = function_exists('tenant') && tenant() ? tenant('id') : null;
            broadcast(new \App\Events\ShiftClosed($shift));
        }

        Log::info("🏁 [OperationalShiftClosure] Turno finalizado com sucesso.", $results);

        return $results;
    }
}
```
