```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use App\Notifications\OrderReadyForDeliveryNotification;
use App\Services\Customers\CustomerMappingService;
use App\Services\Orders\ComboProrationHelper;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class OperationsDashboardService
{
    public function __construct(protected CustomerMappingService $customerMapper) {}

    public function getActiveOrdersDashboard(): array
    {
        $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest('opened_at')->first();
        $shiftStart = $shift ? $shift->opened_at : now()->startOfDay();

        $orders = Order::with([
                    "items.modifiers", "items.subItems.modifiers", "items.product.category",
                    "items.kitchen", "items.product.kitchen",
                    "customer.addresses.street", "customer.addresses.neighborhood",
                    "addressModel.street", "addressModel.neighborhood",
                    "payments.items.modifiers",
                    "fiscalDocument",
                    "diningTable"
                ])
                ->where(function ($query) use ($shiftStart) {
                    $query->whereNotIn("status", ["closed", "cancelled"])
                            ->orWhere(function ($subQuery) use ($shiftStart) {
                                $subQuery->whereIn("status", ["closed", "cancelled"])
                                        ->where('updated_at', '>=', $shiftStart);
                            });
                })
                ->orderBy("created_at", "asc")
                ->get();

        $mappedOrders = $orders->map(function ($order) {
            $fullAddress = null;
            $neighborhoodName = null;

            if ($order->type === "delivery" && ($order->address_id || $order->address || $order->address_snapshot)) {
                $addr = $order->address_snapshot ?? $order->address ?? $order->getRelationValue('address') ?? $order->addressModel;

                if (is_array($addr)) {
                    $neighborhoodName = is_array($addr['neighborhood'] ?? null)
                        ? ($addr['neighborhood']['name'] ?? null)
                        : ($addr['neighborhood'] ?? null);

                    $streetName = is_array($addr['street'] ?? null)
                        ? ($addr['street']['name'] ?? null)
                        : ($addr['street'] ?? null);

                    $number = !empty($addr['no_number']) ? 'S/N' : ($addr['number'] ?? '');
                    $complement = !empty($addr['complement']) ? "({$addr['complement']})" : '';

                    $fullAddress = $addr['full_address'] ?? trim("{$streetName}, {$number} - {$neighborhoodName} {$complement}");
                } elseif (is_object($addr)) {
                    $neighborhoodName = $addr->neighborhood->name ?? ($addr->neighborhood ?? null);
                    $streetName = $addr->street->name ?? ($addr->street ?? null);
                    $number = $addr->no_number ? 'S/N' : ($addr->number ?? '');
                    $complement = $addr->complement ? "({$addr->complement})" : '';

                    $fullAddress = $addr->full_address ?? trim("{$streetName}, {$number} - {$neighborhoodName} {$complement}");
                }
            }

            $deliveryMethods = is_string($order->payment_intent_methods)
                ? json_decode($order->payment_intent_methods, true)
                : $order->payment_intent_methods;

            if (empty($deliveryMethods) && $order->payments->isNotEmpty()) {
                $deliveryMethods = $order->payments->map(fn($p) => [
                    'method_id'   => $p->payment_method_id,
                    'method_name' => $p->method,
                    'amount'      => (float) $p->amount,
                    'change_target' => (float) $order->delivery_change_target,
                ])->toArray();
            }

            // 🚀 Rateio proporcional para combos
            $comboParents = $order->items->filter(fn($i) => !$i->parent_item_id && $order->items->contains('parent_item_id', $i->id));
            $orderProrations = [];
            foreach ($comboParents as $parent) {
                $children = $order->items->filter(fn($i) => $i->parent_item_id === $parent->id);
                $orderProrations += ComboProrationHelper::calculateProration($parent, $children, $order->type);
            }

            return [
                "id"                    => $order->id,
                "driver_id"             => $order->driver_id,
                "customer_name"         => $order->customer_name,
                "customer_id"           => $order->customer_id,
                "customer"              => $this->customerMapper->mapOrderCustomer($order->customer),
                "dining_table_id"       => $order->dining_table_id,
                "table_number"          => $order->table_number,
                "type"                  => $order->type,
                "status"                => $order->status,
                "payment_status"        => $order->payment_status,
                "payment_intent_status" => $order->payment_intent_status,
                "payment_intent_methods"=> $deliveryMethods,
                "payments"              => $order->payments->map(fn($p) => [
                    "id"                => $p->id,
                    "payment_method_id" => $p->payment_method_id,
                    "method"            => $p->method,
                    "amount"            => (float) $p->amount,
                    "is_paid"           => (bool) $p->is_paid,
                    "created_at"        => $p->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                    "items"             => $p->items->map(function ($pi) use ($p) {
                        $pivotAmount = (float) $pi->pivot->amount;
                        $resolvedAmount = $pivotAmount > 0
                            ? $pivotAmount
                            : ($p->items->count() === 1 ? (float) $p->amount : (float) $pi->total_price);

                        return [
                            "id"           => $pi->id,
                            "name"         => $pi->product_name,
                            "product_name" => $pi->product_name,
                            "quantity"     => (float) $pi->pivot->quantity,
                            "total_amount" => $resolvedAmount,
                            "notes"        => $pi->notes,
                            "modifiers"    => $pi->modifiers->map(fn($m) => [
                                "id"       => $m->modifier_option_id,
                                "name"     => $m->name,
                                "qty"      => (float) $m->quantity,
                                "price"    => (float) $m->price
                            ])->values()->all(),
                            "pivot"        => [
                                "quantity" => (float) $pi->pivot->quantity,
                                "amount"   => $resolvedAmount,
                            ]
                        ];
                    })->values()->all(),
                ])->values(),
                "payment_method_name"   => !empty($deliveryMethods) ? ($deliveryMethods[0]['method_name'] ?? null) : ($order->payments->first()?->method ?? null),
                "total"                 => (float) $order->total,
                "created_at"            => $order->created_at ? $order->created_at->toISOString() : null,
                "time"                  => $order->created_at ? $order->created_at->format("H:i") : null,
                "minutes_active"        => $order->created_at ? $order->created_at->diffInMinutes(now()) : 0,
                "address"               => $fullAddress,
                "neighborhood"          => $neighborhoodName,
                "phone"                 => $order->customer_phone ?? $order->customer?->phone ?? null,
                "items"                 => $order->items->map(function ($i) use ($orderProrations) {
                    $isChild = (bool) $i->parent_item_id;
                    $prorationData = $isChild ? ($orderProrations[$i->id] ?? null) : null;
                    $catalogPrice = $prorationData ? $prorationData['catalog_unit_price'] : (float) $i->unit_price;
                    $allocatedUnitPrice = $prorationData ? $prorationData['prorated_unit_price'] : (float) $i->unit_price;

                    return [
                        "id"                   => $i->id,
                        "parent_item_id"       => $i->parent_item_id,
                        "product_id"           => $i->product_id,
                        "name"                 => $i->product_name,
                        "quantity"             => (float) $i->quantity,
                        "paid_qty"             => (float) ($i->paid_qty ?? 0),
                        "unit_price"           => (float) $i->unit_price,
                        "total_price"          => (float) $i->total_price,
                        "catalog_price"        => $catalogPrice,
                        "allocated_unit_price" => $allocatedUnitPrice,
                        "effective_unit_price" => $allocatedUnitPrice,
                        "status"               => $i->status,
                        "production_status"    => $i->production_status ?? $i->status,
                        "category_name"        => $i->product?->category?->name ?? null,
                        "kitchen_type"         => $i->kitchen?->type ?? $i->product?->kitchen?->type ?? null,
                        "operator_id"          => $i->operator_id ?? $i->prepared_by_id ?? null,
                        "operator_name"        => $i->operator?->name ?? $i->preparedBy?->name ?? null,
                        "created_at"           => $i->created_at ? $i->created_at->toISOString() : null,
                        "fired_at"             => $i->fired_at ? $i->fired_at->toISOString() : null,
                        "is_combo_item"        => $i->is_combo_item,
                        "modifiers"            => $i->modifiers->map(fn($m) => [
                            "id"               => $m->modifier_option_id,
                            "name"             => $m->name,
                            "qty"              => (float) $m->quantity,
                            "price"            => (float) $m->price
                        ])->values(),
                    ];
                })->values(),
            ];
        });

        return ["initialOrders" => $mappedOrders];
    }

    public function updateOrderStatus(Order $order, mixed $statusOrData, bool $stampIntermediates = false): Order
    {
        $newStatus = is_array($statusOrData) ? ($statusOrData['status'] ?? $order->status) : $statusOrData;
        $stamp = is_array($statusOrData) ? ($statusOrData['stamp_intermediates'] ?? $stampIntermediates) : $stampIntermediates;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $newStatus, $stamp) {
            $order->status = $newStatus;

            if ($newStatus === 'preparing' || ($stamp && in_array($newStatus, ['ready', 'dispatched']))) {
                if (!$order->started_preparing_at) {
                    $order->started_preparing_at = now();
                }
                $order->items()->where('production_status', 'pending')->update(['production_status' => 'preparing']);
            }

            if ($newStatus === 'ready') {
                if (true) {
                    $order->ready_at = now();
                }
                $order->items()->whereIn('production_status', ['pending', 'preparing'])->update(['production_status' => 'ready']);

                // 🛵 DISPARO PUSH: Notifica todos os motoboys que há entrega pronta no balcão
                if ($order->type === 'delivery') {
                    try {
                        $drivers = User::whereHas('roles', fn($q) => $q->whereIn('name', ['driver', 'motoboy', 'entregador']))->get();
                        if ($drivers->isNotEmpty()) {
                            Notification::send($drivers, new OrderReadyForDeliveryNotification($order));
                        }
                    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                        Log::warning("⚠️ [WebPush] Falha ao notificar motoboys sobre pedido #{$order->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
                    }
                }
            }

            if ($newStatus === 'dispatched') {
                if (true) {
                    $order->dispatched_at = now();
                }
            }

            if (in_array($newStatus, ['closed', 'completed'])) {
                if (true) {
                    $order->closed_at = now();
                }
            }

            $order->save();

            broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh()));

            return $order;
        });
    }

    public function getManagerShiftSummary(?User $user): ?array
    {
        if (!$user || !$user->hasAnyRole(['admin', 'gerente', 'manager'])) return null;

        $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest('opened_at')->first();
        if (!$shift) return null;

        $closedOrders = Order::where('created_at', '>=', $shift->opened_at)->where('status', 'closed')->get();
        $revenue = $closedOrders->sum('total');
        $count = $closedOrders->count();

        return [
            'revenue'       => $revenue,
            'order_count'   => $count,
            'avg_ticket'    => $count > 0 ? $revenue / $count : 0,
            'by_type'       => [
                'delivery'  => $closedOrders->where('type', 'delivery')->sum('total'),
                'table'     => $closedOrders->where('type', 'table')->sum('total'),
                'counter'   => $closedOrders->where('type', 'counter')->sum('total'),
            ],
            'shift_start'   => $shift->opened_at->format('H:i'),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Services\Customers\CustomerMappingService;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\DiningTable;
use App\Models\TableArea;
use App\Models\Street;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class OperationsMenuService
{
    protected CustomerMappingService $customerMapper;

    public function __construct(CustomerMappingService $customerMapper)
    {
        $this->customerMapper = $customerMapper;
    }

    public function getOrderEntryData(Request $request): array
    {
        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Injetado latestCostHistory
        $products = Product::whereIn("type", ["dish", "combo", "resale"])
            ->whereIn("status", ["available", "out_of_stock", "paused", "active"])
            ->where("show_on_menu", true)
            ->with(["modifiers.options", "comboGroups.items.product", "latestCostHistory"])
            ->get();

        $categories = Category::where("type", "external")
            ->whereNotIn("status", ["archived", "arquivado"])
            ->select("id", "name", "parent_id", "image_path", "sort_order", "status")
            ->orderBy("sort_order", "asc")
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($category) {
                $category->image_url = $category->image_path ? url("/media/file?path=" . $category->image_path) : null;
                return $category;
            });

        $categoryTree = Category::where(function ($q) {
                $q->whereNull('parent_id')->orWhere('parent_id', 0);
            })
            ->where("type", "external")
            ->whereNotIn("status", ["archived", "arquivado"])
            ->with([
                'children' => fn($q) => $q->where('type', 'external')->whereNotIn('status', ['archived', 'arquivado'])->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc'),
                'children.children' => fn($q) => $q->where('type', 'external')->whereNotIn('status', ['archived', 'arquivado'])->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc'),
                'children.children.children' => fn($q) => $q->where('type', 'external')->whereNotIn('status', ['archived', 'arquivado'])->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc'),
                'children.children.children.children' => fn($q) => $q->where('type', 'external')->whereNotIn('status', ['archived', 'arquivado'])->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc'),
            ])
            ->orderBy("sort_order", "asc")
            ->get();

        $validExternalCategoryIds = $categories->pluck("id")->toArray();

        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Injetado latestCostHistory
        $categoryProductsCache = Product::whereNotNull('category_id')
            ->whereIn("type", ["dish", "resale", "manufactured"])
            ->whereIn("status", ["available", "out_of_stock", "paused", "active"])
            ->where("show_on_menu", true)
            ->with("latestCostHistory")
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('category_id');

        $mappedProducts = $products
            ->filter(fn($product) => in_array($product->category_id, $validExternalCategoryIds))
            ->map(function ($product) use ($categoryProductsCache) {
                return $this->mapProductData($product, false, $categoryProductsCache);
            })->values();

        $tableAreas = $this->getTableAreas();
        $customers = $this->customerMapper->getAllForPos();
        $editOrderData = null;

        if ($request->has("append_to_order")) {
            $editOrderData = Order::with(["customer", "addressModel", "items.modifiers", "diningTable"])
                                  ->find($request->input("append_to_order"));
        }

        $withRelations = [];
        if (method_exists(Street::class, 'neighborhood')) {
            $withRelations[] = 'neighborhood';
        }
        if (method_exists(Street::class, 'segments')) {
            $withRelations[] = 'segments.neighborhood';
        }

        $streetQuery = Street::with($withRelations);
        if (true) {
            $streetQuery->where('is_active', true);
        }
        $streets = $streetQuery->orderBy('name')->get();

        return [
            "operatorName"      => auth()->user()->name ?? "Operador Caixa",
            "initialCategories" => $categories,
            "categoryTree"      => $categoryTree,
            "initialProducts"   => $mappedProducts,
            "initialTableAreas" => $tableAreas,
            "initialCustomers"  => $customers,
            "initialStreets"    => $streets,
            "streets"           => $streets,
            "editOrderData"     => $editOrderData,
        ];
    }

    public function getTerminalData(Request $request): array
    {
        $categories = Category::where("type", "!=", "internal")
            ->whereNotIn("status", ["archived", "arquivado"])
            ->select("id", "name", "parent_id", "image_path", "sort_order", "status")
            ->orderBy("sort_order", "asc")
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($category) {
                $category->image_url = $category->image_path ? url("/media/file?path=" . $category->image_path) : null;
                return $category;
            });

        $tableAreas = $this->getTableAreas();

        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Injetado latestCostHistory
        $categoryProductsCache = Product::whereNotNull('category_id')
            ->whereIn("type", ["dish", "resale", "manufactured"])
            ->whereIn("status", ["available", "out_of_stock", "paused", "active"])
            ->where("show_on_menu", true)
            ->with("latestCostHistory")
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('category_id');

        // 🚀 OTIMIZAÇÃO: Injetado latestCostHistory
        $products = Product::with(["modifiers.options", "comboGroups.items.product", "latestCostHistory"])
            ->whereIn("type", ["resale", "recipe", "combo", "manufactured"])
            ->whereIn("status", ["available", "out_of_stock", "paused"])
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($product) use ($categoryProductsCache) {
                return $this->mapProductData($product, true, $categoryProductsCache);
            });

        return [
            "operatorName"      => auth()->user()->name ?? "Cliente",
            "initialCategories" => $categories,
            "initialProducts"   => $products,
            "initialTableAreas" => $tableAreas,
        ];
    }

    public function getTableAreas()
    {
        return TableArea::with([
            'diningTables.activeOrders' => function ($query) {
                $query->select('id', 'dining_table_id', 'table_number', 'customer_name as identifier');
            },
            'diningTables.linkedTables.activeOrders' => function ($query) {
                $query->select('id', 'dining_table_id', 'table_number', 'customer_name as identifier');
            }
        ])
        ->select("id", "name")
        ->get()
        ->map(function ($area) {
            return [
                "id"   => $area->id,
                "name" => $area->name,
                "tables" => $area->diningTables->map(function ($table) {
                    // Agrega pedidos próprios com os pedidos das mesas filhas agrupadas
                    $allOrders = collect($table->activeOrders);

                    if ($table->relationLoaded('linkedTables') && $table->linkedTables->isNotEmpty()) {
                        $childOrders = $table->linkedTables->flatMap(fn ($child) => $child->activeOrders);
                        $allOrders = $allOrders->merge($childOrders);
                    }

                    $isOccupied = $allOrders->isNotEmpty();

                    return [
                        "id"              => $table->id,
                        "name"            => $table->name,
                        "status"          => $isOccupied ? 'occupied' : ($table->status === 'free' ? 'available' : ($table->status ?? 'available')),
                        "parent_table_id" => $table->parent_table_id ?? null,
                        "linked_tables"   => $table->relationLoaded('linkedTables')
                            ? $table->linkedTables->map(fn ($lt) => ['id' => $lt->id, 'name' => $lt->name])->toArray()
                            : [],
                        "active_orders"   => $allOrders->values()->toArray(),
                    ];
                })->toArray(),
            ];
        });
    }

    private function mapProductData($product, $isTerminal, $categoryProductsCache)
    {
        $price = $isTerminal && $product->promo_price > 0 ? $product->promo_price : $product->dine_in_price;

        return [
            "id"             => $product->id,
            "category_id"    => $product->category_id,
            "name"           => $product->name,
            "description"    => $product->description,
            "type"           => $product->type,
            "status"         => $product->status,
            "price"          => (float) $price,
            "delivery_price" => (float) ($product->delivery_price > 0 ? $product->delivery_price : $product->dine_in_price),
            "image"          => $product->image_path ? url("/media/file?path=" . $product->image_path) : null,
            "is_grab_and_go" => !(bool) $product->requires_preparation,
            "track_inventory"=> (bool) $product->track_inventory,
            "current_stock"  => (float) $product->current_stock,
            "modifiers"      => $product->modifiers->map(function ($group) {
                $excluded = json_decode($group->pivot->excluded_options ?? '[]', true) ?? [];
                return [
                    "id"                     => $group->id,
                    "name"                   => $group->display_name ?? $group->name,
                    "type"                   => $group->type,
                    "pricing_strategy"       => $group->pricing_strategy,
                    "display_order_strategy" => $group->display_order_strategy,
                    "min_selections"         => $group->min_selections,
                    "max_selections"         => $group->max_selections,
                    "max_free"               => $group->max_free,
                    "increment"              => $group->increment,
                    "allow_quantity"         => $group->allow_quantity,
                    "options"                => $group->options
                        ->filter(fn($opt) => !in_array($opt->id, $excluded))
                        ->map(function ($opt) {
                            return [
                                "id"                => $opt->id,
                                "name"              => $opt->name,
                                "price"             => (float) $opt->price,
                                "sort_order"        => $opt->sort_order ?? 0,
                                "historical_weight" => (int) ($opt->historical_weight ?? 0),
                                "is_active"         => (bool) ($opt->is_active ?? true),
                            ];
                        })->values(),
                ];
            }),
            "combo_groups"   => $product->comboGroups->map(function ($group) use ($isTerminal, $categoryProductsCache) {
                return [
                    "id"          => $group->id,
                    "name"        => $group->name,
                    "min_choices" => $group->min_choices,
                    "max_choices" => $group->max_choices,
                    "items"       => $group->items->flatMap(function ($item) use ($isTerminal, $categoryProductsCache) {
                        if ($item->category_id && !$isTerminal) {
                            $categoryProducts = $categoryProductsCache->get($item->category_id, collect());

                            return $categoryProducts->map(function ($catProduct) use ($item) {
                                return [
                                    "id"               => "cat_" . $item->id . "_prod_" . $catProduct->id,
                                    "product_id"       => $catProduct->id,
                                    "category_id"      => $item->category_id,
                                    "product_name"     => $catProduct->name,
                                    "additional_price" => (float) $item->additional_price,
                                    "status"           => $catProduct->status,
                                ];
                            });
                        }
                        return [[
                            "id"               => (string) $item->id,
                            "product_id"       => $item->product_id,
                            "category_id"      => null,
                            "product_name"     => $item->product->name ?? "Item Desconhecido",
                            "additional_price" => (float) $item->additional_price,
                            "status"           => $item->product->status ?? 'available',
                        ]];
                    })->values(),
                ];
            }),
        ];
    }
```

## File: app/Services/RestaurantOps/PosSecurityService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\PosAudit;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Exception;

class PosSecurityService
{
    public function validateAndLog(string $action, ?string $pin, ?string $reason, array $context = []): User
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $mode = $settings->pos_security_mode ?? 'standard';
        $customActions = $settings->pos_secure_actions ?? [];

        $requiresAuth = false;

        if ($mode === 'strict') {
            $requiresAuth = true;
        } elseif ($mode === 'standard') {
            $requiresAuth = in_array($action, ['cancel_item', 'cancel_order', 'apply_discount', 'cash_out', 'close_shift_override']);
        } elseif ($mode === 'custom') {
            $requiresAuth = in_array($action, $customActions);
        }

        $operator = Auth::user();
        $authorizer = $operator;

        if ($requiresAuth) {
            if (empty($pin)) {
                throw new Exception("Esta ação exige a senha (PIN) de um gestor.");
            }

            // 🚀 1. Busca imediata O(1) para PINs legados em texto puro
            $authorizer = User::where('pin', $pin)->where('is_active', true)->first();

            // 🚀 2. Se não achou, filtra apenas os usuários que usam Hash bcrypt ($2y$) e faz o check
            if (!$authorizer) {
                $hashedUsers = User::whereNotNull('pin')
                    ->where('is_active', true)
                    ->where('pin', 'like', '$2y$%')
                    ->get();

                $authorizer = $hashedUsers->first(function ($user) use ($pin) {
                    return Hash::check($pin, $user->pin);
                });
            }

            if (!$authorizer) {
                throw new Exception("PIN inválido ou não encontrado.");
            }

            $isAuthorized = $authorizer->hasAnyRole(['admin', 'manager', 'gerente']);

            if (!$isAuthorized) {
                try {
                    $isAuthorized = $authorizer->can('pos.authorize_operations') 
                        || $authorizer->can('pos.autorizar_operacoes');
                } catch (\Throwable) {
                    $isAuthorized = false;
                }
            }

            if (!$isAuthorized) {
                throw new Exception("A sua senha está correta, mas você não tem permissão para autorizar esta operação.");
            }
        }

        PosAudit::create([
            'action' => $action,
            'operator_id' => $operator->id ?? null,
            'authorizer_id' => $authorizer->id ?? null,
            'reason' => $reason,
            'context' => $context,
        ]);

        return $authorizer;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Events\CatalogUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class PosSettingsService
{
    public function getSettingsData(): array
    {
    $categories = \App\Models\Category::whereNull('parent_id')
        ->where('type', 'external')
        ->with([
            'children' => fn($q) => $q->where('type', 'external')->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc'),
            'children.children' => fn($q) => $q->where('type', 'external')->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc'),
            'children.children.children' => fn($q) => $q->where('type', 'external')->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc'),
            'children.children.children.children' => fn($q) => $q->where('type', 'external')->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc'),
        ])
        ->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc')
        ->get();

    return [
        'categories' => $categories];
    }

    public function reorderItems(string $type, array $items): void
    {
        if ($type === 'categories') {
            \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::transaction(function () use ($items) {
                $this->saveCategoryTree($items, null);
            });

            // Transmite o evento para atualizar os WebSockets/KDS se necessário
            $tenant = tenant('id') ?? 'central';
            broadcast(new \App\Events\CatalogUpdated($tenant));
        }
    }

    private function saveCategoryTree(array $nodes, ?int $parentId = null): void
    {
    foreach ($nodes as $index => $node) {
        if (!isset($node['id'])) continue;

        // 🚀 SONDA LARAVEL 2: O que ele vai gravar no banco?
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::info("💾 GRAVANDO NÓ ID: {$node['id']} | Ordem: {$index} | Pai: " . ($parentId ?? 'NULL'));

        \App\Models\Category::where('id', $node['id'])->update([
            'sort_order' => $index,
            'parent_id'  => $parentId,
        ]);

        if (!empty($node['children']) && is_array($node['children'])) {
            $this->saveCategoryTree($node['children'], (int) $node['id']);
        }
    }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\ProductionOrder;
use App\Events\CatalogUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ProductionService
{
    /**
     * Finaliza a ordem de produção, injeta no estoque e notifica os terminais.
     */
    public function finishOrder(int $orderId, float $actualQty): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($orderId, $actualQty) {
            $order = ProductionOrder::with('product')->findOrFail($orderId);

            $order->update([
                'status'     => 'completed',
                'actual_qty' => $actualQty
            ]);

            $product = $order->product;

            if ($product && $product->track_inventory) {
                $product->increment('current_stock', $actualQty);

                if ($product->status === 'out_of_stock' && $product->current_stock > 0) {
                    $product->update(['status' => 'available']);

                    $tenant = function_exists('tenant') && tenant('id') ? tenant('id') : 'central';
                    broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenant));
                }
            }
        });
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $orderId, string $status): void
    {
        $order = ProductionOrder::findOrFail($orderId);
        $order->update(['status' => $status]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Enums\EmploymentType;
use App\Enums\PaymentCycle;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\BankAccount;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\Printer;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\FreelancerReceipt;
use App\Services\Printing\PrintDispatcher;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ShiftAttendanceService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected PrintDispatcher $printDispatcher
    ) {}

    public function getShiftUsersData(): array
    {
        $hojeInt = now()->dayOfWeek;
        $mapaDias = [
            0 => 'dom', 1 => 'seg', 2 => 'ter', 3 => 'qua',
            4 => 'qui', 5 => 'sex', 6 => 'sab'
        ];
        $hojeString = $mapaDias[$hojeInt];

        $roleMap = [
            'admin' => 'Administrador', 'manager' => 'Gerente',
            'pos' => 'Caixa', 'waiter' => 'Garçom',
            'driver' => 'Motoboy', 'kitchen' => 'Cozinha'
        ];

        return User::with(['employee', 'roles'])
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->whereHas('employee', function ($query) {
                $query->where('is_active', true);
            })
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($u) use ($hojeString, $roleMap) {
                $emp = $u->employee;
                $isScheduled = false;
                $dailyRate = 0;
                $isFreelancer = false;

                if ($emp) {
                    $dailyRate = (float) ($emp->base_remuneration ?? 0);

                    $isFreelancer = in_array($emp->employment_type, [
                        EmploymentType::FREELANCE_FIXED,
                        EmploymentType::FREELANCER,
                    ], true);

                    if (!empty($emp->work_days)) {
                        $workDays = is_string($emp->work_days) ? json_decode($emp->work_days, true) : $emp->work_days;
                        $isScheduled = is_array($workDays) && in_array($hojeString, $workDays);
                    }
                }

                $availableRoles = $u->roles->map(function ($role) use ($roleMap) {
                    return [
                        'value' => $role->name,
                        'label' => $roleMap[$role->name] ?? ucfirst($role->name)
                    ];
                })->toArray();

                if (empty($availableRoles)) {
                    $availableRoles = [['value' => 'waiter', 'label' => 'Garçom']];
                }

                return [
                    'id'              => $u->id,
                    'user_id'         => $u->id,
                    'name'            => $u->name,
                    'available_roles' => $availableRoles,
                    'employment_type' => $isFreelancer ? 'freelancer' : 'clt',
                    'is_scheduled'    => $isScheduled,
                    'default_rate'    => $dailyRate,
                    'daily_rate'      => $dailyRate,
                ];
            })
            ->sortBy('name')
            ->values()
            ->toArray();
    }

    public function getCurrentAttendees(?CashShift $currentShift): array
    {
        if (!$currentShift) return [];

        return $currentShift->attendees->map(function($a) {
            return [
                'user_id'            => $a->id,
                'status'             => $a->pivot->status,
                'attendance_status'  => $a->pivot->attendance_status,
                'daily_rate'         => (float) ($a->pivot->daily_rate ?? 0),
                'account_payable_id' => $a->pivot->account_payable_id,
                'assigned_role'      => $a->pivot->assigned_role ?? null
            ];
        })->toArray();
    }

    public function syncShiftAttendees(array $attendees, ?CashShift $shift = null): void
    {
        $shift = $shift ?? CashShift::current();
        if (!$shift) return;

        $currentAttendees = $shift->attendees()->get()->keyBy('id');

        $syncData = [];
        foreach ($attendees as $att) {
            $userId = $att['user_id'] ?? $att['id'] ?? null;
            if (!$userId) continue;

            $existing = $currentAttendees->get($userId);

            $dailyRate = (float) (
                $att['daily_rate']
                ?? $att['daily.rate']
                ?? $att['dailyRate']
                ?? $att['default_rate']
                ?? data_get($att, 'daily.rate')
                ?? ($existing ? $existing->pivot->daily_rate : 0)
            );

            $syncData[$userId] = [
                'checked_in_at'     => $existing ? $existing->pivot->checked_in_at : now(),
                'status'            => 'active',
                'attendance_status' => $att['attendance_status'] ?? $att['status'] ?? 'present',
                'daily_rate'        => $dailyRate,
                'assigned_role'     => $att['assigned_role'] ?? ($existing ? $existing->pivot->assigned_role : null)
            ];
        }

        if (!isset($syncData[$shift->opened_by])) {
            $existingManager = $currentAttendees->get($shift->opened_by);
            $syncData[$shift->opened_by] = [
                'checked_in_at'     => $existingManager ? $existingManager->pivot->checked_in_at : $shift->opened_at,
                'status'            => 'active',
                'attendance_status' => 'present',
                'daily_rate'        => $existingManager ? (float) ($existingManager->pivot->daily_rate ?? 0) : 0,
                'assigned_role'     => $existingManager ? ($existingManager->pivot->assigned_role ?? 'manager') : 'manager'
            ];
        }

        $shift->attendees()->syncWithoutDetaching($syncData);

        $receivedUserIds = array_keys($syncData);
        $missingIds = $currentAttendees->keys()->diff($receivedUserIds);

        if ($missingIds->isNotEmpty()) {
            foreach ($missingIds as $missingId) {
                $shift->attendees()->updateExistingPivot($missingId, [
                    'status'         => 'inactive',
                    'checked_out_at' => now()
                ]);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 PONTE DE CONSUMO: Calcula o consumo do colaborador durante o turno aberto
     */
    public function getFreelancerShiftConsumption(User $user, CashShift $shift): array
    {
        $employee = $user->employee;
        $shiftStart = $shift->opened_at;

        // 1. Localiza o cliente vinculado ao usuário ou colaborador
        $customer = $user->customer;
        if (!$customer && $employee) {
            $customer = \App\Models\Customer::where('phone', $employee->phone)
                ->orWhere('cpf', $employee->cpf)
                ->first();
        }

        // 2. Busca pedidos com consumo interno ou vinculados ao perfil
        $orders = Order::where('created_at', '>=', $shiftStart)
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled'])
            ->where(function ($q) use ($user, $customer) {
                $q->where(function ($sub) use ($user) {
                    $sub->where('employee_id', $user->id)
                        ->where(function ($w) {
                            $w->where('customer_name', 'like', '%Consumo Interno%')
                              ->orWhere('payment_intent_status', 'internal')
                              ->orWhere('payment_intent_methods', 'like', '%internal%');
                        });
                });

                if ($customer) {
                    $q->orWhere('customer_id', $customer->id);
                }
            })
            ->get();

        $ordersTotal = (float) $orders->sum('total');

        // 3. Débitos avulsos na conta corrente durante o turno
        $ledgerDebits = 0.0;
        if ($employee) {
            $ledgerDebits = (float) $employee->ledgers()
                ->where('created_at', '>=', $shiftStart)
                ->where('type', 'debit')
                ->where('description', 'like', '%Consumo%')
                ->sum('amount');
        }

        $totalConsumption = round($ordersTotal + $ledgerDebits, 2);

        return [
            'total'          => $totalConsumption,
            'orders_count'   => $orders->count(),
            'orders'         => $orders->map(fn($o) => [
                'id'    => $o->id,
                'total' => (float) $o->total,
                'time'  => $o->created_at->format('H:i')
            ])->toArray(),
            'ledger_debits'  => $ledgerDebits,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a radiografia financeira completa para o modal de liquidação
     */
    public function getFreelancerPayoutDetails(int $userId, ?CashShift $shift = null): array
    {
        $shift = $shift ?? CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();
        if (!$shift) {
            throw new \Exception('Nenhum turno aberto.');
        }

        $user = User::with('employee')->findOrFail($userId);
        $employee = $user->employee;

        $attendeePivot = $shift->attendees()->where('users.id', $userId)->first()?->pivot;
        $grossRate = (float) ($attendeePivot?->daily_rate ?: ($employee?->base_remuneration ?? 0));

        $consumptionData = $this->getFreelancerShiftConsumption($user, $shift);
        $consumptionAmount = (float) $consumptionData['total'];

        $netAmount = max(0, round($grossRate - $consumptionAmount, 2));

        $latestLedger = $employee?->ledgers()->latest('id')->first();
        $previousBalance = $latestLedger ? (float) $latestLedger->balance : 0.00;
        $totalDue = round($previousBalance + $netAmount, 2);

        return [
            'user' => [
                'id'           => $user->id,
                'name'         => $user->name,
                'pix_key_type' => $employee?->pix_key_type,
                'pix_key'      => $employee?->pix_key,
            ],
            'previous_balance'    => $previousBalance,
            'ledger_history'      => $employee ? $employee->ledgers()->latest('id')->take(30)->get()->toArray() : [],
            'gross_rate'          => $grossRate,
            'consumption_amount'  => $consumptionAmount,
            'consumption_details' => $consumptionData,
            'net_amount'          => $netAmount, // Líquido SÓ de hoje
            'total_due'           => $totalDue,  // Saldo + Hoje
            'is_paid'             => (bool) ($attendeePivot?->account_payable_id),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 Liquidação oficial do freelancer com saída bancária/caixa, extrato de RH e impressão
     */
    public function payFreelancer(array $data, User $operator): void
    {
        $user = User::with('employee')->findOrFail($data['user_id']);
        $employee = $user->employee;

        if (!$employee) {
            throw new \Exception('O colaborador não tem um perfil de RH vinculado.');
        }

        $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();
        if (!$shift) {
            throw new \Exception('Não existe nenhum turno aberto para registrar o pagamento.');
        }

        $payoutDetails = $this->getFreelancerPayoutDetails($user->id, $shift);
        $grossRate = (float) ($data['gross_rate'] ?? $payoutDetails['gross_rate']);
        $consumptionAmount = (float) ($data['consumption_deducted'] ?? $payoutDetails['consumption_amount']);
        $netAmount = (float) max(0, round($grossRate - $consumptionAmount, 2)); // O que ele gerou hoje

        // O valor efetivamente pago pelo operador (Pode ser maior, menor ou igual ao total_due)
        $paidAmount = isset($data['amount']) ? (float) $data['amount'] : (float) ($payoutDetails['total_due'] ?? $netAmount);

        $paymentMethod = $data['payment_method']; // 'cash' ou 'bank'
        $bankAccountId = !empty($data['bank_account_id']) ? (int) $data['bank_account_id'] : null;

        $bankAccount = $bankAccountId ? BankAccount::find($bankAccountId) : null;
        $paymentMethodLabel = $paymentMethod === 'accumulate' ? 'Acumulado no Saldo (Sem repasse)' : ($paymentMethod === 'cash' ? 'Dinheiro (Gaveta)' : 'PIX (' . ($bankAccount?->name ?? 'Banco') . ')');

        DB::transaction(function () use (
            $data, $user, $employee, $shift, $operator,
            $grossRate, $consumptionAmount, $netAmount, $paidAmount,
            $paymentMethod, $bankAccountId, $paymentMethodLabel
        ) {
            $desc = "Diária Turno #{$shift->id} - {$user->name}";
            if ($consumptionAmount > 0) {
                $desc .= " (Bruto: R$ {$grossRate} - Consumo: R$ {$consumptionAmount})";
            }
            if ($paidAmount <= 0) {
                $desc = "Acúmulo de Saldo (Fechamento de Turno #{$shift->id}) - {$user->name}";
            }

            // 1. Cria o Contas a Pagar já liquidado (a baixa bancária/gaveta é registrada na tabela transactions)
            $payable = AccountPayable::create([
                'employee_id'            => $employee->id,
                'description'            => $desc,
                'amount'                 => $paidAmount,
                'due_date'               => now()->toDateString(),
                'payment_date'           => now()->toDateString(),
                'status'                 => 'paid',
                'accounting_category'    => 'equipe',
                'accounting_subcategory' => 'extras',
                'paid_by'                => 'company',
                'observations'           => "Liquidado via {$paymentMethodLabel} no Turno #{$shift->id}",
            ]);

            // 2. Sangria no Caixa se pago em dinheiro da gaveta
            if ($paymentMethod === 'cash' && $paidAmount > 0) {
                Transaction::create([
                    'cash_shift_id'   => $shift->id,
                    'bank_account_id' => $shift->bank_account_id,
                    'type'            => 'out',
                    'category'        => 'cash_out',
                    'amount'                 => $paidAmount,
                    'description'     => "Sangria: Diária Freelancer - {$user->name}",
                    'operator_name'   => $operator->name ?? 'Sistema',
                    'transaction_date'=> now(),
                ]);
            }

            // 3. Transação bancária se pago via PIX/Banco fora da gaveta
            if ($paymentMethod === 'bank' && $bankAccountId && $paidAmount > 0) {
                Transaction::create([
                    'cash_shift_id'   => null,
                    'bank_account_id' => $bankAccountId,
                    'type'            => 'out',
                    'category'        => 'bank_out',
                    'amount'                 => $paidAmount,
                    'description'     => "PIX Diária Freelancer - {$user->name}",
                    'operator_name'   => $operator->name ?? 'Sistema',
                    'transaction_date'=> now(),
                ]);
            }

            // 4. Conciliação completa na conta-corrente do colaborador (EmployeeLedger)
            $latestLedger = $employee->ledgers()->latest('id')->first();
            $balance = $latestLedger ? (float) $latestLedger->balance : 0.00;

            // Crédito da diária
            $employee->ledgers()->create([
                'type'        => 'credit',
                'description' => "Diária de Trabalho (Turno #{$shift->id})",
                'amount'      => $grossRate,
                'balance'     => $balance + $grossRate,
            ]);
            $balance += $grossRate;

            // Débito do consumo abatido
            if ($consumptionAmount > 0) {
                $employee->ledgers()->create([
                    'type'        => 'debit',
                    'description' => "Abatimento de Consumo Interno (Turno #{$shift->id})",
                    'amount'      => $consumptionAmount,
                    'balance'     => $balance - $consumptionAmount,
                ]);
                $balance -= $consumptionAmount;
            }

            // Débito do valor pago
            if ($paidAmount > 0) {
                $employee->ledgers()->create([
                    'type'        => 'debit',
                    'description' => "Liquidação Diária ({$paymentMethodLabel})",
                    'amount'                 => $paidAmount,
                    'balance'      => $balance - $paidAmount,
                ]);
            }

            // 5. Atualiza o status na escala do turno
            $shift->attendees()->updateExistingPivot($user->id, [
                'account_payable_id' => $payable->id,
                'daily_rate'         => $grossRate
            ]);
        });

        // 🚀 6. IMPRESSÃO AUTOMÁTICA DO COMPROVATIVO TÉRMICO
        // Suprime a impressão se a diária for apenas acumulada em saldo ou sem liquidação financeira imediata
        if ($paymentMethod === 'accumulate' || $paidAmount <= 0.00) {
            Log::info("ℹ️ [ShiftAttendance] Diária acumulada para [{$user->name}]. Impressão de recibo suprimida.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            $cashierPrinter = Printer::where('is_cashier', true)->where('is_active', true)->first()
                ?? Printer::where('is_active', true)->first();

            if ($cashierPrinter) {
                $receipt = new FreelancerReceipt(
                    freelancerName: $user->name,
                    netAmount: $netAmount,
                    grossAmount: $grossRate,
                    consumptionAmount: $consumptionAmount,
                    paymentMethod: $paymentMethodLabel,
                    operatorName: $operator->name ?? 'Caixa',
                    pixKey: $employee->pix_key
                );

                $this->printDispatcher->dispatch($cashierPrinter, $receipt);
                Log::info("🖨️ [ShiftAttendance] Recibo de freelancer impresso com sucesso para [{$user->name}].");
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::warning("⚠️ [ShiftAttendance] Falha ao imprimir recibo de freelancer: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 TRAVA DO CAIXA: Localiza freelancers presentes com diária pendente de pagamento
     */
    public function getPendingDailyFreelancers(CashShift $shift): Collection
    {
        return $shift->attendees()
            ->wherePivot('attendance_status', 'present')
            ->wherePivotNull('account_payable_id')
            ->whereHas('employee', function ($q) {
                $q->whereIn('employment_type', [
                    EmploymentType::FREELANCER->value,
                    EmploymentType::FREELANCE_FIXED->value,
                ])->orWhere('payment_cycle', PaymentCycle::DAILY->value);
            })
            ->get();
    }

    public function checkIsOnDuty(User $user): bool
    {
        $settings = \App\Models\CompanySetting::getCached();
        $isManager = $user->hasAnyRole(['admin', 'gerente', 'manager']);
        $isAttendanceRequired = $settings ? $settings->require_shift_attendance : false;

        if ($isManager || !$isAttendanceRequired) {
            return true;
        }

        return $user->isOnActiveShift();
    }

    public function startUserShift(User $user): void
    {
        $activeShift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();

        if (!$activeShift) {
            throw new \Exception('Não é possível iniciar o turno. O Caixa da loja ainda está fechado.');
        }

        $dailyRate = (float) ($user->employee?->base_remuneration ?? 0);
        $primaryRole = $user->roles->first()?->name ?? 'waiter';

        $activeShift->attendees()->syncWithoutDetaching([
            $user->id => [
                'checked_in_at'     => now(),
                'status'            => 'active',
                'attendance_status' => 'present',
                'daily_rate'        => $dailyRate,
                'assigned_role'     => $primaryRole
            ]
        ]);
    }

    public static function getActiveShiftStaffByRoles(array $roles): \Illuminate\Support\Collection
    {
        $activeShift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();

        if (!$activeShift) {
            return collect();
        }

        return $activeShift->attendees()
            ->wherePivot('status', 'active')
            ->wherePivot('attendance_status', 'present')
            ->where(function ($query) use ($roles) {
                $query->whereIn('shift_attendance.assigned_role', $roles)
                      ->orWhereHas('roles', function ($q) use ($roles) {
                          $q->whereIn('name', $roles);
                      });
            })
            ->get();
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/RestaurantOps/ShiftCashierService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\BankAccount;
use App\Models\Printer;
use App\Events\ShiftClosed;
use App\Services\Printing\Documents\ShiftClosureReport;
use App\Services\Printing\PrintDispatcher;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class ShiftCashierService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected PrintDispatcher $printDispatcher
    ) {}

    public function openShift(array $data, int $operatorId, string $operatorName): CashShift
    {
        if (CashShift::where('status', 'open')->exists()) {
            throw new \Exception('Já existe um turno aberto neste terminal.');
        }

        $bankAccountId = $data['bank_account_id'] ?? BankAccount::first()?->id ?? 1;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $operatorId, $operatorName, $bankAccountId) {
            $shift = CashShift::create([
                'bank_account_id' => $bankAccountId,
                'status'          => 'open',
                'opened_at'       => now(),
                'opening_balance' => (float) ($data['amount'] ?? 0),
                'opened_by'       => $operatorId,
            ]);

            if (($data['amount'] ?? 0) > 0) {
                Transaction::create([
                    'cash_shift_id'   => $shift->id,
                    'bank_account_id' => $bankAccountId,
                    'type'            => 'in',
                    'category'        => 'opening_balance',
                    'amount'          => (float) $data['amount'],
                    'description'     => 'Abertura de Caixa (Troco Inicial)',
                    'operator_name'   => $operatorName,
                    'transaction_date'=> now(),
                ]);
            }

            broadcast(new \App\Events\ShiftOpened($shift));
            Log::info("🚀 [ShiftCashierService] Turno #{$shift->id} aberto pelo operador [{$operatorName}].");

            return $shift;
        });
    }

    public function closeShift(CashShift $shift, array $data, int $operatorId, string $operatorName): CashShift
    {
        $tenant = function_exists('tenant') ? tenant() : null;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($shift, $data, $operatorId) {
            $updatePayload = [
                'status'                 => 'closed',
                'closed_at'              => now(),
                'closing_balance_actual' => (float) ($data['amount'] ?? 0),
                'closed_by'              => $operatorId,
                'notes'                  => $data['notes'] ?? ($data['observation'] ?? null),
            ];

            if (true) {
                $updatePayload['accepting_orders'] = false;
            }

            $shift->update($updatePayload);
        });

        // 🚀 TRANSMISSÃO EM TEMPO REAL: Notifica PosApp, TeamApp e CustomerApp
        try {
            broadcast(new ShiftClosed($shift));
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [ShiftCashierService] Falha ao transmitir evento ShiftClosed: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        // 🖨️ IMPRESSÃO IMEDIATA DO RELATÓRIO DE FECHAMENTO (Antes de qualquer rotina Artisan externa)
        try {
            $cashierPrinter = Printer::where('is_cashier', true)
                ->where('is_active', true)
                ->first()
                ?? Printer::where('is_active', true)->first();

            if ($cashierPrinter) {
                $report = new ShiftClosureReport($shift);
                $this->printDispatcher->dispatch($cashierPrinter, $report);
                Log::info("🖨️ [ShiftCashierService] Relatório do Turno #{$shift->id} enviado para a impressora [{$cashierPrinter->name}].");
            } else {
                Log::notice("⚠️ [ShiftCashierService] Nenhuma impressora de caixa ativa encontrada para o Turno #{$shift->id}.");
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::warning("⚠️ [ShiftCashierService] Falha ao imprimir relatório de fechamento do Turno #{$shift->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        // Sincronização de consumo WMS
        try {
            $affected = app(\App\Services\RestaurantOps\WmsRestockService::class)->syncPendingConsumptionToShelf($shift->id);
            Log::info("📦 [WmsRestock] Consumo de prateleira consolidado no Turno #{$shift->id} ({$affected} regras atualizadas).");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [WmsRestock] Falha ao sincronizar reposição no fechamento do Turno #{$shift->id}: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        // 🧹 Limpeza de comandas abandonadas com proteção de contexto multi-tenant
        $tenantId = $tenant?->id ?? (function_exists('tenant') && tenant() ? tenant('id') : null);
        $options = ['--on-shift-close' => true];

        if ($tenantId) {
            $options['--tenant'] = $tenantId;
        }

        try {
            Artisan::call('erp:process-abandoned-carts', $options);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error("🚨 [ShiftCashierService] Falha ao purgar comandas no fechamento do caixa: " . $e->getMessage());
        } finally {
            // 🛡️ BLINDAGEM DE TENANCY: Restaura o tenant caso o comando Artisan tenha resetado a conexão
            if ($tenant && (!function_exists('tenant') || !tenant())) {
                tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
            }
        }

        Log::info("🏁 [ShiftCashierService] Turno #{$shift->id} fechado pelo operador [{$operatorName}]. Ciclo completo.");

        return $shift;
    }

    public function closeShiftWithCleanup(CashShift $shift, array $data, int $operatorId, string $operatorName): CashShift
    {
        return $this->closeShift($shift, $data, $operatorId, $operatorName);
    }

    public function recordTransaction(array $data, string $operatorName): Transaction
    {
        $shift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->first();

        if (!$shift) {
            throw new \Exception('Nenhum turno aberto para registrar a movimentação.');
        }

        $typeLabel = $data['type'] === 'out' ? 'Sangria' : 'Suprimento';

        $transaction = Transaction::create([
            'cash_shift_id'   => $shift->id,
            'bank_account_id' => $shift->bank_account_id,
            'type'            => $data['type'],
            'category'        => $data['type'] === 'out' ? 'cash_out' : 'cash_in',
            'amount'          => (float) $data['amount'],
            'description'     => $data['description'] ?? "{$typeLabel} manual",
            'operator_name'   => $operatorName,
            'transaction_date'=> now(),
        ]);

        Log::info("💸 [ShiftCashierService] Movimentação avulsa ({$data['type']}) de R$ {$data['amount']} registrada no Turno #{$shift->id}.");

        return $transaction;
    }

    public function rollbackPayment(Order $order, int|string $paymentId): Payment
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $paymentId) {
            /** @var Payment $payment */
            $payment = $order->payments()->with(['transaction', 'items'])->findOrFail($paymentId);

            try {
                if ($payment->relationLoaded('transaction') && $payment->transaction) {
                    $payment->transaction->delete();
                } else {
                    Transaction::where('order_id', $order->id)
                        ->where('payment_id', $payment->id)
                        ->delete();
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                Transaction::where('order_id', $order->id)
                    ->where('payment_id', $payment->id)
                    ->delete();
            }

            if ($payment->items && $payment->items->isNotEmpty()) {
                foreach ($payment->items as $item) {
                    $pivotQty = (float) ($item->pivot->quantity ?? 1);
                    $pivotAmount = (float) ($item->pivot->amount ?? 0);

                    $item->paid_qty = max(0, round((float) ($item->paid_qty ?? 0) - $pivotQty, 4));
                    $item->save();

                    if ($item->parent_item_id) {
                        $parent = OrderItem::find($item->parent_item_id);
                        if ($parent && (float) ($parent->total_price ?? 0) > 0) {
                            $proportionalDecrease = ($pivotAmount / (float) $parent->total_price) * (float) ($parent->quantity ?? 1);
                            $parent->paid_qty = max(0, round((float) ($parent->paid_qty ?? 0) - $proportionalDecrease, 4));
                            $parent->save();
                        }
                    }

                    $subItems = OrderItem::where('parent_item_id', $item->id)->get();
                    if ($subItems->isNotEmpty() && (float) ($item->quantity ?? 1) > 0) {
                        $ratio = $pivotQty / (float) $item->quantity;
                        foreach ($subItems as $sub) {
                            $subDecrease = (float) ($sub->quantity ?? 1) * $ratio;
                            $sub->paid_qty = max(0, round((float) ($sub->paid_qty ?? 0) - $subDecrease, 4));
                            $sub->save();
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $remainingPaymentsCount = $order->payments()->where('id', '!=', $payment->id)->count();
                if ($remainingPaymentsCount === 0) {
                    $order->items()->update(['paid_qty' => 0]);
                }
            }

            if (method_exists($payment, 'items')) {
                $payment->items()->detach();
            }
            $payment->delete();

            $totalPaid = (float) $order->payments()->sum('amount');
            $totalOrder = (float) $order->total;

            if ($totalPaid <= 0.01) {
                $order->payment_status = 'pending';
                if (in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'completed'])) {
                    $order->status = 'pending';
                    if (true) {
                        $order->closed_at = null;
                    }
                }
            } elseif ($totalPaid < ($totalOrder - 0.01)) {
                $order->payment_status = 'partial';
                if (in_array($order->status, ['closed', 'completed'])) {
                    $order->status = 'pending';
                    if (true) {
                        $order->closed_at = null;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $order->payment_status = 'paid';
            }

            $order->save();

            Log::info("↩️ [PaymentRollback] Pagamento #{$paymentId} do Pedido #{$order->id} estornado com integridade contábil e proporcional.");

            return $payment;
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class StoreAvailabilityService
{
    public function getStoreStatus(): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
        $now = Carbon::now();

        $status = [
            'is_open'            => false,
            'is_pre_order'       => false,
            'is_past_closing'    => false,
            'active_channels'    => [],
            'next_open_time'     => null,
            'current_close_time' => null,
            'last_closed_at'     => null,
            'reason'             => null
        ];

        if (!$settings) return $status;

        // ========================================================
        // 1. TRAVAS EMERGENCIAIS E OPERACIONAIS (Overrides Absolutos)
        // ========================================================

        // A) Fechamento por tempo indeterminado
        if (!empty($settings->is_closed_indefinitely)) {
            $status['reason'] = 'closed_indefinitely';
            return $status;
        }

        // B) Fechamento Operacional Manual (Corte de pedidos no Turno Ativo)
        $activeShift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest('opened_at')->first();

        if ($activeShift && isset($activeShift->accepting_orders) && $activeShift->accepting_orders === false) {
            $status['is_open'] = false;
            $status['reason'] = 'manual_override_closed';

            $nextOpenings = $this->calculateNextOpenings($settings, $now);
            if (!empty($nextOpenings)) {
                $status['next_open_time'] = $nextOpenings[0]['start']->toIso8601String();
            }

            return $status;
        }

        // ========================================================
        // 2. AVALIAÇÃO DE HORÁRIOS PROGRAMADOS E CAIXA FÍSICO
        // ========================================================

        $isShiftOpen = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->exists();

        // Loja 24 Horas
        if (!empty($settings->is_24_hours)) {
            $status['is_open'] = true;
            $status['active_channels'] = ['delivery', 'counter', 'table'];
            return $status;
        }

        // Matriz semanal de horários
        $hours = is_string($settings->business_hours)
            ? json_decode($settings->business_hours, true)
            : ($settings->business_hours ?? []);

        $activeChannels = [];
        $nextOpenings = [];
        $pastClosings = [];
        $currentClosings = [];

        if (!empty($hours)) {
            foreach ($hours as $block) {
                $dayOfWeek = (int) $block['day_of_week'];
                $openStr = substr($block['open_time'], 0, 5);
                $closeStr = substr($block['close_time'], 0, 5);
                $channels = $block['active_channels'] ?? [];

                for ($i = -1; $i <= 7; $i++) {
                    $checkDate = $now->copy()->addDays($i);

                    if ($checkDate->dayOfWeek === $dayOfWeek) {
                        $start = $checkDate->copy()->setTimeFromTimeString($openStr);
                        $end = $checkDate->copy()->setTimeFromTimeString($closeStr);

                        // Vira a madrugada
                        if ($end->lessThan($start)) {
                            $end->addDay();
                        }

                        if ($now->between($start, $end)) {
                            $activeChannels = array_merge($activeChannels, $channels);
                            $currentClosings[] = $end->copy();
                        } elseif ($start->greaterThan($now)) {
                            $nextOpenings[] = [
                                'start'    => $start->copy(),
                                'end'      => $end->copy(),
                                'channels' => $channels
                            ];
                        }

                        if ($end->lessThanOrEqualTo($now)) {
                            $pastClosings[] = $end->copy();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!empty($pastClosings)) {
                usort($pastClosings, fn($a, $b) => $b <=> $a);
                $status['last_closed_at'] = $pastClosings[0]->toIso8601String();
            }

            if (!empty($nextOpenings)) {
                usort($nextOpenings, fn($a, $b) => $a['start'] <=> $b['start']);
                $status['next_open_time'] = $nextOpenings[0]['start']->toIso8601String();
            }
        }

        $activeChannels = array_values(array_unique($activeChannels));
        $isScheduledOpen = !empty($activeChannels);

        // ========================================================
        // 3. INTEGRAÇÃO BIDIRECIONAL: CAIXA x HORÁRIOS PROGRAMADOS
        // ========================================================

        // CENÁRIO A: Caixa está ABERTO -> A loja opera imediatamente!
        if ($isShiftOpen) {
            $status['is_open'] = true;
            $status['active_channels'] = $isScheduledOpen ? $activeChannels : ['delivery', 'counter', 'table'];

            // 1. Horário de fechamento da janela em andamento
            if (!empty($currentClosings)) {
                usort($currentClosings, fn($a, $b) => $a <=> $b);
                $status['current_close_time'] = $currentClosings[0]->toIso8601String();
            }
            // 2. 🚀 REGRA 1: Caixa abriu mais cedo que o horário da escala
            elseif (!empty($nextOpenings)) {
                $nextBlock = $nextOpenings[0];
                if ($now->diffInHours($nextBlock['start'], false) <= 14) {
                    $status['current_close_time'] = $nextBlock['end']->toIso8601String();
                    if (!empty($nextBlock['channels'])) {
                        $status['active_channels'] = $nextBlock['channels'];
                    }
                }
            }

            // 3. 🚀 REGRA 2: Passou do horário regular de fechar, mas o turno continua aberto
            if (empty($status['current_close_time']) && !empty($pastClosings)) {
                $mostRecentPastClosing = $pastClosings[0];
                if ($now->diffInHours($mostRecentPastClosing) <= 12) {
                    $status['current_close_time'] = $mostRecentPastClosing->toIso8601String();
                    $status['is_past_closing'] = true;
                }
            }

            // Validação de extrapolação de horário
            if (!empty($status['current_close_time'])) {
                $closeDate = Carbon::parse($status['current_close_time']);
                if ($now->greaterThanOrEqualTo($closeDate)) {
                    $status['is_past_closing'] = true;
                }
            }

            return $status;
        }

        // CENÁRIO B: Caixa está FECHADO
        if ($isScheduledOpen) {
            if ($settings->enforce_cashier_open) {
                $status['is_open'] = false;
                $status['reason'] = 'cashier_closed';

                if ($settings->allow_pre_orders) {
                    $status['is_pre_order'] = true;
                    $status['active_channels'] = $activeChannels;
                } else {
                    $status['is_pre_order'] = false;
                    $status['active_channels'] = [];
                }

                if (!empty($currentClosings)) {
                    usort($currentClosings, fn($a, $b) => $a <=> $b);
                    $status['current_close_time'] = $currentClosings[0]->toIso8601String();
                }
            } else {
                $status['is_open'] = true;
                $status['active_channels'] = $activeChannels;

                if (!empty($currentClosings)) {
                    usort($currentClosings, fn($a, $b) => $a <=> $b);
                    $status['current_close_time'] = $currentClosings[0]->toIso8601String();
                }
            }
        } else {
            $status['is_open'] = false;
            $status['reason'] = 'outside_hours';

            if ($settings->allow_pre_orders && !empty($nextOpenings) && $settings->pre_order_buffer_minutes > 0) {
                $nextBlock = $nextOpenings[0];
                $diffMinutes = $now->diffInMinutes($nextBlock['start'], false);

                if ($diffMinutes > 0 && $diffMinutes <= $settings->pre_order_buffer_minutes) {
                    $status['is_pre_order'] = true;
                    $status['active_channels'] = $nextBlock['channels'];
                }
            }
        }

        return $status;
    }

    protected function calculateNextOpenings($settings, $now): array
    {
        $hours = is_string($settings->business_hours) ? json_decode($settings->business_hours, true) : ($settings->business_hours ?? []);
        $nextOpenings = [];

        foreach ($hours as $block) {
            $dayOfWeek = (int) $block['day_of_week'];
            $openStr = substr($block['open_time'], 0, 5);
            $closeStr = substr($block['close_time'], 0, 5);
            $channels = $block['active_channels'] ?? [];

            for ($i = -1; $i <= 7; $i++) {
                $checkDate = $now->copy()->addDays($i);
                if ($checkDate->dayOfWeek === $dayOfWeek) {
                    $start = $checkDate->copy()->setTimeFromTimeString($openStr);
                    $end = $checkDate->copy()->setTimeFromTimeString($closeStr);
                    if ($end->lessThan($start)) {
                        $end->addDay();
                    }
                    if ($start->greaterThan($now)) {
                        $nextOpenings[] = [
                            'start'    => $start->copy(),
                            'end'      => $end->copy(),
                            'channels' => $channels
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        usort($nextOpenings, fn($a, $b) => $a['start'] <=> $b['start']);
        return $nextOpenings;
    }
}
```
