```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\DiningTable;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Events\OrderUpdated;
use App\Events\DiningTableUpdated;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class TablesService
{
    public function updateStatus(DiningTable $table, string $status): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($table, $status) {
            $lockedTable = DiningTable::where('id', $table->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $lockedTable->update(['status' => $status]);

            DB::afterCommit(fn () => broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($lockedTable->fresh())));
        });
    }

    public function move(DiningTable $sourceTable, int $targetTableId): DiningTable
    {
        if ((int) $sourceTable->id === $targetTableId) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'target_table_id' => 'A mesa de destino deve ser diferente da mesa atual.',
            ]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($sourceTable, $targetTableId) {
            // Trava as duas mesas para evitar double booking/race conditions
            $sourceTable = DiningTable::where('id', $sourceTable->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $targetTable = DiningTable::where('id', $targetTableId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

            $orders = Order::where('dining_table_id', $sourceTable->id)
                ->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'delivered'])
                ->where('payment_status', '!=', 'paid')
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->get();

            $updatePayload = [
                'table_number' => $targetTable->name,
                'dining_table_id' => $targetTable->id
            ];

            foreach ($orders as $order) {
                $order->update($updatePayload);

                DB::afterCommit(fn () => broadcast(new OrderUpdated($order->fresh())));
            }

            $sourceTable->update(['status' => 'available']);
            $targetTable->update(['status' => 'occupied']);

            DB::afterCommit(function () use ($sourceTable, $targetTable) {
                broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($sourceTable->fresh()));
                broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($targetTable->fresh()));
            });

            return $targetTable;
        });
    }

    public function join(DiningTable $primaryTable, array $secondaryTableIds): void
    {
        $secondaryIds = array_filter(
            $secondaryTableIds,
            fn ($id) => (int) $id !== (int) $primaryTable->id
        );

        if (empty($secondaryIds)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'secondary_table_ids' => 'Selecione ao menos uma mesa secundária diferente da principal.',
            ]);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($primaryTable, $secondaryIds) {
            $primaryTable = DiningTable::where('id', $primaryTable->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $secondaryTables = DiningTable::whereIn('id', $secondaryIds)->lockForUpdate()->get();

            foreach ($secondaryTables as $secTable) {
                $secTable->update([
                    'parent_table_id' => $primaryTable->id,
                    'status'          => 'occupied',
                ]);

                // As comandas mantêm seus dining_table_id originais (mantém a rastreabilidade)
                // O Vue/Frontend deve usar as props da mesa "Pai" e das mesas filhas.

                DB::afterCommit(fn () => broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($secTable->fresh())));
            }

            $primaryTable->update(['status' => 'occupied']);

            DB::afterCommit(fn () => broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($primaryTable->fresh())));
        });
    }

    public function split(DiningTable $table): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($table) {
            $table = DiningTable::where('id', $table->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

            // Se for uma mesa secundária, separa só ela
            if ($table->parent_table_id) {
                $table->update([
                    'parent_table_id' => null,
                    'status'          => $table->activeOrders()->exists() ? 'occupied' : 'available',
                ]);
                DB::afterCommit(fn () => broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($table->fresh())));
                return;
            }

            // Se for mesa principal, separa todas as secundárias
            $secondaries = DiningTable::where('parent_table_id', $table->id)->lockForUpdate()->get();

            foreach ($secondaries as $sec) {
                $sec->update([
                    'parent_table_id' => null,
                    'status'          => $sec->activeOrders()->exists() ? 'occupied' : 'available',
                ]);
                DB::afterCommit(fn () => broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($sec->fresh())));
            }

            // Atualiza status da mesa principal
            $hasActiveOrders = $table->activeOrders()->exists();
            $table->update(['status' => $hasActiveOrders ? 'occupied' : 'available']);

            DB::afterCommit(fn () => broadcast(new DiningTableUpdated($table->fresh())));
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\RestaurantOps;

use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ProductStorageLocation;
use App\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Events\CatalogUpdated;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class WmsRestockService
{
    /**
     * Retorna o quadro de reposição para o painel (TeamApp / Retaguarda).
     */
    public function getRestockBoard(?int $shiftId = null): array
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::first();
        $mode = $settings->wms_restock_mode ?? 'free';

        $soldProducts = [];
        if ($mode === 'sales_driven') {
            $soldProducts = $this->calculatePendingSales($shiftId);
        }

        $locations = StorageLocation::query()
            ->where(function ($q) {
                $q->where('is_active', true)->orWhereNull('is_active');
            })
            ->whereIn('type', ['display', 'intermediate'])
            ->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc')
            ->get()
            ->map(function (StorageLocation $location) use ($mode, $soldProducts) {

                $rules = ProductStorageLocation::query()
                    ->where('storage_location_id', $location->id)
                    ->whereHas('product', function ($q) {
                        $q->where('products.track_inventory', true)
                          ->where('products.requires_preparation', false)
                          ->where('products.type', 'resale')
                          ->where('products.status', 'available')
                          ->where(function ($sub) {
                              // 🛡️ BLINDAGEM: Produto de revenda precisa obrigatoriamente ter preço de venda
                              $sub->whereNotNull('products.dine_in_price')
                                  ->orWhereNotNull('products.delivery_price');
                          })
                          ->whereNull('products.deleted_at');
                    })
                    ->with(['product.category'])
                    ->get();

                $items = $rules->map(function ($rule) use ($mode, $soldProducts) {
                    $product = $rule->product;

                    // Salvaguarda caso o relacionamento venha corrompido
                    if (!$product || $product->status !== 'available' || $product->type !== 'resale') {
                        return null;
                    }

                    $suggestedRestock = 0;
                    $virtualStock = (float) $rule->current_stock;
                    $isCritical = false;

                    if ($mode === 'sales_driven') {
                        $soldQty = (float) ($soldProducts[$product->id] ?? 0);
                        $virtualStock = $rule->current_stock - $soldQty;
                        $spaceLeft = max(0, $rule->max_capacity - $virtualStock);
                        $suggestedRestock = min($soldQty, $spaceLeft);
                    }

                    if ($virtualStock <= $rule->min_level) {
                        $isCritical = true;
                    }

                    $totalStock = (float) ($product->current_stock ?? 0);

                    return [
                        'rule_id'          => $rule->id,
                        'product_id'       => $product->id,
                        'name'             => $product->name,
                        'category_id'      => $product->category_id,
                        'type'             => $product->type,
                        'category_name'    => $product->category?->name ?? 'Geral',
                        'category_order'   => $product->category?->sort_order ?? 999,
                        'unit_of_measure'  => $product->unit_of_measure ?? 'un',
                        'source_location'  => $rule->source_location ?? 'Almoxarifado Principal',
                        'current_stock'    => max(0, $virtualStock),
                        'max_capacity'     => (float) $rule->max_capacity,
                        'min_level'        => (float) $rule->min_level,
                        'is_critical'      => $isCritical,
                        'suggested_restock'=> max(0, $suggestedRestock),
                        'total_stock'      => $totalStock,
                        'status'           => $product->status,
                    ];
                })->filter(function ($item) use ($mode) {
                    if (!$item) return false;

                    if ($mode === 'sales_driven') {
                        return $item['suggested_restock'] > 0 || $item['is_critical'];
                    }

                    return true;
                })
                ->sort(function ($a, $b) {
                    $catOrderA = $a['category_order'] ?? 999;
                    $catOrderB = $b['category_order'] ?? 999;
                    if ($catOrderA !== $catOrderB) {
                        return $catOrderA <=> $catOrderB;
                    }

                    $catNameA = $a['category_name'] ?? '';
                    $catNameB = $b['category_name'] ?? '';
                    if ($catNameA !== $catNameB) {
                        return strcasecmp($catNameA, $catNameB);
                    }

                    return strcasecmp($a['name'] ?? '', $b['name'] ?? '');
                })
                ->values();

                return [
                    'location_id'    => $location->id,
                    'location_name'  => $location->name,
                    'restock_mode'   => $mode,
                    'critical_count' => $items->where('is_critical', true)->count(),
                    'items'          => $items,
                ];
            })->filter(fn ($loc) => $loc['items']->count() > 0)->values();

        return $locations->toArray();
    }

    public function calculateRestockNeeds(?int $shiftId = null): array
    {
        return $this->getRestockBoard($shiftId);
    }

    protected function calculatePendingSales(?int $shiftId): array
    {
        $query = Order::query()->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'pending']);

        if ($shiftId) {
            $query->where('cash_shift_id', $shiftId);
        } else {
            $activeShift = CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();
            if ($activeShift) {
                $query->where('cash_shift_id', $activeShift->id);
            }
        }

        return DB::table('order_items')
            ->join('orders', 'order_items.order_id', '=', 'orders.id')
            ->whereIn('orders.id', $query->select('id'))
            ->where('order_items.status', '!=', 'cancelled')
            ->select('order_items.product_id', DB::raw('SUM(order_items.quantity) as total_qty'))
            ->groupBy('order_items.product_id')
            ->pluck('total_qty', 'product_id')
            ->toArray();
    }

    public function addStockToShelf(int $ruleId, float $addedStock): ProductStorageLocation
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($ruleId, $addedStock) {
            $rule = ProductStorageLocation::lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($ruleId);
            $product = Product::lockForUpdate()->find($rule->product_id);

            $rule->current_stock += $addedStock;

            if ($rule->max_capacity > 0 && $rule->current_stock > $rule->max_capacity) {
                $rule->current_stock = $rule->max_capacity;
            }

            $rule->save();

            if ($product) {
                if ((float) $product->current_stock < (float) $rule->current_stock) {
                    $product->current_stock = (float) $rule->current_stock;
                }

                if ($product->status === 'out_of_stock' && (float) $product->current_stock > 0) {
                    app(InventoryService::class)->triggerStockRestored($product);
                } else {
                    $product->save();
                    $tenantId = tenant('id') ?? 'central';
                    broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenantId));
                }
            } else {
                $tenantId = tenant('id') ?? 'central';
                broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenantId));
            }

            Log::info("📦 [WmsRestock] Reposição salva: +{$addedStock} na regra #{$ruleId} (Produto: {$rule->product_id})");

            return $rule->load('product');
        });
    }

    public function updateLocationStock(int $ruleId, float $addedStock): ProductStorageLocation
    {
        return $this->addStockToShelf($ruleId, $addedStock);
    }

    public function syncPendingConsumptionToShelf(?int $shiftId = null): int
    {
        $soldProducts = $this->calculatePendingSales($shiftId);
        if (empty($soldProducts)) {
            return 0;
        }

        $affectedRules = 0;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($soldProducts, &$affectedRules) {
            foreach ($soldProducts as $productId => $qtySold) {
                $rules = ProductStorageLocation::where('product_id', $productId)->get();

                if ($rules->isEmpty()) continue;

                $remainingToDeduct = $qtySold;

                foreach ($rules as $rule) {
                    if ($remainingToDeduct <= 0) break;

                    if ($rule->current_stock > 0) {
                        $deduct = min($rule->current_stock, $remainingToDeduct);
                        $rule->current_stock -= $deduct;
                        $rule->save();

                        $remainingToDeduct -= $deduct;
                        $affectedRules++;
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        return $affectedRules;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\SupplyChain;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\ShoppingListItem;
use App\Models\ProductCostHistory;
use App\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Models\ProductionOrder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ProcurementService
{
    /**
     * Varre todo o estoque e calcula reposições com agrupamento em embalagens fechadas.
     */
    public function generateAutomatedShoppingList(bool $ignoreWeekdays = false): int
    {
        $todayStr = strtolower(now()->format('D'));

        $suppliersOrderingToday = Supplier::where('is_active', true)
            ->where(function ($q) use ($todayStr, $ignoreWeekdays) {
                if (!$ignoreWeekdays) {
                    $q->whereJsonContains('order_days', $todayStr)
                      ->orWhereNull('order_days');
                }
            })
            ->pluck('id');

        $productsToReplenish = Product::where('track_inventory', true)
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['archived'])
            ->whereIn('type', ['resale', 'ingredient', 'packaging', 'supply', 'consumable'])
            ->where(function ($q) {
                $q->whereRaw('current_stock <= COALESCE(min_stock, 0)')
                  ->orWhere('current_stock', '<=', 0);
            })
            ->get();

        $generatedCount = 0;

        foreach ($productsToReplenish as $product) {
            $currentStock = (float) $product->current_stock;
            $minStock = (float) ($product->min_stock ?? 0);
            $targetStock = (float) ($product->max_stock ?? ($product->par_level ?? ($minStock * 2)));

            $baseDeficit = max(1.0, round($targetStock - $currentStock, 3));
            $isCritical = $currentStock <= 0;

            // 🚀 MATEMÁTICA DE CONVERSÃO: Arredonda para fardos/caixas fechadas
            $packaging = $product->resolvePurchasePackaging();
            $factor = $packaging['factor'];

            if ($factor > 1) {
                $packsNeeded = (int) ceil($baseDeficit / $factor);
                $finalUnitsQty = $packsNeeded * $factor;
            } else {
                $packsNeeded = 0;
                $finalUnitsQty = $baseDeficit;
            }

            $supplierId = $product->supplier_id
                ?? ProductCostHistory::where('product_id', $product->id)->latest('id')->value('supplier_id');

            $isSupplierDay = $supplierId && $suppliersOrderingToday->contains($supplierId);

            if ($ignoreWeekdays || $isSupplierDay || $isCritical || empty($supplierId)) {
                $item = ShoppingListItem::firstOrNew([
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'status'     => 'pending'
                ]);

                $item->suggested_qty = $item->exists ? max((float) $item->suggested_qty, $finalUnitsQty) : $finalUnitsQty;
                $item->urgency_level = $isCritical ? 'critical' : ($item->urgency_level ?? 'normal');
                if (!$item->supplier_id && $supplierId) {
                    $item->supplier_id = $supplierId;
                }

                $unitCost = (float) ($product->base_cost ?? 0);
                if ($unitCost > 0) {
                    $item->estimated_cost = round($item->suggested_qty * $unitCost, 2);
                }

                $item->save();
                $generatedCount++;
            }
        }

        Log::info("🛒 [ProcurementService] Varredura concluída. {$generatedCount} itens calculados com fator de conversão.");

        return $generatedCount;
    }

    /**
     * Adiciona manualmente com suporte a embalagens e caixas
     */
    public function addManualItem(int $productId, float $qty, ?string $notes = null, ?int $supplierId = null, bool $isPackInput = false): ShoppingListItem
    {
        $product = Product::findOrFail($productId);
        $packaging = $product->resolvePurchasePackaging();
        $factor = $packaging['factor'];

        // Se o operador informou "2 fardos", converte para as unidades de consumo correspondentes
        $finalUnits = ($isPackInput && $factor > 1) ? round($qty * $factor, 3) : $qty;

        $item = ShoppingListItem::firstOrNew([
            'product_id' => $product->id,
            'status'     => 'pending'
        ]);

        $item->suggested_qty = $item->exists ? ((float) $item->suggested_qty + $finalUnits) : $finalUnits;
        $item->urgency_level = 'manual';
        if ($notes) {
            $item->notes = trim(($item->notes ? $item->notes . ' | ' : '') . $notes);
        }

        $resolvedSupplierId = $supplierId
            ?? $item->supplier_id
            ?? $product->supplier_id
            ?? ProductCostHistory::where('product_id', $product->id)->latest('id')->value('supplier_id');

        if ($resolvedSupplierId) {
            $item->supplier_id = $resolvedSupplierId;
        }

        $unitCost = (float) ($product->base_cost ?? 0);
        if ($unitCost > 0) {
            $item->estimated_cost = round($item->suggested_qty * $unitCost, 2);
        }

        $item->save();

        return $item;
    }

    /**
     * MOMENTO 1: Carrega os produtos de um StorageLocation para contagem física rápida
     */
    public function getStorageLocationAuditData(int $locationId): array
    {
        $location = StorageLocation::with(['storageRules.product'])->findOrFail($locationId);

        $resale = [];
        $ingredients = [];
        $supplies = [];
        $manufactured = [];

        foreach ($location->storageRules as $rule) {
            $product = $rule->product;
            if (!$product || $product->status === 'archived') continue;

            // 🛑 Pratos montados são excluídos do levantamento de estoque
            if ($product->type === 'dish') continue;

            $packaging = $product->resolvePurchasePackaging();

            $itemData = [
                'rule_id'            => $rule->id,
                'product_id'         => $product->id,
                'name'               => $product->name,
                'type'               => $product->type,
                'current_stock'      => (float) $product->current_stock,
                'min_stock'          => (float) ($product->min_stock ?? 0),
                'max_stock'          => (float) ($product->max_stock ?? 0),
                'base_uom'           => $packaging['base_uom'],
                'purchase_uom'       => $packaging['purchase_uom'],
                'conversion_factor'  => $packaging['factor'],
                'is_pack'            => $packaging['is_pack'],
                'is_low'             => (float) $product->current_stock <= (float) ($product->min_stock ?? 0),
            ];

            if ($product->type === 'resale') {
                $resale[] = $itemData;
            } elseif ($product->type === 'ingredient') {
                $ingredients[] = $itemData;
            } elseif (in_array($product->type, ['supply', 'packaging', 'consumable'])) {
                $supplies[] = $itemData;
            } elseif ($product->type === 'manufactured') {
                $manufactured[] = $itemData;
            }
        }

        return [
            'location'     => ['id' => $location->id, 'name' => $location->name],
            'resale'       => $resale,
            'ingredients'  => $ingredients,
            'supplies'     => $supplies,
            'manufactured' => $manufactured,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * MOMENTO 1 (Submissão): Roteia as faltas do local físico para Compra ou Produção
     */
    public function submitLocationAudit(int $locationId, array $items): array
    {
        $purchasesCreated = 0;
        $productionCreated = 0;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($items, &$purchasesCreated, &$productionCreated) {
            foreach ($items as $entry) {
                $productId = (int) $entry['product_id'];
                $qtyNeeded = (float) ($entry['quantity'] ?? 0);
                if ($qtyNeeded <= 0) continue;

                $product = Product::find($productId);
                if (!$product) continue;

                if ($product->type === 'manufactured') {
                    // 🚀 ROTEAMENTO: Preparos internos vão para a fila da esteira de produção
                    if (class_exists(ProductionOrder::class)) {
                        ProductionOrder::create([
                            'product_id'   => $product->id,
                            'quantity'     => $qtyNeeded,
                            'status'       => 'pending',
                            'priority'     => 'high',
                            'created_by'   => auth()->id(),
                            'notes'        => 'Gerado via conferência no local: ' . ($entry['location_name'] ?? 'Armazém'),
                        ]);
                        $productionCreated++;
                    }
                } else {
                    // 🚀 ROTEAMENTO: Revenda, insumos e embalagens vão para a Lista de Compras
                    $isPack = !empty($entry['is_pack']);
                    $this->addManualItem($productId, $qtyNeeded, 'Conferência física no local', null, $isPack);
                    $purchasesCreated++;
                }
            }
        });

        return [
            'purchases_count'  => $purchasesCreated,
            'production_count' => $productionCreated,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * MOMENTO 2: Constrói a Matriz de Cotações com agrupamento em Caixas/Fardos
     */
    public function getSmartBiddingMatrix(): array
    {
        $pendingItems = ShoppingListItem::with(['product.category', 'supplier'])
            ->where('status', 'pending')
            ->get();

        $matrix = [];
        $unassignedKey = 'avulso';

        foreach ($pendingItems as $item) {
            $product = $item->product;
            if (!$product) continue;

            $packaging = $product->resolvePurchasePackaging();
            $factor = $packaging['factor'];
            $baseQty = (float) $item->suggested_qty;

            // Calcula exibição de fardos e unidades
            if ($factor > 1) {
                $packsCount = (int) ceil($baseQty / $factor);
                $packDisplay = "{$packsCount} {$packaging['purchase_uom']} ({$baseQty} {$packaging['base_uom']})";
            } else {
                $packsCount = $baseQty;
                $packDisplay = "{$baseQty} {$packaging['base_uom']}";
            }

            $suppliersFound = [];

            if ($item->supplier_id && $item->supplier) {
                $suppliersFound[$item->supplier_id] = [
                    'supplier'  => $item->supplier,
                    'unit_cost' => (float) ($item->estimated_cost ? ($item->estimated_cost / max(1, $baseQty)) : ($product->base_cost ?? 0))
                ];
            } elseif ($product->supplier_id) {
                $sup = Supplier::find($product->supplier_id);
                if ($sup) {
                    $suppliersFound[$sup->id] = [
                        'supplier'  => $sup,
                        'unit_cost' => (float) ($product->base_cost ?? 0)
                    ];
                }
            }

            $histories = ProductCostHistory::with('supplier')
                ->where('product_id', $product->id)
                ->whereNotNull('supplier_id')
                ->selectRaw('supplier_id, MAX(id) as latest_id, unit_cost')
                ->groupBy('supplier_id', 'unit_cost')
                ->get();

            foreach ($histories as $h) {
                if ($h->supplier && !isset($suppliersFound[$h->supplier_id])) {
                    $suppliersFound[$h->supplier_id] = [
                        'supplier'  => $h->supplier,
                        'unit_cost' => (float) $h->unit_cost
                    ];
                }
            }

            $formatLine = function ($unitCost) use ($item, $product, $packaging, $factor, $packsCount, $packDisplay, $baseQty) {
                $costVal = (float) $unitCost;
                $packCost = round($costVal * $factor, 2);
                $totalEstimated = round($costVal * $baseQty, 2);

                return [
                    'id'                => $item->id,
                    'shopping_list_id'  => $item->id,
                    'product_id'        => $product->id,
                    'product_name'      => $product->name,
                    'suggested_qty'     => $baseQty,
                    'suggested_packs'   => $packsCount,
                    'pack_display'      => $packDisplay,
                    'uom'               => $packaging['base_uom'],
                    'purchase_uom'      => $packaging['purchase_uom'],
                    'conversion_factor' => $factor,
                    'is_pack'           => $packaging['is_pack'],
                    'urgency'           => $item->urgency_level,
                    'urgency_level'     => $item->urgency_level,
                    'last_cost'         => $costVal,
                    'pack_cost'         => $packCost,
                    'estimated_total'   => $totalEstimated,
                    'notes'             => $item->notes,
                ];
            };

            if (empty($suppliersFound)) {
                if (!isset($matrix[$unassignedKey])) {
                    $matrix[$unassignedKey] = [
                        'supplier_name'   => 'Compras Avulsas (Feira / Mercado)',
                        'order_days'      => [],
                        'estimated_total' => 0.0,
                        'items'           => []
                    ];
                }

                $cost = (float) ($item->estimated_cost ? ($item->estimated_cost / max(1, $baseQty)) : ($product->base_cost ?? 0));
                $line = $formatLine($cost);
                $matrix[$unassignedKey]['items'][] = $line;
                $matrix[$unassignedKey]['estimated_total'] = round($matrix[$unassignedKey]['estimated_total'] + $line['estimated_total'], 2);
            } else {
                foreach ($suppliersFound as $supId => $sData) {
                    $supplier = $sData['supplier'];

                    if (!isset($matrix[$supId])) {
                        $matrix[$supId] = [
                            'supplier_name'   => $supplier->trade_name ?: ($supplier->company_name ?: $supplier->name),
                            'order_days'      => is_array($supplier->order_days) ? $supplier->order_days : json_decode($supplier->order_days ?? '[]', true),
                            'estimated_total' => 0.0,
                            'items'           => []
                        ];
                    }

                    $line = $formatLine($sData['unit_cost']);
                    $matrix[$supId]['items'][] = $line;
                    $matrix[$supId]['estimated_total'] = round($matrix[$supId]['estimated_total'] + $line['estimated_total'], 2);
                }
            }
        }

        return $matrix;
    }

    public function approvePurchase(int $shoppingListId, int $supplierId, float $approvedQty, float $agreedCost): void
    {
        $item = ShoppingListItem::findOrFail($shoppingListId);

        $item->update([
            'supplier_id'    => $supplierId,
            'approved_qty'   => $approvedQty,
            'estimated_cost' => round($approvedQty * $agreedCost, 2),
            'status'         => 'ordered'
        ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/SupplyChain/ProductionPlanningService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\SupplyChain;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ProductionOrder;
use App\Models\TechnicalSheet;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\ShoppingListItem;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ProductionPlanningService
{
    public function generateDailyProductionOrders(): void
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();
        $mode = $settings->demand_forecast_mode ?? 'manual_par';

        // Busca apenas produtos que são produzidos internamente (WIP)
        $manufacturedProducts = Product::where('type', 'manufactured')
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->get();

        foreach ($manufacturedProducts as $product) {
            $targetQty = 0;

            if ($mode === 'manual_par') {
                $targetQty = (float) ($product->par_level ?? 0);
            } else {
                // Inteligência: Poderia buscar a média de vendas das últimas 4 semanas do mesmo dia
                // Aqui simplificaremos usando o par_level + um buffer de segurança
                $bufferDays = (int) ($settings->production_buffer_days ?? 1);
                $targetQty = ((float) ($product->par_level ?? 0)) * $bufferDays;
            }

            $currentStock = (float) ($product->current_stock ?? 0);
            $qtyToProduce = $targetQty - $currentStock;

            if ($qtyToProduce > 0) {
                // 1. Gera a Ordem para a Cozinha
                ProductionOrder::create([
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'planned_qty' => $qtyToProduce,
                    'status' => 'pending',
                    'due_date' => today(),
                ]);

                Log::info("👨‍🍳 [Produção] Ordem gerada: {$qtyToProduce}x {$product->name}");

                // 2. EXPLOSÃO DA FICHA TÉCNICA (BOM)
                // Vamos verificar se a produção disso vai esgotar os ingredientes do estoque!
                $ingredients = TechnicalSheet::where('parent_product_id', $product->id)->where('is_active', true)->get();

                foreach ($ingredients as $ingredientLine) {
                    $rawMaterial = Product::find($ingredientLine->ingredient_product_id);
                    if (!$rawMaterial || !$rawMaterial->track_inventory) continue;

                    // Quanto vamos consumir dessa matéria-prima para essa produção?
                    $neededQty = $qtyToProduce * (float) $ingredientLine->quantity;
                    $projectedStock = $rawMaterial->current_stock - $neededQty;

                    // Se a produção for zerar o estoque ou deixá-lo abaixo do mínimo, aciona as Compras!
                    if ($projectedStock <= (float) ($rawMaterial->min_stock ?? 0)) {
                        $suggestedPurchase = max(0, ($rawMaterial->max_stock ?? 0) - $projectedStock);

                        if ($suggestedPurchase > 0) {
                            ShoppingListItem::updateOrCreate(
                                ['product_id' => $rawMaterial->id, 'status' => 'pending'],
                                [
                                    'suggested_qty' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::raw("suggested_qty + {$suggestedPurchase}"),
                                    'urgency_level' => 'normal',
                                    'notes' => "Demanda gerada pela Ordem de Produção do item: {$product->name}"
                                ]
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Support/ProductFormatter.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Models\Product;

class ProductFormatter
{
    /**
     * Retorna a pílula HTML rica para exibir dentro do Dropdown aberto.
     */
    public static function getHtmlLabel(Product $product): string
    {
        $categoryName = $product->category?->name ?? 'Sem categoria';

        $typeLabel = match($product->type) {
            'ingredient' => 'Insumos',
            'resale' => 'Revendas',
            'packaging' => 'Embalagens',
            'consumable' => 'Consumos',
            'dish' => 'Pratos',
            'combo' => 'Combos',
            'manufactured' => 'Preparados',
            default => 'Outros',
        };

        return "
            <div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%;'>
                <span style='font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-color);'>{$product->name}</span>
                <span style='font-size: 0.70rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9ca3af; margin-left: 0.5rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden;'>
                    {$typeLabel} &rsaquo; {$categoryName}
                </span>
            </div>
        ";
    }

    /**
     * Retorna o texto limpo para exibir quando o item já está selecionado na caixa.
     */
    public static function getCleanLabel(Product $product): string
    {
        $categoryName = $product->category?->name ?? 'Sem categoria';

        return "{$product->name} — ({$categoryName})";
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\BankStatement;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ImportBankStatementsSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        // Certifique-se de que o ficheiro conciliacao-bancaria.csv está na raiz do projeto
        $csvFile = base_path('storage/app/conciliacao-bancaria.csv');

        if (!file_exists($csvFile)) {
            $this->command->error("⚠️ Arquivo conciliacao-bancaria.csv não encontrado na raiz do projeto!");
            return;
        }

        $file = fopen($csvFile, 'r');
        $header = fgetcsv($file); // Lê o cabeçalho
        $count = 0;

        $this->command->info("Iniciando a importação do Histórico de Conciliação Bancária...");

        while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
            // Evita linhas em branco ou mal formatadas
            if (count($header) !== count($row)) continue;
            
            $data = array_combine($header, $row);

            // Se não tiver ID da transação, não conseguimos rastrear, então saltamos
            if (empty($data['id_transacao_banco'])) {
                continue;
            }

            $amount = (float) $data['valor_banco'];
            
            // Mapeia o status do seu sistema antigo para o novo
            $status = match($data['status_conciliacao']) {
                'Pendente no Sistema' => 'pending',
                'Conciliado' => 'reconciled',
                'Ignorado' => 'ignored',
                default => 'pending',
            };

            // Cria ou atualiza a linha do extrato
            BankStatement::updateOrCreate(
                ['fitid' => trim($data['id_transacao_banco'])], // O ID único que vem do banco
                [
                    'bank_date' => $data['data_no_banco'],
                    'description' => $data['historico_banco'],
                    'amount' => $amount,
                    'type' => $amount >= 0 ? 'credit' : 'debit',
                    'status' => $status,
                ]
            );
            $count++;
        }

        fclose($file);
        $this->command->info("✅ Mágica feita! {$count} linhas de extrato foram importadas para o painel.");
    }
}
```

## File: database/seeders/SyncFuzzyOrdersSeeder.php
```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Customer;

class SyncFuzzyOrdersSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        // Pega apenas os pedidos que AINDA estão órfãos
        $orders = Order::whereNull('customer_id')
                       ->whereNotNull('customer_name')
                       ->where('customer_name', '!=', '')
                       ->get();

        $count = 0;

        foreach ($orders as $order) {
            // 1. Limpa espaços fantasmas do início e do fim
            $cleanName = trim($order->customer_name);
            
            // Ignora o genérico do WhatsApp para não bagunçar
            if (str_contains(strtolower($cleanName), 'avulso')) {
                continue; 
            }

            // TENTATIVA 1: Nome exato, mas sem espaços fantasmas
            $customer = Customer::where('name', $cleanName)->first();

            // TENTATIVA 2: Busca aproximada (LIKE)
            if (!$customer) {
                // Procura clientes que contenham esse nome no meio do seu nome completo
                $possibleCustomers = Customer::where('name', 'LIKE', '%' . $cleanName . '%')->get();
                
                // Só amarra se tiver certeza absoluta (apenas 1 resultado)
                if ($possibleCustomers->count() === 1) {
                    $customer = $possibleCustomers->first();
                }
            }

            // Se o nosso detetive encontrou o cliente, fazemos o match!
            if ($customer) {
                $order->customer_id = $customer->id;
                $order->timestamps = false; // Não muda a data original do pedido
                $order->save();
                
                $count++;
                $this->command->line("Ligado: Pedido #{$order->id} ({$cleanName}) -> Cliente ID {$customer->id} ({$customer->name})");
            }
        }

        $this->command->info("==== RESULTADO DA BUSCA INTELIGENTE ====");
        $this->command->info("- Mais {$count} pedidos foram resgatados e ligados aos clientes corretos!");
    }
}
```

## File: database/seeders/SyncOrderCustomersSeeder.php
```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Customer;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class SyncOrderCustomersSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        // Pega todos os pedidos que não têm ID de cliente, mas têm o Nome preenchido
        $orders = Order::whereNull('customer_id')
                       ->whereNotNull('customer_name')
                       ->where('customer_name', '!=', '')
                       ->get();

        $count = 0;
        $notFound = 0;

        $this->command->warn("Iniciando sincronização de " . $orders->count() . " pedidos órfãos...");

        foreach ($orders as $order) {
            // Procura o cliente na tabela de clientes com exatamente o mesmo nome
            $customer = Customer::where('name', $order->customer_name)->first();

            if ($customer) {
                // Se encontrou, liga o ID do cliente ao pedido!
                $order->customer_id = $customer->id;
                
                // Desligamos os timestamps temporariamente para não alterar a data de "atualização" original do pedido
                $order->timestamps = false; 
                $order->save();
                
                $count++;
            } else {
                $notFound++;
            }
        }

        $this->command->info("==== RESULTADO DA SINCRONIZAÇÃO ====");
        $this->command->info("- Sucesso: {$count} pedidos agora estão perfeitamente ligados aos clientes!");
        
        if ($notFound > 0) {
            $this->command->error("- Atenção: {$notFound} pedidos continuam órfãos porque o cliente não foi encontrado na nova base de dados.");
        }
    }
}
```

## File: database/seeders/WpCategoriesSeeder.php
```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\Category;

class WpCategoriesSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $csvFile = base_path('storage/app/categories.csv');
        
        if (!file_exists($csvFile)) {
            $this->command->error("Ficheiro categories.csv não encontrado!");
            return;
        }

        $file = fopen($csvFile, 'r');
        fgetcsv($file); // Pula o cabeçalho

        $categoriesData = [];

        // Lê todos os dados para a memória
        while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
            if (!isset($row[0]) || trim($row[0]) === '') continue;

            $categoriesData[] = [
                'id' => trim($row[0]),
                'name' => trim($row[1]),
                'slug' => trim($row[2]),
                'parent_id' => (int) trim($row[3]),
                'description' => trim($row[4]),
            ];
        }
        fclose($file);

        // ==========================================
        // VOLTA 1: Cria todas as categorias (sem pai)
        // ==========================================
        $count = 0;
        foreach ($categoriesData as $data) {
            Category::updateOrCreate(
                ['id' => $data['id']],
                [
                    'name' => $data['name'],
                    'slug' => $data['slug'],
                    'description' => $data['description'],
                    'type' => 'external',
                    'is_active' => true,
                    'sort_order' => 0,
                    'parent_id' => null, // Ignoramos o pai por enquanto
                ]
            );
            $count++;
        }

        // ==========================================
        // VOLTA 2: Atualiza a hierarquia (Quem é filho de quem)
        // ==========================================
        $parentCount = 0;
        foreach ($categoriesData as $data) {
            if ($data['parent_id'] > 0) {
                $cat = Category::find($data['id']);
                // Garante que a categoria pai realmente existe no banco antes de ligar
                if ($cat && Category::where('id', $data['parent_id'])->exists()) {
                    $cat->update(['parent_id' => $data['parent_id']]);
                    $parentCount++;
                }
            }
        }

        $this->command->info("PERFEITO! {$count} Categorias criadas e {$parentCount} subcategorias organizadas na hierarquia!");
    }
}
```

## File: database/seeders/WpCombosSeeder.php
```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\ComboGroup;
use App\Models\ComboItem;

class WpCombosSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        Product::unguard();
        ComboGroup::unguard();
        ComboItem::unguard();

        ComboItem::query()->delete();
        ComboGroup::query()->delete();

        $categoriaCombo = Category::firstOrCreate(
            ['name' => 'Combos'],
            [
                'slug' => Str::slug('Combos'),
                'type' => 'external',
                'is_active' => true,
                'sort_order' => 0,
            ]
        );

        // =========================================================================
        // PARTE 1: CRIAR OS PRODUTOS DO TIPO "COMBO"
        // =========================================================================
        $csvCombos = base_path('storage/app/combos.csv');
        if (file_exists($csvCombos)) {
            $file = fopen($csvCombos, 'r');
            fgetcsv($file); // Pula cabeçalho
            $comboCount = 0;

            while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
                // Previne linhas em branco ou lixo do CSV
                if (!isset($row[0]) || trim($row[0]) === '') continue;
                
                $id = trim($row[0]);
                
                // Se o ID não for um número, é um "pedaço" de uma descrição que quebrou a linha. Ignoramos!
                if (!is_numeric($id)) continue; 

                $nome = trim($row[1] ?? 'Combo Sem Nome');
                $status = trim($row[2] ?? 'publish') === 'publish' ? 'available' : 'unavailable';
                $descricao = trim($row[3] ?? '');
                
                // O ?? '0' protege contra o erro Undefined array key 4
                $precoRaw = trim($row[4] ?? '0');
                $preco = $precoRaw === '' ? 0 : (float) str_replace(',', '.', $precoRaw);

                Product::updateOrCreate(
                    ['id' => $id],
                    [
                        'name' => $nome,
                        'type' => 'combo',
                        'description' => $descricao,
                        'dine_in_price' => $preco,
                        'delivery_price' => $preco,
                        'status' => $status,
                        'category_id' => $categoriaCombo->id,
                        'track_inventory' => false,
                        'unit_of_measure' => 'UN',
                    ]
                );
                $comboCount++;
            }
            fclose($file);
            $this->command->info("PARTE 1: {$comboCount} Combos criados como Produtos com sucesso!");
        } else {
            $this->command->error("Arquivo combos.csv não encontrado.");
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // PARTE 2: MONTAR O WIZARD (GRUPOS E ITENS)
        // =========================================================================
        $csvSteps = base_path('storage/app/combo-steps.csv');
        if (file_exists($csvSteps)) {
            $file = fopen($csvSteps, 'r');
            fgetcsv($file); // Pula cabeçalho
            $groupCount = 0;
            $itemCount = 0;

            while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
                if (!isset($row[0]) || trim($row[0]) === '') continue;

                $comboId = trim($row[0]);
                if (!is_numeric($comboId)) continue;

                $tituloPasso = trim($row[3] ?? 'Escolha uma opção');
                $tipoRestricao = trim($row[4] ?? 'products'); 
                $qtdPermitida = (int) trim($row[5] ?? '1');
                
                if (!Product::where('id', $comboId)->exists()) continue;

                $group = ComboGroup::create([
                    'product_id' => $comboId,
                    'name' => $tituloPasso,
                    'min_choices' => $qtdPermitida, 
                    'max_choices' => $qtdPermitida > 0 ? $qtdPermitida : 1,
                ]);
                $groupCount++;

                if ($tipoRestricao === 'products') {
                    $serializedIds = trim($row[6] ?? '');
                    
                    if (!empty($serializedIds) && $serializedIds !== 'null') {
                        $productIds = @unserialize($serializedIds); 
                        
                        if (is_array($productIds)) {
                            foreach ($productIds as $pId) {
                                if (Product::where('id', $pId)->exists()) {
                                    ComboItem::create([
                                        'combo_group_id' => $group->id,
                                        'product_id' => $pId,
                                        'additional_price' => 0,
                                    ]);
                                    $itemCount++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } elseif ($tipoRestricao === 'category') {
                    $categoryId = trim($row[7] ?? '');
                    
                    if (!empty($categoryId) && $categoryId !== 'null') {
                        if (Category::where('id', $categoryId)->exists()) {
                            ComboItem::create([
                                'combo_group_id' => $group->id,
                                'category_id' => $categoryId,
                                'additional_price' => 0,
                            ]);
                            $itemCount++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            fclose($file);
            $this->command->info("PARTE 2: {$groupCount} Etapas do Wizard e {$itemCount} Itens internos vinculados perfeitamente!");
        } else {
            $this->command->error("Arquivo combo-steps.csv não encontrado.");
        }
    }
}
```

## File: database/seeders/WpCustomersSeeder.php
```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Address;
use App\Models\Street;
use App\Models\Neighborhood;

class WpCustomersSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $csvFile = base_path('storage/app/clientes.csv');
        
        if (!file_exists($csvFile)) {
            $this->command->error("Ficheiro não encontrado no caminho: {$csvFile}");
            return;
        }

        $file = fopen($csvFile, 'r');
        fgetcsv($file); // Pula o cabeçalho
        
        $count = 0;

        while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
            // Índices do CSV:
            // 0:id, 1:nome, 2:email, 3:telefone, 4:cpf, 5:data_nascimento, 6:wc_rua, 7:wc_numero, 8:wc_bairro, 9:enderecos_app

            // 1. LIMPEZA DOS DADOS PESSOAIS
            $nome = trim($row[1]);
            $email = (strtolower(trim($row[2])) === 'null' || empty(trim($row[2]))) ? null : trim($row[2]);
            $telefone = trim($row[3]);
            $cpf = trim($row[4]);
            $dataNasc = (strtolower(trim($row[5])) === 'null' || empty(trim($row[5]))) ? null : trim($row[5]);

            $cpf = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $cpf);
            $telefone = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $telefone);

            if (empty($cpf)) continue; 

            // 2. SALVAR O CLIENTE
            $customer = Customer::updateOrCreate(
                ['cpf' => $cpf],
                [
                    'name' => $nome,
                    'email' => $email,
                    'phone' => $telefone,
                    'birth_date' => $dataNasc ?? '1900-01-01',
                ]
            );

            $enderecosParaSalvar = [];

            // 3. RECUPERAR ENDEREÇOS PADRÃO (WooCommerce)
            $wcRua = trim($row[6]);
            if (strtolower($wcRua) !== 'null' && !empty($wcRua)) {
                $wcNumero = trim($row[7]);
                $isSemNumero = empty($wcNumero) || strtoupper($wcNumero) === 'S/N';

                $enderecosParaSalvar[] = [
                    'nickname' => 'Casa', // O padrão para o WC é Casa
                    'street' => $wcRua,
                    'number' => $isSemNumero ? 'S/N' : $wcNumero,
                    'no_number' => $isSemNumero,
                    'district' => trim($row[8]),
                    'complement' => null,
                    'reference' => 'Site WooCommerce',
                    'location_link' => null,
                ];
            }

            // 4. RECUPERAR ENDEREÇOS DO APP (Array Serializado)
            $serializado = trim($row[9]);
            if (strtolower($serializado) !== 'null' && !empty($serializado)) {
                $enderecosApp = @unserialize($serializado); 
                
                if (is_array($enderecosApp)) {
                    foreach ($enderecosApp as $end) {
                        $numeroApp = trim($end['number'] ?? '');
                        $isSemNumeroApp = empty($numeroApp) || strtoupper($numeroApp) === 'S/N';
                        
                        // Garante que o nickname seja um dos aceites (senão, cai no "Outro")
                        $rawNickname = ucfirst(strtolower(trim($end['nickname'] ?? 'Casa')));
                        $validNicknames = ['Casa', 'Trabalho', 'Amor', 'Pai/Mãe', 'Outro'];
                        $nicknameFinal = in_array($rawNickname, $validNicknames) ? $rawNickname : 'Outro';

                        $enderecosParaSalvar[] = [
                            'nickname' => $nicknameFinal,
                            'street' => $end['street'] ?? '',
                            'number' => $isSemNumeroApp ? 'S/N' : $numeroApp,
                            'no_number' => $isSemNumeroApp,
                            'district' => $end['district'] ?? '',
                            'complement' => $end['complement'] ?? null,
                            'reference' => $end['reference'] ?? null,
                            'location_link' => $end['location_link'] ?? null, // Se existia link no WP, resgatamos!
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }

            // 5. SALVAR OS ENDEREÇOS NO BANCO DE DADOS
            foreach ($enderecosParaSalvar as $endData) {
                if (empty($endData['street']) || empty($endData['district'])) continue;

                $street = Street::firstOrCreate(['name' => $endData['street']]);
                
                $neighborhood = Neighborhood::firstOrCreate(
                    ['name' => $endData['district']],
                    ['delivery_fee' => 0]
                );

                Address::firstOrCreate([
                    'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                    'street_id' => $street->id,
                    'neighborhood_id' => $neighborhood->id,
                    'number' => $endData['number'],
                    'nickname' => $endData['nickname'],
                ], [
                    'no_number' => $endData['no_number'],
                    'complement' => $endData['complement'],
                    'reference' => $endData['reference'],
                    'location_link' => $endData['location_link'],
                ]);
            }
            $count++;
        }
        
        fclose($file);
        $this->command->info("Fantástico! {$count} Clientes com os seus endereços otimizados (Apelidos e GPS) foram importados!");
    }
}
```

## File: database/seeders/WpFixModifiersSeeder.php
```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ProductModifier;
use App\Models\ModifierOption;

class WpFixModifiersSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        // =========================================================================
        // PASSO 1: FAXINA (Apagar todos os modificadores duplicados)
        // =========================================================================
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;');
        DB::table('modifier_options')->truncate();
        DB::table('product_modifier')->truncate();
        DB::table('modifier_groups')->truncate();
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;');

        $this->command->warn("Faxina concluída: Modificadores duplicados removidos.");

        // =========================================================================
        // PASSO 2: DESLIGAR A TRAVA E IMPORTAR COM OS IDs ORIGINAIS
        // =========================================================================
        
        // A MAGIA ESTÁ AQUI: Isso permite injetarmos o ID manualmente!
        ProductModifier::unguard(); 
        ModifierOption::unguard();

        $csvModifiers = base_path('storage/app/modifiers-with-id.csv');
        
        if (file_exists($csvModifiers)) {
            $file = fopen($csvModifiers, 'r');
            fgetcsv($file); // Pula cabeçalho
            $modCount = 0;

            while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
                if (count($row) < 9) continue;

                $idGrupo = trim($row[0]);
                $grupoNome = trim($row[1]);
                $min = (int) trim($row[3]);
                $max = (int) trim($row[4]);
                $ordem = (int) trim($row[5]);
                $opcaoNome = trim($row[6]);
                
                $precoRaw = trim($row[7]);
                $preco = $precoRaw === '' ? 0 : (float) str_replace(',', '.', $precoRaw);
                $status = trim($row[8]) === 'disponivel';

                if (empty($idGrupo) || empty($grupoNome) || empty($opcaoNome)) continue;

                $type = 'add_on';
                if (stripos($grupoNome, 'Obs.') !== false) $type = 'observation';
                if (stripos($grupoNome, 'Ingrediente') !== false) $type = 'ingredient';

                // Usamos firstOrCreate para garantir que o Grupo só é criado UMA vez
                $group = ProductModifier::firstOrCreate(
                    ['id' => $idGrupo], // Busca
                    [
                        'id' => $idGrupo, // FORÇA O ID DO WORDPRESS AQUI!
                        'name' => $grupoNome,
                        'type' => $type,
                        'is_active' => true,
                        'min_selections' => $min,
                        'max_selections' => $max > 0 ? $max : 10,
                    ]
                );

                // Cria as opções dentro do grupo
                $group->options()->updateOrCreate(
                    ['name' => $opcaoNome],
                    [
                        'price' => $preco,
                        'sort_order' => $ordem,
                        'is_active' => $status,
                    ]
                );
                $modCount++;
            }
            fclose($file);
            $this->command->info("SUCESSO: {$modCount} opções criadas COM OS IDs EXATOS (Sem duplicação)!");
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // PASSO 3: REFAZER OS LINKS DOS PRODUTOS
        // =========================================================================
        $csvProducts = base_path('storage/app/products-with-modifiers.csv');
        
        if (file_exists($csvProducts)) {
            $file = fopen($csvProducts, 'r');
            fgetcsv($file);
            $syncCount = 0;

            while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
                if (!isset($row[0]) || !isset($row[19])) continue;

                $productId = trim($row[0]);
                $modIdsString = trim(trim($row[19]), '"'); 

                if (empty($modIdsString)) continue;

                $modifierIds = array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $modIdsString)));

                if (count($modifierIds) > 0) {
                    $product = Product::find($productId);
                    if ($product) {
                        // Agora sim, os IDs existem no banco e o link vai funcionar!
                        $product->modifiers()->syncWithoutDetaching($modifierIds);
                        $syncCount++;
                    }
                }
            }
            fclose($file);
            $this->command->info("ESPETÁCULO: {$syncCount} Produtos linkados aos modificadores corretos!");
        }
    }
}
```

```php
namespace Database\Seeders;

class WpLocationsSeeder extends Seeder

    public function run(): void

        $bairrosCsv = base_path('storage/app/bairros.csv');
        
        if (file_exists($bairrosCsv)) {
            $file = fopen($bairrosCsv, 'r');
            fgetcsv($file); // Pula o cabeçalho
            
            while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
                // Índices: 0=id, 1=nome, 2=taxa, 3=frete_gratis
                $freteGratis = (isset($row[3]) && trim($row[3]) !== '') ? (float) $row[3] : null;

                Neighborhood::firstOrCreate(
                    ['name' => trim($row[1])], 
                    [
                        'delivery_fee' => (float) $row[2],
                        'free_shipping_over' => $freteGratis
                    ] 
                );
            }
            fclose($file);
            $this->command->info('Bairros importados com sucesso!');
        } else {
            $this->command->error('Ficheiro bairros.csv não encontrado no caminho: ' . $bairrosCsv);
        }

        // 2. IMPORTAR RUAS E CONECTAR AOS BAIRROS
        $ruasCsv = base_path('storage/app/ruas.csv');
        
        if (file_exists($ruasCsv)) {
            $file = fopen($ruasCsv, 'r');
            fgetcsv($file); // Pula o cabeçalho
            
            while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
                // Índices: 0=id, 1=nome, 2=bairro, 3=num_ini, 4=num_fim
                $nomeRua = trim($row[1]);
                $nomeBairro = trim($row[2]);
                $numInicial = (int) ($row[3] ?? 0);
                $numFinal = (isset($row[4]) && trim($row[4]) !== '') ? (int) $row[4] : null;

                $street = Street::firstOrCreate(
                    ['name' => $nomeRua]
                );

                $neighborhood = Neighborhood::where('name', $nomeBairro)->first();

                if ($neighborhood) {
                    $street->segments()->firstOrCreate([
                        'neighborhood_id' => $neighborhood->id,
                        'start_number' => $numInicial,
                        'end_number' => $numFinal,
                        'zip_code' => null,
                    ]);
                }
            }
            fclose($file);
            $this->command->info('Ruas e Faixas importadas com sucesso!');
        } else {
            $this->command->error('Ficheiro ruas.csv não encontrado no caminho: ' . $ruasCsv);
        }
    }
}
```

## File: database/seeders/WpOrdersSeeder.php
```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\OrderItemModifier;
use App\Models\Product; // Precisamos do Model Product para a verificação

class WpOrdersSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        Order::unguard();
        OrderItem::unguard();
        OrderItemModifier::unguard();

        // 1. FAXINA DOS PEDIDOS ANTERIORES
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;');
        DB::table('order_item_modifiers')->truncate();
        DB::table('order_items')->truncate();
        DB::table('orders')->truncate();
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;');

        $csvFile = base_path('storage/app/sessions-with-items.csv');
        
        if (!file_exists($csvFile)) {
            $this->command->error("Arquivo {$csvFile} não encontrado!");
            return;
        }

        $lines = file($csvFile, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES);
        
        // Remove a primeira linha (cabeçalho)
        array_shift($lines);

        if (empty($lines)) {
            $this->command->error("ERRO CRÍTICO: O ficheiro CSV está vazio!");
            return;
        }

        $ordersGrouped = [];

        // 2. PARSER AVANÇADO (Lê o CSV usando "Raio-X")
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            $line = trim($line);

            // Procura o padrão exato do final da linha
            if (!preg_match('/,(\d+\.\d{2}),(\d+\.\d{2}),(\d+\.\d{2}),([^,]*),(.*),([^,]+),([^,\s]+)$/', $line, $endMatches, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE)) {
                continue;
            }

            $qtd = (float) $endMatches[1][0];
            $preco = (float) $endMatches[2][0];
            $total = (float) $endMatches[3][0];
            $adicionais_json = $endMatches[5][0];
            $status_item = trim($endMatches[7][0]);

            $prefixLength = $endMatches[0][1];
            $prefix = substr($line, 0, $prefixLength);

            // Procura os marcadores fixos no meio da linha
            if (!preg_match('/,(counter|table|delivery|pickup),([^,]+),(\d+),(\d*),/', $prefix, $midMatches, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE)) {
                continue;
            }

            $modalidade = $midMatches[1][0];
            $status_pedido = $midMatches[2][0];
            $id_item = $midMatches[3][0];
            $id_prod = $midMatches[4][0];

            $leftLength = $midMatches[0][1];
            $left = substr($prefix, 0, $leftLength);
            $nome_prod = trim(substr($prefix, $leftLength + strlen($midMatches[0][0])));

            $comma1 = strpos($left, ',');
            $comma2 = strpos($left, ',', $comma1 + 1);

            $id_pedido = substr($left, 0, $comma1);
            $data_pedido = substr($left, $comma1 + 1, $comma2 - $comma1 - 1);
            $nome_cliente = trim(substr($left, $comma2 + 1));

            if (!isset($ordersGrouped[$id_pedido])) {
                $ordersGrouped[$id_pedido] = [
                    'id_pedido' => $id_pedido,
                    'data_pedido' => $data_pedido,
                    'nome_cliente' => $nome_cliente,
                    'modalidade' => $modalidade,
                    'status_pedido' => $status_pedido,
                    'status_item' => $status_item,
                    'items' => []
                ];
            }

            $ordersGrouped[$id_pedido]['items'][] = [
                'id_produto' => $id_prod,
                'nome_produto' => $nome_prod,
                'quantidade' => $qtd,
                'preco_unitario' => $preco,
                'total_item' => $total,
                'adicionais_json' => $adicionais_json
            ];
        }

        $orderCount = 0; $itemCount = 0; $modCount = 0;

        // VERIFICAÇÃO DE SEGURANÇA: Pega todos os IDs de produtos que realmente existem no banco!
        $validProductIds = Product::pluck('id')->toArray();

        // 3. INSERÇÃO NA BASE DE DADOS
        foreach ($ordersGrouped as $orderId => $info) {
            
            $totalPedido = array_sum(array_column($info['items'], 'total_item'));

            $customerName = $info['nome_cliente'];
            $tableNumber = null;
            
            if (preg_match('/^Mesa\s+(\d+)$/i', $customerName, $matches)) {
                $tableNumber = $matches[1];
                $customerName = null;
            } else if (strtolower($customerName) === 'principal' || strtolower($customerName) === 'null') {
                $customerName = 'Balcão Expresso';
            }

            $paymentStatus = 'pending';
            if ($info['status_item'] === 'paid') $paymentStatus = 'paid';
            if ($info['status_pedido'] === 'cancelled') $paymentStatus = 'cancelled';

            $order = Order::create([
                'id' => $orderId,
                'customer_name' => $customerName,
                'table_number' => $tableNumber,
                'type' => $info['modalidade'],
                'status' => $info['status_pedido'],
                'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                'total' => $totalPedido,
                'subtotal' => $totalPedido,
                'created_at' => $info['data_pedido'],
                'updated_at' => $info['data_pedido'],
            ]);
            $orderCount++;

            foreach ($info['items'] as $itemRow) {
                
                // MÁGICA AQUI: Se o ID vier vazio ou o produto não existir mais no banco, deixa como NULL.
                $prodId = !empty($itemRow['id_produto']) ? (int) $itemRow['id_produto'] : null;
                if ($prodId && !in_array($prodId, $validProductIds)) {
                    $prodId = null; 
                }

                $orderItem = OrderItem::create([
                    'order_id' => $order->id,
                    'product_id' => $prodId, // Usa o ID verificado e seguro
                    'product_name' => $itemRow['nome_produto'],
                    'quantity' => $itemRow['quantidade'],
                    'unit_price' => $itemRow['preco_unitario'],
                    'total_price' => $itemRow['total_item'],
                ]);
                $itemCount++;

                // LIGAÇÃO DOS MODIFICADORES
                $jsonMod = $itemRow['adicionais_json'];
                if (!empty($jsonMod) && $jsonMod !== 'null' && $jsonMod !== '[]') {
                    $adicionais = json_decode($jsonMod, true);
                    if (is_array($adicionais)) {
                        foreach ($adicionais as $add) {
                            OrderItemModifier::create([
                                'order_item_id' => $orderItem->id,
                                'name' => $add['name'] ?? 'Adicional',
                                'price' => isset($add['price']) ? (float) $add['price'] : 0,
                                'quantity' => isset($add['qty']) ? (int) $add['qty'] : 1,
                            ]);
                            $modCount++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $this->command->info("==== RESUMO DA IMPORTAÇÃO ====");
        $this->command->line("- Pedidos Gerados: {$orderCount}");
        $this->command->line("- Itens de Cardápio: {$itemCount}");
        $this->command->line("- Modificadores Inseridos: {$modCount}");
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Models\BankAccount;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;

class WpPaymentMethodsSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        BankAccount::unguard();
        PaymentMethod::unguard();

        // Limpeza de segurança
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;');
        DB::table('payment_methods')->truncate();
        DB::table('bank_accounts')->truncate();
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;');

        // 1. CRIAR AS CONTAS BANCÁRIAS BASE
        $cofre = BankAccount::create([
            'name' => 'Cofre (Dinheiro em Espécie)',
            'type' => 'vault',
            'initial_balance' => 0,
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $bancoPrincipal = BankAccount::create([
            'name' => 'Conta Corrente Principal',
            'type' => 'checking',
            'initial_balance' => 0,
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        // 2. IMPORTAR FORMAS DE PAGAMENTO
        $csvFile = base_path('storage/app/payment-methods.csv');
        
        if (!file_exists($csvFile)) {
            $this->command->error("Arquivo {$csvFile} não encontrado!");
            return;
        }

        $file = fopen($csvFile, 'r');
        fgetcsv($file); // Pula o cabeçalho
        $count = 0;

        while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
            if (!isset($row[0])) continue;

            $id = trim($row[0]);
            $nome = trim($row[1]);
            $categoria = trim($row[2]);
            $engine = trim($row[3]);
            $fiscal = trim($row[4]) === 'null' ? null : trim($row[4]);
            $pos = trim($row[5]) === '1';
            $delivery = trim($row[6]) === '1';
            $ativo = trim($row[7]) === '1';
            $icone = trim($row[8]);

            // INTELIGÊNCIA DE ROTEAMENTO
            $destinationId = null;
            
            if ($engine === 'money') {
                // Dinheiro vai para o Cofre
                $destinationId = $cofre->id;
            } elseif (in_array($engine, ['manual', 'pix_sicredi']) && !in_array($categoria, ['Perdas', 'null'])) {
                // Pix, Débito e Crédito vão para o Banco Principal
                $destinationId = $bancoPrincipal->id;
            }

            PaymentMethod::create([
                'id' => $id,
                'name' => $nome,
                'category' => $categoria === 'null' ? null : $categoria,
                'engine_type' => $engine,
                'fiscal_code' => $fiscal,
                'show_on_pos' => $pos,
                'show_on_delivery' => $delivery,
                'is_active' => $ativo,
                'icon' => $icone,
                'destination_account_id' => $destinationId,
            ]);
            
            $count++;
        }
        fclose($file);

        $this->command->info("==== SUCESSO ====");
        $this->command->line("- Contas Criadas: Cofre e Conta Principal");
        $this->command->line("- Formas de Pagamento importadas: {$count}");
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Category;

class WpProductCategorySeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        // Certifique-se de que o nome do ficheiro bate certo com o que fez upload!
        $csvFile = base_path('storage/app/products-categoies.csv'); 
        
        if (!file_exists($csvFile)) {
            $this->command->error("Ficheiro products-categoies.csv não encontrado!");
            return;
        }

        $file = fopen($csvFile, 'r');
        fgetcsv($file); // Pula o cabeçalho
        $count = 0;

        while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
            // A coluna 0 é o ID do produto, a coluna 2 é o Nome da Categoria
            if (!isset($row[0]) || !isset($row[2]) || trim($row[0]) === '') continue;

            $productId = trim($row[0]);
            $categoryName = trim($row[2]);

            if (empty($categoryName)) continue;

            // Procura a categoria pelo nome exato que veio do CSV
            $category = Category::where('name', $categoryName)->first();

            if ($category) {
                // Se encontrou a categoria, atualiza o produto com o ID dela
                $updated = Product::where('id', $productId)->update([
                    'category_id' => $category->id
                ]);

                if ($updated) {
                    $count++;
                }
            }
        }

        fclose($file);
        
        // Limpeza opcional: Se a categoria "Cardápio Geral" ficou vazia, podemos avisar
        $produtosPerdidos = Product::whereHas('category', function($q) {
            $q->where('name', 'Cardápio Geral');
        })->count();

        $this->command->info("ORGANIZAÇÃO CONCLUÍDA: {$count} Produtos movidos para as categorias corretas!");
        if ($produtosPerdidos > 0) {
            $this->command->warn("Atenção: {$produtosPerdidos} produtos continuam na categoria 'Cardápio Geral' pois não tinham categoria no CSV.");
        }
    }
}
```

```php
        $syncCount = 0;

            if (!isset($row[0]) || trim($row[0]) === '') {

            $statusRaw = strtolower(trim($row[7] ?? 'disponivel'));
            $statusFinal = match($statusRaw) {
                'indisponivel' => 'unavailable',
                'oculto' => 'hidden',
                default => 'available',
            };

            // Booleanos (1 ou 0)
            $controlaEstoque = trim($row[4] ?? '0') === '1';
            $exigePreparo = trim($row[8] ?? '0') === '1';
            $exibirDelivery = trim($row[10] ?? '1') === '1';
            $exibirMesa = trim($row[11] ?? '1') === '1';
            $apenasAdultos = trim($row[12] ?? '0') === '1';
            $geraFidelidade = trim($row[13] ?? '0') === '1';

            // Cria ou Atualiza o Produto FORÇANDO o ID do WordPress
            $product = Product::updateOrCreate(
                ['id' => $id],
                [
                    'category_id' => $categoriaPadrao->id,
                    'name' => trim($row[1] ?? 'Produto Sem Nome'),
                    'type' => trim($row[20] ?? 'resale'),
                    'unit_of_measure' => strtoupper(trim($row[21] ?? 'UN')),
                    
                    // Preços
                    'base_cost' => $custoBase,
                    'dine_in_price' => $precoBase,
                    'delivery_price' => $precoBase, // Copiamos o base para o delivery por padrão
                    'promo_price' => $precoPromo > 0 ? $precoPromo : null,
                    
                    // Estoque
                    'track_inventory' => $controlaEstoque,
                    'current_stock' => (float) str_replace(',', '.', trim($row[5] ?? '0')),
                    'min_stock' => (float) str_replace(',', '.', trim($row[6] ?? '0')),
                    
                    // Configurações e Regras
                    'status' => $statusFinal,
                    'requires_preparation' => $exigePreparo,
                    'show_on_delivery' => $exibirDelivery,
                    'show_on_menu' => $exibirMesa,
                    'is_age_restricted' => $apenasAdultos,
                    'loyalty_reward' => $geraFidelidade,
                    'print_station_id' => trim($row[9] ?? null) ?: null,
                    
                    // Fiscal
                    'fiscal_ncm' => trim($row[14] ?? ''),
                    'fiscal_cest' => trim($row[15] ?? ''),
                    'fiscal_cfop' => trim($row[16] ?? ''),
                    'fiscal_origin' => trim($row[17] ?? '0'),
                    'fiscal_csosn' => trim($row[18] ?? ''),
                ]
            );

            $count++;

            // ==========================================
            // A MÁGICA DA LIGAÇÃO COM OS MODIFICADORES
            // ==========================================
            $modIdsString = trim(trim($row[19] ?? ''), '"');
            if (!empty($modIdsString)) {
                $modifierIds = array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $modIdsString)));
                if (count($modifierIds) > 0) {
                    $product->modifiers()->syncWithoutDetaching($modifierIds);
                    $syncCount++;
                }
            }
        }

        fclose($file);
        $this->command->info("ESPETÁCULO! {$count} Produtos importados e {$syncCount} deles já ligados aos Modificadores!");
    }
}
```
