## File: database/seeders/WpTransactionsSeeder.php
```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Models\BankAccount;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\Order;

class WpTransactionsSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        Transaction::unguard();

        // Limpeza de segurança
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;');
        DB::table('transactions')->truncate();
        DB::statement('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;');

        $csvFile = base_path('storage/app/cash-movements.csv');
        
        if (!file_exists($csvFile)) {
            $this->command->error("Arquivo {$csvFile} não encontrado!");
            return;
        }

        // Descobre o Cofre para jogar o dinheiro físico
        $cofre = BankAccount::where('type', 'vault')->first();

        $file = fopen($csvFile, 'r');
        fgetcsv($file); // Pula o cabeçalho
        $count = 0;

        while (($row = fgetcsv($file)) !== false) {
            // fgetcsv lida perfeitamente com vírgulas dentro de textos entre aspas!
            if (!isset($row[0])) continue;

            $dataHora = trim($row[1]);
            $operador = trim($row[2]);
            $sessaoCaixa = trim($row[3]);
            $tipoMovimento = trim($row[5]);
            $formaPagamento = trim($row[6]);
            $valor = (float) trim($row[7]);
            $descricao = trim($row[8]);
            $pedidoId = trim($row[9]);

            // Define se é Entrada (in) ou Saída (out)
            $type = in_array($tipoMovimento, ['sale', 'supply']) ? 'in' : 'out';

            // Define a Conta Bancária e o Método de Pagamento
            $bankAccountId = null;
            $paymentMethodId = null;

            if ($formaPagamento === 'money') {
                $bankAccountId = $cofre ? $cofre->id : null;
            } elseif (is_numeric($formaPagamento)) {
                $paymentMethodId = (int) $formaPagamento;
                $method = PaymentMethod::find($paymentMethodId);
                if ($method) {
                    $bankAccountId = $method->destination_account_id;
                }
            }

            // Verifica se o pedido existe na base de dados para fazer a ligação
            $orderId = (is_numeric($pedidoId) && Order::where('id', $pedidoId)->exists()) ? (int) $pedidoId : null;

            Transaction::create([
                'bank_account_id' => $bankAccountId,
                'payment_method_id' => $paymentMethodId,
                'order_id' => $orderId,
                'type' => $type,
                'amount' => $valor,
                'description' => $descricao,
                'operator_name' => $operador,
                'legacy_session_id' => $sessaoCaixa,
                'transaction_date' => $dataHora,
            ]);
            
            $count++;
        }
        fclose($file);

        $this->command->info("==== SUCESSO ====");
        $this->command->line("- {$count} Movimentações injetadas com sucesso nas Contas Bancárias!");
    }
}
```

## File: Printosa/src/bridge.js
```javascript
import axios from 'axios';
import PusherPkg from 'pusher-js';
import PrinterService from './printer.js';

let Pusher = PusherPkg;
while (Pusher && typeof Pusher !== 'function' && Pusher.default) {
    Pusher = Pusher.default;
}
if (Pusher && typeof Pusher !== 'function' && Pusher.Pusher) {
    Pusher = Pusher.Pusher;
}

class BrasumeBridge {
    constructor(domain, reverbHost, reverbKey, bridgeToken, printMode, logger) {
        this.printMode = printMode;
        this.apiUrl = domain.startsWith('http') ? domain : `https://${domain}`;
        this.reverbHost = reverbHost;
        this.reverbKey = reverbKey;
        this.bridgeToken = bridgeToken;
        this.version = '1.0.0';
        this.tenantId = null;
        this.pusher = null;
        this.log = logger || console.log;

        this.api = axios.create({
            baseURL: this.apiUrl,
            headers: {
                'X-Bridge-Token': this.bridgeToken,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'Accept': 'application/json'
            }
        });
    }

    async start() {
        this.log(`🚀 Iniciando BrasumePrint Bridge v${this.version}...`);

        try {
            this.log("🤝 Fazendo handshake com o servidor...");
            const response = await this.api.post('/api/bridge/handshake', {
                version: this.version
            });

            if (response.data.status === 'outdated') {
                this.log(`❌ ${response.data.message}`);
                throw new Error(response.data.message);
            }

            this.tenantId = response.data.tenant_id;
            this.log(`✅ Handshake aceite! Tenant ID: ${this.tenantId}`);
            this.log("🔌 Conectando o Pusher Nativo ao servidor Reverb...");

            this.pusher = new Pusher(this.reverbKey, {
                wsHost: this.reverbHost,
                wsPort: 80,
                wssPort: 443,
                forceTLS: true,
                disableStats: true,
                enabledTransports: ['ws', 'wss'],
                cluster: 'mt1'
            });

            this.pusher.connection.bind('connected', () => {
                this.log(`🎧 Antena ligada com SUCESSO! Escutando a loja ID: ${this.tenantId}...`);
            });

            this.pusher.connection.bind('error', (err) => {
                const errorMsg = err?.error?.data?.message || err?.message || String(err) || "Erro desconhecido de socket";
                const errorCode = err?.error?.data?.code || err?.code || "N/A";
                this.log(`⚠️ Aviso na conexão Pusher: [Code ${errorCode}] ${errorMsg}`);
            });

            const channel = this.pusher.subscribe(`tenant.${this.tenantId}.printers`);

            channel.bind('print.job.created', async (job) => {
                await this.processJob(job);
            });

            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            this.log(`❌ Falha fatal: ${error.response?.data?.error || error.message}`);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    stop() {
        if (this.pusher) {
            try {
                this.log("🛑 Desconectando antena Pusher/Reverb...");
                if (this.tenantId) {
                    this.pusher.unsubscribe(`tenant.${this.tenantId}.printers`);
                }
                this.pusher.disconnect();
            } catch (e) {
                this.log(`Aviso ao desconectar: ${e.message}`);
            }
            this.pusher = null;
        }
    }

    async processJob(job) {
        const jobId = job.print_job_id || job.id;
        const jobType = job.job_type || job.type;
        const isLocalTest = String(jobId).startsWith('TESTE-LOCAL');

        this.log(`\n   NOVO TRABALHO RECEBIDO! ID: #${jobId} | Tipo: ${jobType}`);

        try {
            const result = await PrinterService.executeJob(job, this.printMode);
            this.log(`  Impressão Sucesso: ${result}`);

            if (!isLocalTest) {
                await this.reportStatus(jobId, 'success');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            this.log(`❌ Erro na impressão: ${error.message}`);

            if (!isLocalTest) {
                await this.reportStatus(jobId, 'failed', error.message);
            }
        }
    }

    async reportStatus(jobId, status, errorMessage = null) {
        try {
            await this.api.post(`/api/bridge/jobs/${jobId}/status`, {
                status: status,
                error_message: errorMessage
            });
        } catch (e) {
            this.log(`Falha ao reportar status ao servidor: ${e.message}`);
        }
    }
}

export default BrasumeBridge;
```

```javascript
import PrinterDriver from "@thiagoelg/node-printer";
import axios from 'axios';
import escpos from 'escpos';
import escposNetwork from 'escpos-network';
import escposUsb from 'escpos-usb';
import fs from 'fs';
import { CharacterSet, PrinterTypes, ThermalPrinter } from "node-thermal-printer";
import os from 'os';
import path from 'path';

escpos.USB = escposUsb;
escpos.Network = escposNetwork;

class LinuxRawDevice {
    constructor(devicePath) {
        this.devicePath = devicePath;
        this.stream = null;
    }
    open(callback) {
        fs.access(this.devicePath, fs.constants.W_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                return callback(new Error(`Sem permissão na porta ${this.devicePath}. No terminal: sudo chmod 666 ${this.devicePath}`));
            }
            try {
                this.stream = fs.createWriteStream(this.devicePath);
                this.stream.on('error', (e) => console.error('[LINUX DEVICE ERROR]', e));
                callback(null);
            } catch (openErr) {
                callback(openErr);
            }
        });
    }
    write(data, callback) {
        if (this.stream) this.stream.write(data, callback);
        else callback(new Error("Stream de hardware fechada"));
    }
    close(callback) {
        if (this.stream) {
            this.stream.end(() => {
                this.stream = null;
                if (callback) callback();
            });
        } else if (callback) {
            callback();
        }
    }
}

function printHardwareQrCode(printer, text, size = 4) {
    const dataBuffer = Buffer.from(text, 'utf-8');
    const len = dataBuffer.length + 3;
    const pL = len & 0xFF;
    const pH = (len >> 8) & 0xFF;
    const moduleSize = Math.min(Math.max(size || 4, 1), 16);

    const buffer = Buffer.concat([
        Buffer.from([0x1D, 0x28, 0x6B, 0x04, 0x00, 0x31, 0x41, 0x32, 0x00]),
        Buffer.from([0x1D, 0x28, 0x6B, 0x03, 0x00, 0x31, 0x43, moduleSize]),
        Buffer.from([0x1D, 0x28, 0x6B, 0x03, 0x00, 0x31, 0x45, 0x30]),
        Buffer.from([0x1D, 0x28, 0x6B, pL, pH, 0x31, 0x50, 0x30]),
        dataBuffer,
        Buffer.from([0x1D, 0x28, 0x6B, 0x03, 0x00, 0x31, 0x51, 0x30]),
        Buffer.from([0x0A])
    ]);

    printer.raw(buffer);
}

let printQueue = Promise.resolve();

class PrinterService {
    static async executeJob(jobData, mode = 'os') {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            printQueue = printQueue
                .catch(() => {})
                .then(async () => {
                    try {
                        const result = await PrinterService._runJob(jobData, mode);
                        resolve(result);
                    } catch (err) {
                        reject(err);
                    }
                });
        });
    }

    static async _runJob(jobData, mode = 'os') {
        return new Promise(async (resolve, reject) => {
            const startTime = Date.now();
            const printerPath = jobData.os_name || jobData.printer_path || '';
            const effectiveMode = printerPath.startsWith('/dev/') ? 'raw' : (mode || 'os');

            if (effectiveMode === 'raw') {
                try {
                    let device;
                    let printer;

                    if (jobData.printer_type === 'network') {
                        device = new escpos.Network(printerPath || '192.168.1.100');
                    } else if (printerPath.startsWith('/dev/')) {
                        console.log(`[LINUX-RAW] Conectando diretamente ao descritor: ${printerPath}`);
                        device = new LinuxRawDevice(printerPath);
                    } else {
                        const usbDevices = escpos.USB.findPrinter();
                        if (!usbDevices || usbDevices.length === 0) {
                            return reject(new Error('Nenhuma impressora USB encontrada fisicamente.'));
                        }
                        device = new escpos.USB();
                    }

                    const options = { encoding: "GB18030" };
                    printer = new escpos.Printer(device, options);

                    device.open(async function (error) {
                        if (error) return reject(error);

                        printer.raw(Buffer.from([
                            0x1B, 0x40,
                            0x1D, 0x21, 0x00,
                            0x1B, 0x20, 0x00
                        ]));

                        let currentFont = 'A';

                        for (const line of jobData.blueprint) {
                            switch (line.cmd) {
                                case 'align':
                                    const rawVal = (line.val || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                                    if (rawVal === 'ct' || rawVal === 'center' || rawVal === 'c') printer.align('CT');
                                    else if (rawVal === 'rt' || rawVal === 'right' || rawVal === 'r') printer.align('RT');
                                    else printer.align('LT');
                                    break;

                                case 'font':
                                    currentFont = (line.val || '').toUpperCase() === 'B' ? 'B' : 'A';
                                    if (currentFont === 'B') {
                                        printer.font('B');
                                        printer.raw(Buffer.from([0x1B, 0x4D, 0x01, 0x1B, 0x21, 0x01]));
                                    } else {
                                        printer.font('A');
                                        printer.raw(Buffer.from([0x1B, 0x4D, 0x00, 0x1B, 0x21, 0x00]));
                                    }
                                    break;

                                case 'text':
                                    if (line.bold) printer.style('B');
                                    else printer.style('NORMAL');

                                    if (line.invert) {
                                        if (typeof printer.inverse === 'function') printer.inverse(true);
                                    } else {
                                        if (typeof printer.inverse === 'function') printer.inverse(false);
                                    }

                                    if (line.size === '2x') {
                                        printer.raw(Buffer.from([0x1D, 0x21, 0x11]));
                                    } else if (line.size === '1,0') {
                                        printer.raw(Buffer.from([0x1D, 0x21, 0x10]));
                                    } else {
                                        printer.raw(Buffer.from([0x1D, 0x21, 0x00]));
                                    }

                                    if (currentFont === 'B') {
                                        printer.raw(Buffer.from([0x1B, 0x4D, 0x01]));
                                    }

                                    printer.text(line.val);
                                    break;

                                case 'image':
                                    try {
                                        const res = await axios.get(line.url, { responseType: 'arraybuffer', timeout: 10000 });
                                        const tempFile = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `raw_img_${Date.now()}.png`);
                                        fs.writeFileSync(tempFile, Buffer.from(res.data));
                                        await new Promise((resImg) => {
                                            escpos.Image.load(tempFile, function (image) {
                                                try { printer.image(image, 'd24'); } catch (e) {}
                                                try { fs.unlinkSync(tempFile); } catch (_) {}
                                                resImg();
                                            });
                                        });
                                    } catch (e) {
                                        console.error("Erro no download da imagem (raw):", e.message);
                                    }
                                    break;

                                case 'qrcode':
                                    printer.align('CT');
                                    printHardwareQrCode(printer, line.data, line.size || 4);
                                    break;

                                case 'cut':
                                    printer.raw(Buffer.from([0x1B, 0x64, 0x02]));
                                    printer.cut();
                                    break;

                                case 'beep':
                                    printer.beep(2, 2);
                                    break;
                            }
                        }

                        printer.close(() => {
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                resolve(`Impressão enviada em ${Date.now() - startTime}ms (Modo RAW)!`);
                            }, 80);
                        });
                    });
                } catch (err) {
                    reject(err);
                }
            } else {
                try {
                    const targetName = printerPath || "POS-80";
                    let interfaceConfig = jobData.printer_type === 'network'
                        ? `tcp://${targetName}:9100`
                        : `printer:${targetName}`;

                    const maxColumns = (jobData.paper_width === 58) ? 42 : 64;

                    const printer = new ThermalPrinter({
                        type: PrinterTypes.EPSON,
                        interface: interfaceConfig,
                        driver: PrinterDriver,
                        characterSet: CharacterSet.PC860_PORTUGUESE,
                        removeSpecialCharacters: false,
                        lineCharacter: "-",
                        width: maxColumns,
                        options: { timeout: 8000 }
                    });

                    const isConnected = await printer.isPrinterConnected();
                    if (!isConnected) return reject(new Error(`A impressora '${targetName}' não foi encontrada no Sistema.`));

                    for (const line of jobData.blueprint) {
                        switch (line.cmd) {
                            case 'align':
                                const alignVal = (line.val || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                                if (alignVal === 'ct' || alignVal === 'center' || alignVal === 'c') printer.alignCenter();
                                else if (alignVal === 'rt' || alignVal === 'right' || alignVal === 'r') printer.alignRight();
                                else printer.alignLeft();
                                break;

                            case 'font':
                                const isB = (line.val || '').toUpperCase() === 'B';
                                if (isB) {
                                    if (typeof printer.setTypeFontB === 'function') printer.setTypeFontB();
                                } else {
                                    if (typeof printer.setTypeFontA === 'function') printer.setTypeFontA();
                                }
                                break;

                            case 'text':
                                printer.bold(line.bold ? true : false);
                                if (line.invert) printer.invert(true);
                                else printer.invert(false);

                                if (line.size === '2x') printer.setTextSize(1, 1);
                                else if (line.size === '1,0') printer.setTextSize(1, 0);
                                else printer.setTextSize(0, 0);

                                printer.println(line.val);
                                break;

                            case 'image':
                                try {
                                    const response = await axios.get(line.url, { responseType: 'arraybuffer', timeout: 10000 });
                                    const imgBuffer = Buffer.from(response.data);

                                    if (typeof printer.printImageBuffer === 'function') {
                                        await printer.printImageBuffer(imgBuffer);
                                    } else {
                                        const tempFile = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `printosa_img_${Date.now()}.png`);
                                        fs.writeFileSync(tempFile, imgBuffer);
                                        try { await printer.printImage(tempFile); }
                                        finally { try { fs.unlinkSync(tempFile); } catch (_) {} }
                                    }
                                } catch (imgError) {}
                                break;

                            case 'qrcode':
                                printer.alignCenter();
                                printer.printQR(line.data, { cellSize: line.size || 6 });
                                break;

                            case 'cut':
                                printer.newLine();
                                printer.newLine();
                                printer.cut();
                                break;

                            case 'beep':
                                printer.beep();
                                break;
                        }
                    }

                    await printer.execute();
                    resolve(`Impressão enviada em ${Date.now() - startTime}ms (Modo OS/CUPS)!`);
                } catch (err) {
                    reject(err);
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

export default PrinterService;
```

```javascript
const { ipcRenderer } = require('electron');

const loginScreen = document.getElementById('login-screen');
const mappingScreen = document.getElementById('mapping-screen');
const dashboardScreen = document.getElementById('dashboard-screen');

const inputApiUrl = document.getElementById('apiUrl');
const inputApiToken = document.getElementById('apiToken');
const btnConnect = document.getElementById('btnConnect');

const printersList = document.getElementById('printers-list');
const btnSaveMapping = document.getElementById('btnSaveMapping');
const activityLog = document.getElementById('activity-log');
const mappedCount = document.getElementById('mapped-count');
const btnTestPrint = document.getElementById('btnTestPrint');
const btnRemap = document.getElementById('btnRemap');
const btnStop = document.getElementById('btnStop');

const btnShowLogs = document.getElementById('btnShowLogs');
const logModal = document.getElementById('log-modal');
const btnCloseLogs = document.getElementById('btnCloseLogs');

function showScreen(screenId) {
    loginScreen.classList.add('hidden');
    mappingScreen.classList.add('hidden');
    dashboardScreen.classList.add('hidden');

    const target = document.getElementById(screenId);
    if (target) target.classList.remove('hidden');
}

function addLog(message, type = 'system') {
    if (!activityLog) return;
    const entry = document.createElement('div');
    entry.className = `log-entry ${type}`;
    const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
    entry.textContent = `[${time}] ${message}`;
    activityLog.appendChild(entry);
    activityLog.scrollTop = activityLog.scrollHeight;
}

let cloudPrinters = [];
let localHardwarePrinters = [
    { id: 'none', name: '-- Não Conectada --' },
    { id: '/dev/usb/lp0', name: 'Porta USB 1 (/dev/usb/lp0)' },
    { id: '/dev/usb/lp1', name: 'Porta USB 2 (/dev/usb/lp1)' },
    { id: 'POS-80', name: 'Fila CUPS (POS-80)' },
    { id: '192.168.1.100', name: 'Rede: EPSON (192.168.1.100)' }
];

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    ipcRenderer.send('request-saved-credentials');
});

ipcRenderer.on('saved-credentials', (event, creds) => {
    if (creds?.domain) inputApiUrl.value = creds.domain;
    if (creds?.bridgeToken) inputApiToken.value = creds.bridgeToken;

    if (creds?.domain && creds?.bridgeToken) {
        showScreen('dashboard-screen');
        addLog("Conexão restaurada com sucesso.", "success");
    } else {
        showScreen('login-screen');
    }
});

ipcRenderer.on('bridge-status', (event, status) => {
    if (status.success) {
        showScreen('dashboard-screen');
        addLog("Motor de Impressão Brasume conectado e operando.", "success");
    } else {
        showScreen('login-screen');
        addLog(`Falha na conexão: ${status.message}`, "error");
        btnConnect.innerText = "Conectar à Brasume";
    }
});

ipcRenderer.on('deeplink-received', (event, data) => {
    if (data.domain) inputApiUrl.value = data.domain;
    if (data.token) inputApiToken.value = data.token;
    addLog(`Deep link processado para ${data.domain}. Conectando...`);
});

btnConnect.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const domain = inputApiUrl.value.trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
    const token = inputApiToken.value.trim();

    if (!domain || !token) {
        alert("Preencha o Endereço do Sistema e o Token.");
        return;
    }

    btnConnect.innerText = "Conectando...";
    addLog("Consultando impressoras cadastradas na nuvem...");

    try {
        const response = await ipcRenderer.invoke('api-fetch-printers', { domain, token });
        cloudPrinters = response.printers || [];

        if (cloudPrinters.length > 0) {
            renderMatchmaker();
            showScreen('mapping-screen');
        } else {
            ipcRenderer.send('start-bridge', { domain, bridgeToken: token, printMode: 'os' });
        }
    } catch (err) {
        alert("Erro ao buscar impressoras: " + err.message);
        btnConnect.innerText = "Conectar à Brasume";
    }
});

function renderMatchmaker() {
    printersList.innerHTML = '';

    cloudPrinters.forEach(printer => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'printer-row';

        const optionsHtml = localHardwarePrinters.map(local => {
            const selected = (printer.os_name === local.id) ? 'selected' : '';
            return `<option value="${local.id}" ${selected}>${local.name}</option>`;
        }).join('');

        row.innerHTML = `
            <div class="cloud-info">
                <div class="cloud-name">${printer.name} ${printer.is_cashier ? '💰' : '🍳'}</div>
                <div class="cloud-meta">Tipo: ${printer.type} | Papel: ${printer.paper_width}mm</div>
            </div>
            <div class="local-select">
                <select id="map-${printer.id}">
                    ${optionsHtml}
                </select>
            </div>
        `;

        printersList.appendChild(row);
    });

    if (mappedCount) mappedCount.textContent = cloudPrinters.length;
}

btnSaveMapping.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const domain = inputApiUrl.value.trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
    const token = inputApiToken.value.trim();

    let hasDirectUsb = false;
    cloudPrinters.forEach(printer => {
        const select = document.getElementById(`map-${printer.id}`);
        if (select && select.value.startsWith('/dev/')) {
            hasDirectUsb = true;
        }
    });

    const printMode = hasDirectUsb ? 'raw' : 'os';
    addLog(`Ligando motor no modo: ${printMode.toUpperCase()}...`);

    ipcRenderer.send('start-bridge', {
        domain,
        bridgeToken: token,
        printMode: printMode
    });
});

if (btnTestPrint) {
    btnTestPrint.addEventListener('click', () => {
        addLog("Disparando comando de teste de impressão...", "system");
        ipcRenderer.send('test-print');
    });
}

if (btnShowLogs && logModal) {
    btnShowLogs.addEventListener('click', () => logModal.classList.remove('hidden'));
}

if (btnCloseLogs && logModal) {
    btnCloseLogs.addEventListener('click', () => logModal.classList.add('hidden'));
}

if (btnRemap) {
    btnRemap.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const domain = inputApiUrl.value.trim();
        const token = inputApiToken.value.trim();
        const res = await ipcRenderer.invoke('api-fetch-printers', { domain, token });
        cloudPrinters = res.printers || [];
        renderMatchmaker();
        showScreen('mapping-screen');
    });
}

if (btnStop) {
    btnStop.addEventListener('click', () => {
        showScreen('login-screen');
        btnConnect.innerText = "Conectar à Brasume";
        addLog("Motor desconectado.", "system");
    });
}
```

```css
/* src/styles.css */

/* Fundo da Aplicação */
body {
    font-family: system-ui;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 20px;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background-image: url('printosa-background-1000.png');
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    background-attachment: fixed;
    color: #f3f4f6;
}

/* Ocultar elementos */
.hidden {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Efeito Glassmorphism (Vidro Fosco) */
.container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 600px;
    padding: 40px;
    border-radius: 60px;

    /* A Mágica do Vidro */
    background: rgba(20, 10, 20, 0.65); /* Fundo escuro semi-transparente para dar contraste */
    backdrop-filter: blur(40px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px);
    border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

/* Cabeçalhos e Logo */
.header-area {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
}
.app-logo {
    width: 90px;
    height: auto;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(197, 26, 102, 0.5));
}
h1 {
    color: white;
    font-size: 4rem;
    margin: 0 0 5px 0;
    text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}
p.subtitle {
    color: #d1d5db;
    opacity: 0.8;
    font-size: 2rem;
    margin: 0;
}

/* Formulários - Inner Floating Label (Perfeito para Glassmorphism) */
.form-group {
    position: relative;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

/* O Input - Mais alto, com espaço reservado no topo */
.form-group input, .form-group select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 24px 14px 8px 14px; /* Muito espaço em cima, pouco em baixo */
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    color: #fff;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    outline: none;
    font-size: 15px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

/* A Label Flutuante - Totalmente Transparente */
.form-group label {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 14px;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    font-size: 14px;
    color: white;
    pointer-events: none; /* Deixa o clique passar para o input */
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    /* ZERO background color! O fundo translúcido reina absoluto. */
}

/* A MÁGICA: Ao focar ou preencher, a label sobe, mas continua DENTRO do campo */
.form-group input:focus,
.form-group input:not(:placeholder-shown) {
    border-color: white;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(197, 26, 102, 0.2);
}

.form-group input:focus + label,
.form-group input:not(:placeholder-shown) + label {
    top: 14px; /* Sobe para o topo interno */
    font-size: 10px;
    color: white;
    font-weight: bold;
}

/* Botões Estilosos */
button {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 24px;
    background-color: white;
    opacity: 0.8;
    color: black;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
}
button:hover {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Linhas de Mapeamento de Hardware */
.printer-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    padding: 15px 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}
.cloud-info { flex: 1; }
.cloud-name { font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; color: #f9a8d4; /* Rosa suave */ }
.cloud-meta { font-size: 12px; color: #9ca3af; margin-top: 4px; }
.local-select { flex: 1; margin-left: 15px; }

/* ==========================================
   TELA 3: DASHBOARD & STATUS
   ========================================== */

/* Cartão de Status Principal */
.status-card {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 20px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
}

/* O "Heartbeat" Branco Pulsante */
.status-indicator {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.pulse-dot {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    background-color: white;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    animation: pulse-white 2s infinite ease-in-out;
}

@keyframes pulse-white {
    0% { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0.7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); }
    70% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); }
    100% { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0.7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); }
}

.status-text {
    color: white;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.printer-summary {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
}

/* Terminal de Atividades (Log de Batalha) */
.log-terminal {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 20px;
    height: 180px;
    padding: 15px 20px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.log-entry {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    line-height: 1.4;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.log-entry.system { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); font-style: italic; }
.log-entry.success { color: white; font-weight: bold; }
.log-entry.error { color: #ff8a8a; } /* Única cor de aviso suave para erros reais */

/* Custom Scrollbar para o Log (Fininha e elegante) */
.log-terminal::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
.log-terminal::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
.log-terminal::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 10px; }
.log-terminal::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); }

/* Hierarquia de Botões de Ação */
.action-buttons {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 15px;
}

/* Substitui a classe base 'button' por algo mais contido para esta tela */
.action-buttons button {
    padding: 18px;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    border-radius: 30px;
}

.btn-secondary {
    background-color: white;
    opacity: 0.85;
    color: black;
}

/* Botão Vazado (Outlined) - Ação Secundária */
.btn-outline {
    background-color: transparent;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
    color: white;
}
.btn-outline:hover {
    border-color: white;
    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

/* Botão de Perigo/Sair - Mantendo o vidro, mas com um toque sutil de vermelho/bordo */
.btn-danger {
    background-color: rgba(200, 20, 50, 0.15);
    border: 2px solid rgba(200, 20, 50, 0.3);
    color: rgba(255, 200, 200, 0.9);
}
.btn-danger:hover {
    background-color: rgba(200, 20, 50, 0.3);
    border-color: rgba(200, 20, 50, 0.6);
    color: white;
}
```

## File: Printosa/main.js
```javascript
import PrinterDriver from "@thiagoelg/node-printer";
import axios from 'axios';
import { app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, Menu, Tray } from 'electron';
import Store from 'electron-store';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import BrasumeBridge from './src/bridge.js';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

let store;
let mainWindow;
let tray = null;
let bridgeInstance = null;
let pendingDeepLinkUrl = null;

const SAAS_REVERB_HOST = 'ws.brasume.com.br';
const SAAS_REVERB_KEY = 'a4px8txpz0axv9h0xhb6';

function log(message) {
    console.log(message);
    if (mainWindow && mainWindow.webContents) {
        mainWindow.webContents.executeJavaScript(`console.log("💻 MAIN SYSTEM:", \`${message}\`)`).catch(() => {});
    }
}

const gotTheLock = app.requestSingleInstanceLock();
if (!gotTheLock) {
    app.quit();
} else {
    app.on('second-instance', (event, commandLine) => {
        if (mainWindow) {
            if (mainWindow.isMinimized()) mainWindow.restore();
            mainWindow.show();
            mainWindow.focus();
        }
        const urlArg = commandLine.find(arg => arg.startsWith('brasumeprint://'));
        if (urlArg) handleDeepLink(urlArg);
    });

    app.on('open-url', (event, url) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        pendingDeepLinkUrl = url;
        if (app.isReady() && mainWindow) {
            handleDeepLink(pendingDeepLinkUrl);
            pendingDeepLinkUrl = null;
        }
    });

    app.whenReady().then(async () => {
        store = new Store();

        if (process.defaultApp && process.argv.length >= 2) {
            app.setAsDefaultProtocolClient('brasumeprint', process.execPath, [path.resolve(process.argv[1])]);
        } else {
            app.setAsDefaultProtocolClient('brasumeprint');
        }

        createWindow();
        createTray();

        const savedDomain = store.get('domain');
        const savedToken = store.get('bridgeToken');
        const savedPrintMode = store.get('printMode') || 'os';

        if (savedDomain && savedToken && !pendingDeepLinkUrl) {
            log(`Credenciais salvas encontradas. Religando no modo: ${savedPrintMode}...`);
            startBridgeProcess(savedDomain, savedToken, savedPrintMode);
        }

        if (process.platform === 'darwin' && pendingDeepLinkUrl) {
            handleDeepLink(pendingDeepLinkUrl);
            pendingDeepLinkUrl = null;
        }

        if (process.platform === 'win32' && process.argv.length > 1) {
            const urlArg = process.argv.find(arg => arg.startsWith('brasumeprint://'));
            if (urlArg) handleDeepLink(urlArg);
        }
    });
}

function handleDeepLink(rawUrl) {
    if (!rawUrl || !rawUrl.toLowerCase().includes('brasumeprint://')) return;
    rawUrl = rawUrl.replace(/&amp;/g, '&');

    try {
        const parsedUrl = new URL(rawUrl);
        const domain = parsedUrl.searchParams.get('domain');
        const token = parsedUrl.searchParams.get('token');

        if (domain && token) {
            const sendDataToView = () => {
                mainWindow.show();
                mainWindow.webContents.send('deeplink-received', { domain, token });
            };

            if (mainWindow.webContents.isLoading()) {
                mainWindow.webContents.once('did-finish-load', sendDataToView);
            } else {
                sendDataToView();
            }

            const currentMode = store ? (store.get('printMode') || 'os') : 'os';
            startBridgeProcess(domain, token, currentMode);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        log(`Falha ao ler Deep Link: ${e.message}`);
    }
}

function createWindow() {
    mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
        width: 450,
        height: 550,
        resizable: false,
        autoHideMenuBar: true,
        webPreferences: {
            nodeIntegration: true,
            contextIsolation: false
        }
    });
    mainWindow.loadFile('src/index.html');

    mainWindow.on('close', (event) => {
        if (!app.isQuitting) {
            event.preventDefault();
            mainWindow.hide();
        }
    });
}

function createTray() {
    const iconPath = path.join(__dirname, 'src', 'printosa-logo-512.png');
    tray = new Tray(iconPath);
    tray.setToolTip('Printosa - Motor de Impressão');
    tray.setContextMenu(Menu.buildFromTemplate([
        { label: 'Mostrar Painel', click: () => mainWindow.show() },
        { type: 'separator' },
        { label: 'Sair Completamente', click: () => { app.isQuitting = true; app.quit(); } }
    ]));

    tray.on('click', () => mainWindow.show());
    tray.on('double-click', () => mainWindow.show());
}

ipcMain.handle('api-fetch-printers', async (event, args) => {
    const domain = args?.domain || (store ? store.get('domain') : null);
    const token = args?.token || (store ? store.get('bridgeToken') : null);

    let cloudPrinters = [];
    if (domain && token) {
        try {
            const url = domain.startsWith('http') ? domain : `https://${domain}`;
            const res = await axios.get(`${url}/api/bridge/printers`, {
                headers: {
                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
                    'X-Bridge-Token': token,
                    'Accept': 'application/json'
                },
                timeout: 7000
            });
            cloudPrinters = res.data?.printers || [];
        } catch (e) {
            log(`Aviso ao consultar impressoras na nuvem: ${e.message}`);
        }
    }

    let localPrinters = [];
    try {
        if (typeof PrinterDriver?.getPrinters === 'function') {
            localPrinters = PrinterDriver.getPrinters();
        }
    } catch (_) {}

    return {
        printers: cloudPrinters,
        localPrinters: localPrinters
    };
});

ipcMain.on('request-saved-credentials', (event) => {
    if (store) {
        event.reply('saved-credentials', {
            domain: store.get('domain'),
            bridgeToken: store.get('bridgeToken'),
            printMode: store.get('printMode') || 'os'
        });
    }
});

ipcMain.on('start-bridge', async (event, creds) => {
    const chosenMode = creds.printMode || 'os';
    await startBridgeProcess(creds.domain, creds.bridgeToken, chosenMode, event);
});

ipcMain.on('test-print', async () => {
    if (!bridgeInstance) {
        log("⚠️ Bridge inativa: impossível enviar teste.");
        return;
    }

    const testJob = {
        id: `TESTE-LOCAL-${Date.now()}`,
        job_type: 'test_ticket',
        os_name: '/dev/usb/lp1',
        blueprint: [
            { cmd: 'align', val: 'center' },
            { cmd: 'text', val: 'PRINTOSA - BRASUME', bold: true, size: '2x' },
            { cmd: 'text', val: 'TESTE DE IMPRESSAO LOCAL', bold: true },
            { cmd: 'text', val: '================================', bold: false },
            { cmd: 'align', val: 'left' },
            { cmd: 'text', val: `Data/Hora: ${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}` },
            { cmd: 'text', val: `Modo Ativo: ${store ? store.get('printMode') || 'raw' : 'raw'}` },
            { cmd: 'text', val: 'Porta Testada: /dev/usb/lp1' },
            { cmd: 'align', val: 'center' },
            { cmd: 'text', val: '--------------------------------' },
            { cmd: 'text', val: 'Hardware Comunicando OK!' },
            { cmd: 'cut' }
        ]
    };

    await bridgeInstance.processJob(testJob);
});

async function startBridgeProcess(domain, bridgeToken, printMode = 'os', ipcEvent = null) {
    if (bridgeInstance) {
        try {
            log("🔄 Desconectando instância anterior da bridge...");
            bridgeInstance.stop();
        } catch (e) {
            log(`Aviso ao encerrar bridge antiga: ${e.message}`);
        }
        bridgeInstance = null;
    }

    try {
        log(`Instanciando a Bridge (Modo base: ${printMode})...`);
        bridgeInstance = new BrasumeBridge(domain, SAAS_REVERB_HOST, SAAS_REVERB_KEY, bridgeToken, printMode, log);
        await bridgeInstance.start();

        if (store) {
            store.set('domain', domain);
            store.set('bridgeToken', bridgeToken);
            store.set('printMode', printMode);
        }

        const replyPayload = { success: true };
        if (ipcEvent) ipcEvent.reply('bridge-status', replyPayload);
        else if (mainWindow) mainWindow.webContents.send('bridge-status', replyPayload);
    } catch (err) {
        const errMsg = err.message || 'Falha na conexão.';
        log(`Erro repassado: ${errMsg}`);
        const replyPayload = { success: false, message: errMsg };
        if (ipcEvent) ipcEvent.reply('bridge-status', replyPayload);
        else if (mainWindow) mainWindow.webContents.send('bridge-status', replyPayload);
    }
}
```

```css
/* 🟠 PENDENTE (Warning) */

/* Garante que o texto dentro do evento herde a cor corretamente */
.fc .fc-event.event-success .fc-event-main,
.fc .fc-event.event-danger .fc-event-main,

.fc .fc-event.event-daily-summary {

    margin: 0 !important;

    color: #000000 !important; 
    border-top: solid 1px var(--)
}

/* ⚪️ COR NO TEMA ESCURO (DARK MODE) */
.dark .fc .fc-event.event-daily-summary {
    
    /* No Dark Mode, voltamos para uma cor clara para ter leitura */
    color: var(--color-primary-100) !important; 
}

/* 🚨 A CHAVE DO PROBLEMA:

.fc .fc-event.event-daily-summary .fc-event-main,
.fc .fc-event.event-daily-summary .fc-event-title,
.fc .fc-event.event-daily-summary .fc-event-title-container {

    clear: both;

    display: table;
}
```

```css
/* ==========================================

   ========================================== */
/* Zeramos apenas a variável de sombra do Tailwind, preservando a variável de Rings */
.shadow-sm,
.shadow,
.shadow-md,
.shadow-lg,
.shadow-xl,
.shadow-2xl {
    --tw-shadow: 0 0 #0000 !important;
    --tw-shadow-colored: 0 0 #0000 !important;

.fi-dropdown-panel {

}
```

```css
/* ==========================================

   ========================================== */

/* 1. REMOVER BOLINHAS E LINHAS NATIVAS */
.fi-sidebar-group ul .fi-sidebar-item-icon,
.fi-sidebar-group ul svg.fi-icon,
.fi-sidebar-item-grouped-border {

}

.fi-sidebar-item-label, .fi-sidebar-group-label {

}

/* 3. INDENTAÇÃO COM DARK MODE */
.fi-sidebar-group ul {

}
.fi-sidebar-item {

}

.fi-sidebar {

}

/* 4. SEARCH BAR CUSTOMIZADA */

    @apply !bg-primary-500/10 hover:!bg-primary-500/15 !p-2 !gap-2 !rounded-lg;
}

input#menu-search {
    outline: 0;
}

.fi-sidebar-group svg {
    width: 18px !important;
}

/* 5. HOVERS E BACKGROUNDS */
.fi-sidebar-group-button {
    @apply !transition-all !duration-200 !ease-in-out !rounded-lg;
}
.fi-sidebar-group-button:hover {
    @apply !bg-gray-100 dark:!bg-white/5;
}

.fi-sidebar-item a {
    @apply !transition-all !duration-200 !ease-in-out !rounded-lg !py-1.5 !px-2;
}
.fi-sidebar-item a:hover {
    @apply !bg-gray-100 dark:!bg-white/5;
}

.fi-sidebar-nav-groups {
    @apply !gap-0;
}

/* 6. FIX DO MENU RECOLHIDO (COLLAPSED) */
.fi-sidebar-is-collapsed .fi-sidebar-group ul,
.fi-sidebar-is-collapsed .fi-sidebar-group-items,
.fi-sidebar-is-collapsed #menu-search {
    @apply !hidden;
}

.fi-sidebar-is-collapsed .fi-input-wrapper {
    @apply !p-2 !justify-center;
}

/* ==========================================
   6. FIX DO MENU RECOLHIDO (COLLAPSED)
   ========================================== */

/* Se a sidebar NÃO tem a classe 'fi-sidebar-open', ela está recolhida. Escondemos os itens: */
.fi-sidebar:not(.fi-sidebar-open) .fi-sidebar-group ul,
.fi-sidebar:not(.fi-sidebar-open) .fi-sidebar-group-items {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Como o menu recolhido tem apenas 2rem (32px), removemos o padding para a lupa caber perfeitamente */
.fi-sidebar:not(.fi-sidebar-open) #search-wrapper {
    padding-left: 0.35rem !important;
    padding-right: 0.35rem !important;
}

/* Esconde o campo de texto e o botão X */
.fi-sidebar:not(.fi-sidebar-open) #menu-search,
.fi-sidebar:not(.fi-sidebar-open) #clear-search {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Centraliza a lupa para ela parecer apenas mais um ícone do menu recolhido */
.fi-sidebar:not(.fi-sidebar-open) .nav-searchbar {
    justify-content: center !important;
    padding: 0.5rem !important;
    background-color: transparent !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
}

/* Efeito de hover (fundo translúcido) na lupa quando recolhido */
.fi-sidebar:not(.fi-sidebar-open) .nav-searchbar:hover {
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-500) 15%, transparent) !important;
}
```

## File: resources/css/pos-theme/globals.css
```css
/* COMPORTAMENTOS GLOBAIS DE UX */
[x-cloak] { display: none !important; }

@layer base {
    /* 🚀 Removemos a borda obrigatória de todos os elementos! */
    * {
        @apply outline-primary-500/50;
    }

    body {
        /* 🚀 CORREÇÃO 2: Usando nosso sistema de superfícies no body! */
        @apply bg-surface-1 text-surface-text font-sans antialiased;
        overscroll-behavior-y: none;
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; height: 6px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: var(--surface-muted);
        border-radius: 9999px;
    }

    /* Fix PrimeVue */
    i.pi, .p-button .pi, .p-button-icon {
            color: currentColor !important;
            font-size: inherit !important;
        }
    }

/* 🚀 NOSSOS UTILITÁRIOS GLOBAIS DRY */
@layer utilities {
    .hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
    }
    .hide-scrollbar {
        -ms-overflow-style: none;
        scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    /* A animação que se repetia nos modais */
    .animate-fade-in {
        animation: fade-in 0.2s ease-out forwards;
    }

    @keyframes fade-in {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-5px); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
}

/* =========================================================
   SCROLLBAR TRANSLÚCIDA E AUTO-HIDE (MacOS Style)
   ========================================================= */

/* Comportamento padrão para Firefox */
.scroll-container {
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: transparent transparent; /* Escondida por padrão */
    transition: scrollbar-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Mostra no Firefox ao passar o mouse */
.scroll-container:hover {
    /* Cinza translúcido e fundo transparente */
    scrollbar-color: rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.2) transparent;
}

/* =========================================================
   Webkit (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Opera)
   ========================================================= */

/* Largura da barra */
.scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
}

/* O trilho (fundo) da barra - 100% transparente */
.scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
}

/* A "pegada" da barra - Invisível por padrão */
.scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 10px;
}

/* A MÁGICA: Revela a barra (translúcida) quando o mouse entra no contêiner */
.scroll-container:hover::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background-color: rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.2); /* Cor cinza do Tailwind com 40% de opacidade */
}

/* Fica mais escura/visível se o usuário passar o mouse na PRÓPRIA barra para arrastar */
.scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background-color: rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.4);
}
```

## File: resources/css/pos-theme/surfaces.css
```css
@theme {
    /* Ensinamos ao Tailwind que estas cores existem e apontam para as nossas variáveis mutáveis */
    --color-surface-1: var(--surface-1);
    --color-surface-2: var(--surface-2);
    --color-surface-3: var(--surface-3);

    --color-surface-text: var(--surface-text);
    --color-surface-muted: var(--surface-muted);
    --color-surface-border: var(--surface-border);
}

@layer base {
    :root {
        --surface-1: var(--color-stone-200);
        --surface-2: var(--color-stone-100);
        --surface-3: white;
        --surface-border: var(--color-stone-300);
        --surface-text: var(--color-stone-900);
        --surface-muted: var(--color-stone-700);
    }

    :root.dark {
        --surface-1: var(--color-stone-950);
        --surface-2: var(--color-stone-900);
        --surface-3: var(--color-stone-800);
        --surface-border: var(--color-stone-700);
        --surface-text: var(--color-stone-100);
        --surface-muted: var(--color-stone-400);
    }
}
```

## File: resources/css/pos-theme/transitions.css
```css
/* ==========================================
   TRANSIÇÕES GLOBAIS DE MODAIS E BOTTOM SHEETS
   ========================================== */

/* 1. Transição do Fundo Desfocado (Overlay) */
.fade-enter-active,
.fade-leave-active,
.fade-backdrop-enter-active,
.fade-backdrop-leave-active {
    transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.fade-enter-from,
.fade-leave-to,
.fade-backdrop-enter-from,
.fade-backdrop-leave-to {
    opacity: 0;
}

/* 2. Transição Metamorfa do Painel (Bottom Sheet Mobile / Modal Desktop) */
.slide-up-enter-active,
.slide-up-leave-active {
    transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.1), opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.slide-up-enter-from,
.slide-up-leave-to {
    transform: translateY(100%);
    opacity: 0;
}

/* 3. Comportamento Adaptativo no Desktop (Aparece no centro da tela) */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
    .slide-up-enter-from,
    .slide-up-leave-to {
        transform: scale(0.95) translateY(10px);
        opacity: 0;
    }

    .slide-up-enter-active,
    .slide-up-leave-active {
        transition: transform 0.2s ease-out, opacity 0.2s ease-out;
    }
}
```

```vue
                            :class="isCustomerMode ? 'c-btn-primary !h-14 !text-xs !uppercase !tracking-widest' : 'h-14 rounded-xl font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-widest shadow-md bg-primary-500 text-white hover:bg-primary-600'"

</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted } from "vue";
import { router, usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";
import FormField from "@/Components/UI/FormField.vue";
import SearchAutocomplete from "@/Components/UI/SearchAutocomplete.vue";
import { useAddressLookup } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useAddressLookup";
import { useWhatsAppSupport } from "@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useWhatsAppSupport";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    customerId: [Number, String],
    addressToEdit: Object,
    mode: { type: String, default: 'modal' },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isCustomerMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["update:visible", "cancel", "success", "save", "update-header", "substep"]);

const toast = useToast();
const page = usePage();
const { openSupport } = useWhatsAppSupport();

const lookupMode = computed(() => page.props.companySettings?.address_lookup_mode || 'cep');
const step = ref(1);
const cepError = ref('');
const loading = ref(false);

const { isSearchingCep, streetSuggestions, loadStreetsDataset, fetchCep, searchStreets, calculateFuzzyNeighborhood } = useAddressLookup(lookupMode);

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (value) => emit("update:visible", value),
});

const defaultForm = () => ({
    nickname: "Entrega",
    zipcode: "",
    street: "",
    street_id: null,
    streetObj: null,
    number: "",
    no_number: false,
    neighborhood: "",
    neighborhood_id: null,
    complement: ""
});

const form = ref(defaultForm());
const activeNicknameTag = ref('Casa');
const streetQuery = ref('');

const syncHeader = () => {
    if (props.mode === 'inline') {
        emit('substep', step.value);
    }
};

onMounted(() => syncHeader());
watch(step, () => syncHeader());

watch(() => props.visible, async (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) {
        cepError.value = '';
        if (props.addressToEdit) {
            form.value = { ...defaultForm(), ...props.addressToEdit };
            streetQuery.value = props.addressToEdit.street || '';
            activeNicknameTag.value = ['Casa', 'Trabalho', 'Amor'].includes(props.addressToEdit.nickname) ? props.addressToEdit.nickname : 'Outro';
            step.value = 2;
        } else {
            form.value = defaultForm();
            streetQuery.value = '';
            activeNicknameTag.value = 'Casa';
            step.value = 1;
            if (lookupMode.value === 'street') await loadStreetsDataset();
        }
    }
}, { immediate: true });

const handleNoNumberChange = () => {
    if (form.value.no_number) form.value.number = '';
};

const handleCepInput = () => {
    cepError.value = '';
    const raw = form.value.zipcode.replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (raw.length === 8) {
        fetchCep(raw, form,
            () => { step.value = 2; },
            () => { cepError.value = 'CEP não encontrado. Verifique e tente novamente.'; }
        );
    }
};

const handleStreetSelect = (street) => {
    form.value.street = street.name;
    form.value.street_id = street.id;
    form.value.streetObj = street;
    streetQuery.value = street.name;

    if (street.segments && street.segments.length === 1) {
        form.value.neighborhood = street.segments[0].neighborhood;
        form.value.neighborhood_id = street.segments[0].neighborhood_id || null;
    } else {
        form.value.neighborhood = "";
        form.value.neighborhood_id = null;
    }
    step.value = 2;
};

const goBack = () => {
    if (step.value === 2 && !props.addressToEdit) {
        step.value = 1;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
};
defineExpose({ goBack });

const handleBack = () => {
    if (step.value === 2 && !props.addressToEdit) step.value = 1;
    else {
        emit("cancel");
        if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
    }
};

const handleSupportNeeded = () => {
    openSupport('address_not_found');
};

watch(() => form.value.number, () => { triggerFuzzyNeighborhood(); });
watch(() => form.value.no_number, () => { triggerFuzzyNeighborhood(); });

const triggerFuzzyNeighborhood = () => {
    if (!form.value.no_number) calculateFuzzyNeighborhood(form);
};

const handleSubmit = () => {
    const isAvulso = props.isGuest || !props.customerId;

    loading.value = true;

    if (lookupMode.value === 'street' && form.value.streetObj) {
        form.value.street = form.value.streetObj.name;
    }

    if (isAvulso) {
        form.value.nickname = 'Entrega';
    } else if (activeNicknameTag.value !== 'Outro') {
        form.value.nickname = activeNicknameTag.value;
    }

    if (form.value.no_number) {
        form.value.number = 'S/N';
    } else {
        form.value.number = String(form.value.number);
    }

    const fullAddress = `${form.value.street}, ${form.value.number}${form.value.complement ? ' - ' + form.value.complement : ''} - ${form.value.neighborhood || ''}`;
    const payload = {
        ...form.value,
        full_address: fullAddress
    };

    if (props.isCustomerMode || isAvulso) {
        loading.value = false;
        emit('save', payload);
        emit('success', payload);

        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos:address-selected', { detail: payload }));
        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Endereço Definido', detail: 'Localização vinculada ao pedido.', life: 3000 });

        if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
        return;
    }

    const url = props.addressToEdit
        ? `/operations/customers/${props.customerId}/addresses/${props.addressToEdit.id}`
        : `/operations/customers/${props.customerId}/addresses`;

    router.post(url, form.value, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            loading.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Sucesso', detail: props.addressToEdit ? 'Endereço atualizado!' : 'Endereço cadastrado com sucesso!' });
            emit("success", payload);
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos:address-selected', { detail: payload }));
            if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
        },
        onError: () => {
            loading.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Houve um problema ao salvar o endereço.' });
        }
    });
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.slide-fade-enter-active, .slide-fade-leave-active { transition: all 0.25s ease; }
.slide-fade-enter-from { transform: translateX(20px); opacity: 0; }
.slide-fade-leave-to { transform: translateX(-20px); opacity: 0; }
</style>
```

```vue
                    </FormField>

                    <FormField v-if="customerRegistrationMode === 'cpf_required' || customerRegistrationMode === 'customer_only'" label="CPF" required>
                        <InputText v-model="form.cpf" @input="formatCpfInput" placeholder="000.000.000-00" class="w-full h-12 font-medium" />
                    </FormField>

                    <FormField label="WhatsApp" :required="reqWhatsapp">
                        <InputText v-model="form.phone" @input="formatPhoneInput" placeholder="(00) 00000-0000" class="w-full h-12 font-medium" />
                    </FormField>

                    <FormField v-if="reqBirthDate || !allowMinors" label="Data de Nascimento" :required="reqBirthDate || !allowMinors">
                        <input type="date" v-model="form.birth_date" class="w-full h-12 px-3 rounded-xl border border-surface-border bg-surface-1 text-surface-text text-sm font-medium outline-none focus:border-primary-500 transition-colors" />
                    </FormField>
                </div>
            </template>

            <!-- 🚀 CAMPOS DE LOGIN: EXIBIDOS APENAS QUANDO SOLICITADOS EXPLICITAMENTE -->
            <div class="flex flex-col gap-3 mt-2 border-t border-surface-border/50 pt-4" v-if="(askEmail || askPassword) && (customerRegistrationMode !== 'serpro_magic' || (serproStep !== 'cpf_input' && serproStep !== 'cpf_exists'))">
                <FormField v-if="askEmail" label="E-mail (Login do App)" required>
                    <InputText v-model="form.email" type="email" placeholder="joao@email.com" class="w-full h-12 font-medium" />
                </FormField>

                <template v-if="askPassword">
                    <FormField label="Criar Senha" required>
                        <InputText v-model="form.password" type="password" placeholder="Mínimo de 6 caracteres" class="w-full h-12 font-medium" />
                    </FormField>
                </template>
            </div>

            <!-- RODAPÉ -->
            <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 w-full mt-4" v-if="(customerRegistrationMode !== 'serpro_magic' || (serproStep !== 'cpf_input' && serproStep !== 'cpf_exists'))">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 w-full">
                    <Button label="Cancelar" variant="text" severity="secondary" @click="isVisible = false" class="font-medium flex-1" />
                    <Button
                        label="Finalizar Cadastro"
                        @click="handleSave"
                        class="font-black flex-1 shadow-md"
                        :disabled="!isReadyToSave"
                    />
                </div>

                <button v-if="hasSupport" @click="openSupport('registration_help')" type="button" class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-success-600 flex items-center gap-1 hover:underline outline-none bg-transparent border-none cursor-pointer mt-1">
                    <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-xs"></i> Precisa de ajuda com o cadastro?
                </button>
            </div>

            <div class="flex justify-center mt-6" v-if="hasSupport && customerRegistrationMode === 'serpro_magic' && serproStep === 'cpf_input'">
                <button @click="openSupport('registration_help')" type="button" class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-success-600 flex items-center gap-1 hover:underline outline-none bg-transparent border-none cursor-pointer">
                    <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-xs"></i> Precisa de ajuda com o cadastro?
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </AdaptiveModal>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, watch } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import Button from "primevue/button";
import InputText from "primevue/inputtext";
import FormField from "@/Components/UI/FormField.vue";
import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";

import { useCustomerRegistration } from "@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerRegistration";
import { useWhatsAppSupport } from "@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useWhatsAppSupport";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    initialName: String,
    askPassword: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    askEmail: { type: Boolean, default: false } // 🚀 Padrão false: Não exige e-mail no PDV
});

const emit = defineEmits(["update:visible", "save"]);

const page = usePage();
const { hasSupport, openSupport } = useWhatsAppSupport();

const customerRegistrationMode = computed(() => page.props.companySettings?.customer_registration_mode || 'basic');
const isVisible = computed({ get: () => props.visible, set: (value) => emit("update:visible", value) });

const {
    form, serproStep, isLoadingSerpro, isCpfValid, isFormValid, isMinorError, existingAccount,
    reqWhatsapp, reqBirthDate, allowMinors,
    formatCpfInput, formatPhoneInput, lookupSerpro, resetForm
} = useCustomerRegistration(customerRegistrationMode);

const registrationMode = computed(() => {
    const mode = page.props.companySettings?.customer_registration_mode || 'basic';
    if (mode === 'customer_only') {
        return 'basic';
    }
    return mode;
});

const isSerproMagic = computed(() => registrationMode.value === 'serpro_magic');
const isCpfRequired = computed(() => registrationMode.value === 'cpf_required');

// 🚀 Validação condicional: só exige e-mail ou senha se as props estiverem ativadas
const isReadyToSave = computed(() => {
    if (!isFormValid.value) return false;
    if (props.askEmail && !form.value.email) return false;
    if (props.askPassword && (!form.value.password || form.value.password.length < 6)) return false;
    return true;
});

watch(() => props.visible, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) { resetForm(props.initialName); }
});

const handleSave = () => { emit("save", { ...form.value }); };
const handleSupportHelp = () => { openSupport('login_cpf_exists', { cpf: form.value.cpf }); };
const formatDate = (isoString) => { if (!isoString) return ''; const [y, m, d] = isoString.split('-'); return `${d}/${m}/${y}`; };
</script>
```

```vue
                         v-bind="$attrs"
                         class="relative bg-surface-3/75 saturate-100 dark:bg-surface-1/30 dark:saturate-100 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl w-full md:w-auto min-w-[320px] max-w-full md:max-w-lg lg:max-w-2xl max-h-[90dvh] flex flex-col md:rounded-3xl rounded-t-[2rem] shadow-[0_-20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] overflow-hidden pointer-events-auto z-10"
                         @click.stop>

<script setup>
import { watch, onUnmounted } from 'vue';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = defineProps({ visible: { type: Boolean, required: true } });
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'close', 'save']);

const close = () => { emit('update:visible', false); emit('close'); };
const handleEscape = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && props.visible) close(); };

watch(() => props.visible, (isVisible) => {
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
        if (isVisible) { document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; document.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscape); }
        else { document.body.style.overflow = ''; document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape); }
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') { document.body.style.overflow = ''; document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape); }
});
</script>

.fade-enter-active, .fade-leave-active { transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }

.slide-up-enter-from, .slide-up-leave-to { transform: translateY(100%); opacity: 0; }
```

```vue
<template>
    <nav class="flex items-center gap-1.5 md:gap-2 whitespace-nowrap min-w-0" :class="sizeClasses[size] || sizeClasses.sm">
        <template v-for="(item, idx) in processedItems" :key="idx">
            <span
                class="transition-colors flex items-center whitespace-nowrap"
                :class="[
                    isLast(idx) && !lastItemClickable
                        ? 'font-black text-surface-text cursor-default pointer-events-none'
                        : 'font-bold text-surface-muted hover:text-primary-smart cursor-pointer',
                    isEditMode ? 'opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed' : ''
                ]"
                @click="handleItemClick(item, idx)"
            >
                <i v-if="isHomeItem(item)" class="pi pi-home text-sm leading-none" title="Início"></i>
                <template v-else>{{ getItemLabel(item) }}</template>
            </span>

            <i v-if="idx < processedItems.length - 1" class="pi pi-chevron-right opacity-40 text-[9px] md:text-[10px] shrink-0"></i>
        </template>
    </nav>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    items: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    activeItem: { type: [String, Object], default: null },
    size: { type: String, default: 'sm' },
    isEditMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    lastItemClickable: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['navigate']);

const isHomeItem = (item) => {
    if (!item) return false;
    if (typeof item === 'object' && item.id === null) return true;
    const val = typeof item === 'string' ? item : (item.label || item.name || item.id || '');
    const normalized = String(val).toLowerCase().trim();
    return normalized === 'início' || normalized === 'inicio' || normalized === 'home';
};

const getItemLabel = (item) => {
    if (!item) return '';
    if (typeof item === 'string') return item;
    return item.label || item.name || '';
};

const isLast = (idx) => idx === processedItems.value.length - 1;

const handleItemClick = (item, idx) => {
    if (props.isEditMode) return;
    if (isLast(idx) && !props.lastItemClickable) return;
    emit('navigate', item);
};

// 🚀 Todas as categorias completas, sem "..."
const processedItems = computed(() => {
    let arr = [...props.items];
    if (props.activeItem) {
        arr.push(props.activeItem);
    }
    return arr;
});

const sizeClasses = {
    sm: 'text-sm md:text-base',
    md: 'text-base md:text-lg',
    lg: 'text-lg md:text-xl'
};
</script>
```

```vue
                <i class="shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200" :class="[item.icon + ' text-sm', isCurrent(item.action) ? 'scale-110' : '']"></i>
                <span v-if="isCurrent(item.action)" class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    {{ item.label }}
                </span>

                <span v-if="item.id === 'spooler' && hasPrintErrors" class="absolute top-0.5 right-0.5 min-w-[18px] h-[18px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-danger-500/80 text-white text-[9px] font-black px-1 border-2 border-surface-2 animate-pulse z-10">
                    {{ $page.props.failedJobsCount || $page.props.failedPrintJobsCount }}
                </span>
            </button>
        </template>

        <!-- 4. CHEVRON (Expandir / Recolher) -->
        <button v-if="hiddenGroup.length > 0" @click="isExpanded = !isExpanded"
                class="flex items-center justify-center w-11 h-11 rounded-full transition-all outline-none cursor-pointer border-none bg-transparent hover:bg-surface-3 text-surface-muted shrink-0 relative"
                title="Mais Módulos">
            <i class="text-sm transition-transform duration-300" :class="isExpanded ? 'pi pi-chevron-left' : 'pi pi-chevron-right'"></i>
            <span v-if="!isExpanded && hasHiddenAlert" class="absolute top-2 right-2 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-danger-500 border border-surface-2 animate-pulse"></span>
        </button>

        <!-- 5. PEDIDOS ESTACIONADOS -->
        <div v-if="parkedOrders.length > 0" class="w-px h-6 bg-surface-border/50 mx-1 shrink-0"></div>
        <div v-if="parkedOrders.length > 0" class="relative shrink-0 h-11 w-11">
            <button @click="toggleParkedMenu" class="flex items-center justify-center w-11 h-11 rounded-full transition-all outline-none cursor-pointer border-none bg-transparent text-warning-500 hover:bg-warning-500/20">
                <i class="pi pi-folder-open text-sm"></i>
                <span class="absolute top-0.5 right-0.5 min-w-[18px] h-[18px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-danger-500/50 text-white text-[9px] font-black px-1 border-2 border-surface-2 animate-in zoom-in">
                    {{ parkedOrders.length }}
                </span>
            </button>
            <ParkedOrdersPopover ref="parkedPopover" />
        </div>
    </nav>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, watch } from "vue";
import { router, usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useCart } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart";
import ParkedOrdersPopover from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/ParkedOrdersPopover.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: { type: String, default: 'new' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'expanded-change']);

const page = usePage();
const { parkedOrders } = useCart();
const parkedPopover = ref(null);
const isExpanded = ref(false);
const navContainer = ref(null);

const navItems = [
    { id: 'novo-pedido', label: 'Caixa', icon: 'pi pi-shopping-cart', action: 'new', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: true },
    { id: 'pedidos', label: 'Operação', icon: 'pi pi-objects-column', action: 'orders', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: true },
    { id: 'crm', label: 'CRM', icon: 'pi pi-users', action: 'customers', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: true },
    { id: 'caixa', label: 'Turno', icon: 'pi pi-wallet', action: 'shift', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: true },
    { id: 'tarefas', label: 'Tarefas', icon: 'pi pi-check-square', action: 'tasks', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: false },
    { id: 'estoque', label: 'Estoque', icon: 'pi pi-box', action: 'availability', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: false },
    { id: 'producao', label: 'Produção', icon: 'pi pi-file-plus', action: 'production', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: false },
    { id: 'compras', label: 'Compras', icon: 'pi pi-shopping-bag', action: 'purchases', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: false },
    { id: 'spooler', label: 'Spooler', icon: 'pi pi-print', action: 'printers', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: false },
    { id: 'ajustes', label: 'Ajustes', icon: 'pi pi-cog', action: 'settings', isSpaTab: true, defaultVisible: false },
];

const isCurrent = (action) => {
    return props.modelValue === action;
};

const visibleGroup = computed(() => navItems.filter(item => item.defaultVisible || isCurrent(item.action)));
const hiddenGroup = computed(() => navItems.filter(item => !item.defaultVisible && !isCurrent(item.action)));

const hasPrintErrors = computed(() => page.props.failedJobsCount > 0 || page.props.failedPrintJobsCount > 0);
const hasHiddenAlert = computed(() => hasPrintErrors.value && hiddenGroup.value.some(item => item.id === 'spooler'));

watch(isExpanded, (newValue) => {
    emit('expanded-change', newValue);
});

const navigate = (action, isSpaTab = false) => {
    isExpanded.value = false;

    if (action === 'home') {
        emit('update:modelValue', 'new');
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'new' }));
        return;
    }

    if (isSpaTab) {
        if (props.modelValue === action) {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-reset', { detail: action }));
            return;
        }

        emit('update:modelValue', action);
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: action }));
        return;
    }

    if (window.location.pathname !== action) {
        router.visit(action);
    }
};

const toggleParkedMenu = (event) => parkedPopover.value.toggle(event);

const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
    if (isExpanded.value && navContainer.value && !navContainer.value.contains(event.target)) {
        isExpanded.value = false;
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    document.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    document.removeEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
});
</script>
```

```vue
                v-if="permissionStatus === 'default'"
                @click="enableNotifications"
                class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-danger-500/10 text-danger-500 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-danger-500 hover:text-white transition-colors outline-none cursor-pointer relative"
                title="Ativar Alertas de Sistema"
            >
                <span class="absolute top-0 right-0 w-2 h-2 bg-danger-500 rounded-full animate-ping"></span>
                <span class="absolute top-0 right-0 w-2 h-2 bg-danger-500 rounded-full border border-surface-1"></span>
                <i class="pi pi-bell animate-wiggle"></i>
            </button>

            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-l border-surface-border pl-4">

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import InputText from "primevue/inputtext";
import { usePushNotifications } from '@/Composables/usePushNotifications';

defineProps({
    searchQuery: String,
    operatorName: String,
});

defineEmits(['update:searchQuery']);

const page = usePage();
const { requestPushPermission, subscribeToWebPush } = usePushNotifications();

// Lê o status real imediatamente
const permissionStatus = ref(
    typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'Notification' in window
    ? Notification.permission
    : 'granted'
);

const enableNotifications = async () => {
    const granted = await requestPushPermission();
    if (granted) {
        permissionStatus.value = 'granted';
        await subscribeToWebPush(page.props.vapidPublicKey);
    } else {
        permissionStatus.value = 'denied';
    }
};
</script>

<style scoped>
@keyframes wiggle {
    0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-10deg); }
    50% { transform: rotate(10deg); }
}
.animate-wiggle { animation: wiggle 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
</style>
```
