```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: { type: [Object, String, Number, null], default: null },
    results: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    isLoading: { type: Boolean, default: false },

    // Chaves de resolução de dados
    labelKey: { type: [String, Function], default: "name" },
    subtitleKey: { type: [String, Function], default: null },
    itemKey: { type: [String, Function], default: "id" },
    iconKey: { type: [String, Function], default: null },

    // Configurações de Input
    placeholder: { type: String, default: "Digite para pesquisar..." },
    searchIcon: { type: String, default: "pi-search" },
    minSearchLength: { type: Number, default: 2 },
    debounceTime: { type: Number, default: 250 },

    // Habilidades Opcionais
    allowCustom: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    customActionLabel: { type: String, default: "Usar termo digitado" },
    allowCreate: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    createActionLabel: { type: String, default: "Cadastrar novo registro" },
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    "update:modelValue",
    "select",
    "search",
    "custom",
    "create",
    "confirm",
    "clear"
]);

const containerRef = ref(null);
const inputRef = ref(null);
const query = ref("");
const showDropdown = ref(false);
let debounceTimeout = null;

const hasSelection = computed(() => props.modelValue !== null && props.modelValue !== undefined && props.modelValue !== "");

const resolveValue = (item, resolver) => {
    if (!item) return "";
    if (typeof resolver === "function") return resolver(item);
    if (typeof item === "object" && resolver) return item[resolver] ?? "";
    return String(item);
};

const resolveKey = (item, index) => {
    const key = resolveValue(item, props.itemKey);
    return key !== "" ? key : index;
};

const displayLabel = computed(() => {
    if (!props.modelValue) return "";
    return resolveValue(props.modelValue, props.labelKey);
});

const displaySubtitle = computed(() => {
    if (!props.modelValue) return "";
    return resolveValue(props.modelValue, props.subtitleKey);
});

const resolvedIcon = computed(() => {
    if (!props.modelValue) return null;
    return resolveValue(props.modelValue, props.iconKey);
});

const getInitials = (text) => {
    if (!text || typeof text !== "string") return "?";
    return text.trim().split(" ").slice(0, 2).map(w => w[0]).join("").toUpperCase();
};

const handleInput = (event) => {
    query.value = event.target.value;
    showDropdown.value = true;

    clearTimeout(debounceTimeout);
    debounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        emit("search", query.value);
    }, props.debounceTime);
};

const handleSelect = (item) => {
    showDropdown.value = false;
    query.value = "";
    emit("update:modelValue", item);
    emit("select", item);
};

const handleCustomSelect = () => {
    const customValue = query.value.trim();
    showDropdown.value = false;
    query.value = "";
    emit("update:modelValue", customValue);
    emit("custom", customValue);
};

const handleCreate = () => {
    const value = query.value.trim();
    showDropdown.value = false;
    emit("create", value);
};

const handleEnter = () => {
    if (props.results.length > 0) {
        handleSelect(props.results[0]);
    } else if (props.allowCustom && query.value.trim()) {
        handleCustomSelect();
    }
};

const handleClear = () => {
    query.value = "";
    emit("update:modelValue", null);
    emit("clear");
    setTimeout(() => {
        showDropdown.value = true;
        inputRef.value?.focus();
    }, 50);
};

const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
    if (containerRef.value && !containerRef.value.contains(event.target)) {
        showDropdown.value = false;
    }
};

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("click", handleClickOutside));
onUnmounted(() => {
    document.removeEventListener("click", handleClickOutside);
    clearTimeout(debounceTimeout);
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.animate-expand-vertical {

    transform-origin: top;
}
@keyframes expandVertical {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: scaleY(0.96); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(1); }
}
</style>
```

```vue
            @input="handleInput"
            @focus="resetInactivityTimer"
            :placeholder="placeholder"
            class="w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-8 rounded-full bg-surface-1/90 text-surface-text text-xs font-medium border border-surface-border/60 focus:border-primary-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/20 outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-surface-muted/60"
        />
        <button
            v-if="modelValue"
            @click="clear"
            type="button"
            class="absolute inset-y-0 right-1 w-8 flex items-center justify-center text-surface-muted hover:text-surface-text transition-colors outline-none cursor-pointer border-none bg-transparent"
        >
            <i class="pi pi-times-circle text-sm"></i>
        </button>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onUnmounted } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: String,
    placeholder: { type: String, default: 'Buscar...' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);
const searchInput = ref(null);
let typingTimer = null;

const resetInactivityTimer = () => {
    if (typingTimer) clearTimeout(typingTimer);
    typingTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        searchInput.value?.blur();
    }, 3000);
};

const handleInput = (event) => {
    emit('update:modelValue', event.target.value);
    resetInactivityTimer();
};

const clear = () => {
    emit('update:modelValue', '');
    if (typingTimer) clearTimeout(typingTimer);
    searchInput.value?.focus();
};

onUnmounted(() => {
    if (typingTimer) clearTimeout(typingTimer);
});
</script>
```

```vue
                        </div>
                        <input type="checkbox" v-model="isNoChange" class="hidden" />
                    </label>
                </div>

                <div class="relative transition-all duration-300" :class="isNoChange ? 'opacity-40 grayscale pointer-events-none' : ''">
                    <span class="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 font-black text-orange-800/50 dark:text-orange-400/50">R$</span>
                    <input
                        type="text"
                        inputmode="numeric"
                        :value="formattedChangeTarget"
                        @input="handleCashInput"
                        placeholder="0,00"
                        class="w-full p-4 pl-12 rounded-xl border border-orange-300 dark:border-orange-700 text-right font-black text-2xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-950 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/50 text-orange-900 dark:text-orange-100 transition-colors"
                    />
                </div>

                <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-1">
                    <Button label="Cancelar" size="small" variant="text" severity="secondary" @click="cancelCashPayment" />
                    <Button label="Confirmar" size="small" severity="warning" @click="executeCashPayment" :disabled="!isNoChange && numericChangeTarget < localAmount" />
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- FORMAS DE PAGAMENTO -->
            <div v-else class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-3 border-t-2 border-surface-border/50 mt-1">
                <button
                    v-for="method in availableMethods"
                    :key="method.id"
                    @click="handleMethodClick(method)"
                    :disabled="isMethodDisabled(method)"
                    class="p-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl flex flex-row items-center justify-start gap-3 transition-all text-left border"
                    :class="[
                        method.colorClass || 'border-stone-100 dark:border-stone-800 bg-surface-1 text-stone-600 dark:text-stone-300 hover:border-primary-500 hover:bg-primary-50 hover:text-primary-700',
                        { 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed': isMethodDisabled(method), 'cursor-pointer': !isMethodDisabled(method) }
                    ]"
                >
                    <i :class="['pi', method.icon, method.iconColor || 'text-xl', 'shrink-0']"></i>

                    <div class="flex flex-col items-start min-w-0 flex-1 leading-tight">
                        <span class="font-black text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider truncate w-full">{{ method.name }}</span>
                        <span v-if="method.subtitle" class="text-[9px] font-medium opacity-75 truncate w-full mt-0.5">{{ method.subtitle }}</span>
                    </div>
                </button>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';
import Button from 'primevue/button';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';
import { useCashInput } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCashInput';

const props = defineProps({
    availableMethods: {
        type: Array,
        default: () => []
    },
    stagedPayments: {
        type: Array,
        default: () => []
    },
    remainingAmount: {
        type: Number,
        default: 0
    },
    allowChangeTarget: {
        type: Boolean,
        default: false
    },
    suggestedAmount: {
        type: Number,
        default: null
    },
    activeDivisor: {
        type: Number,
        default: null
    }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['add-payment', 'remove-payment', 'divide', 'clear-divisor']);

const localAmount = ref(props.suggestedAmount ?? props.remainingAmount);
const pendingCashMethod = ref(null);

const {
    isNoChange,
    formattedChangeTarget,
    numericChangeTarget,
    handleCashInput,
    resetCashInput
} = useCashInput();

watch(() => props.suggestedAmount, (newVal) => {
    if (newVal !== null && newVal !== undefined && newVal > 0) {
        localAmount.value = newVal;
    }
}, { immediate: true });

watch(() => props.remainingAmount, (newVal) => {
    if (!props.activeDivisor && newVal > 0) {
        localAmount.value = newVal;
    }
});

const handleSetRemaining = () => {
    emit('clear-divisor');
    localAmount.value = props.remainingAmount;
};

const isMethodDisabled = (method) => {
    if (method.disabled) return true;
    if (method.engine_type === 'internal_loyalty') return false;
    return !localAmount.value || localAmount.value <= 0;
};

const handleMethodClick = (method) => {
    if (isMethodDisabled(method)) return;

    if (method.engine_type === 'internal_loyalty') {
        emit('add-payment', {
            method_id: method.id,
            method_name: method.name,
            engine_type: method.engine_type,
            amount: Number(Math.min(method.max_value, props.remainingAmount).toFixed(2)),
            change_target: null
        });
        return;
    }

    if (props.allowChangeTarget && method.is_cash) {
        pendingCashMethod.value = method;
        resetCashInput();
    } else {
        emit('add-payment', {
            method_id: method.id,
            method_name: method.name,
            engine_type: method.engine_type,
            amount: Number(localAmount.value),
            change_target: null
        });
    }
};

const executeCashPayment = () => {
    emit('add-payment', {
        method_id: pendingCashMethod.value.id,
        method_name: pendingCashMethod.value.name,
        engine_type: pendingCashMethod.value.engine_type,
        amount: Number(localAmount.value),
        change_target: isNoChange.value ? null : numericChangeTarget.value
    });

    cancelCashPayment();
};

const cancelCashPayment = () => {
    pendingCashMethod.value = null;
    resetCashInput();
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { computed } from 'vue';

    icon: { type: String, required: true },
    label: { type: String, default: '' },
    color: { type: String, default: 'primary' }, // primary, success, danger, warning, surface
    active: { type: Boolean, default: false },   // Modo liga/desliga: 60% quando ligado
    disabled: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    loading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    badge: { type: [String, Number], default: null },
    badgeSeverity: { type: String, default: 'danger' } // danger, warning, success, primary
});

const colorPalette = {
    primary: {
        idle: 'bg-primary-500/5 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-400 hover:bg-primary-500/20',
        active: 'bg-primary-500/40 text-white shadow-sm'
    },
    success: {
        idle: 'bg-emerald-500/5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/20',
        active: 'bg-emerald-500/40 text-white shadow-sm'
    },
    danger: {
        idle: 'bg-rose-500/5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500/20',
        active: 'bg-rose-500/40 text-white shadow-sm'
    },
    warning: {
        idle: 'bg-amber-500/5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500/20',
        active: 'bg-amber-500/40 text-white shadow-sm'
    },
    surface: {
        idle: 'bg-surface-3/50 text-surface-muted hover:bg-surface-3/80 hover:text-surface-text',
        active: 'bg-surface-4 text-surface-text shadow-sm'
    }
};

const badgeClasses = {
    danger: 'bg-danger-500 text-white animate-pulse',
    warning: 'bg-warning-500 text-white',
    success: 'bg-success-smart text-white',
    primary: 'bg-primary-500 text-white'
};

const colorClasses = computed(() => {
    const scheme = colorPalette[props.color] || colorPalette.primary;
    return props.active ? scheme.active : scheme.idle;
});
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 flex-wrap" role="progressbar">
        <template v-for="idx in totalSegments" :key="idx">
            <div
                class="rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)]"
                :class="[getSegmentClass(idx - 1), isGlass ? 'h-1.5' : 'h-2.5']"
            ></div>
        </template>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    current: { type: [Number, String], default: 0 },
    max: { type: [Number, String], default: 1 },
    freeLimit: { type: [Number, String], default: null },
    mode: { type: String, default: 'wizard' },
    isGlass: { type: Boolean, default: false } // 🚀 Prop ativadora do modo vidro
});

const safeCurrent = computed(() => Number(props.current) || 0);
const safeMax = computed(() => Number(props.max) || 1);
const safeFree = computed(() => props.freeLimit !== null ? Number(props.freeLimit) : null);

const totalSegments = computed(() => {
    return safeMax.value > 20 ? 10 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(safeMax.value));
});

const currentStep = computed(() => {
    if (safeMax.value > 20) {
        const perc = safeCurrent.value / safeMax.value;
        return Math.min(Math.floor(perc * totalSegments.value), totalSegments.value);
    }
    return Math.floor(safeCurrent.value);
});

const getSegmentClass = (index) => {
    const colorMap = {
        primary: {
            active: props.isGlass ? 'bg-primary-400' : 'bg-primary-500',
            completed: props.isGlass ? 'bg-primary-400/40' : 'bg-primary-500/40'
        },
        success: {
            active: props.isGlass ? 'bg-emerald-400' : 'bg-success-500',
            completed: props.isGlass ? 'bg-emerald-400/40' : 'bg-success-500/40'
        },
        warning: {
            active: props.isGlass ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-warning-500',
            completed: props.isGlass ? 'bg-amber-400/40' : 'bg-warning-500/40'
        },
    };

    let colorKey = 'primary';
    if (safeCurrent.value >= safeMax.value) {
        colorKey = 'success';
    } else if (safeFree.value !== null && safeCurrent.value >= safeFree.value) {
        colorKey = 'warning';
    }

    const palette = colorMap[colorKey];

    if (currentStep.value >= totalSegments.value) {
        return `w-6 ${palette.active}`;
    }

    if (props.mode === 'wizard') {
        if (index === currentStep.value) return `w-12 ${palette.active}`;
        if (index < currentStep.value) return `w-6 ${palette.completed}`;
        return `w-3 ${props.isGlass ? 'bg-white/20' : 'bg-surface-border'}`;
    } else {
        if (index < currentStep.value) return `w-8 ${palette.active}`;
        return `w-3 opacity-40 ${props.isGlass ? 'bg-white/20' : 'bg-surface-border'}`;
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { usePushNotifications } from '@/Composables/usePushNotifications';

const page = usePage();
const { requestPushPermission, subscribeToWebPush } = usePushNotifications();

// Substitua a linha 30 por esta:
const permissionStatus = ref(
    typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'Notification' in window
    ? Notification.permission
    : 'granted'
);

onMounted(() => {
    if ("Notification" in window) {
        permissionStatus.value = Notification.permission;
    }
});

const enableNotifications = async () => {
    const granted = await requestPushPermission();
    if (granted) {
        permissionStatus.value = 'granted';
        // Usa a VAPID key que já está sendo injetada pelo seu HandleInertiaRequests
        await subscribeToWebPush(page.props.vapidPublicKey);
    } else {
        permissionStatus.value = 'denied';
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: { type: [Number, String], required: true },
    min: { type: [Number, String], default: 1 },
    max: { type: [Number, String], default: null },
    step: { type: [Number, String], default: 1 },
    size: { type: String, default: 'md' },
    variant: { type: String, default: 'default' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'increment', 'decrement']);

const sizeClasses = {
    sm: { container: 'h-8 w-24 p-0.5', text: 'text-xs', icon: 'text-[10px]' },
    md: { container: 'h-11 w-28 p-1', text: 'text-sm font-black', icon: 'text-xs' },
    lg: { container: 'h-14 w-36 p-1.5', text: 'text-xl font-black', icon: 'text-base' }
};

const numMin = computed(() => {
    const val = Number(props.min);
    return isNaN(val) ? 1 : val;
});

const numMax = computed(() => {
    if (props.max === null || props.max === undefined || props.max === '') return null;
    const val = Number(props.max);
    return isNaN(val) ? null : val;
});

const numStep = computed(() => {
    const val = Number(props.step);
    return isNaN(val) || val <= 0 ? 1 : val;
});

const numValue = computed(() => {
    const val = Number(props.modelValue);
    return isNaN(val) ? numMin.value : val;
});

const increment = () => {
    if (numMax.value === null || numValue.value < numMax.value) {
        const next = numValue.value + numStep.value;
        emit('update:modelValue', next);
        emit('increment', next);
    }
};

const decrement = () => {
    if (numValue.value > numMin.value) {
        const prev = Math.max(numMin.value, numValue.value - numStep.value);
        emit('update:modelValue', prev);
        emit('decrement', prev);
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
    <div class="relative w-full" ref="containerRef">
        <input
            ref="inputRef"
            type="text"
            :value="modelValue"
            :placeholder="placeholder"
            :autofocus="autofocus"
            class="w-full h-14 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm outline-none transition-all"
            :class="isCustomerMode
                ? 'bg-white/10 border-none text-white placeholder:text-white/30 focus:bg-white/15'
                : 'bg-surface-1 border border-transparent text-surface-text focus:border-primary-500'"
            @input="handleInput"
            @focus="handleFocus"
        />

        <!-- TELEPORT COM POSICIONAMENTO INTELIGENTE (CIMA / BAIXO) -->
        <Teleport to="body">
            <Transition name="fade-up">
                <div
                    v-if="isOpen && suggestions.length > 0"
                    ref="dropdownRef"
                    :style="dropdownStyle"
                    class="fixed z-[9999] overflow-y-auto hide-scrollbar rounded-2xl p-2 flex flex-col gap-1 border shadow-2xl"
                    :class="isCustomerMode
                        ? 'bg-surface-ground/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border-white/10 text-white'
                        : 'bg-surface-2 border-surface-border text-surface-text'"
                >
                    <button
                        v-for="(item, idx) in suggestions"
                        :key="item.id || idx"
                        type="button"
                        @click="selectItem(item)"
                        class="w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer border-none outline-none flex flex-col"
                        :class="isCustomerMode
                            ? 'hover:bg-white/10 active:bg-white/15 text-white'
                            : 'hover:bg-surface-3 active:bg-surface-4 text-surface-text'"
                    >
                        <slot name="option" :option="item">
                            <span class="font-bold text-sm">{{ item[field] || item }}</span>
                            <span v-if="item.neighborhood?.name" class="text-xs text-surface-muted">
                                {{ item.neighborhood.name }}
                            </span>
                        </slot>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </Transition>
        </Teleport>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, watch, nextTick, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: { type: String, default: '' },
    suggestions: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    placeholder: { type: String, default: '' },
    field: { type: String, default: 'name' },
    isCustomerMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    autofocus: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'search', 'select']);

const inputRef = ref(null);
const containerRef = ref(null);
const dropdownRef = ref(null);
const isOpen = ref(false);
const dropdownStyle = ref({});

const updatePosition = () => {
    if (!inputRef.value || !isOpen.value) {
        console.log("🛸 [SONDA 7 - AUTOCOMPLETE] updatePosition abortado. inputRef:", !!inputRef.value, "isOpen:", isOpen.value);
        return;
    }

    const rect = inputRef.value.getBoundingClientRect();
    const spaceBelow = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom;
    const spaceAbove = rect.top;

    const openUpwards = spaceBelow < 220 && spaceAbove > spaceBelow;

    if (openUpwards) {
        dropdownStyle.value = {
            position: 'fixed',
            left: `${rect.left}px`,
            width: `${rect.width}px`,
            bottom: `${window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8}px`,
            top: 'auto',
            maxHeight: `${Math.min(spaceAbove - 24, 280)}px`
        };
    } else {
        dropdownStyle.value = {
            position: 'fixed',
            left: `${rect.left}px`,
            width: `${rect.width}px`,
            top: `${rect.bottom + 8}px`,
            bottom: 'auto',
            maxHeight: `${Math.min(spaceBelow - 24, 280)}px`
        };
    }

    console.log("🛸 [SONDA 8 - AUTOCOMPLETE] Estilo calculado para a lista flutuante:", dropdownStyle.value);
};

const handleInput = (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    console.log("🛸 [SONDA 5 - AUTOCOMPLETE] handleInput disparado. Valor atual:", val);

    emit('update:modelValue', val);
    emit('search', val);

    if (val.trim().length >= 1) {
        isOpen.value = true;
        nextTick(updatePosition);
    } else {
        isOpen.value = false;
    }
};

const handleFocus = () => {
    if (props.modelValue.trim().length >= 1 && props.suggestions.length > 0) {
        isOpen.value = true;
        nextTick(updatePosition);
    }
};

const selectItem = (item) => {
    isOpen.value = false;
    emit('select', item);
};

const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
    if (!isOpen.value) return;

    const clickedInput = containerRef.value && containerRef.value.contains(e.target);
    const clickedDropdown = dropdownRef.value && dropdownRef.value.contains(e.target);

    if (!clickedInput && !clickedDropdown) {
        isOpen.value = false;
    }
};

watch(() => props.suggestions, (newSuggestions) => {
    console.log("🛸 [SONDA 6 - AUTOCOMPLETE] Recebeu 'suggestions' atualizadas. Total:", newSuggestions?.length);
    if (isOpen.value) {
        nextTick(updatePosition);
    }
}, { deep: true });

onMounted(() => {
    document.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', updatePosition, true);
    window.addEventListener('resize', updatePosition);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    document.removeEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
    window.removeEventListener('scroll', updatePosition, true);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', updatePosition);
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.fade-up-enter-active, .fade-up-leave-active {
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}
.fade-up-enter-from, .fade-up-leave-to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(4px);
}
</style>
```

```vue
    <button
        type="button"
        @click="handleClick"
        :disabled="disabled || isLoading"
        class="relative flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all outline-none cursor-pointer overflow-hidden select-none"
        :class="[
            baseClasses,
            customClass,
            { 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed': disabled || isLoading },
            { 'animate-shake ring-2 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(239,68,68,0.5)] ring-danger-500': isShaking }
        ]"
    >
        <!-- Overlay de carregamento -->
        <div v-if="isLoading" class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-sm z-10 rounded-inherit">
            <i class="pi pi-spinner animate-spin text-current"></i>
        </div>

        <i v-if="icon && !isLoading" :class="['pi', icon]"></i>
        <span v-if="label && !isLoading" class="font-bold whitespace-nowrap">{{ label }}</span>

        <!-- Renderiza o slot (para cards e layouts complexos) ocultando durante o loading se necessário -->
        <div v-if="$slots.default && !isLoading" class="contents">
            <slot></slot>
        </div>
    </button>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    actionCode: { type: String, required: true },
    label: { type: String, default: '' },
    icon: { type: String, default: '' },
    severity: { type: String, default: 'primary' }, // primary, danger, warning, secondary, success
    variant: { type: String, default: 'solid' }, // solid, outlined, text
    disabled: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isLoading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    customClass: { type: String, default: '' } // Padding e border-radius agora são flexíveis
});

const emit = defineEmits(['secure-click']);
const isShaking = ref(false);

const baseClasses = computed(() => {
    let classes = '';

    // Se não for passado um customClass com padding específico, aplica um padrão
    if (!props.customClass.includes('p-') && !props.customClass.includes('px-') && !props.customClass.includes('w-') && !props.label && props.icon) {
        // Estilo botão apenas ícone (quadrado/redondo)
        classes += ' w-11 h-11 rounded-xl ';
    } else if (!props.customClass.includes('px-') && !props.customClass.includes('p-')) {
        // Estilo botão normal
        classes += ' px-4 h-11 rounded-xl text-sm ';
    }

    // Variantes e Severidades
    if (props.variant === 'solid') {
        switch (props.severity) {
            case 'danger': return classes + 'bg-danger-500 hover:bg-danger-400 text-white border-none shadow-sm';
            case 'warning': return classes + 'bg-warning-500 hover:bg-warning-400 text-black border-none shadow-sm';
            case 'secondary': return classes + 'bg-surface-2 hover:bg-surface-3 text-surface-text border-none shadow-sm';
            case 'success': return classes + 'bg-success-500 hover:bg-success-400 text-white border-none shadow-sm';
            default: return classes + 'bg-primary-500 hover:bg-primary-400 text-white border-none shadow-sm';
        }
    }

    if (props.variant === 'outlined') {
        classes += ' border border-solid bg-transparent hover:bg-surface-1 ';
        switch (props.severity) {
            case 'danger': return classes + 'border-danger-500 text-danger-500';
            case 'warning': return classes + 'border-warning-500 text-warning-600';
            case 'secondary': return classes + 'border-surface-border text-surface-text';
            case 'success': return classes + 'border-success-500 text-success-500';
            default: return classes + 'border-primary-500 text-primary-500';
        }
    }

    if (props.variant === 'text') {
        classes += ' bg-transparent border-none hover:bg-surface-1 ';
        switch (props.severity) {
            case 'danger': return classes + 'text-danger-500';
            case 'warning': return classes + 'text-warning-600';
            case 'secondary': return classes + 'text-surface-muted hover:text-surface-text';
            case 'success': return classes + 'text-success-500';
            default: return classes + 'text-primary-500';
        }
    }

    return classes;
});

const triggerShake = () => {
    isShaking.value = true;
    setTimeout(() => { isShaking.value = false; }, 500);
};

const handleClick = (e) => {
    if (props.disabled || props.isLoading) return;
    emit('secure-click', { actionCode: props.actionCode, event: e, fail: triggerShake });
};

defineExpose({ triggerShake });
</script>

<style scoped>

@keyframes shake {
    10%, 90% { transform: translate3d(-1px, 0, 0); }
    20%, 80% { transform: translate3d(2px, 0, 0); }
    30%, 50%, 70% { transform: translate3d(-3px, 0, 0); }
    40%, 60% { transform: translate3d(3px, 0, 0); }
}
</style>
```

```vue
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { useSlideToConfirm } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useSlideToConfirm';

const props = defineProps({
    text: { type: String, default: 'Deslize para Confirmar' },
    successText: { type: String, default: 'Confirmado!' },
    icon: { type: String, default: 'pi-chevron-right' },
    color: { type: String, default: 'primary' },
    disabled: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isLoading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isSuccess: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    format: {
        type: String,
        default: 'long',
        validator: (value) => ['short', 'long'].includes(value)
    }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['confirm']);

// 📳 Helper seguro para vibração em dispositivos móveis
const triggerHaptic = (pattern) => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'vibrate' in navigator) {
        try {
            navigator.vibrate(pattern);
        } catch {
            // Ignora silenciosamente navegadores sem suporte de hardware
        }
    }
};

const interceptedEmit = (eventName, ...args) => {
    if (eventName === 'confirm') {
        if (props.disabled || props.isLoading || props.isSuccess) return;

        // Se a ação for verde/sucesso, vibra em pulso duplo; senão, pulso de confirmação padrão
        const slidePattern = props.color === 'success' ? [60, 40, 100] : 60;
        triggerHaptic(slidePattern);

        emit('confirm', ...args);
    } else {
        emit(eventName, ...args);
    }
};

// 🚀 Vibração dupla mais longa no momento em que a prop isSuccess pinta o botão de verde
watch(() => props.isSuccess, (newVal, oldVal) => {
    if (newVal && !oldVal) {
        triggerHaptic([70, 50, 160]);
    }
});

const colorThemes = {
    primary: { track: 'bg-primary-500/10', border: 'border-primary-500/20', text: 'text-primary-400', thumb: 'bg-primary-500', trail: 'bg-primary-500/20' },

};

const activeTheme = computed(() => colorThemes[props.color] || colorThemes.primary);
const track = ref(null);
const thumb = ref(null);

const { isDragging, dragOffset, handleTrackInteraction, startDrag } = useSlideToConfirm(props, interceptedEmit, track, thumb);
```

## File: resources/js/Composables/useAppLifecycleSync.js
```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue';

export function useAppLifecycleSync(options = {}) {
    const {
        only = [],              // Propriedades do Inertia a recarregar
        minSleepSeconds = 10,   // Tempo mínimo em segundo plano para sincronizar
        onWake = null,          // Callback executado ao acordar com sessão válida
        onSessionExpired = null // Callback customizado caso a sessão expire
    } = options;

    let lastHiddenTime = 0;
    let isChecking = false;

    const handleSessionExpired = () => {
        if (typeof onSessionExpired === 'function') {
            onSessionExpired();
            return;
        }

        // Força um recarregamento total via HTTP GET.
        // Isso renova os cookies, obtém um novo token CSRF e deixa o middleware
        // de autenticação do Laravel redirecionar o utilizador para a tela de PIN/Login.
        window.location.reload();
    };

    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
            lastHiddenTime = Date.now();
            return;
        }

        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            const timeInBackground = (Date.now() - lastHiddenTime) / 1000;

            // Se ficou em segundo plano pelo tempo mínimo configurado
            if (lastHiddenTime > 0 && timeInBackground >= minSleepSeconds && !isChecking) {
                isChecking = true;

                // 1. Reconecta o WebSocket caso o Pusher/Echo tenha dormido
                if (window.Echo?.connector?.pusher) {
                    const state = window.Echo.connector.pusher.connection.state;
                    if (state !== 'connected') {
                        window.Echo.connector.pusher.connect();
                    }
                }

                // 2. Garante que 'auth' SEMPRE seja revalidado no reload
                const propsToReload = only.length > 0
                    ? Array.from(new Set([...only, 'auth']))
                    : undefined;

                // 3. Recarrega as props e inspeciona a saúde da sessão
                router.reload({
                    only: propsToReload,
                    preserveState: true,
                    preserveScroll: true,
                    onSuccess: (page) => {
                        isChecking = false;

                        // Se o backend respondeu 200 mas o utilizador não está mais autenticado
                        const user = page.props?.auth?.user;
                        if (!user) {
                            handleSessionExpired();
                            return;
                        }

                        if (typeof onWake === 'function') {
                            onWake(page);
                        }
                    },
                    onError: () => {
                        isChecking = false;
                    },
                    onFinish: (visit) => {
                        isChecking = false;

                        // 401 = Sessão expirada / Não autorizado
                        // 419 = Token CSRF expirado em segundo plano
                        // 403 = Tenant ou permissão revogada
                        if ([401, 419, 403].includes(visit?.statusCode)) {
                            handleSessionExpired();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            lastHiddenTime = 0;
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
        window.addEventListener('pageshow', handleVisibilityChange); // Suporte ao bfcache do Safari iOS
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
        window.removeEventListener('pageshow', handleVisibilityChange);
    });
}
```

```javascript
export function useAudioAlert() {
    const playBeep = (type = 'cashier') => {
        try {
            const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            if (!AudioContext) return;

            const ctx = new AudioContext();

            if (type === 'cashier') {
                // 🛎️ Som de campainha de balcão (Ding-Dong suave)
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);

                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(783.99, ctx.currentTime); // G5 (Ding)
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, ctx.currentTime + 0.3); // E5 (Dong)

                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, ctx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.8, 0.1);

                osc.start(ctx.currentTime);
                osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 1);
            }
            else if (type === 'kds') {
                // 🖨️ Som de impressora de cozinha (3 beeps agudos e curtos)
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);

                    osc.type = 'square';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(800, ctx.currentTime + (i * 0.2));

                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime + (i * 0.2));
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime + (i * 0.2) + 0.1);

                    osc.start(ctx.currentTime + (i * 0.2));
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (i * 0.2) + 0.15);
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn("Áudio não suportado ou bloqueado pelo navegador:", e);
        }
    };

    return { playBeep };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Composables/useChecklists.js
```javascript
import { useTenantEcho } from '@/Composables/useTenantEcho'; // 🚀 Importação do isolador de Tenant
import axios from 'axios';
import { ref } from 'vue';

export function useChecklists() {
    const checklists = ref([]);
    const isLoading = ref(true);

    const isIssueModalVisible = ref(false);
    const selectedTask = ref(null);
    const issueNotes = ref('');

    // 🚀 Inicia a escuta isolada
    const { listenChannel } = useTenantEcho();

    const fetchChecklists = async () => {
        isLoading.value = true;
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route('operations.checklists.index'));
            checklists.value = response.data.checklists || [];
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Erro ao carregar checklists", e);
        } finally {
            isLoading.value = false;
        }
    };

    const translateTrigger = (type) => {
        const map = {
            shift_start: 'Abertura de Turno',
            shift_end: 'Fechamento',
            scheduled: 'Agendado',
            manual: 'Livre'
        };
        return map[type] || type;
    };

    const formatDeadline = (task) => {
        if (task.recurrence_type === 'once' && task.deadline_date) {
            return `Até ${new Date(task.deadline_date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')} ${new Date(task.deadline_date).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}`;
        }
        if (['shift_start', 'shift_end'].includes(task.trigger_type) && task.deadline_minutes) {
            return `Tolerância: ${task.deadline_minutes} min`;
        }
        if (task.trigger_type === 'scheduled' && task.trigger_time) {
            return `Às ${task.trigger_time.substring(0, 5)}`;
        }
        return 'Sem prazo rígido';
    };

    const markTask = async (taskId, status, notes = null) => {
        checklists.value.forEach(list => {
            const task = list.tasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            if (task) {
                const oldStatus = task.status;
                task.status = status;
                task.notes = notes;

                if (oldStatus === 'pending' && status !== 'pending') list.progress++;
                if (oldStatus !== 'pending' && status === 'pending') list.progress--;
            }
        });

        try {
            await axios.post(route('operations.checklists.sync'), { task_id: taskId, status, notes });
        } catch (e) {
            fetchChecklists();
        }
    };

    const openIssueModal = (task) => {
        selectedTask.value = task;
        issueNotes.value = task.notes || '';
        isIssueModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const submitIssue = () => {
        if (selectedTask.value && issueNotes.value) {
            markTask(selectedTask.value.id, 'issue', issueNotes.value);
            isIssueModalVisible.value = false;
        }
    };

    const listenForRealTimeUpdates = () => {
        // 🚀 O SEGREDO ESTÁ AQUI: Usamos a nossa função segura em vez do window.Echo direto!
        listenChannel('operations', '.ChecklistsUpdated', () => {
            console.log('🔄 Atualização recebida via Reverb! Recarregando tarefas...');
            fetchChecklists();
        });
    };

    return {
        checklists, isLoading, isIssueModalVisible, selectedTask, issueNotes,
        fetchChecklists, translateTrigger, formatDeadline, markTask,
        openIssueModal, submitIssue, listenForRealTimeUpdates
    };
}
```

```javascript
export function useClipboard() {

    const copyToClipboard = async (text, successMessage = "Copiado com sucesso!") => {
        try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            toast.add({ severity: "success", summary: "Copiado!", detail: successMessage, life: 3000 });
            return true;
        } catch (err) {
            toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Erro", detail: "Não foi possível copiar o texto. O seu navegador pode estar a bloquear.", life: 4000 });
            return false;
        }
    };

    return { copyToClipboard };
}
```

```javascript
import { useStoreStatus } from '@/Composables/useStoreStatus';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { computed, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';

// 🚀 SINGLETON GLOBAL: Mantém o valor em memória durante a navegação SPA
const currentBackground = ref(null);

export function useDynamicBackground(forceOpen = false) {
    const page = usePage();
    const { isOpen } = useStoreStatus();

    const pickRandomBackground = (forceRepick = false) => {
        const settings = page.props.publicSettings || page.props.companySettings || {};

        const bgOpen = settings.home_bg_open || [];
        const bgClosed = settings.home_bg_closed || [];

        const currentStatus = (isOpen.value || forceOpen);
        let pool = currentStatus ? bgOpen : (bgClosed.length > 0 ? bgClosed : bgOpen);

        // 🚀 A MÁGICA DA CONTINUIDADE:
        // Lemos do sessionStorage para manter a identidade visual até num F5 (Refresh).
        const savedBg = sessionStorage.getItem('brasume_current_bg');
        const savedStatus = sessionStorage.getItem('brasume_bg_status');

        // Se não estamos forçando a troca, e já temos um fundo salvo que ainda faz sentido pro status atual...
        if (!forceRepick && savedBg && savedStatus === String(currentStatus) && pool.includes(savedBg)) {
            currentBackground.value = savedBg;
            return;
        }

        // Sorteia um novo se for a primeira vez, se não tiver cache, ou se a loja fechou/abriu
        if (pool && pool.length > 0) {
            const picked = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
            currentBackground.value = picked;
            sessionStorage.setItem('brasume_current_bg', picked);
            sessionStorage.setItem('brasume_bg_status', String(currentStatus));
        } else {
            currentBackground.value = null;
            sessionStorage.removeItem('brasume_current_bg');
            sessionStorage.removeItem('brasume_bg_status');
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        pickRandomBackground();
    });

    watch(isOpen, () => {
        // 🚀 Passamos "true" para forçar um novo sorteio já que a loja mudou de Aberto pra Fechado
        pickRandomBackground(true);
    });

    // Retorna a string CSS prontinha para ser injetada no :style
    const backgroundStyle = computed(() => {
        return currentBackground.value
            ? `background-image: url('/media/file?path=${currentBackground.value}');`
            : '';
    });

    return {
        currentBackground,
        backgroundStyle,
        pickRandomBackground
    };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Composables/useDynamicHeaderHeight.js
```javascript
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';

export function useDynamicHeaderHeight(targetRef, options = {}) {
    const {
        cssVarName = '--app-header-height',
        fallbackHeight = 112, // ~7rem (pt-28)
        extraOffset = 0       // Folga opcional em pixels
    } = options;

    const headerHeight = ref(fallbackHeight);
    let observer = null;

    const updateHeight = (el) => {
        if (!el) return;
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const height = Math.ceil(rect.height) + extraOffset;

        if (height > 0 && height !== headerHeight.value) {
            headerHeight.value = height;
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty(cssVarName, `${height}px`);
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        const el = targetRef?.value?.$el || targetRef?.value;
        if (!el) return;

        updateHeight(el);

        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            observer = new ResizeObserver(() => updateHeight(el));
            observer.observe(el);
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => updateHeight(el), { passive: true });
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        if (observer) {
            observer.disconnect();
            observer = null;
        }
        window.removeEventListener('resize', () => {});
        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(cssVarName);
    });

    return {
        headerHeight
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';

export function useInAppBrowser() {
    const isInstagram = ref(false);
    const isInAppBrowser = ref(false);
    const os = ref('other'); // 'ios' | 'android' | 'other'

    onMounted(() => {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

        const ua = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera || '';

        // 1. Identificação do Instagram e outras Webviews sociais
        isInstagram.value = /Instagram/i.test(ua);
        isInAppBrowser.value = isInstagram.value || /FBAN|FBAV|ByteLocale|TikTok/i.test(ua);

        // 2. Identificação do Sistema Operacional
        if (/iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(ua)) {
            os.value = 'ios';
        } else if (/Android/i.test(ua)) {
            os.value = 'android';
        }
    });

    // 🚀 Dica para Android: Intent URI para tentar forçar abertura no Chrome nativo
    const getAndroidIntentUrl = () => {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '#';
        const cleanUrl = window.location.href.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');
        return `intent://${cleanUrl}#Intent;scheme=https;package=com.android.chrome;end`;
    };

    return {
        isInstagram,
        isInAppBrowser,
        os,
        getAndroidIntentUrl
    };
}
```

```javascript
import axios from 'axios';
import { ref } from 'vue';

export function usePushNotifications() {
    // 🚀 SONDA VISUAL: Estado reativo para exibir na tela
    const pushStatus = ref('⏳ Checando...');

    const checkSubscriptionStatus = async () => {
        if (!("Notification" in window) || !("serviceWorker" in navigator)) {
            pushStatus.value = '❌ Não Suportado';
            return;
        }

        if (Notification.permission === 'denied') {
            pushStatus.value = '🚫 Bloqueado';
            return;
        }

        try {
            const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
            const subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();

            if (subscription) {
                pushStatus.value = '✅ Inscrito (Ativo)';
                console.log("📍 [SONDA PUSH FRONT] Dispositivo já possui inscrição:", subscription.toJSON());
            } else {
                pushStatus.value = '⚠️ Não Inscrito';
                console.log("📍 [SONDA PUSH FRONT] Dispositivo suporta, mas não está inscrito no PushManager.");
            }
        } catch (error) {
            pushStatus.value = '❌ Erro SW';
            console.error("📍 [SONDA PUSH FRONT] Erro ao checar inscrição:", error);
        }
    };

    const requestPushPermission = async () => {
        if (!("Notification" in window) || !("serviceWorker" in navigator)) return false;
        if (Notification.permission === "granted") return true;

        if (Notification.permission !== "denied") {
            const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
            if (permission === 'granted') {
                pushStatus.value = '⚠️ Permissão Concedida (Sem Inscrição)';
            } else {
                pushStatus.value = '🚫 Bloqueado';
            }
            return permission === "granted";
        }
        return false;
    };

    const subscribeToWebPush = async (vapidPublicKey) => {
        pushStatus.value = '⏳ Inscrevendo...';
        console.log("📍 [SONDA PUSH FRONT] Iniciando inscrição com a chave VAPID:", vapidPublicKey);

        try {
            const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
            const subscription = await registration.pushManager.subscribe({
                userVisibleOnly: true,
                applicationServerKey: urlBase64ToUint8Array(vapidPublicKey)
            });

            console.log("📍 [SONDA PUSH FRONT] Inscrição gerada no navegador. Enviando para o Laravel...", subscription.toJSON());

            await axios.post(route('api.push.subscribe'), subscription.toJSON());

            pushStatus.value = '✅ Inscrito (Ativo)';
            console.log("📍 [SONDA PUSH FRONT] Laravel confirmou o recebimento da inscrição!");

        } catch (error) {
            pushStatus.value = '❌ Falha na Inscrição';
            console.error("📍 [SONDA PUSH FRONT] Erro crítico ao inscrever Push:", error);
        }
    };

    const urlBase64ToUint8Array = (base64String) => {
        const padding = '='.repeat((4 - base64String.length % 4) % 4);
        const base64 = (base64String + padding).replace(/\-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
        const rawData = window.atob(base64);
        const outputArray = new Uint8Array(rawData.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < rawData.length; ++i) { outputArray[i] = rawData.charCodeAt(i); }
        return outputArray;
    };

    const sendPushNotification = async (title, options = {}) => {
        // Lógica mantida...
        if (!("Notification" in window) || Notification.permission !== "granted") return { success: false };
        try {
            if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
                const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
                await registration.showNotification(title, { icon: '/favicon.ico', requireInteraction: true, ...options });
                return { success: true };
            }
        } catch (error) { return { success: false }; }
    };

    return { pushStatus, checkSubscriptionStatus, requestPushPermission, subscribeToWebPush, sendPushNotification };
}
```

```javascript
import { usePosSecurity } from '@/Pages/Gateway/Composables/usePosSecurity';
import { ref } from 'vue';

export function useSecureAction(companySettings) {
    const isReasonModalVisible = ref(false);
    const itemToProcess = ref(null);
    const authActionType = ref('cancel'); // 'cancel', 'edit' ou 'swap'
    const authNeedsPin = ref(true);

    const { requiresAuth } = usePosSecurity(companySettings || {});

    const initiateSecureAction = (item, type = 'cancel') => {
        itemToProcess.value = item;
        authActionType.value = type;

        // 🚀 Mapeia o Swap para usar a mesma trava de segurança da Edição
        const securityKey = (type === 'edit' || type === 'swap') ? 'edit_item' : (type === 'cancel_order' ? 'cancel_order' : 'cancel_item');
        authNeedsPin.value = requiresAuth(securityKey);

        isReasonModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    return {
        isReasonModalVisible,
        itemToProcess,
        authActionType,
        authNeedsPin,
        initiateSecureAction
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export function useStoreStatus() {
    const page = usePage();
    const toast = useToast();

    const status = computed(() => page.props.storeStatus || {
        is_open: false,
        is_pre_order: false,
        is_past_closing: false,
        active_channels: ['delivery', 'counter', 'table'],
        next_open_time: null,
        current_close_time: null,
        last_closed_at: null,
        reason: null
    });

    const settings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || page.props.publicSettings || {});

    const is24Hours = computed(() => {
        return !!(settings.value.is_24_hours || settings.value.always_open);
    });

    const isClosedIndefinitely = computed(() => {
        return !!(settings.value.is_closed_indefinitely || settings.value.closed_indefinitely);
    });

    const isOpen = computed(() => {
        if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) return false;
        return !!status.value.is_open;
    });

    const isPreOrder = computed(() => isClosedIndefinitely.value ? false : !!status.value.is_pre_order);
    const activeChannels = computed(() => status.value.active_channels);
    const closedReason = computed(() => status.value.reason);

    const canOrder = computed(() => {
        if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) return false;
        return isOpen.value || isPreOrder.value;
    });

    const minutesToOpen = computed(() => {
        if (isClosedIndefinitely.value || !status.value.next_open_time) return null;
        const now = new Date();
        const openTime = new Date(status.value.next_open_time);
        return Math.ceil((openTime - now) / (1000 * 60));
    });

    const isOpeningSoon = computed(() => {
        if (status.value.reason === 'cashier_closed') return true;
        const mins = minutesToOpen.value;
        return mins !== null && mins > 0 && mins <= 30;
    });

    const closeTimeString = computed(() => {
        if (!status.value.current_close_time) return null;
        const closeDate = new Date(status.value.current_close_time);
        return closeDate.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    });

    // 🚀 REGRA 2: Passou do horário regular de fechar, mas o turno continua aberto
    const isPastClosingTime = computed(() => {
        if (!isOpen.value || is24Hours.value) return false;
        if (status.value.is_past_closing) return true;
        if (!status.value.current_close_time) return false;
        const now = new Date();
        const closeDate = new Date(status.value.current_close_time);
        return now >= closeDate;
    });

    // 🏷️ TÍTULO PRINCIPAL DINÂMICO
    const statusTitle = computed(() => {
        if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) return 'Voltamos em breve!';
        if (isOpen.value) {
            if (isPastClosingTime.value) return 'Fechando em breve';
            return 'Estamos abertos!';
        }
        if (status.value.reason === 'cashier_closed') return 'Preparando a loja';
        if (isOpeningSoon.value) return 'Quase abrindo!';
        if (isPreOrder.value) return 'Garanta o seu lugar!';
        return 'Fechado agora';
    });

    // 🏷️ SUBTÍTULO DINÂMICO (Cobre abertura mais cedo e encerramento iminente)
    const storeAvailabilityText = computed(() => {
        if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) return 'Fechado temporariamente.';

        if (status.value.reason === 'manual_override_closed') {
            if (!status.value.next_open_time) return 'Nosso expediente já encerrou.';
            const openTime = new Date(status.value.next_open_time);
            const timeString = openTime.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            return `Expediente encerrado. Voltamos às ${timeString}`;
        }

        if (isOpen.value) {
            if (isPastClosingTime.value) {
                return 'Última chance de pedir!';
            }
            if (is24Hours.value) {
                return 'Funcionando 24 horas';
            }
            if (closeTimeString.value) {
                return `Funcionando até às ${closeTimeString.value}`;
            }
            return 'Estamos abertos!';
        }

        if (status.value.reason === 'cashier_closed') {
            return isPreOrder.value
                ? 'Preparando a loja. Você já pode fazer seu pedido!'
                : 'Preparando a loja. Abriremos em instantes!';
        }

        if (!status.value.next_open_time) return 'Fechado no momento.';

        const mins = minutesToOpen.value;
        if (isOpeningSoon.value) {
            return isPreOrder.value
                ? `Abre em ${mins} min. Cardápio liberado!`
                : `Abre em ${mins} minutos`;
        }

        const openTime = new Date(status.value.next_open_time);
        const timeString = openTime.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        const now = new Date();
        const tomorrow = new Date();
        tomorrow.setDate(now.getDate() + 1);

        if (now.toDateString() === openTime.toDateString()) {
            return `Voltamos hoje às ${timeString}`;
        }
        if (tomorrow.toDateString() === openTime.toDateString()) {
            return `Voltamos amanhã às ${timeString}`;
        }

        const weekday = openTime.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { weekday: 'long' });
        return `Voltamos ${weekday.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + weekday.slice(1)} às ${timeString}`;
    });

    const bannerStyleClass = computed(() => {
        if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) return 'bg-danger-500/80 text-white border-danger-500/20';
        if (isOpen.value && isPastClosingTime.value) return 'bg-amber-500/90 text-amber-950 border-amber-500/30';
        if (isOpeningSoon.value) return 'bg-warning-500/80 text-warning-950 border-warning-500/20';
        return 'bg-danger-500/80 text-white border-danger-500/20';
    });

    const isNotifyMeActive = ref(page.props.auth?.user?.wants_opening_notification || false);
    const isTogglingNotification = ref(false);

    const toggleOpeningNotification = async () => {
        isTogglingNotification.value = true;
        try {
            await axios.post(route('customer.profile.toggle-notification'), {
                wants_notification: isNotifyMeActive.value
            });

            toast.add({
                severity: 'success',
                summary: isNotifyMeActive.value ? 'Aviso Ativado!' : 'Aviso Desativado',
                detail: isNotifyMeActive.value ? 'Enviaremos uma notificação assim que abrirmos.' : 'Você não será mais notificado.',
                life: 3000
            });
        } catch (e) {
            isNotifyMeActive.value = !isNotifyMeActive.value;
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Falha ao atualizar preferência.', life: 3000 });
        } finally {
            isTogglingNotification.value = false;
        }
    };

    return {
        status, isOpen, isPreOrder, activeChannels, closedReason, canOrder,
        minutesToOpen, isOpeningSoon, isWithinOneHour: isOpeningSoon,
        closeTimeString, storeAvailabilityText, bannerStyleClass,
        is24Hours, isClosedIndefinitely, isPastClosingTime,
        statusTitle, statusSubtitle: storeAvailabilityText,
        isNotifyMeActive, isTogglingNotification, toggleOpeningNotification
    };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Composables/useTenantEcho.js
```javascript
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

export function useTenantEcho() {
    const page = usePage();
    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';

    // Guarda as escutas ativas para limpar no final
    const listeners = [];

    const listenChannel = (channelSuffix, eventName, callback) => {
        if (tenantId === 'central' || typeof window.Echo === 'undefined') return;

        const fullChannelName = `tenant.${tenantId}.${channelSuffix}`;

        // Proteção: Evita duplicar a antena se o listenChannel for chamado num Watcher
        const alreadyListening = listeners.find(
            l => l.fullChannelName === fullChannelName && l.eventName === eventName
        );

        if (!alreadyListening) {
            // Assina o canal imediatamente
            window.Echo.channel(fullChannelName).listen(eventName, callback);
            // Guarda a referência
            listeners.push({ fullChannelName, eventName, callback });
        }
    };

    // 🚀 A MÁGICA: Registrado de forma SÍNCRONA logo quando o composable é chamado!
    // O Vue nunca vai perder o contexto deste gancho, mesmo com awaits externos.
    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        if (typeof window.Echo === 'undefined') return;

        listeners.forEach(({ fullChannelName, eventName, callback }) => {
            window.Echo.channel(fullChannelName).stopListening(eventName, callback);
        });
    });

    return { tenantId, listenChannel };
}
```

```javascript
const isMobile = ref(false);
let isListening = false;

export function useViewport(breakpoint = 768) {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && !isListening) {
        const checkMobile = () => {
            isMobile.value = window.innerWidth <= breakpoint;
        };

        // Checa a primeira vez e anexa o ouvinte ÚNICO

        window.addEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
        isListening = true;
    }
```

```javascript
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { computed } from 'vue';

export function useWhatsAppMessages() {
    const page = usePage();
    const { abbreviateName, formatAddress } = useOrderFormatting();

    const supportPhone = computed(() => {
        const phone = page.props.companySettings?.support_whatsapp || '';
        return phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
    });
    const hasSupport = computed(() => supportPhone.value.length >= 10);

    // 👤 Extrai apenas o primeiro nome para comunicação direta e acolhedora com o cliente
    const getFirstName = (name) => {
        if (!name || typeof name !== 'string') return 'Cliente';
        const first = name.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
        return first || 'Cliente';
    };

    // 🌐 Resolve a URL base priorizando o domínio próprio configurado
    const getTenantBaseUrl = () => {
        const customDomain = page.props.companySettings?.custom_domain;
        if (customDomain) {
            const clean = customDomain.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
            return `https://${clean}`;
        }
        return typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : '';
    };

    // ⭐ Resolução da URL amigável de Avaliação do Google do Tenant
    const reviewInviteText = computed(() => {
        const googleLink = page.props.companySettings?.google_review_link;
        if (!googleLink) return '';

        const friendlyUrl = `${getTenantBaseUrl()}/avaliacao`;

        return `\n\n⭐ *Sua opinião vale muito para nós!*\nConte como foi sua experiência: ${friendlyUrl}`;
    });

    const sendWhatsApp = (phone, text) => {
        if (!phone) return false;
        const cleanPhone = phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
        const encodedText = encodeURIComponent(text);
        window.open(`whatsapp://send?phone=55${cleanPhone}&text=${encodedText}`, '_self');
        return true;
    };

    const openSupport = (topic, data = {}) => {
        if (!hasSupport.value) return alert('O número de suporte ainda não foi configurado pelo restaurante.');

        let message = 'Olá! Preciso de ajuda com o sistema.';
        switch (topic) {
            case 'login_cpf_exists': message = `Olá, estou com problemas no cadastro. O sistema diz que o meu CPF (${data.cpf || 'não informado'}) já está registrado. Vocês podem me ajudar?`; break;
            case 'registration_help': message = `Olá! Estou tentando realizar meu cadastro no aplicativo, mas estou com uma dúvida. Poderiam me ajudar?`; break;
            case 'order_issue': message = `Olá, preciso de ajuda com o meu pedido #${formatNumber(data.orderId)}.`; break;
        }
        sendWhatsApp(supportPhone.value, message);
    };

    // 🛵 Mantém a abreviação LGPD para o entregador/motoboy
    const dispatchCourier = (order, courierPhone) => {
        const name = order.customer_id ? abbreviateName(order.customer_name) : order.customer_name;
        const phone = order.customer_phone || order.customer?.phone || 'Não informado';
        const address = formatAddress(order);

        let payments = 'Não informado';
        if (order.payments && order.payments.length > 0) {
            payments = order.payments.map(p => `${p.method || 'Pago'} (${formatCurrency(p.amount)})`).join(', ');
        } else if (order.payment_intent_methods) {
            const methodsArray = typeof order.payment_intent_methods === 'string'
                ? JSON.parse(order.payment_intent_methods)
                : order.payment_intent_methods;

            payments = `Cobrar na entrega: ${methodsArray.map(m => m.method_name || m.method_id).join(', ')}`;
        }

        const msg = `🛵 *Nova Entrega!*\n\n*Pedido:* #${formatNumber(order.id)}\n*Cliente:* ${name}\n*Contato:* ${phone}\n*Endereço:* ${address}\n*Pagamentos:* ${payments}`;
        sendWhatsApp(courierPhone, msg);
    };

    // 💬 Mensagem direta ao cliente: usa o primeiro nome
    const notifyDeliveryOut = (order) => {
        const name = getFirstName(order.customer_name || order.customer?.name);
        const baseMsg = `Olá ${name}, o seu pedido #${formatNumber(order.id)} saiu para entrega e logo chegará até você! 🛵`;
        const fullMsg = `${baseMsg}${reviewInviteText.value}`;
        sendWhatsApp(order.customer?.phone || order.customer_phone, fullMsg);
    };

    // 💬 Mensagem direta ao cliente: usa o primeiro nome
    const notifyPickupReady = (order) => {
        const name = getFirstName(order.customer_name || order.customer?.name);
        const baseMsg = `Olá ${name}, o seu pedido #${formatNumber(order.id)} já está pronto e embalado! Pode vir retirar no balcão. 🍔`;
        const fullMsg = `${baseMsg}${reviewInviteText.value}`;
        sendWhatsApp(order.customer?.phone || order.customer_phone, fullMsg);
    };

    return {
        hasSupport, abbreviateName, formatAddress, getFirstName, getTenantBaseUrl,
        sendWhatsApp, openSupport, dispatchCourier, notifyDeliveryOut, notifyPickupReady
    };
}
```

```vue
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog';

// Importa o formulário de cupons
import CouponQuickForm from './CouponQuickForm.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    crmData: Object
});

const toast = useToast();
const isNewCouponModalVisible = ref(false);
const isSubmitting = ref(false);

const formatCouponValue = (coupon) => {
    if (coupon.type === 'percent') return `${coupon.value}% de desconto`;
    if (coupon.type === 'fixed') return `R$ ${coupon.value.toFixed(2)} de desconto`;
    if (coupon.type === 'free_delivery') return `Entrega Gratuita`;
    return 'Desconto Especial';
};

const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '';
    const [year, month, day] = dateStr.split('-');
    return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
};

// 🚀 LIGAÇÃO COM O BACKEND: Criar Cupom
const handleCreateCoupon = (payload) => {
    isSubmitting.value = true;
    router.post(route('operations.crm.create-coupon'), payload, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
            isNewCouponModalVisible.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Sucesso', detail: 'Novo cupom ativado com sucesso!', life: 3000 });
        },
        onError: () => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Aviso', detail: 'Verifique os dados ou se o código já existe.', life: 4000 });
        }
    });
};

// 🚀 LIGAÇÃO COM O BACKEND: Alternar Automações
const toggleAutomation = (key, value) => {
    router.post(route('operations.crm.toggle-automation'), { key, value }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Atualizado', detail: 'Regras de automação atualizadas.', life: 2000 });
        }
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({ isSubmitting: Boolean });
const emit = defineEmits(['submit']);

const getInitialForm = () => ({
    code: '',
    type: 'fixed',
    value: '',
    min_subtotal: 0,
    global_usage_limit: 0,
    monthly_usage_limit: 0,
    user_usage_limit: 1,
    starts_at: '',
    expires_at: '',
    first_order_only: false,
    is_active: true
});

const form = ref(getInitialForm());

// 🚀 A magia de gerar código aleatório do Filament, agora no Vue!
const generateRandomCode = () => {
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';
    let result = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        result += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    form.value.code = result;
};

const submitForm = () => {
    emit('submit', { ...form.value });
    form.value = getInitialForm();
};
</script>
```

```vue
import CrmOpportunitiesTab from '@/Pages/CRM/CrmOpportunitiesTab.vue';

defineOptions({ layout: DesktopLayout });

const props = defineProps({
    crmData: Object,
    isActive: {
        type: Boolean,
        default: false
    }
});

const isMounted = ref(false);
onMounted(() => isMounted.value = true);

const activeTab = ref('coupons');

const tabOptions = computed(() => {
    const oppCount = props.crmData?.opportunities?.length || 0;
    return [
        { value: 'metrics', label: 'Métricas', icon: 'pi-chart-line' },
        { value: 'opportunities', label: oppCount > 0 ? `Oportunidades (${oppCount})` : 'Oportunidades', icon: 'pi-users' },
        { value: 'coupons', label: 'Cupons & Automação', icon: 'pi-ticket' }
    ];
});

const activeComponent = computed(() => {
    switch (activeTab.value) {
        case 'metrics': return CrmMetricsTab;
        case 'opportunities': return CrmOpportunitiesTab;
        case 'coupons': return CouponManager;
        default: return CouponManager;
    }
});
</script>

.fade-enter-active, .fade-leave-active { transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; }
```

```vue
                        <span class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-surface-muted">Custo de Aquisição (CAC)</span>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const page = usePage();

const props = defineProps({
    crmData: Object
});

const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(value);
};

// Pixels
const hasMetaPixel = computed(() => !!page.props.companySettings?.meta_pixel_id);
const hasGooglePixel = computed(() => !!page.props.companySettings?.google_pixel_id);

// Cálculos de Cashback
const liability = computed(() => props.crmData?.growth?.cashback_liability || 0);

// Cálculos de O2O
const conversionRate = computed(() => {
    const printed = props.crmData?.growth?.flyers_printed || 0;
    const converted = props.crmData?.growth?.flyers_converted || 0;
    if (printed === 0) return 0;
    return ((converted / printed) * 100).toFixed(1);
});

const cac = computed(() => {
    const converted = props.crmData?.growth?.flyers_converted || 0;
    const costPerFlyer = 0.15; // Custo estimado do papel térmico
    const discountGiven = props.crmData?.growth?.flyer_discounts_given || 0;

    if (converted === 0) return 0;

    const totalCost = ((props.crmData?.growth?.flyers_printed || 0) * costPerFlyer) + discountGiven;
    return totalCost / converted;
});
</script>
```

```vue
                        <div v-if="feedback.tags && feedback.tags.length > 0" class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2">
                            <span v-for="tag in feedback.tags" :key="tag" class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-surface-3 text-surface-text rounded-md text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    crmData: {
        type: Object,
        default: () => ({ ratings: [] })
    }
});

const filter = ref('all');

// --- Processamento dos KPIs ---
const allRatings = computed(() => props.crmData?.ratings || []);
const totalRatings = computed(() => allRatings.value.length);

const averageRating = computed(() => {
    if (totalRatings.value === 0) return '0.0';
    const sum = allRatings.value.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.rating, 0);
    return (sum / totalRatings.value).toFixed(1);
});

const fiveStarsCount = computed(() => allRatings.value.filter(r => r.rating === 5).length);
const criticalCount = computed(() => allRatings.value.filter(r => r.rating <= 3).length);

const promoterPercentage = computed(() => {
    if (totalRatings.value === 0) return 0;
    return Math.round((fiveStarsCount.value / totalRatings.value) * 100);
});

const averageColorClass = computed(() => {
    const avg = parseFloat(averageRating.value);
    if (avg >= 4.5) return 'bg-success-500/10 text-success-600';
    if (avg >= 3.5) return 'bg-warning-500/10 text-warning-600';
    return 'bg-danger-500/10 text-danger-600';
});

const getRatingColor = (rating) => {
    if (rating >= 4) return 'text-success-500';
    if (rating === 3) return 'text-warning-500';
    return 'text-danger-500';
};

// --- Filtro de Lista ---
const filteredFeedbacks = computed(() => {
    let list = [...allRatings.value].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at));
    if (filter.value === 'critical') {
        list = list.filter(r => r.rating <= 3);
    }
    return list;
});

// --- Helpers ---
const formatDate = (isoStr) => {
    if (!isoStr) return '';
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(isoStr));
};

const cleanPhone = (phone) => {
    if (!phone) return '';
    return phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
};
</script>
```

```vue
    return `Oi ${firstName}! Faz um tempinho que você não pede com a gente. Preparamos algo especial para matar a saudade, dá uma olhadinha no nosso cardápio! 🍔`;
};
```

```vue
                    <div v-for="i in 3" :key="i" class="relative z-10 w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner">
                        <span class="text-amber-300 font-black text-sm animate-pulse">?</span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <button
                    @click="$emit('open-register')"
                    class="c-btn-primary !h-12 !text-xs !bg-amber-400 !text-black active:!bg-amber-300"
                >

                </button>
            </div>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    isGuest: Boolean,
    activeOrders: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    companySettings: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) }
});

defineEmits(['open-register']);

const hasActiveOrder = computed(() => props.activeOrders && props.activeOrders.length > 0);

const lostCashbackValue = computed(() => {
    if (!props.isGuest || !hasActiveOrder.value) return 0;

    const settings = props.companySettings;
    if (!settings || !settings.loyalty_is_active || settings.loyalty_reward_type !== 'cashback') return 0;

    const totalActiveSpend = props.activeOrders.reduce((sum, order) => sum + Number(order.total), 0);
    const multiplier = Number(settings.loyalty_points_multiplier || 1);
    const pointsEarned = Math.floor(totalActiveSpend * multiplier);
    const conversionRate = Number(settings.loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate || 5);

    return (pointsEarned / 100) * conversionRate;
});

const formatMoney = (val) => Number(val || 0).toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
</script>
```

```vue
                class="w-full h-14 rounded-full bg-white/70 text-black/70 font-black text-base uppercase tracking-widest transition-all border-none outline-none flex items-center justify-center gap-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-primary-600 hover:text-white active:scale-[0.99]"
                :class="isLoading ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-90' : ''"
            >
                <i v-if="isLoading" class="pi pi-spinner pi-spin text-xl"></i>
                <span>{{ isLoading ? 'Carregando...' : 'Ver Cardápio →' }}</span>
            </button>

            <!-- AVISO CONTEXTUAL DE CONSENTIMENTO E PRIVACIDADE -->
            <p class="text-[10px] text-white/50 text-center font-medium leading-tight px-2">
                Ao entrar no cardápio, você concorda com nossos
                <a :href="route('customer.legal')" class="underline underline-offset-2 text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors">

<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useStoreStatus } from '@/Composables/useStoreStatus';

const emit = defineEmits(['menu']);

const page = usePage();
const {
    isOpen,
    isPreOrder,
    isClosedIndefinitely,
    isOpeningSoon,
    isPastClosingTime,
    storeAvailabilityText,
    statusTitle
} = useStoreStatus();

const isLoading = ref(false);

const handleMenuClick = () => {
    isLoading.value = true;

    try {
        localStorage.setItem('cookie_consent_granted', 'true');
    } catch (e) {}

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.gtag === 'function') {
        window.gtag('consent', 'update', {
            'ad_storage': 'granted',
            'ad_user_data': 'granted',
            'ad_personalization': 'granted',
            'analytics_storage': 'granted'
        });
    }

    emit('menu');
};

const titleText = computed(() => {
    if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) return 'Voltamos em breve!';
    if (isOpen.value && isPastClosingTime.value) return 'Fechando em breve';
    if (isOpen.value) return 'Estamos abertos!';
    if (isOpeningSoon.value) return 'Quase abrindo!';
    if (isPreOrder.value) return 'Garanta o seu lugar!';
    return 'Fechado agora';
});

const statusIcon = computed(() => {
    if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) return 'pi-lock';
    if (isOpen.value && isPastClosingTime.value) return 'pi-hourglass';
    if (isOpen.value) return 'pi-check-circle';
    if (isOpeningSoon.value || isPreOrder.value) return 'pi-clock';
    return 'pi-moon';
});

const statusColors = computed(() => {
    if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) return { bg: 'bg-danger-500' };
    if (isOpen.value && isPastClosingTime.value) return { bg: 'bg-amber-500' };
    if (isOpen.value) return { bg: 'bg-success-500' };
    if (isOpeningSoon.value || isPreOrder.value) return { bg: 'bg-warning-500' };
    return { bg: 'bg-surface-400' };
});
</script>
```

```vue
                        >
```
