```vue
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <span v-if="discount > 0" class="text-emerald-400 font-black text-xs tracking-tight">
                        - {{ $formatCurrency(discount) }}
                    </span>
                </div>

                <!-- Input Flutuante de Cupom -->
                <div v-if="showCouponInput" class="relative flex items-center w-full animate-in fade-in duration-200 mt-1">
                    <i class="pi pi-ticket absolute left-3.5 text-white/40 text-xs pointer-events-none"></i>

                    />
                    <button
                        @click="handleApplyCoupon"
                        :disabled="!couponCode"
                        class="absolute right-1.5 h-8 px-4 rounded-xl font-black text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider transition-all border-none outline-none"

import { ref, watch, computed } from "vue";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";

const props = defineProps({
    subtotal: { type: Number, required: true },
    deliveryFee: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    serviceFee: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    serviceTaxPercentage: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    showServiceFeeRow: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    discount: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    cashbackDiscount: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    finalTotal: { type: Number, required: true },
    orderType: { type: String, default: null },
    appliedCouponName: { type: String, default: null }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["apply-coupon", "remove-coupon", "toggle-coupon-form"]);

const showCouponInput = ref(false);
const couponCode = ref("");

const shouldDisplayServiceFee = computed(() => props.showServiceFeeRow || props.serviceFee > 0);

const toggleCouponInput = () => {
    showCouponInput.value = !showCouponInput.value;
    emit('toggle-coupon-form', showCouponInput.value);

    if (!showCouponInput.value && !props.appliedCouponName) {
        couponCode.value = "";
        emit('remove-coupon');
    }
};

const handleApplyCoupon = () => {
    if (!couponCode.value || couponCode.value.trim() === '') return;
    emit('apply-coupon', couponCode.value.trim(), props.subtotal);
};

watch(
    () => [props.discount, props.appliedCouponName],
    ([newDiscount, newCouponName]) => {
        if (newDiscount > 0 || newCouponName) {
            showCouponInput.value = false;
            emit('toggle-coupon-form', false);
        }
    }
);

const closeCouponForm = () => {
    showCouponInput.value = false;
    emit('toggle-coupon-form', false);
};

defineExpose({ closeCouponForm });
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
```

```vue
        <!-- 1. MÉTODOS DE LOGIN -->
        <CustomerAccess
            v-if="subStep === 'methods'"
            :allow-guest="allowGuest"
            :methods="authMethods"
            :needs-email-fallback="needsEmailFallback"
            :is-logging-in="isSubmittingAuth"
            :is-cart-mode="true"
            @login="$emit('login', $event)"
            @open-register="$emit('open-register')"
            @guest-action="$emit('update:sub-step', 'guest_name')"
        />

        <!-- 2. FORMULÁRIO DO VISITANTE (NOME OU WHATSAPP) -->
        <div v-else class="animate-in slide-in-from-right-4 duration-300 flex flex-col h-full w-full pt-2">
            <GuestRegistrationForm
                :is-customer-mode="true"
                :step="subStep"
                :initial-name="guestName"
                :initial-phone="guestPhone"
                @update:name="$emit('update:guest-name', $event)"
                @update:phone="$emit('update:guest-phone', $event)"
                @advance="handleGuestAdvance"
                @submit="handleGuestAdvance"
                @registered="$emit('guest-registered')"
            />
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import CustomerAccess from '@/Pages/Gateway/CustomerAccess.vue';
import GuestRegistrationForm from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/GuestRegistrationForm.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    allowGuest: Boolean,
    authMethods: Array,
    needsEmailFallback: Boolean,
    isSubmittingAuth: Boolean,
    subStep: { type: String, default: 'methods' },
    guestName: { type: String, default: '' },
    guestPhone: { type: String, default: '' }
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'login',
    'open-register',
    'guest-registered',
    'update:sub-step',
    'update:guest-name',
    'update:guest-phone'
]);

const handleGuestAdvance = () => {
    // Se está no nome, avança para o telefone
    if (props.subStep === 'guest_name') {
        emit('update:sub-step', 'guest_phone');
    }
    // Se já está no telefone (ou em outro passo final), conclui o Auth e libera o fluxo
    else if (props.subStep === 'guest_phone') {
        emit('guest-registered');
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
        <CustomerLogisticsSelector
            v-model="selectedType"
            :customer="customer"
            :selected-address="currentAddress"

            @open-new-address="$emit('open-new-address')"
            @apply="handleApply"
        />
    </div>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import CustomerLogisticsSelector from '@/Pages/Customer/Checkout/CustomerLogisticsSelector.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    customer: Object,
    selectedOrderType: { type: String, default: 'delivery' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:selectedOrderType', 'routing-change', 'open-new-address', 'next', 'update-header']);

const selectedType = ref(props.selectedOrderType);
const currentAddress = ref(null);

onMounted(() => {
    emit('update-header', { title: 'Como quer receber?', subtitle: 'Forma de Entrega', currentProgress: 2, maxProgress: 4 });
});

const handleRoutingChange = (payload) => {
    if (!payload) return;
    currentAddress.value = payload.address || null;
    emit('update:selectedOrderType', payload.type);
    emit('routing-change', payload);
};

const handleApply = (payload) => {
    handleRoutingChange(payload);
    emit('next');
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import FormField from "@/Components/UI/FormField.vue";
import SearchAutocomplete from "@/Components/UI/SearchAutocomplete.vue";
import { useAddressLookup } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useAddressLookup";
import { useWhatsAppSupport } from "@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useWhatsAppSupport";

defineProps({
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["save", "success", "substep"]);

const toast = useToast();
const page = usePage();
const { openSupport } = useWhatsAppSupport();

const lookupMode = computed(() => page.props.companySettings?.address_lookup_mode || 'cep');
const step = ref(1);
const cepError = ref('');
const loading = ref(false);

const {
    isSearchingCep,
    streetSuggestions,
    loadStreetsDataset,
    fetchCep,
    searchStreets,
    calculateFuzzyNeighborhood
} = useAddressLookup(lookupMode);

const defaultForm = () => ({
    nickname: "Casa",
    zipcode: "",
    street: "",
    street_id: null,
    streetObj: null,
    number: "",
    no_number: false,
    neighborhood: "",
    neighborhood_id: null,
    complement: ""
});

const form = ref(defaultForm());
const activeNicknameTag = ref('Casa');
const streetQuery = ref('');

onMounted(async () => {
    emit('substep', step.value);
    if (lookupMode.value === 'street') {
        await loadStreetsDataset();
    }
});

watch(step, (val) => emit('substep', val));

const handleNoNumberChange = () => {
    if (form.value.no_number) form.value.number = '';
};

const handleCepInput = () => {
    cepError.value = '';
    const raw = form.value.zipcode.replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (raw.length === 8) {
        fetchCep(raw, form,
            () => { step.value = 2; },
            () => { cepError.value = 'CEP não encontrado. Verifique e tente novamente.'; }
        );
    }
};

// ==============================================================
// LÓGICA ORIGINAL RESTAURADA E INTACTA
// ==============================================================
const handleStreetSelect = (street) => {
    form.value.street = street.name;
    form.value.street_id = street.id;
    form.value.streetObj = street;
    streetQuery.value = street.name;

    if (street.segments && street.segments.length === 1) {
        form.value.neighborhood = street.segments[0].neighborhood;
        form.value.neighborhood_id = street.segments[0].neighborhood_id || null;
    } else {
        form.value.neighborhood = "";
        form.value.neighborhood_id = null;
    }
    step.value = 2;
};

const goBack = () => {
    if (step.value === 2) {
        step.value = 1;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
};
defineExpose({ goBack });

watch(() => form.value.number, () => { triggerFuzzyNeighborhood(); });
watch(() => form.value.no_number, () => { triggerFuzzyNeighborhood(); });

const triggerFuzzyNeighborhood = () => {
    if (!form.value.no_number) calculateFuzzyNeighborhood(form);
};

const handleSubmit = () => {
    loading.value = true;

    if (lookupMode.value === 'street' && form.value.streetObj) {
        form.value.street = form.value.streetObj.name;
    }

    if (activeNicknameTag.value !== 'Outro') {
        form.value.nickname = activeNicknameTag.value;
    }

    if (form.value.no_number) {
        form.value.number = 'S/N';
    } else {
        form.value.number = String(form.value.number);
    }

    emit('save', form.value, {
        onSuccess: () => {
            loading.value = false;
            emit("success");
        },
        onError: (errors) => {
            loading.value = false;
            // 🚀 Mantive apenas a leitura real do erro para não ficar cego
            const realError = (errors && Object.values(errors)[0]) || 'Verifique os dados informados no formulário.';
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Atenção', detail: realError, life: 5000 });
        },
        onFinish: () => {
            loading.value = false;
        }
    });
};
</script>

.slide-fade-leave-to { transform: translateX(-20px); opacity: 0; }
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref, watch, nextTick } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import CustomerCartSummary from '@/Pages/Customer/Cart/CustomerCartSummary.vue';
import LoyaltyCashbackWidget from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/LoyaltyCashbackWidget.vue';
import SlideToConfirm from '@/Components/UI/SlideToConfirm.vue';
import { useCashInput } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCashInput';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    isGuest: Boolean,
    baseSubtotal: Number,
    deliveryFee: Number,
    activeDiscount: Number,
    subtotalWithFeesAndCoupons: Number,
    finalTotalWithDiscount: Number,
    selectedOrderType: String,
    appliedCouponName: String,
    isTypingCoupon: Boolean,
    availableMethods: Array,
    selectedMethod: Object,
    cashChangeTarget: [Number, String],
    useCashbackToggle: Boolean,
    isLoyaltyActive: Boolean,
    availableBalance: Number,
    customerPoints: Number,
    canRedeem: Boolean,
    missingAmount: Number,
    cashbackDiscount: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    isSubmitting: Boolean
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'update:isTypingCoupon', 'apply-coupon', 'remove-coupon', 'update:selectedMethod',
    'update:cashChangeTarget', 'update:useCashbackToggle', 'confirm', 'upgrade-guest'
]);

const page = usePage();
const isShaking = ref(false);
const cartSummaryRef = ref(null);

const isGuestRestricted = computed(() => props.isGuest && page.props.company?.guestRestrictedPayments);

const triggerWarningShake = () => {
    isShaking.value = true;
    setTimeout(() => { isShaking.value = false; }, 450);
};

const handleMethodClick = (method) => {
    console.log('📍 [SONDA VUE 1] Método selecionado pelo cliente:', method.name, method.id);
    if (isGuestRestricted.value && method.engine_type !== 'bank_api') {
        triggerWarningShake();
        return;
    }
    emit('update:selectedMethod', method);
};

// 🚀 NOVA TRAVA DE SEGURANÇA FRONTEND COM LOG
const handleConfirmClick = () => {
    console.log('📍 [SONDA VUE 2] SlideToConfirm disparado.', {
        total: props.finalTotalWithDiscount,
        metodo: props.selectedMethod
    });

    if (props.finalTotalWithDiscount > 0 && !props.selectedMethod) {
        console.warn('🚨 [SONDA VUE ERRO] Tentativa de avanço barrada. Pagamento é obrigatório.');
        return;
    }
    emit('confirm');
};

const getIcon = (method) => {
    const name = method.name.toLowerCase();
    if (method.engine_type === 'bank_api' || name.includes('pix')) return 'pi-qrcode';
    if (name.includes('cartão') || name.includes('credito') || name.includes('debito')) return 'pi-credit-card';
    if (name.includes('dinheiro') || name.includes('cash')) return 'pi-money-bill';
    return 'pi-wallet';
};

const goBack = () => {
    if (props.isTypingCoupon) {
        emit('update:isTypingCoupon', false);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
};
defineExpose({ goBack });
</script>
```

```vue
                <template v-if="resolvedLoading">

                </template>
                <template v-else-if="isExpired">

                    <span class="font-bold text-white/80">Código Expirado</span>
                </template>
            </div>

            <!-- QR Code do PIX -->
            <qrcode-vue
                v-if="resolvedQrCode"
                :value="resolvedQrCode"
                :size="180"
                level="M"
                class="rounded-lg"
            />
            <div v-else class="w-[180px] h-[180px] bg-neutral-100 rounded-lg animate-pulse flex items-center justify-center">

            </div>

        <!-- Botão Copia e Cola -->
        <button
            type="button"
            @click="copyCode"
            :disabled="resolvedLoading || isExpired || !resolvedQrCode"
            class="w-full h-14 rounded-xl c-glass-card-interactive !border-white/20 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest outline-none cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
            <i class="pi" :class="copied ? 'pi-check text-emerald-400' : 'pi-copy'"></i>
            {{ copied ? 'Copiado!' : 'Copiar PIX Copia e Cola' }}
        </button>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import QrcodeVue from 'qrcode.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    pendingOrderId: [String, Number],
    pixData: [Object, String],
    qrCodeString: String,
    txid: String,
    isLoading: Boolean,
    isGeneratingPix: Boolean
});

const emit = defineEmits(['payment-approved', 'update-header']);
const page = usePage();

const timeLeft = ref(600);
const timer = ref(null);
const pollInterval = ref(null);
const copied = ref(false);

const resolvedQrCode = computed(() => {
    if (props.qrCodeString) return props.qrCodeString;
    if (!props.pixData) return '';
    if (typeof props.pixData === 'string') return props.pixData;

    return props.pixData.qr_code
        || props.pixData.pixCopiaECola
        || props.pixData.copia_e_cola
        || props.pixData.qrCode
        || '';
});

const resolvedLoading = computed(() => {
    return !!(props.isLoading || props.isGeneratingPix);
});

const isExpired = computed(() => timeLeft.value <= 0);

const formattedTime = computed(() => {
    const minutes = String(Math.floor(timeLeft.value / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    const seconds = String(timeLeft.value % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${minutes}:${seconds}`;
});

function startTimer() {
    clearInterval(timer.value);
    timeLeft.value = 600;
    timer.value = setInterval(() => {
        if (timeLeft.value > 0) {
            timeLeft.value--;
        } else {
            clearInterval(timer.value);
        }
    }, 1000);
}

async function copyCode() {
    if (!resolvedQrCode.value) return;
    try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(resolvedQrCode.value);
        copied.value = true;
        setTimeout(() => { copied.value = false; }, 3000);
    } catch (err) {}
}

function checkPaymentStatus() {
    if (!props.pendingOrderId) return;

    router.reload({
        only: ['myActiveOrders'],
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: (pageObj) => {
            const orders = pageObj.props.myActiveOrders || [];
            const myOrder = orders.find(o => String(o.id) === String(props.pendingOrderId));
            if (myOrder && myOrder.payment_status === 'paid') {
                clearInterval(timer.value);
                clearInterval(pollInterval.value);
                emit('payment-approved');
            }
        }
    });
}

// Observadores declarados após as funções estarem disponíveis
watch(resolvedQrCode, (newVal) => {
    if (newVal && !timer.value) {
        startTimer();
    }
}, { immediate: true });

watch(() => page.props.myActiveOrders, (orders) => {
    if (!props.pendingOrderId || !orders) return;
    const myOrder = orders.find(o => String(o.id) === String(props.pendingOrderId));
    if (myOrder && myOrder.payment_status === 'paid') {
        clearInterval(timer.value);
        clearInterval(pollInterval.value);
        emit('payment-approved');
    }
}, { deep: true });

onMounted(() => {
    emit('update-header', {
        title: 'Pagamento PIX',
        subtitle: 'Aguardando Recebimento',
        currentProgress: 4,
        maxProgress: 4
    });

    pollInterval.value = setInterval(checkPaymentStatus, 5000);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    clearInterval(timer.value);
    clearInterval(pollInterval.value);
});
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    customer: Object,
    modelValue: { type: String, default: null },
    selectedAddress: Object
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'routing-change', 'open-new-address', 'apply']);

const page = usePage();
const currentType = ref(props.modelValue || null);
const activeAddress = ref(props.selectedAddress || null);

watch(() => props.modelValue, (val) => {
    currentType.value = val || null;
});

const availableChannels = computed(() => {
    let channels = page.props.storeStatus?.active_channels;
    if (typeof channels === 'string') {
        try { channels = JSON.parse(channels); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(channels) || channels.length === 0) {
        channels = ['delivery', 'counter'];
    }

    const options = [];
    if (channels.includes('delivery')) {
        options.push({ label: 'Delivery', value: 'delivery', icon: 'pi-truck' });
    }
    if (channels.includes('counter') || channels.includes('takeaway')) {
        options.push({ label: 'Retirada', value: 'counter', icon: 'pi-shopping-bag' });
    }
    return options;
});

const customerAddresses = computed(() => {
    return props.customer?.addresses || [];
});

const selectChannel = (type) => {
    currentType.value = type;
    emit('update:modelValue', type);

    if (type === 'counter') {
        activeAddress.value = null;
        emit('routing-change', { type: 'counter', address: null });
    } else if (type === 'delivery') {
        if (!activeAddress.value && customerAddresses.value.length > 0) {
            const defaultAddr = customerAddresses.value.find(a => a.is_default) || customerAddresses.value[0];
            chooseAddress(defaultAddr);
        } else {
            emit('routing-change', { type: 'delivery', address: activeAddress.value });
        }
    }
};

const chooseAddress = (addr) => {
    activeAddress.value = addr;
    emit('routing-change', { type: 'delivery', address: addr });
};

const confirmDeliveryStep = () => {
    if (!activeAddress.value) return;
    emit('apply', { type: 'delivery', address: activeAddress.value });
};

const confirmCounterStep = () => {
    emit('apply', { type: 'counter', address: null });
};
</script>
```

```javascript
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

export function useCustomerCheckoutFinancials(props, cartContext, checkoutState, calculateDiscount) {
    const page = usePage();
    const { cartSubtotal } = cartContext;

    const isTableMode = computed(() => Boolean(page.props.tableMode));

    const loyalty = computed(() => {
        const settings = page.props.companySettings || {};
        const isActive = (settings.loyalty_is_active === true || settings.loyalty_is_active === 1 || settings.loyalty_is_active === '1')
            && settings.loyalty_reward_type === 'cashback';

        const points = props.customer?.loyalty_points ? Number(props.customer.loyalty_points) : 0;
        const conversionRate = Number(settings.loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate || 5);
        const balance = (points / 100) * conversionRate;
        const minRedeem = Number(settings.loyalty_min_redeem_value || 0);
        const missing = Math.max(0, minRedeem - cartSubtotal.value);
        const canRedeem = isActive && points > 0 && missing <= 0;

        const maxVal = Number(settings.loyalty_max_redeem_value || 0);
        const maxType = settings.loyalty_max_redeem_type || 'fixed';
        const maxCap = maxVal > 0
            ? (maxType === 'percentage' ? (cartSubtotal.value * maxVal) / 100 : maxVal)
            : Infinity;

        return { isActive, points, balance, missing, canRedeem, maxVal, maxType, maxCap };
    });

    const financials = computed(() => {
        const settings = page.props.companySettings || {};
        const hasServiceTaxGlobal = Boolean(settings.has_service_tax);
        const basePercentage = Number(settings.service_tax_percentage || 0);

        // 🚀 No modo mesa ou balcão, a taxa de entrega é sempre zero
        let deliveryFee = 0;
        if (!isTableMode.value && checkoutState.orderType === 'delivery' && checkoutState.routingMeta) {
            const addr = checkoutState.routingMeta.address || checkoutState.routingMeta.meta?.address;
            if (addr?.delivery_fee !== undefined && addr?.delivery_fee !== null) {
                deliveryFee = Number(addr.delivery_fee);
            } else if (addr?.neighborhood?.delivery_fee !== undefined) {
                deliveryFee = Number(addr.neighborhood.delivery_fee);
            }
        }

        // Taxa de serviço por canal
        let isTaxEnabledForChannel = false;
        if (hasServiceTaxGlobal) {
            const type = isTableMode.value ? 'table' : (checkoutState.orderType || 'delivery');
            if (type === 'table') {
                isTaxEnabledForChannel = settings.service_tax_table !== false && settings.service_tax_table !== 0;
            } else if (type === 'counter' || type === 'takeaway' || type === 'pickup') {
                isTaxEnabledForChannel = Boolean(settings.service_tax_counter);
            } else if (type === 'delivery') {
                isTaxEnabledForChannel = Boolean(settings.service_tax_delivery);
            }
        }

        const effectiveRate = isTaxEnabledForChannel ? basePercentage : 0;
        const serviceFee = isTaxEnabledForChannel
            ? Math.round((cartSubtotal.value * (basePercentage / 100)) * 100) / 100
            : 0;

        const discount = calculateDiscount(cartSubtotal.value, deliveryFee, serviceFee);
        let cashbackDiscount = 0;

        if (checkoutState.useCashbackToggle && loyalty.value.canRedeem) {
            const availableSubtotal = Math.max(0, cartSubtotal.value - discount);
            cashbackDiscount = Math.min(loyalty.value.balance, availableSubtotal, loyalty.value.maxCap);
        }

        const finalTotal = Math.max(0, cartSubtotal.value + deliveryFee + serviceFee - discount - cashbackDiscount);

        return {
            subtotal: cartSubtotal.value,
            deliveryFee,
            delivery_fee: deliveryFee,
            serviceFee,
            service_fee: serviceFee,
            serviceTaxPercentage: basePercentage,
            effectiveServiceTaxRate: effectiveRate,
            hasServiceTaxGlobal,
            isTaxEnabledForChannel,
            showServiceFeeRow: hasServiceTaxGlobal,
            discount,
            cashbackDiscount,
            finalTotal
        };
    });

    return { loyalty, financials };
}
```

```javascript
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { useAnalytics } from '@/Composables/useAnalytics';
import { useCoupons } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCoupons';

import { useCustomerCheckoutFinancials } from './useCustomerCheckoutFinancials';
import { useCustomerCheckoutPayload } from './useCustomerCheckoutPayload';
import { useCustomerCheckoutNavigation } from './useCustomerCheckoutNavigation';

export function useCustomerCheckoutFlow(props, cartContext, activeTab) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const { trackPurchase } = useAnalytics();
    const { cart, clearCart } = cartContext;
    const { activeCoupon, removeCoupon, calculateDiscount } = useCoupons();

    const isCheckoutModalVisible = ref(false);
    const isSubmitting = ref(false);
    const activePixData = ref(null);
    const activeOrderId = ref(null);

    const {
        checkoutState, headerState, goBack, openCheckout,
        cancelPixPayment, stepRef, isTableMode
    } = useCustomerCheckoutNavigation(
        props, cartContext, activeTab, isCheckoutModalVisible,
        isSubmitting, activePixData, activeOrderId
    );

    const { loyalty, financials } = useCustomerCheckoutFinancials(props, cartContext, checkoutState, calculateDiscount);
    const { buildPayload } = useCustomerCheckoutPayload(props, cartContext, financials, activeCoupon, checkoutState);

    const handleCheckoutLogin = (credentials) => {
        isSubmitting.value = true;
        router.post(route('customer.auth.login'), credentials, {
            preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: (pageResp) => {
                isSubmitting.value = false;
                if (Object.keys(pageResp.props.errors).length === 0) checkoutState.step = isTableMode.value ? 'payment' : 'logistics';
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                isSubmitting.value = false;
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Ops!', detail: Object.values(errors)[0], life: 4000 });
            }
        });
    };

    const finalizeOrder = () => {
        if (isSubmitting.value) return;

        isSubmitting.value = true;
        const backupCart = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cart.value));
        const finalSnapshot = financials.value.finalTotal;
        const payload = buildPayload(finalSnapshot);

        router.post(route('customer.checkout.store'), payload, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: (pageResp) => {
                isSubmitting.value = false;

                if (pageResp.props.flash?.error) {
                    cart.value = backupCart;
                    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro no Pedido', detail: pageResp.props.flash.error, life: 5000 });
                    return;
                }

                const returnedOrderId = pageResp.props.flash?.order_id || pageResp.props.order_id || pageResp.props.order?.id;
                const returnedPixData = pageResp.props.flash?.pix_data || pageResp.props.pix_data || pageResp.props.order?.pix_data;
                const methodType = checkoutState.selectedMethod?.engine_type || (returnedPixData ? 'bank_api' : 'local');

                if (methodType === 'bank_api' || returnedPixData) {
                    if (returnedPixData) {
                        activeOrderId.value = returnedOrderId;
                        activePixData.value = returnedPixData;
                        checkoutState.step = 'pix';

                        sessionStorage.setItem('customer_active_pix_order_id', String(returnedOrderId));
                        sessionStorage.setItem('customer_active_pix_data', JSON.stringify(returnedPixData));

                        sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_pending_checkout');
                        sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_checkout_saved_state');
                    } else {
                        clearCart();
                        isCheckoutModalVisible.value = false;
                        toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atenção', detail: 'Não foi possível carregar o QR Code. Tente novamente.', life: 5000 });
                    }
                } else {
                    clearCart();
                    removeCoupon();
                    isCheckoutModalVisible.value = false;
                    activeTab.value = isTableMode.value ? 'orders' : 'home';
                    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Pedido Recebido!', detail: 'O seu pedido já está sendo preparado!', life: 4000 });
                }
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                isSubmitting.value = false;
                cart.value = backupCart;
                cancelPixPayment();
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Não foi possível finalizar', detail: Object.values(errors)[0], life: 5000 });
            }
        });
    };

    const handlePixSuccess = () => {
        clearCart();
        removeCoupon();
        isCheckoutModalVisible.value = false;
        activePixData.value = null;
        activeOrderId.value = null;
        sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_active_pix_order_id');
        sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_active_pix_data');
        activeTab.value = isTableMode.value ? 'orders' : 'home';
        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Pagamento Aprovado!', detail: 'O seu pedido já está sendo preparado!', life: 4000 });
    };

    // 🚀 Listener global para reabrir o QR Code a partir do card na Home
    const handleResumePixEvent = (e) => {
        const order = e.detail?.order;
        if (!order) return;

        activeOrderId.value = order.id;

        const savedPix = sessionStorage.getItem('customer_active_pix_data');
        if (savedPix) {
            try {
                activePixData.value = JSON.parse(savedPix);
            } catch (err) {
                activePixData.value = savedPix;
            }
        } else if (order.txid) {
            activePixData.value = {
                txid: order.txid,
                qr_code: order.txid,
                pixCopiaECola: order.txid
            };
        }

        checkoutState.step = 'pix';
        isCheckoutModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        window.addEventListener('customer-resume-pix', handleResumePixEvent);
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        window.removeEventListener('customer-resume-pix', handleResumePixEvent);
    });

    return {
        isCheckoutModalVisible, isSubmitting, activePixData, activeOrderId,
        stepRef, headerState, goBack, checkoutState, loyalty, financials,
        openCheckout, handleCheckoutLogin, finalizeOrder, handlePixSuccess
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { reactive, computed, watch, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useAnalytics } from '@/Composables/useAnalytics';

export function useCustomerCheckoutNavigation(props, cartContext, activeTab, isCheckoutModalVisible, isSubmitting, activePixData, activeOrderId) {
    const page = usePage();
    const { trackInitiateCheckout } = useAnalytics();
    const { cart, cartSubtotal } = cartContext;

    const stepRef = ref(null);
    const isTableMode = computed(() => Boolean(page.props.tableMode));

    const checkoutState = reactive({
        step: isTableMode.value ? 'payment' : 'logistics',
        authSubStep: 'methods',
        guestName: '',
        guestPhone: '',
        addressSubStep: 1,
        orderType: isTableMode.value ? 'table' : (cartContext.orderType?.value || 'delivery'),
        routingMeta: isTableMode.value ? {
            type: 'table',
            table_id: page.props.tableMode?.id,
            table: page.props.tableMode
        } : null,
        selectedMethod: null,
        cashChangeTarget: '',
        isTypingCoupon: false,
        useCashbackToggle: false,
    });

    const headerState = computed(() => {
        const isGuest = props.isGuest || !page.props.auth?.user;

        if (isTableMode.value) {
            const max = isGuest ? 2 : 1;
            let current = 1;
            let title = 'Finalizar Pedido na Mesa';

            if (checkoutState.step === 'auth') {
                current = 1;
                title = 'Identifique-se para Pedir';
            } else if (checkoutState.step === 'payment' || checkoutState.step === 'pix') {
                current = max;
                title = checkoutState.step === 'pix' ? 'Pagamento PIX da Mesa' : 'Como prefere pagar?';
            }

            return { title, current, max };
        }

        const max = isGuest ? 4 : 2;
        let current = 1;
        let title = 'Finalizar Pedido';

        if (checkoutState.step === 'auth') {
            current = 1;
            if (checkoutState.authSubStep === 'methods') title = 'Identifique-se';
            else if (checkoutState.authSubStep === 'guest_name') title = 'Como podemos te chamar?';
            else if (checkoutState.authSubStep === 'guest_phone') title = 'Qual seu WhatsApp?';
        } else if (checkoutState.step === 'logistics') {
            current = isGuest ? 2 : 1;
            title = 'Como quer receber?';
        } else if (checkoutState.step === 'new_address') {
            current = isGuest ? 3 : 1;
            title = checkoutState.addressSubStep === 1 ? 'Novo Endereço' : 'Detalhes do Local';
        } else if (checkoutState.step === 'payment' || checkoutState.step === 'pix') {
            current = max;
            if (checkoutState.step === 'pix') title = 'Pagamento PIX';
            else if (checkoutState.isTypingCoupon) title = 'Adicionar Cupom';
            else title = 'Como prefere pagar?';
        }

        return { title, current, max };
    });

    const goBack = () => {
        if (stepRef.value && typeof stepRef.value.goBack === 'function') {
            if (stepRef.value.goBack()) return;
        }

        const isGuest = props.isGuest || !page.props.auth?.user;

        if (checkoutState.step === 'auth') {
            if (checkoutState.authSubStep === 'guest_phone') {
                checkoutState.authSubStep = 'guest_name';
                return;
            }
            if (checkoutState.authSubStep === 'guest_name') {
                checkoutState.authSubStep = 'methods';
                return;
            }
            isCheckoutModalVisible.value = false;
            return;
        }

        if (isTableMode.value && checkoutState.step === 'payment') {
            if (checkoutState.isTypingCoupon) {
                checkoutState.isTypingCoupon = false;
            } else {
                isCheckoutModalVisible.value = false;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (checkoutState.step === 'logistics') {
            if (isGuest) {
                checkoutState.step = 'auth';
                checkoutState.authSubStep = 'guest_phone';
            } else {
                isCheckoutModalVisible.value = false;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (checkoutState.step === 'new_address') {
            checkoutState.step = 'logistics';
            checkoutState.orderType = '';
            checkoutState.routingMeta = null;
            return;
        }

        if (checkoutState.step === 'payment') {
            if (checkoutState.isTypingCoupon) {
                checkoutState.isTypingCoupon = false;
            } else {
                checkoutState.step = 'logistics';
            }
            return;
        }

        if (checkoutState.step === 'pix') {
            // Volta para a seleção de forma de pagamento mantendo o carrinho intacto
            cancelPixPayment(true);
            return;
        }
    };

    const cancelPixPayment = (forceCancelOrder = false) => {
        if (activeOrderId.value && forceCancelOrder) {
            router.post(route('customer.orders.cancel', activeOrderId.value), {}, {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                onFinish: () => {
                    checkoutState.step = 'payment';
                    activePixData.value = null;
                    activeOrderId.value = null;
                    sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_active_pix_data');
                    sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_active_pix_order_id');
                }
            });
        } else {
            checkoutState.step = 'payment';
            activePixData.value = null;
            activeOrderId.value = null;
            sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_active_pix_data');
            sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_active_pix_order_id');
        }
    };

    const openCheckout = () => {
        const isGuest = props.isGuest || !page.props.auth?.user;
        const needsAuth = isGuest && !props.customer;

        if (isTableMode.value) {
            checkoutState.step = needsAuth ? 'auth' : 'payment';
            checkoutState.orderType = 'table';
            checkoutState.routingMeta = {
                type: 'table',
                table_id: page.props.tableMode?.id,
                table: page.props.tableMode
            };
        } else {
            checkoutState.step = needsAuth ? 'auth' : 'logistics';
        }

        checkoutState.authSubStep = 'methods';
        checkoutState.addressSubStep = 1;
        checkoutState.selectedMethod = null;
        checkoutState.cashChangeTarget = '';
        checkoutState.isTypingCoupon = false;
        checkoutState.useCashbackToggle = false;

        sessionStorage.setItem('customer_pending_checkout', 'true');
        trackInitiateCheckout(cartSubtotal.value);

        isCheckoutModalVisible.value = true;
        activePixData.value = null;
        activeOrderId.value = null;
    };

    watch(isCheckoutModalVisible, (visible) => {
        if (!visible && !isSubmitting.value && checkoutState.step !== 'pix') {
            sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_pending_checkout');
            sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_checkout_saved_state');
        }
    });

    watch(
        () => [checkoutState.orderType, checkoutState.routingMeta],
        ([orderType, routingMeta]) => {
            if (isCheckoutModalVisible.value && orderType) {
                sessionStorage.setItem(
                    'customer_checkout_saved_state',
                    JSON.stringify({ orderType, routingMeta })
                );
            }
        },
        { deep: true }
    );

    onMounted(() => {
        const pendingCheckout = sessionStorage.getItem('customer_pending_checkout');
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const hasCheckoutParam = urlParams.get('checkout') === 'true' || urlParams.get('resume_checkout') === 'true';

        if ((pendingCheckout === 'true' || hasCheckoutParam) && cart.value && cart.value.length > 0) {
            sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_pending_checkout');

            if (hasCheckoutParam) {
                urlParams.delete('checkout');
                urlParams.delete('resume_checkout');
                const newQuery = urlParams.toString() ? `?${urlParams.toString()}` : '';
                window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, `${window.location.pathname}${newQuery}`);
            }

            const savedState = sessionStorage.getItem('customer_checkout_saved_state');
            if (savedState) {
                try {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(savedState);
                    if (parsed.orderType) checkoutState.orderType = parsed.orderType;
                    if (parsed.routingMeta) checkoutState.routingMeta = parsed.routingMeta;
                } catch (e) {}
                sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_checkout_saved_state');
            }

            if (activeTab && activeTab.value) {
                activeTab.value = 'cart';
            }

            setTimeout(() => {
                openCheckout();
            }, 250);
        }
    });

    return {
        checkoutState,
        headerState,
        goBack,
        openCheckout,
        cancelPixPayment,
        stepRef,
        isTableMode
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

export function useCustomerCheckoutPayload(props, cartContext, financials, activeCoupon, checkoutState) {
    const page = usePage();
    const { cart } = cartContext;

    const resolveProductId = (productId, id) => {
        for (const candidate of [productId, id]) {
            if (!candidate) continue;
            if (typeof candidate === 'number') return candidate;
            const str = String(candidate);
            const match = str.match(/_prod_(\d+)/) || str.match(/(\d+)$/);
            if (match) return parseInt(match[1], 10);
            const num = parseInt(str, 10);
            if (!isNaN(num)) return num;
        }
        return null;
    };

    const buildCleanItems = () => {
        return (cart.value || []).map(item => ({
            cartId: item.cartId,
            id: Number(item.id),
            name: item.name,
            price: Number(item.price),
            qty: Number(item.qty),
            notes: item.notes || null,
            isTakeaway: Boolean(item.isTakeaway),
            isCombo: Boolean(item.isCombo || (item.comboItems && item.comboItems.length > 0)),
            replaces_item_id: item.replaces_item_id || null,
            auth_reason: item.auth_reason || null,
            is_loss: item.is_loss || null,
            structuredModifiers: (item.structuredModifiers || []).map(mod => ({
                id: mod.id ? Number(mod.id) : null,
                group_id: mod.group_id ? Number(mod.group_id) : null,
                name: mod.name,
                price: Number(mod.price || 0),
                qty: Number(mod.qty || mod.quantity || 1)
            })),
            comboItems: (item.comboItems || []).map(combo => ({
                id: combo.id,
                product_id: resolveProductId(combo.product_id, combo.id),
                name: combo.name || combo.product_name || 'Subitem',
                group_id: combo.group_id ? Number(combo.group_id) : null,
                group_name: combo.group_name ?? null,
                price: Number(combo.price || 0),
                qty: Number(combo.qty || combo.quantity || 1),
                notes: combo.notes || null,
                structuredModifiers: (combo.structuredModifiers || []).map(cMod => ({
                    id: cMod.id ? Number(cMod.id) : null,
                    group_id: cMod.group_id ? Number(cMod.group_id) : null,
                    name: cMod.name,
                    price: Number(cMod.price || 0),
                    qty: Number(cMod.qty || cMod.quantity || 1)
                }))
            }))
        }));
    };

    const buildCleanAddress = (rawAddr) => {
        if (!rawAddr) return null;

        const resolvedDeliveryFee = rawAddr.delivery_fee !== undefined && rawAddr.delivery_fee !== null
            ? Number(rawAddr.delivery_fee)
            : (rawAddr.neighborhood?.delivery_fee !== undefined ? Number(rawAddr.neighborhood.delivery_fee) : financials.value.deliveryFee);

        const isNoNumber = Boolean(rawAddr.no_number || rawAddr.noNumber || rawAddr.number === 'S/N');

        return {
            ...rawAddr,
            id: rawAddr.id || null,
            street_id: rawAddr.street?.id || rawAddr.street_id || null,
            street: typeof rawAddr.street === 'object' && rawAddr.street !== null ? (rawAddr.street.name || '') : (rawAddr.street || ''),
            neighborhood_id: rawAddr.neighborhood?.id || rawAddr.neighborhood_id || null,
            neighborhood: typeof rawAddr.neighborhood === 'object' && rawAddr.neighborhood !== null ? (rawAddr.neighborhood.name || '') : (rawAddr.neighborhood || ''),
            number: isNoNumber ? 'S/N' : (rawAddr.number !== undefined && rawAddr.number !== null ? String(rawAddr.number) : 'S/N'),
            no_number: isNoNumber,
            complement: rawAddr.complement || null,
            reference: rawAddr.reference || null,
            nickname: rawAddr.nickname || null,
            full_address: rawAddr.full_address || null,
            delivery_fee: resolvedDeliveryFee
        };
    };

    const buildPayload = (finalSnapshot) => {
        const tableMode = page.props.tableMode;
        const isTable = Boolean(tableMode) || checkoutState.orderType === 'table';

        const rawRouting = checkoutState.routingMeta?.meta || checkoutState.routingMeta || {};
        const isGuestUser = props.isGuest || !page.props.auth?.user;

        let resolvedCustomer = null;
        if (props.customer && props.customer.id) {
            resolvedCustomer = {
                id: props.customer.id,
                name: props.customer.name,
                phone: props.customer.phone,
                cpf: props.customer.cpf,
                email: props.customer.email
            };
        } else if (isGuestUser) {
            resolvedCustomer = {
                id: 'temp_' + Date.now(),
                name: checkoutState.guestName || 'Visitante',
                phone: checkoutState.guestPhone || null
            };
        }

        const isBankApi = checkoutState.selectedMethod?.engine_type === 'bank_api';

        const routing = {
            ...rawRouting,
            type: isTable ? 'table' : checkoutState.orderType,
            customer: resolvedCustomer,
            customer_id: resolvedCustomer?.id,
            customer_name: resolvedCustomer?.name,
            customer_phone: resolvedCustomer?.phone,
            address_id: isTable ? null : (rawRouting.address_id || null),
            address: isTable ? null : buildCleanAddress(rawRouting.address),
            payment_method_id: checkoutState.selectedMethod?.id || null,
            payment_method_name: checkoutState.selectedMethod?.name || null,
            payment_engine: checkoutState.selectedMethod?.engine_type || 'local',
            payment_intent_status: isBankApi ? 'pix_waiting' : (isTable ? 'pay_on_pickup' : 'pay_on_delivery'),
            cashback_discount: financials.value.cashbackDiscount > 0 ? financials.value.cashbackDiscount : null,
            cash_change_target: checkoutState.cashChangeTarget || null
        };

        if (isTable) {
            const tableId = tableMode?.id || rawRouting.table_id || rawRouting.dining_table_id;
            const tableName = tableMode?.name || rawRouting.table_number || rawRouting.table?.name || '';
            routing.dining_table_id = tableId ? Number(tableId) : null;
            routing.table_id = tableId ? Number(tableId) : null;
            routing.table_number = tableName;
            routing.table = { id: tableId, name: tableName };
        }

        const payload = {
            items: buildCleanItems(),
            routing,
            financials: {
                subtotal: financials.value.subtotal,
                deliveryFee: isTable ? 0 : financials.value.deliveryFee,
                delivery_fee: isTable ? 0 : financials.value.deliveryFee,
                serviceFee: financials.value.serviceFee,
                service_fee: financials.value.serviceFee,
                discount: financials.value.discount,
                finalTotal: finalSnapshot,
                coupon_code: activeCoupon.value?.code || null
            }
        };

        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const resolvedAppendId = props.editOrderData?.id
            || urlParams.get('append_to_order')
            || sessionStorage.getItem('customer_append_order_id');

        if (resolvedAppendId) {
            payload.append_to_order = Number(resolvedAppendId);
        }

        return payload;
    };

    return { resolveProductId, buildCleanItems, buildCleanAddress, buildPayload };
}
```

```javascript
import axios from 'axios';
import { ref } from 'vue';

// 🚀 Estado Global Compartilhado
const favorites = ref([]);
const isLoadingFavorites = ref(false);

export function useCustomerFavorites() {
    const fetchFavorites = async (customerId) => {
        // 🚀 Trava de segurança: Se não houver ID ou se for cliente temporário em memória, não chama o backend
        if (!customerId || String(customerId).startsWith('temp_')) {
            favorites.value = [];
            return;
        }

        isLoadingFavorites.value = true;

        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route('api.customers.favorites', customerId));

            // Tenta ler data encapsulado ou raiz; fallback para array vazio
            favorites.value = response.data.data || response.data || [];

        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Erro ao buscar favoritos do cliente:", error);
            favorites.value = [];
        } finally {
            isLoadingFavorites.value = false;
        }
    };

    const clearFavorites = () => {
        favorites.value = [];
    };

    return {
        favorites,
        isLoadingFavorites,
        fetchFavorites,
        clearFavorites
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { computed } from 'vue';

export function useCustomerHeaderContext({
    activeTab,
    activeAppendOrder,
    activeCategory,
    activeProduct,
    activeComboInnerProduct,
    productTotal,
    menuSearchQuery,
    menuView
}) {
    const page = usePage();

    const getFirstName = (fullName) => {
        if (!fullName || typeof fullName !== 'string') return '';
        return fullName.trim().split(' ')[0];
    };

    const headerContext = computed(() => {
        const user = page.props.auth?.user;
        const customer = user?.customer;
        const rawName = customer?.name || user?.name;
        const firstName = getFirstName(rawName);
        const tableMode = page.props.tableMode;

        // 🎯 1. Modificadores de Produto DENTRO de um Combo
        if (activeProduct?.value && activeComboInnerProduct?.value) {
            const innerName = activeComboInnerProduct.value.name
                || activeComboInnerProduct.value.product_name
                || 'Personalizando Item';

            return {
                title: innerName,
                subtitle: activeProduct.value.name,
                price: Number(productTotal?.value ?? activeProduct.value.price ?? 0)
            };
        }

        // 🎯 2. Configuração de Produto / Combo Aberto (com Preço Dinâmico)
        if (activeProduct?.value) {
            const rawPrice = productTotal?.value
                ?? activeProduct.value.total
                ?? activeProduct.value.price
                ?? activeProduct.value.base_price
                ?? 0;

            return {
                title: activeProduct.value.name,
                subtitle: activeProduct.value.category_name || activeCategory?.value?.name || 'Personalizando Item',
                price: Number(rawPrice)
            };
        }

        // 3. Modo Complemento Ativo (Append Order)
        if (activeAppendOrder?.value) {
            return {
                title: `Adicionar ao Pedido #${activeAppendOrder.value.id}`,
                subtitle: tableMode ? `Comanda na ${tableMode.name}` : 'Itens em Preparo na Cozinha'
            };
        }

        // 4. Modo Mesa: Títulos dedicados de Salão
        if (tableMode) {
            if (activeTab?.value === 'menu') {
                return {
                    title: 'Cardápio',
                    subtitle: tableMode.name
                };
            }

            if (activeTab?.value === 'orders') {
                return {
                    title: 'Conta da Mesa',
                    subtitle: `${tableMode.name} • Pedidos Ativos`
                };
            }

            if (activeTab?.value === 'cart') {
                return {
                    title: 'Novo Pedido',
                    subtitle: tableMode.name
                };
            }
        }

        // 5. Aba HOME: Saudação
        if (activeTab?.value === 'home') {
            return {
                isHome: true,
                firstName: firstName,
                title: null,
                subtitle: null
            };
        }

        // 6. Aba CARDÁPIO: Top 10, Favoritos ou Título Fixo
        if (activeTab?.value === 'menu') {
            if (menuView?.value === 'bestsellers') {
                return {
                    title: 'Top 10: Mais Pedidos',
                    subtitle: 'Destaques'
                };
            }

            if (menuView?.value === 'favorites') {
                return {
                    title: 'Meus Favoritos',
                    subtitle: 'Salvos por Você'
                };
            }

            // 🚀 FIXO: Permanece "Cardápio" sem trocar pelo nome da categoria durante o scroll
            return {
                title: 'Cardápio',
                subtitle: null
            };
        }

        // 7. Demais Abas
        const titles = {
            orders: { title: 'Meus Pedidos', subtitle: 'Acompanhamento' },
            account: { title: 'Minha Conta', subtitle: 'Perfil e Endereços' },
            cart: { title: 'Meu Carrinho', subtitle: 'Revisão do Pedido' }
        };

        return titles[activeTab?.value] || { title: 'Cardápio Digital', subtitle: 'Bem-vindo' };
    });

    return {
        headerContext
    };
}
```

```javascript
import Fuse from 'fuse.js';
import {  computed, onMounted, ref  } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

export function useCustomerMenu(props) {
    const searchQuery = ref('');
    const activeCategoryId = ref(null);
    const scrollArea = ref(null);
    const categoryRefs = ref({});
    const autoOpenProduct = ref(null);

    const setCategoryRef = (el, id) => {
        if (el) categoryRefs.value[id] = el;
    };

    const getOrderedFlatCategories = (flatList) => {
        if (!Array.isArray(flatList)) return [];

        const list = flatList.map(c => ({
            ...c,
            _order: Number(c.sort_order ?? c.order ?? c.position ?? 0),
            _id: Number(c.id),
            _parentId: c.parent_id ? Number(c.parent_id) : null
        }));

        const roots = list.filter(c => !c._parentId).sort((a, b) => (a._order - b._order) || (a._id - b._id));

        const childrenMap = {};
        list.filter(c => c._parentId).forEach(c => {
            if (!childrenMap[c._parentId]) childrenMap[c._parentId] = [];
            childrenMap[c._parentId].push(c);
        });

        Object.values(childrenMap).forEach(children => {
            children.sort((a, b) => (a._order - b._order) || (a._id - b._id));
        });

        const result = [];
        const addedIds = new Set();

        const traverse = (node) => {
            if (addedIds.has(node._id)) return;
            result.push(node);
            addedIds.add(node._id);

            if (childrenMap[node._id]) {
                childrenMap[node._id].forEach(child => traverse(child));
            }
        };

        roots.forEach(root => traverse(root));

        list.forEach(c => {
            if (!addedIds.has(c._id)) {
                result.push(c);
                addedIds.add(c._id);
            }
        });

        return result;
    };

    const validProducts = computed(() => {
        return (props.products || []).filter(p => {
            const isNotArchived = p.status !== 'archived' && p.status !== 'arquivado';
            const isAvailableForDelivery = p.show_on_delivery !== false && p.show_on_delivery !== 0;

            return isNotArchived && isAvailableForDelivery;
        });
    });

    const menuProductFuse = computed(() => {
        return new Fuse(validProducts.value, {
            keys: [
                { name: 'name', weight: 0.7 },
                { name: 'description', weight: 0.3 }
            ],
            threshold: 0.35,
            distance: 100,
            ignoreLocation: true,
            minMatchCharLength: 2
        });
    });

    const groupedMenu = computed(() => {
        const query = searchQuery.value.trim();
        const result = [];

        const orderedCategories = getOrderedFlatCategories(props.categories || [])
            .filter(c => c.status !== 'archived' && c.status !== 'arquivado' && c.is_active !== false && c.is_active !== 0);

        if (orderedCategories.length === 0) return result;

        let matchedProductIds = null;
        if (query.length >= 2) {
            matchedProductIds = new Set(menuProductFuse.value.search(query).map(hit => hit.item.id));
        }

        orderedCategories.forEach(category => {
            let catProducts = validProducts.value.filter(p => Number(p.category_id) === Number(category.id));

            if (matchedProductIds) {
                catProducts = catProducts.filter(p => matchedProductIds.has(p.id));
            }

            if (catProducts.length > 0) {
                const page = usePage();
                const outOfStockMode = page?.props?.companySettings?.out_of_stock_mode || 'disable_bottom';

                const isBlocked = (p) => {
                    if (!p) return false;
                    const s = String(p.status || '').toLowerCase();
                    if (['out_of_stock', 'unavailable', 'paused'].includes(s)) return true;
                    if (p.track_inventory && parseFloat(p.current_stock ?? 0) <= 0) return true;
                    return false;
                };

                if (outOfStockMode === 'hide') {
                    catProducts = catProducts.filter(p => !isBlocked(p));
                }

                catProducts.sort((a, b) => {
                    if (outOfStockMode === 'disable_bottom') {
                        const aB = isBlocked(a) ? 1 : 0;
                        const bB = isBlocked(b) ? 1 : 0;
                        if (aB !== bB) return aB - bB;
                    }

                    const pOrderA = Number(a.sort_order ?? a.order ?? a.position ?? 0);
                    const pOrderB = Number(b.sort_order ?? b.order ?? b.position ?? 0);
                    if (pOrderA !== pOrderB) return pOrderA - pOrderB;

                    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
                });

                let displayName = category.name;
                if (category._parentId) {
                    const parent = props.categories.find(c => Number(c.id) === category._parentId);
                    if (parent) displayName = `${parent.name} • ${category.name}`;
                }

                result.push({
                    category: { ...category, displayName },
                    products: catProducts
                });
            }
        });

        return result;
    });

    const visibleCategories = computed(() => groupedMenu.value.map(g => g.category));

    let isProgrammaticScroll = false;

    const scrollToCategory = (categoryId) => {
        activeCategoryId.value = categoryId;
        const targetEl = categoryRefs.value[categoryId];
        if (targetEl && scrollArea.value) {
            isProgrammaticScroll = true;
            scrollArea.value.scrollTo({ top: targetEl.offsetTop - 20, behavior: 'smooth' });
            setTimeout(() => { isProgrammaticScroll = false; }, 600);
        }
    };

    const handleScroll = () => {
        if (isProgrammaticScroll || !scrollArea.value || groupedMenu.value.length === 0) return;

        const containerTop = scrollArea.value.scrollTop;
        const containerCenter = containerTop + (scrollArea.value.clientHeight / 3);

        let currentActiveId = null;

        for (const group of groupedMenu.value) {
            const el = categoryRefs.value[group.category.id];
            if (el && (el.offsetTop - 25) <= containerCenter) {
                currentActiveId = group.category.id;
            }
        }

        if (currentActiveId && currentActiveId !== activeCategoryId.value) {
            activeCategoryId.value = currentActiveId;
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        if (visibleCategories.value.length > 0) {
            activeCategoryId.value = visibleCategories.value[0].id;
        }

        setTimeout(() => {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const targetProductSlug = urlParams.get('produto');
            const targetCategorySlug = urlParams.get('categoria');

            // 1. PRIORIDADE: Deep-link de produto (Abre os modificadores e posiciona a categoria ao fundo)
            if (targetProductSlug && validProducts.value.length > 0) {
                const targetProduct = validProducts.value.find(p => {
                    const slug = (p.slug || p.name || '').toString().toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[\s_]+/g, '-');
                    const paramSlug = String(targetProductSlug).toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[\s_]+/g, '-');
                    return slug === paramSlug || String(p.id) === String(targetProductSlug);
                });

                if (targetProduct) {
                    autoOpenProduct.value = targetProduct;
                    scrollToCategory(targetProduct.category_id);
                    return;
                }
            }

            // 2. FALLBACK: Deep-link de categoria (Rola a página até o grupo)
            if (targetCategorySlug && visibleCategories.value.length > 0) {
                const targetCategory = visibleCategories.value.find(c => {
                    const slug = (c.slug || c.name || '').toString().toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[\s_]+/g, '-');
                    const paramSlug = String(targetCategorySlug).toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[\s_]+/g, '-');
                    return slug === paramSlug || String(c.id) === String(targetCategorySlug);
                });

                if (targetCategory) {
                    scrollToCategory(targetCategory.id);
                }
            }
        }, 300);
    });

    return {
        searchQuery,
        activeCategoryId,
        scrollArea,
        setCategoryRef,
        groupedMenu,
        visibleCategories,
        scrollToCategory,
        handleScroll,
        autoOpenProduct
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { formatCpfCnpj, formatPhone } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import axios from "axios";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import { computed, ref } from "vue";

export function useCustomerRegistration(customerRegistrationMode, options = {}) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const page = usePage();

    const isCustomerMode = computed(() => {
        if (typeof options === 'boolean') return options;
        if (options?.isCustomerMode !== undefined) return Boolean(options.isCustomerMode);
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            const path = window.location.pathname;
            // 🚀 Se estiver em rotas operacionais do PDV, Balcão ou Equipe, NÃO é modo cliente (B2C)
            if (path.startsWith('/pos') || path.startsWith('/team') || path.startsWith('/waiter') || path.startsWith('/operations')) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    });

    const settings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || page.props.company_settings || {});
    const reqWhatsapp = computed(() => settings.value.require_whatsapp !== false && settings.value.require_whatsapp !== 0 && settings.value.require_whatsapp !== '0');
    const reqBirthDate = computed(() => settings.value.require_birth_date === true || settings.value.require_birth_date === 1 || settings.value.require_birth_date === '1');
    const allowMinors = computed(() => settings.value.allow_minors !== false && settings.value.allow_minors !== 0 && settings.value.allow_minors !== '0');

    const form = ref({ name: "", phone: "", cpf: "", birth_date: null, email: "", password: "" });
    const serproStep = ref('cpf_input');
    const isLoadingSerpro = ref(false);

    const existingAccount = ref(null);

    const formatCpfInput = (e) => {
        let val = e?.target?.value !== undefined ? e.target.value : e;
        if (typeof val !== 'string') return;
        form.value.cpf = formatCpfCnpj(val);
        if (e?.target) e.target.value = form.value.cpf;
    };

    const formatPhoneInput = (e) => {
        let val = e?.target?.value !== undefined ? e.target.value : e;
        if (typeof val !== 'string') return;
        form.value.phone = formatPhone(val);
        if (e?.target) e.target.value = form.value.phone;
    };

    const calculateAge = (dob) => {
        if (!dob) return 0;
        const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dob).getTime();
        return Math.abs(new Date(diff).getUTCFullYear() - 1970);
    };

    const isCpfValid = computed(() => {
        let strCPF = String(form.value.cpf || '').replace(/[^\d]+/g, '');
        if (strCPF.length !== 11) return false;
        if (/^(\d)\1+$/.test(strCPF)) return false;

        let soma = 0, resto;
        for (let i = 1; i <= 9; i++) soma += parseInt(strCPF.substring(i - 1, i)) * (11 - i);
        resto = (soma * 10) % 11;
        if (resto === 10 || resto === 11) resto = 0;
        if (resto !== parseInt(strCPF.substring(9, 10))) return false;

        soma = 0;
        for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) soma += parseInt(strCPF.substring(i - 1, i)) * (12 - i);
        resto = (soma * 10) % 11;
        if (resto === 10 || resto === 11) resto = 0;
        if (resto !== parseInt(strCPF.substring(10, 11))) return false;

        return true;
    });

    const isPhoneValid = computed(() => {
        const rawPhone = String(form.value.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
        return rawPhone.length >= 10 && rawPhone.length <= 11;
    });

    const isMinorError = computed(() => {
        if (!allowMinors.value && form.value.birth_date) {
            return calculateAge(form.value.birth_date) < 18;
        }
        return false;
    });

    const isFormValid = computed(() => {
        const hasName = Boolean(form.value.name && form.value.name.trim().length >= 2);
        const hasPhone = isPhoneValid.value;
        const hasBirth = form.value.birth_date !== null && form.value.birth_date !== "";

        let valid = hasName;

        if (reqWhatsapp.value) valid = valid && hasPhone;
        if (reqBirthDate.value) valid = valid && hasBirth;
        if (isMinorError.value) valid = false;

        const rawMode = (typeof customerRegistrationMode === 'object' && customerRegistrationMode?.value)
            ? customerRegistrationMode.value
            : (customerRegistrationMode || 'basic');

        // 🛡️ Se o tenant for 'customer_only', no PDV o CPF se comporta como opcional ('basic')
        const mode = (rawMode === 'customer_only' && !isCustomerMode.value) ? 'basic' : rawMode;

        const rawCpf = String(form.value.cpf || '').replace(/\D/g, '');

        // 🚀 Exige CPF estritamente se for cpf_required ou se for customer_only dentro do app do cliente
        if (mode === 'cpf_required' || (mode === 'customer_only' && isCustomerMode.value)) {
            return valid && isCpfValid.value;
        }

        // Modo Serpro (consulta na Receita Federal)
        if (mode === 'serpro_magic') {
            return (serproStep.value === 'confirm_data' || serproStep.value === 'manual_fallback') && valid;
        }

        // Modos opcionais (basic, etc.): se começou a digitar CPF, valida; se estiver em branco, libera!
        if (rawCpf.length > 0) {
            return valid && isCpfValid.value;
        }

        return valid;
    });

    const lookupSerpro = async () => {
        isLoadingSerpro.value = true;
        try {
            const cleanCpf = String(form.value.cpf || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            form.value.cpf = formatCpfCnpj(cleanCpf);

            const response = await axios.get(route('api.customers.check-cpf'), { params: { cpf: cleanCpf } });

            if (response.data.available === false) {
                existingAccount.value = response.data;
                serproStep.value = 'cpf_exists';
                return;
            }

            const payload = response.data.data || response.data;
            const fetchedName = payload.nome || payload.name;
            const fetchedDob = payload.nascimento || payload.birth_date;

            if (fetchedName) {
                form.value.name = fetchedName;
                form.value.birth_date = fetchedDob;
                serproStep.value = 'confirm_data';
            } else {
                serproStep.value = 'manual_fallback';
            }
        } catch (e) {
            serproStep.value = 'manual_fallback';
        } finally {
            isLoadingSerpro.value = false;
        }
    };

    const resetForm = (initialData = {}) => {
        const seedName = typeof initialData === 'string' ? initialData : (initialData?.name || "");
        form.value = {
            name: seedName,
            phone: initialData?.phone ? formatPhone(initialData.phone) : "",
            cpf: initialData?.cpf || "",
            birth_date: initialData?.birth_date || null,
            email: initialData?.email || "",
            password: ""
        };
        existingAccount.value = null;
        serproStep.value = 'cpf_input';
    };

    return {
        form, serproStep, isLoadingSerpro, isCpfValid, isPhoneValid, isFormValid, isMinorError, existingAccount,
        reqWhatsapp, reqBirthDate, allowMinors,
        formatCpfInput, formatPhoneInput, lookupSerpro, resetForm
    };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerSearch.js
```javascript
import axios from "axios";
import debounce from "lodash/debounce";
import { ref } from "vue";

export function useCustomerSearch(initialCustomers) {
    const query = ref("");
    const results = ref([]);
    const isLoading = ref(false);
    const showDropdown = ref(false);

    const executeSearch = debounce(async (searchTerm) => {
        if (!searchTerm || searchTerm.length < 2) {
            results.value = [];
            return;
        }

        isLoading.value = true;
        const lowerQuery = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const cleanQuery = searchTerm.replace(/\D/g, "");

        // 1. 🚀 Busca Local Instantânea (Zero Delay) com Barreira de Ativação
        let localResults = (initialCustomers || []).filter((c) => {
            // Se o cliente foi explicitamente desativado no Filament, ignora e barra no front-end
            if (c.is_active === false || c.is_active === 0) return false;

            const matchName = c.name?.toLowerCase().includes(lowerQuery);
            const matchPhone = c.phone?.replace(/\D/g, "").includes(cleanQuery);
            return matchName || (cleanQuery && matchPhone);
        });

        if (localResults.length > 0) {
            results.value = localResults.slice(0, 5);
            isLoading.value = false;
            return;
        }

        // 2. Busca na API se não achar localmente (Ajustado para capturar apenas registros ativos)
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route('api.customers.search'), { params: { q: searchTerm } });

            // 🚀 Proteção extra: Filtra também os resultados que venham da chamada assíncrona da API
            const activeApiResults = (response.data || []).filter(c => c.is_active !== false && c.is_active !== 0);

            results.value = activeApiResults.slice(0, 5);
        } catch (error) {
            results.value = [];
        } finally {
            isLoading.value = false;
        }
    }, 300);

    return { query, results, isLoading, showDropdown, executeSearch };
}
```

```javascript
import { useAnalytics } from '@/Composables/useAnalytics';
import { useTenantEcho } from '@/Composables/useTenantEcho';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, watch } from 'vue';

export function useCustomerSync(props, activeTab, couponContext, flowContext) {
    const page = usePage();
    const toast = useToast();
    const { initPixels } = useAnalytics();
    const { listenChannel } = useTenantEcho();

    const { fetchWallet, applyCoupon } = couponContext;
    const { initializeFlow, autoParkCurrent } = flowContext;

    const handlePopState = (event) => {
        if (event.state && event.state.tab) activeTab.value = event.state.tab;
    };

    const applyOrderRealTimeUpdate = (e) => {
        // 🚀 Suporte transparente tanto para payload enxuto (raiz) quanto empacotado
        const order = e?.orderData || e?.order || e;
        const currentCustomerId = page.props.customer?.id || localStorage.getItem('brasume_guest_anchor');
        const eventCustomerId = order?.customer_id;
        const orderId = order?.id || order?.orderId;
        const status = order?.status;

        // 🛡️ TRAVA ESTRITA: Só processa se o evento pertencer inequivocamente a este cliente
        if (!eventCustomerId || String(eventCustomerId) !== String(currentCustomerId)) {
            return;
        }

        const existingOrder = [...(props.myActiveOrders || []), ...(props.myHistory || [])]
            .find(o => String(o.id) === String(orderId));

        const hasStatusChanged = !existingOrder || existingOrder.status !== status;

        if (hasStatusChanged && status) {
            const statusMessages = {
                preparing: '👨‍🍳 Seu pedido começou a ser preparado!',
                ready: '✅ Seu pedido está pronto!',
                dispatched: '🛵 Seu pedido saiu para entrega!',
                closed: '✨ Pedido finalizado com sucesso!',
                cancelled: '❌ Pedido cancelado.'
            };

            if (statusMessages[status]) {
                toast.add({
                    severity: status === 'cancelled' ? 'error' : 'info',
                    summary: 'Status do Pedido',
                    detail: statusMessages[status],
                    life: 4000
                });
            }
        }

        router.reload({
            only: ['myActiveOrders', 'myHistory', 'customer'],
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true
        });
    };

    const handleShiftEvent = (isOpen, message) => {
        toast.add({
            severity: isOpen ? 'success' : 'warn',
            summary: isOpen ? 'Estamos Abertos!' : 'Expediente Encerrado',
            detail: message,
            life: 5000
        });

        router.reload({
            only: ['storeStatus', 'companySettings'],
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true
        });
    };

    onMounted(async () => {
        initPixels();
        await fetchWallet();

        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const couponParam = urlParams.get('auto_coupon') || urlParams.get('cupom') || urlParams.get('coupon');

        if (couponParam) {
            const cleanCode = couponParam.toUpperCase();
            localStorage.setItem('pos_magic_coupon', cleanCode);

            urlParams.delete('auto_coupon');
            urlParams.delete('cupom');
            urlParams.delete('coupon');
            const newQuery = urlParams.toString() ? '?' + urlParams.toString() : '';
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname + newQuery);

            const success = await applyCoupon(cleanCode, 0);
            if (success) {
                toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Presente Ativado! 🎉', detail: `O desconto ${cleanCode} será aplicado no seu carrinho.`, life: 5000 });
            }
        }

        const path = window.location.pathname;
        if (path.includes('/customer/cart')) activeTab.value = 'cart';
        else if (path.includes('/customer/orders')) activeTab.value = 'orders';
        else if (path.includes('/customer/profile')) activeTab.value = 'account';
        else if (path.includes('/customer/home')) activeTab.value = 'home';
        else activeTab.value = 'menu';

        window.addEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);

        if (typeof initializeFlow === 'function') {
            initializeFlow(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search));
        }

        const serverCustomerId = page.props.customer?.id;
        if (serverCustomerId) {
            localStorage.setItem('brasume_guest_anchor', serverCustomerId);
        } else {
            const savedAnchor = localStorage.getItem('brasume_guest_anchor');
            if (savedAnchor) {
                axios.post(route('customer.auth.guest-restore'), { guest_id: savedAnchor })
                    .then(() => { router.reload({ preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }); })
                    .catch(() => localStorage.removeItem('brasume_guest_anchor'));
            }
        }

        if (window.Echo) {
            const customerId = serverCustomerId || localStorage.getItem('brasume_guest_anchor');

            // 🚀 Canal privativo do cliente (sem duplicações de alias e sem canal fantasma 'orders')
            if (customerId) {
                listenChannel(`customer.${customerId}`, '.order.updated', applyOrderRealTimeUpdate);
                listenChannel(`customer.${customerId}`, '.order.cancelled', applyOrderRealTimeUpdate);
            }

            // 🚀 Sincronização de Turno: Atualiza "Aberto/Fechado" na hora
            listenChannel('shift', '.shift.opened', () => handleShiftEvent(true, 'A loja já está aceitando pedidos!'));
            listenChannel('shift', '.shift.closed', () => handleShiftEvent(false, 'A loja encerrou os pedidos por hoje.'));

            // 🚀 Ajustes da loja e Catálogo
            listenChannel('system', '.settings.updated', () => {
                router.reload({ only: ['storeStatus', 'companySettings'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
            });
            listenChannel('catalog', '.catalog.updated', () => {
                router.reload({ only: ['initialCategories', 'initialProducts'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
            });
        }
    });

    watch(activeTab, (newTab, oldTab) => {
        if (!newTab || newTab === oldTab) return;
        const newUrl = `/customer/${newTab}`;
        if (window.location.pathname !== newUrl) {
            window.history.pushState({ tab: newTab }, '', newUrl);
        }
    });

    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        if (typeof autoParkCurrent === 'function') autoParkCurrent();
        window.removeEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
    });
}
```
