```javascript
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { computed } from 'vue';

export function useWhatsAppSupport() {
    const page = usePage();

    const supportPhone = computed(() => {
        const phone = page.props.publicSettings?.support_whatsapp || page.props.companySettings?.support_whatsapp || '';
        return phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
    });

    const whatsappHandle = computed(() => {
        let handle = page.props.publicSettings?.whatsapp_handle || page.props.companySettings?.whatsapp_handle || '';
        return handle.replace('@', '').trim();
    });

    const hasSupport = computed(() => supportPhone.value.length >= 10 || whatsappHandle.value.length > 0);

    const generateLink = (topic, data = {}) => {
        if (!hasSupport.value) return null;

        let message = 'Olá! Preciso de ajuda com o sistema.';

        switch (topic) {
            case 'login_cpf_exists':
                message = `Olá, estou com problemas no cadastro do App. O sistema diz que o meu CPF (${data.cpf || 'não informado'}) já está registrado, mas não consigo acessar. Vocês podem me ajudar?`;
                break;
            // 🚀 Template específico para o modal de Upgrade
            case 'upgrade_cpf_exists':
                message = `Olá! Estou tentando ativar o acompanhamento em tempo real no aplicativo, mas o sistema informou que o meu CPF (${data.cpf || 'não informado'}) já está cadastrado. Podem me ajudar a liberar meu acesso?`;
                break;
            case 'registration_help':
                message = `Olá! Estou tentando realizar meu cadastro no aplicativo, mas estou com uma dúvida/problema. Poderiam me ajudar?`;
                break;
            case 'order_issue':
                message = `Olá, preciso de ajuda com o meu pedido #${data.orderId || ''}.`;
                break;
            case 'address_not_found':
                message = `Olá! Estou tentando cadastrar meu endereço para entrega, mas não estou conseguindo localizar minha rua/CEP no aplicativo. Podem me ajudar?`;
                break;
        }

        const encodedMessage = encodeURIComponent(message);

        // 🚀 PRIORIDADE 1: Se houver telefone numérico, usa o link direto do WhatsApp (mais estável)
        if (supportPhone.value.length >= 10) {
            return `https://wa.me/55${supportPhone.value}?text=${encodedMessage}`;
        }

        // PRIORIDADE 2: Fallback para o @handle se não houver número configurado
        if (whatsappHandle.value) {
            return `https://wa.me/${whatsappHandle.value}?text=${encodedMessage}`;
        }

        return null;
    };

    const openSupport = (topic, data = {}) => {
        const link = generateLink(topic, data);
        if (link) {
            // 🚀 _blank preserva a aplicação aberta em segundo plano
            window.open(link, '_blank');
        } else {
            alert('O número de suporte ainda não foi configurado pelo restaurante.');
        }
    };

    return { hasSupport, generateLink, openSupport };
}
```

```vue
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                <h3 class="font-black text-xl text-surface-text">Horários de Atendimento</h3>
                <button @click="$emit('update:visible', false)" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-surface-2 hover:bg-surface-3 text-surface-muted flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer border-none outline-none">
                    <i class="pi pi-times text-sm font-bold"></i>
                </button>
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <div v-for="(day, index) in weekDays" :key="index"
                    class="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 rounded-xl border transition-colors"
                    :class="isToday(index) ? 'bg-primary-500/10 border-primary-500/30' : 'bg-transparent border-transparent'">

                    <span class="font-bold text-sm flex items-center" :class="isToday(index) ? 'text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-400' : 'text-surface-text'">
                        {{ day.name }}
                        <span v-if="isToday(index)" class="ml-2 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest bg-primary-500 text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                            Hoje
                        </span>
                    </span>

                    <span class="text-sm font-black tracking-tight" :class="day.isOpen ? 'text-surface-text' : 'text-danger-500'">
                        {{ day.isOpen ? `${day.open} às ${day.close}` : 'Fechado' }}
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </AdaptiveModal>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    settings: Object
});

defineEmits(['update:visible']);

const isToday = (index) => {
    const today = new Date().getDay(); // 0 = Domingo, 1 = Segunda...
    return today === index;
};

const weekDays = computed(() => {
    const days = [
        { name: 'Domingo', isOpen: false },
        { name: 'Segunda-feira', isOpen: false },
        { name: 'Terça-feira', isOpen: false },
        { name: 'Quarta-feira', isOpen: false },
        { name: 'Quinta-feira', isOpen: false },
        { name: 'Sexta-feira', isOpen: false },
        { name: 'Sábado', isOpen: false }
    ];

    if (props.settings?.business_hours && Array.isArray(props.settings.business_hours)) {
        props.settings.business_hours.forEach(schedule => {
            const dayIndex = parseInt(schedule.day_of_week);
            if (days[dayIndex]) {
                days[dayIndex].isOpen = true;
                days[dayIndex].open = schedule.open_time.substring(0, 5);
                days[dayIndex].close = schedule.close_time.substring(0, 5);
            }
        });
    }
    return days;
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, watch, onUnmounted, ref, onMounted } from 'vue';

import ProgressBar from "@/Components/UI/ProgressBar.vue";
import ComboStepGrid from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ComboStepGrid.vue";
import ComboSidebar from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ComboSidebar.vue";
import CustomerProductModifiers from "./CustomerProductModifiers.vue";
import ComboDynamicNav from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ComboDynamicNav.vue";

import { useComboWizard } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useComboWizard";
import { dynamicIslandTypeOverride } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useDynamicIsland";
import { validateProductModifiers } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart";

const props = defineProps({
    product: Object,
    breadcrumbs: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    isEditMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    globalProductsList: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['close', 'crumb-click', 'confirm-combo', 'update:total', 'update:inner-product']);

const isMounted = ref(false);
onMounted(() => { isMounted.value = true; });

const isTeamMode = computed(() => false);
const isCustomerMode = computed(() => true);

const comboGroupsList = computed(() => {
    return props.product?.combo_groups || props.product?.comboGroups || props.product?.groups || [];
});

const resolvedBreadcrumbs = computed(() => {
    if (props.breadcrumbs && props.breadcrumbs.length > 0) return props.breadcrumbs;
    if (props.product?.category?.name) return ['Início', props.product.category.name];
    return ['Início'];
});

const {
    currentStepIndex, showMobileSummary, showInnerModifiers, modifyingProduct, isAdding, isAddSuccess,
    currentGroup, isLastStep, canAddMore, globalSelectionsArray, comboHelpers, isCurrentStepValid,
    comboProgressMax, comboProgressCurrent, wizardTotal, addCatalogItemToTray, openModifiers,
    handleModifierConfirm, removeSelection, handleMobileBack, handleBackOrCancel, nextStep, handleClearCombo,
    isEditingComboItem, canGoBack, getSelectionsCountForGroup
} = useComboWizard(props, emit);

// 🛡️ VALIDAÇÃO ESTRITA: O combo só é completo se TODOS os grupos e modificadores estiverem satisfeitos
const isComboComplete = computed(() => {
    // Se ainda estiver com a tela de modificadores de um item aberta, nunca está pronto
    if (showInnerModifiers.value) return false;

    const groups = comboGroupsList.value;
    if (!groups || groups.length === 0) return false;

    const selections = globalSelectionsArray.value || [];

    // 1. Verifica se CADA grupo atingiu a quantidade mínima exigida
    for (const group of groups) {
        const minChoices = Number(group.min_choices ?? 1);
        const gId = group.id ?? group.group_id;

        const selectionsInGroup = selections.filter(sel =>
            String(sel.groupId ?? sel.group_id) === String(gId)
        );

        const totalQtyInGroup = selectionsInGroup.reduce((sum, s) => sum + Number(s.qty || 1), 0);
        if (totalQtyInGroup < minChoices) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    // 2. Verifica se CADA subitem selecionado cumpriu suas escolhas obrigatórias
    for (const sel of selections) {
        const itemProd = sel.item?.product || sel.item || {};
        const check = validateProductModifiers(itemProd, sel.structuredModifiers);
        if (!check.valid) {
            return false; // Subitem incompleto
        }
    }

    return true;
});

const handleComboConfirmTrigger = () => {
    if (!isComboComplete.value) {
        // Se ainda não estiver completo, avança para o próximo passo pendente
        nextStep();
        return;
    }
    nextStep();
};

const handleStepSelect = (step) => {
    const groups = comboGroupsList.value;
    const targetIndex = groups.findIndex(g => String(g.id ?? g.group_id) === String(step.groupId));
    if (targetIndex !== -1) {
        currentStepIndex.value = targetIndex;
        showMobileSummary.value = false;
    }
};

watch([showInnerModifiers, modifyingProduct], ([isShowing, modProd]) => {
    emit('update:inner-product', isShowing && modProd ? modProd : null);
}, { immediate: true });

watch(wizardTotal, (newTotal) => {
    emit('update:total', newTotal);
}, { immediate: true });

const totalSelectedItems = computed(() => {
    return globalSelectionsArray.value?.length || 0;
});

watch(showInnerModifiers, (isShowing) => {
    dynamicIslandTypeOverride.value = isShowing ? 'modifier' : null;
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    emit('update:inner-product', null);
    dynamicIslandTypeOverride.value = null;
});
</script>

</style>
```

```vue
<template>
    <button
        @click="$emit('click', product)"
        :disabled="isBlocked"
        class="c-glass-card-interactive flex items-stretch p-3 md:p-4 gap-4 w-full text-left relative transition-all duration-200"
        :class="isBlocked ? 'grayscale opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : ''"
    >
        <!-- 🖼️ IMAGEM -->
        <div class="relative bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 overflow-hidden w-24 h-24 md:w-28 md:h-28 rounded-2xl">
            <img
                v-if="finalImageUrl"
                :src="finalImageUrl"
                class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover"
                loading="lazy"
            />
            <i v-else class="pi pi-image text-white/20 text-3xl"></i>

            <!-- Badges de Disponibilidade / Promo -->


            <div v-if="product?.promo_price > 0" class="absolute top-2 left-2 c-badge bg-warning-500/90 text-white font-black text-[9px] uppercase tracking-widest">
                Promo
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 📝 INFOS DO PRODUTO -->
        <div class="flex flex-col flex-1 min-w-0 w-full justify-center py-0.5">
            <h3 class="c-text-main w-full line-clamp-2">
                {{ product?.name }}
            </h3>

            <p
                v-if="displayDescription"
                class="c-text-muted line-clamp-2 mt-1"
            >
                {{ displayDescription }}
            </p>

            <div class="mt-auto flex items-end justify-between gap-2 w-full pt-2">
                <div class="flex flex-col">
                    <span v-if="product?.promo_price > 0" class="text-[10px] text-white/40 line-through font-medium">
                        {{ $formatCurrency(originalTotal ) }}
                    </span>
                    <span class="font-black text-lg text-white/80 tracking-tight">
                        {{ $formatCurrency(finalTotal ) }}
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </button>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({ product: Object });
defineEmits(['click']);

const page = usePage();

const isPaused = computed(() => props.product?.status === 'paused');

const isOutOfStock = computed(() => {
    if (props.product?.status === 'out_of_stock' || props.product?.status === 'unavailable') return true;
    if (props.product?.track_inventory && parseFloat(props.product?.current_stock) <= 0) return true;
    return false;
});

const isBlocked = computed(() => isPaused.value || isOutOfStock.value);

const finalImageUrl = computed(() => {
    if (!props.product) return null;
    const prodPath = props.product.image || props.product.image_path;
    if (prodPath) return prodPath.startsWith('http') ? prodPath : `/media/file?path=${prodPath}`;
    const categories = page.props.initialCategories || [];
    const category = categories.find(c => c.id === props.product.category_id);
    if (category?.image_path) return category.image_path.startsWith('http') ? category.image_path : `/media/file?path=${category.image_path}`;
    return null;
});

const selections = computed(() => props.product?.favorite_selections || props.product?.cartItem?.structuredModifiers || []);

const displayDescription = computed(() => {
    const list = selections.value;
    if (list && list.length > 0) {
        const names = list.map(m => m.name).filter(Boolean);
        if (names.length === 1) return names[0];
        if (names.length > 1) return names.join(', ').replace(/, ([^,]*)$/, ' e $1');
    }
    return props.product?.description || '';
});

const extraPrice = computed(() => selections.value.reduce((sum, mod) => {
    const modPrice = typeof mod.price === 'string' ? parseFloat(mod.price.replace(',', '.')) : (mod.price || 0);
    return sum + (modPrice * parseInt(mod.qty || mod.quantity || 1));
}, 0));

const originalTotal = computed(() => {
    const rawPrice = props.product?.price ?? props.product?.dine_in_price ?? 0;
    const base = typeof rawPrice === 'string' ? parseFloat(rawPrice.replace(',', '.')) : Number(rawPrice || 0);
    return base + extraPrice.value;
});

const finalTotal = computed(() => {
    const rawBase = props.product?.promo_price > 0 ? props.product.promo_price : (props.product?.price ?? props.product?.dine_in_price ?? 0);
    const base = typeof rawBase === 'string' ? parseFloat(rawBase.replace(',', '.')) : Number(rawBase || 0);
    return base + extraPrice.value;
});
</script>
```

```vue
                            ></textarea>

                    <div v-else class="flex flex-col gap-6">

                            <ModifierOptionsGroup
                                :group="group"

                                :is-customer-mode="true"

<script setup>
import { ref, watch, computed } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useModifiers } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useModifiers";

import ModifierTabs from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ModifierTabs.vue";
import ModifierOptionsGroup from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ModifierOptionsGroup.vue";
import QtyStepper from "@/Components/UI/QtyStepper.vue";
import ModifierDynamicNav from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ModifierDynamicNav.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    product: Object,
    isEditMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    breadcrumbs: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["confirm", "close", "crumb-click", "update:total"]);
const page = usePage();

const isPredictiveEnabled = computed(() => {
    const mode = page.props.companySettings?.predictive_modifiers_mode || 'disabled';
    return mode === 'all' || mode === 'customer';
});

const stateHelpers = useModifiers(true);
const itemObservation = ref("");
const activeTab = ref(null);
const localQuantity = ref(1);
const maxQuantity = computed(() => props.product?.cartItem?.maxQty || 99);
const isAdding = ref(false);
const isAddSuccess = ref(false);

const normalizeType = (type) => {
    const t = String(type || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (t === 'ingredient' || t === 'ingrediente') return 'ingredient';
    if (t === 'add_on' || t === 'additional' || t === 'adicional' || t === 'addon') return 'add_on';
    if (t === 'observation' || t === 'observacao' || t === 'observação') return 'observation';

};

const allTabs = computed(() => {
    const mods = props.product?.modifiers || [];
    const tabs = [];

    const ingredientGroups = mods.filter(g => normalizeType(g.type) === 'ingredient');
    const addonGroups = mods.filter(g => normalizeType(g.type) === 'add_on');
    const observationGroups = mods.filter(g => normalizeType(g.type) === 'observation');

    if (ingredientGroups.length > 0) {
        const hasReq = ingredientGroups.some(g => (g.min_selections || 0) > 0);
        const isComp = ingredientGroups.every(g => stateHelpers.isGroupSatisfied(g));
        tabs.push({
            id: 'ingredient',
            label: 'Ingredientes',
            icon: 'pi-sparkles',
            groupCount: ingredientGroups.length,
            hasRequired: hasReq,
            hasPendingRequired: hasReq && !isComp,
            isComplete: isComp,
            groups: ingredientGroups
        });
    }

    if (addonGroups.length > 0) {
        const hasReq = addonGroups.some(g => (g.min_selections || 0) > 0);
        const isComp = addonGroups.every(g => stateHelpers.isGroupSatisfied(g));
        tabs.push({
            id: 'add_on',
            label: 'Adicionais',
            icon: 'pi-plus-circle',
            groupCount: addonGroups.length,
            hasRequired: hasReq,
            hasPendingRequired: hasReq && !isComp,
            isComplete: isComp,
            groups: addonGroups
        });
    }

    const hasReq = observationGroups.some(g => (g.min_selections || 0) > 0);
    const isComp = observationGroups.every(g => stateHelpers.isGroupSatisfied(g));
    tabs.push({
        id: 'observation',
        label: 'Observações',
        icon: 'pi-pen-to-square',
        groupCount: observationGroups.length,
        hasRequired: hasReq,
        hasPendingRequired: hasReq && !isComp,
        isComplete: isComp,
        groups: observationGroups
    });

    return tabs;
});

const currentTab = computed(() => allTabs.value.find(t => t.id === activeTab.value) || allTabs.value[0]);
const currentTabGroups = computed(() => currentTab.value?.groups || []);

watch(() => props.product, (newVal) => {
    itemObservation.value = "";
    localQuantity.value = newVal?.cartItem?.qty || 1;
    let existingModifiers = newVal?.cartItem?.structuredModifiers ? [...newVal.cartItem.structuredModifiers] : [];
    const obsIndex = existingModifiers.findIndex(m => m.is_joker && m.name.startsWith('Obs: '));
    if (obsIndex > -1) {
        itemObservation.value = existingModifiers[obsIndex].name.replace('Obs: ', '');
        existingModifiers.splice(obsIndex, 1);
    }
    stateHelpers.initModifiers(newVal?.modifiers, existingModifiers);
}, { immediate: true });

watch(() => allTabs.value, (newTabs) => {
    if (newTabs.length > 0 && (!activeTab.value || !newTabs.find(t => t.id === activeTab.value))) activeTab.value = newTabs[0].id;
}, { immediate: true });

watch(() => stateHelpers.hasJokerSelected(props.product?.modifiers), (isJokerNowActive) => {
    if (isJokerNowActive) setTimeout(() => { activeTab.value = 'observation'; }, 300);
});

const currentTotal = computed(() => stateHelpers.calculateTotal(props.product?.price, props.product?.modifiers));
const isSelectionValid = computed(() => stateHelpers.isValid(props.product?.modifiers, itemObservation.value));

watch([currentTotal, localQuantity], () => {
    emit('update:total', currentTotal.value * localQuantity.value);
}, { immediate: true });

const confirmAndAdd = () => {
    if (!isSelectionValid.value) return;
    isAdding.value = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
        isAdding.value = false;
        isAddSuccess.value = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
            const extraPrice = currentTotal.value - Number(props.product.price);
            let text = stateHelpers.buildModifiersText(props.product.modifiers);
            const structured = stateHelpers.buildStructuredModifiers(props.product.modifiers);

            if (itemObservation.value.trim()) {
                text += text ? ` | Obs: ${itemObservation.value}` : `Obs: ${itemObservation.value}`;
                structured.push({ id: null, name: `Obs: ${itemObservation.value}`, price: 0, qty: 1, is_joker: true });
            }
            emit("confirm", { text: text, extraPrice: extraPrice, isTakeaway: false, structuredModifiers: structured, qty: localQuantity.value });
        }, 500);
    }, 300);
};
</script>
```

```vue
            <CustomerProductCard

                :key="item.variant_signature || item.id"
                :product="item"
                layout="list"
                @click="$emit('open-product', $event)"
            />
        </div>

        <!-- Empty State em Glassmorphism Sem Bordas -->

                <i class="pi pi-bolt text-2xl text-white/30"></i>
            </div>
            <h3 class="c-title !text-base mb-1">Carregando tendências...</h3>
            <p class="c-text-muted max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
                Assim que os pedidos começarem a sair, as combinações favoritas da galera aparecerão aqui.
            </p>
        </div>
    </div>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import CustomerProductCard from '@/Pages/Customer/Menu/CustomerProductCard.vue';
import { useFavoriteCombinations } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useFavoriteCombinations';

defineProps({
    layout: { type: String, default: 'list' },
    customerId: { type: [String, Number], default: null }
});

defineEmits(['open-product']);

const { topCombinations, isLoading } = useFavoriteCombinations();
const page = usePage();

const enrichedCombinations = computed(() => {
    const dict = {};
    (page.props.initialProducts || []).forEach(p => { dict[p.id] = p; });

    return (topCombinations.value || []).map(combo => {
        const realProduct = dict[combo.product_id || combo.id];
        if (!realProduct) return null;

        const rawSelections = combo.modifiers || combo.selections || combo.favorite_selections || [];

        // 🚀 O MOTOR DE HIGIENIZAÇÃO DE INGREDIENTES
        const ingredientGroups = (realProduct.modifiers || []).filter(g => g.type === 'ingredient');
        let cleanedSelections = rawSelections;

        if (ingredientGroups.length > 0) {
            const validIngredients = [];
            ingredientGroups.forEach(g => {
                (g.options || []).forEach(opt => validIngredients.push({ ...opt, groupId: g.id }));
            });

            const tempCleaned = [];
            let isMappingBroken = false;

            for (const sel of rawSelections) {
                const selId = String(sel.id || sel.modifier_option_id);
                const selName = String(sel.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                const selGroupId = String(sel.group_id || sel.modifier_group_id);

                const matchedIngredient = validIngredients.find(opt =>
                    String(opt.id) === selId || String(opt.name).toLowerCase().trim() === selName
                );

                if (matchedIngredient) {
                    tempCleaned.push({
                        ...sel,
                        id: matchedIngredient.id,
                        name: matchedIngredient.name,
                        price: Number(matchedIngredient.price || 0),
                        group_id: matchedIngredient.groupId
                    });
                } else if (sel.type === 'ingredient' || sel.is_ingredient || (selGroupId && ingredientGroups.some(g => String(g.id) === selGroupId))) {
                    isMappingBroken = true;
                    break;
                } else {
                    tempCleaned.push(sel);
                }
            }

            if (isMappingBroken) return null;
            cleanedSelections = tempCleaned;
        }

        return {
            ...realProduct,
            favorite_selections: cleanedSelections,
            cartItem: {
                qty: combo.quantity || 1,
                isTakeaway: false,
                structuredModifiers: cleanedSelections.map(m => ({
                    id: m.id || m.modifier_option_id,
                    name: m.name,
                    price: Number(m.price || 0),
                    qty: Number(m.quantity || m.qty || 1),
                    is_joker: !!m.is_joker,
                    group_id: m.group_id || m.modifier_group_id || null
                }))
            }
        };
    }).filter(Boolean);
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

import { useActiveOrderWidget } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useActiveOrderWidget';
import CustomerOrderHistoryCard from '@/Pages/Customer/Orders/CustomerOrderHistoryCard.vue';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';
import { useWhatsAppSupport } from '@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useWhatsAppSupport';

const props = defineProps({
    initialOrders: {
        type: Array,
        default: () => []
    }
});

const page = usePage();
const isExpanded = ref(false);
const showPushPromptModal = ref(false);
const showCancelModal = ref(false);

const acceptPush = () => { showPushPromptModal.value = false; };
const rejectPush = () => { showPushPromptModal.value = false; };

const {
    primaryOrder, hasActiveOrder, canCancel, canAppendItems,
    currentTimelineStep, timeSinceUpdate, cancelOrder, appendItems
} = useActiveOrderWidget(() => props.initialOrders);

const { openSupport } = useWhatsAppSupport();

const isPixWaiting = computed(() => {
    return primaryOrder.value?.status === 'pending_payment'
        || primaryOrder.value?.payment_intent_status === 'pix_waiting';
});

const canCancelEffective = computed(() => {
    return isPixWaiting.value || canCancel.value;
});

const tenantAllowsAppend = computed(() => {
    const settings = page.props.companySettings || {};
    return settings.customer_can_append_orders !== false;
});

const isAppendAllowed = computed(() => {
    return tenantAllowsAppend.value && canAppendItems.value;
});

const resumePix = () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('customer-resume-pix', { detail: { order: primaryOrder.value } }));
};

const executeCancel = () => {
    showCancelModal.value = false;
    if (primaryOrder.value?.id) {
        cancelOrder(primaryOrder.value.id);
    }
};

const currentPhaseText = computed(() => {
    if (isPixWaiting.value) return 'Aguardando Pagamento Pix';
    if (currentTimelineStep.value === 1) return 'Recebido pela loja';
    if (currentTimelineStep.value === 2) return 'Sendo preparado';
    if (currentTimelineStep.value === 3) return primaryOrder.value?.type === 'delivery' ? 'Saiu para entrega' : 'Pronto para retirada';
    return 'Aguardando processamento';
});

const formatTime = (dateVal) => {
    if (!dateVal) return '';
    try {
        const safeStr = typeof dateVal === 'string' ? dateVal.replace(' ', 'T') : dateVal;
        const d = new Date(safeStr);
        if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
        return d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    } catch (e) {
        return '';
    }
};

const step1Time = computed(() => formatTime(primaryOrder.value?.created_at));
const step2Time = computed(() => {
    if (!primaryOrder.value || currentTimelineStep.value < 2) return '';
    return formatTime(primaryOrder.value.started_preparing_at || primaryOrder.value.updated_at);
});
const step3Time = computed(() => {
    if (!primaryOrder.value || currentTimelineStep.value < 3) return '';
    return formatTime(
        primaryOrder.value.dispatched_at ||
        primaryOrder.value.ready_at ||
        primaryOrder.value.updated_at
    );
});

const progressWidth = computed(() => {
    if (currentTimelineStep.value <= 1) return '0%';
    if (currentTimelineStep.value === 2) return '50%';
    if (currentTimelineStep.value >= 3) return '80%';
    return '0%';
});

const handleWhatsAppSupport = () => {
    openSupport('order_issue', { orderId: primaryOrder.value.id });
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';
import CustomerOrderHistoryItemRow from './CustomerOrderHistoryItemRow.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    order: { type: Object, required: true },
    isWidgetMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

defineEmits(['reorder']);

const isExpanded = ref(false);

const formattedOrderId = computed(() => {
    return Number(props.order.id || 0).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
});

const orderTotal = computed(() => props.order.total || 0);
const orderSubtotal = computed(() => props.order.subtotal || 0);
const orderDeliveryFee = computed(() => props.order.delivery_fee || 0);
const orderServiceFee = computed(() => props.order.service_fee || 0);
const orderDiscount = computed(() => props.order.discount || 0);

// 🚀 Badge dinâmico de status financeiro (Pago / Pendente / Estornado)
const paymentStatusBadge = computed(() => {
    const ps = props.order.payment_status;
    const dps = props.order.payment_intent_status;

    if (ps === 'paid' || dps === 'paid') {
        return {
            label: 'Pago',
            class: 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20',
            dotClass: 'bg-emerald-400'
        };
    }

    if (ps === 'refunded') {
        return {
            label: 'Estornado',
            class: 'bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/20',
            dotClass: 'bg-purple-400'
        };
    }

    return {
        label: 'Pagto. Pendente',
        class: 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20',
        dotClass: 'bg-amber-400 animate-pulse'
    };
});

const hasCashback = computed(() => {
    return Number(props.order.cashback_used) > 0 ||
           (props.order.payments || []).some(p => p.payment_method?.engine_type === 'internal_loyalty');
});

const typeInfo = computed(() => {
    const t = props.order.type || 'delivery';
    if (t === 'delivery') return { label: 'Entrega', icon: 'pi-truck' };
    if (t === 'table') return { label: `Mesa ${props.order.table_number || ''}`.trim(), icon: 'pi-book' };
    if (t === 'counter') return { label: 'Balcão', icon: 'pi-shop' };
    if (['pickup', 'takeaway'].includes(t)) return { label: 'Retirada', icon: 'pi-shopping-bag' };
    return { label: 'Pedido', icon: 'pi-receipt' };
});

const formattedDate = computed(() => {
    if (!props.order.created_at) return '';
    const date = new Date(props.order.created_at);

    let weekday = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR', { weekday: 'short' }).format(date).replace('.', '');
    weekday = weekday.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + weekday.slice(1);
    const dateStr = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: '2-digit' }).format(date);

    return `${weekday}, ${dateStr}`;
});

const statusBadge = computed(() => {
    const s = props.order.status;
    if (['delivered', 'closed', 'completed'].includes(s)) return { label: 'Concluído', class: 'bg-success-400/10 text-success-500' };
    if (s === 'cancelled') return { label: 'Cancelado', class: 'bg-danger-400/10 text-danger-400' };
    return { label: 'Em Andamento', class: 'bg-warning-400/10 text-warning-400' };
});

const paymentDetails = computed(() => {
    const list = [];
    let totalRealPaid = 0;

    if (props.order.payments && props.order.payments.length > 0) {
        props.order.payments.forEach((p) => {
            const name = String(p.method_name || p.payment_method?.name || p.method || 'Pagamento');
            let icon = 'pi pi-wallet text-surface-muted';
            const isCashback = p.payment_method?.engine_type === 'internal_loyalty';

            const nameLower = name.toLowerCase();
            if (isCashback) icon = 'pi pi-star-fill text-yellow-500';
            else if (nameLower.includes('pix')) icon = 'pi pi-qrcode text-teal-500';
            else if (nameLower.includes('cartão') || nameLower.includes('credito') || nameLower.includes('debito')) icon = 'pi pi-credit-card text-blue-500';
            else if (nameLower.includes('dinheiro') || nameLower.includes('cash')) icon = 'pi pi-money-bill text-emerald-500';

            list.push({ label: name, value: Number(p.amount), isCashback: isCashback, icon });
            totalRealPaid += Number(p.amount);
        });
    } else if (props.order.payment_intent_methods) {
        try {
            const arr = typeof props.order.payment_intent_methods === 'string'
                ? JSON.parse(props.order.payment_intent_methods)
                : props.order.payment_intent_methods;

            arr.forEach(a => {
                const name = String(a.method_name || a.method_id || a);
                list.push({ label: `Pagar na Entrega: ${name}`, value: null, isCashback: false, icon: 'pi pi-wallet text-surface-muted' });
            });
        } catch(e) {
            list.push({ label: 'Pagar na Entrega', value: null, isCashback: false, icon: 'pi pi-wallet text-surface-muted' });
        }
    }

    const cashbackVal = Number(props.order.cashback_used || orderDiscount.value);
    const isCashbackListed = list.some(l => l.isCashback === true);

    if (hasCashback.value && !isCashbackListed) {
        if (cashbackVal > 0) {
            list.push({ label: 'Cashback Utilizado', value: cashbackVal, isCashback: true, icon: 'pi pi-star-fill text-yellow-500' });
        } else if (props.order.payment_status === 'paid' && list.length === 0) {
            list.push({ label: 'Saldo de Cashback (100%)', value: orderTotal.value, isCashback: true, icon: 'pi pi-star-fill text-yellow-500' });
        }
    }

    if (list.length === 0) {
        list.push({ label: 'Não Informado', value: null, isCashback: false, icon: 'pi pi-question-circle text-surface-muted' });
    }

    return list;
});

const canViewReceipt = computed(() => {
    // 🚀 Pedidos legados e cancelados não possuem DANFE PDF nativa
    if (props.order.is_legacy || props.order.status === 'cancelled') return false;

    if (typeof props.order.has_fiscal_document !== 'undefined') {
        return Boolean(props.order.has_fiscal_document);
    }

    return ['delivered', 'closed', 'completed'].includes(props.order.status);
});
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-1 py-2.5">
        <!-- Linha Principal do Produto -->
        <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                <div class="flex gap-1 font-medium text-sm text-surface-text">
                    <span class="shrink-0">{{ itemQty }} ×</span>
                    <span>{{ cleanItemName }}</span>
                </div>
                <!-- 🚀 NOVO: Badge se for um resgate de pontos (Prêmio) -->
                <div v-if="isReward" class="pl-5 pt-0.5">
                    <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400">
                        <i class="pi pi-star-fill text-[8px]"></i> Prêmio Resgatado
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="flex flex-col items-end">
                <span class="text-sm text-surface-text shrink-0" :class="{ 'line-through opacity-50': isReward && itemTotal == 0 }">
                    {{ $formatCurrency(itemTotal) }}
                </span>
                <span v-if="isReward && itemTotal == 0" class="text-xs font-black text-emerald-400">
                    GRÁTIS
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Lista de Modificadores/Adicionais -->
        <div v-if="cleanModifiers && cleanModifiers.length > 0" class="flex flex-col pl-6 mt-0.5 gap-0.5">
            <span v-for="(mod, idx) in cleanModifiers" :key="idx" class="text-xs font-medium text-surface-muted">
                → {{ mod.quantity > 1 ? mod.quantity + ' × ' : '' }}{{ mod.name }}
            </span>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    item: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) }
});

const itemQty = computed(() => props.item?.quantity || 1);

// 🚀 Higieniza o título do produto removendo marcadores internos de viagem e o emoji 🎁
const cleanItemName = computed(() => {
    const raw = props.item?.product_name || props.item?.name || 'Item';
    return raw
        .replace(/\s*[\(\[](Viagem|Para Levar|Takeaway)[\)\]]/gi, '')
        .replace('🎁 [Prêmio]', '')
        .trim();
});

const itemTotal = computed(() => props.item?.total_price || props.item?.price || 0);

// 🚀 Checa se o item foi um prêmio do programa de fidelidade
const isReward = computed(() => {
    return props.item?.is_reward === true
        || props.item?.loyalty_reward_type === 'product'
        || String(props.item?.product_name || '').includes('[Prêmio]');
});

// 🚀 Oculta modificadores fantasmas criados exclusivamente para controle de embalagem
const cleanModifiers = computed(() => {
    if (!props.item?.modifiers) return [];
    return props.item.modifiers.filter(m => {
        const name = (m.name || '').toLowerCase();
        return !name.includes('viagem') && !name.includes('para levar');
    });
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import axios from 'axios';

const props = defineProps({
    orderId: { type: [Number, String], required: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['rated']);

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const rating = ref(0);
const selectedTags = ref([]);
const comment = ref('');
const isSubmitting = ref(false);
const isSubmitted = ref(false);
const errorMessage = ref(null);

const availableTags = ['Sabor', 'Temperatura', 'Entrega Demorada', 'Embalagem', 'Preço'];

const googleReviewLink = computed(() => {
    return page.props.companySettings?.google_review_link
        || page.props.publicSettings?.google_review_link
        || null;
});

const setRating = (val) => {
    rating.value = val;
    errorMessage.value = null;
};

const toggleTag = (tag) => {
    const idx = selectedTags.value.indexOf(tag);
    if (idx > -1) selectedTags.value.splice(idx, 1);
    else selectedTags.value.push(tag);
};

const submitRating = async (destination = 'internal') => {
    if (isSubmitting.value || rating.value === 0) return;

    isSubmitting.value = true;
    errorMessage.value = null;

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('customer.orders.rate', props.orderId), {
            rating: rating.value,
            tags: selectedTags.value,
            comment: comment.value.trim() || null
        }, {
            headers: {
                'Accept': 'application/json',
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
            }
        });

        isSubmitted.value = true;
        emit('rated', response.data?.data || { rating: rating.value });

        toast.add({
            severity: 'success',
            summary: 'Obrigado!',
            detail: 'Sua avaliação foi registrada com sucesso.',
            life: 3000
        });

        if (destination === 'google' && googleReviewLink.value) {
            window.open(googleReviewLink.value, '_blank');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        const msg = e.response?.data?.message || 'Não foi possível registrar sua avaliação.';
        errorMessage.value = msg;

        toast.add({
            severity: 'error',
            summary: 'Atenção',
            detail: msg,
            life: 4000
        });
    } finally {
        isSubmitting.value = false;
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
                    Pedir Novamente
                </span>
            </div>
            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-white/50">
                Pedido #{{ $formatNumber(order.id) }} • {{ formattedDate }}
            </span>
        </div>

        <!-- CORPO: ITENS DETALHADOS COM COMBOS E ADICIONAIS -->
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="flex flex-col min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p class="text-xs font-bold text-white/90 line-clamp-2 leading-snug">
                    {{ itemsSummary }}
                </p>
                <span class="text-[11px] font-black text-primary-smart mt-1">
                    {{ $formatCurrency(order.total) }}
                </span>
            </div>

            <!-- BOTÃO DE REPETIR -->
            <button
                type="button"
                @click="handleReorderClick"
                :disabled="isLoading"
                class="h-11 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-primary-500 hover:bg-primary-400 active:scale-95 text-black font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 border-none cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-md disabled:opacity-50"
            >
                <i class="pi" :class="isLoading ? 'pi-spinner animate-spin' : 'pi-replay'"></i>
                <span>Repetir</span>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    order: { type: Object, required: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['reorder']);

const isLoading = ref(false);

const formattedDate = computed(() => {
    if (!props.order?.created_at) return '';
    const date = new Date(props.order.created_at);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' });
});

const itemsSummary = computed(() => {
    const items = props.order?.items || [];
    if (items.length === 0) return 'Itens diversos';

    const mainItems = items.filter(i => !i.parent_item_id && !i.is_combo_item);

    return mainItems.map(main => {
        const qty = main.quantity > 1 ? `${main.quantity}x ` : '';
        const baseName = `${qty}${main.product_name}`;

        // 🚀 Identifica subitens do combo
        const subItems = (main.sub_items || main.subItems || []).length > 0
            ? (main.sub_items || main.subItems)
            : items.filter(i => i.parent_item_id === main.id);

        if (subItems.length > 0) {
            const subDetails = subItems.map(s => {
                const sMods = (s.modifiers || []).map(m => m.name).filter(Boolean);
                return sMods.length > 0
                    ? `${s.product_name} (${sMods.join(', ')})`
                    : s.product_name;
            }).join(', ');
            return `${baseName} [${subDetails}]`;
        }

        // Modificadores do item simples
        const mods = (main.modifiers || []).map(m => m.name).filter(Boolean);
        if (mods.length > 0) {
            return `${baseName} (${mods.join(', ')})`;
        }

        return baseName;
    }).join(' • ');
});

const handleReorderClick = () => {
    isLoading.value = true;
    emit('reorder', props.order);
    setTimeout(() => {
        isLoading.value = false;
    }, 1500);
};
</script>
```

```vue
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between pl-2 pr-4">
            <h3 class="font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-surface-muted flex items-center gap-2">
                <i class="pi pi-gift text-primary-500"></i> Resgate seus Pontos
            </h3>
            <span class="text-[10px] font-black text-primary-600 bg-primary-500/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg uppercase tracking-widest border border-primary-500/20">
                Saldo: {{ customerPoints }} pts
            </span>
        </div>

        <div class="flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 pb-4 px-2 hide-scrollbar snap-x">
            <!-- 🚀 Loop totalmente limpo delegando o design ao Card -->
            <LoyaltyRewardCard
                v-for="product in rewardProducts"
                :key="'reward_' + product.id"
                :product="product"
                :can-redeem="canRedeem(product)"
                @redeem="handleRedeem"
            />
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import LoyaltyRewardCard from '@/Pages/Customer/Profile/LoyaltyRewardCard.vue'; // 🚀 Import do novo componente

const props = defineProps({
    products: { type: Array, required: true },
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    cart: { type: Array, required: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['redeem-reward']);
const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();
const settings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});

const isLoyaltyActive = computed(() => settings.value.loyalty_is_active && settings.value.loyalty_reward_type === 'product');

const rewardProducts = computed(() => {
    return props.products.filter(p => p.loyalty_reward === true && p.status === 'available');
});

const customerPoints = computed(() => props.customer?.loyalty_points || 0);

const pointsInCart = computed(() => {
    return props.cart.reduce((sum, item) => {
        return sum + (item.is_reward ? (item.points_cost * item.qty) : 0);
    }, 0);
});

const canRedeem = (product) => {
    const cost = Number(product.loyalty_points_cost || 0);
    return (customerPoints.value - pointsInCart.value) >= cost;
};

const handleRedeem = (product) => {
    if (canRedeem(product)) {
        emit('redeem-reward', product);
    } else {
        toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Saldo Insuficiente', detail: 'Você não tem pontos suficientes para adicionar mais este item.', life: 3000 });
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
                <div v-if="statementEntries.length === 0" class="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-8 text-surface-muted opacity-60">

                        </span>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    orders: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible']);
const page = usePage();

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (val) => emit('update:visible', val)
});

const settings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});
const conversionRate = computed(() => Number(settings.value.loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate || 5));
const customerPoints = computed(() => Number(props.customer?.loyalty_points || 0));
const availableBalance = computed(() => (customerPoints.value / 100) * conversionRate.value);

// 🚀 CÁLCULO VISUAL DO TEMPO DE VALIDADE RESTANTE
const expirationWarning = computed(() => {
    if (!props.customer?.loyalty_points_expires_at || customerPoints.value <= 0) return null;

    const expiryDate = new Date(props.customer.loyalty_points_expires_at);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = expiryDate - now;
    const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

    if (diffDays <= 0) {
        return { text: 'Pontos expirando hoje!', isUrgent: true };
    }

    const formattedDate = expiryDate.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
    if (diffDays <= 7) {
        return { text: `Atenção: Saldo expira em ${diffDays} dia(s) (${formattedDate})`, isUrgent: true };
    }

    return { text: `Válido até ${formattedDate} (${diffDays} dias restantes)`, isUrgent: false };
});

// 🚀 EXTRAÇÃO DA LINHA DO TEMPO DIRETO DOS PEDIDOS
const statementEntries = computed(() => {
    const list = [];

    (props.orders || []).forEach((order) => {
        if (order.status === 'cancelled') return;

        const dateStr = order.created_at
            ? new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
            : 'Data não registrada';

        // 1. Resgate de Cashback
        const cashbackUsed = Number(order.cashback_used || 0);
        if (cashbackUsed > 0) {
            const pointsDeducted = Math.ceil((cashbackUsed / conversionRate.value) * 100);
            list.push({
                type: 'redeem',
                title: `Resgate no Pedido #${order.id}`,
                date: dateStr,
                rawDate: new Date(order.created_at || 0),
                formattedValue: formatCurrency(cashbackUsed),
                points: pointsDeducted
            });
        }

        // 2. Pontos Ganhos
        const earned = Number(order.loyalty_points_earned || 0);
        if (earned > 0) {
            const earnedValue = (earned / 100) * conversionRate.value;
            list.push({
                type: 'earn',
                title: `Pontos do Pedido #${order.id}`,
                date: dateStr,
                rawDate: new Date(order.created_at || 0),
                formattedValue: formatCurrency(earnedValue),
                points: earned
            });
        }
    });

    return list.sort((a, b) => b.rawDate - a.rawDate);
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import FormField from '@/Components/UI/FormField.vue';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';
import { formatPhone, formatCpfCnpj } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({ visible: Boolean });
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible']);

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();
const isSubmitting = ref(false);

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (val) => emit('update:visible', val)
});

const form = ref({
    name: '',
    cpf: '',
    phone: '',
    birth_date: ''
});

const formatCpfInput = (e) => {
    form.value.cpf = formatCpfCnpj(e.target.value);
};

const formatPhoneInput = (e) => {
    form.value.phone = formatPhone(e.target.value);
};

const isFormValid = computed(() => {
    const cleanCpf = form.value.cpf.replace(/\D/g, '');
    const cleanPhone = form.value.phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
    return form.value.name.trim().length >= 2 && cleanCpf.length === 11 && cleanPhone.length >= 10;
});

watch(() => props.visible, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) {
        const c = page.props.customer || {};
        form.value.name = c.name || '';
        form.value.phone = c.phone ? formatPhone(c.phone) : '';
        form.value.cpf = c.cpf ? formatCpfCnpj(c.cpf) : '';
        form.value.birth_date = c.birth_date || '';
    }
});

const handleUpgrade = () => {
    if (!isFormValid.value || isSubmitting.value) return;
    isSubmitting.value = true;

    router.post(route('customer.auth.upgrade'), form.value, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isVisible.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Perfil Atualizado!', detail: 'Seus dados foram salvos com sucesso.', life: 4000 });
        },
        onError: (err) => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Atenção', detail: Object.values(err)[0] || 'Erro ao atualizar.', life: 5000 });
        },
        onFinish: () => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
        }
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog';
import Drawer from 'primevue/drawer';
import FormField from "@/Components/UI/FormField.vue";
import LoyaltyStatementModal from "@/Pages/Customer/Profile/LoyaltyStatementModal.vue";
import { formatPhone, formatCurrency, getInitials } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useViewport } from '@/Composables/useViewport';

const props = defineProps({
    customer: Object,
    isGuest: Boolean,
    loginConfig: Object,
    myHistory: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'open-register', 'open-login', 'upgrade-account', 'add-address',
    'logout', 'delete-account', 'update-profile', 'deactivate-address'
]);

const { isMobile } = useViewport();
const page = usePage();

const isEditModalVisible = ref(false);
const isStatementModalVisible = ref(false);
const editForm = ref({ name: '', phone: '' });

// 🚀 Resolução dos pedidos para alimentar o extrato (prop ou Inertia share)
const historyOrders = computed(() => {
    if (props.myHistory && props.myHistory.length > 0) return props.myHistory;
    return page.props.myHistory || [];
});

const loyaltyEnabled = computed(() => {
    const isActive = page.props.companySettings?.loyalty_is_active;
    return isActive === true || isActive === 1 || isActive === '1';
});

const loyaltyScoreText = computed(() => {
    if (!props.customer) return formatCurrency(0);

    const rewardType = page.props.companySettings?.loyalty_reward_type;
    const pts = Number(props.customer.loyalty_points) || 0;

    if (rewardType === 'product') {
        return `${pts} ${pts === 1 ? 'Ponto' : 'Pontos'}`;
    }

    const conversionRate = Number(page.props.companySettings?.loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate || 5);
    const balanceInReais = (pts / 100) * conversionRate;

    return formatCurrency(balanceInReais);
});

const expandAddresses = ref(false);

const activeAddresses = computed(() => {
    if (!props.customer || !props.customer.addresses) return [];
    return props.customer.addresses.filter(a => a.is_active !== false && a.is_active !== 0 && a.is_active !== '0');
});

const visibleAddresses = computed(() => {
    if (expandAddresses.value) return activeAddresses.value;
    return activeAddresses.value.slice(0, 3);
});

const hasMoreAddresses = computed(() => {
    return !expandAddresses.value && activeAddresses.value.length > 3;
});

const openEditProfile = () => {
    editForm.value = {
        name: props.customer?.name || '',
        phone: formatPhone(props.customer?.phone) || ''
    };
    isEditModalVisible.value = true;
};

const formatPhoneInput = (e) => {
    editForm.value.phone = formatPhone(e.target.value);
};

const submitProfileUpdate = () => {
    emit('update-profile', editForm.value, () => {
        isEditModalVisible.value = false;
    });
};

const confirmDeactivateAddress = (id) => {
    if (confirm('Tem certeza de que deseja remover este endereço?')) {
        emit('deactivate-address', id);
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, watch } from 'vue';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

import axios from 'axios';

import MobileLayout from "@/Layouts/MobileLayout.vue";
import CustomerProductModifiers from "@/Pages/Customer/Menu/CustomerProductModifiers.vue";
import CustomerComboWizard from "@/Pages/Customer/Menu/CustomerComboWizard.vue";
import CustomerDynamicIsland from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerDynamicIsland.vue";
import CustomerCheckoutModal from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerCheckoutModal.vue";
import UpgradeAccountModal from "@/Pages/Customer/Profile/UpgradeAccountModal.vue";
import NewAddressModal from "@/Components/Modals/NewAddressModal.vue";
import NewCustomerModal from "@/Components/Modals/NewCustomerModal.vue";
import StoreLocationModal from "@/Pages/Customer/Home/StoreLocationModal.vue";
import BusinessHoursModal from "@/Pages/Customer/Home/BusinessHoursModal.vue";

import CustomerHeader from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerHeader.vue";
import { useDynamicBackground } from '@/Composables/useDynamicBackground';
import CustomerTabContainer from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerTabContainer.vue";
import { useCart } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart";
import { useOrderFlow } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFlow";
import { useReorder } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useReorder";
import { useStoreStatus } from "@/Composables/useStoreStatus";
import { useCoupons } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCoupons';
import { useAnalytics } from '@/Composables/useAnalytics';
import { useCustomerCheckoutFlow } from '@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerCheckoutFlow';
import { useCustomerSync } from '@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerSync';
import { useTheme } from '@/Composables/useTheme';
import { useCustomerHeaderContext } from '@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerHeaderContext';
import { useAppLifecycleSync } from '@/Composables/useAppLifecycleSync';
import { useTenantEcho } from '@/Composables/useTenantEcho';
import { useDynamicFooterHeight } from '@/Composables/useDynamicFooterHeight';

defineOptions({ layout: MobileLayout, inheritAttrs: false });

    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    initialCategories: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    initialProducts: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    myActiveOrders: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    myHistory: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();
const { trackViewContent } = useAnalytics();
const { backgroundStyle } = useDynamicBackground();
const { setMode } = useTheme();

useAppLifecycleSync({
    only: ['customerOrder', 'catalog', 'companySettings'],
    minSleepSeconds: 15
});

const cartContext = useCart();
const { cart, cartSubtotal, updateQty, clearCart, autoParkCurrent } = cartContext;
const orderType = cartContext.orderType = ref('delivery');

const hasActiveOrder = computed(() => props.myActiveOrders && props.myActiveOrders.length > 0);
const cartTotalItems = computed(() => {
    return (cart.value || []).reduce((acc, item) => acc + (Number(item.qty) || 1), 0);
});

const searchParams = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search) : null;
const hasDeepLink = searchParams ? (searchParams.has('produto') || searchParams.has('categoria')) : false;
const activeTab = ref(hasDeepLink ? 'menu' : 'home');

const currentAppendOrderId = ref(null);
const activeAppendOrder = computed(() => {
    if (!currentAppendOrderId.value) return null;
    return (props.myActiveOrders || []).find(o => String(o.id) === String(currentAppendOrderId.value)) || null;
});

const handleCancelAppend = () => {
    sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_append_order_id');
    currentAppendOrderId.value = null;
    clearCart();
    toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Cancelado', detail: 'Modo de adição de itens cancelado.', life: 3000 });
};

const isUpgradeModalVisible = ref(false);
const isNewAddressModalVisible = ref(false);
const showNewCustomerModal = ref(false);
const isStoreLocationModalVisible = ref(false);
const isBusinessHoursModalVisible = ref(false);
const isRegisterModalVisible = ref(false);

const handleOpenAuthModal = () => { showNewCustomerModal.value = true; };

const handleSwitchTabEvent = (event) => {
    if (event.detail && typeof event.detail === 'string') activeTab.value = event.detail;
    currentAppendOrderId.value = sessionStorage.getItem('customer_append_order_id');
};

const couponsContext = useCoupons();

const tryApplyCouponCode = async (couponCode) => {
    if (!couponCode) return;
    const cleanCode = String(couponCode).trim().toUpperCase();

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('customer.coupons.validate'), {
            code: cleanCode,
            subtotal: Number(cartSubtotal.value || 0)
        });

        const data = response.data;
        if (data.success) {
            if (typeof couponsContext.applyCoupon === 'function') {
                couponsContext.applyCoupon(data);
            } else if (couponsContext.activeCoupon) {
                couponsContext.activeCoupon.value = data;
            }

            sessionStorage.removeItem('pending_coupon_code');

            toast.add({
                severity: 'success',
                summary: '🎁 Presente Resgatado!',
                detail: `Cupom ${cleanCode} aplicado com sucesso!`,
                life: 6000
            });
        } else {
            toast.add({
                severity: 'warn',
                summary: 'Atenção ao Cupom',
                detail: data.message || 'Cupom inválido para esta compra.',
                life: 5000
            });
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Coupon] Falha ao validar cupom recebido:', e);
    }
};

const sanitizeCustomerSession = () => {
    const storedAppendId = sessionStorage.getItem('customer_append_order_id');
    if (storedAppendId) {
        const orderStillValid = (props.myActiveOrders || []).some(o => String(o.id) === String(storedAppendId));
        if (!orderStillValid) {
            sessionStorage.removeItem('customer_append_order_id');
            currentAppendOrderId.value = null;
        }
    }

    if (orderType.value === 'table' && !page.props.tableMode) {
        orderType.value = 'delivery';
        localStorage.removeItem('pos_draft_routing');
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    setMode('dark');
    sanitizeCustomerSession();

    const storedAppendId = sessionStorage.getItem('customer_append_order_id');
    if (storedAppendId) {
        currentAppendOrderId.value = storedAppendId;
    }

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const incomingCoupon = urlParams.get('cupom') || urlParams.get('coupon');

    if (incomingCoupon) {
        const cleanIncoming = incomingCoupon.trim().toUpperCase();
        const isAuthenticatedUser = Boolean(props.customer?.id || page.props.auth?.user?.id);

        if (isAuthenticatedUser) {
            tryApplyCouponCode(cleanIncoming);
        } else {
            sessionStorage.setItem('pending_coupon_code', cleanIncoming);
            toast.add({
                severity: 'info',
                summary: '🎁 Presente Identificado!',
                detail: `Cupom ${cleanIncoming} reservado! Identifique-se para ativá-lo no seu primeiro pedido.`,
                life: 8000
            });
        }

        urlParams.delete('cupom');
        urlParams.delete('coupon');
        const cleanQuery = urlParams.toString() ? `?${urlParams.toString()}` : '';
        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, `${window.location.pathname}${cleanQuery}`);
    }

    window.addEventListener('open-customer-auth-modal', handleOpenAuthModal);
    window.addEventListener('customer-switch-tab', handleSwitchTabEvent);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('open-customer-auth-modal', handleOpenAuthModal);
    window.removeEventListener('customer-switch-tab', handleSwitchTabEvent);
});

useTenantEcho().listenChannel('shift', '.shift.closed', () => {
    sanitizeCustomerSession();
    router.reload({ only: ['myActiveOrders', 'companySettings'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
});

const menuSearchQuery = ref('');
const menuActiveCategory = ref(null);
const menuView = ref('catalog');
const activeMenuCategories = ref([]);

const productTotal = ref(0);
const activeComboInnerProduct = ref(null);

const loginConfig = computed(() => {
    const methods = page.props.companySettings?.customer_auth_methods ?? page.props.company?.customerAuthMethods ?? [];
    const allowGuestFlag = page.props.companySettings?.customer_allow_guest ?? page.props.company?.allowGuest;
    return {
        allowGuest: allowGuestFlag === true || allowGuestFlag === 1 || allowGuestFlag === '1',
        customerAuthMethods: methods,
        needsEmailFallback: !methods || methods.length === 0
    };

watch(() => cart.value.length, (newLength, oldLength) => {

        activeTab.value = 'menu';

    activeComboInnerProduct.value = null;

watch(isComboVisible, (visible) => { if (!visible) activeComboInnerProduct.value = null; });

const handleIslandCheckout = () => {
    if (!canOrder.value) {
        toast.add({

const onProductClick = (product) => {
    productTotal.value = Number(product.price || product.base_price || 0);
    trackViewContent(product);

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        const productParam = product.slug || product.id;
        url.searchParams.set('produto', productParam);
        window.history.pushState({}, '', url.toString());
    }

    handleProductClick(product);
};

watch(menuActiveCategory, (newCatId) => {
    if (newCatId && activeTab.value === 'menu' && !isModifiersVisible.value && !isComboVisible.value) {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            const url = new URL(window.location.href);
            const cat = (activeMenuCategories.value || []).find(c => c.id === newCatId);
            const catParam = (cat?.slug || cat?.name || newCatId).toString().toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[\s_]+/g, '-');
            url.searchParams.set('categoria', catParam);
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, url.toString());
        }
    }
});

const handleRedeemReward = (product) => {
    const rewardProduct = {
        ...product, dine_in_price: 0, delivery_price: 0, promo_price: 0,
        name: `🎁 [Prêmio] ${product.name}`,
    };
    cartContext.addToCart({
        product: rewardProduct, qty: 1, modifiersText: `Custo: ${product.loyalty_points_cost} pts`, extraPrice: 0,
        isTakeaway: false, comboItems: null, structuredModifiers: [], orderType: orderType.value
    });
    cart.value[cart.value.length - 1].is_reward = true;
    cart.value[cart.value.length - 1].points_cost = product.loyalty_points_cost;

    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Prêmio Resgatado!', detail: `${product.name} foi adicionado ao carrinho grátis!`, life: 3000 });
    activeTab.value = 'cart';
};

        onError: (err) => toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Atenção', detail: Object.values(err)[0] || 'Verifique os dados.', life: 4000 })
    });
};

const handleDeactivateAddress = (addressId) => {
    router.post(route('customer.profile.deactivate-address', addressId), {}, {

    });
};

const handleSaveNewAddress = (addressData, callbacks = null) => {
    const isGuestUser = props.isGuest || !page.props.auth?.user;
    const endpoint = isGuestUser ? route('customer.auth.guest-address') : route('customer.profile.add-address');

    router.post(endpoint, addressData, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: (pageResp) => {
            isNewAddressModalVisible.value = false;
            if (callbacks && typeof callbacks.onSuccess === 'function') {
                callbacks.onSuccess(pageResp);
            }
        },
        onError: (errors) => {
            if (callbacks && typeof callbacks.onError === 'function') callbacks.onError(errors);
        },
        onFinish: () => {
            if (callbacks && typeof callbacks.onFinish === 'function') callbacks.onFinish();
        }
    });

const handleLogout = () => {
    clearCart();
    localStorage.removeItem('brasume_guest_anchor');
    localStorage.removeItem('pos_draft_routing');

const confirmDeleteAccount = () => {
    if (confirm('Tem certeza de que deseja apagar a sua conta e todo o seu histórico de pedidos? Esta ação é irreversível.')) {
        localStorage.removeItem('brasume_guest_anchor');
        localStorage.removeItem('pos_draft_routing');
        router.post(route('customer.auth.delete-account'));

watch(() => props.customer, (newCustomer) => {

        }));

        if (!props.isGuest) {
```

```vue
<template>
    <AdaptiveModal v-model:visible="isVisible" :content-class="'!p-0 !bg-transparent'">
        <div class="w-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden p-6 max-h-[85vh] shadow-2xl">

            <!-- CABEÇALHO DO MODAL -->
            <div class="shrink-0 bg-z-10 text-center relative pt-5 flex flex-col gap-2 pb-2">
                <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-surface-text">
                    {{ forceRegistration ? 'Crie sua Conta' : 'Oi de novo!' }}
                </h2>
                <p class="text-sm font-medium text-surface-muted pb-6">
                    {{ forceRegistration ? 'Para receber a notificação, crie uma conta grátis.' : 'Como você deseja continuar?' }}
                </p>
                <p v-if="!forceRegistration" class="text-xs font-medium text-surface-text pb-6">
                    Selecione um aplicativo que você já usa para se conectar sem precisar criar uma senha.
                </p>
            </div>

            <!-- CORPO -->
            <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto hide-scrollbar flex flex-col px-4 relative">
                <div v-if="!showGuestForm" class="flex flex-col gap-4 animate-in fade-in duration-300">
                    <CustomerAccess
                        :allow-guest="allowGuest"
                        :methods="customerAuthMethods"
                        :needs-email-fallback="needsEmailFallback"
                        :is-logging-in="isSubmitting"
                        :is-cart-mode="isCartMode"
                        @login="handleLogin"
                        @open-register="$emit('open-register')"
                        @guest-action="showGuestForm = true"
                    />
                </div>

                <div v-else class="animate-in slide-in-from-right-4 duration-300">
                    <button @click="showGuestForm = false" class="micro-label hover:text-surface-text outline-none mb-4 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <i class="pi pi-arrow-left"></i> Voltar
                    </button>
                    <GuestRegistrationForm @registered="handleGuestRegistered" />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </AdaptiveModal>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { usePage, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';
import CustomerAccess from "@/Pages/Gateway/CustomerAccess.vue";
import GuestRegistrationForm from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/GuestRegistrationForm.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    isCartMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    forceRegistration: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'open-register', 'authenticated']);
const page = usePage();

const isSubmitting = ref(false);
const showGuestForm = ref(false);

const allowGuest = computed(() => {
    if (props.forceRegistration) return false;
    if (props.isGuest) return false;
    const flag = page.props.companySettings?.customer_allow_guest ?? page.props.company?.allowGuest;
    return flag === true || flag === 1 || flag === '1';
});

const customerAuthMethods = computed(() => {
    return page.props.companySettings?.customer_auth_methods ?? page.props.company?.customerAuthMethods ?? [];
});

const needsEmailFallback = computed(() => {
    return !customerAuthMethods.value || customerAuthMethods.value.length === 0;
});

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (value) => {
        emit('update:visible', value);
        if (!value) setTimeout(() => showGuestForm.value = false, 300);
    }
});

// 🚀 Marca o sessionStorage ao abrir em modo carrinho
watch(() => props.visible, (val) => {
    if (val && props.isCartMode) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('customer_pending_checkout', 'true');
    }
});

const handleLogin = (credentials) => {
    isSubmitting.value = true;
    router.post(route('customer.auth.login'), credentials, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: (page) => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
            if (Object.keys(page.props.errors).length === 0) {
                isVisible.value = false;
                emit('authenticated');
            }
        },
        onError: () => { isSubmitting.value = false; }
    });
};

const handleGuestRegistered = () => {
    isVisible.value = false;
    emit('authenticated');
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';
import CustomerOrderLineItem from "@/Pages/Customer/Cart/CustomerOrderLineItem.vue";
import QtyStepper from "@/Components/UI/QtyStepper.vue";
import CustomerClosedCheckoutBlock from "@/Pages/Customer/Cart/CustomerClosedCheckoutBlock.vue";
import { useStoreStatus } from '@/Composables/useStoreStatus';

const props = defineProps({
    cart: { type: Array, required: true },
    cartSubtotal: { type: Number, required: true },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    appendOrder: { type: Object, default: null }
});

defineEmits(['update-qty', 'clear-cart', 'edit-item', 'checkout', 'go-to-menu', 'open-register', 'cancel-append']);

const page = usePage();
const { canOrder } = useStoreStatus();

const companySettings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});
const hasServiceTaxGlobal = computed(() => Boolean(companySettings.value.has_service_tax));
const serviceTaxPercentage = computed(() => Number(companySettings.value.service_tax_percentage || 0));

const isTaxEnabledForChannel = computed(() => {
    if (!hasServiceTaxGlobal.value) return false;
    const type = props.appendOrder?.type || 'delivery';
    if (type === 'table') {
        return companySettings.value.service_tax_table !== false && companySettings.value.service_tax_table !== 0;
    }
    if (type === 'counter' || type === 'takeaway' || type === 'pickup') {
        return Boolean(companySettings.value.service_tax_counter);
    }
    if (type === 'delivery') {
        return Boolean(companySettings.value.service_tax_delivery);
    }
    return false;
});

const appendServiceFee = computed(() => {
    if (!props.appendOrder || !isTaxEnabledForChannel.value) return 0;
    return Math.round((props.cartSubtotal * (serviceTaxPercentage.value / 100)) * 100) / 100;
});

const appendTotal = computed(() => {
    return props.cartSubtotal + appendServiceFee.value;
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';
import ProgressBar from '@/Components/UI/ProgressBar.vue';
import CheckoutStepAuth from '@/Pages/Customer/Checkout/CheckoutStepAuth.vue';
import CheckoutStepLogistics from '@/Pages/Customer/Checkout/CheckoutStepLogistics.vue';
import CheckoutStepPayment from '@/Pages/Customer/Checkout/CheckoutStepPayment.vue';
import CheckoutStepPix from '@/Pages/Customer/Checkout/CheckoutStepPix.vue';
import CheckoutStepNewAddress from '@/Pages/Customer/Checkout/CheckoutStepNewAddress.vue';
import { useCoupons } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCoupons';

const { applyCoupon, removeCoupon } = useCoupons();

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    customer: Object,
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    paymentMethods: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    loginConfig: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    state: { type: Object, required: true },
    financials: { type: Object, required: true },
    loyalty: { type: Object, required: true },
    isSubmitting: Boolean,
    headerState: { type: Object, required: true },
    goBack: { type: Function, required: true },
    pendingOrderId: [String, Number],
    pixData: [Object, String]
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'confirm', 'open-register', 'pix-success', 'save-address', 'checkout-login', 'bind-ref', 'update-substep']);

const handleRoutingChange = (payload) => {
    if (!payload) return;
    const metaData = payload.meta ? payload.meta : payload;
    props.state.routingMeta = metaData;
    if (metaData.type) props.state.orderType = metaData.type;
};

// 🛑 BLINDAGEM: Fechar o modal durante o Pix apenas oculta a janela sem matar o pedido
const handleModalVisibilityChange = (newVisible) => {
    emit('update:visible', newVisible);
};

const handleNewAddressSuccess = (createdAddress) => {
    const addr = createdAddress || {};
    const streetName = addr.street?.name || addr.street || '';
    const neighborhoodName = addr.neighborhood?.name || addr.neighborhood || '';
    const numberStr = addr.no_number ? 'S/N' : (addr.number || 'S/N');
    const comp = addr.complement ? ` (${addr.complement})` : '';

    const completeAddress = {
        ...addr,
        id: addr.id || null,
        street: streetName,
        neighborhood: neighborhoodName,
        number: numberStr,
        full_address: addr.full_address || `${streetName}, ${numberStr} - ${neighborhoodName}${comp}`
    };

    if (!props.state.routingMeta) props.state.routingMeta = {};
    props.state.routingMeta.type = 'delivery';
    props.state.routingMeta.address = completeAddress;
    props.state.routingMeta.address_id = completeAddress.id || null;
    props.state.orderType = 'delivery';

    if (props.customer) {
        if (!Array.isArray(props.customer.addresses)) {
            props.customer.addresses = [];
        }
        props.customer.addresses.push(completeAddress);
    }

    props.state.step = 'payment';
};
</script>

.slide-fade-enter-from { transform: translateX(20px); opacity: 0; }
.slide-fade-leave-to { transform: translateX(-20px); opacity: 0; }
</style>
```

```vue
                    <button

                        class="c-island-btn relative"

                    >

                    :disabled="!canOrder"
                    :is-success="isCheckoutSuccess"
                    @confirm="handleConfirmPayment"
                    class="w-56 sm:w-64 !h-11 transition-all"
                    :class="{ 'opacity-60 grayscale cursor-not-allowed pointer-events-none': !canOrder }"
```
