```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useDynamicIsland } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useDynamicIsland";
import SlideToConfirm from '@/Components/UI/SlideToConfirm.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    activeTab: String,
    cartLength: { type: [Number, Array], default: 0 },
    cart: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    hasActiveOrder: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    configuratorType: { type: String, default: null },
    canOrder: { type: Boolean, default: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:activeTab', 'reset-menu', 'trigger-checkout']);
const page = usePage();

const isTableMode = computed(() => Boolean(page.props.tableMode));

const isCheckoutSuccess = ref(false);
const sliderKey = ref(0);

const totalCartCount = computed(() => {
    if (Array.isArray(props.cart) && props.cart.length > 0) {
        return props.cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (Number(item.qty) || 1), 0);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(props.cartLength)) {
        return props.cartLength.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (Number(item.qty) || 1), 0);
    }
    return Number(props.cartLength) || 0;
});

const isCartMode = computed(() => props.activeTab === 'cart' && totalCartCount.value > 0);

const sliderButtonText = computed(() => {
    if (!props.canOrder) return 'Loja Fechada';
    return isTableMode.value ? 'Deslize para Pedir' : 'Deslize para Pagar';
});

const sliderButtonIcon = computed(() => {
    if (!props.canOrder) return 'pi-lock';
    return isTableMode.value ? 'pi-send' : 'pi-shopping-cart';
});

const {
    baseIslandClass,
    shapeIslandClass,
    islandStyle,
    islandRef,
    contentRef,
    handleTabClick
} = useDynamicIsland(props, emit);

// 🚀 A ILHA ESTÁ SEMPRE VISÍVEL QUANDO ESTÁ NO MODO CONFIGURADOR
const isVisible = computed(() =>
    isTableMode.value ||
    totalCartCount.value > 0 ||
    props.customer !== null ||
    props.hasActiveOrder ||
    props.configuratorType !== null
);

const showAdvancedTabs = computed(() => props.customer !== null || props.hasActiveOrder);

const handleConfirmPayment = () => {
    if (!props.canOrder || isCheckoutSuccess.value) return;

    isCheckoutSuccess.value = true;
    emit('trigger-checkout');

    setTimeout(() => {
        isCheckoutSuccess.value = false;
        sliderKey.value++;
    }, 1000);
};

watch(
    () => [isCartMode.value, props.canOrder],
    ([newCartMode]) => {
        if (!newCartMode) isCheckoutSuccess.value = false;
        sliderKey.value++;
    }
);
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useStoreStatus } from '@/Composables/useStoreStatus';
import { useWhatsAppSupport } from '@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useWhatsAppSupport';
import { useDynamicHeaderHeight } from '@/Composables/useDynamicHeaderHeight';

const props = defineProps({
    contextTitle: { type: String, default: null },
    contextSubtitle: { type: String, default: null },
    price: { type: Number, default: null },
    activeProduct: { type: Object, default: null },
    isHome: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    firstName: { type: String, default: '' }
});

defineEmits(['open-location', 'open-hours', 'close-product']);

const page = usePage();
const { isOpen, isClosedIndefinitely, isOpeningSoon, isPreOrder, status } = useStoreStatus();
const { hasSupport, openSupport } = useWhatsAppSupport();

const headerEl = ref(null);
useDynamicHeaderHeight(headerEl);

const tableMode = computed(() => page.props.tableMode || null);
const companySettings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});

const hasLogo = computed(() => {
    return !!(companySettings.value.logo_svg_path || companySettings.value.logo_path);
});

const logoUrl = computed(() => {
    const path = companySettings.value.logo_svg_path || companySettings.value.logo_path;
    return path ? `/media/file?path=${path}` : '';
});

const storeName = computed(() => {
    return companySettings.value.trade_name || companySettings.value.company_name || 'Lanchonete';
});

const statusBadgeProps = computed(() => {
    if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) {
        return { label: 'Fechado', colorClass: 'text-danger-500 bg-danger-500/10', dotClass: 'bg-danger-500' };
    }
    if (isOpen.value) {
        return { label: 'Aberto', colorClass: 'text-success-500 bg-success-500/10', dotClass: 'bg-success-500' };
    }
    if (isOpeningSoon.value || isPreOrder.value || status.value?.reason === 'cashier_closed') {
        return { label: 'Abrindo', colorClass: 'text-warning-500 bg-warning-500/10', dotClass: 'bg-warning-500' };
    }
    return { label: 'Fechado', colorClass: 'text-surface-400 bg-surface-400/10', dotClass: 'bg-surface-400' };
});
</script>
```

```vue
                :active-orders="$page.props.myActiveOrders"

            <!-- 2. WIDGET DO PEDIDO ATIVO (Apenas clientes logados) -->

                    :order="lastReorderableOrder"

                />

            <div class="px-3" v-if="isRatingEnabled && pendingRatingOrder && !isGuest && !hasActiveOrder">
                <OrderRatingWidget
                    :order-id="pendingRatingOrder.id"
                    @rated="handleRatingSuccess"

            <!-- 6. BANNER DE CRM DINÂMICO (CUPONS) -->

                v-if="featuredCrmCoupon && !hasActiveOrder"
                :coupon="featuredCrmCoupon"
                :company-settings="$page.props.companySettings"
                @use-coupon="handleBannerCta"

<script setup>
import { computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useCoupons } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCoupons';
import { useStoreStatus } from '@/Composables/useStoreStatus';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';

import ActiveOrderWidget from '@/Pages/Customer/Orders/ActiveOrderWidget.vue';
import OrderRatingWidget from '@/Pages/Customer/Orders/OrderRatingWidget.vue';
import GuestConversionBanner from '@/Pages/Customer/Banners/GuestConversionBanner.vue';
import CrmFeaturedBanner from '@/Pages/Customer/Banners/CrmFeaturedBanner.vue';
import ReorderWidget from '@/Pages/Customer/Orders/ReorderWidget.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: true },
    myHistory: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['navigate-to-menu', 'open-register', 'open-hours', 'open-location', 'reorder']);

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();
const { wallet, fetchWallet, applyCoupon } = useCoupons();
const {
    isOpen,
    isOpeningSoon,
    isPreOrder,
    isClosedIndefinitely,
    storeAvailabilityText,
    status
} = useStoreStatus();

const hasActiveOrder = computed(() => page.props.myActiveOrders && page.props.myActiveOrders.length > 0);

// 🚀 ANIMAÇÃO DE CONFETTI NA HOME
const fireConfetti = () => {
    const duration = 3 * 1000;
    const animationEnd = Date.now() + duration;
    const defaults = { startVelocity: 30, spread: 360, ticks: 60, zIndex: 9999 };

    const interval = setInterval(function() {
        const timeLeft = animationEnd - Date.now();
        if (timeLeft <= 0) return clearInterval(interval);

        const particleCount = 50 * (timeLeft / duration);
        confetti(Object.assign({}, defaults, { particleCount, origin: { x: (Math.random() * 0.4) + 0.1, y: Math.random() - 0.2 } }));
        confetti(Object.assign({}, defaults, { particleCount, origin: { x: (Math.random() * 0.4) + 0.5, y: Math.random() - 0.2 } }));
    }, 250);
};

const checkAndFireConfetti = (orderId) => {
    if (!orderId) return;
    const storageKey = `confetti_fired_order_${orderId}`;
    if (!sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey)) {
        sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, 'true');
        fireConfetti();
    }
};

const onOrderPlacedSuccess = (e) => {
    const orderId = e.detail?.orderId;
    if (orderId) checkAndFireConfetti(orderId);
};

// 🎯 Vigia o flash message deste cliente específico
watch(
    [() => page.props.flash?.success, () => page.props.flash?.order_id],
    ([hasSuccess, flashOrderId]) => {
        if (!flashOrderId) return;

        const isOrderCreation = Boolean(page.props.flash?.order_id) && (
            !hasSuccess || (
                /pedido/i.test(hasSuccess) &&
                /(realizado|criado|confirmado|recebido|enviado)/i.test(hasSuccess) &&
                !/cancelad/i.test(hasSuccess)
            )
        );

        if (isOrderCreation) {
            checkAndFireConfetti(flashOrderId);
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

onMounted(async () => {
    window.addEventListener('order-placed-success', onOrderPlacedSuccess);
    await fetchWallet();

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const couponParam = urlParams.get('cupom') || urlParams.get('coupon');

    if (couponParam) {
        const cleanCode = couponParam.toUpperCase();
        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
        const success = await applyCoupon(cleanCode, 0);
        if (success) {
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Cupom Ativado! 🎉', detail: 'O desconto foi engatilhado para seu pedido.', life: 5000 });
        }
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('order-placed-success', onOrderPlacedSuccess);
});

const lastReorderableOrder = computed(() => {
    const history = props.myHistory?.length > 0 ? props.myHistory : (page.props.myHistory || []);
    return history.find(o => ['delivered', 'completed', 'closed'].includes(o.status)) || null;
});

const statusCardBadge = computed(() => {
    if (isClosedIndefinitely.value) {
        return {
            title: 'Fechado temporariamente',
            bg: 'bg-danger-500/20',
            text: 'text-danger-400',
            icon: 'pi-lock'
        };
    }

    if (isOpen.value) {
        return {
            title: 'Loja Aberta',
            bg: 'bg-emerald-500/20',
            text: 'text-emerald-400',
            icon: 'pi-check-circle'
        };
    }

    if (isOpeningSoon.value || status.value?.reason === 'cashier_closed') {
        return {
            title: isPreOrder.value ? 'Pré-Pedido Liberado' : 'Quase Abrindo',
            bg: 'bg-amber-500/20',
            text: 'text-amber-400',
            icon: isPreOrder.value ? 'pi-shopping-bag' : 'pi-clock'
        };
    }

    return {
        title: 'Loja Fechada',
        bg: 'bg-white/10',
        text: 'text-white/60',
        icon: 'pi-moon'
    };
});

const isRatingEnabled = computed(() => {
    return page.props.companySettings?.request_order_rating !== false;
});

const pendingRatingOrder = computed(() => {
    const history = props.myHistory?.length > 0 ? props.myHistory : (page.props.myHistory || []);
    if (!isRatingEnabled.value || history.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }

    return history.find(order =>
        !order.is_legacy &&
        ['delivered', 'completed', 'closed'].includes(order.status) &&
        !order.rating
    );
});

const handleRatingSuccess = (ratingData) => {
    if (pendingRatingOrder.value) {
        pendingRatingOrder.value.rating = ratingData;
    }
};

const featuredCrmCoupon = computed(() => {
    if (!wallet.value || wallet.value.length === 0) return null;
    return wallet.value.find(c => c.purpose === 'birthday') ||
           wallet.value.find(c => c.purpose === 'churn') ||
           wallet.value.find(c => c.is_exclusive) ||
           wallet.value[0] || null;
});

const handleBannerCta = async (couponCode) => {
    await applyCoupon(couponCode, 0);
    emit('navigate-to-menu');
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed } from 'vue';
import CustomerProductCard from "@/Pages/Customer/Menu/CustomerProductCard.vue";
import EmptyState from "@/Components/UI/EmptyState.vue";
import ExpandableSearch from "@/Components/UI/ExpandableSearch.vue";
import SegmentedControl from '@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue';
import CategoryMenu from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Menu/CategoryMenu.vue";

import TopSellingWidget from '@/Pages/Customer/Menu/TopSellingWidget.vue';
import CustomerFavoritesMenu from '@/Pages/Customer/Menu/CustomerFavoritesMenu.vue';

import { useCustomerMenu } from "@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerMenu";
import { useCustomerFavorites } from '@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerFavorites';

const props = defineProps({
    isActive: { type: Boolean, default: true },
    isConfiguratorOpen: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    categories: { type: Array, required: true },
    products: { type: Array, required: true },
    menuSearch: { type: String, default: '' },
    menuView: { type: String, default: 'catalog' },
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'product-click', 'open-recommended', 'update:menuCategory',
    'update:menuSearch', 'update:menuView', 'open-login',
    'update:visibleCategories'
]);

const isMounted = ref(false);
onMounted(() => { isMounted.value = true; });

const filteredCategories = computed(() => {
    return (props.categories || []).filter(c => {
        if (!c || !c.name) return false;
        const nameLower = String(c.name).toLowerCase().trim();
        return c.id !== 'all' &&
               c.id !== 0 &&
               c.id !== null &&
               c.id !== '' &&
               nameLower !== 'todos os itens' &&
               nameLower !== 'todos';
    });
});

const productDictionary = computed(() => {
    const dict = {};
    const len = props.products.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        dict[props.products[i].id] = props.products[i];
    }
    return dict;
});

const { favorites, fetchFavorites } = useCustomerFavorites();

watch(() => props.customer?.id, (newId) => {
    if (newId && !props.isGuest) {
        fetchFavorites(newId);
    }
}, { immediate: true });

const enrichedFavorites = computed(() => {
    if (!favorites.value || favorites.value.length === 0) return [];

    return favorites.value
        .map(fav => {
            const realProduct = productDictionary.value[fav.product_id || fav.id];
            if (!realProduct) return null;

            const rawSelections = fav.modifiers || fav.selections || [];
            const ingredientGroups = (realProduct.modifiers || []).filter(g => g.type === 'ingredient');
            let cleanedSelections = rawSelections;

            if (ingredientGroups.length > 0) {
                const validIngredients = [];
                ingredientGroups.forEach(g => {
                    (g.options || []).forEach(opt => validIngredients.push({ ...opt, groupId: g.id }));
                });

                const tempCleaned = [];
                let isMappingBroken = false;

                for (const sel of rawSelections) {
                    const selId = String(sel.id || sel.modifier_option_id);
                    const selName = String(sel.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    const selGroupId = String(sel.group_id || sel.modifier_group_id);

                    const matchedIngredient = validIngredients.find(opt =>
                        String(opt.id) === selId || String(opt.name).toLowerCase().trim() === selName
                    );

                    if (matchedIngredient) {
                        tempCleaned.push({
                            ...sel,
                            id: matchedIngredient.id,
                            name: matchedIngredient.name,
                            price: Number(matchedIngredient.price || 0),
                            group_id: matchedIngredient.groupId
                        });
                    } else if (sel.type === 'ingredient' || sel.is_ingredient || (selGroupId && ingredientGroups.some(g => String(g.id) === selGroupId))) {
                        isMappingBroken = true;
                        break;
                    } else {
                        tempCleaned.push(sel);
                    }
                }

                if (isMappingBroken) return null;
                cleanedSelections = tempCleaned;
            }

            return {
                ...realProduct,
                favorite_selections: cleanedSelections,
                cartItem: {
                    qty: fav.quantity || 1,
                    isTakeaway: false,
                    structuredModifiers: cleanedSelections.map(m => ({
                        id: m.id,
                        name: m.name,
                        price: Number(m.price || 0),
                        qty: Number(m.quantity || m.qty || 1),
                        is_joker: !m.is_joker,
                        group_id: m.group_id || m.modifier_group_id || null
                    }))
                }
            };
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
});

const menuViewOptions = computed(() => [
    { label: 'Cardápio', value: 'catalog', icon: 'pi-th-large' },
    { label: 'Top 10', value: 'bestsellers', icon: 'pi-bolt' },
    {
        label: enrichedFavorites.value.length > 0 ? `Favoritos (${enrichedFavorites.value.length})` : 'Favoritos',
        value: 'favorites',
        icon: 'pi-heart-fill'
    }
]);

const {
    searchQuery, activeCategoryId, scrollArea, setCategoryRef,
    groupedMenu, visibleCategories, scrollToCategory, handleScroll,
    autoOpenProduct
} = useCustomerMenu(props);

// 🚀 SINCRONIZAÇÃO DA ORDEM DO MENU: As pílulas usam a ordem exata de groupedMenu
const synchronizedCategories = computed(() => {
    if (groupedMenu.value && groupedMenu.value.length > 0) {
        return groupedMenu.value.map(g => g.category);
    }
    return filteredCategories.value;
});

watch(autoOpenProduct, (productToOpen) => {
    if (productToOpen) {
        emit('product-click', productToOpen);
    }
});

watch(visibleCategories, (newVal) => {
    emit('update:visibleCategories', newVal);
}, { immediate: true });

watch(() => props.menuSearch, (newVal) => { searchQuery.value = newVal; });
watch(activeCategoryId, (newVal) => { emit('update:menuCategory', newVal); });

const handleCategoryClick = (categoryId) => {
    activeCategoryId.value = categoryId;
    const targetEl = document.getElementById(`category-group-${categoryId}`);

    if (targetEl && scrollArea.value) {
        scrollArea.value.scrollTo({ top: targetEl.offsetTop - 10, behavior: 'smooth' });
    } else {
        scrollToCategory(categoryId);
    }
};

const views = computed(() => {
    if (props.customer && !props.isGuest) return ['catalog', 'bestsellers', 'favorites'];
    return ['catalog'];
});

const activeIndex = computed(() => {
    const idx = views.value.indexOf(props.menuView);
    return idx !== -1 ? idx : 0;
});

watch(activeIndex, () => {
    if (scrollArea.value) scrollArea.value.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
});

const isDragging = ref(false);
const dragOffset = ref(0);
const touchStartX = ref(0);
const touchStartY = ref(0);
let isHorizontalSwiping = null;

const handleTouchStart = (e) => {
    touchStartX.value = e.touches[0].clientX;
    touchStartY.value = e.touches[0].clientY;
    isDragging.value = true;
    dragOffset.value = 0;
    isHorizontalSwiping = null;
};

const handleTouchMove = (e) => {
    if (!isDragging.value) return;
    const currentX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    const currentY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    const diffX = currentX - touchStartX.value;
    const diffY = Math.abs(currentY - touchStartY.value);

    if (isHorizontalSwiping === null) {
        if (diffY > 10 && diffY > Math.abs(diffX)) {
            isHorizontalSwiping = false;
        } else if (Math.abs(diffX) > 10) {
            isHorizontalSwiping = true;
        }
    }

    if (isHorizontalSwiping) {
        if (
            (activeIndex.value === 0 && diffX > 0) ||
            (activeIndex.value === views.value.length - 1 && diffX < 0)
        ) {
            dragOffset.value = diffX * 0.3;
        } else {
            dragOffset.value = diffX;
        }
    }
};

const handleTouchEnd = () => {
    if (!isDragging.value) return;
    isDragging.value = false;

    if (isHorizontalSwiping) {
        const threshold = window.innerWidth * 0.25;

        if (dragOffset.value < -threshold && activeIndex.value < views.value.length - 1) {
            emit('update:menuView', views.value[activeIndex.value + 1]);
        } else if (dragOffset.value > threshold && activeIndex.value > 0) {
            emit('update:menuView', views.value[activeIndex.value - 1]);
        }
    }

    dragOffset.value = 0;
    isHorizontalSwiping = null;
};

const handleGlobalCategoryClick = (e) => {
    if (props.menuView !== 'catalog') emit('update:menuView', 'catalog');
    handleCategoryClick(e.detail);
};

onMounted(() => { window.addEventListener('menu-scroll-to-category', handleGlobalCategoryClick); });
onUnmounted(() => { window.removeEventListener('menu-scroll-to-category', handleGlobalCategoryClick); });
</script>
```

```vue
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-qrcode text-base" :class="{ 'animate-spin': isGeneratingPix }"></i>
                    <span>Pagar via PIX no Telemóvel</span>
                </button>

                <!-- ÁREA PIX EMBUTIDA (Quando gerado) -->
                <div v-else class="p-3 bg-surface-1 rounded-2xl border border-teal-500/30 flex flex-col gap-3 animate-in fade-in">

                </p>
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import axios from 'axios';

import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';
import CheckoutStepPix from '@/Pages/Customer/Checkout/CheckoutStepPix.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    myActiveOrders: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    tableMode: { type: Object, default: () => null },
    paymentMethods: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['go-to-menu', 'order-paid']);

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const isReloading = ref(false);
const isCallingWaiter = ref(false);
const waiterCooldown = ref(0);
let cooldownTimer = null;

// Gestão de PIX
const showPixArea = ref(false);
const isGeneratingPix = ref(false);
const activePixData = ref(null);
const activePixOrderId = ref(null);

const pixMethod = computed(() => {
    return (props.paymentMethods || []).find(m => m.engine_type === 'bank_api' || String(m.name).toLowerCase().includes('pix'));
});

// 🚀 Extração e normalização de todos os itens com suporte a cancelados
const allItems = computed(() => {
    const list = [];

    (props.myActiveOrders || []).forEach(order => {
        const orderCustomer = order.customer?.name || order.customer_name || 'Mesa';

        (order.items || []).forEach(item => {
            const isCancelled = item.status === 'cancelled' || order.status === 'cancelled';
            const originalTotal = Number(item.total_price || item.price || 0);

            list.push({
                ...item,
                orderId: order.id,
                orderedBy: orderCustomer.split(' ')[0],
                isCancelled,
                originalTotal,
                total_price: isCancelled ? 0.00 : originalTotal,
                modifiersText: (item.modifiers || []).map(m => m.name).join(', ') || item.modifiers_text || ''
            });
        });
    });

    return list;
});

const activeItemsCount = computed(() => allItems.value.filter(i => !i.isCancelled).length);

// 🚀 Totais consolidados da mesa
const tableFinancials = computed(() => {
    let subtotal = 0;
    let serviceFee = 0;
    let discount = 0;
    let total = 0;

    (props.myActiveOrders || []).forEach(order => {
        if (order.status !== 'cancelled') {
            subtotal += Number(order.subtotal || 0);
            serviceFee += Number(order.service_fee || 0);
            discount += Number(order.discount || 0);
            total += Number(order.total || 0);
        }
    });

    return { subtotal, serviceFee, discount, total };
});

const reloadTableOrders = () => {
    isReloading.value = true;
    router.reload({
        only: ['myActiveOrders'],
        preserveScroll: true,
        onFinish: () => { isReloading.value = false; }
    });
};

// 🚀 Disparo de Chamar Garçom
const triggerCallWaiter = async () => {
    if (waiterCooldown.value > 0 || isCallingWaiter.value) return;

    isCallingWaiter.value = true;

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('customer.table.call-waiter'));
        toast.add({
            severity: 'success',
            summary: 'Garçom Notificado!',
            detail: response.data?.message || 'Um atendente está a caminho da sua mesa.',
            life: 5000
        });

        // Inicia Cooldown de 60 segundos
        waiterCooldown.value = 60;
        cooldownTimer = setInterval(() => {
            if (waiterCooldown.value > 0) {
                waiterCooldown.value--;
            } else {
                clearInterval(cooldownTimer);
            }
        }, 1000);
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({
            severity: 'error',
            summary: 'Erro',
            detail: e.response?.data?.message || 'Não foi possível chamar o atendente. Tente novamente.',
            life: 4000
        });
    } finally {
        isCallingWaiter.value = false;
    }
};

// 🚀 Inicializa o Pagamento PIX da Mesa
const initiatePixPayment = () => {
    const firstUnpaidOrder = (props.myActiveOrders || []).find(o => o.payment_status !== 'paid');

    if (!firstUnpaidOrder) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Conta Paga', detail: 'Esta comanda já consta como liquidada.', life: 3000 });
        return;
    }

    if (firstUnpaidOrder.pix_data) {
        activePixData.value = firstUnpaidOrder.pix_data;
        activePixOrderId.value = firstUnpaidOrder.id;
        showPixArea.value = true;
    } else {
        toast.add({
            severity: 'warn',
            summary: 'PIX no Caixa',
            detail: 'Para liquidar esta comanda via PIX, o operador do caixa pode gerar o código no balcão.',
            life: 5000
        });
    }
};

const handlePixSuccess = () => {
    showPixArea.value = false;
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Pagamento Confirmado!', detail: 'A sua comanda foi liquidada.', life: 4000 });
    reloadTableOrders();
    emit('order-paid');
};

onUnmounted(() => {
    if (cooldownTimer) clearInterval(cooldownTimer);
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import CustomerOrderHistoryCard from '@/Pages/Customer/Orders/CustomerOrderHistoryCard.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    myHistory: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false } // 🚀 Adicionamos a prop do Nível 2
});

defineEmits(['reorder', 'go-to-menu', 'open-login', 'open-register']);

const displayLimit = ref(10);

const sortedHistory = computed(() => {
    if (!props.myHistory) return [];
    return [...props.myHistory].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at));
});

const visibleHistory = computed(() => {
    return sortedHistory.value.slice(0, displayLimit.value);
});

const hasMoreOrders = computed(() => {
    return displayLimit.value < sortedHistory.value.length;
});

const loadMore = () => {
    displayLimit.value += 10;
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, onMounted, watch } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';

import CustomerCartTab from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerCartTab.vue";
import CustomerHomeTab from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerHomeTab.vue";
import CustomerMenuTab from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerMenuTab.vue";
import CustomerOrdersTab from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerOrderHistoryTab.vue";
import CustomerAccountTab from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerAccountTab.vue";
import CustomerAuthModal from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerAuthModal.vue";
import CustomerOpenTabs from "@/Pages/Customer/CustomerOpenTabs.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    activeTab: String,
    isConfiguratorOpen: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    myActiveOrders: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    myHistory: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    initialProducts: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    initialCategories: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    cart: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    cartSubtotal: Number,
    orderType: String,
    loginConfig: Object,
    appendOrder: { type: Object, default: null },

    menuSearch: { type: String, default: '' },
    menuCategory: { type: [String, Number], default: null },
    menuView: { type: String, default: 'catalog' }
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'update:activeTab', 'retry-pix', 'change-payment', 'upgrade-account',
    'reorder', 'redeem-reward', 'product-click', 'update-qty', 'clear-cart',
    'edit-item', 'checkout', 'update:orderType', 'open-register', 'add-address',
    'logout', 'delete-account', 'update-profile', 'deactivate-address', 'open-location', 'open-hours',
    'update:menuSearch', 'update:menuCategory', 'update:menuView', 'update:visibleCategories',
    'cancel-append'
]);

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();
const isAuthModalVisible = ref(false);
const forceAuthModalRegistration = ref(false);

const openStrictAuthModal = () => {
    forceAuthModalRegistration.value = true;
    isAuthModalVisible.value = true;
};

watch(isAuthModalVisible, (newVal) => {
    if (!newVal) {
        setTimeout(() => { forceAuthModalRegistration.value = false; }, 300);
    }
});

onMounted(() => {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

    if (urlParams.has('open_login')) {
        isAuthModalVisible.value = true;
    }

    if (urlParams.has('open_upgrade')) {
        emit('upgrade-account');
    }
});

watch(() => props.customer, (newCustomer) => {
    if (newCustomer) {
        localStorage.setItem('brasume_customer_footprint', JSON.stringify({
            name: newCustomer.name,
            email: newCustomer.email,
            method: page.props.auth?.user?.provider_name || 'email'
        }));

        if (!props.isGuest) {
            const currentMode = page.props.companySettings?.customer_registration_mode;
            const needsCpf = ['cpf_required', 'customer_only', 'serpro_magic'].includes(currentMode);

            if (!newCustomer.phone || (needsCpf && !newCustomer.cpf)) {
                toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Quase lá!', detail: 'Para liberar todas as funções, confirme alguns dados.', life: 6000 });
                emit('upgrade-account');
            }
        } else if (!newCustomer.phone) {
            toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Quase lá!', detail: 'Por favor, informe seu WhatsApp para liberar as opções de entrega.', life: 8000 });
            emit('update:activeTab', 'account');
        }
    }
}, { immediate: true });

const handleSwitchToRegister = () => {
    isAuthModalVisible.value = false;
    setTimeout(() => emit('open-register'), 300);
};

const handleAuthSuccess = () => { isAuthModalVisible.value = false; };
</script>
```

```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export function useLoginGateway(companyProp) {
    const toast = useToast();

    // ==========================================
    // REGRAS DE NEGÓCIO COMPUTADAS
    // ==========================================
    const allowGuest = computed(() => companyProp?.allowGuest ?? true);
    const customerMethods = computed(() => companyProp?.customerAuthMethods || []);
    const teamMethods = computed(() => companyProp?.teamAuthMethods || []);

    const customerNeedsEmailFallback = computed(() => !customerMethods.value.includes('google') && !customerMethods.value.includes('whatsapp'));
    const teamNeedsEmailFallback = computed(() => !teamMethods.value.includes('pin') && !teamMethods.value.includes('google'));

    // ==========================================
    // CHAMADAS DE AUTENTICAÇÃO (API)
    // ==========================================
    const isCustomerLoggingIn = ref(false);

    const loginCustomer = (payload) => {
        isCustomerLoggingIn.value = true;

        router.post(route('customer.auth.login'), payload, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onFinish: () => {
                isCustomerLoggingIn.value = false;
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Acesso Negado', detail: errors.email || 'E-mail ou senha incorretos.', life: 4000 });
            }
        });
    };

    const isRegisteringCustomer = ref(false);
    const registerCustomer = (formData, onSuccessCallback) => {
        isRegisteringCustomer.value = true;
        router.post(route('customer.auth.register'), formData, {
            onSuccess: () => {
                isRegisteringCustomer.value = false;
                if (onSuccessCallback) onSuccessCallback();
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                isRegisteringCustomer.value = false;
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro no Cadastro', detail: Object.values(errors)[0] || 'Verifique os dados informados.', life: 4000 });
            }
        });
    };

    const isTeamLoggingIn = ref(false);
    const loginTeam = (form) => {
        isTeamLoggingIn.value = true;
        router.post(route('auth.team-login'), form, {
            onFinish: () => {
                isTeamLoggingIn.value = false;
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Acesso Negado', detail: errors.email || 'Credenciais inválidas.', life: 4000 });
            }
        });
    };

    const isPinLoggingIn = ref(false);
        const loginWithPin = (payload, clearPinCallback) => {
            isPinLoggingIn.value = true;
            router.post(route('auth.pin.login'), payload, {
                preserveScroll: true,
                onFinish: () => {
                    isPinLoggingIn.value = false;
                },
                onError: (errors) => {
                    if (clearPinCallback) clearPinCallback();
                    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Acesso Negado', detail: errors.pin || 'PIN inválido ou incorreto.', life: 3000 });
                }
            });
        };

    return {
        allowGuest, customerMethods, teamMethods,
        customerNeedsEmailFallback, teamNeedsEmailFallback,
        isCustomerLoggingIn, loginCustomer,
        isRegisteringCustomer, registerCustomer,
        isTeamLoggingIn, loginTeam,
        isPinLoggingIn, loginWithPin
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed } from "vue";

export function usePosSecurity(companySettings) {
    const securityMode = computed(() => companySettings?.pos_security_mode || 'standard');
    const customActions = computed(() => companySettings?.pos_secure_actions || []);

    const requiresAuth = (actionType) => {
        if (securityMode.value === 'free') return false;
        if (securityMode.value === 'strict') return true;

        if (securityMode.value === 'standard') {
                    // 🚀 ADICIONADO AQUI TAMBÉM:
                    return ['cancel_item', 'cancel_order', 'apply_discount', 'cash_out', 'close_shift_override'].includes(actionType);
                }

        if (securityMode.value === 'custom') {
            return customActions.value.includes(actionType);
        }

        return false;
    };

    return { requiresAuth, securityMode };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Pages/Gateway/Composables/useRemoteUnlock.js
```javascript
import axios from 'axios';
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';

export function useRemoteUnlock() {
    const isWaiting = ref(false);
    const deviceUuid = ref('');

    const generateUUID = () => {
        if (crypto && crypto.randomUUID) return crypto.randomUUID();
        return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
            var r = Math.random() * 16 | 0, v = c == 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
            return v.toString(16);
        });
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        let uuid = localStorage.getItem('device_uuid');
        if (!uuid) {
            uuid = generateUUID();
            localStorage.setItem('device_uuid', uuid);
        }
        deviceUuid.value = uuid;

        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Rota nomeada
        axios.post(route('auth.remote.request'), { device_uuid: uuid })
            .then(() => {
                isWaiting.value = true;
            })
            .catch((e) => console.log('Dispositivo não homologado ainda.', e));

        if (window.Echo) {
            window.Echo.channel(`device.${uuid}`)
                .listen('.device.unlocked', (event) => {

                    // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Rota nomeada
                    axios.post(route('auth.remote.exchange'), { token: event.token })
                        .then(() => {
                            window.location.href = event.redirectUrl;
                        })
                        .catch((error) => {
                            console.error('Falha ao consumir o Token Remoto', error);
                        });
                });
        }
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        if (window.Echo && deviceUuid.value) {
            window.Echo.leaveChannel(`device.${deviceUuid.value}`);
        }
    });

    return {
        isWaiting,
        deviceUuid
    };
}
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import FormField from '@/Components/UI/FormField.vue';

const page = usePage();

const props = defineProps({
    allowGuest: Boolean,
    methods: {
        type: Array,
        default: null // 🚀 Permite usar o middleware global se null for passado
    },
    needsEmailFallback: Boolean,
    isLoggingIn: Boolean,
    isCartMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

// 🛡️ BLINDAGEM REATIVA
const activeMethods = computed(() => {
    const list = props.methods ?? page.props.company?.customerAuthMethods ?? [];
    return Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
});

const emit = defineEmits(['login', 'open-register', 'guest-action']);
const toast = useToast();

const isLoggingInLocally = ref(false);
const isLoggingInFacebook = ref(false);

const loginWithGoogle = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    isLoggingInLocally.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('google.url', { intent: 'customer' }));
        if (response.data?.url) {
            window.location.href = response.data.url;
        }
    } catch {
        isLoggingInLocally.value = false;
    }
};

const loginWithFacebook = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    isLoggingInFacebook.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('facebook.url', { intent: 'customer' }));
        if (response.data?.url) {
            window.location.href = response.data.url;
        }
    } catch {
        isLoggingInFacebook.value = false;
    }
};

// WhatsApp OTP State
const showWhatsappFlow = ref(false);
const otpStep = ref('phone');
const whatsappNumber = ref('');
const otpCode = ref('');
const isSendingOtp = ref(false);
const isVerifyingOtp = ref(false);

const requestOtp = async () => {
    if (whatsappNumber.value.length < 14) return;
    isSendingOtp.value = true;

    try {
        await axios.post(route('customer.auth.whatsapp.send'), { phone: whatsappNumber.value });
        otpStep.value = 'code';
        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Código Enviado', detail: 'Verifique seu WhatsApp.', life: 4000 });
    } catch (err) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Atenção', detail: err.response?.data?.message || 'Falha ao enviar código.' });
    } finally {
        isSendingOtp.value = false;
    }
};

const handleOtpInput = () => {
    if (otpCode.value.length === 6) {
        verifyOtp();
    }
};

const verifyOtp = async () => {
    if (otpCode.value.length < 6 || isVerifyingOtp.value) return;
    isVerifyingOtp.value = true;

    try {
        await axios.post(route('customer.auth.whatsapp.verify'), {
            phone: whatsappNumber.value,
            code: otpCode.value
        });
        window.location.reload();
    } catch (err) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Código Inválido', detail: 'Verifique os 6 dígitos digitados.' });
    } finally {
        isVerifyingOtp.value = false;
    }
};

const resetWhatsappFlow = () => {
    showWhatsappFlow.value = false;
    otpStep.value = 'phone';
    whatsappNumber.value = '';
    otpCode.value = '';
};

// E-mail Form State
const showEmailForm = ref(false);
const form = ref({ email: '', password: '' });
const submitForm = () => {
    emit('login', { email: form.value.email, password: form.value.password });
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, onMounted, watch, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useStoreStatus } from "@/Composables/useStoreStatus";

defineOptions({ layout: null });

const page = usePage();
// 🚀 Puxando o objeto global injetado pelo Middleware
const company = computed(() => page.props.company || {});
const { isOpen } = useStoreStatus();

const showWhatsappInput = ref(false);
const showEmailForm = ref(false);
const isLoggingIn = ref(false);
const whatsappNumber = ref('');
const form = ref({ email: '', password: '' });

// ==========================================
// MOTOR DE PLANO DE FUNDO
// ==========================================
const currentBackground = ref(null);

const pickRandomBackground = () => {
    const pubSettings = page.props.publicSettings;
    const bgOpen = pubSettings?.home_bg_open || [];
    const bgClosed = pubSettings?.home_bg_closed || [];
    let pool = isOpen.value ? bgOpen : (bgClosed.length > 0 ? bgClosed : bgOpen);

    if (pool && pool.length > 0) {
        currentBackground.value = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
    } else {
        currentBackground.value = null;
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    pickRandomBackground();
});

watch(isOpen, () => pickRandomBackground());

// ==========================================
// AÇÕES
// ==========================================
const handleGuest = () => {};
const requestOtp = () => {};
const submitEmailLogin = () => {
    isLoggingIn.value = true;
    router.post(route('customer.auth.login'), {
        email: form.value.email,
        password: form.value.password
    }, {
        onFinish: () => { isLoggingIn.value = false; }
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
            <div class="bg-white p-2 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-surface-border mb-3">
                <qrcode-vue :value="adminUrl" :size="120" level="M" render-as="svg" />
            </div>
            <p class="text-[11px] text-surface-muted font-medium px-4">
                Escaneie pelo celular para acessar rapidamente a rota <strong class="text-surface-text">/admin/devices</strong> e cadastrar esta máquina na hora.
            </p>
        </div>

        <p v-if="errorMessage" class="text-danger-500 text-xs font-bold mt-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2">

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import InputText from 'primevue/inputtext';
import QrcodeVue from 'qrcode.vue';

const emit = defineEmits(['paired']);
const deviceUuid = ref('');
const isLoading = ref(false);
const errorMessage = ref('');

// 🚀 A URL é dinâmica, baseada no domínio atual da lanchonete
const adminUrl = computed(() => window.location.origin + '/admin/devices');

const verifyDevice = async () => {
    if (!deviceUuid.value) return;

    isLoading.value = true;
    errorMessage.value = '';

    try {
        // 🚀 Rota Ziggy mapeada corretamente
        const response = await axios.post(route('auth.qr.validate'), {
            device_uuid: deviceUuid.value.trim()
        });

        if (response.data.valid) {
            // Salva no cofre do navegador (localStorage) permanentemente
            localStorage.setItem('brasume_device_uuid', deviceUuid.value.trim());
            localStorage.setItem('brasume_device_name', response.data.device.name);
            localStorage.setItem('brasume_device_type', response.data.device.type);

            emit('paired', response.data.device);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        errorMessage.value = error.response?.data?.error || 'UUID inválido ou máquina não autorizada.';
    } finally {
        isLoading.value = false;
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { abbreviateName } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import AvatarBox from "@/Components/UI/AvatarBox.vue";
import NumericKeypad from "@/Components/UI/NumericKeypad.vue";
import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    staff: Array,
    isLoggingIn: Boolean,
    errorMessage: String // 🚀 Prop de erro direto na tela
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'submit-pin', 'clear-error']);

const isProfilesVisible = ref(false);
const isPinVisible = ref(false);
const selectedProfile = ref(null);
const pin = ref('');

watch(() => props.visible, (newVal) => {
    if (newVal) {
        isProfilesVisible.value = true;
        isPinVisible.value = false;
        selectedProfile.value = null;
        pin.value = '';
        emit('clear-error');
    } else {
        isProfilesVisible.value = false;
        isPinVisible.value = false;
    }
});

const closeFlow = () => emit('update:visible', false);

const backToProfiles = () => {
    isPinVisible.value = false;
    pin.value = '';
    emit('clear-error');
    isProfilesVisible.value = true;
};

const selectProfile = (user) => {
    selectedProfile.value = user;
    isProfilesVisible.value = false;
    isPinVisible.value = true;
    emit('clear-error');
};

const addPin = (num) => {
    if (props.errorMessage) emit('clear-error');
    if (pin.value.length < 4) pin.value += num;
    if (pin.value.length === 4) submit();
};

const clearPin = () => {
    pin.value = '';
    emit('clear-error');
};

const submit = () => {
    if (pin.value.length < 4 || !selectedProfile.value) return;
    emit('submit-pin', { email: selectedProfile.value.email, pin: pin.value }, clearPin);
};
</script>
```

```vue
                v-if="sessionToken"
                :value="qrUrl"
                :size="200"
                level="H"
                render-as="svg"
                class="transition-opacity duration-300"
                :class="{'opacity-30 blur-sm scale-95': isGenerating}"
            />

            <!-- Corrigido texto invisível (branco no branco) -->
            <div v-if="!sessionToken" class="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 text-surface-500">
                <i class="pi pi-spin pi-spinner text-2xl text-surface-400"></i>
                <span class="text-xs font-bold">Criptografando...</span>
            </div>

            <div v-if="isAuthorized" class="absolute inset-0 bg-success-500/95 backdrop-blur-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-white animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-300">
                <i class="pi pi-check-circle text-5xl mb-2 animate-bounce"></i>
                <span class="font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">Autorizado!</span>
                <span class="text-[10px] opacity-80">Abrindo sistema...</span>
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import QrcodeVue from 'qrcode.vue';
import axios from 'axios';

const props = defineProps({
    deviceUuid: { type: String, default: '' }
});

const page = usePage();
const activeUuid = ref('');
const sessionToken = ref('');
const deviceData = ref(null);
const isAuthorized = ref(false);
const isGenerating = ref(false);
let rotationInterval = null;

// 🚀 A URL aponta para a Sessão Volátil
const qrUrl = computed(() => {
    return sessionToken.value ? `${window.location.origin}/team/quick-unlock/${sessionToken.value}` : '';
});

// Busca o Nome e Tipo para exibir na tela usando a rota correta do Ziggy
const fetchDeviceDetails = async () => {
    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('auth.qr.validate'), { device_uuid: activeUuid.value });
        if (response.data?.valid) {
            deviceData.value = response.data.device;
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Falha ao validar máquina:', error);
    }
};

// Cria um token aleatório e avisa o Laravel
const generateSession = async () => {
    if (!activeUuid.value) return;

    isGenerating.value = true;
    const token = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);

    // 🚀 Desconecta da rádio velha antes de criar uma nova
    if (sessionToken.value && window.Echo) {
        window.Echo.leaveChannel(`qr-auth.${sessionToken.value}`);
    }

    try {
        await axios.post(route('auth.remote.register-qr'), {
            device_uuid: activeUuid.value,
            session_token: token
        });

        sessionToken.value = token;
        listenForWebSocket(); // 🚀 Inicia a escuta IMEDIATAMENTE após gerar o token!

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Falha ao registrar sessão de segurança:', error);
    } finally {
        setTimeout(() => { isGenerating.value = false; }, 300);
    }
};

// Escuta a autorização remota via WebSockets e faz o handshake na rota correta
// Escuta a autorização remota via WebSockets e faz o handshake na rota correta
const listenForWebSocket = () => {
    if (!sessionToken.value) {
        console.warn('📡 [Echo] Tentou sintonizar sem token!');
        return;
    }

    if (!window.Echo) {
        console.error('❌ [Echo] window.Echo não está disponível no navegador!');
        return;
    }

    const channelName = `qr-auth.${sessionToken.value}`;
    console.log(`📡 [Echo] Sintonizando a antena no canal: ${channelName}`);

    // A função que processa o destravamento caso qualquer um dos eventos abaixo seja ouvido
    const processUnlock = async (event, eventName) => {
        console.log(`🚨 [Echo] BINGO! Evento [${eventName}] recebido no terminal:`, event);
        isAuthorized.value = true;
        window.Echo.leaveChannel(channelName);

        try {
            console.log('🚀 [Axios] Disparando o Exchange Final para injetar a sessão...', {
                device_uuid: activeUuid.value,
                token: sessionToken.value
            });

            const response = await axios.post(route('auth.qr.exchange'), {
                device_uuid: activeUuid.value,
                token: sessionToken.value
            });

            console.log('✅ [Axios] Resposta do Servidor:', response.data);

            if (response.data?.success) {
                console.log('🎉 [Axios] Sucesso! Redirecionando a tela em 800ms...');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = response.data.redirect || '/team';
                }, 800);
            } else {
                console.warn('⚠️ [Axios] O servidor não retornou success = true:', response.data);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('❌ [Axios] Erro crítico ao efetuar handshake final:', error);
            console.error('❌ [Axios] Resposta do erro:', error.response?.data);
            isAuthorized.value = false;
        }
    };

    // 🚀 A REDE DE PESCA: Vamos ouvir 3 variações do nome do evento para garantir!
    window.Echo.channel(channelName)
        .listen('.DeviceQrAuthorized', (e) => processUnlock(e, '.DeviceQrAuthorized'))
        .listen('DeviceQrAuthorized', (e) => processUnlock(e, 'DeviceQrAuthorized'))
        .listen('.App\\Events\\DeviceQrAuthorized', (e) => processUnlock(e, 'FQCN (App\\Events...)'));
};

// Inicializador centralizado
const initDevice = (uuid) => {
    if (!uuid || activeUuid.value === uuid) return;

    activeUuid.value = uuid;

    fetchDeviceDetails();
    generateSession();

    if (rotationInterval) clearInterval(rotationInterval);
    rotationInterval = setInterval(generateSession, 60000);
    // Removemos a chamada do listenForWebSocket daqui, pois ela agora ocorre dentro do generateSession() após criar o Token.
};

onMounted(() => {
    // Tenta pegar de qualquer lugar (Prop, Inertia, LocalStorage)
    const initialUuid = props.deviceUuid || page.props.device?.uuid || localStorage.getItem('brasume_device_uuid') || '';
    if (initialUuid) {
        initDevice(initialUuid);
    }
});

// Fica de olho caso a prop mude ou atrase
watch(() => props.deviceUuid, (newUuid) => {
    if (newUuid) {
        initDevice(newUuid);
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    if (rotationInterval) clearInterval(rotationInterval);
    if (activeUuid.value && window.Echo) window.Echo.leaveChannel(`device.${activeUuid.value}`);
});
</script>
```

```vue
                    <p class="text-surface-400 text-xs mt-0.5">Insira a chave gerada no painel Filament</p>
                </div>

                <DevicePairingBox @paired="handleDevicePaired" />

            <!-- ETAPA 3: DISPOSITIVO HOMOLOGADO -> QR CODE LOGIN -->
            <div v-else class="flex flex-col gap-5">
                <!-- Status do Dispositivo -->
                <div class="bg-success-500/10 border border-success-500/30 p-4 rounded-2xl flex flex-col gap-3 text-success-400 shadow-inner">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-start">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div class="w-10 h-10 bg-success-500/20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-success-500">
                                <i class="pi pi-shield text-xl"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex flex-col text-left">
                                <span class="text-[9px] text-success-500/80 uppercase tracking-widest font-black">Terminal Homologado</span>
                                <span class="font-bold text-sm leading-tight text-success-600">{{ deviceData?.name || 'Máquina Principal' }}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button
                            @click="unpairDevice"
                            title="Desvincular máquina"
                            class="text-[10px] text-surface-400 hover:text-danger-500 underline font-medium outline-none transition-colors"
                        >
                            Trocar chave
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <!-- 🚀 NOVO: TIPO DE DISPOSITIVO VISÍVEL AQUI -->
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white/50 border border-success-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg w-fit mt-1">
                        <span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-success-600">Configuração:</span>

<script setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import DevicePairingBox from './DevicePairingBox.vue';
import QrLoginBox from './QrLoginBox.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'close']);

const isCheckingDevice = ref(true);
const isDeviceAuthorized = ref(false);
const deviceData = ref(null);

const close = () => {
    emit('update:visible', false);
    emit('close');
};

const checkDeviceAuthorization = async () => {
    const uuid = localStorage.getItem('brasume_device_uuid');

    if (!uuid) {
        isDeviceAuthorized.value = false;
        isCheckingDevice.value = false;
        return;
    }

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('auth.qr.validate'), { device_uuid: uuid });
        if (response.data.valid) {
            isDeviceAuthorized.value = true;
            deviceData.value = response.data.device;
        } else {
            handleUnauthorized();
        }
    } catch (error) {
        handleUnauthorized();
    } finally {
        isCheckingDevice.value = false;
    }
};

const handleUnauthorized = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('brasume_device_uuid');
    isDeviceAuthorized.value = false;
};

const handleDevicePaired = (devicePayload) => {
    if (devicePayload && (devicePayload.uuid || devicePayload.device_uuid)) {
        const key = devicePayload.uuid || devicePayload.device_uuid;
        localStorage.setItem('brasume_device_uuid', key);
        deviceData.value = devicePayload;
        isDeviceAuthorized.value = true;
    } else {
        window.location.reload();
    }
};

const unpairDevice = () => {
    if (confirm('Deseja remover o emparelhamento deste terminal?')) {
        handleUnauthorized();
    }
};

watch(() => props.visible, (newVal) => {
    if (newVal) {
        isCheckingDevice.value = true;
        checkDeviceAuthorization();
    }
}, { immediate: true });
</script>
```

```vue
                </div>
            </div>

                <SlideToConfirm
                    text="Deslize para Autorizar"

                    :is-loading="isSubmitting"
                    :is-success="isSuccess"
                    @confirm="handleConfirm"

<script setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';
import SlideToConfirm from '@/Components/UI/SlideToConfirm.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: { type: Boolean, required: true },
    token: { type: String, default: '' } // 🚀 O Token volátil capturado
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'unlocked', 'close']);

const toast = useToast();
const isSubmitting = ref(false);
const isSuccess = ref(false);
const isLoadingDevice = ref(false);
const device = ref(null);

const debugLogs = ref([]);
const addLog = (msg) => { debugLogs.value.push(msg); };

const fetchDeviceDetails = async () => {
    isLoadingDevice.value = true;
    device.value = null;

    const tokenPreview = props.token ? props.token.substring(0,8) : 'vazio';
    addLog(`Iniciando fetch para Sessão: ${tokenPreview}...`);

    try {
        addLog(`Disparando POST para buscar dados da sessão remota...`);

        // 🚀 Busca pelo Token da Sessão ou pelo UUID (Fallback)
        const response = await axios.post(route('auth.qr.validate'), {
            session_token: props.token,
            device_uuid: props.token
        });

        addLog(`Resposta recebida! Status: ${response.status}`);

        if (response.data && response.data.valid) {
            device.value = response.data.device;
            addLog(`Máquina identificada: ${device.value.name}`);
        } else {
            addLog(`Sessão não encontrada ou expirada: ${JSON.stringify(response.data)}`);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        addLog(`ERRO CATCH: ${error.message}`);
        if (error.response) {
            addLog(`HTTP ${error.response.status}: ${JSON.stringify(error.response.data)}`);
        }
    } finally {
        isLoadingDevice.value = false;
        addLog('Fim do fluxo de fetch de segurança.');
    }
};

watch(() => [props.visible, props.token], ([newVisible, newToken]) => {
    addLog(`Watch disparado. Visible: ${newVisible} | Token: ${newToken ? 'Presente' : 'Vazio'}`);
    if (newVisible && newToken) {
        fetchDeviceDetails();
    }
}, { immediate: true });

const handleClose = () => {
    if (isSubmitting.value) return;
    emit('update:visible', false);
    emit('close');
};

const handleConfirm = async () => {
    isSubmitting.value = true;
    addLog('Gestor autorizou. Disparando approve...');

    try {
        // Envia o UUID real da máquina ou o token para aprovação
        await axios.post(route('team.remote-unlock.approve'), {
            device_uuid: device.value?.uuid || props.token,
            session_token: props.token
        });

        addLog('Approve com sucesso!');
        isSubmitting.value = false;
        isSuccess.value = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Terminal Liberado', detail: 'A máquina foi desbloqueada!', life: 3000 });
            emit('unlocked');
            emit('update:visible', false);
            setTimeout(() => { isSuccess.value = false; }, 300);
        }, 800);

    } catch (error) {
        isSubmitting.value = false;
        addLog(`ERRO APPROVE: ${error.response ? error.response.status : error.message}`);
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Falha na Autorização', detail: 'Erro ao autorizar terminal.', life: 4000 });
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
                    {{ showMobileAuth ? 'Acesso de Caixa' : 'Acesso de Atendimento' }}
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- MODAL DE PIN MOBILE -->
        <PinAuthFlow
            v-model:visible="showPinFlow"
            :staff="authorizedStaff"
            :is-logging-in="isPinLoggingIn"
            :error-message="pinErrorMessage"
            @clear-error="pinErrorMessage = ''"
            @submit-pin="handleMobilePinLogin"
        />
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { usePage, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { useRemoteUnlock } from '@/Pages/Gateway/Composables/useRemoteUnlock';
import { useLoginGateway } from '@/Pages/Gateway/Composables/useLoginGateway';
import { useDynamicBackground } from '@/Composables/useDynamicBackground';

import PinAuthFlow from '@/Pages/Gateway/PinAuthFlow.vue';
import QrLoginBox from '@/Pages/Gateway/QrLoginBox.vue';
import DevicePairingBox from '@/Pages/Gateway/DevicePairingBox.vue';

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const { backgroundStyle } = useDynamicBackground(true);

const props = defineProps({
    portal: String,
    mode: String,
    authorizedStaff: Array,
    storeStatus: Object,
});

const company = computed(() => page.props.company || {});

// 🚀 Determina o modo inicial: se rota foi 'mobile', abre Atendente; se 'desktop', abre Caixa
const showMobileAuth = ref(props.mode === 'mobile');
const mobileForm = ref({ email: '', password: '' });

const { teamMethods, teamNeedsEmailFallback, isTeamLoggingIn, loginTeam } = useLoginGateway(company.value);

const activeMethods = computed(() => {
    if (props.portal === 'kds') {
        return company.value.kdsAuthMethods || [];
    }
    return company.value.cashierAuthMethods || [];
});

const { isWaiting } = useRemoteUnlock();

const deviceType = ref('Desconhecido');
const activeDeviceUuid = ref('');
const isCheckingDevice = ref(true);
const isDeviceAuthorized = ref(false);

const checkDeviceAuthorization = async () => {
    const uuid = localStorage.getItem('brasume_device_uuid');

    if (!uuid) {
        isDeviceAuthorized.value = false;
        isCheckingDevice.value = false;
        return;
    }

    activeDeviceUuid.value = uuid;

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('auth.qr.validate'), { device_uuid: uuid });
        if (response.data.valid) {
            isDeviceAuthorized.value = true;
            deviceType.value = response.data.device.type;
        } else {
            handleUnauthorized();
        }
    } catch (error) {
        handleUnauthorized();
    } finally {
        isCheckingDevice.value = false;
    }
};

const handleUnauthorized = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('brasume_device_uuid');
    activeDeviceUuid.value = '';
    isDeviceAuthorized.value = false;
};

const handleDevicePaired = (devicePayload) => {
    if (devicePayload && (devicePayload.uuid || devicePayload.device_uuid)) {
        const key = devicePayload.uuid || devicePayload.device_uuid;
        localStorage.setItem('brasume_device_uuid', key);
        window.location.reload();
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    deviceType.value = localStorage.getItem('brasume_device_type') || 'Desconhecido';

    // 🚀 Só recorre ao user-agent se o modo não veio cravado pela URL
    if (!props.mode && (page.props.device?.is_mobile || page.props.device?.is_tablet)) {
        showMobileAuth.value = true;
    }

    checkDeviceAuthorization();
});

watch([activeDeviceUuid, isDeviceAuthorized], ([newUuid, isAuthorized]) => {
    if (newUuid && isAuthorized && window.Echo) {
        console.log(`📡 [Antena Gateway] Conectando ao canal: device.${newUuid}`);

        window.Echo.channel(`device.${newUuid}`)
            .listen('.DeviceRemoteUnlocked', (event) => {
                console.log('✅ [WebSocket] Evento de Liberação Recebido!', event);
                toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Autorizado', detail: 'O gestor liberou o terminal!', life: 3000 });

                try {
                    router.post(route('auth.remote.exchange'), { token: event.token }, {
                        preserveScroll: true,
                        preserveState: false,
                        onSuccess: () => {
                            console.log('🚀 [Gateway] Sessão gerada! Redirecionando...');

                            // 🛡️ SANITIZAÇÃO DE ESCOPO DO PWA:
                            // Garante SEMPRE caminho relativo local (/pos, /team),
                            // ignorando o domínio do gestor (adm.brasume.com.br) que disparou o evento.
                            let targetPath = '/pos';

                            if (event.redirectUrl) {
                                try {
                                    targetPath = event.redirectUrl.startsWith('http')
                                        ? new URL(event.redirectUrl).pathname
                                        : event.redirectUrl;
                                } catch {
                                    targetPath = '/pos';
                                }
                            }

                            window.location.href = targetPath;
                        },
                        onError: (errors) => {
                            console.error('🚨 [Gateway] Erro no exchange:', errors);
                            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: errors.error || 'Falha na validação final.', life: 4000 });
                        }
                    });
                } catch (error) {
                    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Erro de comunicação.', life: 4000 });
                }
            });
    }
}, { immediate: true });

// LÓGICA DO PIN PARA MOBILE
const showPinFlow = ref(false);
const isPinLoggingIn = ref(false);
const pinErrorMessage = ref('');

const handleMobilePinLogin = (payload, clearPinCallback) => {
    isPinLoggingIn.value = true;
    pinErrorMessage.value = '';

    router.post(route('auth.pin.login'), {
        email: payload.email,
        pin: payload.pin,
        device_uuid: activeDeviceUuid.value
    }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isPinLoggingIn.value = false;
            showPinFlow.value = false;
        },
        onError: (errors) => {
            isPinLoggingIn.value = false;
            if (clearPinCallback) clearPinCallback();
            pinErrorMessage.value = errors.pin || 'Acesso negado. Verifique os dados.';
        }
    });
};

// LÓGICA DO PIN PAD (Terminal Fixo)
const pin = ref('');
const isSubmitting = ref(false);

const appendPin = (num) => {
    if (pin.value.length < 4) {
        pin.value += String(num);
        if (pin.value.length === 4) submitPin();
    }
};

const clearPin = () => { pin.value = ''; };

const submitPin = () => {
    if (pin.value.length !== 4) return;

    isSubmitting.value = true;
    router.post(route('auth.pin.login'), {
        pin: pin.value,
        device_uuid: activeDeviceUuid.value
    }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
        },
        onError: (errors) => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
            pin.value = '';
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Acesso Negado', detail: errors.pin || 'PIN incorreto ou turno fechado.', life: 4000 });
        }
    });
};
</script>
```

```javascript
import { router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useStorage } from '@vueuse/core';
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";

// ==========================================
// 🚀 1. SINGLETON DO SMART TIMER (Relógio Global Único)
// ==========================================
const currentTime = ref(new Date());
let timerInterval = null;

// Só inicia o relógio uma vez na vida do navegador
if (!timerInterval && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    timerInterval = setInterval(() => { currentTime.value = new Date(); }, 10000);
}

export function useKds(props) {
    const getElapsedMinutes = (item) => {
        if (!item.fired_at) return 0;
        const fired = new Date(item.fired_at);
        const diffMs = currentTime.value - fired;
        return Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / 60000)); // 🚀 Blinda contra números negativos
    };

    const getElapsedTime = (item) => {
        return `${getElapsedMinutes(item)} min`;
    };

    const getTimerState = (item) => {
        if (item.production_status === 'pending' || !item.prep_time_minutes) return 'normal';
        const elapsed = getElapsedMinutes(item);
        const target = item.prep_time_minutes;

        if (elapsed >= target) return 'late';
        if (elapsed >= (target * 0.75)) return 'warning';
        return 'normal';
    };

    const getTimerColorClass = (item) => {
        const state = getTimerState(item);
        if (state === 'late') return 'border-l-red-500';
        if (state === 'warning') return 'border-l-orange-500';
        return 'border-l-primary-500';
    };

    const getTimerTextColor = (item) => {
        const state = getTimerState(item);
        if (state === 'late') return 'text-red-500';
        if (state === 'warning') return 'text-orange-500';
        return 'text-primary-500';
    };

    // ==========================================
    // 2. GESTÃO DE COLUNAS E "MODO TODAS"
    // ==========================================
    const isSettingsOpen = ref(false);
    const tempColumns = ref([]);
    const savedSettings = useStorage('pos_kds_settings', {});

    const activeColumns = computed(() => {
        if (props.activeKitchenId === 'all') {
            return [
                { id: "pending", label: "Entrada (Todas)", is_final: false },
                { id: "preparing", label: "Em Preparo (Geral)", is_final: false },
                { id: "ready", label: "Pronto (Finalização)", is_final: true },
            ];
        }

        const kId = String(props.activeKitchenId || 'default');
        if (!savedSettings.value[kId] || savedSettings.value[kId].length === 0) {
            return [
                { id: "pending", label: "Fila de Entrada", is_final: false },
                { id: "preparing", label: "Em Preparo", is_final: false },
                { id: "ready", label: "Pronto", is_final: true },
            ];
        }
        return savedSettings.value[kId];
    });

    const openSettings = () => {
        tempColumns.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeColumns.value));
        isSettingsOpen.value = true;
    };

    const addColumn = () => { tempColumns.value.push({ id: 'col_' + Date.now(), label: 'Nova Coluna', is_final: false }); };
    const removeColumn = (index) => { tempColumns.value.splice(index, 1); };
    const setFinalColumn = (index) => { tempColumns.value.forEach((col, i) => col.is_final = (i === index)); };

    const saveColumns = () => {
        const kId = String(props.activeKitchenId || 'default');
        savedSettings.value = {
            ...savedSettings.value,
            [kId]: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(tempColumns.value))
        };
        isSettingsOpen.value = false;
    };

    // ==========================================
    // 3. FLUXO DE DADOS (O Mapeamento Mágico)
    // ==========================================
    const columnsData = ref({});

    watch(() => [props.initialItems, activeColumns.value], () => {
        const newData = {};
        activeColumns.value.forEach(col => { newData[col.id] = []; });

        (props.initialItems || []).forEach(item => {
            if (props.activeKitchenId === 'all') {
                let targetCol = 'preparing';
                const kId = String(item.kitchen_id || 'default');
                const kitchenCols = savedSettings.value[kId];

                if (!kitchenCols || kitchenCols.length === 0) {
                    if (item.production_status === 'pending') targetCol = 'pending';
                    else if (item.production_status === 'ready') targetCol = 'ready';
                } else {
                    if (item.production_status === kitchenCols[0].id) {
                        targetCol = 'pending';
                    } else {
                        const colDef = kitchenCols.find(c => c.id === item.production_status);
                        if (colDef && colDef.is_final) targetCol = 'ready';
                    }
                }
                if (newData[targetCol]) newData[targetCol].push(item);
            } else {
                if (newData[item.production_status]) {
                    newData[item.production_status].push(item);
                } else if (activeColumns.value.length > 0) {
                    newData[activeColumns.value[0].id].push(item);
                }
            }
        });
        columnsData.value = newData;
    }, { immediate: true, deep: true });

    const changeKitchen = (id) => {
        router.visit(route('operations.kds', { kitchen_id: id }), { preserveState: false });
    };

    const onDragChange = (event, newStatus) => {
        if (event.added) {
            const item = event.added.element;
            let finalStatusToSend = newStatus;

            if (props.activeKitchenId === 'all') {
                const kId = String(item.kitchen_id || 'default');
                const savedSettingsValue = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pos_kds_settings') || '{}');
                const kitchenCols = savedSettingsValue[kId];

                if (kitchenCols && kitchenCols.length >= 3) {
                    if (newStatus === 'pending') {
                        finalStatusToSend = kitchenCols[0].id;
                    } else if (newStatus === 'ready') {
                        const finalCol = kitchenCols.find(c => c.is_final);
                        finalStatusToSend = finalCol ? finalCol.id : kitchenCols[kitchenCols.length - 1].id;
                    } else {
                        finalStatusToSend = kitchenCols[1].id;
                    }
                }
            }

            router.post(route('operations.kds.update-status', item.id), {
                production_status: finalStatusToSend
            }, {
                preserveScroll: true,
                preserveState: true
            });
        }
    };

    const clearReadyItems = (columnId) => {
        const readyItems = columnsData.value[columnId] || [];
        readyItems.forEach(item => {
            router.post(route('operations.kds.update-status', item.id), { production_status: 'delivered' }, { preserveScroll: true, preserveState: true });
        });
    };

    return {
        currentTime,
        isSettingsOpen, tempColumns, activeColumns, columnsData,
        openSettings, addColumn, removeColumn, setFinalColumn, saveColumns,
        changeKitchen, onDragChange, clearReadyItems,
        getElapsedTime, getTimerColorClass, getTimerTextColor
    };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Pages/Kds/Composables/useKdsItemTimer.js
```javascript
import { computed } from 'vue';

export function useKdsItemTimer(itemRef, currentTimeRef) {

    // 🚀 Helper matemático encapsulado e à prova de balas
    const getElapsedMinutes = (dateString) => {
            if (!dateString) return 0;

            let safeDate = dateString;
            if (typeof dateString === 'string') {
                safeDate = safeDate.replace(' ', 'T');
                // 🚀 Se a string de data não tiver a terminação 'Z' ou um fuso '-03', nós forçamos o Z (UTC).
                // Como no Laravel a DB já salva em UTC, isso vai estabilizar o fuso no mundo inteiro!
                if (!safeDate.endsWith('Z') && !safeDate.includes('-') && !safeDate.includes('+')) {
                    safeDate += 'Z';
                }
            }

            const start = new Date(safeDate).getTime();
            const now = new Date(currentTimeRef.value).getTime();

            if (isNaN(start) || isNaN(now)) return 0;

            const diffMs = now - start;
            return Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / 60000));
        };

    // OS DOIS TEMPOS DISTINTOS
    const totalTime = computed(() => getElapsedMinutes(itemRef.value.created_at));
    const phaseTime = computed(() => getElapsedMinutes(itemRef.value.updated_at));

    // Avalia a cor de alerta usando o fired_at (se já estiver no fogo) ou o tempo total
    const timerState = computed(() => {
        if (!itemRef.value.prep_time_minutes) return 'normal';

        const elapsed = itemRef.value.fired_at
            ? getElapsedMinutes(itemRef.value.fired_at)
            : totalTime.value;

        const target = itemRef.value.prep_time_minutes;

        if (elapsed >= target) return 'late';
        if (elapsed >= (target * 0.75)) return 'warning';
        return 'normal';
    });

    const timerColorClass = computed(() => {
        if (timerState.value === 'late') return 'border-l-red-500';
        if (timerState.value === 'warning') return 'border-l-orange-500';
        return 'border-l-primary-500';
    });

    const timerTextColorClass = computed(() => {
        if (timerState.value === 'late') return 'text-red-500';
        if (timerState.value === 'warning') return 'text-orange-500';
        return 'text-primary-500';
    });

    return {
        totalTime,
        phaseTime,
        timerColorClass,
        timerTextColorClass
    };
}
```
