```vue
        <div class="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-hidden relative p-3 md:p-4">

            <!-- 🍸 MODO A: VISTA COMPACTA DO BAR (Lista Única Ordenada por Tempo) -->
            <div v-if="isBarMode" class="h-full overflow-y-auto hide-scrollbar flex flex-col gap-3 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
                <div v-if="barItems.length === 0" class="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center opacity-40 py-16">
                    <i class="pi pi-check-circle text-4xl text-surface-muted mb-2"></i>
                    <p class="text-sm font-bold text-surface-text">Nenhuma bebida pendente</p>
                    <span class="text-xs text-surface-muted">Aguardando novos pedidos do salão e balcão.</span>
                </div>

                <KdsBarCard
                    v-for="item in barItems"
                    :key="item.id"
                    :item="item"
                    :current-time="currentTime"
                    @complete="handleCompleteBarItem"
                    @print="handlePrintItem"
                    @loss="openLossModal"
                    @cancel="openCancelModal"
                />
            </div>

            <!-- 🍳 MODO B: QUADRO KANBAN DA COZINHA (Colunas Drag & Drop) -->
            <div v-else class="h-full overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar">
                <div class="flex h-full gap-3 min-w-[750px] lg:min-w-0">
                    <div
                        v-for="col in activeColumns"
                        :key="col.id"
                        class="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-[260px] max-w-[380px] bg-surface-2 rounded-2xl border border-surface-border overflow-hidden h-full shadow-xs"
                    >
                        <!-- Cabeçalho da Coluna -->
                        <div class="px-4 py-3 bg-surface-3/70 border-b border-surface-border flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                                <h3 class="font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-surface-text truncate">
                                    {{ col.label }}
                                </h3>
                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-surface-1 text-surface-muted border border-surface-border">
                                    {{ columnsData[col.id]?.length || 0 }}
                                </span>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Botão Limpar Prontos -->
                            <button
                                v-if="col.is_final && !readonly && (columnsData[col.id]?.length || 0) > 0"
                                type="button"
                                @click="clearReadyItems(col.id)"
                                class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-success-600 dark:text-success-400 hover:underline bg-transparent border-none cursor-pointer outline-none"
                            >
                                Limpar
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Área de Itens da Coluna -->
                        <draggable
                            v-model="columnsData[col.id]"
                            group="kds-items"
                            item-key="id"
                            class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2.5 flex flex-col gap-2.5 hide-scrollbar min-h-0"
                            ghost-class="opacity-40"
                            :disabled="readonly"
                            @change="onDragChange($event, col.id)"
                        >
                            <template #item="{ element: item }">
                                <KdsItemCard
                                    :item="item"
                                    :is-global-view="activeKitchenId === 'all'"
                                    :kitchen-name="getKitchenName(item.kitchen_id)"
                                    :readonly="readonly"
                                    :current-time="currentTime"
                                    @print="handlePrintItem"
                                    @loss="openLossModal"
                                    @cancel="openCancelModal"
                                />
                            </template>
                        </draggable>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 🚀 3. MODAIS OPERACIONAIS -->
        <KdsColumnSettingsModal
            v-model:visible="isSettingsOpen"
            :columns="tempColumns"
            @update:columns="tempColumns = $event"
            @add="addColumn"
            @remove="removeColumn"
            @set-final="setFinalColumn"
            @save="saveColumns"
        />

        <KdsLossModal
            v-model:visible="isLossModalVisible"
            :item="selectedKdsItem"
            @confirm="submitLoss"
        />

        <KdsCancelModal
            v-model:visible="isCancelModalVisible"
            :item="selectedKdsItem"
            @confirm="submitCancel"
        />

        <ManagerAuthModal
            v-model:visible="isAuthModalVisible"
            @confirm="handleAuthConfirm"
        />
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed } from "vue";
import { usePage, router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import draggable from "vuedraggable";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";

import ManagerAuthModal from "@/Pages/Gateway/Components/ManagerAuthModal.vue";
import KdsItemCard from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsItemCard.vue";
import KdsBarCard from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsBarCard.vue";
import KdsColumnSettingsModal from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsColumnSettingsModal.vue";
import KdsLossModal from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsLossModal.vue";
import KdsCancelModal from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsCancelModal.vue";
import { useKds } from "@/Pages/Kds/Composables/useKds";

const props = defineProps({
    kitchens: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    activeKitchenId: { type: [Number, String], default: 'all' },
    initialItems: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    readonly: { type: Boolean, default: false },
});

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const {
    isSettingsOpen, tempColumns, activeColumns, columnsData, currentTime,
    openSettings, addColumn, removeColumn, setFinalColumn, saveColumns,
    onDragChange, clearReadyItems
} = useKds(props);

// Avaliação do Modo Bar vs Modo Cozinha
const activeKitchenObj = computed(() => {
    if (props.activeKitchenId === 'all') return null;
    return props.kitchens.find(k => String(k.id) === String(props.activeKitchenId));
});

const isBarMode = computed(() => activeKitchenObj.value?.type === 'bar');

const barItems = computed(() => {
    let items = [];
    Object.values(columnsData.value).forEach(colArray => {
        items = items.concat(colArray);
    });
    return items.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
});

// Ações Conectadas às Rotas do Ziggy
const handleCompleteBarItem = (item) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.update-status', item.id), { production_status: 'delivered' }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            void(0)
        }
    });
};

const isLossModalVisible = ref(false);
const isCancelModalVisible = ref(false);
const selectedKdsItem = ref(null);

const handlePrintItem = (item) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.print-item', item.id), {}, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            void(0)
        }
    });
};

const openLossModal = (item) => {
    selectedKdsItem.value = item;
    isLossModalVisible.value = true;
};

const openCancelModal = (item) => {
    selectedKdsItem.value = item;
    isCancelModalVisible.value = true;
};

const submitLoss = (lossData) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.loss', selectedKdsItem.value.id), lossData, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: false,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isLossModalVisible.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Perda Registrada', detail: 'Desperdício debitado do estoque.', life: 3000 });
        }
    });
};

const submitCancel = (cancelData) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.cancel', selectedKdsItem.value.id), cancelData, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: false,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isCancelModalVisible.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Item Cancelado', detail: 'Comanda atualizada com sucesso.', life: 3000 });
        }
    });
};

const getKitchenName = (id) => {
    if (!id) return 'Sem Praça';
    const kit = props.kitchens?.find(k => String(k.id) === String(id));
    return kit ? kit.name : '';
};

// Autorização do Gestor para Configurar Colunas
const isAuthModalVisible = ref(false);
const requestSettingsAccess = () => { isAuthModalVisible.value = true; };
const handleAuthConfirm = (authData) => {
    isAuthModalVisible.value = false;
    if (authData?.password && authData.password.length >= 3) {
        openSettings();
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';

    if (window.Echo) {
        window.Echo.channel(`tenant.${tenantId}.kds`)
            .listen('.items.created', (e) => {
                (e.items || []).forEach(newItem => {
                    if (props.activeKitchenId !== 'all' && String(newItem.kitchen_id) !== String(props.activeKitchenId)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    const targetStatus = newItem.production_status || 'pending';
                    if (columnsData.value && columnsData.value[targetStatus]) {
                        const exists = columnsData.value[targetStatus].some(item => item.id === newItem.id);
                        if (!exists) {
                            columnsData.value[targetStatus].unshift(newItem);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';
    if (window.Echo) {
        window.Echo.leaveChannel(`tenant.${tenantId}.kds`);
    }
});
</script>
```

```vue
                            >

                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">

                <button type="button" @click="saveTask" class="h-10 px-5 rounded-xl bg-primary-500 hover:bg-primary-600 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase border-none cursor-pointer">Salvar Tarefa</button>
            </template>

    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import SegmentedControl from '@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue';
import SearchAutocomplete from '@/Components/UI/SearchAutocomplete.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    isActive: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const toast = useToast();
const isMounted = ref(false);
const activeView = ref('monitoring');

const viewOptions = [
    { label: 'Acompanhamento', value: 'monitoring', icon: 'pi-chart-bar' },
    { label: 'Gerenciar Rotinas', value: 'templates', icon: 'pi-sliders-h' }
];

const checklists = ref([]);
const overview = ref({
    completion_percentage: 0,
    total_tasks: 0,
    completed_tasks: 0,
    issues_count: 0,
    issues: []
});

const loadManagementData = async () => {
    try {
        const res = await axios.get(route('operations.checklists.management'));
        checklists.value = res.data.checklists || [];
        overview.value = res.data.overview || overview.value;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Falha ao carregar dados operacionais dos checklists', e);
    }
};

// Modal de Grupo (Checklist)
const isChecklistModalOpen = ref(false);
const editingChecklist = ref(null);
const checklistForm = ref({ title: '', is_active: true });

const openChecklistModal = (item = null) => {
    editingChecklist.value = item;
    checklistForm.value = {
        title: item?.title || '',
        is_active: item ? Boolean(item.is_active) : true
    };
    isChecklistModalOpen.value = true;
};

const saveChecklist = async () => {
    if (!checklistForm.value.title.trim()) return;
    try {
        if (editingChecklist.value) {
            await axios.put(route('operations.checklists.update', editingChecklist.value.id), checklistForm.value);
        } else {
            await axios.post(route('operations.checklists.store'), checklistForm.value);
        }
        isChecklistModalOpen.value = false;
        loadManagementData();
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Não foi possível salvar a rotina.', life: 3000 });
    }
};

const deleteChecklist = async (checklist) => {
    if (!confirm(`Deseja remover o grupo "${checklist.title}" e todas as suas tarefas?`)) return;
    try {
        await axios.delete(route('operations.checklists.destroy', checklist.id));
        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Removido', detail: 'Rotina excluída.', life: 2500 });
        loadManagementData();
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Falha ao excluir rotina.', life: 3000 });
    }
};

// Modal de Tarefa e Inventário
const isTaskModalOpen = ref(false);
const currentChecklistForTask = ref(null);
const editingTask = ref(null);

const inventorySuggestions = ref([]);
const isSearchingInventory = ref(false);

const taskForm = ref({
    description: '',
    instructions: '',
    assignment_type: 'all',
    recurrence_type: 'daily',
    trigger_type: 'manual',
    completion_type: 'shared',
    is_inventory_task: false,
    inventory_item_type: 'App\\Models\\Product',
    inventory_item_id: null,
    inventory_item_name: ''
});

// 🚀 Funções do Autocomplete
const handleSearchInventory = async (query) => {
    taskForm.value.inventory_item_name = query;

    if (!query || query.length < 2) {
        inventorySuggestions.value = [];
        return;
    }

    isSearchingInventory.value = true;
    try {
        // Garantir que a rota .search-inventory foi registrada no seu web.php/api.php
        const targetRoute = typeof route === 'function' && route().has('operations.checklists.search-inventory')
            ? route('operations.checklists.search-inventory')
            : '/operations/checklists/search-inventory';

        const response = await axios.get(targetRoute, {
            params: {
                type: taskForm.value.inventory_item_type,
                q: query
            }
        });
        inventorySuggestions.value = response.data;
    } catch (e) {
        inventorySuggestions.value = [];
    } finally {
        isSearchingInventory.value = false;
    }
};

const handleSelectInventoryItem = (item) => {
    taskForm.value.inventory_item_id = item.id;
    taskForm.value.inventory_item_name = item.name;
    inventorySuggestions.value = [];
};

const clearInventorySelection = () => {
    taskForm.value.inventory_item_id = null;
    taskForm.value.inventory_item_name = '';
    inventorySuggestions.value = [];
};

const openTaskModal = (checklist, task = null) => {
    currentChecklistForTask.value = checklist;
    editingTask.value = task;

    taskForm.value = {
        description: task?.description || '',
        instructions: task?.instructions || '',
        assignment_type: task?.assignment_type || 'all',
        recurrence_type: task?.recurrence_type || 'daily',
        trigger_type: task?.trigger_type || 'manual',
        completion_type: task?.completion_type || 'shared',
        is_inventory_task: Boolean(task?.is_inventory_task),
        inventory_item_type: task?.inventory_item_type || 'App\\Models\\Product',
        inventory_item_id: task?.inventory_item_id || null,
        inventory_item_name: task?.inventory_item?.name || ''
    };

    isTaskModalOpen.value = true;
};

const saveTask = async () => {
    if (!taskForm.value.description.trim()) return;

    // Validação extra se a flag de inventário estiver ligada
    if (taskForm.value.is_inventory_task && !taskForm.value.inventory_item_id) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atenção', detail: 'Selecione um item de estoque ou desmarque a opção.', life: 4000 });
        return;
    }

    try {
        if (editingTask.value) {
            await axios.put(route('operations.checklists.tasks.update', editingTask.value.id), taskForm.value);
        } else {
            await axios.post(route('operations.checklists.tasks.store', currentChecklistForTask.value.id), taskForm.value);
        }
        isTaskModalOpen.value = false;
        loadManagementData();
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Falha ao salvar tarefa.', life: 3000 });
    }
};

const deleteTask = async (task) => {
    if (!confirm(`Deseja remover a tarefa "${task.description}"?`)) return;
    try {
        await axios.delete(route('operations.checklists.tasks.destroy', task.id));
        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Removido', detail: 'Tarefa excluída.', life: 2500 });
        loadManagementData();
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Falha ao excluir tarefa.', life: 3000 });
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    isMounted.value = true;
    loadManagementData();
});
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
    <div class="w-full h-full flex flex-col animate-in fade-in duration-300">
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6 2xl:grid-cols-7 gap-2.5 overflow-y-auto hide-scrollbar pb-24">
            <ProductCard
                v-for="item in enrichedFavorites"
                :key="item.id + '-' + Math.random()"
                :product="item"
                @click="$emit('favorite-click', $event)"
            />
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import ProductCard from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Menu/ProductCard.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    favorites: { type: Array, required: true }
});

defineEmits(['favorite-click']);
const page = usePage();

const enrichedFavorites = computed(() => {
    const dict = {};
    (page.props.initialProducts || []).forEach(p => { dict[p.id] = p; });

    return (props.favorites || []).map(fav => {
        const realProduct = dict[fav.product_id || fav.id];
        if (!realProduct) return null;

        const rawSelections = fav.modifiers || fav.selections || fav.favorite_selections || [];

        // 🚀 O MOTOR DE HIGIENIZAÇÃO (Tolerância Zero)
        const ingredientGroups = (realProduct.modifiers || []).filter(g => g.type === 'ingredient');
        let cleanedSelections = rawSelections;

        // Se o produto atual exige ingredientes, ativamos a varredura profunda
        if (ingredientGroups.length > 0) {

            // 1. Mapeia tudo o que é válido hoje (Ingredientes e Adicionais)
            const allValidOptions = [];
            (realProduct.modifiers || []).forEach(g => {
                (g.options || []).forEach(opt => {
                    allValidOptions.push({ ...opt, groupId: g.id, groupType: g.type });
                });
            });

            const tempCleaned = [];
            let isMappingBroken = false;

            for (const sel of rawSelections) {
                const selId = String(sel.id || sel.modifier_option_id);
                const selName = String(sel.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();

                // Procura correspondência no cardápio vivo (por ID ou Nome exato)
                const matchedOption = allValidOptions.find(opt =>
                    String(opt.id) === selId || String(opt.name).toLowerCase().trim() === selName
                );

                if (matchedOption) {
                    // Sobreviveu: Recebe a estrutura limpa e nova
                    tempCleaned.push({
                        ...sel,
                        id: matchedOption.id,
                        name: matchedOption.name,
                        price: Number(matchedOption.price || 0),
                        group_id: matchedOption.groupId,
                        is_ingredient: matchedOption.groupType === 'ingredient'
                    });
                } else if (sel.is_joker || selName.startsWith('obs:')) {
                    // Anotações e "Outros" passam livremente
                    tempCleaned.push(sel);
                } else {
                    // 🚀 MORTE SÚBITA: É um modificador órfão do legado que não existe mais.
                    // Como o produto exige ingredientes, abortamos a exibição por segurança.
                    isMappingBroken = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (isMappingBroken) return null; // Aniquila o favorito sujo
            cleanedSelections = tempCleaned;
        }

        return {
            ...realProduct, // Mantém o schema oficial das categorias[cite: 5]
            favorite_selections: cleanedSelections,
            cartItem: {
                qty: fav.quantity || 1,
                isTakeaway: false,
                structuredModifiers: cleanedSelections.map(m => ({
                    id: m.id || m.modifier_option_id,
                    name: m.name,
                    price: Number(m.price || 0),
                    qty: Number(m.quantity || m.qty || 1),
                    is_joker: !!m.is_joker,
                    group_id: m.group_id || m.modifier_group_id || null
                }))
            }
        };
    }).filter(Boolean); // Limpa as falhas silenciosamente
});
</script>
```

```vue
                {{ item.category?.name || 'Sem Categoria' }}
            </span>

            <h3
                class="font-black text-xs md:text-sm leading-snug line-clamp-2 mt-0.5"
                :class="statusType === 'available' ? 'text-surface-text' : (statusType === 'paused' ? 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300' : 'text-red-700 dark:text-red-300')"
            >
                {{ item.name }}
            </h3>

            <!-- Estoque atual -->
            <div v-if="item.track_inventory" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                <span
                    class="inline-flex items-center text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md leading-none border"
                    :class="statusType === 'out_of_stock'
                        ? 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 border-red-500/20'
                        : 'bg-surface-2 text-surface-muted border-surface-border/50'"
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-box text-[9px] mr-1"></i>
                    {{ item.current_stock }} {{ item.unit_of_measure }}
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- COLUNA 2: Ações de Disponibilidade -->
        <div class="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-end relative">

            <!-- ESTADO B: Input Rápido de Reabastecimento (Ao clicar no Verde com saldo 0) -->
            <div v-if="isPromptingStock" class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-150">
                <input
                    type="number"
                    v-model.number="newStockValue"
                    class="w-14 h-6 text-xs font-black text-center rounded-md border bg-surface-2 text-surface-text focus:border-primary-500 px-1 outline-none"
                    placeholder="Qtd"
                    @keyup.enter="confirmRestock"
                    autofocus
                >
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        @click="confirmRestock"
                        class="w-6 h-6 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-md flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer border-none shadow-sm"
                        title="Confirmar saldo"
                    >
                        <i class="pi pi-check text-[9px] font-bold"></i>
                    </button>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        @click="isPromptingStock = false"
                        class="w-6 h-6 bg-surface-2 hover:bg-surface-3 text-surface-muted hover:text-surface-text rounded-md flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-surface-border/50"
                        title="Cancelar"
                    >
                        <i class="pi pi-times text-[9px]"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- ESTADO A: CHIP RETRÁTIL ELEGANTE (Alongamento Vertical) -->
            <div v-else class="relative flex items-center justify-center">

                <div
                    v-if="isExpanded"
                    class="fixed inset-0 z-10"
                    @click.stop="isExpanded = false"
                ></div>

                <div
                    class="transition-all duration-200 ease-out z-20 flex flex-col items-center rounded-full"
                    :class="isExpanded
                        ? 'absolute top-0 right-0 bg-surface-3 p-2 gap-2 shadow-lg'
                        : 'relative p-2'"
                >
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        @click.stop="toggleExpand"
                        class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer border-none outline-none shadow-xs active:scale-95"
                        :class="currentStatusObj.color"
                        :title="`${currentStatusObj.label} (Clique para alterar)`"
                    >
                        <i class="pi text-[8px] font-black" :class="currentStatusObj.icon"></i>
                    </button>

                    <template v-if="isExpanded">
                        <button
                            v-for="opt in otherStatusOptions"
                            :key="opt.key"
                            type="button"
                            @click.stop="selectStatus(opt.key)"
                            class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer border-none outline-none opacity-85 hover:opacity-100 hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 shadow-xs animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150"
                            :class="opt.color"
                            :title="opt.label"
                        >
                            <i class="pi text-[8px] font-black" :class="opt.icon"></i>
                        </button>
                    </template>
                </div>

            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import SlideToConfirm from '@/Components/UI/SlideToConfirm.vue';

const props = defineProps({ item: Object });
const emit = defineEmits(['updateStatus']);

const isExpanded = ref(false);
const isPromptingStock = ref(false);
const isConfirmingOutOfStock = ref(false);
const newStockValue = ref('');

const statusOptions = [
    {
        key: 'available',
        label: 'Disponível',
        icon: 'pi-check',
        color: 'bg-emerald-500 text-white ring-1 ring-emerald-500/40 hover:bg-emerald-600'
    },
    {
        key: 'paused',
        label: 'Pausado',
        icon: 'pi-pause',
        color: 'bg-amber-500 text-white ring-1 ring-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-600'
    },
    {
        key: 'out_of_stock',
        label: 'Esgotado',
        icon: 'pi-times',
        color: 'bg-red-500 text-white ring-1 ring-red-500/40 hover:bg-red-600'
    }
];

const statusType = computed(() => {
    if (props.item.status === 'paused') return 'paused';

    if (props.item.track_inventory && parseFloat(props.item.current_stock) <= 0) {
        return 'out_of_stock';
    }

    if (props.item.status === 'out_of_stock') return 'out_of_stock';

    return 'available';
});

const currentStatusObj = computed(() => {
    return statusOptions.find(opt => opt.key === statusType.value) || statusOptions[0];
});

const otherStatusOptions = computed(() => {
    return statusOptions.filter(opt => opt.key !== statusType.value);
});

const toggleExpand = () => {
    isExpanded.value = !isExpanded.value;
};

const selectStatus = (targetStatus) => {
    isExpanded.value = false;

    if (targetStatus === 'available' && props.item.track_inventory && parseFloat(props.item.current_stock) <= 0) {
        newStockValue.value = props.item.par_level || props.item.max_stock || 1;
        isPromptingStock.value = true;
        isConfirmingOutOfStock.value = false;
        return;
    }

    if (targetStatus === 'out_of_stock' && props.item.track_inventory && parseFloat(props.item.current_stock) > 0) {
        isConfirmingOutOfStock.value = true;
        isPromptingStock.value = false;
        return;
    }

    emit('updateStatus', {
        item: props.item,
        action: targetStatus,
        new_stock: targetStatus === 'out_of_stock' ? 0 : null
    });
};

const executeOutOfStock = () => {
    isConfirmingOutOfStock.value = false;
    emit('updateStatus', {
        item: props.item,
        action: 'out_of_stock',
        new_stock: 0
    });
};

const confirmRestock = () => {
    if (newStockValue.value === '' || newStockValue.value === null || newStockValue.value < 0) return;

    emit('updateStatus', {
        item: props.item,
        action: 'available',
        new_stock: Number(newStockValue.value)
    });

    isPromptingStock.value = false;
};
</script>
```

```vue
            title="Alternar O de Sempre"
        >
            <i class="pi" :class="isFavoritesActive ? 'pi-star-fill' : 'pi-star'"></i>

import PosTeleportButton from '@/Components/UI/PosTeleportButton.vue';

import SegmentedControl from '@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue';

import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    isMounted: Boolean,
    isActive: Boolean,
    searchQuery: String,
    selectedCategory: [String, Number],
    categoryLayout: String,
    productCardLayout: String,
    hasFavorites: Boolean,
    isFavoritesActive: Boolean,
    isManagerActive: Boolean
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'update:searchQuery', 'update:categoryLayout', 'update:productCardLayout',
    'toggle-favorites', 'toggle-manager'
]);

const isGridActive = computed(() => {
    return (!props.selectedCategory && !props.searchQuery) ? props.categoryLayout === 'grid' : props.productCardLayout === 'square';
});

const isListActive = computed(() => {
    return (!props.selectedCategory && !props.searchQuery) ? props.categoryLayout === 'list' : props.productCardLayout === 'list';
});

const emitGridClick = () => {
    if (!props.selectedCategory && !props.searchQuery) emit('update:categoryLayout', 'grid');
    else emit('update:productCardLayout', 'square');
};

const emitListClick = () => {
    if (!props.selectedCategory && !props.searchQuery) emit('update:categoryLayout', 'list');
    else emit('update:productCardLayout', 'list');
};
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
    <div class="flex flex-col h-full bg-surface-2 rounded-4xl p-4 md:p-6 gap-4 md:gap-6 overflow-hidden w-full">

        <div class="flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
            <div>
                <h2 class="font-black text-surface-text text-xl">Entregas & Balcão</h2>
            </div>
            <Badge :value="orders.length" severity="warn" />
        </div>

        <div class="flex-1 overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar min-h-0">
            <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 h-full min-w-[800px] lg:min-w-0">

                <div
                    v-for="column in kanbanColumns"
                    :key="column.id"
                    class="flex flex-col bg-surface-3 rounded-[1.5rem] overflow-hidden h-full min-h-[400px]"
                >
                    <div class="p-3 md:p-4 flex justify-between items-center bg-surface-3 shrink-0">
                        <h3 class="font-black text-surface-text text-sm">{{ column.label }}</h3>
                        <Badge :value="columnsData[column.id]?.length || 0" :severity="column.badgeSeverity" />
                    </div>

                    <!-- Draggable container para as raias do Kanban -->
                    <draggable
                        v-model="columnsData[column.id]"
                        group="kanban-delivery"
                        item-key="id"
                        class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 flex flex-col gap-2 hide-scrollbar min-h-0"
                        ghost-class="opacity-40"
                        @change="onDragChange($event, column.id)"
                    >
                        <template #item="{ element: order }">
                            <div class="flex flex-col">
                                <OrderCard
                                    :order="order"
                                    @click="$emit('open-menu', order)"
                                    @move-prev="moveOrderPrev(order)"
                                    @move-next="moveOrderNext(order)"
                                    class="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform"
                                />
                            </div>
                        </template>
                    </draggable>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, watch, defineProps, defineEmits } from "vue";
import Badge from "primevue/badge";
import OrderCard from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderCard.vue";
import draggable from "vuedraggable";

const props = defineProps({ orders: { type: Array, default: () => [] } });
const emit = defineEmits(["advance-status", "open-menu"]);

const kanbanColumns = [
    { id: "pending", label: "Entrada", badgeSeverity: "secondary" },
    { id: "preparing", label: "Em Preparo", badgeSeverity: "secondary" },
    { id: "ready", label: "Despachando", badgeSeverity: "secondary" },
    { id: "dispatched", label: "Em Rota", badgeSeverity: "secondary" },
];

const columnsData = ref({
    pending: [],
    preparing: [],
    ready: [],
    dispatched: []
});

// Normaliza status para a coluna correspondente
const getColumnForStatus = (status) => {
    if (status === 'pending' || status === 'pending_payment') return 'pending';
    return status;
};

watch(() => props.orders, (newOrders) => {
    kanbanColumns.forEach(col => {
        columnsData.value[col.id] = (newOrders || [])
            .filter(o => getColumnForStatus(o.status) === col.id)
            .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
    });
}, { immediate: true, deep: true });

const onDragChange = (event, newStatus) => {
    if (event.added) {
        const droppedOrder = event.added.element;
        emit('advance-status', droppedOrder, newStatus);
    }
};

// 🚀 NAVEGAÇÃO DAS SETINHAS
const moveOrderPrev = (order) => {
    if (!order) return;
    const currentStatus = getColumnForStatus(order.status);
    const currentIndex = kanbanColumns.findIndex(c => c.id === currentStatus);
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
        const previousStatus = kanbanColumns[currentIndex - 1].id;
        emit('advance-status', order, previousStatus);
    }
};

const moveOrderNext = (order) => {
    if (!order) return;
    const currentStatus = getColumnForStatus(order.status);
    const currentIndex = kanbanColumns.findIndex(c => c.id === currentStatus);

    if (currentStatus === 'dispatched' || currentIndex === kanbanColumns.length - 1) {
        emit('advance-status', order, 'closed');
        return;
    }

    if (currentIndex < kanbanColumns.length - 1 && currentIndex !== -1) {
        const nextStatus = kanbanColumns[currentIndex + 1].id;
        emit('advance-status', order, nextStatus);
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
                />

        <!-- 2. TELEPORT DO SEGMENTED CONTROL NO TEAM MODE PARA O HEADER -->
        <Teleport to="#team-header-action-portal" v-if="isMounted && isTeamMode">
            <SegmentedControl
                v-model="viewMode"

        <!-- CARDS VIEW -->
        <div v-show="viewMode === 'cards'" class="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0 pt-2">
            <EmptyState
                v-if="sortedOrders.length === 0"
                icon="pi-coffee"
                title="Nenhuma mesa ou comanda aberta."
            />

            <TransitionGroup v-else name="list" tag="div"
                class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto hide-scrollbar min-h-0 relative content-start auto-rows-max"
                :class="isTeamMode
                    ? 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 p-0 pb-32'
                    : (isExpanded ? 'grid grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4 px-4 pb-6' : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 px-4 pb-6')">
                <OrderCard
                    v-for="order in sortedOrders"
                    :key="order.id"
                    :order="order"
                    :show-total="!isTeamMode"
                    :is-highlighted="highlightedId === order.id"
                    :is-team-mode="isTeamMode"
                    @click="$emit('open-menu', order)"
                />
            </TransitionGroup>
        </div>

        <!-- MAP VIEW -->
        <div v-show="viewMode === 'map'" class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto hide-scrollbar min-h-0 relative" :class="isTeamMode ? 'p-0 pb-32 bg-transparent' : 'p-4 bg-surface-1'">
            <RoutingTable
                :table-areas="tableAreas"
                mode="direct"
                @table-click="handleTableClick"
                @load-order="handleLoadOrder"
            />
        </div>

    </div>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue';
import Badge from "primevue/badge";
import OrderCard from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderCard.vue";
import RoutingTable from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/RoutingTable.vue";
import EmptyState from "@/Components/UI/EmptyState.vue";
import SegmentedControl from "@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    orders: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    tableAreas: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    highlightedId: { type: [Number, String], default: null },
    isTeamMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isExpanded: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["open-menu", "create-order"]);
const viewMode = ref('cards');
const isMounted = ref(false);

onMounted(() => { isMounted.value = true; });

const viewOptions = [
    { label: 'Lista', value: 'cards' },
    { label: 'Mapa', value: 'map' }
];

const sortedOrders = computed(() => {
    return [...props.orders].sort((a, b) => {
        let dateA = a.created_at ? new Date(a.created_at) : new Date(0);
        let dateB = b.created_at ? new Date(b.created_at) : new Date(0);
        return dateA - dateB;
    });
});

const handleTableClick = (table, isOccupied, existingOrder) => {
    let fullOrder = existingOrder;
    if (isOccupied && existingOrder) {
        fullOrder = props.orders.find(o => o.id === existingOrder.id) || existingOrder;
    }
    emit('create-order', table, isOccupied, fullOrder);
};

const handleLoadOrder = (orderId) => {
    const fullOrder = props.orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
    if (fullOrder) {
        emit('open-menu', fullOrder);
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
                    class="w-10 h-10 bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-colors outline-none border border-red-500/20 shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
                    title="Cancelar Item"
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-times-circle text-sm"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- SLIDE TO CONFIRM -->
        <div class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-surface-border/50">
            <SlideToConfirm
                text="Entregar"
                success-text="Entregue!"
                :is-loading="isCompleting"
                :is-success="isSuccess"
                @confirm="handleConfirm"
                class="!h-14"
            />
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, toRefs, computed } from "vue";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";
import { useKdsItemTimer } from "@/Pages/Kds/Composables/useKdsItemTimer";
import SlideToConfirm from "@/Components/UI/SlideToConfirm.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    item: { type: Object, required: true },
    currentTime: { type: Date, default: () => new Date() }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['print', 'loss', 'cancel', 'complete']);

const { item, currentTime } = toRefs(props);
const { getOrderTitle } = useOrderFormatting();
const formattedTitle = computed(() => getOrderTitle(item.value?.order));
const { totalTime, timerColorClass, timerTextColorClass } = useKdsItemTimer(item, currentTime);

const isCompleting = ref(false);
const isSuccess = ref(false);

// 🚀 PARSER INTELIGENTE DE MODIFICADORES (Suporta `modifiers`, `structured_modifiers` e trata quantidades)
const parsedModifiers = computed(() => {
    const raw = item.value?.modifiers || item.value?.structured_modifiers || item.value?.structuredModifiers || [];
    if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];

    const parentQty = Number(item.value?.quantity || item.value?.qty || 1);

    return raw
        .map(m => {
            let totalModQty = Number(m.quantity ?? m.qty ?? 1);
            let unitQty = totalModQty;
            
            // Isola a quantidade unitária do modificador para evitar confusão na cozinha
            if (parentQty > 1 && totalModQty >= parentQty && (totalModQty % parentQty === 0)) {
                unitQty = totalModQty / parentQty;
            }

            const name = (m.name || m.modifier_name || m.option_name || '').trim();
            return {
                id: m.id || `${name}_${unitQty}`,
                name,
                qty: unitQty
            };
        })
        .filter(m => m.name && m.name !== '\u200B');
});

const handleConfirm = () => {
    isCompleting.value = true;

    // Feedback visual verde antes de concluir e remover da esteira
    setTimeout(() => {
        isCompleting.value = false;
        isSuccess.value = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
            emit('complete', props.item);
        }, 400);
    }, 250);
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import Button from 'primevue/button';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';

const props = defineProps({ visible: Boolean, item: Object });
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'confirm']);

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (value) => emit('update:visible', value),
});

const form = ref({ reason: null, blockSales: false, itemToBlock: null });

watch(() => props.visible, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) form.value = { reason: null, blockSales: false, itemToBlock: compositionOptions.value[0] || null };
});

const compositionOptions = computed(() => {
    if (!props.item) return [];
    let options = [{ label: `Prato Completo (${props.item.product_name})`, type: 'main', id: props.item.product_id }];
    if (props.item.modifiers) {
        props.item.modifiers.forEach(mod => {
            options.push({ label: `Insumo Extra (${mod.name})`, type: 'modifier', id: mod.modifier_option_id, opt_name: mod.name });
        });
    }
    return options;
});

const isValid = computed(() => {
    if (!form.value.reason) return false;
    if (form.value.reason === 'Falta de Insumos' && form.value.blockSales && !form.value.itemToBlock) return false;
    return true;
});

const handleConfirm = () => {
    emit('confirm', {
        reason: form.value.reason,
        block_sales: form.value.blockSales,
        block_type: form.value.blockSales ? form.value.itemToBlock.type : null,
        block_id: form.value.blockSales ? form.value.itemToBlock.id : null
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
            <span v-else class="text-sm font-bold text-surface-muted">--</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Setinha indicadora -->
        <div class="flex flex-col justify-center z-10 text-surface-border">
            <i class="pi pi-angle-right text-2xl"></i>
        </div>

        <!-- 🛎️ FASE 3: Pronto/Entregue -->
        <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all z-10"
             :class="isReady ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-40 grayscale'">
            <div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-1.5 transition-colors"
                 :class="isReady ? 'bg-success-500 text-white' : 'bg-surface-3 text-surface-muted'">
                <i class="pi pi-check text-xs"></i>
            </div>
            <span class="text-xs font-black mb-0.5 transition-colors"
                  :class="isReady ? 'text-success-600 dark:text-success-400' : 'text-surface-muted'">Concluído</span>
            <span v-if="isReady" class="text-sm font-bold text-success-600 dark:text-success-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                <i class="pi pi-clock text-xs"></i> {{ readyTime }}m
            </span>
            <span v-else class="text-sm font-bold text-surface-muted">--</span>
        </div>

    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    item: {
        type: Object,
        required: true
    }
});

// 🚀 MOTOR DE TEMPO REAL
const now = ref(new Date());
let timerInterval;

onMounted(() => {
    timerInterval = setInterval(() => { now.value = new Date(); }, 30000); // Atualiza a cada 30s
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    clearInterval(timerInterval);
});

// Calculadora de minutos
const getElapsedMinutes = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return 0;

    // Corrige fuso horário se vier truncado do banco
    let safeDate = dateString;
    if (typeof safeDate === 'string' && !safeDate.includes('T')) {
        safeDate = safeDate.replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z';
    }

    const past = new Date(safeDate);
    const diff = Math.floor((now.value - past) / 60000);
    return diff < 0 ? 0 : diff;
};

// 🚦 ESTADOS DO ITEM
const status = computed(() => props.item?.production_status || 'pending');

const isPreparing = computed(() => ['preparing', 'in_progress'].includes(status.value));
const isReady = computed(() => ['ready', 'delivered'].includes(status.value));

// ⏱️ TEMPOS
// Há quantos minutos o garçom lançou o item?
const requestedTime = computed(() => getElapsedMinutes(props.item?.created_at));

// Há quantos minutos a cozinha "puxou" o ticket (fired_at)?
const prepTime = computed(() => {
    if (!props.item?.fired_at) return null;
    return getElapsedMinutes(props.item.fired_at);
});

// Há quantos minutos o item foi marcado como pronto?
const readyTime = computed(() => {
    if (!isReady.value) return null;
    // Quando ele muda para "ready", o updated_at reflete esse momento exato.
    return getElapsedMinutes(props.item?.updated_at);
});

// Barra de progresso ao fundo
const progressWidth = computed(() => {
    if (isReady.value) return 'w-full';
    if (isPreparing.value) return 'w-[66%]';
    return 'w-[33%]';
});
</script>
```

```vue
                <Select

                    optionLabel="name"
                    optionValue="id"
                    placeholder="Selecione o destino de emergência..."
                    class="w-full"
                    showClear
                />
                <small class="text-surface-muted italic text-[10px]">Deixe em branco para voltar ao funcionamento normal.</small>
            </div>

        <template #footer>
            <Button label="Cancelar" variant="text" severity="secondary" @click="$emit('update:visible', false)" />

<script setup>
import { ref, watch, computed } from 'vue';
import Button from 'primevue/button';
import Select from 'primevue/select';

const props = defineProps({ visible: Boolean, printer: Object, allPrinters: Array });
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'save']);

const selectedFallback = ref(null);

watch(() => props.visible, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen && props.printer) {
        selectedFallback.value = props.printer.fallback_printer_id;
    }
});

const availablePrinters = computed(() => {
    return props.allPrinters.filter(p => p.id !== props.printer?.id);
});

const handleSave = () => {
    emit('save', { printer_id: props.printer.id, fallback_printer_id: selectedFallback.value });
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import axios from 'axios';
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import AppLayout from "@/Layouts/DesktopLayout.vue";
import PrintJobRow from "@/Pages/Operations/Printers/PrintJobRow.vue";
import FallbackModal from "@/Pages/Operations/Printers/FallbackModal.vue";
import Checkbox from 'primevue/checkbox';
import EmptyState from "@/Components/UI/EmptyState.vue";

defineOptions({ layout: AppLayout });

// 🚀 BLINDAGEM DE PROPS COM FALLBACKS DEFAULT NATIVOS DO VUE
const props = defineProps({
    printers: {
        type: Array,
        default: () => []
    },
    printJobs: {
        type: Array,
        default: () => []
    },
    isActive: {
        type: Boolean,
        default: false
    }
});

// 🚀 COMPUTEDS SEGURAS CONTRA ERROS SILENCIOSOS
const safePrinters = computed(() => Array.isArray(props.printers) ? props.printers : []);
const safePrintJobs = computed(() => Array.isArray(props.printJobs) ? props.printJobs : []);

const isMounted = ref(false);
onMounted(() => { isMounted.value = true; });

const getPrinterCompactClass = (printer) => {
    if (printer.fallback_printer_id) return 'bg-warning-500/10 border-warning-500/50 text-warning-600 hover:bg-warning-500/20';
    if (printer.last_status === 'failed') return 'bg-danger-500/10 border-danger-500/50 text-danger-500 hover:bg-danger-500/20 animate-pulse';
    return 'bg-success-500/10 border-success-500/30 text-success-500 hover:bg-success-500/20';
};

const selectedJobs = ref([]);

const isAllSelected = computed(() => {
    return safePrintJobs.value.length > 0 && selectedJobs.value.length === safePrintJobs.value.length;
});

const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (isAllSelected.value) {
        selectedJobs.value = [];
    } else {
        selectedJobs.value = safePrintJobs.value.map(j => j.id);
    }
};

const toggleSelection = (id) => {
    const idx = selectedJobs.value.indexOf(id);
    if (idx > -1) selectedJobs.value.splice(idx, 1);
    else selectedJobs.value.push(id);
};

const retrySingle = (id) => {
    axios.post(route('operations.printers.retry'), { job_ids: [id] });
};

const retrySelected = () => {
    axios.post(route('operations.printers.retry'), { job_ids: selectedJobs.value }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => { selectedJobs.value = []; }
    });
};

const retryAllFailed = () => {
    router.post(route('operations.printers.retry-all'), { preserveState: true, }, { preserveState: true });
};

const isFallbackModalVisible = ref(false);
const printerToConfigure = ref(null);

const openFallbackModal = (printer) => {
    printerToConfigure.value = printer;
    isFallbackModalVisible.value = true;
};

const saveFallback = (payload) => {
    router.post(route('operations.printers.fallback', payload.printer_id), { preserveState: true,  fallback_printer_id: payload.fallback_printer_id }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => { isFallbackModalVisible.value = false; }
    });
};
</script>

<style scoped>

.fade-enter-from, .fade-leave-to { opacity: 0; }
</style>
```

```vue
            @action="customHandleMenuAction"
            @duplicate-item="handleItemDuplicate"
            @modify-item="handleItemModifyWithTabSwitch"
            @swap-item="handleItemSwapWithTabSwitch"
            @cancel-item="handleItemCancel"
            @transfer-items="handleTransferTrigger"
            @reprint-item="handleItemReprint"
        />

        <OrderTransformer v-model:visible="isTransformerVisible" :order="orderToModify" @transform="handleTransformation" />

        <PaymentIntentModal
            v-model:visible="isPaymentModalVisible"
            :order="orderToUpdatePayment"
            :customer="orderToUpdatePayment?.customer"
            :order-total="Number(orderToUpdatePayment?.total || 0)"
            :existing-intent="orderToUpdatePayment?.payment_intent_status"
            :existing-methods="orderToUpdatePayment?.payment_intent_methods"
            :payment-methods="availablePaymentMethods"
            @confirm="handleUpdatePayment"
        />

        <ChangeAddressModal v-model:visible="isChangeAddressModalVisible" :order="orderToUpdateAddress" @confirm="handleChangeAddressConfirm" />
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import PosTeleportButton from '@/Components/UI/PosTeleportButton.vue';

import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed, watch } from "vue";
import { router, usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import { useConfirm } from "primevue/useconfirm";
import ConfirmDialog from "primevue/confirmdialog";

import DesktopLayout from "@/Layouts/DesktopLayout.vue";
import SegmentedControl from "@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue";
import ExpandableSearch from "@/Components/UI/ExpandableSearch.vue";

import TransferItemsModal from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/TransferItemsModal.vue";
import OrderContextMenu from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderContextMenu.vue";
import OrderTransformer from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderTransformer.vue";
import OpenTabs from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Dashboard/OpenTabs.vue";
import DeliveryKanban from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Dashboard/DeliveryKanban.vue";
import PaymentIntentModal from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/PaymentIntentModal.vue";
import ChangeAddressModal from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/ChangeAddressModal.vue";
import OrderDetails from "@/Pages/Operations/OrderDetails.vue";

import { useItemActions } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useItemActions";
import { useControlPanel } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useControlPanel";
import { useCart } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart";

defineOptions({ layout: DesktopLayout, inheritAttrs: false });

const props = defineProps({
    initialOrders: Array,
    companySettings: Object,
    tableAreas: Array,
    isActive: {
        type: Boolean,
        default: false
    }
});

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();
const confirm = useConfirm();
const isMounted = ref(false);

const initialOrdersRef = computed(() => props.initialOrders);
const isTabsExpanded = ref(false);

defineEmits(['close', 'go-back']);

const {
    activeTab, searchQuery, contextMenuVisible, selectedOrderContext, orderToModify,
    isTransformerVisible, isPaymentModalVisible, orderToUpdatePayment,
    isChangeAddressModalVisible, orderToUpdateAddress, isTransferModalVisible,
    transferSourceOrder, transferItemIds, activeOrders,
    onSiteOrders, deliveryOrders, historyOrders, openContextMenu, handleMenuAction,
    handleChangeAddressConfirm, handleAdvanceStatus, handleUpdatePayment,
    handleTransferTrigger, handleExecuteTransfer, handleTransformation,
    focusedOrderId, focusedOrder
} = useControlPanel(initialOrdersRef);

const { draftRouting, orderType, clearCart } = useCart();

const tabOptions = computed(() => [
    { label: `Ativos (${activeOrders.value.length})`, value: 'active' },
    { label: `Histórico (${historyOrders.value.length})`, value: 'history' }
]);

const availablePaymentMethods = computed(() => {
    return page.props.paymentMethods || page.props.cashierData?.paymentMethods || [];
});

const dispatchedOrdersCount = computed(() => {
    return deliveryOrders.value.filter(o => o.status === 'dispatched').length;
});

const hasDispatchedOrders = computed(() => dispatchedOrdersCount.value > 0);

const confirmBulkComplete = () => {
    confirm.require({
        message: `Você tem certeza que deseja finalizar os ${dispatchedOrdersCount.value} pedidos que estão em rota? O sistema tentará processar os pagamentos automaticamente usando as promessas do motoboy.`,
        header: 'Baixar Entregas em Rota',
        icon: 'pi pi-bolt text-warning-500',
        rejectProps: { label: 'Cancelar', severity: 'secondary', outlined: true },
        acceptProps: { label: 'Sim, Baixar Todos', severity: 'warning', icon: 'pi pi-bolt' },
        accept: () => {
            executeBulkComplete();
        }
    });
};

const executeBulkComplete = () => {
    router.post(route('operations.orders.bulk-complete-dispatched'), {}, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: (pageProps) => {
            const flash = pageProps.props.flash || {};
            if (flash.success) toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Rota Baixada', detail: flash.success, life: 5000 });
            if (flash.warning) toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atenção (Inconsistências)', detail: flash.warning, life: 8000 });
        }
    });
};

watch(() => props.isActive, (active) => {
    if (!active) {
        focusedOrderId.value = null;
        contextMenuVisible.value = false;
        selectedOrderContext.value = null;
        isTransformerVisible.value = false;
        isPaymentModalVisible.value = false;
        isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = false;
        isTransferModalVisible.value = false;
        searchQuery.value = '';
    }
});

const navigateToPosTab = () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'pos' }));
};

const handleNewOrder = () => {
    clearCart();
    orderType.value = 'table';
    draftRouting.value = {
        order_id: null,
        existing_order_id: null,
        type: 'table',
        table: null,
        identifier: '',
        customer: null,
        customer_phone: null,
        address: null
    };
    navigateToPosTab();
};

const handleCreateOrderOnTable = (table, isOccupied, existingOrder) => {
    if (isOccupied && existingOrder) {
        openContextMenu(existingOrder);
    } else {
        orderType.value = 'table';
        draftRouting.value = {
            order_id: null,
            existing_order_id: null,
            type: 'table',
            table: { id: table.id, name: table.name, status: table.status },
            identifier: '',
            customer: null,
            customer_phone: null,
            address: null
        };
        navigateToPosTab();
    }
};

const customHandleMenuAction = (actionId, order) => {
    if (actionId === 'new_subaccount') {
        contextMenuVisible.value = false;
        orderType.value = 'table';
        draftRouting.value = {
            order_id: null,
            existing_order_id: null,
            type: 'table',
            table: { id: order.dining_table_id || order.table_id || null, name: order.table_number },
            identifier: 'Nova Conta',
            customer: null,
            customer_phone: null,
            address: null
        };
        navigateToPosTab();
    } else {
        handleMenuAction(actionId, order);
    }
};

const { handleItemDuplicate, handleItemModify, handleItemSwap, handleItemCancel } = useItemActions(selectedOrderContext, contextMenuVisible, '/pos');

const handleItemModifyWithTabSwitch = (payload) => {
    handleItemModify(payload);
    navigateToPosTab();
};

const handleItemSwapWithTabSwitch = (payload) => {
    handleItemSwap(payload);
    navigateToPosTab();
};

const handleItemReprint = (item) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.print-item', item.id), {}, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: (pageProps) => {
            if (pageProps.props.flash?.error) {
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Atenção', detail: pageProps.props.flash.error, life: 4000 });
            } else {
                toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Reimpressão', detail: `Via de ${item.product_name || item.name} enviada para a produção!`, life: 3000 });
            }
        }
    });
};

const handleKeydown = (e) => {
    const activeTag = document.activeElement.tagName;
    if (activeTag === 'INPUT' || activeTag === 'TEXTAREA') return;
    if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'n') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleNewOrder();
    }
};

const handleTabReset = (e) => {
    if (e.detail === 'orders') {
        focusedOrderId.value = null;
    }
};

const handleCloseOrderDetails = () => {
    focusedOrderId.value = null;
};

const handleWaiterCalled = (event) => {
    toast.add({
        severity: 'warn',
        summary: `🔔 Chamada: ${event.table_name || 'Mesa'}`,
        detail: `${event.customer_name || 'Cliente'} está solicitando atendimento na mesa!`,
        life: 10000
    });

    try {
        const audio = new Audio('/sounds/notification.mp3');
        audio.play().catch(() => {});
    } catch (err) {}
};

onMounted(() => {
    isMounted.value = true;
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
    window.addEventListener('pos-tab-reset', handleTabReset);
    window.addEventListener('pos-close-order-details', handleCloseOrderDetails);

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (urlParams.get('open_order') && props.initialOrders) {
        const orderToOpen = props.initialOrders.find(o => o.id == urlParams.get('open_order'));
        if (orderToOpen) {
            focusedOrderId.value = orderToOpen.id;
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
        }
    }

    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';

    window.Echo.channel(`tenant.${tenantId}.operations`)
        .listen('.waiter.called', handleWaiterCalled);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';

    window.Echo.leaveChannel(`tenant.${tenantId}.orders`);
    window.Echo.leaveChannel(`tenant.${tenantId}.operations`);

    window.removeEventListener('pos-tab-reset', handleTabReset);
    window.removeEventListener('pos-close-order-details', handleCloseOrderDetails);
});
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, onMounted, computed } from 'vue';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import DesktopLayout from '@/Layouts/DesktopLayout.vue';

import ExpandableSearch from "@/Components/UI/ExpandableSearch.vue";
import SegmentedControl from "@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue";
import EmptyState from "@/Components/UI/EmptyState.vue";
import InventoryCard from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Catalog/InventoryCard.vue";

import { useAvailability } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useAvailability";

defineOptions({ layout: DesktopLayout });

const props = defineProps({
    catalog: Array,
    isActive: {
        type: Boolean,
        default: false
    }
});

const toast = useToast();
const isMounted = ref(false);

onMounted(() => {
    isMounted.value = true;
});

const portalTarget = computed(() => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
    return document.getElementById('dynamic-island-portal') ? '#dynamic-island-portal' : null;
});

const typeFilters = [
    { label: 'Revenda', value: 'resale', icon: 'pi-shopping-bag' },
    { label: 'Insumos', value: 'ingredients', icon: 'pi-apple' },
    { label: 'Suprimentos', value: 'supplies', icon: 'pi-box' },
];

const catalogRef = computed(() => props.catalog || []);

const {
    selectedLocation,
    selectedType,
    searchQuery,
    locationOptions,
    groupedCatalog
} = useAvailability(catalogRef, toast);

if (selectedType.value === 'all') {
    selectedType.value = 'resale';
}

const formattedLocationOptions = computed(() => {
    return (locationOptions.value || []).map(loc => ({
        label: loc.critical > 0 ? `${loc.label} (${loc.critical})` : loc.label,
        value: loc.value,
        icon: loc.critical > 0 ? 'pi-exclamation-triangle' : (loc.value === 'all' ? 'pi-globe' : 'pi-map-marker')
    }));
});

const handleStatusUpdate = (payload) => {
    router.post(route('operations.availability.toggle'), {
        product_id: payload.item.id,
        action: payload.action,
        new_stock: payload.new_stock
    }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed } from "vue";
import { usePage, router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import draggable from "vuedraggable";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";

import ManagerAuthModal from "@/Pages/Gateway/Components/ManagerAuthModal.vue";
import KdsItemCard from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsItemCard.vue";
import KdsBarCard from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsBarCard.vue";
import KdsColumnSettingsModal from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsColumnSettingsModal.vue";
import KdsLossModal from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsLossModal.vue";
import KdsCancelModal from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsCancelModal.vue";
import { useKds } from "@/Pages/Kds/Composables/useKds";

const props = defineProps({
    kitchens: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    activeKitchenId: { type: [Number, String], default: 'all' },
    initialItems: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    readonly: { type: Boolean, default: false },
});

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const {
    isSettingsOpen, tempColumns, activeColumns, columnsData, currentTime,
    openSettings, addColumn, removeColumn, setFinalColumn, saveColumns,
    onDragChange, clearReadyItems
} = useKds(props);

// Avaliação do Modo Bar vs Modo Cozinha
const activeKitchenObj = computed(() => {
    if (props.activeKitchenId === 'all') return null;
    return props.kitchens.find(k => String(k.id) === String(props.activeKitchenId));
});

const isBarMode = computed(() => activeKitchenObj.value?.type === 'bar');

const barItems = computed(() => {
    let items = [];
    Object.values(columnsData.value).forEach(colArray => {
        items = items.concat(colArray);
    });
    return items.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
});

// Ações Conectadas às Rotas do Ziggy
const handleCompleteBarItem = (item) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.update-status', item.id), { production_status: 'delivered' }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            void(0)
        }
    });
};

const isLossModalVisible = ref(false);
const isCancelModalVisible = ref(false);
const selectedKdsItem = ref(null);

const handlePrintItem = (item) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.print-item', item.id), {}, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            void(0)
        }
    });
};

const openLossModal = (item) => {
    selectedKdsItem.value = item;
    isLossModalVisible.value = true;
};

const openCancelModal = (item) => {
    selectedKdsItem.value = item;
    isCancelModalVisible.value = true;
};

const submitLoss = (lossData) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.loss', selectedKdsItem.value.id), lossData, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: false,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isLossModalVisible.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Perda Registrada', detail: 'Desperdício debitado do estoque.', life: 3000 });
        }
    });
};

const submitCancel = (cancelData) => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.cancel', selectedKdsItem.value.id), cancelData, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: false,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isCancelModalVisible.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Item Cancelado', detail: 'Comanda atualizada com sucesso.', life: 3000 });
        }
    });
};

const getKitchenName = (id) => {
    if (!id) return 'Sem Praça';
    const kit = props.kitchens?.find(k => String(k.id) === String(id));
    return kit ? kit.name : '';
};

// Autorização do Gestor para Configurar Colunas
const isAuthModalVisible = ref(false);
const requestSettingsAccess = () => { isAuthModalVisible.value = true; };
const handleAuthConfirm = (authData) => {
    isAuthModalVisible.value = false;
    if (authData?.password && authData.password.length >= 3) {
        openSettings();
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';

    if (window.Echo) {
        window.Echo.channel(`tenant.${tenantId}.kds`)
            .listen('.items.created', (e) => {
                (e.items || []).forEach(newItem => {
                    if (props.activeKitchenId !== 'all' && String(newItem.kitchen_id) !== String(props.activeKitchenId)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    const targetStatus = newItem.production_status || 'pending';
                    if (columnsData.value && columnsData.value[targetStatus]) {
                        const exists = columnsData.value[targetStatus].some(item => item.id === newItem.id);
                        if (!exists) {
                            columnsData.value[targetStatus].unshift(newItem);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';
    if (window.Echo) {
        window.Echo.leaveChannel(`tenant.${tenantId}.kds`);
    }
});
</script>
```
