<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import { router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import DesktopLayout from "@/Layouts/DesktopLayout.vue";
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatPhone } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useViewport } from "@/Composables/useViewport";

import CheckoutHeader from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutHeader.vue";
import CheckoutItemsList from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutItemsList.vue";
import OrderActionsGrid from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderActionsGrid.vue";
import OperationReasonModal from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/OperationReasonModal.vue";
import TransferItemsModal from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/TransferItemsModal.vue";
import OrderTransformer from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderTransformer.vue";
import PaymentIntentModal from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/PaymentIntentModal.vue";
import ChangeAddressModal from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/ChangeAddressModal.vue";
import AssignCourierModal from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/AssignCourierModal.vue";
import NewAddressModal from "@/Components/Modals/NewAddressModal.vue";
import PosTeleportButton from "@/Components/UI/PosTeleportButton.vue";

import { useSecureAction } from "@/Composables/useSecureAction";
import { useItemActions } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useItemActions";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";
import { useWhatsAppMessages } from "@/Composables/useWhatsAppMessages";
import { useOrderDetailsOrchestrator } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderDetailsOrchestrator";

defineOptions({ layout: DesktopLayout });

const props = defineProps({
    order: { type: Object, required: true },
    tableAreas: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    companySettings: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    couriers: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["close"]);

const toast = useToast();
const { isMobile } = useViewport();
const isMounted = ref(false);
const itemSearchQuery = ref("");

const closeOrderDetails = () => {
    emit('close');
};

onMounted(() => {
    isMounted.value = true;
    window.addEventListener('pos-close-order-details', closeOrderDetails);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('pos-close-order-details', closeOrderDetails);
});

const isNewAddressModalVisible = ref(false);
const addressToEdit = ref(null);

const handleCreateNewAddress = () => {
    addressToEdit.value = null;
    if (isMobile.value) {
        isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = false;
        setTimeout(() => { isNewAddressModalVisible.value = true; }, 150);
    } else {
        activeSidebarView.value = 'new_address';
    }
};

const handleEditAddress = (addr) => {
    addressToEdit.value = addr;
    if (isMobile.value) {
        isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = false;
        setTimeout(() => { isNewAddressModalVisible.value = true; }, 150);
    } else {
        activeSidebarView.value = 'new_address';
    }
};

const handleNewAddressSuccess = () => {
    isNewAddressModalVisible.value = false;
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (isMobile.value) isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = true;
        else activeSidebarView.value = 'address';
    }, 150);
};

const chipBase = "flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-black outline-none transition-colors ";
const chipInteractive = chipBase + "p-option cursor-pointer";
const chipWarning = chipBase + "bg-warning-500/10 text-warning-600 dark:text-warning-400 cursor-pointer hover:bg-warning-500/20";
const chipDanger = chipBase + "bg-danger-500/10 text-danger-700 dark:text-danger-300 cursor-pointer hover:bg-danger-500/20";

const {
    getOrderTitle, abbreviateName, formatAddress,
    parseAddress, getCustomerPhone, getPaymentBadges
} = useOrderFormatting();

const { dispatchCourier, sendWhatsApp } = useWhatsAppMessages();

const activeItemsExploded = computed(() => {
    const rawItems = props.order?.items || [];
    if (!rawItems.length) return [];

    const roots = [];
    const orphanChildren = [];

    rawItems.forEach(item => {
        if (item.status === 'cancelled') return;

        if (item.parent_item_id) {
            orphanChildren.push(item);
        } else {
            roots.push({ ...item });
        }
    });

    const result = [];

    roots.forEach(parent => {
        result.push({
            ...parent,
            available_parts: Number(parent.quantity || 1),
            selected_parts: Number(parent.quantity || 1),
            parts_per_unit: 1,
            effective_unit_price: Number(parent.unit_price || 0)
        });

        const dbChildren = orphanChildren.filter(c => String(c.parent_item_id) === String(parent.id));
        const embeddedChildren = parent.sub_items || parent.subItems || parent.combo_items || parent.comboChildren || [];

        const allChildrenMap = new Map();
        [...dbChildren, ...embeddedChildren].forEach(c => {
            if (c && c.id && c.status !== 'cancelled') {
                allChildrenMap.set(c.id, c);
            }
        });

        allChildrenMap.forEach(child => {
            result.push({
                ...child,
                is_combo_child: true,
                combo_parent_id: parent.id,
                combo_parent_name: parent.product_name || parent.name,
                effective_unit_price: 0,
                unit_price: 0,
                total_price: 0,
                available_parts: Number(child.quantity || parent.quantity || 1),
                selected_parts: Number(child.quantity || parent.quantity || 1),
                parts_per_unit: 1
            });
        });
    });

    orphanChildren.forEach(child => {
        if (!result.some(r => r.id === child.id)) {
            result.push({
                ...child,
                is_combo_child: true,
                effective_unit_price: 0,
                unit_price: 0,
                total_price: 0,
                available_parts: Number(child.quantity || 1),
                selected_parts: Number(child.quantity || 1),
                parts_per_unit: 1
            });
        }
    });

    return result;
});

const {
    activeSidebarView, selectedItemIds, isTransferModalVisible,
    isTransformerVisible, isPaymentModalVisible, isChangeAddressModalVisible,
    isCourierSwapModalVisible, transferItemIds, toggleItemSelection, toggleSelectAllItems,
    handleAction, openSingleTransfer, handleExecuteTransfer, handleTransformation,
    handleUpdatePayment, handleChangeAddressConfirm, handleDeactivateAddress,
    handleAssignCourier, executeBulkAction
} = useOrderDetailsOrchestrator(props, activeItemsExploded);

const assignedCourier = computed(() => {
    if (!props.order?.driver_id) return null;
    return props.couriers.find(c => c.id === props.order.driver_id);
});

const pendingDispatch = ref(false);
const executeCourierDispatch = () => {
    const courier = assignedCourier.value;
    if (!courier) {
        pendingDispatch.value = true;
        toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Atenção', detail: 'Vincule o entregador primeiro.' });
        if (isMobile.value) isCourierSwapModalVisible.value = true;
        else activeSidebarView.value = 'courier_swap';
        return;
    }
    if (!courier.phone) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Sem WhatsApp cadastrado.' });
        return;
    }
    dispatchCourier(props.order, courier.phone);
};

const cancelAssignmentModal = () => {
    pendingDispatch.value = false;
    if (!isMobile.value) activeSidebarView.value = 'menu';
};

const triggerCourierAssignment = (courier) => {
    handleAssignCourier(courier, (assignedData) => {
        if (pendingDispatch.value) {
            pendingDispatch.value = false;
            if (assignedData.phone) setTimeout(() => dispatchCourier(props.order, assignedData.phone), 300);
            else toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Motoboy vinculado não possui WhatsApp.' });
        }
    });
};

const formattedOrderTitle = computed(() => getOrderTitle(props.order));
const isGuestUser = computed(() => !props.order?.customer_id && ['counter', 'delivery'].includes(props.order?.type));

const parsedAddressData = computed(() => parseAddress(props.order?.address));
const displayAddressText = computed(() => parsedAddressData.value ? (formatAddress(props.order) || 'Endereço sem detalhes') : '+ Adicionar Endereço');

const customerPhone = computed(() => getCustomerPhone(props.order));
const hasPhone = computed(() => customerPhone.value && customerPhone.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '').length >= 10);
const openCustomerWhatsApp = () => {
    if (hasPhone.value) sendWhatsApp(customerPhone.value, `Olá! Falando do restaurante sobre o pedido #${props.order?.id}. `);
};

const isPaid = computed(() => props.order?.payment_status === 'paid');
const orderTotalPaid = computed(() => (props.order?.payments || []).reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.amount), 0));
const orderRemaining = computed(() => Math.max(0, Number(props.order?.total || 0) - orderTotalPaid.value));

const paymentMissing = computed(() => {
    if (props.order?.type === 'table' || isPaid.value) return false;
    if (props.order?.payment_intent_status && props.order?.payment_intent_status !== 'pending_choice') return false;
    if (props.order?.payments && props.order?.payments.length > 0) return false;
    return true;
});

const parsedPaymentBadges = computed(() => getPaymentBadges(props.order));
const translatedType = computed(() => {
    const t = { table: "Mesa", counter: "Balcão", delivery: "Delivery" };
    return t[props.order?.type] || "";
});

const dummyRef = ref(true);
const { handleItemDuplicate, handleItemModify, handleItemSwap, handleItemCancel } = useItemActions(
    computed(() => props.order),
    dummyRef,
    'pos.index'
);

const { isReasonModalVisible, itemToProcess, authActionType, authNeedsPin, initiateSecureAction } = useSecureAction(
    props.companySettings
);

const handleItemReprint = (item, qty = 'all') => {
    router.post(route('operations.kds.print-item', item.id), {
        qty: qty
    }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => void(0),
        onError: (err) => toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Falha na Impressão', detail: Object.values(err)[0] || 'Erro ao enviar para o spooler.' })
    });
};

const handlePrintDeliveryDispatch = () => {
    router.post(route('operations.orders.print-delivery', props.order.id), {}, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            void(0)
        },
        onError: (err) => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Falha na Impressão', detail: Object.values(err)[0] || 'Erro ao enviar para o spooler.', life: 4000 });
        }
    });
};

const triggerSecureAction = (item, type, qty = 'all') => {
    if (item) item.action_qty = qty;
    initiateSecureAction(item, type);
    if (!isMobile.value) {
        isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
        setTimeout(() => activeSidebarView.value = 'reason', 50);
    }
};

const handleItemAction = (payload) => {
    const { type, item, qty = 'all' } = payload;
    if (item) item.action_qty = qty;

    if (type === 'reprint') {
        handleItemReprint(item, qty);
    } else if (type === 'duplicate') {
        handleItemDuplicate(item);
    } else if (type === 'edit') {
        triggerSecureAction(item, 'edit', qty);
    } else if (type === 'transfer') {
        if (item) item.transfer_qty = qty;
        openSingleTransfer(item);
    } else if (type === 'cancel') {
        triggerSecureAction(item, 'cancel', qty);
    }
};

const handleDirectReprint = (item) => handleItemReprint(item, 'all');

const handleFinishOrder = () => {
    router.post(route('operations.orders.update-status', props.order.id), {
        status: 'closed'
    }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Pedido Finalizado', detail: `Pedido #${props.order.id} concluído e arquivado no histórico.`, life: 3000 });
            closeOrderDetails();
        },
        onError: (err) => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro ao Finalizar', detail: Object.values(err)[0] || 'Não foi possível finalizar o pedido.', life: 4000 });
        }
    });
};

const handleGridAction = (actionId) => {
    if (actionId === 'add_items') {
        const orderData = props.order;
        const newUrl = `/pos?append_to_order=${orderData.id}`;
        window.history.pushState({ tab: 'pos' }, '', newUrl);
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-append-to-order', { detail: orderData }));
        closeOrderDetails();
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'pos' }));
        return;
    }

    if (actionId === 'dispatch_courier') executeCourierDispatch();
    else if (['print_delivery', 'print_dispatch', 'print_courier', 'delivery_dispatch', 'print_driver', 'print_motoboy'].includes(actionId)) handlePrintDeliveryDispatch();
    else if (actionId === 'cancel_order') triggerSecureAction(props.order, 'cancel_order');
    else if (actionId === 'finish_order') handleFinishOrder();
    else handleAction(actionId);
};

const handleConfirmAuth = (authData) => {
    const qty = itemToProcess.value?.action_qty || 'all';

    if (authActionType.value === 'edit') {
        handleItemModify({ item: itemToProcess.value, authData, action_qty: qty });
    } else if (authActionType.value === 'swap') {
        handleItemSwap({ item: itemToProcess.value, authData, action_qty: qty });
    } else if (authActionType.value === 'cancel_order') {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.cancel', itemToProcess.value.id), {
            reason: authData.reason,
            is_loss: authData.isLoss,
            lost_items: authData.lostItems,
            pin: authData.password
        }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
                toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Pedido Cancelado', detail: 'O pedido foi estornado e encerrado.', life: 4000 });
                closeOrderDetails();
            },
            onError: (err) => {
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: err.pin || 'Erro ao cancelar.', life: 4000 });
            }
        });
    } else {
        handleItemCancel({
            item: itemToProcess.value,
            action_qty: qty,
            isLoss: authData.isLoss,
            reason: authData.reason,
            password: authData.password
        });
    }

    isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
    activeSidebarView.value = 'menu';
    selectedItemIds.value = [];
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.fade-enter-active, .fade-leave-active { transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; }
.fade-enter-from, .fade-leave-to { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.98); }
</style>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { formatPhone, formatCurrency, getInitials } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    customer: Object,
    address: Object,
    customers: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'change-customer',
    'select-address',
    'open-new-address',
    'apply'
]);

const toast = useToast();

const customerAddresses = computed(() => {
    if (!props.customer) return [];
    const fresh = props.customers.find(c => c.id === props.customer.id);
    return fresh?.addresses || props.customer.addresses || [];
});

// Filtra apenas os endereços ativos (is_active !== false e !== 0)
const activeAddresses = computed(() => {
    return customerAddresses.value.filter(a => a.is_active !== false && a.is_active !== 0 && a.is_active !== '0');
});

const isReadyToApply = computed(() => Boolean(props.customer && props.address));

const confirmDelivery = () => {
    if (!isReadyToApply.value) return;
    emit('apply', {
        type: 'delivery',
        customer: props.customer,
        address: props.address
    });
};

const handleDeactivateAddress = (addr) => {
    const addressName = addr.full_address || addr.street?.name || addr.street || 'este endereço';
    if (!confirm(`Deseja realmente inativar ${addressName}?`)) return;

    // Se o endereço inativado for o atualmente selecionado no rascunho, desmarca-o
    if (props.address?.id === addr.id) {
        emit('select-address', null);
    }

    // Caso 1: Endereço temporário em memória
    if (addr.is_temporary || String(addr.id).startsWith('temp_')) {
        const idx = props.customer.addresses?.findIndex(a => a.id === addr.id);
        if (idx !== undefined && idx > -1) {
            props.customer.addresses.splice(idx, 1);
        }
        toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Removido', detail: 'Endereço temporário descartado.', life: 3000 });
        return;
    }

    // Caso 2: Endereço persistido no banco de dados
    const customerId = props.customer.id;
    router.post(route('operations.customers.addresses.deactivate', [customerId, addr.id]), {}, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            addr.is_active = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Inativado', detail: 'Endereço removido da lista.', life: 3000 });
        },
        onError: () => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Não foi possível inativar o endereço.', life: 4000 });
        }
    });
};
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { useCustomerRegistration } from "@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerRegistration";
import { formatPhone, formatCpfCnpj } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    companySettings: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    customers: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    initialName: { type: String, default: '' },
    orderType: { type: String, default: 'delivery' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['success']);
const toast = useToast();
const isSubmitting = ref(false);

// 🚀 No PDV, se a regra for 'customer_only', o CPF é opcional ('basic')
const registrationMode = computed(() => {
    const mode = props.companySettings?.customer_registration_mode || 'basic';
    if (mode === 'customer_only') {
        return 'basic';
    }
    return mode;
});

const isSerproMagic = computed(() => registrationMode.value === 'serpro_magic');
const isCpfRequired = computed(() => registrationMode.value === 'cpf_required');

const {
    form,
    serproStep,
    isLoadingSerpro,
    isCpfValid,
    isPhoneValid,
    isFormValid,
    isMinorError,
    existingAccount,
    reqWhatsapp,
    reqBirthDate,
    formatCpfInput,
    formatPhoneInput,
    lookupSerpro,
    resetForm
} = useCustomerRegistration(registrationMode, { isCustomerMode: false });

watch(() => props.initialName, (val) => {
    if (val && !form.value.name) {
        form.value.name = val;
    }
}, { immediate: true });

const resolvedExistingCustomer = computed(() => {
    if (serproStep.value !== 'cpf_exists') return null;

    const rawCpf = String(form.value.cpf || '').replace(/\D/g, '');

    if (existingAccount.value?.customer) return existingAccount.value.customer;
    if (existingAccount.value?.data?.id) return existingAccount.value.data;
    if (existingAccount.value?.id) return existingAccount.value;

    if (rawCpf && props.customers?.length > 0) {
        const found = props.customers.find(c => {
            const cCpf = String(c.cpf || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            return cCpf === rawCpf;
        });
        if (found) return found;
    }

    return {
        id: existingAccount.value?.id || null,
        name: existingAccount.value?.name || form.value.name || 'Cliente Cadastrado',
        phone: existingAccount.value?.phone || form.value.phone || '',
        cpf: form.value.cpf
    };
});

const chooseExistingCustomer = () => {
    if (!resolvedExistingCustomer.value) return;

    toast.add({
        severity: 'info',
        summary: 'Cliente Vinculado',
        detail: `${resolvedExistingCustomer.value.name} foi selecionado para o pedido.`,
        life: 3000
    });

    emit('success', resolvedExistingCustomer.value);
    resetForm();
};

const submit = () => {
    if (!isFormValid.value || isMinorError.value || isSubmitting.value) return;

    isSubmitting.value = true;

    router.post(route('operations.customers.store'), form.value, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: (res) => {
            const created = res.props.flash?.createdCustomer || { ...form.value };
            toast.add({
                severity: 'success',
                summary: 'Cliente Cadastrado',
                detail: `${created.name} pronto para delivery.`,
                life: 3000
            });
            emit('success', created);
            resetForm();
        },
        onError: (err) => {
            const msg = Object.values(err)[0] || 'Verifique as informações do formulário.';
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro no Cadastro', detail: msg, life: 5000 });
        },
        onFinish: () => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
        }
    });
};

const formatDate = (isoString) => {
    if (!isoString) return '';
    const parts = isoString.split('-');
    if (parts.length === 3) return `${parts[2]}/${parts[1]}/${parts[0]}`;
    return isoString;
};
</script>

            :class="isValid && !isSubmitting

        >

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';

const props = defineProps({
    companySettings: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    customers: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    orderType: { type: String, default: 'delivery' },
    allowEmptyPhone: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['success']);

const toast = useToast();
const name = ref('');
const phone = ref('');
const isSubmitting = ref(false);
const nameInputRef = ref(null);

const isCounter = computed(() => props.orderType === 'counter' || props.allowEmptyPhone);

const rawPhone = computed(() => String(phone.value || '').replace(/\D/g, ''));

const isValid = computed(() => {
    const hasName = name.value.trim().length >= 2;
    if (!hasName) return false;

    // No balcão: Se vazio, é válido. Se preenchido, exige 10 ou 11 dígitos.
    if (isCounter.value) {
        if (!rawPhone.value) return true;
        return rawPhone.value.length >= 10 && rawPhone.value.length <= 11;
    }

    // No delivery: WhatsApp é sempre obrigatório
    return rawPhone.value.length >= 10 && rawPhone.value.length <= 11;
});

const handleEnterKey = () => {
    if (isCounter.value && !phone.value) {
        handleSubmit();
    }
};

const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!isValid.value || isSubmitting.value) return;

    isSubmitting.value = true;
    const cleanPhoneVal = rawPhone.value ? rawPhone.value : null;

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('customer.auth.guest-register'), {
            name: name.value.trim(),
            phone: cleanPhoneVal,
            channel: props.orderType
        });

        const createdCustomer = response.data?.customer || {
            id: response.data?.id || `temp_${Date.now()}`,
            name: name.value.trim(),
            phone: cleanPhoneVal,
            is_temporary: true
        };

        toast.add({
            severity: 'success',
            summary: 'Cliente Definido',
            detail: `${createdCustomer.name} vinculado ao pedido.`,
            life: 3000
        });

        emit('success', createdCustomer);
    } catch (e) {
        // Fallback local caso o endpoint falhe ou crie cliente em memória
        const localCustomer = {
            id: null,
            name: name.value.trim(),
            phone: cleanPhoneVal,
            is_temporary: true
        };

        emit('success', localCustomer);
    } finally {
        isSubmitting.value = false;
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    if (nameInputRef.value) {
        nameInputRef.value.focus();
    }
});
</script>

            <div
                v-for="c in filteredCustomers"
                :key="c.id"
                @click="$emit('select', c)"
                class="p-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-surface-3 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between transition-colors group"
            >
                <div class="flex flex-col">
                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-surface-text group-hover:text-primary-smart transition-colors">{{ c.name }}</span>
                    <span class="text-xs font-medium text-surface-muted">{{ formatPhone(c.phone) || c.cpf || 'Sem telefone' }}</span>
                </div>
                <i class="pi pi-chevron-right text-xs text-surface-muted/40 group-hover:text-primary-smart transition-colors"></i>
            </div>

                <button
                    type="button"
                    @click="$emit('go-to-new', searchQuery)"
                    class="text-xs font-black text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-400 hover:underline uppercase tracking-wider bg-transparent border-none cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mx-auto"
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-user-plus text-xs"></i>
                    <span>Não encontrou? Cadastrar "{{ searchQuery }}"</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div v-else class="p-4 text-center text-xs text-surface-muted">
            Digite pelo menos 2 caracteres para localizar o cliente.
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import Fuse from 'fuse.js';
import { formatPhone } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    customers: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

defineEmits(['select', 'go-to-new']);

const searchQuery = ref('');

const customerFuse = computed(() => {
    return new Fuse(props.customers || [], {
        keys: [
            { name: 'name', weight: 0.7 },
            { name: 'phone', weight: 0.3 },
            { name: 'cpf', weight: 0.3 }
        ],
        threshold: 0.35,
        distance: 100,
        ignoreLocation: true,
        minMatchCharLength: 2
    });
});

const filteredCustomers = computed(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.value.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) return [];

    const digitsOnly = q.replace(/\D/g, '');
    const cleanChars = q.replace(/[\s\-\(\)\.]/g, '');

    // Se a busca for predominantemente números (DDD, telefone ou CPF)
    if (digitsOnly.length >= 2 && digitsOnly.length === cleanChars.length) {
        return props.customers.filter(c => {
            const cleanPhone = (c.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            const cleanCpf = (c.cpf || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            return cleanPhone.includes(digitsOnly) || cleanCpf.includes(digitsOnly);
        });
    }

    // Busca difusa para nomes
    return customerFuse.value.search(q).map(hit => hit.item);
});
</script>

                />

<script setup>
import { ref, reactive, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import Fuse from 'fuse.js';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';
import SearchAutocomplete from '@/Components/UI/SearchAutocomplete.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    customerId: [Number, String],
    customerName: String,
    streets: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'success']);

const streetSearchText = ref('');
const streetResults = ref([]);
const selectedStreet = ref(null);
const isSubmitting = ref(false);

const form = reactive({
    street_id: null,
    neighborhood_id: null,
    number: '',
    no_number: false,
    complement: '',
    reference: ''
});

// =====================================
// ÍNDICE FUZZY SEARCH (FUSE.JS)
// =====================================
const fuseInstance = computed(() => {
    return new Fuse(props.streets, {
        keys: [
            { name: 'name', weight: 0.7 },
            { name: 'neighborhood.name', weight: 0.3 },
            { name: 'segments.neighborhood.name', weight: 0.3 }
        ],
        threshold: 0.35, // 0.0 é correspondência exata, 1.0 aceita qualquer coisa
        distance: 100,
        ignoreLocation: true,
        minMatchCharLength: 2,
        useExtendedSearch: false
    });
});

const handleStreetSearch = (term) => {
    const q = (term || '').trim();
    if (!q || q.length < 2) {
        streetResults.value = [];
        return;
    }

    const searchHits = fuseInstance.value.search(q);
    // Limita aos 15 melhores resultados e desembrulha o objeto do Fuse
    streetResults.value = searchHits.slice(0, 15).map(hit => hit.item);
};

const handleStreetSelect = (street) => {
    selectedStreet.value = street;
    form.street_id = street.id;

    form.neighborhood_id = street.neighborhood_id
        || street.neighborhood?.id
        || street.segments?.[0]?.neighborhood_id
        || street.segments?.[0]?.neighborhood?.id
        || null;

    streetSearchText.value = street.name;
};

watch(streetSearchText, (val) => {
    if (!val || (selectedStreet.value && val !== selectedStreet.value.name)) {
        selectedStreet.value = null;
        form.street_id = null;
        form.neighborhood_id = null;
    }
});

// =====================================
// COMPUTADOS E VALIDAÇÕES
// =====================================
const detectedNeighborhoodName = computed(() => {
    if (!selectedStreet.value) return null;
    if (form.neighborhood_id && selectedStreet.value.segments) {
        const seg = selectedStreet.value.segments.find(s => s.neighborhood_id === form.neighborhood_id || s.neighborhood?.id === form.neighborhood_id);
        if (seg) return seg.neighborhood?.name || seg.neighborhood;
    }
    return selectedStreet.value?.neighborhood?.name
        || selectedStreet.value?.segments?.[0]?.neighborhood?.name
        || null;
});

const detectedDeliveryFee = computed(() => {
    if (!selectedStreet.value) return 0;
    if (form.neighborhood_id && selectedStreet.value.segments) {
        const seg = selectedStreet.value.segments.find(s => s.neighborhood_id === form.neighborhood_id || s.neighborhood?.id === form.neighborhood_id);
        if (seg) return Number(seg.neighborhood?.delivery_fee ?? 0);
    }
    const fee = selectedStreet.value?.neighborhood?.delivery_fee
        ?? selectedStreet.value?.segments?.[0]?.neighborhood?.delivery_fee
        ?? 0;
    return Number(fee);
});

watch(() => form.number, () => { resolvePosSegment(); });
watch(() => form.no_number, () => { resolvePosSegment(); });

const resolvePosSegment = () => {
    const street = selectedStreet.value;
    if (!street || !street.segments || street.segments.length === 0) return;

    if (street.segments.length === 1) {
        form.neighborhood_id = street.segments[0].neighborhood_id || street.segments[0].neighborhood?.id || null;
        return;
    }

    const num = parseInt(form.number);
    let matched = null;

    if (!form.no_number && !isNaN(num)) {
        matched = street.segments.find(s => {
            const start = parseInt(s.start_number) || 0;
            const end = s.end_number ? parseInt(s.end_number) : Infinity;
            return num >= start && num <= end;
        });
    }

    if (!matched) matched = street.segments[0];

    if (matched) {
        form.neighborhood_id = matched.neighborhood_id || matched.neighborhood?.id || null;
    }
};

const handleNoNumberChange = () => {
    if (form.no_number) form.number = '';
};

const canSubmit = computed(() => {
    const hasStreet = !!form.street_id;
    const hasNumber = form.no_number || form.number.trim() !== '';
    const hasComplement = !form.no_number || form.complement.trim() !== '';

    return hasStreet && hasNumber && hasComplement;
});

const isTemporaryCustomer = computed(() => {
    return !props.customerId || String(props.customerId).startsWith('temp_');
});

// =====================================
// SUBMISSÃO
// =====================================
const close = () => {
    emit('update:visible', false);
};

const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!canSubmit.value) return;
    isSubmitting.value = true;

    const streetName = selectedStreet.value?.name || streetSearchText.value || 'Logradouro';
    const neighborhoodName = detectedNeighborhoodName.value || 'Bairro';

    // 1. Cliente em Memória (Rascunho Rápido)
    if (isTemporaryCustomer.value) {
        const tempAddress = {
            id: `temp_addr_${Date.now()}`,
            is_temporary: true,
            nickname: 'Casa',
            street_id: form.street_id,
            neighborhood_id: form.neighborhood_id,
            street: selectedStreet.value,
            neighborhood: selectedStreet.value?.neighborhood || selectedStreet.value?.segments?.[0]?.neighborhood,
            number: form.no_number ? 'S/N' : form.number,
            no_number: form.no_number,
            noNumber: form.no_number,
            complement: form.complement,
            reference: form.reference,
            delivery_fee: detectedDeliveryFee.value,
            full_address: `${streetName}, ${form.no_number ? 'S/N' : form.number}${form.complement ? ' - ' + form.complement : ''}`
        };

        setTimeout(() => {
            emit('success', tempAddress);
            isSubmitting.value = false;
            close();
        }, 200);
        return;
    }

    // 2. Cliente Persistido no Banco de Dados
    const payload = {
        nickname: 'Casa',
        street: streetName,
        street_id: form.street_id,
        number: form.no_number ? 'S/N' : form.number,
        noNumber: Boolean(form.no_number),
        no_number: Boolean(form.no_number),
        neighborhood: neighborhoodName,
        neighborhood_id: form.neighborhood_id,
        complement: form.complement || null,
        reference: form.reference || null
    };

    router.post(route('operations.customers.addresses.store', props.customerId), payload, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: (page) => {

                        <input

                            placeholder="000.000.000-00"

                    </button>
                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        :disabled="isSubmitting"
                        class="h-12 px-6 rounded-xl bg-primary-500 hover:bg-primary-600 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2 border-none cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                        <i v-if="isSubmitting" class="pi pi-spinner pi-spin text-xs"></i>

<script setup>
import { ref, reactive, watch, nextTick } from 'vue';
import { formatPhone, formatCpfCnpj } from '@/Utils/formatters';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    initialQuery: { type: String, default: '' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'success']);

const nameInput = ref(null);
const isSubmitting = ref(false);

const form = reactive({
    name: '',
    phone: '',
    cpf: ''
});

watch(() => props.visible, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) {
        // Pré-preenche se o operador digitou número de telefone ou nome no campo de busca
        const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(props.initialQuery.replace(/\D/g, ''));
        if (isNumeric && props.initialQuery.length >= 8) {
            form.phone = formatPhone(props.initialQuery);
            form.name = '';
        } else {
            form.name = props.initialQuery || '';
            form.phone = '';
        }
        form.cpf = '';

        nextTick(() => nameInput.value?.focus());
    }
});

const handlePhoneInput = (e) => {
    form.phone = formatPhone(e.target.value);
};

const handleCpfInput = (e) => {
    form.cpf = formatCpfCnpj(e.target.value);
};

const close = () => {
    emit('update:visible', false);
};

const handleSubmit = () => {
    isSubmitting.value = true;

    router.post(route('operations.customers.store'), form, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: (page) => {
            const createdCustomer = page.props.flash?.createdCustomer;
            emit('success', createdCustomer || { ...form });
            close();
        },
        onFinish: () => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
        }
    });
};
</script>

            </span>

            >

            </span>
        </div>

        <!-- 🚀 COLUNA 3: BOTÕES DE AÇÃO (Sempre visíveis, 1 lápis e 1 lixeira) -->
        <div class="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5">

                type="button"
                @click.stop.prevent="$emit('edit', address)"
                class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all outline-none cursor-pointer"
                :class="isSelected
                    ? 'hover:bg-primary-500/40'
                    : 'hover:text-primary-smart hover:bg-surface-3/20'
                "
                title="Editar Endereço"
            >
                <i class="pi pi-pencil text-xs"></i>
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                @click.stop.prevent="handleDeactivate"
                class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all outline-none cursor-pointer"
                :class="isSelected
                ? 'hover:bg-primary-500/40'
                : 'hover:text-primary-smart hover:bg-surface-3/20'
                "
                title="Excluir Endereço"
            >
                <i class="pi pi-trash text-xs"></i>
            </button>

<script setup>
import { computed, onMounted } from "vue";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";

const props = defineProps({
    address: { type: Object, required: true },
    isSelected: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    customerId: [Number, String]
});

const emit = defineEmits(['select', 'deactivate', 'edit']);

const { formatAddress } = useOrderFormatting();

// 🚀 FORMATADOR DINÂMICO REAPROVEITADO
const displayAddress = computed(() => {
    // O formatAddress espera um objeto order, mas podemos passar um "fake order" só com a propriedade address!
    return formatAddress({ address: props.address }) || 'Endereço sem detalhes';
});

// 🚀 FORMATADOR DINÂMICO PARA A TAXA DE ENTREGA
const displayFee = computed(() => {
    let fee = 0;
    if (props.address.delivery_fee !== undefined && props.address.delivery_fee !== null) {
        fee = Number(props.address.delivery_fee);
    } else if (props.address.neighborhood?.delivery_fee !== undefined) {
        fee = Number(props.address.neighborhood.delivery_fee);
    }
    return fee === 0 ? "Grátis" : formatCurrency(fee);
});

const nicknameColorClass = computed(() => {
    const nick = String(props.address?.nickname || 'Casa').toLowerCase();
    if (props.isSelected) return 'bg-white/20 text-white border-white/10';
    if (nick === 'trabalho') return 'bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 border-purple-500/20';
    if (nick === 'outro') return 'bg-warning-500/10 text-warning-600 dark:text-warning-400 border-warning-500/20';
    return 'bg-primary-500/10 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-400 border-primary-500/20';
});

const handleDeactivate = () => {
    if (confirm(`Deseja realmente remover este endereço de ${props.address.nickname || 'Casa'} da lista?`)) {
        emit('deactivate', props.address.id);
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    console.log('🕵️‍♂️ [SONDA 2 - AddressCard] Dados brutos do endereço injetado:', props.address);
});
</script>

    customers: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    streets: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    editOrderData: { type: Object, default: null },
    isWaiterMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isGiftFilterActive: { type: Boolean, default: false },
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'update-qty',
    'clear-cart',
    'park-order',
    'edit-item',
    'checkout',
    'update:orderType',
    'routing-valid',
    'routing-meta',
    'toggle-gift-filter',
]);

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const hoveredIndex = ref(null);
const expandedStates = ref({});
const showEstimatorConfig = ref(false);

const { draftRouting: orderMetadata } = useCart();

// 🚀 COMPOSABLE DEDICADO DE ADIÇÃO DE ITENS (APPEND)
const initialOrdersRef = computed(() => page.props.initialOrders || []);
const {
    targetOrderId,
    isAppending,
    originalOrder,
    alreadyPaidAmount,
    newItemsAmount,
    balanceDue,
    wasOriginallyPaid,
    changeAnalysis
} = useOrderAppend(orderMetadata, computed(() => props.cartSubtotal), initialOrdersRef);

const isRoutingProcessOpen = ref(false);
const isRoutingValid = ref(false);

const isCustomerModalVisible = ref(false);
const customerQueryForModal = ref('');
const isAddressCreateVisible = ref(false);

const availableStreets = computed(() => {
    if (props.streets && props.streets.length > 0) return props.streets;
    return page.props.initialStreets || page.props.streets || [];
});

const selectedCustomerId = computed(() => orderMetadata.value?.customer?.id || null);
const selectedCustomerName = computed(() => orderMetadata.value?.customer?.name || 'Cliente');

watch(
    () => [props.editOrderData, orderMetadata.value?.existing_order_id],
    ([editData, existingId]) => {
        if (editData || existingId) {
            isRoutingProcessOpen.value = false;
            isRoutingValid.value = true;
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

watch(() => props.editOrderData, (editData) => {
    if (editData) {
        let targetType = editData.type || 'table';
        if (!editData.type && editData.table_number) targetType = 'table';

        let tableId = editData.dining_table_id || editData.table_id || editData.table?.id || null;
        let tableName = editData.table_number || editData.table?.name || '';

        if (!tableId && tableName && props.tableAreas?.length > 0) {
            const found = props.tableAreas
                .flatMap(a => a.tables || [])
                .find(t => String(t.name) === String(tableName) || String(t.number) === String(tableName));
            if (found) tableId = found.id;
        }

        let targetTable = targetType === 'table' ? { id: tableId, name: tableName } : null;
        let resolvedIdentifier = editData.identifier || editData.customer_name || '';

        if (targetType === 'table' && !resolvedIdentifier && targetTable?.name) {
            resolvedIdentifier = `Mesa ${targetTable.name}`;
        }

        orderMetadata.value = {
            existing_order_id: editData.id,
            order_id: editData.id,
            type: targetType,
            identifier: resolvedIdentifier,
            customer: editData.customer || (editData.customer_name ? { name: editData.customer_name, phone: editData.customer_phone } : null),
            address: editData.address || null,
            table: targetTable
        };

        isRoutingValid.value = true;
        isRoutingProcessOpen.value = false;

        emit('update:orderType', targetType);
        emit('routing-meta', orderMetadata.value);
    } else {
        if (orderMetadata.value) {
            orderMetadata.value.existing_order_id = null;
            orderMetadata.value.order_id = null;
        }
    }
}, { immediate: true, deep: true });

const handleOpenNewCustomer = (query = '') => {
    customerQueryForModal.value = query;
    isCustomerModalVisible.value = true;
};

const handleCustomerCreated = (newCustomer) => {
    orderMetadata.value = { ...orderMetadata.value, customer: newCustomer };
    emit('routing-meta', orderMetadata.value);

    if (props.orderType === 'delivery') {
        isAddressCreateVisible.value = true;
    }
};

const handleOpenNewAddress = () => {
    if (!selectedCustomerId.value) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atenção', detail: 'Selecione ou cadastre o cliente antes de adicionar um endereço.', life: 3000 });
        return;
    }
    isAddressCreateVisible.value = true;
};

const handleAddressCreated = (newAddress) => {
    isAddressCreateVisible.value = false;

    const streetName = newAddress.street?.name || newAddress.street || '';
    const neighborhoodName = newAddress.neighborhood?.name || newAddress.neighborhood || '';
    const formattedText = newAddress.full_address || `${streetName}, ${newAddress.number || 'S/N'}${neighborhoodName ? ' - ' + neighborhoodName : ''}`;

    const completeAddress = {
        ...newAddress,
        full_address: formattedText
    };

    orderMetadata.value = {
        ...orderMetadata.value,
        address: completeAddress
    };

    if (orderMetadata.value.customer?.is_temporary) {
        if (!Array.isArray(orderMetadata.value.customer.addresses)) {
            orderMetadata.value.customer.addresses = [];
        }
        orderMetadata.value.customer.addresses.push(completeAddress);
    }

    isRoutingValid.value = true;
    isRoutingProcessOpen.value = false;
    emit('routing-valid', true);
    emit('routing-meta', orderMetadata.value);
};

const isLoyaltyGiftActive = computed(() => page.props.companySettings?.loyalty_is_active && page.props.companySettings?.loyalty_reward_type === 'product');

const customerPoints = computed(() => {
    const metaCustomer = orderMetadata.value?.customer;
    if (!metaCustomer || !metaCustomer.id) return 0;
    const fresh = props.customers.find(c => c.id === metaCustomer.id);
    return fresh ? fresh.loyalty_points : 0;
});

const toggleGiftFilter = () => {
    emit('toggle-gift-filter', { active: !props.isGiftFilterActive, points: customerPoints.value });
};

watch(customerPoints, () => {
    if (props.isGiftFilterActive) {
        emit('toggle-gift-filter', { active: false, points: 0 });
    }
});

const headerTitle = computed(() => {
    const appendPrefix = isAppending.value ? `[Reforço #${targetOrderId.value}] ` : '';

    if (props.orderType === 'table') {
        const table = orderMetadata.value?.table;
        if (!table || !table.name) {
            return `${appendPrefix}Selecionar Mesa...`;
        }

        const tableName = String(table.name || table.number || '');
        const identifier = String(orderMetadata.value?.identifier || props.editOrderData?.customer_name || '');
        const isGenericName = !identifier || identifier.toLowerCase() === tableName.toLowerCase() || identifier.toLowerCase() === `mesa ${tableName.toLowerCase()}` || identifier.toLowerCase() === 'geral' || identifier.toLowerCase() === 'nova conta';
        return `${appendPrefix}${isGenericName ? `Mesa ${tableName}` : `Mesa ${tableName} (${identifier})`}`;
    }
    if (props.orderType === 'counter') {
        const identifier = orderMetadata.value?.identifier || orderMetadata.value?.customer?.name || props.editOrderData?.customer_name;
        return `${appendPrefix}${identifier ? abbreviateName(identifier) : 'Balcão'}`;
    }
    if (props.orderType === 'delivery') {
        const identifier = orderMetadata.value?.identifier || orderMetadata.value?.customer?.name || props.editOrderData?.customer_name;
        return `${appendPrefix}${identifier ? abbreviateName(identifier) : 'Delivery'}`;
    }
    return 'Selecionar Destino...';
});

const headerSubtitle = computed(() => {
    if (isAppending.value) return 'Adicionando produtos ao pedido já em andamento';
    if (props.orderType === 'table') {
        const table = orderMetadata.value?.table;
        return table?.name ? `Mesa ${table.name || table.number}` : 'Nenhuma mesa selecionada';
    }
    if (props.orderType === 'counter') return 'Balcão / Retirada';
    if (props.orderType === 'delivery') {
        const addr = orderMetadata.value?.address;
        if (!addr) return 'Aguardando seleção de endereço...';
        return addr.full_address || `${addr.street || ''}, ${addr.number || 'S/N'}`;
    }
    return 'Selecione o destino do pedido...';
});

const { activeCoupon, applyCoupon, removeCoupon } = useCoupons();

const companySettings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});
const hasServiceTaxGlobal = computed(() => Boolean(companySettings.value.has_service_tax));
const serviceTaxPercentage = computed(() => Number(companySettings.value.service_tax_percentage || 0));

const isTaxEnabledForChannel = computed(() => {
    if (!hasServiceTaxGlobal.value) return false;
    const type = props.orderType || orderMetadata.value?.type;
    if (type === 'table') return companySettings.value.service_tax_table !== false && companySettings.value.service_tax_table !== 0;
    if (type === 'counter' || type === 'takeaway' || type === 'pickup') return Boolean(companySettings.value.service_tax_counter);
    if (type === 'delivery') return Boolean(companySettings.value.service_tax_delivery);
    return false;
});

const deliveryFee = computed(() => {
    if (isAppending.value) return 0;
    return props.orderType === 'delivery' && orderMetadata.value?.address?.delivery_fee
        ? Number(orderMetadata.value.address.delivery_fee)
        : 0;
});

const serviceFee = computed(() => {
    if (!isTaxEnabledForChannel.value) return 0;
    return Math.round((props.cartSubtotal * (serviceTaxPercentage.value / 100)) * 100) / 100;
});

const activeDiscount = computed(() => {
    if (!activeCoupon.value) return 0;
    if (activeCoupon.value.type === 'fixed_total') {
        const totalBruto = props.cartSubtotal + deliveryFee.value + serviceFee.value;
        const descontoAritmetico = totalBruto - Number(activeCoupon.value.value || 0);
        return descontoAritmetico > 0 ? descontoAritmetico : 0;
    }
    return Number(activeCoupon.value.discount || activeCoupon.value.discount_amount || activeCoupon.value.value || 0);
});

const appliedCouponName = computed(() => activeCoupon.value ? (activeCoupon.value.code || activeCoupon.value.name || null) : null);
const finalTotal = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.cartSubtotal + (deliveryFee.value || 0) + (serviceFee.value || 0) - activeDiscount.value));

onMounted(() => {
    const magicCoupon = localStorage.getItem('pos_magic_coupon');
    if (magicCoupon) {
        const unwatch = watch(() => props.cartSubtotal, (newTotal) => {
            if (newTotal > 0 && !activeCoupon.value) {
                applyCoupon(magicCoupon, newTotal).then((success) => {
                    if (success) {
                        localStorage.removeItem('pos_magic_coupon');
                        unwatch();
                    }
                });
            }
        }, { immediate: true });
    }
});

const setExpanded = (item, index, state) => { expandedStates.value[item.cartId || index] = state; };
const isLineHidden = (index) => {
    const nextItem = props.cart[index + 1];
    return expandedStates.value[props.cart[index].cartId || index] || (nextItem && expandedStates.value[nextItem.cartId || index + 1]);
};

const handleOrderTypeUpdate = (newType) => {
    if (newType !== props.orderType) {
        emit('update:orderType', newType);
        if (!isAppending.value) {
            isRoutingProcessOpen.value = true;
        }
        if (newType !== null) showEstimatorConfig.value = false;
    }
};

const handleRoutingChange = (payload) => {
    isRoutingValid.value = isAppending.value ? true : payload.isValid;

    // 🚀 Se a chave 'customer' veio explicitamente na meta (mesmo que seja null para limpar), respeita o que veio!
    const resolvedCustomer = (payload.meta && 'customer' in payload.meta)
        ? payload.meta.customer
        : (orderMetadata.value?.customer
            || props.editOrderData?.customer
            || (props.editOrderData?.customer_name ? { name: props.editOrderData.customer_name } : null));

    // 🚀 Se a chave 'identifier' veio na meta, respeita (mesmo que seja string vazia)
    const resolvedIdentifier = (payload.meta && 'identifier' in payload.meta)
        ? payload.meta.identifier
        : (orderMetadata.value?.identifier
            || props.editOrderData?.customer_name
            || (typeof resolvedCustomer === 'string' ? resolvedCustomer : resolvedCustomer?.name)
            || '');

    // 🚀 Se a chave 'address' veio na meta (mesmo que seja null), respeita a limpeza
    const resolvedAddress = (payload.meta && 'address' in payload.meta)
        ? payload.meta.address
        : (orderMetadata.value?.address
            || props.editOrderData?.address
            || null);

    orderMetadata.value = {
        ...orderMetadata.value,
        ...payload.meta,
        customer: resolvedCustomer,
        identifier: resolvedIdentifier,
        address: resolvedAddress,
        existing_order_id: orderMetadata.value?.existing_order_id || props.editOrderData?.id || null,
        order_id: orderMetadata.value?.order_id || props.editOrderData?.id || null
    };

    emit('routing-valid', isRoutingValid.value);
    emit('routing-meta', orderMetadata.value);
};

const handleRoutingApply = () => {
    isRoutingProcessOpen.value = false;
};

const toggleEstimator = () => {
    showEstimatorConfig.value = !showEstimatorConfig.value;
    if (showEstimatorConfig.value) isRoutingProcessOpen.value = false;
};

const promptSubAccountName = () => {
    const identifier = window.prompt("Digite o nome do cliente para esta sub-conta (Ex: João):");
    if (identifier && identifier.trim() !== "") {
        orderMetadata.value.identifier = identifier.trim();
        emit('routing-meta', orderMetadata.value);
    }
};

const handleLoadOrder = (payload) => {
    const targetId = typeof payload === 'object' ? payload?.id : payload;
    if (targetId) {
        orderMetadata.value = {
            ...orderMetadata.value,
            existing_order_id: targetId,
            order_id: targetId
        };
        isRoutingProcessOpen.value = false;
        isRoutingValid.value = true;
        emit('routing-meta', orderMetadata.value);
    }
};

const handleParkOrder = () => { emit('park-order'); };

const handleClearCartAction = () => {
    if (orderMetadata.value) {
        orderMetadata.value.existing_order_id = null;
        orderMetadata.value.order_id = null;
    }
    emit('clear-cart');
};

const canSubmit = computed(() => {
    if (props.cart.length === 0) return false;

    // Se estiver adicionando itens:
    if (isAppending.value) {
        // Bloqueia se o valor dos novos itens estourar a nota informada para troco
        if (changeAnalysis.value?.isExceeded) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (!isRoutingValid.value) return false;
    if (props.orderType === 'table' && !orderMetadata.value?.table?.id) return false;
    return true;
});

const processCheckout = () => {
    if (!canSubmit.value) return;

    if (isAppending.value && changeAnalysis.value?.isExceeded) {
        toast.add({
            severity: 'error',
            summary: 'Troco Excedido',
            detail: changeAnalysis.value.warning,
            life: 5000
        });
        return;
    }

    const finalTotals = {
        subtotal: props.cartSubtotal,
        deliveryFee: deliveryFee.value,
        serviceFee: serviceFee.value,
        discount: activeDiscount.value,
        finalTotal: finalTotal.value
    };

    if (activeCoupon.value) {
        finalTotals.coupon_code = activeCoupon.value.code;
    }

    const appendId = targetOrderId.value;

    emit('checkout', {
        order_id: appendId,
        append_to_order: appendId,
        meta: {
            ...orderMetadata.value,
            order_id: appendId,
            existing_order_id: appendId,
            type: props.orderType || orderMetadata.value?.type || 'table'
        },
        totals: finalTotals
    });
};
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from "vue";
import Button from "primevue/button";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import CouponPickerModal from "./CouponPickerModal.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    subtotal: { type: Number, required: true },
    deliveryFee: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    serviceFee: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    serviceTaxPercentage: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    showServiceFeeRow: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    discount: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    cashbackDiscount: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    finalTotal: { type: Number, required: true },
    orderType: { type: [String, null], default: null },
    isRoutingValid: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    canSubmit: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    appliedCouponName: { type: String, default: null },
    customerId: { type: [Number, null], default: null },
});

const emit = defineEmits(["checkout", "apply-coupon", "remove-coupon", "toggle-coupon-form"]);

const showCouponModal = ref(false);

const shouldDisplayServiceFee = computed(() => props.showServiceFeeRow || props.serviceFee > 0);

const openCouponModal = () => {
    showCouponModal.value = true;
    emit("toggle-coupon-form", true);
};

const handleApplyFromModal = (code) => {
    emit("apply-coupon", code, props.subtotal);
    showCouponModal.value = false;
    emit("toggle-coupon-form", false);
};

const handleRemoveCoupon = () => {
    emit("remove-coupon");
};

const closeCouponForm = () => {
    showCouponModal.value = false;
    emit("toggle-coupon-form", false);
};

defineExpose({ closeCouponForm });
</script>

                                    class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                                >
                                    Exclusivo PDV
                                </span>
                            </div>

                            <span class="text-xs text-surface-500 dark:text-surface-400 font-medium mt-0.5 line-clamp-2">
                                {{ coupon.description }}
                            </span>

                    </div>

                    <!-- Badge de Desconto & Ação -->
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
                        <div class="text-right">
                            <span class="block text-sm font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                {{ coupon.label }}
                            </span>
                            <span v-if="!coupon.meets_subtotal" class="text-[10px] text-danger-500 font-semibold">
                                Falta R$ {{ (coupon.min_subtotal - subtotal).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') }}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <button
                            v-if="coupon.meets_subtotal"
                            class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-surface-100 dark:bg-surface-700 group-hover:bg-primary-500 group-hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition-colors border-none cursor-pointer"

                Nenhum cupom disponível no momento.
            </div>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog';
import axios from 'axios';

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    subtotal: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    customerId: { type: [Number, null], default: null },
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'apply']);

const isOpen = computed({
    get: () => props.modelValue,
    set: (val) => emit('update:modelValue', val),
});

const coupons = ref([]);
const isLoading = ref(false);
const isApplying = ref(false);
const searchTerm = ref('');

const fetchCoupons = async () => {
    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(route('pos.coupons.available'), {
            params: {
                subtotal: props.subtotal,
                customer_id: props.customerId,
            },
        });
        coupons.value = response.data.coupons || [];
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Erro ao carregar cupons do PDV:', error);
        coupons.value = [];
    } finally {
        isLoading.value = false;
    }
};

watch(() => props.modelValue, (visible) => {
    if (visible) {
        searchTerm.value = '';
        fetchCoupons();
    }
});

const filteredCoupons = computed(() => {
    if (!searchTerm.value) return coupons.value;
    const term = searchTerm.value.toUpperCase().trim();
    return coupons.value.filter(c =>
        (c.name && c.name.toUpperCase().includes(term)) ||
        (c.code && c.code.toUpperCase().includes(term)) ||
        (c.label && c.label.toUpperCase().includes(term)) ||
        (c.description && c.description.toUpperCase().includes(term))
    );
});

const selectCoupon = (code) => {
    emit('apply', code);
    isOpen.value = false;
};

const handleDirectApply = () => {
    if (!searchTerm.value.trim()) return;
    emit('apply', searchTerm.value.trim().toUpperCase());
    isOpen.value = false;
};
</script>

import { onMounted, onUnmounted, watch, ref } from "vue";
import { formatPhone, abbreviateName } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useCustomerSearch } from "@/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerSearch";
import { getInitials } from "@/Utils/formatters.js"

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: { type: [Object, Number, String], default: null },
    initialCustomers: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    orderType: { type: String, default: 'counter' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["update:modelValue", "customer-selected", "create-new", "confirm"]);

const searchContainer = ref(null);
const selectedCustomer = ref(null);

const { query, results, isLoading, showDropdown, executeSearch } = useCustomerSearch(props.initialCustomers);

const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
    if (searchContainer.value && !searchContainer.value.contains(event.target)) {
        showDropdown.value = false;
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    document.addEventListener("click", handleClickOutside);
    if (props.modelValue) selectedCustomer.value = props.modelValue;
});
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("click", handleClickOutside));

// 🚀 O GATILHO NATIVO ANTI-BUGS
const handleInputEvent = (event) => {
    query.value = event.target.value;
    showDropdown.value = true;
    executeSearch(query.value);
};

const selectCustomer = (customer) => {
    selectedCustomer.value = customer;
    showDropdown.value = false;
    query.value = "";
    emit("update:modelValue", customer);
    emit("customer-selected", customer);
};

const useSimpleId = () => {
    const simpleName = query.value.trim();
    selectedCustomer.value = simpleName;
    showDropdown.value = false;
    query.value = "";
    emit("update:modelValue", simpleName);
    emit("customer-selected", simpleName);
};

const clearSelection = () => {
    selectedCustomer.value = null;
    emit("update:modelValue", null);
    emit("customer-selected", null);
    setTimeout(() => { showDropdown.value = true; }, 10);
};

watch(() => props.modelValue, (newVal) => { selectedCustomer.value = newVal; });
</script>

                    @input="handlePhoneInput"
                    @keyup.enter="submitRegistration"
                    autofocus
                />
            </FormField>
            <SecureActionButton action-code="guest_register" @secure-click="submitRegistration" :disabled="!isPhoneValid" :is-loading="loading" severity="primary" custom-class="c-btn-primary mt-2 w-full h-11" >
                <i v-if="loading" class="pi pi-spinner pi-spin"></i>
                <span>{{ loading ? 'Processando...' : 'Continuar para Pedido' }}</span>

<script setup>
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';

import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { formatPhone } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import FormField from "@/Components/UI/FormField.vue";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";

const props = defineProps({
    isCustomerMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    step: { type: [Number, String], default: 1 },
    initialName: { type: String, default: "" },
    initialPhone: { type: String, default: "" }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['registered', 'update:step', 'update:name', 'update:phone', 'advance']);

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();
const settings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});
const reqWhatsapp = computed(() => settings.value.require_whatsapp ?? true);

const currentStep = computed(() => props.step);

// Restaura os dados digitados anteriormente
const name = ref(props.initialName || "");
const phone = ref(props.initialPhone || "");
const loading = ref(false);

watch(() => props.initialName, (val) => { if (val) name.value = val; });
watch(() => props.initialPhone, (val) => { if (val) phone.value = val; });

const handleNameInput = () => {
    emit('update:name', name.value);
};

const handlePhoneInput = (e) => {
    let val = e?.target?.value || e;
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
        phone.value = formatPhone(val);
        if (e?.target) e.target.value = phone.value;
    }
    emit('update:phone', phone.value);
};

const isNameValid = computed(() => name.value.trim().length >= 3);
const isPhoneValid = computed(() => {
    const raw = phone.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
    return reqWhatsapp.value ? raw.length >= 10 : true;
});

const handleAdvance = () => {
    if (isNameValid.value) {
        emit('advance');
    }
};

const submitRegistration = () => {
    if (!isPhoneValid.value) return;
    loading.value = true;

    router.post(route('customer.auth.guest-register'), {
        name: name.value,
        phone: phone.value
    }, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            loading.value = false;
            emit('registered');
        },
        onError: (errors) => {
            loading.value = false;
            const errorMsg = errors.guest || Object.values(errors)[0] || 'Verifique os dados e tente novamente.';
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: errorMsg, life: 5000 });
        }
    });
};
</script>

                >

            <!-- 🚀 AVISO DO TETO DE RESGATE (FIXO OU PERCENTUAL) -->
            <div
                v-if="canRedeem && hasMaxLimit"
                class="mt-3 text-[11px] px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border flex items-start gap-2 transition-colors"
                :class="isCapLimitingBalance ? 'bg-primary-500/10 border-primary-500/30 text-primary-smart' : 'bg-surface-3/70 border-surface-border/50 text-surface-muted'"
            >
                <i class="pi pi-info-circle text-xs shrink-0 mt-0.5" :class="isCapLimitingBalance ? 'text-primary-500' : 'text-surface-muted'"></i>
                <div class="leading-tight flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                    <div>
                        <span>Limite máximo de resgate: </span>
                        <b class="text-surface-text">{{ maxLimitDescription }}</b>
                    </div>
                    <span v-if="isCapLimitingBalance" class="text-[10px] opacity-85">
                        O saldo restante permanecerá salvo na sua conta para as próximas compras.
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>

                <i class="pi pi-info-circle text-xs shrink-0"></i>
                <span>Faltam <b>{{ $formatCurrency(missingAmount) }}</b> em produtos para liberar o uso de cashback neste pedido.</span>
            </div>

            <div v-else-if="customerPoints <= 0" class="mt-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-surface-muted bg-surface-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2 border border-surface-border/50">

                <span>Você ainda não possui saldo de cashback para resgatar.</span>
            </div>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: Boolean,
    isLoyaltyActive: Boolean,
    availableBalance: Number,
    customerPoints: Number,
    canRedeem: Boolean,
    missingAmount: Number,
    maxCap: { type: Number, default: null },
    maxRedeemType: { type: String, default: null }, // 'fixed' | 'percentage'
    maxRedeemValue: { type: [Number, String], default: null },
    isGuest: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    title: { type: String, default: 'Cashback' }
});

defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);

const page = usePage();
const companySettings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});

// 🎯 Resolve tipo e valor (Props têm precedência sobre os settings globais)
const resolvedLimitType = computed(() => {
    return props.maxRedeemType || companySettings.value.loyalty_max_redeem_type || 'fixed';
});

const resolvedLimitValue = computed(() => {
    if (props.maxRedeemValue !== null && props.maxRedeemValue !== undefined) {
        return Number(props.maxRedeemValue);
    }
    const settingVal = companySettings.value.loyalty_max_redeem_value;
    return settingVal ? Number(settingVal) : null;
});

const hasMaxLimit = computed(() => {
    return resolvedLimitValue.value !== null && resolvedLimitValue.value > 0;
});

// Checa se o teto é menor que o saldo total acumulado do cliente
const isCapLimitingBalance = computed(() => {
    if (!props.availableBalance) return false;
    if (props.maxCap !== null && props.maxCap !== undefined) {
        return props.maxCap < props.availableBalance;
    }
    if (resolvedLimitType.value === 'fixed' && resolvedLimitValue.value) {
        return resolvedLimitValue.value < props.availableBalance;
    }
    return false;
});

// Monta o descritivo dinâmico para valor fixo ou percentual
const maxLimitDescription = computed(() => {
    if (!hasMaxLimit.value) return '';

    if (resolvedLimitType.value === 'percentage') {
        const pctText = `${resolvedLimitValue.value}% do pedido`;
        if (props.maxCap) {
            return `${pctText} (${formatCurrency(props.maxCap)})`;
        }
        return pctText;
    }

    // Tipo Fixo
    return `${formatCurrency(resolvedLimitValue.value)} por pedido`;
});
</script>

                v-if="localOrderType === 'counter'"
                :model-value="sharedCustomer"
                @update:model-value="setSharedCustomer"
                :customer="sharedCustomer"
                @update:customer="setSharedCustomer"
                :customers="customers"
                @apply="triggerImmediateApply"
                @create-new="handleCreateNewCustomer"
                @open-new-customer="handleCreateNewCustomer"
            />

            <RoutingDelivery
                v-if="localOrderType === 'delivery'"
                :customer="sharedCustomer"
                @update:customer="handleCustomerChange"
                :address="deliveryAddress"
                @update:address="handleAddressChange"
                :customers="customers"
                @apply="handleApply($event)"
                @create-new="handleCreateNewCustomer"
                @open-new-customer="handleCreateNewCustomer"
                @customer-selected="updateParentState"
                @open-new-address="$emit('open-new-address')"
                @open-edit-address="$emit('open-edit-address', $event)"
            />
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { watch } from 'vue';
import RoutingTable from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/RoutingTable.vue";
import RoutingCounter from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/RoutingCounter.vue";
import RoutingDelivery from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/RoutingDelivery.vue";

import { useOrderRouting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderRouting";
import { useCart } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart";

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: { type: String, default: 'table' },
    isOpen: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    tableAreas: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    customers: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    isWaiterMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    routingMeta: { type: Object, default: null } // 🚀 Adicionado para absorver o estado do TeamApp
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    "update:modelValue",
    "routing-change",
    "apply",
    "load-order",
    "open-new-customer",
    "open-new-address",
    "open-edit-address",
    "toggle-open",
    "open"
]);

const {
    localOrderType, resetTableTrigger, orderTypeOptions, selectedTable, tableIdentifier,
    sharedCustomer, deliveryAddress, selectOrderType, handleApply,
    triggerImmediateApply, updateParentState,
    setSelectedTable, setTableIdentifier, setSharedCustomer, setDeliveryAddress
} = useOrderRouting(props, emit);

const { draftRouting } = useCart();

// Sincronização direta caso o TeamApp envie atualizações via props.routingMeta
watch(() => props.routingMeta, (newMeta) => {
    if (newMeta) {
        if (newMeta.table !== undefined) setSelectedTable(newMeta.table);
        if (newMeta.identifier !== undefined) setTableIdentifier(newMeta.identifier);
        if (newMeta.customer !== undefined) setSharedCustomer(newMeta.customer);
        if (newMeta.address !== undefined) setDeliveryAddress(newMeta.address);
        if (newMeta.type && newMeta.type !== localOrderType.value) selectOrderType(newMeta.type);
    }
}, { deep: true, immediate: true });

watch(() => props.modelValue, (newVal) => {
    if (newVal && newVal !== localOrderType.value) {
        selectOrderType(newVal);
    }
});

watch(() => draftRouting.value?.type, (newType) => {
    if (newType && newType !== localOrderType.value) {
        selectOrderType(newType);
    }
});

watch(() => draftRouting.value?.table, (newTable) => {
    if (newTable) setSelectedTable(newTable);
}, { deep: true });

watch(() => draftRouting.value?.customer, (newCustomer) => {
    if (newCustomer !== undefined) setSharedCustomer(newCustomer);
}, { deep: true });

watch(() => draftRouting.value?.address, (newAddress) => {
    if (newAddress !== undefined) setDeliveryAddress(newAddress);
}, { deep: true });

const handleCustomerChange = (newCustomer) => {
    setSharedCustomer(newCustomer);
    if (!newCustomer && draftRouting.value) {
        draftRouting.value.customer = null;
    }
};

const handleAddressChange = (newAddress) => {
    setDeliveryAddress(newAddress);
    if (!newAddress && draftRouting.value) {
        draftRouting.value.address = null;
    }
};

const handleTabChange = (type) => {
    // Se clicar na aba já ativa, alterna abrir/fechar as opções
    if (type === localOrderType.value) {
        emit('toggle-open');
        return;
    }

    if (type === 'table') {
        setSharedCustomer(null);
        setDeliveryAddress(null);
        if (draftRouting.value) {
            draftRouting.value.customer = null;
            draftRouting.value.address = null;
        }
    } else if (type === 'counter') {
        setSelectedTable(null);
        setDeliveryAddress(null);
        if (draftRouting.value) {
            draftRouting.value.table = null;
            draftRouting.value.address = null;
        }
    } else if (type === 'delivery') {
        setSelectedTable(null);
        setTableIdentifier("");
        if (draftRouting.value) {
            draftRouting.value.table = null;
            draftRouting.value.identifier = "";
        }
    }

    selectOrderType(type);
    localOrderType.value = type;

    if (draftRouting.value) {
        draftRouting.value.type = type;
    }

    emit('update:modelValue', type);
    emit('open'); // 🚀 Abre o drawer automaticamente ao mudar de canal
};

const handleCreateNewCustomer = (query = '') => {
    emit('open-new-customer', query);
};
</script>

import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";

const popoverRef = ref(null);

import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

import SegmentedControl from "@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue";
import DeliveryCustomerSearch from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/Delivery/DeliveryCustomerSearch.vue";
import DeliveryCustomerQuick from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/Delivery/DeliveryCustomerQuick.vue";
import DeliveryCustomerNew from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/Delivery/DeliveryCustomerNew.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: [Object, String],
    customer: Object,
    customers: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    isCustomerMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'update:modelValue',
    'update:customer',
    'apply',
    'customer-selected',
    'create-new'
]);

const page = usePage();
const companySettings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});

const activeSubTab = ref('search');
const newCustomerSeedName = ref('');

const counterSubTabOptions = [
    { label: 'Pesquisar', value: 'search', icon: 'pi-search' },
    { label: 'Rápido',    value: 'quick',  icon: 'pi-bolt' },
    { label: 'Novo',      value: 'new',    icon: 'pi-user-plus' }
];

const currentCustomer = computed(() => {
    if (props.customer && typeof props.customer === 'object') return props.customer;
    if (props.modelValue && typeof props.modelValue === 'object') return props.modelValue;
    return null;
});

const formatPhone = (phone) => {
    if (!phone) return '';
    const p = String(phone).replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (p.length === 11) return p.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{5})(\d{4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
    if (p.length === 10) return p.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{4})(\d{4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
    return phone;
};

const handleCustomerSelected = (c) => {
    emit('update:modelValue', c);
    emit('update:customer', c);
    emit('customer-selected', c);
    emit('apply', { customer: c, address: null, identifier: c?.name || '' });
};

const handleGoToNew = (name) => {
    newCustomerSeedName.value = name;
    activeSubTab.value = 'new';
};

const handleChangeCustomer = () => {
    emit('update:modelValue', null);
    emit('update:customer', null);
    emit('customer-selected', null);
    emit('apply', { customer: null, address: null, identifier: 'Balcão' });
    newCustomerSeedName.value = '';
    activeSubTab.value = 'search';
};

const handleConfirm = () => {
    emit('apply', { customer: currentCustomer.value, address: null, identifier: currentCustomer.value?.name || 'Balcão' });
};
</script>
