```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

import SegmentedControl from "@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue";
import DeliveryCustomerSearch from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/Delivery/DeliveryCustomerSearch.vue";
import DeliveryCustomerQuick from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/Delivery/DeliveryCustomerQuick.vue";
import DeliveryCustomerNew from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/Delivery/DeliveryCustomerNew.vue";
import DeliveryAddressList from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/Delivery/DeliveryAddressList.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    customer: Object,
    address: Object,
    customers: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    'update:customer',
    'update:address',
    'apply',
    'customer-selected',
    'open-new-address',
    'open-edit-address',
    'open-new-customer'
]);

const page = usePage();
const companySettings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});

const activeSubTab = ref('search');
const newCustomerSeedName = ref('');

const deliverySubTabOptions = [
    { label: 'Pesquisar', value: 'search', icon: 'pi-search' },
    { label: 'Rápido',    value: 'quick',  icon: 'pi-bolt' },
    { label: 'Novo',      value: 'new',    icon: 'pi-user-plus' }
];

const handleGoToNew = (name = '') => {
    newCustomerSeedName.value = name;
    activeSubTab.value = 'new';
};

const handleCustomerSelected = (c) => {
    emit('update:customer', c);
    emit('customer-selected', c);

    if (c.addresses && c.addresses.length > 0) {
        emit('update:address', c.addresses[0]);
    } else {
        emit('update:address', null);
    }
};

const handleChangeCustomer = () => {
    emit('update:customer', null);
    emit('update:address', null);
    newCustomerSeedName.value = '';
    activeSubTab.value = 'search';
};
</script>
```

```vue
                                    class="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-success-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-surface-2 shadow-sm z-10 animate-in zoom-in-50 duration-150"
                                    title="Selecionada para Junção"
                                >
                                    <i class="pi pi-check text-[9px] font-black"></i>
                                </div>

                                <!-- INDICADOR DE STATUS OCUPADA -->
                                <div
                                    v-else-if="isTableOccupied(table)"
                                    class="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-warning-500 border-2 border-surface-2 shadow-sm animate-pulse"
                                    title="Mesa Ocupada"
                                ></div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- CARD EXPANDIDO: CONTAS ATIVAS DA MESA -->
                            <div v-if="expandedTableId === table.id" class="basis-full w-full my-1 p-3 bg-surface-2 border border-surface-border rounded-2xl flex flex-col gap-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 shadow-inner">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                    <span class="micro-label">
                                        Contas ativas na Mesa {{ getMergedDisplayName(table) }} ({{ getTableActiveOrders(table).length }})
                                    </span>

                                    <!-- Botão Separar se a mesa estiver agrupada -->
                                    <button
                                        v-if="isMergedParent(table)"
                                        type="button"
                                        @click.stop="handleSplitTable(table)"
                                        class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider border border-red-500/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                                    >
                                        <i class="pi pi-unlink mr-1"></i> Separar Mesas
                                    </button>
                                </div>

                                <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
                                    <button v-for="order in getTableActiveOrders(table)" :key="order.id"
                                        @click="selectExistingOrder(table, order)"
                                        class="p-3 bg-surface-1 border border-surface-border hover:border-warning-500 hover:text-warning-400 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium text-surface-text text-left truncate transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 outline-none cursor-pointer">
                                        <i class="pi fa-receipt text-warning-500 text-xs"></i>
                                        {{ order.identifier ? `${getMergedDisplayName(table)} (${order.identifier})` : `Conta #${order.id}` }}
                                    </button>

                                    <button @click="createNewSubAccount(table)"
                                        class="p-3 bg-primary-500/10 text-primary-400 hover:bg-primary-500/20 rounded-xl text-sm font-black border border-transparent transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm outline-none cursor-pointer">
                                        <i class="pi pi-plus-circle text-sm"></i> Nova Conta Paralela
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                        </template>
                    </template>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- BLOCO DE CONFIRMAÇÃO DA JUNÇÃO NA BASE DO WIDGET -->
            <div
                v-if="isMergeMode && selectedForMerge.length > 0"
                class="mt-4 p-3.5 bg-surface-2 border border-surface-border rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 shadow-lg shrink-0"
            >
                <div class="flex flex-col">
                    <span class="text-xs font-bold text-surface-text">
                        {{ selectedForMerge.length }} mesa(s) selecionada(s)
                    </span>
                    <span class="text-[11px] text-surface-muted font-medium">
                        {{ selectedForMergeNames.join(' + ') }}
                    </span>
                </div>

                <button
                    type="button"
                    @click="confirmMergeTables"
                    :disabled="selectedForMerge.length < 2"
                    class="h-9 px-4 rounded-xl bg-success-500 hover:bg-success-600 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer border-none shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-check text-xs"></i>
                    Confirmar Junção
                </button>
            </div>
        </template>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';

const props = defineProps({
    modelValue: Object,
    identifier: String,
    tableAreas: Array,
    resetTrigger: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    mode: { type: String, default: 'selector' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["update:modelValue", "update:identifier", "apply", "load-order", "table-click"]);

const toast = useToast();
const expandedTableId = ref(null);

// Estados de Junção
const isMergeMode = ref(false);
const selectedForMerge = ref([]);

// Todas as mesas do salão em array plano
const allTables = computed(() => {
    return (props.tableAreas || []).flatMap(area => area.tables || []);
});

// Resolução de mesas secundárias vinculadas
const getLinkedChildren = (table) => {
    if (!table) return [];
    if (table.linked_tables && table.linked_tables.length > 0) {
        return table.linked_tables;
    }
    return allTables.value.filter(t => Number(t.parent_table_id) === Number(table.id));
};

const isMergedParent = (table) => {
    return getLinkedChildren(table).length > 0;
};

const isMergedChild = (table) => {
    return table.parent_table_id !== null && table.parent_table_id !== undefined && table.parent_table_id !== '';
};

// Filtra mesas secundárias da grade (mesas filhas são ocultadas)
const getVisibleTables = (area) => {
    if (!area?.tables) return [];
    return area.tables.filter(table => !isMergedChild(table));
};

// Nome amigável combinado em ordem ascendente (ex: 1+12)
const getMergedDisplayName = (table) => {
    if (!table) return '';
    const children = getLinkedChildren(table);
    if (children.length === 0) return table.name;

    const names = [table.name, ...children.map(c => c.name)].sort((a, b) =>
        String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })
    );

    return names.join('+');
};

// Consolida os pedidos ativos da mesa e de suas mesas filhas
const getTableActiveOrders = (table) => {
    if (!table) return [];
    const orders = [...(table.active_orders || [])];

    const children = getLinkedChildren(table);
    children.forEach(child => {
        const fullChild = allTables.value.find(t => t.id === child.id) || child;
        if (Array.isArray(fullChild.active_orders)) {
            orders.push(...fullChild.active_orders);
        }
    });

    const seen = new Set();
    return orders.filter(o => {
        if (!o || !o.id || seen.has(o.id)) return false;
        seen.add(o.id);
        return true;
    });
};

// Determina ocupação via status ou presença de pedidos ativos
const isTableOccupied = (table) => {
    if (!table) return false;
    if (table.status === 'occupied') return true;
    if (getTableActiveOrders(table).length > 0) return true;

    const children = getLinkedChildren(table);
    return children.some(c => {
        const fullChild = allTables.value.find(t => t.id === c.id) || c;
        return fullChild.status === 'occupied' || (fullChild.active_orders?.length > 0);
    });
};

const selectedForMergeNames = computed(() => {
    return selectedForMerge.value
        .map(id => allTables.value.find(t => t.id === id)?.name)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
});

watch(() => props.resetTrigger, () => {
    expandedTableId.value = null;
    isMergeMode.value = false;
    selectedForMerge.value = [];
});

const toggleMergeMode = () => {
    isMergeMode.value = !isMergeMode.value;
    selectedForMerge.value = [];
    expandedTableId.value = null;
};

const handleTableClick = (table) => {
    if (isMergeMode.value) {
        if (selectedForMerge.value.includes(table.id)) {
            selectedForMerge.value = selectedForMerge.value.filter(id => id !== table.id);
        } else {
            selectedForMerge.value.push(table.id);
        }
        return;
    }

    const occupied = isTableOccupied(table);
    const activeOrders = getTableActiveOrders(table);
    const existingOrder = occupied && activeOrders.length > 0 ? activeOrders[0] : null;

    if (props.mode === 'direct') {
        if (occupied && activeOrders.length > 1) {
            expandedTableId.value = expandedTableId.value === table.id ? null : table.id;
            return;
        }
        emit('table-click', table, occupied, existingOrder);
        return;
    }

    if (occupied) {
        expandedTableId.value = expandedTableId.value === table.id ? null : table.id;
    } else {
        expandedTableId.value = null;
        emit('update:modelValue', table);
        emit('update:identifier', "");
        emit('apply');
    }
};

const confirmMergeTables = async () => {
    if (selectedForMerge.value.length < 2) return;

    try {
        const sortedSelectedTables = [...selectedForMerge.value]
            .map(id => allTables.value.find(t => t.id === id))
            .filter(Boolean)
            .sort((a, b) => String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));

        const primaryTable = sortedSelectedTables[0];
        const secondaryTableIds = sortedSelectedTables.slice(1).map(t => t.id);

        await axios.post(route('operations.tables.join', primaryTable.id), {
            secondary_table_ids: secondaryTableIds
        });

        toast.add({
            severity: 'success',
            summary: 'Mesas Unidas',
            detail: `As mesas ${selectedForMergeNames.value.join(' + ')} foram agrupadas no lugar da Mesa ${primaryTable.name}.`,
            life: 3000
        });

        isMergeMode.value = false;
        selectedForMerge.value = [];
        router.reload({ only: ['initialTableAreas'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });

    } catch (error) {
        toast.add({
            severity: 'error',
            summary: 'Falha na Junção',
            detail: error.response?.data?.message || 'Não foi possível juntar as mesas.',
            life: 4000
        });
    }
};

const handleSplitTable = async (table) => {
    try {
        await axios.post(route('operations.tables.split', table.id));

        toast.add({
            severity: 'info',
            summary: 'Mesas Separadas',
            detail: `A Mesa ${getMergedDisplayName(table)} foi desmembrada com sucesso.`,
            life: 3000
        });

        expandedTableId.value = null;
        router.reload({ only: ['initialTableAreas'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });

    } catch (error) {
        toast.add({
            severity: 'error',
            summary: 'Atenção',
            detail: error.response?.data?.message || 'Não foi possível separar a mesa.',
            life: 4000
        });
    }
};

const selectExistingOrder = (table, order) => {
    expandedTableId.value = null;
    emit('update:modelValue', table);
    emit('update:identifier', order.identifier || order.customer_name || "");
    emit('load-order', order.id);
    emit('apply');
};

const createNewSubAccount = (table) => {
    expandedTableId.value = null;

    if (props.mode === 'direct') {
        emit('table-click', table, false, null);
    } else {
        emit('update:modelValue', table);
        emit('update:identifier', "Nova Conta");
        emit('apply');
    }
};

const clearTable = () => {
    expandedTableId.value = null;
    emit('update:modelValue', null);
    emit('update:identifier', "");
};
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 px-1">
            <h3 class="font-black text-surface-muted text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest">ESTIMATIVA DE ENTREGA</h3>
            <button @click="$emit('close')" class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full text-surface-muted flex items-center justify-center outline-none p-hover">
                <i class="pi pi-times text-[10px] font-medium"></i>
            </button>
        </div>

        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-1">

            <template v-if="estimateMode !== 'none'">
                <button
                    v-for="(est, idx) in generatedEstimates"
                    :key="idx"
                    @click="copyToClipboard(est.value)"
                    class="p-option p-hover rounded-xl flex-1 p-3 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                    {{ est.label }}
                </button>
            </template>

            <button
                v-if="estimateBusy && estimateMode !== 'none'"
                @click="copyToClipboard('busy')"
                class="p-option p-hover rounded-xl flex-1 p-3 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
            >
                Lotado
            </button>

            <button
                @click="copyToClipboard(null)"
                class="p-option p-hover rounded-xl flex-1 p-3 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
            >
                Sem estimativa
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import { usePosSettings } from "@/Pages/Pos/Composables/usePosSettings";
import { useOrderExport } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderExport"; // 🚀 Importado

const props = defineProps({ cart: Array, metadata: Object, totals: Object });
const emit = defineEmits(['close']);
const toast = useToast();
const { estimateMode, estimateMin, estimateMax, estimateStep, estimateBusy } = usePosSettings();
const { buildWhatsAppSummary } = useOrderExport(); // 🚀 Instanciado

const generatedEstimates = computed(() => {
    let options = [];
    let current = estimateMin.value;
    let step = estimateStep.value > 0 ? estimateStep.value : 15;

    while (current < estimateMax.value) {
        let next = current + step;
        if (estimateMode.value === 'range') {
            options.push({ label: `${current}-${next} min`, value: `${current} a ${next} minutos` });
        } else {
            options.push({ label: `${current} min`, value: `${current} minutos` });
        }
        current = next;
    }
    return options;
});

const copyToClipboard = async (estimateType) => {
    // 🚀 Chamada limpa para o Composable!
    let text = buildWhatsAppSummary(props.cart, props.metadata, props.totals);

    if (estimateType) {
        text += `\n\n⏱️ *Previsão de Entrega:* `;
        if (estimateType === 'busy') {
            text += `Devido ao alto volume de pedidos, não conseguimos enviar uma estimativa exata no momento. Seu pedido sairá o mais rápido possível!`;
        } else {
            text += estimateType;
        }
    }

    try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        toast.add({ severity: "success", summary: "Copiado!", detail: "Resumo copiado com sucesso.", life: 3000 });
        emit('close');
    } catch (err) {
        toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Erro", detail: "Não foi possível copiar o texto.", life: 3000 });
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
                    Estornado

            <p v-else class="text-xs font-medium text-surface-text truncate">

            :class="{
                'text-surface-muted line-through opacity-40': item.status === 'cancelled',
                'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400': item._type === 'transaction' && item.type === 'in' && item.order_id,
                'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400': item._type === 'transaction' && item.type === 'in' && !item.order_id,
                'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400': item._type === 'transaction' && item.type === 'out',
                'text-surface-text': item._type === 'order' && item.status !== 'cancelled'
            }"
        >
            <span v-if="item._type === 'transaction'">{{ item.type === 'in' ? '+' : '-' }}</span>

        </div>

        <!-- SEFAZ -->
        <div class="w-16 shrink-0 flex justify-center">
            <template v-if="item._type === 'order' && item.status !== 'cancelled'">
                <span
                    v-if="item.fiscal_status === 'authorized'"
                    class="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-check text-[8px]"></i> NFC-e
                </span>
                <span
                    v-else-if="item.fiscal_status === 'rejected'"
                    class="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-danger-500 bg-danger-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-times text-[8px]"></i> Erro
                </span>
                <span
                    v-else
                    class="text-[9px] font-semibold text-surface-muted/60 uppercase tracking-wider"
                >

                </span>
            </template>
        </div>

        <div class="w-8 flex justify-end shrink-0">
            <button
                v-if="item._type === 'order'"
                type="button"
                @click.stop="$emit('action', { type: 'manage', order: item })"
                class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-surface-1 text-surface-muted hover:text-primary-smart hover:bg-surface-3 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center outline-none border border-surface-border/50 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
                title="Abrir Pedido"
            >
                <i class="pi pi-arrow-right text-[9px] font-bold"></i>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { formatCurrency, abbreviateName } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    item: { type: Object, required: true },
    isSelected: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

defineEmits(['toggle-selection', 'action']);

const displayOrderTitle = computed(() => {
    const it = props.item;
    const custName = it.customer_name?.trim();
    const tableNum = it.table_number?.trim();

    if (it.type === 'table') {
        if (!custName || custName.toLowerCase() === `mesa ${tableNum}`.toLowerCase()) {
            return `Mesa ${tableNum || 'Salão'}`;
        }
        return `${custName} • Mesa ${tableNum}`;
    }

    if (it.type === 'delivery') {
        return custName || 'Cliente Delivery';
    }

    return custName || 'Consumidor Final';
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, computed } from 'vue';
import SelectableCard from '@/Components/UI/SelectableCard.vue';
import SegmentedControl from '@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    user: Object,
    payoutDetails: {
        type: Object,
        default: () => ({})
    },
    bankAccounts: {
        type: Array,
        default: () => []
    }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['cancel', 'confirm']);

const activeTab = ref('payment');
const step = ref('method');

const tabOptions = [
    { label: 'Liquidação', value: 'payment', icon: 'pi-money-bill' },
    { label: 'Extrato', value: 'ledger', icon: 'pi-list' }
];

const localGrossRate = ref(0);
const localPaidAmount = ref(0);

const payoutData = ref({
    previous_balance: 0,
    gross_rate: 0,
    consumption_amount: 0,
    net_amount: 0,
    ledger_history: [],
    user: {}
});

const totalDue = computed(() => {
    const prev = payoutData.value.previous_balance || 0;
    const gross = localGrossRate.value || 0;
    const cons = payoutData.value.consumption_amount || 0;
    return Math.max(0, prev + gross - cons);
});

watch(() => props.payoutDetails, (newVal) => {
    if (newVal && Object.keys(newVal).length > 0) {
        payoutData.value = newVal;
        localGrossRate.value = newVal.gross_rate || 0;

        const calcTotal = (newVal.previous_balance || 0) + (newVal.gross_rate || 0) - (newVal.consumption_amount || 0);
        localPaidAmount.value = Math.max(0, calcTotal);
    }
}, { immediate: true, deep: true });

onMounted(() => {
    step.value = 'method';
    activeTab.value = 'payment';
});

const selectMethod = (method, bankAccountId = null) => {
    emit('confirm', {
        method,
        bankAccountId,
        amount: localPaidAmount.value,
        gross_rate: localGrossRate.value,
        consumption_deducted: payoutData.value.consumption_amount
    });
};

const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '';
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }).format(d);
};
</script>
```

```vue
                                <div class="min-w-0 text-right truncate">Liquidação</div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- LINHAS ROLÁVEIS -->
                            <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col divide-y divide-surface-border/50 hide-scrollbar">
                                <template v-for="user in sortedUsers" :key="user.id">
                                    <ShiftAttendanceRow
                                        v-if="attendanceData[user.id]"
                                        :user="user"
                                        :can-payout="effectiveMode !== 'open'"
                                        v-model="attendanceData[user.id]"
                                        @pay-freelancer="(u, rate) => $emit('pay-freelancer', u, rate)"
                                    />
                                </template>

                                <div v-if="sortedUsers.length === 0" class="p-12 text-center text-surface-muted text-sm font-medium">
                                    Nenhum colaborador com cadastro ativo encontrado.
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';
import ShiftAttendanceRow from './ShiftAttendanceRow.vue';
import { useShiftAttendance } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useShiftAttendance';

const props = defineProps({
    users: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    currentAttendees: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    flowMode: {
        type: String,
        default: 'mid_shift', // 'open', 'close', 'mid_shift'
        validator: (v) => ['open', 'close', 'mid_shift'].includes(v)
    },
    isMidShift: { type: Boolean, default: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['cancel', 'confirm', 'pay-freelancer']);

const { syncMidShiftAttendance } = useShiftAttendance();

const attendanceData = ref({});

const effectiveMode = computed(() => {
    if (props.flowMode && props.flowMode !== 'mid_shift') return props.flowMode;
    return props.isMidShift ? 'mid_shift' : 'close';
});

const headerTitle = computed(() => {
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'open') return 'Abertura de Turno • Equipe e Ponto';
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'close') return 'Fechamento de Turno • Equipe e Acertos';
    return 'Escala e Ponto';
});

const headerSubtitle = computed(() => {
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'open') return 'Confirme a presença e funções dos colaboradores antes de abrir o caixa.';
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'close') return 'Confirme a presença e efetue os acertos dos freelancers para encerrar o turno.';
    return 'Gerencie a presença da sua equipe em ordem alfabética.';
});

const headerIcon = computed(() => {
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'open') return 'pi-user-plus';
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'close') return 'pi-user-check';
    return 'pi-users';
});

const confirmButtonLabel = computed(() => {
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'open') return 'Avançar para Abertura de Caixa';
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'close') return 'Confirmar e Finalizar';
    return 'Salvar Ponto';
});

const confirmButtonIcon = computed(() => {
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'open') return 'pi-arrow-right';
    if (effectiveMode.value === 'close') return 'pi-check-circle';
    return 'pi-check';
});

const sortedUsers = computed(() => {
    const safeUsers = Array.isArray(props.users) ? props.users : [];
    return [...safeUsers].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
});

const roleWarnings = computed(() => {
    const warnings = [];
    const roleCounts = {};

    Object.values(attendanceData.value).forEach(data => {
        if (data && data.status === 'present' && data.assigned_role) {
            roleCounts[data.assigned_role] = (roleCounts[data.assigned_role] || 0) + 1;
        }
    });

    if (roleCounts['pos'] > 1) warnings.push('Não é permitido ter mais de um Caixa (POS) ativo.');
    if (roleCounts['manager'] > 1 || roleCounts['admin'] > 1) warnings.push('Há mais de um Gestor/Admin definido.');

    return warnings;
});

const initAttendanceData = () => {
    const newState = {};
    const safeUsers = Array.isArray(props.users) ? props.users : [];
    const safeAttendees = Array.isArray(props.currentAttendees) ? props.currentAttendees : [];

    safeUsers.forEach(u => {
        const existing = safeAttendees.find(a => a.user_id === u.id);

        const primaryRole = u.roles && u.roles.length > 0
            ? u.roles[0].name
            : (u.available_roles?.[0]?.value || 'waiter');

        if (existing) {
            newState[u.id] = {
                status: existing.attendance_status || 'present',
                rate: existing.daily_rate > 0 ? existing.daily_rate : (u.base_remuneration || u.default_rate || 0),
                is_paid: !!existing.account_payable_id,
                assigned_role: existing.assigned_role || primaryRole
            };
        } else {
            let defaultStatus = 'absent';

            if (u.employment_type === 'clt' || u.employment_type === 'partner' || u.is_scheduled) {
                defaultStatus = 'present';
            }

            newState[u.id] = {
                status: defaultStatus,
                rate: u.base_remuneration || u.default_rate || 0,
                is_paid: false,
                assigned_role: primaryRole
            };
        }
    });

    attendanceData.value = { ...attendanceData.value, ...newState };
};

// 🚀 Reage tanto à lista geral quanto às atualizações dos presentes (ex: após pagar diária)
watch(() => [props.users, props.currentAttendees], () => {
    initAttendanceData();
}, { deep: true, immediate: true });

const isSubmitting = ref(false);

const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (roleWarnings.value.length > 0 || isSubmitting.value) return;

    isSubmitting.value = true;

    const payload = Object.keys(attendanceData.value).map(userId => {
        const data = attendanceData.value[userId];
        return {
            user_id: parseInt(userId),
            attendance_status: data.status,
            daily_rate: data.status === 'present' ? Number(data.rate) : 0,
            assigned_role: data.assigned_role
        };
    });

    if (effectiveMode.value === 'mid_shift') {
        syncMidShiftAttendance(payload, () => {
            isSubmitting.value = false;
            emit('cancel');
        });
    } else {
        isSubmitting.value = false;
        emit('confirm', { attendees: payload });
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { computed } from 'vue';
import AvatarBox from '@/Components/UI/AvatarBox.vue';
import SegmentedControl from '@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue';
import { abbreviateName, formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    user: { type: Object, required: true },
    modelValue: { type: Object, required: true },
    canPayout: { type: Boolean, default: true }
});

defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'pay-freelancer']);

const isClt = computed(() => props.user.employment_type === 'clt');

const attendanceOptions = computed(() => [
    { label: 'Sim', value: 'present' },
    { label: 'Falta', value: 'absent' },
    { label: 'Folga', value: 'day_off', disabled: !isClt.value },
    { label: 'Férias', value: 'vacation', disabled: !isClt.value }
]);

const getRoleLabel = (roleValue, availableRoles) => {
    if (!availableRoles) return roleValue;
    const role = availableRoles.find(r => r.value === roleValue);
    return role ? role.label : roleValue;
};

const getAvatarColor = (roleValue) => {
    const colors = {
        'admin': 'bg-red-500',
        'manager': 'bg-purple-500',
        'pos': 'bg-blue-500',
        'waiter': 'bg-primary-500',
        'driver': 'bg-orange-500',
        'kitchen': 'bg-amber-500'
    };
    return colors[roleValue] || 'bg-stone-500';
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, computed, watch, nextTick } from 'vue';
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    actionType: { type: String, default: 'close_shift_override' },
    itemName: { type: String, default: '' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'confirm']);

const pin = ref('');
const pinInputRef = ref(null);

watch(() => props.visible, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) {
        pin.value = '';
        nextTick(() => {
            pinInputRef.value?.focus();
        });
    }
});

const modalTitle = computed(() => {
    const titles = {
        close_shift_override: 'Quebra de Caixa',
        cash_out: 'Autorização de Sangria',
        shift_attendance: 'Validação de Escala'
    };
    return titles[props.actionType] || 'Autorização do Gestor';
});

const modalIcon = computed(() => {
    const icons = {
        close_shift_override: 'pi-exclamation-triangle',
        cash_out: 'pi-arrow-up',
        shift_attendance: 'pi-users'
    };
    return icons[props.actionType] || 'pi-lock';
});

const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (!pin.value || pin.value.length < 3) return;
    emit('confirm', { password: pin.value });
};
</script>
```

```vue
                            </button>

                            <InputNumber
                                :ref="el => setInputRef(el, getIndex(key))"
                                v-model="counts[key]"
                                :min="0"
                                autocomplete="off"
                                @keydown="handleKeydown($event, getIndex(key))"
                                class="w-full [&>input]:w-full [&>input]:h-9 [&>input]:text-center [&>input]:px-1 [&>input]:text-xs [&>input]:font-black bg-surface-2 rounded-xl border-transparent focus:border-primary-500"
                            />

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                tabindex="-1"
                                @click="stepDecrement(key)"
                                :disabled="!counts[key] || counts[key] <= 0"
                                class="w-full h-7 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 hover:bg-surface-3 active:scale-95 text-surface-muted hover:text-surface-text flex items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer mt-1 border-none disabled:opacity-20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                                title="Remover 1 moeda"
                            >
                                <i class="pi pi-minus text-[10px] font-bold"></i>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import InputNumber from 'primevue/inputnumber';

const props = defineProps({
    mode: {
        type: String,
        default: 'open',
        validator: (v) => ['open', 'close'].includes(v)
    },
    companySettings: {
        type: Object,
        default: () => ({})
    },
    expectedTotal: {
        type: Number,
        default: 0
    }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:data', 'submit']);

const isOpenMode = computed(() => props.mode === 'open');

const simpleTotal = ref(0);
const retainedCoins = ref(0);
const counts = ref({
    b200: null, b100: null, b50: null, b20: null, b10: null, b5: null, b2: null,
    c1: null, c50: null, c25: null, c10: null, c5: null
});

// Reseta o form: chamável do componente pai
const resetForm = () => {
    simpleTotal.value = 0;
    retainedCoins.value = 0;
    Object.keys(counts.value).forEach(key => {
        counts.value[key] = null;
    });
};

defineExpose({
    resetForm
});

const moneyValues = {
    bills: { b200: 200, b100: 100, b50: 50, b20: 20, b10: 10, b5: 5, b2: 2 },
    coins: { c1: 1, c50: 0.5, c25: 0.25, c10: 0.1, c5: 0.05 }
};

const formatMoney = (val) => Number(val || 0).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');

const stepIncrement = (key) => {
    counts.value[key] = (Number(counts.value[key]) || 0) + 1;
};

const stepDecrement = (key) => {
    const current = Number(counts.value[key]) || 0;
    counts.value[key] = current > 1 ? current - 1 : (current === 1 ? 0 : null);
};

const allKeys = [...Object.keys(moneyValues.bills), ...Object.keys(moneyValues.coins)];
const inputRefs = ref([]);

const getIndex = (key) => allKeys.indexOf(key);

const setInputRef = (el, index) => {
    if (el) inputRefs.value[index] = el;
};

const focusInput = (index) => {
    const component = inputRefs.value[index];
    if (component && component.$el) {
        const input = component.$el.querySelector('input');
        if (input) {
            input.focus();
            setTimeout(() => input.select(), 10);
        }
    }
};

const handleKeydown = (event, index) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (index < allKeys.length - 1) {
            focusInput(index + 1);
        } else {
            emit('submit');
        }
    } else if (event.key === 'Backspace') {
        const val = counts.value[allKeys[index]];
        if (!val && index > 0) {
            event.preventDefault();
            focusInput(index - 1);
        }
    }
};

const coinsTotal = computed(() => {
    return Object.keys(moneyValues.coins).reduce((sum, k) => sum + ((counts.value[k] || 0) * moneyValues.coins[k]), 0);
});

const calculatedTotal = computed(() => {
    const bills = Object.keys(moneyValues.bills).reduce((sum, k) => sum + ((counts.value[k] || 0) * moneyValues.bills[k]), 0);
    return bills + coinsTotal.value;
});

const isConfirmDisabled = computed(() => {
    if (!isOpenMode.value && props.companySettings.cash_opening_mode === 'total' && props.companySettings.carry_over_mode === 'coins_only') {
        return Number(retainedCoins.value) > Number(simpleTotal.value);
    }
    return false;
});

// Sincroniza em tempo real com o painel lateral da direita
watch([counts, simpleTotal, retainedCoins, calculatedTotal, coinsTotal, isConfirmDisabled], () => {
    const isDetailed = props.companySettings.cash_opening_mode !== 'total';
    const finalAmount = isDetailed ? calculatedTotal.value : Number(simpleTotal.value || 0);

    let retainedAmount = 0;
    if (!isOpenMode.value) {
        if (props.companySettings.carry_over_mode === 'total') {
            retainedAmount = finalAmount;
        } else if (props.companySettings.carry_over_mode === 'coins_only') {
            retainedAmount = isDetailed ? coinsTotal.value : Number(retainedCoins.value || 0);
        }
    }

    emit('update:data', {
        amount: finalAmount,
        retainedAmount: retainedAmount,
        coinsTotal: coinsTotal.value,
        details: isDetailed ? counts.value : null,
        isValid: !isConfirmDisabled.value
    });
}, { deep: true, immediate: true });
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { useConfirm } from 'primevue/useconfirm';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    mode: { type: String, default: 'open' },
    companySettings: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    amount: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    coinsTotal: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    isValid: { type: Boolean, default: true },
    hasActiveShift: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    hasStagedAttendees: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['confirm', 'cancel', 'back-to-attendance']);
const confirm = useConfirm();

const isOpenMode = computed(() => props.mode === 'open');
const observation = ref('');
const isConfirming = ref(false);

const formatMoney = (val) => Number(val || 0).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');

const triggerConfirmation = () => {
    if (!props.isValid || isConfirming.value) return;
    isConfirming.value = true;

    const acceptCallback = () => {
        isConfirming.value = false;
        emit('confirm', { observation: observation.value });
    };

    const rejectCallback = () => {
        isConfirming.value = false;
    };

    if (isOpenMode.value) {
        confirm.require({
            message: `Confirma a abertura do caixa com o fundo de troco de R$ ${formatMoney(props.amount)}?`,
            header: 'Abertura de Caixa',
            icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
            acceptProps: { label: 'Sim, Abrir Caixa', icon: 'pi pi-check' },
            rejectProps: { label: 'Revisar', severity: 'secondary', outlined: true, icon: 'pi pi-times' },
            accept: acceptCallback,
            reject: rejectCallback,
            onHide: rejectCallback
        });
    } else {
        // No fechamento, avança diretamente para a etapa de acertos
        isConfirming.value = false;
        emit('confirm', { observation: observation.value });
    }
};

defineExpose({ triggerConfirmation });
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    currentShift: { type: Object, default: () => null },
    dynamicTotal: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    expectedInDrawer: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    selectedCount: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    unifiedHistory: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const page = usePage();

const formatMoney = (value) => parseFloat(value || 0).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');

const shiftOrders = computed(() => {
    const fromUnified = (props.unifiedHistory || []).filter(item => item._type === 'order' && item.status !== 'cancelled');
    if (fromUnified.length > 0) return fromUnified;

    const fromProps = (page.props.ordersHistory || []).filter(o => o.status !== 'cancelled');
    return fromProps.map(o => ({ ...o, amount: Number(o.total || o.amount || 0) }));
});

const displayRevenue = computed(() => shiftOrders.value.reduce((sum, order) => sum + Number(order.amount ?? order.total ?? order._mathValue ?? 0), 0));
const displayOrderCount = computed(() => shiftOrders.value.length);
const displayAvgTicket = computed(() => displayOrderCount.value === 0 ? 0 : displayRevenue.value / displayOrderCount.value);

// 🚀 Aqui separamos por Valor (amount) e Quantidade (count)
const displayByType = computed(() => {
    const byType = {
        delivery: { amount: 0, count: 0 },
        table: { amount: 0, count: 0 },
        counter: { amount: 0, count: 0 }
    };

    shiftOrders.value.forEach(order => {
        const type = order.type || 'counter';
        const val = Number(order.amount ?? order.total ?? order._mathValue ?? 0);

        if (byType[type] !== undefined) {
            byType[type].amount += val;
            byType[type].count += 1;
        } else {
            byType.counter.amount += val;
            byType.counter.count += 1;
        }
    });

    return byType;
});

const parseSafeTime = (dateVal) => {
    if (!dateVal) return null;
    const str = String(dateVal).trim();
    const match = str.match(/(?:T|\s|^)([01]\d|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)/);
    if (match) return `${match[1]}:${match[2]}`;
    try {
        const d = new Date(str);
        if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
};

const formattedShiftStart = computed(() => {
    const shift = props.currentShift || page.props.currentShift;
    const shiftDate = shift?.opened_at || shift?.created_at;
    if (shiftDate) {
        const parsed = parseSafeTime(shiftDate);
        if (parsed) return parsed;
    }

    const openTx = (props.unifiedHistory || []).find(item => item._type === 'transaction' && ((item.description && item.description.toLowerCase().includes('abert')) || item.is_opening_balance === true));
    if (openTx) return parseSafeTime(openTx.created_at || openTx.time);

    return '--:--';
});
</script>
```

```vue
                <label class="text-xs font-medium text-stone-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Observação (Opcional)</label>
                <InputText v-model="observation" placeholder="Relate algo sobre o turno..." class="w-full" />
            </div>
        </div>

        <template #footer>
            <SecureActionButton action-code="cancel" label="Cancelar" variant="text" severity="secondary" @secure-click="$emit('update:visible', false)" />
            <SecureActionButton :action-code="actionType === 'open' ? 'open_shift' : 'close_shift'" :label="actionType === 'open' ? 'Abrir Caixa' : 'Confirmar Fechamento'" icon="pi-check" :disabled="isConfirmDisabled" severity="primary" custom-class="h-11 px-4 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold" @secure-click="handleConfirm" />
        </template>
    </BaseModal>
</template>

<script setup>
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';

import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import Button from 'primevue/button';
import InputNumber from 'primevue/inputnumber';
import InputText from 'primevue/inputtext';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({ visible: Boolean, actionType: String, companySettings: Object });
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'confirm']);

const simpleTotal = ref(0);
const retainedCoins = ref(0);
const observation = ref("");

const moneyValues = {
    bills: { b200: 200, b100: 100, b50: 50, b20: 20, b10: 10, b5: 5, b2: 2 },
    coins: { c1: 1, c50: 0.5, c25: 0.25, c10: 0.1, c5: 0.05 }
};

const counts = ref({});

const resetCounts = () => {
    Object.keys(moneyValues.bills).forEach(k => counts.value[k] = 0);
    Object.keys(moneyValues.coins).forEach(k => counts.value[k] = 0);
    simpleTotal.value = 0;
    retainedCoins.value = 0;
    observation.value = "";
};

// Soma apenas as moedas (para o modo detalhado)
const coinsTotal = computed(() => {
    let sum = 0;
    Object.keys(moneyValues.coins).forEach(k => sum += (counts.value[k] || 0) * moneyValues.coins[k]);
    return sum;
});

const calculatedTotal = computed(() => {
    let sum = 0;
    Object.keys(moneyValues.bills).forEach(k => sum += (counts.value[k] || 0) * moneyValues.bills[k]);
    sum += coinsTotal.value;
    return sum;
});

const isConfirmDisabled = computed(() => {
    if (props.actionType === 'open') return false;
    // Impede o usuário de reter mais troco do que o total que ele informou na gaveta
    if (props.companySettings.cash_opening_mode === 'total' && props.companySettings.carry_over_mode === 'coins_only') {
        return retainedCoins.value > simpleTotal.value;
    }
    return false;
});

watch(() => props.visible, (newVal) => { if (newVal) resetCounts(); });

const handleConfirm = () => {
    const finalAmount = props.companySettings.cash_opening_mode === 'detailed' ? calculatedTotal.value : Number(simpleTotal.value);

    // Calcula automaticamente o fundo de troco retido para enviar ao backend
    let retainedAmount = 0;
    if (props.actionType === 'close') {
        if (props.companySettings.carry_over_mode === 'total') {
            retainedAmount = finalAmount;
        } else if (props.companySettings.carry_over_mode === 'coins_only') {
            retainedAmount = props.companySettings.cash_opening_mode === 'detailed' ? coinsTotal.value : Number(retainedCoins.value);
        }
    }

    const payload = {
        amount: finalAmount,
        retained_amount: retainedAmount, // 🚀 NOVO: Enviamos o valor retido para o Laravel
        observation: observation.value,
        details: props.companySettings.cash_opening_mode === 'detailed' ? counts.value : null
    };

    emit('confirm', payload);
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import InputNumber from 'primevue/inputnumber';

const props = defineProps({
    type: {
        type: String,
        default: 'in'
    }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['confirm', 'cancel']);

const amount = ref(null);
const description = ref('');
const isSubmitting = ref(false);

const isInput = computed(() => props.type === 'in');
const isValid = computed(() => Number(amount.value) > 0 && description.value.trim().length >= 3);

watch(() => props.type, () => {
    amount.value = null;
    description.value = '';
    isSubmitting.value = false;
});

const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (!isValid.value || isSubmitting.value) return;
    isSubmitting.value = true;
    emit('confirm', {
        type: props.type,
        amount: Number(amount.value),
        description: description.value.trim()
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-surface-text">{{ currentAddressText }}</span>
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 mt-2">
                <h3 class="text-sm font-black text-surface-muted pl-1 text-center">Selecione outro endereço</h3>

                <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <div v-if="formattedAddresses.length > 0" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
                        <!-- 🚀 CORRIGIDO: O botão absoluto duplicado foi deletado daqui -->
                        <AddressCard
                            v-for="addr in formattedAddresses"
                            :key="addr.id"
                            :address="addr"
                            :customer-id="order?.customer_id"
                            :is-selected="selectedAddressId === addr.id"
                            @select="selectAddress"
                            @deactivate="$emit('deactivate', $event)"
                            @edit="$emit('edit', $event)"
                        />
                    </div>
                    <div v-else class="text-center p-4 bg-surface-2 rounded-xl border border-surface-border text-xs font-medium text-surface-muted">
                        Este cliente não possui outros endereços salvos.
                    </div>

                    <button @click="$emit('create-new')" class="w-full mt-2 p-4 border border-dashed border-primary-500/40 rounded-xl bg-primary-500/5 text-primary-600 hover:bg-primary-500/10 hover:border-primary-500/60 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 outline-none cursor-pointer">
                        <i class="pi pi-plus text-sm"></i>

                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

            <SecureActionButton action-code="cancel" label="Cancelar" variant="text" severity="secondary" custom-class="font-medium flex-1" @secure-click="handleCancel" />
            <Button
                label="Confirmar"
                icon="pi pi-check"
                @click="handleConfirm"
                :disabled="!selectedAddressId || isCurrentAddressSelected"
                class="flex-1 font-black shadow-md"
            />
        </div>
    </component>
</template>

<script setup>
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';

import { ref, computed, watch } from "vue";
import Button from "primevue/button";
import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";
import AddressCard from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/AddressCard.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    order: Object,
    mode: { type: String, default: 'modal' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["update:visible", "confirm", "deactivate", "cancel", "create-new", "edit"]);

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (value) => emit("update:visible", value),
});

const selectedAddressId = ref(null);
const selectedAddressObj = ref(null);

const currentAddressText = computed(() => {
    if (typeof props.order?.address === 'string') return props.order.address;
    if (props.order?.address?.full_address) return props.order.address.full_address;
    return 'Nenhum endereço selecionado';
});

const currentAddressId = computed(() => {
    return props.order?.address_id || props.order?.address?.id || null;
});

const isCurrentAddressSelected = computed(() => {
    return selectedAddressId.value === currentAddressId.value;
});

watch(() => props.visible, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) {
        selectedAddressId.value = currentAddressId.value;
        selectedAddressObj.value = null;
    }
});

const formattedAddresses = computed(() => {
    if (!props.order?.customer?.addresses) return [];

    return props.order.customer.addresses
        .filter(addr => addr.is_active !== false && addr.is_active !== 0 && addr.is_active !== '0')
        .map(addr => {
            let addressText = addr.full_address;
            if (!addressText && addr.street) {
                const streetName = typeof addr.street === 'object' ? addr.street.name : addr.street;
                const neighborhoodName = typeof addr.neighborhood === 'object' ? addr.neighborhood.name : addr.neighborhood;
                addressText = `${streetName}, ${addr.number || 'S/N'} - ${neighborhoodName || 'Bairro Indefinido'}`;
                if (addr.complement) addressText += ` (${addr.complement})`;
            }

            let fee = addr.delivery_fee;
            if ((fee === undefined || fee === null) && addr.neighborhood) {
                fee = typeof addr.neighborhood === 'object' ? addr.neighborhood.delivery_fee : 0;
            }

            return { ...addr, full_address: addressText || 'Endereço sem detalhes', delivery_fee: Number(fee || 0) };
        });
});

const selectAddress = (addr) => {
    selectedAddressId.value = addr.id;
    selectedAddressObj.value = addr;
};

const handleCancel = () => {
    emit("cancel");
    if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};

const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (!selectedAddressObj.value) return;
    emit("confirm", {
        order_id: props.order.id,
        new_address_id: selectedAddressObj.value.id,
        new_address: selectedAddressObj.value.full_address,
        new_delivery_fee: selectedAddressObj.value.delivery_fee
    });
    if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};
</script>
```

```vue
                    >

                    {{ $formatCurrency(item.catalog_price) }}
                </span>

            <span v-else class="text-sm font-black text-surface-text">
                {{ $formatCurrency(displayPrice) }}
            </span>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from "vue";
import { formatCurrency, formatFraction, abbreviateName } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";
import QtyStepper from "@/Components/UI/QtyStepper.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    item: Object,
    mode: { type: String, default: 'checkout' },
    isSelected: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isExpanded: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["increment", "decrement", "divide-item", "toggle-menu", "toggle-select", "toggle-expand"]);

const { formatModifiersList } = useOrderFormatting();
const localDivisor = ref("");

const handleExpandToggle = () => {
    emit('toggle-expand', props.item.id);
};

const isActive = computed(() => {
    if (props.mode === 'details') return props.isSelected;
    return props.item.selected_parts > 0;
});

const displayPrice = computed(() => {
    const ppu = props.item.parts_per_unit || 1;
    const price = props.item.effective_unit_price || 0;

    if (props.mode === 'details') {
        const parts = props.item.available_parts || props.item.quantity || 1;
        return parts * (price / ppu);
    }

    // No checkout: se estiver selecionado, calcula a cota selecionada; se estiver 0, mostra a cota de 1 unidade
    const parts = props.item.selected_parts > 0 ? props.item.selected_parts : 1;
    return parts * (price / ppu);
});

const parsedModifiersLines = computed(() => formatModifiersList(props.item));

const formatTime = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return '--:--';
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};

let debounceTimer = null;
watch(localDivisor, (newVal) => {
    if (!newVal && newVal !== 0) return;
    if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const val = parseInt(newVal);
        if (val && val >= 1) emit("divide-item", props.item, val);
        localDivisor.value = "";
    }, 800);
});

const handleInputImmediate = () => {
    if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    const val = parseInt(localDivisor.value);
    if (val && val >= 1) emit("divide-item", props.item, val);
    localDivisor.value = "";
};
</script>

.animate-fade-in { animation: fade-in 0.2s ease-out forwards; }
</style>
```

```vue
                    <CheckoutItem
                        v-show="!item.is_combo_child || expandedCombos.includes(item.combo_parent_id) || Boolean(searchQuery)"
                        :item="item"
                        :mode="mode"
                        :is-selected="mode === 'details' ? selectedIds.includes(item.id) : (item.selected_parts > 0)"
                        :is-expanded="expandedCombos.includes(item.id) || Boolean(searchQuery)"
                        @increment="$emit('increment', item)"
                        @decrement="$emit('decrement', item)"
                        @divide-item="(arg1, arg2) => handleItemDivide(item, arg1, arg2)"

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from "vue";
import CheckoutItem from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutItem.vue";
import CheckoutPaymentHistory from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutPaymentHistory.vue";
import ItemActionPopover from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/ItemActionPopover.vue";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";

const props = defineProps({
    displayItems: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    orderPayments: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    mode: { type: String, default: 'checkout' },
    selectedIds: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    isAllSelected: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    searchQuery: { type: String, default: '' }
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    "increment",
    "decrement",
    "divide-item",
    "quick-add",
    "quick-cancel",
    "toggle-select",
    "toggle-all",
    "action",
    "rollback-payment"
]);

const { formatModifiersList } = useOrderFormatting();

const expandedCombos = ref([]);
const actionPopoverRef = ref(null);

const toggleCombo = (id) => {
    const idx = expandedCombos.value.indexOf(id);
    if (idx > -1) expandedCombos.value.splice(idx, 1);
    else expandedCombos.value.push(id);
};

const handleToggleMenu = (event, item) => {
    if (actionPopoverRef.value) {
        actionPopoverRef.value.toggle(event, item);
    }
};

const itemMatchesQuery = (item, query) => {
    if (!query) return true;
    const cleanQ = String(query).toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!cleanQ) return true;

    const name = String(item.product_name || item.name || '').toLowerCase();
    if (name.includes(cleanQ)) return true;

    const notes = String(item.notes || '').toLowerCase();
    if (notes.includes(cleanQ)) return true;

    const modLines = formatModifiersList(item) || [];
    if (modLines.some(line => String(line).toLowerCase().includes(cleanQ))) {
        return true;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(item.modifiers)) {
        const matched = item.modifiers.some(m => {
            const mName = String(m.name || m.modifier_name || m.option_name || '').toLowerCase();
            return mName.includes(cleanQ);
        });
        if (matched) return true;
    }

    const structured = item.structured_modifiers || item.structuredModifiers;
    if (Array.isArray(structured)) {
        const matched = structured.some(m => String(m.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanQ));
        if (matched) return true;
    }

    return false;
};

const activeItems = computed(() => {
    const rawItems = props.displayItems || [];
    if (!rawItems.length) return [];

    let base = rawItems.filter(i => i.status !== 'cancelled');

    if (props.mode !== 'details') {
        base = base.filter(i => (Number(i.available_parts) > 0.0001 || Number(i.selected_parts) > 0));
    }

    const q = (props.searchQuery || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!q) {
        return base;
    }

    const matchingIds = new Set();
    const parentsToKeep = new Set();

    base.forEach(item => {
        if (itemMatchesQuery(item, q)) {
            matchingIds.add(String(item.id));
            if (item.unique_id) matchingIds.add(String(item.unique_id));
            if (item.is_combo_child && item.combo_parent_id) {
                parentsToKeep.add(String(item.combo_parent_id));
            }
        }
    });

    return base.filter(item => {
        const itemIdStr = String(item.id);
        const uniqueIdStr = item.unique_id ? String(item.unique_id) : null;
        const isDirectMatch = matchingIds.has(itemIdStr) || (uniqueIdStr && matchingIds.has(uniqueIdStr));

        if (isDirectMatch) return true;

        if (item.has_exploded_children && parentsToKeep.has(itemIdStr)) {
            return true;
        }

        if (item.is_combo_child && item.combo_parent_id && matchingIds.has(String(item.combo_parent_id))) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    });
});

const paidItems = computed(() => {
    return (props.displayItems || []).filter((i) => {
        const paid = i.paid_parts !== undefined ? Number(i.paid_parts) : Number(i.paid_qty || 0);
        return paid > 0.0001;
    }).map(i => {
        if (i.paid_parts === undefined) {
            return { ...i, paid_parts: Number(i.paid_qty || 0), parts_per_unit: 1, effective_unit_price: Number(i.unit_price) };
        }
        return i;
    });
});

const handleItemDivide = (loopItem, arg1, arg2) => {
    const targetItem = (arg2 !== undefined && typeof arg1 === 'object') ? arg1 : loopItem;
    const targetDivisor = arg2 !== undefined ? arg2 : arg1;
    emit('divide-item', targetItem, targetDivisor);
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.scroll-container {
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}
</style>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import { formatFraction } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";

const props = defineProps({
    orderPayments: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    paidItems: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    mode: { type: String, default: 'checkout' }
});

defineEmits(['rollback-payment']);

const { formatModifiersList } = useOrderFormatting();
const getItemModsLines = (item) => formatModifiersList(item);

const totalPaidAmount = computed(() => {
    if (props.orderPayments && props.orderPayments.length > 0) {
        return props.orderPayments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.amount || 0), 0);
    }
    return props.paidItems.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.paid_parts * (i.effective_unit_price / i.parts_per_unit)), 0);
});

const paymentBlocks = computed(() => {
    const payments = props.orderPayments || [];
    if (payments.length === 0) return [];

    return payments.map(pay => {
        if (Array.isArray(pay.items) && pay.items.length > 0) {
            return {
                ...pay,
                items: pay.items.map(it => {
                    const qty = Number(it.pivot?.quantity ?? it.quantity ?? 1);
                    let amount = Number(it.pivot?.amount ?? it.total_amount ?? 0);

                    if (amount <= 0 && Number(pay.amount) > 0) {
                        amount = pay.items.length === 1
                            ? Number(pay.amount)
                            : (qty * (Number(it.unit_price) || (Number(pay.amount) / pay.items.length)));
                    }

                    let ppu = Number(it.parts_per_unit || 1);
                    let paid_parts = qty;

                    if (qty > 0 && qty < 1) {
                        ppu = Math.round(1 / qty);
                        paid_parts = Math.round(qty * ppu);
                    } else if (qty % 1 !== 0) {
                        ppu = 2;
                        paid_parts = Math.round(qty * 2);
                    }

                    return {
                        ...it,
                        name: it.name || it.product_name,
                        paid_parts: paid_parts,
                        parts_per_unit: ppu,
                        effective_unit_price: qty > 0 ? (amount / qty) : amount,
                        total_amount: amount,
                        modifiers: it.modifiers || [],
                        notes: it.notes || null
                    };
                })
            };
        }

        if (payments.length === 1 && props.paidItems.length > 0) {
            return {
                ...pay,
                items: props.paidItems.map(it => ({
                    ...it,
                    total_amount: it.paid_parts * (it.effective_unit_price / it.parts_per_unit)
                }))
            };
        }

        return { ...pay, items: [] };
    });
});

const unassignedPaidItems = computed(() => {
    const hasAttachedItems = (props.orderPayments || []).some(p => Array.isArray(p.items) && p.items.length > 0);
    if (hasAttachedItems || (props.orderPayments || []).length <= 1) return [];
    return props.paidItems;
});

const getPaymentIcon = (methodName = '') => {
    const m = String(methodName).toLowerCase();
    if (m.includes('pix')) return 'pi pi-bolt';
    if (m.includes('cart') || m.includes('créd') || m.includes('déb')) return 'pi pi-credit-card';
    if (m.includes('dinheiro') || m.includes('money') || m.includes('espécie')) return 'pi pi-money-bill';
    return 'pi pi-wallet';
};

const formatPaymentTime = (dateValue) => {
    if (!dateValue) return '';
    try {
        const str = String(dateValue);
        if (str.includes(' ') && str.split(' ')[1]) return str.split(' ')[1].substring(0, 5);
        if (str.includes('T')) {
            const date = new Date(str);
            if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) return date.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        }
        const date = new Date(dateValue);
        if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) return date.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        return str.substring(11, 16);
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
};
</script>
```

```vue
            :class="{ 'opacity-40 pointer-events-none': !$page.props.hasOpenShift }"
            :available-methods="mappedMethods"
            :staged-payments="stagedPayments"
            :remaining-amount="pendingToStage"
            :suggested-amount="suggestedAmount"
            :active-divisor="activeDivisor"
            :allow-change-target="false"
            @divide="$emit('divide', $event)"
            @clear-divisor="$emit('clear-divisor')"

        />

                    :value="customerDocument"
                    @input="handleDocumentInput"
                    placeholder="Deixe em branco p/ Consumidor Final"
                    maxlength="18"
                    class="w-full h-14 pl-12 pr-4 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 text-surface-text text-lg font-black focus:border-primary-500 outline-none transition-all"

<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import PaymentStagingArea from "@/Components/UI/PaymentStagingArea.vue";
import { formatCurrency, formatCpfCnpj } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { usePaymentFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/usePaymentFormatting";

const props = defineProps({
    orderSubtotal: Number,
    deliveryFee: Number,
    serviceFeeAmount: Number,
    discount: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    dynamicTotal: Number,
    pendingToStage: Number,
    suggestedAmount: {
        type: Number,
        default: null
    },
    activeDivisor: {
        type: Number,
        default: null
    },
    stagedPayments: Array,
    paymentMethods: Array,
    companySettings: Object,
    isServiceTaxEnabled: Boolean,
    order: Object,
    cashbackValue: Number,
    customerDocument: String
});

const emit = defineEmits([
    "update:isServiceTaxEnabled",
    "divide",
    "clear-divisor",
    "add-payment",
    "remove-payment",
    "update:cashbackValue",
    "update:customerDocument",
    "go-to-cashier"
]);

const { getPaymentIcon } = usePaymentFormatting();

const isTableServiceAvailable = computed(() => {
    return props.order?.type === 'table' && Boolean(props.companySettings?.has_service_tax);
});

const goToCashier = () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'shift' }));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-close-checkout'));
    emit('go-to-cashier');
};

const handleDocumentInput = (e) => {
    const formatted = formatCpfCnpj(e.target.value);
    e.target.value = formatted;
    emit('update:customerDocument', formatted);
};

const isLoyaltyActive = computed(() => props.companySettings?.loyalty_is_active && props.companySettings?.loyalty_reward_type === 'cashback');

const customerBalanceReais = computed(() => {
    if (!props.order?.customer) return 0;
    const pts = props.order.customer.loyalty_points || 0;
    const rate = Number(props.companySettings?.loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate || 5);
    return (pts / 100) * rate;
});

const mappedMethods = computed(() => {
    let methods = props.paymentMethods.map(m => ({
        id: m.id,
        name: m.name,
        icon: getPaymentIcon(m),
        is_cash: m.engine_type === 'money',
        engine_type: m.engine_type
    }));

    if (isLoyaltyActive.value) {
        const hasCustomer = !!props.order?.customer;
        const balance = customerBalanceReais.value;
        const alreadyStaged = props.stagedPayments.some(p => p.engine_type === 'internal_loyalty');

        let subtitle = 'Sem saldo';
        if (!hasCustomer) subtitle = 'Vincule o cliente';
        else if (alreadyStaged) subtitle = 'Já aplicado';
        else if (balance > 0) subtitle = `Saldo: ${formatCurrency(balance)}`;

        const isDisabled = !hasCustomer || balance <= 0 || alreadyStaged || props.pendingToStage <= 0;

        methods.unshift({
            id: 'cashback',
            name: 'Cashback',
            subtitle: subtitle,
            icon: 'pi-star-fill',
            iconColor: 'text-primary-500 text-2xl',
            is_cash: false,
            engine_type: 'internal_loyalty',
            disabled: isDisabled,
            max_value: balance,
            colorClass: 'border-primary-500/40 bg-primary-500/5 text-primary-700 dark:text-primary-400 hover:bg-primary-500/10 hover:border-primary-500/60'
        });
    }

    return methods;
});

const handleAddPayment = (payload) => {
    if (payload.engine_type === 'internal_loyalty') {
        emit('update:cashbackValue', payload.amount);
    }
    emit('add-payment', payload);
};

const handleRemovePayment = (idx) => {
    const payment = props.stagedPayments[idx];
    if (payment && payment.engine_type === 'internal_loyalty') {
        emit('update:cashbackValue', 0);
    }
    emit('remove-payment', idx);
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';
import { computed } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";

const props = defineProps({
    isCancelled: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    order: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    flashError: { type: String, default: null },
    isEmitting: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    fiscalSuccess: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isZeroRevenue: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

defineEmits(["action"]);

const page = usePage();
const companySettings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});
const isFiscalEmitter = computed(() => companySettings.value.is_fiscal_emitter || false);

const hasFiscalDocument = computed(() => {
    return props.fiscalSuccess === true
        || props.order?.has_fiscal_document === true
        || props.order?.fiscal_status === 'authorized'
        || props.order?.fiscal_document?.status === 'authorized'
        || props.order?.fiscalDocument?.status === 'authorized'
        || page.props.hasFiscalDocument === true
        || false;
});

const isEligibleChannel = computed(() => {
    const type = props.order?.type;
    return ['delivery', 'counter', 'takeaway', 'pickup'].includes(type);
});

const isClaimEligibleChannel = computed(() => {
    const type = props.order?.type;
    return ['table', 'counter', 'takeaway', 'pickup', 'delivery'].includes(type);
});

const isFromCustomerApp = computed(() => {
    const src = props.order?.source;
    const hasEmployee = Boolean(props.order?.employee_id);
    return src === 'customer_app' || (!hasEmployee && !['pos_app', 'team_app', 'pos', 'team'].includes(src));
});

const isFromOperatorApp = computed(() => {
    const src = props.order?.source;
    const hasEmployee = Boolean(props.order?.employee_id);
    return hasEmployee || ['pos_app', 'team_app', 'pos', 'team'].includes(src);
});

const canPrintLoyaltyFlyer = computed(() => {
    const s = companySettings.value;
    const isLoyaltyActive = Boolean(s.loyalty_is_active && s.print_loyalty_flyer);
    const hasRewards = Number(props.order?.loyalty_points_earned || 0) > 0 || Number(props.order?.cashback_earned || 0) > 0;
    const hasCustomer = Boolean(props.order?.customer || props.order?.customer_id);

    return isLoyaltyActive && isEligibleChannel.value && isFromOperatorApp.value && hasCustomer && hasRewards;
});

const canPrintGrowthFlyer = computed(() => {
    const s = companySettings.value;
    return Boolean(s.print_growth_flyer && isEligibleChannel.value && isFromCustomerApp.value);
});

const canPrintTableClaimFlyer = computed(() => {
    const s = companySettings.value;
    const isLoyaltyActive = Boolean(s.loyalty_is_active);
    const isAnonymous = !props.order?.customer && !props.order?.customer_id;
    const hasTotal = Number(props.order?.total || 0) > 0;

    return isLoyaltyActive && isClaimEligibleChannel.value && isAnonymous && hasTotal;
});

const hasAnyFlyerAction = computed(() => {
    return canPrintLoyaltyFlyer.value || canPrintGrowthFlyer.value || canPrintTableClaimFlyer.value;
});

const marketingGridCols = computed(() => {
    const activeCount = [
        canPrintLoyaltyFlyer.value,
        canPrintGrowthFlyer.value,
        canPrintTableClaimFlyer.value
    ].filter(Boolean).length;

    return activeCount > 1 ? 'grid-cols-2' : 'grid-cols-1';
});
</script>
```
