```vue
                    <span>
                        {{ activeItem?.is_combo_child
                            ? 'Duplicar como Avulso (+1)'
                            : (actionScope === 'single' && (activeItem?.quantity || 1) > 1
                                ? 'Duplicar (+1)'
                                : ((activeItem?.quantity || 1) > 1 ? `Duplicar (+${activeItem?.quantity})` : 'Duplicar (+1)'))
                        }}
                    </span>
                </button>

                <!-- 3. EDITAR -->
                <button
                    type="button"
                    @click="dispatchAction('edit')"
                    class="action-btn"
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-pencil action-icon"></i>
                    <span>{{ activeItem?.has_exploded_children || activeItem?.is_combo_child ? 'Editar Combo' : (actionScope === 'single' && (activeItem?.quantity || 1) > 1 ? 'Editar 1 un.' : 'Editar') }}</span>
                </button>

                <!-- 4. Transferir (Bloqueado para subitens de combo) -->
                <button v-if="!activeItem?.is_combo_child" type="button" @click="dispatchAction('transfer')" class="action-btn">
                    <i class="pi pi-sync action-icon"></i>
                    <span>{{ actionScope === 'single' && (activeItem?.quantity || 1) > 1 ? 'Transferir 1 un.' : 'Transferir' }}</span>
                </button>

                <!-- 5. Cancelar / Estornar (Bloqueado para subitens de combo) -->
                <template v-if="!activeItem?.is_combo_child">
                    <div class="h-px bg-surface-border/50 my-1"></div>
                    <button type="button" @click="dispatchAction('cancel')" class="action-btn font-bold text-surface-text hover:text-primary-smart">
                        <i class="pi pi-trash action-icon text-primary-500"></i>
                        <span>{{ actionScope === 'single' && (activeItem?.quantity || 1) > 1 ? 'Estornar 1 un.' : 'Cancelar / Estornar' }}</span>
                    </button>
                </template>
            </div>

            <!-- Ações: Modo Checkout -->
            <div v-else class="flex flex-col gap-0.5 pt-0.5">
                <button type="button" @click="dispatchQuickAdd" class="action-btn">
                    <i class="pi pi-plus-circle action-icon"></i>
                    <span>{{ activeItem?.is_combo_child ? 'Adicionar como Avulso (+1)' : 'Adicionar Lançamento (+1)' }}</span>
                </button>

                <button v-if="!activeItem?.is_combo_child" type="button" @click="dispatchQuickCancel" class="action-btn font-bold text-surface-text hover:text-primary-smart">
                    <i class="pi pi-trash action-icon text-primary-500"></i>
                    <span>Estornar (Requer Senha)</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </Popover>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount } from "vue";
import Popover from "primevue/popover";

const props = defineProps({
    mode: { type: String, default: 'checkout' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["action", "quick-add", "quick-cancel"]);

const popoverRef = ref(null);
const contentRef = ref(null);
const activeItem = ref(null);
const triggerEl = ref(null);
const actionScope = ref('single');

const toggle = (event, item) => {
    activeItem.value = item;
    actionScope.value = 'single';
    triggerEl.value = event.currentTarget || event.target;

    if (popoverRef.value) {
        popoverRef.value.toggle(event);
    }
};

const hide = () => {
    if (popoverRef.value) {
        popoverRef.value.hide();
    }
};

const handleOutsideClick = (e) => {
    if (!contentRef.value || !triggerEl.value) return;

    const clickedInside = contentRef.value.contains(e.target);
    const clickedTrigger = triggerEl.value.contains(e.target);

    if (!clickedInside && !clickedTrigger) {
        hide();
    }
};

const handleShow = () => {
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', handleOutsideClick, true);

    nextTick(() => {
        if (!contentRef.value || !triggerEl.value) return;

        const popoverContainer = contentRef.value.closest('.p-popover') || contentRef.value.parentElement;
        if (!popoverContainer) return;

        const triggerRect = triggerEl.value.getBoundingClientRect();
        const popoverRect = popoverContainer.getBoundingClientRect();

        let left = triggerRect.right + 12 + window.scrollX;
        let isFlipped = false;

        if (triggerRect.right + 12 + popoverRect.width > window.innerWidth - 16) {
            left = triggerRect.left - popoverRect.width - 12 + window.scrollX;
            isFlipped = true;
        }

        let top = triggerRect.top + (triggerRect.height / 2) - 26 + window.scrollY;

        if (top + popoverRect.height > window.innerHeight + window.scrollY - 16) {
            top = window.innerHeight + window.scrollY - popoverRect.height - 16;
        }
        if (top < window.scrollY + 16) {
            top = window.scrollY + 16;
        }

        popoverContainer.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
        popoverContainer.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;

        if (isFlipped) {
            popoverContainer.classList.add('flipped-left');
        } else {
            popoverContainer.classList.remove('flipped-left');
        }
    });
};

const handleHide = () => {
    window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', handleOutsideClick, true);
};

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    handleHide();
});

const dispatchAction = (type) => {
    hide();
    const qty = ((activeItem.value?.quantity || 1) > 1) ? actionScope.value : 'all';
    emit('action', {
        type,
        item: activeItem.value,
        qty
    });
};

const dispatchQuickAdd = () => {
    hide();
    emit('quick-add', activeItem.value);
};

const dispatchQuickCancel = () => {
    hide();
    emit('quick-cancel', activeItem.value);
};

defineExpose({ toggle, hide });
</script>

<style scoped>
:deep(.p-popover:before),
:deep(.p-popover:after) {
    display: none !important;
}

:deep(.lateral-popover-theme::before) {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: -5px;
    top: 20px;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    background-color: var(--surface-1);
    border-left: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1;
}

:deep(.lateral-popover-theme.flipped-left::before) {
    left: auto;
    right: -5px;
    border-left: none;
    border-top: none;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

.action-btn {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.625rem;
    padding: 0.45rem 0.625rem;
    border-radius: 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--surface-text);
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: left;
    transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;

}

}

    transition: color 0.15s ease;
}

}
```

```vue
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';

    visible: Boolean,
    mode: { type: String, default: 'modal' },
    itemName: String,
    actionType: String,
    requiresPin: Boolean,
    itemToProcess: Object
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'cancel', 'confirm']);

    set: (value) => emit('update:visible', value)
});

const form = ref({ reason: null, isLoss: false, lostItems: [], password: '' });

watch(() => props.visible, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) {
        form.value = { reason: null, isLoss: false, lostItems: [], password: '' };
    }
}, { immediate: true });

const isOrderContext = computed(() => props.actionType === 'cancel_order');

// Ações fiscais que acionam cancelamento de NFC-e na SEFAZ
const isFiscalAction = computed(() => ['cancel_order', 'reactivate', 'correct_payment'].includes(props.actionType));

const reasonLength = computed(() => (form.value.reason || '').trim().length);

const orderItems = computed(() => {
    if (isOrderContext.value && props.itemToProcess?.items) {
        return props.itemToProcess.items.filter(i => i.status !== 'cancelled');
    }
    return [];
});

watch(() => form.value.isLoss, (newVal) => {
    if (newVal && isOrderContext.value && orderItems.value.length > 0) {
        form.value.lostItems = orderItems.value.map(i => i.id);
    } else {
        form.value.lostItems = [];
    }
});

const toggleLossItem = (id) => {
    const idx = form.value.lostItems.indexOf(id);
    if (idx > -1) form.value.lostItems.splice(idx, 1);
    else form.value.lostItems.push(id);
};

const toggleAllItems = () => {
    if (form.value.lostItems.length === orderItems.value.length) form.value.lostItems = [];
    else form.value.lostItems = orderItems.value.map(i => i.id);
};

const title = computed(() => {
    if (props.actionType === 'cancel') return 'Estornar Item';
    if (props.actionType === 'cancel_order') return 'Cancelar Pedido';
    if (props.actionType === 'rollback_payment') return 'Estornar Pagamento';
    if (props.actionType === 'reactivate') return 'Reativar Pedido';
    if (props.actionType === 'correct_payment') return 'Corrigir Pagamento';
    if (props.actionType === 'edit' || props.actionType === 'swap') return 'Alteração de Item';
    return 'Autorização';
});

const iconColors = computed(() => {
    if (props.actionType === 'cancel' || props.actionType === 'cancel_order') {
        return { bg: 'bg-red-500/10', icon: 'pi-times-circle', text: 'text-red-600' };
    }
    if (props.actionType === 'rollback_payment' || props.actionType === 'correct_payment') {
        return { bg: 'bg-amber-500/10', icon: 'pi-exclamation-triangle', text: 'text-amber-500' };
    }
    if (props.actionType === 'reactivate') {
        return { bg: 'bg-primary-500/10', icon: 'pi-refresh', text: 'text-primary-600' };
    }
    return { bg: 'bg-primary-500/10', icon: 'pi-pencil', text: 'text-primary-600' };
});

const showLossOptions = computed(() => ['cancel', 'cancel_order', 'swap'].includes(props.actionType));

// Todos os motivos agora respeitam estritamente a exigência legal de >= 15 caracteres da SEFAZ
const reasons = computed(() => {
    if (props.actionType === 'reactivate') {
        return [
            'Reabertura para inclusão de novos itens',
            'Reabertura solicitada pelo cliente',
            'Fechamento indevido pelo operador',
            'Ajuste operacional de comanda'
        ];
    }
    if (props.actionType === 'correct_payment') {
        return [
            'Forma de pagamento lançada incorreta',
            'Cliente solicitou troca da forma de pagamento',
            'Divisão de valores lançada incorretamente',
            'Ajuste de bandeira ou modalidade do cartão'
        ];
    }
    if (props.actionType === 'rollback_payment') {
        return [
            'Erro no lançamento da forma de pagamento',
            'Cliente solicitou troca do meio de pagamento',
            'Divisão de conta lançada incorretamente',
            'Pagamento duplicado no sistema'
        ];
    }
    if (props.actionType === 'cancel' || props.actionType === 'cancel_order') {
        return [
            'Erro de lançamento operacional do pedido',
            'Desistência do pedido pelo cliente',
            'Falta de insumos para preparo do prato',
            'Demora excessiva na produção ou entrega'
        ];
    }
    return [
        'Troca solicitada pelo cliente',
        'Erro no lançamento do pedido',
        'Falta de insumos para preparo',
        'Problema na qualidade do item'
    ];
});

const confirmLabel = computed(() => {
    if (props.actionType === 'cancel' || props.actionType === 'cancel_order' || props.actionType === 'rollback_payment') {
        return 'Confirmar Estorno';
    }
    if (props.actionType === 'reactivate') {
        return 'Reativar Pedido';
    }
    if (props.actionType === 'correct_payment') {
        return 'Corrigir Pagamento';
    }
    return 'Confirmar Alteração';
});

const isValid = computed(() => {
    const trimmedReason = (form.value.reason || '').trim();
    if (!trimmedReason) return false;
    if (isFiscalAction.value && trimmedReason.length < 15) return false;
    if (props.requiresPin && (!form.value.password || form.value.password.length < 4)) return false;
    if (form.value.isLoss && isOrderContext.value && form.value.lostItems.length === 0) return false;
    return true;
});

const handleCancel = () => {
    emit('cancel');
    if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};

const handleConfirm = () => {
    emit('confirm', {
        reason: (form.value.reason || '').trim(),
        isLoss: form.value.isLoss,
        lostItems: form.value.lostItems,
        password: form.value.password
    });
};
```

```vue
            <div v-if="currentStep === 'payment_panel'" class="animate-fade-in flex flex-col gap-4 shrink-0">
                <div v-if="isOverpaid" class="p-4 bg-danger-500/10 border border-danger-500/30 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3 text-danger-500">
                    <i class="pi pi-exclamation-triangle mt-0.5"></i>
                    <div class="text-sm font-medium">
                        <p>O valor alocado excede o total do pedido!</p>
                        <p class="text-xs font-normal mt-1 opacity-80">Por favor, ajuste os valores nos pagamentos adicionados.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <PaymentStagingArea
                    :available-methods="resolvedPaymentMethods"
                    :staged-payments="promises"
                    :remaining-amount="remainingAmount"
                    :allow-change-target="true"
                    @add-payment="handleAddPromise"
                    @remove-payment="handleRemovePromise"
                />
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- RODAPÉ -->
        <div v-if="currentStep === 'mode'" class="flex w-full shrink-0 mt-auto pt-6 border-t border-surface-border/50">
            <SecureActionButton
                action-code="cancel"
                label="Cancelar"
                variant="text"
                severity="secondary"
                custom-class="font-medium flex-1"
                :disabled="processingStatus === 'loading'"
                @secure-click="handleCancel"
            />
        </div>

        <div v-else class="flex gap-2 w-full shrink-0 mt-auto pt-6 border-t border-surface-border/50">
            <Button
                label="Voltar"
                text
                severity="secondary"
                :disabled="processingStatus !== 'idle'"
                @click="currentStep = 'mode'"
                class="flex-1 font-medium cursor-pointer"
            />

            <Button
                :label="processingStatus === 'loading' ? 'Processando...' : (processingStatus === 'success' ? 'Concluído!' : 'Confirmar')"
                :icon="processingStatus === 'loading' ? 'pi pi-spinner pi-spin' : 'pi pi-check'"
                :disabled="remainingAmount > 0 || isOverpaid || processingStatus !== 'idle'"
                :severity="processingStatus === 'error' ? 'danger' : (processingStatus === 'success' ? 'success' : 'primary')"
                @click="handleConfirmFinal"
                class="flex-1 font-black shadow-md cursor-pointer transition-all"
            />
        </div>
    </component>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, watch, computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import Button from 'primevue/button';

import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";
import PaymentStagingArea from "@/Components/UI/PaymentStagingArea.vue";
import SelectableCard from "@/Components/UI/SelectableCard.vue";
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/Utils/formatters';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    orderTotal: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    existingIntent: String,
    existingMethods: [Array, String, Object],
    mode: { type: String, default: 'modal' },
    hidePendingChoice: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    paymentMethods: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    customer: { type: Object, default: null },
    order: { type: Object, default: null },
    orderType: { type: String, default: null }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'confirm', 'cancel']);
const page = usePage();

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (value) => emit('update:visible', value)
});

const isCounter = computed(() => {
    const rawType = props.orderType || props.order?.type || '';
    return ['counter', 'pickup', 'takeaway'].includes(rawType);
});

const currentStep = ref('mode');
const finalIntent = ref('pending_choice');
const promises = ref([]);

const processingMode = ref(null);
const processingStatus = ref('idle');

const resetProcessing = () => {
    processingMode.value = null;
    processingStatus.value = 'idle';
};

const handleSuccess = () => {
    processingStatus.value = 'success';
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
        resetProcessing();
    }, 600);
};

const handleError = () => {
    processingStatus.value = 'error';
    setTimeout(() => resetProcessing(), 2500);
};

const resolvedPaymentMethods = computed(() => {
    const rawMethods = props.paymentMethods?.length > 0
        ? props.paymentMethods
        : (page.props.paymentMethods || page.props.cashierData?.paymentMethods || []);

    if (!rawMethods || rawMethods.length === 0) return [];

    const activeCustomer = props.customer || props.order?.customer;
    const settings = page.props.companySettings || {};
    const conversionRate = Number(settings.loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate || 5);
    const customerPoints = Number(activeCustomer?.loyalty_points || 0);
    const availableCashback = roundNumber((customerPoints / 100) * conversionRate);

    return rawMethods
        .filter(m => m.is_active !== false && m.status !== 'inactive')
        .map(m => {
            const isCash = m.engine_type === 'cash' || String(m.name).toLowerCase().includes('dinheiro');
            const isLoyalty = m.engine_type === 'internal_loyalty' || String(m.name).toLowerCase().includes('cashback');

            let icon = m.icon;
            if (!icon) {
                if (isCash) icon = 'pi-money-bill';
                else if (isLoyalty) icon = 'pi-star';
                else if (String(m.name).toLowerCase().includes('pix')) icon = 'pi-qrcode';
                else icon = 'pi-credit-card';
            }

            let subtitle = m.subtitle || null;
            let disabled = false;

            if (isLoyalty) {
                if (!activeCustomer) {
                    subtitle = 'Cliente não identificado';
                    disabled = true;
                } else if (availableCashback <= 0) {
                    subtitle = 'Sem saldo de pontos';
                    disabled = true;
                } else {
                    subtitle = `Saldo: ${formatCurrency(availableCashback)}`;
                }
            }

            return {
                id: m.id,
                name: m.name,
                engine_type: m.engine_type,
                is_cash: isCash,
                icon,
                subtitle,
                disabled,
                max_value: isLoyalty ? availableCashback : null,
                colorClass: m.colorClass || null
            };
        });
});

const roundNumber = (num) => Math.round((Number(num) + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;

watch(() => props.visible, (val) => {
    if (val) {
        resetProcessing();
        if (props.existingIntent && props.existingIntent !== 'pending_choice') {
            finalIntent.value = props.existingIntent;
            if (['pay_on_delivery', 'pay_on_counter', 'pay_on_pickup'].includes(props.existingIntent)) {
                currentStep.value = 'payment_panel';
                // 🚀 Aqui carregamos o método esticado que veio do hook useOrderAppend!
                let parsed = props.existingMethods;
                while (typeof parsed === 'string') {
                    try { parsed = JSON.parse(parsed); } catch (e) { break; }
                }
                promises.value = Array.isArray(parsed) ? [...parsed] : [];
            } else {
                currentStep.value = 'mode';
                promises.value = [];
            }
        } else {
            currentStep.value = 'mode';
            finalIntent.value = 'pending_choice';
            promises.value = [];
        }
    }
}, { immediate: true });

const allocatedAmount = computed(() => promises.value.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (Number(p.amount) || 0), 0));
const remainingAmount = computed(() => Math.max(0, Number(((props.orderTotal || 0) - allocatedAmount.value).toFixed(2))));
const isOverpaid = computed(() => allocatedAmount.value > (props.orderTotal || 0) + 0.01);

const handleCancel = () => {
    emit("cancel");
    if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};

const selectMode = (mode) => {
    if (processingStatus.value === 'loading') return;

    finalIntent.value = mode;

    if (mode === 'pay_on_delivery' || mode === 'pay_on_counter') {
        currentStep.value = 'payment_panel';
    } else {
        processingMode.value = mode;
        processingStatus.value = 'loading';

        setTimeout(() => {
            emit('confirm', {
                intent: mode,
                payment_intent_status: mode,
                payment_intent_methods: null,
                onSuccess: handleSuccess,
                onError: handleError
            });

            setTimeout(() => {
                if (processingStatus.value === 'loading') {
                    handleSuccess();
                }
            }, 1500);
        }, 50);
    }
};

const handleAddPromise = (payload) => {
    const existingIndex = promises.value.findIndex(p => p.method_id === payload.method_id);
    if (existingIndex > -1) {
        const existing = promises.value[existingIndex];
        existing.amount = roundNumber(existing.amount + Number(payload.amount));
        if (payload.change_target) existing.change_target = payload.change_target;
        if (existing.change_target && existing.change_target < existing.amount) existing.change_target = null;
    } else {
        promises.value.push({
            method_id: payload.method_id,
            method_name: payload.method_name,
            engine_type: payload.engine_type,
            amount: Number(payload.amount),
            change_target: payload.change_target || null
        });
    }
};

const handleRemovePromise = (idx) => promises.value.splice(idx, 1);

const handleConfirmFinal = () => {
    if (processingStatus.value === 'loading') return;

    processingStatus.value = 'loading';
    const resolvedStatus = isCounter.value ? 'pay_on_pickup' : 'pay_on_delivery';
    processingMode.value = resolvedStatus;

    setTimeout(() => {
        // 🚀 O pulo do gato: Entrega exatamente as promessas (promises.value) ajustadas!
        emit('confirm', {
            intent: resolvedStatus,
            payment_intent_status: resolvedStatus,
            payment_intent_methods: promises.value,
            onSuccess: handleSuccess,
            onError: handleError
        });

        setTimeout(() => {
            if (processingStatus.value === 'loading') {
                handleSuccess();
            }
        }, 1500);
    }, 50);
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.animate-fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-in-out; }
@keyframes fadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-5px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
</style>
```

```vue
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between w-full gap-3 mt-4 border-t border-white/10 pt-6">

<script setup>
import SecureActionButton from '@/Components/UI/SecureActionButton.vue';

import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';
import QrcodeVue from 'qrcode.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    orderId: { type: [Number, String], required: true },
    qrCodeString: { type: String, default: null },
    txid: { type: String, default: null },
    isLoading: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['cancel', 'refresh', 'expired']);

// 🚀 EXATAMENTE 10 MINUTOS (600s)
const timeLeft = ref(600);
const timer = ref(null);
const copied = ref(false);

const isExpired = computed(() => timeLeft.value <= 0);

const formattedTime = computed(() => {
    const minutes = Math.floor(timeLeft.value / 60);
    const seconds = timeLeft.value % 60;
    return `${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`;
});

const startTimer = () => {
    clearInterval(timer.value);
    timeLeft.value = 600;

    timer.value = setInterval(() => {
        if (timeLeft.value > 0) {
            timeLeft.value--;
        } else {
            clearInterval(timer.value);
            // 🚀 AVISA O PAI QUE O TEMPO ACABOU!
            emit('expired');
        }
    }, 1000);
};

const copyCode = async () => {
    if (!props.qrCodeString) return;
    try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.qrCodeString);
        copied.value = true;
        setTimeout(() => copied.value = false, 3000);
    } catch (err) {}
};

onMounted(() => { if (props.qrCodeString) startTimer(); });
watch(() => props.qrCodeString, (newVal) => { if (newVal) startTimer(); });
onUnmounted(() => { clearInterval(timer.value); });
</script>
```

```vue
                <img v-if="imageUrl" :src="imageUrl" class="w-full h-full object-cover" alt="" />
                <i v-else class="pi pi-image text-surface-muted opacity-30 text-base"></i>
            </div>

                <span class="font-black text-sm break-words leading-tight">{{ category?.name }}</span>
            </div>

            <div v-if="isSelected" class="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-primary-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center mr-1">

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    category: Object,
    layout: { type: String, default: 'grid' },
    isSelected: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    glassMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

defineEmits(['click']);
const page = usePage();

const imageUrl = computed(() => {
    const path = props.category?.image_path || props.category?.image;
    if (path) {
        const ts = props.category?.updated_at ? new Date(props.category.updated_at).getTime() : '';
        return path.startsWith('http') ? path : `/media/file?path=${path}&v=${ts}`;
    }

    const categories = page?.props?.initialCategories || page?.props?.categories || [];
    let currentParentId = props.category?.parent_id;
    let depth = 0;

    while (currentParentId && Number(currentParentId) !== 0 && depth < 10) {
        const parentCat = categories.find(c => String(c.id) === String(currentParentId));
        if (!parentCat) break;
        const parentPath = parentCat.image_path || parentCat.image;
        if (parentPath) {
            const ts = parentCat.updated_at ? new Date(parentCat.updated_at).getTime() : '';
            return parentPath.startsWith('http') ? parentPath : `/media/file?path=${parentPath}&v=${ts}`;
        }
        currentParentId = parentCat.parent_id;
        depth++;
    }

    return null;
});

const cardClasses = computed(() => {
    const base = 'relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 outline-none text-left group cursor-pointer shrink-0';

    // 1. Horizontal (Pílula)
    if (props.layout === 'horizontal') {
        const shape = 'flex items-center justify-center px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full w-auto min-w-[max-content]';

        if (props.glassMode) {
            if (props.isSelected) return `${base} ${shape} bg-primary-500/10 text-primary-300`;
            return `${base} ${shape} bg-white/10 text-surface-text`;
        } else {
            if (props.isSelected) return `${base} ${shape} bg-primary-500 text-white`;
            return `${base} ${shape} bg-surface-3 hover:bg-primary-500/20 text-surface-text`;
        }
    }

    // 2. Lista / Vertical
    if (props.layout === 'list' || props.layout === 'vertical') {
        const shape = 'flex items-center p-3 rounded-2xl gap-4 w-full';
        if (props.isSelected) return `${base} ${shape} bg-primary-500/10 text-primary-700 dark:text-primary-400`;
        return `${base} ${shape} bg-surface-1 hover:bg-primary-500/20 text-surface-text`;
    }

    // 3. Grade (Full-Bleed + Scrim)
    const shape = 'flex flex-col rounded-2xl w-full aspect-[3/4] bg-surface-2';
    if (props.isSelected) {
        return `${base} ${shape} ring-2 ring-primary-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-surface-1 shadow-lg`;
    }
    return `${base} ${shape} hover:shadow-xl`;
});
</script>
```

```vue
});
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, nextTick, onMounted } from 'vue';
import CategoryCard from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Menu/CategoryCard.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    categories: { type: Array, required: true },
    selected: { type: [Number, String, null], required: true },
    layout: { type: String, default: 'horizontal' },
    showAll: { type: Boolean, default: true },
    glassMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:selected']);

// 🚀 LOG DIAGNÓSTICO: Azul
const logMenuOrder = () => {
    if (!props.categories) return;
    const nomes = props.categories.map(c => c.name || c.displayName);
};

onMounted(logMenuOrder);
watch(() => props.categories, logMenuOrder, { deep: true });

const menuContainer = ref(null);

watch(() => props.selected, async () => {
    await nextTick();
    if (menuContainer.value && props.layout === 'horizontal') {
        const activeEl = menuContainer.value.querySelector('[data-selected="true"]');
        if (activeEl) {
            const container = menuContainer.value;
            const scrollLeft = activeEl.offsetLeft - (container.offsetWidth / 2) + (activeEl.offsetWidth / 2);
            container.scrollTo({ left: Math.max(0, scrollLeft), behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
    }
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    product: Object,
    layout: { type: String, default: 'grid' }
});

defineEmits(['click']);

const page = usePage();

const isPaused = computed(() => props.product?.status === 'paused');

const isOutOfStock = computed(() => {
    if (props.product?.status === 'out_of_stock' || props.product?.status === 'unavailable') return true;
    if (props.product?.track_inventory && parseFloat(props.product?.current_stock) <= 0) return true;
    return false;
});

const isBlocked = computed(() => isPaused.value || isOutOfStock.value);

const finalImageUrl = computed(() => {
    if (!props.product) return null;

    const prodPath = props.product.image || props.product.image_path;
    if (prodPath) {
        const ts = props.product.updated_at ? new Date(props.product.updated_at).getTime() : '';
        return prodPath.startsWith('http') ? prodPath : `/media/file?path=${prodPath}&v=${ts}`;
    }

    const categories = page.props.initialCategories || page.props.categories || [];
    const category = categories.find(c => c.id === props.product.category_id);

    if (category) {
        const catPath = category.image_path || category.image;
        if (catPath) {
            const ts = category.updated_at ? new Date(category.updated_at).getTime() : '';
            return catPath.startsWith('http') ? catPath : `/media/file?path=${catPath}&v=${ts}`;
        }
    }

    return null;
});

const selections = computed(() => {
    if (props.product?.favorite_selections && Array.isArray(props.product.favorite_selections)) {
        return props.product.favorite_selections;
    }
    if (props.product?.cartItem?.structuredModifiers && Array.isArray(props.product.cartItem.structuredModifiers)) {
        return props.product.cartItem.structuredModifiers;
    }
    return [];
});

const modifiersText = computed(() => {
    const list = selections.value;
    if (!list || list.length === 0) return '';
    const names = list.map(m => m.name).filter(Boolean);
    if (names.length === 0) return '';
    if (names.length === 1) return names[0];
    const last = names.pop();
    return names.join(', ') + ' e ' + last;
});

const extraPrice = computed(() => {
    let extra = 0;
    selections.value.forEach(mod => {
        const modPrice = typeof mod.price === 'string' ? parseFloat(mod.price.replace(',', '.')) : (mod.price || 0);
        extra += (modPrice * parseInt(mod.qty || mod.quantity || 1));
    });
    return extra;
});

const originalTotal = computed(() => {
    const rawPrice = props.product?.price ?? props.product?.dine_in_price ?? 0;
    const base = typeof rawPrice === 'string' ? parseFloat(rawPrice.replace(',', '.')) : Number(rawPrice || 0);
    return base + extraPrice.value;
});

const finalTotal = computed(() => {
    const rawBase = props.product?.promo_price > 0 ? props.product.promo_price : (props.product?.price ?? props.product?.dine_in_price ?? 0);
    const base = typeof rawBase === 'string' ? parseFloat(rawBase.replace(',', '.')) : Number(rawBase || 0);
    return base + extraPrice.value;
});
</script>
```

```javascript
import { usePosSecurity } from '@/Pages/Gateway/Composables/usePosSecurity';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export function useCashier(props, { onShiftStaged } = {}) {

    const { requiresAuth } = usePosSecurity(props.companySettings || {});
    const toast = useToast();

    const showOrders = ref(true);
    const showTransactions = ref(true);
    const activeOrderTypes = ref(['table', 'counter', 'delivery']);
    const selectedRows = ref(new Set());

    const isLogoutPromptVisible = ref(false);

    const translatePayment = (engineType, fallbackName) => {
        const map = {
            'money': 'Dinheiro',
            'cash': 'Dinheiro',
            'credit_card': 'Crédito',
            'debit_card': 'Débito',
            'pix': 'Pix',
            'pix_sicredi': 'Pix'
        };
        return map[engineType] || fallbackName || 'Outro';
    };

    const getOrderTypeInfo = (type) => {
        const map = {
            'table': { label: 'Mesa', icon: 'pi pi-table' },
            'counter': { label: 'Balcão', icon: 'pi pi-shopping-bag' },
            'delivery': { label: 'Delivery', icon: 'pi pi-truck' }
        };
        return map[type] || { label: 'Avulso', icon: 'pi pi-box' };
    };

    const formatTimeOnly = (dateStr) => {
        if (!dateStr) return '--:--';
        try {
            const safeStr = String(dateStr).trim();
            const d = new Date(safeStr.replace(' ', 'T'));
            if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
                return d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            }
            const match = safeStr.match(/(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
            if (match) return `${match[1]}:${match[2]}`;
        } catch (e) {}
        return '--:--';
    };

    const formatDateTime = (dateStr) => {
        if (!dateStr) return '';
        try {
            const safeStr = String(dateStr).trim().replace(' ', 'T');
            const d = new Date(safeStr);
            if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(dateStr);
            return d.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' });
        } catch (e) {
            return String(dateStr);
        }
    };

    const unifiedHistory = computed(() => {
        let list = [];
        if (showOrders.value && props.ordersHistory) {
            props.ordersHistory.forEach(o => {
                if (!activeOrderTypes.value.includes(o.type)) return;

                const hasPayments = Array.isArray(o.payments) && o.payments.length > 0;
                const isPaidOrSettled = o.payment_status === 'paid' || o.payment_status === 'partial' || ['closed', 'completed'].includes(o.status);

                if (!hasPayments && !isPaidOrSettled) {
                    return;
                }

                const typeInfo = getOrderTypeInfo(o.type);

                const tableName = o.dining_table?.name || o.diningTable?.name || o.table_number;
                if (o.type === 'table' && tableName) {
                    typeInfo.label = `Mesa ${tableName}`;
                }

                const payments = o.payments?.map(p => {
                    const engine = p.engine_type || p.payment_method?.engine_type;
                    return translatePayment(engine, p.method);
                }).join(', ') || 'Não Pago';

                let operatorName = 'Autoatendimento';
                if (o.cashier?.name) {
                    operatorName = o.cashier.name;
                } else if (o.attendant?.name || o.waiter?.name || o.employee?.name) {
                    operatorName = o.attendant?.name || o.waiter?.name || o.employee?.name;
                } else if (o.cashier_id) {
                    operatorName = 'Caixa';
                } else if (o.employee_id) {
                    operatorName = 'Atendente';
                }

                list.push({
                    ...o,
                    _uniqueId: `order_${o.id}`,
                    _type: 'order',
                    _sortTime: o.updated_at || o.created_at || o.time,
                    _typeLabel: typeInfo.label,
                    _typeIcon: typeInfo.icon,
                    _paymentsLabel: payments,
                    type: o.type,
                    status: o.status,
                    time: formatTimeOnly(o.created_at || o.updated_at || o.time),
                    operator: operatorName,
                    amount: Number(o.total || 0),
                    _mathValue: o.status === 'cancelled' ? 0 : Number(o.total || 0)
                });
            });
        }
        if (showTransactions.value && props.transactionsHistory) {
            props.transactionsHistory.forEach(t => {
                list.push({
                    ...t,
                    _uniqueId: `trans_${t.id}`,
                    _type: 'transaction',
                    _sortTime: t.updated_at || t.created_at || t.time,
                    time: formatTimeOnly(t.created_at || t.updated_at || t.time),
                    operator: t.operator_name || t.user?.name || 'Sistema',
                    amount: Number(t.amount || 0),
                    _mathValue: t.type === 'in' ? Number(t.amount || 0) : -Number(t.amount || 0)
                });
            });
        }
        return list.sort((a, b) => {
            if (a._sortTime > b._sortTime) return -1;
            if (a._sortTime < b._sortTime) return 1;
            return 0;
        });
    });

    const dynamicTotal = computed(() => {
        if (selectedRows.value.size > 0) {
            return unifiedHistory.value
                .filter(item => selectedRows.value.has(item._uniqueId))
                .reduce((sum, item) => sum + item._mathValue, 0);
        }
        return unifiedHistory.value.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item._mathValue, 0);
    });

    const expectedInDrawer = computed(() => {
        let totalCash = 0;
        if (props.currentShift && props.currentShift.opening_balance) {
            totalCash += Number(props.currentShift.opening_balance);
        }

        if (props.transactionsHistory) {
            props.transactionsHistory.forEach(t => {
                if (String(t.description || '').toLowerCase().includes('abertura')) return;
                if (t.type === 'in') totalCash += Number(t.amount);
                if (t.type === 'out') totalCash -= Number(t.amount);
            });
        }

        if (props.ordersHistory) {
            props.ordersHistory.forEach(o => {
                if (o.status !== 'cancelled' && o.payments) {
                    o.payments.forEach(p => {
                        const engine = p.engine_type || p.payment_method?.engine_type;
                        const isCash = engine === 'money' || engine === 'cash' || String(p.method || '').toLowerCase().includes('dinheiro');

                        if (isCash) {
                            totalCash += Number(p.amount);
                        }
                    });

                    if (o.change_returned) {
                        totalCash -= Number(o.change_returned);
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        return totalCash;
    });

    const toggleAllRows = (selectAll) => {
        selectAll ? unifiedHistory.value.forEach(item => selectedRows.value.add(item._uniqueId)) : selectedRows.value.clear();
    };
    const toggleRowSelection = (uniqueId) => {
        selectedRows.value.has(uniqueId) ? selectedRows.value.delete(uniqueId) : selectedRows.value.add(uniqueId);
    };
    const toggleOrderTypeFilter = (type) => {
        const index = activeOrderTypes.value.indexOf(type);
        if (index > -1) activeOrderTypes.value.splice(index, 1);
        else activeOrderTypes.value.push(type);
        selectedRows.value.clear();
    };

    const isShiftModalVisible = ref(false);
    const shiftActionType = ref('open');
    const isTransactionModalVisible = ref(false);
    const transactionType = ref('in');
    const isAuthModalVisible = ref(false);
    const authActionType = ref('cash_out');
    const authItemName = ref('');
    const authorizedPin = ref(null);
    const pendingShiftPayload = ref(null);
    const pendingAttendancePayload = ref(null);

    const openShiftModal = (type) => {
        shiftActionType.value = type;
        isShiftModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const handleLogout = () => {
        isLogoutPromptVisible.value = false;
        router.post(route('logout'));
    };

    const handleStayInPos = () => {
        isLogoutPromptVisible.value = false;
        router.reload({ only: ['cashierData', 'initialOrders'], preserveScroll: true, preserveState: true });
    };

    const executeShiftAction = (finalPayload) => {
        const isClosing = shiftActionType.value === 'close';
        const endpoint = isClosing ? route('operations.cashier.close') : route('operations.cashier.open');

        router.post(endpoint, finalPayload, {
            preserveState: isClosing,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isShiftModalVisible.value = false;
                pendingShiftPayload.value = null;

                if (isClosing) {
                    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Turno Fechado', detail: 'O turno foi encerrado com sucesso!', life: 4000 });
                    isLogoutPromptVisible.value = true;
                }
            },
            onError: (e) => {
                const firstError = e && typeof e === 'object' ? Object.values(e)[0] : null;
                const message = firstError || e?.error || e?.message || e?.shift || 'Erro ao processar turno.';

                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Falha', detail: message, life: 6000 });
            }
        });
    };

    const processShiftAction = (payload, explicitType = null) => {
        if (explicitType) {
            shiftActionType.value = explicitType;
        }

        if (shiftActionType.value === 'close' && props.companySettings?.cash_management_mode === 'employee') {
            const expected = expectedInDrawer.value;
            const informed = Number(payload.amount ?? payload.closing_balance ?? 0);
            const difference = Math.abs(expected - informed);
            const tolerance = Number(props.companySettings?.cash_difference_tolerance || 5);

            if (difference > tolerance) {
                pendingShiftPayload.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
                authActionType.value = 'close_shift_override';
                authItemName.value = `Diferença de Caixa: R$ ${difference.toFixed(2)}`;
                isShiftModalVisible.value = false;
                isAuthModalVisible.value = true;
                return;
            }
        }

        pendingShiftPayload.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
        isShiftModalVisible.value = false;

        if (onShiftStaged) onShiftStaged(shiftActionType.value, pendingShiftPayload.value);
    };

    const finalizeShiftWithAttendance = (attendeesArray) => {
        if (!pendingShiftPayload.value) return;

        const finalPayload = {
            ...pendingShiftPayload.value,
            attendees: Array.isArray(attendeesArray) ? attendeesArray : []
        };

        executeShiftAction(finalPayload);
    };

    const openTransactionModal = (type) => {
        if (type === 'out' && requiresAuth('cash_out')) {
            authActionType.value = 'cash_out';
            authItemName.value = 'Sangria de Caixa';
            isAuthModalVisible.value = true;
            return;
        }
        transactionType.value = type;
        isTransactionModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const processTransaction = (payload) => {
        const data = { ...payload, pin: authorizedPin.value };
        router.post(route('operations.cashier.transaction'), data, {
            preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => { isTransactionModalVisible.value = false; authorizedPin.value = null; },
            onError: (e) => { toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: e.pin || 'Erro ao processar transação.', life: 4000 }); authorizedPin.value = null; }
        });
    };

    const triggerAttendanceSync = (payload, onSuccessCallback) => {
        const userRoles = props.auth?.user?.roles || [];
        const isManagerOrAdmin = userRoles.some(r => {
            const roleName = typeof r === 'string' ? r : r.name;
            return ['admin', 'gerente', 'manager'].includes(roleName);
        });

        if (!isManagerOrAdmin) {
            pendingAttendancePayload.value = { payload, onSuccessCallback };
            authActionType.value = 'shift_attendance';
            authItemName.value = 'Aprovação de Ponto e Escala';
            isAuthModalVisible.value = true;
            return;
        }
        executeAttendanceSync(payload, null, onSuccessCallback);
    };

    const executeAttendanceSync = (payload, pin = null, onSuccessCallback = null) => {
        router.post(route('operations.attendance.sync'), { preserveState: true,  attendees: Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : [], pin: pin }, {
            preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => { pendingAttendancePayload.value = null; if (onSuccessCallback) onSuccessCallback(); },
            onError: (errors) => { toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Falha', detail: errors.pin || 'Erro ao sincronizar ponto.', life: 4000 }); }
        });
    };

    const handleOrderAction = (payload) => {
        if (payload.type === 'manage') {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-open-checkout', { detail: { orderId: payload.order.id } }));
        }
    };

    const handleAuthConfirm = (authData) => {
        isAuthModalVisible.value = false;
        if (authActionType.value === 'cash_out') {
            authorizedPin.value = authData.password;
            transactionType.value = 'out';
            isTransactionModalVisible.value = true;
        } else if (authActionType.value === 'close_shift_override') {
            pendingShiftPayload.value.pin = authData.password;
            if (onShiftStaged) onShiftStaged('close', pendingShiftPayload.value);
        } else if (authActionType.value === 'shift_attendance') {
            if (pendingAttendancePayload.value) {
                executeAttendanceSync(pendingAttendancePayload.value.payload, authData.password, pendingAttendancePayload.value.onSuccessCallback);
            }
        }
    };

    return {
            showOrders, showTransactions, activeOrderTypes, selectedRows, unifiedHistory,
            dynamicTotal, expectedInDrawer, formatDateTime, isShiftModalVisible,
            shiftActionType, isTransactionModalVisible, transactionType, isAuthModalVisible,
            authActionType, authItemName, pendingShiftPayload,
            isLogoutPromptVisible, handleLogout, handleStayInPos,
            toggleAllRows, toggleRowSelection, toggleOrderTypeFilter, openShiftModal, processShiftAction,
            openTransactionModal, processTransaction, handleOrderAction, handleAuthConfirm,
            finalizeShiftWithAttendance, triggerAttendanceSync, executeShiftAction
        };
}
```

```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted } from 'vue';

export function useCheckoutPix(order, handlePixApprovedCallback, toast) {
    // 🚀 FASE 1: Distinção Clara! O QR Code só fica a aguardar se for de facto uma API de banco!
    const isPixWaitingPhase = computed(() => {
        if (!order.value) return false;

        const isPending = order.value.payment_status === 'pending_payment';
        const hasTxid = Boolean(order.value.txid);
        const isNotManual = order.value.payment_intent_status !== 'manual';

        return isPending && hasTxid && isNotManual;
    });

    const onPixApprovedByWebhook = () => {
        if (!isPixWaitingPhase.value) return;

        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'PIX Confirmado!', detail: 'A transferência foi reconhecida pelo banco.', life: 5000 });

        if (typeof handlePixApprovedCallback === 'function') {
            handlePixApprovedCallback();
        }

        router.reload({ only: ['order', 'initialOrders'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
    };

    const handleWebSocketsPixEvent = (e) => {
        if (!isPixWaitingPhase.value) return;
        if (String(e.detail?.orderId) === String(order.value?.id)) {
            onPixApprovedByWebhook();
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        window.addEventListener('pos-pix-approved', handleWebSocketsPixEvent);
    });

    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        window.removeEventListener('pos-pix-approved', handleWebSocketsPixEvent);
    });

    // 🚀 CANCELAMENTO MANUAL OU POR EXPIRAÇÃO (10 MIN)
    const cancelPixPayment = (isAutoExpire = false) => {
        // Envia um pedido de DELETE ou POST para limpar a promessa de pagamento do pedido
        router.post(route('operations.orders.cancel-intent', order.value.id), {}, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                if (isAutoExpire) {
                    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'PIX Expirado', detail: 'O tempo limite de 10 minutos esgotou-se. O PIX foi cancelado.', life: 6000 });
                } else {
                    toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'PIX Cancelado', detail: 'A cobrança digital foi descartada.', life: 4000 });
                }
            },
            onError: () => {
                // Tenta forçar via cancelamento global se a intenção falhar
                router.post(route('operations.orders.cancel', order.value.id));
            }
        });
    };

    const refreshPixPayment = () => {
        toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Recarregando', detail: 'Gerando uma nova cobrança na instituição financeira...', life: 3000 });
        cancelPixPayment(false);
    };

    return {
        isPixWaitingPhase,
        cancelPixPayment,
        refreshPixPayment,
        onPixApprovedByWebhook
    };
}
```

```javascript
import axios from 'axios';
import { ref, unref } from 'vue';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

export function useCheckoutProcessor({
    order,
    props, toast, emitClose, isFiscalEmitter, checkoutPrintMode, customerDocument,
    stagedPayments, reactiveItems, serviceFeeAmount, localCashbackAmountToSend,
    authActionType, itemToProcess, authNeedsPin, initiateSecureAction, isReasonModalVisible, isPostPaymentPhase,
    appliedCheckoutCoupon,
    isZeroRevenueOrder
}) {
    const isEmittingNfce = ref(false);
    const isFiscalSuccess = ref(false);
    const fiscalEmitError = ref(null);
    const isProcessingPayment = ref(false);
    const isPaymentSuccess = ref(false);

    const page = usePage();

    const getOrder = () => (order && order.value) ? order.value : (props.order?.value || props.order);
    const getOrderId = () => getOrder()?.id;

    const goBack = () => {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        url.searchParams.delete('order');
        url.searchParams.delete('checkout');
        url.searchParams.delete('open_order');
        window.history.replaceState({ tab: 'orders' }, '', '/pos/orders');

        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-close-order-details'));
        emitClose();
    };

    const executeAutoPrintRule = () => {
        if (checkoutPrintMode.value && checkoutPrintMode.value !== 'ask' && checkoutPrintMode.value !== 'none') {
            if (['home', 'no_print', 'finish', 'close'].includes(checkoutPrintMode.value)) {
                return;
            }
            handlePostPaymentAction({ type: checkoutPrintMode.value });
        }
    };

    const triggerSilentEmission = async () => {
        const orderId = getOrderId();
        if (!orderId) return;

        if (isZeroRevenueOrder && unref(isZeroRevenueOrder)) {
            isEmittingNfce.value = false;
            return;
        }

        isEmittingNfce.value = true;
        fiscalEmitError.value = null;

        try {
            const apiClient = axios || window.axios;
            const response = await apiClient.post(route('operations.orders.emit-nfce', orderId), {
                document: unref(customerDocument)
            }, {
                headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
            });

            if (response.data?.success) {
                isFiscalSuccess.value = true;

                const target = getOrder();
                if (target) {
                    target.has_fiscal_document = true;
                    target.fiscal_status = 'authorized';
                }

                if (props.order) {
                    if (props.order.value) {
                        props.order.value.has_fiscal_document = true;
                        props.order.value.fiscal_status = 'authorized';
                    } else {
                        props.order.has_fiscal_document = true;
                        props.order.fiscal_status = 'authorized';
                    }
                }

                const list = page.props.initialOrders || page.props.orders || [];
                const fromList = list.find(o => o.id === orderId);
                if (fromList) {
                    fromList.has_fiscal_document = true;
                    fromList.fiscal_status = 'authorized';
                }

                setTimeout(() => {
                    isEmittingNfce.value = false;
                    executeAutoPrintRule();
                }, 1500);

            } else {
                isEmittingNfce.value = false;
                isFiscalSuccess.value = false;
                fiscalEmitError.value = response.data?.message || 'Falha ao emitir nota fiscal.';
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Aviso Fiscal', detail: fiscalEmitError.value, life: 6000 });
            }
        } catch (error) {
            isEmittingNfce.value = false;
            isFiscalSuccess.value = false;
            const errMsg = error.response?.data?.message || Object.values(error.response?.data?.errors || {})[0] || 'O servidor recusou a requisição fiscal.';
            fiscalEmitError.value = errMsg;
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro Fiscal', detail: errMsg, life: 6000 });
        }
    };

    const processPayment = async () => {
        const orderId = getOrderId();
        if (isProcessingPayment.value || !orderId) return;

        isProcessingPayment.value = true;

        const paymentsToSubmit = (stagedPayments.value || []).map(p => ({
            method_id: p.real_method_id || p.method_id || p.payment_method_id || p.payment_method?.id,
            amount: Number(p.amount)
        }));

        // 🚀 FILTRA APENAS OS ITENS SELECIONADOS PARA ESTA RODADA DE PAGAMENTO
        const itemsToPay = (reactiveItems?.value || [])
            .filter(i => (Number(i.selected_parts) || 0) > 0)
            .map(i => {
                const ppu = Number(i.parts_per_unit) || 1;
                const qty = Number(i.selected_parts) / ppu;
                const unitPrice = Number(i.effective_unit_price || i.unit_price || 0);
                return {
                    id: i.id,
                    pay_qty: qty,
                    amount: Math.round(qty * unitPrice * 100) / 100
                };
            });

        const payload = {
            payments: paymentsToSubmit,
            items: itemsToPay,
            service_fee: Math.max(0, Number(unref(serviceFeeAmount) || 0)),
            cashback_used: Math.max(0, Number(unref(localCashbackAmountToSend) || 0)),
            document: unref(customerDocument),
            coupon_code: unref(appliedCheckoutCoupon)
        };

        try {
            const apiClient = axios || window.axios;
            const response = await apiClient.post(route('operations.orders.pay', orderId), payload, {
                headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
            });

            const returnedOrder = response.data?.order || response.data?.data || null;

            stagedPayments.value = [];
            localCashbackAmountToSend.value = 0;

            if (reactiveItems && reactiveItems.value) {
                itemsToPay.forEach(paidItem => {
                    const found = reactiveItems.value.find(i => i.id === paidItem.id);
                    if (found) {
                        found.base_paid = (found.base_paid || 0) + paidItem.pay_qty;
                    }
                });
            }

            const updatedOrder = returnedOrder || getOrder();

            const isZeroRev = isZeroRevenueOrder ? unref(isZeroRevenueOrder) : false;

            const shouldEmit = Boolean(
                isFiscalEmitter?.value &&
                !isZeroRev &&
                updatedOrder?.fiscal_status !== 'authorized' &&
                !updatedOrder?.has_fiscal_document
            );

            isPaymentSuccess.value = true;
            isProcessingPayment.value = false;

            if (shouldEmit) {
                isEmittingNfce.value = true;
            }

            if (isPostPaymentPhase) {
                isPostPaymentPhase.value = true;
            }

            if (shouldEmit) {
                triggerSilentEmission();
            } else {
                executeAutoPrintRule();
            }

        } catch (error) {
            isProcessingPayment.value = false;
            isEmittingNfce.value = false;
            const errMsg = error.response?.data?.message || Object.values(error.response?.data?.errors || {})[0] || 'Falha ao processar o pagamento.';
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro de Pagamento', detail: errMsg, life: 5000 });
        }
    };

    const handlePostPaymentAction = async (action) => {
        const orderId = getOrderId();
        const type = typeof action === 'string' ? action : action?.type;

        if (type === 'no_print' || type === 'close' || type === 'home') {
            goBack();
            return;
        }

        if (type === 'emit_nfce') {
            if (isZeroRevenueOrder && unref(isZeroRevenueOrder)) {
                toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Aviso', detail: 'Emissão fiscal não permitida para pedidos sem faturamento.', life: 4000 });
                return;
            }
            triggerSilentEmission();
            return;
        }

        if (type === 'reactivate' || type === 'correct_payment') {
            if (authActionType) authActionType.value = type;
            if (authNeedsPin) authNeedsPin.value = Boolean(props.companySettings?.require_pin_for_voids ?? true);
            if (isReasonModalVisible) isReasonModalVisible.value = true;
            return;
        }

        try {
            const apiClient = axios || window.axios;
            await apiClient.post(route('operations.finalize-receipt', orderId), { print_action: type }, {
                headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
            });
        } catch (error) {
            const errMsg = error.response?.data?.message || Object.values(error.response?.data?.errors || {})[0] || "Falha na comunicação de impressão.";
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: errMsg, life: 4000 });
        }
    };

    const confirmCancellation = async (authData) => {
        const orderId = getOrderId();
        const targetType = unref(authActionType);

        try {
            if (targetType === 'reactivate' || targetType === 'correct_payment') {
                await router.post(route('operations.orders.reactivate', orderId), {
                    pin: authData.password || authData.pin,
                    reason: authData.reason,
                    mode: targetType
                }, {
                    preserveScroll: true,
                    preserveState: true,
                    onSuccess: () => {
                        isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
                        if (isPostPaymentPhase) isPostPaymentPhase.value = false;
                        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Conta Reaberta', detail: 'O status do pedido voltou para pendente.', life: 3000 });

                        router.reload({ only: ['initialOrders', 'cashierData'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
                    },
                    onError: (err) => {
                        const errMsg = err.pin || err.message || "Erro ao reabrir conta.";
                        toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Acesso Negado", detail: errMsg, life: 5000 });
                    }
                });
                return;
            }

            const apiClient = axios || window.axios;
            await apiClient.post(route('operations.orders.refund-and-clone', orderId), {
                pin: authData.password || authData.pin,
                reason: authData.reason,

            }, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } });

            isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
            router.reload({ only: ['initialOrders', 'cashierData'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
        } catch (e) {
            const errMsg = e.response?.data?.message || Object.values(e.response?.data?.errors || {})[0] || "Erro interno.";
            toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Acesso Negado", detail: errMsg, life: 5000 });
        }
    };

    return {
        isEmittingNfce,
        isFiscalSuccess,
        fiscalEmitError,
        isProcessingPayment,
        isPaymentSuccess,
        processPayment,
        handlePostPaymentAction,
        confirmCancellation
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export function useFiscalBatchEmitter(props, unifiedHistory) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const isRetryingFiscal = ref(false);

    const pendingFiscalOrders = computed(() => {
        const list = (props.ordersHistory && props.ordersHistory.length > 0)
            ? props.ordersHistory
            : (unifiedHistory.value || []).filter(item => item._type === 'order');

        return list.filter(order => {
            const isNotCancelled = order.status !== 'cancelled';
            const isNotAuthorized = order.fiscal_status !== 'authorized';

            // 🛑 REGRA FISCAL ESTRITA: Apenas pedidos QUITADOS entram no lote
            const hasPayment = order.payment_status === 'paid' || (Array.isArray(order.payments) && order.payments.length > 0);
            const isSettled = ['closed', 'completed'].includes(order.status) || order.payment_status === 'paid';
            const isNotOpenTable = !(order.type === 'table' && order.status !== 'closed' && order.payment_status !== 'paid');

            return isNotCancelled && isNotAuthorized && hasPayment && isSettled && isNotOpenTable;
        });
    });

    const retryFailedFiscal = async () => {
        if (isRetryingFiscal.value) return;

        if (pendingFiscalOrders.value.length === 0) {
            toast.add({
                severity: 'info',
                summary: 'NFC-e em Dia',
                detail: 'Nenhum cupom fiscal pendente de emissão para os pedidos pagos deste turno.',
                life: 3000
            });
            return;
        }

        isRetryingFiscal.value = true;
        let successCount = 0;
        let failCount = 0;
        const errorsList = [];

        for (const order of pendingFiscalOrders.value) {
            try {
                const endpoint = window.route && route().has('operations.orders.emit-nfce')
                    ? route('operations.orders.emit-nfce', order.id)
                    : `/operations/orders/${order.id}/emit-nfce`;

                const res = await axios.post(endpoint, {}, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });

                if (res.data?.success !== false) {
                    successCount++;
                } else {
                    failCount++;
                    errorsList.push(`#${order.id}: ${res.data.message || 'Erro Sefaz'}`);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                failCount++;
                const msg = error.response?.data?.message || error.message || 'Erro Sefaz';
                errorsList.push(`#${order.id}: ${msg}`);
            }
        }

        isRetryingFiscal.value = false;

        if (successCount > 0) {
            toast.add({
                severity: 'success',
                summary: 'Emissão Concluída',
                detail: `${successCount} cupom(ns) fiscal(is) autorizado(s) com sucesso na SEFAZ!`,
                life: 4000
            });

            router.reload({
                only: ['ordersHistory', 'cashierData', 'initialOrders'],
                preserveScroll: true,
                preserveState: true
            });
        }

        if (failCount > 0) {
            toast.add({
                severity: 'warn',
                summary: `${failCount} Falha(s) na SEFAZ`,
                detail: errorsList.slice(0, 2).join(' | '),
                life: 6000
            });
        }
    };

    return {
        isRetryingFiscal,
        pendingFiscalOrders,
        retryFailedFiscal
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { useTenantEcho } from '@/Composables/useTenantEcho';
import { onMounted } from 'vue';

export function usePosSync(activeTab, checkoutData) {
    const page = usePage();
    const toast = useToast();
    const echo = useTenantEcho();

    let reloadTimer = null;
    const reloadOperationsBoard = () => {
        if (reloadTimer) clearTimeout(reloadTimer);
        reloadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            router.reload({
                only: ['initialOrders', 'managerData', 'cashierData', 'initialTableAreas', 'ordersHistory'],
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true
            });
        }, 300);
    };

    const handleOrderSignal = (e) => {
        const orderId = Number(e?.id || e?.orderId);

        // Se o operador está no checkout exatamente com esta conta aberta
        if (activeTab?.value === 'checkout' && checkoutData?.value?.order && orderId) {
            if (Number(checkoutData.value.order.id) === orderId) {
                if (e.status) checkoutData.value.order.status = e.status;
                if (e.payment_status) checkoutData.value.order.payment_status = e.payment_status;

                // 🚀 Notifica a tela de Checkout Pix que o pagamento foi liquidado pelo banco
                if (e.payment_status === 'paid') {
                    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-pix-approved', {
                        detail: { orderId }
                    }));
                }
            }
        }

        reloadOperationsBoard();
    };

    const initPosSync = () => {
        // 🎯 Inscrição única no canal central de operações
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.order.created', reloadOperationsBoard);
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.order.updated', handleOrderSignal);
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.order.cancelled', handleOrderSignal);
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.table.updated', reloadOperationsBoard);

        // Turno
        echo.listenChannel('shift', '.shift.opened', () => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Turno Aberto', detail: 'O caixa foi aberto.', life: 3000 });
            reloadOperationsBoard();
        });
        echo.listenChannel('shift', '.shift.closed', () => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Turno Fechado', detail: 'O turno operacional foi encerrado.', life: 4000 });
            reloadOperationsBoard();
        });

        // Vitrine de produtos
        echo.listenChannel('catalog', '.catalog.updated', () => {
            if (activeTab?.value === 'checkout') return;
            router.reload({ only: ['catalog', 'initialProducts'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
        });
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        initPosSync();
    });

    return { initPosSync };
}
```

```javascript
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';

export function usePosTerminalLock() {
    const toast = useToast();
    const isTerminalLocked = ref(localStorage.getItem('brasume_terminal_locked') === 'true');

    const lockTerminal = async () => {
        isTerminalLocked.value = true;
        localStorage.setItem('brasume_terminal_locked', 'true');

        const currentDeviceUuid = localStorage.getItem('brasume_device_uuid') || window.Laravel?.device_uuid;
        if (currentDeviceUuid) {
            try {
                await axios.post(route('team.remote-unlock.lock'), { device_uuid: currentDeviceUuid });
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Falha ao sincronizar trava de terminal com o servidor.', error);
            }
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        const currentDeviceUuid = localStorage.getItem('brasume_device_uuid') || window.Laravel?.device_uuid;

        if (currentDeviceUuid && window.Echo) {
            window.Echo.channel(`device.${currentDeviceUuid}`)
                .listen('.DeviceRemoteUnlocked', () => {
                    if (isTerminalLocked.value) {
                        isTerminalLocked.value = false;
                        localStorage.removeItem('brasume_terminal_locked');
                        toast.add({
                            severity: 'success',
                            summary: 'Terminal Retomado',
                            detail: 'O gestor autorizou o seu retorno à operação!',
                            life: 3000
                        });
                    }
                })
                .listen('.DeviceRemoteLocked', () => {
                    isTerminalLocked.value = true;
                    localStorage.setItem('brasume_terminal_locked', 'true');
                    toast.add({
                        severity: 'warn',
                        summary: 'Acesso Interrompido',
                        detail: 'O gestor bloqueou este terminal remotamente.',
                        life: 5000
                    });
                });
        }
    });

    return {
        isTerminalLocked,
        lockTerminal
    };
}
```
