```vue
    <div class="grid h-full min-h-0 w-full bg-surface-1 text-surface-text overflow-hidden font-sans p-2 transition-all duration-500 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_360px] xl:grid-cols-[1fr_400px] gap-2">

        <!-- 1. DYNAMIC ISLAND (CONTROLE REMOTO DO TURNO) -->
        <Teleport v-if="isTeleportActive" to="#dynamic-island-portal">
            <div class="flex items-center h-10 md:h-12 shrink-0 mr-1 gap-2 md:gap-3">

                <!-- FILTROS (Liga/desliga quando a tabela está visível) -->
                <PosTeleportButton
                    v-if="leftView === 'table'"
                    icon="pi-filter"
                    color="primary"
                    label="Filtros da Tabela"
                    :active="showOrders || showTransactions"
                    @click="toggleFilterMenu"
                />

                <div class="w-px h-6 bg-surface-border/50 mx-1"></div>

                <!-- ABRIR CAIXA (Cor: Success) -->
                <PosTeleportButton
                    v-if="!currentShift"
                    icon="pi-lock-open"
                    color="success"
                    label="Abrir Caixa"
                    @click="openShiftView('open')"
                />

                <!-- BOTÕES DE AÇÃO DO TURNO -->
                <template v-else>
                    <!-- SUPRIMENTO (ENTRADA) -->
                    <PosTeleportButton
                        icon="pi-arrow-down"
                        color="primary"
                        label="Suprimento (Entrada)"
                        @click="openTransactionView('in')"
                    />

                    <!-- SANGRIA (RETIRADA) -->
                    <PosTeleportButton
                        icon="pi-arrow-up"
                        color="primary"
                        label="Sangria (Retirada)"
                        @click="openTransactionView('out')"
                    />

                    <!-- PONTO / EQUIPE DO TURNO -->
                    <PosTeleportButton
                        icon="pi-users"
                        color="primary"
                        label="Equipe do Turno (Ponto)"
                        @click="openMidShiftAttendance"
                    />

                    <!-- REEMISSÃO FISCAL EM LOTE -->
                    <PosTeleportButton
                        v-if="companySettings?.is_fiscal_emitter"
                        icon="pi-bolt"
                        color="primary"
                        :loading="isRetryingFiscal"
                        :disabled="isRetryingFiscal || pendingFiscalOrders.length === 0"
                        :badge="pendingFiscalOrders.length > 0 && !isRetryingFiscal ? pendingFiscalOrders.length : null"
                        badge-severity="danger"
                        :label="pendingFiscalOrders.length > 0 ? `Emitir ${pendingFiscalOrders.length} NFC-e pendente(s)` : 'Todas as NFC-e foram autorizadas'"
                        @click="retryFailedFiscal"
                    />

                    <!-- ENCERRAR TURNO OPERACIONAL -->
                    <PosTeleportButton
                        icon="pi-history"
                        color="primary"
                        label="Encerrar Turno Operacional"
                        @click="openOperationalView"
                    />

                    <!-- FECHAR CAIXA FINANCEIRO (Cor: Success) -->
                    <PosTeleportButton
                        icon="pi-lock"
                        color="success"
                        label="Fechar Caixa (Financeiro)"
                        @click="openShiftView('close')"
                    />
                </template>
            </div>
        </Teleport>

        <!-- 2. ÁREA PRINCIPAL (ESQUERDA) -->
        <div class="flex flex-col h-full min-h-0 min-w-0 bg-surface-2 rounded-4xl overflow-hidden relative">
            <Transition name="fade" mode="out-in">
                <CashierTable
                    v-if="leftView === 'table'"
                    class="w-full h-full"
                    :unified-history="unifiedHistory"
                    :selected-rows="selectedRows"
                    @toggle-selection="toggleRowSelection"
                    @toggle-all="toggleAllRows"
                    @action="handleOrderAction"
                />

                <!-- CONTAGEM DE CAIXA: ABERTURA / FECHAMENTO -->
                <ShiftCashForm
                    v-else-if="leftView === 'open_shift' || leftView === 'close_shift'"
                    ref="shiftCashFormRef"
                    :mode="leftView === 'open_shift' ? 'open' : 'close'"
                    class="w-full h-full"
                    :company-settings="companySettings"
                    :expected-total="expectedInDrawer"
                    @update:data="shiftFormData = $event"
                    @submit="triggerSidebarSubmit"
                />

                <!-- ESCALA E PONTO: GERENCIA EQUIPE E LIQUIDAÇÃO DE FREELANCERS -->
                <ShiftAttendance
                    v-else-if="leftView === 'attendance'"
                    class="w-full h-full"
                    :users="users"
                    :current-attendees="currentAttendees"
                    :flow-mode="currentAttendanceFlowMode"
                    @cancel="handleAttendanceCancel"
                    @confirm="handleAttendanceConfirm"
                    @pay-freelancer="openFreelancerPayment"
                />
            </Transition>
        </div>

        <!-- 3. ÁREA SECUNDÁRIA (DIREITA) -->
        <div class="flex flex-col h-full min-h-0 bg-surface-2 rounded-4xl overflow-hidden relative shadow-sm shrink-0">
            <Transition name="fade" mode="out-in">

                <!-- SIDEBAR DE CONFIRMAÇÃO DO TURNO (TOTAL, OBSERVAÇÃO, AÇÃO) -->
                <ShiftCashSidebar
                    v-if="rightView === 'shift_action'"
                    ref="shiftSidebarRef"
                    class="w-full h-full"
                    :mode="leftView === 'open_shift' ? 'open' : 'close'"
                    :company-settings="companySettings"
                    :amount="shiftFormData.amount"
                    :coins-total="shiftFormData.coinsTotal"
                    :is-valid="shiftFormData.isValid"
                    :has-active-shift="Boolean(currentShift)"
                    :has-staged-attendees="stagedAttendees.length > 0"
                    @cancel="resetViews"
                    @back-to-attendance="handleBackToAttendanceFromOpen"
                    @confirm="handleShiftSidebarConfirm"
                />

                <!-- EMPTY STATE QUANDO CAIXA ESTÁ FECHADO -->
                <div v-else-if="rightView === 'empty'" class="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-8 opacity-70">
                    <div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-primary-500/10 text-primary-500 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
                        <i class="pi pi-lock-open text-2xl font-black"></i>
                    </div>
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-black mb-1 uppercase tracking-wider text-surface-text">Abertura de Turno</h3>
                    <p class="text-xs text-surface-muted max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
                        Passo 1: Confirme a equipe presente para liberar o acesso ao sistema. Em seguida, informe o fundo de troco da gaveta.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <!-- PAINEL DE ACERTO DE FREELANCER -->
                <FreelancerPayment
                    v-else-if="rightView === 'freelancer_payment'"
                    class="w-full h-full"
                    :user="freelancerToPay"
                    :payout-details="freelancerPayoutDetails"
                    :bank-accounts="bankAccounts"
                    @cancel="handleFreelancerCancel"
                    @confirm="handleFreelancerConfirm"
                />

                <ShiftDashboard
                    v-else-if="rightView === 'dashboard'"
                    class="w-full h-full"
                    :current-shift="currentShift"
                    :manager-data="managerData"
                    :dynamic-total="dynamicTotal"
                    :expected-in-drawer="expectedInDrawer"
                    :selected-count="selectedRows.size"
                    :unified-history="unifiedHistory"
                />

                <TransactionForm
                    v-else-if="rightView === 'transaction'"
                    class="w-full h-full"
                    :type="transactionType"
                    @cancel="resetViews"
                    @confirm="handleTransactionConfirm"
                />

                <!-- PAINEL DE FECHAMENTO OPERACIONAL -->
                <CloseOperationalShift
                    v-else-if="rightView === 'close_operational'"
                    class="w-full h-full"
                    :is-processing="isOperationalProcessing"
                    @cancel="resetViews"
                    @confirm="handleConfirmOperationalClose"
                />
            </Transition>
        </div>

        <CashierFilterPanel
            ref="filterPanelRef"
            v-model:show-orders="showOrders"
            v-model:show-transactions="showTransactions"
            :active-types="activeOrderTypes"
            @toggle-type="toggleOrderTypeFilter"
        />

        <ShiftAuthModal
            v-model:visible="isAuthModalVisible"
            :action-type="authActionType"
            :item-name="authItemName"
            @confirm="handleAuthConfirm"
        />
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, onActivated, onDeactivated, watch } from 'vue';
import DesktopLayout from '@/Layouts/DesktopLayout.vue';

import CashierFilterPanel from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/CashierFilterPanel.vue';
import CashierTable from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/CashierTable.vue';
import ShiftCashForm from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/ShiftCashForm.vue';
import ShiftCashSidebar from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/ShiftCashSidebar.vue';
import ShiftAttendance from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/ShiftAttendance.vue';
import ShiftDashboard from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/ShiftDashboard.vue';
import TransactionForm from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/TransactionForm.vue';
import ShiftAuthModal from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/ShiftAuthModal.vue';
import FreelancerPayment from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/FreelancerPayment.vue';
import CloseOperationalShift from '@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cashier/CloseOperationalShift.vue';
import PosTeleportButton from '@/Components/UI/PosTeleportButton.vue';

import { useCashier } from '@/Pages/Pos/Composables/useCashier';
import { useFiscalBatchEmitter } from '@/Pages/Pos/Composables/useFiscalBatchEmitter';
import { useShiftAttendance } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useShiftAttendance';
import { useOperationalShift } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOperationalShift';

defineOptions({ layout: DesktopLayout });

const props = defineProps({
    currentShift: Object,
    ordersHistory: Array,
    transactionsHistory: Array,
    managerData: Object,
    bankAccounts: Array,
    users: Array,
    currentAttendees: Array,
    companySettings: Object,
    isActive: {
        type: Boolean,
        default: false
    }
});

const isTeleportActive = ref(false);

onMounted(() => { isTeleportActive.value = props.isActive; });
onActivated(() => { isTeleportActive.value = true; });
onDeactivated(() => { isTeleportActive.value = false; });
onBeforeUnmount(() => { isTeleportActive.value = false; });
watch(() => props.isActive, (newVal) => { isTeleportActive.value = newVal; });

const leftView = ref('table');
const rightView = ref('dashboard');
const isStagedAttendance = ref(false);
const stagedAttendees = ref([]);

const shiftFormData = ref({
    amount: 0,
    retainedAmount: 0,
    coinsTotal: 0,
    details: null,
    isValid: true
});

const shiftSidebarRef = ref(null);
const shiftCashFormRef = ref(null);

// 🚀 1. INICIALIZAÇÃO DE COMPOSABLES PRIMÁRIOS (Antes dos Watchers)
const {
    showOrders, showTransactions, activeOrderTypes, selectedRows, unifiedHistory,
    dynamicTotal, expectedInDrawer, isAuthModalVisible, authActionType, authItemName,
    shiftActionType, pendingShiftPayload,
    toggleAllRows, toggleRowSelection, toggleOrderTypeFilter, processTransaction,
    handleAuthConfirm, triggerAttendanceSync, processShiftAction,
    finalizeShiftWithAttendance, executeShiftAction
} = useCashier(props, {
    onShiftStaged: (type, payload) => {
        if (type === 'close') {
            isStagedAttendance.value = true;
            leftView.value = 'attendance';
            rightView.value = 'dashboard';
        }
    }
});

const {
    processFreelancerPayment,
    freelancerToPay,
    freelancerPayoutDetails,
    confirmFreelancerPayment
} = useShiftAttendance();

const { isRetryingFiscal, pendingFiscalOrders, retryFailedFiscal } = useFiscalBatchEmitter(props, unifiedHistory);

const {
    isProcessing: isOperationalProcessing,
    submitCloseShift: submitOperationalCloseShift
} = useOperationalShift();

// 🚀 2. COMPUTEDS E MÉTODOS DE ESTADO DE VIEW
const currentAttendanceFlowMode = computed(() => {
    if (!props.currentShift || shiftActionType.value === 'open') {
        return 'open';
    }
    if (isStagedAttendance.value && shiftActionType.value === 'close') {
        return 'close';
    }
    return 'mid_shift';
});

const resetViews = () => {
    isStagedAttendance.value = false;
    stagedAttendees.value = [];

    if (!props.currentShift) {
        shiftActionType.value = 'open';
        leftView.value = 'attendance';
        rightView.value = 'empty';
    } else {
        leftView.value = 'table';
        rightView.value = 'dashboard';
    }
};

// 🚀 3. WATCHER DE TURNO (Agora shiftActionType já existe com segurança)
watch(() => props.currentShift, () => {
    resetViews();
}, { immediate: true });

const filterPanelRef = ref(null);
const toggleFilterMenu = (event) => { filterPanelRef.value?.toggle(event); };

const openFreelancerPayment = (user, rate) => {
    processFreelancerPayment(user, rate);
    rightView.value = 'freelancer_payment';
};

const handleFreelancerConfirm = (payload) => {
    confirmFreelancerPayment(payload);
    rightView.value = 'dashboard';
};

const handleFreelancerCancel = () => {
    rightView.value = 'dashboard';
};

const handleOrderAction = (payload) => {
    if (payload.type === 'manage' && payload.order?.id) {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-open-checkout', {
            detail: {
                orderId: payload.order.id,
                mode: 'payment'
            }
        }));
    }
};

const openShiftView = (type) => {
    shiftActionType.value = type;

    if (type === 'open') {
        stagedAttendees.value = [];
        leftView.value = 'attendance';
        rightView.value = 'empty';
    } else {
        leftView.value = 'close_shift';
        rightView.value = 'shift_action';
    }
};

const triggerSidebarSubmit = () => {
    shiftSidebarRef.value?.triggerConfirmation();
};

const handleBackToAttendanceFromOpen = () => {
    leftView.value = 'attendance';
    rightView.value = 'empty';
};

const handleShiftSidebarConfirm = ({ observation }) => {
    const isOpening = shiftActionType.value === 'open';

    if (isOpening) {
        executeShiftAction({
            amount: shiftFormData.value.amount,
            retained_amount: shiftFormData.value.retainedAmount,
            observation: observation,
            details: shiftFormData.value.details,
            attendees: stagedAttendees.value
        });
    } else {
        processShiftAction({
            amount: shiftFormData.value.amount,
            retained_amount: shiftFormData.value.retainedAmount,
            observation: observation,
            details: shiftFormData.value.details
        }, 'close');
    }
};

const handleAttendanceConfirm = (attendeesPayload) => {
    const teamArray = Array.isArray(attendeesPayload)
        ? attendeesPayload
        : (attendeesPayload?.attendees || []);

    if (shiftActionType.value === 'open' && !props.currentShift) {
        stagedAttendees.value = teamArray;
        leftView.value = 'open_shift';
        rightView.value = 'shift_action';
    } else if (isStagedAttendance.value && shiftActionType.value === 'close') {
        finalizeShiftWithAttendance(teamArray);
    } else {
        triggerAttendanceSync(teamArray, () => {
            leftView.value = 'table';
        });
    }
};

const handleAttendanceCancel = () => {
    resetViews();
};

const handleTransactionConfirm = (payload) => {
    processTransaction(payload);
    resetViews();
};

const openMidShiftAttendance = () => {
    isStagedAttendance.value = false;
    shiftActionType.value = 'mid_shift';
    leftView.value = 'attendance';
};

const transactionType = ref('in');
const openTransactionView = (type) => {
    transactionType.value = type;
    rightView.value = 'transaction';
};

const openOperationalView = () => {
    leftView.value = 'table';
    rightView.value = 'close_operational';
};

const handleConfirmOperationalClose = (closeStoreChoice) => {
    const unpaidCount = (props.currentAttendees || []).filter(a => Number(a.daily_rate) > 0 && !a.account_payable_id).length;
    submitOperationalCloseShift(closeStoreChoice, () => {
        resetViews();
    }, unpaidCount);
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.fade-enter-active,
.fade-leave-active {
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}
.fade-enter-from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.98);
}
.fade-leave-to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.98);
}
</style>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import axios from "axios";
import { ref, computed, onMounted, watch } from "vue";
import { router, usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";

import Button from "primevue/button";
import Dialog from "primevue/dialog";

import CheckoutItemsList from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutItemsList.vue";
import CheckoutPaymentPanel from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutPaymentPanel.vue";
import CheckoutPostPaymentPanel from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutPostPaymentPanel.vue";
import CheckoutHeader from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutHeader.vue";
import PixWaitingArea from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/PixWaitingArea.vue";
import CustomerSearch from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/CustomerSearch.vue";
import NewCustomerModal from "@/Components/Modals/NewCustomerModal.vue";
import OperationReasonModal from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/OperationReasonModal.vue";

import { useCheckoutMath } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCheckoutMath";
import { useOrderFinancials } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFinancials";
import { useCheckoutStaging } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCheckoutStaging";
import { useSecureAction } from "@/Composables/useSecureAction";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";

import { useCheckoutPix } from "@/Pages/Pos/Composables/useCheckoutPix";
import { useCheckoutProcessor } from "@/Pages/Pos/Composables/useCheckoutProcessor";

const props = defineProps({ order: Object, paymentMethods: Array, companySettings: Object });
const emit = defineEmits(['close']);
const toast = useToast();
const page = usePage();

const isMounted = ref(false);

const liveOrder = computed(() => {
    const base = props.order || {};
    const list = page.props.initialOrders || page.props.orders || [];
    const fromList = list.find(o => o.id === base.id);

    if (!fromList) return base;

    const items = (base.items && base.items.length > 0)
        ? base.items.map(bItem => {
            const uItem = fromList.items?.find(fi => fi.id === bItem.id);
            return uItem ? { ...bItem, ...uItem } : bItem;
        })
        : (fromList.items || []);

    const payments = Array.isArray(base.payments)
        ? base.payments
        : (fromList.payments || []);

    return {
        ...base,
        ...fromList,
        items,
        payments
    };
});

const orderRef = computed(() => liveOrder.value);
const checkoutPrintMode = computed(() => props.companySettings?.checkout_print_mode || 'ask');

const isPostPaymentPhase = ref(
    liveOrder.value?.payment_status === 'paid' ||
    liveOrder.value?.status === 'closed' ||
    liveOrder.value?.status === 'cancelled'
);

watch(
    () => [liveOrder.value?.payment_status, liveOrder.value?.status],
    ([payStatus, orderStatus]) => {
        if (payStatus === 'paid' || orderStatus === 'closed' || orderStatus === 'cancelled') {
            isPostPaymentPhase.value = true;
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

const customerDocument = ref(liveOrder.value?.customer?.cpf || "");
const localCashbackAmountToSend = ref(0);
const isGrouped = ref(true);
const itemSearchQuery = ref("");

const isServiceTaxEnabled = ref(liveOrder.value?.type === 'table' && Boolean(props.companySettings?.has_service_tax));
watch(() => [liveOrder.value?.id, liveOrder.value?.type], ([, type]) => {
    isServiceTaxEnabled.value = type === 'table' && Boolean(props.companySettings?.has_service_tax);
});

const isFiscalEmitter = computed(() => props.companySettings?.is_fiscal_emitter || false);

const isLinkCustomerModalVisible = ref(false);
const customerToLink = ref(null);
const isNewCustomerModalVisible = ref(false);
const newCustomerInitialName = ref("");
const appliedCheckoutCoupon = ref(null);
const appliedCheckoutDiscount = ref(0);

const { getOrderTitle } = useOrderFormatting();

const orderDestinationTitle = computed(() => {
    if (liveOrder.value?.type === 'table') {
        return liveOrder.value.table_number ? `Mesa ${liveOrder.value.table_number}` : 'Mesa Salão';
    }
    if (liveOrder.value?.customer_name || liveOrder.value?.customer?.name) {
        return liveOrder.value.customer_name || liveOrder.value.customer?.name;
    }
    return getOrderTitle(liveOrder.value) || 'Balcão';
});

const headerSubtitle = computed(() => getOrderTitle(liveOrder.value));

const activeOrderItems = computed(() => {
    const items = (liveOrder.value?.items && liveOrder.value.items.length > 0)
        ? liveOrder.value.items
        : (props.order?.items || []);
    return items.filter(i => i.status !== 'cancelled');
});

const {
    reactiveItems, isAllSelected, displayItems, toggleAllSelections,
    handleDivideItem, handleToggleSelect, increment, decrement,
    orderTotalItemsValue, selectedSubtotal
} = useCheckoutMath(activeOrderItems, isGrouped);

const selectedItemsValue = computed(() => selectedSubtotal.value);

const selectionRatio = computed(() => {
    const total = orderTotalItemsValue.value;
    return total === 0 ? 0 : Math.min(1, selectedItemsValue.value / total);
});

const { deliveryFee, discount, serviceFeeAmount, feesAndDiscounts } = useOrderFinancials(liveOrder, orderTotalItemsValue, isServiceTaxEnabled, props.companySettings);

const effectiveServiceFee = computed(() => Number((serviceFeeAmount.value * selectionRatio.value).toFixed(2)));
const effectiveDeliveryFee = computed(() => Number((deliveryFee.value * selectionRatio.value).toFixed(2)));
const effectiveDiscount = computed(() => Number((discount.value * selectionRatio.value).toFixed(2)));

const totalAlreadyPaid = computed(() => {
    return (liveOrder.value?.payments || []).reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.amount || 0), 0);
});

// 🚀 Detecta se o pedido foi 100% baixado em Perda ou 100% em Cupom de Desconto
const isZeroRevenueOrder = computed(() => {
    const o = liveOrder.value || {};
    const subtotal = Number(o.subtotal || 0);
    const delivery = Number(o.delivery_fee || 0);
    const discountVal = Math.max(Number(o.discount || 0), Number(appliedCheckoutDiscount.value || 0));
    const effectiveTotal = Math.max(0, subtotal + delivery - discountVal);

    // 1. 100% de desconto por cupom (total do faturamento zerado)
    if (effectiveTotal <= 0.01) {
        return true;
    }

    // 2. 100% com método de Perda / Quebra (engine_type === 'loss')
    const payments = Array.isArray(o.payments) && o.payments.length > 0
        ? o.payments
        : (stagedPayments.value || []);

    if (payments.length > 0) {
        const methodsMap = new Map((props.paymentMethods || []).map(m => [m.id, m.engine_type || m.engine]));
        const allLoss = payments.every(p => {
            const engine = p.payment_method?.engine_type
                || p.payment_method?.engine
                || methodsMap.get(p.payment_method_id || p.method_id);
            const name = (p.method || p.name || '').toLowerCase();
            return engine === 'loss' || name.includes('perda') || name.includes('quebra');
        });
        if (allLoss) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
});

const itemsPaidValue = computed(() => {
    return reactiveItems.value
        .filter(i => !i.parent_item_id)
        .reduce((sum, item) => sum + (Number(item.base_paid || 0) * item.effective_unit_price), 0);
});

const unallocatedPaid = computed(() => {
    return Math.max(0, totalAlreadyPaid.value - itemsPaidValue.value);
});

const handleApplyCheckoutCoupon = async (code) => {
    try {
        const response = await axios.post(route('customer.coupons.validate'), {
            code: code,
            subtotal: selectedItemsValue.value,
            is_pos: true,
            customer_id: liveOrder.value?.customer_id
        });

        appliedCheckoutCoupon.value = response.data.code;

        // Puxa o cálculo oficial do backend simulando o applyCoupon no composable
        const type = response.data.type;
        const val = Number(response.data.value || 0);

        if (type === 'percent') {
            appliedCheckoutDiscount.value = Math.round(((selectedItemsValue.value * val) / 100) * 100) / 100;
        } else if (type === 'fixed') {
            appliedCheckoutDiscount.value = Math.min(val, selectedItemsValue.value);
        } else if (type === 'free_delivery') {
            appliedCheckoutDiscount.value = effectiveDeliveryFee.value;
        } else if (type === 'fixed_total') {
            const bruto = selectedItemsValue.value + effectiveDeliveryFee.value + effectiveServiceFee.value;
            const diff = bruto - val;
            appliedCheckoutDiscount.value = diff > 0 ? diff : 0;
        }

        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Sucesso', detail: response.data.message, life: 3000 });
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Atenção', detail: e.response?.data?.message || 'Cupom inválido.', life: 4000 });
    }
};

const handleRemoveCheckoutCoupon = () => {
    appliedCheckoutCoupon.value = null;
    appliedCheckoutDiscount.value = 0;
};

const intendedPaymentTotal = computed(() => {
    const rawTotal = selectedItemsValue.value + (feesAndDiscounts.value * selectionRatio.value);
    const paidDeduction = unallocatedPaid.value * selectionRatio.value;

    // 🚀 NOVO: Abate o valor do cupom do total da conta!
    const finalAmount = rawTotal - paidDeduction - appliedCheckoutDiscount.value;

    return Math.max(0, Number((finalAmount).toFixed(2)));
});

const {
    stagedPayments, pendingToStage, addPayment,
    removePayment, divideBy, setAmountToRemaining, autoStagePayments,
    suggestedAmount, activeDivisor, clearDivisor
} = useCheckoutStaging(intendedPaymentTotal);

watch(intendedPaymentTotal, (newVal, oldVal) => {
    if (newVal !== oldVal) {
        stagedPayments.value = [];
        clearDivisor();
    }
});

watch(() => liveOrder.value?.payments, (newPayments, oldPayments) => {
    if (newPayments && oldPayments && newPayments.length !== oldPayments.length) {
        stagedPayments.value = [];
        clearDivisor();
        localCashbackAmountToSend.value = 0;
    }
}, { deep: true });

const canSubmitCheckout = computed(() => {
    const requiredAmount = intendedPaymentTotal.value - localCashbackAmountToSend.value;
    const stagedTotalAmount = stagedPayments.value.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amount, 0);
    return intendedPaymentTotal.value > 0 && stagedTotalAmount >= (requiredAmount - 0.01);
});

const handleManualClose = () => {
    emit('close');
};

const handleAddPayment = (method) => { addPayment(method, toast); };

const handleQuickAdd = (item) => {
    const targetId = item?._parent_ref?.id || item?.id;
    router.post(route('operations.quick-add', liveOrder.value?.id || props.order?.id), {
        item_id: targetId,
        should_print: false,
    }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
    });
};

const { isReasonModalVisible, itemToProcess, authActionType, authNeedsPin, initiateSecureAction } = useSecureAction(props.companySettings);

const handleQuickCancel = (item) => {
    initiateSecureAction(item?._parent_ref || item, 'cancel');
};

const handleRollbackPayment = (payment) => {
    if (!payment || !payment.id) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atenção', detail: 'Identificador não localizado.', life: 3000 });
        return;
    }

    itemToProcess.value = payment;
    authActionType.value = 'rollback_payment';
    authNeedsPin.value = Boolean(props.companySettings?.require_pin_for_voids ?? true);
    isReasonModalVisible.value = true;
};

const handleConfirmAction = (authData) => {
    // 🚀 Tratamento de ações a nível de Conta Inteira (Reativar / Corrigir Tudo)
    if (authActionType.value === 'reactivate' || authActionType.value === 'correct_payment') {
        confirmCancellation(authData);
        return;
    }

    // Fluxo para Estorno Unitário de um Pagamento já existe
    if (authActionType.value === 'rollback_payment') {
        const payment = itemToProcess.value;
        if (!payment || !payment.id) {
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Nenhum pagamento selecionado.', life: 3000 });
            return;
        }

        router.delete(route('operations.orders.payments.rollback', { order: liveOrder.value.id, payment: payment.id }), {
            data: {
                pin: authData?.password || authData?.pin || null,
                reason: authData?.reason || 'Estorno solicitado pelo operador'
            },
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
                itemToProcess.value = null;

                if (props.order?.payments) {
                    props.order.payments = props.order.payments.filter(p => p.id !== payment.id);
                }

                if (props.order?.items) {
                    props.order.items.forEach(i => {
                        i.paid_qty = 0;
                    });
                }

                if (props.order) {
                    props.order.payment_status = 'pending';
                    if (props.order.status === 'closed' || props.order.status === 'completed') {
                        props.order.status = 'pending';
                    }
                }

                const fromList = (page.props.initialOrders || []).find(o => o.id === liveOrder.value?.id);
                if (fromList) {
                    fromList.payments = (fromList.payments || []).filter(p => p.id !== payment.id);
                    if (fromList.items) fromList.items.forEach(i => { i.paid_qty = 0; });
                    fromList.payment_status = 'pending';
                    fromList.status = 'pending'; // Força a visualização pendente
                }

                reactiveItems.value.forEach(item => {
                    item.base_paid = 0;
                    item.paid_parts = 0;
                    item.available_parts = (item.base_qty ?? item.quantity ?? 1) * (item.parts_per_unit || 1);
                    item.selected_parts = item.available_parts;
                });

                stagedPayments.value = [];
                clearDivisor();

                toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Estornado', detail: 'Pagamento revertido com sucesso!', life: 3000 });
                isPostPaymentPhase.value = false;

                router.reload({
                    only: ['cashierData', 'initialOrders'],
                    preserveScroll: true,
                    preserveState: true
                });
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Falha no Estorno', detail: errors?.pin || errors?.reason || 'Não foi possível estornar.', life: 4000 });
            }
        });
    } else {
        // Fluxo de Estorno de Item isolado
        const targetItem = itemToProcess.value;
        const targetId = targetItem?._parent_ref?.id || targetItem?.id;
        if (!targetId) {
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Nenhum item selecionado.', life: 3000 });
            return;
        }

        router.post(route('operations.orders.cancel-item', liveOrder.value.id), {
            item_id: targetId,
            pin: authData?.password || authData?.pin || null,
            reason: authData?.reason || 'Ajuste no encerramento de conta',
            is_loss: Boolean(authData?.isLoss || authData?.is_loss)
        }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
                itemToProcess.value = null;
                toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Item Estornado', detail: 'Item removido do pedido.', life: 2500 });
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Falha', detail: errors?.pin || errors?.reason || 'Não foi possível estornar o item.', life: 3000 });
            }
        });
    }
};

const printBill = () => {
    router.post(route('operations.print-conference', liveOrder.value.id), {}, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {}
    });
};

const linkCustomer = () => {
    const payload = {
        customer_id: typeof customerToLink.value === 'object' ? customerToLink.value.id : null,
        customer_name: typeof customerToLink.value === 'object' ? customerToLink.value.name : customerToLink.value,
        coupon_code: appliedCheckoutCoupon.value
    };
    router.post(route('operations.orders.link-customer', liveOrder.value.id), payload, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isLinkCustomerModalVisible.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Sucesso', detail: 'Cliente vinculado!', life: 3000 });
        }
    });
};

const openNewCustomerModal = (initialName = "") => {
    newCustomerInitialName.value = typeof initialName === 'string' ? initialName : "";
    isLinkCustomerModalVisible.value = false;
    isNewCustomerModalVisible.value = true;
};

const handleSaveNewCustomer = (customerData) => {
    router.post(route('operations.customers.store'), customerData, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isNewCustomerModalVisible.value = false;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Sucesso', detail: 'Cliente cadastrado!', life: 3000 });
        }
    });
};

const handlePixApproved = () => {
    isPostPaymentPhase.value = true;
};

const {
    isPixWaitingPhase, cancelPixPayment, refreshPixPayment, onPixApprovedByWebhook
} = useCheckoutPix(orderRef, handlePixApproved, toast);

const handlePostPaymentActionIntercepted = (action) => {
    const type = typeof action === 'string' ? action : action?.type;
    if (type === 'close' || type === 'finish' || type === 'home' || type === 'no_print') {
        emit('close');
    } else {
        handlePostPaymentAction(action);
    }
};

const {
    isEmittingNfce,
    isFiscalSuccess,
    fiscalEmitError,
    processPayment,
    handlePostPaymentAction,
    confirmCancellation
} = useCheckoutProcessor({
    order: orderRef,
    props,
    toast,
    emitClose: () => {
        emit('close');
    },
    isFiscalEmitter,
    checkoutPrintMode,
    customerDocument,
    stagedPayments,
    reactiveItems,
    serviceFeeAmount,
    localCashbackAmountToSend,
    authActionType,
    itemToProcess,
    authNeedsPin,
    initiateSecureAction,
    isReasonModalVisible,
    isPostPaymentPhase,
    appliedCheckoutCoupon,
    isZeroRevenueOrder
});

onMounted(() => {
    isMounted.value = true;
    autoStagePayments(liveOrder.value, props.paymentMethods);
});
</script>
```

```vue
} = useOrderWorkspace(cartContext, favoritesContext, currentOrderContext);

const syncAppendUrl = (orderId = null) => {

    const url = new URL(window.location.href);

        url.searchParams.delete('order_id');
    } else {
        url.searchParams.delete('append_to_order');
        url.searchParams.delete('order_id');
    }

    window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, url.toString());
};

const cleanEditUrlParams = () => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    url.searchParams.delete('is_combo');

    currentOrderContext.value = null;
    syncAppendUrl(null);
    cleanEditUrlParams();

    if (typeof resetDraftState === 'function') resetDraftState('table');
    else if (typeof clearCart === 'function') clearCart();

    if (typeof handleClearWorkspace === 'function') handleClearWorkspace();
};

const handleDeliveryPaymentConfirm = async (payload) => {
    try {
        isPendingCheckoutSubmission.value = true;

        const targetId = currentOrderContext.value?.id || draftRouting.value?.existing_order_id;

        // 🚀 Aguarda a criação e captura o ID retornado
        const result = await handleInlinePaymentConfirm(payload);
        const resolvedId = result?.order?.id || result?.id || result?.data?.id || targetId;

        if (typeof clearCart === 'function') clearCart();
        if (typeof handleClearWorkspace === 'function') handleClearWorkspace();

        if (payload?.intent === 'pay_now') {
            if (resolvedId) {
                emit('open-checkout', resolvedId);
            }
        } else {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'orders' }));
            emit('order-created');
        }

    } catch (error) {
        isPendingCheckoutSubmission.value = false;
        console.error('Erro ao finalizar pedido com promessa de pagamento:', error);
    }
};

const onCartCheckout = async (checkoutPayload) => {
    try {
        await handleCheckoutWrapper(checkoutPayload);

        if (activeCartSidebarView.value === 'payment') return;

        isPendingCheckoutSubmission.value = true;

        // 🚀 O FIX: Esvazia a memória do carrinho e reseta os configuradores antes de sair
        if (typeof clearCart === 'function') clearCart();
        if (typeof handleClearWorkspace === 'function') handleClearWorkspace();

        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'orders' }));
        emit('order-created');
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Erro ao processar checkout do carrinho:', error);
    }
};

const handleOrderCompleted = () => {
    resetAppendState();
    isPendingCheckoutSubmission.value = false;
};

const {
    isModifiersVisible, isComboVisible, activeProduct, editItemIndex,
    initializeFlow, closeConfigurators: baseCloseConfigurators, handleProductClick, openEditModifiers,
    handleModifiersConfirm, handleComboConfirm: baseHandleComboConfirm, productBreadcrumbs, handleFavoriteClick
} = useOrderFlow(props, cartContext, () => {
    let deliveryFee = 0, discount = 0, meta = {}, finalTotal = cartSubtotal.value;
    try {
        meta = draftRouting.value || {};
        deliveryFee = meta.address?.delivery_fee || meta.deliveryAddress?.delivery_fee || 0;
    } catch (e) {}

    onCartCheckout({ meta, totals: { subtotal: cartSubtotal.value, deliveryFee, discount, finalTotal } });
});

const handleComboConfirm = (comboData) => {
    const editingMeta = activeProduct.value?.cartItem;
    baseHandleComboConfirm(comboData);

    if (editingMeta?.replaces_item_id) {
        const lastItem = cart.value[cart.value.length - 1];
        if (lastItem) {
            lastItem.replaces_item_id = editingMeta.replaces_item_id;
            lastItem.auth_reason = editingMeta.auth_reason;
            lastItem.is_loss = editingMeta.is_loss;
            if (editingMeta.qty) {
                lastItem.qty = editingMeta.qty;
            }
        }
        cleanEditUrlParams();
    }
};

const closeConfigurators = () => {
    baseCloseConfigurators();
    cleanEditUrlParams();
};

const handleCategorySelect = (categoryId) => {
    selectedCategory.value = categoryId;
    closeConfigurators();
};

const handleComboEditCheck = (order, editItemId, isComboRequested, urlParams) => {
    const items = order.items || [];
    const targetItem = items.find(i => String(i.id) === String(editItemId));

    if (!targetItem) return;

    const isCombo = isComboRequested ||
                    Boolean(targetItem.is_combo_item) ||
                    items.some(i => String(i.parent_item_id) === String(targetItem.id));

    if (!isCombo) return;

    const catalogProduct = (props.initialProducts || []).find(p => String(p.id) === String(targetItem.product_id));
    if (!catalogProduct) return;

    const children = items.filter(i => String(i.parent_item_id) === String(targetItem.id) && i.status !== 'cancelled');

    const hydratedComboItems = children.map(c => {
        const rawMods = c.modifiers || c.structured_modifiers || c.structuredModifiers || [];
        const structuredModifiers = rawMods.map(m => ({
            id: m.id ?? m.modifier_option_id ?? null,
            group_id: m.group_id ?? m.modifier_group_id ?? null,
            name: m.name,
            price: Number(m.price || 0),
            qty: Number(m.qty || m.quantity || 1)
        }));

        const modifiersText = structuredModifiers.map(m => (m.qty > 1 ? `${m.qty}x ` : '') + m.name).join(', ');

        return {
            id: c.id,
            product_id: Number(c.product_id),
            name: c.name || c.product_name,
            group_id: c.group_id || null,
            modifiersText: modifiersText,
            structuredModifiers: structuredModifiers
        };
    });

    const editQtyParam = urlParams.get('edit_qty');
    const resolvedQty = editQtyParam === 'all' || !editQtyParam ? Number(targetItem.quantity || 1) : Number(editQtyParam);

    const comboToEdit = {
        ...catalogProduct,
        cartItem: {
            cartId: targetItem.id,
            replaces_item_id: targetItem.id,
            auth_reason: urlParams.get('auth_reason') || '',
            is_loss: urlParams.get('is_loss') === 'true',
            qty: resolvedQty,
            comboItems: hydratedComboItems
        }
    };

    baseCloseConfigurators();
    activeProduct.value = comboToEdit;
    editItemIndex.value = targetItem.id;
    isComboVisible.value = true;
    isModifiersVisible.value = false;
};

const applyOrderContext = (orderData = null) => {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    initializeFlow(urlParams);

    let targetOrder = orderData || currentOrderContext.value;

    if (!targetOrder) {
        const targetOrderId = urlParams.get('append_to_order') || urlParams.get('order_id');
        if (targetOrderId) {
            const initialOrders = page.props.initialOrders || [];
            targetOrder = initialOrders.find(o => o.id == targetOrderId) || { id: Number(targetOrderId) };
        }
    }

    if (targetOrder && targetOrder.id) {
        currentOrderContext.value = targetOrder;
        syncAppendUrl(targetOrder.id);

        let targetType = targetOrder.type || 'table';
        if (!targetOrder.type && targetOrder.table_number) targetType = 'table';

        let targetTable = null;
        let resolvedIdentifier = targetOrder.identifier || targetOrder.customer_name || '';

        if (targetType === 'table') {
            let tableId = targetOrder.dining_table_id || targetOrder.table_id || targetOrder.table?.id || null;
            let tableName = targetOrder.table_number || targetOrder.table?.name || '';

            if (!tableId && tableName && props.initialTableAreas?.length > 0) {
                const found = props.initialTableAreas
                    .flatMap(a => a.tables || [])
                    .find(t => t.name == tableName || t.number == tableName);
                if (found) tableId = found.id;
            }

            targetTable = { id: tableId, name: tableName };
            if (!resolvedIdentifier) resolvedIdentifier = `Mesa ${tableName}`;
        }

        if (targetType === 'counter' && !resolvedIdentifier) {
            resolvedIdentifier = targetOrder.customer?.name || 'Cliente Avulso';
        }

        draftRouting.value = {
            order_id: targetOrder.id || null,
            existing_order_id: targetOrder.id || null,
            type: targetType,
            table: targetTable,
            identifier: resolvedIdentifier,
            customer: targetOrder.customer || (targetOrder.customer_name ? { name: targetOrder.customer_name, phone: targetOrder.customer_phone } : null),
            address: targetOrder.address || null
        };

        orderType.value = targetType;

        const editItemId = urlParams.get('edit_item');
        const isComboRequested = urlParams.get('is_combo') === 'true';

        if (editItemId && targetOrder) {
            handleComboEditCheck(targetOrder, editItemId, isComboRequested, urlParams);
        }
    }
};

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') applyOrderContext(props.editOrderData);

watch(() => props.isActive, (active) => {
    if (active) {
        isPendingCheckoutSubmission.value = false;
        applyOrderContext(currentOrderContext.value || props.editOrderData);
    } else {
        if (!isPendingCheckoutSubmission.value) {
            const items = cart.value?.items || cart.value || [];
            const hasItems = Array.isArray(items) ? items.length > 0 : Object.keys(items).length > 0;

            if (hasItems) {
                if (typeof autoParkCurrent === 'function') autoParkCurrent();
                else if (typeof parkOrder === 'function') parkOrder();
            }
        }

        closeConfigurators();
        isCategoryManagerActive.value = false;
        isFavoritesViewActive.value = false;
        activeCartSidebarView.value = 'cart';

        if (!currentOrderContext.value && !isPendingCheckoutSubmission.value) {
            resetAppendState();
            orderType.value = 'table';
            if (draftRouting.value) draftRouting.value.type = 'table';
        }
    }
});

const handleAppendOrderEvent = (event) => {
    if (event.detail) applyOrderContext(event.detail);
};

const handleTabReset = (event) => {
    if (event.detail !== 'pos') return;

    const items = cart.value?.items || cart.value || [];
    const hasItems = Array.isArray(items) ? items.length > 0 : Object.keys(items).length > 0;

    if (!hasItems) {
        resetAppendState();
        orderType.value = 'table';
        return;
    }

    confirm.require({
        message: 'Você possui um pedido em andamento no caixa. O que deseja fazer com este rascunho?',
        header: 'Pedido em Andamento',
        icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
        rejectProps: { label: 'Descartar e Limpar', severity: 'danger', outlined: true, icon: 'pi pi-trash' },
        acceptProps: { label: 'Estacionar Rascunho', severity: 'warn', icon: 'pi pi-pause-circle' },
        accept: () => {
            if (typeof parkOrder === 'function') parkOrder();
            else autoParkCurrent();
            resetAppendState();
            orderType.value = 'table';
        },
        reject: () => {
            resetAppendState();
            orderType.value = 'table';
        }
    });
};

const closeOrderDetails = () => { emit('close'); };

onMounted(() => {
    isMounted.value = true;
    window.addEventListener('pos-tab-reset', handleTabReset);
    window.addEventListener('pos-append-to-order', handleAppendOrderEvent);
    window.addEventListener('pos-close-order-details', closeOrderDetails);
    window.addEventListener('pos-order-completed', handleOrderCompleted);

    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';
    window.Echo.channel(`tenant.${tenantId}.catalog`)
        .listen('.catalog.updated', () => {
            router.reload({
                only: ['initialCategories', 'categoryTree', 'initialProducts'],
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true
            });
        });
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('pos-tab-reset', handleTabReset);
    window.removeEventListener('pos-append-to-order', handleAppendOrderEvent);
    window.removeEventListener('pos-close-order-details', closeOrderDetails);
    window.removeEventListener('pos-order-completed', handleOrderCompleted);

    if (!isPendingCheckoutSubmission.value) {
        autoParkCurrent();
    }

    const tenantId = page.props.tenantId || page.props.tenant?.id || window.Laravel?.tenant_id || 'central';
    window.Echo.leaveChannel(`tenant.${tenantId}.catalog`);
});

const {
    searchQuery, selectedCategory, breadcrumbs,
    visibleGridCategories, shouldShowCategoryGrid, shouldShowProductGrid
} = useMenuNavigation(() => props.initialCategories, () => props.initialProducts, settings);

watch(searchQuery, (newQuery) => {
    const q = (newQuery || "").trim();
    if (q.length > 0) {
        if (isFavoritesViewActive.value) isFavoritesViewActive.value = false;
        if (isCategoryManagerActive.value) isCategoryManagerActive.value = false;
    }
});

const handleToggleFavorites = () => {
    isFavoritesViewActive.value = !isFavoritesViewActive.value;
    if (isFavoritesViewActive.value) {
        isCategoryManagerActive.value = false;
        searchQuery.value = '';
    }
};

const handleToggleManager = () => {
    isCategoryManagerActive.value = !isCategoryManagerActive.value;
    if (isCategoryManagerActive.value) {
        isFavoritesViewActive.value = false;
        searchQuery.value = '';
    }
};

const onProductClick = (product) => {
    searchQuery.value = '';
    handleProductClick(product);
};

const { catalogBreadcrumbs, handleBreadcrumbNavigate } = useCatalogBreadcrumbs(
    breadcrumbs,
    props.initialCategories,
    closeConfigurators,
    handleCategorySelect
);

const isGiftFilterActive = ref(false);
const allowedGiftPoints = ref(0);

const handleGiftFilterTrigger = (payload) => {
    isGiftFilterActive.value = payload.active;
    allowedGiftPoints.value = payload.points;
};

const productFuse = computed(() => {
    return new Fuse(props.initialProducts || [], {
        keys: [
            { name: 'name', weight: 0.7 },
            { name: 'description', weight: 0.3 }
        ],
        threshold: 0.35,
        distance: 100,
        ignoreLocation: true,
        minMatchCharLength: 2
    });
});

const filteredProducts = computed(() => {
    if (!props.initialProducts) return [];
    let list = props.initialProducts;

    if (isGiftFilterActive.value) {
        return list.filter(p => p.loyalty_reward === true && p.loyalty_points_cost > 0 && p.loyalty_points_cost <= allowedGiftPoints.value && p.status === 'available');
    }

    if (settings.outOfStockMode.value === 'hide') {
        list = list.filter(p => p.status !== 'out_of_stock' && p.status !== 'unavailable');
    }

    const q = (searchQuery.value || "").trim();
    if (q.length >= 2) {
        list = productFuse.value.search(q).map(hit => hit.item);
    } else if (selectedCategory.value) {
        list = list.filter(p => p.category_id == selectedCategory.value);
    } else if (categoryLayout.value !== 'horizontal' && categoryLayout.value !== 'vertical') {
        return [];
    }

    const isProdBlocked = (p) => {
        if (!p) return false;
        const s = String(p.status || '').toLowerCase();
        if (['out_of_stock', 'unavailable', 'paused'].includes(s)) return true;
        if (p.track_inventory && parseFloat(p.current_stock ?? 0) <= 0) return true;
        return false;
    };

    if (settings.outOfStockMode.value === 'hide') {
        list = list.filter(p => !isProdBlocked(p));
    }

    if (settings.outOfStockMode.value === 'disable_bottom') {
        list = [...list].sort((a, b) => {
            const aOos = isProdBlocked(a);
            const bOos = isProdBlocked(b);
            if (aOos && !bOos) return 1;
            if (!aOos && bOos) return -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }

    return list;
});
</script>
```

```vue
defineOptions({ layout: DesktopLayout });

const props = defineProps({
    defaultTab: { type: String, default: 'new' },
    kitchens: Array,
    kdsItems: Array,
});

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const resolveInitialTab = () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const parts = window.location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
        if (parts.length > 1 && parts[0] === 'pos') {
            const urlTab = parts[1];
            const validTabs = ['new', 'pos', 'orders', 'customers', 'shift', 'tasks', 'availability', 'production', 'purchases', 'printers', 'checkout'];
            if (validTabs.includes(urlTab)) return urlTab === 'pos' ? 'new' : urlTab;
        }
    }
    const initial = props.defaultTab || page.props.activeTab || page.props.tab || 'new';
    return initial === 'pos' ? 'new' : initial;
};

const activeTab = ref(resolveInitialTab());
const isNavExpanded = ref(false);
const activeKdsTab = ref('all');
const checkoutData = ref(null);
const printAlerts = ref([]);

const removePrintAlert = (index) => {
    printAlerts.value.splice(index, 1);
};

const { currentMode, setMode } = useTheme();
const { isTerminalLocked, lockTerminal } = usePosTerminalLock();

const toggleTheme = () => {
    if (currentMode.value === 'light') setMode('dark');
    else if (currentMode.value === 'dark') setMode('system');
    else setMode('light');
};

const themeIcon = computed(() => {
    if (currentMode.value === 'light') return 'pi-sun';
    if (currentMode.value === 'dark') return 'pi-moon';
    return 'pi-desktop';
});

const purgeShiftData = (notify = false) => {
    localStorage.removeItem('pos_parked_orders');
    localStorage.removeItem('pos_draft_cart');
    localStorage.removeItem('pos_draft_routing');
    checkoutData.value = null;

    if (notify) {
        toast.add({
            severity: 'info',
            summary: 'Turno Atualizado',
            detail: 'Rascunhos e pedidos estacionados do turno anterior foram limpos.',
            life: 5000
        });
    }
};

const checkShiftIntegrity = () => {
    const currentShift = page.props.cashierData?.currentShift;
    const storedShiftId = localStorage.getItem('pos_active_shift_id');

    if (!currentShift) {
        if (storedShiftId || localStorage.getItem('pos_parked_orders')) {
            purgeShiftData(false);
            localStorage.removeItem('pos_active_shift_id');
        }
    } else {
        if (storedShiftId && String(storedShiftId) !== String(currentShift.id)) {
            purgeShiftData(true);
        }
        localStorage.setItem('pos_active_shift_id', String(currentShift.id));
    }
};

const goToCheckout = async (target) => {
    // 🛡️ Extrai o ID com segurança (seja número, string ou objeto { id: 1538 })
    const orderId = (typeof target === 'object' && target !== null) ? (target.id || target.orderId) : target;
    if (!orderId) return;

    activeTab.value = 'checkout';
    checkoutData.value = null;
    window.history.pushState({ tab: 'checkout' }, '', `/pos/orders?checkout=${orderId}`);

    try {
        // 🚀 Removemos o 'X-Inertia' para acionar o return response()->json($payload) do controller
        const response = await axios.get(route('operations.checkout', orderId), {
            headers: {
                'Accept': 'application/json'
            }
        });

        const payload = response.data?.props || response.data;
        checkoutData.value = {
            order: payload.order,
            paymentMethods: payload.paymentMethods || payload.payment_methods || [],
            companySettings: payload.companySettings || payload.company_settings || page.props.companySettings
        };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Erro ao abrir checkout:', e);
        activeTab.value = 'orders';
        window.history.pushState({ tab: 'orders' }, '', `/pos/orders`);
        toast.add({
            severity: 'error',
            summary: 'Erro',
            detail: 'Não foi possível carregar a conta deste pedido.',
            life: 4000
        });
    }
};

const goToOperations = () => {
    activeTab.value = 'orders';
    window.history.pushState({ tab: 'orders' }, '', `/pos/orders`);
    router.reload({
        only: ['initialOrders', 'initialTableAreas', 'cashierData', 'printerData'],
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true
    });
};

const handleTabChange = (e) => {
    let targetTab = e.detail;
    if (targetTab === 'operations') targetTab = 'orders';
    if (targetTab === 'pos') targetTab = 'new';

    if (activeTab.value === 'checkout' && targetTab !== 'checkout') {
        checkoutData.value = null;
    }

    activeTab.value = targetTab;
    const newUrl = targetTab === 'new' ? '/pos/new' : `/pos/${targetTab}`;
    if (window.location.pathname !== newUrl && !window.location.pathname.includes(newUrl)) {
        window.history.pushState({ tab: targetTab }, '', newUrl);
    }
};

// 🛡️ AUTO-RESET E PRIVACIDADE DE CAIXA POR INATIVIDADE (60 segundos)
usePosIdleTimer({
    timeout: 60000, // 1 minuto
    isEnabled: () => {
        // 1. Cenário Checkout: está na aba checkout E o pedido já foi pago/liquidado
        const isFinishedCheckout = activeTab.value === 'checkout' &&
            (checkoutData.value?.order?.payment_status === 'paid' ||
             checkoutData.value?.order?.status === 'closed' ||
             checkoutData.value?.order?.status === 'completed');

        // 2. Cenário Turno/Caixa: está na aba de conferência de turno/valores
        const isShiftView = activeTab.value === 'shift';

        return isFinishedCheckout || isShiftView;
    },
    onIdle: () => {
        // Cenário 1: Fecha o checkout concluído e prepara nova venda
        if (activeTab.value === 'checkout') {
            closeCheckout();
            activeTab.value = 'new';
        }
        // Cenário 2: Oculta valores financeiros do caixa e volta ao cardápio de atendimento
        else if (activeTab.value === 'shift') {
            activeTab.value = 'new';
            const newUrl = '/pos/new';
            if (window.location.pathname !== newUrl) {
                window.history.pushState({ tab: 'new' }, '', newUrl);
            }
        }
    }
});

const closeCheckout = () => {
    checkoutData.value = null;
    activeTab.value = 'orders';

    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    url.searchParams.delete('order');
    url.searchParams.delete('checkout');
    window.history.replaceState({ tab: 'orders' }, '', '/pos/orders');

    router.reload({
        only: ['initialOrders', 'initialTableAreas', 'cashierData'],
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true
    });
};

const handlePopState = (event) => {
    if (event.state && event.state.tab) {
        activeTab.value = event.state.tab === 'pos' ? 'new' : event.state.tab;
    } else {
        const parts = window.location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
        const tab = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : 'new';
        activeTab.value = (tab === 'new' || tab === 'pos') ? 'new' : tab;
    }

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const orderId = urlParams.get('order') || urlParams.get('checkout');
    if (activeTab.value === 'checkout' && orderId) {
        goToCheckout(orderId);
    }
};

const handleOpenCheckoutEvent = (e) => {
    const orderId = e.detail?.orderId || e.detail;
    goToCheckout(orderId);
};

const { initPosSync } = usePosSync(activeTab, checkoutData);
initPosSync();

// 🚀 RECEPTOR EM TEMPO REAL: Alertas de Falha de Impressão (Todas as Origens)
useTenantEcho().listenChannel('operations', '.print.alert', (data) => {
    printAlerts.value.push(data);
});

useTenantEcho().listenChannel('shift', '.shift.closed', () => {
    purgeShiftData(false);
    localStorage.removeItem('pos_active_shift_id');
});

onMounted(() => {
    checkShiftIntegrity();

    if (window.location.pathname === '/pos' || window.location.pathname === '/pos/') {
        window.history.replaceState({ tab: 'new' }, '', '/pos/new');
    }

    window.addEventListener('pos-tab-changed', handleTabChange);
    window.addEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
    window.addEventListener('pos-open-checkout', handleOpenCheckoutEvent);

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const orderId = urlParams.get('order') || urlParams.get('checkout');
    if (orderId && (activeTab.value === 'checkout' || window.location.pathname.includes('/checkout'))) {
        goToCheckout(orderId);
    }
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('pos-tab-changed', handleTabChange);
    window.removeEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
    window.removeEventListener('pos-open-checkout', handleOpenCheckoutEvent);
});

const handleLogout = () => {
    router.post(route('logout'), {}, {
        onFinish: () => { window.location.href = '/pos/login'; }
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
            <SegmentedControl
                v-model="theme"
                :options="[

<script setup>
import { computed, watch } from 'vue';
import SettingCard from "./SettingCard.vue";
import { usePosSettings } from "@/Pages/Pos/Composables/usePosSettings";

const props = defineProps({
    isTeamMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const { categoryLayout, productCardLayout, theme, categoryHierarchy, addressLookupMode, outOfStockMode } = usePosSettings();

const categoryLayoutOptions = computed(() => {
    const opts = [{ label: 'Topo', value: 'horizontal', icon: 'pi-bars' }];
    if (!props.isTeamMode) opts.push({ label: 'Lateral', value: 'vertical', icon: 'pi-align-left' });
    opts.push({ label: 'Grade', value: 'grid', icon: 'pi-th-large' });
    opts.push({ label: 'Lista', value: 'list', icon: 'pi-list' });
    return opts;
});

// 🚀 A MÁGICA DA SINCRONIZAÇÃO DO LAYOUT (USANDO FUNÇÕES DE GETTER BLINDADAS)
watch(() => productCardLayout?.value, (newVal) => {
    if (newVal === 'list' && categoryLayout?.value === 'grid') {
        categoryLayout.value = 'list';
    }
    else if (newVal === 'square' && categoryLayout?.value === 'list') {
        categoryLayout.value = 'grid';
    }
});

// 🚀 A MÁGICA DA SINCRONIZAÇÃO DO TEMA (USANDO FUNÇÕES DE GETTER BLINDADAS)
watch(() => theme?.value, (newMode) => {
    if (!newMode) return;
    localStorage.setItem('pos_color_scheme', newMode);

    if (newMode === 'dark' || (newMode === 'system' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)) {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
    } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
    }
});
</script>
```

```javascript
import { useTenantEcho } from '@/Composables/useTenantEcho';
import { router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { computed, isRef, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export function useActiveOrderWidget(initialOrders = []) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const page = usePage();
    const { listenChannel } = useTenantEcho();

    const getInitialArray = () => {
        if (isRef(initialOrders)) return initialOrders.value || [];
        if (typeof initialOrders === 'function') return initialOrders() || [];
        return initialOrders || [];
    };

    const activeOrders = ref(getInitialArray());

    watch(() => getInitialArray(), (newVal) => {
        if (Array.isArray(newVal)) {
            activeOrders.value = [...newVal];
        }
    }, { deep: true });

    const primaryOrder = computed(() => {
        if (!activeOrders.value || activeOrders.value.length === 0) return null;
        return activeOrders.value[0];
    });

    const hasActiveOrder = computed(() => primaryOrder.value !== null);

    const canCancel = computed(() => {
        if (!primaryOrder.value) return false;
        return ['pending', 'pending_payment'].includes(primaryOrder.value.status);
    });

    const canAppendItems = computed(() => {
        if (!primaryOrder.value) return false;
        return ['pending', 'pending_payment', 'preparing'].includes(primaryOrder.value.status);
    });

    // 🚀 FASES CORRIGIDAS: 'dispatched' pertence ao Passo 3 (Em Rota)
    const currentTimelineStep = computed(() => {
        if (!primaryOrder.value) return 0;
        const status = primaryOrder.value.status;
        const isDelivery = primaryOrder.value.type === 'delivery';

        // Passo 1: Recebido / Aguardando confirmação
        if (['pending', 'pending_payment'].includes(status)) return 1;

        if (isDelivery) {
            // Delivery Passo 2: Sendo preparado ou Embalado na cozinha
            if (['preparing', 'ready'].includes(status)) return 2;
            // Delivery Passo 3: Com o motoboy / Entregue / Concluído
            if (['dispatched', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'closed', 'completed'].includes(status)) return 3;
        } else {
            // Balcão / Mesa
            if (['preparing'].includes(status)) return 2;
            if (['ready', 'closed', 'completed'].includes(status)) return 3;
        }

        return 0;
    });

    const now = ref(Date.now());
    let timerInterval = null;

    const timeSinceUpdate = computed(() => {
        if (!primaryOrder.value?.updated_at) return '';
        const diffMs = now.value - new Date(primaryOrder.value.updated_at).getTime();
        const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);

        if (diffMins < 1) return 'agora mesmo';
        if (diffMins < 60) return `há ${diffMins} min`;
        const hours = Math.floor(diffMins / 60);
        return `há ${hours} h`;
    });

    const cancelOrder = (orderId) => {
        router.post(route('customer.orders.cancel', orderId), { preserveState: true, }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: (pageResp) => {
                if (pageResp.props.flash?.success) toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Cancelado', detail: pageResp.props.flash.success, life: 5000 });
            },
            onError: (errors) => toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Ops!', detail: Object.values(errors)[0] || 'Erro ao cancelar.', life: 5000 })
        });
    };

    const appendItems = (orderId) => {
        if (!orderId) return;

        // 1. Grava o ID do pedido que receberá os novos itens
        sessionStorage.setItem('customer_append_order_id', String(orderId));

        // 2. Dispara evento local para troca instantânea de aba sem reload
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('customer-switch-tab', { detail: 'menu' }));

        // 3. Redirecionamento seguro usando o nome correto da rota registrada ('customer.app')
        if (typeof route === 'function' && route().has('customer.app')) {
            router.visit(route('customer.app', { tab: 'menu' }), {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true
            });
        }
    };

    // 🚀 Aplicação reativa imutável da atualização
    const applyOrderUpdate = (payload) => {
        const incoming = payload?.orderData || payload?.order || payload;
        if (!incoming || !incoming.id) return;

        const incomingId = Number(incoming.id);
        const index = activeOrders.value.findIndex(o => Number(o.id) === incomingId);

        if (index !== -1) {
            // Cria um novo array para disparar a reatividade imediata do Vue
            const updated = [...activeOrders.value];
            updated[index] = { ...updated[index], ...incoming };
            activeOrders.value = updated;
            now.value = Date.now();

            if (incoming.status === 'preparing') {
                toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Na Cozinha!', detail: 'Seu pedido começou a ser preparado.', life: 5000 });
            } else if (['dispatched', 'out_for_delivery'].includes(incoming.status)) {
                toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Saiu para entrega! 🛵', detail: 'O entregador já está a caminho.', life: 6000 });
            } else if (['closed', 'cancelled'].includes(incoming.status)) {
                activeOrders.value = activeOrders.value.filter(o => Number(o.id) !== incomingId);
            }
        }
    };

    const listenToOrders = () => {
        if (typeof window.Echo === 'undefined') return;

        // 1. Antena Canal Tenant Global
        try {
            // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Usamos o listenChannel nativo.
            // Ele faz o stopListening automático no onBeforeUnmount sem matar o canal inteiro!
            listenChannel('orders', '.order.updated', applyOrderUpdate);
            listenChannel('orders', 'OrderUpdated', applyOrderUpdate);
        } catch (e) {}

        // 2. Antena Canal Específico do Pedido
        activeOrders.value.forEach(order => {
            window.Echo.channel(`order.${order.id}`)
                .listen('.order.updated', applyOrderUpdate)
                .listen('OrderUpdated', applyOrderUpdate);
        });
    };

    const stopListening = () => {
        if (typeof window.Echo === 'undefined') return;

        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Removemos o leave global. Fecha apenas os canais específicos dos pedidos concluídos.
        activeOrders.value.forEach(order => window.Echo.leave(`order.${order.id}`));
    };

    watch(() => activeOrders.value.map(o => o.id).join(','), () => {
        stopListening();
        listenToOrders();
    });

    onMounted(() => {
        listenToOrders();
        timerInterval = setInterval(() => now.value = Date.now(), 60000);
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        stopListening();
        if (timerInterval) clearInterval(timerInterval);
    });

    return {
        activeOrders, primaryOrder, hasActiveOrder, canCancel, canAppendItems,
        currentTimelineStep, timeSinceUpdate, cancelOrder, appendItems
    };
}
```

```javascript
import axios from "axios";
import Fuse from "fuse.js";
import { nextTick, ref } from "vue";

export function useAddressLookup(addressLookupMode) {
    const isSearchingCep = ref(false);
    const isLoadingStreets = ref(false);
    const streetSuggestions = ref([]);
    const baseStreetsDataset = ref([]);
    let fuseInstance = null;

    const loadStreetsDataset = async () => {
        if (addressLookupMode.value === 'street' && baseStreetsDataset.value.length === 0) {
            isLoadingStreets.value = true;
            try {
                // Presume que a rota devolve a tabela de streets com os segmentos
                const response = await axios.get(route('api.streets.index'));
                baseStreetsDataset.value = response.data;
                fuseInstance = new Fuse(baseStreetsDataset.value, { keys: ["name"], threshold: 0.3, distance: 100 });
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Erro ao carregar ruas:", error);
            } finally {
                isLoadingStreets.value = false;
            }
        }
    };

    const fetchCep = async (zipcode, formRef, successCallback, errorCallback) => {
        let clean = zipcode.replace(/\D/g, "");
        if (clean.length === 8) {
            isSearchingCep.value = true;
            try {
                // 🚀 MIGRAÇÃO: BrasilAPI
                const response = await axios.get(`https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cep/v1/${clean}`);
                formRef.value.street = response.data.street || "";
                formRef.value.neighborhood = response.data.neighborhood || "";

                nextTick(() => { if (successCallback) successCallback(); });
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(error);
                if (errorCallback) errorCallback();
            } finally {
                isSearchingCep.value = false;
            }
        }
    };

    const searchStreets = (event) => {
        const query = event.query;
        if (!query || query.trim().length < 2) { streetSuggestions.value = []; return; }

        if (fuseInstance) {
            streetSuggestions.value = fuseInstance.search(query).map(res => res.item);
        } else {
            streetSuggestions.value = [];
        }
    };

        const calculateFuzzyNeighborhood = (formRef) => {
        const form = formRef.value || formRef;
        const street = form.streetObj || null;
        if (!street || !street.segments || street.segments.length === 0) return;

        // Se tem apenas 1 segmento, define direto
        if (street.segments.length === 1) {
            form.neighborhood = street.segments[0].neighborhood?.name || street.segments[0].neighborhood || "";
            form.neighborhood_id = street.segments[0].neighborhood_id || street.segments[0].neighborhood?.id || null;
            return;
        }

        const num = parseInt(form.number);
        let matched = null;

        // Se informou número válido, busca em qual faixa (segmento) se encontra
        if (!form.no_number && !isNaN(num)) {
            matched = street.segments.find(s => {
                const start = parseInt(s.start_number) || 0;
                const end = s.end_number ? parseInt(s.end_number) : Infinity;
                return num >= start && num <= end;
            });
        }

        // Fallback: se não achar faixa compatível ou estiver S/N, pega o primeiro
        if (!matched) matched = street.segments[0];

        if (matched) {
            form.neighborhood = matched.neighborhood?.name || matched.neighborhood || "";
            form.neighborhood_id = matched.neighborhood_id || matched.neighborhood?.id || null;
        }
    };

    return {
        isSearchingCep, isLoadingStreets, streetSuggestions,
        loadStreetsDataset, fetchCep, searchStreets, calculateFuzzyNeighborhood
    };
}
```
