```javascript
import { computed, ref, unref } from 'vue';

export function useAvailability(catalogRef, toast) {
    const selectedLocation = ref('all');
    const selectedType = ref('all');
    const searchQuery = ref('');
    const activeMode = ref('status'); // 'status' | 'inventory'

    const modeOptions = [
        { label: 'Status', value: 'status', icon: 'pi-bolt' },
        { label: 'Inventário', value: 'inventory', icon: 'pi-clipboard' }
    ];

    // 🛑 Trava estrita: itens sem estoque físico (Pratos montados e Combos)
    const isExcludedFromStock = (item) => {
        if (!item) return true;
        if (item.status === 'archived') return true;

        const type = String(item.type || '').toLowerCase();
        if (type === 'dish' || type === 'combo') return true;

        if (item.is_combo === true || item.is_combo === 1 || item.is_combo === '1' || item.is_combo === 'true') {
            return true;
        }
        if (item.isCombo === true || item.isCombo === 1 || item.isCombo === '1' || item.isCombo === 'true') {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    };

    const getStatusWeight = (item) => {
        if (item.status === 'out_of_stock' || (item.track_inventory && parseFloat(item.current_stock) <= 0)) {
            return 0; // 🔴 Vermelho (Esgotado)
        }
        if (item.status === 'paused') {
            return 1; // 🟡 Amarelo (Pausado)
        }
        return 2; // 🟢 Verde (Disponível)
    };

    const extractLocations = (item) => {
        if (Array.isArray(item.storage_locations) && item.storage_locations.length > 0) {
            return item.storage_locations.map(loc => typeof loc === 'object' ? loc : { id: loc, name: String(loc) });
        }
        if (Array.isArray(item.storage_rules) && item.storage_rules.length > 0) {
            return item.storage_rules.map(rule => rule.storage_location || rule.storageLocation || {
                id: rule.storage_location_id,
                name: rule.location_name || `Local #${rule.storage_location_id}`
            }).filter(Boolean);
        }
        if (item.storage_location && typeof item.storage_location === 'object') {
            return [item.storage_location];
        }
        if (item.location_name || item.storage_location_name) {
            return [{
                id: item.storage_location_id || item.location_id || item.location_name,
                name: item.location_name || item.storage_location_name
            }];
        }
        return [{ id: 'general', name: 'Estoque Central / Geral' }];
    };

    const resolveItemSection = (item) => {
        const type = (item.type || '').toLowerCase();
        if (type === 'resale') return 'resale';
        if (type === 'ingredient') return 'ingredients';
        if (['supply', 'packaging', 'consumable'].includes(type)) return 'supplies';
        if (type === 'manufactured') return 'manufactured';
        return 'resale';
    };

    const availableLocations = computed(() => {
        const items = (unref(catalogRef) || []).filter(i => !isExcludedFromStock(i));
        const map = new Map();

        items.forEach(item => {
            const locs = extractLocations(item);
            locs.forEach(loc => {
                const key = String(loc.id);
                if (!map.has(key)) {
                    map.set(key, { id: loc.id, name: loc.name, total: 0, critical: 0 });
                }
                const entry = map.get(key);
                entry.total++;
                if (getStatusWeight(item) < 2) {
                    entry.critical++;
                }
            });
        });

        return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    });

    const locationOptions = computed(() => {
        const list = [{ label: 'Todos os Locais', value: 'all', critical: 0 }];
        let totalCritical = 0;

        availableLocations.value.forEach(loc => {
            totalCritical += loc.critical;
            list.push({
                label: loc.name,
                value: String(loc.id),
                critical: loc.critical
            });
        });

        list[0].critical = totalCritical;
        return list;
    });

    const groupedCatalog = computed(() => {
        const rawItems = (unref(catalogRef) || []).filter(item => !isExcludedFromStock(item));
        const term = searchQuery.value?.trim().toLowerCase();
        const locationsMap = new Map();

        rawItems.forEach(item => {
            // No Modo Inventário, só exibe itens que controlam estoque físico
            if (activeMode.value === 'inventory' && !item.track_inventory) {
                return;
            }

            if (term) {
                const matches = (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                                (item.sku || '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                                (item.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                                String(item.id).includes(term);
                if (!matches) return;
            }

            const section = resolveItemSection(item);
            if (selectedType.value !== 'all' && selectedType.value !== section) {
                return;
            }

            const itemLocs = extractLocations(item);

            itemLocs.forEach(loc => {
                const locKey = String(loc.id);

                if (selectedLocation.value !== 'all' && selectedLocation.value !== locKey) {
                    return;
                }

                if (!locationsMap.has(locKey)) {
                    locationsMap.set(locKey, {
                        id: loc.id,
                        name: loc.name,
                        criticalCount: 0,
                        totalCount: 0,
                        resale: [],
                        ingredients: [],
                        supplies: [],
                        manufactured: []
                    });
                }

                const locGroup = locationsMap.get(locKey);
                locGroup.totalCount++;

                if (getStatusWeight(item) < 2) {
                    locGroup.criticalCount++;
                }

                locGroup[section].push(item);
            });
        });

        const sortItems = (list) => {
            return list.slice().sort((a, b) => {
                const wA = getStatusWeight(a);
                const wB = getStatusWeight(b);
                if (wA !== wB) return wA - wB;
                return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '', 'pt-BR');
            });
        };

        const result = Array.from(locationsMap.values()).map(loc => ({
            ...loc,
            resale: sortItems(loc.resale),
            ingredients: sortItems(loc.ingredients),
            supplies: sortItems(loc.supplies),
            manufactured: sortItems(loc.manufactured)
        }));

        return result.sort((a, b) => {
            if (b.criticalCount !== a.criticalCount) return b.criticalCount - a.criticalCount;
            return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        });
    });

    return {
        selectedLocation,
        selectedType,
        searchQuery,
        activeMode,
        modeOptions,
        locationOptions,
        groupedCatalog
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { useAnalytics } from '@/Composables/useAnalytics';
import { useStorage } from "@vueuse/core";
import { computed, watch } from "vue";

export const createDefaultRouting = (type = 'table') => ({
    order_id: null,
    existing_order_id: null,
    type: type,
    dining_table_id: null,
    table_id: null,
    table: null,
    identifier: '',
    customer: null,
    customer_phone: null,
    address_id: null,
    address: null
});

export function generateModifiersHash(modifiers = []) {
    if (!modifiers || !Array.isArray(modifiers) || modifiers.length === 0) {
        return "none";
    }
    const normalized = [...modifiers]
        .map(m => ({
            id: Number(m.id || m.modifier_option_id || 0),
            group_id: Number(m.group_id || m.modifier_group_id || 0),
            qty: Number(m.qty || m.quantity || 1),
            price: Number(m.price || 0),
            name: String(m.name || '').trim()
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => (a.group_id - b.group_id) || (a.id - b.id) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    return JSON.stringify(normalized);
}

export function generateComboHash(comboItems = []) {
    if (!comboItems || !Array.isArray(comboItems) || comboItems.length === 0) {
        return "none";
    }
    const normalized = [...comboItems].map(c => ({
        product_id: Number(c.product_id || c.id || 0),
        group_id: Number(c.group_id || 0),
        qty: Number(c.qty || c.quantity || 1),
        modHash: generateModifiersHash(c.structuredModifiers || c.modifiers || [])
    })).sort((a, b) => (a.group_id - b.group_id) || (a.product_id - b.product_id));

    return JSON.stringify(normalized);
}

const cart = useStorage("pos_draft_cart", []);
const parkedOrders = useStorage("pos_parked_orders", []);
const globalOrderType = useStorage("pos_draft_type", 'table');
const globalDraftRouting = useStorage("pos_draft_routing", createDefaultRouting('table'));

watch(globalOrderType, (newType) => {
    if (globalDraftRouting.value) {
        globalDraftRouting.value.type = newType;
        if (newType !== 'delivery') {
            globalDraftRouting.value.address = null;
            globalDraftRouting.value.address_id = null;
        }
    }
}, { immediate: true });

export function validateProductModifiers(prod, structuredModifiers = []) {
    if (!prod) return { valid: true };

    const groups = prod.modifier_groups || prod.modifierGroups || [];
    for (const group of groups) {
        const min = Number(group.min_choices ?? group.min_quantity ?? (group.is_required ? 1 : 0));
        if (min > 0) {
            const selectedInGroup = (structuredModifiers || []).filter(m =>
                String(m.group_id || m.modifier_group_id) === String(group.id)
            );
            const totalQty = selectedInGroup.reduce((sum, m) => sum + Number(m.qty || 1), 0);

            if (totalQty < min) {
                return {
                    valid: false,
                    productName: prod.name || 'Produto',
                    groupName: group.name || group.title || 'Modificador Obrigatório',
                    missing: min - totalQty
                };
            }
        }
    }
    return { valid: true };
}

export function useCart() {
    const { trackAddToCart } = useAnalytics();

    const setOrderType = (newType) => {
        globalOrderType.value = newType;
        if (globalDraftRouting.value) {
            globalDraftRouting.value.type = newType;
            if (newType !== 'delivery') {
                globalDraftRouting.value.address = null;
                globalDraftRouting.value.address_id = null;
            }
        }
    };

    const addToCart = ({
        product, extraPrice = 0, isTakeaway = false,
        comboItems = null, structuredModifiers = [], qty = 1,
        replaces_item_id = null, parent_item_id = null, is_combo_child = false,
        auth_reason = null, is_loss = null, isSubItemOfCombo = false, basePriceOverride = null
    }) => {
        const mainCheck = validateProductModifiers(product, structuredModifiers);
        if (!mainCheck.valid) {
            console.error(`[useCart] Inserção bloqueada: "${mainCheck.productName}" requer seleção no grupo "${mainCheck.groupName}".`);
            return false;
        }

        if (comboItems && Array.isArray(comboItems)) {
            for (const sub of comboItems) {
                const subProd = sub.product || sub;
                const subCheck = validateProductModifiers(subProd, sub.structuredModifiers);
                if (!subCheck.valid) {
                    console.error(`[useCart] Combo bloqueado: O item "${subCheck.productName}" requer "${subCheck.groupName}".`);
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        // Subitem de combo tem preço base 0
        let basePrice = 0;
        if (!isSubItemOfCombo && basePriceOverride === null) {
            basePrice = globalOrderType.value === "delivery" && product.delivery_price > 0
                ? Number(product.delivery_price)
                : Number(product.price ?? product.dine_in_price ?? 0);
        }

        const finalPrice = basePrice + Number(extraPrice || 0);
        const isCombo = comboItems !== null;
        const comboHash = isCombo ? generateComboHash(comboItems) : null;
        const modHash = generateModifiersHash(structuredModifiers);

        const existingItem = cart.value.find(
            (item) => item.id === product.id && item.modHash === modHash && item.isTakeaway === isTakeaway && item.comboHash === comboHash
        );

        if (existingItem && !replaces_item_id) {
            existingItem.qty += qty;
        } else {
            cart.value.push({
                cartId: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                id: product.id,
                name: isSubItemOfCombo ? `${product.name} (Adicional Combo)` : product.name,
                price: finalPrice,
                extra_price: Number(extraPrice || 0),
                qty: qty,
                structuredModifiers: structuredModifiers,
                isTakeaway: isTakeaway,
                productOriginal: product,
                isCombo: isCombo,
                comboItems: comboItems,
                comboHash: comboHash,
                modHash: modHash,
                replaces_item_id: replaces_item_id,
                parent_item_id: parent_item_id || product.combo_parent_id || null,
                is_combo_child: is_combo_child || isSubItemOfCombo,
                auth_reason: auth_reason,
                is_loss: is_loss
            });
        }
        trackAddToCart(product, extraPrice + (product.promo_price || product.price || 0));
        return true;
    };

    const updateQty = (index, delta) => {
        if (cart.value[index]) {
            const current = Number(cart.value[index].qty ?? cart.value[index].quantity ?? 1);
            const next = current + Number(delta);
            cart.value[index].qty = next;
            if (cart.value[index].qty <= 0) cart.value.splice(index, 1);
        }
    };

    const updateItemModifiers = (index, { extraPrice, isTakeaway, structuredModifiers = [] }) => {
        const item = cart.value[index];
        if (!item) return;

        const check = validateProductModifiers(item.productOriginal, structuredModifiers);
        if (!check.valid) {
            console.error(`[useCart] Edição bloqueada: "${check.productName}" requer "${check.groupName}".`);
            return false;
        }

        item.isTakeaway = isTakeaway;
        item.structuredModifiers = structuredModifiers;
        item.modHash = generateModifiersHash(structuredModifiers);

        if (item.is_combo_child) {
            item.price = Number(extraPrice || 0);
            item.extra_price = Number(extraPrice || 0);
        } else {
            const basePrice = globalOrderType.value === "delivery" && item.productOriginal.delivery_price > 0
                ? Number(item.productOriginal.delivery_price)
                : Number(item.productOriginal.price ?? item.productOriginal.dine_in_price ?? 0);
            item.price = basePrice + extraPrice;
        }
        return true;
    };

    const resetDraftState = (type = 'table') => {
        cart.value = [];
        globalOrderType.value = type;
        globalDraftRouting.value = createDefaultRouting(type);
    };

    const clearCart = () => {
        resetDraftState('table');
    };

    const cartSubtotal = computed(() => cart.value.reduce((total, item) => total + item.price * item.qty, 0));

    const parkCurrentOrder = (orderMetadata, orderType) => {
        if (cart.value.length === 0) return;
        parkedOrders.value.push({
            id: Date.now(),
            date: new Date().toISOString(),
            cart: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cart.value)),
            type: orderType,
            meta: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(orderMetadata || {})),
            total: cartSubtotal.value
        });
        clearCart();
    };

    const autoParkCurrent = (incomingOrderId = null) => {
        if (cart.value.length === 0) return;
        const meta = globalDraftRouting.value || {};
        const type = globalOrderType.value || "table";
        if (incomingOrderId && meta.order_id === incomingOrderId) return;
        parkCurrentOrder(meta, type);
    };

    const resumeOrder = (parkedId) => {
        const targetOrder = parkedOrders.value.find(p => p.id === parkedId);
        if (!targetOrder) return;

        if (cart.value && cart.value.length > 0) {
            autoParkCurrent();
        }

        const index = parkedOrders.value.findIndex(p => p.id === parkedId);
        if (index === -1) return;

        const parked = parkedOrders.value[index];
        cart.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(parked.cart || []));
        globalOrderType.value = parked.type || 'table';
        globalDraftRouting.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(parked.meta || createDefaultRouting(parked.type || 'table')));
        parkedOrders.value.splice(index, 1);
    };

    const discardParkedOrder = (parkedId) => {
        const index = parkedOrders.value.findIndex(p => p.id === parkedId);
        if (index > -1) parkedOrders.value.splice(index, 1);
    };

    const loadEditOrder = (orderData) => {
        autoParkCurrent(orderData.id);
        clearCart();
    };

    const startNewOrder = () => {
        autoParkCurrent();
        clearCart();
    };

    return {
        cart,
        orderType: globalOrderType,
        draftRouting: globalDraftRouting,
        setOrderType,

        parkedOrders, parkCurrentOrder, parkOrder: autoParkCurrent, resumeOrder, discardParkedOrder,

    };
```

```javascript
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export function useCashback(customerRef, orderSubtotalRef) {
    const page = usePage();
    const settings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});

    const useCashbackToggle = ref(false);

    const isLoyaltyActive = computed(() => settings.value.loyalty_is_active && settings.value.loyalty_reward_type === 'cashback');
    const minRedeemValue = computed(() => Number(settings.value.loyalty_min_redeem_value || 0));
    const conversionRate = computed(() => Number(settings.value.loyalty_cashback_conversion_rate || 5));

    // 🚀 CONFIGURAÇÃO DE TETO MÁXIMO
    const maxRedeemValue = computed(() => Number(settings.value.loyalty_max_redeem_value || 0));
    const maxRedeemType = computed(() => settings.value.loyalty_max_redeem_type || 'fixed');

    const customerPoints = computed(() => customerRef.value?.loyalty_points || 0);
    const canRedeem = computed(() => orderSubtotalRef.value >= minRedeemValue.value);

    const missingAmount = computed(() => Math.max(0, minRedeemValue.value - orderSubtotalRef.value));
    const availableBalance = computed(() => (customerPoints.value / 100) * conversionRate.value);

    // 🚀 CÁLCULO DO TETO APLICÁVEL AO PEDIDO
    const maxAllowedCap = computed(() => {
        if (maxRedeemValue.value <= 0) return Infinity;

        if (maxRedeemType.value === 'percentage') {
            return (orderSubtotalRef.value * maxRedeemValue.value) / 100;
        }

        return maxRedeemValue.value;
    });

    const cashbackDiscount = computed(() => {
        if (!useCashbackToggle.value || !canRedeem.value || customerPoints.value <= 0) return 0;

        // 🚀 O desconto respeita: saldo disponível, subtotal do pedido e o teto configurado
        return Math.min(availableBalance.value, orderSubtotalRef.value, maxAllowedCap.value);
    });

    watch([canRedeem, isLoyaltyActive], ([redeemable, active]) => {
        if (!redeemable || !active || customerPoints.value <= 0) {
            useCashbackToggle.value = false;
        }
    });

    return {
        useCashbackToggle,
        cashbackDiscount,
        isLoyaltyActive,
        availableBalance,
        customerPoints,
        canRedeem,
        missingAmount,
        maxRedeemValue,
        maxRedeemType,
        maxAllowedCap
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export function useCashInput() {
    const isNoChange = ref(true);
    const formattedChangeTarget = ref('');

    // Transforma "50,00" no número 50.00 para envio ao backend e validações
    const numericChangeTarget = computed(() => {
        if (!formattedChangeTarget.value) return 0;
        return parseFloat(formattedChangeTarget.value.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.')) || 0;
    });

    // A Mágica da digitação (da direita para a esquerda)
    const handleCashInput = (e) => {
        let val = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); // Remove absolutamente tudo que não for número

        if (!val || parseInt(val, 10) === 0) {
            formattedChangeTarget.value = '';
            isNoChange.value = true;
            return;
        }

        isNoChange.value = false;
        formattedChangeTarget.value = (parseInt(val, 10) / 100).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
    };

    // Se ligar o toggle "Sem Troco", limpa o input
    watch(isNoChange, (newVal) => {
        if (newVal) formattedChangeTarget.value = '';
    });

    const resetCashInput = () => {
        formattedChangeTarget.value = '';
        isNoChange.value = true;
    };

    return {
        isNoChange,
        formattedChangeTarget,
        numericChangeTarget,
        handleCashInput,
        resetCashInput
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed } from 'vue';

export function useCatalogBreadcrumbs(breadcrumbs, initialCategories, closeConfigurators, handleCategorySelect) {

    const catalogBreadcrumbs = computed(() => {
        const crumbs = breadcrumbs.value || [];

        if (crumbs.length === 0) {
            return { items: [], active: 'Início' };
        }

        const items = [{ label: 'Início', id: null }];
        for (let i = 0; i < crumbs.length - 1; i++) {
            items.push({
                label: crumbs[i].name || crumbs[i].label,
                id: crumbs[i].id
            });
        }

        const active = crumbs[crumbs.length - 1].name || crumbs[crumbs.length - 1].label;
        return { items, active };
    });

    const handleBreadcrumbNavigate = (item) => {
        if (typeof closeConfigurators === 'function') {
            closeConfigurators();
        }

        if (!item || item.id === null) {
            handleCategorySelect(null);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof item === 'string') {
            const normalized = item.toLowerCase().trim();
            if (['início', 'inicio', 'home'].includes(normalized)) {
                handleCategorySelect(null);
                return;
            }

            const rawCategories = typeof initialCategories === 'function' ? initialCategories() : initialCategories;
            const foundCat = (rawCategories || []).find(
                c => (c.name || c.label || '').toLowerCase().trim() === normalized
            );
            handleCategorySelect(foundCat ? foundCat.id : null);
            return;
        }

        if (item.id !== undefined) {
            handleCategorySelect(item.id);
        }
    };

    return {
        catalogBreadcrumbs,
        handleBreadcrumbNavigate
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from "vue";

export function useCategoryManager(categoryTreeProp) {
    const isCategoryManagerActive = ref(false);
    const localCategories = ref(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(categoryTreeProp.value || [])));
    const historyStack = ref([]);
    const currentSnapshot = ref(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(categoryTreeProp.value || [])));

    // Sincroniza quando o servidor atualizar as categorias
    watch(categoryTreeProp, (newVal) => {
        const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(newVal || []));
        localCategories.value = cloned;
        currentSnapshot.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cloned));
        historyStack.value = [];
    }, { deep: true });

    const autoSaveCategories = () => {
        router.post(route('settings.reorder'), { preserveState: true,  type: 'categories', items: localCategories.value }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
        });
    };

    const handleCategorySave = () => {
        historyStack.value.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentSnapshot.value)));
        if (historyStack.value.length > 25) {
            historyStack.value.shift();
        }
        currentSnapshot.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(localCategories.value));
        autoSaveCategories();
    };

    const undoCategoryChange = () => {
        if (historyStack.value.length === 0) return;
        const previousState = historyStack.value.pop();
        localCategories.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(previousState));
        currentSnapshot.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(previousState));
        autoSaveCategories();
    };

    const handleKeyDownCtrlZ = (e) => {
        if (!isCategoryManagerActive.value) return;

        const isEditingText = ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(e.target.tagName) || e.target.isContentEditable;
        if (isEditingText) return;

        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'z') {
            e.preventDefault();
            undoCategoryChange();
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDownCtrlZ);
    });

    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDownCtrlZ);
    });

    return {
        isCategoryManagerActive,
        localCategories,
        historyStack,
        handleCategorySave,
        undoCategoryChange
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed, ref, unref, watch } from "vue";

/**
 * Resolve o divisor de partes (denominador) ideal com base no histórico de pagamentos fracionados.
 */
export function resolvePartsPerUnit(paidQty, totalQty, existingParts = 1) {
    const paid = Number(paidQty) || 0;
    const qty = Number(totalQty) || 1;

    if (paid <= 0 || paid >= qty || (paid % 1 === 0)) {
        return (Number(existingParts) > 1) ? Number(existingParts) : 1;
    }

    if (existingParts && Number(existingParts) > 1) {
        const parts = Number(existingParts);
        const remPaid = Math.abs(Math.round(paid * parts) - (paid * parts));
        if (remPaid < 0.01) {
            return parts;
        }
    }

    // Busca o denominador comum que divide perfeitamente o pago e o restante (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12)
    const denominators = [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12];
    for (const d of denominators) {
        const remPaid = Math.abs(Math.round(paid * d) - (paid * d));
        const remRemaining = Math.abs(Math.round((qty - paid) * d) - ((qty - paid) * d));
        if (remPaid < 0.01 && remRemaining < 0.01) {
            return d;
        }
    }

    const fracRemaining = (qty - paid) % 1;
    if (fracRemaining > 0.001) {
        const d = Math.round(1 / fracRemaining);
        if (d >= 1 && d <= 20) return d;
    }

    const fracPaid = paid % 1;
    const dPaid = Math.round(1 / fracPaid);
    if (dPaid >= 1 && dPaid <= 20) return dPaid;

    return 1;
}

/**
 * Função utilitária pura de rateio proporcional de combos para o frontend.
 */
export function calculateComboProration(parent, children) {
    if (!parent || !children || children.length === 0) return {};

    const parentQty = Number(parent.quantity ?? parent.base_qty ?? 1);
    const parentUnitPrice = Number(parent.unit_price ?? parent.effective_unit_price ?? 0);
    const parentTotalPrice = Number(parent.total_price) || (parentQty * parentUnitPrice);

    let totalCatalogSum = 0;
    const itemsCatalog = [];

    children.forEach(child => {
        const cQty = Number(child.quantity ?? child.base_qty ?? 1);

        let standalonePrice = Number(
            child.catalog_price ||
            child.product?.dine_in_price ||
            child.product?.price ||
            child.unit_price ||
            0
        );

        if (child.modifiers && Array.isArray(child.modifiers)) {
            const modsSum = child.modifiers.reduce((mSum, m) => mSum + (Number(m.price || 0) * Number(m.qty || m.quantity || 1)), 0);
            standalonePrice += (modsSum / cQty);
        }

        const childCatalogTotal = cQty * (standalonePrice > 0 ? standalonePrice : 10);
        totalCatalogSum += childCatalogTotal;

        itemsCatalog.push({
            id: child.id,
            qty: cQty,
            unitCatalog: standalonePrice > 0 ? standalonePrice : 10,
            totalCatalog: childCatalogTotal
        });
    });

    const prorationMap = {};

    if (totalCatalogSum > 0.001) {
        const factor = parentTotalPrice / totalCatalogSum;
        itemsCatalog.forEach(item => {
            const proratedUnit = Math.round((item.unitCatalog * factor) * 100) / 100;
            prorationMap[item.id] = {
                catalogUnitPrice: item.unitCatalog,
                proratedUnitPrice: proratedUnit,
                proratedTotal: Math.round((proratedUnit * item.qty) * 100) / 100
            };
        });
    } else {
        const totalQty = children.reduce((sum, c) => sum + Number(c.quantity ?? c.base_qty ?? 1), 0);
        const equalShare = totalQty > 0 ? Math.round((parentTotalPrice / totalQty) * 100) / 100 : 0;
        children.forEach(c => {
            prorationMap[c.id] = {
                catalogUnitPrice: 0,
                proratedUnitPrice: equalShare,
                proratedTotal: equalShare * Number(c.quantity ?? c.base_qty ?? 1)
            };
        });
    }

    return prorationMap;
}

export function useCheckoutMath(initialItemsRef, isGroupedRef, orderType = ref('table'), customSettings = null) {
    const reactiveItems = ref([]);

    const getRawItems = () => {
        const val = unref(initialItemsRef);
        return Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    };

    const initializeItems = (items, existingList = []) => {
        const rawItems = items || [];
        const parents = rawItems.filter(i => !i.parent_item_id);
        const children = rawItems.filter(i => !!i.parent_item_id);

        const mapped = [];

        parents.forEach(parent => {
            const existingParent = existingList.find(e => e.id === parent.id);

            const parentQty = Number(parent.quantity) || 1;
            const parentPaid = Number(parent.paid_qty) || 0;
            const parentUnitPrice = Number(parent.unit_price) || 0;

            const comboChildren = children.filter(c => String(c.parent_item_id) === String(parent.id));
            const isCombo = comboChildren.length > 0;

            // 🚀 Resolução precisa de partes fracionadas
            const parentParts = resolvePartsPerUnit(parentPaid, parentQty, existingParent?.parts_per_unit);

            const parentAvailableParts = Math.max(0, Math.round((parentQty - parentPaid) * parentParts));
            let parentSelected = parentAvailableParts;

            if (existingParent && existingParent.selected_parts !== undefined) {
                parentSelected = Math.min(existingParent.selected_parts, parentAvailableParts);
            } else if (parentParts > 1) {
                parentSelected = Math.min(1, parentAvailableParts);
            }

            mapped.push({
                ...existingParent,
                ...parent,
                unique_id: `grp_${parent.id}`,
                is_combo_parent: isCombo,
                has_exploded_children: isCombo,
                base_qty: parentQty,
                base_paid: parentPaid,
                parts_per_unit: parentParts,
                paid_parts: Math.round(parentPaid * parentParts),
                available_parts: parentAvailableParts,
                selected_parts: parentSelected,
                effective_unit_price: parentUnitPrice,
            });

            if (isCombo) {
                const prorationMap = calculateComboProration(parent, comboChildren);

                comboChildren.forEach(child => {
                    const existingChild = existingList.find(e => e.id === child.id);

                    const cQty = Number(child.quantity) || 1;
                    const cPaid = Number(child.paid_qty) || 0;
                    const proration = prorationMap[child.id] || {};

                    const allocatedPrice = Number(child.allocated_unit_price || child.prorated_unit_price || proration.proratedUnitPrice || 0);
                    const catalogPrice = Number(child.catalog_price || proration.catalogUnitPrice || allocatedPrice);

                    const cParts = resolvePartsPerUnit(cPaid, cQty, existingChild?.parts_per_unit);

                    const cAvailableParts = Math.max(0, Math.round((cQty - cPaid) * cParts));
                    let cSelected = 0;

                    if (existingChild && existingChild.selected_parts !== undefined) {
                        cSelected = Math.min(existingChild.selected_parts, cAvailableParts);
                    }

                    mapped.push({
                        ...existingChild,
                        ...child,
                        unique_id: `grp_${child.id}`,
                        is_combo_child: true,
                        combo_parent_id: parent.id,
                        combo_parent_name: parent.product_name || parent.name,
                        base_qty: cQty,
                        base_paid: cPaid,
                        parts_per_unit: cParts,
                        paid_parts: Math.round(cPaid * cParts),
                        available_parts: cAvailableParts,
                        selected_parts: cSelected,
                        catalog_price: catalogPrice,
                        effective_unit_price: allocatedPrice,
                    });
                });
            }
        });

        return mapped;
    };

    reactiveItems.value = initializeItems(getRawItems());

    watch(() => getRawItems(), (newItems) => {
        reactiveItems.value = initializeItems(newItems, reactiveItems.value);
    }, { deep: true });

    const activeParents = computed(() =>
        reactiveItems.value.filter(
            (i) => !i.parent_item_id && i.available_parts > 0,
        ),
    );

    const isAllSelected = computed(() => {
        if (activeParents.value.length === 0) return false;
        return activeParents.value.every((i) => i.selected_parts > 0);
    });

    const toggleAllSelections = () => {
        const allParentsSelected = activeParents.value.every(i => i.selected_parts > 0);
        const newState = !allParentsSelected;

        reactiveItems.value.forEach((item) => {
            if (!item.parent_item_id) {
                item.selected_parts = newState ? item.available_parts : 0;
            } else {
                item.selected_parts = 0;
            }
        });
        reactiveItems.value = [...reactiveItems.value];
    };

    const displayItems = computed(() => {
        return reactiveItems.value;
    });

    const handleDivideItem = (itemOrDivisor, maybeDivisor) => {
        let item = itemOrDivisor;
        let divisor = maybeDivisor;

        if (typeof itemOrDivisor === 'number' || typeof itemOrDivisor === 'string') {
            if (maybeDivisor && typeof maybeDivisor === 'object') {
                item = maybeDivisor;
                divisor = itemOrDivisor;
            }
        }

        const rawDivisor = parseInt(divisor) || 1;
        const newDivisor = rawDivisor < 1 ? 1 : rawDivisor;

        const targetId = item?.id || item?._parent_ref?.id;
        const target = reactiveItems.value.find(r => String(r.id) === String(targetId)) || item;

        if (!target) return;

        target.parts_per_unit = newDivisor;

        const baseQty = Number(target.base_qty ?? target.quantity ?? 1);
        const basePaid = Number(target.base_paid ?? target.paid_qty ?? 0);

        target.paid_parts = Math.round(basePaid * newDivisor);
        target.available_parts = Math.max(0, Math.round((baseQty - basePaid) * newDivisor));

        if (newDivisor > 1) {
            target.selected_parts = Math.min(1, target.available_parts);
        } else {
            target.selected_parts = target.available_parts;
        }

        if (target.is_combo_child) {
            const parent = reactiveItems.value.find(r => String(r.id) === String(target.combo_parent_id));
            if (parent) parent.selected_parts = 0;
        }

        reactiveItems.value = [...reactiveItems.value];
    };

    const handleToggleSelect = (item) => {
        const targetId = item.id;
        const target = reactiveItems.value.find(r => String(r.id) === String(targetId)) || item;

        if (target.selected_parts > 0) {
            target.selected_parts = 0;
        } else {
            target.selected_parts = target.available_parts;

            if (target.is_combo_child) {
                const parent = reactiveItems.value.find(r => String(r.id) === String(target.combo_parent_id));
                if (parent) parent.selected_parts = 0;
            } else if (target.is_combo_parent) {
                reactiveItems.value.filter(c => String(c.combo_parent_id) === String(target.id)).forEach(c => {
                    c.selected_parts = 0;
                });
            }
        }
        reactiveItems.value = [...reactiveItems.value];
    };

    const increment = (item) => {
        const targetId = item.id;
        const target = reactiveItems.value.find(r => String(r.id) === String(targetId)) || item;

        if (target.selected_parts < target.available_parts) {
            target.selected_parts++;
            if (target.is_combo_child) {
                const parent = reactiveItems.value.find(r => String(r.id) === String(target.combo_parent_id));
                if (parent) parent.selected_parts = 0;
            }
            reactiveItems.value = [...reactiveItems.value];
        }
    };

    const decrement = (item) => {
        const targetId = item.id;
        const target = reactiveItems.value.find(r => String(r.id) === String(targetId)) || item;

        if (target.selected_parts > 0) {
            target.selected_parts--;

        }
    };

    const selectedSubtotal = computed(() => {
        return reactiveItems.value.reduce((sum, item) => {
            if (item.selected_parts <= 0 || !item.parts_per_unit) return sum;

    });

    const orderTotalItemsValue = computed(() => {
        return reactiveItems.value

    });

    const calculateServiceFee = (type, settings) => {
        if (!settings || !settings.has_service_tax) return 0;

        let enabled = false;
        if (type === 'table') enabled = settings.service_tax_table !== false && settings.service_tax_table !== 0;
        else if (type === 'counter' || type === 'takeaway' || type === 'pickup') enabled = Boolean(settings.service_tax_counter);
        else if (type === 'delivery') enabled = Boolean(settings.service_tax_delivery);

        if (!enabled) return 0;

        const rate = Number(settings.service_tax_percentage || 0);
        return Math.round((selectedSubtotal.value * (rate / 100)) * 100) / 100;
    };

    return {
        reactiveItems,
        isAllSelected,
        displayItems,
        selectedSubtotal,
        orderTotalItemsValue,
        calculateServiceFee,
        toggleAllSelections,
        handleDivideItem,
        handleToggleSelect,
        increment,
        decrement,
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export function useCheckoutStaging(intendedPaymentTotal) {
    const stagedPayments = ref([]);

    // 🚀 ESTADO DO DIVISOR (LIGA / DESLIGA)
    const activeDivisor = ref(null);
    const divisionBaseAmount = ref(0);

    const currentStagedTotal = computed(() => {
        return stagedPayments.value.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.amount, 0);
    });

    const pendingToStage = computed(() => {
        const remaining = intendedPaymentTotal.value - currentStagedTotal.value;
        return remaining > 0 ? remaining : 0;
    });

    const changeAmount = computed(() => {
        const diff = currentStagedTotal.value - intendedPaymentTotal.value;
        return diff > 0 ? diff : 0;
    });

    // Calcula o valor teórico de cada fatia com base no saldo quando a divisão foi ligada
    const splitSliceAmount = computed(() => {
        if (!activeDivisor.value || activeDivisor.value <= 1 || divisionBaseAmount.value <= 0) {
            return null;
        }
        return parseFloat((divisionBaseAmount.value / activeDivisor.value).toFixed(2));
    });

    // 🚀 Próximo valor sugerido para o input
    const suggestedAmount = computed(() => {
        const remaining = pendingToStage.value;
        if (remaining <= 0) return 0;

        if (!activeDivisor.value || !splitSliceAmount.value) {
            return parseFloat(remaining.toFixed(2));
        }

        const slice = splitSliceAmount.value;

        // Se a fatia restante for menor ou igual à fatia (proteção de centavos de arredondamento)
        if (remaining <= slice + 0.05) {
            return parseFloat(remaining.toFixed(2));
        }

        return slice;
    });

    // 🚀 TOGGLE LIGA / DESLIGA DA DIVISÃO
    const divideBy = (divisor) => {
        if (activeDivisor.value === divisor) {
            // Se já estava ativo no mesmo número, DESLIGA
            clearDivisor();
        } else {
            // LIGA a divisão
            activeDivisor.value = divisor;
            divisionBaseAmount.value = pendingToStage.value > 0 ? pendingToStage.value : intendedPaymentTotal.value;
        }
    };

    const clearDivisor = () => {
        activeDivisor.value = null;
        divisionBaseAmount.value = 0;
    };

    const addPayment = (method, toast) => {
        const remainingAmount = pendingToStage.value;

        if (remainingAmount <= 0) {
            toast?.add({
                severity: "warn",
                summary: "Conta Paga",
                detail: "A conta já está totalmente paga.",
                life: 3000,
            });
            return;
        }

        if (method.engine_type === "internal_loyalty") {
            const hasLoyalty = stagedPayments.value.some((p) => p.engine_type === "internal_loyalty");
            if (hasLoyalty) {
                toast?.add({
                    severity: "warn",
                    summary: "Resgate Único",
                    detail: "Só é possível usar o saldo de Cashback uma vez por venda.",
                    life: 3000,
                });
                return;
            }
        }

        const resolvedId = method.method_id || method.id;
        const amountToAdd = method.amount
            ? parseFloat(Number(method.amount).toFixed(2))
            : parseFloat((suggestedAmount.value || remainingAmount).toFixed(2));

        stagedPayments.value.push({
            id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
            real_method_id: resolvedId,
            method_name: method.method_name || method.name,
            name: method.method_name || method.name,
            engine_type: method.engine_type,
            amount: amountToAdd,
            change_target: method.change_target || null
        });

        // Se a conta for zerada, desliga a divisão automaticamente
        if (pendingToStage.value <= 0.01) {
            clearDivisor();
        }
    };

    const removePayment = (index) => {
        stagedPayments.value.splice(index, 1);
        if (stagedPayments.value.length === 0 && activeDivisor.value) {
            divisionBaseAmount.value = intendedPaymentTotal.value;
        }
    };

    const setAmountToRemaining = (index) => {
        clearDivisor();
        const payment = stagedPayments.value[index];
        if (!payment) return;

        const otherPaymentsTotal = currentStagedTotal.value - payment.amount;
        let newAmount = intendedPaymentTotal.value - otherPaymentsTotal;
        if (newAmount < 0) newAmount = 0;

        stagedPayments.value[index].amount = parseFloat(newAmount.toFixed(2));
    };

    const autoStagePayments = (order, paymentMethods) => {
        if (!order || stagedPayments.value.length > 0) return;

        let deliveryMethods = order.payment_intent_methods;
        if (typeof deliveryMethods === 'string') {
            try {
                deliveryMethods = JSON.parse(deliveryMethods);
            } catch (e) {
                deliveryMethods = null;
            }
        }

        if (!Array.isArray(deliveryMethods) || deliveryMethods.length === 0) return;

        const shouldAdjustSingle = deliveryMethods.length === 1;

        deliveryMethods.forEach((dm) => {
            const rawName = String(dm.method_name || dm.name || dm.method || dm.method_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();

            const matched = (paymentMethods || []).find(pm => {
                if (dm.method_id && !isNaN(Number(dm.method_id)) && Number(pm.id) === Number(dm.method_id)) return true;
                const pmName = String(pm.name).trim().toLowerCase();
                if (pmName === rawName) return true;
                if ((rawName.includes('débito') || rawName.includes('debito')) && (pmName.includes('débito') || pmName.includes('debito'))) return true;
                if ((rawName.includes('crédito') || rawName.includes('credito')) && (pmName.includes('crédito') || pmName.includes('credito'))) return true;
                if ((rawName.includes('dinheiro') || rawName.includes('cash')) && (pm.engine_type === 'money' || pmName.includes('dinheiro'))) return true;
                if (rawName.includes('pix') && (pm.engine_type === 'pix' || pm.engine_type === 'bank_api' || pmName.includes('pix'))) return true;
                return false;
            });

            const methodId = matched?.id || (isNaN(Number(dm.method_id)) ? paymentMethods?.[0]?.id : Number(dm.method_id));
            const methodName = matched?.name || dm.method_name || dm.name || 'Pagamento';
            const engineType = matched?.engine_type || (dm.is_cash ? 'money' : 'card');

            let val = Number(dm.amount) || 0;
            if (shouldAdjustSingle && intendedPaymentTotal.value > 0) {
                val = intendedPaymentTotal.value;
            } else if (val <= 0) {
                val = intendedPaymentTotal.value;
            }

            stagedPayments.value.push({
                id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                real_method_id: methodId,
                method_name: methodName,
                name: methodName,
                engine_type: engineType,
                amount: parseFloat(val.toFixed(2)),
                change_target: dm.change_target ? Number(dm.change_target) : null
            });
        });
    };

    return {
        stagedPayments,
        currentStagedTotal,
        pendingToStage,
        suggestedAmount,
        activeDivisor,
        changeAmount,
        addPayment,
        removePayment,
        divideBy,
        clearDivisor,
        setAmountToRemaining,
        autoStagePayments
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";

export function useComboWizard(props, emit) {
    const currentStepIndex = ref(0);
    const selections = ref({});
    const activeInstanceId = ref(null);

    // 🚀 RASCUNHO PENDENTE: Segura o item selecionado até a confirmação explícita dos modificadores
    const pendingDraftItem = ref(null);

    const showInnerModifiers = ref(false);

    const canAddMore = computed(() => currentGroup.value && currentSelections.value.length < currentGroup.value.max_choices);

            newVal.combo_groups.forEach((g) => { selections.value[g.id] = []; });
        }

        if (newVal?.cartItem?.comboItems) {
            newVal.cartItem.comboItems.forEach(cItem => {
                let targetGroup = newVal.combo_groups.find(g => g.items.some(i => i.product_id === cItem.product_id));
                if (targetGroup) {
                    const originalItem = targetGroup.items.find(i => i.product_id === cItem.product_id);
                    if (originalItem) {
                        const extra = (cItem.structuredModifiers || []).reduce((sum, m) => sum + (Number(m.price) * Number(m.qty || 1)), 0);
                        selections.value[targetGroup.id].push({
                            instanceId: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                            item: originalItem,
                            modifiersText: cItem.modifiersText || "",
                            extraPrice: extra,
                            groupId: Number(targetGroup.id),
                            structuredModifiers: cItem.structuredModifiers || [],
                            qty: 1
                        });
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }, { immediate: true });

    const comboHelpers = {
        hasModifiers: (comboItem) => {
            if (!comboItem) return false;
            const prodId = comboItem.product_id || comboItem.id;
            const fullProd = (props.globalProductsList || []).find((p) => p.id === prodId) || comboItem;
            const groups = fullProd.modifier_groups || fullProd.modifierGroups || fullProd.modifiers || [];
            return Array.isArray(groups) && groups.length > 0;
        }
    };

    // 🛡️ VALIDADOR: Verifica se um subitem cumpriu todos os grupos de modificadores obrigatórios
    const isSelectionValid = (sel) => {
        if (!sel || !sel.item) return false;
        const prodId = sel.item.product_id || sel.item.id;
        const fullProd = (props.globalProductsList || []).find((p) => p.id === prodId) || sel.item;
        const groups = fullProd.modifier_groups || fullProd.modifierGroups || fullProd.modifiers || [];

        for (const group of groups) {
            const min = Number(group.min_choices ?? group.min_quantity ?? (group.is_required ? 1 : 0));
            if (min > 0) {
                const selectedInGroup = (sel.structuredModifiers || []).filter(m =>
                    String(m.group_id || m.modifier_group_id) === String(group.id)
                );
                const totalQty = selectedInGroup.reduce((sum, m) => sum + Number(m.qty || 1), 0);

    const getSelectionsCountForGroup = (groupId) => {

        let maxAllowed = 1;

        if (groupDef) {
            const currentCount = (selections.value[groupId] || []).length;
            maxAllowed = Math.max(1, (Number(groupDef.max_choices) - currentCount));
        }

        modifyingProduct.value = {
            ...fullProdInfo,
            cartItem: {
                qty: 1,
                structuredModifiers: [],
                maxQty: maxAllowed

        const groupDef = props.product?.combo_groups?.find(g => Number(g.id) === Number(selectionInstance.groupId));

        }

            cartItem: {

            const maxChoices = Number(groupDef?.max_choices || 1);

                extraPrice: Number(modifiersData.extraPrice || 0),

                for (let i = 0; i < clonesToCreate; i++) {

    watch(showInnerModifiers, (isShowing) => {

                isAdding.value = false;
                isAddSuccess.value = true;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    let structuredComboItems = [];
                    Object.keys(selections.value).forEach((groupId) => {
                        selections.value[groupId].forEach((sel) => {
                            structuredComboItems.push({
                                product_id: sel.item.product_id || sel.item.id,
                                name: sel.item.product_name || sel.item.name,
                                group_id: Number(groupId),
                                modifiersText: sel.modifiersText,
                                structuredModifiers: sel.structuredModifiers || [],
                                qty: Number(sel.qty || 1),
                                price: Number(sel.item.additional_price || sel.item.price || 0)

                    emit("confirm-combo", {
                        structuredItems: structuredComboItems,
                        extraPrice: wizardTotal.value - Number(props.product.price)

    const handleClearCombo = () => {
        currentStepIndex.value = 0;
        showMobileSummary.value = false;
        pendingDraftItem.value = null;
        if (props.product?.combo_groups) {
```

## File: resources/js/Pages/Shared/Composables/useControlPanel.js
```javascript
import { useWhatsAppMessages } from "@/Composables/useWhatsAppMessages";
import { router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from "vue";

export function useControlPanel(initialOrders) {
    const activeTab = ref("active");
    const searchQuery = ref("");
    const { notifyDeliveryOut, notifyPickupReady } = useWhatsAppMessages();

    const focusedOrderId = ref(null);

    const focusedOrder = computed(() => {
        if (!focusedOrderId.value || !initialOrders.value) return null;
        return initialOrders.value.find(o => o.id == focusedOrderId.value) || null;
    });

    // 🚀 SINCRONIZAÇÃO NATIVA COM A HISTORY API (?open_order=123)
    watch(focusedOrderId, (newId) => {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        if (newId) {
            if (url.searchParams.get('open_order') !== String(newId)) {
                url.searchParams.set('open_order', newId);
                window.history.pushState({ open_order: newId }, '', url.toString());
            }
        } else {
            if (url.searchParams.has('open_order')) {
                url.searchParams.delete('open_order');
                window.history.pushState({}, '', url.toString());
            }
        }
    });

    const handlePopState = () => {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const orderIdFromUrl = urlParams.get('open_order');
        focusedOrderId.value = orderIdFromUrl ? Number(orderIdFromUrl) : null;
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        window.addEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const initialOpenId = urlParams.get('open_order');
        if (initialOpenId) {
            focusedOrderId.value = Number(initialOpenId);
        }
    });

    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        window.removeEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
    });

    const contextMenuVisible = ref(false);
    const selectedOrderContext = ref(null);
    const orderToModify = ref(null);
    const isTransformerVisible = ref(false);
    const isPaymentModalVisible = ref(false);
    const orderToUpdatePayment = ref(null);
    const isChangeAddressModalVisible = ref(false);
    const orderToUpdateAddress = ref(null);
    const isTransferModalVisible = ref(false);
    const transferSourceOrder = ref(null);
    const transferItemIds = ref([]);
    const highlightedOrderId = ref(null);

    const orderMatchesSearch = (order, queryStr, queryNum) => {
        if (!queryStr) return true;

        const searchableValues = [
            String(order.id || ''),
            order.daily_code,
            order.customer_name,
            order.identifier,
            order.phone,
            order.customer?.phone,
            order.customer?.cpf,
            String(order.table_number || ''),
            order.address,
            order.neighborhood,
            order.delivery_neighborhood,
            order.routing?.address?.neighborhood,
            order.meta?.address?.neighborhood
        ];

        const searchString = searchableValues
            .filter(val => val !== null && val !== undefined && val !== '')
            .join(' ')
            .toLowerCase();

        if (queryNum && searchString.replace(/\D/g, '').includes(queryNum)) {
            return true;
        }

        return searchString.includes(queryStr);
    };

    const activeOrders = computed(() => {
        if (!initialOrders.value) return [];
        const queryStr = (searchQuery.value || "").toLowerCase().replace(/^#\s*/, '').trim();
        const queryNum = queryStr.replace(/\D/g, '');

        return initialOrders.value.filter((o) => {
            const isActive = !["closed", "cancelled", "completed", "delivered"].includes(o.status);
            return isActive && orderMatchesSearch(o, queryStr, queryNum);
        });
    });

    const onSiteOrders = computed(() => {
        const filtered = activeOrders.value.filter((o) => o.type === "table");
        return filtered.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
    });

    // 🚀 Suporta delivery, counter, pickup, takeaway e qualquer comanda que não seja mesa física
    const deliveryOrders = computed(() => {
        const filtered = activeOrders.value.filter((o) => o.type !== "table");
        return filtered.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
    });

    const historyOrders = computed(() => {
        if (!initialOrders.value) return [];
        const queryStr = (searchQuery.value || "").toLowerCase().replace(/^#\s*/, '').trim();
        const queryNum = queryStr.replace(/\D/g, '');

        return initialOrders.value
            .filter((o) => {
                const isClosedOrCancelled = ["closed", "cancelled", "completed", "delivered"].includes(o.status);
                return isClosedOrCancelled && orderMatchesSearch(o, queryStr, queryNum);
            })
            .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at));
    });

    const openContextMenu = (order) => {
        if (order?.id) {
            focusedOrderId.value = order.id;
        }
    };

    const handleMenuAction = (action, order) => {
        contextMenuVisible.value = false;
        switch (action) {
            case "checkout":
                router.visit(route('operations.checkout', order.id));
                break;
            case "add_items": {
                const currentPath = window.location.pathname.replace('/orders', '/pos');
                window.history.replaceState({}, '', `${currentPath}?append_to_order=${order.id}`);
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-append-to-order', { detail: order }));
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'pos' }));
                break;
            }
            case "transform_order":
                orderToModify.value = order;
                isTransformerVisible.value = true;
                break;
            case "delivery_payment":
                orderToUpdatePayment.value = order;
                isPaymentModalVisible.value = true;
                break;
            case "change_address":
                orderToUpdateAddress.value = order;
                isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = true;
                break;
            case "print_partial":
                alert(`Enviando impressão de conferência do pedido #${order.id}...`);
                break;
        }
    };

    const handleChangeAddressConfirm = (payload) => {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.change-address', payload.order_id), {
            address_id: payload.new_address_id,
            address: payload.new_address,
            delivery_fee: payload.new_delivery_fee
        }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => { isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = false; },
            onError: () => alert("Erro ao atualizar o endereço do pedido.")
        });
    };

    const handleAdvanceStatus = (order, newStatus) => {
        const isPaid = order.payment_status === 'paid' || order.payment_intent_status === 'paid';

        if (
            order.type === 'delivery' &&
            (newStatus === 'ready' || newStatus === 'dispatched') &&
            !isPaid &&
            order.payment_intent_status === 'pending_choice'
        ) {
            alert("Atenção: Este pedido está configurado como 'Decidir Depois'. Defina a forma de pagamento primeiro.");
            focusedOrderId.value = order.id;
            return;
        }

        if (order.type === 'counter' && order.status === 'ready' && newStatus === 'dispatched') {
            if (order.payment_status === 'paid') {
                handleAdvanceStatus(order, 'closed');
                return;
            }
            if (confirm("Pedidos de Balcão não possuem entrega. Deseja abrir a tela de recebimento para liquidar a conta?")) {
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-open-checkout', { detail: { orderId: order.id } }));
            }
            return;
        }

        if (newStatus === 'closed') {
            if (order.payment_status !== 'paid') {
                if (confirm(`O Pedido #${order.id} ainda não foi pago. Deseja abrir a tela de recebimento para liquidar a conta?`)) {
                    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-open-checkout', { detail: { orderId: order.id } }));
                }
                return;
            }

            if (!confirm(`Confirmar a entrega e finalizar o Pedido #${order.id}?`)) {
                return;
            }
        }

        let payload = { status: newStatus };
        if (order.status === 'pending' && (newStatus === 'ready' || newStatus === 'dispatched')) {
            payload.stamp_intermediates = true;
        }

        router.post(route('operations.orders.update-status', order.id), payload, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                if (order.type === 'delivery' && newStatus === 'ready') {
                    if (confirm("Pedido pronto! Enviar ticket de despacho para o Motoboy?")) {
                        router.post(route('operations.orders.print-delivery', order.id), {}, { preserveScroll: true, preserveState: true });
                    }
                }

                if (order.type === 'delivery' && newStatus === 'dispatched') {
                    if (confirm("Pedido em rota! Enviar mensagem no WhatsApp do cliente?")) {
                        notifyDeliveryOut(order);
                    }
                }

                if (order.type === 'counter' && newStatus === 'ready') {
                    const phone = order.customer?.phone || order.customer_phone || null;
                    if (phone && phone.replace(/\D/g, '').length >= 10) {
                        if (confirm("Pedido de balcão pronto! Notificar cliente no WhatsApp?")) {
                            notifyPickupReady(order);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    };

    const handleUpdatePayment = (intentData) => {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.update-delivery-payment', orderToUpdatePayment.value.id), intentData, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => { isPaymentModalVisible.value = false; },
            onError: () => alert("Erro ao atualizar o pagamento."),
        });
    };

    const handleTransferTrigger = (data) => {
        transferSourceOrder.value = data.order;
        transferItemIds.value = data.itemIds;
        isTransferModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const handleExecuteTransfer = (transferPayload) => {
        router.post(route('operations.transfer-items'), transferPayload, {
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => { isTransferModalVisible.value = false; }
        });
    };

    const handleTransformation = (payload) => {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.transform', payload.order.id), payload, {
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => { isTransformerVisible.value = false; },
        });
    };

    return {
        activeTab,
        searchQuery,
        contextMenuVisible,
        selectedOrderContext,
        orderToModify,
        isTransformerVisible,
        isPaymentModalVisible,
        orderToUpdatePayment,
        isChangeAddressModalVisible,
        orderToUpdateAddress,
        isTransferModalVisible,
        transferSourceOrder,
        transferItemIds,
        highlightedOrderId,
        activeOrders,
        onSiteOrders,
        deliveryOrders,
        historyOrders,
        openContextMenu,
        handleMenuAction,
        handleChangeAddressConfirm,
        handleAdvanceStatus,
        handleUpdatePayment,
        handleTransferTrigger,
        handleExecuteTransfer,
        handleTransformation,
        focusedOrderId,
        focusedOrder
    };
}
```

```javascript
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

// Estado global compartilhado em toda a aplicação
const wallet = ref([]);
const activeCoupon = ref(null);
const isLoadingWallet = ref(false);
const isApplyingCoupon = ref(false);

export function useCoupons() {
    const toast = useToast();

    // Nome legível do cupom ativo
    const appliedCouponName = computed(() => {
        if (!activeCoupon.value) return null;
        return activeCoupon.value.code || activeCoupon.value.name || null;
    });

    // 🚀 O MOTOR DE CÁLCULO CENTRALIZADO (Espelha o backend CouponService.php)
    const calculateDiscount = (subtotal = 0, deliveryFee = 0, serviceFee = 0) => {
        if (!activeCoupon.value) return 0;

        const type = activeCoupon.value.type;
        const val = Number(activeCoupon.value.value || 0);
        const sub = Number(subtotal || 0);
        const delivery = Number(deliveryFee || 0);
        const service = Number(serviceFee || 0);

        if (type === 'percent') {
            return Math.round(((sub * val) / 100) * 100) / 100;
        }

        if (type === 'fixed') {
            return Math.min(val, sub);
        }

        if (type === 'free_delivery') {
            return delivery;
        }

        // Tipo exclusivo do teste PIX / valor fixo cravado
        if (type === 'fixed_total') {
            const totalBruto = sub + delivery + service;
            const diff = totalBruto - val;
            return diff > 0 ? diff : 0;
        }

        return 0;
    };

    // Busca a carteira de cupons do cliente
    const fetchWallet = async () => {
        if (isLoadingWallet.value) return;
        isLoadingWallet.value = true;

        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route('customer.coupons.wallet'));
            wallet.value = response.data.coupons || [];
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Erro ao buscar carteira de cupons:', error);
            wallet.value = [];
        } finally {
            isLoadingWallet.value = false;
        }
    };

    // Valida e aplica o cupom
    const applyCoupon = async (code, subtotal) => {
        if (!code || isApplyingCoupon.value) return false;
        isApplyingCoupon.value = true;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route('customer.coupons.validate'), {
                code: code,
                subtotal: subtotal,
                is_pos: true // 🚀 Permite cupons exclusivos do caixa
            });

            activeCoupon.value = response.data;
            toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Oba!', detail: response.data.message, life: 3000 });
            return true;

        } catch (error) {
            activeCoupon.value = null;
            const msg = error.response?.data?.message || 'Código inválido ou expirado.';

            const requiresAuth = error.response?.status === 401 || error.response?.status === 403 || msg.toLowerCase().includes('login');

            if (requiresAuth) {
                toast.add({
                    severity: 'warn',
                    summary: 'Benefício Exclusivo',
                    detail: 'Crie uma conta rapidinho (ou faça login) para garantir este desconto!',
                    life: 6000
                });

                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-customer-auth-modal'));
            } else {
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Ops...', detail: msg, life: 4000 });
            }

            return false;
        } finally {
            isApplyingCoupon.value = false;
        }
    };

    // Remove o cupom ativo
    const removeCoupon = () => {
        activeCoupon.value = null;
    };

    return {
        wallet,
        activeCoupon,
        appliedCouponName,
        isLoadingWallet,
        isApplyingCoupon,
        fetchWallet,
        applyCoupon,
        removeCoupon,
        calculateDiscount // 🚀 Exportado para qualquer componente
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';

// 🚀 SINGLETON GLOBAL: Permite que um configurador aninhado dite o formato exato da ilha
export const dynamicIslandTypeOverride = ref(null);

export function useDynamicIsland(props, emit) {
    const islandRef = ref(null);
    const contentRef = ref(null);
    const islandWidth = ref(null);
    const islandHeight = ref(null);

    let resizeObserver = null;
    let isUpdating = false;

    // Identidade visual idêntica para todas as telas (blur e cor de superfície unificados)
    const baseIslandClass = "fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-[70] backdrop-blur-md bg-surface-1/40 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] select-none will-change-[width,height,border-radius]";

    // Formato da cápsula: rounded-3xl para 2 linhas e rounded-full para linha única
    const shapeIslandClass = computed(() => {
        const currentType = dynamicIslandTypeOverride.value || (props ? props.configuratorType : null);

        if (currentType === 'two-rows' || currentType === 'combo-expanded') {
            return 'rounded-3xl';
        }
        return 'rounded-full';
    });

    const updateDimensions = () => {
        if (isUpdating) return;
        const target = contentRef.value;
        if (!target) return;

        const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        const targetW = Math.ceil(rect.width);
        const targetH = Math.ceil(rect.height);

        const diffW = Math.abs(targetW - (islandWidth.value || 0));
        const diffH = Math.abs(targetH - (islandHeight.value || 0));

        if (targetW > 0 && targetH > 0 && (diffW >= 2 || diffH >= 2)) {
            isUpdating = true;
            islandWidth.value = targetW;
            islandHeight.value = targetH;

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                isUpdating = false;
            });
        }
    };

    const islandStyle = computed(() => {
        const baseStyle = {
            transform: 'translate3d(-50%, 0, 0)',
            transition: 'width 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), height 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-radius 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)'
        };

        if (!islandWidth.value || !islandHeight.value) {
            return {
                ...baseStyle,
                width: 'max-content',
                height: 'max-content'
            };
        }

        return {
            ...baseStyle,
            width: `${islandWidth.value}px`,
            height: `${islandHeight.value}px`
        };
    });

    const handleTabClick = (tab) => {
        if (props && 'orderContext' in props && props.orderContext) {
            emit('close-context');
        }
        if (props && tab === 'menu' && props.activeTab === 'menu') {
            emit('reset-menu');
        } else if (emit) {
            emit('update:activeTab', tab);
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        nextTick(() => {
            updateDimensions();
            if (contentRef.value && typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
                resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
                    updateDimensions();
                });
                resizeObserver.observe(contentRef.value);
            }
        });
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        if (resizeObserver) {
            resizeObserver.disconnect();
            resizeObserver = null;
        }
    });

    if (props) {
        watch(
            () => [props.activeTab, props.cartLength, props.configuratorType, props.orderContext, dynamicIslandTypeOverride.value],
            () => {
                nextTick(updateDimensions);
            },
            { deep: true }
        );
    }

    return {
        baseIslandClass,
        shapeIslandClass,
        islandStyle,
        islandRef,
        contentRef,
        handleTabClick
    };
}
```

```javascript
import axios from 'axios';
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';

// 🚀 ESTADO GLOBAL EM CACHE
const topCombinations = ref([]);
const isLoading = ref(true);
const hasFetched = ref(false);

export function useFavoriteCombinations() {
    const fetchTopCombinations = async (force = false) => {
        // Se já buscou nesta sessão, não busca de novo!
        if (hasFetched.value && !force) return;

        try {
            isLoading.value = true;
            const response = await axios.get(route('api.top-combinations'));
            topCombinations.value = response.data.data || [];
            hasFetched.value = true;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Falha ao carregar as combinações favoritas:', error);
            topCombinations.value = [];
        } finally {
            isLoading.value = false;
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        fetchTopCombinations();
    });

    return {
        topCombinations,
        isLoading,
        refresh: () => fetchTopCombinations(true)
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';

export function useItemActions(selectedOrderContext, contextMenuVisible, routeName = 'pos.index') {
    const toast = useToast();

    const getOrderId = (item) => {
        return selectedOrderContext?.value?.id || item?.order_id || item?.order?.id;
    };

    const handleItemDuplicate = (item) => {
        if (contextMenuVisible && 'value' in contextMenuVisible) {
            contextMenuVisible.value = false;
        }

        router.post(route('operations.quick-add', getOrderId(item)), {
            item_id: item.id,
            should_print: true
        }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Item Duplicado', detail: 'Nova comanda enviada para produção (+1).', life: 3000 });
            },
            onError: () => {
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Não foi possível duplicar o item.', life: 4000 });
            }
        });
    };

    const handleItemModify = (payload) => {
        if (contextMenuVisible && 'value' in contextMenuVisible) {
            contextMenuVisible.value = false;
        }

        const rawItem = payload.item || payload;
        const qty = payload.action_qty || rawItem?.action_qty || 'all';
        const originalQty = qty === 'all' ? rawItem.quantity : qty;

        const isSubItem = Boolean(rawItem.parent_item_id || rawItem.combo_parent_id);
        const resolvedParentId = rawItem.parent_item_id || rawItem.combo_parent_id || null;
        const isFullCombo = !isSubItem && Boolean(rawItem.has_exploded_children || rawItem.is_combo_item || rawItem.sub_items?.length);

        const targetUrl = route(routeName, {
            tab: routeName === 'team.app' ? 'menu' : 'pos',
            append_to_order: getOrderId(rawItem),
            edit_item: rawItem.id,
            parent_item_id: resolvedParentId || undefined,
            is_combo_child: isSubItem ? 'true' : undefined,
            is_combo: isFullCombo ? 'true' : undefined,
            edit_qty: qty,
            original_qty: originalQty,
            auth_reason: payload.authData?.reason || '',
            is_loss: payload.authData?.isLoss ? 'true' : 'false'
        });

        router.visit(targetUrl);
    };

    const handleItemSwap = (payload) => {
        if (contextMenuVisible && 'value' in contextMenuVisible) {
            contextMenuVisible.value = false;
        }

        const qty = payload.action_qty || payload.item?.action_qty || 'all';
        const originalQty = qty === 'all' ? payload.item.quantity : qty;

        const targetUrl = route(routeName, {
            tab: routeName === 'team.app' ? 'menu' : 'pos',
            append_to_order: getOrderId(payload.item),
            swap_item: payload.item.id,
            swap_qty: qty,
            original_qty: originalQty,
            auth_reason: payload.authData?.reason || '',
            is_loss: payload.authData?.isLoss ? 'true' : 'false'
        });

        router.visit(targetUrl);
    };

    const handleItemCancel = (payload) => {
        const itemToCancel = payload.item || payload;
        const orderId = getOrderId(itemToCancel);
        const actionQty = payload.action_qty || itemToCancel.action_qty || 'all';

        router.post(route('operations.orders.cancel-item', orderId), {
            item_id: itemToCancel.id,
            qty: actionQty,
            is_loss: payload.isLoss || false,
            reason: payload.reason || 'Cancelado pela Copa/Bar',
            pin: payload.password || payload.pin || null,
        }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Sucesso', detail: 'Item estornado!', life: 3000 }),
            onError: (e) => toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Acesso Negado', detail: e.pin || e.reason || 'Erro ao estornar.', life: 5000 }),
        });
    };

    return {
        handleItemDuplicate,
        handleItemModify,
        handleItemSwap,
        handleItemCancel
    };
}
```
