```javascript
import { computed, ref, unref, watch } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

export function useMenuNavigation(getCategories, getProducts, settings = {}) {
    const selectedCategory = ref(null);
    const searchQuery = ref('');

    // 🛡️ 1. Critério de produto disponível
    const isProductAvailable = (p) => {
        if (!p) return false;
        if (p.is_available === false || p.is_available === 0) return false;
        if (p.is_active === false || p.is_active === 0) return false;
        if (p.status === 'inactive' || p.status === 'disabled') return false;
        return true;
    };

    // 📦 2. Lista de produtos disponíveis no catálogo
    const availableProductsList = computed(() => {
        const productsList = typeof getProducts === 'function' ? getProducts() : unref(getProducts);
        if (!productsList || !Array.isArray(productsList)) return [];

        return productsList.filter(isProductAvailable);
    });

    // 🎯 3. Set com IDs das categorias que possuem produtos diretamente
    const directCategoryIdsWithProducts = computed(() => {
        const set = new Set();
        for (const p of availableProductsList.value) {
            if (p.category_id !== null && p.category_id !== undefined && p.category_id !== '' && p.category_id !== 0) {
                set.add(String(p.category_id));
            }
        }
        return set;
    });

    // 🌳 4. Mapa Pai -> Filhos para varredura em árvore
    const categoryTreeChildrenMap = computed(() => {
        const cats = typeof getCategories === 'function' ? getCategories() : unref(getCategories);
        if (!cats || !Array.isArray(cats)) return new Map();

        const map = new Map();
        for (const c of cats) {
            if (!c || c.id === null || c.id === undefined) continue;
            const pId = c.parent_id ? String(c.parent_id) : null;
            if (!map.has(pId)) {
                map.set(pId, []);
            }
            map.get(pId).push(String(c.id));
        }
        return map;
    });

    // 🔍 5. Função recursiva: Checa se a categoria OU algum descendente tem produtos
    const hasAvailableProducts = (categoryId, directIdsSet, childrenMap, visited = new Set()) => {
        const strId = String(categoryId);
        if (visited.has(strId)) return false;
        visited.add(strId);

        if (directIdsSet.has(strId)) return true;

        const children = childrenMap.get(strId) || [];
        for (const childId of children) {
            if (hasAvailableProducts(childId, directIdsSet, childrenMap, visited)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    };

    // 🚀 6. Categorias finais higienizadas (Apenas as que contêm produtos disponíveis)
    const availableCategories = computed(() => {
        const cats = typeof getCategories === 'function' ? getCategories() : unref(getCategories);
        if (!cats || !Array.isArray(cats)) return [];

        const directSet = directCategoryIdsWithProducts.value;
        const childrenMap = categoryTreeChildrenMap.value;

        return cats.filter(c => {
            if (!c || c.id === null || c.id === undefined || c.id === '' || c.id === 'all' || c.id === 0) {
                return false;
            }
            const nameLower = String(c.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            if (nameLower === 'todos os itens' || nameLower === 'todos') {
                return false;
            }

            return hasAvailableProducts(c.id, directSet, childrenMap);
        });
    });

    const rootCategories = computed(() => {
        return availableCategories.value.filter(c => !c.parent_id);
    });

    const childCategories = computed(() => {
        if (!selectedCategory.value) return [];
        return availableCategories.value.filter(c => String(c.parent_id) === String(selectedCategory.value));
    });

    const activeMenuCategory = computed(() => {
        if (!selectedCategory.value) return null;
        const cats = typeof getCategories === 'function' ? getCategories() : unref(getCategories);
        if (!cats || !Array.isArray(cats)) return null;
        return cats.find(c => String(c.id) === String(selectedCategory.value));
    });

    watch(availableCategories, (validCats) => {
        if (selectedCategory.value) {
            const stillValid = validCats.some(c => String(c.id) === String(selectedCategory.value));
            if (!stillValid) {
                selectedCategory.value = null;
            }
        }
    });

    const breadcrumbs = computed(() => {
        const cats = typeof getCategories === 'function' ? getCategories() : unref(getCategories);
        if (!cats || !Array.isArray(cats) || !selectedCategory.value) return [];

        const path = [];
        let currentId = String(selectedCategory.value);

        while (currentId) {
            const cat = cats.find(c => String(c.id) === currentId);
            if (!cat) break;
            path.unshift(cat);
            currentId = cat.parent_id ? String(cat.parent_id) : null;
        }
        return path;
    });

    const goBackCategory = () => {
        if (!selectedCategory.value) return;
        const currentCat = activeMenuCategory.value;
        if (currentCat && currentCat.parent_id) {
            selectedCategory.value = currentCat.parent_id;
        } else {
            selectedCategory.value = null;
        }
    };

    // 🚀 O QUE APARECE NO MENU DE CATEGORIAS (BARRA OU LATERAL)?
    const visibleMenuCategories = computed(() => {
        const cats = availableCategories.value;
        if (!cats || cats.length === 0) return [];

        // Se estiver pesquisando, oculta a barra para dar espaço total aos resultados
        if (searchQuery.value && searchQuery.value.trim() !== '') {
            return [];
        }

        if (settings.categoryHierarchy === 'flat') {
            return cats;
        }

        if (!selectedCategory.value) return rootCategories.value;
        if (childCategories.value.length > 0) return childCategories.value;

        const currentCat = activeMenuCategory.value;
        if (currentCat) {
            return cats.filter(c => String(c.parent_id) === String(currentCat.parent_id));
        }

        return rootCategories.value;
    });

    // 🚀 O QUE APARECE NO CATEGORY GRID CENTRAL?
    const visibleGridCategories = computed(() => {
        if (unref(settings.categoryLayout) !== 'grid' && unref(settings.categoryLayout) !== 'list') {
            return [];
        }
        if (searchQuery.value && searchQuery.value.trim() !== '') return [];

        if (!selectedCategory.value) {
            return rootCategories.value;
        }

        return childCategories.value;
    });

    const shouldShowCategoryGrid = computed(() => {
        return visibleGridCategories.value.length > 0 && !searchQuery.value;
    });

    // 🚀 QUAIS PRODUTOS APARECEM NO GRID? (Com busca sem distinção de acentos)
    const filteredProducts = computed(() => {
        const list = availableProductsList.value;
        if (!list || list.length === 0) return [];

        // 1. Busca por termo: ignora pastas e pesquisa em todo o catálogo
        if (searchQuery.value && searchQuery.value.trim() !== '') {
            const cleanStr = (s) => String(s || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();
            const query = cleanStr(searchQuery.value);

            return list.filter(p => {
                const name = cleanStr(p.name);
                const code = cleanStr(p.code || p.id);
                const sku = cleanStr(p.sku);
                return name.includes(query) || code.includes(query) || sku.includes(query);
            });
        }

        // 2. Raiz do menu (Nenhuma categoria selecionada)
        if (!selectedCategory.value) {
            if (shouldShowCategoryGrid.value) {
                return list.filter(p => !p.category_id || p.category_id === 0);
            }
            return list;
        }

        const currentCatId = String(selectedCategory.value);

        // 3. Dentro de uma categoria: apenas os produtos vinculados a ela
        let result = list.filter(p => String(p.category_id) === currentCatId);

        const page = usePage();
        const mode = unref(settings?.outOfStockMode) || page?.props?.companySettings?.out_of_stock_mode || 'disable_bottom';

        const isUnavailable = (p) => {
            if (!p) return false;
            const s = String(p.status || '').toLowerCase();
            if (['out_of_stock', 'unavailable', 'paused'].includes(s)) return true;
            if (p.track_inventory && parseFloat(p.current_stock ?? 0) <= 0) return true;
            return false;
        };

        if (mode === 'hide') {
            return result.filter(p => !isUnavailable(p));
        }

        if (mode === 'disable_bottom') {
            return [...result].sort((a, b) => {
                const aBlocked = isUnavailable(a);
                const bBlocked = isUnavailable(b);
                if (aBlocked && !bBlocked) return 1;
                if (!aBlocked && bBlocked) return -1;
                return 0;
            });
        }

        return result;
    });

    const shouldShowProductGrid = computed(() => {
        return filteredProducts.value.length > 0;
    });

    return {
        selectedCategory,
        activeMenuCategory,
        searchQuery,
        breadcrumbs,
        goBackCategory,
        visibleMenuCategories,
        visibleGridCategories,
        shouldShowCategoryGrid,
        filteredProducts,
        shouldShowProductGrid
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { ref } from "vue";

export function useModifiers(isCustomerMode = false) {
    const selections = ref({});

    const initModifiers = (modifiers, existingStructured = []) => {
        selections.value = {};
        if (!modifiers) return;

        modifiers.forEach((g) => {
            selections.value[g.id] = { selectedIds: [], qtys: {} };
        });

        if (existingStructured && existingStructured.length > 0) {
            existingStructured.forEach(sel => {
                let foundGroup = null;
                let foundOpt = null;

                if (sel.group_id) {
                    foundGroup = modifiers.find(g => String(g.id) === String(sel.group_id));
                    if (foundGroup) {
                        foundOpt = getOptionsWithJoker(foundGroup).find(o => String(o.id) === String(sel.id) || (sel.is_joker && o.isJoker));
                    }
                }

                if (!foundGroup) {
                    for (const g of modifiers) {
                        const opt = getOptionsWithJoker(g).find(o => String(o.id) === String(sel.id) || (sel.is_joker && o.isJoker) || (sel.name && o.name === sel.name));
                        if (opt) {
                            foundGroup = g;
                            foundOpt = opt;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (foundGroup && foundOpt) {
                    if (foundGroup.allow_quantity && foundGroup.type !== 'ingredient') {
                        selections.value[foundGroup.id].qtys[foundOpt.id] = sel.qty || 1;
                    } else {
                        selections.value[foundGroup.id].selectedIds.push(foundOpt.id);
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    };

    const getOptionsWithJoker = (group) => {
        if (group.type === "ingredient") {
            if (isCustomerMode) {
                return group.options;
            }
            return [
                ...group.options,
                { id: `outro_${group.id}`, name: "Outro", price: 0, isJoker: true },
            ];
        }
        return group.options;
    };

    const isSelected = (group, opt) => selections.value[group.id]?.selectedIds.includes(opt.id) || false;

    const isDisabled = (group, opt) => {
        const state = selections.value[group.id];
        if (!state) return false;
        if (isSelected(group, opt)) return false;

        if (!opt.isJoker && state.selectedIds.some(id => String(id).startsWith('outro_'))) {
            return true;
        }

        if (group.max_selections > 0 && state.selectedIds.length >= group.max_selections) return true;
        return false;
    };

    const toggleSelection = (group, opt) => {
        if (isDisabled(group, opt)) return;
        const state = selections.value[group.id];
        const idx = state.selectedIds.indexOf(opt.id);

        if (idx > -1) {
            state.selectedIds.splice(idx, 1);
        } else {
            if (opt.isJoker) {
                state.selectedIds = [opt.id];
            } else {
                const jokerIdx = state.selectedIds.findIndex(id => String(id).startsWith('outro_'));
                if (jokerIdx > -1) state.selectedIds.splice(jokerIdx, 1);

                state.selectedIds.push(opt.id);
            }
        }
    };

    const getQty = (group, opt) => selections.value[group.id]?.qtys[opt.id] || 0;

    const updateQty = (group, opt, delta) => {
        const state = selections.value[group.id];
        let current = state.qtys[opt.id] || 0;
        current += delta;
        if (current < 0) current = 0;
        state.qtys[opt.id] = current;
    };

    const evaluateGroup = (group) => {
        const state = selections.value[group.id];
        if (!state) return { total: 0, optionTotals: {} };

        let total = 0;
        let optionTotals = {};
        const increment = Number(group.increment || 0);
        const optionsWithJoker = getOptionsWithJoker(group);

        if (group.type === 'ingredient') {
            let selectedItems = state.selectedIds.map(optId => {
                const opt = optionsWithJoker.find(o => String(o.id) === String(optId));
                return { opt, basePrice: Number(opt?.price || 0) };
            }).filter(i => i.opt);

            selectedItems.sort((a, b) => b.basePrice - a.basePrice);

            let freeRemaining = group.max_free || 0;

            selectedItems.forEach(item => {
                let finalItemPrice = item.basePrice;

                if (!item.opt.isJoker) {
                    if (freeRemaining > 0) {
                        freeRemaining--;
                    } else {
                        finalItemPrice += increment;
                    }
                }

                total += finalItemPrice;
                optionTotals[item.opt.id] = { qty: 1, totalCost: finalItemPrice };
            });
        } else {
            if (group.allow_quantity) {
                optionsWithJoker.forEach(opt => {
                    const qty = state.qtys[opt.id] || 0;
                    if (qty > 0) {
                        const cost = Number(opt.price || 0) * qty;
                        total += cost;
                        optionTotals[opt.id] = { qty, totalCost: cost };
                    }
                });
            } else {
                state.selectedIds.forEach(optId => {
                    const opt = optionsWithJoker.find(o => String(o.id) === String(optId));
                    if (opt) {
                        const unitPrice = Number(opt.price || 0);
                        total += unitPrice;
                        optionTotals[opt.id] = { qty: 1, totalCost: unitPrice };
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        return { total, optionTotals };
    };

    const getEffectivePrice = (group, opt) => {
        if (opt.isJoker) return 0;
        const basePrice = Number(opt.price || 0);

        if (group.type !== 'ingredient') return basePrice;

        const state = selections.value[group.id];
        if (!state) return basePrice;

        const isSel = isSelected(group, opt);

        if (isSel) {
            const evaluated = evaluateGroup(group);
            return evaluated.optionTotals[opt.id]?.totalCost ?? basePrice;
        } else {
            const currentCount = state.selectedIds.filter(id => !String(id).startsWith('outro_')).length;
            const increment = Number(group.increment || 0);

            if (currentCount >= group.max_free) {
                return basePrice + increment;
            }
            return basePrice;
        }
    };

    const calculateTotal = (basePrice, modifiers) => {
        let total = Number(basePrice || 0);
        if (!modifiers) return total;
        modifiers.forEach((group) => {
            total += evaluateGroup(group).total;
        });
        return total;
    };

    const hasJokerSelected = (modifiers) => {
        if (!modifiers) return false;
        for (const group of modifiers) {
            const state = selections.value[group.id];
            if (state && state.selectedIds.some(id => String(id).startsWith('outro_'))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    };

    // 🚀 NOVO: Checa se um grupo individual atingiu os requisitos mínimos
    const isGroupSatisfied = (group) => {
        if (!group) return true;
        const min = Number(group.min_selections ?? group.min_choices ?? 0);
        if (min <= 0) return true;

        const state = selections.value[group.id];
        if (!state) return false;

        if (group.allow_quantity && group.type !== 'ingredient') {
            const totalQty = Object.values(state.qtys || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + Number(b || 0), 0);
            return totalQty >= min;
        } else {
            return (state.selectedIds || []).length >= min;
        }
    };

    const isValid = (modifiers, noteText = "") => {
        if (!modifiers) return true;
        for (const group of modifiers) {
            if (!isGroupSatisfied(group)) return false;
        }

        if (hasJokerSelected(modifiers) && (!noteText || noteText.trim().length < 3)) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    };

    const buildModifiersText = (modifiers) => {
        let parts = [];
        if (!modifiers) return "";
        modifiers.forEach((group) => {
            const state = selections.value[group.id];
            if (!state) return;

            let groupParts = [];
            if (group.allow_quantity && group.type !== 'ingredient') {
                group.options.forEach((opt) => {
                    const qty = state.qtys[opt.id] || 0;
                    if (qty > 0) groupParts.push(`${qty}x ${opt.name}`);
                });
            } else {
                state.selectedIds.forEach((optId) => {
                    const opt = getOptionsWithJoker(group).find((o) => String(o.id) === String(optId));
                    if (opt) groupParts.push(opt.name);
                });
            }

            if (groupParts.length > 0) {
                parts.push(groupParts.join(', '));
            }
        });
        return parts.join(" | ");
    };

    const buildStructuredModifiers = (modifiers) => {
        let structured = [];
        if (!modifiers) return structured;
        modifiers.forEach((group) => {
            const evaluated = evaluateGroup(group);
            const state = selections.value[group.id];
            if (!state) return;

            if (group.allow_quantity && group.type !== 'ingredient') {
                group.options.forEach((opt) => {
                    const qty = state.qtys[opt.id] || 0;
                    if (qty > 0) {
                        structured.push({
                            id: opt.id,
                            name: opt.name,
                            price: evaluated.optionTotals[opt.id]?.totalCost / qty || 0,
                            qty: qty,
                            is_joker: !!opt.isJoker,
                            group_id: group.id,
                        });
                    }
                });
            } else {
                state.selectedIds.forEach((optId) => {
                    const opt = getOptionsWithJoker(group).find((o) => String(o.id) === String(optId));
                    if (opt) {
                        structured.push({
                            id: opt.isJoker ? null : opt.id,
                            name: opt.name,
                            price: evaluated.optionTotals[opt.id]?.totalCost || 0,
                            qty: 1,
                            is_joker: !!opt.isJoker,
                            group_id: group.id,
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        });
        return structured;
    };

    return {
        initModifiers, getOptionsWithJoker, isSelected, isDisabled, toggleSelection, getQty,
        updateQty, getEffectivePrice, calculateTotal, isValid, hasJokerSelected, isGroupSatisfied,
        buildModifiersText, buildStructuredModifiers,
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { useConfirm } from 'primevue/useconfirm';
import { ref } from 'vue';

export function useOperationalShift() {
    const isModalVisible = ref(false);
    const isProcessing = ref(false);
    const toast = useToast();
    const confirm = useConfirm();

    const openModal = () => {
        isModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
        isModalVisible.value = false;
    };

    const submitCloseShift = (closeStore = true, onSuccessCallback = null, unpaidCount = 0) => {
        const executeClose = () => {
            isProcessing.value = true;

            router.post(route('operations.shift.close-operational'), {
                close_store: closeStore
            }, {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                onSuccess: () => {
                    isProcessing.value = false;
                    isModalVisible.value = false;

                    toast?.add({
                        severity: 'success',
                        summary: 'Turno Operacional Encerrado',
                        detail: closeStore
                            ? 'Turno encerrado e loja fechada no app do cliente!'
                            : 'Turno encerrado! A loja continua aberta no app.',
                        life: 4000
                    });

                    if (onSuccessCallback) onSuccessCallback();
                },
                onError: (errors) => {
                    isProcessing.value = false;
                    toast?.add({
                        severity: 'error',
                        summary: 'Erro ao Encerrar Turno',
                        detail: errors.error || 'Não foi possível encerrar o turno operacional.',
                        life: 5000
                    });
                }
            });
        };

        // 🚀 Interceptador com o PrimeVue ConfirmDialog
        if (unpaidCount > 0) {
            confirm.require({
                header: 'Pagamentos Pendentes',
                message: `Você possui ${unpaidCount} colaborador(es) sem pagamento liquidado. Deseja acumular as diárias no extrato deles e encerrar o turno mesmo assim?`,
                icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle text-warning-500',
                acceptClass: 'p-button-warning px-4 py-2',
                rejectClass: 'p-button-secondary p-button-text px-4 py-2',
                acceptLabel: 'Sim, rolar dívidas',
                rejectLabel: 'Voltar e Pagar',
                accept: () => {
                    executeClose();
                }
            });
        } else {
            executeClose();
        }
    };

    return {
        isModalVisible,
        isProcessing,
        openModal,
        closeModal,
        submitCloseShift
    };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderAppend.js
```javascript
import { computed } from 'vue';

export function useOrderAppend(draftRouting, cartSubtotal, initialOrdersRef = null) {
    const targetOrderId = computed(() => {
        return draftRouting.value?.order_id
            || draftRouting.value?.id
            || draftRouting.value?.existing_order_id
            || draftRouting.value?.append_to_order
            || null;
    });

    const isAppending = computed(() => Boolean(targetOrderId.value));

    // Busca o objeto completo da encomenda original na lista de pedidos ativos
    const originalOrder = computed(() => {
        if (!isAppending.value || !initialOrdersRef) return null;
        const orders = initialOrdersRef.value || [];
        return orders.find(o => String(o.id) === String(targetOrderId.value)) || null;
    });

    const alreadyPaidAmount = computed(() => {
        if (!originalOrder.value) return 0.00;
        if (originalOrder.value.total_paid !== undefined) {
            return Number(originalOrder.value.total_paid);
        }
        const payments = originalOrder.value.payments || [];
        return payments.filter(p => p.is_paid || p.status === 'paid').reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.amount || 0), 0);
    });

    const originalTotal = computed(() => {
        return originalOrder.value ? Number(originalOrder.value.total || 0) : 0.00;
    });

    const newItemsAmount = computed(() => {
        return Number(cartSubtotal.value || 0);
    });

    const projectedTotal = computed(() => {
        return Number((originalTotal.value + newItemsAmount.value).toFixed(2));
    });

    const balanceDue = computed(() => {
        const diff = projectedTotal.value - alreadyPaidAmount.value;
        return diff > 0 ? Number(diff.toFixed(2)) : 0.00;
    });

    const wasOriginallyPaid = computed(() => {
        return originalOrder.value?.payment_status === 'paid'
            || (alreadyPaidAmount.value > 0 && alreadyPaidAmount.value >= (originalTotal.value - 0.05));
    });

    // 🚀 LÊ E EXPORTA AS PROMESSAS PRÉVIAS
    const preExistingPaymentIntents = computed(() => {
        if (!originalOrder.value) return [];
        let methods = originalOrder.value.payment_intent_methods;
        if (!methods) return [];

        while (typeof methods === 'string') {
            try { methods = JSON.parse(methods); } catch (e) { break; }
        }
        return Array.isArray(methods) ? methods : [];
    });

    // 🚀 INFLA O ÚLTIMO PAGAMENTO PARA COBRIR O NOVO VALOR
    const autoScaledPaymentIntents = computed(() => {
        const baseMethods = [...preExistingPaymentIntents.value];
        if (baseMethods.length === 0) return [];

        // Pega o último método usado e soma a ele o valor dos novos itens
        const lastMethod = { ...baseMethods[baseMethods.length - 1] };
        lastMethod.amount = Number(lastMethod.amount) + newItemsAmount.value;

        // Limpa o target do troco para forçar o operador a reavaliar a nota
        lastMethod.change_target = null;

        baseMethods[baseMethods.length - 1] = lastMethod;
        return baseMethods;
    });

    const changeAnalysis = computed(() => {
        const target = draftRouting.value?.cash_change_target
            || draftRouting.value?.change_target
            || originalOrder.value?.change_target
            || null;

        if (!target) {
            return { hasChange: false, targetAmount: 0, calculatedChange: 0, isExceeded: false, warning: null };
        }

        const targetFloat = Number(target);
        const change = Number((targetFloat - projectedTotal.value).toFixed(2));
        const isExceeded = projectedTotal.value > targetFloat;

        return {
            hasChange: true,
            targetAmount: targetFloat,
            calculatedChange: Math.max(0, change),
            isExceeded,
            warning: isExceeded
                ? `O novo total (R$ ${projectedTotal.value.toFixed(2)}) excede o valor para troco informado (R$ ${targetFloat.toFixed(2)})!`
                : `Troco recalculado: Levar R$ ${change.toFixed(2)} de volta.`
        };
    });

    return {
        targetOrderId,
        isAppending,
        originalOrder,
        originalTotal,
        alreadyPaidAmount,
        newItemsAmount,
        projectedTotal,
        balanceDue,
        wasOriginallyPaid,
        preExistingPaymentIntents,
        autoScaledPaymentIntents,
        changeAnalysis
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { useViewport } from "@/Composables/useViewport";
import { router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import { ref } from "vue";
import { useCart } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart";

export function useOrderDetailsOrchestrator(props, activeItemsGrouped) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const { isMobile } = useViewport();

    const activeSidebarView = ref('menu');
    const selectedItemIds = ref([]);

    const isTransferModalVisible = ref(false);
    const isTransformerVisible = ref(false);
    const isPaymentModalVisible = ref(false);
    const isChangeAddressModalVisible = ref(false);
    const isCourierSwapModalVisible = ref(false);

    const isCheckoutModalVisible = ref(false);
    const checkoutData = ref(null);
    const isFetchingCheckout = ref(false);

    const transferItemIds = ref([]);

    const resolveTableData = (order) => {
        if (!order) return { id: null, name: '' };
        const id = order.dining_table_id
            || order.table_id
            || order.dining_table?.id
            || order.diningTable?.id
            || order.table?.id
            || null;

        const name = order.table_number
            || order.table?.name
            || order.table?.number
            || order.dining_table?.name
            || order.dining_table?.table_number
            || order.diningTable?.name
            || order.diningTable?.table_number
            || (id ? String(id) : '');

        return {
            id: id ? Number(id) : null,
            name: String(name || '').trim()
        };
    };

    const toggleItemSelection = (item) => {
        const id = typeof item === 'object' ? item.id : item;
        const targetItem = typeof item === 'object' ? item : activeItemsGrouped.value.find(i => i.id === id);

        const isSelected = selectedItemIds.value.includes(id);
        let idsToToggle = [id];

        if (targetItem && !targetItem.is_combo_child && targetItem.has_exploded_children) {
            const children = activeItemsGrouped.value.filter(i => i.combo_parent_id === id);
            idsToToggle.push(...children.map(c => c.id));
        }

        if (isSelected) {
            selectedItemIds.value = selectedItemIds.value.filter(selectedId => !idsToToggle.includes(selectedId));
        } else {
            const newIds = idsToToggle.filter(newId => !selectedItemIds.value.includes(newId));
            selectedItemIds.value.push(...newIds);
        }
    };

    const toggleSelectAllItems = () => {
        if (selectedItemIds.value.length === activeItemsGrouped.value.length) {
            selectedItemIds.value = [];
        } else {
            selectedItemIds.value = activeItemsGrouped.value.map(i => i.id);
        }
    };

    const navigateToPosTab = () => {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'pos' }));
    };

    const handleAction = async (actionId) => {
        if (actionId === 'transfer_all') {
            transferItemIds.value = activeItemsGrouped.value.map(i => i.id);
            if (isMobile.value) isTransferModalVisible.value = true;
            else activeSidebarView.value = 'transfer';
            return;
        }

        switch (actionId) {
            case "checkout":
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-open-checkout', { detail: { orderId: props.order.id } }));
                break;

            case "add_items": {
                const tableInfo = resolveTableData(props.order);
                const routingPayload = {
                    id: props.order.id,
                    order_id: props.order.id,
                    existing_order_id: props.order.id,
                    type: props.order.type || "table",
                    dining_table_id: tableInfo.id,
                    table_id: tableInfo.id,
                    table: tableInfo.id ? { id: tableInfo.id, name: tableInfo.name } : null,
                    identifier: props.order.customer_name || props.order.identifier || (tableInfo.name ? `Mesa ${tableInfo.name}` : ''),
                    customer: props.order.customer ? { id: props.order.customer.id, name: props.order.customer.name, phone: props.order.customer.phone } : null,
                    customer_phone: props.order.customer_phone || props.order.customer?.phone || null,
                    address_id: props.order.address_id || props.order.address?.id || null,
                    address: props.order.address_snapshot || props.order.address || null,
                };

                const { draftRouting, orderType } = useCart();
                if (draftRouting) draftRouting.value = routingPayload;
                if (orderType) orderType.value = props.order.type || "table";

                localStorage.setItem("pos_draft_type", props.order.type || "table");
                localStorage.setItem("pos_draft_routing", JSON.stringify(routingPayload));
                localStorage.setItem("pos_return_url", "/operations");
                localStorage.setItem("pos_return_order_id", String(props.order.id));
                navigateToPosTab();
                break;
            }

            case "transform_order":
                if (isMobile.value) isTransformerVisible.value = true;
                else activeSidebarView.value = 'transform';
                break;

            case "delivery_payment":
                if (isMobile.value) isPaymentModalVisible.value = true;
                else activeSidebarView.value = 'payment';
                break;

            case "change_address":
                if (isMobile.value) isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = true;
                else activeSidebarView.value = 'address';
                break;

            case "swap_courier":
                if (isMobile.value) isCourierSwapModalVisible.value = true;
                else activeSidebarView.value = 'courier_swap';
                break;

            case "new_subaccount": {
                const tableInfo = resolveTableData(props.order);

                localStorage.setItem("pos_draft_type", "table");
                localStorage.setItem("pos_draft_routing", JSON.stringify({
                    type: 'table',
                    orderType: 'table',
                    dining_table_id: tableInfo.id,
                    table_id: tableInfo.id,
                    selectedTable: { id: tableInfo.id, name: tableInfo.name },
                    table: { id: tableInfo.id, name: tableInfo.name },
                    tableIdentifier: ''
                }));
                navigateToPosTab();
                break;
            }

            case "print_partial":
                router.post(route('operations.print-conference', props.order.id), {}, {
                    preserveScroll: true,
                    preserveState: true,
                    onSuccess: () => void(0)
                });
                break;
        }
    };

    const openSingleTransfer = (item) => {
        transferItemIds.value = [item.id];
        if (isMobile.value) isTransferModalVisible.value = true;
        else activeSidebarView.value = 'transfer';
    };

    const handleExecuteTransfer = (payload) => {
        router.post(route('operations.transfer-items'), payload, {
            preserveState: false,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isTransferModalVisible.value = false;
                activeSidebarView.value = 'menu';
                selectedItemIds.value = [];
            }
        });
    };

    const handleTransformation = (payload) => {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.transform', props.order.id), payload, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isTransformerVisible.value = false;

                const targetType = payload.new_type || payload.newType || payload.type;
                if (targetType === 'delivery' && !props.order.address && !props.order.address_snapshot) {
                    if (isMobile.value) {
                        isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = true;
                    } else {
                        activeSidebarView.value = 'address';
                    }
                } else {
                    activeSidebarView.value = 'menu';
                }
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                const message = Object.values(errors)[0] || 'Falha ao converter pedido. Verifique os dados.';
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: message, life: 5000 });
            }
        });
    };

    const handleUpdatePayment = (intentData) => {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.update-delivery-payment', props.order.id), intentData, {
            onSuccess: () => {
                isPaymentModalVisible.value = false;
                activeSidebarView.value = 'menu';

                if (intentData.intent === 'pay_now' || intentData.payment_intent_status === 'pay_now') {
                    handleAction('checkout');
                }
            }
        });
    };

    const handleChangeAddressConfirm = (payload) => {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.change-address', payload.order_id), {
            address_id: payload.new_address_id,
            address: payload.new_address,
            delivery_fee: payload.new_delivery_fee
        }, {
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = false;
                activeSidebarView.value = 'menu';
            }
        });
    };

    const handleDeactivateAddress = (addressId) => {
        router.post(route('operations.customers.addresses.deactivate', [props.order.customer_id, addressId]), {}, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Removido', detail: 'Endereço inativado.', life: 3000 });
                isChangeAddressModalVisible.value = false;
                activeSidebarView.value = 'menu';
            }
        });
    };

    const handleAssignCourier = (courier, onSuccessCallback = null) => {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.assign-courier', props.order.id), {
            driver_id: courier.id
        }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isCourierSwapModalVisible.value = false;
                activeSidebarView.value = 'menu';

                if (onSuccessCallback) onSuccessCallback(courier);
            }
        });
    };

    // 🚀 EXECUÇÃO DAS AÇÕES EM LOTE
    const executeBulkAction = (actionType) => {
        if (actionType === 'transfer') {
            transferItemIds.value = [...selectedItemIds.value];
            if (isMobile.value) isTransferModalVisible.value = true;
            else activeSidebarView.value = 'transfer';
        }
        else if (actionType === 'print') {
            const ids = [...selectedItemIds.value];
            if (ids.length === 0) {
                toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atenção', detail: 'Nenhum item selecionado.', life: 3000 });
                return;
            }

            router.post(route('operations.kds.bulk-print'), {
                item_ids: ids
            }, {
                preserveScroll: true,
                preserveState: true,
                onSuccess: () => {
                    toast.add({
                        severity: 'success',
                        summary: 'Impressão em Lote',
                        detail: `${ids.length} item(ns) enviado(s) para a cozinha!`,
                        life: 3000
                    });
                    selectedItemIds.value = [];
                },
                onError: (err) => {
                    const msg = err && typeof err === 'object' ? Object.values(err)[0] : 'Falha ao imprimir itens em lote.';
                    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro de Impressão', detail: msg, life: 5000 });
                }
            });
        }
    };

    return {
        activeSidebarView, selectedItemIds, isTransferModalVisible,
        isTransformerVisible, isPaymentModalVisible, isChangeAddressModalVisible,
        isCourierSwapModalVisible, isCheckoutModalVisible, checkoutData, isFetchingCheckout,
        transferItemIds, toggleItemSelection, toggleSelectAllItems,
        handleAction, openSingleTransfer, handleExecuteTransfer, handleTransformation,
        handleUpdatePayment, handleChangeAddressConfirm, handleDeactivateAddress,
        handleAssignCourier, executeBulkAction
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";

export function useOrderExport() {
    const { formatModifiersList, abbreviateName } = useOrderFormatting();

    const buildWhatsAppSummary = (cart, metadata, totals) => {
        let summary = `*RESUMO DO PEDIDO*\n`;

        if (metadata?.type === 'counter' || metadata?.type === 'pickup' || metadata?.type === 'takeaway') {
            summary += `🛍️ *Retirada*\n`;
        } else if (metadata?.type === 'table') {
            const tableLabel = metadata?.table?.name || metadata?.dining_table?.name || metadata?.table_number || '';
            summary += `🍽️ *Mesa ${tableLabel}*\n`;
        }

        if (metadata?.customer?.name) {
            summary += `\n👤 *Cliente:* ${abbreviateName(metadata.customer.name)}\n`;
        } else if (metadata?.identifier) {
            summary += `\n👤 *Cliente:* ${abbreviateName(metadata.identifier)}\n`;
        }

        if (metadata?.type === 'delivery') {
            const addr = metadata.address || metadata.address_snapshot;
            if (addr) {
                const streetLine = addr.full_address || `${addr.street?.name || addr.street || ''}, ${addr.number || 'S/N'} - ${addr.neighborhood?.name || addr.neighborhood || ''}`;
                summary += `📍 *Endereço:* ${streetLine}\n`;

                if (addr.complement) summary += `   ↳ Comp: ${addr.complement}\n`;
                if (addr.reference) summary += `   ↳ Ref: ${addr.reference}\n`;
            }
        }

        summary += `--------------------------\n`;

        cart.forEach((item) => {
            const isCortesia = item.is_reward ? ' [CORTESIA]' : '';
            summary += `*${item.qty} × ${item.name}${isCortesia}* - ${formatCurrency(item.price * item.qty)}\n`;

            const modsList = formatModifiersList(item);
            if (modsList && modsList.length > 0) {
                modsList.forEach(modLine => {
                    summary += `   ↳ ${modLine}\n`;
                });
            }

            if (item.modifiersText && (!modsList || modsList.length === 0)) {
                summary += `   ↳ Obs: ${item.modifiersText}\n`;
            } else if (item.notes) {
                summary += `   ↳ Obs: ${item.notes}\n`;
            }

            if (item.comboItems && item.comboItems.length > 0) {
                item.comboItems.forEach((c) => {
                    summary += `   ↳ 1 × ${c.name}`;

                    if (c.price > 0 || c.additional_price > 0) {
                        const extraPrice = c.price || c.additional_price;
                        summary += ` (+ ${formatCurrency(extraPrice)})`;
                    }
                    summary += `\n`;

                    const comboModsList = formatModifiersList(c);
                    if (comboModsList && comboModsList.length > 0) {
                        comboModsList.forEach(modLine => {
                            summary += `      ↳ ${modLine}\n`;
                        });
                    }

                    if (c.modifiersText && (!comboModsList || comboModsList.length === 0)) {
                        summary += `      ↳ Obs: ${c.modifiersText}\n`;
                    } else if (c.notes) {
                        summary += `      ↳ Obs: ${c.notes}\n`;
                    }
                });
            }
            summary += `\n`;
        });

        summary += `--------------------------\n`;

        summary += `*Subtotal:* ${formatCurrency(totals.subtotal)}\n`;

        if (totals.deliveryFee > 0 && metadata?.type === 'delivery') {
            summary += `*Taxa de Entrega:* ${formatCurrency(totals.deliveryFee)}\n`;
        }
        if (totals.serviceFee > 0) {
            summary += `*Taxa de Serviço:* ${formatCurrency(totals.serviceFee)}\n`;
        }
        if (totals.discount > 0) {
            summary += `*Desconto:* -${formatCurrency(totals.discount)}\n`;
        }

        summary += `*TOTAL:* ${formatCurrency(totals.finalTotal)}\n`;

        return summary;
    };

    return { buildWhatsAppSummary };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed, unref } from "vue";

export function useOrderFinancials(
    order,
    orderTotalItemsValue,
    isServiceTaxEnabled,
    companySettings,
) {
    const rawOrder = computed(() => unref(order) || {});

    // 🚀 A taxa de entrega só pode existir se a modalidade for estritamente delivery
    const deliveryFee = computed(() => {
        const type = rawOrder.value.type || 'table';
        if (type !== 'delivery') return 0;
        return Number(rawOrder.value.delivery_fee || 0);
    });

    const discount = computed(() => Number(rawOrder.value.discount || 0));

    const showServiceFeeRow = computed(() => Boolean(companySettings?.has_service_tax));

    const serviceTaxPercentage = computed(() => Number(companySettings?.service_tax_percentage || 0));

    const isChannelEligible = computed(() => {
        const type = rawOrder.value.type || 'table';
        if (type === 'table') {
            return companySettings?.service_tax_table !== false && companySettings?.service_tax_table !== 0;
        }
        if (type === 'counter' || type === 'takeaway' || type === 'pickup') {
            return Boolean(companySettings?.service_tax_counter);
        }
        if (type === 'delivery') {
            return Boolean(companySettings?.service_tax_delivery);
        }
        return false;
    });

    const serviceFeeAmount = computed(() => {
        const isManuallyActive = unref(isServiceTaxEnabled) !== false;
        if (!isManuallyActive || !showServiceFeeRow.value || !isChannelEligible.value) {
            return 0;
        }

        const percentage = serviceTaxPercentage.value;
        return Math.round((Number(unref(orderTotalItemsValue) || 0) * (percentage / 100)) * 100) / 100;
    });

    const dynamicOrderTotal = computed(
        () =>
            Number(unref(orderTotalItemsValue) || 0) +
            deliveryFee.value +
            serviceFeeAmount.value -
            discount.value,
    );

    const feesAndDiscounts = computed(
        () => deliveryFee.value + serviceFeeAmount.value - discount.value,
    );

    return {
        deliveryFee,
        discount,
        serviceFeeAmount,
        serviceTaxPercentage,
        showServiceFeeRow,
        isChannelEligible,
        dynamicOrderTotal,
        feesAndDiscounts,
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { ref } from "vue";

export function useOrderFlow(props, cartContext, autoCheckoutCallback = null) {
    const { cart, addToCart, updateItemModifiers, loadEditOrder, startNewOrder, orderType } = cartContext;

    const isModifiersVisible = ref(false);
    const isComboVisible = ref(false);
    const activeProduct = ref(null);
    const editItemIndex = ref(null);

    const hasComboGroups = (prod) => {
        if (!prod || !prod.combo_groups) return false;
        return Array.isArray(prod.combo_groups)
            ? prod.combo_groups.length > 0
            : Object.keys(prod.combo_groups).length > 0;
    };

    const getStructuredMods = (item) => {
        if (item.cartItem?.structuredModifiers && Array.isArray(item.cartItem.structuredModifiers)) {
            return item.cartItem.structuredModifiers;
        }

        if (item.structuredModifiers && Array.isArray(item.structuredModifiers)) {
            return item.structuredModifiers;
        }

        const raw = item.favorite_selections
            || item.structured_modifiers
            || item.meta?.modifiers
            || (Array.isArray(item.modifiers) && !item.modifiers[0]?.options ? item.modifiers : []);

        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];

        return raw.map(m => ({
            id: m.modifier_option_id || m.id,
            name: m.name,
            price: Number(m.price || 0),
            qty: Math.max(1, (m.quantity || m.qty || 1) / (item.quantity || item.qty || 1)),
            is_joker: m.is_joker !== undefined ? !!m.is_joker : (m.modifier_option_id === null),
            group_id: m.modifier_group_id || m.group_id || null
        }));
    };

    const initializeFlow = (urlParams) => {
        if (urlParams.get('action') === 'new') startNewOrder();

        if (props.editOrderData) {
            loadEditOrder(props.editOrderData);
            orderType.value = props.editOrderData.type;

            const duplicateItemId = urlParams.get('duplicate_item');
            const editItemId = urlParams.get('edit_item');
            const swapItemId = urlParams.get('swap_item');
            const originalQty = Number(urlParams.get('original_qty')) || 1;
            const isComboChild = urlParams.get('is_combo_child') === 'true';
            const parentItemId = urlParams.get('parent_item_id');

            const targetItemId = duplicateItemId || editItemId || swapItemId;

            if (targetItemId && props.editOrderData.items && props.editOrderData.items.length > 0) {
                const targetItem = props.editOrderData.items.find(i => String(i.id) === String(targetItemId));

                if (targetItem) {
                    const catalogProductId = targetItem.product_id || targetItem.item_id || targetItem.id;
                    const originalProduct = props.initialProducts.find(p => String(p.id) === String(catalogProductId));

                    if (originalProduct && !swapItemId) {
                        const structuredMods = getStructuredMods(targetItem);
                        const childItems = props.editOrderData.items.filter(i => String(i.parent_item_id) === String(targetItem.id));
                        const comboItems = targetItem.comboChildren || childItems.map(c => ({
                            product_id: c.product_id || c.item_id,
                            name: c.name || c.product_name,
                            modifiersText: c.modifiers_text,
                            structuredModifiers: getStructuredMods(c)
                        }));

                        const isSubItem = isComboChild || Boolean(targetItem.parent_item_id) || Boolean(parentItemId);

                        activeProduct.value = {
                            ...originalProduct,
                            is_combo_child: isSubItem,
                            combo_parent_id: parentItemId || targetItem.parent_item_id || null,
                            cartItem: {
                                qty: targetItem.quantity || 1,
                                structuredModifiers: structuredMods,
                                comboItems: (!isSubItem && comboItems.length > 0) ? comboItems : null,
                                isSubItem: isSubItem
                            }
                        };

                        if (editItemId) {
                            activeProduct.value.editContext = {
                                replaces_item_id: editItemId,
                                parent_item_id: parentItemId || targetItem.parent_item_id || null,
                                is_combo_child: isSubItem,
                                original_qty: originalQty,
                                auth_reason: urlParams.get('auth_reason'),
                                is_loss: urlParams.get('is_loss') === 'true'
                            };
                        }

                        if (isSubItem) {
                            isModifiersVisible.value = true;
                            isComboVisible.value = false;
                        } else {
                            (originalProduct.type === 'combo' || comboItems.length > 0)
                                ? isComboVisible.value = true
                                : isModifiersVisible.value = true;
                        }
                    }
                    else if (swapItemId) {
                        const swapContext = {
                            replaces_item_id: swapItemId,
                            original_qty: originalQty,
                            auth_reason: urlParams.get('auth_reason'),
                            is_loss: urlParams.get('is_loss') === 'true'
                        };
                        localStorage.setItem('pos_swap_context', JSON.stringify(swapContext));
                    }

                    localStorage.setItem('pos_return_url', '/operations');
                    localStorage.setItem('pos_return_order_id', props.editOrderData.id);
                }
            }
        }
    };

    const closeConfigurators = () => {
        const returnUrl = localStorage.getItem('pos_return_url');

        isModifiersVisible.value = false;
        isComboVisible.value = false;

        if (returnUrl === '/operations') {
            const orderId = localStorage.getItem('pos_return_order_id');
            localStorage.removeItem('pos_return_url');
            localStorage.removeItem('pos_return_order_id');
            router.visit(`/operations?open_order=${orderId}`);
            return;
        }

        setTimeout(() => { if (!isModifiersVisible.value && !isComboVisible.value) activeProduct.value = null; }, 300);
    };

    const handleProductClick = (product) => {
        let productWithContext = { ...product };

        const swapContext = localStorage.getItem('pos_swap_context');
        if (swapContext) {
            productWithContext.editContext = JSON.parse(swapContext);
            localStorage.removeItem('pos_swap_context');
        }

        activeProduct.value = productWithContext;
        editItemIndex.value = null;

        const typeStr = String(product.type || '').toLowerCase();
        const isActuallyACombo = typeStr === 'combo' || hasComboGroups(product) || product.isCombo === true;

        if (isActuallyACombo) {
            isComboVisible.value = true;
        } else {
            isModifiersVisible.value = true;
        }
    };

    const handleFavoriteClick = (favorite) => {
        const originalProduct = props.initialProducts.find(p => p.id === (favorite.product_id || favorite.id));

        if (!originalProduct) {
            alert("Este produto favorito não está mais disponível no cardápio atual.");
            return;
        }

        const structuredMods = getStructuredMods(favorite);
        let comboItems = null;
        const childItems = favorite.combo_items || favorite.subItems || [];

        if (childItems.length > 0) {
            comboItems = childItems.map(c => ({
                product_id: c.product_id || c.item_id,
                name: c.name || c.product_name,
                modifiersText: c.modifiers_text || c.modifiersText || "",
                structuredModifiers: getStructuredMods(c)
            }));
        }

        activeProduct.value = {
            ...originalProduct,
            cartItem: {
                qty: 1,
                structuredModifiers: structuredMods,
                comboItems: comboItems && comboItems.length > 0 ? comboItems : null
            }
        };

        editItemIndex.value = null;

        (originalProduct.type === 'combo' || comboItems) ? isComboVisible.value = true : isModifiersVisible.value = true;
    };

    const openEditModifiers = (item, index) => {
        const originalProduct = props.initialProducts.find((p) => p.id === item.id);
        activeProduct.value = { ...originalProduct, cartItem: item };
        editItemIndex.value = index;

        const typeStr = String(originalProduct?.type || '').toLowerCase();
        const isActuallyACombo = item.isCombo === true || typeStr === 'combo' || hasComboGroups(originalProduct);

        if (isActuallyACombo) {
            isComboVisible.value = true;
        } else {
            isModifiersVisible.value = true;
        }
    };

    const _finalizeContextualAction = (itemToAdd) => {
        if (activeProduct.value.editContext) {
            itemToAdd.replaces_item_id = activeProduct.value.editContext.replaces_item_id;
            itemToAdd.parent_item_id   = activeProduct.value.editContext.parent_item_id;
            itemToAdd.is_combo_child   = activeProduct.value.editContext.is_combo_child;
            itemToAdd.auth_reason      = activeProduct.value.editContext.auth_reason;
            itemToAdd.is_loss          = activeProduct.value.editContext.is_loss;
            itemToAdd.qty              = activeProduct.value.editContext.original_qty;

            if (itemToAdd.is_combo_child) {
                itemToAdd.isSubItemOfCombo = true;
                itemToAdd.basePriceOverride = 0;
            }

            addToCart(itemToAdd);

            isModifiersVisible.value = false;
            isComboVisible.value = false;

            if (autoCheckoutCallback) autoCheckoutCallback();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    };

    const handleModifiersConfirm = (configuredItem) => {
        if (editItemIndex.value !== null) {
            updateItemModifiers(editItemIndex.value, { ...configuredItem, orderType: orderType.value });
            cart.value[editItemIndex.value].qty = configuredItem.qty;
        } else {
            let itemToAdd = { product: activeProduct.value, ...configuredItem, orderType: orderType.value };
            if (_finalizeContextualAction(itemToAdd)) return;
            addToCart(itemToAdd);
        }
        closeConfigurators();
    };

    const handleComboConfirm = (configuredCombo) => {
        let itemToAdd = {
            product: activeProduct.value,
            comboItems: configuredCombo.structuredItems,
            extraPrice: configuredCombo.extraPrice,
            orderType: orderType.value
        };
        if (_finalizeContextualAction(itemToAdd)) return;

        addToCart(itemToAdd);
        closeConfigurators();
    };

    return {
        isModifiersVisible, isComboVisible, activeProduct, editItemIndex,
        initializeFlow, closeConfigurators, handleProductClick, handleFavoriteClick, openEditModifiers,
        handleModifiersConfirm, handleComboConfirm
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { abbreviateName } from "@/Utils/formatters";

export function useOrderFormatting() {

    const getOrderTitle = (orderOrMeta) => {
        if (!orderOrMeta) return "";
        const type = orderOrMeta.type;
        const tableName = String(
            orderOrMeta.dining_table?.name ||
            orderOrMeta.diningTable?.name ||
            orderOrMeta.table_number ||
            orderOrMeta.table?.name ||
            orderOrMeta.meta?.table?.name ||
            "Avulsa"
        );

        const customerName = orderOrMeta.customer_name || orderOrMeta.identifier || orderOrMeta.meta?.identifier || orderOrMeta.customer?.name || "";

        // 🔒 LGPD: Abrevia o nome universalmente antes de montar a string de retorno
        const safeCustomerName = customerName ? abbreviateName(customerName) : "";

        if (type === 'table') {
            const isGenericName = !customerName ||
                                  customerName.toLowerCase() === tableName.toLowerCase() ||
                                  customerName.toLowerCase() === `mesa ${tableName.toLowerCase()}` ||
                                  customerName.toLowerCase() === 'geral';

            return isGenericName ? `Mesa ${tableName}` : `Mesa ${tableName} (${safeCustomerName})`;
        }

        if (type === 'counter') {
            return safeCustomerName || "Balcão";
        }

        return safeCustomerName || "Delivery";
    };

    const formatModifiersList = (targetItem) => {
        if (!targetItem) return [];

        const raw = targetItem.structured_modifiers || targetItem.modifiers || targetItem.structuredModifiers;
        if (!Array.isArray(raw) || raw.length === 0) {
            if (targetItem.modifiers_text || targetItem.modifiersText) {
                return [targetItem.modifiers_text || targetItem.modifiersText];
            }
            return [];
        }

        // Pega a quantidade do item pai (pela prop ou pelo banco) para isolar
        const parentQty = Number(targetItem.quantity || targetItem.qty || targetItem.available_parts || 1);

        const groups = {};
        raw.forEach(m => {
            if (m.name === '\u200B') return;

            const totalModQty = Number(m.quantity ?? m.qty ?? 1);

            let unitQty = totalModQty;
            // Isola a quantidade do modificador por UNIDADE do prato
            if (parentQty > 1 && totalModQty >= parentQty && (totalModQty % parentQty === 0)) {
                unitQty = totalModQty / parentQty;
            }

            let text = `${unitQty > 1 ? unitQty + 'x ' : ''}${m.name}`;

            // Adiciona o valor financeiro extra na string, se houver
            const modPrice = Number(m.price || 0);
            if (modPrice > 0) {
                const fPrice = new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(modPrice);
                text += ` (+ R$ ${fPrice})`;
            }

            const gid = m.group_id || m.modifier_group_id || 'ungrouped';

            if (!groups[gid]) groups[gid] = [];
            groups[gid].push(text);
        });

        return Object.values(groups).map(g => g.join(', '));
    };

    const groupActiveItems = (itemsArray) => {
        if (!itemsArray || !Array.isArray(itemsArray)) return [];

        const allActive = itemsArray.filter((i) => i.status !== "cancelled");
        const parents = allActive.filter((i) => !i.parent_item_id);
        const children = allActive.filter((i) => !!i.parent_item_id);

        return parents.map((parent) => ({
            ...parent,
            hasChildren: children.some((c) => String(c.parent_item_id) === String(parent.id)),
            comboChildren: children.filter((c) => String(c.parent_item_id) === String(parent.id))
        }));
    };

    const parseAddress = (addressRaw) => {
        if (!addressRaw) return null;
        if (typeof addressRaw === 'object') return addressRaw;
        if (typeof addressRaw === 'string') {
            try { return JSON.parse(addressRaw); } catch(e) { return { full_address: addressRaw }; }
        }
        return addressRaw;
    };

    const formatAddress = (order) => {
        const a = parseAddress(order?.address_snapshot || order?.address || order?.deliveryAddress);
        if (!a) return null;
        if (a.full_address) return a.full_address;

        const streetName = a.street?.name || a.street_name || a.street || '';
        const neighborhood = a.neighborhood?.name || a.neighborhood_name || a.neighborhood || '';
        const comp = a.complement ? ` (${a.complement})` : '';
        const number = a.no_number ? 'S/N' : (a.number || 'S/N');

        if (streetName) {
            return `${streetName}, ${number} - ${neighborhood}${comp}`;
        }

        return null;
    };

    const getCustomerPhone = (order) => {
        if (!order) return null;
        const parsedAddr = parseAddress(order.address_snapshot || order.address);

        return order.customer?.phone
            || order.customer_phone
            || order.phone
            || parsedAddr?.phone
            || null;
    };

    const resolvePaymentIcon = (engineType, fiscalCode = null) => {
        if (engineType === 'bank_api') return 'pi-qrcode';
        if (engineType === 'money') return 'pi-money-bill';
        if (engineType === 'internal_loyalty') return 'pi-star-fill text-yellow-500';
        if (engineType === 'manual') {
            if (fiscalCode === '17') return 'pi-qrcode';
            if (['03', '04'].includes(String(fiscalCode))) return 'pi-credit-card';
            if (fiscalCode === '01') return 'pi-money-bill';
        }
        return 'pi fa-wallet';
    };

    const getPaymentBadges = (order) => {
        let badges = [];
        if (!order) return badges;

        if (order.payments && order.payments.length > 0) {
            order.payments.forEach(p => {
                const method = p.paymentMethod || p.payment_method;
                const engine = method?.engine_type || p.engine_type;
                const fiscalCode = method?.fiscal_code || p.fiscal_code;
                const label = p.method_name || p.method || method?.name || 'Pagamento';

                badges.push({
                    label,
                    icon: resolvePaymentIcon(engine, fiscalCode)
                });
            });
            return badges;
        }

        if (order.payment_intent_methods) {
            let methodsArray = order.payment_intent_methods;
            if (typeof methodsArray === 'string') {
                try { methodsArray = JSON.parse(methodsArray); } catch (e) { methodsArray = []; }
            }

            if (Array.isArray(methodsArray)) {
                methodsArray.forEach(m => {
                    const engine = m.engine_type;
                    const fiscalCode = m.fiscal_code;
                    const label = String(m.method || m.method_name || m.name || 'Pagamento');

                    badges.push({
                        label,
                        icon: resolvePaymentIcon(engine, fiscalCode)
                    });
                });
            }
        }
        return badges;
    };

    return {
        getOrderTitle,
        formatModifiersList,
        groupActiveItems,
        abbreviateName,
        formatAddress,
        parseAddress,
        getCustomerPhone,
        getPaymentBadges
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export function useOrderRouting(props, emit) {
    const initialMeta = props.routingMeta || null;

    const localOrderType = ref(props.modelValue || initialMeta?.type || 'table');
    const resetTableTrigger = ref(0);
    const selectedTable = ref(initialMeta?.table || null);
    const tableIdentifier = ref(initialMeta?.identifier || '');
    const sharedCustomer = ref(initialMeta?.customer || null);
    const deliveryAddress = ref(initialMeta?.address || null);

    // 🚀 Sincroniza se o tipo de pedido for alterado externamente pelo pai
    watch(() => props.modelValue, (newType) => {
        if (newType && newType !== localOrderType.value) {
            localOrderType.value = newType;
            if (newType !== 'delivery') {
                deliveryAddress.value = null;
            }
        }
    });

    const setSelectedTable = (val) => selectedTable.value = val;
    const setTableIdentifier = (val) => tableIdentifier.value = val;
    const setSharedCustomer = (val) => sharedCustomer.value = val;
    const setDeliveryAddress = (val) => deliveryAddress.value = val;

    // 🚀 O endereço só é hidratado automaticamente se o tipo ATIVO for Delivery
    watch(sharedCustomer, (newCustomer) => {
        if (localOrderType.value === 'delivery' && newCustomer && !deliveryAddress.value) {
            if (newCustomer.address) {
                deliveryAddress.value = newCustomer.address;
            } else if (Array.isArray(newCustomer.addresses) && newCustomer.addresses.length > 0) {
                deliveryAddress.value = newCustomer.addresses.find(a => a.is_default) || newCustomer.addresses[0];
            }
        } else if (localOrderType.value !== 'delivery') {
            deliveryAddress.value = null;
        }
    }, { deep: true });

    const orderTypeOptions = computed(() => [
        { label: "Mesa", value: "table", icon: "pi pi-th-large" },
        { label: "Delivery", value: "delivery", icon: "pi pi-truck" },
        { label: "Balcão", value: "counter", icon: "pi pi-shopping-bag" }
    ]);

    const selectOrderType = (type) => {
        if (localOrderType.value !== type) {
            localOrderType.value = type;
            if (type !== 'delivery') {
                deliveryAddress.value = null;
            }
            emit('update:modelValue', type);
        }
    };

    const isLocalValid = computed(() => {
        if (!localOrderType.value) return false;

        if (localOrderType.value === 'delivery') {
            const hasAddress = !!(
                deliveryAddress.value ||
                sharedCustomer.value?.address ||
                (Array.isArray(sharedCustomer.value?.addresses) && sharedCustomer.value.addresses.length > 0)
            );

            const hasCustomer = !!(
                sharedCustomer.value?.id ||
                (typeof sharedCustomer.value === 'string' && sharedCustomer.value.trim().length > 0) ||
                (typeof sharedCustomer.value?.name === 'string' && sharedCustomer.value.name.trim().length > 0) ||
                (typeof tableIdentifier.value === 'string' && tableIdentifier.value.trim().length > 0)
            );

            return hasAddress && hasCustomer;
        }

        if (localOrderType.value === 'counter') {
            const hasCustomer = !!(
                sharedCustomer.value?.id ||
                (typeof sharedCustomer.value === 'string' && sharedCustomer.value.trim().length > 0) ||
                (typeof sharedCustomer.value?.name === 'string' && sharedCustomer.value.name.trim().length > 0) ||
                (typeof tableIdentifier.value === 'string' && tableIdentifier.value.trim().length > 0)
            );
            return hasCustomer;
        }

        if (localOrderType.value === 'table') {
            return !!(selectedTable.value && (selectedTable.value.id || selectedTable.value.dining_table_id));
        }

        return false;
    });

    watch([localOrderType, selectedTable, tableIdentifier, sharedCustomer, deliveryAddress], () => {
        let resolvedIdentifier = tableIdentifier.value || '';

        if (localOrderType.value === 'counter' && sharedCustomer.value) {
            resolvedIdentifier = typeof sharedCustomer.value === 'string'
                ? sharedCustomer.value
                : (sharedCustomer.value.name || tableIdentifier.value || '');
        } else if (localOrderType.value === 'delivery' && sharedCustomer.value) {
            resolvedIdentifier = typeof sharedCustomer.value === 'string'
                ? sharedCustomer.value
                : (sharedCustomer.value.name || '');
        }

        const resolvedPhone = typeof sharedCustomer.value === 'object'
            ? (sharedCustomer.value?.phone || null)
            : null;

        // 🛑 TRAVA DE SEGURANÇA: Endereço é NULO em qualquer tipo que não seja Delivery
        const isDelivery = localOrderType.value === 'delivery';

        const finalAddress = isDelivery
            ? (deliveryAddress.value ||
                sharedCustomer.value?.address ||
                (Array.isArray(sharedCustomer.value?.addresses) ? (sharedCustomer.value.addresses.find(a => a.is_default) || sharedCustomer.value.addresses[0]) : null))
            : null;

        const resolvedTableId = localOrderType.value === 'table'
            ? (selectedTable.value?.id || selectedTable.value?.dining_table_id || null)
            : null;

        emit('routing-change', {
            isValid: isLocalValid.value,
            meta: {
                type: localOrderType.value,
                dining_table_id: resolvedTableId,
                table_id: resolvedTableId,
                table: localOrderType.value === 'table' ? selectedTable.value : null,
                identifier: resolvedIdentifier,
                customer: sharedCustomer.value,
                customer_phone: resolvedPhone,
                address_id: finalAddress?.id || null,
                address: finalAddress
            }
        });
    }, { deep: true, immediate: true });

    const handleApply = (override = null) => {
        const finalCustomer = override?.customer || sharedCustomer.value;
        const isDelivery = localOrderType.value === 'delivery';

        let finalAddress = null;
        if (isDelivery) {
            finalAddress = override?.address || deliveryAddress.value ||
                (Array.isArray(finalCustomer?.addresses) ? (finalCustomer.addresses.find(a => a.is_default) || finalCustomer.addresses[0]) : null);
        }

        if (override?.customer) sharedCustomer.value = override.customer;
        deliveryAddress.value = finalAddress;

        let resolvedIdentifier = tableIdentifier.value || '';
        if (localOrderType.value === 'counter' && finalCustomer) {
            resolvedIdentifier = typeof finalCustomer === 'string'
                ? finalCustomer
                : (finalCustomer.name || tableIdentifier.value || '');
        }

        const resolvedTableId = localOrderType.value === 'table'
            ? (selectedTable.value?.id || selectedTable.value?.dining_table_id || null)
            : null;

        emit('apply', {
            type: localOrderType.value,
            dining_table_id: resolvedTableId,
            table_id: resolvedTableId,
            table: localOrderType.value === 'table' ? selectedTable.value : null,
            identifier: resolvedIdentifier,
            customer: finalCustomer,
            customer_phone: typeof finalCustomer === 'object' ? (finalCustomer?.phone || null) : null,
            address_id: finalAddress?.id || null,
            address: finalAddress
        });
    };

    const triggerImmediateApply = () => {
        handleApply();
    };

    const updateParentState = () => {};

    return {
        localOrderType,
        resetTableTrigger,
        orderTypeOptions,
        selectedTable,
        tableIdentifier,
        sharedCustomer,
        deliveryAddress,
        isLocalValid,
        selectOrderType,
        handleApply,
        triggerImmediateApply,
        updateParentState,
        setSelectedTable,
        setTableIdentifier,
        setSharedCustomer,
        setDeliveryAddress
    };
}
```
