```javascript
import { useCart } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart";
import { router, usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import { unref } from "vue";

export function useOrderSubmission(cartRef, editOrderId, source = 'pos_app') {
    const toast = useToast();
    const page = usePage();
    const { resetDraftState } = useCart();

    const resolveProductId = (productId, id) => {
        for (const candidate of [productId, id]) {
            if (!candidate) continue;
            if (typeof candidate === 'number') return candidate;
            const str = String(candidate);
            const match = str.match(/_prod_(\d+)/) || str.match(/(\d+)$/);
            if (match) return parseInt(match[1], 10);
            const num = parseInt(str, 10);
            if (!isNaN(num)) return num;
        }
        return null;
    }

    const executeSubmit = (payload, endpointUrl) => {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            router.post(endpointUrl, payload, {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                onSuccess: (pageResp) => {
                    if (pageResp.props.flash?.error) {
                        toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Atenção", detail: pageResp.props.flash.error, life: 5000 });
                        reject(new Error(pageResp.props.flash.error));
                        return;
                    }

                    const createdOrderId = pageResp.props.flash?.order_id
                        || pageResp.props.order_id
                        || pageResp.props.flash?.success_order_id
                        || pageResp.props.flash?.order?.id
                        || payload.order_id;

                    resetDraftState();

                    const resultData = { order: { id: createdOrderId }, id: createdOrderId };

                    const isPayNow = payload.frontend_intent === 'pay_now'
                                  || payload.intent === 'pay_now'
                                  || payload.routing?.payment_intent_status === 'pay_now';

                    if (isPayNow && createdOrderId) {
                        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-open-checkout', { detail: { orderId: createdOrderId } }));
                        resolve(resultData);
                        return;
                    }

                    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-tab-changed', { detail: 'orders' }));
                    resolve(resultData);
                },
                onError: (errors) => {
                    const message = Object.values(errors)[0] || "Erro ao processar o pedido. Revise o carrinho.";
                    toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Erro", detail: message, life: 5000 });
                    reject(errors);
                }
            });
        });
    };

    const submitOrder = (checkoutData) => {
        const settings = page.props.companySettings || {};
        const meta = checkoutData?.meta || {};
        const currentType = meta.type || 'table';

        // 🚀 O pulo do gato: Identificação direta se estamos anexando a algo existente
        const rawMetaOrderId = unref(meta.order_id) || unref(meta.existing_order_id) || unref(meta.id) || unref(checkoutData?.order_id) || unref(checkoutData?.append_to_order);
        const rawEditOrderId = unref(editOrderId);
        const resolvedOrderId = rawMetaOrderId || rawEditOrderId || null;

        const tableId = meta.table?.id || meta.dining_table_id || meta.table_id || null;
        const tableName = meta.table?.name || meta.table_number || '';
        const addressId = meta.address?.id || meta.address_id || null;

        // Validações exclusivas para "Criação de Comanda"
        if (!resolvedOrderId) {
            if (currentType === 'table' && !tableId) {
                toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Mesa Obrigatória', detail: 'Selecione uma mesa válida para lançar o pedido.', life: 4500 });
                return Promise.reject(new Error('Mesa obrigatória'));
            }

            if (currentType === 'counter') {
                const customerName = (meta.customer?.name || meta.customer_name || meta.identifier || '').trim();
                const customerId = meta.customer?.id || meta.customer_id;

                if (!customerName && !customerId) {
                    toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Identificação Obrigatória', detail: 'Para pedidos de Balcão, informe o nome ou selecione o cliente.', life: 4500 });
                    return Promise.reject(new Error('Identificação obrigatória'));
                }
            }
        }

        const cleanItems = (cartRef.value || []).map(item => ({
            cartId: item.cartId,
            id: Number(item.id),
            name: item.name,
            price: Number(item.price || 0),
            extra_price: Number(item.extra_price || item.price || 0),
            qty: Number(item.qty),
            notes: item.notes || null,
            isTakeaway: Boolean(item.isTakeaway),
            isCombo: Boolean(item.isCombo),
            replaces_item_id: item.replaces_item_id || null,
            parent_item_id: item.parent_item_id || null,
            is_combo_child: Boolean(item.is_combo_child),
            auth_reason: item.auth_reason || null,
            is_loss: item.is_loss || null,
            structuredModifiers: (item.structuredModifiers || []).map(mod => ({
                id: mod.id ? Number(mod.id) : null,
                group_id: mod.group_id ? Number(mod.group_id) : null,
                name: mod.name,
                price: Number(mod.price || 0),
                qty: Number(mod.qty || mod.quantity || 1)
            })),
            comboItems: (item.comboItems || []).map(combo => ({
                id: combo.id,
                product_id: resolveProductId(combo.product_id, combo.id),
                name: combo.name || combo.product_name || 'Subitem',
                group_id: combo.group_id ? Number(combo.group_id) : null,
                group_name: combo.group_name ?? null,
                price: Number(combo.price || 0),
                qty: Number(combo.qty || combo.quantity || 1),
                notes: combo.notes || null,
                structuredModifiers: (combo.structuredModifiers || []).map(cMod => ({
                    id: cMod.id ? Number(cMod.id) : null,
                    group_id: cMod.group_id ? Number(cMod.group_id) : null,
                    name: cMod.name,
                    price: Number(cMod.price || 0),
                    qty: Number(cMod.qty || cMod.quantity || 1)
                }))
            }))
        }));

        const payload = {
            source: source,
            items: cleanItems,
            routing: {
                ...meta,
                type: currentType,
                dining_table_id: tableId ? Number(tableId) : null,
                table_id: tableId ? Number(tableId) : null,
                table_number: tableName,
                address_id: addressId ? Number(addressId) : null,
                kitchen_print_mode: settings.kitchen_print_mode || 'station',
                kitchen_separate_multiples: settings.kitchen_separate_multiples || false
            },
            financials: checkoutData.totals,
            frontend_intent: checkoutData.frontend_intent || checkoutData.intent || meta.payment_intent_status || null,
            is_internal_operation: true
        };

        // 🚀 ROTEAMENTO: Escolhe a Rota Dedicada
        const endpointUrl = resolvedOrderId
            ? route('operations.orders.append', resolvedOrderId)
            : route('operations.orders.store');

        if (resolvedOrderId) {
            payload.order_id = resolvedOrderId; // Previne warnings em rotinas internas
        }

        return executeSubmit(payload, endpointUrl);
    };

    return { submitOrder };
}
```

```javascript
import { useOrderSubmission } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderSubmission';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { computed, ref, unref, watch } from 'vue';

export function useOrderWorkspace(cartContext, favoritesContext, editOrderData) {
    const { cart, clearCart, draftRouting, orderType } = cartContext;
    const { favorites, fetchFavorites, clearFavorites } = favoritesContext;
    const toast = useToast();

    const isFavoritesViewActive = ref(false);

    const resolvedEditOrder = computed(() => unref(editOrderData));
    const resolvedOrderId = computed(() => resolvedEditOrder.value?.id || null);

    const currentCustomerId = computed(() => {
        const meta = draftRouting.value;
        if (!meta) return null;
        return meta.customer?.id || meta.sharedCustomer?.id || meta.address?.customer_id || meta.deliveryAddress?.customer_id || null;
    });

    watch(currentCustomerId, (newId) => {
        if (newId) fetchFavorites(newId);
        else {
            clearFavorites();
            isFavoritesViewActive.value = false;
        }
    }, { immediate: true });

    watch(favorites, (newFavs) => {
        isFavoritesViewActive.value = !!(newFavs && newFavs.length > 0);
    }, { deep: true });

    const activeCartSidebarView = ref('cart');
    const stashedCheckoutData = ref(null);

    const { submitOrder } = useOrderSubmission(cart, resolvedOrderId, 'pos_app');

    const handleClearWorkspace = () => {
        clearCart();
        activeCartSidebarView.value = 'cart';
        stashedCheckoutData.value = null;

        if (window.location.search) {
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
        }
    };

    const sanitizeMeta = (rawMeta) => {
        if (!rawMeta || typeof rawMeta !== 'object') return {};

        const rawCustomer = rawMeta.customer || {};
        const rawTable = rawMeta.table || {};
        const rawAddress = rawMeta.address || {};

        let parsedNeighborhood = '';
        if (rawAddress.neighborhood) {
            parsedNeighborhood = typeof rawAddress.neighborhood === 'object'
                ? (rawAddress.neighborhood.name || '')
                : String(rawAddress.neighborhood || '');
        }

        const resolvedTableId = rawTable.id || rawMeta.dining_table_id || rawMeta.table_id || null;
        const resolvedAddressId = rawAddress.id || rawMeta.address_id || null;

        return {
            type: rawMeta.type || orderType.value || 'table',
            dining_table_id: resolvedTableId,
            table_id: resolvedTableId,
            table: (rawMeta.table || resolvedTableId) ? {
                id: resolvedTableId,
                name: rawTable.name || rawTable.number || rawMeta.table_number || ''
            } : null,
            identifier: String(rawMeta.identifier || ''),
            customer: rawMeta.customer ? {
                id: rawCustomer.id || null,
                name: rawCustomer.name || '',
                phone: rawCustomer.phone || null
            } : null,
            customer_phone: rawMeta.customer_phone || rawCustomer.phone || null,
            address_id: resolvedAddressId,
            address: rawMeta.address ? {
                id: resolvedAddressId,
                street: rawAddress.street || '',
                number: rawAddress.number || '',
                neighborhood: parsedNeighborhood,
                delivery_fee: Number(rawAddress.delivery_fee || rawAddress.fee || 0)
            } : null
        };
    };

    const handleCheckoutWrapper = (checkoutData) => {
        const rawPayload = (checkoutData instanceof Event || checkoutData?.target) ? {} : (checkoutData || {});

        const cleanMeta = sanitizeMeta(rawPayload.meta || draftRouting.value);

        const isDelivery = cleanMeta.type === 'delivery' || !!cleanMeta.address || orderType.value === 'delivery';
        const isCounter = cleanMeta.type === 'counter' || orderType.value === 'counter';

        const safePayload = {
            ...rawPayload,
            meta: cleanMeta,
            totals: rawPayload.totals || {}
        };

        if (isDelivery || isCounter) {
            safePayload.meta.type = isDelivery ? 'delivery' : 'counter';
            stashedCheckoutData.value = safePayload;
            activeCartSidebarView.value = 'payment';
        } else {
            submitOrder(safePayload);
        }
    };

    const handleInlinePaymentConfirm = (intentData) => {
        const targetOrderId = resolvedOrderId.value;

        if (targetOrderId) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                router.post(route('operations.orders.update-delivery-payment', targetOrderId), intentData, {
                    preserveScroll: true,
                    onSuccess: () => {
                        if (intentData.intent === 'pay_now' || intentData.payment_intent_status === 'pay_now') {
                            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pos-open-checkout', { detail: { orderId: targetOrderId } }));
                        }
                        activeCartSidebarView.value = 'cart';
                        resolve({ order: { id: targetOrderId }, id: targetOrderId });
                    },
                    onError: reject
                });
            });
        } else {
            if (!stashedCheckoutData.value) {
                return Promise.reject(new Error('Nenhum dado de pedido retido para checkout.'));
            }

            stashedCheckoutData.value.meta.payment_intent_status = intentData.payment_intent_status;
            stashedCheckoutData.value.meta.payment_intent_methods = intentData.payment_intent_methods;
            stashedCheckoutData.value.frontend_intent = intentData.intent || intentData.payment_intent_status;

            if (Array.isArray(intentData.payment_intent_methods)) {
                const cashMethod = intentData.payment_intent_methods.find(m => m.change_target);
                if (cashMethod) {
                    stashedCheckoutData.value.meta.change_target = cashMethod.change_target;
                }
            }

            const submissionPromise = submitOrder(stashedCheckoutData.value);
            activeCartSidebarView.value = 'cart';
            return submissionPromise;
        }
    };

    return {
        isFavoritesViewActive,
        activeCartSidebarView,
        stashedCheckoutData,
        handleClearWorkspace,
        handleCheckoutWrapper,
        handleInlinePaymentConfirm,
        handleInlineDeliveryPaymentConfirm: handleInlinePaymentConfirm
    };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Pages/Shared/Composables/usePaymentFormatting.js
```javascript
export function usePaymentFormatting() {

    // Unifica a lógica do ícone baseada na engine ou gateway do pagamento
    const getPaymentIcon = (method) => {
        if (!method) return 'pi fa-wallet';

        if (method.engine_type === 'bank_api' || method.gateway_driver) {
            if (method.category === 'pix' || String(method.gateway_driver).includes('pix')) return 'pi-qrcode';
            return 'pi-bolt';
        }

        if (method.engine_type === 'money') return 'pi-money-bill';
        return 'pi-credit-card';
    };

    // Unifica o subtítulo descritivo
    const getPaymentSubtitle = (method) => {
        if (!method) return '';

        if (method.engine_type === 'bank_api' || method.gateway_driver) return 'Pagar online agora';
        if (method.engine_type === 'money') return 'Pagamento em espécie';
        return 'A maquininha vai até você';
    };

    return { getPaymentIcon, getPaymentSubtitle };
}
```

```javascript
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';

// Variável Global: Cache Client-Side (Evita múltiplos downloads na mesma sessão)
const backendMatrix = ref(null);
const isLoadingMatrix = ref(false);

export function usePredictiveModifiers(explicitContext = null) {
    const page = usePage();

    const currentContext = computed(() => {
        if (explicitContext) return explicitContext;
        return typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.pathname.startsWith('/team')
            ? 'waiter'
            : 'customer';
    });

    const isPredictiveEnabled = computed(() => {
        const mode = page.props.companySettings?.predictive_modifiers_mode || 'disabled';

        if (mode === 'all') return true;
        if (mode === 'customer') return currentContext.value === 'customer';
        if (mode === 'waiter') return currentContext.value === 'waiter';

        return false;
    });

    const fetchMatrix = async () => {
        if (!isPredictiveEnabled.value || backendMatrix.value !== null || isLoadingMatrix.value) return;

        isLoadingMatrix.value = true;
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route('api.predictive-matrix'));
            backendMatrix.value = response.data || {};
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Erro ao carregar IA Preditiva', e);
            backendMatrix.value = {};
        } finally {
            isLoadingMatrix.value = false;
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        fetchMatrix();
    });

    const getRecommendations = (availableOptions, selectedOptions, maxChoices = 3) => {
        if (!isPredictiveEnabled.value || availableOptions.length === 0) return [];

        const selectedIds = selectedOptions.map(o => o.id);
        const unselectedOpts = availableOptions.filter(o => !selectedIds.includes(o.id) && !o.isJoker);

        if (unselectedOpts.length === 0 || selectedIds.length === 0) return [];

        const matrix = backendMatrix.value || {};

        const scores = unselectedOpts.map(opt => {
            let score = 0;
            let validConnections = 0;

            selectedIds.forEach(sId => {
                const coOccurrence = matrix[sId]?.[opt.id] || 0;

                if (coOccurrence > 0) {
                    const optionPopularity = opt.historical_weight > 0 ? opt.historical_weight : 1;
                    const affinity = coOccurrence / (optionPopularity + 10);

                    score += affinity;
                    validConnections++;
                }
            });

            // Regra AND: precisa ter saído junto com todas as seleções atuais
            if (validConnections < selectedIds.length) {
                score = 0;
            } else {
                score += (opt.historical_weight || 0) * 0.00001;
            }

            return { id: opt.id, score };
        });

        scores.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        const topScores = scores.filter(s => s.score > 0);

        if (topScores.length > 0) {
            return topScores.slice(0, maxChoices).map(s => s.id);
        }

        return [];
    };

    return { isPredictiveEnabled, getRecommendations };
}
```

```javascript
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";

export function useReorder(cartContext, activeTab, initialProductsRef) {
    const toast = useToast();

    const handleReorder = (order) => {
        const { clearCart, addToCart, orderType } = cartContext;

        clearCart();
        orderType.value = order.type || 'delivery';

        let hasMissingItems = false;
        let missingNames = [];

        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO CANÔNICA: Itens principais são aqueles SEM parent_item_id (incluindo combos)
        const parentItems = (order.items || []).filter(i => !i.parent_item_id);

        parentItems.forEach(oldItem => {
            const currentProduct = (initialProductsRef.value || []).find(p => p.id === oldItem.product_id);

            if (!currentProduct || currentProduct.status === 'out_of_stock' || currentProduct.status === 'unavailable') {
                hasMissingItems = true;
                missingNames.push(oldItem.product_name);
                return;
            }

            const itemQty = Math.max(1, Number(oldItem.quantity || 1));

            // Modificadores do item principal
            const structuredMods = (oldItem.modifiers || []).map(m => ({
                id: m.modifier_option_id || m.id,
                name: m.name,
                price: Number(m.price || 0),
                qty: Math.max(1, Number(m.quantity || 1) / itemQty),
                is_joker: !m.modifier_option_id,
                group_id: m.modifier_group_id || m.group_id || null
            }));

            // Subitens vinculados via parent_item_id
            const rawSubItems = (oldItem.sub_items || oldItem.subItems || []).length > 0
                ? (oldItem.sub_items || oldItem.subItems)
                : (order.items || []).filter(i => String(i.parent_item_id) === String(oldItem.id));

            let comboItems = null;

            if (rawSubItems.length > 0) {
                comboItems = rawSubItems.map((sub, idx) => {
                    const subQty = Math.max(1, Number(sub.quantity || 1));
                    const subMods = (sub.modifiers || []).map(m => ({
                        id: m.modifier_option_id || m.id,
                        group_id: m.modifier_group_id || m.group_id || null,
                        name: m.name,
                        price: Number(m.price || 0),
                        qty: Math.max(1, Number(m.quantity || 1) / subQty),
                        is_joker: !m.modifier_option_id
                    }));

                    return {
                        id: sub.product_id || sub.id || idx,
                        product_id: sub.product_id,
                        name: sub.product_name || sub.name,
                        product_name: sub.product_name || sub.name,
                        group_id: sub.group_id || sub.combo_group_id || null,
                        group_name: sub.group_name || '',
                        price: Number(sub.unit_price || sub.price || 0),
                        qty: subQty,
                        structuredModifiers: subMods
                    };
                });
            }

            let extraPrice = structuredMods.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.price * m.qty), 0);
            if (comboItems && comboItems.length > 0) {
                comboItems.forEach(c => {
                    extraPrice += Number(c.price || 0);
                    extraPrice += (c.structuredModifiers || []).reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.price * m.qty), 0);
                });
            }

            const isCombo = Boolean(comboItems && comboItems.length > 0) || Boolean(currentProduct.is_combo);

            addToCart({
                product: currentProduct,
                isCombo: isCombo,
                extraPrice: extraPrice,
                isTakeaway: Boolean(oldItem.is_to_go || oldItem.isTakeaway),
                comboItems: comboItems,
                structuredModifiers: structuredMods,
                orderType: order.type || orderType.value,
                qty: itemQty
            });
        });

        if (hasMissingItems) {
            toast.add({
                severity: 'warn',
                summary: 'Aviso de Estoque',
                detail: `Alguns itens não estão disponíveis hoje e foram ignorados: ${missingNames.join(', ')}`,
                life: 6000
            });
        } else {
            toast.add({
                severity: 'success',
                summary: 'Carrinho Montado!',
                detail: 'O seu pedido anterior foi carregado com sucesso.',
                life: 3000
            });
        }

        activeTab.value = 'cart';
    };

    return { handleReorder };
}
```

```javascript
import { useStorage } from '@vueuse/core';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

// Estado global compartilhado
const locations = ref([]);
const isLoading = ref(false);
const hasFetched = ref(false);
const activeAvailabilityProduct = ref(null);

// Sub-aba ativa compartilhada entre a Ilha e a Aba: 'clipboard' | 'box'
const activeSubTab = ref('clipboard');

export function useRestock(shiftId = null) {
    const toast = useToast();

    const storageKey = `team_restock_draft_shift_${shiftId || 'active'}`;
    const restockDrafts = useStorage(storageKey, {});

    const isFreeMode = computed(() => {
        return (locations.value[0]?.restock_mode || 'free') === 'free';
    });

    // No modo puxado por vendas (sales_driven), vai direto para a Caixa de coleta
    watch(isFreeMode, (free) => {
        if (!free) {
            activeSubTab.value = 'box';
        }
    }, { immediate: true });

    // 🛡️ Validação estrita de elegibilidade
    const isRestockableItem = (item) => {
        const isResale = (item?.type || '').toLowerCase() === 'resale';
        const isAvailable = (item?.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'available';
        return isResale && isAvailable;
    };

    // Contagem reativa de itens pendentes na Caixa de Coleta
    const totalBoxItemsCount = computed(() => {
        let count = 0;
        locations.value.forEach(loc => {
            const list = (loc.items || []).filter(isRestockableItem);
            list.forEach(item => {
                const qty = isFreeMode.value
                    ? Number(restockDrafts.value[item.rule_id] || 0)
                    : Number(item.suggested_restock || 0);

                if (qty > 0 || (!isFreeMode.value && item.is_critical)) {
                    count++;
                }
            });
        });
        return count;
    });

    const fetchRestockBoard = async (force = false, forceZero = false) => {
        if (hasFetched.value && !force) return;

        isLoading.value = true;
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route('operations.restock-board'), {
                headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
            });

            const payload = response.data?.data || response.data || [];
            locations.value = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : [];
            hasFetched.value = true;

            locations.value.forEach(loc => {
                const list = (loc.items || loc.tasks || []).filter(isRestockableItem);
                list.forEach(item => {
                    const id = item.rule_id || item.product_id;
                    if (loc.restock_mode === 'free') {
                        if (forceZero || restockDrafts.value[id] === undefined) {
                            restockDrafts.value[id] = 0;
                        }
                    } else {
                        restockDrafts.value[id] = Number(item.suggested_restock || 0);
                    }
                });
            });
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Erro ao buscar reposição WMS:", e);
            toast?.add({
                severity: 'error',
                summary: 'Erro',
                detail: 'Falha ao buscar quadro de reposição.',
                life: 3000
            });
        } finally {
            isLoading.value = false;
        }
    };

    const resetForNewRound = () => {
        const freshDrafts = {};
        locations.value.forEach(loc => {
            const list = (loc.items || loc.tasks || []).filter(isRestockableItem);
            list.forEach(item => {
                const id = item.rule_id || item.product_id;
                freshDrafts[id] = 0;
            });
        });

        restockDrafts.value = freshDrafts;
        activeSubTab.value = 'clipboard';

        toast?.add({
            severity: 'info',
            summary: 'Nova Rodada',
            detail: 'Contadores zerados para nova rodada de reposição.',
            life: 2500
        });
    };

    const confirmRestock = async (item, mode = 'free') => {
        const id = item.rule_id || item.product_id;
        const addedQty = Number(item.qty_to_collect || restockDrafts.value[id] || item.suggested_restock || 0);

        if (addedQty <= 0) {
            restockDrafts.value[id] = 0;
            return;
        }

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route('operations.restock-board.stock'), {
                rule_id: item.rule_id,
                added_stock: addedQty
            });

            if (response.data?.success) {
                locations.value.forEach(loc => {
                    if (loc.items) {
                        loc.items = loc.items.filter(i => i.rule_id !== item.rule_id);
                    }
                });
                locations.value = locations.value.filter(loc => loc.items && loc.items.length > 0);
                restockDrafts.value[id] = 0;

                toast?.add({
                    severity: 'success',
                    summary: 'Reposição Concluída',
                    detail: `${item.name} abastecido com +${addedQty} ${item.unit_of_measure}.`,
                    life: 2500
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Erro ao confirmar reposição:", e);
            toast?.add({
                severity: 'error',
                summary: 'Erro',
                detail: 'Não foi possível salvar a reposição no servidor.',
                life: 3000
            });
        }
    };

    const markTaskDone = (locationId, productId) => {
        const loc = locations.value.find(l => l.location_id === locationId);
        if (!loc) return;

        if (loc.items) {
            loc.items = loc.items.filter(i => i.product_id !== productId);
            if (loc.items.length === 0) locations.value = locations.value.filter(l => l.location_id !== locationId);
        }
    };

    const openAvailability = (item) => {
        activeAvailabilityProduct.value = {
            id: item.product_id,
            name: item.name,
            status: item.status,
            current_stock: item.total_stock,
            location_stock: item.current_stock,
            rule_id: item.rule_id,
            location_name: item.location_name
        };
    };

    const closeAvailability = () => {
        activeAvailabilityProduct.value = null;
    };

    const clearRestock = () => {
        locations.value = [];
        hasFetched.value = false;
        restockDrafts.value = {};
    };

    const totalItemsToRestock = computed(() => {
        return locations.value.reduce((total, loc) => {
            const list = (loc.items || []).filter(isRestockableItem);
            return total + list.filter(item => (item.suggested_restock > 0 || item.is_critical)).length;
        }, 0);
    });

    const totalCriticalItems = computed(() => {
        return locations.value.reduce((total, loc) => total + (loc.critical_count || 0), 0);
    });

    return {
        locations,
        isLoading,
        restockDrafts,
        activeAvailabilityProduct,
        activeSubTab,
        isFreeMode,
        totalBoxItemsCount,
        fetchRestockBoard,
        resetForNewRound,
        confirmRestock,
        markTaskDone,
        openAvailability,
        closeAvailability,
        clearRestock,
        totalItemsToRestock,
        totalCriticalItems
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';

const isAttendanceModalVisible = ref(false);
const attendanceActionType = ref('mid_shift');
const isFreelancerPaymentVisible = ref(false);
const freelancerToPay = ref(null);
const freelancerPayoutDetails = ref({});

export function useShiftAttendance() {
    const openMidShiftAttendance = () => {
        attendanceActionType.value = 'mid_shift';
        isAttendanceModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const openShiftAttendanceFlow = (type) => {
        attendanceActionType.value = type;
        isAttendanceModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const syncMidShiftAttendance = (attendeesArray, onSuccessCallback) => {
        router.post(route('operations.attendance.sync'), { attendees: attendeesArray }, { preserveState: true, 
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isAttendanceModalVisible.value = false;
                if (onSuccessCallback) onSuccessCallback();
            },
            onError: () => alert("Erro ao atualizar a equipe. Verifique sua conexão.")
        });
    };

    // 🚀 Busca a apuração de consumo e diária do backend antes de abrir o modal
    const processFreelancerPayment = async (user, rate = null) => {
        freelancerToPay.value = user;

        try {
            const resp = await axios.get(route('operations.attendance.payout-details', user.id));
            freelancerPayoutDetails.value = resp.data;
        } catch (e) {
            // Fallback se a requisição assíncrona falhar
            freelancerPayoutDetails.value = {
                user: { id: user.id, name: user.name },
                gross_rate: Number(rate || user.base_remuneration || user.default_rate || 0),
                consumption_amount: 0,
                net_amount: Number(rate || user.base_remuneration || user.default_rate || 0)
            };
        }

        isFreelancerPaymentVisible.value = true;
    };

    const confirmFreelancerPayment = (payload) => {
        router.post(route('operations.attendance.pay'), { preserveState: true, 
            user_id: freelancerToPay.value.id,
            amount: payload.amount,
            gross_rate: payload.gross_rate,
            consumption_deducted: payload.consumption_deducted,
            payment_method: payload.method,
            bank_account_id: payload.bankAccountId
        }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                isFreelancerPaymentVisible.value = false;
                freelancerToPay.value = null;
                freelancerPayoutDetails.value = {};
            },
            onError: (err) => {
                const msg = err && typeof err === 'object' ? Object.values(err)[0] : 'Erro ao processar pagamento.';
                alert(msg);
            }
        });
    };

    return {
        isAttendanceModalVisible,
        attendanceActionType,
        isFreelancerPaymentVisible,
        freelancerToPay,
        freelancerPayoutDetails,
        openMidShiftAttendance,
        openShiftAttendanceFlow,
        syncMidShiftAttendance,
        processFreelancerPayment,
        confirmFreelancerPayment
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export function useSlideToConfirm(props, emit, trackRef, thumbRef) {
    const isDragging = ref(false);
    const isAnimatingHint = ref(false);
    const thumbOpacity = ref(1);
    const dragOffset = ref(0);
    const startX = ref(0);
    const hasMoved = ref(false);
    let activeTouchId = null;

    const getMaxOffset = () => {
        if (trackRef.value && thumbRef.value) {
            const calculated = trackRef.value.offsetWidth - thumbRef.value.offsetWidth - 8;
            return Math.max(calculated, 40);
        }
        return 80;
    };

    const resetSlider = () => {
        isDragging.value = false;
        dragOffset.value = 0;
        thumbOpacity.value = 1;
        cleanupGlobalListeners();
    };

    watch(() => props.isLoading, (loading, oldLoading) => {
        if (!loading && oldLoading && !props.isSuccess) {
            resetSlider();
        }
    });

    const triggerHintAnimation = () => {
        if (isAnimatingHint.value || isDragging.value) return;
        isAnimatingHint.value = true;
        const maxOffset = getMaxOffset();
        dragOffset.value = Math.min(maxOffset, 45);

        setTimeout(() => {
            thumbOpacity.value = 0;
            setTimeout(() => {
                dragOffset.value = 0;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    thumbOpacity.value = 1;
                    setTimeout(() => { isAnimatingHint.value = false; }, 200);
                }, 100);
            }, 200);
        }, 300);
    };

    const handleTrackInteraction = () => {
        if (props.disabled || props.isLoading || props.isSuccess || isAnimatingHint.value || isDragging.value) return;
        triggerHintAnimation();
    };

    const onDrag = (e) => {
        if (!isDragging.value) return;

        let clientX = 0;
        if (e.type.includes('touch')) {
            const touch = Array.from(e.touches).find(t => t.identifier === activeTouchId) || e.touches[0];
            if (!touch) return;
            clientX = touch.clientX;
            if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
        } else {
            clientX = e.clientX;
        }

        let newOffset = clientX - startX.value;
        if (Math.abs(newOffset) > 5) hasMoved.value = true;

        const maxOffset = getMaxOffset();
        if (newOffset < 0) newOffset = 0;
        if (newOffset > maxOffset) newOffset = maxOffset;

        dragOffset.value = newOffset;
    };

    const endDrag = () => {
        if (!isDragging.value) return;
        isDragging.value = false;
        cleanupGlobalListeners();

        const maxOffset = getMaxOffset();
        const target = maxOffset * 0.70;

        if (dragOffset.value >= target) {
            dragOffset.value = maxOffset;
            emit('confirm');
        } else if (!hasMoved.value || dragOffset.value < 10) {
            triggerHintAnimation();
        } else {
            dragOffset.value = 0;
        }
    };

    const cancelDrag = () => {
        if (!isDragging.value) return;
        resetSlider();
    };

    const startDrag = (e) => {
        if (props.disabled || props.isLoading || props.isSuccess) return;

        isAnimatingHint.value = false;
        isDragging.value = true;
        hasMoved.value = false;

        if (e.type.includes('touch')) {
            const touch = e.touches[0];
            activeTouchId = touch.identifier;
            startX.value = touch.clientX;

            window.addEventListener('touchmove', onDrag, { passive: false });
            window.addEventListener('touchend', endDrag);
            window.addEventListener('touchcancel', cancelDrag);
        } else {
            startX.value = e.clientX;
            window.addEventListener('mousemove', onDrag);
            window.addEventListener('mouseup', endDrag);
        }

        if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    };

    const cleanupGlobalListeners = () => {
        activeTouchId = null;
        window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onDrag);
        window.removeEventListener('mouseup', endDrag);
        window.removeEventListener('touchmove', onDrag);
        window.removeEventListener('touchend', endDrag);
        window.removeEventListener('touchcancel', cancelDrag);
    };

    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        cleanupGlobalListeners();
    });

    return {
        isDragging, isAnimatingHint, dragOffset,
        handleTrackInteraction, startDrag, onDrag, endDrag, triggerHintAnimation, resetSlider
    };
}
```

```vue
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted, nextTick } from 'vue';
import SlideToConfirm from "@/Components/UI/SlideToConfirm.vue";
import { dynamicIslandTypeOverride } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useDynamicIsland';

const props = defineProps({

    showSummary: Boolean,
    showTakeaway: { type: Boolean, default: true },

    progress: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    totalItems: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    hasItems: { type: Boolean, default: null },
    isLastStep: Boolean,

    const path = window.location.pathname;
    return path.startsWith('/team') || path.startsWith('/pos') || path.startsWith('/waiter');
});

const isMounted = ref(false);

onMounted(() => {
    // 🚀 Timer protetor de montagem do Teleport
    setTimeout(() => {

            isMounted.value = true;
        });
    }, 100);
});

const itemsCountDisplay = computed(() => {

});

);

onUnmounted(() => {
```

```vue
<template>
    <button
        type="button"
        @click="handleClick"
        :disabled="isDisabled"
        class="relative overflow-hidden p-option transition-all duration-300 outline-none! text-left group flex flex-col justify-end"
        :class="[
            layout === 'square' || layout === 'grid'
                ? 'w-full aspect-[3/4] rounded-2xl border border-transparent hover:border-primary-500/50'
                : 'w-full min-h-[100px] rounded-2xl border border-transparent',
            isDisabled ? 'grayscale opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : 'cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.98]'
        ]"
    >
        <!-- 🖼️ IMAGEM FULL-BLEED DE FUNDO -->
        <img
            v-if="finalImageUrl"
            :src="finalImageUrl"
            class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500"
            loading="lazy"
        />
        <div
            v-else
            class="absolute inset-0 bg-surface-2 flex items-center justify-center"
        >
            <i class="pi pi-image text-surface-muted/30 text-3xl"></i>
        </div>

        <!-- 🌑 SCRIM GRADIENTE ESCURO NA BASE (SEM DIVISÃO) -->
        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/95 via-black/50 to-transparent pointer-events-none"></div>

        <!-- 📝 INFOS DO PRODUTO SOBREPOSTAS NA BASE -->
        <div class="relative z-10 p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-end w-full min-w-0">
            <h3 class="font-black text-white text-sm leading-tight break-words drop-shadow-md">
                {{ productName }}
            </h3>

            <p
                v-if="productDescription"
                class="text-[11px] font-medium text-white/75 leading-snug w-full mt-1 line-clamp-2 drop-shadow"
            >
                {{ productDescription }}
            </p>
        </div>
    </button>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";

const props = defineProps({
    item: { type: Object, required: true },
    disabled: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    hasModifiers: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    layout: { type: String, default: "square" }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["add"]);
const page = usePage();

const productName = computed(() => {
    return props.item?.product_name || props.item?.product?.name || props.item?.name || "";
});

const productDescription = computed(() => {
    return props.item?.description || props.item?.product?.description || "";
});

const isOutOfStock = computed(() => {
    const prod = props.item?.product || props.item || {};
    if (["out_of_stock", "unavailable", "paused"].includes(prod.status)) return true;
    if (prod.track_inventory && parseFloat(prod.current_stock) <= 0) return true;
    return false;
});

const isDisabled = computed(() => props.disabled || isOutOfStock.value);

const finalImageUrl = computed(() => {
    if (!props.item) return null;

    // 1. Imagem do próprio item de combo ou do produto
    const itemOrProd = props.item.product || props.item;
    const path = props.item.image || props.item.image_path || itemOrProd.image || itemOrProd.image_path;
    if (path) {
        const ts = props.item.updated_at || itemOrProd.updated_at
            ? new Date(props.item.updated_at || itemOrProd.updated_at).getTime()
            : "";
        return path.startsWith("http") ? path : `/media/file?path=${path}${ts ? `&v=${ts}` : ""}`;
    }

    // 2. Busca pela categoria do produto e escala na árvore de categorias-mãe
    const categories = page?.props?.initialCategories || page?.props?.categories || [];
    const products = page?.props?.initialProducts || [];

    let currentCatId = props.item.category_id || itemOrProd.category_id;
    if (!currentCatId) {
        const prodId = props.item.product_id || props.item.id;
        const foundProd = products.find(p => String(p.id) === String(prodId));
        if (foundProd) {
            currentCatId = foundProd.category_id;
        }
    }

    let depth = 0;
    while (currentCatId && depth < 10) {
        const cat = categories.find(c => String(c.id) === String(currentCatId));
        if (!cat) break;
        const catPath = cat.image_path || cat.image;
        if (catPath) {
            const ts = cat.updated_at ? new Date(cat.updated_at).getTime() : "";
            return catPath.startsWith("http") ? catPath : `/media/file?path=${catPath}${ts ? `&v=${ts}` : ""}`;
        }
        currentCatId = cat.parent_id && Number(cat.parent_id) !== 0 ? cat.parent_id : null;
        depth++;
    }

    return null;
});

const handleClick = () => {
    if (isDisabled.value) return;
    emit("add", props.item, true);
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";

const props = defineProps({
    allSelections: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    groups: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    helpers: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    isFirstStep: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isLastStep: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isValid: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isTeamMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isCustomerMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['edit', 'remove', 'cancel', 'next', 'select-step']);

const isTeamApp = computed(() => {
    if (props.isTeamMode) return true;
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    const path = window.location.pathname;
    return path.startsWith('/team') || path.startsWith('/waiter');
});

const showFooter = computed(() => {
    return !props.isCustomerMode && !props.isTeamMode && !isTeamApp.value;
});

const resolveGroupDetails = (groupId, sel = null) => {
    const group = (props.groups || []).find(g => String(g.id) === String(groupId))
        || sel?.group
        || null;

    const title = group?.instruction || group?.name || sel?.groupName || sel?.item?.group_name || 'Item do Combo';
    const maxChoices = Number(group?.max_choices) || 1;

    return { title, maxChoices };
};

const getModifiersSummary = (sel) => {
    const mods = sel.structuredModifiers || [];
    if (!Array.isArray(mods) || mods.length === 0) return '';
    return mods.map(m => `${(Number(m.qty || 1) > 1) ? m.qty + 'x ' : ''}${m.name}`).join(', ');
};

const stepGroups = computed(() => {
    const map = new Map();

    if (props.groups && props.groups.length > 0) {
        props.groups.forEach(g => {
            const gId = g.id ?? g.group_id ?? 'default';
            const details = resolveGroupDetails(gId);
            map.set(String(gId), {
                groupId: gId,
                title: details.title,
                maxChoices: details.maxChoices,
                itemsMap: new Map(),
                totalQty: 0
            });
        });
    }

    props.allSelections.forEach(sel => {
        const gId = String(sel.groupId ?? 'default');

        if (!map.has(gId)) {
            const details = resolveGroupDetails(sel.groupId, sel);
            map.set(gId, {
                groupId: sel.groupId,
                title: details.title,
                maxChoices: details.maxChoices,
                itemsMap: new Map(),
                totalQty: 0
            });
        }

        const step = map.get(gId);
        step.totalQty += 1;

        // 🚀 ASSINATURA ESTRUTURADA: Depende exclusivamente dos IDs e quantidades dos modificadores
        const modsSignature = (sel.structuredModifiers || [])
            .map(m => `${m.id || m.name}:${m.qty || 1}`)
            .sort()
            .join('|');
        const signature = `${sel.groupId}-${sel.item?.product_id || sel.item?.id}-${modsSignature}`;

        if (step.itemsMap.has(signature)) {
            const existing = step.itemsMap.get(signature);
            existing.qty++;
            existing.instanceIds.push(sel.instanceId);
        } else {
            step.itemsMap.set(signature, {
                signature,
                qty: 1,
                instanceIds: [sel.instanceId],
                instanceId: sel.instanceId,
                item: sel.item,
                structuredModifiers: sel.structuredModifiers || [],
                extraPrice: Number(sel.extraPrice || 0)
            });
        }
    });

    return Array.from(map.values()).map(step => ({
        groupId: step.groupId,
        title: step.title,
        maxChoices: step.maxChoices,
        totalQty: step.totalQty,
        remainingChoices: Math.max(0, step.maxChoices - step.totalQty),
        items: Array.from(step.itemsMap.values())
    }));
});

const totalItemPrice = (sel) => {
    const additional = Number(sel.item?.additional_price || 0);
    const extra = Number(sel.extraPrice || 0);
    return (additional + extra) * sel.qty;
};

const removeGroup = (instanceIds) => {
    instanceIds.forEach(id => {
        emit('remove', id);
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
                >

                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 📊 BARRA DE PROGRESSO DA ETAPA -->
            <div v-if="maxChoices > 1" class="pt-1">
                <ProgressBar
                    :current="selectionsCount"
                    :max="maxChoices"
                    mode="quantity"
                />
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 📜 ÁREA DE ROLAGEM DEDICADA: Grid de até 4 Colunas no Desktop -->

            class="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain touch-pan-y hide-scrollbar pb-4 pr-1"
            :class="productCardLayout === 'square'
                ? 'grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 auto-rows-max'
                : 'grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 auto-rows-max'"
        >
            <ComboItemCard
                v-for="item in (group?.items || [])"
                :key="item.id"
                :item="item"
                :disabled="!canAddMore && maxChoices > 1"
                :has-modifiers="helpers?.hasModifiers(item)"
                :layout="productCardLayout"
                class="shrink-0"
                @add="$emit('add',$event, true)"
            />

<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import ComboItemCard from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ComboItemCard.vue";
import ProgressBar from "@/Components/UI/ProgressBar.vue";
import { usePosSettings } from "@/Pages/Pos/Composables/usePosSettings";

const { productCardLayout } = usePosSettings();

const props = defineProps({
    group: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    allGroups: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    currentStep: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    canAddMore: { type: Boolean, default: true },
    helpers: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
    selectionsCount: { type: Number, default: 0 }
});

defineEmits(["add"]);

const maxChoices = computed(() => Number(props.group?.max_choices) || 1);
const minChoices = computed(() => Number(props.group?.min_choices) || 1);

const remainingChoices = computed(() => Math.max(0, maxChoices.value - (props.selectionsCount || 0)));
const isStepComplete = computed(() => (props.selectionsCount || 0) >= maxChoices.value);

const feedbackText = computed(() => {
    if (!props.group || Object.keys(props.group).length === 0) return "";

    if (maxChoices.value === 1) {
        return (props.selectionsCount || 0) >= 1
            ? "Opção selecionada! Você pode trocar clicando em outro item."
            : "Selecione 1 opção para avançar.";
    }

    if (isStepComplete.value) {
        return "Passo completo! Você já pode avançar para a próxima etapa.";
    }

    if ((props.selectionsCount || 0) > 0) {
        return `Você escolheu ${props.selectionsCount}. Falta${remainingChoices.value > 1 ? "m" : ""} ${remainingChoices.value} ${remainingChoices.value === 1 ? "opção" : "opções"}.`;
    }

    if (minChoices.value === maxChoices.value) {
        return `Escolha ${maxChoices.value} opções para este passo.`;
    }

    return `Selecione de ${minChoices.value} a ${maxChoices.value} opções.`;
});
</script>
```

```vue
                    :can-add-more="canAddMore"
                    :helpers="comboHelpers"
                    :selections-count="getSelectionsCountForGroup(currentGroup.id)"
                    @add="addCatalogItemToTray"
                    class="w-full h-full"

            <div v-show="!(isTeamMode || isCustomerMode) || showMobileSummary" class="w-full md:w-[320px] lg:w-[360px] shrink-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden min-h-0 animate-in slide-in-from-right-4 duration-300" :class="(isTeamMode || isCustomerMode) ? 'bg-surface-1 border-t border-surface-border pt-2' : 'bg-surface-3 rounded-3xl rounded-l-lg'">

                    :all-selections="globalSelectionsArray"

                <ProductModifiers
                    :product="modifyingProduct"
                    :is-edit-mode="isEditingComboItem"
                    :is-team-mode="isTeamMode"
                    :is-customer-mode="isCustomerMode"
                    :breadcrumbs="[...resolvedBreadcrumbs, product?.name]"
                    @confirm="handleModifierConfirm"
                    @close="showInnerModifiers = false"
                />
            </div>
        </Transition>

<script setup>
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
const page = usePage();

import { computed, watch, onUnmounted, ref, onMounted } from 'vue';

import ProductHeader from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ProductHeader.vue";
import ComboStepGrid from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ComboStepGrid.vue";
import ComboSidebar from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ComboSidebar.vue";
import ProductModifiers from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ProductModifiers.vue";
import ComboDynamicNav from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ComboDynamicNav.vue";
import ProgressBar from "@/Components/UI/ProgressBar.vue";

import { useComboWizard } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useComboWizard";
import { dynamicIslandTypeOverride } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useDynamicIsland";

const props = defineProps({
    product: Object,
    orderType: String,
    breadcrumbs: { type: [Array, Object], default: () => [] },
    isEditMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isTeamMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isCustomerMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    globalProductsList: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['close', 'crumb-click', 'confirm-combo', 'update:total']);

const isMounted = ref(false);
onMounted(() => { isMounted.value = true; });

const resolvedBreadcrumbs = computed(() => {
    // 1. Tenta resolver a árvore a partir do category_id do produto
    const catId = props.product?.category_id || props.product?.category?.id;
    const globalCategories = page?.props?.initialCategories || page?.props?.categories || [];

    const path = [];
    let currentId = catId;
    let depth = 0;

    while (currentId && depth < 10) {
        const cat = globalCategories.find(c => String(c.id) === String(currentId));
        if (!cat) break;
        path.unshift({ label: cat.name || cat.label, id: cat.id });
        currentId = cat.parent_id && Number(cat.parent_id) !== 0 ? cat.parent_id : null;
        depth++;
    }

    if (path.length > 0) {
        return [{ label: 'Início', id: null }, ...path];
    }

    // 2. Fallback: Se props.breadcrumbs for o objeto do useCatalogBreadcrumbs ({ items, active })
    if (props.breadcrumbs && typeof props.breadcrumbs === 'object' && !Array.isArray(props.breadcrumbs)) {
        const items = props.breadcrumbs.items || [];
        const active = props.breadcrumbs.active;
        const result = [...items];
        if (active && active !== 'Início') {
            result.push({ label: active, id: null });
        }
        if (result.length > 0) return result;
    }

    // 3. Fallback: Array regular
    const raw = Array.isArray(props.breadcrumbs)
        ? props.breadcrumbs
        : (props.breadcrumbs?.items || []);

    if (raw.length > 0) {
        const cleaned = raw.map(b => typeof b === 'string' ? { label: b, id: null } : b);
        return [{ label: 'Início', id: null }, ...cleaned];
    }

    return [{ label: 'Início', id: null }];
});

const {
    currentStepIndex, showMobileSummary, showInnerModifiers, modifyingProduct, isAdding, isAddSuccess,
    currentGroup, isLastStep, canAddMore, globalSelectionsArray, comboHelpers, isCurrentStepValid,
    comboProgressMax, comboProgressCurrent, wizardTotal, addCatalogItemToTray, openModifiers,
    handleModifierConfirm, removeSelection, handleMobileBack, handleBackOrCancel, nextStep, handleClearCombo,
    isEditingComboItem, canGoBack, getSelectionsCountForGroup
} = useComboWizard(props, emit);

// 🚀 NAVEGAÇÃO DIRETA PARA O PASSO AO CLICAR NO SLOT FALTANTE
const handleStepSelect = (step) => {
    const groups = props.product?.combo_groups || [];
    const targetIndex = groups.findIndex(g => String(g.id ?? g.group_id) === String(step.groupId));
    if (targetIndex !== -1) {
        currentStepIndex.value = targetIndex;
        showMobileSummary.value = false;
    }
};

watch(wizardTotal, (newTotal) => {
    emit('update:total', newTotal);
}, { immediate: true });

watch(showInnerModifiers, (isShowing) => {
    dynamicIslandTypeOverride.value = isShowing ? 'modifier' : null;
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    dynamicIslandTypeOverride.value = null;
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.page-fade-enter-active, .page-fade-leave-active { transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; }
.page-fade-enter-from, .page-fade-leave-to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
</style>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted, nextTick } from 'vue';
import SlideToConfirm from "@/Components/UI/SlideToConfirm.vue";
import { dynamicIslandTypeOverride } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useDynamicIsland';

defineProps({

    showTakeaway: { type: Boolean, default: true },
    isTakeaway: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isEditMode: Boolean,
    isValid: Boolean,
    isAdding: Boolean,
    isAddSuccess: Boolean
});

defineEmits(['back', 'toggle-takeaway', 'confirm']);

const isTeamApp = computed(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    const path = window.location.pathname;
    return path.startsWith('/team') || path.startsWith('/pos') || path.startsWith('/waiter');
});

const isMounted = ref(false);

onMounted(() => {
    // 🚀 O delay permite que o v-if da Ilha insira a div '#island-portal-target'

    }, 100);
});

watch(
    isTeamApp,
    (isTeam) => {
        dynamicIslandTypeOverride.value = isTeam ? 'two-rows' : 'single-row';
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

onUnmounted(() => {
    dynamicIslandTypeOverride.value = null;
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import ProgressBar from "@/Components/UI/ProgressBar.vue";
import QtyStepper from "@/Components/UI/QtyStepper.vue";
import { usePredictiveModifiers } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/usePredictiveModifiers';

const props = defineProps({
    group: Object,
    helpers: Object,
    isTeamMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const page = usePage();
const { getRecommendations } = usePredictiveModifiers();

const outOfStockMode = computed(() => {
    return page?.props?.companySettings?.out_of_stock_mode || 'disable_bottom';
});

const isOptionUnavailable = (opt) => {
    if (!opt) return false;
    if (opt.isJoker) return false;
    return opt.is_active === false || opt.is_active === 0 || opt.is_active === '0';
};

const processOptionsByStock = (optionsList) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(optionsList)) return [];
    const mode = outOfStockMode.value;

    if (mode === 'hide') {
        return optionsList.filter(opt => !isOptionUnavailable(opt));
    }

    if (mode === 'disable_bottom') {
        return [...optionsList].sort((a, b) => {
            const aBlocked = isOptionUnavailable(a);
            const bBlocked = isOptionUnavailable(b);
            if (aBlocked && !bBlocked) return 1;
            if (!aBlocked && bBlocked) return -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }

    return optionsList;
};

const isCloudRender = computed(() => {
    return !props.group.allow_quantity || props.group.type === 'observation';
});

const progressMax = computed(() => {
    return props.group.max_selections > 0 ? props.group.max_selections : props.group.max_free;
});

const currentProgress = computed(() => {
    let total = 0;
    const allOpts = props.helpers.getOptionsWithJoker(props.group);
    allOpts.forEach(opt => {
        if (props.group.allow_quantity && !isCloudRender.value) {
            total += props.helpers.getQty(props.group, opt) || 0;
        } else {
            if (props.helpers.isSelected(props.group, opt)) total += 1;
        }
    });
    return total;
});

const sortedCloudOptionsBase = computed(() => {
    if (!isCloudRender.value) return [];
    const opts = [...props.helpers.getOptionsWithJoker(props.group)];
    return opts.sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.isJoker) return 1;
        if (b.isJoker) return -1;
        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
});

const processedStepperOptions = computed(() => {
    return processOptionsByStock(props.helpers.getOptionsWithJoker(props.group));
});

const processedCloudOptions = computed(() => {
    return processOptionsByStock(sortedCloudOptionsBase.value);
});

// Retrocompatibilidade no template:
const sortedCloudOptions = computed(() => processedCloudOptions.value);

const predictedOptionIds = computed(() => {
    if (!isCloudRender.value || props.group.type !== 'ingredient') return [];

    const available = props.helpers.getOptionsWithJoker(props.group);
    const selected = available.filter(opt => props.helpers.isSelected(props.group, opt));
    const limit = props.group.max_selections > 0 ? props.group.max_selections : 3;

    if (props.group.max_selections > 0 && selected.length >= props.group.max_selections) {
        return [];
    }

    return getRecommendations(available, selected, limit);
});

const isPredicted = (optId) => {
    return predictedOptionIds.value.some(id => String(id) === String(optId));
};

const getQtyDisplay = (opt) => {
    if (props.group.allow_quantity) {
        return props.helpers.getQty(props.group, opt);
    }
    return props.helpers.isSelected(props.group, opt) ? 1 : 0;
};

const getMaxQty = (opt) => {
    if (!props.group.allow_quantity) return 1;
    if (isOptionUnavailable(opt)) return 0;
    if (props.helpers.isDisabled(props.group, opt)) return getQtyDisplay(opt);
    return null;
};

const handleStepperUpdate = (opt, newVal) => {
    if (isOptionUnavailable(opt)) return;
    const current = getQtyDisplay(opt);
    if (newVal > current) {
        if (props.group.allow_quantity) props.helpers.updateQty(props.group, opt, 1);
        else if (!props.helpers.isSelected(props.group, opt)) props.helpers.toggleSelection(props.group, opt);
    } else if (newVal < current) {
        if (props.group.allow_quantity) props.helpers.updateQty(props.group, opt, -1);
        else if (props.helpers.isSelected(props.group, opt)) props.helpers.toggleSelection(props.group, opt);
    }
};

const getCalculatedPrice = (opt) => {
    const qty = getQtyDisplay(opt);
    const unitPrice = props.helpers.getEffectivePrice(props.group, opt);
    if (qty > 1 && props.group.allow_quantity) return unitPrice * qty;
    return unitPrice;
};

const formatCleanCurrency = (value) => {
    const formatted = formatCurrency(value);
    return formatted.replace(',00', '').replace('.00', '');
};
</script>
```

```vue
        <!-- MODO PDV / EQUIPE (B2B) -->
        <template v-else>
            <!-- LINHA 1: BREADCRUMBS NO TOPO (Alinhado com o catálogo) -->
            <div v-if="showBreadcrumbs && normalizedItems.length > 0" class="flex-1 min-w-0 flex items-center mb-2">
                <Breadcrumb
                    :items="normalizedItems"
                    :is-edit-mode="isEditMode"
                    :last-item-clickable="true"
                    size="sm"
                    @navigate="(item) => $emit('crumb-click', item)"
                />
            </div>

            <!-- LINHA 2: NOME DO PRODUTO & PREÇO -->
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center gap-4 shrink-0 w-full min-h-[40px]">
                <h1 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-surface-text leading-tight tracking-tight break-words flex-1 min-w-0">
                    {{ title }}
                </h1>

                <div class="flex items-center shrink-0">
                    <span class="text-3xl font-black leading-none tracking-tight">
                        {{ $formatCurrency(total) }}
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </template>

        <!-- Barra de Progresso (Combos) -->

            <ProgressBar :current="progressCurrent" :max="progressMax" />
        </div>

<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import ProgressBar from "@/Components/UI/ProgressBar.vue";
import Breadcrumb from "@/Components/UI/Breadcrumb.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    title: { type: String, required: true },
    breadcrumbs: { type: [Array, Object], default: () => [] },
    showBreadcrumbs: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    total: { type: Number, required: true },
    isValid: { type: Boolean, default: true },
    isEditMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    progressCurrent: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    progressMax: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    hideBackBtn: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isCustomerMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

defineEmits(['close', 'crumb-click']);

const normalizedItems = computed(() => {
    if (Array.isArray(props.breadcrumbs)) {
        return props.breadcrumbs.length > 0 ? props.breadcrumbs : [{ label: 'Início', id: null }];
    }
    if (props.breadcrumbs && typeof props.breadcrumbs === 'object') {
        const items = Array.isArray(props.breadcrumbs.items) ? [...props.breadcrumbs.items] : [];
        if (props.breadcrumbs.active && !['início', 'inicio', 'home'].includes(String(props.breadcrumbs.active).toLowerCase().trim())) {
            items.push({ label: props.breadcrumbs.active, id: null });
        }
        if (items.length > 0) return items;
    }
    return [{ label: 'Início', id: null }];
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, computed, onMounted } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useModifiers } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useModifiers";

import ProductHeader from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ProductHeader.vue";
import ModifierTabs from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ModifierTabs.vue";
import ModifierOptionsGroup from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ModifierOptionsGroup.vue";
import QtyStepper from "@/Components/UI/QtyStepper.vue";
import Breadcrumb from "@/Components/UI/Breadcrumb.vue";
import ModifierDynamicNav from "@/Pages/Shared/Configurators/ModifierDynamicNav.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    product: Object,
    orderType: { type: String, default: null },
    isEditMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isTeamMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isCustomerMode: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    breadcrumbs: { type: [Array, Object], default: () => [] }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["confirm", "close", "crumb-click", "update:total"]);
const page = usePage();

const isMounted = ref(false);
onMounted(() => { isMounted.value = true; });

const isPredictiveEnabled = computed(() => {
    const mode = page.props.companySettings?.predictive_modifiers_mode || 'disabled';
    return mode === 'all' || mode === 'waiter';
});

const resolvedBreadcrumbs = computed(() => {
    const catId = props.product?.category_id || props.product?.category?.id;
    const globalCategories = page.props.initialCategories || [];

    const path = [];
    let currentId = catId;
    let depth = 0;

    while (currentId && depth < 10) {
        const cat = globalCategories.find(c => String(c.id) === String(currentId));
        if (!cat) break;
        path.unshift({ label: cat.name, id: cat.id });
        currentId = cat.parent_id && Number(cat.parent_id) !== 0 ? cat.parent_id : null;
        depth++;
    }

    if (path.length > 0) {
        return [{ label: 'Início', id: null }, ...path];
    }

    if (props.breadcrumbs && typeof props.breadcrumbs === 'object' && !Array.isArray(props.breadcrumbs)) {
        const items = props.breadcrumbs.items || [];
        const active = props.breadcrumbs.active;
        const result = [...items];
        if (active && !['início', 'inicio', 'home'].includes(String(active).toLowerCase().trim())) {
            result.push({ label: active, id: null });
        }
        if (result.length > 0) return result;
    }

    const raw = Array.isArray(props.breadcrumbs)
        ? props.breadcrumbs
        : (props.breadcrumbs?.items || []);

    if (raw.length > 0) {
        const cleaned = raw.map(b => typeof b === 'string' ? { label: b, id: null } : b);
        return [{ label: 'Início', id: null }, ...cleaned];
    }

    return [{ label: 'Início', id: null }];
});

const stateHelpers = useModifiers(false);
const itemObservation = ref("");
const activeTab = ref(null);
const localQuantity = ref(1);
const maxQuantity = computed(() => props.product?.cartItem?.maxQty || 99);
const isTakeaway = ref(false);

const isAdding = ref(false);
const isAddSuccess = ref(false);

// 🚀 NORMALIZADOR DE MACRO-TIPOS
const normalizeType = (type) => {
    const t = String(type || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (t === 'ingredient' || t === 'ingrediente') return 'ingredient';
    if (t === 'add_on' || t === 'additional' || t === 'adicional' || t === 'addon') return 'add_on';
    if (t === 'observation' || t === 'observacao' || t === 'observação') return 'observation';
    return 'add_on';
};

// 🎯 COMPILADOR DAS MACRO-ABAS (Máximo 3 abas semânticas)
const allTabs = computed(() => {
    const mods = props.product?.modifiers || [];
    const tabs = [];

    const ingredientGroups = mods.filter(g => normalizeType(g.type) === 'ingredient');
    const addonGroups = mods.filter(g => normalizeType(g.type) === 'add_on');
    const observationGroups = mods.filter(g => normalizeType(g.type) === 'observation');

    if (ingredientGroups.length > 0) {
        const hasReq = ingredientGroups.some(g => (g.min_selections || 0) > 0);
        const isComp = ingredientGroups.every(g => stateHelpers.isGroupSatisfied(g));
        tabs.push({
            id: 'ingredient',
            label: 'Ingredientes',
            icon: 'pi-sparkles',
            groupCount: ingredientGroups.length,
            hasRequired: hasReq,
            hasPendingRequired: hasReq && !isComp,
            isComplete: isComp,
            groups: ingredientGroups
        });
    }

    if (addonGroups.length > 0) {
        const hasReq = addonGroups.some(g => (g.min_selections || 0) > 0);
        const isComp = addonGroups.every(g => stateHelpers.isGroupSatisfied(g));
        tabs.push({
            id: 'add_on',
            label: 'Adicionais',
            icon: 'pi-plus-circle',
            groupCount: addonGroups.length,
            hasRequired: hasReq,
            hasPendingRequired: hasReq && !isComp,
            isComplete: isComp,
            groups: addonGroups
        });
    }

    // A aba Observações recebe instruções livres para a cozinha e eventuais opções de remoção
    const hasReq = observationGroups.some(g => (g.min_selections || 0) > 0);
    const isComp = observationGroups.every(g => stateHelpers.isGroupSatisfied(g));
    tabs.push({
        id: 'observation',
        label: 'Observações',
        icon: 'pi-pen-to-square',
        groupCount: observationGroups.length,
        hasRequired: hasReq,
        hasPendingRequired: hasReq && !isComp,
        isComplete: isComp,
        groups: observationGroups
    });

    return tabs;
});

const currentTab = computed(() => allTabs.value.find(t => t.id === activeTab.value) || allTabs.value[0]);
const currentTabGroups = computed(() => currentTab.value?.groups || []);

watch(() => props.product, (newVal) => {
    itemObservation.value = "";
    localQuantity.value = newVal?.cartItem?.qty || 1;
    isTakeaway.value = newVal?.cartItem?.isTakeaway || false;
    let existingModifiers = newVal?.cartItem?.structuredModifiers ? [...newVal.cartItem.structuredModifiers] : [];
    const obsIndex = existingModifiers.findIndex(m => m.is_joker && m.name.startsWith('Obs: '));
    if (obsIndex > -1) {
        itemObservation.value = existingModifiers[obsIndex].name.replace('Obs: ', '');
        existingModifiers.splice(obsIndex, 1);
    }
    stateHelpers.initModifiers(newVal?.modifiers, existingModifiers);
}, { immediate: true });

watch(() => allTabs.value, (newTabs) => {
    if (newTabs.length > 0 && (!activeTab.value || !newTabs.find(t => t.id === activeTab.value))) {
        activeTab.value = newTabs[0].id;
    }
}, { immediate: true });

watch(() => stateHelpers.hasJokerSelected(props.product?.modifiers), (isJokerNowActive) => {
    if (isJokerNowActive) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            activeTab.value = 'observation';
        }, 300);
    }
});

const currentTotal = computed(() => stateHelpers.calculateTotal(props.product?.price, props.product?.modifiers));

watch([currentTotal, localQuantity], ([newTotal, newQty]) => {
    emit("update:total", newTotal * newQty);
}, { immediate: true });

const isSelectionValid = computed(() => stateHelpers.isValid(props.product?.modifiers, itemObservation.value));

const confirmAndAdd = () => {
    if (!isSelectionValid.value) return;

    isAdding.value = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
        isAdding.value = false;
        isAddSuccess.value = true;

        setTimeout(() => {
            const extraPrice = currentTotal.value - Number(props.product.price);
            let text = stateHelpers.buildModifiersText(props.product.modifiers);
            const structured = stateHelpers.buildStructuredModifiers(props.product.modifiers);

            if (itemObservation.value.trim()) {
                text += text ? ` | Obs: ${itemObservation.value}` : `Obs: ${itemObservation.value}`;
                structured.push({ id: null, name: `Obs: ${itemObservation.value}`, price: 0, qty: 1, is_joker: true });
            }

            const finalIsTakeaway = (props.orderType === 'delivery' || props.orderType === 'counter') ? true : isTakeaway.value;

            emit("confirm", { text: text, extraPrice: extraPrice, isTakeaway: finalIsTakeaway, structuredModifiers: structured, qty: localQuantity.value });
        }, 500);
    }, 300);
};
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";
import { useWhatsAppMessages } from "@/Composables/useWhatsAppMessages";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    order: Object,
    couriers: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    mode: { type: String, default: 'modal' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'cancel', 'assign']);
const { abbreviateName } = useWhatsAppMessages();

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (val) => emit('update:visible', val)
});

const handleCancel = () => {
    emit('cancel');
    if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};

const handleAssign = (courier) => {
    emit('assign', courier);
    if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};
</script>
```
