```vue
                subtitle="Notificar cliente"
                icon="pi pi-send"
                icon-color="text-primary-500"
                @click="notifyDispatch"
            />

            <template v-if="!isTeamMode">
                <OrderContextAction
                    :disabled="order?.type !== 'delivery'"
                    label="Via do Motoboy"
                    subtitle="Comanda da embalagem"
                    icon="pi pi-truck"
                    icon-color="text-surface-muted"
                    @click="$emit('action', 'print_delivery', order)"
                />

                <OrderContextAction
                    :disabled="order?.type !== 'delivery'"
                    label="Avisar Entregador"
                    subtitle="Enviar para WhatsApp"
                    icon="pi pi-whatsapp"
                    icon-color="text-green-500"
                    @click="$emit('action', 'dispatch_courier', order)"
                />
            </template>

            <OrderContextAction
                :disabled="order?.status === 'closed' || order?.status === 'cancelled'"
                label="Cancelar Pedido"
                subtitle="Estornar e encerrar"
                icon="pi pi-times-circle"
                icon-color="text-danger-500"
                @click="$emit('action', 'cancel_order', order)"
            />
        </div>

        <!-- 🚀 CONTROLE DE REPUTAÇÃO E AVALIAÇÃO DO PEDIDO -->
        <div v-if="!isTeamMode && order?.type !== 'table' && companySettings?.request_order_rating !== false" class="flex items-center justify-between p-3 mt-2 bg-surface-2 border border-surface-border rounded-xl">
            <div class="flex flex-col gap-0.5 min-w-0 pr-4">
                <span class="text-[11px] font-black text-surface-text uppercase tracking-widest leading-tight">Inibir Avaliação App</span>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-medium text-surface-muted leading-snug">Não solicitar feedback caso o cliente esteja insatisfeito.</span>
            </div>

            <button
                type="button"
                @click="toggleRatingInhibition"
                :disabled="isTogglingRating"
                class="w-12 h-7 rounded-full relative transition-colors duration-200 shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow-inner flex items-center px-1 border-none outline-none"
                :class="[
                    isRatingSkipped ? 'bg-danger-500' : 'bg-surface-3 border border-surface-border',
                    isTogglingRating ? 'opacity-50 cursor-wait' : ''
                ]"
            >
                <div
                    class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white transition-transform duration-200 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center"
                    :class="isRatingSkipped ? 'translate-x-[20px]' : 'translate-x-0'"
                >
                    <i v-if="isTogglingRating" class="pi pi-spinner pi-spin text-[10px] text-surface-400"></i>
                    <i v-else-if="isRatingSkipped" class="pi pi-times text-[10px] text-danger-500"></i>
                </div>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { usePage, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import OrderContextAction from "./OrderContextAction.vue";
import { useWhatsAppMessages } from "@/Composables/useWhatsAppMessages";

const props = defineProps({
    order: { type: Object, required: true },
    isTeamMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['action']);
const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();
const { notifyDeliveryOut, notifyPickupReady } = useWhatsAppMessages();

const companySettings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});

const customerPhone = computed(() => props.order?.customer?.phone || props.order?.customer_phone || null);
const hasPhone = computed(() => {
    if (!customerPhone.value) return false;
    return customerPhone.value.replace(/\D/g, '').length >= 10;
});

const isPaid = computed(() => props.order?.payment_status === 'paid');

const handlePrimaryAction = () => {
    if (isPaid.value && props.order?.type === 'counter') {
        emit('action', 'finish_order', props.order);
    } else {
        emit('action', 'checkout', props.order);
    }
};

const canChargePix = computed(() => {
    return (
        Boolean(companySettings.value.sicredi_is_active) &&
        companySettings.value.sicredi_enable_waiter_pix !== false &&
        !isPaid.value &&
        props.order?.status !== 'closed'
    );
});

const notifyDispatch = () => {
    if (!hasPhone.value) return;
    if (props.order?.type === 'counter') notifyPickupReady(props.order);
    else notifyDeliveryOut(props.order);
};

const isRatingSkipped = computed(() => {
    return props.order?.rating?.rating === 0;
});

const isTogglingRating = ref(false);

const toggleRatingInhibition = () => {
    if (isTogglingRating.value) return;

    isTogglingRating.value = true;
    const nextState = !isRatingSkipped.value;

    router.post(route('operations.orders.toggle-rating', props.order.id), { preserveState: true,  skip_rating: nextState }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        preserveState: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            toast.add({
                severity: nextState ? 'warn' : 'success',
                summary: nextState ? 'Avaliação Inibida' : 'Avaliação Permitida',
                detail: nextState ? 'O cliente não será questionado sobre este pedido.' : 'O widget de avaliação voltará a aparecer.',
                life: 3000
            });
        },
        onError: () => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Não foi possível alterar o status da avaliação.', life: 3000 });
        },
        onFinish: () => {
            isTogglingRating.value = false;
        }
    });
};
</script>
```

```vue
                            {{ paymentMethodLabel }}

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount } from "vue";
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";

const props = defineProps({
    order: Object,
    showTotal: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isHighlighted: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isTeamMode: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

defineEmits(["click", "move-prev", "move-next"]);
const { getOrderTitle } = useOrderFormatting();

const now = ref(new Date());
let clockInterval = null;

onMounted(() => {
    clockInterval = setInterval(() => {
        now.value = new Date();
    }, 180000);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    if (clockInterval) clearInterval(clockInterval);
});

const timeElapsed = computed(() => {
    if (!props.order?.created_at) return "0min";

    let dateStr = props.order.created_at;
    let manipulatedStr = dateStr;

    if (typeof manipulatedStr === 'string') {
        manipulatedStr = manipulatedStr.replace(' ', 'T');
        if (!manipulatedStr.endsWith('Z') && !manipulatedStr.includes('-') && !manipulatedStr.includes('+')) {
            manipulatedStr += 'Z';
        }
    }

    const created = new Date(manipulatedStr);
    const diffMs = now.value - created;
    const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);

    if (isNaN(created) || diffMins < 0) return "0min";
    if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}min`;

    const hours = Math.floor(diffMins / 60);
    const mins = diffMins % 60;
    return mins > 0 ? `${hours}h ${mins}min` : `${hours}h`;
});

// 🚀 REGRAS FINANCEIRAS INTELIGENTES DO CARD
const isPaid = computed(() => {
    if (props.order?.payment_status === 'paid') return true;
    const totalPaid = (props.order?.payments || []).reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.amount || 0), 0);
    const orderTotal = Number(props.order?.total || 0);
    return orderTotal > 0 && totalPaid >= (orderTotal - 0.05);
});

// ⚠️ RECONHECIMENTO DE PIX PENDENTE (AGUARDANDO WEBHOOK OU COMPROVANTE)
const isWaitingPix = computed(() => {
    if (isPaid.value) return false;
    return props.order?.payment_intent_status === 'pix_waiting'
        || props.order?.status === 'pending_payment';
});

const deliveryMethodsParsed = computed(() => {
    let methods = props.order?.payment_intent_methods;
    if (!methods) return [];
    if (typeof methods === 'string') {
        try { methods = JSON.parse(methods); } catch (e) { return []; }
    }
    return Array.isArray(methods) ? methods : [];
});

const isPaymentUndefined = computed(() => {
    if (props.order?.type === 'table' || isPaid.value || isWaitingPix.value) return false;

    const status = props.order?.payment_intent_status;
    if (!status || status === 'pending_choice') return true;
    if (status === 'pay_on_delivery' && deliveryMethodsParsed.value.length === 0) return true;

    return false;
});

const paymentMethodLabel = computed(() => {
    if (isPaid.value) return 'Pago';

    if (isWaitingPix.value) {
        return 'Aguardando Pix';
    }

    if (props.order?.payment_intent_status === 'pay_now') {
        return 'Pagar no Caixa';
    }

    if (deliveryMethodsParsed.value.length > 0) {
        return deliveryMethodsParsed.value.map(m => {
            const name = m.method_name || m.name || m.method_id || 'Dinheiro';
            if (m.change_target && Number(m.change_target) > Number(m.amount)) {
                return `${name} (Troco R$ ${Number(m.change_target).toFixed(0)})`;
            }
            return name;
        }).join(' + ');
    }

    if (props.order?.payments && props.order.payments.length > 0) {
        return props.order.payments.map(p => p.method || p.method_name).join(' + ');
    }

    return null;
});

const formattedName = computed(() => {
    if (props.isTeamMode && props.order.type === "table") {
        const tableName = String(props.order.table_number || "Avulsa");
        const customerName = String(props.order.identifier || props.order.customer_name || "");

        const isGenericName = !customerName ||
                              customerName.toLowerCase() === tableName.toLowerCase() ||
                              customerName.toLowerCase() === `mesa ${tableName.toLowerCase()}` ||
                              customerName.toLowerCase() === 'geral' ||
                              customerName.toLowerCase() === 'nova conta';

        return isGenericName ? tableName : `${tableName} (${customerName})`;
    }

    return getOrderTitle(props.order);
});

const typeLabel = computed(() => {
    if (props.order.type === "table") return "Mesa";
    if (props.order.type === "counter") return "Balcão";

    const neighborhood =
        props.order.address?.neighborhood ||
        props.order.routing?.address?.neighborhood ||
        props.order.meta?.address?.neighborhood ||
        props.order.neighborhood ||
        props.order.delivery_neighborhood;

    return neighborhood || "Delivery";
});
</script>
```

```vue
]);
```

```vue
        <div class="flex flex-col gap-4">

                :item="activeItem"

                <OrderContextAction label="Reimprimir Via" subtitle="Na cozinha" icon="pi pi-print" icon-color="text-surface-muted" @click="executeMobileItemAction('reprint')" />

                <OrderContextAction label="Duplicar Item (+1)" subtitle="Acrescentar igual" icon="pi pi-plus-circle" icon-color="text-success-500" @click="executeMobileItemAction('duplicate')" :class="isDuplicating ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''">
                    <template v-if="isDuplicateSuccess"><span class="text-success-500 font-medium text-xs"><i class="pi pi-check"></i> Sucesso</span></template>
                </OrderContextAction>

                <!-- MENU TURBINADO PARA QUANTIDADES > 1 -->
                <template v-if="activeItem && activeItem.quantity > 1">
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <OrderContextAction label="Editar 1" icon="pi pi-pencil" icon-color="text-warning-500" @click="executeMobileItemAction('edit', 1)" />
                        <OrderContextAction label="Editar Tudo" icon="pi pi-pencil" icon-color="text-warning-500" @click="executeMobileItemAction('edit', 'all')" />

                        <OrderContextAction label="Transferir Tudo" icon="pi pi-sync" icon-color="text-primary-500" @click="executeMobileItemAction('transfer', 'all')" />

                        <OrderContextAction label="Cancelar 1" icon="pi pi-trash" icon-color="text-red-500" @click="executeMobileItemAction('cancel', 1)" />
                        <OrderContextAction label="Cancelar Tudo" icon="pi pi-trash" icon-color="text-red-500" @click="executeMobileItemAction('cancel', 'all')" />
                    </div>
                </template>

                <template v-else>

                    <OrderContextAction label="Cancelar Item" subtitle="Estornar" icon="pi pi-trash" icon-color="text-red-500" @click="executeMobileItemAction('cancel', 'all')" />

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from "vue";
import Drawer from "primevue/drawer";
import Dialog from "primevue/dialog";
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber } from "@/Utils/formatters";

import KdsStatus from '@/Pages/Operations/Components/Kds/KdsStatus.vue';
import OrderContextItem from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderContextItem.vue";
import OrderContextAction from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderContextAction.vue";
import OrderActionsGrid from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderActionsGrid.vue";
import OperationReasonModal from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/OperationReasonModal.vue";
import { useSecureAction } from "@/Composables/useSecureAction";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";
import { useViewport } from "@/Composables/useViewport";
import { useWhatsAppMessages } from "@/Composables/useWhatsAppMessages";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    showActions: Boolean,
    order: Object,
    companySettings: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["update:visible", "update:showActions", "action", "reprint-item", "cancel-item", "transfer-items", "modify-item", "duplicate-item", "swap-item"]);

const { getOrderTitle, groupActiveItems } = useOrderFormatting();
const { isMobile } = useViewport();
const { abbreviateName, formatAddress } = useWhatsAppMessages();

const isVisible = computed({
  get: () => props.visible,
  set: (value) => emit("update:visible", value),
});

const isOrderActionsOpen = computed({
  get: () => props.showActions,
  set: (value) => emit("update:showActions", value),
});

const translatedStatus = (status) => {
    const map = {
        pending: 'Pendente',
        preparing: 'Em Preparo',
        ready: 'Pronto / Despachando',
        dispatched: 'Em Rota',
        closed: 'Concluído',
        cancelled: 'Cancelado'
    };
    return map[status] || status;
};

const statusStyle = (status) => {
    const styles = {
        pending: 'bg-warning-500/10 text-warning-600 border-warning-500/20',
        preparing: 'bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-600 border-orange-500/20',
        ready: 'bg-info-500/10 text-info-600 border-info-500/20',
        dispatched: 'bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-600 border-purple-500/20',
        closed: 'bg-success-500/10 text-success-600 border-success-500/20',
        cancelled: 'bg-danger-500/10 text-danger-600 border-danger-500/20'
    };
    return styles[status] || 'bg-surface-2 text-surface-muted border-surface-border';
};

const isItemActionsOpen = ref(false);
const activeItem = ref(null);

const isDuplicating = ref(false);
const isDuplicateSuccess = ref(false);

const openItemActionsSheet = (item) => {
    activeItem.value = item;
    isDuplicating.value = false;
    isDuplicateSuccess.value = false;
    isItemActionsOpen.value = true;
};

const executeMobileItemAction = (type, qty = 'all') => {
    if (type === 'reprint') {
        isItemActionsOpen.value = false;
        emit("reprint-item", activeItem.value);
        return;
    }

    if (type === 'duplicate') {
        isDuplicating.value = true;
        emit('duplicate-item', activeItem.value, (success) => {
            isDuplicating.value = false;
            if (success) {
                isDuplicateSuccess.value = true;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    isDuplicateSuccess.value = false;
                    isItemActionsOpen.value = false;
                }, 1000);
            }
        });
        return;
    }

    isItemActionsOpen.value = false;
    if (type === 'edit') initiateEdit(activeItem.value, qty);
    if (type === 'transfer') openSingleTransfer(activeItem.value, qty);
    if (type === 'cancel') initiateCancellation(activeItem.value, qty);
};

const selectedItemIds = ref([]);
watch(isVisible, () => { selectedItemIds.value = []; });

const orderItems = computed(() => props.order?.items || []);
const activeItemsGrouped = computed(() => groupActiveItems(orderItems.value));

const formattedOrderTitle = computed(() => {
    if (!props.order) return "";
    if (props.order.type === 'table') {
        const displayTable = props.order.table_number?.toLowerCase().includes('mesa') ? props.order.table_number : `Mesa ${props.order.table_number}`;
        if (!props.order.customer_id) return displayTable;
        return `${displayTable} (${abbreviateName(props.order.customer_name)})`;
    }
    if (props.order.customer_id) {
        return abbreviateName(props.order.customer_name);
    }
    return props.order.customer_name;
});

const toggleItemSelection = (id) => {
  const idx = selectedItemIds.value.indexOf(id);
  if (idx > -1) selectedItemIds.value.splice(idx, 1);
  else selectedItemIds.value.push(id);
};

const toggleSelectAllItems = () => {
  if (selectedItemIds.value.length === activeItemsGrouped.value.length) selectedItemIds.value = [];
  else selectedItemIds.value = activeItemsGrouped.value.map(i => i.id);
};

const openSingleTransfer = (item, qty = 'all') => {
  isVisible.value = false;
  emit("transfer-items", { order: props.order, itemIds: [item.id], qty });
};

const executeBulkAction = (actionType) => {
  if (actionType === 'transfer') {
    isVisible.value = false;
    emit("transfer-items", { order: props.order, itemIds: [...selectedItemIds.value] });
  } else if (actionType === 'print') {
    alert(`Reimprimindo produção para os itens selecionados.`);
    selectedItemIds.value = [];
  } else if (actionType === 'delete') {
    if (confirm(`Deseja realmente estornar os ${selectedItemIds.value.length} itens selecionados?`)) {
       alert('Lógica em lote acionada.');
    }
  }
};

const { isReasonModalVisible, itemToProcess, authActionType, authNeedsPin, initiateSecureAction } = useSecureAction(props.companySettings);

const initiateCancellation = (item, qty = 'all') => {
  item.action_qty = qty;
  initiateSecureAction(item, 'cancel');
};

const initiateEdit = (item, qty = 'all') => {
  item.action_qty = qty;
  initiateSecureAction(item, 'edit');
};

const initiateSwap = (item, qty = 'all') => {
  item.action_qty = qty;
  initiateSecureAction(item, 'swap');
};

const handleConfirmAuth = (authData) => {
  const qty = itemToProcess.value?.action_qty || 'all';

  if (authActionType.value === 'edit') {
      emit("modify-item", { item: itemToProcess.value, authData, action_qty: qty });
  } else if (authActionType.value === 'swap') {
      emit("swap-item", { item: itemToProcess.value, authData, action_qty: qty });
  } else {
      emit("cancel-item", {
          item: itemToProcess.value,
          action_qty: qty,
          isLoss: authData.isLoss,
          reason: authData.reason,
          password: authData.password
      });
  }
  isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
};

const isPaid = computed(() => props.order?.payment_status === 'paid');
const translatedType = computed(() => {
  const types = { table: "Mesa", counter: "Balcão", delivery: "Delivery" };
  return props.order ? types[props.order.type] : "";
});

const handleAction = (actionId) => {
  isOrderActionsOpen.value = false;
  isVisible.value = false;
  if (actionId === 'transfer_all') {
      const allItemIds = activeItemsGrouped.value.map(i => i.id);
      emit("transfer-items", { order: props.order, itemIds: allItemIds });
      return;
  }
  emit("action", actionId, props.order);
};
</script>
```

```vue
        class="flex flex-col gap-1 -mx-2 transition-all surface-card-ghost cursor-pointer"
        :class="{ 'is-expanded': isExpanded }"

                    <div v-for="(line, mIdx) in getModsLines(cItem.structuredModifiers || cItem.modifiers, cItem.quantity || cItem.qty)" :key="mIdx" class="text-[10px] text-surface-muted/80">
                        {{ line }}
                    </div>

        </div>

        <div v-else-if="parsedModifiersLines.length > 0" class="flex flex-col gap-0.5 mt-0.5 pl-1">
            <span v-for="(line, idx) in parsedModifiersLines" :key="idx" class="text-sm text-surface-muted">
                {{ line }}
            </span>
        </div>

        <div v-show="isExpanded" class="flex flex-col animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-200 mt-2">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center pt-2 border-t-2 border-surface-border/30 cursor-default" @click.stop>

<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed } from "vue";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/Utils/formatters";
import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";

const props = defineProps({
    title: String,
    qty: { type: Number, default: 1 },
    price: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    structuredModifiers: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    comboItems: Array,
    isAddition: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    isTakeaway: { type: Boolean, default: false }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['expanded-change']);

const { formatModifiersList } = useOrderFormatting();

const isExpanded = ref(false);
const cardElement = ref(null);

watch(isExpanded, (newVal) => { emit('expanded-change', newVal); });

const parsedModifiersLines = computed(() => formatModifiersList({ structuredModifiers: props.structuredModifiers, qty: props.qty }));
const getModsLines = (rawArray, parentQty) => formatModifiersList({ structuredModifiers: rawArray, qty: parentQty || props.qty });

const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
    if (isExpanded.value && cardElement.value && !cardElement.value.contains(event.target)) {
        isExpanded.value = false;
    }
};

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("click", handleClickOutside));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("click", handleClickOutside));
</script>
```

```vue
        <!-- CORPO DO FORMULÁRIO -->

            <div class="flex flex-col gap-3 shrink-0">

                    v-if="order?.type !== 'counter'"
                    @select="selectTarget('counter')"
                    :is-selected="targetType === 'counter'"
                    color="purple"
                    icon="pi-shopping-bag"
                    title="Mudar para Balcão/Comanda"
                    subtitle="Transforma em pedido de retirada e remove taxa de entrega."
                />

                <SelectableCard
                    v-if="order?.type !== 'delivery'"
                    @select="selectTarget('delivery')"
                    :is-selected="targetType === 'delivery'"
                    color="red"
                    icon="pi-motorcycle"
                    title="Converter para Delivery"
                    subtitle="Habilita entrega e abre o preenchimento de endereço e taxa."
                />
            </div>

            <div v-if="targetType === 'table'" class="mt-2 animate-fade-in flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-[250px]">
                <div class="text-xs font-black text-stone-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 px-1 text-center">Selecione a nova Mesa</div>
                <div class="flex-1 bg-surface-2/50 border border-surface-border/50 rounded-2xl p-2 overflow-y-auto hide-scrollbar shadow-inner">
                    <RoutingTable
                        v-model="selectedTable"
                        v-model:identifier="customerName"
                        :table-areas="tableAreas"
                    />
                </div>
            </div>

            <div v-if="targetType === 'counter'" class="mt-2 animate-fade-in shrink-0">
                <label class="block text-xs font-medium text-stone-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 text-center">Nome / Número da Comanda</label>
                <input
                    type="text"
                    v-model="targetIdentifier"
                    placeholder="Ex: João 45"
                    class="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border border-stone-300 dark:border-stone-700 bg-stone-50 dark:bg-stone-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 outline-none transition-all font-medium text-lg text-center"
                />
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- RODAPÉ -->
        <div class="flex gap-2 w-full shrink-0 mt-auto pt-6 border-t border-surface-border/50">
            <Button label="Cancelar" variant="text" severity="secondary" @click="handleCancel" class="flex-1 font-medium" />
            <Button label="Confirmar" severity="help" class="flex-1 font-black shadow-md" :disabled="!canSubmit" @click="confirmTransformation" />
        </div>
    </component>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from "vue";
import Button from "primevue/button";
import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";
import SelectableCard from "@/Components/UI/SelectableCard.vue";
import RoutingTable from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Cart/RoutingTable.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    order: Object,
    tableAreas: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    mode: { type: String, default: 'modal' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["update:visible", "transform", "cancel"]);

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (value) => emit("update:visible", value),
});

const targetType = ref("");
const targetIdentifier = ref("");
const selectedTable = ref(null);
const customerName = ref("");

const resetState = () => {
    targetType.value = "";
    targetIdentifier.value = "";
    selectedTable.value = null;
    customerName.value = "";
};

watch(() => props.order, resetState);
watch(isVisible, (val) => { if (!val) resetState(); });

const currentTypeLabel = computed(() => {
    const types = { table: "Mesa", counter: "Balcão", delivery: "Delivery" };
    return props.order ? types[props.order.type] : "";
});

const selectTarget = (type) => {
    targetType.value = type;
    targetIdentifier.value = "";
    selectedTable.value = null;
    customerName.value = "";
};

const canSubmit = computed(() => {
    if (!targetType.value) return false;
    if (targetType.value === "table" && !selectedTable.value?.id && !selectedTable.value?.name) return false;
    if (targetType.value === "counter" && targetIdentifier.value.trim() === "") return false;
    return true;
});

const handleCancel = () => {
    emit("cancel");
    if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};

const confirmTransformation = () => {
    const finalIdentifier = targetType.value === "table"
        ? (selectedTable.value?.name || "")
        : targetIdentifier.value;

    emit("transform", {
        order: props.order,
        new_type: targetType.value,
        newType: targetType.value,
        type: targetType.value,
        table_id: selectedTable.value?.id || null,
        dining_table_id: selectedTable.value?.id || null,
        table_number: selectedTable.value?.name || null,
        identifier: finalIdentifier,
        customer_name: targetType.value === "table" ? customerName.value : targetIdentifier.value
    });

    if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};
</script>
```

```vue
import { ref, computed, watch } from "vue";
import Button from "primevue/button";
import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";
import SegmentedControl from "@/Components/UI/SegmentedControl.vue";
import { formatNumber } from "@/Utils/formatters";

const props = defineProps({
    visible: Boolean,
    sourceOrder: Object,
    itemIds: Array,
    tableAreas: Array,
    mode: { type: String, default: 'modal' }
});

const emit = defineEmits(["update:visible", "confirm", "cancel"]);

const isVisible = computed({
  get: () => props.visible,
  set: (value) => emit("update:visible", value),
});

const destType = ref("table");
const selectedTable = ref(null);
const selectedDestOrder = ref(null);
const newSubAccountName = ref("");

watch(isVisible, (newVal) => {
  if (newVal) {
    selectedTable.value = null;
    selectedDestOrder.value = null;
    newSubAccountName.value = "";
  }
});

const sourceOrderTitle = computed(() => {
  if (!props.sourceOrder) return "";
  return props.sourceOrder.type === 'table'
    ? `Mesa ${props.sourceOrder.table_number || ''} (${props.sourceOrder.customer_name || 'Geral'})`
    : props.sourceOrder.customer_name || `Pedido #${formatNumber(props.sourceOrder.id)}`;
});

const setDestinationType = (type) => {
    destType.value = type;
    selectedTable.value = null;
    selectedDestOrder.value = null;
};

const handleSelectTable = (table) => {
  selectedTable.value = table;
  if (!table.active_orders || table.active_orders.length === 0) {
    selectedDestOrder.value = "new_general";
  } else {
    selectedDestOrder.value = null;
  }
};

const canSubmit = computed(() => {
  if (destType.value === 'counter_delivery') return ['new_counter', 'new_delivery'].includes(selectedDestOrder.value);
  if (destType.value === 'table') {
    if (!selectedTable.value) return false;
    if (selectedDestOrder.value === 'new_subaccount') return newSubAccountName.value.trim().length > 0;
    return selectedDestOrder.value !== null;
  }
  return false;
});

const handleCancel = () => {
  emit("cancel");
  if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};

const handleConfirm = () => {
  if (!canSubmit.value) return;

  emit("confirm", {
    source_order_id: props.sourceOrder.id,
    item_ids: props.itemIds,
    destination_type: destType.value,
    destination_table_id: selectedTable.value?.id || null,
    destination_dining_table_id: selectedTable.value?.id || null,
    destination_table_name: selectedTable.value?.name || null,
    destination_order_intent: selectedDestOrder.value,
    new_subaccount_name: newSubAccountName.value
  });

  if (props.mode !== 'inline') isVisible.value = false;
};
</script>
```

```vue
                    <p class="text-sm font-medium text-surface-muted mt-1 uppercase tracking-widest">
                        Ordens de preparo interno para reabastecimento.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <button @click="fetchOrders(true)" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-surface-3 hover:bg-surface-border transition-colors flex items-center justify-center outline-none cursor-pointer">

                </button>

            <!-- CONTEÚDO -->

                <!-- Loader -->
                <div v-if="isLoading" class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 opacity-50">
                    <i class="pi pi-spin pi-spinner text-4xl mb-3 text-primary-500"></i>
                    <span class="text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase text-surface-muted">Buscando Ordens...</span>
                </div>

                <!-- Cards -->
                <div v-else-if="localOrders.length > 0" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    <ProductionOrderCard
                        v-for="order in localOrders"
                        :key="order.id"
                        :order="order"
                        @update-status="handleUpdateStatus"
                        @finish-order="handleFinishOrder"
                    />
                </div>

                <!-- Empty State -->
                <div v-else class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-surface-muted opacity-60">
                    <i class="pi pi-thumbs-up text-6xl mb-4"></i>
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold">Produção em dia!</h3>
                    <p class="text-sm mt-1">Nenhuma ordem pendente na cozinha.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import DesktopLayout from '@/Layouts/DesktopLayout.vue';
import ProductionOrderCard from '@/Pages/Shared/SupplyChain/ProductionOrderCard.vue';

// No Desktop, usa o layout. No Celular (dentro do TeamApp), o Inertia ignora isso. Mágica!
defineOptions({ layout: DesktopLayout });

const props = defineProps({
    // Recebe as ordens via Inertia (se estiver no PC). Se for null, estamos no PWA (Celular).
    orders: { type: Array, default: null }
});

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const localOrders = ref(props.orders || []);
const isLoading = ref(!props.orders);

const fetchOrders = async (forceRefresh = false) => {
    // Se não for um refresh forçado e as ordens já vieram do PC, não precisa buscar!
    if (!forceRefresh && props.orders) return;

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
        // X-Inertia: true força o Laravel a devolver JSON limpo em vez de HTML!
        const response = await axios.get(route('operations.production-board'), {
            headers: { 'X-Inertia': 'true', 'X-Inertia-Version': page.version }
        });

        const fetched = response.data?.props?.orders;

        // A blindagem que impede o travamento do computador:
        localOrders.value = Array.isArray(fetched) ? fetched : [];
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Falha ao buscar as ordens de produção.', life: 3000 });
    } finally {
        isLoading.value = false;
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    fetchOrders();
});

const handleUpdateStatus = async ({ id, status }) => {
    try {
        await axios.post(route('operations.production-board.status'), { id, status });
        fetchOrders(true);
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Não foi possível atualizar o status.', life: 3000 });
    }
};

const handleFinishOrder = async (order) => {
    try {
        await axios.post(route('operations.production-board.finish'), {
            id: order.id,
            actual_qty: order.planned_qty
        });
        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Boa!', detail: 'Estoque do produto reabastecido.', life: 3000 });
        fetchOrders(true);
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Não foi possível concluir a ordem.', life: 3000 });
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold">Tudo abastecido!</h3>
                    <p class="text-sm mt-1">Não há intenções de compra pendentes.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import DesktopLayout from '@/Layouts/DesktopLayout.vue';
import ShoppingSupplierCard from '@/Pages/Shared/SupplyChain/ShoppingSupplierCard.vue';

// Layout nativo do PC
defineOptions({ layout: DesktopLayout });

const props = defineProps({
    biddingMatrix: { type: Object, default: null }
});

const page = usePage();
const toast = useToast();

const localMatrix = ref(props.biddingMatrix || {});
const isLoading = ref(!props.biddingMatrix);

const fetchShoppingList = async (forceRefresh = false) => {
    if (!forceRefresh && props.biddingMatrix) return;

    isLoading.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(route('operations.shopping-list'), {
            headers: { 'X-Inertia': 'true', 'X-Inertia-Version': page.version }
        });

        const fetched = response.data?.props?.biddingMatrix;

        // Blindagem contra bug da string
        localMatrix.value = (typeof fetched === 'object' && fetched !== null) ? fetched : {};
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Falha ao buscar intenções de compra.', life: 3000 });
    } finally {
        isLoading.value = false;
    }
};

onMounted(() => {
    fetchShoppingList();
});

const removeItem = async (itemId) => {
    try {
        await axios.post(route('operations.shopping-list.remove'), { id: itemId });
        fetchShoppingList(true);
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Não foi possível remover o item.', life: 3000 });
    }
};

const approveOrder = async (supplierId, items) => {
    try {
        await axios.post(route('operations.shopping-list.approve'), {
            supplier_id: supplierId,
            items: items.map(i => ({ id: i.id, qty: i.suggested_qty }))
        });
        toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Sucesso', detail: 'Pedido aprovado e enviado ao financeiro.', life: 3000 });
        fetchShoppingList(true);
    } catch (e) {
        toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Erro', detail: 'Falha ao aprovar pedido.', life: 3000 });
    }
};
</script>
```

```vue
const updateUnitsFromPacks = (item) => {

    const factor = Number(item.conversion_factor || 1);
    item.suggested_qty = Math.round(packs * factor * 1000) / 1000;
```

```vue
            </p>

                <button
                    v-if="canGoBack"
                    @click="goPrevious"
                    type="button"
                    class="w-full sm:w-auto h-12 px-6 rounded-full font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest bg-surface-1 border border-surface-border text-surface-text hover:bg-surface-3 transition-colors outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                    Voltar
                </button>

                <!-- Botão Primário: Retorna à raiz do PWA contextual (Caixa, Garçom, KDS ou Cardápio) -->
                <button
                    @click="goToContextHome"
                    type="button"
                    class="w-full sm:w-auto h-12 px-6 rounded-full font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest bg-primary-500 text-white hover:bg-primary-600 transition-colors shadow-md outline-none border-none cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                    <i class="pi pi-home text-xs"></i>
                    <span>Ir para {{ app_label }}</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    status: {
        type: Number,
        required: true,
    },
    home_url: {
        type: String,
        default: '/',
    },
    app_label: {
        type: String,
        default: 'Início',
    },
    return_url: {
        type: String,
        default: null,
    },
});

const errorData = computed(() => {
    const map = {
        503: { title: 'Serviço Indisponível', description: 'Estamos em manutenção programada. Volte em alguns minutinhos!', icon: 'pi pi-cog', color: '#f59e0b' },
        500: { title: 'Erro Interno', description: 'Ops, algo deu errado nos nossos servidores. Nossa equipe já foi notificada.', icon: 'pi pi-server', color: '#ef4444' },
        404: { title: 'Página Não Encontrada', description: 'O endereço digitado não existe ou foi movido dentro do sistema.', icon: 'pi pi-map', color: '#8b5cf6' },
        403: { title: 'Acesso Negado', description: 'Você não possui permissão para acessar esta seção com o perfil atual.', icon: 'pi pi-lock', color: '#ef4444' },
    };

    return map[props.status] || {
        title: 'Ops! Algo deu errado',
        description: 'Encontramos um comportamento inesperado.',
        icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
        color: '#6b7280',
    };
});

const canGoBack = computed(() => {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.history.length > 1;
});

const goPrevious = () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.history.length > 1) {
        window.history.back();
    } else if (props.return_url) {
        router.visit(props.return_url);
    } else {
        router.visit(props.home_url);
    }
};

const goToContextHome = () => {
    router.visit(props.home_url);
};
</script>
```

```vue
                <div v-for="(dayName, index) in dayNames" :key="index"
                    class="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border"
                    :class="isToday(index) ? 'bg-primary-500/10 border-primary-500/30' : 'bg-surface-2 border-surface-border'">

                    <span class="font-bold text-sm" :class="isToday(index) ? 'text-primary-600' : 'text-surface-text'">
                        {{ dayName }} <span v-if="isToday(index)" class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-widest ml-1 opacity-80">(Hoje)</span>
                    </span>

                    <div class="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
                        <template v-if="getHoursForDay(index).length > 0">
                            <span v-for="(turn, idx) in getHoursForDay(index)" :key="idx" class="text-xs font-bold text-surface-muted bg-surface-3 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                                {{ turn.open_time }} - {{ turn.close_time }}
                            </span>
                        </template>
                        <span v-else class="text-xs font-black text-danger-500 uppercase tracking-widest bg-danger-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                            Fechado
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </AdaptiveModal>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: { type: Boolean, required: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible']);

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (value) => emit('update:visible', value),
});

const page = usePage();
const settings = computed(() => page.props.companySettings || {});

// Laravel formata os dias de 0 a 6 (0 = Domingo, 6 = Sábado)
const dayNames = ['Domingo', 'Segunda-feira', 'Terça-feira', 'Quarta-feira', 'Quinta-feira', 'Sexta-feira', 'Sábado'];

const currentDayOfWeek = new Date().getDay();

const isToday = (dayIndex) => dayIndex === currentDayOfWeek;

const getHoursForDay = (dayIndex) => {
    const hoursArray = settings.value.business_hours || [];

    return hoursArray
        .filter(rule => rule.day_of_week == dayIndex)
        .map(rule => {
            // Remove os segundos (HH:MM:SS -> HH:MM)
            const formatTime = (time) => time ? time.substring(0, 5) : '--:--';
            return {
                open_time: formatTime(rule.open_time),
                close_time: formatTime(rule.close_time)
            };
        });
};
</script>
```

```vue
                    </span>

                    </span>

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import AdaptiveModal from '@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    visible: { type: Boolean, required: true }
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible']);

const isVisible = computed({
    get: () => props.visible,
    set: (value) => emit('update:visible', value),
});

const page = usePage();

const formattedAddress = computed(() => {
    const settings = page.props.companySettings;
    if (!settings) return 'Endereço não configurado.';

    // Concatena as informações disponíveis
    const parts = [settings.address, settings.address_number, settings.address_district, settings.address_city, settings.address_state];
    return parts.filter(p => p).join(', ');
});

const openMaps = () => {
    const query = encodeURIComponent(formattedAddress.value);
    const url = /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent)
        ? `geo:0,0?q=${query}`
        : `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${query}`;

    window.open(url, '_blank');
};
</script>
```

## File: resources/js/Pages/Team/Composables/useTeamApp.js
```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { useCart } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart';

const isStarting = ref(false);
const activeTab = ref('menu');
const contextMenuVisible = ref(false);
const selectedOrderContext = ref(null);

export function useTeamApp() {

    const resolveTableData = (order) => {
        if (!order) return { id: null, name: '' };
        const id = order.dining_table_id
            || order.table_id
            || order.dining_table?.id
            || order.diningTable?.id
            || order.table?.id
            || null;

        const name = order.table_number
            || order.table?.name
            || order.table?.number
            || order.dining_table?.name
            || order.dining_table?.table_number
            || order.diningTable?.name
            || order.diningTable?.table_number
            || (id ? String(id) : '');

        return {
            id: id ? Number(id) : null,
            name: String(name || '').trim()
        };
    };

    const startShift = () => {
        isStarting.value = true;
        router.post(route('team.start-shift'), {}, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onError: (err) => { if (err.shift) alert(err.shift); },
            onFinish: () => isStarting.value = false
        });
    };

    const openContextMenu = (order) => {
        selectedOrderContext.value = order;
        contextMenuVisible.value = true;
    };

    const handleMenuAction = (action, order) => {
        contextMenuVisible.value = false;

        switch (action) {
            case "add_items": {
                const tableInfo = resolveTableData(order);
                const routingPayload = {
                    id: order.id,
                    order_id: order.id,
                    existing_order_id: order.id,
                    type: order.type || 'table',
                    dining_table_id: tableInfo.id,
                    table_id: tableInfo.id,
                    table: tableInfo.id ? { id: tableInfo.id, name: tableInfo.name } : null,
                    identifier: order.customer_name || order.identifier || (tableInfo.name ? `Mesa ${tableInfo.name}` : ''),
                    customer: order.customer ? { id: order.customer.id, name: order.customer.name, phone: order.customer.phone } : null,
                    customer_phone: order.customer_phone || order.customer?.phone || null,
                    address_id: order.address_id || order.address?.id || null,
                    address: order.address_snapshot || order.address || null,
                    source: 'team_app'
                };

                const { draftRouting, orderType } = useCart();
                if (draftRouting) draftRouting.value = routingPayload;
                if (orderType) orderType.value = order.type || 'table';

                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('pos_draft_routing', JSON.stringify(routingPayload));
                    localStorage.setItem('pos_draft_type', order.type || 'table');
                    localStorage.setItem('pos_return_url', '/team');
                    localStorage.setItem('pos_return_order_id', String(order.id));
                } catch (e) {}

                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('team-tab-changed', { detail: 'menu' }));
                break;
            }
            case "checkout":
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('team-open-checkout', { detail: { orderId: order.id } }));
                break;
            case "print_partial":
                router.post(route('operations.print-conference', order.id), {}, {
                    preserveScroll: true, preserveState: true,
                    onSuccess: () => alert(`Conferência enviada para a impressora!`)
                });
                break;
            case "transfer_all":
                alert('A transferência de mesas deve ser realizada no Caixa principal.');
                break;
        }
    };

    return {
        isStarting, activeTab,
        contextMenuVisible, selectedOrderContext,
        startShift, openContextMenu, handleMenuAction
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { computed } from 'vue';

export function useTeamBarKds(props, handleItemCancel) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const page = usePage();

    const barItems = computed(() => {
        let kdsQueue = [];
        const routingMode = page.props.companySettings?.bar_kds_routing_mode || 'shared';

        (props.initialOrders || []).forEach(order => {
            if (['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'delivered'].includes(order.status)) return;

            (order.items || []).forEach(item => {
                let itemStatus = item.production_status || item.status || 'pending';
                if (['cancelled', 'returned'].includes(itemStatus)) return;

                const kitchenType = item.kitchen_type;
                const itemName = (item.name || item.product_name || '').toLowerCase();
                const categoryName = (item.category_name || '').toLowerCase();

                const isDrinkFallback =
                    categoryName.includes('bebida') || categoryName.includes('bar') || categoryName.includes('suco') ||
                    itemName.includes('suco') || itemName.includes('coca') || itemName.includes('água') || itemName.includes('agua') ||
                    itemName.includes('chopp') || itemName.includes('cerveja') || itemName.includes('drink') || itemName.includes('espumante') || itemName.includes('refrigerante');

                const isFromBar = kitchenType === 'bar' || (!kitchenType && isDrinkFallback);

                if (isFromBar) {
                    let mappedItem = { ...item, order: order };

                    if (routingMode === 'strict' && itemStatus === 'pending') {
                        mappedItem.production_status = 'preparing';
                        mappedItem.operator_id = order.employee_id
                            || order.attendant?.id
                            || order.waiter?.id
                            || order.user_id
                            || order.created_by;

                        mappedItem.operator_name = order.attendant?.name
                            || order.waiter?.name
                            || order.employee?.name
                            || order.user_name
                            || 'Dono do Pedido';
                    }

                    kdsQueue.push(mappedItem);
                }
            });
        });

        return kdsQueue.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
    });

    // 🚀 Contagem estrita apenas de itens aguardando preparo ou sendo preparados (ignora entregues e prontos)
    const pendingBarItemsCount = computed(() => {
        return barItems.value.filter(item => {
            const status = item.production_status || item.status || 'pending';
            return !['delivered', 'ready', 'cancelled', 'returned'].includes(status);
        }).length;
    });

    const handleKdsTake = (item) => {
        // Atualização otimista imediata
        item.production_status = 'preparing';
        if (item.order?.items) {
            const original = item.order.items.find(i => i.id === item.id);
            if (original) original.production_status = 'preparing';
        }

        router.post(route('operations.kds.update-status', item.id), { production_status: 'preparing' }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => void(0),
        });
    };

    const handleKdsComplete = (item) => {
        // Atualização otimista imediata para sumir da fila e zerar a badge no mesmo instante
        item.production_status = 'delivered';
        if (item.order?.items) {
            const original = item.order.items.find(i => i.id === item.id);
            if (original) original.production_status = 'delivered';
        }

        router.post(route('operations.kds.update-status', item.id), { production_status: 'delivered' }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: () => void(0),
        });
    };

    const handleKdsPrint = (item) => {
        router.post(route('operations.kds.print-item', item.id), { qty: 'all' }, { preserveScroll: true, preserveState: true });
    };

    const handleKdsCancel = (item) => {
        if (typeof handleItemCancel === 'function') handleItemCancel(item);
    };

    return {
        barItems,
        pendingBarItemsCount,
        barItemsCount: pendingBarItemsCount,
        handleKdsTake,
        handleKdsComplete,
        handleKdsPrint,
        handleKdsCancel
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { computed } from 'vue';

export function useTeamHeaderContext({
    activeTab,
    contextMenuVisible,
    selectedOrderContext,
    isAllowanceMode,
    cartRoutingMeta,
    cart,
    orderType,
    operatorName
}) {
    const page = usePage();

    const getFirstName = (fullName) => {
        if (!fullName || typeof fullName !== 'string') return '';
        return fullName.trim().split(' ')[0];
    };

    const headerContext = computed(() => {
        // 1. Contexto explícito de uma mesa/comanda aberta no menu de ações do mapa
        if (contextMenuVisible?.value && selectedOrderContext?.value) {
            const table = selectedOrderContext.value.dining_table?.name
                || selectedOrderContext.value.diningTable?.name
                || selectedOrderContext.value.table_number
                || selectedOrderContext.value.table?.name;

            const name = selectedOrderContext.value.customer_name;
            const id = selectedOrderContext.value.id;

            return {
                title: table ? `Mesa ${table}` : (name || `Pedido #${id}`),
                subtitle: selectedOrderContext.value.type === 'table' ? 'Mesa' : 'Balcão'
            };
        }

        // 2. Aba HOME: Saudação personalizada para o turno
        if (activeTab?.value === 'home') {
            const rawName = operatorName?.value || page.props.auth?.user?.name || 'Equipe';
            const firstName = getFirstName(rawName);

            return {
                title: `Bom turno, ${firstName}!`,
                subtitle: 'Painel da Equipe'
            };
        }

        // 3. Aba CARRINHO E CARDÁPIO (quando com itens em rascunho)
        if (activeTab?.value === 'cart' || (activeTab?.value === 'menu' && cartRoutingMeta?.value)) {
            if (isAllowanceMode?.value) {
                return {
                    title: 'Consumo Interno',
                    subtitle: 'Débito em Carteira'
                };
            }

            // A. Adicionando itens em pedido existente
            if (cartRoutingMeta?.value?.existing_order_id || cartRoutingMeta?.value?.id) {
                const table = cartRoutingMeta.value.dining_table?.name
                    || cartRoutingMeta.value.table?.name
                    || cartRoutingMeta.value.table_number;
                const ident = cartRoutingMeta.value.identifier;

                return {
                    title: table ? `Mesa ${table}` : (ident || `Comanda #${cartRoutingMeta.value.id}`),
                    subtitle: 'Adicionando Itens'
                };
            }

            // B. Novo Pedido com Destino já selecionado (Mesa Específica)
            if (cartRoutingMeta?.value?.type === 'table') {
                const tableName = cartRoutingMeta.value.table?.name || cartRoutingMeta.value.table_number;
                if (tableName) {
                    return {
                        title: `Mesa ${tableName}`,
                        subtitle: cartRoutingMeta.value.identifier ? `Ref: ${cartRoutingMeta.value.identifier}` : 'Novo Pedido'
                    };
                }
            }

            // C. Novo Pedido Delivery ou Balcão com identificador
            if (cartRoutingMeta?.value?.identifier) {
                return {
                    title: cartRoutingMeta.value.identifier,
                    subtitle: cartRoutingMeta.value.type === 'delivery' ? 'Delivery' : 'Balcão'
                };
            }

            // D. Fallback genérico para Carrinho sem destino
            if (activeTab?.value === 'cart' && cart?.value && cart.value.length > 0) {
                return {
                    title: orderType?.value === 'table' ? 'Mesa a Definir' : 'Comanda Aberta',
                    subtitle: 'Novo Pedido'
                };
            }
        }

        // 4. Demais abas: exibe o título nativo
        return {
            title: null,
            subtitle: null
        };
    });

    return {
        headerContext
    };
}
```

```javascript
import { useCart } from '@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useCart';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { ref, nextTick } from 'vue';

export function useTeamSubmit(state) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const isSubmittingOrder = ref(false);
    const isOrderSuccess = ref(false);
    const { draftRouting } = useCart();

    const resolveProductId = (productId, id) => {
        for (const candidate of [productId, id]) {
            if (!candidate) continue;
            if (typeof candidate === 'number') return candidate;
            const str = String(candidate);
            const match = str.match(/_prod_(\d+)/) || str.match(/(\d+)$/);
            if (match) return parseInt(match[1], 10);
            const num = parseInt(str, 10);
            if (!isNaN(num)) return num;
        }
        return null;
    };

    const handleCreateOrderOnTable = (table, isOccupied, existingOrder) => {
        if (isOccupied && existingOrder) {
            state.openContextMenu(existingOrder);
            return;
        }

        state.clearCart();

        const resolvedTableId = Number(table.dining_table_id || table.id);

        const routingPayload = {
            order_id: null,
            existing_order_id: null,
            type: 'table',
            dining_table_id: resolvedTableId,
            table_id: resolvedTableId,
            table: { id: resolvedTableId, name: table.name || '', status: table.status || '' },
            identifier: '',
            customer: null,
            customer_phone: null,
            address_id: null,
            address: null,
            source: 'team_app'
        };

        if (draftRouting) {
            draftRouting.value = routingPayload;
        }

        state.cartRoutingMeta.value = routingPayload;
        state.cartRoutingValid.value = true;
        state.orderType.value = 'table';

        try {
            localStorage.setItem('pos_draft_routing', JSON.stringify(routingPayload));
            localStorage.setItem('pos_draft_type', 'table');
        } catch (e) {}

        nextTick(() => {
            state.cartComponentKey.value++;
            state.activeTab.value = 'menu';
        });
    };

    const customHandleMenuAction = (actionId, order) => {
        // 🛡️ Garante a recuperação da comanda mesmo se o evento não passar o objeto
        const targetOrder = order || state.selectedOrderContext?.value;
        if (!targetOrder) return;

        const resolvedTableId = targetOrder.dining_table_id
            || targetOrder.table_id
            || targetOrder.dining_table?.id
            || targetOrder.diningTable?.id
            || targetOrder.table?.id
            || null;

        if (actionId === 'new_subaccount') {
            if (state.contextMenuVisible) state.contextMenuVisible.value = false;
            if (state.showOrderActionsSheet) state.showOrderActionsSheet.value = false;
            state.clearCart();

            const routingPayload = {
                order_id: null,
                existing_order_id: null,
                type: 'table',
                is_subaccount: true,
                dining_table_id: resolvedTableId ? Number(resolvedTableId) : null,
                table_id: resolvedTableId ? Number(resolvedTableId) : null,
                table: {
                    id: resolvedTableId ? Number(resolvedTableId) : null,
                    name: targetOrder.table_number || targetOrder.table?.name || ''
                },
                identifier: `Sub-conta ${targetOrder.table_number || ''}`,
                customer: null,
                customer_phone: null,
                address_id: null,
                address: null,
                source: 'team_app'
            };

            if (draftRouting) draftRouting.value = routingPayload;
            state.cartRoutingMeta.value = routingPayload;
            state.cartRoutingValid.value = Boolean(resolvedTableId);
            state.orderType.value = 'table';

            try {
                localStorage.setItem('pos_draft_routing', JSON.stringify(routingPayload));
                localStorage.setItem('pos_draft_type', 'table');
            } catch (e) {}

            nextTick(() => {
                state.cartComponentKey.value++;
                state.activeTab.value = 'menu';
            });

            void(0)

        } else if (actionId === 'add_items') {
            // 🛑 1. FECHA TODOS OS MODAIS E SHEETS PARA EVITAR RETENÇÃO DE MEMÓRIA
            if (state.contextMenuVisible) state.contextMenuVisible.value = false;
            if (state.showOrderActionsSheet) state.showOrderActionsSheet.value = false;
            state.clearCart();

            const orderTitle = targetOrder.type === 'table' ? `Mesa ${targetOrder.table_number}` : (targetOrder.customer_name || `Comanda #${targetOrder.id}`);

            const resolvedAddressId = targetOrder.address_id
                || targetOrder.address?.id
                || targetOrder.deliveryAddress?.id
                || null;

            // 🛑 2. PAYLOAD HIGIENIZADO (APENAS TIPOS PRIMITIVOS E ESSENCIAIS)
            const routingPayload = {
                id: targetOrder.id,
                order_id: targetOrder.id,
                existing_order_id: targetOrder.id,
                type: targetOrder.type || 'table',
                dining_table_id: resolvedTableId ? Number(resolvedTableId) : null,
                table_id: resolvedTableId ? Number(resolvedTableId) : null,
                table: {
                    id: resolvedTableId ? Number(resolvedTableId) : null,
                    name: targetOrder.table_number || targetOrder.table?.name || ''
                },
                identifier: targetOrder.customer_name || targetOrder.identifier || '',
                customer: targetOrder.customer ? { id: targetOrder.customer.id, name: targetOrder.customer.name, phone: targetOrder.customer.phone } : null,
                customer_phone: targetOrder.customer_phone || targetOrder.customer?.phone || null,
                address_id: resolvedAddressId,
                address: targetOrder.address_snapshot || null,
                source: 'team_app'
            };

            if (draftRouting) draftRouting.value = routingPayload;
            state.cartRoutingMeta.value = routingPayload;
            state.cartRoutingValid.value = true;
            state.orderType.value = targetOrder.type || 'table';

            try {
                localStorage.setItem('pos_draft_routing', JSON.stringify(routingPayload));
                localStorage.setItem('pos_draft_type', targetOrder.type || 'table');
            } catch (e) {}

            // 🛑 3. QUEBRA DA PILHA SÍNCRONA: Aguarda a desmontagem do menu de contexto
            nextTick(() => {
                state.cartComponentKey.value++;
                state.activeTab.value = 'menu';
            });

            void(0)

        } else {
            state.handleMenuAction(actionId, targetOrder);
        }
    };

    const handleSendOrder = (checkoutData) => {
        isSubmittingOrder.value = true;

        const cleanItems = (state.cart.value || []).map(item => ({
            cartId: item.cartId,
            id: Number(item.id),
            name: item.name,
            price: Number(item.price),
            qty: Number(item.qty),
            notes: item.notes || null,
            isTakeaway: Boolean(item.isTakeaway),
            isCombo: Boolean(item.isCombo || (item.comboItems && item.comboItems.length > 0)),
            replaces_item_id: item.replaces_item_id || null,
            auth_reason: item.auth_reason || null,
            is_loss: item.is_loss || null,
            structuredModifiers: (item.structuredModifiers || []).map(mod => ({
                id: mod.id ? Number(mod.id) : null,
                group_id: mod.group_id ? Number(mod.group_id) : null,
                name: mod.name,
                price: Number(mod.price || 0),
                qty: Number(mod.qty || mod.quantity || 1)
            })),
            comboItems: (item.comboItems || []).map(combo => ({
                id: combo.id,
                product_id: resolveProductId(combo.product_id, combo.id),
                name: combo.name || combo.product_name || 'Subitem',
                group_id: combo.group_id ? Number(combo.group_id) : null,
                group_name: combo.group_name ?? null,
                price: Number(combo.price || 0),
                qty: Number(combo.qty || combo.quantity || 1),
                notes: combo.notes || null,
                structuredModifiers: (combo.structuredModifiers || []).map(cMod => ({
                    id: cMod.id ? Number(cMod.id) : null,
                    group_id: cMod.group_id ? Number(cMod.group_id) : null,
                    name: cMod.name,
                    price: Number(cMod.price || 0),
                    qty: Number(cMod.qty || cMod.quantity || 1)
                }))
            }))
        }));

        const resolvedOrderId = state.props.editOrderData?.id
            || checkoutData.meta?.id
            || checkoutData.meta?.order_id
            || state.cartRoutingMeta.value?.id
            || draftRouting?.value?.id
            || null;

        const rawRouting = checkoutData.meta || state.cartRoutingMeta.value || draftRouting?.value || {};
        const tableId = rawRouting.table?.id || rawRouting.dining_table_id || rawRouting.table_id || null;
        const addressId = rawRouting.address?.id || rawRouting.address_id || null;

        const resolvedRouting = {
            ...rawRouting,
            dining_table_id: tableId ? Number(tableId) : null,
            table_id: tableId ? Number(tableId) : null,
            address_id: addressId ? Number(addressId) : null,
            source: 'team_app'
        };

        if (state.isAllowanceMode?.value) {
            resolvedRouting.payment_engine = 'internal';
            resolvedRouting.payment_method_name = 'Consumo Interno';
        }

        const resolvedFinancials = {
            subtotal: Number(checkoutData.totals?.subtotal || state.cartSubtotal.value || 0),
            deliveryFee: Number(checkoutData.totals?.deliveryFee || 0),
            serviceFee: Number(checkoutData.totals?.serviceFee || 0),
            discount: Number(checkoutData.totals?.discount || 0),
            finalTotal: Number(checkoutData.totals?.finalTotal || state.cartSubtotal.value || 0),
            coupon_code: checkoutData.totals?.coupon_code || null,
            coupon_id: checkoutData.totals?.coupon_id || null,
        };

        const payload = {
            source: 'team_app',
            order_id: resolvedOrderId,
            items: cleanItems,
            routing: resolvedRouting,
            financials: resolvedFinancials,
        };

        const backupCart = state.cart.value.map(item => ({ ...item }));

        if (window.location.search) {
            window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.pathname);
        }

        router.post(route('operations.orders.store'), payload, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: (page) => {
                if (page.props.flash && (page.props.flash.error || page.props.flash.warning)) {
                    isSubmittingOrder.value = false;
                    state.cart.value = backupCart;
                    const errorMsg = page.props.flash.error || page.props.flash.warning;
                    toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Erro no Servidor", detail: errorMsg, life: 8000 });
                    return;
                }

                isSubmittingOrder.value = false;
                isOrderSuccess.value = true;

                if (state.isAllowanceMode) state.isAllowanceMode.value = false;
                state.clearCart();
                state.cartRoutingValid.value = false;
                state.cartRoutingMeta.value = null;
                if (draftRouting) draftRouting.value = null;
                localStorage.removeItem('pos_draft_routing');

                state.cartComponentKey.value++;

                setTimeout(() => {
                    isOrderSuccess.value = false;
                    state.activeTab.value = 'operations';

                    router.reload({
                        only: ['initialOrders'],
                        preserveState: true,
                        preserveScroll: true
                    });
                }, 1200);
            },
            onError: (errors) => {
                isSubmittingOrder.value = false;
                state.cart.value = backupCart;

                const errorMsg = errors && Object.values(errors).length > 0
                    ? Object.values(errors)[0]
                    : "Falha de comunicação com o servidor.";

                toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Erro de Validação", detail: errorMsg, life: 6000 });
            },
        });
    };

    const triggerCheckout = () => {
        if (state.cart.value.length === 0) {
            isSubmittingOrder.value = true;
            setTimeout(() => isSubmittingOrder.value = false, 50);

            toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Comanda Vazia', detail: 'Adicione itens antes de confirmar o pedido.', life: 3000 });
            return;
        }

        const currentMeta = state.cartRoutingMeta.value || draftRouting?.value || {};
        const currentType = state.orderType.value || currentMeta.type || 'table';

        const tableId = currentMeta.dining_table_id || currentMeta.table_id || currentMeta.table?.id;
        const hasTable = currentType === 'table' && Boolean(tableId);
        const hasCounter = currentType === 'counter' && Boolean(currentMeta.customer || currentMeta.customer_name || currentMeta.identifier);
        const hasDelivery = currentType === 'delivery' && Boolean(currentMeta.address || currentMeta.address_id);

        if (!state.cartRoutingValid.value && !hasTable && !hasCounter && !hasDelivery) {
            isSubmittingOrder.value = true;
            setTimeout(() => isSubmittingOrder.value = false, 50);

            const detailMsg = currentType === 'table'
                ? 'Por favor, selecione uma mesa para despachar o pedido.'
                : 'Defina o destino do pedido antes de confirmar.';
            toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Destino Indefinido', detail: detailMsg, life: 4000 });
            return;
        }

        handleSendOrder({
            meta: currentMeta,
            totals: {
                subtotal: state.cartSubtotal.value,
                deliveryFee: 0,
                serviceFee: 0,
                discount: 0,
                finalTotal: state.cartSubtotal.value
            }
        });
    };

    const customHandleItemDuplicate = (item, doneCallback) => {
        const targetId = item._parent_ref ? item._parent_ref.id : item.id;

        router.post(route('operations.quick-add', state.selectedOrderContext.value.id), {
            item_id: targetId,
            should_print: true,
            source: 'team_app'
        }, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            preserveState: true,
            onSuccess: (page) => {
                let updatedOrder = page.props.initialOrders?.find(o => o.id === state.selectedOrderContext.value.id);
                if (updatedOrder) {
                    state.selectedOrderContext.value = updatedOrder;
                    if (typeof doneCallback === 'function') doneCallback(true);
                } else {
                    router.reload({
                        only: ['initialOrders'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true,
                        onSuccess: (newPage) => {
                            const freshOrder = newPage.props.initialOrders?.find(o => o.id === state.selectedOrderContext.value.id);
                            if (freshOrder) state.selectedOrderContext.value = freshOrder;
                            if (typeof doneCallback === 'function') doneCallback(true);
                        }
                    });
                }
            },
            onError: () => {
                if (typeof doneCallback === 'function') doneCallback(false);
                toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Ação Negada', detail: 'Não foi possível duplicar este item.', life: 4000 });
            }
        });
    };

    return {
        isSubmittingOrder, isOrderSuccess, handleCreateOrderOnTable,
        customHandleMenuAction, handleSendOrder, triggerCheckout, customHandleItemDuplicate
    };
}
```

## File: resources/js/Pages/Team/Composables/useTeamSync.js
```javascript
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast';
import { useTenantEcho } from '@/Composables/useTenantEcho';
import { onMounted } from 'vue';

export function useTeamSync(state = {}) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const echo = useTenantEcho();

    let reloadTimer = null;
    const reloadTeamData = () => {
        if (reloadTimer) clearTimeout(reloadTimer);
        reloadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            router.reload({
                only: ['initialOrders', 'initialTableAreas', 'activeShift'],
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true
            });
        }, 300);
    };

    const handleOrderSignal = (e) => {
        const orderId = Number(e?.id || e?.orderId);

        if (state.selectedOrderContext?.value && orderId && Number(state.selectedOrderContext.value.id) === orderId) {
            if (e.status) state.selectedOrderContext.value.status = e.status;
            if (e.payment_status) state.selectedOrderContext.value.payment_status = e.payment_status;

            if (e.payment_status === 'paid' || e.status === 'closed') {
                toast.add({
                    severity: 'success',
                    summary: 'Conta Paga',
                    detail: 'A comanda selecionada foi quitada no caixa.',
                    life: 4000
                });
            }
        }

        reloadTeamData();
    };

    const initTeamSync = () => {
        // 🎯 Inscrição única no canal central de operações
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.order.created', reloadTeamData);
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.order.updated', handleOrderSignal);
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.order.cancelled', reloadTeamData);
        echo.listenChannel('operations', '.table.updated', reloadTeamData);

        // Catálogo
        echo.listenChannel('catalog', '.catalog.updated', () => {
            router.reload({ only: ['initialCategories', 'initialProducts'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
        });

        // Turno
        echo.listenChannel('shift', '.shift.closed', () => {
            if (typeof state.onShiftClosed === 'function') state.onShiftClosed();
            toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Turno Fechado', detail: 'O caixa encerrou o turno.', life: 5000 });
            reloadTeamData();
        });

        echo.listenChannel('shift', '.shift.opened', () => {
            toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Turno Aberto', detail: 'O caixa abriu um novo turno.', life: 3000 });
            reloadTeamData();
        });
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        initTeamSync();
    });

    return { initTeamSync };
}
```

```vue
                    <span class="text-2xl font-black text-primary-500">{{ formattedBalance }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-surface-2 flex items-center justify-center text-surface-muted border border-surface-border">

            >

            >
                <span class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <i class="pi pi-cog text-lg text-surface-muted"></i>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    employeeData: {
        type: Object,
        default: () => ({ balance: 0 })
    }
});

defineEmits(['startAllowanceOrder', 'openSettings']);

const page = usePage();
const user = computed(() => page.props.auth?.user || {});

const userName = computed(() => user.value.name || 'Colaborador');
const userEmail = computed(() => user.value.email || 'equipe@brasume.com.br');

const userRole = computed(() => {
    if (user.value.roles && user.value.roles.length > 0) {
        return user.value.roles[0].replace('_', ' ');
    }
    return user.value.role || 'Operador';
});

const userInitials = computed(() => {
    const names = userName.value.split(' ');
    if (names.length >= 2) {
        return `${names[0][0]}${names[names.length - 1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
    }
    return userName.value.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
});

const formattedBalance = computed(() => {
    const balance = props.employeeData?.balance || 0;
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(balance);
});
</script>
```

```vue
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <span class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-surface-muted font-bold shrink-0 ml-2">
                        {{ device.operator.role || 'Operador' }}
                    </span>
                </div>

                <!-- AÇÕES COM SLIDETOCONFIRM -->
                <div class="pt-0.5">
                    <!-- 🛡️ 1. SLIDE PARA LIBERAR / AUTORIZAR ACESSO -->
                    <SlideToConfirm

                        v-else
                        text="Deslize p/ Bloquear"

                        color="danger"
                        :disabled="isSubmitting === device.uuid"
                        :is-loading="isSubmitting === device.uuid"
                        format="long"
                        @confirm="toggleDeviceAccess(device)"

                    />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div v-if="isScanning" class="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-black flex flex-col animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-300">
            <div class="absolute top-0 w-full p-4 flex justify-between items-center z-10 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/80 to-transparent">
                <div class="text-white">
                    <h3 class="font-black text-lg">Escanear Terminal</h3>
                    <p class="text-xs opacity-80">Aponte para o QR Code na tela do computador</p>

                <qrcode-stream @detect="onDetectQrCode" @error="onCameraError" class="h-full w-full object-cover"></qrcode-stream>
                <div class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center">
```
