```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from "vue";
import { router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useToast } from "primevue/usetoast";
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber } from "@/Utils/formatters";

import CheckoutItemsList from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/CheckoutItemsList.vue";
import TransferItemsModal from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/TransferItemsModal.vue";
import OrderTransformer from "@/Pages/Shared/Order/OrderTransformer.vue";
import OperationReasonModal from "@/Pages/Pos/Components/Checkout/OperationReasonModal.vue";
import AdaptiveModal from "@/Components/UI/AdaptiveModal.vue";

import { useOrderFormatting } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useOrderFormatting";
import { useItemActions } from "@/Pages/Shared/Composables/useItemActions";
import { useSecureAction } from "@/Composables/useSecureAction";

const props = defineProps({
    order: { type: Object, required: true },
    tableAreas: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    companySettings: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
});

const emit = defineEmits(["close", "add-items"]);

const toast = useToast();
const { getOrderTitle, groupActiveItems } = useOrderFormatting();

const formattedOrderTitle = computed(() => getOrderTitle(props.order));
const translatedType = computed(() => {
    const t = { table: "Mesa", counter: "Balcão", delivery: "Delivery" };
    return t[props.order?.type] || "Mesa";
});
const isPaid = computed(() => props.order?.payment_status === "paid");
const activeItemsGrouped = computed(() => groupActiveItems(props.order?.items));

// Estados de modais
const openOrderOptions = ref(false);
const isTransferModalVisible = ref(false);
const isTransformerVisible = ref(false);
const transferItemIds = ref([]);
const isPrintingConference = ref(false);

// Ações nos itens (cancelar, duplicar, trocar)
const dummyRef = ref(true);
const { handleItemDuplicate, handleItemModify, handleItemSwap, handleItemCancel } = useItemActions(
    computed(() => props.order),
    dummyRef,
    'team.app'
);

const { isReasonModalVisible, itemToProcess, authActionType, authNeedsPin, initiateSecureAction } = useSecureAction(
    props.companySettings
);

const handleItemAction = (payload) => {
    const { type, item } = payload;
    if (type === "duplicate") handleItemDuplicate(item);
    else if (type === "transfer") {
        transferItemIds.value = [item.id];
        isTransferModalVisible.value = true;
    } else if (type === "edit") {
        triggerSecureAction(item, "edit");
    } else if (type === "cancel") {
        triggerSecureAction(item, "cancel");
    }
};

const triggerSecureAction = (item, type) => {
    initiateSecureAction(item, type);
};

const handleConfirmAuth = (authData) => {
    if (authActionType.value === "edit") {
        handleItemModify({ item: itemToProcess.value, authData });
    } else if (authActionType.value === "swap") {
        handleItemSwap({ item: itemToProcess.value, authData });
    } else if (authActionType.value === "cancel_order") {
        router.post(route('operations.orders.cancel', itemToProcess.value.id),
            {
                reason: authData.reason,
            },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                is_loss: authData.isLoss,
                lost_items: authData.lostItems,
                pin: authData.password,
            },
            {
                preserveScroll: true,
                onSuccess: () => {
                    isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
                    toast.add({ severity: "success", summary: "Cancelado", detail: "Pedido cancelado.", life: 3000 });
                    emit("close");
                },
                onError: (err) => {
                    toast.add({ severity: "error", summary: "Erro", detail: err.pin || "Erro ao cancelar.", life: 4000 });
                },
            }
        );
        return;
    } else {
        handleItemCancel({
            item: itemToProcess.value,
            isLoss: authData.isLoss,
            reason: authData.reason,
            password: authData.password,
        });
    }

    isReasonModalVisible.value = false;
};

// Navegação para o cardápio
const handleAddItems = () => {
    localStorage.setItem("pos_draft_type", props.order?.type || "table");
    localStorage.setItem("pos_return_url", "/team");
    localStorage.setItem("pos_return_order_id", props.order?.id);
    emit("add-items", props.order);
};

// Transferências
const handleOpenTransferAll = () => {
    transferItemIds.value = activeItemsGrouped.value.map((i) => i.id);
    isTransferModalVisible.value = true;
};

const handleExecuteTransfer = (payload) => {
    router.post(route("operations.transfer-items"), payload, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            isTransferModalVisible.value = false;
            void(0)
        },
    });
};

const handleTransformation = (payload) => {
    router.post(route("operations.orders.transform", props.order?.id), payload, {
        onSuccess: () => {
            isTransformerVisible.value = false;
            void(0)
        },
    });
};

// Impressão da parcial
const handlePrintConference = () => {
    if (isPrintingConference.value) return;
    isPrintingConference.value = true;

    router.post(
        route("operations.print-conference", props.order?.id),
        {},
        {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onFinish: () => {
                isPrintingConference.value = false;
            },
            onSuccess: () => {
                void(0)
            },
        }
    );
};
</script>
```

```vue
        <div v-if="activeTab === 'bar'" class="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col min-h-0 animate-in fade-in">
            <TeamBarTab
                :pending-items="barItems"
                @take-item="$emit('kds-take', $event)"
                @complete-item="$emit('kds-complete', $event)"
                @print-item="$emit('kds-print', $event)"
                @loss-item="$emit('kds-loss', $event)"
            />
        </div>

        <!-- ⚙️ ABA: CONFIGURAÇÕES -->
        <div v-show="activeTab === 'settings'" class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto hide-scrollbar p-4 pb-32 animate-in fade-in">
            <AppearanceSettings :is-team-mode="true" />
        </div>

        <!-- 👛 ABA: CARTEIRA (Perfil Corporativo) -->
        <div v-if="activeTab === 'wallet'" class="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col min-h-0 animate-in fade-in">
            <CorporateProfileTab
                :employee-data="$page.props.employeeWalletData"
                @start-allowance-order="$emit('startAllowanceOrder')"
                @open-settings="$emit('update:activeTab', 'settings')"
            />
        </div>

        <!-- 🛵 ABA: MOTOBOY -->
        <div v-if="activeTab === 'driver'" class="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col min-h-0 animate-in fade-in">
            <DriverBoard />
        </div>

        <!-- ✅ ABA: CHECKLISTS -->
        <div v-if="activeTab === 'checklists'" class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 pb-32 hide-scrollbar animate-in fade-in">
            <TeamChecklists />
        </div>

        <!-- 🏭 ABA: PRODUÇÃO -->
        <div v-if="activeTab === 'production'" class="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col min-h-0 pb-20 animate-in fade-in">
            <ProductionBoard :orders="$page.props.productionOrders || []" />
        </div>

        <!-- 🛒 ABA: COMPRAS -->
        <div v-if="activeTab === 'shopping'" class="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col min-h-0 pb-20 animate-in fade-in">
            <ShoppingList :bidding-matrix="$page.props.biddingMatrix || {}" />
        </div>

        <!-- 🛒 CARRINHO DA EQUIPE -->
        <TeamCart
            ref="cartRef"
            :key="cartComponentKey"
            v-show="activeTab === 'cart'"
            class="!border-none !rounded-none !shadow-none h-full animate-in slide-in-from-right-4"
            :cart="cart"
            :cart-subtotal="cartSubtotal"
            :order-type="orderType"
            :table-areas="initialTableAreas"
            :customers="initialCustomers"
            :edit-order-data="editOrderData"
            :is-allowance-mode="isAllowanceMode"
            :cart-routing-meta="cartRoutingMeta"
            @update-qty="(idx, delta) => $emit('update-qty', idx, delta)"
            @clear-cart="$emit('clearCart')"
            @edit-item="(item, idx) => $emit('edit-item', item, idx)"
            @checkout="$emit('checkout', $event)"
            @update:orderType="$emit('update:orderType', $event)"
            @routing-valid="$emit('routingValid', $event)"
            @routing-meta="$emit('routingMeta', $event)"
        />
    </main>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, defineAsyncComponent } from 'vue';
import TeamCart from "@/Pages/Team/TeamCart.vue";
import AppearanceSettings from "@/Pages/Settings/Components/AppearanceSettings.vue";
import OpenTabs from "@/Pages/Operations/Components/Dashboard/OpenTabs.vue";
import TeamMenuTab from "@/Pages/Team/TeamMenuTab.vue";

// Abas Assíncronas (Lazy Load)
const InventoryTab = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/InventoryTab.vue'));
const TeamHomeTab = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/TeamHomeTab.vue'));
const RestockTab = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/RestockTab.vue'));
const ManagerShiftDashboard = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/ManagerShiftDashboard.vue'));
const CorporateProfileTab = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/CorporateProfileTab.vue'));
const DriverBoard = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/DriverBoard.vue'));
const TeamChecklists = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/TeamChecklists.vue'));
const ProductionBoard = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Shared/SupplyChain/ProductionBoard.vue'));
const ShoppingList = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Shared/SupplyChain/ShoppingList.vue'));
const DeviceFleetPanel = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/DeviceFleetPanel.vue'));
const TeamBarTab = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/Pages/Team/TeamBarTab.vue'));

const props = defineProps({
    activeTab: String,
    searchQuery: { type: String, default: '' },
    categoryLayout: String,
    mobileCategoryLayout: String,
    productCardLayout: String,
    visibleMenuCategories: Array,
    activeMenuCategory: [String, Number],
    visibleGridCategories: Array,
    shouldShowCategoryGrid: Boolean,
    shouldShowProductGrid: Boolean,
    filteredProducts: Array,
    onSiteOrders: Array,
    initialTableAreas: Array,
    restockData: Object,
    catalog: Array,
    initialProducts: Array,
    cartComponentKey: Number,
    cart: Array,
    cartSubtotal: Number,
    orderType: String,
    initialCustomers: Array,
    editOrderData: Object,
    isAllowanceMode: Boolean,
    cartRoutingMeta: Object,
    barItems: { type: Array, default: () => [] }
});

defineEmits([
    'update:activeTab', 'update:searchQuery', 'categorySelect', 'productClick', 'openMenu',
    'createOrder', 'startAllowanceOrder', 'update-qty', 'clearCart',
    'edit-item', 'checkout', 'update:orderType', 'routingValid', 'routingMeta',
    'kds-take', 'kds-complete', 'kds-print', 'kds-loss', 'kds-cancel'
]);

const cartRef = ref(null);

const toggleCartRouting = () => {
    cartRef.value?.toggleRouting();
};

defineExpose({
    toggleCartRouting
});
</script>
```

```php
@props(['payable'])

    $color = $isLate ? "text-danger-600" : "text-warning-600";
@endphp

            <x-heroicon-m-calendar class="w-4 h-4 mr-2 text-gray-400 shrink-0"/>
            Venc: {{ $date }}
        </span>
        @if($isLate)
            <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-danger-100 text-danger-800">Em Atraso</span>
        @endif
    </div>

    <div class="grow mt-4 mb-8">
        <p class="text-lg text-gray-900 dark:text-white font-medium leading-tight">
            {{ $payable->description }}

        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase font-medium mb-1">Valor Original</p>
        <p class="text-2xl font-medium {{ $color }}">
            R$ {{ $val }}
        </p>
    </div>
</div>
```

```php
@props(['statement', 'score' => 0])

    $val = "R$ " . number_format(abs((float) $statement->amount), 2, ",", ".");

    $desc = $statement->counterparty_name ?: $statement->description;

    $badgeColor = $score >= 80
        ? "bg-success-100 text-success-800 dark:bg-success-800 dark:text-success-100"
        : ($score >= 50 ? "bg-warning-100 text-warning-800 dark:bg-warning-800 dark:text-warning-100" : "bg-danger-100 text-danger-800 dark:bg-danger-800 dark:text-danger-100");
@endphp

<div class='flex items-center justify-between w-full gap-4 px-2 py-1'>

        <x-heroicon-m-calendar class="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-gray-400 shrink-0"/>
        {{ $date }}
    </div>
    <div class='flex items-center grow text-left text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200'>
        <x-heroicon-m-building-storefront class="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-gray-400 shrink-0"/>
        {{ $desc }}
    </div>
    <div class='flex items-center justify-end text-danger-600 font-medium w-32'>
        <x-heroicon-m-currency-dollar class="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-danger-400 shrink-0"/>
        {{ $val }}
    </div>
    <div class='w-32 text-right'>
        @if($score > 0)
            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] uppercase font-medium tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 {{ $badgeColor }}">
                <x-heroicon-m-check class="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 shrink-0"/>
                {{ $score }}% Match
            </span>
        @else
            {{-- 🚀 A NOVA BADGE DE FALLBACK (MATEMÁTICA PURA) --}}
            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] uppercase font-medium tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-400">
                <x-heroicon-m-arrows-right-left class="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 shrink-0"/>
                Valor Próximo
            </span>
        @endif
    </div>
</div>
```

```php
        id="nfe_upload"
```

## File: resources/views/filament/resources/categories/pages/tree-category.blade.php
```php
<x-filament-panels::page>
    <!-- Script leve de Drag and Drop -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.2/Sortable.min.js"></script>

    <div class="p-6 bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-gray-900/50 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800"
         x-data="treeDragAndDrop($wire)"
         x-init="initTree()">

        <div id="tree-root" class="sortable-list space-y-1" data-parent-id="">
            @if($this->getCategories()->isNotEmpty())
                @include('filament.components.category-tree-node', ['categories' => $this->getCategories()])
            @else
                <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                    Nenhuma categoria cadastrada até o momento.
                </div>
            @endif
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('treeDragAndDrop', (wire) => ({
                initTree() {
                    this.$nextTick(() => {
                        this.bindSortable();
                    });
                },
                bindSortable() {
                    const lists = document.querySelectorAll('.sortable-list');
                    lists.forEach(list => {
                        new Sortable(list, {
                            group: 'nested-tree',
                            animation: 150,
                            handle: '.drag-handle',
                            fallbackOnBody: true,
                            swapThreshold: 0.65,
                            onEnd: (evt) => {
                                const treeData = this.serializeTree(document.getElementById('tree-root'));
                                wire.updateCategoryOrder(treeData);
                            }
                        });
                    });
                },
                serializeTree(container) {
                    const items = [];
                    const children = Array.from(container.children).filter(el => el.classList.contains('sortable-item'));

                    children.forEach(item => {
                        const id = item.getAttribute('data-id');
                        const subContainer = item.querySelector('.sortable-list');
                        const node = {
                            id: parseInt(id),
                            children: subContainer ? this.serializeTree(subContainer) : []
                        };
                        items.push(node);
                    });

                    return items;
                }
            }));
        });
    </script>
</x-filament-panels::page>
```

```php
    <body class="bg-[#FDFDFC] dark:bg-[#0a0a0a] text-[#1b1b18] flex p-6 lg:p-8 items-center lg:justify-center min-h-screen flex-col">
        <header class="w-full lg:max-w-4xl max-w-[335px] text-sm mb-6 not-has-[nav]:hidden">
            @if (Route::has('login'))
                <nav class="flex items-center justify-end gap-4">
                    @auth
                        <a
                            href="{{ url('/dashboard') }}"
                            class="inline-block px-5 py-1.5 dark:text-[#EDEDEC] border-[#19140035] hover:border-[#1915014a] border text-[#1b1b18] dark:border-[#3E3E3A] dark:hover:border-[#62605b] rounded-sm text-sm leading-normal"
                        >
                            Dashboard
                        </a>
                    @else
                        <a
                            href="{{ route('login') }}"
                            class="inline-block px-5 py-1.5 dark:text-[#EDEDEC] text-[#1b1b18] border border-transparent hover:border-[#19140035] dark:hover:border-[#3E3E3A] rounded-sm text-sm leading-normal"
                        >
                            Log in
                        </a>

                        @if (Route::has('register'))
                            <a
                                href="{{ route('register') }}"
                                class="inline-block px-5 py-1.5 dark:text-[#EDEDEC] border-[#19140035] hover:border-[#1915014a] border text-[#1b1b18] dark:border-[#3E3E3A] dark:hover:border-[#62605b] rounded-sm text-sm leading-normal">
                                Register
                            </a>
                        @endif
                    @endauth
                </nav>
            @endif
        </header>
        <div class="flex items-center justify-center w-full transition-opacity opacity-100 duration-750 lg:grow starting:opacity-0">
            <main class="flex max-w-[335px] w-full flex-col-reverse lg:max-w-4xl lg:flex-row">
                <div class="text-[13px] leading-[20px] flex-1 p-6 pb-12 lg:p-20 bg-white dark:bg-[#161615] dark:text-[#EDEDEC] shadow-[inset_0px_0px_0px_1px_rgba(26,26,0,0.16)] dark:shadow-[inset_0px_0px_0px_1px_#fffaed2d] rounded-bl-lg rounded-br-lg lg:rounded-tl-lg lg:rounded-br-none">
                    <h1 class="mb-1 font-medium">Let's get started</h1>
                    <p class="mb-2 text-[#706f6c] dark:text-[#A1A09A]">Laravel has an incredibly rich ecosystem. <br>We suggest starting with the following.</p>
                    <ul class="flex flex-col mb-4 lg:mb-6">
                        <li class="flex items-center gap-4 py-2 relative before:border-l before:border-[#e3e3e0] dark:before:border-[#3E3E3A] before:top-1/2 before:bottom-0 before:left-[0.4rem] before:absolute">
                            <span class="relative py-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#161615]">
                                <span class="flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#FDFDFC] dark:bg-[#161615] shadow-[0px_0px_1px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03),0px_1px_2px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] w-3.5 h-3.5 border dark:border-[#3E3E3A] border-[#e3e3e0]">
                                    <span class="rounded-full bg-[#dbdbd7] dark:bg-[#3E3E3A] w-1.5 h-1.5"></span>
                                </span>
                            </span>
                            <span>
                                Read the
                                <a href="https://laravel.com/docs" target="_blank" class="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 font-medium underline underline-offset-4 text-[#f53003] dark:text-[#FF4433] ml-1">
                                    <span>Documentation</span>
                                    <svg
                                        width="10"
                                        height="11"
                                        viewBox="0 0 10 11"
                                        fill="none"
                                        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                        class="w-2.5 h-2.5"
                                    >
                                        <path
                                            d="M7.70833 6.95834V2.79167H3.54167M2.5 8L7.5 3.00001"
                                            stroke="currentColor"
                                            stroke-linecap="square"
                                        />
                                    </svg>
                                </a>
                            </span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="flex items-center gap-4 py-2 relative before:border-l before:border-[#e3e3e0] dark:before:border-[#3E3E3A] before:bottom-1/2 before:top-0 before:left-[0.4rem] before:absolute">
                            <span class="relative py-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#161615]">
                                <span class="flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#FDFDFC] dark:bg-[#161615] shadow-[0px_0px_1px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03),0px_1px_2px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] w-3.5 h-3.5 border dark:border-[#3E3E3A] border-[#e3e3e0]">
                                    <span class="rounded-full bg-[#dbdbd7] dark:bg-[#3E3E3A] w-1.5 h-1.5"></span>
                                </span>
                            </span>
                            <span>
                                Watch video tutorials at
                                <a href="https://laracasts.com" target="_blank" class="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 font-medium underline underline-offset-4 text-[#f53003] dark:text-[#FF4433] ml-1">
                                    <span>Laracasts</span>
                                    <svg
                                        width="10"
                                        height="11"
                                        viewBox="0 0 10 11"
                                        fill="none"
                                        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                        class="w-2.5 h-2.5"
                                    >
                                        <path
                                            d="M7.70833 6.95834V2.79167H3.54167M2.5 8L7.5 3.00001"
                                            stroke="currentColor"
                                            stroke-linecap="square"
                                        />
                                    </svg>
                                </a>
                            </span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                    <ul class="flex gap-3 text-sm leading-normal">
                        <li>
                            <a href="https://cloud.laravel.com" target="_blank" class="inline-block dark:bg-[#eeeeec] dark:border-[#eeeeec] dark:text-[#1C1C1A] dark:hover:bg-white dark:hover:border-white hover:bg-black hover:border-black px-5 py-1.5 bg-[#1b1b18] rounded-sm border border-black text-white text-sm leading-normal">
                                Deploy now
                            </a>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
                <div class="bg-[#fff2f2] dark:bg-[#1D0002] relative lg:-ml-px -mb-px lg:mb-0 rounded-t-lg lg:rounded-t-none lg:rounded-r-lg aspect-[335/376] lg:aspect-auto w-full lg:w-[438px] shrink-0 overflow-hidden">
                    {{-- Laravel Logo --}}
```

```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\DynamicManifestController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Auth\TeamGatewayController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Auth\PinAuthController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Auth\QrAuthController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Auth\RemoteUnlockController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Auth\TwoFactorController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\RestaurantOps\BridgeApiController;
use App\Http\Controllers\GoogleController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Auth\LogoutController;
use App\Http\Controllers\FacebookController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Auth\SocialLoginReceiverController;

// Manifest PWA
Route::get('/manifest.json', [DynamicManifestController::class, 'show']);

// Logout Unificado
Route::post('/logout', [LogoutController::class, 'destroy'])->name('logout');

// Gateway B2C (Cliente)
Route::get("/customer/login", function () {
    if (auth()->check()) {
        return redirect()->intended('/customer/home');
    }

    $url = session()->get('url.intended', '/customer/home');
    $separator = str_contains($url, '?') ? '&' : '?';
    return redirect($url . $separator . 'open_login=true');
})->name("login");

// Gateways B2B (Equipe)
Route::get("/pos/login", [TeamGatewayController::class, 'show'])->name("pos.login");
Route::get("/waiter/login", [TeamGatewayController::class, 'show'])->name("waiter.login");
Route::get("/kds/login", [TeamGatewayController::class, 'show'])->name("kds.login");
Route::get("/team/login", [TeamGatewayController::class, 'show'])->name("team.login");

// 🔙 Aliases de compatibilidade para evitar RouteNotFoundException
Route::get("/team/desktop/login", fn () => redirect()->route('pos.login'))->name("team.desktop.login");
Route::get("/team/mobile/login", fn () => redirect()->route('waiter.login'))->name("team.mobile.login");

// 🔒 PIN com Blindagem contra Força Bruta (Máximo 5 tentativas por minuto por IP)
Route::prefix('auth/pin')->middleware(['throttle:5,1'])->group(function () {
    Route::post('/login', [PinAuthController::class, 'login'])->name('auth.pin.login');
    Route::post('/login-email', [PinAuthController::class, 'loginWithEmail'])->name('auth.pin.login-email');
});

// Autenticação QR
Route::prefix('auth/qr')->group(function () {
    Route::post('/exchange', [QrAuthController::class, 'exchangeToken'])->name('auth.qr.exchange');
    Route::middleware(['auth:web,team'])->post('/authorize', [QrAuthController::class, 'authorizeLogin'])->name('auth.qr.authorize');
    Route::post('/validate-device', [QrAuthController::class, 'validateDevice'])->name('auth.qr.validate');
});

// Controle de Frota (Liberação Remota)
Route::prefix('auth/remote')->group(function () {
    Route::post('/request', [RemoteUnlockController::class, 'requestUnlock'])->name('auth.remote.request');
    Route::post('/exchange', [RemoteUnlockController::class, 'exchange'])->name('auth.remote.exchange');
    Route::post('/register-qr', [RemoteUnlockController::class, 'registerQrSession'])->name('auth.remote.register-qr');

    Route::middleware(['auth:team'])->group(function () {
        Route::get('/fleet', [RemoteUnlockController::class, 'fleet'])->name('auth.remote.fleet');
        Route::post('/approve', [RemoteUnlockController::class, 'approve'])->name('team.remote-unlock.approve');
        Route::post('/lock', [RemoteUnlockController::class, 'lock'])->name('team.remote-unlock.lock');
    });
});

Route::middleware(['auth:web,team'])
    ->get('/team/quick-unlock/{token}', [RemoteUnlockController::class, 'handleQuickUnlockScan'])
    ->name('team.quick-unlock');

// 2FA
Route::middleware(['auth:web,team'])->group(function () {
    Route::get('/auth/2fa', [TwoFactorController::class, 'showChallenge'])->name('auth.2fa.challenge');
    Route::post('/auth/2fa/verify', [TwoFactorController::class, 'verifyChallenge'])->name('auth.2fa.verify');
});

// Spooler Local (Bridge API)
Route::prefix('api/bridge')->group(function () {
    Route::post('/handshake', [BridgeApiController::class, 'handshake']);
    Route::get('/printers', [BridgeApiController::class, 'getPrinters']);
    Route::post('/jobs/{id}/status', [BridgeApiController::class, 'updateJobStatus']);
});

// Google OAuth
Route::post("/auth/google/get-url", [GoogleController::class, "getGoogleUrl"])->name("google.url");
Route::get("/auth/google/redirect", [GoogleController::class, "redirectToGoogle"])
    ->name("google.redirect")
    ->withoutMiddleware(['guest', \Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\RedirectIfAuthenticated::class]);

Route::get("/auth/google/magic-login-team", [GoogleController::class, "magicLoginTeam"])
    ->name("auth.magic.team")
    ->withoutMiddleware(['guest', \Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\RedirectIfAuthenticated::class]);

Route::get("/auth/google/magic-login-customer", [GoogleController::class, "magicLoginCustomer"])
    ->name("auth.magic.customer")
    ->withoutMiddleware(['guest', \Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\RedirectIfAuthenticated::class]);

// Rota para o Vue requisitar a URL de login do Facebook
Route::post('/auth/facebook/url', [FacebookController::class, 'getFacebookUrl'])->name('facebook.url');

// Receptor do Magic Login no tenant
Route::get('/auth/social/magic-login', [SocialLoginReceiverController::class, 'magicLogin'])->name('social.magic-login');
```

```php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

// ⭐ ATALHO AMIGÁVEL DE AVALIAÇÃO NO GOOGLE
Route::get('/avaliacao', function () {
    $setting = CompanySetting::getCached() ?? CompanySetting::first();
    $targetUrl = $setting?->google_review_link;

    if (!empty($targetUrl)) {
        return redirect()->away($targetUrl);
    }

    return redirect()->to('/cardapio');
})->name('tenant.review');

// 📲 ROTA DO QR CODE DA MESA (Autoatendimento)
Route::get('/mesa/{hash}', [CustomerAppController::class, 'resolveTableQrCode'])->name('customer.table.qr');

        ->name("customer.auth.whatsapp.send");

        ->withoutMiddleware([

        ])
        ->name("customer.auth.whatsapp.verify");

    // 👤 Visitante (Guest Mode)
    Route::post("/guest-register", [CustomerGuestController::class, "register"])->name("customer.auth.guest-register");

    // 🛒 Operações de Pedidos, Avaliações e Cupons
```

```php
            ->name('operations.attendance.payout-details');

        Route::post('/attendance/pay', [ShiftAttendanceController::class, 'payFreelancer'])
            ->name('operations.attendance.pay');
    });

    // ==========================================
    // ↩️ 4. ESTORNOS E AUDITORIA

    Route::post('/orders/{order}/rollback-payment/{payment}', [CashierController::class, 'rollbackPayment'])
        ->name('operations.cashier.rollback-payment');

    Route::post('/orders/{order}/refund-and-clone', [CashierController::class, 'refundAndClone'])
        ->name('operations.orders.refund-and-clone');
});
```

```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Apps\TeamDispatcherController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Apps\PosAppController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Apps\TeamAppController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Apps\KdsAppController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Tenant\Terminals\PosOrderEntryController;

// ==========================================
// 🚀 ATALHOS AMIGÁVEIS E ALIASES DE NAVEGAÇÃO
// ==========================================
Route::middleware(['auth:team'])->group(function () {
    Route::get('/pdv', fn () => redirect()->to('/pos' . (request()->getQueryString() ? '?' . request()->getQueryString() : '')));
    Route::get('/caixa', fn () => redirect()->to('/pos' . (request()->getQueryString() ? '?' . request()->getQueryString() : '')));
    Route::get('/garcom', fn () => redirect()->to('/team/app' . (request()->getQueryString() ? '?' . request()->getQueryString() : '')));
    Route::get('/cozinha', fn () => redirect()->to('/kds' . (request()->getQueryString() ? '?' . request()->getQueryString() : '')));

    Route::get("/team/desktop/{tab?}", fn ($tab = null) => redirect()->to('/pos' . ($tab ? '/' . $tab : '') . (request()->getQueryString() ? '?' . request()->getQueryString() : '')))->where('tab', '.*')->name('team.desktop');
    Route::get("/team/mobile/{tab?}", fn ($tab = null) => redirect()->route('team.app', ['tab' => $tab]))->where('tab', '.*')->name('team.mobile');
    Route::get("/waiter/{tab?}", fn ($tab = null) => redirect()->route('team.app', ['tab' => $tab]))->where('tab', '.*')->name('waiter.index');
    Route::get("/team/kds/{kitchen_id?}", fn ($kitchen_id = null) => redirect()->route('kds.index', ['kitchen_id' => $kitchen_id]))->name('team.kds');
});

// ==========================================
// 👥 NÚCLEO DOS 3 APPS B2B DA OPERAÇÃO
// ==========================================
Route::middleware(['auth:team'])->group(function () {

    Route::get("/team", [TeamDispatcherController::class, "index"])->name("team.index");
    Route::post("/team/start-shift", [TeamDispatcherController::class, "startShift"])->name("team.start-shift");

    // 🖥️ 1. PosApp
    Route::get("/pos/{tab?}", [PosAppController::class, "index"])
        ->where('tab', '.*')
        ->name("pos.index");

    Route::get("/pos/order-entry", [PosOrderEntryController::class, "index"])
        ->name("pos.order-entry");

    // 📱 2. TeamApp
    Route::get("/team/app/{tab?}", [TeamAppController::class, "index"])
        ->where('tab', '.*')
        ->name("team.app");

    // 🍳 3. KdsApp
    Route::get("/kds/{kitchen_id?}", [KdsAppController::class, "index"])
        ->name("kds.index");
});
```

## File: routes/channels.php
```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Broadcast;

Broadcast::channel('App.Models.User.{id}', function ($user, $id) {
    return (int) $user->id === (int) $id;
});

// 🛡️ Canal restrito à equipe interna (POS, KDS, Garçom, Gestor)
Broadcast::channel('tenant.{tenantId}.operations', function ($user, $tenantId) {
    return $user !== null && (string) (tenant('id') ?? 'central') === (string) $tenantId;
});

// 🛡️ Canal restrito a impressoras e hardware do salão
Broadcast::channel('tenant.{tenantId}.hardware', function ($user, $tenantId) {
    return $user !== null && (string) (tenant('id') ?? 'central') === (string) $tenantId;
});

// 🛡️ Canal restrito a um cliente específico (autenticado ou convidado)
Broadcast::channel('tenant.{tenantId}.customer.{customerId}', function ($user, $tenantId, $customerId) {
    // Se o cliente for usuário autenticado
    if ($user && method_exists($user, 'customer') && (int) $user->customer?->id === (int) $customerId) {
        return true;
    }
    // Se for convidado navegando com cookie de sessão
    return (int) session('guest_customer_id') === (int) $customerId;
});
```

## File: debug_shift_blocking_orders.php
```php
<?php

$tenant = \App\Models\Tenant::find('nativa')
    ?? \App\Models\Tenant::where('slug', 'nativa')->orWhere('name', 'like', '%nativa%')->first();

if (!$tenant) {
    echo "❌ Tenant nativa não localizado!\n";
    return;
}

tenancy()->initialize($tenant);

$shift = \App\Models\CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();

echo "\n==================== TURNO ATUAL ====================\n";
if ($shift) {
    echo "Turno ID: {$shift->id}\n";
    echo "Abertura: {$shift->opened_at}\n";
    echo "Status: {$shift->status}\n";
} else {
    echo "⚠️ Nenhum turno com status 'open' encontrado!\n";
}
echo "=====================================================\n\n";

// Busca os pedidos não-mesa (balcão, delivery, retirada) que impedem o fechamento:
// 1. Status diferente de finalizado/cancelado OU
// 2. Pagamento pendente/parcial
$blockingOrders = \App\Models\Order::query()
    ->where('type', '!=', 'table')
    ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'voided', 'refunded'])
    ->where(function ($q) {
        $q->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'completed'])
          ->orWhereNotIn('payment_status', ['paid']);
    })
    ->with(['customer', 'payments'])
    ->get();

echo "🔍 Total de pedidos balcão/delivery pendentes: " . $blockingOrders->count() . "\n\n";

if ($blockingOrders->isEmpty()) {
    echo "Nenhum pedido encontrado na regra padrão. Buscando em modo amplo (todos não finalizados):\n";
    $broadSearch = \App\Models\Order::whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'completed', 'cancelled'])
        ->get(['id', 'type', 'status', 'payment_status', 'created_at']);
    echo json_encode($broadSearch, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n";
    return;
}

foreach ($blockingOrders as $order) {
    $paidSum = (float) $order->payments->sum('amount');
    $balance = round((float) $order->total - $paidSum, 2);

    echo "--------------------------------------------------\n";
    echo "📦 PEDIDO #{$order->id}\n";
    echo "Tipo: {$order->type}\n";
    echo "Origem/Canal: " . ($order->source ?? 'N/A') . "\n";
    echo "Status do Pedido: {$order->status}\n";
    echo "Status de Pagamento: {$order->payment_status}\n";
    echo "Valor Total: R$ " . number_format($order->total, 2, ',', '.') . "\n";
    echo "Total Pago: R$ " . number_format($paidSum, 2, ',', '.') . "\n";
    echo "Saldo Devedor: R$ " . number_format($balance, 2, ',', '.') . "\n";
    echo "Cliente: " . ($order->customer_name ?? $order->customer?->name ?? 'Consumidor Final') . "\n";
    echo "Criado em: " . $order->created_at?->format('d/m/Y H:i:s') . "\n";
    echo "--------------------------------------------------\n";
}
```

## File: exportar_settings.php
```php
<?php

use App\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;

echo "\n=========================================================\n";
echo "⚙️  EXPORTANDO COMPANY SETTINGS (TENANT: NATIVA)\n";
echo "=========================================================\n\n";

// 1. Encontra e inicializa a Lanchonete 'nativa'
$tenant = Tenant::find('nativa');

if ($tenant) {
    tenancy()->initialize($tenant);

    // 2. Busca o registro único de configurações
    $settings = CompanySetting::getCached();

    if ($settings) {
        // 3. Converte para JSON bonitinho e fácil de ler
        $jsonContent = json_encode($settings->toArray(), JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

        // 4. Define o caminho para salvar na RAIZ do projeto
        $filePath = base_path('company_settings_snapshot.json');

        // 5. Salva o arquivo sobrescrevendo o anterior
        File::put($filePath, $jsonContent);

        echo "✅ Snapshot das configurações gerado com sucesso!\n";
        echo "📂 Salvo em: {$filePath}\n\n";
    } else {
        echo "⚠️ Aviso: A tabela company_settings está vazia neste tenant.\n\n";
    }

    tenancy()->end();
} else {
    echo "❌ Erro: Tenant 'nativa' não encontrado no banco de dados.\n\n";
}
```

```php
<?php

function replaceInFile($filePath, $search, $replace) {
    if (!file_exists($filePath)) return;
    $content = file_get_contents($filePath);
    if (str_contains($content, $search)) {
        $content = str_replace($search, $replace, $content);
        file_put_contents($filePath, $content);
        echo "✅ Corrigido: {$filePath}\n";
    }
}

// 1. BLINDAR useCustomerSync.js
$syncFile = 'resources/js/Pages/Customer/Composables/useCustomerSync.js';
if (file_exists($syncFile)) {
    $syncContent = file_get_contents($syncFile);

    // Substitui reload forçado de settings por reload reativo do Inertia
    $oldSettingsListener = "listenChannel('system', '.settings.updated', () => window.location.reload(true));";
    $newSettingsListener = "listenChannel('system', '.settings.updated', () => {
                router.reload({ only: ['storeStatus', 'companySettings'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });
            });";

    if (str_contains($syncContent, $oldSettingsListener)) {
        $syncContent = str_replace($oldSettingsListener, $newSettingsListener, $syncContent);
        echo "✅ useCustomerSync.js: settings.updated protegido contra F5 físico!\n";
    }

    // Se houver .then(() => window.location.reload())
    $oldPromiseReload = ".then(() => window.location.reload())";
    $newPromiseReload = ".then(() => { router.reload({ preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true }); })";
    if (str_contains($syncContent, $oldPromiseReload)) {
        $syncContent = str_replace($oldPromiseReload, $newPromiseReload, $syncContent);
        echo "✅ useCustomerSync.js: promise reload suavizado!\n";
    }

    file_put_contents($syncFile, $syncContent);
}

// 2. BLINDAR CustomerApp.vue
replaceInFile(
    'resources/js/Pages/Customer/CustomerApp.vue',
    "router.reload({ only: ['myActiveOrders', 'companySettings'] });",
    "router.reload({ only: ['myActiveOrders', 'companySettings'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });"
);

replaceInFile(
    'resources/js/Pages/Customer/CustomerApp.vue',
    "router.post(route('customer.profile.update'), formData, {\n        preserveScroll: true,\n        onSuccess:",
    "router.post(route('customer.profile.update'), formData, {\n        preserveScroll: true,\n        preserveState: true,\n        onSuccess:"
);

// 3. BLINDAR CustomerOpenTabs.vue
replaceInFile(
    'resources/js/Pages/Customer/CustomerOpenTabs.vue',
    "router.reload({\n        only: ['myActiveOrders'],\n    });",
    "router.reload({\n        only: ['myActiveOrders'],\n        preserveState: true,\n        preserveScroll: true,\n    });"
);

// 4. BLINDAR UpgradeAccountModal.vue
$upgradeFile = 'resources/js/Pages/Customer/Profile/UpgradeAccountModal.vue';
if (file_exists($upgradeFile)) {
    $upgradeContent = file_get_contents($upgradeFile);

    // Substitui o reload físico por reidratação do cliente
    if (str_contains($upgradeContent, 'window.location.reload();')) {
        $upgradeContent = str_replace(
            'window.location.reload();',
            "router.reload({ only: ['customer', 'auth'], preserveState: true, preserveScroll: true });",
            $upgradeContent
        );
    }

    // Adiciona preserveState no post de upgrade se não tiver
    $upgradeContent = preg_replace(
        '/router\.post\(route\(\'customer\.auth\.upgrade\'\),\s*\{([^}]+)\},\s*\{/s',
        "router.post(route('customer.auth.upgrade'), { $1 }, {\n        preserveState: true,\n        preserveScroll: true,",
        $upgradeContent
    );

    file_put_contents($upgradeFile, $upgradeContent);
    echo "✅ UpgradeAccountModal.vue blindado com sucesso!\n";
}
```

## File: fix_helpers.php
```php
<?php
$dir = new RecursiveDirectoryIterator(__DIR__ . '/app/Filament');
$iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator($dir);
$count = 0;

foreach ($iterator as $file) {
    if ($file->isFile() && $file->getExtension() === 'php') {
        $content = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
        
        // Padrão Regex: Captura exatamente ->helperText('texto') ou ->helperText("texto")
        $pattern = '/(->helperText\(\s*)([\'"])(.*?)(?<!\\\\)\2(\s*\))/s';
        
        // Substitui pelo hintIcon nativo com a cor primary e Tooltip
        $replacement = '->hintIcon(\'heroicon-m-question-mark-circle\', tooltip: $2$3$2)->hintColor(\'primary\')';
        
        $newContent = preg_replace($pattern, $replacement, $content, -1, $replaced);
        
        if ($replaced > 0 && $newContent !== $content) {
            file_put_contents($file->getPathname(), $newContent);
            $count += $replaced;
            echo "✅ Ajustado: " . $file->getFilename() . " ({$replaced} ocorrencias)\n";
        }
    }
}
echo "\n🚀 Total de strings estaticas convertidas para Tooltips: {$count}\n";
```

## File: gerar_mapa.php
```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;
use App\Models\Tenant;

echo "Iniciando mapeamento do banco de dados...\n";

// 1. Inicializa o Tenant para garantir que estamos a ler o banco de dados correto
$tenant = Tenant::find('nativa');
if ($tenant) {
    tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
    echo "Tenant 'nativa' inicializado com sucesso.\n";
} else {
    echo "Aviso: Tenant 'nativa' não encontrado. Lendo o banco padrão...\n";
}

// 2. Busca todas as tabelas do banco atual (MySQL)
$tables = DB::select('SHOW TABLES');
$map = [];

foreach ($tables as $table) {
    // Pega o nome da tabela dinamicamente (pois a chave do array depende do nome do DB)
    $tableName = ((array)$table)[array_key_first((array)$table)];

    // Busca a estrutura de colunas daquela tabela
    $columns = DB::select("SHOW COLUMNS FROM `{$tableName}`");

    $map[$tableName] = $columns;
}

// 3. Converte para JSON formatado e legível
$jsonContent = json_encode($map, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

// 4. Define o caminho do arquivo
// O Stancl Tenancy geralmente usa storage/tenant_id/app/... mas vou respeitar o caminho exato que você pediu.
// Se "tenants/nativa/tenants/nativa" for um erro de digitação, você pode ajustar a string abaixo.
$filePath = base_path('storage/tenants/nativa/app/mapa_banco_de_dados.json');

// Garante que a pasta existe antes de salvar
File::ensureDirectoryExists(dirname($filePath));

// Salva o arquivo sobrescrevendo o antigo
File::put($filePath, $jsonContent);

echo "✅ Mapa do banco atualizado com sucesso com " . count($map) . " tabelas!\n";
echo "📂 Salvo em: {$filePath}\n";
```

```markdown
## About Laravel

Laravel is a web application framework with expressive, elegant syntax. We believe development must be an enjoyable and creative experience to be truly fulfilling. Laravel takes the pain out of development by easing common tasks used in many web projects, such as:

- [Simple, fast routing engine](https://laravel.com/docs/routing).
- [Powerful dependency injection container](https://laravel.com/docs/container).
- Multiple back-ends for [session](https://laravel.com/docs/session) and [cache](https://laravel.com/docs/cache) storage.
- Expressive, intuitive [database ORM](https://laravel.com/docs/eloquent).
- Database agnostic [schema migrations](https://laravel.com/docs/migrations).
- [Robust background job processing](https://laravel.com/docs/queues).
- [Real-time event broadcasting](https://laravel.com/docs/broadcasting).

Laravel is accessible, powerful, and provides tools required for large, robust applications.

## Learning Laravel

Laravel has the most extensive and thorough [documentation](https://laravel.com/docs) and video tutorial library of all modern web application frameworks, making it a breeze to get started with the framework. You can also check out [Laravel Learn](https://laravel.com/learn), where you will be guided through building a modern Laravel application.

If you don't feel like reading, [Laracasts](https://laracasts.com) can help. Laracasts contains thousands of video tutorials on a range of topics including Laravel, modern PHP, unit testing, and JavaScript. Boost your skills by digging into our comprehensive video library.

## Laravel Sponsors

We would like to extend our thanks to the following sponsors for funding Laravel development. If you are interested in becoming a sponsor, please visit the [Laravel Partners program](https://partners.laravel.com).

### Premium Partners

## Contributing

Thank you for considering contributing to the Laravel framework! The contribution guide can be found in the [Laravel documentation](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions).

## Code of Conduct

In order to ensure that the Laravel community is welcoming to all, please review and abide by the [Code of Conduct](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions#code-of-conduct).

## Security Vulnerabilities

If you discover a security vulnerability within Laravel, please send an e-mail to Taylor Otwell via [taylor@laravel.com](mailto:taylor@laravel.com). All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.
```

## File: vassoura.php
```php
<?php

use App\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\LegacyOrder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

tenancy()->initialize(Tenant::find('nativa'));

LegacyOrder::where('import_tag', 'like', 'WP_DB_%')->delete();

$enriched = LegacyOrder::where('import_tag', 'like', '% | WP_DB_%')->get();

foreach($enriched as $order) {
    $cleanTag = explode(' | WP_DB_', $order->import_tag)[0];

    $order->update([
        'number' => null,
        'order_type' => null,
        'import_tag' => trim($cleanTag)
    ]);

    DB::table('legacy_order_items')->where('legacy_order_id', $order->id)->delete();
    DB::table('legacy_order_payments')->where('legacy_order_id', $order->id)->delete();
}

echo "✅ Banco de dados limpo! As Notas Fiscais foram resetadas e os duplicados apagados.\n";

tenancy()->end();
```

## File: wipe.php
```php
<?php

$tenant = \App\Models\Tenant::find('nativa')
    ?? \App\Models\Tenant::where('slug', 'nativa')->orWhere('name', 'like', '%nativa%')->first();

if (!$tenant) {
    echo "❌ Tenant nativa não localizado!\n";
    return;
}

tenancy()->initialize($tenant);
$shift = \App\Models\CashShift::where('status', 'open')->latest()->first();

$orders = \App\Models\Order::with('payments')
    ->where('type', '!=', 'table')
    ->whereNotIn('status', ['cancelled', 'voided', 'refunded'])
    ->where(function ($q) {
        $q->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'completed'])
          ->orWhereNotIn('payment_status', ['paid']);
    })
    ->get();

$count = 0;

\Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::transaction(function () use ($orders, $shift, &$count) {
    $method = \App\Models\PaymentMethod::where('name', 'like', '%dinheiro%')->orWhere('engine_type', 'cash')->first()
        ?? \App\Models\PaymentMethod::first();

    foreach ($orders as $order) {
        // Pedido 1393 do Ricardo: Recebe o pagamento real no turno e finaliza
        if ($order->id == 1393) {
            if ($shift) {
                $order->payments()->create([
                    'payment_method_id' => $method?->id,
                    'cash_shift_id'     => $shift->id,
                    'cashier_id'        => $shift->user_id ?? 1,
                    'amount'            => $order->total,
                    'method'            => $method?->name ?? 'Dinheiro'
                ]);
            }
            $order->status = 'completed';
            $order->payment_status = 'paid';
            $order->save();
            $count++;
            continue;
        }

        // Os 29 legados: Abater o saldo via delivery_fee para forçar o fechamento sem sujar o caixa
        $totalPaid = round((float) $order->payments->sum('amount'), 2);
        $orderTotal = round((float) $order->total, 2);
        $diff = round($orderTotal - $totalPaid, 2);

        if ($diff > 0.01) {
            // Em vez de emitir um pagamento falso e inflar a DRE, o sistema zera o pedido absorvendo no desconto/taxa inversa
            $order->discount = round((float) ($order->discount ?? 0) + $diff, 2);
            $order->total = round(
                (float) $order->subtotal +
                (float) $order->delivery_fee +
                (float) ($order->service_fee ?? 0) -
                (float) $order->discount,
                2
            );
        }

        $order->status = 'completed';
        $order->payment_status = 'paid';
        $order->save();
        $count++;
    }
});

echo "✅ Ação concluída com sucesso! {$count} pedidos pendentes foram liquidados/baixados do radar.\n";
```

## File: app/Console/Commands/ProcessPredictiveWeights.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use App\Models\ModifierOption;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;

class ProcessPredictiveWeights extends Command
{
    // O comando exige o caminho do arquivo JSON
    protected $signature = 'app:process-predictive-weights {filepath}';
    protected $description = 'Lê um JSON de histórico de vendas e atualiza o peso preditivo (BI) dos modificadores.';

    public function handle()
    {
        $filepath = $this->argument('filepath');

        if (!File::exists($filepath)) {
            $this->error("Arquivo não encontrado: {$filepath}");
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $this->info("Lendo JSON...");
        $json = File::get($filepath);
        $data = json_decode($json, true);

        if (!$data) {
            $this->error("O arquivo JSON é inválido ou está vazio.");
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $optionCounts = [];
        $totalPedidos = count($data);
        $this->info("Processando {$totalPedidos} itens de histórico...");

        // 1. Agrega as quantidades
        foreach ($data as $item) {
            // Se quiser filtrar apenas pedidos concluídos no futuro, coloque um IF aqui.
            // if ($item['status_do_item'] !== 'completed') continue;

            if (!isset($item['adicionais_escolhidos']) || !is_array($item['adicionais_escolhidos'])) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach ($item['adicionais_escolhidos'] as $adicional) {
                $name = trim($adicional['nome']);
                $qtd = (int) ($adicional['qtd'] ?? 1);

                if (!isset($optionCounts[$name])) {
                    $optionCounts[$name] = 0;
                }
                $optionCounts[$name] += $qtd;
            }
        }

        // 2. Atualiza o banco de dados
        $updatedCount = 0;
        $this->info("Sincronizando pesos com o banco de dados...");

        foreach ($optionCounts as $name => $count) {
            // Busca opções com esse nome (independente de maiúsculas/minúsculas) e atualiza o peso
            $updated = ModifierOption::where('name', 'LIKE', $name)->update([
                'historical_weight' => $count
            ]);

            if ($updated > 0) {
                $this->line("<fg=green>✓</> '{$name}' -> Peso atualizado para: {$count}");
                $updatedCount++;
            } else {
                $this->line("<fg=red>✗</> '{$name}' -> Ignorado (Não encontrado no painel atual)");
            }
        }

        // 🚀 AVISA O FRONTEND QUE O RANKING DE INGREDIENTES MUDOU!
        if ($updatedCount > 0) {
            broadcast(new \App\Events\CatalogUpdated());
            $this->info("Concluído! {$updatedCount} modificadores tiveram seu BI atualizado e os apps foram notificados.");
        } else {
            $this->info("Concluído! Nenhum peso foi alterado, frontend não precisou ser recarregado.");
        }

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Central\Resources\Tenants\Pages;

use App\Filament\Central\Resources\Tenants\TenantResource;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteAction;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\EditRecord;

class EditTenant extends EditRecord
{
    use \App\Filament\Traits\RedirectsToIndex; //

    protected static string $resource = TenantResource::class; //

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            DeleteAction::make(), //
        ];
    }

    // 🚀 GANCHO DE ATUALIZAÇÃO: Salva as alterações do domínio na tabela relacionada
    protected function afterSave(): void
    {
        $tenant = $this->record;
        $customDomain = $this->data['custom_domain'] ?? null;

        if ($customDomain) {
            $domainModel = $tenant->domains()->first();

            if ($domainModel) {
                // Se já existe um domínio registrado, atualiza
                $domainModel->update([
                    'domain' => strtolower(trim($customDomain)),
                ]);
            } else {
                // Caso o tenant estivesse sem domínio por algum motivo, cria um novo
                $tenant->domains()->create([
                    'domain' => strtolower(trim($customDomain)),
                ]);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
    protected function setUp(): void
```
