```php
            ->modalWidth("5xl")
            ->icon("heroicon-o-table-cells")
            ->color("info")
            ->steps([
                // 🚀 PASSO 1: UPLOAD & INJEÇÃO DE SESSÃO
                Step::make("1. Upload")
                    ->description("Envie um ou vários ficheiros CSV e identifique o lote.")
                    ->schema([
                        Grid::make(2)->schema([
                            TextInput::make("import_tag")
                                ->label("Identificador / Tag do Lote")
                                ->default("CSV_V1_" . now()->format("Ymd_His"))
                                ->required()
                                ->maxLength(255),

                            FileUpload::make("csv_file")
                                ->label("Ficheiros CSV")
                                ->multiple()
                                ->disk(config('livewire.temporary_file_upload.disk') ?: 'local')
                                ->directory("csv_v1_imports")
                                ->required()
                                ->live()
                                ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set) {
                                    $headers = [];
                                    if ($state && is_array($state) && count($state) > 0) {
                                        $file = array_values($state)[0];

                                        if ($file instanceof \Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile) {
                                            $handle = fopen($file->getRealPath(), "r");
                                            if ($handle) {
                                                $firstLine = fgets($handle);
                                                $firstLine = preg_replace('/^[\xef\xbb\xbf]+/', '', $firstLine);

                                                if ($firstLine) {
                                                    $delimiter = strpos($firstLine, ";") !== false ? ";" : ",";
                                                    rewind($handle);
                                                    $rawHeaders = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);

                                                    if ($rawHeaders) {
                                                        $rawHeaders[0] = preg_replace('/^[\xef\xbb\xbf]+/', '', $rawHeaders[0]);
                                                        foreach ($rawHeaders as $idx => $col) {
                                                            $colName = trim($col);
                                                            if ($colName === '') {
                                                                $numeroColuna = $idx + 1;
                                                                $colName = "⚠️ Coluna Sem Nome ({$numeroColuna})";
                                                            }
                                                            $headers[(string) $idx] = $colName;
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                }
                                                fclose($handle);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    $set("csv_headers", json_encode($headers));

                                    // Injeção da Sessão
                                    $fields = ['col_number', 'col_date', 'col_type', 'col_customer', 'col_neighborhood', 'col_total_order', 'col_code', 'col_product', 'col_qty', 'col_price'];
                                    foreach ($fields as $field) {
                                        if ($val = session()->get("csv_map_{$field}")) {
                                            $set($field, $val);
                                        }
                                    }
                                    if ($payments = session()->get('csv_map_payments')) {
                                        $set('payment_mappings', $payments);
                                    }
                                }),
                        ]),
                        Hidden::make("csv_headers"),
                    ]),

                // 🚀 PASSO 2: MAPEAMENTO
                Step::make("2. Mapeamento")
                    ->description("Configure a estrutura de dados. O sistema salvará essas escolhas ao confirmar.")
                    ->schema(function (Get $get) {
                        $headers = json_decode($get("csv_headers"), true) ?? [];
                        if (empty($headers)) {
                            return [Placeholder::make("w")->hiddenLabel()->content("⚠️ Faça o upload dos arquivos no passo anterior.")];
                        }

                        $v3Payments = \App\Models\PaymentMethod::pluck("name", "id")->toArray();

                        $makeSelect = function($name, $label, $required = false, $helper = null) use ($headers) {
                            $field = Select::make($name)->label($label)->options($headers);
                            if ($required) $field->required();
                            if ($helper) $field->helperText($helper);
                            return $field;
                        };

                        return [
                            Section::make("Estrutura do Pedido e dos Itens")
                                ->collapsible()
                                ->schema([
                                    Grid::make(3)->schema([
                                        $makeSelect("col_number", "Nº do Pedido/Comanda", true),
                                        $makeSelect("col_date", "Data e Hora do Pedido", true),
                                        $makeSelect("col_type", "Tipo (Mesa/Delivery)"),
                                    ]),
                                    Grid::make(3)->schema([
                                        $makeSelect("col_customer", "Nome do Cliente"),
                                        $makeSelect("col_neighborhood", "Bairro de Entrega"),
                                        $makeSelect("col_total_order", "Total do Pedido (Acumulado)", true, "A coluna que contém o valor final."),
                                    ]),
                                    Grid::make(4)->schema([
                                        $makeSelect("col_code", "Código (Opcional)"),
                                        $makeSelect("col_product", "Nome do Produto", true),
                                        $makeSelect("col_qty", "Qtd", true),
                                        $makeSelect("col_price", "Preço Unit.", true),
                                    ]),
                                ]),

                            Section::make("Conciliação Financeira (Formas de Pagamento)")
                                ->collapsible()
                                ->schema([
                                    Placeholder::make("payment_notice")->hiddenLabel()->content(new HtmlString('<div class="p-3 bg-amber-50 border-l-4 border-amber-400 text-amber-700 rounded text-xs flex items-center gap-2"><span>💡</span><span><b>Aviso:</b> Deixe vazio se não possuir detalhes de pagamentos em colunas separadas.</span></div>')),
                                    Repeater::make("payment_mappings")
                                        ->label("Vincular Colunas Financeiras")
                                        ->addActionLabel("Adicionar Regra")
                                        ->schema([
                                            Select::make("csv_columns")->label("Colunas no CSV")->options($headers)->multiple()->required(),
                                            Select::make("v3_payment_id")->label("Corresponde ao ERP (V3)")->options($v3Payments)->searchable()->required(),
                                        ])
                                        ->columns(2)
                                        ->columnSpanFull(),
                                ]),
                        ];
                    }),

                // 🚀 PASSO 3: SIMULAÇÃO COM LOG DE AUDITORIA (DRY RUN)
                Step::make("3. Simulação (Dry Run)")
                    ->description("Analise as discrepâncias e os matches encontrados antes de gravar.")
                    ->schema(function (Get $get) {
                        $fileState = $get("csv_file");
                        if (empty($fileState) || $get("col_number") === null) return [Placeholder::make("w")->hiddenLabel()->content("Preencha o mapeamento para ver o resumo.")];

                        $disk = config('livewire.temporary_file_upload.disk') ?: 'local';
                        $files = is_array($fileState) ? array_values($fileState) : [$fileState];

                        $orders = [];
                        $logEntries = [];
                        $tag = $get("import_tag");
                        $logEntries[] = "=== RELATÓRIO DE AUDITORIA DO LOTE CSV: {$tag} ===";
                        $logEntries[] = "Gerado em: " . now()->format('d/m/Y H:i:s');
                        $logEntries[] = "Arquivos em processamento: " . count($files);
                        $logEntries[] = str_repeat("-", 50);

                        $parseMoney = fn($v) => (float) str_replace(",", ".", preg_replace("/[^0-9,-]/", "", str_replace("\t", ",", (string) $v)));

                        foreach ($files as $file) {
                            $fullPath = null;
                            if ($file instanceof \Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile) {
                                $fullPath = $file->getRealPath();
                            } elseif (is_string($file) && !empty($file)) {
                                $fullPath = Storage::disk($disk)->path($file);
                            }

                            if (!$fullPath || !file_exists($fullPath)) continue;

                            $handle = fopen($fullPath, "r");
                            $firstLine = fgets($handle);
                            $firstLine = preg_replace('/^[\xef\xbb\xbf]+/', '', $firstLine);
                            $delimiter = strpos($firstLine, ";") !== false ? ";" : ",";
                            rewind($handle);
                            fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter); // Pula cabeçalho

                            $lineNumber = 1;
                            $fileName = basename($fullPath);

                            while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
                                $lineNumber++;
                                $num = trim($row[$get("col_number")] ?? "");

                                if (empty($num)) {
                                    $logEntries[] = "[AVISO - {$fileName}] Linha {$lineNumber}: Ignorada. Falta o Número do Pedido.";
                                    continue;
                                }

                                if (!isset($orders[$num])) {
                                    $orders[$num] = [
                                        "items_sum" => 0.0,
                                        "final_total" => 0.0,
                                        "date" => trim($row[$get("col_date")] ?? ""),
                                    ];
                                }

                                $qty = $parseMoney($row[$get("col_qty")] ?? "0");
                                $price = $parseMoney($row[$get("col_price")] ?? "0");

                                $orders[$num]["items_sum"] += ($qty * $price);
                                $orders[$num]["final_total"] = $parseMoney($row[$get("col_total_order")] ?? "0");
                            }
                            fclose($handle);
                        }

                        $totalOrders = count($orders);
                        $fretesRecuperados = 0;
                        $valorRecuperado = 0.0;
                        $faturamentoTotal = 0.0;
                        $notasEncontradas = 0;

                        $fretesConhecidos = [6.00, 8.00, 9.00, 11.00, 15.00];

                        foreach ($orders as $num => $data) {
                            $faturamentoTotal += $data["final_total"];
                            $diff = round($data["final_total"] - $data["items_sum"], 2);

                            if ($diff > 0 && in_array($diff, $fretesConhecidos)) {
                                $fretesRecuperados++;
                                $valorRecuperado += $diff;
                                $logEntries[] = "[TAXA DE ENTREGA] Pedido {$num}: Frete oculto de R$ " . number_format($diff, 2, ',', '.') . " identificado.";
                            } elseif ($diff > 0) {
                                $logEntries[] = "[DISCREPÂNCIA] Pedido {$num}: Total R$ " . number_format($data["final_total"], 2, ',', '.') . " vs Soma dos Itens R$ " . number_format($data["items_sum"], 2, ',', '.') . " (Diferença não mapeada de R$ {$diff}).";
                            }

                            // Verifica se existe nota na Staging Area
                            try {
                                $issueDate = Carbon::createFromFormat("d/m/Y - H:i", $data["date"])->format("Y-m-d H:i:s");
                            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                                try {
                                    $issueDate = Carbon::parse(str_replace(' - ', ' ', $data["date"]))->format("Y-m-d H:i:s");
                                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                                    $issueDate = now()->format("Y-m-d H:i:s");
                                }
                            }

                            $matchXml = FiscalDocument::where('status', 'processing')
                                ->whereBetween('issue_date', [
                                    Carbon::parse($issueDate)->subHours(12),
                                    Carbon::parse($issueDate)->addHours(12)
                                ])
                                ->where(function($query) use ($data) {
                                    $query->whereBetween('total_value', [$data["final_total"] - 1.0, $data["final_total"] + 1.0])
                                          ->orWhereBetween('total_value', [$data["items_sum"] - 1.0, $data["items_sum"] + 1.0]);
                                })
                                ->exists();

                            if ($matchXml) {
                                $notasEncontradas++;
                                $logEntries[] = "[MATCH FISCAL] Pedido {$num}: Nota Fiscal (V2) correspondente encontrada.";
                            } else {
                                $logEntries[] = "[NÃO-FISCAL] Pedido {$num}: Será guardado no histórico sem XML correspondente.";
                            }
                        }

                        $fatStr = number_format($faturamentoTotal, 2, ',', '.');
                        $valRecStr = number_format($valorRecuperado, 2, ',', '.');

                        $logContent = implode("\r\n", $logEntries);
                        $base64Log = base64_encode($logContent);

                        return [
                            Placeholder::make("staging_results")
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->content(new HtmlString("
                                    <div class='flex flex-col gap-4 p-6 bg-surface-2 rounded-xl border border-surface-border'>
                                        <h3 class='text-lg font-black text-primary-600 flex items-center gap-2'>
                                            <svg class='w-6 h-6' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-width='2' d='M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2'></path></svg>
                                            Auditoria de Lote (Sem gravação)
                                        </h3>

                                        <div class='grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 mb-2'>
                                            <div class='p-4 bg-surface-1 rounded-lg border border-surface-border text-center'>
                                                <span class='block text-[10px] text-surface-muted uppercase tracking-wider'>Pedidos Únicos</span>
                                                <span class='block text-2xl font-black text-surface-text mt-1'>{$totalOrders}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class='p-4 bg-success-500/10 rounded-lg border border-success-500/20 text-center'>
                                                <span class='block text-[10px] text-success-700 uppercase tracking-wider'>Faturamento Bruto</span>
                                                <span class='block text-xl font-black text-success-700 mt-1'>R$ {$fatStr}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class='p-4 bg-warning-500/10 rounded-lg border border-warning-500/20 text-center'>
                                                <span class='block text-[10px] text-warning-700 uppercase tracking-wider'>Fretes Fantasmas</span>
                                                <span class='block text-2xl font-black text-warning-700 mt-1'>{$fretesRecuperados}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class='p-4 bg-info-500/10 rounded-lg border border-info-500/20 text-center'>
                                                <span class='block text-[10px] text-info-700 uppercase tracking-wider'>R$ Oculto Recuperado</span>
                                                <span class='block text-xl font-black text-info-700 mt-1'>+ R$ {$valRecStr}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class='p-4 bg-primary-500/10 rounded-lg border border-primary-500/20 text-center'>
                                                <span class='block text-[10px] text-primary-700 uppercase tracking-wider'>Notas Casadas</span>
                                                <span class='block text-2xl font-black text-primary-700 mt-1'>{$notasEncontradas}</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>

                                        <div class='flex items-center justify-between bg-surface-1 p-4 rounded-lg border border-surface-border'>
                                            <p class='text-sm text-surface-muted m-0'>Se os dados baterem, baixe o log para conferência e clique em <b>Confirmar</b>.</p>

                                            <a href='data:text/plain;base64,{$base64Log}' download='Auditoria_{$tag}.txt' class='inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 bg-primary-600 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg hover:bg-primary-700 transition-colors shadow-sm cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0'>
                                                <svg class='w-4 h-4 mr-2' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-width='2' d='M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-4l-4 4m0 0l-4-4m4 4V4'></path></svg>
                                                Baixar Log de Auditoria
                                            </a>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                "))
                        ];
                    }),
            ])
            ->action(function (array $data) {
                // 🚀 GRAVAÇÃO DA SESSÃO AO SUBMETER
                $fieldsToSave = ['col_number', 'col_date', 'col_type', 'col_customer', 'col_neighborhood', 'col_total_order', 'col_code', 'col_product', 'col_qty', 'col_price'];
                foreach ($fieldsToSave as $f) {
                    if (isset($data[$f])) session()->put("csv_map_{$f}", $data[$f]);
                }
                if (isset($data['payment_mappings'])) {
                    session()->put('csv_map_payments', $data['payment_mappings']);
                }

                set_time_limit(0);
                ini_set("memory_limit", "1024M");
                DB::disableQueryLog();

                $fileState = $data["csv_file"] ?? null;
                if (empty($fileState)) {
                    Notification::make()->title("Ficheiros não recebidos. Tente novamente.")->danger()->send();
                    return;
                }

                $files = is_array($fileState) ? array_values($fileState) : [$fileState];
                $disk = config('livewire.temporary_file_upload.disk') ?: 'local';
                $tag = trim($data["import_tag"]);

                $orders = [];
                $parseMoney = fn($v) => (float) str_replace(",", ".", preg_replace("/[^0-9,-]/", "", str_replace("\t", ",", (string) $v)));
                $fretesConhecidos = [6.00, 8.00, 9.00, 11.00, 15.00];
                $filesToDelete = [];

                foreach ($files as $file) {
                    $fullPath = null;
                    $relativePath = null;

                    if ($file instanceof \Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile) {
                        $fullPath = $file->getRealPath();
                    } elseif (is_string($file) && !empty($file)) {
                        $fullPath = Storage::disk($disk)->path($file);
                        $relativePath = $file;
                    }

                    if (!$fullPath || !file_exists($fullPath)) continue;
                    if ($relativePath) $filesToDelete[] = $relativePath;

                    $handle = fopen($fullPath, "r");
                    $firstLine = fgets($handle);
                    $firstLine = preg_replace('/^[\xef\xbb\xbf]+/', '', $firstLine);
                    $delimiter = strpos($firstLine, ";") !== false ? ";" : ",";
                    rewind($handle);
                    fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);

                    while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
                        $num = trim($row[$data["col_number"]] ?? "");
                        if (empty($num)) continue;

                        if (!isset($orders[$num])) {
                            $orders[$num] = [
                                "number" => $num,
                                "customer" => isset($data["col_customer"]) && isset($row[$data["col_customer"]]) ? trim($row[$data["col_customer"]]) : "",
                                "neighborhood" => isset($data["col_neighborhood"]) && isset($row[$data["col_neighborhood"]]) ? trim($row[$data["col_neighborhood"]]) : "",
                                "date" => isset($data["col_date"]) && isset($row[$data["col_date"]]) ? trim($row[$data["col_date"]]) : "",
                                "type" => isset($data["col_type"]) && isset($row[$data["col_type"]]) ? trim($row[$data["col_type"]]) : "",
                                "items_sum" => 0.0,
                                "final_total" => 0.0,
                                "hidden_fee" => 0.0,
                                "items" => [],
                                "payments" => [],
                            ];

                            if (!empty($data["payment_mappings"])) {
                                foreach ($data["payment_mappings"] as $mapping) {
                                    $v3Id = $mapping["v3_payment_id"];
                                    $csvCols = $mapping["csv_columns"] ?? [];

                                    foreach ($csvCols as $colIndex) {
                                        $val = $parseMoney($row[$colIndex] ?? 0);
                                        if ($val > 0) {
                                            $orders[$num]["payments"][$v3Id] = ($orders[$num]["payments"][$v3Id] ?? 0) + $val;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        $qty = $parseMoney($row[$data["col_qty"]] ?? "0");
                        $unitPrice = $parseMoney($row[$data["col_price"]] ?? "0");
                        $lineTotal = $qty * $unitPrice;

                        $orders[$num]["items_sum"] += $lineTotal;
                        $orders[$num]["final_total"] = $parseMoney($row[$data["col_total_order"]] ?? "0");

                        $orders[$num]["items"][] = [
                            "code" => isset($data["col_code"]) && isset($row[$data["col_code"]]) ? trim($row[$data["col_code"]]) : "",
                            "name" => isset($data["col_product"]) && isset($row[$data["col_product"]]) ? trim($row[$data["col_product"]]) : "",
                            "qty" => $qty,
                            "unit_price" => $unitPrice,
                            "total_price" => $lineTotal,
                        ];
                    }
                    fclose($handle);
                }

                $totalImported = 0;
                $fretesCriados = 0;
                $notasCasadas = 0;
                $v3PaymentsMap = \App\Models\PaymentMethod::pluck("name", "id")->toArray();

                foreach (array_chunk($orders, 250, true) as $chunk) {
                    DB::beginTransaction();
                    try {
                        foreach ($chunk as $num => $d) {

                            $diff = round($d["final_total"] - $d["items_sum"], 2);
                            if ($diff > 0 && in_array($diff, $fretesConhecidos)) {
                                $d["hidden_fee"] = $diff;
                                $d["type"] = "Delivery";
                            }

                            $cleanCust = trim(preg_replace("/^\s*\d+\s*-\s*/", "", $d["customer"]));
                            $lCust = !empty($cleanCust) ? LegacyCustomer::firstOrCreate(["legacy_name" => $cleanCust]) : null;
                            $lNeigh = !empty($d["neighborhood"]) ? LegacyNeighborhood::firstOrCreate(["legacy_name" => $d["neighborhood"]]) : null;

                            $orderType = match (mb_strtolower($d["type"])) {
                                "mesa", "table" => "table",
                                "delivery", "entrega" => "delivery",
                                default => "counter",
                            };

                            try {
                                $issueDate = Carbon::createFromFormat("d/m/Y - H:i", $d["date"])->format("Y-m-d H:i:s");
                            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                                try {
                                    $issueDate = Carbon::parse(str_replace(' - ', ' ', $d["date"]))->format("Y-m-d H:i:s");
                                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                                    $issueDate = now()->format("Y-m-d H:i:s");
                                }
                            }

                            $matchXml = FiscalDocument::where('status', 'processing')
                                ->whereBetween('issue_date', [
                                    Carbon::parse($issueDate)->subHours(12),
                                    Carbon::parse($issueDate)->addHours(12)
                                ])
                                ->where(function($query) use ($d) {
                                    $query->whereBetween('total_value', [$d["final_total"] - 1.0, $d["final_total"] + 1.0])
                                          ->orWhereBetween('total_value', [$d["items_sum"] - 1.0, $d["items_sum"] + 1.0]);
                                })
                                ->first();

                            $orderModel = LegacyOrder::updateOrCreate(
                                ["number" => $num, "import_tag" => $tag],
                                [
                                    "number" => $matchXml ? $matchXml->number : $num,
                                    "issue_date" => $issueDate,
                                    "order_type" => $orderType,
                                    "status" => "processed",
                                    "legacy_customer_id" => $lCust?->id,
                                    "legacy_neighborhood_id" => $lNeigh?->id,
                                    "total_value" => $d["final_total"],
                                    "delivery_fee" => $d["hidden_fee"],
                                    "discount" => 0,
                                    "nfe_key" => $matchXml ? $matchXml->access_key : null,
                                    "series" => $matchXml ? $matchXml->series : null,
                                    "xml_content" => $matchXml ? $matchXml->xml_content : null,
                                ]
                            );

                            if ($matchXml) {
                                // 🚀 CORREÇÃO AQUI: Removemos o order_id para evitar o erro de chave estrangeira
                                $matchXml->update(['status' => 'authorized']);
                                $notasCasadas++;
                            }

                            DB::table("legacy_order_items")->where("legacy_order_id", $orderModel->id)->delete();
                            DB::table("legacy_order_payments")->where("legacy_order_id", $orderModel->id)->delete();

                            foreach ($d["items"] as $item) {
                                $name = $item["name"];
                                if (empty($name)) continue;

                                $code = !empty($item["code"]) ? $item["code"] : mb_strtoupper($name);
                                $lProd = LegacyProduct::firstOrCreate(["name" => $name], ["legacy_code" => $code]);

                                if ($lProd->is_ignored) continue;

                                LegacyOrderItem::create([
                                    "legacy_order_id" => $orderModel->id,
                                    "legacy_product_id" => $lProd->id,
                                    "quantity" => $item["qty"],
                                    "unit_price" => $item["unit_price"],
                                    "total_price" => $item["total_price"],
                                ]);
                            }

                            foreach ($d["payments"] as $v3Id => $amt) {
                                $pName = $v3PaymentsMap[$v3Id] ?? "Forma " . $v3Id;
                                $lPay = LegacyPaymentMethod::firstOrCreate(
                                    ["name" => $pName],
                                    ["current_payment_method_id" => $v3Id]
                                );

                                LegacyOrderPayment::create([
                                    "legacy_order_id" => $orderModel->id,
                                    "legacy_payment_method_id" => $lPay->id,
                                    "amount" => $amt,
                                ]);
                            }

                            if ($d["hidden_fee"] > 0) {
                                $fretesCriados++;
                            }

                            $totalImported++;
                        }
                        DB::commit();
                    } catch (\Exception $e) {
                        DB::rollBack();
                        foreach($filesToDelete as $pathToDelete) {
                             Storage::disk($disk)->delete($pathToDelete);
                        }
                        throw $e;
                    }
                }

                foreach($filesToDelete as $pathToDelete) {
                     Storage::disk($disk)->delete($pathToDelete);
                }

                LegacyImportLog::create([
                    "import_tag" => $tag,
                    "type" => "v1_detailed_with_freight_match",
                    "items_count" => $totalImported,
                ]);

                Notification::make()
                    ->title("Importação V1 em Lote Concluída!")
                    ->body("<b>{$totalImported}</b> pedidos processados.<br><b>{$notasCasadas}</b> notas fiscais vinculadas.<br><b>{$fretesCriados}</b> taxas recuperadas.")
                    ->success()
                    ->send();
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/Actions/ImportV2XmlAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use ZipArchive;

class ImportV2XmlAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return "import_v2_xml";
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label("Importar Documentos (XML / ZIP)")
            ->icon("heroicon-o-document-text")
            ->color("success")
            ->modalHeading("Importação de Documentos Fiscais (V2)")
            ->modalDescription("Fase 1 (ELT): O sistema irá extrair os dados dos arquivos para popular os dicionários e estacionar as notas na área de processamento (Staging).")
            ->form([
                Section::make("Configurações")->schema([
                    TextInput::make("import_tag")
                        ->label("Identificador / Tag")
                        ->default("XML_" . now()->format("Ymd_His"))
                        ->required(),
                ]),
                Section::make("Arquivos")->schema([
                    FileUpload::make("fiscal_files")
                        ->label("Arquivos (XML ou ZIP)")
                        ->multiple()
                        ->disk(config('livewire.temporary_file_upload.disk') ?: 'local')
                        ->maxSize(131072) // 128MB
                        ->required(),
                ]),
            ])
            ->action(function (array $data) {
                set_time_limit(0);
                ini_set("memory_limit", "1024M");
                DB::disableQueryLog();

                $service = app(\App\Services\Fiscal\LegacyFiscalImportService::class);
                $importedCount = 0;
                $duplicateCount = 0;
                $errorCount = 0;
                $errorReasons = [];

                $disk = config('livewire.temporary_file_upload.disk') ?: 'local';

                $processFile = function($content, $tag) use ($service, &$importedCount, &$duplicateCount, &$errorCount, &$errorReasons) {
                    try {
                        $status = $service->processV2XmlContent($content, $tag);
                        if ($status === "imported") $importedCount++;
                        elseif ($status === "duplicate") $duplicateCount++;
                    } catch (\Exception $e) {
                        $errorCount++;
                        $msg = $e->getMessage();
                        $errorReasons[$msg] = ($errorReasons[$msg] ?? 0) + 1;
                    }
                };

                foreach ($data["fiscal_files"] as $filePath) {
                    $fullPath = Storage::disk($disk)->path($filePath);

                    if (strtolower(pathinfo($fullPath, PATHINFO_EXTENSION)) === "zip") {
                        $zip = new \ZipArchive();
                        if ($zip->open($fullPath) === true) {
                            for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
                                $fileName = $zip->getNameIndex($i);

                                // 🚀 A VACINA ANTI-FANTASMAS (Ignora metadados do Mac/Linux)
                                if (str_contains($fileName, '__MACOSX') || str_starts_with(basename($fileName), '.')) {
                                    continue;
                                }

                                if (strtolower(pathinfo($fileName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION)) === "xml") {
                                    $processFile($zip->getFromIndex($i), $data["import_tag"]);
                                }
                            }
                            $zip->close();
                        }
                    } else {
                        $processFile(Storage::disk($disk)->get($filePath), $data["import_tag"]);
                    }

                    Storage::disk($disk)->delete($filePath);
                }

                $errorDetails = "";
                if (!empty($errorReasons)) {
                    $errorDetails = "<br><br><div style='padding:10px; background:rgba(255,0,0,0.1); border-radius:8px;'><b>Detalhamento das Rejeições:</b><br>";
                    arsort($errorReasons);
                    foreach ($errorReasons as $reason => $count) {
                        $errorDetails .= "<li><b>{$count}x</b> : {$reason}</li>";
                    }
                    $errorDetails .= "</div>";
                }

                if ($importedCount > 0 || $duplicateCount > 0 || $errorCount > 0) {
                    if ($importedCount > 0) {
                        \App\Models\LegacyImportLog::create(["import_tag" => $data["import_tag"], "type" => "v2_fiscal", "items_count" => $importedCount]);
                    }

                    Notification::make()
                        ->title("Auditoria de Importação V2")
                        ->body(new HtmlString("
                            <b class='text-success-600'>{$importedCount}</b> notas importadas para a Staging Area.<br>
                            <b class='text-warning-600'>{$duplicateCount}</b> notas ignoradas (já existem no banco).<br>
                            <b class='text-danger-600'>{$errorCount}</b> arquivos ignorados ou inválidos.
                            {$errorDetails}
                        "))
                        ->success()
                        ->persistent()
                        ->send();
                }
            });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

// Models
use App\Models\LegacyImportLog;
use App\Models\LegacyOrder;
use App\Models\LegacyOrderItem;
use App\Models\LegacyOrderPayment;
use App\Models\FiscalDocument;
use App\Models\LegacyProduct;
use App\Models\LegacyPaymentMethod;

class MapFiscalDocumentsAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'map_fiscal_documents';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label("Mapear Notas (Match)")
            ->icon("heroicon-o-cpu-chip")
            ->color("success")
            ->visible(fn(LegacyImportLog $record) => $record->type === 'v2_fiscal')
            ->form(function(LegacyImportLog $record) {
                // A Trava de Segurança: Checa se os dicionários estão resolvidos
                $unmappedProducts = LegacyProduct::whereNull('current_product_id')->where('is_ignored', false)->count();
                $unmappedPayments = LegacyPaymentMethod::whereNull('current_payment_method_id')->count();

                if ($unmappedProducts > 0 || $unmappedPayments > 0) {
                    return [
                        Placeholder::make('warning')
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->content(new HtmlString("<div class='p-4 bg-danger-50 text-danger-700 border border-danger-200 rounded-lg'><b>⚠️ Acesso Bloqueado:</b><br>Existem <b>{$unmappedProducts} produtos</b> e <b>{$unmappedPayments} formas de pagamento</b> legadas aguardando mapeamento no dicionário.<br><br>Você precisa resolvê-los primeiro nas suas respectivas telas para que o sistema consiga traduzir os itens dos XMLs de forma segura.</div>"))
                    ];
                }

                $docsCount = FiscalDocument::where('import_tag', $record->import_tag)->where('status', 'processing')->count();

                if ($docsCount === 0) {
                    return [
                        Placeholder::make('empty')->hiddenLabel()->content(new HtmlString("<div class='p-4 bg-success-50 text-success-700 rounded-lg'>Todas as notas deste lote já foram mapeadas e processadas!</div>"))
                    ];
                }

                return [
                    Placeholder::make('info')
                        ->hiddenLabel()
                        ->content(new HtmlString("<div class='p-4 bg-primary-50 text-primary-700 border border-primary-200 rounded-lg'><b>Tudo pronto para a Transformação!</b><br>Existem <b>{$docsCount} notas fiscais</b> em área de Staging neste lote.<br><br><b>Motor de Resolução:</b><br>1. O sistema buscará pedidos antigos sem nota com o mesmo valor e data (Match 100%).<br>2. Caso não exista correspondência, criará automaticamente os novos pedidos históricos extraindo os itens e pagamentos do XML.</div>"))
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (LegacyImportLog $record, Action $action) {
                // Bloqueia a execução se os dicionários estiverem sujos
                $unmappedProducts = LegacyProduct::whereNull('current_product_id')->where('is_ignored', false)->count();
                $unmappedPayments = LegacyPaymentMethod::whereNull('current_payment_method_id')->count();

                if ($unmappedProducts > 0 || $unmappedPayments > 0) {
                    Notification::make()->title("Ação cancelada. Resolva os dicionários primeiro.")->danger()->send();
                    $action->halt();
                }

                $docs = FiscalDocument::where('import_tag', $record->import_tag)
                    ->where('status', 'processing')
                    ->get();

                if($docs->isEmpty()) return;

                $matchedCount = 0;
                $createdCount = 0;

                DB::beginTransaction();
                try {
                                    $service = app(\App\Services\Fiscal\LegacyFiscalImportService::class);
                                    $result = $service->mapFiscalDocuments($record->import_tag);

                                    Notification::make()->title("Mapeamento concluído!")
                                        ->body("<b>{$result['matched']}</b> notas vinculadas.<br><b>{$result['created']}</b> novos pedidos criados.")
                                        ->success()->send();
                                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                                    Notification::make()->title("Erro no mapeamento")->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send();
                                }
                            });
    }
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/Actions/UndoImportAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

// Models
use App\Models\LegacyImportLog;
use App\Models\LegacyDailyRevenue;
use App\Models\LegacyOrder;
use App\Models\FiscalDocument;

class UndoImportAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'undo_import';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label("Desfazer")
            ->icon("heroicon-m-arrow-uturn-left")
            ->color("danger")
            ->requiresConfirmation()
            ->action(function (LegacyImportLog $record) {
                DB::beginTransaction();
                try {
                    if ($record->type === "v0_consolidated") {
                        LegacyDailyRevenue::where("import_tag", $record->import_tag)->delete();

                    } elseif ($record->type === "v2_fiscal") {
                        // 1. Desfaz as notas em staging
                        FiscalDocument::where('import_tag', $record->import_tag)->delete();

                        // 2. Desfaz os matches na V1
                        LegacyOrder::where('xml_content', 'like', "%{$record->import_tag}%")
                            ->orWhereNotNull('nfe_key')
                            ->whereDoesntHave('items') // fallback heurístico
                            ->update(['nfe_key' => null, 'xml_content' => null, 'series' => null, 'number' => null]);

                        // 3. Apaga os pedidos criados NESTA importação
                        $orderIds = LegacyOrder::where("import_tag", $record->import_tag)->pluck("id");
                        DB::table("legacy_order_items")->whereIn("legacy_order_id", $orderIds)->delete();
                        DB::table("legacy_order_payments")->whereIn("legacy_order_id", $orderIds)->delete();
                        LegacyOrder::whereIn("id", $orderIds)->delete();

                    } elseif ($record->type === "v1_database") {
                        // 🚀 1. Lógica Híbrida: Limpa as Notas Fiscais Enriquecidas (Tira a etiqueta colada)
                        $enrichedOrders = LegacyOrder::where('import_tag', 'like', "% | {$record->import_tag}")->get();
                        foreach ($enrichedOrders as $order) {
                            $cleanTag = trim(str_replace(" | {$record->import_tag}", "", $order->import_tag));

                            $order->update([
                                'number' => null,
                                'order_type' => null,
                                'import_tag' => $cleanTag
                            ]);

                            // Apaga os itens e pagamentos, deixando a capa do XML limpa para a próxima vez
                            DB::table("legacy_order_items")->where("legacy_order_id", $order->id)->delete();
                            DB::table("legacy_order_payments")->where("legacy_order_id", $order->id)->delete();
                        }

                        // 🚀 2. Lógica Híbrida: Apaga os pedidos puramente criados do zero pelo WP
                        $orderIds = LegacyOrder::where("import_tag", $record->import_tag)->pluck("id");
                        DB::table("legacy_order_items")->whereIn("legacy_order_id", $orderIds)->delete();
                        DB::table("legacy_order_payments")->whereIn("legacy_order_id", $orderIds)->delete();
                        LegacyOrder::whereIn("id", $orderIds)->delete();

                    } else {
                        // V1 Padrão antigo
                        $orderIds = LegacyOrder::where("import_tag", $record->import_tag)->pluck("id");
                        DB::table("legacy_order_items")->whereIn("legacy_order_id", $orderIds)->delete();
                        DB::table("legacy_order_payments")->whereIn("legacy_order_id", $orderIds)->delete();
                        LegacyOrder::whereIn("id", $orderIds)->delete();
                    }

                    $record->delete();
                    DB::commit();
                    Notification::make()->title("Importação revertida com sucesso!")->success()->send();
                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                    DB::rollBack();
                    throw $e;
                }
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Pages/Settings/ManageCompanySettings.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages\Settings;

use Filament\Pages\Page;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Forms\Concerns\InteractsWithForms;
use Filament\Forms\Contracts\HasForms;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use App\Filament\Pages\Settings\Schemas\CompanySettingsForm;

class ManageCompanySettings extends Page implements HasForms
{
    use InteractsWithForms;

    protected static string|\BackedEnum|null $navigationIcon = "heroicon-o-cog-6-tooth";
    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = "Configurações";
    protected static ?string $title = "Geral";
    protected string $view = "filament.pages.manage-company-settings";

    public ?array $data = [];

    public function mount(): void
    {
        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: O Admin lê SEMPRE direto do banco de dados!
        $setting = CompanySetting::first();
        $this->form->fill($setting ? $setting->toArray() : []);
    }

    public function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return CompanySettingsForm::configure($schema)
            ->statePath('data');
    }

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            Action::make("save")
                ->label("Salvar Tudo")
                ->color("primary")
                ->action("submit"),
        ];
    }

    public function submit()
    {
        $data = $this->form->getState();
        // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Pega a instância fresca do banco para atualizar
        $setting = CompanySetting::first() ?? new CompanySetting();

        // 1. PROCESSA NOVO CERTIFICADO NO ATO DE SALVAR
        if (!empty($data["new_certificate"])) {
            if (empty($data["certificate_password"])) {
                Notification::make()->title("Senha Obrigatória")->body("Por favor, informe a senha do certificado recém-anexado.")->warning()->send();
                return;
            }

            $fileData = $data["new_certificate"];
            $uploadedFile = is_array($fileData) ? array_values($fileData)[0] : $fileData;

            if ($uploadedFile instanceof \Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile) {
                $pfxContent = $uploadedFile->get();
                $certs = [];

                if (openssl_pkcs12_read($pfxContent, $certs, $data["certificate_password"])) {

                    if ($setting->certificate_path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($setting->certificate_path)) {
                        Storage::disk('local')->delete($setting->certificate_path);
                    }

                    $fileName = "certificates/cert_" . time() . ".pfx";
                    Storage::disk('local')->put($fileName, $pfxContent);
                    $data["certificate_path"] = $fileName;

                    $certPem = $certs["cert"] ?? null;
                    if (empty($certPem) && !empty($certs["extracerts"])) {
                        $certPem = $certs["extracerts"][0];
                    }

                    if ($certPem) {
                        $certData = openssl_x509_parse($certPem);

                        if (isset($certData["validTo_time_t"])) {
                            $data["certificate_expiration"] = date("Y-m-d", $certData["validTo_time_t"]);
                        }

                        $commonName = $certData["subject"]["CN"] ?? "";
                        preg_match("/[0-9]{14}/", $commonName, $matches);
                        $cnpjExtraido = $matches[0] ?? null;

                        if ($cnpjExtraido) {
                            $data["cnpj"] = $cnpjExtraido;

                            if (empty($data["company_name"]) || empty($data["zip_code"])) {
                                $response = Http::get("https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cnpj/v1/{$cnpjExtraido}");

                                if ($response->successful()) {
                                    $apiData = $response->json();

                                    if (empty($data["company_name"])) $data["company_name"] = $apiData["razao_social"] ?? null;
                                    if (empty($data["trade_name"])) $data["trade_name"] = $apiData["nome_fantasia"] ?? $apiData["razao_social"] ?? null;

                                    if (empty($data["zip_code"]) && !empty($apiData["cep"])) {
                                        $data["zip_code"] = $apiData["cep"];
                                        $cepClean = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $apiData["cep"]);
                                        $cepResp = Http::get("https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cep/v2/{$cepClean}");

                                        if ($cepResp->successful()) {
                                            $cepData = $cepResp->json();
                                            if (empty($data["street"])) $data["street"] = $cepData["street"] ?? null;
                                            if (empty($data["neighborhood"])) $data["neighborhood"] = $cepData["neighborhood"] ?? null;
                                            if (empty($data["state"])) $data["state"] = $cepData["state"] ?? null;
                                            if (empty($data["ibge_code"])) $data["ibge_code"] = $cepData["ibge"] ?? null;
                                            if (empty($data["city"])) $data["city"] = $cepData["city"] ?? null;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Notification::make()->title("Certificado Lido!")->body("Os dados foram extraídos e validados.")->success()->send();
                } else {
                    Notification::make()->title("Senha Incorreta")->body("Não foi possível ler o arquivo. Verifique a senha informada.")->danger()->send();
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        unset($data["new_certificate"]);

        if (empty($data["certificate_password"])) {
            unset($data["certificate_password"]);
        }

        $setting->fill($data);
        $setting->save(); // 🚀 Isso vai acionar o boot() do model e limpar o cache para o Vue!

        Notification::make()->title("Salvo!")->body("As configurações foram gravadas com sucesso.")->success()->send();

        return $this->redirect(static::getUrl());
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use Filament\Pages\Page;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Forms\Concerns\InteractsWithForms;
use Filament\Forms\Contracts\HasForms;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\Contracts\HasActions;
use Filament\Actions\Concerns\InteractsWithActions;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;
use Livewire\Attributes\On;

use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use App\Models\ProductCostHistory;
use App\Models\PersonalPurchase;
use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\ReceivedInvoiceResource;
use App\Filament\Pages\ImportInvoice\Schemas\ImportInvoiceForm;
use App\Filament\Pages\ImportInvoice\Actions\ApproveSmartMatchesAction;
use App\Filament\Traits\HasWelcomeModal;
use App\Services\Purchases\InvoiceImportService;
use App\Services\Purchases\InvoiceItemProcessor;
use Filament\Support\Facades\FilamentView;

class ImportInvoice extends Page implements HasForms, HasActions
{
    use InteractsWithForms;
    use InteractsWithActions;
    use HasWelcomeModal;

    protected static string | \BackedEnum | null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-document-arrow-up';
    protected static string | \UnitEnum | null $navigationGroup = 'Estoque & Compras';
    protected static ?string $title = 'Importar Compras';
    protected static bool $shouldRegisterNavigation = false;
    protected string $view = 'filament.pages.import-invoice';

    public ?array $data = [];
    public ?int $invoiceId = null;
    public ?ReceivedInvoice $invoiceRecord = null;

    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->checkWelcomeModal();

        $rawInvoiceId = request()->query('invoice') ?? request()->query('nfe') ?? request()->query('record');
        $initialData = [];

        if ($rawInvoiceId) {
            $this->invoiceId = (int) $rawInvoiceId;
            $this->invoiceRecord = ReceivedInvoice::find($this->invoiceId);

            // Carrega o XML limpo apenas na primeira montagem da página
            if ($this->invoiceRecord && $this->invoiceRecord->xml_content) {
                $processor = app(InvoiceImportService::class);
                $initialData = $processor->extractDataFromXml($this->invoiceRecord->xml_content, $this->invoiceRecord->id);
            }
        }

        $this->data = $initialData;
        $this->form->fill($this->data);

        FilamentView::registerRenderHook(
            'tables::toolbar.search.before',
            function () {
                $invoiceKey = $this->data['invoice_key'] ?? 'none';
                return Blade::render('@include("filament.components.tabs-render-hook", [
                    "stockCount" => \App\Models\ProductCostHistory::where("nfe_key", $invoiceKey)->count(),
                    "personalCount" => \App\Models\PersonalPurchase::where("nfe_key", $invoiceKey)->count(),
                ])', ['invoiceKey' => $invoiceKey]);
            },
            scopes: [
                \App\Livewire\ProcessedStockTable::class,
                \App\Livewire\ProcessedPersonalTable::class,
            ]
        );
    }

    public function getInvoiceRecord(): ?ReceivedInvoice
    {
        if ($this->invoiceRecord) {
            return $this->invoiceRecord;
        }

        $id = $this->invoiceId
            ?? ($this->data['received_invoice_id'] ?? null)
            ?? request()->query('invoice')
            ?? request()->query('nfe')
            ?? request()->query('record');

        return $this->invoiceRecord = $id ? ReceivedInvoice::find($id) : null;
    }

    public function getInvoiceProperty(): ?ReceivedInvoice
    {
        return $this->getInvoiceRecord();
    }

    public function getRecordProperty(): ?ReceivedInvoice
    {
        return $this->getInvoiceRecord();
    }

    /**
     * Processa a confirmação de um item e atualiza estritamente a chave xml_items.
     */
    public function confirmItem(array $payload): array
    {
        $processor = app(\App\Services\Purchases\InvoiceItemProcessor::class);
        $currentItems = $this->data['xml_items'] ?? [];

        $result = $processor->processConfirmedItems($payload, (array) $currentItems);

        $this->data['xml_items'] = array_values($result['updated_items'] ?? []);
        $this->form->fill($this->data);

        return $result;
    }

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            ApproveSmartMatchesAction::make('approveSmartMatches'),
            $this->getWelcomeAction(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getViewData(): array
    {
        $invoiceKey = $this->data['invoice_key'] ?? 'none';
        return [
            'stockCount' => ProductCostHistory::where('nfe_key', $invoiceKey)->count(),
            'personalCount' => PersonalPurchase::where('nfe_key', $invoiceKey)->count(),
        ];
    }

    public function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema
            ->statePath('data')
            ->components(ImportInvoiceForm::schema());
    }

    /**
     * Ação Nativa de Finalização (Lê diretamente do estado fresco do Livewire)
     */
    public function finishImportAction(): Action
    {
        return Action::make('finishImport')
            ->label('Finalizar Importação')
            ->color('primary')
            // Removemos o requiresConfirmation condicional daqui para forçar a execução direta
            ->action(function () {
                $state = $this->form->getState();
                $items = $state['xml_items'] ?? [];

                $pendingItems = collect($items)->where('confirmation_step', 0);

                // 🚀 SONDA: Se o sistema encontrar pendentes, trava tudo e cospe os dados!
                if ($pendingItems->isNotEmpty()) {
                    dd([
                        'ALERTA' => 'O SISTEMA ENCONTROU ITENS FANTASMAS!',
                        'QTD_PENDENTES' => $pendingItems->count(),
                        'QTD_TOTAL_NO_FORM' => count($items),
                        'ITENS_PENDENTES' => $pendingItems->toArray(),
                        'ESTADO_CRU_DO_LIVEWIRE' => $this->data['xml_items'] ?? []
                    ]);
                }

                // Se passar da sonda, é porque realmente estava vazio e deve finalizar
                app(\App\Services\Purchases\InvoiceImportService::class)->finalizeInvoice($state);

                \Filament\Notifications\Notification::make()
                    ->title('Nota Fiscal Finalizada!')
                    ->success()
                    ->send();

                return redirect()->to(\App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\ReceivedInvoiceResource::getUrl('index'));
            });
    }

    public function restoreToPendingQueue(array $itemData, bool $isPersonal): void
    {
        $xmlItems = $this->data['xml_items'] ?? [];
        $xmlItems[] = [
            'xml_name' => $itemData['xml_name'],
            'xml_qty' => $itemData['xml_qty'] ?? $itemData['available_qty'] ?? 1,
            'available_qty' => $itemData['xml_qty'] ?? $itemData['available_qty'] ?? 1,
            'xml_cost' => $itemData['xml_cost'],
            'xml_uom' => $itemData['xml_uom'],
            'conversion_factor' => $itemData['conversion_factor'] ?? 1,
            'product_id' => $isPersonal ? null : ($itemData['product_id'] ?? null),
            'is_matched' => $isPersonal ? 0 : 1,
            'item_uuid' => Str::uuid()->toString(),
            'confirmation_step' => 0,
            'factor_source' => 'manual',
        ];

        $this->data['xml_items'] = collect($xmlItems)->sortByDesc('is_matched')->values()->toArray();
    }

    #[On('items-restored')]
    public function handleRestoredItems(array $items, bool $isPersonal): void
    {
        foreach ($items as $itemData) {
            $this->restoreToPendingQueue($itemData, $isPersonal);
        }
        $this->form->fill($this->data);
    }

    protected function getWelcomeMessage(): HtmlString
    {
        return new HtmlString('
            <div class="wm-container">
                <p>Você está na mesa de operação! Aqui transformamos o XML do fornecedor em <strong>atualização de Estoque</strong> e <strong>Contas a Pagar</strong>.</p>
                <div class="wm-step-list">
                    <div class="wm-step-item">
                        <div class="wm-step-icon"><svg fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z"></path></svg></div>
                        <div><p class="wm-step-title">1. Aprovação Inteligente</p><p class="wm-step-description">Se o sistema encontrar produtos que você já vinculou antes, um botão aparecerá no topo para aprová-los em lote.</p></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="wm-step-item">
                        <div class="wm-step-icon"><svg fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13.19 8.688a4.5 4.5 0 011.242 7.244l-4.5 4.5a4.5 4.5 0 01-6.364-6.364l1.757-1.757m13.35-.622l1.757-1.757a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364l-4.5 4.5a4.5 4.5 0 001.242 7.244"></path></svg></div>
                        <div><p class="wm-step-title">2. Amarração de Insumos</p><p class="wm-step-description">Vincule os produtos desconhecidos aos insumos do estoque. O sistema memorizará essas relações para as próximas notas.</p></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="wm-step-item">
                        <div class="wm-step-icon"><svg fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z"></path></svg></div>
                        <div><p class="wm-step-title">3. Uso Pessoal ou Consumo</p><p class="wm-step-description">Itens fora da operação comercial devem ser marcados como "Uso Pessoal", preservando as fichas técnicas de CMV.</p></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        ');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\AccountPayableResource;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\ListRecords;
use Filament\Actions;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;

use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;

use App\Models\RecurringExpense;

use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Tabs\Tab;

class ListAccountPayables extends ListRecords
{
    protected static string $resource = AccountPayableResource::class;

    public function getDefaultActiveTab(): string | int | null
    {
        return 'tabela';
    }

    public function getTabs(): array
    {
        return [
            'tabela' => Tab::make('Visão de Tabela')
                ->icon('heroicon-m-table-cells'),

            'calendario' => Tab::make('Visão de Calendário')
                ->icon('heroicon-m-calendar-days'),
        ];
    }

    protected function getTableQuery(): ?\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder
    {
        $abaAtual = $this->activeTab ?? $this->getDefaultActiveTab();

        if ($abaAtual === 'calendario') {
            return parent::getTableQuery()->whereRaw('1 = 0');
        }

        return parent::getTableQuery();
    }

    public function getHeader(): ?\Illuminate\Contracts\View\View
    {
        $abaAtual = $this->activeTab ?? $this->getDefaultActiveTab();

        if ($abaAtual === 'calendario') {
            echo "<style>
                /* 1. Oculta tudo que pertence à tabela E o empty-state */
                .fi-ta-table,
                .fi-ta-search-field,
                .fi-ta-filters-dropdown,
                .fi-ta-actions,
                .fi-ta-empty-state {
                    display: none !important;
                }

                /* 2. Zera o esqueleto/cartão da tabela */
                .fi-ta-ctn.fi-ta-ctn-with-footer.fi-ta-ctn-with-header,
                .fi-ta-ctn {
                    background: transparent !important;
                    padding: 0 !important;
                    box-shadow: unset !important;
                    border: none !important;
                }

                /* 3. Limpa o toolbar do cabeçalho */
                .fi-ta-header-toolbar {
                    padding: 0 !important;
                    border: 0 !important;
                }

                .fi-ta { background: transparent !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: none !important; }

                /* 4. Layout 100% fluido do calendário */
                .fi-wi { height: calc(100vh - 250px) !important; margin-top: 0 !important; }
                .fi-wi > div { height: 100% !important; }
                .fc { height: 100% !important; background: white; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); }
                .dark .fc { background: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; }

                /* 5. TIPOGRAFIA DO CALENDÁRIO */
                .fc {
                    font-family: 'SF Compact Rounded', ui-rounded, sans-serif !important;
                }

                /* Reverte o cabeçalho (Dom, Seg, Ter...) para a fonte normal */
                .fc-col-header-cell-cushion {
                    font-family: 'Stack Sans Text', system-ui, sans-serif !important;
                    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
                }

                /* 6. REDUÇÃO DO TAMANHO DA FONTE (-2px) */
                .fc-event-main, .fc-event-title, .fc-daygrid-day-number {
                    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
                    line-height: 1.2 !important;
                }
            </style>";
        } else {
            echo "<style>
                /* Ocultamos o Widget quando a aba Tabela está ativa */
                .fi-wi { display: none !important; }
            </style>";
        }

        return null;
    }

    protected function getFooterWidgets(): array
    {
        return [
            \App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\Widgets\AccountPayablesCalendarWidget::class,
        ];
    }

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            Actions\CreateAction::make(),

            Actions\Action::make('gerar_recorrentes')
                ->label('Lançamento Rápido (Mês)')
                ->icon('heroicon-o-calendar-days')
                ->color('success')
                ->modalHeading('Gerar Contas Recorrentes')
                ->modalDescription('Selecione o mês e preencha os valores das contas variáveis. O sistema não duplicará contas já geradas.')
                ->modalWidth('4xl')
                ->fillForm(fn (): array => [
                    'reference_month' => now()->month,
                    'reference_year' => now()->year,
                    'accounts_to_generate' => $this->getAccountsToGenerateData(now()->month, now()->year),
                ])
                ->form([
                    Section::make('Período de Referência')
                        ->schema([
                            Select::make('reference_month')
                                ->label('Mês')
                                ->options([
                                    1 => 'Janeiro', 2 => 'Fevereiro', 3 => 'Março', 4 => 'Abril',
                                    5 => 'Maio', 6 => 'Junho', 7 => 'Julho', 8 => 'Agosto',
                                    9 => 'Setembro', 10 => 'Outubro', 11 => 'Novembro', 12 => 'Dezembro',
                                ])
                                ->live()
                                ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set, Get $get) => $set('accounts_to_generate', $this->getAccountsToGenerateData($get('reference_month'), $get('reference_year'))))
                                ->required(),

                            TextInput::make('reference_year')
                                ->label('Ano')
                                ->numeric()
                                ->live()
                                ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set, Get $get) => $set('accounts_to_generate', $this->getAccountsToGenerateData($get('reference_month'), $get('reference_year'))))
                                ->required(),
                        ])->columns(2),

                    Repeater::make('accounts_to_generate')
                        ->label('Contas Encontradas')
                        ->addable(false)
                        ->deletable(false)
                        ->reorderable(false)
                        ->columns(4)
                        ->columnSpanFull()
                        ->schema([
                            Hidden::make('fixed_account_id'),
                            TextInput::make('name')->label('Conta')->readOnly()->columnSpan(2),
                            TextInput::make('due_date')->label('Vencimento')->readOnly()->columnSpan(1),
                            TextInput::make('amount')
                                ->label('Valor (R$)')
                                ->numeric()
                                ->prefix('R$')
                                ->required()
                                ->columnSpan(1),
                        ])
                ])
                ->action(function (array $data) {
                    $gerados = 0;
                    foreach ($data['accounts_to_generate'] as $item) {
                        $recurringExpense = RecurringExpense::find($item['fixed_account_id']);
                        if (!$recurringExpense) continue;
                        $dueDate = Carbon::createFromFormat('d/m/Y', $item['due_date'])->format('Y-m-d');

                        $exists = AccountPayable::where('fixed_account_id', $recurringExpense->id)
                            ->whereMonth('due_date', clone Carbon::parse($dueDate)->month)
                            ->whereYear('due_date', clone Carbon::parse($dueDate)->year)
                            ->exists();

                        if (!$exists) {
                            AccountPayable::create([
                                'supplier_id' => $recurringExpense->supplier_id,
                                'fixed_account_id' => $recurringExpense->id,
                                'description' => $recurringExpense->name . ' - Ref ' . str_pad($data['reference_month'], 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) . '/' . $data['reference_year'],
                                'amount' => $item['amount'],
                                'due_date' => $dueDate,
                                'status' => 'pending',
                                'accounting_category' => $recurringExpense->accounting_category,
                                'accounting_subcategory' => $recurringExpense->accounting_subcategory,
                                'contract_number' => $recurringExpense->contract_number,
                                'is_auto_debit' => $recurringExpense->is_auto_debit,
                                'account_holder' => $recurringExpense->account_holder,
                                'paid_by' => $recurringExpense->paid_by,
                            ]);
                            $gerados++;
                        }
                    }

                    Notification::make()
                        ->title("Sucesso!")
                        ->body("{$gerados} contas fixas geradas para o mês.")
                        ->success()
                        ->send();
                })
        ];
    }

    protected function getAccountsToGenerateData($month, $year): array
    {
        if (!$month || !$year) return [];
        $activeAccounts = RecurringExpense::where('is_active', true)->get();
        $items = [];

        foreach ($activeAccounts as $account) {
            $creationDate = $account->created_at;
            $requestDate = Carbon::createFromDate($year, $month, 1);

            if ($requestDate->startOfMonth()->lessThan($creationDate->copy()->startOfMonth())) {
                continue;
            }
            $alreadyExists = AccountPayable::where('fixed_account_id', $account->id)
                ->whereMonth('due_date', $month)
                ->whereYear('due_date', $year)
                ->exists();
            if (!$alreadyExists) {
                $daysInMonth = Carbon::createFromDate($year, $month, 1)->daysInMonth;
                $diaVencimento = $account->due_day > $daysInMonth ? $daysInMonth : $account->due_day;

                $items[] = [
                    'fixed_account_id' => $account->id,
                    'name' => $account->name,
                    'due_date' => Carbon::createFromDate($year, $month, $diaVencimento)->format('d/m/Y'),
                    'amount' => $account->value_type === 'fixed' ? $account->default_amount : null,
                ];
            }
        }

        return $items;
    }
}
```

```php
class AccountPayableForm
{
    public static function getFormSchema(bool $isModal = false): array
    {
        $abaComprovativo = [
            Placeholder::make('bank_statement_info')
                ->hiddenLabel()
                // 🚀 CORREÇÃO 1: Removida a tipagem estrita. E verificação usando instanceof
                ->content(function ($record) {
                    if (!$record instanceof \App\Models\AccountPayable || !$record->bankStatement) return '';

                    $stmt = $record->bankStatement;
                    $val = number_format(abs($stmt->amount), 2, ',', '.');
                    $date = $stmt->bank_date->format('d/m/Y');
                    $icon = Blade::render('<x-heroicon-o-check-circle class="w-8 h-8 shrink-0" />');

                    return new HtmlString("
                        <div class='p-4 bg-success-50 dark:bg-success-900/30 rounded-xl border border-success-200 dark:border-success-800 text-success-800 dark:text-success-400 flex items-center gap-4 mb-4'>
                            {$icon}
                            <div>
                                <p class='font-medium text-sm uppercase tracking-wider'>Liquidado via Extrato Bancário</p>
                                <p class='text-xs mt-1 font-medium'>Transação: {$stmt->description} ({$stmt->counterparty_name}) | Data: {$date} | Valor: R$ {$val}</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ");
                })
                // 🚀 CORREÇÃO 2: Verificação segura no visible()
                ->visible(fn ($record) => $record instanceof \App\Models\AccountPayable && $record->bankStatement !== null)
                ->columnSpanFull(),
        ];

        $abaDetalhes = [
            TextInput::make("description")
                ->label("Descrição")
                ->required()
                ->placeholder("Ex: Conta de Luz, Pagamento Freelancer")
                ->columnSpanFull(),
            ToggleButtons::make("beneficiary_type")
                ->label("Tipo de Destinatário")
                ->options([
                    "supplier" => "Fornecedor",
                    "employee" => "Colaborador",
                ])
                ->icons([
                    "supplier" => "heroicon-o-building-office",
                    "employee" => "heroicon-o-user",
                ])
                ->colors(["supplier" => "primary", "employee" => "info"])
                ->inline()
                ->default("supplier")
                ->live()
                ->dehydrated(false)
                // 🚀 CORREÇÃO 3: Garantir que não quebra se for um Extrato Bancário a inicializar os campos
                ->afterStateHydrated(function ($component, $record) {
                    if ($record instanceof \App\Models\AccountPayable) {
                        $component->state(
                            $record->employee_id ? "employee" : "supplier",
                        );
                    }
                })
                ->afterStateUpdated(function ($set) {
                    $set("supplier_id", null);
                    $set("employee_id", null);
                })
                ->columnSpanFull(),
            Grid::make(4)->schema([
                Select::make("supplier_id")
                    ->disabled(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_supplier_locked'))

                    ->afterStateUpdated(function (

                    ->visible(

                    ->columnSpan(2),
                Select::make("employee_id")
                    ->label("Colaborador Vinculado")
                    ->options(fn() => \App\Models\Employee::where('is_active', true)->pluck("name", "id"))
                    ->searchable()
                    ->visible(
```
