```php
                    ->columnSpan(2),
                TextInput::make("amount")
                    ->label('Valor (R$)')
                    ->required()
                    ->numeric()
                    ->prefix('R$')
                    ->columnSpan(1),
                TextInput::make("installment")
                    ->label("Parcela")
                    ->placeholder("Ex: 1/3")
                    ->columnSpan(1),
            ]),
        ];

        $abaDRE = [
            Grid::make(2)->schema([
                Select::make("accounting_category")
                    ->label("Categoria de Despesa")
                    ->options(\App\Services\Accounting\AccountingService::getCategories())
                    ->live()
                    ->afterStateUpdated(
                        fn($set) => $set("accounting_subcategory", null),
                    )
                    ->required(),
                Select::make("accounting_subcategory")

                    ->options(

                            $get,
                        ) => \App\Services\Accounting\AccountingService::getSubcategories(
                            $get("accounting_category"),
                        ),
                    )
                    ->required()
                    ->disabled(fn($get) => !$get("accounting_category")),
            ]),
        ];

        $abaVencimento = [
            Grid::make(4)->schema([ // Mudamos para 4 colunas
                DatePicker::make("due_date")
                    ->label("Data de Vencimento")
                    ->required()
                    ->columnSpan(1),

                Select::make("status")
                    ->label("Status")

                        "pending" => "Pendente",

                    ->live()
                    ->disabled(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_status_locked'))
                    ->dehydrated()
                    ->columnSpan(1),

                DatePicker::make("payment_date")

                    ->required(fn($get) => $get("status") === "paid")
                    ->disabled(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_status_locked'))
                    ->dehydrated()
                    ->columnSpan(1),

                // 🚀 NOVO CAMPO: Qual conta pagou?
                Select::make("bank_account_id")
                    ->label("Conta Bancária (Saída)")
                    ->options(fn () => \App\Models\BankAccount::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                    ->visible(fn($get) => $get("status") === "paid")

        $abaAnexos = [

        return [

    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/AccountPayables/Tables/AccountPayablesTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\Tables;

use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\TernaryFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Grouping\Group;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use App\Filament\Resources\AccountPayables\Actions\ReverseConciliationAction; // 🚀 O NOVO IMPORT

class AccountPayablesTable
{
    public static function build(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->defaultGroup('due_date')
            ->groups([
                Group::make('due_date')
                    ->label('Vencimento')
                    ->date(),
                Group::make('status')
                    ->label('Status'),
                Group::make('supplier.name')
                    ->label('Fornecedor'),
            ])
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('due_date')
                    ->label('Vencimento')
                    ->date('d/m/Y')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->color(fn ($record) => $record->status === 'pending' && $record->due_date < now() ? 'danger' : null),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('description')
                    ->label('Descrição')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->limit(40),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('supplier.name')
                    ->label('Fornecedor')
                    ->searchable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('amount')
                    ->label('Valor')
                    ->money('BRL')
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('status')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'pending' => 'Pendente',
                        'paid' => 'Pago',
                        'cancelled' => 'Cancelado',
                        default => $state,
                    })
                    ->colors([
                        'warning' => 'pending',
                        'success' => 'paid',
                        'danger' => 'cancelled',
                    ]),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('due_date', 'asc')
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make('status')
                    ->options([
                        'pending' => 'Pendente',
                        'paid' => 'Pago',
                        'cancelled' => 'Cancelado',
                    ]),
                TernaryFilter::make('is_late')
                    ->label('Atrasadas')
                    ->queries(
                        true: fn ($query) => $query->where('status', 'pending')->whereDate('due_date', '<', now()),
                        false: fn ($query) => $query->whereDate('due_date', '>=', now()),
                    )
            ])
            ->actions([
                Action::make('pay')
                    ->label('Baixar')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-banknotes')
                    ->color('success')
                    ->visible(fn ($record) => $record->status === 'pending')
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->form([
                        DatePicker::make('payment_date')
                            ->label('Data em que foi pago')
                            ->default(now())
                            ->required(),
                    ])
                    ->action(function ($record, array $data) {
                        $record->update([
                            'status' => 'paid',
                            'payment_date' => $data['payment_date'],
                        ]);
                    }),

                // 🚀 A MÁGICA DRY: Uma única linha resolve todo o modal!
                ReverseConciliationAction::configure(Action::make('conciliar_reverso')),

                EditAction::make(),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankAccounts\Schemas;


use App\Enums\BankAccountType;use Filament\Schemas\Components\Tabs;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Repeater;
use Filament\Forms\Components\CheckboxList;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use App\Support\BankList;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Unique;

class BankAccountForm
{
    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            Tabs::make("Tabs")
                ->tabs([
                    // ==========================================
                    // ABA 1: DETALHES DA CONTA
                    // ==========================================
                    Tabs\Tab::make("Detalhes da Conta")->schema([
                        Grid::make(3)->schema([
                            TextInput::make("name")
                                ->unique(ignoreRecord: true, modifyRuleUsing: fn(Unique $rule) => $rule->withoutTrashed())
                                ->label("Nome de Identificação")
                                ->required()
                                ->placeholder("Ex: Sicredi Principal")
                                ->columnSpan(2),

                            Select::make("type")
                                ->label("Tipo de Conta")
                                ->options(BankAccountType::class)
                                ->required()
                                ->live()
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            Select::make("bank_code")
                                ->label("Banco")
                                ->options(BankList::all())
                                ->searchable()
                                ->preload()
                                ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get("type") !== "vault")
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            TextInput::make("agency")
                                ->label("Agência")
                                ->placeholder("Ex: 0001")
                                ->visible(fn(Get $get) => in_array($get("type"), ["checking", "savings"]))
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            TextInput::make("account_number")
                                ->label("Número da Conta")
                                ->placeholder("Ex: 12345-6")
                                ->visible(fn(Get $get) => in_array($get("type"), ["checking", "savings"]))
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            TextInput::make("initial_balance")
                                ->label(fn(Get $get) => $get("type") === 'credit_card' ? 'Limite do Cartão' : 'Saldo Inicial')
                                ->numeric()
                                ->prefix('R$')
                                ->default(0)
                                ->columnSpan(1),

                            Toggle::make("is_active")
                                ->label("Conta Ativa?")
                                ->default(true)
                                ->inline(false)
                                ->columnSpan(1),
                        ]),
                    ]),

                    // ==========================================
                    // ABA 2: TAXAS E RECEBIMENTOS
                    // ==========================================
                    Tabs\Tab::make("Taxas e Adquirentes")
                        ->visible(fn(Get $get) => in_array($get("type"), ["checking", "savings"]))
                        ->schema([
                            Section::make("Taxas de Operação")
                                ->description("Percentuais descontados pela maquininha/adquirente")
                                ->schema([
                                    Grid::make(3)->schema([
                                        TextInput::make("debit_fee")->label("Taxa de Débito")->numeric()->default(0)->suffix("%"),
                                        TextInput::make("credit_fee")->label("Taxa de Crédito")->numeric()->default(0)->suffix("%"),
                                        TextInput::make("anticipation_fee")->label("Taxa Antecipação (a.m)")->numeric()->suffix("%"),
                                    ]),
                                ]),

                            Section::make("Prazos de Liquidação")
                                ->description("Dias úteis até o dinheiro cair na conta (Esperado)")
                                ->schema([
                                    Grid::make(2)->schema([
                                        TextInput::make("debit_term_days")->label("Prazo Débito (Dias)")->numeric()->default(1),
                                        TextInput::make("credit_term_days")->label("Prazo Crédito (Dias)")->numeric()->default(30),
                                    ]),
                                ]),

                            Section::make("Calendário de Antecipação")->schema([
                                Select::make("anticipation_strategy")
                                    ->label("Estratégia de Antecipação")
                                    ->options([
                                        "none" => "Não Antecipar (Receber no prazo original)",
                                        "automatic" => "Antecipação Automática (Todo dia)",
                                        "scheduled" => "Agendada (Dias específicos da semana)",
                                    ])
                                    ->live()
                                    ->default("none"),

                                CheckboxList::make("anticipation_days")
                                    ->label("Dias da semana autorizados")
                                    ->options(['monday' => 'Seg.', 'tuesday' => 'Ter.', 'wednesday' => 'Qua.', 'thursday' => 'Qui.', 'friday' => 'Sex.'])
                                    ->columns(5)
                                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get("anticipation_strategy") === "scheduled"),
                            ]),
                        ]),
                ])
                ->columnSpanFull(),
        ];
    }

    public static function configure(\Filament\Schemas\Schema $schema): \Filament\Schemas\Schema
        {
            return $schema->schema(self::getFormSchema());
        }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankAccounts\Tables;


use App\Enums\BankAccountType;use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables;
use App\Support\BankList; // A nossa classe que traduz os bancos

class BankAccountsTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table->columns([
            // Nome personalizado da conta (ex: Sicredi Principal)
            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('name')
                ->label('Nome da Conta')
                ->searchable()
                ->sortable(),

            // Coluna da Instituição Financeira
            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('bank_code')
                ->label('Banco')
                ->searchable()
                ->sortable()
                ->formatStateUsing(fn (?string $state): ?string => BankList::all()[$state] ?? $state)
                ->description(fn ($record) => $record->type !== 'vault'
                    ? "Ag: {$record->agency} / Cc: {$record->account_number}"
                    : null
                ),

            // Tipo de Conta com Badge colorida
            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('type')
                            ->label('Tipo')
                            ->badge()
                            ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                                'vault' => 'Cofre',
                                'checking' => 'Corrente',
                                'savings' => 'Poupança',
                                'credit_card' => 'Cartão de Crédito', // 🚀
                                default => $state,
                            })
                            ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                                'vault' => 'warning',
                                'checking' => 'info',
                                'savings' => 'success',
                                'credit_card' => 'danger', // 🚀 Vermelho/Danger pois é conta de passivo!
                                default => 'gray',
                            }),

            // Saldo Inicial formatado em Reais
            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('initial_balance')
                ->label('Saldo Inicial')
                ->money('BRL')
                ->sortable(),

            // Switch de Ativo/Inativo diretamente na listagem
            Tables\Columns\ToggleColumn::make('is_active')
                ->label('Ativa?'),

        ])
        ->filters([
            // Filtro rápido por tipo de conta
            Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make('type')
                ->label('Filtrar por Tipo')
                ->options(BankAccountType::class),
        ])
        ->actions([
                    \Filament\Actions\ViewAction::make(), // 🚀 NOVO BOTÃO DE VER
                    \Filament\Actions\EditAction::make(),
                ])
        ->bulkActions([
            \Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup::make([
                \Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction::make(),
            ]),
        ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/BankStatements/Actions/AutoConciliateAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use App\Models\BankStatement;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\PaymentBatch;
use App\Services\Accounting\BankMatchScoringService;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Schemas\ConciliationTabsSchema;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Radio;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Filament\Support\Enums\Alignment;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;

class AutoConciliateAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return "auto_conciliate";
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label("Conciliação Automática")
            ->icon("heroicon-o-sparkles")
            ->color("warning")
            ->hidden(
                fn(): bool => BankStatement::query()
                    ->where("status", "pending")
                    ->where("amount", "<", 0)
                    ->count() === 0,
            )
            ->modalHeading("Conciliação Automática")
            ->modalDescription("Selecione o par perfeito para esta transação.")
            ->modalWidth("5xl")
            ->extraModalWindowAttributes(["class" => "ux-conciliation-modal"])
            ->modalFooterActionsAlignment(Alignment::End)
            ->modalCancelAction(false)
            ->modalSubmitAction(
                fn($action, $livewire) => $action
                    ->label("Conciliar e Avançar")
                    ->visible(fn() => $livewire->currentStmtId !== null),
            )
            ->extraModalFooterActions(
                fn($livewire): array => [
                    Action::make("skip_transaction")
                        ->label("Pular esta transação")
                        ->color("gray")
                        ->icon("heroicon-m-forward")
                        ->visible(fn() => $livewire->currentStmtId !== null)
                        ->action(function ($livewire, Action $action) {
                            if ($livewire->currentStmtId) {
                                $skipped = session()->get("auto_conciliate_skipped", []);
                                $skipped[] = $livewire->currentStmtId;
                                session()->put("auto_conciliate_skipped", array_unique($skipped));
                            }
                            $livewire->replaceMountedAction("auto_conciliate");
                            $action->halt();
                        }),
                ],
            )
            ->form(function ($livewire) {
                $pendingStatements = BankStatement::query()
                    ->where("status", "pending")
                    ->where("amount", "<", 0)
                    ->get();

                if ($pendingStatements->isEmpty()) {
                    session()->forget("auto_conciliate_skipped");
                    $livewire->currentStmtId = null;
                    return [
                        Placeholder::make("empty")
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->content(new HtmlString('<div class="text-center text-gray-500 py-12">🎉 Não há mais despesas para conciliar!</div>')),
                    ];
                }

                $service = new BankMatchScoringService();
                $scoredQueue = [];
                foreach ($pendingStatements as $stmt) {
                    $matches = $service->findMatchesFor($stmt);
                    $scoredQueue[] = [
                        "stmt" => $stmt,
                        "matches" => $matches,
                        "max_score" => $matches->count() > 0 ? $matches->max("score") : -1,
                    ];
                }

                $skippedIds = session()->get("auto_conciliate_skipped", []);
                usort($scoredQueue, function ($a, $b) use ($skippedIds) {
                    $aIsSkipped = in_array($a["stmt"]->id, $skippedIds);
                    $bIsSkipped = in_array($b["stmt"]->id, $skippedIds);
                    if ($aIsSkipped !== $bIsSkipped) return $aIsSkipped ? 1 : -1;
                    if ($b["max_score"] !== $a["max_score"]) return $b["max_score"] <=> $a["max_score"];
                    return $a["stmt"]->bank_date <=> $b["stmt"]->bank_date;
                });

                $bestItem = $scoredQueue[0];
                $statement = $bestItem["stmt"];
                $matches = $bestItem["matches"];
                $livewire->currentStmtId = $statement->id;

                $bestCandidateId = count($matches) > 0 ? "payable_" . $matches->first()["candidate"]->id : null;

                return [
                    Grid::make(12)->schema([

                        // 🚀 A MÁGICA: O ESPARGUETE DE HTML SUMIU DAQUI!
                        Placeholder::make("bank_transaction")
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->columnSpan(4)
                            ->content(fn() => view('components.bank-transaction-card', ['statement' => $statement])),

                        Grid::make(1)
                            ->columnSpan(8)
                            ->schema([
                                Radio::make("selected_match")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->live()
                                    ->afterStateUpdated(
                                        fn($state, Set $set) => filled($state) ? $set("manual_payable_id", null) : null,
                                    )
                                    ->visible(count($matches) > 0)
                                    ->options(function () use ($matches) {
                                        $options = [];
                                        foreach ($matches as $match) {
                                            $options["payable_" . $match["candidate"]->id] = " ";
                                        }
                                        return $options;
                                    })
                                    ->descriptions(function () use ($matches) {
                                        $descriptions = [];

                                        // 🚀 TUDO LIMPO! Sem Heroicons nem HTML no PHP
                                        foreach ($matches as $match) {
                                            $descriptions["payable_" . $match["candidate"]->id] = new HtmlString(
                                                view('components.payable-candidate-row', [
                                                    'candidate' => $match["candidate"],
                                                    'score' => $match["score"]
                                                ])->render()
                                            );
                                        }

                                        return $descriptions;
                                    })
                                    ->default($bestCandidateId),

                                Placeholder::make("divider")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->visible(count($matches) > 0)
                                    ->content(new HtmlString('<div class="relative flex items-center py-2"><div class="grow border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"></div><span class="shrink-0 mx-4 text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-center">Ou busque manualmente</span><div class="grow border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"></div></div>')),

                                Select::make("manual_payable_id")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->placeholder("🔍 Pesquisar conta ou lote existente...")
                                    ->searchable()
                                    ->preload()
                                    ->live()
                                    ->afterStateUpdated(
                                        fn($state, Set $set) => filled($state) ? $set("selected_match", null) : null,
                                    )
                                    ->options(function () {
                                        $payables = AccountPayable::query()
                                            ->where("status", "pending")
                                            ->whereNull("payment_batch_id")
                                            ->get()
                                            ->mapWithKeys(fn($p) => ["payable_" . $p->id => "📄 " . ($p->supplier->name ?? ($p->employee->name ?? "S/F")) . " - R$ " . number_format($p->amount, 2, ",", ".")]);
                                        $batches = PaymentBatch::query()
                                            ->where("status", "pending")
                                            ->get()
                                            ->mapWithKeys(fn($b) => ["batch_" . $b->id => "📦 LOTE: " . $b->description . " - R$ " . number_format($b->total_amount, 2, ",", ".")]);
                                        return collect($payables)->union($batches)->toArray();
                                    })
                                    ->suffixAction(
                                        Action::make("advanced_conciliation")
                                            ->icon("heroicon-m-plus")
                                            ->tooltip("Criar Nova Despesa")
                                            ->modalHeading("Nova Despesa Avançada")
                                            ->modalWidth("4xl")
                                            ->form([
                                                ConciliationTabsSchema::make($statement),
                                            ])
                                            ->action(function (array $data, $livewire) use ($statement) {
                                                ConciliationTabsSchema::processConciliation($data, $statement);
                                                Notification::make()->title("Conciliado com sucesso!")->success()->send();
                                                $livewire->replaceMountedAction("auto_conciliate");
                                            }),
                                    ),

                                Placeholder::make("no_matches")
                                    ->hiddenLabel()
                                    ->visible(count($matches) === 0)
                                    ->content(function () {
                                        $searchIcon = Blade::render('<x-heroicon-m-magnifying-glass class="w-12 h-12 mb-2 opacity-20"/>');
                                        return new HtmlString("<div class=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-xl text-gray-400 text-sm italic text-center\">{$searchIcon}Nenhuma sugestão disponível para esta transação.<br>Use a busca manual acima.</div>");
                                    }),
                            ]),
                    ]),
                    Hidden::make("statement_id")->default(fn() => $statement->id),
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (array $data, $livewire, Action $action) {
                $selectedId = $data["manual_payable_id"] ?? ($data["selected_match"] ?? null);

                if ($selectedId && !empty($data["statement_id"])) {
                    $statement = BankStatement::query()->find($data["statement_id"]);

                    ConciliationTabsSchema::processConciliation(
                        ["existing_payable_id" => $selectedId],
                        $statement,
                    );

                    Notification::make()->title("Conciliado com sucesso!")->success()->send();

                    $skipped = session()->get("auto_conciliate_skipped", []);
                    if (($key = array_search($data["statement_id"], $skipped)) !== false) {
                        unset($skipped[$key]);
                        session()->put("auto_conciliate_skipped", array_values($skipped));
                    }
                }

                $livewire->replaceMountedAction("auto_conciliate");
                $action->halt();
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/BankStatements/Actions/ImportOfxAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use App\Models\BankAccount;
use App\Models\BankStatement;
use App\Models\AccountPayable;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Services\BankDictionaries\BankDictionaryFactory;
use App\Services\Accounting\BankMatchScoringService;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class ImportOfxAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return "import_ofx";
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label("Importar OFX")
            ->icon("heroicon-o-arrow-up-tray")
            ->color("primary")
            ->form([
                Select::make("bank_account_id")
                    ->label("Conta Bancária de Destino")
                    ->options(BankAccount::pluck("name", "id"))
                    ->required()
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload(),

                FileUpload::make("ofx_file")
                    ->label("Arquivo(s) OFX")
                    ->multiple() // 🚀 A MÁGICA AQUI: Agora aceita dezenas de arquivos de uma vez!
                    ->storeFiles(false)
                    ->required(),
            ])
            ->action(function (array $data) {
                $accountId = $data["bank_account_id"];
                $uploadedFiles = $data["ofx_file"];

                // Garante que é sempre um array para podermos fazer o loop
                if (!is_array($uploadedFiles)) {
                    $uploadedFiles = [$uploadedFiles];
                }

                $account = BankAccount::find($accountId);
                $dictionary = BankDictionaryFactory::make($account?->bank_code);
                $BankMatchScoringService = new BankMatchScoringService();

                $importedCount = 0;
                $autoFeesCount = 0;
                $autoMatchesCount = 0;
                $autoPersonalCount = 0;

                // 🚀 NOVO LOOP: Passa por todos os arquivos arrastados para a caixa!
                foreach ($uploadedFiles as $uploadedFile) {
                    $content = file_get_contents($uploadedFile->getRealPath());

                    $blocks = explode("<STMTTRN>", $content);
                    array_shift($blocks);

                    foreach ($blocks as $txn) {
                        preg_match("/<DTPOSTED>([^<]+)/i", $txn, $dRaw);
                        preg_match("/<TRNAMT>([^<]+)/i", $txn, $amt);
                        preg_match("/<FITID>([^<]+)/i", $txn, $fid);
                        preg_match('/<MEMO>([^<\r\n]+)/i', $txn, $mem);

                        if (!empty($fid[1])) {
                            $dateStr = substr(trim($dRaw[1]), 0, 8);
                            $date = Carbon::createFromFormat("Ymd", $dateStr)->format("Y-m-d");
                            $val = (float) trim($amt[1]);
                            $rawMemo = trim($mem[1] ?? "S/D");

                            $parsedData = $dictionary->parseMemo($rawMemo);
                            $counterparty = empty($parsedData["name"])
                                ? $account->name ?? "Desconhecido"
                                : $parsedData["name"];

                            // 🛡️ A BARREIRA ANTIDUPLICAÇÃO: O firstOrCreate trava repetições baseadas no FITID!
                            $stmt = BankStatement::firstOrCreate(
                                ["fitid" => trim($fid[1])],
                                [
                                    "bank_account_id" => $accountId,
                                    "bank_date" => $date,
                                    "description" => $parsedData["clean_description"],
                                    "document" => $parsedData["document"],
                                    "statement_identifier" => $parsedData["statement_identifier"] ?? null,
                                    "movement_type" => $parsedData["movement_type"] ?? "other",
                                    "counterparty_name" => $counterparty,
                                    "amount" => $val,
                                    "type" => $val >= 0 ? "credit" : "debit",
                                    "status" => "pending",
                                ],
                            );

                            // O sistema só incrementa contadores e faz conciliação se a linha for efetivamente NOVA
                            if ($stmt->wasRecentlyCreated) {
                                $importedCount++;

                                $matchedSupplier = null;
                                if ($stmt->document) {
                                    $matchedSupplier = Supplier::where("document", $stmt->document)->first();
                                }
                                if (!$matchedSupplier) {
                                    $matchedSupplier = Supplier::where("name", $stmt->counterparty_name)
                                        ->orWhere("document_name", $stmt->counterparty_name)
                                        ->first();
                                }

                                if ($matchedSupplier && $matchedSupplier->is_personal && $stmt->amount < 0) {
                                    $desc = "Uso Pessoal: " . ($stmt->description ?: $stmt->counterparty_name);
                                    $payable = AccountPayable::create([
                                        "description" => $desc,
                                        "supplier_id" => $matchedSupplier->id,
                                        "amount" => abs((float) $stmt->amount),
                                        "due_date" => $stmt->bank_date,
                                        "is_personal" => true,
                                        "accounting_category" => "socios",
                                        "accounting_subcategory" => "pessoal",
                                    ]);

                                    \App\Services\Accounting\BankReconciliationService::finalize($stmt, $payable, $matchedSupplier->id, $desc);
                                    $autoPersonalCount++;
                                }
                                elseif ($stmt->movement_type === "bank_fee" && $stmt->amount < 0) {
                                    $desc = $stmt->description ?: "Tarifa Bancária";
                                    $payable = AccountPayable::create([
                                        "description" => $desc,
                                        "amount" => abs((float) $stmt->amount),
                                        "due_date" => $stmt->bank_date,
                                        "accounting_category" => "adm",
                                        "accounting_subcategory" => "taxas",
                                    ]);

                                    \App\Services\Accounting\BankReconciliationService::finalize($stmt, $payable, null, $desc);
                                    $autoFeesCount++;
                                }
                                elseif ($stmt->amount < 0) {
                                    $matches = $BankMatchScoringService->findMatchesFor($stmt);
                                    if ($matches->isNotEmpty() && $matches->first()["score"] >= 95) {
                                        $payable = $matches->first()["candidate"];

                                        \App\Services\Accounting\BankReconciliationService::finalize($stmt, $payable, $payable->supplier_id);
                                        $autoMatchesCount++;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } // Fim do loop de arquivos

                if ($importedCount === 0) {
                    Notification::make()
                        ->title("Nenhuma transação nova!")
                        ->body("O sistema processou os ficheiros e todas as transações já existiam na base de dados.")
                        ->info()
                        ->send();
                    return;
                }

                $message = "Foram adicionadas {$importedCount} transações.";
                if ($autoFeesCount > 0 || $autoMatchesCount > 0 || $autoPersonalCount > 0) {
                    $message .= " O sistema auto-conciliou ";
                    if ($autoMatchesCount > 0) {
                        $message .= "{$autoMatchesCount} pagamentos exatos, ";
                    }
                    if ($autoPersonalCount > 0) {
                        $message .= "{$autoPersonalCount} despesas de sócios, ";
                    }
                    if ($autoFeesCount > 0) {
                        $message .= "{$autoFeesCount} taxas bancárias.";
                    }
                }

                Notification::make()
                    ->title("Importação Inteligente!")
                    ->body(trim($message, ", "))
                    ->success()
                    ->send();
            });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Schemas;

use App\Models\RecurringExpense;
use App\Models\BankStatement;

use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

class ConciliationTabsSchema
{
    public static function make(BankStatement $statement): Group
        {
            $amountStr = number_format(abs((float) $statement->amount), 2, ',', '.');
            $colorClass = $statement->amount < 0 ? 'text-danger-600' : 'text-success-600';
            $dateStr = $statement->bank_date ? $statement->bank_date->format('d/m/Y') : '-';
            $descStr = $statement->counterparty_name ?: $statement->description;
            $docStr = $statement->document ? "<span class='ml-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300'>DOC: {$statement->document}</span>" : '';

            $calendarIcon = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade::render("<x-heroicon-m-calendar class='w-4 h-4 mr-1.5 text-gray-400 shrink-0' />");

            $headerHtml = new HtmlString("
                <style>.fi-modal-window .fi-has-gap { gap: 1.5rem !important; }</style>
                <div class='flex items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/80 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 mb-2'>
                    <div class='flex flex-col'>
                        <span class='text-[10px] font-medium text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1'>Transação do Extrato</span>
                        <div class='text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center'>
                            {$calendarIcon}
                            <span>{$dateStr} &nbsp;&mdash;&nbsp; {$descStr} {$docStr}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class='text-right flex flex-col items-end'>
                        <span class='text-[10px] font-medium text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1'>Valor</span>
                        <div class='text-lg font-medium {$colorClass}'>
                            R$ {$amountStr}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            ");

            return Group::make([
                Placeholder::make('statement_header')->hiddenLabel()->content($headerHtml),
                \Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden::make('is_supplier_locked')->default(false)->dehydrated(false),

                ToggleButtons::make('conciliation_type')
                    ->label('1. Qual é a natureza desta transação?')
                    ->options([
                        'avulsa' => 'Despesa Avulsa / Lote',
                        'fixa' => 'Conta Fixa (Recorrente)',
                        'pessoal' => 'Despesa Pessoal / Sócio',
                        'transferencia' => 'Transferência / Pgto de Fatura',
                    ])
                    ->colors(['avulsa' => 'primary', 'fixa' => 'warning', 'pessoal' => 'info', 'transferencia' => 'success'])
                    ->icons(['avulsa' => 'heroicon-o-document-text', 'fixa' => 'heroicon-o-arrow-path', 'pessoal' => 'heroicon-o-user', 'transferencia' => 'heroicon-o-arrows-right-left'])
                    ->inline()->live()->required(),

                ToggleButtons::make('action_mode')
                    ->label('2. O que deseja fazer?')
                    ->options(['link' => 'Vincular a um registo pendente', 'new' => 'Lançar como novo registo'])
                    ->icons(['link' => 'heroicon-o-link', 'new' => 'heroicon-o-plus-circle'])
                    ->inline()->live()->required()
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => filled($get('conciliation_type')) && $get('conciliation_type') !== 'transferencia'),

                Section::make("Vincular a Despesa/Lote Pendente")
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('conciliation_type') === 'avulsa' && $get('action_mode') === 'link')
                    ->schema([
                        Select::make("existing_payable_id")
                            ->hiddenLabel()->searchable()->placeholder("Busque por fornecedor, lote ou valor...")
                            ->options(function () {
                                $payables = AccountPayable::where("status", "pending")->whereNull("payment_batch_id")->where("is_personal", false)->get()
                                    ->mapWithKeys(fn($p) => ["payable_" . $p->id => "📄 " . ($p->supplier->name ?? ($p->employee->name ?? "S/F")) . " - R$ " . number_format($p->amount, 2, ",", ".")]);
                                $batches = PaymentBatch::where("status", "pending")->get()
                                    ->mapWithKeys(fn($b) => ["batch_" . $b->id => "📦 LOTE: " . $b->description . " - R$ " . number_format($b->total_amount, 2, ",", ".")]);
                                return collect($payables)->union($batches)->toArray();
                            }),
                    ]),
                Section::make("Lançar Nova Despesa")
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('conciliation_type') === 'avulsa' && $get('action_mode') === 'new')
                    ->schema([ Group::make(AccountPayableForm::getFormSchema(true))->statePath('avulsa_new') ]),

                Section::make("Vincular a uma Conta Recorrente")
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('conciliation_type') === 'fixa' && $get('action_mode') === 'link')
                    ->schema([
                        Select::make("existing_fixed_id")
                            ->hiddenLabel()->searchable()->placeholder("Selecione o Contrato / Assinatura")
                            ->options(RecurringExpense::where("is_active", 1)->get()->mapWithKeys(fn($f) => [$f->id => "🔄 " . ($f->supplier->name ?? "S/F") . " - " . $f->name])),
                    ]),
                Section::make("Cadastrar Nova Conta Recorrente")
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('conciliation_type') === 'fixa' && $get('action_mode') === 'new')
                    ->schema([ Group::make(RecurringExpenseForm::getFormSchema(true))->statePath('fixa_new') ]),

                Section::make("Vincular a Despesa Pessoal Pendente")
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('conciliation_type') === 'pessoal' && $get('action_mode') === 'link')
                    ->schema([
                        Select::make("existing_personal_id")
                            ->hiddenLabel()->searchable()->placeholder("Busque pelas suas despesas pendentes...")
                            ->options(fn() => AccountPayable::where("status", "pending")->where("is_personal", true)->get()->mapWithKeys(fn($p) => [$p->id => "👤 " . ($p->supplier->name ?? "S/F") . " - R$ " . number_format($p->amount, 2, ",", ".")])),
                    ]),
                Section::make("Lançar Nova Despesa Pessoal")
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('conciliation_type') === 'pessoal' && $get('action_mode') === 'new')
                    ->schema([
                        Group::make([
                            Toggle::make('identify_supplier')->label('Deseja identificar a pessoa/empresa?')->live()->default(false)->hidden(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_supplier_locked')),
                            Select::make('supplier_id')->label('Favorecido')->options(Supplier::where('is_active', true)->pluck('name', 'id'))->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_supplier_locked') || $get('identify_supplier'))->required(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_supplier_locked') || $get('identify_supplier'))->disabled(fn(Get $get) => $get('is_supplier_locked'))->dehydrated()->createOptionForm([Section::make("Novo Favorecido")->schema(\App\Filament\Resources\Suppliers\Schemas\SupplierForm::getFormSchema())])->createOptionAction(fn ($action) => $action->fillForm(['document' => $statement->document, 'name' => $statement->counterparty_name ?: $statement->description]))->createOptionUsing(fn(array $data) => Supplier::create($data)->id),
                            TextInput::make('description')->label('Descrição do Gasto'),
                        ])->statePath('pessoal_new')
                    ]),

                Section::make("Detalhes da Transferência")
                    ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get('conciliation_type') === 'transferencia')
                    ->schema([
                        Group::make([
                            Select::make('target_account_id')
                                ->label('Conta de Destino / Origem')
                                ->helperText('Selecione o Cartão de Crédito ou a Conta Bancária que recebeu/enviou este valor.')
                                ->options(BankAccount::where('is_active', true)->where('id', '!=', $statement->bank_account_id)->pluck('name', 'id'))
                                ->searchable()
                                ->required(),
                            TextInput::make('description')
                                ->label('Descrição da Movimentação')
                                ->default(fn() => "Transferência: " . ($statement->counterparty_name ?: $statement->description))
                                ->required(),
                        ])->statePath('transfer_new')
                    ]),
            ]);
        }

        // 🚀 O CÓDIGO REESCRITO (AGORA DELEGA TUDO PARA O MOTOR!)
        public static function processConciliation(array $data, BankStatement $statement): void
        {
            $type = $data['conciliation_type'] ?? null;
            $mode = $data['action_mode'] ?? null;

            if (!$type && !empty($data['existing_payable_id'])) {
                $type = 'avulsa'; $mode = 'link';
            }

            $conciliable = null;
            $supplierId = null;
            $description = null;

            if ($type === 'transferencia') {
                $tData = $data['transfer_new'] ?? [];
                if (!empty($tData['target_account_id'])) {
                    $conciliable = BankAccount::find($tData['target_account_id']);
                    $description = $tData['description'] ?? "Transferência";
                }
            }
            elseif ($type === 'avulsa') {
                if ($mode === 'link' && !empty($data['existing_payable_id'])) {
                    $idRaw = $data["existing_payable_id"];
                    if (str_starts_with($idRaw, "batch_")) {
                        $conciliable = PaymentBatch::find(str_replace("batch_", "", $idRaw));
                    } else {
                        $conciliable = AccountPayable::find(str_replace("payable_", "", $idRaw));
                        $supplierId = $conciliable->supplier_id;
                    }
                } elseif ($mode === 'new' && !empty($data['avulsa_new']['amount'])) {
                    $cleanData = Arr::except($data['avulsa_new'], ['is_supplier_locked', 'is_status_locked']);
                    $conciliable = AccountPayable::create($cleanData);
                    $supplierId = $conciliable->supplier_id;
                }
            }
            elseif ($type === 'fixa') {
                if ($mode === 'link' && !empty($data['existing_fixed_id'])) {
                    $fixed = RecurringExpense::find($data["existing_fixed_id"]);
                    $desc = $fixed->name . " (" . $statement->bank_date->format("M/Y") . ")";
                    $conciliable = AccountPayable::create(["description" => $desc, "amount" => abs((float) $statement->amount), "supplier_id" => $fixed->supplier_id, "accounting_category" => $fixed->accounting_category, "accounting_subcategory" => $fixed->accounting_subcategory, "due_date" => $statement->bank_date]);
                    $supplierId = $fixed->supplier_id;
                } elseif ($mode === 'new' && !empty($data['fixa_new']['name'])) {
                    $fixed = RecurringExpense::create(Arr::except($data['fixa_new'], ['is_supplier_locked', 'is_status_locked']));
                    $conciliable = AccountPayable::create(["description" => $fixed->name . " (Inicial)", "amount" => abs((float) $statement->amount), "supplier_id" => $fixed->supplier_id, "accounting_category" => $fixed->accounting_category, "accounting_subcategory" => $fixed->accounting_subcategory, "due_date" => $statement->bank_date]);
                    $supplierId = $fixed->supplier_id;
                }
            }
            elseif ($type === 'pessoal') {
                if ($mode === 'link' && !empty($data['existing_personal_id'])) {
                    $conciliable = AccountPayable::find($data['existing_personal_id']);
                    $supplierId = $conciliable->supplier_id;
                } elseif ($mode === 'new') {
                    $pData = $data['pessoal_new'] ?? [];
                    $supplierId = !empty($pData['is_supplier_locked']) || (!empty($pData['identify_supplier']) && !empty($pData['supplier_id'])) ? $pData['supplier_id'] : Supplier::firstOrCreate(['name' => 'Uso Pessoal / Sócios'], ['type' => 'physical', 'is_personal' => true, 'accounting_category' => 'socios', 'accounting_subcategory' => 'pessoal', 'is_active' => true])->id;
                    $desc = !empty($pData['description']) ? $pData['description'] . " - " . $statement->counterparty_name : "Uso Pessoal: " . ($statement->counterparty_name ?? $statement->description);
                    $conciliable = AccountPayable::create(["description" => $desc, "supplier_id" => $supplierId, "amount" => abs((float) $statement->amount), "due_date" => $statement->bank_date, "is_personal" => true, "accounting_category" => "socios", "accounting_subcategory" => "pessoal"]);
                }
            }

            // 🚀 O TOQUE FINAL DE MESTRE: O MOTOR TRATA DE TUDO!
            if ($conciliable) {
                BankReconciliationService::finalize($statement, $conciliable, $supplierId, $description);
            }
        }
    }
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/BankStatements/Tables/BankStatementsTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Tables;

use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use App\Models\BankStatement;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Schemas\ConciliationTabsSchema;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions\BulkPersonalAction;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions\BulkExpenseAction;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions\BulkEmployeeAction;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions\BulkRecurringAction;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Actions\BulkTransferAction;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class BankStatementsTable
{
    public static function build(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("bank_date")
                    ->label("Data")
                    ->date("d/m/Y")
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("movement_type")
                    ->label("Operação")
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(
                        fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                            "pix_in" => "Pix Recebido", "pix_out" => "Pix Pago", "boleto_out" => "Boleto",
                            "card_in" => "Cartão", "transfer" => "Transferência", "fixed_bill" => "Conta Fixa",
                            "tax_bill" => "Imposto", "payroll" => "Folha Pagto.", "bank_fee" => "Taxa Banco",
                            "atm_in" => "Depósito", "atm_out" => "Saque", default => "Outros",
                        },
                    )
                    ->color(fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        "pix_in", "card_in", "atm_in" => "success",
                        "bank_fee" => "danger",
                        default => "warning",
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("counterparty_name")
                    ->label("Contraparte")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->weight("bold")
                    ->description(function (BankStatement $record) {
                        $badge = "";
                        if ($record->document) {
                            if (Supplier::where("document", $record->document)->exists()) {
                                $badge = '<span class="mt-1 inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">🏢 Fornecedor</span>';
                            } elseif (Employee::where("cpf", $record->document)->exists()) {
                                $badge = '<span class="mt-1 inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-fuchsia-100 text-fuchsia-800">👤 Colaborador</span>';
                            }
                        }
                        return $badge ? new HtmlString($badge) : null;
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("document")
                    ->label("Documento / ID")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->getStateUsing(fn (BankStatement $record) => $record->document ?: '-')
                    ->description(fn (BankStatement $record) => $record->statement_identifier ? "ID: " . $record->statement_identifier : null),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("amount")
                    ->label("Valor")
                    ->money("BRL")
                    ->sortable()
                    ->color(fn($record) => $record->type === "credit" ? "success" : "danger")
                    ->weight("bold"),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("status")
                    ->label("Status")
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(
                        fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                            "pending" => "Pendente", "reconciled" => "Conciliado", "ignored" => "Ignorado", default => $state,
                        }
                    )
                    ->colors(["warning" => "pending", "success" => "reconciled", "gray" => "ignored"]),
            ])
            ->filters([]) // Filtros removidos pois as Abas assumiram este papel
            ->actions([
            Action::make("conciliar")
                ->label("Conciliar")
                ->icon("heroicon-m-arrows-right-left")
                ->button()
                ->outlined()
                ->color("gray")
                ->visible(fn(BankStatement $record): bool => $record->status === "pending")
                ->modalHeading("Conciliar Transação")
                // 🚀 Abre elegantemente na lateral
                ->slideOver()
                ->fillForm(function (BankStatement $record): array {
                    $cleanDoc = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $record->document);
                    $supplierId = null;

                    if (!empty($cleanDoc)) {
                        $supplier = \App\Models\Supplier::where('document', $record->document)
                            ->orWhere('document', $cleanDoc)
                            ->first();

                        if (!$supplier) {
                            $supplier = \App\Models\Supplier::whereNotNull('document')->get()->first(function ($s) use ($cleanDoc) {
                                return preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $s->document) === $cleanDoc;
                            });
                        }
                        $supplierId = $supplier?->id;
                    }

                    $amount = abs((float) $record->amount);
                    $date = $record->bank_date->format('Y-m-d');
                    $desc = $record->counterparty_name ?: $record->description;
                    $locked = $supplierId !== null;

                    return [
                        'conciliation_type' => null,
                        'action_mode' => null,
                        'existing_payable_id' => null,
                        'existing_fixed_id' => null,
                        'existing_personal_id' => null,

                        'avulsa_new' => [
                            'amount' => $amount,

                            // 🚀 O SEGREDO DO PAGAMENTO AQUI:
                            'due_date' => $date, // Mantemos como padrão inicial caso o utilizador não queira alterar
                            'payment_date' => $date, // A data do banco vai para a Data de Pagamento!
                            'status' => 'paid', // Forçamos o status para Pago
                            'is_status_locked' => true, // Injetamos a trava antifraude/anticlique!

                            'description' => $desc,
                            'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
                            'is_supplier_locked' => $locked,
                        ],
                        'fixa_new' => [
                            'default_amount' => $amount,
                            'due_day' => $record->bank_date->format('d'),
                            'name' => $desc,
                            'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
                            'is_supplier_locked' => $locked,
                        ],
                        'pessoal_new' => [
                            'description' => '',
                            'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
                            'is_supplier_locked' => $locked,
                        ],
                    ];
                })
                ->form(fn(BankStatement $record) => [ConciliationTabsSchema::make($record)])
                ->action(function (array $data, BankStatement $record): void {
                    ConciliationTabsSchema::processConciliation($data, $record);

                    \Filament\Notifications\Notification::make()
                        ->title("Conciliado com sucesso!")
                        ->success()
                        ->send();
                }),

           //     Action::make("ignorar")
           //         ->label("Ignorar")
           //         ->icon("heroicon-m-x-mark")
           //         ->button()
           //         ->color("gray")
           //         ->requiresConfirmation()
           //         ->visible(fn(BankStatement $record): bool => $record->status === "pending")
           //         ->action(fn(BankStatement $record) => $record->update(["status" => "ignored"])),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    BulkExpenseAction::make(),
                    BulkEmployeeAction::make(), // 🚀 A Nova
                    BulkTransferAction::make(),
                    BulkRecurringAction::make(), // 🚀 A Nova
                    BulkPersonalAction::make(),
                ]),
            ])
            ->defaultSort("bank_date", "desc");
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/BankStatements/BankStatementResource.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements;

use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Pages;
use App\Models\BankStatement;
use Filament\Resources\Resource;
use Filament\Tables\Table;

// Importamos APENAS a Tabela, pois não há Form global manual
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\Tables\BankStatementsTable;

class BankStatementResource extends Resource
{
    protected static ?string $model = BankStatement::class;

    protected static string|\UnitEnum|null $navigationGroup = 'Financeiro';

    public static function getNavigationIcon(): string|\BackedEnum|null
    {
        return "heroicon-o-arrows-right-left";
    }

    public static function getNavigationGroup(): ?string
    {
        return "Financeiro";
    }

    // 1. Define o número que vai aparecer na Badge
    public static function getNavigationBadge(): ?string
    {
        // Conta quantos extratos estão com o status "pending"
        $count = \App\Models\BankStatement::where("status", "pending")->count();

        // Retorna o número em string, ou null se for 0 (assim a badge some quando tudo estiver limpo 🎉)
        return $count > 0 ? (string) $count : null;
    }

    // 2. Define a cor da Badge (opcional, mas dá um destaque visual)
    public static function getNavigationBadgeColor(): ?string
    {
        // Se quiser que fique vermelho de "urgente", use 'danger'
        // 'warning' (amarelo), 'success' (verde), 'primary' (azul)
        return "warning";
    }

    public static function getModelLabel(): string
    {
        return "Conciliação Bancária";
    }

    public static function getPluralModelLabel(): string
    {
        return "Conciliações";
    }

    // Delega APENAS a Table
    public static function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return BankStatementsTable::build($table);
    }

    public static function getPages(): array
    {
        return [
            // Como não há Create nem Edit manual, temos apenas a página Manage (index)
            "index" => Pages\ManageBankStatements::route("/"),
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/CashShifts/Tables/CashShiftTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\CashShifts\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Textarea;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\Transaction;

class CashShiftTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('id')->label('Turno #')->sortable(),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('bankAccount.name')->label('Gaveta')->weight('bold')->searchable(),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('opener.name')->label('Operador'),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('opened_at')->label('Abertura')->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')->sortable(),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('opening_balance')->label('Fundo de Troco')->money('BRL'),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('status')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'open' => 'Aberto',
                        'closed' => 'Fechado',
                        default => $state,
                    })
                    ->colors([
                        'success' => 'open',
                        'gray' => 'closed',
                    ]),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('difference')
                    ->label('Diferença')
                    ->money('BRL')
                    ->color(fn ($state) => $state < 0 ? 'danger' : ($state > 0 ? 'success' : 'gray'))
                    ->visible(fn ($record) => $record && $record->status === 'closed'),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('opened_at', 'desc')
            ->actions([

                // ==========================================
                // 1. SUPRIMENTO (Entrada de Dinheiro)
                // ==========================================
                \Filament\Actions\Action::make('suprimento')
                    ->label('Suprimento')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-down-tray')
                    ->color('success')
                    ->visible(fn (CashShift $record) => $record->status === 'open')
                    ->form([
                        TextInput::make('amount')->label('Valor (R$)')->numeric()->prefix('R$')->required(),
                        TextInput::make('description')->label('Motivo')->default('Troco extra / Suprimento')->required(),
                    ])
                    ->action(function (CashShift $record, array $data) {
                        app(\App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftCashierService::class)->recordTransaction([
                            'type' => 'in',
                            'amount' => $data['amount'],
                            'description' => $data['description'],
                        ], auth()->user()->name ?? 'Sistema', $record->bank_account_id);

                        Notification::make()->title('Suprimento Registrado!')->success()->send();
                    }),

                // ==========================================
                // 2. SANGRIA (Retirada de Dinheiro)
                // ==========================================
                \Filament\Actions\Action::make('sangria')
                    ->label('Sangria')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-up-tray')
                    ->color('warning')
                    ->visible(fn (CashShift $record) => $record->status === 'open')
                    ->form([
                        TextInput::make('amount')->label('Valor (R$)')->numeric()->prefix('R$')->required(),
                        TextInput::make('description')->label('Motivo')->default('Retirada de excesso / Sangria')->required(),
                    ])
                    ->action(function (CashShift $record, array $data) {
                        app(\App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftCashierService::class)->recordTransaction([
                            'type' => 'out',
                            'amount' => $data['amount'],
                            'description' => $data['description'],
                        ], auth()->user()->name ?? 'Sistema', $record->bank_account_id);

                        Notification::make()->title('Sangria Registrada!')->success()->send();
                    }),

                // ==========================================
                // 3. FECHAR CAIXA (Inteligente)
                // ==========================================
                \Filament\Actions\Action::make('fechar_caixa')
                    ->label('Fechar Caixa')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-lock-closed')
                    ->color('danger')
                    ->visible(fn (CashShift $record) => $record->status === 'open')
                    ->form(function (CashShift $record) {

                        // MATEMÁTICA REAL DO CAIXA!
                        // Pega todas as entradas (Vendas em Dinheiro e Suprimentos) desde que o caixa abriu
                        $entradas = Transaction::where('bank_account_id', $record->bank_account_id)
                            ->where('transaction_date', '>=', $record->opened_at)
                            ->where('type', 'in')
                            ->sum('amount');

                        // Pega todas as saídas (Sangrias e Despesas) desde que o caixa abriu
                        $saidas = Transaction::where('bank_account_id', $record->bank_account_id)
                            ->where('transaction_date', '>=', $record->opened_at)
                            ->where('type', 'out')
                            ->sum('amount');

                        // O que o sistema espera que esteja na gaveta de dinheiro:
                        $expected = $record->opening_balance + $entradas - $saidas;

                        return [
                            TextInput::make('closing_balance_expected')
                                ->label('Valor Esperado (Fundo + Vendas + Suprimentos - Sangrias)')
                                ->numeric()
                                ->prefix('R$')
                                ->default($expected)
                                ->readOnly()
                                ->extraInputAttributes(['style' => 'font-weight: bold; background-color: #f3f4f6;']),

                            TextInput::make('closing_balance_actual')
                                ->label('Valor Físico Contado na Gaveta')
                                ->numeric()
                                ->prefix('R$')
                                ->required()
                                ->autofocus(),

                            Textarea::make('notes')
                                ->label('Justificativa (Obrigatório se houver diferença)'),
                        ];
                    })
                    ->action(function (CashShift $record, array $data): void {
                        app(\App\Services\RestaurantOps\ShiftCashierService::class)->closeShift([
                            'amount' => $data['closing_balance_actual'],
                            'retained_amount' => 0, // Admin retém zero por padrão nesta tela
                            'observation' => $data['notes'],
                            'details' => null
                        ], auth()->id(), $record); // 🚀 Injeta o turno exato da linha!

                        Notification::make()->title('Caixa Fechado com sucesso!')->success()->send();
                    }),

                \Filament\Actions\ViewAction::make()->iconButton(),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\Categories\Pages;

use Filament\Resources\Pages\EditRecord;
use App\Events\CatalogUpdated; // 🚀 Importado
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log; // 🚀 Importado

class EditCategory extends EditRecord
{
    use \App\Filament\Traits\RedirectsToIndex;

    protected static string $resource = CategoryResource::class;

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            Actions\DeleteAction::make(),
        ];
    }

    // 🚀 O GATILHO INFALÍVEL DO FILAMENT (O SEU CONTROLLER)
    protected function afterSave(): void
    {
        // $this->record é a categoria que acabou de ser editada e salva com sucesso
        $tenantId = $this->record->tenant_id ?? tenant('id') ?? 'central';

        Log::info("⚡ GATILHO FILAMENT (Edit): Avisando Tenant {$tenantId}");

        try {
            \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache::tags(['catalog'])->flush();
        } catch (\Exception $e) { }

        // Dispara o aviso para o Reverb (Fila) !
        broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenantId));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Categories\Schemas;

use App\Enums\CategoryType;
use App\Enums\ProductStatus;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Textarea;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Unique;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile;
use Intervention\Image\ImageManager;
use Intervention\Image\Drivers\Gd\Driver;

class CategoryForm
{
    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            Section::make("Detalhes")
                ->schema([
                    TextInput::make("name")
                        ->label("Nome")
                        ->required()
                        ->live(onBlur: true)
                        ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set, ?string $state) => $set('slug', Str::slug($state)))
                        ->unique(
                            ignoreRecord: true,
                            modifyRuleUsing: fn(Unique $rule) => $rule->withoutTrashed(),
                        )
                        ->columnSpan(2),

                    TextInput::make("slug")
                        ->label("Slug (URL)")
                        ->required()
                        ->unique(
                            ignoreRecord: true,
                            modifyRuleUsing: fn(Unique $rule) => $rule->withoutTrashed(),
                        )
                        ->columnSpan(1),

                    Select::make("type")
                        ->label("Macro Área (Tipo)")
                        ->options(CategoryType::class)
                        ->required()
                        ->default(CategoryType::EXTERNAL->value)
                        ->columnSpan(1),

                    Select::make("parent_id")
                        ->relationship("parent", "name")
                        ->label("Categoria Pai (Opcional)")
                        ->searchable()
                        ->preload()
                        ->columnSpan(1)
                        ->createOptionForm([
                            TextInput::make("name")
                                ->label("Nome")
                                ->required(),
                            Select::make("type")
                                ->label("Macro Área")
                                ->options(CategoryType::class)
                                ->required()
                                ->default(CategoryType::EXTERNAL->value),
                        ]),

                    Select::make("status")
                        ->label("Status de Disponibilidade")
                        ->options(ProductStatus::class)
                        ->required()
                        ->default(ProductStatus::AVAILABLE->value)
                        ->columnSpan(1),

                    Select::make("visibility")
                        ->label("Visibilidade")
                        ->options([
                            "external" => "Visível (Público/Cardápio)",
                            "internal" => "Oculto (Uso Interno/PDV)",
                        ])
                        ->required()
                        ->default("external")
                        ->columnSpan(1),
                ])
                ->columns(3)
                ->columnSpanFull(),

            Section::make("Mídia & Descrição")
                ->schema([
                    FileUpload::make("image_path")
                        ->label("Imagem da Categoria")
                        ->image()
                        ->disk('public')
                        ->visibility('public')
                        ->directory("categories")
                        ->saveUploadedFileUsing(function (TemporaryUploadedFile $file): string {
                            $manager = new ImageManager(new Driver());
                            $path = 'categories/' . Str::uuid() . '.webp';

                            $image = $manager->read($file->getRealPath())
                                ->scaleDown(width: 500)
                                ->toWebp(quality: 85);

                            Storage::disk('public')->put($path, $image->toString(), 'public');
                            return $path;
                        })
                        ->columnSpan(1),

                    Textarea::make("description")
                        ->label("Descrição")
                        ->rows(4)
                        ->columnSpan(2),
                ])
                ->columns(3)
                ->columnSpanFull(),

            Section::make("Configurações")
                ->schema([
                    TextInput::make("sort_order")
                        ->label("Ordem de Exibição")
                        ->numeric()
                        ->default(0)
                        ->columnSpan(1),

                    Toggle::make("is_active")
                        ->label("Ativa?")
                        ->default(true)
                        ->inline(false)
                        ->columnSpan(1),
                ])
                ->columns(2)
                ->columnSpanFull(),
        ];
    }

    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->schema(self::getFormSchema());
    }
}
```
