```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Coupons\Tables;


use App\Enums\CouponType;use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteAction;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use Filament\Actions\ViewAction;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\ToggleColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\TernaryFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class CouponTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Campanha / Promoção')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('medium')
                    ->placeholder('Sem nome definido')
                    ->description(fn ($record) => $record->description ? Str::limit($record->description, 45) : null),

                TextColumn::make('code')
                    ->label('Código')
                    ->badge()
                    ->copyable()
                    ->copyMessage('Código copiado!')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight('bold')
                    ->description(fn ($record) => $record->is_pos_only ? '⚡ Exclusivo PDV' : null),

                TextColumn::make('type_and_value')
                    ->label('Desconto')
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        if ($record->type === 'free_delivery') return 'Entrega Grátis';
                        if ($record->type === 'fixed') return 'R$ ' . number_format((float) $record->value, 2, ',', '.');
                        if ($record->type === 'fixed_total') return 'Total R$ ' . number_format((float) $record->value, 2, ',', '.');
                        return round((float) $record->value, 0) . '%';
                    })
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn ($record) => match ($record->type) {
                        'free_delivery' => 'info',
                        'fixed_total' => 'warning',
                        default => 'success',
                    }),

                TextColumn::make('usage_count')
                    ->label('Utilizações')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn ($record) => $record->global_usage_limit > 0
                        ? "{$record->usage_count} / {$record->global_usage_limit}"
                        : "{$record->usage_count} (Ilimitado)")
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('customer.name')
                    ->label('Exclusividade')
                    ->placeholder('Público (Todos)')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->description(fn ($record) => $record->first_order_only ? 'Apenas 1ª Compra' : null),

                TextColumn::make('status_badge')
                    ->label('Situação')
                    ->badge()
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        if (!$record->is_active) return 'Desativado';
                        if ($record->expires_at && now()->greaterThan($record->expires_at)) return 'Expirado';
                        if ($record->starts_at && now()->lessThan($record->starts_at)) return 'Programado';
                        if ($record->global_usage_limit > 0 && $record->usage_count >= $record->global_usage_limit) return 'Esgotado';
                        return 'Ativo';
                    })
                    ->colors([
                        'success' => 'Ativo',
                        'info' => 'Programado',
                        'danger' => fn ($state) => in_array($state, ['Desativado', 'Expirado', 'Esgotado']),
                    ]),

                ToggleColumn::make('is_active')
                    ->label('Ativo?')
                    ->sortable(),
            ])
            ->filters([
                TernaryFilter::make('is_active')
                    ->label('Status de Ativação'),

                TernaryFilter::make('is_pos_only')
                    ->label('Canal')
                    ->trueLabel('Apenas PDV (Caixa)')
                    ->falseLabel('Disponível no App / Delivery'),

                SelectFilter::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo de Desconto')
                    ->options(CouponType::class),
            ])
            ->actions([
                ViewAction::make()->iconButton(),
                EditAction::make()->iconButton(),
                DeleteAction::make()->iconButton(),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc');
    }
}
```

```php
                    // 🚀 RÓTULO MÁGICO: Vinculado aos casos do Enum tipado
                    TextInput::make("base_remuneration")

            Section::make("Benefícios & Escala")->schema([

                        "sab" => "Sábado",

                    ->columns(4),

                Toggle::make("receives_night_premium")
                    ->label("Recebe Adicional Noturno?")

                    ->columnSpanFull(),
            ]),
        ];

    {
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Employees\Tables;

use App\Enums\EmploymentType;

use Filament\Tables\Columns\ToggleColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Actions\ViewAction;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;

class EmployeeTable
{
    public static function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Colaborador')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('employment_type')
                    ->label('Vínculo')
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('work_days')
                    ->label('Escala')
                    ->visible(fn ($record) => $record?->employment_type === EmploymentType::FREELANCE_FIXED)
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn ($state) => count($state ?? []) . ' dias/semana')
                    ->color('primary'),

                TextColumn::make('user.roles.name')
                    ->label('Cargos / Acesso')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color('gray')
                    ->placeholder('Nenhum cargo'),

                TextColumn::make('user_status')
                    ->label('Conta de Acesso')
                    ->state(fn ($record) => $record->user ? 'Usuário criado' : 'Sem usuário')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'Usuário criado' => 'success',
                        'Sem usuário' => 'danger',
                        default => 'gray',
                    })
                    ->icon(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'Usuário criado' => 'heroicon-m-link',
                        'Sem usuário' => 'heroicon-m-link-slash',
                        default => 'heroicon-m-link',
                    })
                    ->alignCenter(),

                ToggleColumn::make('is_active')
                    ->label('Ativo')
                    ->sortable(),
            ])
            ->filters([
                //
            ])
            ->actions([
                ViewAction::make()->iconButton(),
                EditAction::make()->iconButton(),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\Pages;

class CreateIngredient extends CreateRecord
{

    {
```

```php
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Unique;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Set;
use Filament\Actions\Action;

class IngredientForm
{
    // ==========================================
    // 1. ÁRVORE DECLARATIVA (Limpa e Legível)
    // ==========================================
    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            Section::make("Dados do Insumo / Preparo")
                ->schema([
                    Grid::make(3)->schema([
                        self::getNameField(),
                        self::getCategoryField(),
                    ]),

                    Grid::make(4)->schema([
                        self::getTypeField(),
                        self::getUnitOfMeasureField(),
                        self::getRecipeYieldField(),
                        self::getBaseCostField(),
                    ]),

                    Grid::make(3)->schema([self::getTrackInventoryField()]),
                ])
                ->columnSpanFull(),
        ];
    }

    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->schema(self::getFormSchema());
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 2. CONSTRUTORES DE CAMPOS (Isolados)
    // ==========================================
    private static function getNameField(): Forms\Components\TextInput
    {
        return Forms\Components\TextInput::make("name")
            ->unique(
                ignoreRecord: true,
                modifyRuleUsing: fn(Unique $rule) => $rule->withoutTrashed(),
            )
            ->label("Nome do Insumo/Preparo")
            ->required()
            ->columnSpan(2);
    }

    private static function getCategoryField(): Forms\Components\Select
    {
        return Forms\Components\Select::make("category_id")
            ->label("Categoria de Insumo")
            ->options(
                // 🚀 Lista APENAS categorias internas de insumo/produção
                fn() => Category::where("type", "internal")->pluck("name", "id"),
        )
            ->required()
            ->searchable()
            ->preload()
            ->live()
            ->afterStateUpdated(function ($state, Set $set) {
                $category = Category::find($state);
                if ($category && str_contains(strtolower($category->name), "preparo interno")) {
                    $set("type", "manufactured");
                } else {
                    $set("type", "ingredient");
                }
            })
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getTypeField(): Forms\Components\Select
    {
        return Forms\Components\Select::make("type")
            ->label("Tipo de Item")
            ->options([
                "ingredient"   => "Insumo (Comprado)",
                "manufactured" => "Preparado (Receita Interna)",
            ])
            ->default("ingredient")
            ->required()
            ->live()
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getUnitOfMeasureField(): Forms\Components\Select
    {
        return Forms\Components\Select::make("unit_of_measure")
            ->label("Unidade de Medida")
            ->options(UnitOfMeasure::class)
            ->required()
            ->live()
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getRecipeYieldField(): Forms\Components\TextInput
    {
        return Forms\Components\TextInput::make("recipe_yield")
            ->label("Rendimento do Preparo")
            ->numeric()
            ->default(1.0)
            ->step(0.0001)
            ->hintIcon(
                "heroicon-m-information-circle",
                tooltip: "Ex: Faz 2.1kg mas rende 1.8kg. Insira 1.8",
            )
            ->hintColor("primary")
            ->visible(fn(Get $get) => $get("type") === "manufactured")
            ->suffixAction(self::getYieldCalculatorAction())
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getBaseCostField(): Forms\Components\TextInput
    {
        return Forms\Components\TextInput::make("base_cost")
            ->label("Custo Médio")
            ->prefix('R$')
            ->formatStateUsing(function ($state, ?Product $record) {
                if ($record) {
                    $realCost = \App\Services\Catalog\ProductCostingService::calculateBaseCost(
                        $record,
                    );
                    $formatted = rtrim(
                        rtrim(number_format($realCost, 5, ",", "."), "0"),
                        ",",
                    );
                    $parts = explode(",", $formatted);
                    return count($parts) > 1
                        ? (strlen($parts[1]) < 2
                            ? $parts[0] . "," . str_pad($parts[1], 2, "0")
                            : $formatted)
                        : $formatted . ",00";
                }
                return $state;
            })
            ->readOnly(
                fn(?Product $record, Get $get) => $get("type") ===
                    "manufactured" ||
                    ($record && $record->costHistories()->exists()),
            )
            ->dehydrated(
                fn(?Product $record, Get $get) => !(
                    $get("type") === "manufactured" ||
                    ($record && $record->costHistories()->exists())
                ),
            )
            ->mutateDehydratedStateUsing(function ($state) {
                if (blank($state)) {
                    return 0;
                }
                return (float) str_replace(
                    ",",
                    ".",
                    str_replace(".", "", (string) $state),
                );
            })
            ->hintIcon("heroicon-m-information-circle")
            ->hintColor("primary")
            ->hintIconTooltip(function (?Product $record, Get $get) {
                if ($get("type") === "manufactured") {
                    return "Calculado pela Ficha Técnica.";
                }
                if ($record && $record->costHistories()->exists()) {
                    return "Bloqueado. Extraído da Nota de Compra.";
                }
                return "Sem histórico. Digite o custo base inicial.";
            })
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    private static function getTrackInventoryField(): Forms\Components\Toggle
    {
        return Forms\Components\Toggle::make("track_inventory")
            ->label("Controlar Estoque Físico?")
            ->default(true)
            ->inline(false)
            ->columnSpan(1);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 3. AÇÕES COMPLEXAS E REGRAS DE NEGÓCIO
    // ==========================================
    private static function getYieldCalculatorAction(): Action
    {
        return Action::make("calculadora_rendimento")
            ->icon("heroicon-m-calculator")
            ->tooltip("Calcular Rendimento por Regra de Três")
            ->color("primary")
            ->visible(
                fn(Get $get, ?Product $record) => $get("type") ===
                    "manufactured" &&
                    $get("unit_of_measure") === "UN" &&
                    $record !== null,
            )
            ->modalHeading("Calculadora de Rendimento")
            ->modalDescription(
                "O sistema vai somar os ingredientes da sua ficha técnica e calcular quantas unidades rendem.",
            )
            ->form(function (?Product $record) {
                $totalGrams = self::calculateTotalGramsFromSheet($record);

                if ($totalGrams == 0) {
                    return [
                        Forms\Components\Placeholder::make("aviso")
                            ->label("Atenção")
                            ->content(
                                "Nenhum ingrediente em Peso ou Volume encontrado. Salve os insumos na Ficha Técnica primeiro!",
                            ),
                    ];
                }

                $displayInput =
                    $totalGrams >= 1000
                        ? number_format($totalGrams / 1000, 3, ",", "") .
                            " kg / L"
                        : number_format($totalGrams, 0, "", "") . " g / ml";

                return [
                    Forms\Components\Placeholder::make("entrada_total")
                        ->label("Entrada Total (Ficha Técnica)")
                        ->content($displayInput),

                    Grid::make(2)->schema([
                        Forms\Components\TextInput::make("unit_weight")
                            ->label("Peso de 1 Unidade")
                            ->numeric()
                            ->required()
                            ->live(onBlur: true),

                        Forms\Components\Select::make("weight_unit")
                            ->label("Medida")
                            ->options([
                                "g" => "Gramas (g)",
                                "kg" => "Quilos (kg)",
                            ])
                            ->default("g")
                            ->required()
                            ->live(),
                    ]),

                    Forms\Components\Placeholder::make("rendimento_calculado")
                        ->label("Rendimento")
                        ->content(function (Get $get) use ($totalGrams) {
                            $weight = (float) $get("unit_weight");
                            if ($weight <= 0) {
                                return "-";
                            }
                            $weightInGrams =
                                $get("weight_unit") === "kg"
                                    ? $weight * 1000
                                    : $weight;
                            $yield = floor($totalGrams / $weightInGrams);
                            return "{$yield} un (arredondado)";
                        }),
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (array $data, Set $set, ?Product $record) {
                if (!isset($data["unit_weight"])) {
                    return;
                }

                $totalGrams = self::calculateTotalGramsFromSheet($record);
                $weight = (float) $data["unit_weight"];

                if ($weight > 0) {
                    $weightInGrams =
                        $data["weight_unit"] === "kg"
                            ? $weight * 1000
                            : $weight;
                    $set("recipe_yield", floor($totalGrams / $weightInGrams));
                }
            });
    }

    // Helper: Verifica se a categoria é "Preparo Interno"
    private static function isManufacturedCategory($categoryId): bool
    {
        if (!$categoryId) {
            return false;
        }
        $category = Category::find($categoryId);
        return $category &&
            str_contains(strtolower($category->name), "preparo interno");
    }

    // Helper: Soma todo o peso da ficha técnica (evita código duplicado)
    private static function calculateTotalGramsFromSheet(
        ?Product $record,
    ): float {
        if (!$record) {
            return 0;
        }

        $totalGrams = 0;
        $sheetItems = \App\Models\TechnicalSheet::where(
            "parent_product_id",
            $record->id,
        )->get();

        foreach ($sheetItems as $item) {
            $child = Product::find($item->ingredient_product_id);
            if ($child) {
                $qty = (float) $item->quantity;
                $uom = strtoupper($child->unit_of_measure ?? "UN");
                if (in_array($uom, ["KG", "LT"])) {
                    $totalGrams += $qty * 1000;
                } elseif (in_array($uom, ["GR", "ML"])) {
                    $totalGrams += $qty;
                }
            }
        }
        return $totalGrams;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients;

use App\Filament\Traits\HasGlobalSearch;
use App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\Pages;
use App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\Schemas\IngredientForm;
use App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\Tables\IngredientTable;
use App\Filament\Resources\Products\RelationManagers\CostHistoriesRelationManager;
use App\Filament\Resources\Products\RelationManagers\InventoryMovementsRelationManager;
use App\Filament\Resources\Products\RelationManagers\TechnicalSheetsRelationManager;
use App\Models\Product;
use Filament\Resources\Resource;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class IngredientResource extends Resource
{
    use HasGlobalSearch;

    protected static ?string $model = Product::class;
    protected static ?string $slug = 'insumos';
    protected static string | \BackedEnum | null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-scale';
    protected static string | \UnitEnum | null $navigationGroup = 'Estoque & Compras';
    protected static ?string $modelLabel = 'Insumo / Ingrediente';
    protected static ?string $pluralModelLabel = 'Insumos';

    public static function getEloquentQuery(): Builder
{
    return parent::getEloquentQuery()
        ->whereIn('type', ['ingredient', 'manufactured', 'internal'])
        ->whereHas('category', fn($query) => $query->where('type', 'internal'));
}

    public static function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return IngredientForm::configure($schema);
    }

    public static function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return IngredientTable::configure($table);
    }

    public static function getRelations(): array
    {
        return [
            TechnicalSheetsRelationManager::class,
            CostHistoriesRelationManager::class,
            InventoryMovementsRelationManager::class, // 🚀 Extrato Kardex
        ];
    }

    public static function getPages(): array
    {
        return [
            'index' => Pages\ListIngredients::route('/'),
            'create' => Pages\CreateIngredient::route('/create'),
            'view' => Pages\ViewIngredient::route('/{record}'),
            'edit' => Pages\EditIngredient::route('/{record}/edit'),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Kitchens\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables;

// 🚀 IMPORTAÇÕES UNIFICADAS DO FILAMENT V4
use Filament\Actions;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class KitchenTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('name')->label('Cozinha')->searchable(),
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('printer.name')->label('Impressora vinculada'),
                Tables\Columns\ToggleColumn::make('is_active')->label('Ativa'),
            ])
            ->recordActions([
                // 🚀 Usando o namespace raiz unificado
                Actions\EditAction::make()->iconButton()->tooltip('Editar'),

                // 🚀 O BOTÃO MÁGICO DE ATRIBUIÇÃO EM LOTE
                Actions\Action::make('bulk_assign')
                    ->label('Vincular Categorias')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-sparkles')
                    ->color('success')
                    ->iconButton()
                    ->tooltip('Atribuir a categorias inteiras')
                    ->modalHeading(fn ($record) => "Vincular Categorias à Cozinha: {$record->name}")
                    ->modalDescription('Todos os produtos das categorias selecionadas passarão a ser preparados nesta cozinha automaticamente. (As configurações individuais anteriores serão sobrescritas).')
                    ->form([
                        Select::make('category_ids')
                            ->label('Escolha as Categorias')
                            ->options(Category::where('type', 'external')->pluck('name', 'id'))
                            ->multiple()
                            ->searchable()
                            ->preload()
                            ->required()
                    ])
                    ->action(function ($record, array $data) {
                        // Faz a injeção em massa hiper-rápida direto no banco
                        $count = Product::whereIn('category_id', $data['category_ids'])
                            ->update(['kitchen_id' => $record->id]);

                        Notification::make()
                            ->success()
                            ->title('Associação em Massa Concluída!')
                            ->body("A cozinha foi vinculada a {$count} produtos com sucesso.")
                            ->send();
                    })
            ])
            ->toolbarActions([
                Actions\BulkActionGroup::make([
                    Actions\DeleteBulkAction::make()
                ])
            ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyDailyRevenue/Pages/ManageLegacyDailyRevenues.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyDailyRevenue\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\LegacyDailyRevenue\LegacyDailyRevenueResource;
use App\Models\LegacyDailyRevenue;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\CreateAction;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\ManageRecords;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Wizard\Step;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\CheckboxList;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Get;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class ManageLegacyDailyRevenues extends ManageRecords
{
    protected static string $resource = LegacyDailyRevenueResource::class;

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            Action::make("import_v0_wizard")
                ->label("Assistente de Importação (CSV)")
                ->icon("heroicon-o-sparkles")
                ->color("primary")
                ->modalWidth("4xl")
                ->steps([
                    // =====================================
                    // PASSO 1: CONFIGURAÇÃO E PERGUNTAS
                    // =====================================
                    Step::make("1. Estrutura")
                        ->description("O que o seu ficheiro contém?")
                        ->schema([
                            Placeholder::make("info")
                                ->hiddenLabel()
                                ->content(
                                    "As colunas de Data e Valor Total são obrigatórias. Indique abaixo o que mais o seu ficheiro contém:",
                                ),
                            Toggle::make("has_payments")
                                ->label(
                                    "Tem colunas de Formas de Pagamento? (Ex: Pix, Dinheiro, Cartão)",
                                )
                                ->default(false)
                                ->live(),
                            Toggle::make("has_types")
                                ->label(
                                    "Tem colunas de Tipos de Venda? (Ex: Salão, Delivery)",
                                )
                                ->default(false)
                                ->live(),
                            Toggle::make("has_order_count")
                                ->label(
                                    "Tem uma coluna com a Quantidade de Pedidos do dia?",
                                )
                                ->default(false)
                                ->live(),
                            Toggle::make("has_expenses")
                                ->label(
                                    "Tem uma coluna de Despesas/Custos do dia?",
                                )
                                ->default(false)
                                ->live(),
                        ])
                        ->columns(2),

                    // =====================================
                    // PASSO 2: UPLOAD DO FICHEIRO
                    // =====================================
                    Step::make("2. Upload")
                        ->description("Carregue o CSV consolidado")
                        ->schema([
                            TextInput::make("import_tag")
                                ->label("Tag de Importação")
                                ->required()
                                ->default(now()->format("Y-m-d_H:i")),

                            FileUpload::make("csv_file")
                                ->label("Ficheiro CSV")
                                ->acceptedFileTypes([
                                    "text/csv",
                                    "text/plain",
                                    "application/csv",
                                ])
                                ->disk("local")
                                ->directory("csv_v0_imports")
                                ->required()
                                ->live(), // 🚀 Crucial: Faz o ficheiro ficar disponível para o Passo 3 instantaneamente
                        ]),

                    // =====================================
                    // PASSO 3: MAPEAMENTO DINÂMICO!
                    // =====================================
                    Step::make("3. Mapeamento")
                        ->description("Cruze os dados do CSV")
                        ->schema(function (Get $get) {
                            $fileState = $get("csv_file");
                            $headers = [];

                            // A Mágica: Vai ler o cabeçalho do ficheiro que acabou de ser feito o upload
                            if ($fileState) {
                                // O FileUpload pode retornar um array ou string dependendo da configuração
                                $path = is_array($fileState)
                                    ? reset($fileState)
                                    : $fileState;
                                $fullPath = Storage::disk("local")->path($path);

                                if (file_exists($fullPath)) {
                                    $handle = fopen($fullPath, "r");
                                    if ($handle) {
                                        $firstLine = fgets($handle);
                                        $delimiter =
                                            strpos($firstLine, ";") !== false
                                                ? ";"
                                                : ",";
                                        rewind($handle);
                                        $rawHeaders = fgetcsv(
                                            $handle,
                                            0,
                                            $delimiter,
                                        );
                                        if ($rawHeaders) {
                                            foreach (
                                                $rawHeaders
                                                as $index => $col
                                            ) {
                                                // O índice do CSV será a chave (value) do Select, o texto será a Label
                                                $headers[
                                                    (string) $index
                                                ] = trim($col);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        fclose($handle);
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            if (empty($headers)) {
                                return [
                                    Placeholder::make("warning")
                                        ->hiddenLabel()
                                        ->content(
                                            "⚠️ Faça o upload do ficheiro no Passo 2 para ver as opções.",
                                        ),
                                ];
                            }

                            $schema = [
                                Select::make("col_date")
                                    ->label("Coluna de Data")
                                    ->options($headers)
                                    ->required(),
                                Select::make("col_total")
                                    ->label("Coluna de Total Faturado")
                                    ->options($headers)
                                    ->required(),
                            ];

                            if ($get("has_order_count")) {
                                $schema[] = Select::make("col_order_count")
                                    ->label("Coluna de Qtd de Pedidos")
                                    ->options($headers)
                                    ->required();
                            }

                            if ($get("has_expenses")) {
                                $schema[] = Select::make("col_expenses")
                                    ->label("Coluna de Despesas")
                                    ->options($headers)
                                    ->required();
                            }

                            // Usamos CheckboxList para ele poder escolher VÁRIAS colunas que são formas de pagamento!
                            if ($get("has_payments")) {
                                $schema[] = CheckboxList::make("col_payments")
                                    ->label(
                                        "Selecione TODAS as colunas que são Formas de Pagto",
                                    )
                                    ->options($headers)
                                    ->columns(3)
                                    ->columnSpanFull();
                            }

                            if ($get("has_types")) {
                                $schema[] = CheckboxList::make("col_types")
                                    ->label(
                                        "Selecione TODAS as colunas que são Tipos de Venda",
                                    )
                                    ->options($headers)
                                    ->columns(3)
                                    ->columnSpanFull();
                            }

                            return $schema;
                        })
                        ->columns(2),
                ])
                // =====================================
                // AÇÃO DE GRAVAÇÃO (O MOTOR DA V0)
                // =====================================
                ->action(function (array $data) {
                    $path = is_array($data["csv_file"])
                        ? reset($data["csv_file"])
                        : $data["csv_file"];
                    $fullPath = Storage::disk("local")->path($path);

                    $handle = fopen($fullPath, "r");
                    $firstLine = fgets($handle);
                    $delimiter = strpos($firstLine, ";") !== false ? ";" : ",";
                    rewind($handle);

                    // Lemos o cabeçalho para poder cruzar o index numérico do CSV com o nome da coluna no JSON
                    $rawHeaders = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter);
                    $headers = [];
                    foreach ($rawHeaders as $index => $col) {
                        $headers[(string) $index] = trim($col);
                    }

                    $parseMoney = function ($value) {
                        if (empty($value)) {
                            return 0;
                        }
                        $clean = preg_replace("/[^0-9,-]/", "", $value);
                        return (float) str_replace(",", ".", $clean);
                    };

                    $count = 0;

                    // Lemos as linhas de dados
                    while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
                        $rawDate = trim($row[$data["col_date"]] ?? "");
                        if (empty($rawDate)) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        try {
                            // Converte inteligentemente datas do Brasil (d/m/Y) ou Standard (Y-m-d)
                            $date = Carbon::parse(
                                str_replace("/", "-", $rawDate),
                            )->format("Y-m-d");
                        } catch (\Exception $e) {
                            continue; // Pula a linha se a data for inválida
                        }

                        $total = $parseMoney($row[$data["col_total"]] ?? 0);

                        $orderCount = isset($data["col_order_count"])
                            ? (int) ($row[$data["col_order_count"]] ?? 0)
                            : null;
                        $expenses = isset($data["col_expenses"])
                            ? $parseMoney($row[$data["col_expenses"]] ?? 0)
                            : null;

                        // Agrupa as Formas de Pagamento Num Array JSON!
                        // O nome da chave será o nome da coluna do CSV
                        $paymentsBreakdown = [];
                        if (!empty($data["col_payments"])) {
                            foreach ($data["col_payments"] as $colIndex) {
                                $val = $parseMoney($row[$colIndex] ?? 0);
                                if ($val > 0) {
                                    $paymentsBreakdown[
                                        $headers[$colIndex]
                                    ] = $val;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // Agrupa os Tipos
                        $typesBreakdown = [];
                        if (!empty($data["col_types"])) {
                            foreach ($data["col_types"] as $colIndex) {
                                $val = $parseMoney($row[$colIndex] ?? 0);
                                if ($val > 0) {
                                    $typesBreakdown[$headers[$colIndex]] = $val;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // Grava ou Atualiza a Data
                        LegacyDailyRevenue::updateOrCreate(
                            ["date" => $date],
                            [
                                "total_revenue" => $total,
                                "order_count" => $orderCount,
                                "expenses" => $expenses,
                                "payments_breakdown" => empty(
                                    $paymentsBreakdown
                                )
                                    ? null
                                    : $paymentsBreakdown,
                                "types_breakdown" => empty($typesBreakdown)
                                    ? null
                                    : $typesBreakdown,
                                "import_tag" => trim($data["import_tag"]),
                            ],
                        );
                        $count++;
                    }
                    fclose($handle);
                    Storage::disk("local")->delete($path);

                    Notification::make()
                        ->title("Mapeamento Concluído!")
                        ->body(
                            "<b>{$count} dias</b> de faturamento consolidados importados com sucesso.",
                        )
                        ->success()
                        ->send();
                }),

            CreateAction::make()->label("Novo Faturamento"),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyOrders\Tables;


use App\Enums\OrderType;use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Actions\ViewAction;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class LegacyOrdersTable
{
    public static function build(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make("import_tag")
                    ->label("Tag Importação")
                    ->badge()
                    ->color("gray")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make("issue_date")
                    ->label("Data")
                    ->dateTime("d/m/Y H:i")
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make("order_type")
                    ->label("Tipo")
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(
                        fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                            "delivery" => "Delivery",
                            "counter" => "Balcão",
                            "table" => "Mesa",
                            default => $state,
                        },
                    ),

                // 🚀 A CORREÇÃO ESTÁ AQUI: Substituímos o array do searchable por uma Closure explícita
                TextColumn::make("customer_name")
                    ->label("Cliente")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        if ($record->customer_id) {
                            return $record->customer?->name ?? "Consumidor Final";
                        }
                        if ($record->legacy_customer_id) {
                            return $record->legacyCustomer?->legacy_name ?? "Consumidor Final";
                        }
                        return "Consumidor Final";
                    })
                    ->searchable(query: function (Builder $query, string $search): Builder {
                        // O encapsulamento num where() isola o "OR" do resto da query da tabela
                        return $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                            $q->whereHas('customer', function ($q2) use ($search) {
                                $q2->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                            })
                            ->orWhereHas('legacyCustomer', function ($q3) use ($search) {
                                $q3->where('legacy_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                            });
                        });
                    }),

                TextColumn::make("total_value")
                    ->label("Total (Itens)")
                    ->money("BRL")
                    ->sortable(),
            ])
            ->defaultSort("issue_date", "desc")
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make("order_type")
                    ->label("Tipo de Pedido")
                    ->options(OrderType::class),
            ])
            ->actions([ViewAction::make()]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyProducts/Actions/BatchResolveProductsAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyProducts\Actions;

use App\Models\LegacyProduct;
use App\Models\Product;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\CheckboxList;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class BatchResolveProductsAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return "batch_resolve";
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label("Associar Automaticamente")
            ->icon("heroicon-o-sparkles")
            ->color("primary")
            ->modalHeading("Mapeamento em Lote")
            ->modalDescription(
                "O sistema agrupou os itens pendentes por similaridade e está a aprender com as suas associações anteriores. Desmarque o que não for correspondente.",
            )
            ->modalSubmitActionLabel("Vincular Selecionados")
            ->modalWidth("2xl")
            ->form(fn() => $this->getBatchForm())
            ->action(fn(array $data) => $this->performBatchAction($data));
    }

    protected function getBatchForm(): array
    {
        $matches = $this->getNextBatchMatches();

        if (empty($matches["items"])) {
            return [
                Placeholder::make("empty")
                    ->hiddenLabel()
                    ->content(
                        new HtmlString(
                            '<div class="text-center text-gray-500 py-4">Nenhuma sugestão óbvia encontrada (abaixo de 60%).<br>Os itens restantes precisam ser resolvidos manualmente.</div>',
                        ),
                    ),
            ];
        }

        $allOfferedKeys = collect($matches["items"])
            ->map(fn($m) => $m["legacy_id"] . "|" . $m["product_id"])
            ->toArray();

        return [
            Placeholder::make("confidence_badge")
                ->hiddenLabel()
                ->content(
                    new HtmlString(
                        "<div class='text-lg font-medium text-primary-600 mb-2'>🔥 Lote de Confiança Atual: ~{$matches["confidence"]}%</div>",
                    ),
                ),

            CheckboxList::make("approved_matches")
                ->hiddenLabel()
                ->options(
                    collect($matches["items"])->mapWithKeys(function ($match) {
                        return [
                            $match["legacy_id"] . "|" . $match["product_id"] => "{$match["legacy_name"]} ➔ {$match["product_name"]}",
                        ];
                    }),
                )
                ->default($allOfferedKeys)
                ->bulkToggleable()
                ->columns(1),

            Hidden::make("all_suggested_pairs")->default(json_encode($allOfferedKeys)),
        ];
    }

    protected function performBatchAction(array $data): void
    {
        $approved = $data["approved_matches"] ?? [];
        $allSuggested = json_decode($data["all_suggested_pairs"] ?? '[]', true);

        $rejected = array_diff($allSuggested, $approved);

        // 1. SESSÃO: Salvar a "Lista Negra" na sessão atual do usuário
        if (!empty($rejected)) {
            $cachedRejects = session()->get('rejected_legacy_matches', []);
            $mergedRejects = array_unique(array_merge($cachedRejects, array_values($rejected)));
            session()->put('rejected_legacy_matches', $mergedRejects);
        }

        // 2. GRAVAÇÃO DOS APROVADOS
        $count = 0;
        foreach ($approved as $combined) {
            [$legacyId, $productId] = explode("|", $combined);
            LegacyProduct::where("id", $legacyId)->update([
                "current_product_id" => $productId,
                "is_ignored" => false,
            ]);
            $count++;
        }

        Notification::make()
            ->title("{$count} itens vinculados com sucesso!")
            ->success()
            ->send();
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 O NORMALIZADOR: Remove acentos, pontuação, espaços duplos e atira para maiúsculas.
     */
    private function normalizeText(?string $text): string
    {
        if (!$text) return '';
        $text = Str::ascii($text); // Remove acentos (Á => A)
        $text = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9\s]/', ' ', $text); // Troca símbolos por espaço
        $text = preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $text); // Mata espaços duplos
        return strtoupper(trim($text));
    }

    private function getNextBatchMatches(): array
    {
        $pendingLegacy = LegacyProduct::whereNull("current_product_id")
            ->where("is_ignored", false)
            ->get();

        if ($pendingLegacy->isEmpty()) {
            return ["confidence" => 0, "items" => []];
        }

        $products = Product::select("id", "name")
            ->whereHas('category', function ($query) {
                $query->where('type', 'external');
            })
            ->get();

        if ($products->isEmpty()) {
            return ["confidence" => 0, "items" => []];
        }

        // 🚀 A MENTE COLETIVA: Puxa o histórico de resoluções para usar como "Apelidos"
        $resolvedLegacyNames = LegacyProduct::whereNotNull("current_product_id")
            ->where("is_ignored", false)
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('current_product_id')
            ->map(function ($items) {
                return $items->pluck('name')->toArray();
            });

        $rejectedPairs = session()->get('rejected_legacy_matches', []);
        $allBestMatches = [];

        foreach ($pendingLegacy as $legacy) {
            $bestMatch = null;
            $highestSim = 0;
            $normalizedLegacyName = $this->normalizeText($legacy->name);

            foreach ($products as $product) {
                $pairKey = $legacy->id . "|" . $product->id;

                if (in_array($pairKey, $rejectedPairs)) {
                    continue;
                }

                // 1. Testa contra o nome oficial do produto novo
                $normalizedProductName = $this->normalizeText($product->name);
                similar_text($normalizedLegacyName, $normalizedProductName, $percentOfficial);
                $localMaxSim = $percentOfficial;

                // 2. 🚀 Testa contra TODOS os apelidos que você já ensinou ao sistema
                if ($resolvedLegacyNames->has($product->id)) {
                    foreach ($resolvedLegacyNames->get($product->id) as $pastName) {
                        similar_text($normalizedLegacyName, $this->normalizeText($pastName), $percentAlias);
                        if ($percentAlias > $localMaxSim) {
                            $localMaxSim = $percentAlias;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if ($localMaxSim > $highestSim) {
                    $highestSim = $localMaxSim;
                    $bestMatch = $product;
                }

                // Atalho de performance: se bateu 100% com algo, não precisa olhar mais nada para este produto!
                if ($highestSim == 100) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if ($bestMatch && $highestSim >= 60) {
                $groupSim = floor($highestSim);
                if ($groupSim % 2 !== 0) {
                    $groupSim--; // Agrupa aos pares
                }

                $allBestMatches[$groupSim][] = [
                    "legacy_id" => $legacy->id,
                    "legacy_name" => $legacy->name,
                    "product_id" => $bestMatch->id,
                    "product_name" => $bestMatch->name,
                ];
            }
        }

        if (empty($allBestMatches)) {
            return ["confidence" => 0, "items" => []];
        }

        krsort($allBestMatches);
        $highestConfidence = array_key_first($allBestMatches);

        return [
            "confidence" => $highestConfidence,
            "items" => $allBestMatches[$highestConfidence],
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/LegacyProducts/Schemas/LegacyProductForm.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\LegacyProducts\Schemas;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\LegacyProduct;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Actions;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class LegacyProductForm
{
    protected static array $suggestionsMemory = [];

    public static function build(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->components([
            Hidden::make("confirming_sugg_id")
                ->dehydrated(false)
                ->default(null),

            // 🚀 SEÇÃO 1: Nome Original (Ocupando a tela toda, limpa e direta)
            Section::make("Dados do XML (Histórico)")
                ->columnSpanFull()
                ->schema([
                    TextInput::make("name")->label("Nome Original")->disabled(),
                ]),

            // 🚀 SEÇÃO 2: Mapeamento (Ocupando a tela toda, abaixo da Seção 1)
            Section::make("Mapeamento de Produto")
                ->description(
                    "Selecione um produto, use as sugestões ou marque para ignorar. Clique em Salvar para avançar.",
                )
                ->columnSpanFull()
                ->schema([
                    Select::make("current_product_id")
                        ->label("Pesquisa Manual")
                        ->relationship("currentProduct", "name")
                        ->searchable()
                        ->preload()
                        // 🚀 CHAMA O FORMULÁRIO COMPLETO COM UMA LINHA DE CÓDIGO!
                        ->createOptionForm(
                            \App\Filament\Resources\Products\Schemas\ProductForm::getFormSchema(),
                        )
                        // E para garantir que a grade interna do Modal fique certinha com 4 colunas:
                        ->createOptionModalHeading("Criar Novo Produto")
                        ->columns(4),

                    Toggle::make("is_ignored")
                        ->label("Ignorar este item")
                        ->helperText("Marque se virou adicional ou não importa mais.",
                        )
                        ->inline(false),

                    Actions::make([
                        self::buildSuggestionButton(1),
                        self::buildSuggestionButton(2),
                        self::buildSuggestionButton(3),
                    ])->columnSpanFull(),
                ]),
        ]);
    }

    private static function getSuggestions($record)
    {
        if (!$record || $record->current_product_id || $record->is_ignored) {
            return collect();
        }

        $key = $record->id;
        if (isset(self::$suggestionsMemory[$key])) {
            return self::$suggestionsMemory[$key];
        }

        $legacyName = strtoupper($record->name);

        $suggestions = Product::query()
            ->select("id", "name")
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($item) use ($legacyName) {
                similar_text($legacyName, strtoupper($item->name), $percent);
                $item->similarity = $percent;
                return $item;
            })
            ->filter(fn($item) => $item->similarity >= 65)
            ->sortByDesc("similarity")
            ->values()
            ->take(3);

        self::$suggestionsMemory[$key] = $suggestions;
        return $suggestions;
    }

    private static function buildSuggestionButton(int $index): Action
    {
        $arrayIndex = $index - 1;

        return Action::make("suggestion_btn_{$index}")
            ->button()
            ->hidden(function ($record) use ($arrayIndex) {
                if (
                    !$record ||
                    $record->current_product_id ||
                    $record->is_ignored
                ) {
                    return true;
                }
                return !isset(self::getSuggestions($record)[$arrayIndex]);
            })
            ->outlined(
                fn($get, $record) => $get("confirming_sugg_id") !==
                    (self::getSuggestions($record)[$arrayIndex]->id ?? null),
            )
            ->icon(function ($get, $record) use ($arrayIndex) {
                $sugg = self::getSuggestions($record)[$arrayIndex] ?? null;
                if (!$sugg) {
                    return "heroicon-m-check-circle";
                }
                return $get("confirming_sugg_id") === $sugg->id
                    ? "heroicon-m-check-badge"
                    : "heroicon-m-check-circle";
            })
            ->color(function ($get, $record) use ($arrayIndex) {
                $sugg = self::getSuggestions($record)[$arrayIndex] ?? null;
                if (!$sugg) {
                    return "info";
                }
                if ($get("confirming_sugg_id") === $sugg->id) {
                    return "success";
                }
                return $sugg->similarity >= 90 ? "success" : "info";
            })
            ->label(function ($get, $record) use ($arrayIndex) {
                $sugg = self::getSuggestions($record)[$arrayIndex] ?? null;
                if (!$sugg) {
                    return "";
                }
                if ($get("confirming_sugg_id") === $sugg->id) {
                    return "CONFIRMAR: {$sugg->name}";
                }
                return "{$sugg->name} (" . round($sugg->similarity) . "%)";
            })
            ->action(function ($get, $set, $record) use ($arrayIndex) {
                $sugg = self::getSuggestions($record)[$arrayIndex] ?? null;
                if (!$sugg) {
                    return;
                }

                if ($get("confirming_sugg_id") !== $sugg->id) {
                    $set("confirming_sugg_id", $sugg->id);
                    return;
                }

                $record->update([
                    "current_product_id" => $sugg->id,
                    "is_ignored" => false,
                ]);

                $set("confirming_sugg_id", null);
                return self::goToNextRecord($record);
            });
    }

    public static function goToNextRecord($record)
    {
        Notification::make()->title("Salvo!")->success()->send();

        $referer = request()->header("Referer");
        if (!$referer) {
            return redirect("/admin/legacy-products");
        }

        $urlParts = parse_url($referer);
        $baseUrl =
            ($urlParts["scheme"] ?? "https") .
            "://" .
            ($urlParts["host"] ?? "") .
            (isset($urlParts["port"]) ? ":" . $urlParts["port"] : "") .
            ($urlParts["path"] ?? "");
        parse_str($urlParts["query"] ?? "", $queryParams);

        $next = LegacyProduct::query()
            ->whereNull("current_product_id")
            ->where("is_ignored", false)
            ->where("id", "!=", $record->id)
            ->first();

        if ($next) {
            $queryParams["tableAction"] = "edit";
            $queryParams["tableActionRecord"] = $next->id;
        } else {
            unset(
                $queryParams["tableAction"],
                $queryParams["tableActionRecord"],
            );
            Notification::make()
                ->title("Fim da Fila!")
                ->body("Todos os produtos foram resolvidos.")
                ->success()
                ->send();
        }

        return redirect(
            $baseUrl .
                (count($queryParams) > 0
                    ? "?" . http_build_query($queryParams)
                    : ""),
        );
    }
}
```

```php
    protected static string|\BackedEnum|null $navigationIcon = "heroicon-o-archive-box";

    protected static ?int $navigationSort = 2;

    public static function getNavigationBadge(): ?string
    {
        try {
            $count = static::getModel()
                ::whereNull("current_product_id")
                ->where("is_ignored", false)
                ->count();

            return $count > 0 ? (string) $count : null;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
```

```php
        $qty = (float) ($baseGet("quantity") ?? 1);

                ((float) ($mod["price"] ?? 0)) *
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\Orders\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\ActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

class OrderTable {
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table {
        return $table->columns([
            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('id')->label('Pedido #')->sortable()->searchable(),

            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('customer_name')->label('Cliente / Mesa')
                ->state(function ($record) {
                    if ($record->customer) return $record->customer->name;
                    if ($record->customer_name) return $record->customer_name;
                    if ($record->table_number) return 'Mesa: ' . $record->table_number;
                    return 'Não Identificado';
                })
                ->searchable(),

            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('type')->label('Modalidade')->badge()
                ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                    'delivery' => 'Delivery',
                    'counter' => 'Balcão',
                    'pickup' => 'Retirada',
                    'table' => 'Mesa',
                    default => $state
                })
                ->colors([
                    'info' => 'delivery',
                    'warning' => 'counter',
                    'success' => 'pickup',
                    'gray' => 'table'
                ]),

            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('total')->label('Total')->money('BRL')->sortable(),

            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('status')->label('Status')->badge()
                ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                    'pending' => 'Pendente',
                    'preparing' => 'Preparando',
                    'ready' => 'Pronto',
                    'out_for_delivery' => 'Em Entrega',
                    'closed' => 'Concluído',
                    'cancelled' => 'Cancelado',
                    default => $state
                })
                ->colors([
                    'warning' => 'pending',
                    'info' => 'preparing',
                    'success' => fn ($state) => in_array($state, ['ready', 'closed']),
                    'danger' => 'cancelled',
                    'primary' => 'out_for_delivery',
                ]),

            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('payment_status')->label('Pagamento')->badge()
                ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                    'paid' => 'Pago',
                    'partial' => 'Parcial',
                    'pending' => 'Pendente',
                    'cancelled' => 'Cancelado',
                    default => $state
                })
                ->colors([
                    'success' => 'paid',
                    'warning' => fn ($state) => in_array($state, ['pending', 'partial']),
                    'danger' => 'cancelled'
                ]),

            Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('created_at')->label('Data')->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')->sortable(),
        ])->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc')
        ->actions([
            EditAction::make()->iconButton(),

            // ==========================================
            // 🚀 BOTÕES FISCAIS (Ajustado com Danfce para Bobinas Térmicas)
            // ==========================================
            ActionGroup::make([
                // 1. Download Nativo do XML
                Action::make('download_xml')
                    ->label('Baixar XML')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-code-bracket')
                    ->color('info')
                    ->action(function ($record) {
                        $doc = $record->fiscalDocument;
                        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($doc) {
                            echo $doc->xml_content;
                        }, "{$doc->access_key}.xml");
                    }),

                // 2. Visualização do DANFE NFC-e usando Danfce 🚀
                Action::make('view_danfe')
                    ->label('Ver Cupom (DANFE)')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-document-text')
                    ->color('gray')
                    ->modalHeading(fn ($record) => "NFC-e Autorizada - Pedido #{$record->id}")
                    ->modalWidth('2xl') // Reduzido de 7xl para 2xl pois cupom térmico é estreito e fica lindo compacto!
                    ->modalSubmitAction(false)
                    ->modalCancelActionLabel('Fechar')
                    ->modalContent(function ($record) {
                        try {
                            // 🚀 CORREÇÃO DEFINITIVA: Instancia a classe Danfce para o Modelo 65
                            $danfce = new \NFePHP\DA\NFe\Danfce($record->fiscalDocument->xml_content);
                            $danfce->creditsIntegratorFooter("Gerado por Brasume ERP");
                            $pdf = $danfce->render();
                            $base64 = base64_encode($pdf);
                            return new HtmlString("<iframe src='data:application/pdf;base64,{$base64}#toolbar=0' width='100%' height='650px' style='border: none; border-radius: 8px;'></iframe>");
                        } catch (\Exception $e) {
                            return new HtmlString("<div class='p-4 text-red-500'>Erro ao gerar PDF do Cupom: {$e->getMessage()}</div>");
                        }
                    }),
            ])
            ->label('Fiscal')
            ->icon('heroicon-m-document-check')
            ->color('gray')
            ->tooltip('Ações Fiscais (NFC-e)')
            ->visible(fn ($record) => $record->fiscalDocument && filled($record->fiscalDocument->xml_content)),

            // ==========================================
            // BOTÃO DA INTELIGÊNCIA DE EXPEDIÇÃO
            // ==========================================
            Action::make('despachar')
                ->label('Despachar')
                ->icon('heroicon-m-truck')
                ->color('success')
                ->hidden(fn ($record) => in_array($record->status, ['out_for_delivery', 'closed', 'cancelled']) || in_array($record->type, ['table', 'counter']))
                ->fillForm(function ($record): array {
                    $totalPoints = 0;

                    if ($record->items) {
                        foreach ($record->items as $item) {
                            $pontosDoProduto = $item->product->packaging_points ?? 0;
                            $totalPoints += ($pontosDoProduto * $item->quantity);
                        }
                    }

                    $sacolaIdeal = Product::whereIn('type', ['packaging', 'supply'])
                        ->where('packaging_points', '>=', $totalPoints)
                        ->where('packaging_points', '>', 0)
                        ->orderBy('packaging_points', 'asc')
                        ->first();

                    return [
                        'packaging_product_id' => $sacolaIdeal ? $sacolaIdeal->id : null,
                        'packaging_qty' => $sacolaIdeal ? 1 : 0,
                    ];
                })
                ->form([
                    Select::make('packaging_product_id')
                        ->label('Embalagem Sugerida')
                        ->options(Product::whereIn('type', ['packaging', 'supply'])->pluck('name', 'id'))
                        ->searchable()
                        ->required()
                        ->helperText('O sistema calculou o volume deste pedido e sugeriu a embalagem ideal.'),

                    TextInput::make('packaging_qty')
                        ->label('Quantidade Utilizada')
                        ->numeric()
                        ->default(1)
                        ->required(),
                ])
                ->modalSubmitActionLabel('Confirmar Expedição')
                ->action(function (array $data, $record): void {
                    $sacola = Product::find($data['packaging_product_id']);

                    if ($sacola && $sacola->track_inventory) {
                        $sacola->current_stock -= $data['packaging_qty'];
                        $sacola->save();
                    }

                    $record->status = 'out_for_delivery';
                    $record->save();

                    Notification::make()
                        ->title('Pedido Despachado!')
                        ->body('Estoque de embalagem baixado e pedido a caminho.')
                        ->success()
                        ->send();
                }),
        ])
        ->bulkActions([
            BulkActionGroup::make([
                DeleteBulkAction::make(),
            ]),
        ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/ProductModifiers/Pages/EditModifierGroup.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\ProductModifiers\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\ProductModifiers\ProductModifierResource;
use Filament\Actions;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\EditRecord;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Product;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class EditModifierGroup extends EditRecord
{
    use \App\Filament\Traits\RedirectsToIndex;

    protected static string $resource = ProductModifierResource::class;

    protected function getHeaderActions(): array
    {
        return [
            // 🚀 O BOTÃO DE BULK ASSIGNMENT AGORA TOTALMENTE ELOQUENT!
            Actions\Action::make('bulk_assign')
                ->label('Vincular a Categorias')
                ->icon('heroicon-o-sparkles')
                ->color('success')
                ->modalHeading('Vincular a todos os produtos de categorias selecionadas')
                ->modalDescription('Isto fará com que este grupo de modificadores seja atrelado individualmente a todos os produtos das categorias que você selecionar abaixo.')
                ->form([
                    Select::make('category_ids')
                        ->label('Escolha as Categorias')
                        ->options(Category::where('type', 'external')->pluck('name', 'id'))
                        ->multiple()
                        ->searchable()
                        ->preload()
                        ->required()
                ])
                ->action(function (array $data) {
                    // 1. Busca os IDs de todos os produtos pertencentes às categorias escolhidas
                    $productIds = Product::whereIn('category_id', $data['category_ids'])->pluck('id')->toArray();

                    if (empty($productIds)) {
                        Notification::make()
                            ->warning()
                            ->title('Nenhum produto afetado')
                            ->body('As categorias selecionadas não possuem produtos cadastrados no momento.')
                            ->send();
                        return;
                    }

                    // 2. Prepara a carga de dados padrão da tabela Pivot (campo excluded_options vazio)
                    $pivotData = [];
                    foreach ($productIds as $pid) {
                        $pivotData[$pid] = ['excluded_options' => json_encode([])];
                    }

                    // 🚀 3. A MÁGICA REATIVA DO ELOQUENT:
                    // Vincula em lote ignorando quem já estava associado (preserva customizações locais).
                    // O método retorna um array discriminando o que foi feito.
                    $syncResult = $this->getRecord()->products()->syncWithoutDetaching($pivotData);

                    // Descobre quantos produtos ganharam o vínculo inédito nesta ação
                    $count = count($syncResult['attached'] ?? []);

                    Notification::make()
                        ->success()
                        ->title('Associação em Massa Concluída!')
                        ->body("O grupo foi vinculado a {$count} novos produtos com sucesso.")
                        ->send();
                }),

            Actions\DeleteAction::make(),
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/ProductModifiers/RelationManagers/OptionsRelationManager.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\ProductModifiers\RelationManagers;

use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Forms\Components as FormComponents;
use Filament\Resources\RelationManagers\RelationManager;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Actions;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\Schemas\IngredientForm;

class OptionsRelationManager extends RelationManager
{
    protected static string $relationship = "options";
    protected static ?string $title = "Opções";

    public function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->schema([
            FormComponents\TextInput::make("name")
                ->label("Nome da Opção")
                ->required()
                ->maxLength(255),

            FormComponents\TextInput::make("price")
                ->label('Preço Adicional (R$)')
                ->numeric()
                ->default(0)
                ->required(),

            // 🚀 NOSSA NOVA INJEÇÃO AQUI: A QUANTIDADE MÁXIMA
            FormComponents\TextInput::make("max_quantity")
                ->label("Qtd. Máxima")
                ->numeric()
                ->default(1)
                ->helperText("Limite por pedido.")
                ->required(),

            FormComponents\Select::make("linked_product_id")
                ->label("Abater Estoque de Qual Insumo? (Opcional)")
                ->relationship(
                    name: "linkedProduct",
                    titleAttribute: "name",
                    modifyQueryUsing: fn(Builder $query) => $query->whereIn(
                        "type",
                        ["ingredient", "manufactured"],
                    ),
                )
                ->searchable()
                ->preload()
                ->live()
                ->createOptionForm(IngredientForm::getFormSchema())
                ->createOptionAction(function (Actions\Action $action) {
                    return $action
                        ->modalHeading("Cadastrar Novo Insumo")
                        ->modalSubmitActionLabel("Salvar e Selecionar")
                        ->modalWidth("4xl");
                }),

            FormComponents\TextInput::make("linked_qty")
                ->label("Quantidade da Porção")
                ->numeric()
                ->step("0.0001")
                ->hidden(fn(Get $get) => blank($get("linked_product_id")))
                ->suffix(function (Get $get) {
                    $productId = $get("linked_product_id");
                    if (blank($productId)) {
                        return null;
                    }

                    $product = \App\Models\Product::find($productId);
                    return $product
                        ? strtoupper($product->unit_of_measure)
                        : null;
                }),

            FormComponents\TextInput::make("sort_order")
                ->label("Ordem")
                ->numeric()
                ->default(0),

            FormComponents\Toggle::make("is_active")
                ->label("Ativo?")
                ->default(true)
                ->inline(false),
        ]);
    }

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->recordTitleAttribute("name")
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("sort_order")
                    ->label("Ordem")
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("name")
                    ->label("Nome da Opção")
                    ->searchable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("price")
                    ->label("Preço Venda")
                    ->money("BRL")
                    ->sortable()
                    ->color("primary"),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("max_quantity")
                    ->label("Máximo")
                    ->badge()
                    ->color("info")
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn ($state) => $state . "x"),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("linkedProduct.name")
                    ->label("Insumo")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->placeholder("-"),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("linked_qty")
                    ->label("Porção")
                    ->formatStateUsing(function ($state, $record) {
                        if (blank($state) || !$record->linked_product_id) {
                            return "-";
                        }

                        $val = (float) $state;
                        $formatted = rtrim(
                            rtrim(number_format($val, 4, ",", "."), "0"),
                            ",",
                        );
                        if ($formatted === "") {
                            $formatted = "0";
                        }

                        return $formatted .
                            " " .
                            strtoupper(
                                $record->linkedProduct->unit_of_measure ?? "",
                            );
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("cost")
                    ->label("Custo da Porção")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        if (
                            !$record->linked_product_id ||
                            blank($record->linked_qty)
                        ) {
                            return null;
                        }

                        $unitCost = \App\Services\Catalog\ProductCostingService::calculateBaseCost(
                            $record->linkedProduct,
                        );

                        $portionCost = $unitCost * (float) $record->linked_qty;

                        return $portionCost;
                    })
                    ->money("BRL")
                    ->placeholder("-")
                    ->color("warning"),

                Tables\Columns\ToggleColumn::make("is_active")->label("Ativa"),
            ])
            ->defaultSort("sort_order")
            ->headerActions([Actions\CreateAction::make()])
            ->recordActions([
```
