## File: app/Filament/Resources/ProductModifiers/Tables/ProductModifierTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\ProductModifiers\Tables;

use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Actions;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Category;

class ProductModifierTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->defaultSort('name', 'asc')
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Nome')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'ingredient' => 'Ingrediente',
                        'add_on' => 'Adicional',
                        'observation' => 'Observação',
                        default => ucfirst($state),
                    })
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'ingredient' => 'info',
                        'add_on' => 'success',
                        'observation' => 'warning',
                        default => 'gray',
                    })
                    ->sortable(),

                // 🚀 RADAR 1: Quantidade de Categorias Únicas Atingidas
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('categories_count')
                    ->label('Categorias')
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $productIds = DB::table('modifier_group_product')
                            ->where('modifier_group_id', $record->id)
                            ->pluck('product_id');

                        if ($productIds->isEmpty()) {
                            return 0;
                        }

                        return Product::whereIn('id', $productIds)
                            ->whereNotNull('category_id')
                            ->distinct('category_id')
                            ->count('category_id');
                    })
                    ->badge()
                    ->color('gray')
                    ->sortable(query: function (Builder $query, string $direction): Builder {
                        return $query->orderBy(
                            DB::table('modifier_group_product')
                                ->join('products', 'products.id', '=', 'modifier_group_product.product_id')
                                ->whereColumn('modifier_group_product.modifier_group_id', 'modifier_groups.id')
                                ->whereNotNull('products.category_id')
                                ->selectRaw('count(distinct products.category_id)'),
                            $direction
                        );
                    }),

                // 🚀 RADAR 2: Total de Produtos
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('products_count')
                    ->counts('products')
                    ->label('Produtos')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color('primary')
                    ->sortable(),

                // 🚀 RADAR 3: Itens com is_active = false dentro deste grupo
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('inactive_options_count')
                    ->label('Inativos')
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        return DB::table('modifier_options')
                            ->where('modifier_group_id', $record->id)
                            ->where('is_active', false)
                            ->count();
                    })
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn ($state) => (int) $state > 0 ? 'danger' : 'gray')
                    ->sortable(query: function (Builder $query, string $direction): Builder {
                        return $query->orderBy(
                            DB::table('modifier_options')
                                ->whereColumn('modifier_options.modifier_group_id', 'modifier_groups.id')
                                ->where('modifier_options.is_active', false)
                                ->selectRaw('count(*)'),
                            $direction
                        );
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\ToggleColumn::make('is_active')
                    ->label('Ativo')
                    ->sortable(),
            ])
            ->filters([
                // 1. Filtro por Tipo de Modificador
                Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    ->options([
                        'ingredient' => 'Ingrediente',
                        'add_on' => 'Adicional',
                        'observation' => 'Observação',
                    ])
                    ->multiple(),

                // 2. Filtro por Status (Ativo por padrão)
                Tables\Filters\TernaryFilter::make('is_active')
                    ->label('Status do Grupo')
                    ->trueLabel('Apenas Ativos')
                    ->falseLabel('Apenas Inativos')
                    ->default(true),

                // 3. Filtro por Categoria de Produtos Vinculados
                Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make('category_id')
                    ->label('Categoria do Cardápio')
                    ->options(fn () => Category::where('type', 'external')->pluck('name', 'id'))
                    ->query(function (Builder $query, array $data): Builder {
                        if (empty($data['value'])) {
                            return $query;
                        }

                        return $query->whereExists(function ($sub) use ($data) {
                            $sub->select(DB::raw(1))
                                ->from('modifier_group_product')
                                ->join('products', 'products.id', '=', 'modifier_group_product.product_id')
                                ->whereColumn('modifier_group_product.modifier_group_id', 'modifier_groups.id')
                                ->where('products.category_id', $data['value']);
                        });
                    })
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload(),

                // 4. Atalho: Grupos que possuem opções desativadas
                Tables\Filters\Filter::make('has_inactive_options')
                    ->label('Com opções inativas')
                    ->toggle()
                    ->query(fn (Builder $query) => $query->whereHas('options', fn ($q) => $q->where('is_active', false))),

                // 5. Atalho: Grupos órfãos (sem nenhum produto vinculado)
                Tables\Filters\Filter::make('unlinked')
                    ->label('Sem produtos vinculados')
                    ->toggle()
                    ->query(fn (Builder $query) => $query->whereDoesntHave('products')),
            ])
            ->recordActions([
                Actions\EditAction::make()->iconButton(),
            ])
            ->toolbarActions([
                Actions\BulkActionGroup::make([
                    Actions\DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Products/Actions/SmartMergeAction.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Products\Actions;

use App\Models\Product;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Hidden;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Placeholder;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Radio;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class SmartMergeAction extends Action
{
    public string $categoryType = 'external';

    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'smart_merge';
    }

    public function categoryType(string $type): static
    {
        $this->categoryType = $type;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * Normaliza nomes para agrupamento por proximidade:
     * - Converte para minúsculas e remove acentos
     * - Remove ruídos como 'polpa'
     * - Unifica unidades de medida (1,5 l -> 1.5l)
     * - Remove espaços extras e caracteres especiais
     */
    public static function normalizeName(string $name): string
    {
        $str = mb_strtolower($name, 'UTF-8');
        $str = Str::ascii($str);

        // Remove termos ruído comuns em cardápios
        $str = preg_replace('/\bpolpa\b/i', '', $str);

        // Padroniza volumes e medidas (ex: '1,5 l', '1,5L', '1.5 l' -> '1.5l')
        $str = preg_replace('/(\d+)[,\.](\d+)\s*(l|ml|kg|g)\b/i', '$1.$2$3', $str);
        $str = preg_replace('/(\d+)\s*(l|ml|kg|g)\b/i', '$1$2', $str);

        // Remove pontuação e caracteres não alfanuméricos
        $str = preg_replace('/[^\w\s\.]/', ' ', $str);

        return trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $str));
    }

    /**
     * Busca produtos da macro-área incluindo produtos sem categoria
     */
    protected function getScopedProducts(): Collection
    {
        return Product::query()
            ->where(function ($query) {
                $query->whereNull('category_id')
                    ->orWhereHas('category', fn ($q) => $q->where('type', $this->categoryType));
            })
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * Agrupa duplicados por proximidade textual
     */
    protected function getDuplicateGroups(): Collection
    {
        return $this->getScopedProducts()
            ->groupBy(fn (Product $product) => self::normalizeName($product->name))
            ->filter(fn (Collection $group) => $group->count() > 1);
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('Limpar Base')
            ->icon('heroicon-o-sparkles')
            ->color('warning')
            ->badge(function () {
                $count = $this->getDuplicateGroups()->count();
                return $count > 0 ? $count : null;
            })
            ->badgeColor('danger')
            ->modalHeading(fn () => match($this->categoryType) {
                'internal' => 'Inteligência de Mesclagem de Insumos',
                'supply'   => 'Inteligência de Mesclagem de Materiais',
                default    => 'Inteligência de Mesclagem de Produtos',
            })
            ->modalDescription('O sistema agrupou itens com nomes idênticos ou aproximados (ex: variações com e sem "Polpa", caixa alta/baixa ou sem categoria).')
            ->modalSubmitActionLabel('Mesclar e Avançar')
            ->modalWidth('3xl')
            ->form(function () {
                $duplicateGroups = $this->getDuplicateGroups();
                $duplicates = $duplicateGroups->first();

                $itemLabel = match($this->categoryType) {
                    'internal' => 'Insumo',
                    'supply'   => 'Material de Consumo',
                    default    => 'Produto'
                };

                if (! $duplicates) {
                    return [
                        Placeholder::make('empty')
                            ->hiddenLabel()
                            ->content(new HtmlString("<div class='text-center text-gray-500 py-4'>🎉 Parabéns! Nenhum(a) {$itemLabel} duplicado(a) foi encontrado(a) na base.</div>")),
                    ];
                }

                // Cálculo de relevância para sugerir o melhor candidato
                foreach ($duplicates as $dup) {
                    $score = 0;

                    if ($dup->status === 'active' || $dup->status === 'available') $score += 10;
                    if ($dup->image_path) $score += 10;
                    if ($dup->category_id) $score += 10; // Prefere itens já categorizados
                    if ((float) $dup->current_stock > 0) $score += 15;
                    if ((float) $dup->base_cost > 0) $score += 10;

                    try { $score += $dup->costHistories()->count() * 20; } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
                    try { $score += $dup->technicalSheets()->count() * 20; } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
                    try { $score += $dup->modifiers()->count() * 15; } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

                    $dup->smart_score = $score;
                }

                $duplicates = $duplicates->sortByDesc('smart_score')->values();
                $bestCandidate = $duplicates->first();

                $options = [];
                $descriptions = [];

                foreach ($duplicates as $dup) {
                    $options[$dup->id] = "ID #{$dup->id} - {$dup->name}";

                    $isRecommended = ($dup->id === $bestCandidate->id)
                        ? '<span class="ml-2 inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-medium bg-success-100 text-success-800 dark:bg-success-800 dark:text-success-100">Recomendado pelo Sistema 💡</span>'
                        : '';

                    $categoryLabel = $dup->category?->name ?? '⚠️ Sem Categoria';
                    $price = number_format((float) ($dup->dine_in_price ?? $dup->base_cost), 2, ',', '.');
                    $stock = (float) $dup->current_stock;
                    $status = in_array($dup->status, ['active', 'available']) ? 'Ativo' : 'Inativo';

                    $descriptions[$dup->id] = new HtmlString("
                        <div class='mt-1 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700'>
                            <div class='grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 mb-2'>
                                <span><strong>Categoria:</strong> {$categoryLabel}</span>
                                <span><strong>Valor:</strong> R$ {$price}</span>
                                <span><strong>Estoque:</strong> {$stock}</span>
                                <span><strong>Status:</strong> {$status}</span>
                            </div>
                            <span class='text-xs text-gray-400'>Pontuação de Relevância: <b>{$dup->smart_score} pontos</b></span>
                            {$isRecommended}
                        </div>
                    ");
                }

                $namesComparison = $duplicates->pluck('name')->unique()->implode(' <span class="text-amber-500 font-bold px-1">vs</span> ');

                return [
                    Hidden::make('group_ids')
                        ->default($duplicates->pluck('id')->values()->toArray()),

                    Placeholder::make('target')
                        ->hiddenLabel()
                        ->content(new HtmlString("
                            <div class='text-lg font-semibold text-primary-600 mb-1'>Conflito Identificado:</div>
                            <div class='p-3 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-lg text-sm text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 mb-3'>
                                {$namesComparison}
                            </div>
                            <p class='text-sm text-gray-500'>Selecione qual registro deve ser mantido como o oficial. Os demais serão removidos e seus históricos (pedidos, fichas técnicas e custos) transferidos.</p>
                        ")),

                    Radio::make('master_id')
                        ->hiddenLabel()
                        ->options($options)
                        ->descriptions($descriptions)
                        ->default($bestCandidate->id)
                        ->required(),
                ];
            })
            ->action(function (array $data) {
                $masterId = $data['master_id'] ?? null;
                $groupIds = $data['group_ids'] ?? [];

                if (! $masterId || empty($groupIds)) {
                    return;
                }

                $master = Product::find($masterId);
                if (! $master) {
                    return;
                }

                $losers = Product::whereIn('id', $groupIds)
                    ->where('id', '!=', $masterId)
                    ->get();

                // Herança inteligente: se o mestre estiver sem categoria ou imagem, absorve do item que tiver
                if (empty($master->category_id)) {
                    $donorCategory = $losers->firstWhere('category_id', '!==', null);
                    if ($donorCategory) {
                        $master->update(['category_id' => $donorCategory->category_id]);
                    }
                }

                if (empty($master->image_path)) {
                    $donorImage = $losers->firstWhere('image_path', '!==', null);
                    if ($donorImage) {
                        $master->update(['image_path' => $donorImage->image_path]);
                    }
                }

                // Transfere vínculos relacionais
                foreach ($losers as $loser) {
                    DB::table('technical_sheets')->where('parent_product_id', $loser->id)->update(['parent_product_id' => $masterId]);
                    DB::table('technical_sheets')->where('ingredient_product_id', $loser->id)->update(['ingredient_product_id' => $masterId]);

                    DB::table('product_cost_histories')->where('product_id', $loser->id)->update(['product_id' => $masterId]);
                    DB::table('product_modifier')->where('product_id', $loser->id)->update(['product_id' => $masterId]);
                    DB::table('modifier_options')->where('linked_product_id', $loser->id)->update(['linked_product_id' => $masterId]);
                    DB::table('combo_groups')->where('product_id', $loser->id)->update(['product_id' => $masterId]);
                    DB::table('combo_items')->where('product_id', $loser->id)->update(['product_id' => $masterId]);
                    DB::table('offers')->where('trigger_product_id', $loser->id)->update(['trigger_product_id' => $masterId]);
                    DB::table('legacy_products')->where('current_product_id', $loser->id)->update(['current_product_id' => $masterId]);

                    if (Schema::hasTable('order_items')) {
                        DB::table('order_items')->where('product_id', $loser->id)->update(['product_id' => $masterId]);
                    }

                    $loser->delete();
                }

                Notification::make()
                    ->title("Produtos mesclados com sucesso!")
                    ->success()
                    ->send();
            })
            ->after(function ($livewire) {
                if ($this->getDuplicateGroups()->isNotEmpty()) {
                    $livewire->mountAction('smart_merge');
                } else {
                    $livewire->dispatch('$refresh');
                }
            });
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Products/RelationManagers/CostHistoriesRelationManager.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Products\RelationManagers;

use Filament\Forms;
use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Resources\RelationManagers\RelationManager;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Services\Catalog\InventoryService;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;

class CostHistoriesRelationManager extends RelationManager
{
    protected static string $relationship = "costHistories";
    protected static ?string $title = "Histórico de Compras";

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->recordTitleAttribute("nfe_key")
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("data_compra")
                    ->label("Data")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $invoice = ReceivedInvoice::where("nfe_key", $record->nfe_key)->first();
                        $dataCompra = $invoice ? $invoice->issue_date : null;
                        return $dataCompra ? Carbon::parse($dataCompra)->format("d/m/Y") : "Desconhecida";
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("supplier.name")
                    ->label("Fornecedor")
                    ->state(fn ($record) => $record->supplier?->name ?? "Desconhecido / Avulso")
                    ->searchable(["supplier.name", "supplier.document_name"])
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("xml_name")
                    ->label("Produto")
                    ->limit(35)
                    ->tooltip(fn($state) => $state),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("quantity")
                    ->label("Qtd.")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $factor = $record->conversion_factor ?: 1;
                        $originalQty = (float) ($record->quantity / $factor);
                        $uom = strtolower($record->original_unit_of_measure ?? "un");
                        $formattedQty = $originalQty == floor($originalQty)
                            ? number_format($originalQty, 0, ",", ".")
                            : number_format($originalQty, 2, ",", ".");
                        return "{$formattedQty} {$uom}";
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("unit_cost")
                    ->label("Custo")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $cost = $record->original_unit_cost ?? ($record->unit_cost * ($record->conversion_factor ?: 1));
                        $uom = $record->original_unit_of_measure ?? "un";
                        return 'R$ ' . number_format((float) $cost, 2, ",", ".") . " /" . strtolower($uom);
                    })
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("internal_cost")
                    ->label("Custo Unit.")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $cost = $record->unit_cost;
                        $uom = $record->product?->unit_of_measure ?? "un";
                        return 'R$ ' . number_format((float) $cost, 2, ",", ".") . " /" . strtolower($uom);
                    }),
            ])
            ->headerActions([
                Action::make("addManualPurchase")
                    ->label("Adicionar Compra Manual")
                    ->icon("heroicon-o-plus-circle")
                    ->color("primary")
                    ->modalHeading("Registar Compra Avulsa")
                    ->form([
                        Grid::make(2)->schema([
                            DatePicker::make("purchase_date")->label("Data")->default(now())->required(),
                            Select::make("supplier_id")
                                ->label("Fornecedor (Opcional)")
                                ->options(fn() => Supplier::where('is_active', true)->pluck("name", "id"))
                                ->searchable(),
                        ]),
                        Grid::make(2)->schema([
                            TextInput::make("quantity")->label("Qtd.")->numeric()->required()
                                ->suffix(fn($livewire) => $livewire->getOwnerRecord()->unit_of_measure ?? "UN"),
                            TextInput::make("unit_cost")->label("Custo Unitário")->numeric()->prefix('R$')->required(),
                        ]),
                        Grid::make(2)->schema([
                            Toggle::make("update_stock")->label("Dar entrada no estoque?")->default(true),
                            Toggle::make("update_cost")->label("Atualizar custo base?")->default(true),
                        ])
                    ])
                    ->action(function (array $data, $livewire) {
                        $product = $livewire->getOwnerRecord();
                        $dateStr = Carbon::parse($data["purchase_date"])->format("Ymd");
                        $timeStr = now()->format("His");
                        $fakeNfeKey = "MANUAL-{$dateStr}-{$timeStr}";

                        $supplierName = $data["supplier_id"]
                            ? Supplier::find($data["supplier_id"])->name
                            : "Compra Manual / Avulsa";

                        ReceivedInvoice::create([
                            "nfe_key"      => $fakeNfeKey,
                            "emitter_name" => $supplierName,
                            "emitter_cnpj" => "00000000000000",
                            "total_value"  => $data["quantity"] * $data["unit_cost"],
                            "issue_date"   => Carbon::parse($data["purchase_date"]),
                            "status"       => "processed",
                        ]);

                        $product->costHistories()->create([
                            "supplier_id"              => $data["supplier_id"] ?? null,
                            "nfe_key"                  => $fakeNfeKey,
                            "xml_name"                 => $product->name . " (Lançamento Manual)",
                            "quantity"                 => $data["quantity"],
                            "conversion_factor"        => 1,
                            "unit_cost"                => $data["unit_cost"],
                            "original_quantity"        => $data["quantity"],
                            "original_unit_of_measure" => $product->unit_of_measure,
                            "original_unit_cost"       => $data["unit_cost"],
                        ]);

                        if ($data["update_cost"]) {
                            $product->update(['base_cost' => $data["unit_cost"]]);
                        }

                        // 🚀 ENTRADA COM CASCATA E WEBSOCKET VIA INVENTORY SERVICE
                        if ($data["update_stock"]) {
                            app(InventoryService::class)->addStock($product, (float) $data["quantity"], 'compra_manual');
                        }

                        Notification::make()
                            ->title("Compra manual registrada!")
                            ->body("Estoque adicionado e cardápio sincronizado em tempo real.")
                            ->success()
                            ->send();
                    }),
            ])
            ->defaultSort("created_at", "desc");
    }

    public static function canViewForRecord($ownerRecord, $pageClass): bool
    {
        return !in_array($ownerRecord->type, ["dish", "combo"]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Products/RelationManagers/ProductModifiersRelationManager.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Products\RelationManagers;

use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Resources\RelationManagers\RelationManager;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Forms\Components\CheckboxList;

// 🚀 IMPORTAÇÕES CORRETAS PARA FILAMENT V4 (Arquitetura Unificada)
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\AttachAction;
use Filament\Actions\DetachAction;
use Filament\Actions\DetachBulkAction;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;

class ProductModifiersRelationManager extends RelationManager
{
    protected static string $relationship = 'modifiers';
    protected static ?string $title = 'Modificadores';
    protected static string|\BackedEnum|null $icon = 'heroicon-o-queue-list';

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->recordTitleAttribute('name')
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Grupo')
                    ->weight('bold')
                    ->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'ingredient' => 'info',
                        'add_on' => 'success',
                        'removal' => 'danger',
                        default => 'gray',
                    }),

                // 🚀 INDICADOR DE EXCEÇÕES LOCAIS
                TextColumn::make('pivot.excluded_options')
                    ->label('Opções Ocultadas Neste Produto')
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $excluded = json_decode($record->pivot->excluded_options ?? '[]', true) ?? [];
                        if (empty($excluded)) return 'Todas Disponíveis';
                        return count($excluded) . ' opção(ões) oculta(s)';
                    })
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn ($state) => $state === 'Todas Disponíveis' ? 'success' : 'warning'),
            ])
            ->headerActions([
                // 🚀 USANDO A AÇÃO NATIVA DO V4
                AttachAction::make()
                    ->label('Vincular Novo Grupo')
                    ->preloadRecordSelect(),
            ])
            ->actions([
                // 🚀 A MÁGICA LOCAL: Ligar/Desligar itens apenas para este produto
                Action::make('toggle_options')
                    ->label('Ocultar Opções')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-adjustments-horizontal')
                    ->color('warning')
                    ->modalHeading('Ocultar Opções Neste Produto')
                    ->modalDescription('Desmarque as opções que NÃO devem aparecer quando o cliente for comprar este produto específico.')
                    ->form(function ($record) {
                        // Busca todas as opções cadastradas neste grupo
                        $options = $record->options()->pluck('name', 'id')->toArray();

                        return [
                            CheckboxList::make('active_options')
                                ->label('Opções Disponíveis')
                                ->options($options)
                                ->default(function () use ($record, $options) {
                                    // Puxa as que estão excluídas na Pivot
                                    $excluded = json_decode($record->pivot->excluded_options ?? '[]', true) ?? [];
                                    // Marca as que NÃO estão excluídas
                                    return array_diff(array_keys($options), $excluded);
                                })
                                ->columns(2)
                        ];
                    })
                    ->action(function ($record, array $data, $livewire) {
                        $active = $data['active_options'] ?? [];
                        $all = $record->options()->pluck('id')->toArray();

                        // O que sobrou (não está ativo) vai para o array de excluídos
                        $excluded = array_values(array_diff($all, $active));

                        // Salva a exceção na Pivot do Produto!
                        $livewire->getOwnerRecord()->modifiers()->updateExistingPivot($record->id, [
                            'excluded_options' => json_encode($excluded)
                        ]);
                    }),

                DetachAction::make()->label('Desvincular Grupo'),
            ])
            ->bulkActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    DetachBulkAction::make()->label('Desvincular Selecionados'),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Products\RelationManagers;


use App\Enums\OrderType;use Filament\Resources\RelationManagers\RelationManager;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Components\TextInput;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Toggle;
use Filament\Actions;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use App\Models\Product;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get;
use App\Services\Catalog\ProductCostingService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\TernaryFilter;

class TechnicalSheetsRelationManager extends RelationManager
{
    protected static string $relationship = "technicalSheets";
    protected static ?string $title = "Ficha Técnica";
    protected static ?string $modelLabel = "Item da Ficha Técnica";
    protected static ?string $pluralModelLabel = "Itens da Ficha Técnica";

    public function form(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        $isFinalProduct = in_array($this->getOwnerRecord()->type, [
            "dish",
            "combo",
            "resale",
        ]);

        return $schema
            ->components([
                Select::make("ingredient_product_id")
                    ->label("Componente (Insumo, Preparado ou Material)")
                    ->options(function () {
                        return Product::query()
                            ->whereHas(
                                "category",
                                fn($query) => $query->whereIn("type", [
                                    "internal",
                                    "supply",
                                    "resale",
                                ]),
                            )
                            ->with("category")
                            ->get()
                            ->groupBy(function ($product) {
                                return $product->category?->name ??
                                    "Outros / Sem Categoria";
                            })
                            ->map(
                                fn($products) => $products->pluck("name", "id"),
                            )
                            ->toArray();
                    })
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload()
                    ->required()
                    ->live()
                    ->columnSpan(1),

                TextInput::make("quantity")
                    ->label("Quantidade")
                    ->numeric()
                    ->inputMode("decimal")
                    ->required()
                    ->suffix(function (Get $get) {
                        $productId = $get("ingredient_product_id");
                        if (!$productId) {
                            return null;
                        }

                        return Product::find($productId)?->unit_of_measure;
                    })
                    ->columnSpan(1),

                Select::make("order_type")
                    ->label("Aplicação (Canais)")
                    ->multiple()
                    ->options(OrderType::class)
                    ->default(["table", "counter", "delivery"])
                    ->required()
                    ->columnSpan(1)
                    ->visible($isFinalProduct),

                Toggle::make("is_active")
                    ->label("Ativo")
                    ->helperText("Desative insumos antigos em vez de apagá-los para não perder histórico.")
                    ->default(true)
                    ->columnSpan(1),
            ])
            ->columns(2);
    }

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        $isFinalProduct = in_array($this->getOwnerRecord()->type, [
            "dish",
            "combo",
            "resale",
        ]);

        return $table
            ->recordTitleAttribute("ingredient_product_id")
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\ToggleColumn::make("is_active")
                    ->label("Ativo")
                    ->afterStateUpdated(function ($record, $state, $livewire) {
                        $livewire->dispatch("update-margin-widget");
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("ingredient.name")
                    ->label("Ingrediente/Insumo")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->weight("bold")
                    ->color(fn ($record) => $record->is_active ? null : 'gray')
                    ->description(fn ($record) => $record->is_active ? '' : 'Insumo desativado'),

                // A Fusão da Quantidade + Unidade de Medida
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("quantity")
                    ->label("Quantidade")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $val = (float) $record->quantity;
                        $um = strtolower(
                            $record->ingredient?->unit_of_measure ?? "",
                        );

                        if (floor($val) == $val) {
                            $numStr = number_format($val, 0, ",", ".");
                        } else {
                            $numStr = number_format($val, 4, ",", ".");
                            $numStr = rtrim(rtrim($numStr, "0"), ",");
                        }

                        return "{$numStr} {$um}";
                    })
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn ($record) => $record->is_active ? 'gray' : 'gray'),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("cost")
                    ->label("Custo Total")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $ingredient = $record->ingredient;
                        if (!$ingredient) {
                            return 0;
                        }

                        $unitCost = ProductCostingService::calculateBaseCost(
                            $ingredient,
                        );
                        return (float) $record->quantity * $unitCost;
                    })
                    ->money("BRL")
                    ->weight("bold")
                    ->color(fn ($record) => $record->is_active ? 'danger' : 'gray'),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("order_type")
                    ->label("Aplicação")
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(
                        fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                            "table" => "Mesa",
                            "counter" => "Balcão",
                            "delivery" => "Delivery",
                            default => $state,
                        },
                    )
                    ->color(
                        fn(string $state, $record): string => !$record->is_active ? "gray" : match ($state) {
                            "table" => "info",
                            "counter" => "warning",
                            "delivery" => "success",
                            default => "gray",
                        },
                    )
                    ->visible($isFinalProduct),
            ])
            ->filters([

                            $ownerRecord = $livewire->getOwnerRecord();
                            $sourceProduct = Product::with(

                            if (

    public function getTableRecordClassesUsing(): ?\Closure

    public static function canViewForRecord($ownerRecord, $pageClass): bool
    {
```

```php
class ProductForm
{

    {
        return [
            BasicSection::make(),
            PriceAndStockSection::make(),
            ProductionSection::make(),
            FiscalSection::make(),
            WmsSection::make(),
            ComboSection::make(),
        ];

                ->label("Nome do Produto")

            Forms\Components\Select::make("type")

                ->options(ProductType::class)
                ->default("ingredient")

                ->afterStateUpdated(fn(Set $set) => $set("category_id", null))
                ->required(),

                ->default("UN")
                ->required(),

            Forms\Components\Toggle::make("track_inventory")
                ->label("Controlar Estoque?")
                ->default(true)
                ->inline(false),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;

use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;

use App\Services\Catalog\ProductCostingService;
use App\Services\Catalog\AvailabilityService;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class ProductTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->recordUrl(fn (Product $record): string => ProductResource::getUrl('view', ['record' => $record]))
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Nome do Produto')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->grow(true)
                    ->wrap(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (string $state): string => match (strtolower($state)) {
                        'dish'         => 'Prato',
                        'combo'        => 'Combo',
                        'resale'       => 'Revenda',
                        'ingredient'   => 'Insumo',
                        'manufactured' => 'Preparado',
                        default        => ucfirst($state),
                    })
                    ->color('gray')
                    ->grow(false),

                Tables\Columns\SelectColumn::make('category_id')
                    ->label('Categoria')
                    ->options(function () {
                        return Category::query()
                            ->with('parent')
                            ->get()
                            ->sortBy(fn ($cat) => ($cat->parent?->name ?? $cat->name) . ' ' . $cat->name)
                            ->mapWithKeys(function (Category $category) {
                                $label = $category->parent
                                    ? "{$category->parent->name} ➔ {$category->name}"
                                    : "📁 {$category->name}";

                                return [$category->id => $label];
                            })
                            ->toArray();
                    })
                    ->placeholder('Sem Categoria')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->selectablePlaceholder(false)
                    ->grow(true),

                Tables\Columns\TextInputColumn::make('dine_in_price')
                    ->label('Preço Salão')
                    ->type('number')
                    ->step('0.01')
                    ->rules(['required', 'numeric', 'min:0'])
                    ->sortable()
                    ->grow(false)
                    ->width('1%'),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('lucratividade')
                    ->label('Margem')
                    ->state(function (Product $record) {
                        if (in_array($record->type, ['ingredient', 'supply', 'internal'])) return null;

                        $data = ProductCostingService::getMarginData($record);
                        return $data['margin_percentage'] ?? 0;
                    })
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn ($state) => $state !== null ? number_format((float)$state, 2, ',', '.') . '%' : '-')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(function ($state) {
                        if ($state === null) return 'gray';
                        $pct = (float) $state;
                        if ($pct >= 30) return 'success';
                        if ($pct >= 15) return 'warning';
                        return 'danger';
                    })
                    ->grow(false),

                Tables\Columns\SelectColumn::make('status')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->options(ProductStatus::class)
                    ->selectablePlaceholder(false)
                    ->sortable()
                    ->rules(['required'])
                    ->grow(false)
                    ->width('155px')
                    ->updateStateUsing(function ($record, $state, $livewire) {
                        // 1. Barreira estrita: Disponível exige saldo físico positivo
                        if ($state === 'available' && $record->track_inventory && (float) $record->current_stock <= 0) {
                            Notification::make()
                                ->warning()
                                ->title('Estoque Zerado')
                                ->body("Você não pode colocar '{$record->name}' como disponível sem dar entrada no saldo.")
                                ->send();

                            $livewire->dispatch('$refresh');
                            return;
                        }

                        // 2. Dispara a máquina de estados completa do AvailabilityService
                        try {
                            app(AvailabilityService::class)->updateAvailability($record->id, $state);

                            Notification::make()
                                ->success()
                                ->title('Disponibilidade Atualizada')
                                ->body("Status de '{$record->name}' atualizado com cascata e propagação em tempo real.")
                                ->send();
                        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                            Notification::make()
                                ->danger()
                                ->title('Erro ao Atualizar')
                                ->body($e->getMessage())
                                ->send();
                        }

                        $livewire->dispatch('$refresh');
                    }),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('connection_status')
                    ->label('Cadeia de custos')
                    ->state(function (Product $record) {
                        if ($record->type === 'dish') {
                            return $record->technicalSheets()->exists() ? 'Conectado' : 'Desconectado';
                        }

                        if ($record->type === 'resale') {
                            return $record->costHistories()->exists() ? 'Conectado' : 'Desconectado';
                        }

                        return 'Conectado';
                    })
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'Conectado'    => 'gray',
                        'Desconectado' => 'danger',
                        default        => 'gray',
                    })
                    ->icon(fn (string $state): string => match ($state) {
                        'Conectado'    => 'heroicon-m-link',
                        'Desconectado' => 'heroicon-m-link-slash',
                        default        => 'heroicon-m-link',
                    })
                    ->grow(false),
            ])
            ->filters([
                Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make('category_id')
                    ->label('Categorias')
                    ->relationship('category', 'name')
                    ->multiple()
                    ->searchable()
                    ->preload(),

                Tables\Filters\SelectFilter::make('status')
                    ->label('Status')
                    ->multiple()
                    ->options(ProductStatus::class),
            ])
            ->actions([])
            ->bulkActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                    MergeProductsBulkAction::make(),

                    BulkAction::make('alterarCategoria')
                        ->label('Alterar Categoria')
                        ->icon('heroicon-o-tag')
                        ->form([
                            FormComponents\Select::make('category_id')
                                ->label('Nova Categoria')
                                ->options(fn () => Category::pluck('name', 'id'))
                                ->required(),
                        ])
                        ->action(fn(Collection $records, array $data) => $records->each->update(['category_id' => $data['category_id']])),

                    Actions\BulkAction::make('alterarStatus')
                        ->label('Alterar Status')
                        ->icon('heroicon-o-check-circle')
                        ->form([
                            FormComponents\Select::make('status')
                                ->label('Novo Status')
                                ->options(ProductStatus::class)
                                ->required(),
                        ])
                        ->action(function(Collection $records, array $data) {
                            $successCount = 0;
                            $skippedCount = 0;
                            $availabilityService = app(AvailabilityService::class);

                            foreach ($records as $record) {
                                if ($data['status'] === 'available' && $record->track_inventory && (float) $record->current_stock <= 0) {
                                    $skippedCount++;
                                    continue;
                                }

                                try {
                                    $availabilityService->updateAvailability($record->id, $data['status']);
                                    $successCount++;
                                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                                    $skippedCount++;
                                }
                            }

                            if ($skippedCount > 0) {
                                Notification::make()
                                    ->warning()
                                    ->title('Atenção ao Estoque')
                                    ->body("{$successCount} produtos atualizados. {$skippedCount} foram ignorados por estarem sem estoque ou com pendências.")
                                    ->send();
                            } else {
                                Notification::make()
                                    ->success()
                                    ->title('Sucesso!')
                                    ->body("{$successCount} produtos atualizados com propagação em tempo real.")
                                    ->send();
                            }
                        }),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Products/Widgets/ProductMarginWidget.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Products\Widgets;

use App\Services\Catalog\ProductCostingService;
use Filament\Widgets\Widget;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Livewire\Attributes\On;

class ProductMarginWidget extends Widget
{
    public ?Model $record = null;
    public ?Model $ownerRecord = null; // 🚀 Captura o produto se o widget estiver "preso" dentro de um RelationManager!

    public ?array $simulatedData = null;

    protected string $view = 'filament.resources.products.widgets.product-margin-widget';
    protected int | string | array $columnSpan = 'full';

    #[On('update-margin-widget')]
    public function applySimulation(?array $simulatedData = null)
    {
        $this->simulatedData = $simulatedData;
    }

    #[On('reset-margin-widget')]
    public function resetSimulation()
    {
        $this->simulatedData = null;
    }

    protected function getViewData(): array
    {
        // 1. Identifica o alvo (seja na página principal ou no RelationManager)
        $targetRecord = $this->record ?? $this->ownerRecord;

        if (!$targetRecord) {
            return ['marginData' => null];
        }

        // 🚀 REGRA DE VISIBILIDADE:
        // Ocultamos o widget em insumos simples (sem ficha técnica).
        // Ele só aparece se for um tipo de venda (dish, combo, resale) OU se tiver uma receita (preparado).
        $hasRecipe = $targetRecord->technicalSheets()->exists();
        $isComplexType = in_array($targetRecord->type, ['dish', 'combo', 'manufactured', 'resale']);

        if (!$isComplexType && !$hasRecipe) {
            return ['marginData' => null];
        }

        // 🚀 PRIORIZAÇÃO DO CUSTO REAL:
        // Se o produto tiver ficha técnica, forçamos o cálculo recursivo para que o base_cost
        // reflita a soma dos ingredientes (os R$ 4,68 do seu suco) e não o valor zerado do banco.
        if ($hasRecipe) {
            $realCost = ProductCostingService::calculateBaseCost($targetRecord);
            $targetRecord->base_cost = $realCost;
        }

        // Agora calculamos a margem com o custo já atualizado no objeto
        $marginData = ProductCostingService::getMarginData($targetRecord);

        // Aplica os dados de simulação se o usuário estiver mexendo no simulador
        if ($this->simulatedData) {
            $costDifference = $this->simulatedData['cost'] - $marginData['base_cost'];
            $marginData['cost_table'] += $costDifference;
            $marginData['cost_counter'] += $costDifference;
            $marginData['cost_delivery'] += $costDifference;

            $marginData['sell_price'] = $this->simulatedData['sell_price'];
            $marginData['base_cost'] = $this->simulatedData['cost'];
            $marginData['net_profit'] = $this->simulatedData['net_profit'];
            $marginData['margin_percentage'] = $this->simulatedData['margin_percentage'];
            $marginData['contribution_margin'] = $this->simulatedData['contribution_margin'];

            $marginData['simples_amount'] = $this->simulatedData['simples_amount'];
            $marginData['icms_amount'] = $this->simulatedData['icms_amount'];
            $marginData['card_fee_amount'] = $this->simulatedData['card_fee_amount'];
            $marginData['total_variables'] = $this->simulatedData['total_variable_costs'];
        }

        return [
            'record' => $targetRecord,
            'marginData' => $marginData,
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/Products/Widgets/ProductSimulatorWidget.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Products\Widgets;

use App\Services\Catalog\ProductCostingService;
use Filament\Widgets\Widget;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class ProductSimulatorWidget extends Widget
{
    public ?Model $record = null;
    public ?Model $ownerRecord = null; // 🚀 Proteção RelationManager

    public array $selectedAddons = [];
    public ?string $customPrice = null;
    public ?string $desiredMargin = null;
    public ?string $activeMode = null;

    protected string $view = 'filament.resources.products.widgets.product-simulator-widget';
    protected int | string | array $columnSpan = 'full';

    public function updatedCustomPrice($value)
    {
        $this->desiredMargin = null;
        if (blank($value)) {
            $this->activeMode = null;
            $this->customPrice = null;
        } else {
            $this->activeMode = 'price';
            $this->customPrice = preg_replace('/[^0-9,]/', '', $value);
        }
        $this->recalculateAndSync();
    }

    public function updatedDesiredMargin($value)
    {
        $this->customPrice = null;
        if (blank($value)) {
            $this->activeMode = null;
            $this->desiredMargin = null;
        } else {
            $this->activeMode = 'margin';
            $this->desiredMargin = preg_replace('/[^0-9,]/', '', $value);
        }
        $this->recalculateAndSync();
    }

    public function updatedSelectedAddons()
    {
        $this->recalculateAndSync();
    }

    public function recalculateAndSync()
    {
        $targetRecord = $this->record ?? $this->ownerRecord;
        if (!$targetRecord) return;

        $customValue = null;
        if ($this->activeMode === 'margin' && !blank($this->desiredMargin)) {
            $customValue = (float) str_replace(',', '.', $this->desiredMargin);
        } elseif ($this->activeMode === 'price' && !blank($this->customPrice)) {
            $customValue = (float) str_replace(',', '.', $this->customPrice);
        }

        // 🚀 O WIDGET AGORA É BURRO! Só chama o Serviço e despacha o evento.
        $simulatedData = ProductCostingService::simulatePricing(
            $targetRecord,
            $this->selectedAddons,
            $this->activeMode,
            $customValue
        );

        $this->dispatch('update-margin-widget', simulatedData: $simulatedData);
    }

    public function getViewData(): array
    {
        $targetRecord = $this->record ?? $this->ownerRecord;
        if (!$targetRecord) return [];
        return [
            'modifierGroups' => $targetRecord->modifiers()->whereIn('type', ['add_on', 'ingredient'])->with('options')->get(),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
class ProductResource extends Resource

        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\Actions;

use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\TextEntry;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\ReceivedInvoiceResource;
use App\Filament\Pages\ImportInvoice;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;

class InvoiceSummaryAction extends Action
{
    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'resumo_nota';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label('Ver Resumo')
            ->extraAttributes(['class' => 'hidden']) // Oculto na coluna, ativo no clique da linha
            ->modalHeading('Resumo da Nota Fiscal')
            ->modalDescription(
                fn($record) => $record && $record->status === 'pending'
                    ? 'A SEFAZ exige a "Ciência da Operação" para liberar a lista de produtos (XML completo). Abaixo estão os dados de cabeçalho disponíveis neste momento.'
                    : 'Detalhes da Nota Fiscal recebida.'
            )
            ->modalSubmitAction(false) // Mantemos desativado o "Salvar" padrão
            ->modalCancelActionLabel('Fechar e Voltar')

            ->extraModalFooterActions([

                // BOTÃO 1: MANIFESTAR (Ciência da Operação)
                Action::make('manifestar')
                    ->label('Manifestar Ciência')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-check-badge')
                    ->color('info') // Padronizado com a cor da tabela
                    ->visible(fn($record) => $record && $record->status === 'pending')
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->modalHeading('Manifestar Ciência da Operação')
                    ->modalDescription('Confirma a ciência desta nota? O sistema solicitará o XML completo à SEFAZ.')
                    ->action(function ($record) {
                        try {
                            // Lógica pescada da Tabela
                            ReceivedInvoiceResource::transmitirEventoSefaz($record->nfe_key, 210210, 'Ciencia da operacao');
                            $record->update(['status' => 'manifested']);

                            Notification::make()->title('Ciência Confirmada!')->success()->send();
                        } catch (\Exception $e) {
                            if (str_contains($e->getMessage(), '596')) {
                                $record->update(['status' => 'expired_manifestation']);
                                Notification::make()->title('Prazo Expirado!')->body('A Sefaz bloqueou a ciência por limite de tempo. Use o botão de anexo na linha para subir o XML.')->warning()->send();
                            } else {
                                Notification::make()->title('Erro Técnico')->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send();
                            }
                        }
                    }),

                // BOTÃO 2: REJEITAR (Desconhecimento da Operação)
                Action::make('rejeitar')
                    ->label('Desconhecer Operação')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-x-circle')
                    ->color('danger')
                    ->visible(fn($record) => $record && $record->status === 'pending')
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->modalHeading('Desconhecer Operação')
                    ->modalDescription('Tem certeza que deseja informar à SEFAZ o desconhecimento desta nota? Esta ação é irreversível.')
                    ->action(function ($record) {
                        try {
                            // Lógica pescada da Tabela
                            ReceivedInvoiceResource::transmitirEventoSefaz($record->nfe_key, 210220, 'Desconhecimento da operacao');
                            $record->update(['status' => 'rejected']);

                            Notification::make()->title('Operação Rejeitada!')->success()->send();
                        } catch (\Exception $e) {
                            Notification::make()->title('Erro ao Rejeitar')->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send();
                        }
                    }),

                // BOTÃO 3: PROCESSAR OU VISUALIZAR (Importar / Auditar)
                Action::make('processar')
                    ->label(fn($record) => $record->status === 'processed' ? 'Visualizar / Auditar' : 'Processar Entrada')
                    ->icon(fn($record) => $record->status === 'processed' ? 'heroicon-m-eye' : 'heroicon-m-arrow-path')
                    ->color(fn($record) => $record->status === 'processed' ? 'info' : 'success')
                    ->visible(fn($record) => $record && in_array($record->status, ['ready', 'manifested', 'processed']) && $record->has_full_xml)
                    ->action(function ($record) {
                        return redirect()->to(ImportInvoice::getUrl(['invoice' => $record->id]));
                    }),
            ])

            ->infolist([
                Section::make('Dados Informados pela SEFAZ')
                    ->columns(2)
                    ->schema([
                        TextEntry::make('nfe_key')
                            ->label('Chave de Acesso (44 Dígitos)')
                            ->columnSpan(1)
                            ->copyable()
                            ->extraAttributes(['class' => 'break-all']),

                        TextEntry::make('emitter_cnpj')->label('CNPJ do Emissor'),

                        TextEntry::make('emitter_name')->label('Razão Social (SEFAZ)'),

                        TextEntry::make('fantasy_name')
                            ->label('Nome Fantasia (BrasilAPI)')
                            ->state(function ($record) {
                                $cnpjLimpo = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $record->emitter_cnpj);
                                if (empty($cnpjLimpo) || strlen($cnpjLimpo) !== 14) return 'Dados incompletos';

                                try {
                                    $response = Http::withoutVerifying()->timeout(5)->get("https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cnpj/v1/{$cnpjLimpo}");
                                    if ($response->successful()) {
                                        $data = $response->json();
                                        return !empty($data['nome_fantasia']) ? $data['nome_fantasia'] : ($data['razao_social'] ?? 'Sem Fantasia');
                                    }
                                    return "Não encontrado (Status: {$response->status()})";
                                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                                    return 'Falha na consulta externa';
                                }
                            }),

                        TextEntry::make('issue_date')->label('Data de Emissão')->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i'),

                        TextEntry::make('total_value')->label('Valor Total da Nota')->money('BRL'),
                    ])
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\Pages;

class ManageReceivedInvoices extends ManageRecords

    public function mount(): void

    {

                )
                ->badge(
                    fn() => ReceivedInvoice::whereIn("status", [
                        "pending",
                        "manifested",
                        "ready",
                        "return_pending",
                        "expired_manifestation",
                    ])->count(),
                )
                ->badgeColor("warning"),

            "historico" => SchemaComponents\Tabs\Tab::make("Histórico")
                ->icon("heroicon-m-check-badge")
                ->modifyQueryUsing(
```
