```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\Tables;

use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\ReceivedInvoiceResource;
use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\Actions\InvoiceSummaryAction;
use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\Actions\ViewDanfeAction;
use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\Actions\ProcessReturnAction;
use App\Filament\Pages\ImportInvoice;
use App\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\CompanySetting; // 🚀 Importado para checar o certificado
use App\Filament\Pages\ManageCompanySettings; // 🚀 Importado para gerar a URL correta
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\BulkAction;
use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class ReceivedInvoicesTable
{
    public static function build(Table $table): Table
    {
        // 🚀 CHECAGEM DO CERTIFICADO:
        // Busca as configurações e avalia se o certificado digital está preenchido
        $setting = CompanySetting::getCached();

        // Ajuste 'certificate_path' abaixo para o nome real da coluna no seu banco (ex: certificate, certificado_file...)
        $hasCertificate = $setting && !empty($setting->certificate_path);

        return $table
            // 🚀 SE NÃO HOUVER CERTIFICADO, FORÇA A TABELA A FICAR VAZIA PARA EXIBIR A TELA DE BLOQUEIO
            ->modifyQueryUsing(function ($query) use ($hasCertificate) {
                if (! $hasCertificate) {
                    return $query->whereRaw('1 = 0'); // Query impossível para esvaziar a tabela de forma limpa
                }
                return $query;
            })
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("issue_date")
                    ->label("Emissão")
                    ->dateTime("d/m/Y H:i")
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("emitter_name")
                    ->label("Fornecedor")
                    ->state(function ($record) {
                        $supplier = Supplier::with("parent")
                            ->where("document", $record->emitter_cnpj)
                            ->first();

                        if ($supplier) {
                            $childName = $supplier->name;

                            if ($supplier->parent) {
                                $parentName = $supplier->parent->name;
                                return "{$parentName} ({$childName})";
                            }

                            return $childName;
                        }

                        return $record->emitter_name;
                    })
                    ->searchable(query: function (Builder $query, string $search): Builder {
                            return $query->where('emitter_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                                ->orWhereHas('costHistories', function ($q) use ($search) {
                                    $q->where('xml_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                                })
                                ->orWhereHas('personalPurchases', function ($q) use ($search) {
                                    $q->where('xml_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                                });
                        })
                        ->limit(45),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("emitter_cnpj")
                    ->label("CNPJ")
                    ->copyable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("total_value")
                    ->label("Valor Total")
                    ->money("BRL"),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("xml_content")
                    ->searchable()
                    ->hidden(),

                    Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("status")
                        ->label("Status")
                        ->badge()
                        ->formatStateUsing(
                                                    fn(string $state): string => match ($state) {
                                                        "pending" => "Pendente",
                                                        "manifested" => "Aguard. XML",
                                                        "ready" => "Confirmada",
                                                        "processed" => "Processada",
                                                        "rejected" => "Rejeitada",
                                                        "canceled_by_supplier" => "Cancelada",
                                                        "returned" => "Devolvida (Anulada)", // 🚀 A nota de Venda original
                                                        "return_receipt" => "Recibo de Devolução",
                                                        "expired_manifestation" => "Expirada",// 🚀 A nota que o fornecedor emitiu anulando
                                                        default => $state,
                                                    },
                                                )
                                                ->colors([
                                                    "gray" => ["pending", "return_receipt"],
                                                    "warning" => "manifested",
                                                    "success" => "processed",
                                                    "primary" => "ready",
                                                    "danger" => ["rejected", "canceled_by_supplier", "returned", "expired_manifestation"],
                                                ]),
            ])
            ->defaultSort("issue_date", "desc")
            ->recordAction("resumo_nota")
            ->filters([
            SelectFilter::make("status")
                ->label("Filtrar Status")
                ->options([
                    "pending" => "Pendente",
                    "ready" => "Manifestada",
                    "processed" => "Processada",
                    "rejected" => "Rejeitada",
                    "canceled_by_supplier" => "Cancelada", // 🚀 Novo Filtro
                ]),
            ])
            ->toolbarActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    BulkAction::make("manifestar_lote")
                        ->label("Dar Ciência nas Selecionadas")
                        ->icon("heroicon-m-check-badge")
                        ->color("info")
                        ->requiresConfirmation()
                        ->visible(
                            fn(\Livewire\Component $livewire) => property_exists($livewire, "activeTab")
                                ? $livewire->activeTab !== "historico"
                                : true,
                        )
                        ->action(function (Collection $records) {
                            $sucesso = 0;
                            $falha = 0;
                            foreach ($records as $record) {
                                if ($record->status !== "pending") {
                                    continue;
                                }
                                try {
                                    ReceivedInvoiceResource::transmitirEventoSefaz(
                                        $record->nfe_key,
                                        210210,
                                        "Ciencia da operacao"
                                    );
                                    $record->update(["status" => "manifested"]);
                                    $sucesso++;
                                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                                    // 🚀 SEFAZ GRITOU 596? MARCA COMO EXPIRADO SILENCIOSAMENTE!
                                    if (str_contains($e->getMessage(), '596')) {
                                        $record->update(["status" => "expired_manifestation"]);
                                    }
                                    $falha++;
                                }
                            }
                            if ($sucesso > 0) {
                                Notification::make()->title("{$sucesso} notas prontas para processar!")->success()->send();
                            }
                            if ($falha > 0) {
                                Notification::make()->title("Falha em {$falha} notas.") ->danger()->send();
                            }
                        })
                        ->deselectRecordsAfterCompletion(),

                    BulkAction::make("estornar_lote")
                        ->label("Estornar Lote Selecionado")
                        ->icon("heroicon-m-arrow-uturn-left")
                        ->color("danger")
                        ->requiresConfirmation()
                        ->modalHeading("Estornar Notas Fiscais")
                        ->modalDescription("Isso vai reverter o estoque adicionado, apagar as despesas, excluir os lançamentos do contas a pagar e devolver as notas para a fila de processamento. Deseja continuar?")
                        ->visible(
                            fn(\Livewire\Component $livewire) => property_exists($livewire, "activeTab")
                                ? $livewire->activeTab === "historico"
                                : false,
                        )
                        ->action(function (Collection $records) {
                            foreach ($records as $invoice) {
                                if ($invoice->status !== "processed") {
                                    continue;
                                }

                                \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::transaction(function () use ($invoice) {
                                    $histories = \App\Models\ProductCostHistory::where("nfe_key", $invoice->nfe_key)->with("product")->get();
                                    foreach ($histories as $history) {
                                        if ($history->product) {
                                            $history->product->decrement("current_stock", $history->quantity);
                                        }
                                        $history->delete();
                                    }

                                \App\Models\PersonalPurchase::where("nfe_key", $invoice->nfe_key)->delete();

                                $payables = \App\Models\AccountPayable::where("nfe_key", $invoice->nfe_key)->get();
                                foreach ($payables as $payable) {
                                    if ($payable->status === 'paid') {
                                        throw new \Exception("A nota {$invoice->nfe_key} possui faturas já pagas. Desfaça a conciliação no Extrato Bancário primeiro.");
                                    }
                                    $payable->delete();
                                }

                                $invoice->update(["status" => "ready"]);
                                });
                            }
                            Notification::make()->title("Lote estornado com sucesso!")->body("As notas voltaram para a fila de pendências.") ->success()->send();
                        })
                        ->deselectRecordsAfterCompletion(),
                ]),
            ])
            ->actions([
                InvoiceSummaryAction::make(),
                Action::make('upload_xml_row')
                    ->label('Anexar XML')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-document-arrow-up')
                    ->iconButton() // Botão limpo na tabela
                    ->tooltip('Prazo expirado. Anexe o XML manualmente.')
                    ->color('warning')
                    ->visible(fn($record) => $record->status === 'expired_manifestation') // Só aparece quando der o erro 596
                    ->form([
                        \Filament\Forms\Components\FileUpload::make('xml_file')
                            ->label('Ficheiro XML da Nota Completo')
                            ->acceptedFileTypes(['text/xml', 'application/xml'])
                            ->directory('temp_xmls')
                            ->required(),
                    ])
                    ->action(function ($record, array $data) {
                        try {
                            // 1. Lê o ficheiro temporário que o Filament subiu
                            $xmlContent = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage::get($data['xml_file']);

                            // 2. Apaga o ficheiro do disco, já o temos na memória!
                            \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage::delete($data['xml_file']);

                            $xml = simplexml_load_string($xmlContent);
                            if (!$xml || $xml->getName() !== 'nfeProc') {
                                throw new \Exception("Ficheiro inválido. Tem de subir o XML completo (nfeProc).");
                            }

                            // 3. O Escudo de Segurança: Confirma se o XML é o dono desta linha
                            $chaveRecebida = str_replace('NFe', '', (string) $xml->NFe->infNFe['Id']);
                            if ($chaveRecebida !== $record->nfe_key) {
                                throw new \Exception("Atenção: O XML enviado pertence a outra nota fiscal (Chave diferente)!");
                            }

                            // 4. Injeta na linha existente e acorda o processo
                            $record->update([
                                'xml_content' => $xmlContent,
                                'status' => 'ready'
                            ]);

                            // 5. Tenta aprovar automaticamente os itens no histórico
                            app(\App\Services\Purchases\InvoiceImportService::class)->attemptAutoApproval($record);

                            Notification::make()->title('XML anexado com sucesso!')->body('A nota está pronta para ser importada.')->success()->send();
                        } catch (\Exception $e) {
                            Notification::make()->title('Erro na Leitura')->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send();
                        }
                    }),
                ProcessReturnAction::make(),
                Action::make("manifestar")
                    ->label("Dar Ciência")
                    ->icon("heroicon-m-check-badge")
                    ->iconButton()
                    ->tooltip('Manifestar conhecimento')
                    ->color("info")
                    ->visible(fn($record) => $record->status === "pending" && $record->status !== "canceled_by_supplier")
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->action(function ($record) {
                        try {
                            ReceivedInvoiceResource::transmitirEventoSefaz($record->nfe_key, 210210, "Ciencia da operacao");
                            $record->update(["status" => "manifested"]);
                            Notification::make()->title("Ciência enviada! O XML será baixado em breve.")->success()->send();
                        } catch (\Exception $e) {
                            // 🚀 O INTERCEPTADOR DO ERRO 596
                            if (str_contains($e->getMessage(), '596')) {
                                $record->update(['status' => 'expired_manifestation']);
                                Notification::make()
                                    ->title('Prazo Expirado!')
                                    ->body('A Sefaz bloqueou a ciência por limite de tempo. Use o botão de anexo na linha para subir o XML.')
                                    ->warning()
                                    ->send();
                            } else {
                                Notification::make()->title("Erro Técnico")->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send();
                            }
                        }
                    }),

                Action::make("rejeitar")
                    ->label("Desconhecer")
                    ->icon("heroicon-m-x-circle")
                    ->iconButton()
                    ->tooltip('Rejeitar nota')
                    ->color("danger")
                    ->visible(fn($record) => $record->status === "pending")
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->action(function ($record) {
                        try {
                            ReceivedInvoiceResource::transmitirEventoSefaz($record->nfe_key, 210220, "Desconhecimento da operacao");
                            $record->update(["status" => "rejected"]);
                            Notification::make()->title("Operação Rejeitada!")->success()->send();
                        } catch (\Exception $e) {
                            Notification::make()->title("Erro ao Rejeitar")->body($e->getMessage())->danger()->send();
                        }
                    }),

                    Action::make("processar")
                                        ->label("Importar")
                                        ->icon("heroicon-o-arrow-down-on-square-stack")
                                        ->iconButton()
                                        ->tooltip('Processar nota')
                                        ->color("success")
                                        // 🚀 Só mostra se for 'ready'. Ignora 'returned', 'return_receipt', etc.
                                        ->visible(fn($record) => $record->status === "ready" && $record->has_full_xml)
                                        ->action(fn($record) => redirect()->to(ImportInvoice::getUrl(["invoice" => $record->id]))),

                ViewDanfeAction::make(),
                Action::make("download_xml")
                    ->label("Baixar")
                    ->icon("heroicon-o-arrow-down-tray")
                    ->iconButton()
                    ->tooltip('Baixar XML')
                    ->color("gray")
                    ->visible(fn($record) => !empty($record->xml_content))
                    ->action(fn($record) => response()->streamDownload(fn() => print $record->xml_content, "NFe_{$record->nfe_key}.xml")),
            ])
            // 🚀 O SEGREDO VISUAL: Constrói uma tela vazia totalmente customizada com Tailwind!
            ->emptyStateHeading(fn() => $hasCertificate ? 'Nenhuma nota fiscal encontrada' : 'Configuração Pendente: Certificado Digital A1')
            ->emptyStateDescription(fn() => $hasCertificate
                ? 'Use o botão de sincronização no topo para buscar novos documentos na SEFAZ.'
                : new HtmlString('
                    <div class="max-w-md mx-auto text-center space-y-3 mt-2">
                        <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm leading-relaxed">
                            Para consultar e importar notas fiscais direto da SEFAZ, sua empresa precisa de um <b>Certificado Digital A1 ativo</b>. O certificado atual está ausente ou inválido.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                ')
            )
            ->emptyStateIcon(fn() => $hasCertificate ? 'heroicon-o-document-text' : 'heroicon-o-shield-exclamation')
            ->emptyStateActions([
                // Só renderiza o botão se o certificado estiver faltando
                Action::make('ir_configuracoes')
                    ->label('Ir para as Configurações')
                    ->icon('heroicon-o-cog-6-tooth')
                    ->color('primary')
                    ->button()
                    ->url(fn() => ManageCompanySettings::getUrl())

            ]);
    }
```

## File: app/Filament/Resources/ReceivedInvoices/ReceivedInvoiceResource.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices;

use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\Pages;
use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use Filament\Resources\Resource;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use NFePHP\NFe\Tools;
use NFePHP\Common\Certificate;

// Importa nossa Tabela Isolada
use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\Tables\ReceivedInvoicesTable;

class ReceivedInvoiceResource extends Resource
{
    protected static ?string $model = ReceivedInvoice::class;
    protected static string | \UnitEnum | null $navigationGroup = 'Estoque & Compras';
    protected static ?string $title = 'Notas de Compra';
    protected static ?string $modelLabel = 'Nota de Compra';
    protected static ?string $pluralModelLabel = 'Notas de Compra';

    // =========================================================
    // BADGES NO MENU DO RECURSO (Círculos de Aviso)
    // =========================================================
    public static function getNavigationBadge(): ?string
    {
        try {
            $pending = static::getModel()::where('status', 'pending')->count();
            if ($pending > 0) return (string) $pending;

            $processing = static::getModel()::whereIn('status', ['manifested', 'ready'])->count();
            if ($processing > 0) return (string) $processing;

            return null;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static function getNavigationBadgeColor(): string | array | null
    {
        try {
            $pending = static::getModel()::where('status', 'pending')->count();
            if ($pending > 0) return 'danger'; // Vermelho para ação urgente

            $processing = static::getModel()::whereIn('status', ['manifested', 'ready'])->count();
            if ($processing > 0) return 'warning'; // Âmbar para notas aguardando processamento

            return null;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    // =========================================================
    // MOTOR CENTRAL DE EVENTOS DA SEFAZ
    // =========================================================
    public static function transmitirEventoSefaz($chave, $tpEvento, $justificativa = '')
    {
        $setting = CompanySetting::getCached();
        if (!$setting || !$setting->certificate_path || !$setting->certificate_password) {
            throw new \Exception('O certificado digital não foi configurado.');
        }

        $config = json_encode([
            "atualizacao" => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            "tpAmb" => 1,
            "razaosocial" => $setting->company_name,
            "cnpj" => preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $setting->cnpj),
            "siglaUF" => $setting->state,
            "schemes" => "PL_009_V4",
            "versao" => '4.00',
        ]);

        $pfxContent = Storage::get($setting->certificate_path);
        $certificate = Certificate::readPfx($pfxContent, $setting->certificate_password);
        $tools = new Tools($config, $certificate);

        $response = $tools->sefazManifesta($chave, $tpEvento, $justificativa, 1);

        $std = new \NFePHP\NFe\Common\Standardize();
        $arr = $std->toArray($response);

        if (isset($arr['cStat']) && $arr['cStat'] == 128) {
            $ret = $arr['retEvento'][0] ?? $arr['retEvento'] ?? [];
            $inf = $ret['infRet'] ?? $ret['infEvento'] ?? null;
            $eventoStat = $inf['cStat'] ?? null;
            $motivo = $inf['xMotivo'] ?? 'Sem motivo informado pela Sefaz';

            // 135 = Evento Registrado | 573 = Duplicidade
            if (in_array($eventoStat, [135, 136, 573])) {
                return true;
            }
            throw new \Exception("Sefaz negou o evento ({$eventoStat}): {$motivo}");
        }

        throw new \Exception("Falha de Lote SEFAZ: " . ($arr['xMotivo'] ?? 'Comunicação falhou.'));
    }

    // =========================================================
    // DELEGAÇÃO DE TABELA
    // =========================================================
    public static function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return ReceivedInvoicesTable::build($table);
    }

    public static function canCreate(): bool
    {
        return false;
    }

    public static function getPages(): array
    {
        return [
            'index' => Pages\ManageReceivedInvoices::route('/'),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\Suppliers\Tables;

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make("type")

                    ->badge()
                    ->formatStateUsing(

            ->actions([

            ->bulkActions([

                    MergeSuppliersBulkAction::make(),

                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Supplies\Schemas;

use App\Enums\CategoryType;
use App\Enums\ProductStatus;
use App\Enums\ProductType;
use App\Enums\UnitOfMeasure;
use Filament\Forms;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Section;
use Filament\Schemas\Components\Grid;
use App\Models\Category;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Unique;

class SupplyForm
{
    public static function getFormSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            Section::make("Dados do Material")
                ->schema([
                    Grid::make(3)->schema([
                        Forms\Components\TextInput::make("name")
                            ->unique(
                                ignoreRecord: true,
                                modifyRuleUsing: fn(Unique $rule) => $rule->withoutTrashed(),
                            )
                            ->label("Descrição do Material")
                            ->required()
                            ->maxLength(255)
                            ->columnSpan(2),

                        Forms\Components\Select::make("category_id")
                            ->label("Categoria de Consumo")
                            ->options(fn() => Category::where("type", CategoryType::SUPPLY->value)->pluck("name", "id"))
                            ->required()
                            ->searchable()
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ]),

                    Grid::make(4)->schema([
                        Forms\Components\Select::make("type")
                            ->label("Classificação")
                            ->options([
                                ProductType::PACKAGING->value  => ProductType::PACKAGING->getLabel(),
                                ProductType::CONSUMABLE->value => ProductType::CONSUMABLE->getLabel(),
                            ])
                            ->required()
                            ->default(ProductType::CONSUMABLE->value)
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        Forms\Components\Select::make("status")
                            ->label("Disponibilidade")
                            ->options(ProductStatus::class)
                            ->default(ProductStatus::AVAILABLE->value)
                            ->required()
                            ->selectablePlaceholder(false)
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        Forms\Components\Select::make("unit_of_measure")
                            ->label("Unidade de Medida")
                            ->options(UnitOfMeasure::class)
                            ->required()
                            ->default(UnitOfMeasure::UN->value)
                            ->columnSpan(1),

                        Forms\Components\Toggle::make("track_inventory")
                            ->label("Controlar Estoque?")
                            ->default(true)
                            ->inline(false)
                            ->columnSpan(1),
                    ]),

                    Forms\Components\TextInput::make("base_cost")
                        ->label("Custo Base")
                        ->prefix('R$')
                        ->formatStateUsing(function ($state, ?\App\Models\Product $record) {
                            if ($record) {
                                $latestHistory = \App\Models\ProductCostHistory::where("product_id", $record->id)
                                    ->latest("id")
                                    ->first();
                                if ($latestHistory) {
                                    $state = $latestHistory->unit_cost;
                                }
                            }

                            if (blank($state)) return null;

                            $val = (float) $state;
                            $formatted = rtrim(rtrim(number_format($val, 5, ",", "."), "0"), ",");
                            $parts = explode(",", $formatted);
                            return count($parts) > 1
                                ? (strlen($parts[1]) < 2 ? $parts[0] . "," . str_pad($parts[1], 2, "0") : $formatted)
                                : $formatted . ",00";
                        })
                        ->readOnly(fn(?\App\Models\Product $record) => $record && $record->costHistories()->exists())
                        ->dehydrated(fn(?\App\Models\Product $record) => !($record && $record->costHistories()->exists()))
                        ->mutateDehydratedStateUsing(function ($state) {
                            if (blank($state)) return 0;
                            return (float) str_replace(",", ".", str_replace(".", "", (string) $state));
                        })
                        ->helperText(function (?\App\Models\Product $record) {
                            if ($record && $record->costHistories()->exists()) {
                                return "Bloqueado. O sistema está extraindo o custo do Histórico de Compras.";
                            }
                            return "Sem histórico de notas. Você pode digitar o custo base inicial.";
                        })
                        ->suffix(function ($record) {
                            if (!$record) return "";
                            $lastPurchase = \App\Models\ProductCostHistory::where("product_id", $record->id)->latest()->first();
                            $uom = $lastPurchase?->original_unit_of_measure ?? $record->unit_of_measure;
                            return $uom ? " /" . strtolower($uom) : "";
                        })
                        ->columnSpanFull(),
                ])
                ->columnSpanFull(),
        ];
    }

    public static function configure(Schema $schema): Schema
    {
        return $schema->schema(self::getFormSchema());
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Filament\Resources\Supplies;

use App\Filament\Traits\HasGlobalSearch;

use App\Models\Product;
use Filament\Resources\Resource;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Schemas\Schema;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class SupplyResource extends Resource
{
    use HasGlobalSearch;

    protected static ?string $model = Product::class;
    protected static ?string $slug = 'material-consumo';
    protected static string | \BackedEnum | null $navigationIcon = 'heroicon-o-archive-box';
    protected static string | \UnitEnum | null $navigationGroup = 'Estoque & Compras';
    protected static ?string $modelLabel = 'Suprimento';
    protected static ?string $pluralModelLabel = 'Suprimentos';

        {
            return parent::getEloquentQuery()
                ->whereIn('type', ['supply', 'consumable', 'packaging'])
                ->whereHas('category', fn($query) => $query->where('type', 'supply'));
        }

    {

    {
        return [
```

```php
                            'kds'     => '🍳 Cozinha / Produção (KDS)',
                            'waiter'  => '📱 Garçom / Atendimento',
                            'driver'  => '🛵 Entregador / Motoboy',

                        })
                        ->multiple()
                        ->preload()
                        ->searchable()
                        ->columnSpanFull(),

                    TextInput::make('password')
                        ->label('Senha Tradicional (Fallback)')
                        ->password()
                        ->revealable()
                        ->dehydrateStateUsing(fn ($state) => Hash::make($state))

                        ->required(fn (string $context): bool => $context === 'create')

                        ->dehydrateStateUsing(fn ($state) => Hash::make($state))

                        ->helperText('Senha exclusiva para libertar Estornos e descontos na tela do Caixa.'),

            // ==========================================

            Section::make('Autenticação de Dois Fatores (2FA)')

                ])->columns(2),
        ]);
    }
```

## File: app/Filament/Traits/HasGlobalSearch.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Traits;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString;

/**
 * @mixin \Filament\Resources\Resource
 */
trait HasGlobalSearch
{
    // 1. QUAIS COLUNAS O FILAMENT DEVE PESQUISAR?
    public static function getGloballySearchableAttributes(): array
    {
        $model = static::getModel();

        if ($model === \App\Models\Customer::class || $model === \App\Models\Employee::class) {
            return ['name', 'cpf', 'phone', 'email'];
        }

        if ($model === \App\Models\Supplier::class) {
            return ['name', 'document_name', 'document'];
        }

        return ['name'];
    }

    // 2. PARA ONDE IR AO CLICAR NO RESULTADO?
    public static function getGlobalSearchResultUrl(Model $record): string
    {
        if (static::hasPage('view')) {
            return static::getUrl('view', ['record' => $record]);
        }

        return static::getUrl('edit', ['record' => $record]);
    }

    // ==============================================================
    // 🚀 A MÁGICA VISUAL: Título e Breadcrumb na mesma linha
    // ==============================================================
    public static function getGlobalSearchResultTitle(Model $record): string | HtmlString
    {
        $name = $record->name ?? 'Sem Nome';
        $breadcrumb = '';

        if ($record instanceof \App\Models\Product) {
            $typeLabel = match($record->type) {
                'ingredient' => 'Insumo',
                'resale' => 'Revenda',
                'packaging' => 'Embalagem',
                'consumable' => 'Consumo',
                'dish' => 'Prato',
                'combo' => 'Combo',
                'manufactured' => 'Preparado',
                default => 'Outros',
            };

            $categoryName = $record->category?->name ?? 'Sem categoria';
            $breadcrumb = "{$typeLabel} &rsaquo; {$categoryName}";
        }
        elseif ($record instanceof \App\Models\Supplier) {
            $breadcrumb = $record->type === 'virtual' ? 'Virtual' : 'Físico';
        }
        elseif ($record instanceof \App\Models\Category) {
            $breadcrumb = match($record->type) {
                'external' => 'Vendas & Cardápio',
                'internal' => 'Cozinha & Insumos',
                'supply' => 'Uso e Consumo',
                default => 'Outros',
            };
        }

        // 🚀 O TRUQUE DO CSS E DO FLEXBOX:
        // 1. O style alarga a caixa de pesquisa do Filament para não espremer o texto (max-width: 600px).
        // 2. O flex + justify-between empurra o breadcrumb todo para a direita.
        return new HtmlString("
            <style>
                .fi-global-search-results-ctn {
                    max-width: 600px !important;
                    width: 100% !important;
                }
            </style>
            <div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%; gap: 1rem;'>
                <span style='font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-color); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;'>
                    {$name}
                </span>
                " . ($breadcrumb ? "<span style='font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9ca3af; letter-spacing: 0.05em; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;'>{$breadcrumb}</span>" : "") . "
            </div>
        ");
    }

    // ==============================================================
    // 🚀 DETALHES ADICIONAIS (Ficam discretos abaixo da linha principal)
    // ==============================================================
    public static function getGlobalSearchResultDetails(Model $record): array
    {
        $details = [];

        // Para os produtos, mantemos apenas o estoque na linha de baixo
        if ($record instanceof \App\Models\Product) {
            if ($record->track_inventory) {
                $stock = rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float) $record->current_stock, 3, ',', '.'), '0'), ',');
                if ($stock === '') $stock = '0';
                $details['Estoque'] = "{$stock} " . strtoupper($record->unit_of_measure);
            }
        }
        elseif ($record instanceof \App\Models\Supplier) {
            if ($record->document) $details['Doc'] = $record->document;
        }
        elseif ($record instanceof \App\Models\Customer || $record instanceof \App\Models\Employee) {
            if ($record->phone) $details['Tel'] = $record->phone;
            if ($record->cpf) $details['CPF'] = $record->cpf;
        }

        return $details;
    }
}
```

## File: app/Filament/Widgets/BillingChartWidget.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use Filament\Widgets\ChartWidget;
use Filament\Widgets\Concerns\InteractsWithPageFilters;
use App\Services\Analytics\BillingService;
use App\Services\Analytics\LegacyDataCapabilityService;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class BillingChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected ?string $heading = 'Evolução de Receita';
    protected static ?int $sort = 2;
    protected int | string | array $columnSpan = 'full';

    // 🚀 REDUZINDO A ALTURA PARA UM VISUAL PANORÂMICO
    protected ?string $maxHeight = '220px';

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        // 🚀 Trata $this->filters nulo no ciclo inicial do Livewire
        $filters = $this->filters ?? [];

        $data = BillingService::getConsolidatedDailyRevenue($filters);

        $timeGrouping = $filters['time_grouping'] ?? 'day';

        // 🚀 AGRUPAMENTO INTELIGENTE (INCLUINDO ANO)
        $groupedData = collect($data)->groupBy(function ($row) use ($timeGrouping) {
            $date = Carbon::parse($row->report_date);
            return match ($timeGrouping) {
                'year' => $date->format('Y'),
                'week' => 'Sem. ' . $date->format('W / Y'),
                'month' => ucfirst($date->translatedFormat('M / Y')),
                default => $date->format('d/m/Y'),
            };
        });

        $labels = [];
        $revenueData = [];

        foreach ($groupedData as $label => $group) {
            $labels[] = $label;
            $revenueData[] = round($group->sum('total_revenue'), 2);
        }

        return [
            'datasets' => [
                [
                    'label' => 'Faturamento Consolidado (R$)',
                    'data' => $revenueData,
                    'fill' => 'start',
                    'backgroundColor' => 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)',
                    'borderColor' => '#10b981',
                    'tension' => 0.4,
                ],
            ],
            'labels' => $labels,
        ];
    }

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'line';
    }

    // 🚀 MÁGICA DO EIXO X: Esconde as datas espremidas
    protected function getOptions(): array
    {
        return [
            'scales' => [
                'x' => [
                    'ticks' => [
                        'autoSkip' => true,
                        'maxTicksLimit' => 12,
                        'maxRotation' => 0,
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }

    protected function getEmptyStateDescription(): ?string
    {
        $startDate = $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null;

        $cutoffMessage = LegacyDataCapabilityService::getDetailedCutoffMessage($startDate);

        if ($cutoffMessage) {
            return $cutoffMessage;
        }

        return 'Não existem dados de faturamento (nem legados, nem atuais) registados para os filtros selecionados.';
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use Filament\Widgets\StatsOverviewWidget as BaseWidget;
use Filament\Widgets\StatsOverviewWidget\Stat;
use Filament\Widgets\Concerns\InteractsWithPageFilters;
use App\Services\Analytics\BillingService;

class BillingStatsWidget extends BaseWidget
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?int $sort = 1;

    protected function getStats(): array
    {
        // 🚀 Garante array vazio caso os filtros ainda não tenham sido inicializados
        $filters = $this->filters ?? [];

        $data = BillingService::getConsolidatedDailyRevenue($filters);

        $totalRevenue = $data->sum('total_revenue');
        $totalOrders = $data->sum('total_orders');
        $ticketMedio = $totalOrders > 0 ? ($totalRevenue / $totalOrders) : 0;

        return [
            Stat::make('Faturamento Total', 'R$ ' . number_format($totalRevenue, 2, ',', '.'))
                ->description('Visão Executiva Consolidada')
                ->descriptionIcon('heroicon-m-arrow-trending-up')
                ->color('success'),

            Stat::make('Volume de Pedidos', number_format($totalOrders, 0, ',', '.'))
                ->description('Pedidos finalizados no período')
                ->color('primary'),

            Stat::make('Ticket Médio', 'R$ ' . number_format($ticketMedio, 2, ',', '.'))
                ->description('Gasto médio por pedido')
                ->color('info'),
        ];
    }
}
```

## File: app/Http/Controllers/GoogleController.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Laravel\Socialite\Facades\Socialite;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Crypt;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use App\Services\Auth\GoogleAuthService;
use App\Services\Customers\CustomerRegistrationService;

class GoogleController extends Controller
{
    public function redirectToGoogle(Request $request)
    {
        $tenantHost = $request->query('host', request()->getHost());
        $intent = $request->query('intent', 'team');
        $returnTo = $request->query('return_to', $request->header('referer', '/'));

        $statePayload = base64_encode(json_encode([
            'host'      => $tenantHost,
            'intent'    => $intent,
            'return_to' => $returnTo,
        ]));

        return Socialite::driver('google')
            ->with(['state' => $statePayload])
            ->redirect();
    }

    public function getGoogleUrl(Request $request)
    {
        $tenantHost = $request->query('host', request()->getHost());
        $intent = $request->query('intent', 'customer');
        $returnTo = $request->input('return_to', $request->header('referer', '/'));

        $statePayload = base64_encode(json_encode([
            'host'      => $tenantHost,
            'intent'    => $intent,
            'return_to' => $returnTo,
        ]));

        $redirectUrl = Socialite::driver('google')
            ->with(['state' => $statePayload])
            ->redirect()
            ->getTargetUrl();

        return response()->json(['url' => $redirectUrl]);
    }

    public function handleGoogleCallback(Request $request)
    {
        try {
            $googleUser = Socialite::driver('google')->stateless()->user();
            $stateDecoded = base64_decode($request->input('state'));
            $stateData = json_decode($stateDecoded, true);

            $returnTo = '/';
            if (is_array($stateData)) {
                $tenantHost = $stateData['host'];
                $intent = $stateData['intent'] ?? 'team';
                $returnTo = $stateData['return_to'] ?? '/';
            } else {
                $tenantHost = $stateDecoded;
                $intent = 'team';
            }

            if ($tenantHost === 'adm.brasume.com.br') {
                $user = User::where('email', $googleUser->getEmail())->first();

                if (! $user) {
                    return redirect()->route('filament.central.auth.login')->with('error', 'Acesso negado. Administrador do SaaS não encontrado.');
                }

                Auth::login($user);
                return redirect()->to('/admin');
            }

            $payload = json_encode([
                'email'      => $googleUser->getEmail(),
                'name'       => $googleUser->getName(),
                'intent'     => $intent,
                'return_to'  => $returnTo,
                'expires_at' => now()->addMinutes(5)->timestamp
            ]);

            $token = urlencode(Crypt::encryptString($payload));

            if ($intent === 'customer') {
                return redirect("https://{$tenantHost}/auth/google/magic-login-customer?token={$token}");
            }
            return redirect("https://{$tenantHost}/auth/google/magic-login-team?token={$token}");

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('🔥 [GOOGLE OAUTH CALLBACK ERROR] ' . $e->getMessage());
            return redirect('/')->with('error', 'Falha ao autenticar com o Google. O processo foi cancelado.');
        }
    }

    public function magicLoginCustomer(Request $request, GoogleAuthService $authService, CustomerRegistrationService $registrationService)
    {
        $token = $request->query('token');

        try {
            $result = $authService->processCustomerLogin($token, session('guest_customer_id'), $registrationService);

            $targetUrl = $result['return_to'] ?? '/';

            // Higienização de segurança para evitar loops
            if (empty($targetUrl) || str_contains($targetUrl, '/auth/google')) {
                $targetUrl = '/';
            }

            if ($result['status'] === 'requires_cpf') {
                $targetUrl = preg_replace('/([?&])open_upgrade=[^&]+(&|$)/', '$1', $targetUrl);
                $targetUrl = rtrim($targetUrl, '?&');

                $separator = str_contains($targetUrl, '?') ? '&' : '?';
                $targetUrl .= $separator . 'open_upgrade=true';

                return redirect()->to($targetUrl)->with('info', $result['message']);
            }

            $request->session()->regenerate();
            $request->session()->save();

            return redirect()->to($targetUrl)->with('success', $result['message']);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('🔥 [ERRO CRÍTICO] Falha no Magic Login B2C: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return redirect()->to('/')->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function magicLoginTeam(Request $request, GoogleAuthService $authService)
    {
        $token = $request->query('token');

        try {
            $result = $authService->processTeamLogin($token);
            $request->session()->regenerate();
            $request->session()->save();

            return redirect()->to($result['redirect'] ?? '/team');

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('🛑 [GOOGLE TEAM ERROR] ' . $e->getMessage());
            return redirect()->route('team.login')->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Middleware;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\CashShift;
use App\Models\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\PrintJob;
use App\Services\RestaurantOps\StoreAvailabilityService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Detection\MobileDetect;

class HandleInertiaRequests extends Middleware
{
    protected $rootView = 'app';

    public function version(Request $request): ?string
    {
        return parent::version($request);
    }

    public function share(Request $request): array
    {
        // 🚀 1. Detecta se estamos num inquilino ativo ou no domínio central
        $isTenant = function_exists('tenant') && tenant('id') !== null;

        // 🚀 2. Só lê do banco se houver um tenant ativo (evita erro 1146 no erp-central)
        $setting = $isTenant ? CompanySetting::getCached() : null;
        $themeColor = $setting->theme_color ?? 'blue';

        $teamMethods = is_array($setting?->team_auth_methods)
            ? $setting->team_auth_methods
            : ($setting?->team_auth_methods ? [$setting->team_auth_methods] : ['native']);

        // 🛡️ BLINDAGEM DE TIPO PARA O JSON/ARRAY
        $customerMethods = $setting?->customer_auth_methods;
        if (is_string($customerMethods)) {
            $customerMethods = json_decode($customerMethods, true) ?: [];
        }

        $companyFormatted = $isTenant ? [
            'name'                    => $setting->company_name ?? 'Nossa Loja',
            'logo'                    => $setting?->logo_path,
            'allowGuest'              => (bool) ($setting->customer_allow_guest ?? true),
            'guestRestrictedPayments' => (bool) ($setting->guest_restricted_payments ?? true),
            'require_whatsapp'        => (bool) ($setting->require_whatsapp ?? false),
            'customerAuthMethods'     => is_array($customerMethods) ? $customerMethods : [],
            'teamAuthMethods'         => $teamMethods,
            'cashierAuthMethods'      => $setting->cashier_auth_methods ?? ['native', 'qr_code'],
            'kdsAuthMethods'          => $setting->kds_auth_methods ?? ['pin', 'qr_code'],
        ] : null;

        $detect = new MobileDetect();
        $os = $detect->isiOS() ? 'ios' : ($detect->isAndroidOS() ? 'android' : 'desktop');

        return array_merge(parent::share($request), [
            'auth' => [
                'user' => function () use ($request) {
                    $user = auth('team')->user() ?? auth('web')->user() ?? $request->user();
                    if (! $user) return null;

                    $userData = $user->toArray();
                    if (method_exists($user, 'getRoleNames')) {
                        $roleNames = $user->getRoleNames()->toArray();
                        $userData['roles'] = $roleNames;
                        $userData['role'] = $roleNames[0] ?? ($user->role ?? null);
                    } else {
                        $userData['roles'] = isset($user->role) ? [$user->role] : [];
                        $userData['role'] = $user->role ?? null;
                    }
                    return $userData;
                },
            ],

            'device' => [
                'is_mobile'  => $detect->isMobile(),
                'is_tablet'  => $detect->isTablet(),
                'is_desktop' => !$detect->isMobile() && !$detect->isTablet(),
                'os'         => $os,
            ],

            // 🚀 Formas de Pagamento filtradas cirurgicamente por canal
            'paymentMethods' => function () use ($isTenant, $request) {
                if (! $isTenant) return [];

                $isCustomerRoute = $request->is('/')
                    || $request->is('customer*')
                    || $request->is('mesa*')
                    || $request->routeIs('customer.*');

                $isPosRoute = $request->is('pos*')
                    || $request->routeIs('pos.*')
                    || $request->is('operations*')
                    || $request->is('team*');

                $channel = $isCustomerRoute ? 'delivery' : ($isPosRoute ? 'pos' : 'all');

                return Cache::remember(
                    'tenant_payment_methods_' . tenant('id') . '_' . $channel,
                    now()->addMinutes(15),
                    function () use ($isCustomerRoute, $isPosRoute) {
                        $query = PaymentMethod::where('is_active', true)
                            ->where('engine_type', '!=', 'internal_loyalty');

                        if ($isCustomerRoute) {
                            $query->where('show_on_delivery', true);
                        } elseif ($isPosRoute) {
                            $query->where('show_on_pos', true);
                        }

                        return $query->orderBy('id', 'asc')->get();
                    }
                );
            },

            // 🚀 Status da Loja (só roda se houver loja ativa)
            'storeStatus' => function () use ($isTenant) {
                if (! $isTenant) {
                    return null;
                }

                try {
                    return app(StoreAvailabilityService::class)->getStoreStatus();
                } catch (\Throwable) {
                    return [
                        'is_open'         => false,
                        'is_pre_order'    => false,
                        'active_channels' => ['delivery', 'counter', 'table'],
                        'next_open_time'  => null,
                        'last_closed_at'  => null,
                        'reason'          => 'system_error',
                    ];
                }
            },

            'flash' => [
                'success'         => fn () => $request->session()->get('success'),
                'error'           => fn () => $request->session()->get('error'),
                'info'            => fn () => $request->session()->get('info'),
                'warning'         => fn () => $request->session()->get('warning'),
                'pix_data'        => fn () => $request->session()->get('pix_data'),
                'order_id'        => fn () => $request->session()->get('order_id'),
                'createdCustomer' => fn () => $request->session()->get('createdCustomer'),
            ],

            'tenant'          => $isTenant ? tenant() : null,
            'tenantId'        => $isTenant ? tenant('id') : 'central',
            'theme_color'     => $themeColor,
            'companySettings' => $setting,
            'company'         => $companyFormatted,

            // 🚀 Consultas protegidas contra execução fora de um tenant
            'hasOpenShift'    => fn () => $isTenant ? CashShift::where('status', 'open')->exists() : false,
            'failedJobsCount' => fn () => $isTenant ? PrintJob::where('status', 'failed')->count() : 0,
            'vapidPublicKey'  => config('webpush.vapid.public_key'),
        ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use App\Models\OrderItem;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Widgets\TableWidget as BaseWidget;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class EmployeeConsumptions extends BaseWidget
{
    public $record;

    protected int | string | array $columnSpan = 'full';

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->query(
                OrderItem::query()
                    ->whereIn('order_id', function ($query) {
                        $query->select('orders.id')
                              ->from('orders')
                              ->where('orders.employee_id', $this->record->id)
                              ->where(function ($sub) {
                                  // 1. Pagamentos registrados no modelo novo
                                  $sub->whereExists(function ($pQuery) {
                                      $pQuery->select(DB::raw(1))
                                             ->from('payments')
                                             ->join('payment_methods', 'payments.payment_method_id', '=', 'payment_methods.id')
                                             ->whereColumn('payments.order_id', 'orders.id')
                                             ->where('payment_methods.engine_type', 'internal');
                                  })
                                  // 2. Fallback para registros legados
                                  ->orWhereExists(function ($opQuery) {
                                      $opQuery->select(DB::raw(1))
                                              ->from('order_payments')
                                              ->whereColumn('order_payments.order_id', 'orders.id')
                                              ->where('order_payments.payment_method', 'internal_consumption');
                                  });
                              });
                    })
            )
            ->heading('Histórico de Consumo')
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Data / Hora')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('product_name')
                    ->label('Item Consumido')
                    ->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make('quantity')
                    ->label('Qtd')
                    ->numeric(),

                TextColumn::make('total_price')
                    ->label('Valor Total')
                    ->money('BRL')
                    ->sortable(),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use App\Models\EmployeeLedger;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Widgets\TableWidget as BaseWidget;
use Illuminate\Support\HtmlString; // <-- Importamos o HtmlString aqui!

class EmployeeStatement extends BaseWidget
{
    public $record;

    protected int | string | array $columnSpan = 'full';

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        // Calculamos o saldo antes para usar no HTML do título
        $currentBalance = EmployeeLedger::where('employee_id', $this->record->id)->latest('created_at')->value('balance') ?? 0;

        // Definimos a cor (verde se for positivo, vermelho se for negativo)
        $colorClass = $currentBalance >= 0 ? 'text-success-600 dark:text-success-400' : 'text-danger-600 dark:text-danger-400';
        $formattedBalance = number_format((float)$currentBalance, 2, ',', '.');

        return $table
            ->query(
                EmployeeLedger::query()->where('employee_id', $this->record->id)
            )
            // Aqui fazemos a mágica do Flexbox para colocar um de cada lado!
            ->heading(new HtmlString("
                <div class='flex w-full items-center justify-between'>
                    <span>Extrato Financeiro</span>
                    <span class='text-sm  text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400'>
                        Saldo Atual: <strong class='text-xl {$colorClass}'>R$ {$formattedBalance}</strong>
                    </span>
                </div>
            "))
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Data / Hora')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),

                TextColumn::make('description')
                    ->label('Descrição')
                    ->searchable(),

                TextColumn::make('amount')
                    ->label('Valor')
                    ->badge()
                    ->color(fn($record) => $record->type === 'credit' ? 'success' : 'danger')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn($record) => ($record->type === 'credit' ? '+ R$ ' : '- R$ ') . number_format((float)$record->amount, 2, ',', '.')),

                TextColumn::make('balance')
                    ->label('Saldo Histórico')
                    ->numeric(decimalPlaces: 2, decimalSeparator: ',', thousandsSeparator: '.')
                    ->prefix('R$ ')
                    ->color(fn($record) => $record->balance >= 0 ? 'success' : 'danger')
                    ->weight('bold'),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('created_at', 'desc');
    }
}
```

```php
class ProcessedPersonalTable extends Component implements HasForms, HasTable, HasActions

                    ->money('BRL'),

                TextColumn::make('total_cost')
                    ->label('Valor Total')

                    ->badge()
                    ->color('warning'),

            ->actions([

                    ->label('Desfazer')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-uturn-left')
                    ->color('danger')
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->action(function ($record) {
                        $itemsToRestore = [[
                            'xml_name' => $record->xml_name,
                            'xml_qty' => $record->quantity,
                            'xml_cost' => $record->unit_cost,
                            'xml_uom' => 'UN',
                            'conversion_factor' => 1,
                            'product_id' => null,
                        ]];

                        $record->delete();

                        $this->dispatch('items-restored', items: $itemsToRestore, isPersonal: true);
                        Notification::make()->title('Despesa pessoal estornada!')->success()->send();
                    })
            ])
            // ✅ AQUI MUDOU O NOME DO MÉTODO PARA TOOLBAR ACTIONS
            ->toolbarActions([
                // ✅ MAS A CLASSE DO BOTÃO CONTINUA SENDO BULKACTION
                BulkAction::make('undoPersonalBulk')
                    ->label('Estornar Selecionadas')
                    ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-uturn-left')
                    ->color('danger')
                    ->requiresConfirmation()
                    ->action(function (Collection $records) {
                        $itemsToRestore = [];

                        foreach ($records as $record) {
                            $itemsToRestore[] = [
                                'xml_name' => $record->xml_name,
                                'xml_qty' => $record->quantity,
                                'xml_cost' => $record->unit_cost,
                                'xml_uom' => 'UN',
                                'conversion_factor' => 1,
                                'product_id' => null,
                            ];
                            $record->delete();
                        }

                        $this->dispatch('items-restored', items: $itemsToRestore, isPersonal: true);
                        Notification::make()->title('Estorno pessoal concluído!')->success()->send();
                    })
                    ->deselectRecordsAfterCompletion()
            ]);
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.processed-personal-table');
    }
}
```

## File: app/Livewire/SystemAlerts.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\BankStatement;
use App\Models\ReceivedInvoice;
use App\Filament\Resources\BankStatements\BankStatementResource;
use App\Filament\Resources\ReceivedInvoices\ReceivedInvoiceResource;
use App\Filament\Resources\Products\ProductResource;
use App\Filament\Resources\Ingredients\IngredientResource;
use App\Filament\Resources\Supplies\SupplyResource;

class SystemAlerts extends Component
{
    public function render()
    {
        $alerts = collect();

        // 1. Conciliações Bancárias Pendentes
        $pendingConciliations = BankStatement::where('status', 'pending')->count();
        if ($pendingConciliations > 0) {
            $alerts->push([
                'title' => 'Conciliações Pendentes',
                'message' => "Você tem {$pendingConciliations} extratos para conciliar.",
                'icon' => 'heroicon-o-building-library',
                'color' => 'text-primary-smart',
                'bg' => 'bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/20',
                'url' => BankStatementResource::getUrl('index'),
            ]);
        }

        // 2. Notas Fiscais Pendentes de Manifesto
        $pendingInvoices = ReceivedInvoice::where('status', 'pending')->count();
        if ($pendingInvoices > 0) {
            $alerts->push([
                'title' => 'Novas Notas Fiscais',
                'message' => "Você tem {$pendingInvoices} notas aguardando manifesto.",
                'icon' => 'heroicon-o-document-text',
                'color' => 'text-warning-600 dark:text-warning-400',
                'bg' => 'bg-warning-50 dark:bg-warning-900/20',
                'url' => ReceivedInvoiceResource::getUrl('index'),
            ]);
        }

        // 3. Produtos Duplicados (Macro-áreas)
        $this->checkDuplicates($alerts, 'external', 'Produtos', ProductResource::class);
        $this->checkDuplicates($alerts, 'internal', 'Insumos', IngredientResource::class);
        $this->checkDuplicates($alerts, 'supply', 'Materiais de Consumo', SupplyResource::class);

        return view('livewire.system-alerts', [
            'alerts' => $alerts,
            'totalAlerts' => $alerts->count(),
        ]);
    }

    // Função auxiliar para não repetir o código de checagem de duplicados
    private function checkDuplicates(&$alerts, $type, $label, $resourceClass)
    {
        $duplicateCount = Product::whereHas('category', fn($q) => $q->where('type', $this->categoryType ?? $type))
            ->select('name')
            ->groupBy('name')
            ->havingRaw('COUNT(id) > 1')
            ->get()
            ->count();

        if ($duplicateCount > 0) {
            $alerts->push([
                'title' => "{$label} Duplicados",
                'message' => "A base tem {$duplicateCount} {$label} precisando de mesclagem.",
                'icon' => 'heroicon-o-sparkles',
                'color' => 'text-danger-600 dark:text-danger-400',
                'bg' => 'bg-danger-50 dark:bg-danger-900/20',
                'url' => $resourceClass::getUrl('index'),
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Models/AccountPayable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Observers\AccountPayableObserver;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\ObservedBy;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

#[ObservedBy([AccountPayableObserver::class])]
class AccountPayable extends Model
{
    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        "due_date" => "date",
        "payment_date" => "date",
        "amount" => "decimal:2",
    ];

    // ==========================================
    // FUNÇÃO AUXILIAR: Insere a linha no Extrato do Colaborador
    // ==========================================
    public function launchLedger($type, $description)
    {
        $employee = $this->employee;
        if (!$employee) {
            return;
        }

        $latestLedger = $employee->ledgers()->latest("id")->first();
        $currentBalance = $latestLedger ? (float) $latestLedger->balance : 0;
        $amount = (float) $this->amount;

        $newBalance = $type === "credit"
            ? $currentBalance + $amount
            : $currentBalance - $amount;

        $employee->ledgers()->create([
            "type" => $type,
            "description" => $description,
            "amount" => $amount,
            "balance" => $newBalance,
        ]);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // RELAÇÕES
    // ==========================================
    public function supplier()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Supplier::class);
    }

    public function employee()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Employee::class);
    }

    public function bankStatement()
    {
        return $this->morphOne(\App\Models\BankStatement::class, "conciliable");
    }

    public function bankAccount()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(BankAccount::class);
    }

    public function recurringExpense()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(RecurringExpense::class, 'recurring_expense_id');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * @property-read \App\Models\Customer|null $customer
 * @property-read \App\Models\Neighborhood|null $neighborhood
 * @property-read \App\Models\Street|null $street
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Address newModelQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Address newQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Address query()
 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder
 */
class Address extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $guarded = [];

    // 🚀 1. EAGER LOADING: Sempre que buscar um endereço, já traz a rua e o bairro do banco
    protected $with = ['street', 'neighborhood'];

    // 🚀 2. APPENDS: Força o Laravel a injetar essas propriedades virtuais no JSON que vai para o Vue
    protected $appends = ['full_address', 'delivery_fee'];

    protected $casts = [
        'no_number' => 'boolean',
        'is_active' => 'boolean',
    ];

    // 🚀 3. O ACESSOR BLINDADO DO ENDEREÇO
    public function getFullAddressAttribute(): string
    {
        $streetName = $this->street ? $this->street->name : 'Rua não informada';
        $neighborhoodName = $this->neighborhood ? $this->neighborhood->name : 'Bairro não informado';

        $number = $this->no_number ? 'S/N' : ($this->number ?? 'S/N');
        $comp = $this->complement ? " ({$this->complement})" : '';

        return "{$streetName}, {$number} - {$neighborhoodName}{$comp}";
    }

    // 🚀 4. O ACESSOR DA TAXA DE ENTREGA (Puxa direto do relacionamento com o Bairro)
    public function getDeliveryFeeAttribute(): float
    {
        return $this->neighborhood ? (float) $this->neighborhood->delivery_fee : 0.00;
    }

    public function customer() { return $this->belongsTo(Customer::class); }
    public function street() { return $this->belongsTo(Street::class); }
    public function neighborhood() { return $this->belongsTo(Neighborhood::class); }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * @property-read \App\Models\BankAccount|null $bankAccount
 * @property-read Model|\Eloquent $conciliable
 * @property-read mixed $related_name
 * @property-read \App\Models\Transaction|null $transaction
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|BankStatement newModelQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|BankStatement newQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|BankStatement query()
 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder
 */
class BankStatement extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    // 🚀 Liberamos a atribuição em massa (O Filament já garante a segurança dos dados)
    protected $guarded = [];

    // Formata automaticamente a data para o padrão do Laravel
    protected $casts = [
        "bank_date" => "date",
        "amount" => "decimal:2",
    ];

    // ==========================================
    // RELAÇÕES
    // ==========================================

    // A qual conta bancária este extrato pertence
    public function bankAccount()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(BankAccount::class);
    }

    // Uma linha do extrato bancário pode estar ligada a UMA transação real no sistema
    public function transaction()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Transaction::class);
    }

    // A Mágica do Motor de Conciliação: permite ligar o extrato a Contas, Folhas de Pagamento, etc.
    public function conciliable()
    {
        return $this->morphTo();
    }

    // ==========================================
    // ATRIBUTOS VIRTUAIS
    // ==========================================

    // 🚀 ATRIBUTO VIRTUAL INTELIGENTE: Descobre quem foi pago (Conta Avulsa ou Lote)
    public function getRelatedNameAttribute()
    {
        if (!$this->conciliable) {
            return "-"; // Se não estiver conciliado, retorna um tracinho
        }

        // Se pagou uma conta avulsa, pega o nome do fornecedor (Sem o trade_name antigo!)
        if ($this->conciliable_type === \App\Models\AccountPayable::class) {
            return $this->conciliable->supplier->name ?? "Fornecedor S/N";
        }

        // Se pagou um lote, pega a descrição do lote
        if ($this->conciliable_type === \App\Models\PaymentBatch::class) {
            return "📦 Lote: " . $this->conciliable->description;
        }

        return "Outros";
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;

class CashShift extends Model
{
    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        'opened_at'                => 'datetime',
        'closed_at'                => 'datetime',
        'opening_balance'          => 'decimal:2',
        'closing_balance_expected' => 'decimal:2',
        'closing_balance_actual'   => 'decimal:2',
        'accepting_orders'         => 'boolean',
    ];

    public function bankAccount(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(BankAccount::class);
    }

    public function openedBy(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'opened_by');
    }

    public function closedBy(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'closed_by');
    }

    public function opener(): BelongsTo { return $this->openedBy(); }
    public function closer(): BelongsTo { return $this->closedBy(); }

    public function transactions(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Transaction::class);
    }

    public function payments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Payment::class);
    }

    public function getDifferenceAttribute(): float
    {
        if ($this->status === 'open' || is_null($this->closing_balance_expected) || is_null($this->closing_balance_actual)) {
            return 0.00;
        }
        return (float) ($this->closing_balance_actual - $this->closing_balance_expected);
    }

    /**
     * Colaboradores escalados e presentes no turno
     */
    public function attendees(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(User::class, 'shift_attendance')
                    ->withPivot(
                        'checked_in_at',
                        'checked_out_at',
                        'status',
                        'attendance_status',
                        'daily_rate',
                        'assigned_role',
                        'account_payable_id'
                    )
                    ->withTimestamps();
    }

    public function scopeOpen($query)
    {
        return $query->where('status', 'open');
    }

    public static function current(): ?self
    {
        return static::open()->latest('id')->first();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use App\Events\CatalogUpdated;

class Category extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        "is_active" => "boolean",
        "sort_order" => "integer",
    ];

    protected $appends = ['image_url'];

        public function imageUrl(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::make(
            get: fn () => $this->image_path ? Storage::disk('public')->url($this->image_path) : null,
        );
    }

    public function parent(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Category::class, 'parent_id');
    }

    public function children(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Category::class, 'parent_id')->orderBy('sort_order', 'asc');
    }

    public function products(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Product::class);
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::addGlobalScope('active_category', function (\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder $builder) {
            $builder->where('is_active', true);
        });
        static::saving(function (Category $category) {
            if (empty($category->slug) || $category->isDirty('name') || $category->isDirty('slug')) {
                $source = (!empty($category->slug) && $category->isDirty('slug')) ? $category->slug : $category->name;
                $category->slug = Str::slug($source ?? '');
            }
        });

        static::saved(function ($category) {
            $tenantId = $category->tenant_id ?? tenant('id') ?? 'central';

            Log::info("Atualizando catálogo. Avisando Tenant: {$tenantId}");

            try {
                if (method_exists(Cache::getStore(), 'tags')) {
                    Cache::tags(['catalog'])->flush();
                }
                Cache::forget('customer_catalog_data');
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                Log::error("Aviso de Cache: " . $e->getMessage());
            }

            if (class_exists(CatalogUpdated::class)) {
                broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenantId));
            }
        });

        static::deleted(function ($category) {
            $tenantId = $category->tenant_id ?? tenant('id') ?? 'central';

            try {
                if (method_exists(Cache::getStore(), 'tags')) {
                    Cache::tags(['catalog'])->flush();
                }
                Cache::forget('customer_catalog_data');
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                Log::error("Aviso de Cache (Delete): " . $e->getMessage());
            }

            if (class_exists(CatalogUpdated::class)) {
                broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenantId));
            }
        });

        static::forceDeleted(function (Category $category) {
            try {
                if ($category->image_path && Storage::disk('public')->exists($category->image_path)) {
                    Storage::disk('public')->delete($category->image_path);
                }
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                Log::error("Erro ao apagar imagem da Categoria: " . $e->getMessage());
            }
        });
    }
}
```
