```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Events\SettingsUpdated;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class CompanySetting extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        'customer_auth_methods'      => 'array',
        'kitchen_separate_multiples' => 'boolean',
        'is_fiscal_emitter'          => 'boolean',
        'require_whatsapp'           => 'boolean',
        'require_birth_date'         => 'boolean',
        'allow_minors'               => 'boolean',
        'customer_can_edit_profile'  => 'boolean',
        'has_service_tax'            => 'boolean',
        'service_tax_percentage'     => 'decimal:2',
        'service_tax_table'          => 'boolean',
        'service_tax_counter'        => 'boolean',
        'service_tax_delivery'       => 'boolean',
        'require_shift_attendance'   => 'boolean',
        'loyalty_is_active'          => 'boolean',
        'pos_secure_actions'         => 'array',
        'customer_allow_guest'       => 'boolean',
        'print_bridge_connected_at'  => 'datetime',
        'sefaz_last_sync_at'         => 'datetime',
        'enforce_cashier_open'       => 'boolean',
        'allow_pre_orders'           => 'boolean',
        'pre_order_buffer_minutes'   => 'integer',
        'business_hours'             => 'array',
        'is_24_hours'                => 'boolean',
        'is_closed_indefinitely'     => 'boolean',
        'home_bg_open'               => 'array',
        'home_bg_closed'             => 'array',
        'has_food_allowance'         => 'boolean',
        'self_service_enabled'       => 'boolean',
        'allow_table_self_service'   => 'boolean',
        'attention_categories'       => 'array',
        'cashier_auth_methods'       => 'array',
        'kds_auth_methods'           => 'array',
        'request_order_rating'       => 'boolean',
        'loyalty_max_redeem_value'   => 'decimal:2',
        'loyalty_max_redeem_type'    => 'string',
        'customer_can_append_orders' => 'boolean',
        'print_loyalty_flyer'        => 'boolean',
        'print_growth_flyer'         => 'boolean',
        'growth_flyer_value'         => 'decimal:2',
        'suppress_bar_print_tables' => 'boolean',
        'sicredi_is_active'          => 'boolean',
        'sicredi_enable_driver_pix'  => 'boolean',
        'sicredi_enable_pos_pix'     => 'boolean',
        'sicredi_enable_waiter_pix'  => 'boolean',
    ];

    /**
     * Sanitização automática do domínio personalizado.
     */
    protected function customDomain(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::make(
            set: fn (?string $value) => $value
                ? strtolower(trim(preg_replace('#^https?://#i', '', rtrim($value, '/'))))
                : null
        );
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a URL base do tenant priorizando o domínio próprio configurado.
     */
    public function getBaseUrl(?string $path = null): string
    {
        $base = !empty($this->custom_domain)
            ? 'https://' . $this->custom_domain
            : rtrim(url('/'), '/');

        if ($path) {
            return $base . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        }

        return $base;
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a URL amigável do tenant para avaliação no Google.
     */
    public function getReviewUrl(): ?string
    {
        if (empty($this->google_review_link)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->getBaseUrl('avaliacao');
    }

    public function isServiceTaxEnabledFor(?string $channel): bool
    {
        if (!$this->has_service_tax) {
            return false;
        }

        return match ($channel) {
            'table'                         => (bool) ($this->service_tax_table ?? true),
            'counter', 'takeaway', 'pickup' => (bool) ($this->service_tax_counter ?? false),
            'delivery'                      => (bool) ($this->service_tax_delivery ?? false),
            default                         => false,
        };
    }

    public function calculateServiceFee(float $subtotal, ?string $channel): float
    {
        if (!$this->isServiceTaxEnabledFor($channel)) {
            return 0.00;
        }

        $percentage = (float) ($this->service_tax_percentage ?? 0);
        if ($percentage <= 0) {
            return 0.00;
        }

        return round(($subtotal * $percentage) / 100, 2);
    }

    public static function getCached(): ?self
    {
        if (!function_exists('tenant') || !tenant('id')) {
            return null;
        }

        $tenantId = tenant('id');
        $cacheKey = "company_settings_{$tenantId}";

        try {
            if (method_exists(Cache::getStore(), 'tags')) {
                return Cache::tags(['settings'])->rememberForever($cacheKey, fn () => self::first());
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        return Cache::rememberForever($cacheKey, fn () => self::first());
    }

    public static function purgeCache(?string $tenantId = null): void
    {
        $tenantId = $tenantId ?? (function_exists('tenant') && tenant('id') ? tenant('id') : 'central');
        $cacheKey = "company_settings_{$tenantId}";

        try {
            if (method_exists(Cache::getStore(), 'tags')) {
                Cache::tags(['settings'])->flush();
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        Cache::forget($cacheKey);

        try {
            event(new SettingsUpdated($tenantId));
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::saved(function ($settings) {
            // 1. Limpeza de Cache da Loja
            self::purgeCache();

            // 2. 🚀 AUTOMATIZAÇÃO DE MÉTODOS DE PAGAMENTO RH

            // Vale-Alimentação (Cortesia)
            $allowanceMethod = \App\Models\PaymentMethod::firstOrCreate(
                ['engine_type' => 'allowance'],
                ['name' => 'Vale-Alimentação', 'is_active' => (bool) $settings->has_food_allowance]
            );
            if (!$allowanceMethod->wasRecentlyCreated && (bool) $allowanceMethod->is_active !== (bool) $settings->has_food_allowance) {
                $allowanceMethod->update(['is_active' => (bool) $settings->has_food_allowance]);
            }

            // Fiado (Consumo Interno / Desconto)
            $tabMethod = \App\Models\PaymentMethod::firstOrCreate(
                ['engine_type' => 'internal'],
                ['name' => 'Consumo Interno (Fiado)', 'is_active' => (bool) $settings->allow_employee_tab]
            );
            if (!$tabMethod->wasRecentlyCreated && (bool) $tabMethod->is_active !== (bool) $settings->allow_employee_tab) {
                $tabMethod->update(['is_active' => (bool) $settings->allow_employee_tab]);
            }
        });

        static::deleted(function () {
            self::purgeCache();
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Observers\CustomerObserver;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\ObservedBy;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\HasPushSubscriptions;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;

#[ObservedBy([CustomerObserver::class])] // 🚀 AQUI: Conectando o Observer ao Model!
class Customer extends Model
{
    use Notifiable, HasPushSubscriptions;
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected function cpf(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::make(
            // 🚀 CORREÇÃO: Se estiver vazio, devolve null puro para o banco não reclamar do Unique!
            set: fn (?string $value) => blank($value) ? null : preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $value),
        );
    }

    protected function phone(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::make(
            // 🚀 CORREÇÃO APLICADA AO TELEFONE TAMBÉM POR SEGURANÇA
            set: fn (?string $value) => blank($value) ? null : preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $value),
        );
    }

    public function user()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    public function addresses()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Address::class);
    }

    public function orders()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Order::class);
    }

    // 🚀 A LIGAÇÃO NOVA: Cupons exclusivos vinculados a este cliente (Aniversário, etc)
    public function coupons()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Coupon::class);
    }
}
```

## File: app/Models/DiningTable.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

class DiningTable extends Model
{
    protected $guarded = [];

    public function tableArea(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(TableArea::class);
    }

    /**
     * Mesa principal da qual esta mesa faz parte (caso esteja agrupada)
     */
    public function parentTable(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(DiningTable::class, 'parent_table_id');
    }

    /**
     * Mesas secundárias agrupadas a esta mesa principal
     */
    public function linkedTables(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(DiningTable::class, 'parent_table_id');
    }

    /**
     * Todos os pedidos vinculados a esta mesa
     */
    public function orders(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Order::class, 'dining_table_id');
    }

    /**
     * Pedidos ativos na mesa física direta
     */
    public function activeOrders(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Order::class, 'dining_table_id')
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'delivered'])
            ->where('payment_status', '!=', 'paid');
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a coleção de IDs de todas as mesas envolvidas (pai + filhas)
     */
    public function getGroupTableIds(): Collection
    {
        $primary = $this->parent_table_id ? $this->parentTable : $this;

        if (!$primary) {
            return collect([$this->id]);
        }

        return $primary->linkedTables()->pluck('id')->push($primary->id);
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se ainda há qualquer pedido ativo no grupo de mesas
     */
    public function hasActiveOrdersInGroup(?int $excludeOrderId = null): bool
    {
        $ids = $this->getGroupTableIds();

        return Order::whereIn('dining_table_id', $ids)
            ->when($excludeOrderId, fn ($query) => $query->where('id', '!=', $excludeOrderId))
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['closed', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'delivered'])
            ->where('payment_status', '!=', 'paid')
            ->exists();
    }
}
```

```php
    public const SOURCE_CUSTOMER_APP       = 'customer_app';
    public const SOURCE_CUSTOMER_APP_TABLE = 'customer_app_table';
    public const SOURCE_POS_APP            = 'pos_app';
    public const SOURCE_CASHIER            = 'cashier';
    public const SOURCE_TEAM_APP           = 'team_app';
    public const SOURCE_KIOSK              = 'kiosk';

    public const VALID_SOURCES = [
        self::SOURCE_CUSTOMER_APP,
        self::SOURCE_CUSTOMER_APP_TABLE,
        self::SOURCE_POS_APP,
        self::SOURCE_CASHIER,
        self::SOURCE_TEAM_APP,
        self::SOURCE_KIOSK,
    ];

    // =========================================================================
    // RELACIONAMENTOS DE CLIENTE E LOGÍSTICA
    // =========================================================================

    public function customer(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Customer::class);
    }

    public function deliveryAddress(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Address::class, 'address_id');
    }

    public function addressModel(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->deliveryAddress();
    }

    public function getAddressAttribute($value): ?array
    {
        if (!empty($value)) {
            return is_string($value) ? (json_decode($value, true) ?: null) : $value;
        }

        if (!empty($this->attributes['address_snapshot'])) {
            $snap = $this->attributes['address_snapshot'];
            return is_string($snap) ? (json_decode($snap, true) ?: null) : $snap;
        }

        if ($this->relationLoaded('deliveryAddress') && $this->deliveryAddress) {
            return [
                'id'           => $this->deliveryAddress->id,
                'street'       => $this->deliveryAddress->street?->name ?? ($this->deliveryAddress->street ?? ''),
                'number'       => $this->deliveryAddress->no_number ? 'S/N' : ($this->deliveryAddress->number ?? ''),
                'neighborhood' => $this->deliveryAddress->neighborhood?->name ?? ($this->deliveryAddress->neighborhood ?? ''),
                'complement'   => $this->deliveryAddress->complement,
                'full_address' => $this->deliveryAddress->full_address,
                'delivery_fee' => (float) $this->deliveryAddress->delivery_fee,
            ];
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function setAddressAttribute($value): void
    {
        $json = is_array($value) ? json_encode($value) : $value;
        $this->attributes['address_snapshot'] = $json;
        $this->attributes['address'] = $json;
    }

    public function coupon(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Coupon::class);
    }

    public function driver(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'driver_id');
    }

    /**
     * Utilizador (Garçom / Operador) que lançou o pedido no sistema
     */
    public function attendant(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'employee_id');
    }

    /**
     * Alias semântico para atendente de salão
     */
    public function waiter(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->attendant();
    }

    /**
     * Alias de retrocompatibilidade com queries existentes (Order::with('employee'))
     */
    public function employee(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->attendant();
    }

    /**
     * Operador de caixa responsável pelo registo da comanda
     */
    public function cashier(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'cashier_id');
    }

    /**
     * Accessor para aceder ao perfil formal de RH do atendente (se existir)
     */
    public function getStaffProfileAttribute(): ?Employee
    {
        if ($this->relationLoaded('attendant') && $this->attendant) {
            return $this->attendant->relationLoaded('employee')
                ? $this->attendant->employee
                : $this->attendant->employee()->first();
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function diningTable(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(DiningTable::class, 'dining_table_id');
    }

    public function table(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->diningTable();
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // RELACIONAMENTOS DE ITENS E FISCAL
    // =========================================================================

    public function items(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(OrderItem::class);
    }

    public function fiscalDocument(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(FiscalDocument::class)->latestOfMany();
    }

    public function rating(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(OrderRating::class);
    }

    public function printJobs(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(PrintJob::class);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // RELACIONAMENTOS FINANCEIROS
    // =========================================================================

    public function payments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Payment::class);
    }

    public function transactions(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Transaction::class);
    }

    public function accountReceivables(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(AccountReceivable::class);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // ACESSORES E MOTOR DE CÁLCULO DE PAGAMENTOS
    // =========================================================================

    public function getTotalPaidAttribute(): float
    {
        if ($this->relationLoaded('payments')) {
            return (float) $this->payments->where('is_paid', true)->sum('amount');
        }

        return (float) $this->payments()->where('is_paid', true)->sum('amount');
    }

    public function getBalanceDueAttribute(): float
    {
        $total = (float) ($this->total ?? 0);
        $balance = $total - $this->total_paid;
        return $balance > 0 ? round($balance, 2) : 0.00;
    }

    public function recalculatePaymentStatus(): void
    {
        $totalPaid = $this->total_paid;
        $totalOrder = (float) $this->total;

        if ($totalPaid <= 0) {
            $status = 'pending';
        } elseif ($totalPaid < ($totalOrder - 0.01)) {
            $status = 'partial';
        } else {
            $status = 'paid';
        }

        $this->updateQuietly(['payment_status' => $status]);
    }

    public function getHasFiscalDocumentAttribute(): bool
    {
        return $this->fiscalDocument?->status === 'authorized';
    }

    public function getFiscalStatusAttribute(): ?string
    {
        return $this->fiscalDocument?->status;
    }

    public function fiscalDocuments(): \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(\App\Models\FiscalDocument::class);
    }

    public function cashShift(): \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(CashShift::class, 'cash_shift_id');
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
```

```php
class Payment extends Model

        return $this->belongsTo(PaymentMethod::class);

    {

    }

    public function cashier(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'cashier_id');
    }

    /**
     * Movimentação contábil gerada por este pagamento no livro-caixa
     */
    public function transaction(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(Transaction::class);
    }

    /**
     * Itens cobertos por este pagamento (baixa operacional)
     */

    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(
            OrderItem::class,
            'order_payment_items',

        )

        ->withTimestamps();
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 🛡️ CONTROLE DE ESTADOS & RETROCOMPATIBILIDADE
    // ==========================================
    public function scopeCompleted($query)
    {
        return $query->where('status', 'completed');
    }

    public function scopeCancelled($query)
    {
        return $query->where('status', 'cancelled');
    }

    public function isCompleted(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === 'completed';
    }

    public function isCancelled(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === 'cancelled';
    }

}
```

```php
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Printer newModelQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Printer newQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Printer onlyTrashed()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Printer query()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Printer withTrashed(bool $withTrashed = true)
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Printer withoutTrashed()
 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder
 */
class Printer extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        'is_active' => 'boolean',
        'is_cashier' => 'boolean',
    ];

    /**
     * 🚀 MÁGICA: Eventos do Model
     * Garante que se eu marcar esta impressora como "Caixa",
     * o sistema desmarca automaticamente as outras.
     */
    protected static function booted()
    {
        static::saving(function ($printer) {
            if ($printer->is_cashier) {
                Printer::where('id', '!=', $printer->id)->update(['is_cashier' => false]);
            }
        });
    }

    public function kitchens()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Kitchen::class);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Observers\ProductObserver;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\ObservedBy;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

#[ObservedBy([ProductObserver::class])]
class Product extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        "base_cost"              => "float",
        "dine_in_price"          => "float",
        "delivery_price"         => "float",
        "promo_price"            => "float",
        "conversion_factor"      => "float",
        "current_stock"          => "float",
        "min_stock"              => "float",
        "max_stock"              => "float",
        "track_inventory"        => "boolean",
        "is_grab_and_go"         => "boolean",
        "show_on_menu"           => "boolean",
        "show_on_delivery"       => "boolean",
        "is_age_restricted"      => "boolean",
        "requires_preparation"   => "boolean",
        "loyalty_reward"         => "boolean",
        "prep_time_minutes"      => "integer",
        "serves_people"          => "integer",
        "legacy_modifier_groups" => "array",
        "legacy_recipe"          => "array",
        "is_monofasico"          => "boolean",
        "recipe_yield"           => "decimal:4",
    ];

    protected $appends = ['image_url', 'unit_measure', 'purchase_pack_info'];

    public function getUnitMeasureAttribute(): ?string
    {
        return strtolower($this->unit_of_measure ?? 'un');
    }

    public function setUnitMeasureAttribute($value): void
    {
        $this->attributes['unit_of_measure'] = !empty($value) ? strtoupper($value) : 'UN';
    }

    public function imageUrl(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::make(
            get: fn () => $this->image_path ? Storage::disk('public')->url($this->image_path) : null,
        );
    }

    public function getPurchasePackInfoAttribute(): array
    {
        return $this->resolvePurchasePackaging();
    }

    public function resolvePurchasePackaging(): array
    {
        $factor = (float) ($this->conversion_factor > 0 ? $this->conversion_factor : 1);
        $purchaseUom = $this->purchase_unit_of_measure;

        if (!$purchaseUom || $factor <= 1) {
            $latestPurchase = null;

            if ($this->relationLoaded('latestCostHistory')) {
                $latestPurchase = $this->latestCostHistory;
            } elseif ($this->relationLoaded('costHistories')) {
                $latestPurchase = $this->costHistories->sortByDesc('id')->first();
            } else {
                $latestPurchase = $this->latestCostHistory()->first();
            }

            if ($latestPurchase) {
                if ($latestPurchase->conversion_factor > 1) {
                    $factor = (float) $latestPurchase->conversion_factor;
                }
                if (!empty($latestPurchase->original_unit_of_measure)) {
                    $purchaseUom = strtoupper($latestPurchase->original_unit_of_measure);
                }
            }
        }

        return [
            'factor'       => $factor,
            'purchase_uom' => $purchaseUom ?: strtoupper($this->unit_of_measure ?? 'UN'),
            'base_uom'     => strtoupper($this->unit_of_measure ?? 'UN'),
            'is_pack'      => $factor > 1,
        ];
    }

    public function category(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Category::class);
    }

    public function supplier(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Supplier::class);
    }

    public function modifiers(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(ProductModifier::class, 'modifier_group_product', 'product_id', 'modifier_group_id')
                    ->withPivot('excluded_options')
                    ->withTimestamps();
    }

    public function comboGroups(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ComboGroup::class);
    }

    public function kitchen(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Kitchen::class);
    }

    public function printer(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Printer::class, 'print_station_id');
    }

    public function technicalSheets(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TechnicalSheet::class, "parent_product_id");
    }

    public function costHistories(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ProductCostHistory::class);
    }

    public function latestCostHistory(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(ProductCostHistory::class)->latestOfMany('id');
    }

    public function storageRules(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ProductStorageLocation::class);
    }

    public function storageLocations(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(StorageLocation::class, 'product_storage_location', 'product_id', 'storage_location_id')
                    ->withPivot('current_stock', 'max_capacity', 'restock_threshold', 'source_location_id')
                    ->withTimestamps();
    }

    // 🚀 Extrato Contábil de Estoque (Kardex Ledger)
    public function inventoryMovements(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(InventoryMovement::class)->latest('id');
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::addGlobalScope('active_catalog', function (\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder $builder) {
            if (function_exists('filament') && filament()->getCurrentPanel() !== null) {
                return;
            }

            $builder->where('status', '!=', 'archived');

            $builder->where(function ($query) {
                $query->whereHas('category', function ($q) {
                    $q->where('is_active', true);
                })->orWhereNull('category_id');
            });
        });
    }
}
```

```php
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|ProductModifier withoutTrashed()
 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder
 */
class ProductModifier extends Model
{

    protected $table = 'modifier_groups';

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        'is_active' => 'boolean',
        'allow_quantity' => 'boolean',
        'min_selections' => 'integer',
        'max_selections' => 'integer',
        'max_free' => 'integer',
    ];

    {
        return $this->hasMany(ModifierOption::class, 'modifier_group_id');
    }

    {

                    ->withPivot('excluded_options')
                    ->withTimestamps();
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::saved(function ($modifierGroup) {
            $tenantId = $modifierGroup->tenant_id ?? tenant('id') ?? 'central';

            try {
                \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache::tags(['catalog'])->flush();
            } catch (\Exception $e) { }

            broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenantId));
        });

        static::deleted(function ($modifierGroup) {
            $tenantId = $modifierGroup->tenant_id ?? tenant('id') ?? 'central';

            try {
                \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache::tags(['catalog'])->flush();
            } catch (\Exception $e) { }

            broadcast(new CatalogUpdated($tenantId));
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOneThrough;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasManyThrough;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class Street extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    protected $guarded = [];

    /**
     * Uma rua é formada por uma ou mais faixas/segmentos.
     */
    public function segments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(StreetSegment::class);
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 Bairro principal da Rua.
     * Se a tabela streets tiver neighborhood_id direto, usa BelongsTo.
     * Caso contrário, busca através dos segmentos da rua (hasOneThrough).
     */
    public function neighborhood(): BelongsTo|HasOneThrough
    {
        if (true) {
            return $this->belongsTo(Neighborhood::class);
        }

        return $this->hasOneThrough(
            Neighborhood::class,
            StreetSegment::class,
            'street_id',       // FK na tabela street_segments apontando para streets
            'id',              // PK na tabela neighborhoods
            'id',              // PK na tabela streets
            'neighborhood_id'  // FK na tabela street_segments apontando para neighborhoods
        );
    }

    /**
     * Todos os bairros cruzados pela rua (caso passe por mais de um)
     */
    public function neighborhoods(): HasManyThrough
    {
        return $this->hasManyThrough(
            Neighborhood::class,
            StreetSegment::class,
            'street_id',
            'id',
            'id',
            'neighborhood_id'
        )->distinct();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

/**
 * @property-read \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection<int, \App\Models\AccountPayable> $accountPayables
 * @property-read int|null $account_payables_count
 * @property-read \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection<int, Supplier> $branches
 * @property-read int|null $branches_count
 * @property-read Supplier|null $parent
 * @property-read \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection<int, \App\Models\Transaction> $transactions
 * @property-read int|null $transactions_count
 * @property-read array $family_ids
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Supplier newModelQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Supplier newQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Supplier onlyTrashed()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Supplier query()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Supplier withTrashed(bool $withTrashed = true)
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Supplier withoutTrashed()
 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder
 */
class Supplier extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    protected $guarded = [];

    public function transactions()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Transaction::class);
    }

    public function parent()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Supplier::class, 'parent_id');
    }

    public function branches()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Supplier::class, 'parent_id');
    }

    public function accountPayables()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(\App\Models\AccountPayable::class, 'supplier_id');
    }

    /**
     * 🚀 ACESSOR MÁGICO: Retorna os IDs da Matriz e de todas as Filiais.
     */
    public function getFamilyIdsAttribute(): array
    {
        // 1. Descobre o ID do "Pai" (Se não tiver parent_id, ele próprio é a matriz)
        $matrixId = $this->parent_id ?? $this->id;

        // 2. Busca todos os "Filhos" (Filiais) que apontam para esta Matriz
        $branchIds = self::where('parent_id', $matrixId)->pluck('id')->toArray();

        // 3. Junta a Matriz com as Filiais num único Array e limpa duplicações
        return array_unique(array_merge([$matrixId], $branchIds));
    }

    // 🚀 A TRAVA ABSOLUTA DO BANCO DE DADOS
        protected static function booted()
        {
            static::saving(function ($supplier) {
                if (!empty($supplier->document)) {
                    $exists = self::where('document', $supplier->document)
                        ->where('id', '!=', $supplier->id)
                        ->exists();

                    if ($exists) {
                        throw \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException::withMessages([
                            'document' => "O CNPJ/CPF '{$supplier->document}' já está em uso por outro fornecedor na base de dados."
                        ]);
                    }
                }
            });
        }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Models;
```

```php
/**
 * @property-read \App\Models\Product|null $ingredient
 * @property-read \App\Models\Product|null $parentProduct
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|TechnicalSheet newModelQuery()

 */
class TechnicalSheet extends Model
{
    // 🚀 O Modo Elegante: Aceita tudo que o Filament mandar.
    // O array vazio diz: "Nenhum campo está bloqueado para preenchimento em massa".
    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        'order_type' => 'array',
        'is_active' => 'boolean',
    ];

    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Product::class, 'parent_product_id');
    }

    // O Insumo ou Preparado que vai dentro da receita
    public function ingredient(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Product::class, 'ingredient_product_id');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Stancl\Tenancy\Database\Models\Tenant as BaseTenant;
use Stancl\Tenancy\Contracts\TenantWithDatabase;
use Stancl\Tenancy\Database\Concerns\HasDatabase;
use Stancl\Tenancy\Database\Concerns\HasDomains;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

/**
 * @property string $id
 * @property \Illuminate\Support\Carbon|null $created_at
 * @property \Illuminate\Support\Carbon|null $updated_at
 * @property array<array-key, mixed>|null $data
 * @property-read \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection<int, \Stancl\Tenancy\Database\Models\Domain> $domains
 * @property-read int|null $domains_count
 * @method static \Stancl\Tenancy\Database\TenantCollection<int, static> all($columns = ['*'])
 * @method static \Stancl\Tenancy\Database\TenantCollection<int, static> get($columns = ['*'])
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Tenant newModelQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Tenant newQuery()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Tenant query()
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Tenant whereCreatedAt($value)
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Tenant whereData($value)
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Tenant whereId($value)
 * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>|Tenant whereUpdatedAt($value)
 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder
 */
class Tenant extends BaseTenant implements TenantWithDatabase
{
    use HasDatabase, HasDomains, SoftDeletes;

    /**
     * Boot the model.
     */
    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        // Este evento dispara automaticamente LOGO APÓS um novo tenant ser criado no banco
        static::created(function ($tenant) {

            // Pega o ID da lanchonete recém-criada (ex: 'burguer')
            $tenantId = $tenant->id;

            $caminhos = [
                storage_path("tenants/{$tenantId}/framework/cache"),
                storage_path("tenants/{$tenantId}/framework/views"),
                storage_path("tenants/{$tenantId}/framework/sessions"),
                storage_path("tenants/{$tenantId}/app/livewire-tmp"),
                // Pode adicionar a pasta de certificados aqui também, se quiser!
                storage_path("tenants/{$tenantId}/app/certificates"),
            ];

            foreach ($caminhos as $caminho) {
                if (!file_exists($caminho)) {
                    // Cria a pasta, dá a permissão 775 e true (para criar as subpastas recursivamente)
                    mkdir($caminho, 0775, true);
                }
            }
        });
    }
}
```

```php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Observers\TransactionObserver;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\ObservedBy;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

#[ObservedBy([TransactionObserver::class])]
class Transaction extends Model
{
    use SoftDeletes;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $casts = [
        'amount'           => 'float',
        'transaction_date' => 'datetime',
    ];

    public function bankAccount(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(BankAccount::class);
    }

    public function paymentMethod(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(PaymentMethod::class);
    }

    public function order(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Order::class);
    }

    public function payment(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Payment::class);
    }

    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    public function operator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'user_id');
    }

    public function cashShift(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(CashShift::class);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Database\Factories\UserFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;
use Filament\Models\Contracts\HasTenants;
use Filament\Models\Contracts\FilamentUser;
use Filament\Panel;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Spatie\Permission\Traits\HasRoles;
use NotificationChannels\WebPush\HasPushSubscriptions;

class User extends Authenticatable implements HasTenants, FilamentUser
{
    use HasFactory, Notifiable, HasRoles, HasPushSubscriptions;

    protected $guarded = [];

    protected $hidden = [
        'password',
        'pin',
        'remember_token',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'password'          => 'hashed',
            'pin'               => 'hashed',
        ];
    }

    public function canAccessPanel(Panel $panel): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function getTenants(Panel $panel): array|Collection
    {
        return collect([tenant()]);
    }

    public function canAccessTenant(Model $tenant): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Perfil de RH do colaborador vinculado a esta conta de utilizador
     */
    public function employee(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Employee::class);
    }

    public function customer(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(Customer::class);
    }

    /**
     * Pedidos atendidos/lançados por este utilizador
     */
    public function attendedOrders(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Order::class, 'employee_id');
    }

    /**
     * Pedidos em que este utilizador atuou como caixa de abertura
     */
    public function cashierOrders(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Order::class, 'cashier_id');
    }

    /**
     * Entregas realizadas por este utilizador
     */
    public function deliveryOrders(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Order::class, 'driver_id');
    }

    public function attendedShifts(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(CashShift::class, 'shift_attendance')
                    ->withPivot(
                        'checked_in_at',
                        'checked_out_at',
                        'status',
                        'attendance_status',
                        'daily_rate',
                        'assigned_role',
                        'account_payable_id'
                    )
                    ->withTimestamps();
    }

    public function isOnActiveShift(): bool
    {
        return $this->attendedShifts()
                    ->where('cash_shifts.status', 'open')
                    ->wherePivot('status', 'active')
                    ->exists();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Providers\Filament;

use Filament\Panel;
use Filament\PanelProvider;

use Filament\Enums\UserMenuPosition;

class AdminPanelProvider extends PanelProvider

    public function panel(Panel $panel): Panel
    {
        // ==========================================

        return $panel
            ->id("store")
            ->path("admin")
            ->default()
            ->login()
            ->topbar(true) // 🚀 Topbar ativada nativamente

            // Branding e Layout
            ->brandName(fn() => strtoupper(tenant("id") ?? "Gestão"))
            ->sidebarCollapsibleOnDesktop()
            ->userMenu(position: UserMenuPosition::Sidebar)
            ->sidebarWidth("15rem")
            ->collapsedSidebarWidth("1.5rem")

            // 🚀 Cor padrão (será substituída dinamicamente pelo ApplyTenantTheme Middleware)
            ->colors(["primary" => Color::Amber])
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Providers;

use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Number;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Events\RequestHandled;

// 🚀 Modelos, Observadores e Listeners
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Observers\OrderObserver;
use App\Events\OrderCancelled;
use App\Listeners\ProcessGatewayRefund;
use App\Listeners\ReturnStockAndNotifyCatalog;

class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        //
    }

    public function boot(): void
    {
        // Força HTTPS em produção/Cloudflare
        URL::forceScheme('https');

        // Formatação numérica brasileira (R$ 1.000,00)
        Number::useLocale('pt_BR');

        // =========================================================
        // 🚀 PREVENÇÃO E LOG DE N+1 (LAZY LOADING VIOLATIONS)
        // =========================================================
        Model::preventLazyLoading(!app()->isProduction());

        Model::handleLazyLoadingViolationUsing(function ($model, $relation) {
            Log::warning("⚠️ [N+1 Detectado] Model [".get_class($model)."] carregou [{$relation}] preguiçosamente.", [
                'tenant' => function_exists('tenant') && tenant('id') ? tenant('id') : 'central',
                'url'    => request()->fullUrl(),
            ]);
        });

        // =========================================================
        // ⏱️ MONITORAMENTO DE QUERIES LENTAS (> 50ms)
        // =========================================================
        DB::listen(function ($query) {
            if ($query->time > 50) {
                Log::warning("⏱️ [Query Lenta] {$query->time}ms em {$query->sql}", [
                    'bindings' => $query->bindings,
                    'tenant'   => function_exists('tenant') && tenant('id') ? tenant('id') : 'central',
                    'url'      => request()->fullUrl(),
                ]);
            }
        });

        // =========================================================
        // 🛡️ PERMISSÕES E AUDITORIA
        // =========================================================
        Gate::define('viewHorizon', fn ($user = null) => true);

        Event::listen(function (RequestHandled $event) {
            if ($event->request->getHost() === 'adm.brasume.com.br') {
                Log::info('--- REQUISIÇÃO CENTRAL (' . now()->format('H:i:s') . ') ---');
                Log::info('URL: ' . $event->request->fullUrl());
                Log::info('Logado? ' . (auth()->check() ? 'SIM (ID: '.auth()->id().')' : 'NÃO'));

                if ($event->response->isRedirect()) {
                    Log::warning('=> Redirecionou para: ' . $event->response->getTargetUrl());
                }
            }
        });

        // =========================================================
        // 📦 EVENTOS, LISTENERS E OBSERVERS
        // =========================================================
        Order::observe(OrderObserver::class);

        Event::listen(OrderCancelled::class, ProcessGatewayRefund::class);
        Event::listen(OrderCancelled::class, ReturnStockAndNotifyCatalog::class);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Providers;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Stancl\JobPipeline\JobPipeline;
use Stancl\Tenancy\Events;
use Stancl\Tenancy\Jobs;
use Stancl\Tenancy\Listeners;
use Stancl\Tenancy\Middleware;
use Stancl\Tenancy\Resolvers\DomainTenantResolver;

class TenancyServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    // By default, no namespace is used to support the callable array syntax.
    public static string $controllerNamespace = '';

    public function events()
    {
        return [
            // Tenant events
            Events\CreatingTenant::class => [],
            Events\TenantCreated::class => [
                JobPipeline::make([
                    Jobs\CreateDatabase::class,
                    Jobs\MigrateDatabase::class,
                    // Jobs\SeedDatabase::class,

                    // Your own jobs to prepare the tenant.
                    // Provision API keys, create S3 buckets, anything you want!

                ])->send(function (Events\TenantCreated $event) {
                    return $event->tenant;
                })->shouldBeQueued(false), // `false` by default, but you probably want to make this `true` for production.
            ],
            Events\SavingTenant::class => [],
            Events\TenantSaved::class => [],
            Events\UpdatingTenant::class => [],
            Events\TenantUpdated::class => [],
            Events\DeletingTenant::class => [],
            Events\TenantDeleted::class => [
                JobPipeline::make([
                    Jobs\DeleteDatabase::class,
                ])->send(function (Events\TenantDeleted $event) {
                    return $event->tenant;
                })->shouldBeQueued(false), // `false` by default, but you probably want to make this `true` for production.
            ],

            // Domain events
            Events\CreatingDomain::class => [],
            Events\DomainCreated::class => [],
            Events\SavingDomain::class => [],
            Events\DomainSaved::class => [],
            Events\UpdatingDomain::class => [],
            Events\DomainUpdated::class => [],
            Events\DeletingDomain::class => [],
            Events\DomainDeleted::class => [],

            // Database events
            Events\DatabaseCreated::class => [],
            Events\DatabaseMigrated::class => [],
            Events\DatabaseSeeded::class => [],
            Events\DatabaseRolledBack::class => [],
            Events\DatabaseDeleted::class => [],

            // Tenancy events
            Events\InitializingTenancy::class => [],
            Events\TenancyInitialized::class => [
                Listeners\BootstrapTenancy::class,
            ],

            Events\EndingTenancy::class => [],
            Events\TenancyEnded::class => [
                Listeners\RevertToCentralContext::class,
            ],

            Events\BootstrappingTenancy::class => [],
            Events\TenancyBootstrapped::class => [],
            Events\RevertingToCentralContext::class => [],
            Events\RevertedToCentralContext::class => [],

            // Resource syncing
            Events\SyncedResourceSaved::class => [
                Listeners\UpdateSyncedResource::class,
            ],

            // Fired only when a synced resource is changed in a different DB than the origin DB (to avoid infinite loops)
            Events\SyncedResourceChangedInForeignDatabase::class => [],
        ];
    }

    public function register()
    {
        //
    }

    public function boot()
    {
        // 🚀 CACHE DE RESOLUÇÃO DE DOMÍNIO (Stancl Tenancy)
        // Elimina a query no banco central em toda requisição HTTP
        DomainTenantResolver::$shouldCache = true;
        DomainTenantResolver::$cacheTTL = 86400; // 24 horas (em segundos)
        DomainTenantResolver::$cacheStore = null; // null usa o driver padrão do cache (file/redis)

        $this->bootEvents();$this->mapRoutes();

        $this->makeTenancyMiddlewareHighestPriority();
    }

    protected function bootEvents()
    {
        foreach ($this->events() as $event =>$listeners) {
            foreach ($listeners as$listener) {
                if ($listener instanceof JobPipeline) {
                    $listener =$listener->toListener();
                }

                Event::listen($event,$listener);
            }
        }
    }

    protected function mapRoutes()
    {
        $this->app->booted(function () {
            if (file_exists(base_path('routes/tenant.php'))) {
                Route::namespace(static::$controllerNamespace)
                    ->group(base_path('routes/tenant.php'));
            }
        });
    }

    protected function makeTenancyMiddlewareHighestPriority()
    {
        $tenancyMiddleware = [
            // Even higher priority than the initialization middleware
            Middleware\PreventAccessFromCentralDomains::class,

            Middleware\InitializeTenancyByDomain::class,
            Middleware\InitializeTenancyBySubdomain::class,
            Middleware\InitializeTenancyByDomainOrSubdomain::class,
            Middleware\InitializeTenancyByPath::class,
            Middleware\InitializeTenancyByRequestData::class,
        ];

        foreach (array_reverse($tenancyMiddleware) as$middleware) {
            $this->app[\Illuminate\Contracts\Http\Kernel::class]->prependToMiddlewarePriority($middleware);
        }
    }
}
```

## File: app/Services/Fiscal/SpedDocumentService.php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\Fiscal;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\CompanySetting;
use App\Models\FiscalDocument;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use NFePHP\DA\NFe\Danfe;
use NFePHP\NFe\Make;
use NFePHP\NFe\Tools;
use NFePHP\Common\Certificate;
use NFePHP\NFe\Complements;
use NFePHP\NFe\Common\Standardize;
use stdClass;
use Exception;

class SpedDocumentService
{
    public function renderDanfePdf(string $xmlContent): string
    {
        if (empty($xmlContent)) {
            throw new Exception("XML não fornecido para geração do PDF.");
        }

        $danfe = new Danfe($xmlContent);
        $danfe->debugMode(false);
        $danfe->creditsIntegratorFooter("Gerado por Brasume ERP");

        return $danfe->render();
    }

    public function emitNfce(Order $order, ?string $customerDocument = null, bool $shouldPrint = false, ?\App\Models\Printer $printer = null)
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::first();
        if (!$settings) {
            throw new Exception("Configurações da empresa não encontradas.");
        }

        // 🚀 IDEMPOTÊNCIA: Se este pedido já foi autorizado na SEFAZ, não consome novos números
        $existingDoc = FiscalDocument::where('order_id', $order->id)
            ->where('status', 'authorized')
            ->first();

        if ($existingDoc) {
            if ($shouldPrint && $printer) {
                $dispatcher = app(\App\Services\Printing\PrintDispatcher::class);
                $document = new \App\Services\Printing\Documents\FiscalReceipt($order, $existingDoc->xml_content);
                $dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
            }
            return true;
        }

        $order->loadMissing(['items.product', 'customer', 'payments.paymentMethod']);

        // 🚀 FILTRO CRÍTICO: Isola serviços não-fiscais (copo quebrado, avarias, etc.)
        $serviceItems = $order->items->filter(function ($item) {
            return !in_array($item->status, ['cancelled', 'voided', 'refunded'])
                && $item->product?->type === 'service';
        });
        $totalServicos = (float) $serviceItems->sum('total_price');

        // 🚀 FILTRO FISCAL: Apenas mercadorias tributáveis entram na NFC-e
        $activeItems = $order->items->filter(function ($item) {
            $isValid = !in_array($item->status, ['cancelled', 'voided', 'refunded']) && (float) $item->quantity > 0;
            $isMercadoria = ($item->product?->type !== 'service');

            return $isValid && $isMercadoria;
        })->values();

        if ($activeItems->isEmpty()) {
            throw new Exception("Não é possível emitir NFC-e para um pedido sem mercadorias tributáveis (pedido contendo apenas serviços/avarias).");
        }

        // 🚀 REGRA FISCAL: Isola pagamentos de Cashback E Cortesia/Perda (loss) para convertê-los em Desconto Incondicional
        $discountEquivalentPayments = $order->payments->filter(function ($payment) {
            $engine = $payment->paymentMethod?->engine_type;
            $name = strtolower($payment->method ?? '');

            return in_array($engine, ['internal_loyalty', 'loss'], true)
                || str_contains($name, 'cashback')
                || str_contains($name, 'pontos')
                || str_contains($name, 'cortesia')
                || str_contains($name, 'perda');
        });

        $equivalentDiscount = (float) $discountEquivalentPayments->sum('amount');
        $totalDescontoFiscal = round((float) $order->discount + $equivalentDiscount, 2);

        // 🚀 RESOLVE DOCUMENTO ANTES DO <IDE> PARA VALIDAR FALLBACK DO indPres
        $doc = $customerDocument ?: ($order->customer?->cpf ?? null);
        $cleanDoc = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $doc);
        $hasValidDoc = in_array(strlen($cleanDoc), [11, 14]);

        $totalProdutos = (float) $activeItems->sum('total_price');
        $somaFreteDistribuido = 0;
        $somaDescontoDistribuido = 0;
        $somaOutrosDistribuido = 0;
        $totalActiveCount = $activeItems->count();

        $itensTributaveisCalculados = [];

        foreach ($activeItems as $index => $item) {
            $isLastItem = ($index === $totalActiveCount - 1);
            $peso = $totalProdutos > 0 ? ($item->total_price / $totalProdutos) : 0;

            $freteItem = round((float) $order->delivery_fee * $peso, 2);
            $descontoItem = round($totalDescontoFiscal * $peso, 2);
            $outroItem = round((float) $order->service_fee * $peso, 2);

            if ($isLastItem) {
                $freteItem = round((float) $order->delivery_fee - $somaFreteDistribuido, 2);
                $descontoItem = round($totalDescontoFiscal - $somaDescontoDistribuido, 2);
                $outroItem = round((float) $order->service_fee - $somaOutrosDistribuido, 2);
            } else {
                $somaFreteDistribuido += $freteItem;
                $somaDescontoDistribuido += $descontoItem;
                $somaOutrosDistribuido += $outroItem;
            }

            $itensTributaveisCalculados[] = [
                'item_model'   => $item,
                'index'        => $index + 1,
                'freteItem'    => $freteItem,
                'descontoItem' => $descontoItem,
                'outroItem'    => $outroItem,
            ];
        }

        $vProd  = round($totalProdutos, 2);
        $vFrete = round((float) $order->delivery_fee, 2);
        $vOutro = round((float) $order->service_fee, 2);
        $vDesc  = round($totalDescontoFiscal, 2);

        $vNF = round($vProd + $vFrete + $vOutro - $vDesc, 2);

        if ($vNF <= 0) {
            throw new Exception("Emissão interrompida silenciosamente: O pedido está sendo quitado 100% como Perda/Cortesia/Pontos. Notas com valor zerado são bloqueadas pela SEFAZ.");
        }

        $vPag = 0;
        $sefazPayments = [];
        $pagamentosAudit = [];

        $fiscalPayments = $order->payments->reject(function ($payment) use ($discountEquivalentPayments) {
            return $discountEquivalentPayments->contains('id', $payment->id);
        });

        foreach ($fiscalPayments as $payment) {
            $sefazPayments[] = [
                'tPag' => $this->mapPaymentToSefaz($payment->method),
                'vPag' => (float) $payment->amount,
                'xPag' => $payment->method
            ];
            $vPag += (float) $payment->amount;
            $pagamentosAudit[] = "{$payment->method} (R$ {$payment->amount})";
        }

        if ($vPag < $vNF && !empty($order->payment_intent_methods)) {
            $promises = is_string($order->payment_intent_methods) ? json_decode($order->payment_intent_methods, true) : $order->payment_intent_methods;
            if (is_array($promises)) {
                foreach ($promises as $promise) {
                    $amt = !empty($promise['amount']) ? (float) $promise['amount'] : round($vNF - $vPag, 2);
                    $changeTarget = !empty($promise['change_target']) ? (float) $promise['change_target'] : $amt;

                    $vPagReal = max($amt, $changeTarget);
                    $methodName = $promise['method_name'] ?? 'Dinheiro';

                    $sefazPayments[] = [
                        'tPag' => $this->mapPaymentToSefaz($methodName),
                        'vPag' => $vPagReal,
                        'xPag' => $methodName
                    ];
                    $vPag += $vPagReal;
                    $pagamentosAudit[] = "{$methodName} [Promessa Motoboy] (R$ {$vPagReal})";
                }
            }
        }

        if ($vPag < $vNF) {
            $missing = round($vNF - $vPag, 2);
            $sefazPayments[] = [
                'tPag' => '99',
                'vPag' => $missing,
                'xPag' => 'Outros'
            ];
            $vPag += $missing;
        }

        $vPag = round($vPag, 2);

        if ($vPag < $vNF) {
            $strPagamentos = empty($pagamentosAudit) ? "Nenhum pagamento registrado" : implode(", ", $pagamentosAudit);
            $audit  = "A NF-e custa R$ " . number_format($vNF, 2, ',', '.') . " ";
            $audit .= "[Produtos: {$vProd} | Frete: {$vFrete} | Taxas: {$vOutro} | Desc: -{$vDesc}]. ";
            $audit .= "No entanto, os pagamentos recebidos somam R$ " . number_format($vPag, 2, ',', '.') . " [{$strPagamentos}]. ";
            $audit .= "O sistema bloqueou a emissão pois a SEFAZ rejeitaria (Erro 865). Feche a conta pagando o valor completo.";
            throw new Exception($audit);
        }

        if ($vPag > $vNF && $vPag > 0) {
            $scale = $vNF / $vPag;
            $accumulated = 0.0;
            $totalSefaz = count($sefazPayments);

            foreach ($sefazPayments as $idx => &$p) {
                if ($idx === $totalSefaz - 1) {
                    $p['vPag'] = round($vNF - $accumulated, 2);
                } else {
                    $p['vPag'] = round($p['vPag'] * $scale, 2);
                    $accumulated += $p['vPag'];
                }
            }
            unset($p);
            $vPag = $vNF;
        }

        // Textos Adicionais
        $infCplParts = ["Pedido #{$order->id}"];
        if ($totalServicos > 0) {
            $infCplParts[] = "Serviços/Avarias (R$ " . number_format($totalServicos, 2, ',', '.') . ") não inclusos na NFC-e";
        }
        if ($equivalentDiscount > 0) {
            $infCplParts[] = "Subsídio/Desconto Financeiro: R$ " . number_format($equivalentDiscount, 2, ',', '.');
        }
        if ($order->type === 'delivery' && $order->address) {
            $fullAddr = is_array($order->address) ? ($order->address['full_address'] ?? '') : ($order->address->full_address ?? '');
            if ($fullAddr) {
                $infCplParts[] = "Entrega: {$fullAddr}";
            }
        }
        if (!empty($order->notes)) {
            $infCplParts[] = "Obs: {$order->notes}";
        }
        $infCplText = substr(implode(' | ', $infCplParts), 0, 5000);

        // Configuração mTLS com SEFAZ
        $isHomologation = (string) $settings->environment === '2';
        $cscCode = $isHomologation ? $settings->csc_code_homologation : $settings->csc_code;
        $cscId = $isHomologation ? $settings->csc_id_homologation : $settings->csc_id;

        if (!$cscCode || !$cscId) {
            throw new Exception("Configurações NFC-e Incompletas: CSC (Token) não preenchido para o ambiente atual.");
        }

        if (!$settings->certificate_path || !Storage::disk('local')->exists($settings->certificate_path)) {
            throw new Exception("Certificado Digital A1 não encontrado no cofre do servidor.");
        }

        $configJson = json_encode([
            "atualizacao" => now()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            "tpAmb"       => (int) $settings->environment,
            "razaosocial" => $settings->company_name,
            "siglaUF"     => $settings->state,
            "cnpj"        => preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $settings->cnpj),
            "schemes"     => "PL_009_V4",
            "versao"      => "4.00",
            "tokenIBPT"   => "",
            "CSC"         => $cscCode,
            "CSCid"       => str_pad((string) $cscId, 6, "0", STR_PAD_LEFT)
        ]);

        $certificadoDigital = Storage::disk('local')->get($settings->certificate_path);
        $tools = new Tools($configJson, Certificate::readPfx($certificadoDigital, $settings->certificate_password));
        $tools->model('65');

        // 🚀 CÁLCULO SEGURO DO PONTO DE PARTIDA (Max Banco vs Max Settings)
        $serie = (int) ($settings->nfce_series ?? 2);
        $maxDbNumber = (int) FiscalDocument::where('model', '65')
            ->where('series', (string) $serie)
            ->selectRaw('MAX(CAST(number AS UNSIGNED)) as max_num')
            ->value('max_num');

        $settingsNumber = (int) ($settings->last_nfce_number ?? 0);
        $currentNumber = max($settingsNumber, $maxDbNumber) + 1;

        // 🚀 LAÇO INTELIGENTE DE RETRY EM CASO DE DUPLICIDADE
        $maxAttempts = 20;
        $attempt = 0;
        $authorized = false;
        $xmlAutorizado = null;

        while ($attempt < $maxAttempts && !$authorized) {
            $attempt++;

            $nfe = new Make();

            $stdInfNFe = new stdClass();
            $stdInfNFe->versao = '4.00';
            $nfe->taginfNFe($stdInfNFe);

            $stdIde = new stdClass();
            $stdIde->cUF = $this->getUfCode($settings->state);
            $stdIde->cNF = rand(11111111, 99999999);
            $stdIde->natOp = 'VENDA CONSUMIDOR FINAL';
            $stdIde->mod = 65;
            $stdIde->serie = $serie;
            $stdIde->nNF = $currentNumber;
            $stdIde->dhEmi = date('Y-m-d\TH:i:sP');

            $stdIde->tpNF = 1;
            $stdIde->idDest = 1;
            $stdIde->cMunFG = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($settings->ibge_code ?? '4202008'));
            $stdIde->tpImp = 4;
            $stdIde->tpEmis = 1;
            $stdIde->tpAmb = (int) ($settings->environment ?? 1);
            $stdIde->finNFe = 1;
            $stdIde->indFinal = 1;
            $stdIde->indPres = ($order->type === 'delivery' && $hasValidDoc) ? 4 : 1;
            $stdIde->indIntermed = 0;
            $stdIde->procEmi = 0;
            $stdIde->verProc = '1.0.0';
            $nfe->tagide($stdIde);

            // Emitente
            $stdEmit = new stdClass();
            $stdEmit->xNome = (string) $settings->company_name;
            $stdEmit->xFant = (string) ($settings->trade_name ?? $settings->company_name);
            $stdEmit->CNPJ = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $settings->cnpj);
            $stdEmit->IE = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $settings->ie);
            $stdEmit->CRT = in_array($settings->tax_regime, ['simples', 'mei']) ? 1 : 3;
            $nfe->tagemit($stdEmit);

            $stdEnderEmit = new stdClass();
            $stdEnderEmit->xLgr = (string) ($settings->street ?? 'Rua Principal');
            $stdEnderEmit->nro = (string) ($settings->number ?? 'S/N');
            $stdEnderEmit->xBairro = (string) ($settings->neighborhood ?? 'Centro');
            $stdEnderEmit->cMun = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($settings->ibge_code ?? '4202008'));
            $stdEnderEmit->xMun = (string) ($settings->city ?? 'Balneário Camboriú');
            $stdEnderEmit->UF = (string) ($settings->state ?? 'SC');
            $stdEnderEmit->CEP = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $settings->zip_code);
            $nfe->tagenderEmit($stdEnderEmit);

            // Destinatário
            if ($hasValidDoc) {
                $stdDest = new stdClass();
                if (strlen($cleanDoc) === 14) {
                    $stdDest->CNPJ = $cleanDoc;
                } else {
                    $stdDest->CPF = $cleanDoc;
                }

                $stdDest->xNome = substr(strtoupper($order->customer_name ?? $order->customer?->name ?? 'CONSUMIDOR FINAL'), 0, 60);
                $stdDest->indIEDest = 9;
                $nfe->tagdest($stdDest);

                if ($order->type === 'delivery' && ($order->address || $order->address_id)) {
                    $addr = $order->address;

                    $street = is_array($addr) ? ($addr['street'] ?? '') : ($addr->street->name ?? $addr->street ?? '');
                    $number = is_array($addr) ? ($addr['number'] ?? 'S/N') : ($addr->number ?? 'S/N');
                    $complement = is_array($addr) ? ($addr['complement'] ?? '') : ($addr->complement ?? '');
                    $neighborhood = is_array($addr) ? ($addr['neighborhood'] ?? '') : ($addr->neighborhood->name ?? $addr->neighborhood ?? '');
                    $zipCode = is_array($addr) ? ($addr['zip_code'] ?? null) : ($addr->zip_code ?? null);

                    $stdEnderDest = new stdClass();
                    $stdEnderDest->xLgr = substr(strtoupper($street ?: 'RUA NAO INFORMADA'), 0, 60);
                    $stdEnderDest->nro = substr(strtoupper($number ?: 'S/N'), 0, 60);
                    if (!empty($complement)) {
                        $stdEnderDest->xCpl = substr(strtoupper($complement), 0, 60);
                    }

                    $stdEnderDest->xBairro = substr(strtoupper($neighborhood ?: 'BAIRRO NAO INFORMADO'), 0, 60);
                    $stdEnderDest->cMun = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($settings->ibge_code ?? '4202008'));
                    $stdEnderDest->xMun = strtoupper($settings->city ?? 'Balneário Camboriú');
                    $stdEnderDest->UF = strtoupper($settings->state ?? 'SC');
                    $stdEnderDest->CEP = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($zipCode ?: ($settings->zip_code ?? '00000000')));

                    $nfe->tagenderDest($stdEnderDest);
                }
            }

            // Responsável Técnico
            $stdRespTec = new stdClass();
            $stdRespTec->CNPJ = env('SOFTWARE_HOUSE_CNPJ', '26908287000146');
            $stdRespTec->xContato = env('SOFTWARE_HOUSE_CONTACT', 'Pastelaria Nativa Ltda');
            $stdRespTec->email = env('SOFTWARE_HOUSE_EMAIL', 'contato@brasume.com.br');
            $stdRespTec->fone = env('SOFTWARE_HOUSE_PHONE', '11985071770');
            $nfe->taginfRespTec($stdRespTec);

            // Itens
            foreach ($itensTributaveisCalculados as $calc) {
                $item = $calc['item_model'];
                $idx = $calc['index'];

                $stdProd = new stdClass();
                $stdProd->item = $idx;
                $stdProd->cProd = $item->product_id ?? 'DIV';
                $stdProd->cEAN = 'SEM GTIN';
                $stdProd->xProd = $item->product_name;
                $stdProd->NCM = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($item->product->fiscal_ncm ?? '00000000'));
                $stdProd->CFOP = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($item->product->fiscal_cfop ?? '5102'));
                $stdProd->uCom = strtoupper($item->product->unit_of_measure ?? 'UN');
                $stdProd->qCom = $item->quantity;
                $stdProd->vUnCom = $this->format($item->unit_price, 4);
                $stdProd->vProd = $this->format($item->total_price);
                $stdProd->cEANTrib = 'SEM GTIN';
                $stdProd->uTrib = strtoupper($item->product->unit_of_measure ?? 'UN');
                $stdProd->qTrib = $item->quantity;
                $stdProd->vUnTrib = $this->format($item->unit_price, 4);
                $stdProd->indTot = 1;

                if ($calc['freteItem'] > 0) $stdProd->vFrete = $this->format($calc['freteItem']);
                if ($calc['descontoItem'] > 0) $stdProd->vDesc = $this->format($calc['descontoItem']);
                if ($calc['outroItem'] > 0) $stdProd->vOutro = $this->format($calc['outroItem']);

                $nfe->tagprod($stdProd);

                $stdImposto = new stdClass();
                $stdImposto->item = $idx;
                $nfe->tagimposto($stdImposto);

                $stdICMS = new stdClass();
                $stdICMS->item = $idx;
                $stdICMS->orig = $item->product->fiscal_origin ?? 0;
                $stdICMS->CSOSN = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) ($item->product->fiscal_csosn ?? '102'));
                $nfe->tagICMSSN($stdICMS);

                $stdPIS = new stdClass();
                $stdPIS->item = $idx;
                $stdPIS->CST = str_pad((string) ($item->product->fiscal_pis_cst ?? '49'), 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $stdPIS->vBC = 0.00;
                $stdPIS->pPIS = 0.00;
                $stdPIS->vPIS = 0.00;
                $nfe->tagPIS($stdPIS);

                $stdCOFINS = new stdClass();
                $stdCOFINS->item = $idx;
                $stdCOFINS->CST = str_pad((string) ($item->product->fiscal_cofins_cst ?? '49'), 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $stdCOFINS->vBC = 0.00;
                $stdCOFINS->pCOFINS = 0.00;
                $stdCOFINS->vCOFINS = 0.00;
                $nfe->tagCOFINS($stdCOFINS);
            }

            $stdTransp = new stdClass();
            $stdTransp->modFrete = 9;
            $nfe->tagtransp($stdTransp);

            $stdPag = new stdClass();
            $stdPag->vTroco = 0.00;
            $nfe->tagpag($stdPag);

            foreach ($sefazPayments as $p) {
                $stdDetPag = new stdClass();
                $stdDetPag->tPag = $p['tPag'];
                $stdDetPag->vPag = $this->format($p['vPag']);

                if ($stdDetPag->tPag === '99') {
                    $stdDetPag->xPag = mb_substr(trim($p['xPag'] ?? 'Outros'), 0, 60);
                    if (empty($stdDetPag->xPag) || $stdDetPag->xPag === '99') {
                        $stdDetPag->xPag = 'Outros';
                    }
                }

                if (in_array($p['tPag'], ['03', '04', '17'])) {
                    $stdDetPag->tpIntegra = 2;
                }

                $nfe->tagdetPag($stdDetPag);
            }

            $stdInfAdic = new stdClass();
            $stdInfAdic->infCpl = $infCplText;
            $nfe->taginfAdic($stdInfAdic);

            $xml = $nfe->getXML();
            $xmlAssinado = $tools->signNFe($xml);
            $idLote = str_pad((string) $currentNumber, 15, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);

            try {
                $respostaSefaz = $tools->sefazEnviaLote([$xmlAssinado], $idLote, 1);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                if (str_contains(mb_strtolower($e->getMessage()), 'duplicidade')) {
                    Log::warning("⚠️ [Fiscal] Exceção com duplicidade na SEFAZ para NFC-e nº {$currentNumber}: " . $e->getMessage());
                    $currentNumber++;
                    $settings->last_nfce_number = $currentNumber;
                    $settings->save();
                    continue;
                }
                throw $e;
            }

            $standardizer = new Standardize();
            $stdResponse = $standardizer->toStd($respostaSefaz);

            if ($stdResponse->cStat != 104) {
                $batchCStat = (int) ($stdResponse->cStat ?? 0);
                $batchMotivo = (string) ($stdResponse->xMotivo ?? '');

                if (in_array($batchCStat, [204, 539]) || str_contains(mb_strtolower($batchMotivo), 'duplicidade')) {
                    Log::warning("⚠️ [Fiscal] Lote NFC-e nº {$currentNumber} retornou duplicidade na SEFAZ ({$batchCStat}: {$batchMotivo}). Tentando nº " . ($currentNumber + 1));
                    $currentNumber++;
                    $settings->last_nfce_number = $currentNumber;
                    $settings->save();
                    continue;
                }

                throw new Exception("Erro de Comunicação Sefaz: {$batchMotivo} (cStat: {$batchCStat})");
            }

            $protNFe = $stdResponse->protNFe ?? null;
            if (!$protNFe) {
                throw new Exception("Resposta Sefaz Inesperada: Protocolo não retornado.");
            }

            $statusAutorizacao = (int) ($protNFe->infProt->cStat ?? 0);
            $motivoAutorizacao = (string) ($protNFe->infProt->xMotivo ?? '');

            // 🚀 SUCESSO: Autorizado o uso da NF-e
            if ($statusAutorizacao === 100 || $statusAutorizacao === 150) {
                $xmlAutorizado = Complements::toAuthorize($xmlAssinado, $respostaSefaz);

                FiscalDocument::create([
                    'order_id'    => $order->id,
                    'model'       => '65',
                    'series'      => (string) $serie,
                    'number'      => (string) $currentNumber,
                    'access_key'  => $protNFe->infProt->chNFe,
                    'protocol'    => $protNFe->infProt->nProt,
                    'total_value' => $vNF,
                    'issue_date'  => now(),
                    'status'      => 'authorized',
                    'xml_content' => $xmlAutorizado
                ]);

                $settings->last_nfce_number = $currentNumber;
                $settings->save();

                Cache::forget('company_settings');
                Cache::forget('tenant_company_settings');
                CompanySetting::purgeCache();

                if ($shouldPrint && $printer) {
                    $dispatcher = app(\App\Services\Printing\PrintDispatcher::class);
                    $document = new \App\Services\Printing\Documents\FiscalReceipt($order, $xmlAutorizado);
                    $dispatcher->dispatch($printer, $document);
                }

                $authorized = true;
                break;
            }

            // 🚀 DETECÇÃO DE DUPLICIDADE: 204 (Mesma chave) ou 539 (Chave diferente)
            if (in_array($statusAutorizacao, [204, 539]) || str_contains(mb_strtolower($motivoAutorizacao), 'duplicidade')) {
                Log::warning("⚠️ [Fiscal] NFC-e nº {$currentNumber} retornou duplicidade na SEFAZ ({$statusAutorizacao}: {$motivoAutorizacao}). Tentando nº " . ($currentNumber + 1));
                $currentNumber++;
                $settings->last_nfce_number = $currentNumber;
                $settings->save();
                continue;
            }

            // Qualquer outro erro não é duplicidade; interrompe imediatamente
            throw new Exception("Rejeição SEFAZ: {$motivoAutorizacao} (cStat: {$statusAutorizacao})");
        }

        if (!$authorized) {
            throw new Exception("Não foi possível emitir a NFC-e após {$maxAttempts} tentativas. A SEFAZ persistiu retornando duplicidade de numeração.");
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function cancelNfce(FiscalDocument $document, string $justification)
    {
        $settings = CompanySetting::first();
        if (!$settings || !$settings->certificate_path) {
            throw new Exception("Certificado Digital A1 não encontrado no cofre do servidor.");
        }

        $configJson = json_encode([
            "atualizacao" => now()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            "tpAmb"       => (int) $settings->environment,
            "razaosocial" => $settings->company_name,
            "siglaUF"     => $settings->state,
            "cnpj"        => preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string) $settings->cnpj),
            "schemes"     => "PL_009_V4",
            "versao"      => "4.00",
        ]);

        $certificadoDigital = Storage::disk('local')->get($settings->certificate_path);
        $tools = new Tools($configJson, Certificate::readPfx($certificadoDigital, $settings->certificate_password));
        $tools->model($document->model);

        $response = $tools->sefazCancela(
            $document->access_key,
            $document->protocol,
            $justification,
            1
        );

        $std = new Standardize();
        $arr = $std->toArray($response);

        if (isset($arr['cStat']) && $arr['cStat'] == 128) {
            $retEvento = $arr['retEvento'][0] ?? $arr['retEvento'] ?? [];
            $infEvento = $retEvento['infEvento'] ?? $retEvento['infRet'] ?? null;
            $cStatEvento = $infEvento['cStat'] ?? null;

            if (in_array($cStatEvento, [135, 155])) {
                $document->update(['status' => 'canceled']);
                return true;
            }

            throw new Exception("Sefaz negou o cancelamento: " . ($infEvento['xMotivo'] ?? 'Motivo desconhecido'));
        }

        throw new Exception("Erro Sefaz: " . ($arr['xMotivo'] ?? 'Sem retorno do Governo.'));
    }

    private function format($value, $decimals = 2): string
    {
        return number_format((float)$value, $decimals, '.', '');
    }

    private function mapPaymentToSefaz(string $paymentMethodName): string
    {
        $name = strtolower($paymentMethodName);
        if (str_contains($name, 'dinheiro') || str_contains($name, 'money')) return '01';
        if (str_contains($name, 'crédito') || str_contains($name, 'credito')) return '03';
        if (str_contains($name, 'débito') || str_contains($name, 'debito')) return '04';
        if (str_contains($name, 'pix')) return '17';
        if (str_contains($name, 'vale') || str_contains($name, 'alimentação') || str_contains($name, 'refeição')) return '10';

        return '99';
    }

    private function getUfCode(?string $uf): string
    {
        $ufs = [
            'RO'=>11,'AC'=>12,'AM'=>13,'RR'=>14,'PA'=>15,'AP'=>16,'TO'=>17,
            'MA'=>21,'PI'=>22,'CE'=>23,'RN'=>24,'PB'=>25,'PE'=>26,'AL'=>27,
            'SE'=>28,'BA'=>29,'MG'=>31,'ES'=>32,'RJ'=>33,'SP'=>35,'PR'=>41,
            'SC'=>42,'RS'=>43,'MS'=>50,'MT'=>51,'GO'=>52,'DF'=>53
        ];
        return (string) ($ufs[strtoupper($uf ?? 'SC')] ?? 42);
    }
}
```

```php
            if ($request->is('team*') || $request->is('operations*')) {

            }

            return route('login');

        // ========================================================
        // 🚦 GUARDA 2: BLOQUEIO DE LOGIN DUPLO (JÁ LOGADOS)
```
